text: Absolutely amazing chargrilled oysters! I wanted to lick my plate! So flavorful and delicious. I also had the shrimp and fish Po boy. I wished I tried Acme on the first day of my trip as I would have eaten here everyday! So delicious!
Use to be great but going down hill, got a salad for carry out and the lettuce was rotten.  Pizzas are not as good as they use to be either.  2 stars bc they have good beers, they need to step it up.

I LOVE Casitia Taqueria! Everything is great there. I love the black bean bowl and veggie burritos. Great guacamole and homey habanero sauce is on point! Service is always good too! I also love that they have meatless Monday!

Honestly, my family comes here on a regular basis JUST for the chicken nachos. They are AMAZING. We have never been here & not been impressed. My husband & I usually get burgers of course but today I tried the sriracha Caesar salad and added shrimp and even that was amazing! So happy to have a great spot just a quick 5 min drive away. Thanks for the great food & service as always

My daughters and I were in Nashville for the weekend and absolutely fell in love with this restaurant. Simply fabulous!!  The atmosphere was friendly and the food was our favorite of the weekend. We loved every part of it!
Fantastic food, great variety, good prices and wonderful owners. You couldn't ask for more.

This is a unique fun restaurant that everyone should try at least once.  Perfect if you have out of town guests with kids. 

Fun restaurant that is great for families.  You feel like you've transported back to the 60's, western style (no hippies).  The waiter was super friendly but not over the top.   Also, he had a great handlebar mustache.

I had a fillet which was cooked perfectly.  The beans were nothing to write about.  I'd give the food a solid 3 stars.

I went early for dinner and the large open dining room with rustic western decor was not too loud and was plenty fun.

Did mention it was fun?

Not really into lunch meat sandwiches, but my coworker paid for it. I got the steak and cheese knowing that was the only thing I could stomach. It was ok but I wouldn't pay for it myself . The staff seem to all have bad attitudes but hey that's ok, I wont be back.

I've been going to them for some time now and they are excellent! Super clean and professional and always take their time to do an exceptional job. I've gotten so many different styles and each one has been amazing and lasted well over three weeks. Highly recommend!

We enjoyed ribs and pulled pork - both meats were tender with excellent smoke flavor. If you like hot'n'sweet - try the Voodoo sauce. The pit-smoked beans were awesome with full smoke penetration through the beans, not just the sauce. Looking forward to next time - soon!
Tony and Asia both need raises!!! They both were very fast and friendly. Tony even gave me a way to tweak my usual order! My new favorite location!

Oh sweet Meat..
One of my favs restaurants and truly mostly compliments to the restaurant.  It is located in old strathcona,  it is a spacious, modern and an inviting restaurant.  The king of the menu is meat and it comes in different options.  You also have chicken and pork.  It is a sharing style place so be prepared to share your meal with your friends.  Portions are good size, not very large so you do need to order three portions for two if you want to feel full.  The side dishes are fantastic.. Try the corn bread.. It is so good!!! .  Not a good place for a dieter for sure.  I have been there a few times and I haven't waited for too long or felt rushed after finishing my food.  Service is consistently good.  My only suggestion to the owner is to maybe use some sort of door to enter the bathrooms.  If you are siting by the bathroom area, the traffic is high and also you can actually peek people in it.   I have sat a couple of times around there and It felt kind of funny.  Other than  that.. Great place to eat and grab a drink.  Very causal and relatively affordable so it is recommended for a visit.  Let me know your thoughts.

With all the coffee shop options around the city of Indianapolis, Bovaconti offers several unique features that set it apart from all the others. Nestled right in the heart of Fountain Square, off Virginia Avenue, it is very accessible to pedestrians and also has ample parking for motorists. For those who would prefer to sit outdoors, Bovaconti offers outside seating with a great view. On the inside, the distinct wallpaper, ceiling design, floors and exposed brick provide a visually stimulating experience that distinguishes this coffee shop. Having gotten the nitro cold brew, I can confirm that the quality of their product will not leave you disappointed. Whether you want to grab a sip with friends, grind out work or grab a drink to go, Bovaconti is worth checking out.

The woman who did my nails kept cutting my fingers with the electric file and regular file. They treat their paying customers like dirt. There was an issue with the help color I paid $10 For. I noticed it after I paid on my way to the car. I went right back in and the woman behind the counter did not want to file it off and repaint them after I just paid $10 extra for the gel color less than 2 minutes ago. She told me if she had it taken off she would have recharge me again the $10 I just paid them. They are not losing any money at all. The gel nail polish is $10 a bottle. Essentially I just paid for a whole bottle of nail polish. Every other place I have went too whenever there was an issue they fixed it right away and apologized. This is America not Asia or Vietnam. The hard working paying customer is always right in America. After the way I was treated I felt like calling the cops because I paid for a good service I did not receive. I felt like I was robbed. I will never go back too or recommend this place. Steer clear of this place unless you want to pay more for the worst service you will ever receive.

Love this place! When my husband and I came back from our Hawaii trip, I was sad because I knew the shave ice here wouldn't be the same as Matsumoto's. To my surprise I saw that this place open up a few days after our trip and couldn't wait to give it a try. It definitely is comparable to Matsumoto's and I'm happy that it is really close to our home. There's so many yummy flavors to choose from. You can even add ice cream with your shave ice and top it with other add-ons. Great price for huge servings.
yummy times 10! no doubt some of the best ingredients. really fast and inexpensive. large size pizza for $7 can't be beat and with quality. the gelato looked good but I didn't try. next time

This location is just okay. I'm not certain if they just don't have enough traffic but the doughnuts I've gotten there over the years don't seem to be as fresh as other Krispy Kremes. I'm not a big fan, but my kid loves them. (Lamar's in the KC area are the best in  my humble opinion.)

I wish we had a Longhorn in North Texas.  We were in the mood for Seafood, but couldn't find anything more appealing than Red Lobster so we changed it to steak.  Salads were fresh, steaks were Hot and cooked exactly to order.  Nice meal at a chain steakhouse.

I love this little cafe because they offer almond, soy, coconut and cows milk as options for hot and cold drinks!!! Personally I have never had a cup of coffee in my life but the iced chai latte's are really good. This is a great place to sit by the windows and people watch or read or chill with friends. 124th street has so many great places to shop and meet friends for dinner you can't lose by stopping here for a latte. 

The best part about the Barking Buffalo is that you can shop for handmade designer clothing for men and women and kids at the same time. So many times I have wiped my xmas list clean by one visit. I would rather shop local and shop small than give my money to the mall or to starbucks... it really makes a difference in the lives of small business owners and artists.

Sub Standard store for Non Veg.  I have purchased mutton from this store. I can say Its cheating. This consists of left over bones with little flesh on it  after taking the meat for kheema. 1/4 of the pack is Fat ie the white substance and the rest is bones with little flesh on them. Mutton is hard it took me two hours to coock on a pressure coocker.  Very frustrating.

I was looking to buy a car today or tomorrow, cash in hand ready to go. So I see a car on their site and inquire about it through chat, ask a couple of questions and didn't think I would be able to see it today so I said maybe tomorrow and thanked them. The lady on the chat advised I come in soon as its about to be sold at auction.

I found out later I could stop by and notified them through the chat. This time I asked about warranties and the like and was given a bunch of misinformation. So again I thanked them, logged off the chat and then called Kia customer service and they gave me accurate information.

Once again I contacted them on chat to discuss the misinformation they spewed at me and to verify everything before I make the long drive up there. I wanted to be sure of it all because I planned on buying it tonight. In the middle of me asking for an explanation of the services and warranties offered by the dealership. The person in the chat goes, I'm sorry I just got a call from the dealership......Yes you heard right a sales agent from the dealership, just got a call from the sales department of the dealership to let he know the car was sold...Sure

Long story short, if you inquire about a car, don't ask too many questions, don't call them out on their bs, and don't ask if the price is negotiable, or the call might be randomly "sold". They might even keep the car ads/ \pictures up on their and other sites as well.

From the moment we entered the for today my daughter and I were greeted and welcomed in to have a spectacular experience.
Immediately after the warm welcome we got the rundown on how it all works, the options available and the icing on the cake was finding out that there were gluten-free options available for my wife.
The shop was cozy and had a very positive gone going on.
I definitely recommend checking them out and look forward to trying many more options.
I got the Jersey Devil. Delicious!

Started off with a few craft beers while we looked at the menu. I went straight for the Cuban sandwich as I am trying to find a replacement for LaTropicanas excellent sandwich. This is a great choice. We also tried the Dirty Chick which was delicious. The wait staff is friendly and fast. We will definitely be back.

I was going to be in town for just a few days staying at a nearby hotel, and due to severe food allergies emailed to ask if this store by chance had rice milk and fresh fruit. They had fruit (and many other healthy, delicious, and interesting foods) but didn't normally carry rice milk, so the manager Jessica special ordered it and had it waiting for me the days I was there! How many stores will do that these days? This is a wonderful downtown grocery store and is a great place to drop in and pick up a few nutritious foods for local dwellers and travelers alike, but I am especially grateful that they helped me out and were so friendly! Highly recommended.
Looking for a hard-working professional crew and knows how to keep their cool even under the most intense pressure. I'd recommend them to anyone!

I love this selection of flavors this place has. I've been here a few times now and it is consistently good! There are mini talking did you use 2 hopefully satisfy your sweet tooth. 

It is very clean, and the service is always friendly. The price isn't bad if you don't go overboard. I made that mistake the first few times I came, and couldn't finish what I had dished out.

Overall, I love this place it is in an interesting part of town , which I love to walk around after fulfilling my sugar destiny.
Great place to grab delicious bar food. The service was a little slow, but the food was worth the wait. They have the best pork tenderloin sandwich!
Great food and even better margs. Picking up curbside was easy and staff was friendly.

I started eating here when they opened down the street.  My oldest son worked for the business as a first job in high school. I have had better experiences with the food than my recent visit yesterday. The food tasted bland and was dry. Now take note, we were there at 5:30, so it wasn't at the end of a long day, this was the dinner rush. My two daughters barely finished a leg which was confirmation for me. The other note, the owner. He needs a break. The restaurant needs a break from him. He is getting worse with time. Last night as he was taking my order, I swear he looks like he hasn't changed his clothes all week. Ok, so he's a working owner, I get that, but it was to the point of disgusting. Secondly, his attitude SUCKS!!!  During our encounter, he made no eye contact, seemed bothered by my order, and at one point I asked him if everything was ok?  At the end, when he handed my receipt I asked him "thank you?"  As he hadn't offered me the common courtesy. 
It will be a while before I consider trying them.

Great atmosphere, and location love the fact this restaurant is sort of a old garage which is its greatest charm cause garage door it serves as the window. The food was great, well seasoned and was very delicious. My server was great but there were only two of them so we waited a lot longer than expected. Overall great food.
Staff was very unfriendly and most of their yogurt machines did not work. Can get better yogurt from the gas station!

This place is probably the best holiday location in Florida! The manager was very friendly he gave me an upgraded room for no extra charge. The pool was great. The beach is walking distance. The rim was very large and very very clean. This is a resort not a hotel. I would stay all week here if I didn't have a house booked. I will definitely come back
Not impressed. The food is decent, not so great. You get some value for money only by ordering buffet. We ordered two vegetables and both had same gravy... Not good.

I showed up on a Sunday morning. The menu and options are amazing but the store execution is poor. 

First if they are not serving nitro ice cream for the winter then they should take it off the menu.  

Second they have really great espresso equipment but did not have a barista working that could use it properly....steaming the milk for a latte is a skill and I heard glub glub instead of tearing paper....the resultant latte taste confirmed what I heard.   Suggestion...take a barista class. 

The interior design was great and props to whoever did it...but it is not being maintained and is dirty.  Blue painters tape holding the bar together...really?  

The ranchero omelet was amazing.  Loved it!!!

Anyway great business model but execution and maintenance was poor.

I gave Home Hero 4 stars instead of 5 because they did not come out and estimate the cost of the job. They gave the estimate from photos I took with my IPhone. So they mistakenly estimated the job for the wrong room. However, I would give Randall, the handyman who fixed my exhaust fan in my laundry room (not the bathroom) 5 stars. He took a job that was difficult and with patience and smarts, came up with a perfect solution. I would hire him for any job  in my home. I have already told 2 of my friends in the building. Thank you Randall for a great job! Diane C
Every single time I eat here I always want more. The meat just falls apart and the flavor is all there. For convenient barbecue it truly hits the spot.

The sushi was pretty good, but just not the best that I've ever had. However, the food cooked on the hibachi grill was amazing. Our chef put on a great show, was very humorous, and made sure to engage us in the experience. If you want a dinner and a show, this would be a great option. Great food and a great staff.

I find myself wishing there were Hubbard and Cravens all over the city! There are days I go out of my way to get a drink from them, and it's always worth it! They have tons of seating and tables so it's the perfect place to get work done or meet with a friend. 

I've had food from there once, it was a breakfast sandwich and it was pretty good. Mine had a lot of sauce on it though. I'm it sure if make anything in house or not. But I would eat a snack from there again! 

In my picture I have the "Passion & Desire" tea. I am normally a latte girl (I've loved ALL the lattes I've gotten from here! They keep me coming back! Full of flavor!)  Anyways, back to the tea, ha! Sadly it was just okay, it was a green tea but didn't have a ton of flavor. The flavor I did taste was a little fruity. I think if It were served over ice I would have enjoyed it more, I'm not sure if that's event a thing for this kind of tea ha!

Overall, it's one of my go to spots in Indy when I am meeting with friends, working on something, or if I just want to get out of the house. Check it out, i highly recommend a latte.

Highly recommend. My party and I came in around 5 and where seated relatively fast. It was very busy but they distanced us fantastically. Our server Morgan went above and beyond with her service, recommending her favorite dishes and helping us decide what to add to our dishes. I will definitely be coming back and requesting her section when ever I am visiting.

Always delicious and on the rare occasion it isn't, they go out of their way to make it right. Food is downhome country good - and the biscuits and jam are amazing! Good food for everyone. If you don't like slightly (or moreso) spicy stuff, try the sloppy joe! YUM.

PS Darn good Old Fashioned!

Went there for lunch with a friend.  They were not busy.  My friend ordered a turkey platter.  The waitress forgot the cranberry sauce, but we couldn't get her attention and gave up trying.  I had water, but was charged for a soda.  Mindless service.  The food was mediocre.  Will never return to that place.

Came here for a quick breakfast before our paddle board tour. Awesome bacon Bloody Mary, food portions were good sized and decently priced. Service was excellent (thanks Shane!), and quick walk right across the street to the sugar sands of Clearwater Beach!

After nearly 3 months of numerous phone calls and e-mails we finally recieved all missing items that were promised at the time of sale.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Special Note: I was told on the phone by the salesman when we called, yet again asking what was going on with all the missing parts that were part of the sale, that the car goes through a multi-point inspection before it's put out for sale.

There were so many things wrong (see list below) with this car that were COVERED 100% UNDER WARRANTY when my daughter drove it home that it's my opinion that it never went through these inspections before being put onto the lot.

Spare key didn't work - Fiat's require special keys that have to be programmed

A giant bubble on the paint between the windshield and the sunroof

Passenger seat was broken and wouldn't fold up to allow a passenger in the back

Trunk pull was missing - this was a big problem since my daughter is very tiny and couldn't reach it to close without jumping.

Shelf in the back of the car had broken brackets and the shelf itself was completely gone. (not covered because the entire shelf was missing)

NOT covered under warranty - HUGE rock chip on the windshiled in direct vision of the driver. There's NO WAY this would pass an inspection. We paid to have this fixed ourselves.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Since she had driven over 2 hours each way to buy the car at this dealership it was extremely disheartening to have to beg for things to be made right, because it wasn't a close jot back to the dealership, and it took a post on Yelp and an e-mail to the president to bring any type of reconciliation to it.

WE ourselves brought the car to a Fiat dealership to have all the warranty covered issues taken care of. An hour drive each way.

I would suggest to anyone wanting to purchase a vehicle here to inspect it very closely. You may not be as lucky as we were to have so many of the things wrong still be under warranty.

I am excited to say we have  a little gem in Warrington. 

 Hot Black Tea and fresh crispy wontons  delivered to our table as soon as we sat down!! Something that we love especially on a chilly rainy night.

Delicious  Wonton Egg Drop soup!! 
The lunch specials look amazing. I will check it out next weekend 

Great sushi !  We had the Warrington Roll,  Angry Dragon Roll and Volano Roll. Love them all. We will be back to try the others so many to choose.. 

Our server Michael was very nice and we enjoyed our conversation with him.. 

The owner/chef came out to say hello when we were leaving. Very NICE.

I see two negative posts on here??  I am wondering why. Maybe other businesses nearby are a little nervous.  They should be..
Yummy food And I would definitely go back next time hubby and I make our way back to New Orleans.

Had the Tikka masala with lamb meatballs and the taste was just lighter than we're used to. I've been to the Choolaah in Cleveland and Pittsburgh multiple times and it didn't taste the same. It wasn't as rich as I'm used to.

Update!

I have a been meaning to re-write this review so here goes. We went back with a couple of friends to try it out again and I don't know what they did, but the magic was back. Even tried their salmon and it was awesome. Way to go guys!

I have to admit, I'm a bit put off by the four stars this place got. It was fine, nothing wrong with it really, but also fully in the "Meh" category in my book. Parking is a nightmare, and the speaker shop next door didn't help much, with the cars in the lot testing out their new speakers, blasting the bass so loudly the plates were moving across the table. Then there's the weird booth smell, and yes I'm complained about this before at other places, but seriously, who wants a weird chemical smell assaulting their noses the second they sit down? I wouldn't go back, especially with so many other sushi places to try. Started with Miso and edamame. Too much salt on the edamame, and the miso tasted like it was made from a powdered mix, which is sacrilege in my book. I can make better miso soup from scratch in my sleep. And I'm a white chick that can barely cook. The sushi was fine, I mean I freaking love sushi and even poorly executed sushi is tasty to me, I'm not a sushi snob, but the rice was pretty tough and kind of chewy, and that's another key.  If you can't get your rice right at a sushi place, you might as well close up shop. The rolls were big, yes, but kind of random and messy. Got a variety of rolls, including a caterpillar and a Hawaiian. The eel sauce was really thick on those two for some reason, and seemed to congeal on the plate, so that when I tried to pull a piece of sushi across the sauce, it had the consistency of elmer's glue. ew. I mean whatever, if you want to drop some sake bombs and fill your belly, while enjoying some sweet bass thumps rocking your booth, this spot is a treat. All I know is throughout the dinner my friend and I were looking at each other with our eyebrows up the whole time, as in "WTF", and the jank factor was pretty high.

Sharrott Winery was our savior. Valenzano Winery has completed screwed over a 15 girl bachelorette party and Sharrott was more than happy to accommodate. Natalie was an absolute sweetheart and we couldn't have been happier with the change of plans. Cheers!!

This place never disappoints. Juicy think burgers, stuffed burgers, lamb burgers, if your craving a burger this is the place to go. The locals rave about this place constantly. They do take call ahead orders if you just want to enjoy it at home. Either way, you will be glad you went.

I don't know what others are talking about when they say they weren't pleased with their experience.  I had lunch here today, and it was fabulous!  I had the half rotisserie chicken, greens, and slaw.  Everything was awesome!  The chicken was tender and juicy with a yummy crunchy skin.  You could even see the real herbs used to season it.  I am suprised that no one has commented on the fact that Stone House is a gluten free friendly restaurant.  Even their cornbread is gluten free!  Since they make all thier sides home made, there is no risk of additives and crap that you get when going to a "chain".  The service was great, and they were more than happy to answer any of my questions about ingredients.  In fact, pretty much everything except the sandwiches and mac-n-cheese is gluten free.  My new favorite BBQ place!

I got the portabella eggplant panini.Delicious,especially during this lenten season
Garlic rolls and sauce.YUM
Gatorade
Love this place.My new go to

We were craving some southwestern egg rolls so after a quick shopping stop at Tyrone Mall, my son and I stopped in here for dinner. I got kind of lost finding the restaurant, it's located down a winding road off the main road (I thought I took a wrong turn but nope! Just keep driving down and you'll see it!)

Greeted and seated quickly. Manager on duty was very nice and attentive. Our server was friendly enough. Not the friendliest, but she seemed busy so eh, whatever. My son ordered a kid meal and I ordered the mango-chile tilapia. It came with some rice and broccoli. Ok flavors to the fish, kinda sweet and spicy but I wasn't like "MMMM this is sooo good!" I would not order again. The southwestern egg rolls and molten chocolate cake always taste the same no matter what Chili's you go to lol.

This Chili's location has those self order and self pay touchscreens at the tables. You can reorder drinks, food, and pay your bill at the table without waiting for a server. I ordered dessert from it and paid our bill through it.

Overall, a good Chili's experience.

Awesome.

We've been customers of this store for most of their 20+ years. I have some lovely pieces in the living room that came over from England in various shipments... sadly, they don't do that anymore (seems the dollar is down and shipping costs are up)

Still: Lots of good older wood pieces, stained glass panels and various chairs and even some jewelry.

Prices are affordable and they buy good pieces readily.

This place is amazing! Did the Office first and then our group was addicted! Just finished the medieval room today. Got out with 6 minutes to spare and only 1 1/2 clues. Definitely recommend this place! Cristian was an awesome host!
I ordered thw BOOM BOOM shrimp... it was just the right size for a first quick eats to start our vaca.  Husband got the chargrilled oysters and he enjoyed them as well.

This place is delicious. It's a cute little cart, relatively inconspicuous compared to the nearby Cheese E Wagon. The guy there, Zbigniew, takes his time- they don't take too long, but they take a few minutes. It's absolutely worth it, though. I had a breakfast crepe (at 2pm) and it was fantastic. I'm definitely coming back. Love this place.
Stopped in for breakfast while visiting NOLA. The wait was about 45 minutes, but it was expected. Ordered the pancakes and order was enough to share with hubby. Service was great.

food was really good but after we were sat down(in a pretty empty restaurant) we didn't have a server come up to us for 20 minutes so I had to ask a nearby busser for a waiter. But after that everything was good!

Um, yes please! Santa Barbara knows how to do authentic Mexican food and Los Gallos is no exception! 

The food here is delicious! I had a special, corn tortillas topped with carne asada, peppers, mushrooms, onions and cheese. The tortillas were definitely homemade, thick, soft and wonderful! The meat was tender and juicy. 

I had a field day at the salsa bar with the great assortment of homemade salsas. 

They also served my meal with fresh chips and chunky salsa! The service was incredible! 

I love this shop and highly recommend it!
Was there today, with my friends from the 173d ABN. Great place for everyone very friendly to the veterans. Very friendly staff and very professional. Food was outstanding. Thanks !!!

This is a sandwich shop located inside of a Chevron gas station. I ordered a small sandwich. On their 'menu board' the sandwich normally comes with cheese,  and no veggies on it. I asked for no cheese, but I requested lettuce and pickle on my sandwich. I was charged an extra 35 cents for both the lettuce and the pickle each. The lady working was not very nice about it either. My small sandwich and 2 small bags of chips (2 ounce bags) had my total at $13.00. My sandwich although not bad tasting certainly was nothing special. At all.  I will not be returning. I also will not recommend this place to anyone.

Always an amazing meal. We always arrive early so we can sit at the bar/by the fire for a pre dinner cocktail. The Dillworthtown Inn is fine dinning that's still comfortable. You won't find any place like it!

I love when I can plan a day to come to #pmtstampa because I know I'm going to spend some time relaxing while immersed into the best scalp treatment EVER! The learning leaders do an amazing job guiding their students through various applications of treatment. The students are always so friendly and accommodating! Couldn't ask for better treatment at an AMAZING price!

Part of the Stephen Starr family of restaurants, Jones is a nice casual joint, complete with friendly Lacoste-clad staffers serving up tasty comfort food.

Despite the tempting market salad offering ($14 for all the toppings you want), we ended up splitting an appetizer (tuna tacos) and ordering a pair of entrees (brisket and pork special).  Although all were tasty, the pork entree (served with a zesty demi glaze and delicious cornbread stuffing) was my favorite of all the offerings.

Our server was terrific and the comfortable ambiance was a nice change from some of the more upscale Starr restaurants in town.

Just played there today and the course was in great shape. The Superintendent was actually on the course and apologized for the two greens that were aerated while he was watering them personally. The other 16 greens were incredible, the sand traps were nice and the sand was very playable. He said he is working hard on many updates, looking forward to this summer. He said many people complain about the gravel parking lot. Funny, I think it looks very Colorado and upscale. I don't care where I park, I care about how the course and greens are. If you want everything perfect be prepared to pay over a 100.00 per round. Nice Job Far Oaks.

I've been coming here for over 10 years. Originally on Moana, the newer location has a good view of downtown Reno. I would suggest the nightly risotto special; it is different daily but always creamy the way risotto should be served. It's safe to pick any of the other nightly specials as well. All will be good. The owner/chef is from Italy and knows how Italian food should be served.

Friday night in Philly. Walked down main street with all the restaurants in the street but didn't have reservations. Walked down the side street and found this place. Sat outside. Had really good fish and chips and beer! Yum! So glad we found the place. I would recommend!  Very fresh fish and tarter sauce!

I go here a lot and it is a very busy store. They do have a good section of gluten free products and allergy friendly foods which is a plus. (My son has food allergies) Although their seafood section is gross. I bought shrimp here on two different occasions and both times they smelled God awful and we're slimy. They definitely need to be inspected because I don't think they are handling their seafood properly. Do not but from their seafood department.
The food is excellent here but the service was pretty bad.  I get better customer service from McDonald's.

This was a fantastic restaurant.  The service was great and the food was even better. I had the tawook plate which had marinated grilled chicken, lightly seasoned curry rice and delicious hummus. This place cannot be beat. I was throughly impressed. Don't forget to start or finish with an Arabic coffee.

Went here for the first time and it definitely won't be the last. Everyone was so kind and friendly and the food was fantastic! My husband got the spaghetti and added chicken and scrapped the plate clean. I opted for the mushroom risotto and it was fantastic. My one daughter got the grill cheese and loved it. We stole a couple fries and were extremely surprised and how delicious those were as well. My other daughter got the cheese pizza and it too was good. No complaints with anything! 
I finished with the Orange Creme Brûlée and it was delicious. We all will definitely be back!
Stumbled upon this gem driving through winterburn, the sandwiches truly are a work of art! I will definitely be back!

Solid place with delicious food and atmosphere away from the typical French Quarter destinations when visiting NOLA. Went to NOLA on business with four other co-workers and one of them recommended checking out the Garden District. What a great change-up with many great shops and different types of restaurants when compared with the French Quarter. I did a four taco combo which was about two tacos more than I really needed but in natural fashion I ate all four because this place is that good. All co-workers ordered a variety of things and everything was outstanding. A must eat place when visiting NOLA.
Really good meal tonight.  Friendly staff.  Will plan to return!   The hanger steak was great.  Loved the collard greens. Bengiets were slightly overcooked, but the sauce was very good.

While the decor is straight out of a movie and the people sitting next to us definitely talked like some connected operators, the food was just so-so. Admittedly we went right as kitchen was wrapping up, so excuse the fact it wasn't really hot, it just felt... overdone in a bad way. The gumbo roux was really dark (almost burnt). The bbq on the shrimp and grits was too sweet. The shrimp were actually too big that wondered if the thick middle was cooked all the way... that kind of thing. $30 for shrimp and grits, but you get $1.50 Bloody Mary's with it, so that's a win. It's also on a crowded and kind of crazy street, so... meh. It's good but not great and New Orleans has a lot to eat.

Came here to meet up w/a friend for breakfast.  They have 1 way entrance / exit but do not have people abide by it.  Masks are required.  You can place your order @ the counter or @ the kiosks that are available.

We were the only customers when entering --- were not given any greeting at all; just a cashier that was staring at us to make our order.  We opted to place ours at the counter since we wouldn't have to touch the kiosk screens.  The clerk had an immediate attitude so maybe she was having a bad day or clearly not a morning person, but please don't take that out on the customer.  I ordered the bacon, egg and cheese w/no bread -- she asked how I wanted my egg to which I replied stating over medium.  In a snarky voice she says "we don't offer over medium, we only have scrambled or over easy"....so I say ok, over easy then.  I check out and wait around for my name to be called.  When choosing a table, there were a few that we passed over because they were dirty w/crumbs or watermarks from beverages which indicates that they hadn't wiped down the tables after diners left.

Now the food -- my name was called and I went up to the area to pickup.  I looked at my food and the cheese wasn't even melted on top indicating that they didn't even warm it up!  I asked the girl to please melt the cheese so she took the food back and placed in the warmer -- asked me if I wanted my bacon warmed too to which I was like yes, of course.  The food was ok, no complaints but I have definitely had better.
Literally my favorite matcha in all of AZ! The employees have always been very nice and efficient as well!

Great place to start for all your paper needs.  Invitations, cards, or card stock, you can find tons of options here.  My fiance and I met with a member of the staff here to look at save the date options.  Prices may be a little high, but you're dealing with people who specialize in paper, so you're in good hands.  Even if you don't purchase here, its a great place to gather ideas to begin your search.  Stop in.

Last night we experienced the medical care that AEC provided for our beautiful Cavalier King Charles Spaniel.  Upon arrival, the assistant assessed Cadence immediately and swooped her up to the back offices to begin oxygen right away.

Although our sweet dog did not survive her illness, the emergency care provided by Dr Stacie Lund and her highly skilled assistants was both efficient and caring.  They explained every step of Cadence's treatment including the costs.

Dr Lund was frank and honest with us about the seriousness of Cadence's condition.  She was so very kind and compassionate during a horrific time in our life with the loss of our life.

Thank you Dr Lund for the superior medical and compassionate care.

I ordered delivery tonight and got a confirmation email at 7:40 PM.  It is now 10:50 PM. Still no food. I called at 9:45 asking where it was and the woman wouldn't even look up the order, just said it's on the way. Now I call and then phone is turned off. I will be calling tomorrow for a refund and will never be ordering from here again.

Staff either doesn't want to help or can't I won't blame them. For the the price you pay stay at the comfort inn. It's cheaper and just as clean. Rooms are nice but I was here 5 days and had absolutely no service to my room.

We took the Megabus round trip from Boston to Philly. In Boston, South station has an actual bus terminal which is great. Philly has a sidewalk outside you get to bake in the sun (or I suppose drown or freeze, but we went in July) while waiting for the bus. The stop doesn't have designated waiting areas for each bus, and the crew is more interested in their italian ice and headphones than in customer service. 

On the way down to Philly, you better not have had to pee or sit near the bathroom! There was piss all over the bathroom - toilet, floor, etc. and the stench from the room by the end of the trip could make you vomit. 

Don't think you can get out at the stop in Secaucus NJ either - not to grab something to eat or use the bathroom. There's enough time for the drivers to switch and that is about it. 

Overall, you get what you pay for though. And for $8 round trip, I can understand the bus terminal in Philly and needing to rush through the stop in Jersey. Seriously though, learn to clean your bathrooms!
This place is very homey and offers vegetarian options. I can taste the freshness and my family enjoyed watching the LSU game.

Lucky Strike has a lunch and bowl deal. With a lunch purchase, a person can bowl for free between their lunch hours. It's a steal if you want to take a long lunch and break bread. When I went there was not a big lunch rush on a Thursday. I ordered their Firecracker burger, which was pretty good. The burger was cooked well and the bun was pretty soft. The one negative comment I had was the service.

For only having 5 or so customers, I was surprised why the servers did not come over to the table more often to ask for refills or how our food was. Our waitress came over while we were bowling then asked about our food. Not sure if my eyes deceive me but if she looked at our table, she could tell two plates of untouched food. Then after that inquiry, I did not see her. Strange? Asked about how our food was before having a bite then going MIA?

Overall, good steal for the lunch and bowl deal but service is sub par and slow.

"Amoroso" rolls that can be found at every pizza place on Dale Mabry, every meat you receive is frozen and bought in bulk, EVERY ingredient is sub par (just ask to see the brands), cleanliness isn't a focus. You would think with everything wrong it would at least be affordable. Go anywhere else and you'll have a much better experience.
Love going to Blown Away Blow Dry Bar, because it is easy to get to. People that work there really try to meet your needs. It's affordable and quick.

Super yummy ice cream! Nice employees and the ice cream is delicious, especially the Mango flavor, taste just like real mango. Cafe au lait ice cream also really yummy. And the portion is big, you get one scoop each flavor, but one scoop is really a lot, so I normally get just one flavor every time. I have tried all Flavours here and most of them are really good. Nectar flavor has a little bit powdery taste, but mango is the best IMO
Great neighborhood restaurant.  Food is great and the staff is awesome.

Walked in on Thursday night enticed by the live music. Upon entering the restaurant the waitress/ host?/ busgirl? told us to sit wherever we like, so we did. Once seated our waitress came to a table and handed us the menus, first strike! Those menus appeared to have gone to Bourbon st. and back. They were nasty! Overwhelmed by the dirty menus and the multiple choices we asked our waitress for suggestions. She suggested octopus dumplings and fried chicken. 

After we place our order our waitress asked us if we could move to a smaller table since there was a bigger party wanting to sit where we were. We complied. This party of about 6-8 was so obnoxious and loud! They took up the entire little room which was pretty annoying! I couldn't hear my own thoughts. Before I could asked to be moved to a different table our appetizers were here. 

The octopus dumplings are a joke! A fried, covered in barbecue sauce and spicy mayo, semi-cooked fried ball with a dime size piece of rubbery, bland octopus in the middle! The combination was awful! I never had anything like it at a Japanese restaurant. The fried chicken was subpar and served with a lemonade to dip. Strange! To that I will add that were never offered water or plates (we were sharing!) 

Save your money! You are better off getting a hot dog from across the street!

ehhh its too bad but I guess you get what you pay for here. My 1st visit was good, 2nd visit was okay. 
My nails were okay, uneven cuticle lines, shellac lasted about a week and a half. 
Customer service is garbage, the employees talk about you in another language like you don't even exists sitting inches away from them. 
They had a girl remove my shellac who was no older than 16 years old, that clearly doesn't have a nail technician licenses. She was rough taking off my shellac, ruining part of my nails. The 16 year old daughter acted like I was inconveniencing her life by coming to the salon for services. The employees need to act like they even want to be there, or at least fake it! I always tip 20% in my past visits. 
When I returned for a 3rd try (couldn't beat their prices) her mother told me she was going to remove my shellac again and I asked her if she had a license. She just responded with a dumbfounded look. I just politely left and found a brand new salon down the street.
I wont be returning...

Went to a different waffle house yesterday 3.5 stars...was pretty good, this one was rated nearly a 5 star...I can see why...great service, order was perfect, lots of refills but not over served...food was good...waitress made a Christmas jingle song into a welcome to waffle house song and sang for entire restaurant...it's clean and running on all cylinders here...fantastic job!

Update:

This place has evidently changed hands since the last time I went there. Quality has fallen to unacceptable levels. Will not return.

I had my daughter order a salad for me (to bring home), and I must say it was a disappointment. Maybe I was expecting more... but when you order a salad and ask for chicken, you expect more than a thimbleful. Basically, what a received was a typical "bagged" garden salad with a few tiny pieces of chicken, and it was missing one of the 'extras'. All this around ten dollars? I'll pick up a bag of greens at the grocery store next time and save seven bucks.

Omg! The Spaghetti is amazing !!!! I definitely would recommend! I remembered this restaurant from  like 2yrs ago and it's definitely worth the money. Prices are  just right! I drove 30min just to eat lol that drive was most definitely worth the ride. I will be going back.

My Husband took me there for lunch on 6/1/18. The seating was good, service was great and the food was hot and cooked just the way we asked. It was clean and our server was knowledgeable and very polite. We will definitely go back.

Had I known what I was getting myself into, I would have emotionally prepared myself before walking into Finnley's. I made the smart choice of placing my name on the waitlist via the Yelp app, which was probably the best thing to do if you plan on visiting. When I walked in to let the waitress know I was here, she gave me a glaring look and responded with attitude when I asked about a table. 

I waited inside with 2 other family members near an empty table for 20 minutes, only to be sat down at the same exact table. The waiters were disorganized, running around catering to those who were only ordering drinks. The only redeemable value of this restaurant is the food and the environment. Be aware next time you stop by at Finley's.

We had never been and went with our children and grandchildren- such fun- well organized, clever, creative and lovely staff.  A really fun time  working together as a family and enjoying lots of laughs.  We give it five stars.

This is a beautiful weekend right here.  You've got this wonderful coffee shop on the right side of the newly opened Ace Hotel and fabulous dining at Josephine Estelle on the left .  You are within walking distance to the French Quarter (0.5 mile) and the Warehouse District.  The street cars pass right out front too.  The lattes are beautifully done as are the yogurt parfaits and pastries.  Even if you are staying in the Quarter this place is worth a visit

I've been coming here for years and the Chicken-Lime Tortilla Soup is the best. Never found one that even comes close. I'm not a fan of the thick "stew-like" tortilla soups and this is light and spicy with a great citrus flavor. Greg, the owner, is almost always there taking the orders and offering a warm greeting. Nice to have that neighborhood restaurant where the owner remembers his customers and makes you feel welcome. Great location, nice atmosphere...and oh, that soup!
Pizza is amazing and the sandwhichs are awesome.  People are really nice and have a smile while you order

The food is made fresh and is absolutely AMAZING. The flavors and the heat is perfect. There's a tiny little kick to the sauce, which I'm loving. Definitely come here and splurge a bit. Enjoy the atmosphere, and of course, the food.

This place is delicious.  The owner truly loves cooking and is really proud of his food.  Take a few minutes to talk to him and hear how enthusiastic he is.  He can also make special food.  We asked him to cater some cous cous for us and it was AMAZING.  We called him the day before, but it was totally worth it.  I hope he adds it to the menu.
5 stars for the chocolate cream pie. I haven't had anything else here. Service was great and accommodating.

Worst experience with a repair i ever had!! Had my wife's car in for brakes the brakes screech worse then they did with 2 year old brakes on them! I have brought the car back 3 different times!! And still same outcome!! Horrible i'll never let this man work on my car again!

Decent late night bar food. Went there with a group of people who work in the restaurant industry. I asked to close my tab out, which was only food and one drink. Vito was so rude, looked at me like I was nuisance, walked away and never gave me my tab. I could have just walked out and not even paid my tab but I am not that type of person. I even had cash in my hand ready to close the bill out. I know he is a long time employee but he needs to retire or not be in a position that forces you to engage with customers. Vito doesn't engage with you unless you're a regular. I left the other bartender a tip only because it was not her fault. Just wanted to let the owner know since he reads these reviews.

It's a good enough salon! Not an amazing selection of gel colors but enough that I was able to find something for my pedicure.

The pedicure was nice, she cut my big toes a little too short and one was crooked so I look pretty stupid wearing sandals.

They were slow when I came in and during my pedicure it picked up and I noticed her rushing through the rest of my pedicure, the good stuff being the scrub and "massage", so that they could work on the next walk in.

I'm from out of town so I'm constantly checking out new salons when I come back but I probably won't return. Everyone working was nice but $50 for a below average gel pedicure is a bit too much for me.

They took over China Wok a few years ago.  This is primarily a take spot which has 3 tables with 4 chairs each for dine in. Mon-Sat lunch specials are available from 11am-3pm. They also offer delivery which I have not tried yet since I live nearby and can simply drive and pick up. I have only tried their Chinese dishes which have been well seasoned. Their lomein is good and filling.
Great experience and food. The tuna poke was delicious and both of the bartenders (Mike and Jen) were great. I will definitely be coming back.

This place is a charming little place to have lunch or to hang out and chat. Quality coffee, sandwiches, and pastries. 

The sandwiches are pre-made rather than made to order, so that may or may not appeal to you. 

The one downside to this place however is that the internet is not public.

this place rocks.  kevin our waiter is amazing.  he knew the men plus recited on detail the menu and his favorites.  had the snapper, it is awesome.  all of the apartments are good.  by favorite is the bacon wrapped dates.  sick tacos are interesting.  try the watermelon tmate salad.  interesting mix of sweet and salty.  it all works.  ask for Kevin, great service.

FIRST OFF: NOT GAY. AT ALL. Two grumpy straight ladies... who informed us that they only had "chocolate and Trix" ice cream flavors. The "rainbow" sprinkles were not rainbow, and tasted like I was gnawing on birthday candles... you know, like when the candles are lit for too long and get all drippy over that sickening icing and you get a little unwanted crunchy crunch in your cake. We got chocolate, since we didn't have much of an option, and we were handed cones that were dripping as they were being handed to us. It was a 90 degree day, and it was hotter IN THE ICE CREAM SHOP than outside. A bit of a problem, wouldn't you say? Not only was the ice cream a melted mess, and so over priced for SOFT SERVE, but it didn't taste like anything? Overall, this was quite the letdown. BOO. 

Also, I feel like they need to have a STORY about why it's "big gay ice cream." are you donating all that money I spent on subpar soft serve somewhere?
not as nice as other giants...also the ice cream sections has freezer issues especially by the Ben and Jerrys area ..always getting ice cream that is freezer burnt

RUN and support this amazing brew venture in New Orleans' backyard. I just relocated from Houston area which has no shortage of breweries. Parleaux has phenomenal technique and new, percolating brew styles ready to peak seasonally. Indoor/outdoor seating promote an easy atmosphere that is conveniently kid and pet friendly while not being overrun by either. Very reasonable beer pricing and treat yourself to an ultra soft tee to spread the word.

We love to go to mom and pop's restaurant to support local business especially it good because it BYOB (you can get drunk with your own alcohol). Also, this is the one on our lists we heard lots of good things about this place from our friends that had been there before. There is a house that converted to dinning place, hard wood floor upstairs and down. I went there for Valentine's day had in mind *vanilla butter lobster but when i saw the menu I changed my mind.

Here what we orders:  we had crab cake salad it was so worth- the sauce was amazing. Lamb tenderloin , it just melt in your mouth it sooooo tender.Baked cannelloni stuffed with ricotta and short ribs , rustic tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella. Caramel Apple  - love it ! 

The service was good my waiter was cool, because the table is so close to each other you can take a peak at other folks food :) as I always do!

I would rate this place 3.5 stars for the food and 4 for the service.

Typical decent Asian american entrees, average to mediocre sushi [if you know sushi]

Once got sashimi and regretted it--the fish did not taste fresh at all.  Had an old taste to it...very unpleasant and overpriced for what it was.  Rolls seem skimpy on the fish, but I suppose you don't want to have to taste too much of it, anyway.
Stick to the rolls. And stick to the lunch pricing.

The atmosphere is fine.  Green minty walls, nice tables, cheesy "asian" instrumental music.
(But I care more about the food.)

I like Tokyo Mandarin (5 minutes down the road) a bit better, or Mt. Fuji in Deptford if I'm up for the drive.

Absolutely stunning! 
It's like walking through a land of garden amazement. 
It is well thought out and a peaceful place to shop. 
The retail shop is unique.
There's so many artsy, unique fun items too.
VERY NICE :)

5 minutes ago

I love my model 3, but do not trust the devon service department. I've had my model 3 for 6 months. At 12k miles took it in to local mechanic to have tires rotated. Found out my front tires had worn through to secondary rubber. Called Devon service department three times with no call backs. Finally got it to them, service rep looked at it and said tires were fine. I had to tell him to check the inside of the tires. They finally got the car on a rack and confirmed what I told them. Then after waiting over an hour to speak face to face with a manager, the sales manager lied to me and stated the factory tires were only good for 15k miles. I told him the outside of the tires and the rear tires have at least 15k miles left on them. They were in complete CYA mode so that they were not responsible at all.
Slowest CFA drive-thru ever (and I've been to dozens and dozens of CFAs). Fries were cold and soggy. Worst CFA in the world.

I would given Magic Nails a higher review, but for one male nail tech. I have unfortunately gotten him as my nail tech three times for a mani/pedi. He seemed condescending and judgmental. He made fun of my nail polish color for being too light, almost refused to cut my nails short because he thought it wasn't girly, and on another visit actually said my job in the environmental wasn't real or important. I really like the salon other than him, and it's unfortunate because I don't want to come back.

I was very disappointed that they messed up my booking. I asked for two double bed room and they gave me a king size room so be careful of when you book. 

Upside is that the staff is friendly they also have valet parking. Hotel is very modern.

Restaurant has good food at a reasonable price.

The booths were nice and comfy.  The service was good.  It was a pretty laid back atmosphere with outdoor seating available as well.  

The food seemed freshly made and healthy.  The taste was sort of hit or miss.  Some of the items tasted good while the others weren't the best I've had.
Overall I think it depends on what you order-- and the prices weren't too bad either.

I gotta be honest-- it wasn't the best Italian food I've had, but the service was good.

Polite Society does not disappoint!! Anything you get on the menu will leave you very satisfied and eager to return. I had a friend visit from Raleigh, NC for the weekend and she loves brunch. Of all the brunch places I have been to in St. Louis, there was no other place I wanted to take her than Polite Society!!

Tried to eat here this afternoon, but couldn't even get the hostess to seat us.  As we waited and waited we watched another party walk out with only their water on the table.  There were many empty, clean seats but we stood waiting while she cleaned a booth and then proceeded to grab the broom.  We love Sonny's and have enjoyed this location before.  Today was a nightmare so we ate elsewhere.

Original - yeah this modest little burger joint is the great model that was taken to franchise heights by a Chinese Company Yum Brands.  The eight locations here in SB are not owned by this mega company so if you're looking for a great burger - This is the place.  Try the Ahi burger and sweet potato fries for a tasty meal.

This is my favorite go to breakfast joint. It's cash only which is never a problem because you're entire meal (with huge portions) is under 10$ including the either the best green tea (gunpowder) or fresh squeezed OJ. The owners are great...funny and always sweet. Pancakes as big as your plate, crisp bacon and the best eggs in town. Egg meals     Are served with half a plate if delicious red potatoes seasoned and perfectly crisp. That also have a to go menu which serves the largest bagel egg, bacon and cheese sandwiches you could imagine. It's a simple little set up, nothing fancy but you definitely get more than you pay for. My only issue is that they don't have wifi and I have zero service in there but then again, I have TMobile...

I haven't felt compelled to write a review like this in my history of yelp. This hotel's employees truly went above and beyond during my recent stay in Tampa. I had an emergency where I had to fly into Tampa 4 hours prior. I was able to arrange an early check-in in the morning, and when I got to the front desk I found that I had lost my ID on the plane. I called ahead and explained what happened and the manager on duty was helpful and accomodating! Stuck on the other side of the country and I had my credit cards but lost my ID on the plane! Thank you for your amazing service and hospitality.

Great Pizza.  Good value.  Friendly staff.  Usually some kind of excitement or colourful character.  Favourite spot for the late night crew.  Great selection of slices.  Donair pizza is a highlight.  In truth, I eat here daily.  Don't forget to put honey and hot sauce on your pizza!

I get off work having a taste a gyro, so i looked up the nearest gyro place in my area, than i read the reviews.  Everything to seem to be okay, pretty decent reviews, so i called in the order and they told me 15mins no problem. So i proceed down looking forward to juicy gyro experience, so pull i up to the place and it looks very very suspect. So i walked in and the first came to mind is this place need some interior help very badly. Then i walked to the front , OMG this place is a dump
, the cooking area is super nasty. Than the work says are you here for the spicy gyro i said yes wanted to say no lol. 

Something told me look at the food before i purchase it and thank god i did it looked like some bullshit. I told the guy i aint paying for this, you shoud be ashamed of your serving this bull.
So i walked out, and as for the people who gave this place good reviews on the gyro something is truely wrong with all of you if you like and accept this garage, all of you need to be committed to the nearest  Psycho Ward.

REAL TALK.

My all time favorite warehouse store.  They are on the list of cost-savings places which allows our household of 5 to be a single income household...given the affordability and quality of the products they carry.

The staff is also super friendly.

A total rip off and they totaled my car! Went for an oil change for my Scion xD and they charged me 99$ which is the most I've ever been charged for an oil change for this type of car. Later to find out my oil started leaking directly afterwards and my car started making a weird noise by the time I took it to the mechanic they told me there was no oil in my car and that my engine was ruined and that it would cost 7000$ for a new engine and labor. Now I'm in scrambles trying to buy a new car and I wasn't prepared for this! If I could give this place zero stars I would.

This meal was amazing, hands down my favorite meal of recent months. I loved almost everything I ordered. Cocktails were fabulous. "Absinthe" (we weren't convinced it was actual absinthe, it just tasted like pastis to all of us including the one of us who believes he's had actual absinthe before) was fun. I had the chicken roasted under a brick, but my favorite was probably the bone marrow plated with escargot we had as appetizer. I only wish I had written a review right after I ate here so I'd have a clearer memory of what I got and what it was like.

Valhalla is the best vegan bakery...well anywhere and everywhere I've been this far! She absolutely kills the vegan baking game, the owner is like the Betty Crocker of vegan treats. There's nothing I've had from Valhalla that I didn't absolutely love. I wish I had more photos to post but I eaten the food too quick to even think about a picture! 

Valhalla is located in Orlando at Market on South which is where I've experienced these amazing foods initially. I lived 2 hours away but I always made sure that when I was in town..I'd be at Market on South to pick up some goods. Now, I live in St. Petersburg where I was ECSTATIC to know that Valhalla just expanded and opened up shop here and was not even a 5 minute walk from where I live. It is located in the Baum Market which is so minimal and an awesome place to do work or just to relax and enjoy your meal with naturally lighting coming in from the big windows. The staff is always very nice. 

The pricing is a little expensive but what do you expect for quality food that is cruelty free and made with love and intention? I don't mind paying for that! She has expanded the menu and has added breakfast sandwiches along with her desserts. I am obsessed with Valhalla. This is a place that will absolutely thrive as a vegan establishment. Any non-vegan who has said that vegan desserts are not appetizing, has not tried Valhalla and I always recommend them to everyone. 

I feel a lot of gratitude for an awesome local business that I can always trust to satisfy my sweet tooth.

Stop the bus...

In Nashville at the end of Ragnar Tennessee, I was visiting my fellow-foodie niece, who declared brunch and off we went. She has been to many of the better restaurants in town, and she loved it too.

Ambiance: the minimal crowd present when we arrived before 11am grew a lot during our visit. Music was countrygrass covers of songs I like, just loud enough and not too loud. Funky warm rustic/industrial decor, and mellow innovative vibe with an open kitchen. I could hang out here all day!

The food: oh my gracious.

Started with a bloody... triple smoked whiskey? Yes please. Goldilocks would be pleased with the level of kick - just right! Chili rim. Yum. Niece enjoyed her bubbly too.

We started with the biscuit, which was the right combo of crisp and fluffy and buttery. Not too sweet but sweet enough jam and butter rounded it out. Glad to share so I wouldn't gobble the whole thing.

The greens were top notch, and the preachers breakfast was unparalleled. Collard greens are braised (I think) with bacon, possibly maple bacon, as the flavor was a smidge sweet and all amazing. Add flavorful sausage, perfect grits, and three perfect eggs, and I could eat it every day. Amen!

We polished off the experience with the totally divine carrot ice cream cake and coffee. Eyes rolled back in head. 

Portion sizes were perfect for sharing - both of us went away stuffed after this feast, and it was worth every calorie! I don't give five stars on the first visit often, but Saint Steve made a big impression.

Nap time...

This place is beautiful inside and they have an actual pianist playing for nice mood music..making it feel like an upscale place. The food is average and the service is not very good. Why? The menu does not describe the actual food that you are served. For example. We asked for pita bread to go with a gyro dinner that. The woman (seems to be possibly  one if the owners) said this is pita bread and pointed to a dinner roll that we had been served. That roll was very good and warm but a pita is was not. We said no that is not pita bread and she said this was their pita bread. We didn't argue further as my cold gyro was getting colder. A few minutes later we heard another waitress as a nearby table if they wanted pita bread to go with their meals and they said yes and returned with it. 

When we Asked our waitress again if they had pita bread she said no...so we asked about the other server offering it to her customers she said she was new n didn't know why she asked that. She mumbled about going to check to see if there was any in the kitchen. A few minutes later she returned with one piece of pita n walked away.  Earlier the table behind us was obviously upset as the food they were served was not as described in the menu. 

The placed has a sign outside that says the best Mediterranean  food in town. I would think with a billing like that they would have pita bread...I'm just saying. 

Oh one more thing...they have a belly dancer that stands in the open entrance in her outfit to entice people to enter...could help but feel I was in a strip bar and the stripper were outside teasing the public to come in and see the show while all the time clicking her castanets... I felt dirty as I left. 

I would have given a higher star rating if the problem was just at our table and if the server didn't feel the need to argue with her customers.

I actually found this salon on     .     .      .you guessed it; Yelp! Several people gave such good reviews, that I had to try this place. I am a woman on a budget, so I don't go to salons too often. I have to be careful with my spending. I am pleased to say that  I was not disappointed. I was greeted as soon as I walked in the door. My hair stylist was Andra. She is the BEST! I wanted a haircut with a fresh, new, elegant and sophisticated style; and that is exactly what I got. Andra was professional, courteous, and efficient. I also got some tips from her about keeping my hair smooth and sleek for the next couple of days. The salon is really bright (lots of natural sunlight) and airy. Just a great all around spa experience. Thanks Biz and Andra! I will definitely be back!

It's McDonalds. What can you say? I stop in most every day to grab myself an Iced Tea before work. I get one of two cashiers. One is great, warm and friendly, the other acts as if she's doing me a favour by being there. *shrug* I get it, I did my time too, but c'mon. Enthusiasm for the job, even if it's fake makes the day go by faster.

Ok, here's the deal, the pizza was really good, and a large pizza at about $20 was plenty to split between 4 people. BUT I put the rating low because our interaction with the employees was truly appalling to say the least. Three of my girlfriends and I walked in around 9:30 and the restaurant was empty, except for 4 guys sitting at the bar, and the bartender. As soon as we entered, they began obnoxiously cat-calling and making crude remarks towards us (if that's not enough, we are all only 18 and these men were clearly older than us). One of them asked my friend a question about "how she likes it" and she politely shrugged him off, to which he responded "ok, sexy b****". Now, I have been around New Orleans enough to not be shocked by this, and understand the business can't control the behavior of the customers. So, we ignored them and ordered a large margarita pizza to go. We were told it'd be about 10 minutes & sat at a table far away to wait. THEN these men got up, and went into the kitchen to start making our order!! SO IT TURNED OUT THEY WERE EMPLOYEES! Also, the guy behind the bar was just laughing at their remarks the whole time; it was just extremely uncomfortable. So if you want to go here and don't enjoy being objectified, I recommend ordering on the phone and running in to grab it. Truly disappointed in the staff but the pizza was SO GOOD! If the workers hadn't acted inappropriately I would have given them 4 stars!
The Best Cheesesteak and Italian Hoagie I ever had. Bread is cook fresh everyday in house. Plenty of meat. VERY TAISTY. I highly Recommend

Talk about a joke! If I could rate negative stars I would! This location never has anything hot and ready. I ordered ahead thinking that was the way to go but nope! I couldn't be more wrong! Almost an hour later food is still not ready, another 25 minutes in the lobby with a full house of other upset customers waiting and nothing! Terrible I will never come back to this location. Management really needs to look at this and find out where the issues are. Completely dissatisfied!

Dirty Pablo. Very good well flavored sandwich. Served hot with crispy garlic fries. Plenty of food for 9 bucks. Reminds me of a grilled cheese food truck in Nashville but with better prices and that AZ flavor we all love! Guy at the counter was very friendly and patient. Add a can of coke for a buck and you're all set! Look forward to having this food truck again. Will try the Monte Cristo next. Had trouble choosing today.

Delicious ice cream, good value, and excellent customer service. I had the banana salted caramel and the nib chocolate(?). Very tasty! I was helped by Maddi who was amazingly helpful, friendly, and genuine; some of the best people/customer service skills I've encountered in a retail shop in a long time. Hard to find these days, worth the visit just to witness it!

Cellar + Seller = Sellar.  Beer. Sellar.

Oh what's in a name?  99 beers, that's what!  I love that this place is in the middle of downtown, because now when my friends force me downtown for honky tonkin', I can find refuge in here by the end of the night!

This "hole-in-the-wall" type of establishment is exactly what I look for in a dive bar.  Plenty of beers on tap, jukebox, pool tables, friendly/attentive bartenders, and your basic run-of-the mill pub fare.  Plus, Hooters is just next door in case you want a slightly more legit menu (I said slightly).

If you're a beer lover, and you're stuck next to the Wrangler-wearin', boot struttin', Miller Lite chuggin' honky tonkers, just take a deep breath, close your eyes, and walk north!  You'll hit Beer Sellar, and you'll be glad you did.

They're so friendly!!!! We also got a great deal. I've never felt so strongly about my love for a parking business!!! Park here next time you travel!! We also never once waited for a shuttle, had the shuttle to ourselves, and had no complications / issues. They give you mini water bottles as you leave too!!!
Brent and staff made sure we left with a big smile on our faces!!! Great service and what a deal they gave us. We highly recommend this store!
Awesome hoagie! The place looks very old and dingy but the food is top notch..tried getting my oil and vinegar on the side, i was told by the owner " i have no container for that".??

I highly recommend Pell Tree Company!
I needed to remove a rotting Elm Tree in my front yard, so I decided to give them a call- John was pleasant, knowledgeable and his price was affordable. We scheduled for the following week and they completed the job in a couple of hours. I was impressed with their work and decided to have one more tree in my back yard removed (huge rotting Ash tree) and some branches from a few other trees trimmed. It was all successfully taken care of in a couple of days. 
John and his team were professional and on-point through the entire process. From the estimate, to scheduling the work, to cutting the trees, grinding the stumps, to the cleanup; they were courteous and on time. I am very happy with the entire process and the results. My yard looks great and would definitely use this service again when needed.
I've been thinking about the Tri tip sandwich since the last time I was here.  Yep.  Just as amazing as I remember!!!

This place needs to be on the list of good places to eat with a view.  Sure it's a limited view, but if you like watching people walk by, this is the spot!  Awesome food line up that looks to change daily based on fresh ingredients.  I was not even hungry when I came riding up, but the food was laid out so welcoming and warm.  It reminded me of some quaint country kitchen with pots of food, breads and the like.  Tables are on the east side of the building, so shade would not be a problem here in the evening.  It looks like they are open until 9:00, so you literally have all day to stop in here and check it out.  I guarantee anyone reading this will find at least one thing they like no matter the time.

So the cool thing is you can drive on the wooden wharf and parking for the first 90 minutes is free.    But there just isn't that much to see...  there's the Sea Center museum (small and best for kids), a few restaurants with great views but over-priced menus, and a couple of tourist trap stores.   Worth walking around a bit and maybe grab lunch (for the view), but don't count on spending more than an hour or so here.  

If the water taxi is working (it wasn't on the January weekday we were there), kill two birds with one stone and also see the Harbor - another quick stop.  In fact, if planning a Santa Barbara day, you could do both the Wharf and the Harbor with the water taxi transporting you between the two, grab lunch and have spent a nice couple of hours on the water...  then get on with your day.  

Also, don't feed the damn birds.  They're a menace.  Because people feed them.  Please don't do that.

Dined here for the 1st time Friday evening, it was busy but no wait to be seated. I was excited to try some of the unique spins on classic bar food offered on menu. Unfortunately the descriptions/concepts were better than the tastes..... hot wings & cheesy bacon tots were way over cooked and I like extra crispy wings (but did not request them cooked a certain way) they were not tossed well in sauce and came with a pool of oil/sauce on plate... In my opinion they offer creative gourmet dishes that are prepared by a cook vs. a chef with formal (or industry) training. The prices were  high for the quality/atmosphere. I love to support small local business' and may give it another chance because everywhere has an "off night" & it seems like lots of people have had great experiences. Interestingly enough my dinner company shared they were extremely disappointed on their last visit for similar reasons... but due to the lack of non-chain restaurants in the area & past better experiences selected Becker's out of geographical convenience. It didn't help that our server was not friendly and slow to accommodate a few simple requests. Again, everyone is entitled to an off night and serving is not easy so not a huge deal but this spot definitely did not meet my minimal expectations because of the above reasons.
Food is good wish the staff would smile and be more welcoming...Feels like I'm getting in their way giving them my business

I decided to buy a new car.  I researched until I found the exact car I wanted, a KIA Soul + in titanium grey.  The Kia dealership 5 minutes from my house had the car I wanted, but Gateway KIA offered the same car at a deal that my dealership could not match.  It turns out that my dealership could not match it because the car did not exist!!

My husband first spoke with Dawn, the internet sales person and was quoted an out the door price on the car I wanted.  I then called Dawn and scheduled an appointment to pick up the car the next day.  Friday morning I went to my insurance agents office, they called Gateway KIA and got the VIN  number for the car that I was purchasing.  I was all set to complete my purchase.

My son and I drove an hour to the dealership.  When we arrived, I asked to speak to Dawn.  I then asked if it was OK for my son, my transportation, to leave.  I was assured that yes, it was a done deal.  Dawn handed me off to a salesman and then was never seen again.  5 minutes after my son left, the sales manager, Ray asked me what color car I wanted, since the car I was promised was gone.  He was very rude once he found out I was not settling for another color and even asked one of the salesman to turn up the radio when I started to get loud.   

Not only did Dawn, the person who made the deal with me, never come to speak with me or apologize, but the owner, Ed, who was in the store, didn't bother either.  This is a clear case of bait and switch which is not only immorral, but illegal as well.  I am reporting them to the better business bureau.  I highly recommend that you stay away from this shady business!!!

Oh pizza, you know we have a thing. So, you'll understand why this review is this way.

I have never had Sir Pizza. So, we opted to get delivery. 

We ordered a large pizza with black olives, onions and green peppers with two sides of pizza sauce.

For $20, we got a pizza and two sides of tomato paste. The pizza literally had no flavor.

We also had no idea that we were ordering a thin crust. It would have been nice to have had that communicates to us.

For $20 for a flavorless pizza with sides of tomato paste, I would have driven to the grocery store and bought to frozen pizzas and a jar of gourmet sauce for the same price. 

We couldn't believe pizza from a pizza place could be so bad. Sorry, my taste buds are venting.

My first time to this location. I was a little disappointed to see this location doesn't offer the same yummy coffee combinations as the Northern Lib location. I ordered a apple latte and it was horrible. I didn't drink any of it, I thought my server would ask if it was ok since I never touched it but she didn't. I got the chicken and waffles, my meal was wonderful, my boyfriend ordered a sandwich with fries, his fries were so overcooked you couldn't even eat them. Between the bad drink and overcooked fries I will stay at the northern lib location from how on. I have been their several times and never had any problems

I love across the street from Bitars! They remodeled not too long ago, and there is a bigger dining room/table area. I love their falafel, but more often I stop in for hummus or another dip to go from their fridge. Top notch desserts too!
The food is great and the waitress Judy is awesome. Definitely the best experience in Philly :)

I previously wrote how great the bar staff are, the reason we go there (and they still are great), but how I'd be interested to see if ownership upped their game when American Social, the new place next door, opened up. As we all expected, ownership at Jackson's has changed nothing. Still same tired old decor, still same crappy happy hour with limited choice (Oh, and only outside, not inside - what a joke), boring music, etc etc. American Social now ticks all the boxes as the place to go to. It would be awesome if there was any indication of them trying to improve but that now seems silly to hope for. There's another new place opening up just down the street soon and with the new gastro pub going into the Marriott Waterside replacing Champs, Jackson's will further slide into the rearview mirror and truly become the venue for small prom parties and solo convention boozers - pity.
