As a SLC, Utah boy - this brewery is like Disneyland! So awesome and they were letting us try new brews they haven't even released yet! Not only are they tasty but they're local. Big fan, will come again

When the establishment was Wags My Tail I had not once but twice a horrible experience. 
Now that it's Prancin' Paws Pet Spaw I couldn't be happier. My girls love going there and they always look amazing when I pick them up. Even though I'll be moving to Oro Valley I will continue bringing the girls. 
The staff is awesome! I was thrilled when I was able to walk inside.

Love coming to Brunch here on the weekends. If you go you should probably put down the $20 and go for the bottomless drinking for 2 hour brunch. 
Usually their food is decent. I am not a fan of the All-American burger but everything else I have gotten from there has been decent.

(Visited on 12/18/15) The only reason this got 4 stars is because the place was a little too dim and the restroom was . Other than that, the bands playing were LIVE and had me rocking and bopping. The food was absolutely exquisite. Since they were the first place I ever tasted charbroiled oysters, I do not yet have a basis for comparison; but they were tasty. It was one of those hole-in-the-wall type joints that will surprise the hell out of you. oh, ohhhh, the Oatmeal Cookie cocktail... My Good Lawd it was the most orgasmic treat I have had in a very long time. I honestly believe that it cannot be out done by any other establishment.  It was like the cookie itself, but turned into pure liquid joy. I kid you not, the drink made my heart sing. I'll be back.
Was here today for a post lunch dessert. So happy and surprised they have vegan gelato!!! Yummy. And the owners wife was working and was so pleasant. I will totally be back.

My husband and I are just addicted to the food here. We get take outs here at least 2-3 times a week. The breakfast Burritos Machaca with added potatoes are the best plus the fish taco is a must!!!! Love this place. Absolutely our favorite!!!

I love Crossfit Innate! These guys (and gal) have been doing the fitness thing in Santa Barbara for several years, and as someone who has been with them *almost* since the beginning, it's been an amazing experience watching them grow and constantly improve their business to provide results for the community! Being a member of this gym is really best described as being part of the tribe - we sweat together at the daily WODs, we learn together at various community workshops (Paleo lifestyle, Stretching and Mobility, etc.), we play together (awesome challenges, Spartan Races, etc.) and we eat together (the BEST paleo potlucks in town)!! We support each other in and out of the gym, and you really can't ask for more than that!

If you are looking for a place where you can lose weight, increase strength and mobility, feel empowered, make friends, and just generally embrace a healthy lifestyle, this is your place!! The trainers have an awesome coaching style than can make any level athlete feel safely challenged, so don't worry about being new to crossfit, or fitness in general. Check out their website for more testimonials and success stories- you definitely wont regret giving them a try! See you there :)

Felix's is where it's at.  My friends and I came here to mangia on some raw oysters and mangia we did.  The wait wasn't bad at all, especially for 7 people, and the prices were decent too.  The oysters are huge, delicious, and fresh.  There is plenty of hot sauce and horseradish on the table ready to be plopped onto the oysters and the server also brings lemons with the order.  Seriously...lemon juice + horseradish + hot sauce + raw oysters = pure, unadulterated goodness.  We ended up ordering the chargrilled oysters too, and those were awesome for my friends who anyone who wants their oysters 86 slime.  

**NOLA VISIT #2:  I ended up here with the intention of going to the competition across the street this time, but you know what?  Stick with Felix's.  This place is legit.  The bartenders are hilarious, the oysters are amazing, and the turtle soup?  TO DIE FOR.  Why wait for Acme when everything you want and need is right here at Felix's BUT BETTER?**

I must have passed by this place dozens of times and walked in to oogle the pastries.  But like a good boy left before adding lbs to my frame. 
This morning my sweety and I are heading out of town...looking for a quick breakfast spot that was not McDonalds.
Cajun Kitchen had a line, so we ventured over to camino real market place. Anna'Bakery has a panini style breakfast burrito that is impressive.   I had the sausage egg and cheeze.  Impressive flavor.  They know how to make a mocha, not too hot. They also had no problem calling out "Star-Lord" when my Mocha was ready.  Deserving of the extra tip and worth half a star.
All in all, good service, good food, great price.

It was time to celebrate our wedding anniversary and we decided on Ruth's Chris Steak House.  We had reservations but the bar was fairly empty so we decided to sit there.  Plus a baseball game was on the television.  They have valet parking but we had ubered there.  There is a sign when you walk in (one of my pictures) of what you cannot wear into the restaurant.  

We shared some of their homemade potato chips and ranch dip while we looked over the menu.  I checked my previous review to make sure I didn't order the same thing.  I was filling up on the chips while he ordered a chopped salad.  We both ordered the filet with sides of corn and au gratin potatoes.  My filet was cooked perfectly.  For dessert- crème brulee which I think we fought over.  We seem to fight over a lot of desserts.  

Would I come back here?  Of course I will.  And that's the way it is.
We went for a business lunch.  The lunch was amazing and the service was over the top!  Our server was so attentive, when I left my to go/leftovers, he ran out to my car.  'Would strongly recommend!

This cafe is really wonderful.  The atmosphere is eclectic, and calm.  The people who work there are very nice, thoughtful and helpful.  The coffee drinks are FANTASTIC.  The best I have had in St. Louis, and almost anywhere, in a long time.  The food is very good.  Baked goods seriously excellent and lunch items very tasty.  I could have had more salad for my soup and salad combo, but the ingredients and flavors of both the soup and salad were truly excellent.

My stay at the Red Roof inn was decent. I stayed for a week; so my experience here is different from the average guest.

One thing i like about the inn was its location. It's located conveniently by Tampa's major highways.  The inn is walking distance literally seconds from a restaurant called the Wing House. Only way i can describe the restaurant is similar to Hooters, but in my honest opinion is much better..

I also liked the cable lineup; then again i did have the king size package. The package consisted of an extended cable line up with HBO, a mini fridge(nothing in it), an office area, and a king sized bed. The funny thing was the bed wasn't even a king it was two twins put together.
I was unsatisfied with linen on the bed so i used my own personal sheets and pillow in addition to that my own wash cloth and towel.

Other than that my stay like i said was decent. You get what you pay for but even at that you should receive some level of satisfaction after you check out.

Wouldn't stay here again.

We spent a day at the WWII Museum and were not disappointed. We took most of the day to look through the entire museum from the Pacific Theater, the European Theater and the other stuff the museum had to offer. We did not attend any of the movies that you had an option to see so I can't review that.
We had lunch in the restaurant on site and it was very good with excellent service. If you want to be amazed, take the time to visit this museum and honor those that served during that war.

One of my favorite spots in Philly. Food was always pretty solid and the drinks were food too. I found the menu to be a tad bit overpriced, but not unreasonable. The service was generally okay, and I'm glad they changed the menus. They used to have these huge menu boards that were unwieldy and cumbersome.

Ok, my first review on Yelp. I have contributed a lot to other web sites but I understand real Foodies hang out here! Haha

They also hang out at this restaurant, and for good reason. They make the effort to create interesting food and cocktails. The "smoke if you have them" drink is a lovely presentation and a delicious cocktail.  I also enjoyed the Fresco Martini.  Anytime you combine herbs and gin, I'm there! 

I had the lobster avocado appetizer as my entree. It was supposed to come with a mango coulis. About three-quarters of the way through I realized it wasn't on there and asked the waiter. He went to the kitchen to bring me some but they were out. He apologized, although we always know it's the kitchens fault, and said dessert was on him. That's the kind of apology I like.

I also had the house salad, which was delicious, and my husband had a kale salad, that he enjoyed as well. They do not serve bread here, but we askd for some. They gave us grilled sourdough, and grilled pita. Both really picked up the flavor of the wood grill, and that is always delightful as a salad accompaniment.

My husband loved the halibut, and felt it was a cacophony of flavors. We are flavor whores! Thus, it did not disappoint. Haha

Why not five stars? Well, we sat towards the back of the restaurant which apparently shares an air conditioning system with their private room. There was a large group in the private room and they were heating it up, so the restaurant opted to turn the air conditioning in that zone. Everyone around us put their jackets on and we simply froze. We did complain to the hostess and she explained the situation, which I appreciate. But, apparently the private room won out. Luckily they disbanded not long afterwards and we did not freeze to death in the end.

The restaurant is also quite loud, but that is just a testament to its clientele and the fun they're having eating and drinking. Just don't come here for some romantic dinner.

We ended up having the gooey butter cake for dessert, and it was delicious, but I am glad that we got it for free instead of paying $8 for it.
They're slow here and the owner was completely rude when I asked her for the check. After waiting 30 minutes after my party finished eating. Don't eat here, awful service.

Location location location!

That's all I have to say about this place. The menu is unimpressive, ok place to get a beer but they focus too much on their eat-in guests. (Even though this place is better as a beer joint)

Well, whatever makes more profit and keeps the turnaround quick. 


And I just saw a baby cockroach just crawled on my table ... Hope it can fly ...

This salon is amazing!!!! It's so clean and beautiful inside. The staff are soooo friendly and go out of their way to make you comfortable. I can't say enough about my nails. I love them! If you haven't already tried the salon it is definitely a must try. This will now be my go to nail salon

Atmosphere is great, the food is okay. Was my third time there and the food was just average. The waiter seemed a little distracted and kept forgetting to bring us stuff. Will definitely go there again, just for the drinks though. Love the new outdoor area and that you can bring your pups

This place is great- the mechanic (Herb is the best!) was super friendly and brought me out twice to show me different things on my car and explained everything they did. Scott at the desk was also super friendly and nice. Recommend this place highly!

The type of dining experience that the owner's themselves want you to have!

That's been my experience here...twice. I've had some of the best service around. This last time, our server was polite, funny, and very knowledgeable about the menu -- which is commendable given the length is only a tad shy of War & Peace.

Our food was perfect...the first time. No asking for a fresher or recooked side (which I do here given the fare), never waiting for a refill, and not even having to wonder if the server was ever coming back.

Another impressive experience -- we asked for a booth (I despise their small, uncomfortable chairs). The hostess said she didn't think they had one, and then offered to go check (just as I was about to ask her to). She arrived back a minute later and said she'd found one and would seat us. From someone who's worked in food service...I completely understand table/section rotation...and the need to spread out customers...except for when customers request a table. Then...I don't effin care. Never have, never will. Restaurant staff too obsessed with their operational politics are an immediate turn-off for me...I've walked out of places on people who try to excuse it.
Love this place !  Been there twice and enjoyed the good and great service.  Get the sticky rice coconut with mango for dessert -  amazing!!!
LOVE LOVE LOVE this place!!  Had tried other lash places and these ACTUALLY stay!! And love the warm girly glamour decor

I have to admit, I'm somewhat baffled by all of the poor reviews for this restaurant.  Generally speaking, I stay away from the "cool / overpriced" restaurants.  I want a great meal and a good value - I'm not concerned about being around the shiny people.

When I made my reservation for Ocean Prime, I was concerned that I was breaking my shiny person rule and was about to spend too much money for a very average meal.  I was wrong, or at least partially wrong.

I agree with the comments about the red carpet and the velvet rope.  Neither item is really necessary for me to find the front door.  Likewise, the mandatory valet is a little over the top.  Having said that - so what!  

The bar area was very nice with big strong drinks.  As everyone mentions - they are expensive.  Overall, nice experience in the bar.

As for dinner, the meal was terrific!  Great steaks and great appetizers.  The service was spot on.  Really - nothing to complain about.

In closing - Ocean Prime wants to be a shiny person place and goes to great lengths to give you the shiny feel.  You are going to pay a little extra for the experience - but from the bar to the meal to the service, I found it to be worth the extra money.  I'll go back!

Finally found a delicious and AFFORDABLE sushi restaurant! The menu is big and also offers bubble tea. The sushi is great quality taste for a low price. 11-3 is two sushi rolls for $7.85 (not the fancy ones) 
Great, Friendly customer service. 
I was able to get 2 rolls (spicy crab and Philadelphia roll) + OOLONG milk tea + popcorn chicken appetizer for only $20.00
 
This is definitely my new spot!

This was my first visit after stumbling upon a menu at work. It immediately caught my attention when I saw there were dairy free options (my husband is lactose intolerant). It is slightly hidden, but when we found it, I instantly loved the space. We had the lunch special that day,  zucchini pasta with marinara and it was phenomenal. My husband had the burger wrap and it made the perfect lunch portion. We were offered samples of the chocolate mousse, which was also great. I feel like there is not a bad option on the menu and the staff was great. We will definitely be back.

Absolutely amazing!  Our waiter was attentive, knowledgeable, and very nice.  The food - wow the food is AWESOME.  The baked aged parmesan small plate served with honey and crostini was to die for...how can something so simple be THAT good??
Two of us got the lamb shank which was cooked to perfection (falling off the bone, melt in your mouth perfection).  The other two got some sort of steak and sausage - I tried both and they were equally delicious.  
The two bottles of wine we ordered were outstanding.  So good, in fact, that my boyfriends Dad had a case shipped to his house.  
Amis has such a great atmosphere; we had a fantastic time and will definitely be back.  Hands down one of the best restaurants in Philly!  Certainly one of my favorites.

Stopped here on our way back to Cincinnati from Milwaukee! 

Nice little find! We had shrimp spring rolls, tempura shrimp and veggies and Pho.

Very authentic and filled with Vietnamese patrons, so it must be good!

It was VERY good, worth the stop!

I've had a perfectly lovely beet soup, an amazing bacon whole grain mustard on half a grilled romaine heart salad, a nice fig and goat cheese tart on filo topped w/ microgreens, a nice crispy skinned trout, and some nice moo. Also some relatively average tomato and fish plates, an average duck confit. A terrific pot de creme, an average chocolate cake.The menu changes daily but relatively slowly- a few new things add on and a few things drop off.

Service has been friendly and competent for me. Space includes two tables for two larger groups, but it's mostly 2-4 tops, be sure to make a reservation. Actually, even if you're a smaller party, call ahead if you're going at prime time. Handicapped accessible into the dining room- the bathroom might have a step and the pathways are narrow for wheelchairs.

I come to Franks pretty frequently and the quality still stays really good. It's a nice mom and pop kind of place that serves all kinds of Italian food and its really good. I usually get the pizza and fettucini alfredo and its very good. This time I got some mozzarella sticks to start and they're pretty good. My main meal was a Philly cheesesteak which tasted extremely good. For dessert I got some fried dough balls (I'm not really sure what they're called because its in Italian). But those were exceptional! It tasted like I was going to the fair eating a funnel cake. The service is great as usual and the food is very good. Definitely deserving of a 5.
Had a great lunch outside on a pleasant weather day - fantastic and friendly service - delicious burgers and fries
Welcome to reno!  Burger Me delivers amazing food with great service.
Amazing food! Sushi is fresh and the Thai chicken is excellent as has a good proportion. I will be making this my sushi place for sure.

I needed a garment tailored extremely quickly for an event and Master Tailor & Cleaners was able to get the job done. I won't say how fast it took the tailor or what the garment was, because if I did, he'd be getting all kinds of ridiculous requests. (He mentioned he's already at work until midnight many nights!) But, needless to say, he did a perfect job and I will definitely be returning for all of my tailoring / mending.

Twice in the last few months I've picked up my order and found items were missing when I got home. Both times I called in and spoke to a manager who promised a refund; the first time I never received the refund. When I called Sunday after it happened again, the manager stated that really disturbed him and offered to comp the entire check because of my experience. I thanked him and asked for a receipt which he claimed he couldn't give because of their new system but promised he'd take care of it immediately.

This morning I checked my account and not only did he not refund my entire order, he didn't even refund the item we never received. 

Carside is convenient, but if you're consistently paying for things you don't get, it's not worth it. Unfortunately we won't patronize Chuy's again.

EDIT: I emailed Corporate and contacted the general manager, Alex, on Tuesday. He apologized and promised to take care of the refund personally that day and mail my receipt. He claimed he'd email his contact info so I could message him if I had problems with the credit.

As of Friday, I had no refund, no receipt, no contact info, no call to update the status. I emailed Corporate again and got a call back from Alex explaining my refund never processed because he needed my security code.

So instead of contacting me to ASK for the code, Chuy's continued to ignore the problem and never followed up. After pressing him about my receipt, he admitted he had delegated the responsibility of the refund to someone else, had no clue if my receipt had ever been mailed, and acknowledged he didn't verify my refund had been processed. I also spoke with my bank who checked--no refund had ever been initiated on Tuesday. 

It's fine to be apologetic about misleading customers but when you make a habit of it, don't expect them to return. I won't. I now have a new refund receipt after confronting them on Friday when they finally processed it, but still no credit in my account. I ended up having to file the formal dispute with my bank. 

Like I told the general manager--please process my refund as you promised and you have my solemn word you'll never see or hear from me again. Chuy's has certainly seen the last of us.

This place is the "Cheers" of Medford.  Great interior and atmosphere.  Food is decent, not spectacular.  More like solid bar food.  French onion soup is a mainstay here.  The chili is hearty and spicy. Burgers are not bad.  Sunday's during football season are usually packed with fans.  Good neighborhood hang out spot.

This place is adorbs. It made me miss all the farm-to-table places back in NYC. Cocktails are tasty and the amount of charcuterie is out of this world. Their famous scallops-in-a-cigar-box was a little hokey for me, but they cooked the scallops perfectly. The duck dish was so damn salty, it was inedible (and I like LOTS of salt). I would have sent it back, but I was on a first date and the other party was paying.  Portions are huge, except the desserts are really tiny. Our waiter had so much knowledge on the dishes, ingredients and techniques.
Amazing service, amazing subs.

Refined comfort food, impeccable yet unpretentious pizza, and amazing hospitality. You want their secret? Buy the book -- Pizza Camp. Joe Beddia is a class act, a master of elevated humble food. Chic but functional environment with equally chic and functional service. I love this place. Good vibes!

The place was mobbed with a line literally out the door.

My espresso was delicious. I didn't eat. It looks like they cater to vegans. Lots of items clearly marked as vegan.

The staff is an absolute joy. I asked the barista his name and it's Carlos. Kudos to you, Carlos. You are awesome in the face of desperate people being cranky.

We went on a Sunday at noon and it was very busy. We were greeted at the door and our reservation was made quickly and notifications were sent to my phone- very efficient! Inside was very busy with many tables and booths but we did not feel crowded. Food and beverage selection is extensive with different juice options for mimosas (only $4!!). Food was prepared quickly and tasted amazing. Portions were large and prices were small. Wait staff was incredibly attentive without being overbearing. A few things like silverware and syrup fell through the cracks due to the rush but staff was apologetic and quick to help. This is the first diner I've found in Florida that has the diner-esque atmosphere like diners in the North East. We will definitely be back!

Not the best. We went in on a Saturday night and were greeted by no one. we sat at the bar. it took quite a while to get greeted. we noticed there were regulars who all knew the bartender by name that were getting service... but not us. There were maybe 4 tables with guests in the whole place. We finally ordered a drink and our food. Great draft beer selection though.
Food took about 45 minutes to come out. 
Also it was a VERY SMOKEY place! We noticed on the advertisements we saw it said "Now Non-Smoking!" but it certainly is not.
Bathrooms were also in really poor condition. Not worth the $$$. We wont be back.

We dined here for my husband's 50th Birthday on November 2, 2015. I was able to submit reservations online a week prior. I had written that we liked courtyard seating and that he was celebrating his 50th. I also called them the day before to confirm. When we first arrived at the restaurant I thought it was very impressive with many staff members and beautiful courtyard. They tried to seat us at the first table walking into the courtyard. We asked if we could have another table since we could here all the commotion from the kitchen...so they accommodated and sat us a few tables over. Our waiter Thomas was an elderly gentlemen nice but it seemed like he was awkward and new at his job. The food was not great. We were all very disappointed. I had the crab and shrimp penne, my brother in law had the pork chop, my sister had a vegetarian dish and my husband had the Louisiana Crab Au Gratin and the BBQ Shrimp. Out of all the restaurants we could have picked for this special dinner we picked this one and was very disappointed. I have had far greater food for 1/2 the price. Since I had given the staff a weeks notice for my husbands celebration dinner I would have thought they could have at least brought him a slice of cake and said Happy Birthday. Would only recommend this place for maybe a drink and see the courtyard.

Just drank here so I can't really comment on the food. But the service was slower than most Florida drivers. Nice outdoor patio though, right on Gulf Blvd. and the best part is, just a short drive from Vito and Michael's!

I'd go back and try the food. Even though the reviews on here are scary, it kind of looked good. Of course, head cheese would look good after a day of drinking.
Actually tried this place out. Sandwich was ok. Seems like a popular spot during lunch for the local office workers.

Pretty good sushi. The chefs were very friendly, and FAST! The fish was fresh and the presentations were attractive. I found the sauces that dressed the rolls I had a bit bland and administered with a little too light a hand, but for the $18.95 allyoucan-eat dinner price it was a good deal and we all left happy. I tried several rolls, including the Godzilla Roll, Caterpillar Roll, Unagi Roll, Nevada Roll, and and 007 Roll. The combinations of textures and flavors was inspired. I loved the hot mussels.

Ordered Pud Thai for lunch special with my father who was here for my college graduation. My father had the chicken curry and fried tofu platter with rice. It was a lot of delicious food for the both of us for a great price. I definitely suggest their lunch specials. A great atmosphere with the place and great service. Will definitely be back!

What a treat! We are so glad to have found this hidden gem. We are high risk for Covid and this was our first meal out in over 7 months. Thank you thank you thank you for finding a way to share yummy and fresh food with us safely during these hard times. I felt so safe at this restaurant from ordering, to food delivery, to food prep. The staff were very kind and worked hard to make sure our meal was delicious and safe! The food is fresh and tasty, the atmosphere friendly, and the space open and clean. You can order, eat, and clean all while safely outdoors, but they also provide several great covered outdoor areas for the rainier days.  I highly recommend Peachtree Drive-In! Thank you to the staff, being able to have a little "day out" at your restaurant was a real blessing to us.

My husband and I love Kilwins!! They're also located near Anna Maria Island- we go to both spots! My favorite ice cream is the sea salt and chocolate caramel, and my husband gets the Superman one. They have amazing fudge their too and other chocolate goodies. I highly recommend!

I was looking for some used tires, but wanted a solid deal at a good price. The guys at Bob's were very friendly and the service was fast. They actually let me know 2 of my tires were still in great shape and just needed rotated. So they were more concerned with great customer service, than making that almighty dollar. Most places would have tried their best to sell me, sell me, sell me... Bob's is hands down the best prices and service around! If going to their location on Ulmerton, stop by Seminole Subs and Gyros as well. Hands down the best Gyro I have ever had, and I have tried them all over the States! The guys at Bob's suggested it and they were on point! Great experience at both places and they have earned my business from now on! 5 HUGE STARS!!!!!!!

I wish I could give this place zero stars. 

I've been to this establishment several times and had the worst experience by far on Father's Day. I made the mistake of coming with my family to celebrate and ended up having the worst service. We had a party of 8 of us and was sat fairly quickly for not making any reservations and just walking in. Our server Karen was friendly at first. Deciding to get a pitcher of HOUSE margaritas, because 6 of us wanted one, we let Karen know. She said that wouldn't be enough to serve 6 people. So we then ordered two. Taking roughly 20 minutes or so she brought out two wildly different sized pictures, the first completely filling all six mugs with some to spare. 

It took about 30-45 minutes to even be able to place our order with Karen after being sat. Once we had ordered it took another 45-50 or so minutes to bring out our food. We were brought half the order then waited a few more minutes the brought PART of the other half. I never received my rice, beans, and tortillas that came with my fajitas. I asked once and still never got anything so one of the other people shared theirs with me. 

Karen this whole time never one time came back to table touch, check if we wanted refills on drinks, or anything else the entire rest of the time until she came back asking if we wanted desert. At this point we were fully and just wanted to check out. She brought our bill and when we checked it she had upcharged us to premium margarita pitchers for $40 verses the $22 we had asked for. I being a server know how to order beverages and clearly know what we had said. So I went to Karen to fix the mistake. She then lied straight to my face and said she confirmed with "the man on the end" that we wanted the premium one. This was a complete lie because I was sitting right next to him when he ordered it and said nothing about the upgrade to "Chihuahua's" margaritas with Patron. 

I went back to the table because she said she would talk to her manager. When she came back to the table she said she would pay $30 out of her own pocket to cover part of the mistake. At this point we're all livid and say that's clearly not enough and clearly untrue because no employer makes a sever pay for a mistaken order rang it. Already very angry we confronted with how she never even brought the side plate and tortillas for the fajitas... she said yes I did.  We enforced no, letting her know some one else had to share with her.  She said she would look at the bill again.

Now another random person Baron? In a different, brightly colored shirt comes over and table touches our table asking how everything was, we respond terrible and he chuckles and then asks if we want shots. Why would that be a response at all when we are all clearly very mad. The mid sentence speaking to him he turns around and walks away. If this is the manager he was completely unprofessional and super rude. 

Next, another server comes up with a plate of flan for desert, which we clearly didn't order. Still waiting for Karen to come back one of the other guests I was with went to go find her so we could just pay and leave. We end up just running our cards, not again receiving an itemized copy. 
 
As we walked out Karen was nowhere to be found. Terrible service and mediocre food. Don't come here unless you want to be scammed and ripped off.

Simple, classic diner food. Delicious with a colorful clientele. Very busy Saturday and Sunday, open until 2pm, and CASH ONLY. Perfect turkey clubs, fresh burgers, and outstanding breakfast. I go once a day (though i often forget to check in!) Be nice to the waitstaff, they're the best around!

MRKT is my all-time favourite downtown lunch spot. Their soups and sandwiches are amazing, and the prices are decent. $14 for a soup, sandwich and can of soda. I recently tried their white fish chowder, and it was incredible. I've had all three of their regular sandwiches, and I can't choose a favourite. 

The interior reminds me of being in the hull of a ship. It's very cool. The only downside is it gets pretty loud in there, because the place is always packed. Get there early, or you won't get a seat.

Be sure to check them out on Twitter. They tweet their features daily.

Peche has been on my radar for a while, but I'm not a HUGE seafood person. It took a birthday request to actually get me there last night, but I'm so glad I did!

Our experience:

+Immediate seating for reservations (we even arrived early!)
+Simplistic, beautiful decor
+Team of servers that were all quick, personable, & friendly
+Every bite of food = FRESH & DELICIOUS 
(our table ordered: crab claws, oysters, tuna dip, whole red snapper, brussel sprouts, potatoes, spicy green beans, and Chicken Diablo with summer squash)
+Variety of seating/dining options (regular bar, raw oyster bar, and tables)

-Super LOUD environment (hard to communicate at our small table for 4)
-Oysters from the raw bar are priced per, but you must order by increments of 6
-Price-point was on the high end for some menu items

*NOTE: When making reservations you must leave a credit card number. If your party is a no show, you will be charged $25/pp.

I'll be back again and probably soon - even if it's just for a few specialty drinks and those crab claws!

All I ordered was one fish taco and one shrimp taco. They both arrived piping hot and looked delicious. I was expecting a batter on the fish but it was grilled and it was good but the shrimp taco was amazing. I could not believe how many shrimp they fit on that street taco. They were cooked perfectly and seasoned just right. I will be back for many more of those!

I've been eyeing this place ever since one of my friends posted about them on Snapchat. We finally decided to stop by and was very impressed with the place. There was only person in line when we arrived so everything was pretty quick. They had so many choices, too. I decided to order a custom bowl. I had forgotten what toppings I had with it but I got the salmon as my protein. Maybe I hyped it up too much in my head but I wasn't that impressed. The rice was just meh and the salmon along with the toppings didn't provide much flavor. I didn't hate it but I didn't love it either.

Stopped in for a quick lunch prior to an EIFF screening at the adjacent cinema. 

We sat on the "patio" as the main pub is as dark as a dungeon.

Ordered the beef dip with fries and a coke. Coke was flat and warm (as were all of the soft drinks ordered). Fries were soggy. Beef dip was bland, underseasoned, and served on a soggy roll with a greasy slice of cheese. Even the dill pickle was awful.

My dining companions expressed little enthusiasm about their meals (Shepherd's Pie and Thai Chicken Salad). From what I could see, the portions were large, but neither look particularly appetizing to me. Prices were reasonable.

Service was relatively attentive, but it was noon at Sunday and the pub was not busy.

This place is nice, but not my favorite. The atmosphere is weird, the colored lights on the ceiling and behind the sushi bar are not my idea of great lighting and are actually really distracting. Service isn't great. The first time I came in I ordered the sushi lunch entree or sushi dinner entree, can't remember how late it was. What came out was really beautiful, piled high with all kinds of fantastic fish; because it was the sushi boat special for two. And I paid for it. The second time I came in I waited two whole hours (a friend timed it) for food beyond edamame and it took my friend complaining to get two drinks comped. When it came out though, everything was delicious.

I know a lot of people that really like this place, so I'm willing to give it another chance, and I have been since then and had nothing wrong, but nothing spectacular enough to make me forget the first two times. For me, this place is hit or miss, and would never be my choice on Friday night.
Like searching through your grandmothers attic and finding treasures around every corner! Great little place for bargain hunters and DIYers!!

AM party bus was the biggest disappointments on my wedding day. To start with the driver was unprofessional and unhelpful. He made my bride walk a block and a half to the bus (for no reason) and watched her struggle to get on the bus in her wedding dress while eating chicken wings. The bus was dirty and barely functional. The driver was confused and did not know where any of the predetermined locations were and took over an hour to get from downtown to Audubon park. The bus itself had nothing working. The lights and sound system were "broken". The air conditioning units did not work and had wires hanging from them on the ceilings. The bathroom was a bucket with toilet paper. There was suppose to be water, ice and cups provided, but that did not happen. The plush leather seats were hard and uncomfortable. The hardwood floor was laminate which was splitting apart. Overall this was the worst experience of my wedding day. Finally the owners were not available to discuss these grievances for over a week.
The WiFi didn't work and the barista was unconcerned about the customers. This place was much better when it was La Va.
Nice place in downtown Zionsville.   Solid steak/seafood selections.    Gets busy at times but service is good

Asshole bartender labeled me as someone born in the 90s and made a joke to his friends about how people born in the 90s can't speak.  

What he doesn't understand.  Is I'm 35 born in 85. I have a speech impediment from LOSING MY TONGUE TO STAGE 3 CANCER.    so yes wearing this mask it's hard to understand me but i wear it.  And unfortunately he's wearing his below his nose.   Picture to prove that FYI.  

Never again.

** also he'd know my age if asked for my ID and i get asked for my ID most places.
One of the best steaks you will get in middle Tennessee! The owner always come out and checks on the quality of food.

I read previous reviews that this place was dirty.  Not quite true, the air was a bit stale, but not totally unpleasant..  This was a WW II theater which was converted into a bathhouse.  It's creaky, and in desperate need of a makeover.

You may want to bring your own towel, unless you are a petite flower.  Larger girls forget it.  I went back twice.....still no big towel.  

I wanted to try this place out, I did and probably won't go back.  

I am sure this place makes decent money.  Just take some of that profit and spruce it up, please!

This is one of the best Vietnamese restaurants in the Tampa Bay area. 12 of us ate there yesterday at noon. The menu is spectacular. There are all kinds of sushi, surimi and many other items to choose from, and at very reasonable prices. Just go look at the menu. You'll be amazed. Another thing: the management and staffing is friendly an knowledgeable of their restaurant's offerings. Oh, by the way, the bar is fully stocked to your heart's desire. One thing that really struck me was the chef came to our table to ask us what thought of the restaurant and if we had questions about the food. A perfect experience!

Pay attention to all the one star reviews - they are correct. Absolutely the worst customer service I've ever experienced anywhere. Even when you speak to someone who appears to know what they are talking about, you'll find out after you hang up that whatever they said or promised does not happen.

This is a fairly new business and if you are looking for anything for your home aquarium this is the place to go.   Friendly and knowledgeable staff will help you find what ever you need and if they don't have it they can order for you.

Get the truffle philly cheese steak! So good, but also greasy (what do you expect). Service was really nice and helpful. They brought us our food and even cleaned our table!

It you post a picture to Instagram with their tags or order online, you get free fried Oreos!
Worst place ever I picked up my food and got all the way home and wasn't even the correct items that I ordered. I wouldn't recommend nobody to come here

Holy sushi roll. 

This place is tiny, yet such a gem. You walk in and are immediately greeted. You're given menus and a paper to mark what you'd like to order and are relived because you won't have to wait long for food. They are heavily staffed for the amount of tables there are, so you'll never have to wait more than a minute for your water to be filled or more than ten minutes for your food. 

-Miso Soup: yummy, warm, only $2, delivered to the table within 2 minutes

-Red Dragon rolls: incredible, filled with tuna & avocado, mild

-Christmas rolls: heard they're a favorite, yet spicy 

There's a small, personal room off the front of the restaurant that houses a huge round booth, covered in cool shag carpet. Wow, I'd love to be cool enough to sit in there!
Everything here is amazing. The atmosphere and all of the choices of food are so diverse it is almost impossible to chose!

The best Italian good I've ever had. I grew up a mile from here and never ventured in. Returned to FL for a short trip and old neighbors took me here. I am so pleased they did. This place is EXCELLENT. I will eat here every time I return to Tampa. I had the veal limone with risotto. Boyfriend had penne arabiatta. We also ordered calamari-it was pan seared with a marinara sauce- not the typical fried stuff. Every morsel of every dish ordered was incredible. The service was impeccable as well! A must try!

Came here for brunch this past Sunday and was definately pleased! Service was spectacular and food was delicious. Also, mimosas and bloody marys are half price during brunch. :-)

Lox n bagel...AMAZING! It was one of my favs there that day. They had salad, fruit salad, pasta salad (wasn't too fond of this one), eggs benedict (mmmm), scrambled eggs, turkey and pork sausage, bacon, home fries, french toast, waffles, omlette station (which I did not have a chance to eat bc I was overstuffed), swedish meatballs, salmon, fried chicken, bbq chicken, etc etc etc. There were plenty more, but I'm sure you rather just go there and find out for yourself. Oh, don't forget to use the apple cinnamon butter they have right next to the french toast area. OMG!!!! MMMMMM. 

I will be back! See you soon

Awesome sushi!!!

Ordered the Super Mexican roll to satisfy my pregnancy craving... WOW I'll be back! They add 2 samples of other cooked rolls... Delish! I'll be back post-pregnancy for the real stuff! 

Ambiance- great inside! It's in a strip mall, but DO NOT be put off by this.

Worst McDonalds I ever go to. Pulled up with a mobile order, waited 10+ minutes only to go inside and be told the drive through people were ignoring the order but the front would make it for me. 30 minutes later I left with "fast food". I guess dropping nuggets really is rocket science.  And after I left I discovered my unsweet tea was the most rancid I've ever had so I had nothing to drink. Huge disappointment.

Will be back as soon as I can, not just a unique and welcoming atmosphere but offers fresh brews and fantastic dishes to match. My friend and I sampled just the poutine and some drinks quickly coming to full faith in the dinner menu even tho we weren't late enough for it! The poutine was perfect tho for the price one might wish for more like the donation box on Sundays. Can't fault my flight at all! What a great option of two ingredient style cocktails to add in especially treating those enjoying beer in a reformed service. My friend's house made sangria was just like the water turned to wine ages ago, the best stuff. We regretted not being hungry enough to try the authentic sausage sampler, leaves many reasons to come back to increase our faith, friendly service, plenty of space, easy parking unlike most downtown spots, and that menu all good variety and things I want to try.

I'm unsure if cash and card are accepted since I got a Groupon, but I paid $31 for a 90-minus swamp tour for 2 people via Groupon. If you need transportation you can arrange for a pick-up and drop-off for $20/person (roundtrip).

I ordered a Groupon and was able to easily book the tour day and time and pick-up via the phone. On the day of the tour the bus came to pick us up a little late, but it was a big, nice, comfortable bus with A/C and a funny driver. The driver was also a really talented singer.

When we got to Jean Lafitte we checked in and got a boarding ticket for the regular swamp tour. Once we boarded for the tour the captain gave us the safety features and instructions. Before we even left the dock we could see a couple small alligators swimming up and down the swamp.

The captain was really entertaining and could point out the alligators easily. I sat on the left side and felt like we saw more alligators than the people on the right in the beginning of the tour (when the boat turns around the people on the right saw more because we went back the way we came).

I think my favorite part was being able to hold a baby alligator. It was so cute and really soft, surprisingly. 

I would recommend this tour and would recommend going towards the later afternoon. (The tour guide said alligators are nocturnal so they're more active at night.) Don't forget to tip your tour guide!!

This was THE best hotdog I have EVER had!  The hotdog was wrapped in bacon.  Topped with beans, fresh and grilled onions, mustard, and other yummy goodness.  I stopped on there on a road trip to Los Angeles and ordered one.  It was so good, I stopped again on my way back from LA and ordered TWO!  The staff is nice and friendly.  Its an upgraded hotdog stand so you'll sit outside under a covered patio that's quite comfortable.  There's parking in the back.  ENJOY!

This place is a gem. The food is delicious and the people are so friendly and genuinely nice. It was the very first place where my husband and I went out to dinner when we moved to Reno a couple years ago, and has become a regular takeout place for us. Our go-to is the house fried rice, the xo green beans with pork, and the five spice chicken wings. The eggplant and general chicken dishes are also great. We always order extra rice for leftovers. I feel safe picking up takeout because of their COVID-related practices.

We would highly recommend Pete to anyone who is wine tasting in the area.  He was very flexible, worked with us, very professional, and LOTS of fun.  He know the area, and we were in a Lincoln town car taxi.  Pete knows the best and least crowded places - places my husband and I missed when we did our own tour.  I highly recommend Pete - great service and great value!
Great service. Lovely ambiance. Fresh and delicious oysters. $1 oysters after 5 pm on a Thursday. Ordered 3 dozens for 5 people. The oysters that day were Blue Points. Killed it!

This week,I was fortunate enough to return to Saint Louis and the delightful Saint Louis Art Museum in beautiful Forest Park.This art museum is very comprehensive and it is free,but support from the public helps it maintain its very high standards.This review encompasses its awesome collection of European paintings from the Late Medieval Period(Spinello Aretino,Master of San Torpe)up to the 20th Century(Pablo Picasso,Piet Mondrian).I spent 2 full days in this special art museum.Personal favorites were;Spinello Aretino's"Madonna and Christ Child Enthroned With Angels"(Late Medieval),Lorenzo Di Niccolo's"Madonna and Christ Child With Saints Sebastian,Francis,Blaise,and Christopher"(Late Medieval),Jan Mostaert's"Christ Shown to People"(Northern European Renaissance),Jan Van Dornicke's"Marriage of Virgin"(Renaissance),Juan de Valdes Leal's"Conversion and Baptism of Saint Augustine"(fine Mannerism),Aelbert Cuyp's"Panoramic Landscape With Shepherds"(Dutch Master),Giovanni Paolo Pannini's"Saint Peter's Cathedral,Rome"(18th Century),Hubert Robert's"Obelisk"(Neoclassical),Gustave Dore's"Loch Lomond"(Romantic),Jean Leon Gerome's"Sentinel at Sultan's Tomb"(Oriental),Henri Harpignies'"Village Church"(Realism),Claude Monet's"Promenade With Railroad Bridge,Argentieul"(Impressionistic),Vincent Van Gogh's"Factories At Clichy'(Expressionistic),Maximillian Luce's"Camaret,Moonlight and Fishing Boats"(Pointillism),Paul Delvaux'"Fire"(Surrealism),Max Beckmann's"Bathers"(German Expessionism),Ernst Ludwig Kirschner's"Basel on the Rhine River"(Expressionism),Max Pechstein's"Sunset"(Expressionism),and Pablo Picasso's"Mother"(Blue Period painting).I also appreciated the excellent curatorial work at this art museum and the excellent lighting.

Holy cow. Can't eat just one!! I tried both the maple bacon mini doughnut and the guava cream cheese this morning and they were amazing! Thank God I don't live or work near this place. I would be tempted to splurge every single day! I'm officially a fan!!

Very disrespectful to my friend and I while staying there because he had too many guest coming up to his room , later they found out there was only two people in his room & every guest that had visited earlier had already left they did not apologize just threatened to kick him out. He is a businessman and often has women come and visit because he does own a clothing line he adheres to all policies. It was so disrespectful and rude very disappointed in this experience

Rooftop bar, while offering great views of the city, had abysmal service. Bartenders couldn't have been more disinterested. Not that crowded but these guys had no energy. Like it was a chore to even give me an answer to question. Who trains these people? 

Saw the Catahoula Rooftop Bar from looking over the side and ventured over there. Very cool!
Good food. They seem to get overwhelmed with large crowds....They were definitely understaffed during Sunday afternoon brunch. Drinks are strong.
Great mimosas and wonderful brunch. The eggs Benedict with avocado was delicious! Also a great place for shrimp and grits!! Nice place!

Holy breakfast! Love the options here! My favorite is the Philly Benedict with poached eggs instead of scrambled. My friend got the most amazing cinnamon French toast with sautéed walnuts, bananas, Amaretto, and brian sugar. Great service. Yummy food! Quick seating! The check out was a little slow but MaryAnne herself is there to great you!

Great service, great old time diner feel.  Had the eggs, hash brown with biscuit and side of gravy.  "The best hash brown I ever ate".... My husbands exact words.   The sausage patty was amazing... Real homemade taste. Coffee perfect also!!  I must do whenever your in the area!  Thanks!
Wonderful service, beautiful ambiance, and delicious coffee! We got the horchata latte and caramel macchiato!  Both drinks came w/ a chocolate covered espresso bean!

Have been using them for almost 6 months and I will NOT be back. The gel continuously chips and peels off within 7-10 days and it's $30+ just for polish! The pedicures have turned my toenails YELLOW!!! They haven't used base coat and another nail salon (back in my home state) mentioned it to me that my nails are turning yellow and that is why. In addition to this every pedicure I have had here is not great quality. I leave covered in oil with rough feet. I mean the run the pumice over my foot once. I have calluses on my toes and they say they don't need to be pumiced. Okay. I've had pedicures where top coat isn't even on half of the nail. Not great quality and no customer service for a lot of money honestly.
Great company to work with! Austin was very easy to work with. I will definitely do more business with them and I highly recommend giving them a chance.
beautiful space. friendly staff provides wonderful service. nice wine list. flavorful tapas. prices on the high end for this neighborhood.

Ok. So, 

1. Love the bartender Chelsea.
2. However, we have had several failed attempts trying to come here with a kid.

Last year, we tried to come here when my daughter was sleeping in a stroller and the hostesses head damn near popped off her body. She asked if we could collapse the stroller and take my daughter out of it. Anyone with a 1 yr old knows this is a joke. We laugh about it. 

Today, we saw a table open outside and tried to speak to a hostess. We were ignored for a full 7 minutes. It seems she was training another hostess but I guess it's so important you can ignore customers? And then my stroller proceeded to be run over in staff member carrying a crate. 

Your food and margs are good but not that good.

Slightly tough lamb kabobs over a bed of rice that I had to salt, ironically however, it came with very salty pickled veggies. There was also fatoush which is a salad with house made dressing and I had to salt that too. I wasn't sure about getting seated at first but I finally was able to by the owner's daughter (I think). The other hostess/waitress seemed clueless on interacting with new visitors and about the menu. There is an open mic on Thursdays and that made for an interesting first encounter with the restaurant; people were pretty cool for the most part, singing and reading poetry. Hookah is also available, though I personally would rather be associated with it; I would've dined outside but all the tables with umbrellas were taken and there was a little precipitation outside. I looked forward to my dessert but it was unfortunate; the philo on the baklava had no crisp at all. It may have been too old. Overall, it wasn't a terrible experience. It may have been better if I had arrived earlier, but my flight brought me to St. Louis and I ended up having dinner here at 9p.  I did think it was overpriced for what I ended up receiving and experiencing. Maybe they could work on consistency as I notice other folks really enjoyed their time here.

I expect an ultrasound tech to educate the patient and parent throughout an extensive ultrasound procedure. It's uncomfortable when a tech is all up in your child's groin and no word is uttered. Complete and utter silence. Awkwardly silent.  My son and I are naturally curious folks looking to understand his body and the importance of this procedure. We knew that there is a 1 cm lump in his right vas deferens and we would like to know the details along the way. The tech who saw us was rigid and flat out refused to utter a single word throughout the entire ghastly affair while pressing the wand looking to take extensive screen shots of my child's insides. 

This procedure was an undignified experience as one was told to wait, sit down, and not utter a word. Just wanted to know ....what side are you looking at the left or the right vas deferens? Basically as the parent of the minor all I was good for was to ensure the tech didn't get sued for being alone in the room with my child. How about you inform me what part of my Son's body you are looking at with that wand? 

On a lighter note, the reason for an additional star was Shelly, the front receptionist, who was very hospitable and made the visit pleasant giving information to most patients including ourselves. She treated us with respect and gave us necessary disclosure. My advice to anyone coming to this imaging center is to go straight to Shelly. 

If you are like me, and like the procedure explained in details, ask for someone who informs along the way.  My son had a testicular/scrotum ultrasound where the ultrasound technician failed to educate and inform his clients with basic anatomy information.  Providing quality medical service isn't in line with keeping patients in ignorance. Educating patients and their guardians is mandatory! Hire motivated employees who are personable and highly professional.

I thought this place would be horribly expensive, but if you eaten at enough nice restaurants in the area you see that that their prices are just and your portions are more than appropriate.

Me and my friend had a luttle reservation mix up since I was running late but they were able to accommodate the reservation change and we were seated as soon as we arrived.  Since the server waiting on us hadn't expected our early arrival for our changed reservation there was a little delay in beibg attended to, but once it caught their attention we received spectacular service.  All of the waitstaff in the area attended to our needs whether they were assigned to our table or not. Me and my friend are not anyone special but felt very important with the service we retrieved afterwards. 
Oh yeah and the food was fabulous!
 I will definitely visit thus resturant again very soon.
Really great sushi and certainly a new lower Main Line go to. I just wish that they had a more organized way to pickup takeout!

Absolutely phenomenal. Must get the three way beef, pork belly, frutti di mare, and pork chop. I'm a local and this will be on my rotation of restaurants to go to for client meetings or special occasions. The owner was there and was incredibly friendly as well. Highly recommend.

A home away from home. Since its debut in Tucson, it took me several visits to actually warm up to this place. I found the architecture was way off for the desert landscape and the property was too typical in its Southwestern decor....but then after a few overnight stays and full days at the pool, the serenity of this place took over. The Ritz at Dove mountain is understated and serene. The customer service is excellent, the location is second to none and really....you can get a GREAT nights sleep here. I love, love, love the  beds here. The rooms are a little on the cozy side for a Ritz, but quality is not compromised. The beds are like a cloud, the bathrooms are super spacious, the products are  fab, and the intimate size of the property makes it extra special, it really feels like you're on vacation, even for one night at this place. As expected, the rooms are clean as a whistle. Several dining areas, a coffee shop, and the spa make it super well rounded, especially for its size. The best time spent here is at the pool or snuggled in their in their fluffy beds. Core is excellent, Sushi on Thursdays in the lobby next to Ignite are fun, the poolside restaurant, is my personal fave. The food is light and tasty and the drinks don't stop coming!
 
Overall, I really love the Ritz at Dove Mountain. I have yet to experience a full spa day here, but I'm confident it will be a five star experience.

Breadsticks are not soft and warm. They are nice and tough. I got the Short Rib Lasagna off of the "Test Kitchen" menu. I was pretty excited to give it a shot..... and then it came out and the portion seemed straight off the kids menu. The dish picture is literally maybe half an inch deep by 4 inches by 2.5 inches..... so one small piece of lasagna for, wait for it.... $15.99! I expected a nice sized portion to fill up an adult and this is leaving me hungry and heated over the cost. I asked for bread as well and that's where the ONE hard piece of bread came into play. Overall we had a big party and they handled it decently so that's the only reason for two stars. The food is small in portion size and big in price tag for a chain. Would not recommend and won't be back.

Bandit is my favorite coffee shop to go to in St. Petersburg. The staff is really friendly and kind of present with a cool hipster vibe. The music is always on point and the ambience is minimalist which I love. Bandit coffee quality is the best in the area, in my opinion. It is so rich and smooth, everyone I bring to this establishment also agrees. I always get the oat milk iced latte with vanilla or whatever season flavor they have at the time, they kill it every time! I've never had a bad experience yet. Their prices are definitely worth it, you get what you pay for it. They also offer food now, the only item I've had so far is the vegan burrito and it is to die for. Definitely try it even if you're not vegan, it doesn't disappoint. Previously, there was a lot of seating indoors but not out doors. Recently they've added tables outside too! I give Bandit 10/10 always.

The wings are amazing! 

it's a small place not a lot of seating and very hard to find a parking spot. I'm giving a three because they need more help. They had one waitress for the whole place and it was getting very frustrating.
I have breakfast meetings here all the time. Great service, good food. Love the breakfast sandwich. Good for lunch as well (although I feel out of place with all the big wigs around me.)

Had a long weekend in Nashville and tried a bunch of places. Loved the vibe in Franklin and consider ourselves lucky to have found 55 South for brunch. The seafood gumbo was good, although I would have liked to have kicked it up a notch. Wife got the last piece of quiche, but unfortunately, someone forgot to bake the quiche crust and while the filling was set, the crust was raw. Hard to believe the other 5 pieces of that quiche didn't get returned, too...

Oh well, my wife's replacement for the raw dough quiche was the spinach salad with fried chicken on it. Holy cow was that some PERFECT fried chicken. Cooked a little dark on the outside, the inside wasn't a bit greasy, and perfectly cooked -- delicious!

Love the vibe in the place, although it's a LOUD place -- and packed on a Sunday morning... Don't worry about the wait, though. They take your cell number and you can wander around Franklin buying stuff you don't need while you wait to eat.

Prices aren't bad, and they have brunch special pricing on their mimosas... What's not to like?

Yes I was in the mood for pizza I told you , it's a daily craving.  They actually had Sicilian slices a available!! And they actually looked very good as well?? This is not going to end well....  Well for the first time in quite a while this adventure has a happy ending.    Ordered 3 slices and they gave me an extra slice on the house! I asked for just warm and that's how I received it! Wow what a concept , listening to what the customer asks for.  
Sorry for the dramatics . It's just hard for me to find good Sicilian pizza in the Tampa Bay Area so I get all excited. 

Pizza was very good , thick crust good crunch not overly doughy. 
Sauce was actually balanced well not overly sweet nor acidic.   An abundance of well distributed creamy mozza not overly oily either.  
My only small critique would be I would like more garlic in the sauce.  
I'd put them in my pending top 5  best Sicilian , pending on account I will revisit it and see if they are consistent with quality and taste. Yes I take pizza that seriously! 
Staff was very friendly , I look forward to coming back soon!   I'm curious to see well the Zeppole's are.  

Heads up :  They r just south of the mons Venus on the west side of Dale Mabry.

Thank you so much to all staff of Karens K9 for amazing care of my 2 dogs while we were out for 8 days . I can't be more happy knowing that my dogs were fine and having fun over there . I requested for a bath to one dog before pickup and they did not charge it and gave it for free . What a nice bonus . You guys rocks !

I am writing this while frantically searching for a new salon to fix what this shit show did to our hair. I booked appointments the day before for both my mother and myself, explaining that my mother needed a single process color, cut and blow dry, while I wanted my ombre touched up (it had started getting brassy which is normal on naturally dark brown hair over time) a cut and blow dry. We arrived 15 minutes early where I was immediately told that the stylist I was booked with 'didn't do ombre'. The manager came over and literally pawed through my hair, pulling at pieces and trying to tell me that I couldn't have ash blonde because of my natural color (umm... then how have I always gotten ash blonde ombre for the past 4 years at my old hometown's salon?? They go ash blonde knowing my hair gets brassy very quickly which is what I was trying to do here) I asked if I could switch to the stylist booked at the same time for my mother and was told he didn't have the time. Mom and I exchanged worried looks but since she needed her grey covered for an interview this week and I start a new job tomorrow (just moved here)...we didn't have much choice. For some reason our stylists were still switched and we explained to our respective stylists what we wanted. I needed to be toned (since they didn't have time to do what I had actually booked -_-) and my mom needed her dye resistant grey dealt with. After watching a girl run out fighting tears because her stylist yelled at her over a scheduling issue made by the front desk...oh and taking a regular client who was late before this brand new client... our stylists came back with dye. We both were rushed rushed rushed, including painful hair brushing and slathering on dye with their hands. No color book to talk with us about our options, no plastic caps, no wiping off dye that got on our skin and no time under the dryers. Both stylists ran to other clients (to give u an idea, it took 7 minutes to have dye applied to shoulder length hair before going to the next client). We then got washed, where neither of us had conditioner used??? and when my head went back in the sink, the girl said ' oh so we were just getting you back to your natural color today?' Um no! Mom's hair was almost red instead of her medium brown (with a distinct line where the dye wasn't pulled through her ends) and mine was now all dark brown. So the ombre that I spent multiple appointments and hundreds of dollars to get back home was now gone in 30 minutes. We decided they were in no way cutting our hair after the way they ruined the dye jobs so we said we were running late and only got our hair dried. Again with the pulling and yanking with brushes! We both left with scratch marks on our foreheads from the round brushes used. Both stylists attempted to explain why they did the dye the way they did (even though we hadn't complained) so obviously they knew something was wrong. We paid, ran outside and cried in my car after how awful the whole experience was. Rude, unorganized, unproffessional, rushed, incorrectly done, and painful! This was yesterday and we both woke up with STRAW for hair. Allegedly they used conditioning color (which I doubt if they couldn't be bothered to even wash our hair with conditioner) but our hair feels exponentially worse than it ever has in our lives. My mom is anti-confrontational which is why I'm writing this when I really want to go back there and scream at them in person. You can fuck up my hair and I'll just hate you, never go back, and tell everyone I know what happened... but to mess up my mom's hair to the point where she lost confidence is absolutely unacceptable. I have no idea how this place is still in business...

The service at this particular location is almost inevitably on the awful side.

Also, their money order machine is always down at this location, as the employee informed me this morning...I've lived in the area for a year and usually go to QT to grab a money order for the rent...it took A WHOLE YEAR for the employees here to finally tell me the machine is literally never working.

Walked in for a Saturday lunch. The two waiters were chatting away when we sat down. We waited two minutes for them to greet us and give us a menu. They continued to ignore us so we walked out. I guess they didn't need any business.

To say I loved this place was an understatement. My favorite part of this ice creamery is the ability to do taster scoops! 4 scoops for $5 was the perfect amount to try a few of their AMAZING ice creams (there is no way I could have chosen one!) Be prepared with cash in certain locations!
Stopped in to get some breakfast. They made me a really delicious espresso with milk and I got a cheddar pepper biscuit which was just delicious. I would totally come back to this little Corner Cafe.

Great double char burger made only so much better with the addition of cheese and bacon. Heavenly!!  Interesting side of tempura fried green beans. Both French fries and chocolate malts need work. With as good as the burger is, they are both disappointing. Other things sound good on the menu but I can never pass up the burger.

Fantastic store with an expansive selection of toys, games, and art supplies. The owner was wonderful and took her time to show us around. Explaining the organization and giving recommendations based on ages. We will absolutely return!

This has to be the best barbecue I've ever had I have tried sugar fire ,Pappys ,bandannas  Bogarts , C and K  ,Reds and a few others  I'll just start by saying they actually use wood And The baby back ribs are of the highest quality not spare rehab me like 95% of the other barbecue placesAnd the sauce oh my gosh you just have to see for yourself my first yelp review Not to say it's a nice  spot in a  Beautiful neighborhood.
For starters the girl that made our food was rude and rushed us. She acted as if we were an inconvenience. Also the food was boring. It should be legal to serve this is kind of low grade dog food!!!

Disgusting!!! The pizza smelled like a moldy old rag.. threw the entire thing in the trash. Never in my life did I smell such a thing from a pizza!! The cheesesteak was also inedible. The roll was saturated with water (I assume from steam to melt the cheese). It was a soggy sloppy disgusting mess that also went directly into the trash can. Unless you want to vomit, I wouldn't ever order from this poor excuse for a pizza place.

I worked there for a few weeks and was laid off because I took my grandmother to surgery. The day wasn't approved which I wasn't aware of. I was sent a nasty voice mail by the director Jennifer. Then the next day terminated. Durning my time working at puppy palace I worked two days I wasn't supposed to including a holiday because of no shows so when she questioned my loyalty it was quit offensive. When working there I've experienced some things. Men smoking near the dogs. People spanking the dogs. Dogs being locked in rooms for time out. Dogs being forgotten to be let out. People vaping in the rooms with the dogs. Overall neglect. I've said multiple times while working here I'd never bring my dog to this place even though it was free. It has roaches. The workers and bosses make comments about the customers after you leave. Very unprofessional.

I have recently moved and purchased a bed, couch, and table from Ashley.  Each time I have been in the store Jay J. has been a very helpful sales associate.  He goes above and beyond to assist and get me all the answers I need.  He is very knowledgeable and that has been very helpful in the process of selecting new furniture.
Clean and friendly but the food seemed half-hearted. Greasy, cold potatoes and tastless toast accompanied from-frozen biscuits and gravy. We didn't try the quiche but it did look good.

We landed around 10:30 at night, so our experience was not during typical hours. With that said it was not a good experience, we are priority members with Avis and didn't need to see an attendant but the app was not working. So we got in the preferred line, with about 5 people in the standard line. The worker seemed beyond stressed and overworked. He was a little abrupt in his communication and the line of people seemed to be pretty upset for a long wait. We were taken first and tried to be quick in selecting a car. We didn't get the size vehicle we had opted for, but we decided to deal with it the following day - as we were tired and the attendant seems very stressed. We called the next day to exchange our vehicle but they had no information about us renting a car. So we had to drive back to the airport to resolve the issue.

Ate here when I was in Philadelphia for a conference. Being from the south I've got high standards for BBQ and this place lived up to them all. We got the sampler so that we could try a little of everything. It was a lot of food and we were very pleased with it all. Great atmosphere as well. Highly recommend to anyone traveling through Philadelphia.
They have totally redeemed themselves from my previous review. They have been consistent since then. I love this location.

I have never given a motel 6 a 5- Star but here goes. 

Great price and easy check in process. Great location, about 1/2 block from the beach. You can see the beach from the motel. 

Clean interior and exterior areas. Free WiFi and digital iron. 

The room had some style. Color coordinated and good updated design. I slept well on the firm bed and the large flat screen  TV on the wall chimed on as I slept  on. 

I enjoyed the bench seating for the room desk area. I got some studying done  I actually read a policy manual for an agency that I work with. I was able to concentrate and get some work done as well. 

The TV had a good amount of channels. At least 2- HBO channels and 3 or more ESPN channels. I watched the NBA playoffs so I was good. 

Great spot and I will definitely return.
Damn delicious. Went here after the colts game before our long drive back home. Got 4 different types of sliders, loved the beef/classic with and spicy cilantro/creamy garlic!

Outstanding company TONY ONE OF THE SERVICE MANAGER MAKES THIS COMPANY AND THE OWNER. Honest in all my dealings and helpful when problems occurred great low cost monitoring they keep your systems up and running reliably top priority that's what you need right!
Very nice to eat with family. All food are authentic and fresh. Customer friendly environment.

Unfortunately i don't like beer & they cannot offer cider or food due to laws here BUT the staff was incredibly friendly, basically let me try half a handful of options to see if they could find something close to cider. If I liked beer, I would definitely hang out here!!

Came here on Saturday - we tried to go to Biscuit Love but the line was of course long. I didn't even know Ruby Sunshine existed until someone else in the line mentioned it. We got on their wait list via Yelp and headed on over. So glad we ended up here instead!! The food was SO good (that biscuit and the cane sugar butter - oh em gee) but even better was our server, whose name I can't remember sadly. He was so friendly and warm, and told us the whole history of Ruby Sunshine, which we enjoyed hearing. He seemed like he took a lot of pride in his job and the company as a whole. We really enjoyed our experience and I am looking forward to coming back!

I am a travel nurse. I come home after 6 months and have one month to take care of anything needs doing before I have to go back on the road again. Lensecrafters made my new 
lenses after I came home and had cataract surgery. It took over a week to get them. 
And I couldn't see. The person helping me said
"We did what the Dr told us to do"
I wore them 3 days and went back to my eye Dr who discovered they had made my new glasses with my OLD prescription they had on file. 
Yes. This actually is happening as I write
Meanwhile I makeing no money 
Yes, This actually is really happening
Lensecrafters Park Place Mall
Zero stars is not an option. But it's really zero stars

Panoony's is the best in the Burg by far! Fresh ingredients everyday, very friendly staff, competitive in their pricing and......... they deliver in a timely and courteous manner!! Gotta love Panoony's pizza...... Give em' a try!!!!!
 and
This place is amazing! The owners are so friendly and helpful. They also have amazing Thai Tea! Will be back!

Took 4 employees to figure out how to accept my KK gift card. Had only 6 donut options available (heck the local gas station has more than that). 

As others noted, on previous visits the fresh donuts have a chalky glaze (had this happen many times). I suspect they may be microwaved as one person noted. 

Visit before last they turned me away because my gift card was less than the entire total ($8 and I had $7.44 on my gift card) even though I had the $1 to pay the difference. 

I give it 1 star instead of 0 as it fills my donut fix. (And because I cannot give 0)

I love these guys. Always willing to help and they will try to get me things I'm looking for from their distributor for my next visit. Can't beat the service and the convenience. I've been shopping here for 15 years and have never once had an issue. Great selection of wines too. I was even able to pick up an Eagles Super Bowl commemorative wine from them. Go birds!

One of my favorite sushi spots in the area. I never have to question the quality of the fish and the restaurant has a wide variety of dishes for customers that don't prefer sushi/raw fish. Service is decent and they offer affordable weekday lunch specials. Also BYOB (liquor store a few store's down)

When I heard about this place I was intrigued. I grew up in a Jewish neighborhood in Brooklyn where great Jewish baking was common. Now finding a good Jewish bakery is like finding a unicorn. This place is a unicorn with rainbows. Amazing rye and pumpernickel bread. Best riggulas ever and my dad worked in a Jewish bakery. Onions rolls delicious. I can't wait to go back and I live in Baltimore. Take the time make the trip you'll love it.
Place was super cute. Our waitress was beyond sweet. Pizza was AMAZING!!!! So delicious! Their crust/dough was hands down the best I've eaten in my entire life!

Recently I used them for my daughters wedding.  The photographers were so great   Several people who attended the wedding made nice comments to me about how they liked the way they worked. They quickly put up a blog on their website with a few pics for us to see while waiting for the rest and they are fantastic. Our wedding planner was the best she was well worth every penny I spent.  She relieved so much of my stress unbelievable

* Ubereats order *

I usually order from Captain D's for a quick lunch and have it delivered through Ubereats. The menu has good variety and the food is average.

Sometimes the rice and fish contains a little too much salt and sooner or later you'll find yourself downing a whole jug of water. If you want a healthy option their grilled fish is one of my favourites. It's very light and you won't feel like you're in a food coma afterwards. I've gotten the fries before too and they were well cooked but recently I've been ordering the vegetable sides. On takeout orders they seem to skim out on the veggies especially the broccoli. 

The service is pretty fast. I place my order during peak lunch times and within half an hour I usually receive my food. Given that my other Ubereats orders sometimes take an hour this is a quick choice. The staff take extra care to provide you with the right sauces and enough cutlery to share your food if needed.

Overall if you want a quick light meal then I would recommend Captain D's.

This place is awful. We got there and every ride was down except two. We waited in line for the Cheetah Hunt for 1 hour just to find out they were shutting the rides down. We rode 2 rides in a matter of 4 hours. When we walked out of the park we saw that the park was still accepting tickets instead of kindly warning them that the rides were all shut down. Once we got out they had shut down the tram and we had to walk all the way back to our vehicle. Overall it was a wasted 300 dollars. Now we are able to see why tickets are on sale because of the rides being closed. I would not recommend visiting the park. There were some animals but they all looked hot I just don't recommend it. Don't come here.
