I have never felt so refreshed since I got here in Philly! I was looking for a great church that I will feel as my own family. You have to attend their service to feel their 5 star service. Great location, great crowd and excellebt pastor.
Parking is free also

Good band! Conch fritters were good and so were the fish tacos. Staff is wonderful. Best in john's pass. Get the Malibu Bucket. Yum! Yum! Hiccup!! Plenty of tvs with multiple games on. Fish and chips were excellent. They stayed hot for 20 minute and so fresh. Yummy. Did I say the staff was awesome!!

Delicious food preparations
Great patio
Wonderful service
Tasty wines (Cakebread)
Gorgeous company, thanks Nataliya

Really disappointing. I took in a large order: 4 totes of books and 2 full totes of DVDs and was offered $200 in store credit or $74 in cash + $44 in store credit. I may be unique in this, but I didn't sell my books to buy more books. Would really have appreciated the full $200 - especially when the store is on the completely other side of town from me. When will I have time to drive back and use $40+ in store credit??? Should've kept my books and sold them on Facebook, but when submitting a "large" order you have to leave them overnight and "agree to their terms" which means you don't get your books back.

I would recommend pursuing other options if you are planning to sell your books!

This is my favorite new sandwich shop. They have some amazing sandwiches on their menu, it is hard to choose one favorite. The staff is great and the location is convenient. Make sure you order early, because they will run out on a busy day!

Doesn't look like much stationed next to a Texaco, but I was hungry, so I decided to pop in. I ordered the Grilled Chicken Banh Mi, Shrimp Spring Rolls, Cajun Crack Fries, and a Taro Milk Tea. 

The Banh Mi was lovely, I ordered extra pickled veggies and they did not disappoint! The chicken was flavorful and the bread was soft and flaky at the top. Nice serving size as well 

The Shrimp spring rolls had 3-5 shrimp in them each and was packed with veggies and vermicelli noodles. The wrap was nice and tight, and the sauce that came with was amazing. Im not sure what the sauce was (peanut?) but it was a great consistency, not to thick or loose, and it really brought the spring roll to the next level. 

Cajun Crack Fries were everything I could dream of. It's basically a more flavored and less messy version of ranch fries but with a twist. The chicken cracklings were crispy and the smoked bacon was a nice touch. The flaming hot cracklings crumble was a solid kick to my uvula, but a nice one. 

The Taro Milk Tea was a blended, frozen drink that tasted like ice cream! Gives Starbucks frappe chino a run for its money.

No smoothie combinations offered on the menu, just create your own by choosing a base, 3 fruits and a protein. The options for all 3 are very limited so there isn't much variety in taste. 

They substituted my yogurt with almond milk without telling me. My smoothie didn't look thick or milky at all so I asked to confirm that there was yogurt in it. I was told "we don't have any more yogurt so I put almond milk in". The smoothie wasn't pureed so as I drink it I crunch on ice bits, and it essentially tastes like liquified strawberries. Pretty disappointing.

The owners, staff, and clientele make this feel like your own neighborhood "Cheers". The Fear of a Brett Planet is my absolute favorite beer, and has been for years. The food menu has a little something for everyone. I love the Drunken Groupies. 
The Ladies of Lansdale nights never disappoint. 
If this is a place you've never visited, get in there.

Very, very delicious pastries with a huge variety.  The sandwiches, especially the panini, make a great lunch or even dinner.  If you're craving pastries alone or with a nice informal meal, this is the place to go.
Went there while on vacation for our wedding anniversary, and had a great experience! Staff offered to help but weren't pushy when we said we didn't need any. Huge selection of men's wear

Pros:
Taste for most flavors have been solid. Nothing that has been terribly disappointing. Slightly cleaner than most other froyo places I think.
Good location, b/c it's obviously at the mall.

Cons:
Not as fresh as Pinkberry b/c the toppings are all out in the open.
Kinda pricy but I guess every other froyo place is as well.

So we were walking by and thought we'd grab a bite after a long flight. It's one person running the register/bar/seating/hostess so we waited 5 minutes just to get a table even though the place was practically empty...maybe 4 parties at different tables and a few people at the bar. I felt bad for the girl so when she finally told us to just grab a table, I got my own silverware and menus and waited and waited. The purple-haired girl finally came by and asked what we would like to drink. Naturally I asked for a drink menu and she proceeded to roll her eyes...roll her fuckin eyes after I have waited probably 15 minutes and set my own damn table. She brought the menu from 10 steps away and again we sat and waited and waited. We just walked the fucked out after we clocked it at 5 minutes after receiving the menu. There's plenty of other restaurants I can spend my money at. No review on the food, just a wasted 25+minute wait and didn't even get a water, just shitty attitude. Get a new job if you're burnt out.

I was at this joint running a tab recently & purchased 3 drinks, left without closing tab & get a call the next day from bank notifying me of  2 separate $150 charges. These low life's charged my card extra $ for drinks I never purchased & an extra $150 for a 10th anniversary guest list charge that I never agreed to. Stay away from this place, they are scam artists. I was so furious I tipped off bbb & IRS.

Never been disappointed!

I been here several times and most recently this past weekend. Babayyy I forgot what I was missing. I try to come on Sundays because that's when they have deviled eggs, and I luuuvvv deviled eggs. My go-to is the 2 slices of Meatloaf, Mac & Cheese, and Green Beans. All the sides are good and sometimes I'll add on the yams for a third option. I cannot leave with out getting the banana pudding and kool-aid(yes you read that right). I've also had the catfish and that's cooked fresh for you. 

The location is in a mini-plaza and can get crowded really fact because of the size, but there's still enough space for a few patrons to sit down and eat. Most people, like me, order to-go but I have stayed before. There's plenty of parking available.  Everyone is super nice and helpful and if something you know they should have is in the back, they will go grab it for you. 

I suffered many food comas after eating only to wake up and eat again and pass back out. Now that's the type of food I like. (cues Bruno Mars)

This bike shop is close to where I live. I bought bikes here for my spouse and I a few years back. We absolutely love our bikes and use them every week! Whenever we have trouble or need service we go back to the shop. We've had them service us free of charge which was unexpected and very nice of them. They are always friendly and fast. My friend wanted to get a bike and I got her to buy from them as well strictly for their awesome support and service after you've bought the bike. My father comes to visit me from out of town and always brings his bike (which was not purchased in their store). Whenever he goes to them for help he too raves about the fast and friendly service!

David and Sergey helped me move out of my condo today. They were very affordable, best price I found. They also were able to work with my limited schedule. They made sure to wrap all my precious belongings and fingered out how to get the most space out of the PODS I used. I was able to only use one which saved me a lot of money. I would definitely recommend them. Very efficient and friendly!

Modern and comfortable space with incredible food and kind service. My husband and I ordered a Croque Monster, Loma Bocadillo, and Mac n cheese and each dish was packed with inventive flavors and filling. I don't feel overly full and weighed down by the cheese which is nice! Each meal comes with salad or chips as well so the salad helped balance out the richness of the sandwiches. I'm glad we sought this place out and would highly recommend it to everyone!

I see a lot of fellow Delco Yelpers making the trek out here for this (yo Jim and Tom). So now that I've found it too, let's get more of Delco out here to judge it. 

I just found it because I was in Exton after a doctor's appointment and needed a bite. It seemed like a good idea to come here. 

I didn't go special with the beer. I do enjoy the good beers, but this time a Yards Pale Ale worked well for me. But I did splurge on the Second Coming Burger which they tout so heavily. At $14.99, which is in the range of what places like Rouge charge for burgers (about $3 less currently), I expected something close to greatness.  

I got goodness at the very least. 

The burger is insanely juicy, which is a plus. I enjoyed the sauce on it, though I had expectations set for more tomatoes on it as they seem to bury that part of it. The fries that come along with it are nothing terribly special but good enough. 

I don't think it's worth the price they charge. But I'd eat it again if it were handed to me for sure. 

I do like the atmosphere and the classic rock motif they have going. I'd come back.

I NEVER leave reviews, but I am today. Avoid this place at all costs. Drive a little further to the Bridgeton location. This location is the worst! I placed my order online at 6:15. Was told it would be 20 minutes. Knowing that this was dinner rush, I showed up a little later, 6:50. Once there, the associates couldn't find my order, and that a driver must've taken it. So they "rushed" two new pizzas in the oven and said it would be 10 minutes. The manager also offered to throw in a brownie. 25 minutes later my order was finished. The pizzas looked TERRIBLE! Poor topping distribution, and bare. Then they forgot the brownie that THEY offered to give. I just took my stuff and left. The associates there are awful. Rude, poor attitudes, and didn't take accountability for their mistakes. The only positive out of this experience was the manager was nice and professional. Her staff just sucked

I have never been to a Vietnamese restaurant before, but I love Pho. The Pho with rare beef slices and meat balls was amazing. Less than $10 for a giant bowl with a hefty portion of meat and noodles. The tempered shrimp was also delicious. Overall, great place with amazing food and care in the preparation and presentation.

Absolutely love test pilot! They have a connection with the good lion and oh boy do I love them too. Such a fun, funky, place to be with awesome tiki style decorations. Beware, Test pilot is typically packed on the weekend but for good reason! They are dog friendly and there is plenty of room for groups or just couples. 

Some of my go-to drinks are:
- ken tiki Kentucky (from the good lion)
- passion fruit mule
- the buccaneer

Definitely drop by!

SYOY
Jess H.

Went in on Sunday - and it wasn't packed yet! This was our first visit to this location; we've been to the YH in San Diego and had a nice time. This visit was wonderful! We were seated in the patio - which was enclosed - and no screaming children! Thank you hostess! My husband is a beer snob and loved the variety! I loved the variety of the menu. I am hesitant about places that have too much variety: those who have too much on their menus tend not to be expert at any of them. But what we had was wonderful! We had the devilled eggs as an appetizer - very good, different! We each had soup: Tomato Bisque with basil (wonderful!) and French Onion soup that didn't taste canned or too salty. My hubby's grilled cheese was the best he's ever had (including mom's!) and my turkey sandwich was very good! We cannot wait to return - this will be our new favorite restaurant - but not at peak times or days. By the time we left, it was PACKED...and the Village at Meridian is beautiful. It certainly doesn't look like a typical Idaho venue...so I think on Friday nights/Saturdays/and Sundays after church: be prepared to wait. If you're flexible on time, I don't think you'll be disappointed!

Tried this place a few times. Honestly, I've enjoyed all the meals. Great burgers, good beer selection, but honestly, the atmosphere is not appealing to me. I think when it's warmer, I'll love sitting outside, but inside is too noisy and both times we've had a change of shift during our service, so not really sure who's been waiting on us. Friendly staff, however! Milkshakes rock.

Just had the House Doctor team, Kerry and Roy, come in and replace our water heater tank, and I'd recommend them to anyone who has any plumbing, electrical, carpentry problems that they need a capable team to complete it. They were personable and professional gentlemen, and really did an amazing job, complications and all.

Really had difficulty finding a plumber that I felt I could trust as I'm unfamiliar with the work that needed to be done. I had searched Yelp, Home Advisor, Home Depot, and even Amazon Home Services (AHS), but wasn't satisfied with the polarized reviews of some of the plumbers I read about. Eventually, I stumbled on the House Doctor through AHS where they had excellent reviews, but discovered that they were no longer on that platform. So, I did a quick google search and found them on Home Advisor where it reflected the same enthusiasm for their work. I finally felt somewhat comfortable moving forward with them and have not regretted that decision.

Basically, our water heater had no way of getting out of our basement closet without breaking down a wall / doing some demolition work AND it was going to be very difficult to transport both the old and the replacement water tanks. They got creative with the solution and only had to take out part of the door framing to get it out, cut some piping, cleaned up the area, brought in the new unit, and re-positioned the piping to connect to the new unit. After cleaning up the area and re-installing the door framing, they left the set-up better than it had been before, leaving everything in perfect, working condition.

Kerry and Roy were both personable and funny, but when it came to the work and costs, they didn't play any games. Kerry is not only capable in plumbing, but also electrical work, carpentry, and other areas, so I will definitely be working with him going forward and recommend him to anyone who has any related problems. They don't call him the House Doctor for nothing!

Thanks again guys!
Richard

edit: total costs around $2,000, a bargain for the great work they did. Your mileage may vary.

Mason Jewelers is the best!  They are locally owned and operated.  Not a big box store where everything is cookie cutter.  Scott Mason is great to work with and will listen to you and what you want.  I highly recommend.  Stop by you will be glad you did.

I guess nobody else tried the chile relleno.  OMG - instead of cheese, it had some kind of ground beef concoction.  I specifically did NOT order any beef items when they told me it was ground beef and not shredded.  Felt I was at Taco Bell.  My wife's bean tostada was a tortilla with just runny beans - no garnish, nothing.  I had the combo frajitas - the beef was chewy as were the shrimp.  Then, they allow ladies to come through the restaurant selling flowers.  If I wanted to be hounded while I eat Mexican food, at least it should be Mariachis, no?  At least we used a groupon to minimize the pain.  won't be going back.

I am pretty impressed. My first visit I was greeted by a whole team of folks who worked together to make sure we had a great time.
From the ticket booth, through security to the ones who put a wheelchair in my hands when we needed it.
Not a bad seat in the house.
The beer could be cheaper, but clearly these guys have it together.

Oh yeah! The reviews are true, this is a 5-star restaurant, which explains the wait the two times I've tried to eat here. It was considerably fewer people the second time around, though. We stopped in for "brunch" on a Monday afternoon and were told that it would be a 15-20 minute wait, but we were seated in about 10 minutes. 

It's cozy on the inside and it has a nice, clean layout. The gray metal chairs and wooden tables are pleasant to look act. On the last day of our staycation we ordered the crab coquettes, bbq shrimp and grits, cajun gravy biscuit and a side pancake. We also ordered a mimosa and a hot chocolate, cause it was chilly outside. With the exception of the shrimp and grits, everything was a 5. The shrimp and grits were about a 3.5 in the restaurant. There was something about the flavor that was off. The grits were creamy and shrimp were plump, fat and juicy. Definitely Gulf shrimp. But get this, I brought some home (it was too much food) and put them in the fridge. I heated them up for dinner and they were a 5. That's freaky, but maybe the ingredients just needed more time to come together. So, if you get something and the taste is off, save it for later and try again. 

The crab coquettes were an absolute surprise. It was like eating fried crab dressing. Crispity, crunchity on the outside and oh so yummy on the inside. It was like a Castnet Thanksgiving in my mouth. And the crawfish gravy that comes on top...mmm, mmm! The cajun gravy biscuit was covered in the same sauce and the biscuit was so light and fluffy and buttery. The pancake was thick thick. Yet, it was light as a feather. The syrup was light and sweet and I'm certain I tasted a hint of cane. Not Steen's level cane syrup, but much lighter. 

We also bought a few of the glass bottled juices and lemonades. I've only tried the satsuma so far and it was decent. Not very sweet, but that's probably a good thing because it came in a 20 oz bottle. That's a lot of juice and I don't need all that sugar.

We've been AT&T wireless customers for years.  Most of the time it's been fairly hassle free until we did an upgrade in Jan 2020.  My lady and I needed new phones so we stopped by to swap our old iPhones out for new.  

What I came to realize later, way later is that the agent added another line, gave me a new phone and then we proceeded to pay service charges on another line.  

So I ended up paying for service on a line that had no phone attached to it, plus paying service for the line I used regularly.  

Attempts to resolve with the local store were fruitless. They said I'd need to call retention, gave me a number that didn't work and advised I'd need to ask the person on the other end to cancel the unused line, and if they did t have allotments I should hang up and start all over ago with a new person. 

I went home, called and after about an hour on the phone with Loyalty - not retention, they said I'd have to go back to the store.  

I tweeted out my horrible experience and someone reached out-took my info and a day later offered a very small resolution compared to the expense and hassle I'd been having.  

I'm going to file with the Better Business Bureau to see if I can get a better and more full resolution.  

If you get new phones here best get all the info in print to make sure nothing shady is happening.
I had the Tomahto burger and it was awesome! Parm fries were delicious as well and milk shake was great. We were all very satisfied with our burgers.

It's a park. A great park for walking, running and has some monuments.

I was fortunate to see the 150th anniversary of the Buffalo Soldiers. Seeing something like that doesn't get much better.

Yes it's an addition to the "eat in a bowl" casual dining space but it's the top of the list truly. This import from DC is fresh Mediterranean and their spreads are legendary.  Treat yourself to the crazy feta or the spicy eggplant (babaganoush) and you won't be disappointed.

Stopped by while on vacation. Initially thought they were closed because sign had not been flipped. Extremely glad we did not drive away. Though difficult to get to and is abit rough looking on the outside the food is beyond worth it. I had the mumbo gumbo and the boudine balls. Was easily the best we had on our entire trip. As a chef myself I can say you should make the time to stop by Chef Ron's. You will not be disappointed.

Sushi Ushi is always such a great experience. The sushi is fresh and plentiful. More than anything, the presentation is always so beautiful! My husband is from Japan and this is his favorite sushi spot.

I love this place. Especially the chimichurri sauce! However, the last three times we've been there- even though we're paying for the extra, they've tried to skimp out? It's getting a little frustrating. After all, we're paying for it.

I had to drunkenly try to make my own chimichurri sauce to make up for it...not the same.
First visit to this diner,I cannot say enough on how good everything was food was priced good service was excellent.

There is a poem by Charles Hoffman that states,

SPARKLING and bright in liquid light
Does the wine our goblets gleam in,
With hue as red as rosy bed
Which a bee would choose to dream in.
===============================================
It has been a while since I have had the food.  (pre-yelpness)  However it is the place I frequent after dancing late nights at The Spotted Cat!  Once the tourists start piling in and we need air and a beverage; we meander down to Mojitos.  They always have bands playing.  First there was a Lounge Jazz singer and after her was a brass band.  The bar staff is always quick, appropriately conversational, and deserving of tipping.  The outside patio space is wonderful: water fountain, plenty of seating, and a bar.

Great food, nice atmosphere and outdoor seating!  We ate the pollo asado plate (coconut marinaded chicken) and the lechon (roasted, pulled pork) sandwich.  Both were delicious!  The coffee is good too.

Noisy and hot, this buffet is on par with all of the others in the area.  They have been heavily advertising with coupons, so it made it a little bit better in the wallet area.

The restaurant seemed to be busy with patrons and the plates were filled quite high.  They did have roast duck which I have not seen in any other buffet.  Wife said the fried chicken was quite good.  

Sushi was average and they ran out of options often.  I did not try the Hibachi.  They also have a crepe station.  It was a pain in the ass having young kids ring the bell for no apparent reason except to do it and annoy others.

For better quality food, go to To-Kai (see my review!) in the same shopping center.
Decent, cute waitresses. Also a decent place to draft fantasy football out. Have done so the last couple of years. Very accommodating

I, too, went here after using a groupon.

I wish I could say that I had as good of an experience as the two other reviewers, but I didn't. I also wish I could remember the name of my stylist. Oh well, perhaps it's for the best that I don't out her on here. Maybe it just wasn't her day. 

At any rate, my stylist botched my hair. I said I wanted a trim, she chopped off at least 2.5 inches. I said I wanted soft layers, she made my hair fall in awkward, shortened chunks. She cut my bangs while they were wet and made them too short. It was probably the most difficult haircut I've had in a number of years. Thankfully, it's been a couple of months, so it's finally growing out enough to look decent again, but I will never, ever risk my hair at this salon again. I do hope their other stylists are better.

There was a bit of good, though - it's nicely set up and they give good head massages and scalp treatments. But that's where it ends for me.

This was my first time having dolsot.  I loved the crispy rice on the bottom of the dish! I had the spicy pork bulgogi dolsot. Very flavorful and a great experience.  I definitely would come back to try other dishes.

By far the best meal I've had in the past few days. Ambiance was very lovely. Service great, and food phenomenal. We were always checked on. There was a gentleman with a suit who stopped by our table to greet us and thank us for dining there. That made our dine in feel a bit more special. 

I ordered the rib eye medium rare. It was so good with the key lime bearnaise sauce. I also tried my friend's salmon and it was so juicy with flavors. The table across from us had their meal cooked right in front of them, that was exciting to watch. Makes me wonder if they train all their servers to cook like that. The appetizer we ordered was wonderful. The beef was thinly sliced with a creamy sauce on a bed of spring mix with a light vinaigrette. My favorite side was the lobster whipped potatoes. Both creamy and satisfying.  

At the end, our server came by with a rich chocolate  mousse cake. I am not use to fine dining, but it feels great to have this experience once in awhile.

I've used them since I moved to Tucson area in 1994. They used to be a good service, but things seem to have changed. In the last few months I've: 1. Had a garbage carrier overturned , spilling garbage all over the street (I don't know if the driver dropped it or some animal overturned it before the truck arrived) it was left as is for me to find later. Complaint response was, "Since we went to 'driver only' there's nothing we can do about that". 2. Today (recycle pickup) cardboard and paper were picked up but two bags of other recyclables were put back in the container and left.

The other evening was the first time that I have visited the Persian Grill. In the past have driven by the location plenty of times should have stopped in sooner.

Excellent food, atmosphere and wait staff.   Highly recommend stopping in for a casual eating experience.  Great for vegetarian menu must try their ground beef skewer and any of the lamb choices will not be disappointed!

Loved the gooey butter ice cream, based on a staple dessert of St. Louis. Amazing flavor! The waffle cone is one of the best I've had, a rare cone that I was happy to finish off without ice cream. We'll be back for sure!
Entertaining wait staff (Elliott) and good food and drinks! The Brussels sprouts are amazing.

Order Denied!

I attempted to make a delivery order today.  When I called I was told to call back in fifteen minutes.  That should have warned me off, however, I called back in twenty minutes.  When I called back I was told that they were no longer taking orders.  I reminded her that she told me to call back in fifteen minutes and her reply was, "actually its been twenty one minutes".  She never mentioned their 5 minute ordering window policy.  In the end she still refused to take the order.  They advertised delivery hours until 9:00pm on this day.  The second call was made at 8:40pm.  With an insulting display like this no one can honestly say that customer service is of any concern to this business.

Great, loud music and strong, reasonably priced drinks. Came in here on a Wednesday around 8 p.m. and there was a decent sized, fun crowd. People were up dancing and everything. I gave it three stars because 1. The hookah wasn't that great. It was ok at first but went bad quickly and became very harsh to smoke. 2. Shots were very expensive. Hennessy was $10 a piece. Other than that though I think it's a decent place to come and chill out in for a while on a weekend.

I agree with the other sentiments about the food and service at the new location. Have eaten at the old and new, and this one just lacks. I'm curious to hear if they get their mojo back. I really liked them in the previous location.
This is worst hotel I have ever stayed can't smoke my legalize weed anywhere! Staff will be up your ass about any thing and beds are hard as bricks

So here is my .02 on Ben and Irv's.  It's always good.  It's pricey for a BLT - but you can usually nab a Groupon.  The pickle bowl is the best appetizer ever and the service is usually on point.  You want a delicious stack of pancakes?  You want a toasted bagel with good, fresh Whitefish? Come here.  It's always packed so chose your timing wisely - but it's certainly worth a visit, especially if you are craving a good sandwich or some Jewish deli food!

This meal was impeccable.  Service was excellent.  the duck was exquisite and one of the best Thai meals I've had in a while.   We got the duck in a curry sauce flavored with peanuts. Fabulous. The pad Thai was a huge delicious portion. And the shrimp with cashews was marvelous. We loved the little tented lighted booths. The next time we are in Oldsmar this place is a must for dinner or lunch.

Arrival here to board a Norwegian cruise was a bit chaotic. However, I can't complain too much given the fact there are 3,000 other people trying to get on board also. You can imagine the confusion displayed by 3,000 people coming from all around the world. 

The line through security moved relatively fast and checking in was easy. 

Disembarking the ship was a little more complicated only because we had to go through our lovely US customs. No, I don't have any beef or fruit on me! This line moved reallllly slow....maybe somebody was claiming an orange or something. 

Once through customs, the port staff were very helpful in giving directions to exit and find proper transportation. 

Bon Voyage!
Visited the store today everyone was very nice Melissa helped me pick out some cold pressed juices. Overall I had a great experience I'll be back soon.

Disappointed.  Not enough food at a recent special event dinner. It was served family style and I did not get enough to eat.  What I did try was excellent but when using family style serving you need to ensure that there is enough food. The food I did have was great.  The service staff seemed a little bothered by the large party.  Hoping it was just a bad night.

Everything is amazing! Love this place. I've only done the buffet so far because I like to taste EVERYTHING, at least twice. 

Two of my favorites here are chicken tikka masala and palak paneer. The kheer is also on point. Tons of vegetarian options and the meat options are chicken, fish, and goat. 

The waiters are very nice but yes sometimes you may have to wait to be seated because the one waiter is running around tending to everybody. It's no big deal. I hope this place never closes. I'll be inconsolable.

Clients keep giving me gift cards to Ruth Chris, and I keep accepting them!  I have received great food and great service across the board!  By this point, I've probably tried almost everything on the menu, and I have to say, I haven't gotten ahold of anything I didn't thoroughly enjoy!  I think it's weird that they have to bring everything out on plates that are like 1,000 degrees, but in the whole scheme of things, that is really no big deal.  I definitely recommend Ruth's Chris for a special occasion or business dinner.  I love the filet and potatoes au gratin!

Kids? Kids? Why are you bouncing off the wall? Oh, that's right because you've been fed tons of chocolate. Come on, who doesn't love chocolate--what are you, some sort of freedom hater? In all honesty, the staff here is always super friendly and the prices, while expensive, are fair. Do yourself a favor, say "insert your name, you deserve a chocolate covered strawberry for just being you", and go do it. Their strawberries are insane, and so MASSIVE. Actually, if you get one--bring one to my office. Love their chocolate.

If you're going there for beer and maybe something light, do not sit at a table! Go directly up to the bar and order everything at once. The hostesses are nice and very friendly, but the servers are terrible. They seem to disappear after you put in your drink order, and it takes at least ten minutes before your beer shows up. 

Rather than ask what you'd like to eat, the server drops the beers off and says she will be right back. Another ten minutes goes by, and she's there to take your order. The food is great once you get it, and their beer tour definitely brings you back over and over. Just expect to wait for a long time before you get anything served to you. 

I love the quintessential bar foods; buffalo wings, mozzarella sticks and the like. Their pizza is great too, but be very specific is you want extra anything. We had to ask 3 times for extra basil before the waitress brought it out to us. It gets loud in there, so don't expect an intimate setting unless you're at a table in the corner.

I don't usually use chiropractors, but this one is great and helpful with very important health information. I didn't feel like he was wasting my time. I like that you get your xrays by email and not a disc. Most importantly I left feeling relief from a very painful pinched nerve. He does walkins, where do they do that? If I were in Bloomington the only choice I would have had is to go to the ER, no thank you. I was blessed to find Tankersley Chiropractic when I needed them while in from out of town! 
Raymona-

Great lunch buffet on the weekend.

I completely forgot that this is a vegetarian buffet.  When I was looking at all the dishes I thought, "Where's the meat".  However, once you start eating, you won't feel deprived.  

The buffet is on the smaller side, but there is a pretty good variety.  Even though it is vegetarian, you can still pack on the calories!  They don't bring naan, but they have fried bread as an option.  It is delicious, but I had to stay away.  I found I enjoyed everything that had a lentil base.  I liked everything, but since I don't have great knowledge about Indian food, I can't really expand on what I ate.  I did make the mistake taking a huge bite of the pickled vegetables, thinking it would be like kimchi.  It was extremely sour!  I will stay away from that next time.

The restaurant was pretty empty at lunch on a Saturday.  I never had to wait in line to get food.

Parking is super easy.  I was concerned at first when I saw a sign that said more parking in the back, but I didn't need to be concerned.  The parking lot seems big enough to hold all the traffic.  Maybe during the weekdays it gets busy, but it was fine on a Saturday.

I think this is a great option for good Indian food.
Employees will roll their eyes at you, they are rude they will screw up your order and then insist it is correct go to the taco bell on williams its far superior.
So delicious. I had the fish special. Beautiful outdoor seating. Will definitely go back. Good service too.

this is the best chinese place in valrico. the teriyaki burrito is really good. it comes with rice, noodles, and chicken inside of the burrito. as a side you get french fires with yum-yum sauce and ketchup. the presentation is so pretty! and for the price... perfect! it's such a nice little place to go on a date, with family, or a group of friends. the sushi is really good as well. the employees are very friendly and very sharp. there to refill your drink and ask you how your food is. overall, 10/10 would recommend to everyone.

Hands down the best pizza! And also hands down the best ranch! There's no other ranch that can compare! The servers are hit or miss. Currently there is only one bad server, but all the rest are pretty top notch...but they will never be Libby.

Cable one is getting worse by the month with regard to speed. More & more frequency I have slow Internet. Of course when you call they want to blame your system even if it really is not. Honestly it is as slow today as dial-up was back in the day. I am going to be looking at other options for Internet Service.

Requested fresh apple pies at drive thru with no sugar coating. Observed staff taking made pies w sugar brushing coating off and putting back in fryer! Said that It was not acceptable. Made me wait an additional 15 minutes...

I love the items they had and was tempted to get everything they had! The merchandise they had was fair traded and they had things from many different cultures, which kind of reminded me of Zeebee market. It was nice and quiet inside. Almost everything that they were selling was pretty pricey but it supports people in places with poverty, so I definitely don't mind that at all. Many of the crafts were so unique and beautiful that they looked like someone had worked on them for many hours. Everything was carefully crafted by artisans in 32 different countries, which is cool to think about. If you are in the Loop, stop by here for a minute to view all of the cool selection they have.

On  May 10, 2020, we went to Fox's Pizza Den at 1070 West Main Street, Plainfield, IN 46168,  we ordered several items, and my husband ordered a Philly steak hoagie/sub sandwich,  he ordered his sandwich with just extra cheese and meat only, no peppers or onions,  and we ordered pickup,  and when we arrived at our destination, we discovered my husband sandwich was not correct. My brother in law lives in Camby, Indiana, and we had to drive back to Plainfield, Indiana to get the correct sandwich. Plainfield is about a 10 to 15 min drive from Camby, Indiana. At this time, the assistant manager Bob was on duty.   
 However on 06/06/2020 , around 7pm,  my husband and brother in law went to Fox Pizza Den  at  1070 West Main Street, Plainfield, IN 46168 to order food for pickup,  my husband dealt with the assistant manager Bob,  and they placed their order,  they waited and waited, customers came in,  picked up food, got served for dine in, but they did not get their order,  when my brother in law and husband checked on their order,  the employees lost their food ticket,  my brother in law ordered two sandwiches  Italian sub with no tomato and lettuce,  and when we got to the house, my nephew had take off the tomato on his sandwich, and my brother-in-law ordered a sandwich which he did not want green peppers, and green peppers were on the sandwich. In addition, my brother in law sandwiches sat out, getting cold while the employees were trying to figure out where my husband's order was.  We are not satisified  with the level of service that we have received at your location on our last two visits.  It seems like the assistant manager Bob does not have it together to run this location, or provide correct or appropriate level of service.

I finally had the chance to stop in, and try a few things, there were so many great looking soups, but I just wasn't in a soup mood on Friday night. I ended up taking home some corn fritters - fabulous, with a yummy tangy sauce!  They have shelves of wonderful spices and pastas, I took home some delicious canned tomatoes and a honey butternut squash that I can't wait to try!  There were so many yummy looking items on the menu, and the man at the counter was very helpful with helping me make the right choices!  Oh! The banana bread was JUST delicious too!!

Frustrating and very unsatisfying experience here tonight. The waitress was extremely pushy and rude. I asked for a soda and she immediately left without asking my girlfriend if she wanted anything. Once she returned to take the dinner order, she acted as if we were a huge inconvenience to her. She was telling us how busy they were and to order sushi now because it would take a long time. She literally tried to close my menu as I was still looking at it. Also, it was evident that she was very frustrated and annoyed when we asked any basic questions about the food. 
In addition, a table of 7 people (bigger check) was sat next to us and she took her time with them. She was very welcoming and patiently explained menu items, as well as answering any questions they asked. I can only assume this is because of the amount of money potentially being spent, since they were a table of 7, while we were only a table of two. The food was good but the service was inexcusable. Servers like that reflect on the restaurant as a whole and can really deter people from wanting to eat there.
SCAM!!!! I'm so livid right now that I just lost $90 to these horrible people.  The properties are nothing like they advertise and they are rude and dismissive once they get your money.

A great meal. The Vietnamese Fresh  Shrimp Rolls (Goi Cuon) were wonderfully fresh though not alot of flavor without the sauce. The steamed pork shrimp wontons were very good. The Shakey Beef (Bo Luc Lac was delicious. The beef chunks were tender, perfectly cooked. A very tasty dish though i think it was missing tomatoes.
I look forward to trying their specialities.
But they need to prepare faster, i waited an hour for takeout.

As a long time fan of the Guadalajara on Prince, I was super eager to try the new location, and I was not disappointed! We were sat very quickly even though they said it was a 20 minute wait. Almost everyone at the table ordered 'La Bandera' to drink which is a tri flavored margarita that is red, white, and green. The margarita was mostly green, but still very strong and delicious! We also ordered the queso to start. It was warm and flavorful. For an entree I had the Azteca. It was so good! I could only eat half as I was so full from the chips and margarita, but I gladly took home the rest for leftovers! My boyfriend ordered the carne asada burrito, and was accidentally brought a ground beef burrito. I understand mistakes happen in the kitchen, and he wasn't willing to speak up about it, so he ate the entire burrito, and loved it! Overall, I was very impressed with the service and food at this location, and will gladly return over and over again!

After a long-awaited reservation (4 months out!) four of us headed to Hearthside with wine in our hands and excitement in our hearts. 

The atmosphere of the restaurant is stunning. It's inviting, cozy, and chic. The open-air windows/doors were fabulous, as we were lucky enough to visit on an unseasonably warm spring day. Warm breezes and fun music enveloped us like a giant hug. 

The menu consists of small, medium, and large plates. In order for the kitchen to pace and pair your selections appropriately, you are encouraged to place your entire order at the onset (minus dessert). The pacing, the presentation, the portions, and the flavors of our dishes were impeccable. I am unable to rank our favorite items, as we genuinely loved everything equally. If I had to choose one dish that stood out slightly above the others, then it would be those sensational PEI Mussels (coconut curry, scallions, and lemongrass focaccia for dipping). If I could have ordered vats of that broth to go, then I would be drinking it daily at home. 

Service was attentive, knowledgable, and friendly. They would check-in periodically without conveying an impression that you're being rushed. Water glasses were topped off regularly and our server ensured our wine glasses were full.

Our experience at Hearthside makes me reconsider every other 5 star rating I've ever given to a restaurant on Yelp. This, my friends, was sheer perfection. Five stars are simply not enough!

Beautiful hotel and friendly staff. Jasmine checked us in and assisted us with finding the perfect room. She was very helpful and friendly. All the staff we have encountered have gone above and beyond with helping us and making us comfortable. I highly recommend this hotel. We chose a third floor patio room by the pool. The room is very clean and the bed is so comfortable. The jazz club is a must!

My friend and I come in just to see Alicia. She is the best one there and always does an AMAZING job. Super nice and friendly as well. Some others are very rude but as long as Alicia is there then we will push that aside. If you go there make sure you ask for her. They will tell you she takes longer then the others because she them right and its worth it

Very disappointing. I ordered Camarones ala diabla and it was shrimp in sauce with nothing else. White rice and a salad on the side that looked like it came out of a bag. The pics on their menu are not representative of the actual food you receive. Save your money.

Overall my all time favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara.  The quality of food, service and value is tops!  I love to have drinks and even dinner in the bar too, a fun experience!  Favorite dish is the filet.  Love the wine list. The desserts are yummy too!

CASH ONLY!!! I just wanted to be sure and alert anyone in advance. 
I give this place two stars. Although the burger was hot and fresh, it was not what I expected. The burger was not very big. When the cashier asked what I wanted on it , I said "everything". (A picture on the menu showed a burger with lettuce, tomato, onions.)
However, the burger I received had NO lettuce or tomato. When I asked about it, the cashier said I have to ask for lettuce and tomato. But I did. I said "everything". 
Its a "locals only" atmosphere, not a lot of seating. Not very friendly.
Highly recommend this place, I went for lunch and ordered the falafel hero and got a dinner size salad. Asked for more tzaziki and got plenty. Delicious will be back!!!

Thought we'd support some restaurants during the Covid crises- so we went out here and got some pastas and soup.
Soup was great, but 20bucks for a shrimp & scallop pasta.
A handful of spaghetti with 3(!) shrimp and 2 small rubber bullets that once was scallops....

Think we expected a bit more from this place. 3 solid stars

My husband and I just had a terrible experience. We are interested in taking up golf so we came in today (July 4th) to the golf shop. Matt Nikirk could not have made it more obvious he wanted nothing to do with us. Yes, we were the only people in the shop so he was not busy. After trying multiple times to get some information on what the store offered and golf lessons (he actually told me to turn around and read the flyers when I had questions after I had read the flyers). We asked for his managers number and he had to brush into my husband while walking to the desk. Unprofessional. Rude. Complete lack of customer service. I was told Mo Musser is the head manager and I will be contacting him. He needs to know about the type of employees he has. Yikes.

Came here from Clarksville with my mother and step dad who were visiting from Michigan. Step dad is a big Jimmy Buffet and Margaritaville fan.

Got here at 6pm on a Thursday night. No line or wait time. The hostess is half way inside near the bathrooms, so you need to walk pretty deep into the restaurant to get a seat. Hostess was really nice as was our waitress. Service was a little slow but they were busy and as stated our waitress was extremely friendly. 

Everyone love what they ordered and cleaned their plates.  The Lava lava shrimp was great! A perfect appetizer. The seafood combo was a lot of food and came with three different and really good dipping sauces. The burger was very flavor full. There are a lot of restaurants on the strip so I'm likely to try a new place if by myself, but if ever hosting again I'll likely came back because the menu has good options and the service was good.

Also requested a song and it was played immediately.

First time visit on 9/12/14, limited time, on the way to a concert so chose the Nonna's Special pizza.  Very good, both a friend and I enjoyed it.  Thin crust, just the right amounts of sauce, cheese, sausage, mushrooms, pepperoni.  Also served fresh, warm rolls beforehand - nice.  Only reason for 4 stars vs 5 is that you have to WOW me to earn 5 stars.Will go back!

I didn't order anything fancy, but yet it was so much better than other local Mexican restaurants. Specifically the bean and cheese burrito, which seems like a pretty straight forward item, but somehow it was better here. My husbands tacos were also delicious and we will be back to try more items. It is worth the extra time it takes to get here.

One of my favorite meals since moving to StL. My recommendation: bring friends and make everyone let you at least taste what they ordered. You won't be sorry. 

My party collectively ordered the duck breast with mac and cheese, meatloaf with mashed potatoes, duck confit pot-pie and the bratwurst burger. I would highly recommend any of those entrees but the duck breast was the stand out. Ill be coming back for this dish alone. 

The Shaved Duck also has a great craft beer selection. 

Already planning my next trip!

For me it was a long , boring tour. We stayed in the same section of the swap and it bored me. People were excited about a turtle or a bug and the tour guide would stay there looking at a turtle for 10 minutes! It was way too much time to contemplate a turtle or grass, knowledge is great,  but the time spent on each bug, plant, or turtle was just too much for me. I would have preferred him going up and down the river more. However,  my husband would rate the tour 4 stars as he loved it.

Love their food here. We go here for special occasions and always love the entire visit. Friendly waiters and amazing food. In my opinion, this is better than Sullivans and Ruth Chris, which I have been to quite a bit. 

They have a great special side room my Dad once rented out to surprise my mom for their 30th with all of our family and friends. Very reasonable priced and they helped him out with all of the details, down to getting some flowers for the room.
Can't go wrong with their White Chocolate Mousse! So Yummy!!!

I must give these exceptional and outstanding personnel from Floor and Décor a great review.  I was so impressed w/ the interest they showed me from the time I walked in to this store and all the way to my purchasing their products.  I was assisted by Donald, who showed me the quantity and all the other necessary things I would need to do my floor cover.  Donald assisted me all the way until I was ready to checked out.  At checked out, Lisa was very patient and interested and help me thru since I was purchasing a big quantity and there were items that needed to be kept at the Store until I finalized the purchase of the property I was refurbishing.  The Store Manager Stephanie Lealters was accommodating and actually was there, first hand in making my confusion on checked out smooth and comfortable.  I was so pleased that I came back the next week to purchase for the 2nd property I will be purchasing.  Of course, I requested for Donald, went to  Lisa at check out, and Stepahanie was there first hand to make sure that I as the customer received full satisfaction of service.

This place has a decent selection of beers and ciders. The wine selection is not bad, but it's also a fairly small location. 
We witnessed a less than comfortable interaction between a group of costumers and a cash attendant. The employee handled it like a pro. The costumers were angry that the attendant wouldn't sell them liquor if they couldn't all provide ID - which is the law - she explained that there would be a chance that they are buying it for them blah blah blah. Make sense! The costumers gave her grief and yelled a bit. She stood her ground. Good for her. 
Watch out for people in this parking lot - it's like people don't understand the spot and the road.

Up until our last two visits I would have rated 4.5 stars.  Food has been delicious and service from bartender Elliot has been top notch!  Sadly, NO MORE.  We don't live in the area either and make it point to visit Black Powder Tavern when we can, especially for the Toll House Pie.  

Though this desert has seen changes from pie slice, to individual sized pie/tart pan, and then back to pie slice it was a favorite of ours.  However, whom ever is making it now, PLEASE STOP THEM.  The last two visits there have been no chocolate chips in the pie, so all you are left with is a slightly under-cooked mess of tasteless dough.  The only thing worth eating on the dish is the ice cream.  :(  

Please fix this.

WORTH THE WAIT. OMG BEST RESTAURANTS IN SB!!

my first time in SB and saw this was highly rated on yelp and the yelpers were not wrong. santa barbara shellfish company aint got nothing on brophy bros... we walked from our hotel and arrived around 6:20pm on a friday night. we found the wait to be over an hour and they had so many people there that they ran out of buzzers and told me to return twice to receive one, but they never had any. we spent our hour wait walking the walkways near the beach, water and boats. plus, there are plenty of seats outside nearby to wait. alas, 7:30pm we were seated on the upper deck outdoors (since they only served outdoors during covid).

THE FOOD:
-FREE BREAD... YES THEY HAVE AMAZING FREE SOURDOUGH BREAD THAT MY BODY COULDNT GET ENOUGH OF :D

-garlic baked clams ($15.95) - comes with 6 clams and these were VERY rich, but delicious. my boyfriend couldn't stop raving about them. I think since they're so rich it is great to share among a group. but definitely try these out and pour lots of lemon juice on them!!

-seafood pasta ($21.95) - OMG... so we didn't realize entree specials came with cole slaw, clam chowder or salad, and fries or rice pilaf... ARE YOU SERIOUS?! this is enough to feed 3 people LOL amazing. totally worth the price. HOWEVER let me detail each item:

-seafood pasta - DO NOT ORDER. I dont know why this is a thing, but it was fresh seafood with watery, no flavor linguine. it made me never want to eat linguine again. get something else.

-cole slaw - disappointing, but comes with a lot

-clam chowder cup - HOLY MOLY. MY FIRST CLAM CHOWDER AND AM BLOWN AWAY. 10x better than santa barbara shellfish company down the street. comes with the oyster crackers and the flavor of the clam chowder is out of this world. PLUS with the free sourdough bread I dunked the crap out of it. MUST GET.

-fries - came with so much!!!!!! these were perfectly delicious and just banging. LOL get it!

PROS:
-SWEETEST server. 9/11/20 served us at 7:30pm on the upper deck. female with dark hair. she was so sweet and nice. even the other gentlemen working the deck were nice when we encountered them. JUST 10 STARS for the staff working the tables.
-free bread...
-best clam chowder
-beautiful view
-MADE US FEEL SO DAMN SAFE during covid. omg. I haven't really been dining into restaurants except this trip and they had a hand sanitizer bottle of GOOD hand sanitizer (not the bad smelly ones) sitting on the table and you could tell they were very clean and respective of our space and wearing masks.

CONS:
-seafood pasta is just a no for me
-staff at the front taking names down aren't the nicest

OVERALL:
im recommending everyone to come here. worth the wait. left a lasting impression on us during our first trip out here. thank you brophy bros!
This place is the best. Always satisfied when and leave and the employees are great and friendly! See you guys next time

My first time at this cute tiny shop and it was pretty good. Most of the cupcakes were gone , though that is my fault for going on valentines day . I got red velvet cake bite (amazing) , the death by chocolate cupcake , butter pecan and the cherry brandy cupcake . I didn't try all of them but according to my boyfriend the butter pecan was all sugar and he couldn't even tell what it was supposed to be. The other ones were delicious. I'd give it another try. As for the service it was a little rushed and the person behind the counter seemed annoyed when asked how much the sweets cost.

As a local and die hard fan of supporting my local restaurants, I must say, Rosa Mezcal is on the top of my list, for a number of reasons. First of all, the staff and owner are some of the most caring and attentive I've ever seen. They really care about making sure you have not just a good experience, but a great one. Secondly, the decor of this place makes me feel as if I'm in a Mexican Wonderland. The truck bar, and all the little decor details fascinate me.  If you're a soccer fan, this is your spot, as they have international soccer games on all the time. 

Now let's talk about la comida. As a Latino, I 100% approve of their queso dip. This is my favorite queso dip in the whole city. My tip: take some queso dip on a chip then dip it in their complimentary salsa for an extra kick... so delicious. If the queso gets cold before you finish eating it, as is usually the case with the larger order, they will gladly reheat it for you. The tacos are superb. All of them. Make sure you're hungry, because you get your money's worth of food here. 

Lastly, I have to mention this. After a few visits, I started talking with the owner more and asked why he did not offer "Elote Loco" also known as "Crazy Mexican Corn". This is a street favorite in Mexico - corn on the cob with butter, mayo, parmesean cheese, cayenne pepper and a touch of sea salt served with a lime wedge (optional: cilantro). He said, this particular appetizer style dish was not well known enough or requested enough to be on the menu. Logistically, it would not make sense for him to add it to the menu. Nonetheless, he noticed I was a loyal and regular customer, so he offered to make it for me one day, as long as I called him a day or so in advance for him to make it for me. Soon afterwards, I happily too him up on his offer, two or three times now and it was pretty spectacular. Certainly did not disappoint. So, now I'm kind of on a mission! I believe this would make a great appetizer but he needs demand! So, I'm telling you to DEMAND THE CRAZY MEXICAN CORN!!! Lol. Hopefully, enough locals will read this and request this enough for it to be on the menu. 

Overall, this is a local gem that has truly earned 5 stars from me. Small or large groups would benefit from the intimate environment for a celebratory event. Romantic dates have the perfect setting if seated in the in cozy window booths. Eating alone? The bar is a great spot to hang out as I've done several times. 

Oh, and one more thing. As a very light drinker, I have to say, I really like the flavors of their Mezcal drinks. I don't even know what to order. I just tell the bartenders what I do and do not like and again, no disappointment there. 

Conclusively, dear locals and tourists, I certainly hope you give this place a try!

Hasta la vista!

There was a rubber band in my cheese steak and some sort of hair particle that made me envision my sandwich getting dropped onto the kitchen floor and then just picked up and shlapped right back on there.  The employees said the rubber band was sinew.  Either way, it should not have been on my sandwich.  I want to eat delicious foods that don't force me to fish random textures out of my mouth. So ladylike, right?  Will not be back.

Can't beat the TAX FREE discount! I drove all the way from NoVA and it's worth the drive if buying expensive apple stuff. Store is large and plenty of helpful employees.  I came on a weekday so it wasn't too busy but I'm sure the weekends would be packed.

The owner is very friendly.  If you order something else, he will try to talk you out of it - towards a Chai.  Listen to him.  If he says he makes the best Chai in Philly: he is NOT lying.  He literally makes it from scratch (skipping the sugary powdery standby that most places fall back on).  I highly recommend this place, even if only for the experience.

This is a gorgeous space for a walk. It's very close to UCSB, meaning you may see many students here. Unfortunately right now, with Covid-19 and social distancing, it could be a difficult place to visit. People may not be giving each other room to follow public health guidelines. If that's a concern, you might want to stay away. Otherwise, be sure to bring your mask. 

I visited last week around sunset and the area was moderately populated. There was a fog rolling in across the Naples Point Marine Conservation Area and the view west along the coast was beautiful. I had to be cautious because I'm taking social distancing seriously and some folx on the beach and paths weren't giving me the space I needed. That said, I was mostly able to navigate with a wide enough birth to feel safe, and was glad for the fresh air, scenery, and exercise. It probably gets nuts when it's warm out, but for now as weather remains cool, I feel alright walking in the area with a face covering.

Walked in and the staff were immediately able to diagnose my iPhone's issue (broken LCD), give me a price comparable to what Apple would charge and fix it within the hour.  (Couldn't get an appointment at the Genius Bar - which is a circus - for two days.). Pleasant people, clean and quiet store. I'll be back with other phones that have issues for sure.

So seriously books and wine are two of my favorite things. And this place is so cute! They are also open in the morning for coffee for people who don't want wine at ten am. Located in the heart of dtsp this place made me so happy walking in. (If Elizabeth is working please tell her I said hi, she is great!) While you are browsing their book collection you can sip on wine! And buy bottles of wine to take home (or drink there, no judging!) This spot is such a great addition to our city and I'm so glad I was able to check it out! If wine isn't your "cup of tea" they also have other drinks available including one or two beers, coffee, tea, and sparkling waters. And lots of books to choose from! I like dark and twisty and was able to find a couple I can't wait to dive into!

Hands down one of the best wine bars in downtown St. Pete! The many different selections of wine are amazing and unique. We enjoyed being educated on the different wines and locations of where the wines come from. We absolutely love the decor and the staff are very knowledgeable. The food is amazing! We enjoyed the flatbreads and the meat/cheese boards. Great place to go!

I never ever write bad reviews but I have to for this salon.  DO NOT COME HERE.  Smells bad.  Worst haircut of my life. After reading many reviews, thought we give it a try.  Kevin, the owner himself took literally 5 mins to cut.  Showed him a picture.  He started cutting nonstop. He thin out all my hair and cut my bangs so short.  Was in and out in 10 mins. Very very disrepectful.  Acted like I owed him something.  I hope you go out of business.

You I live sushi and there are now plenty of places to go in St. Louis. So the better half and myself were in Clayton when I had an inkling for some sushi.  The place I want to go to said it was opened on the website, but when we arrived at the door.....CLOSED. so I jump on my yelp app to locate a other location Sushi Ai popped up. Now I've heard a out this o e, but never been.

So we went and was immediately seated. I ordered my normal, but they had a different one that we didn't recognize.  So Vince asked what it was (had lot of black and orange colors) and so we ordered it. Nope, no sake for me because they had bud light lime, lol! The food was good I must say. It was fresh and the service was excellent! Because it's on a main road, the parking can suck! But we found one spot amazingly close and it was the weekend, so that helped. You may want to check out nearby parking when going. I'm just glad I found one close by so if I run to the mall or go pay taxes at the administration bldg., I can go cheer myself up afterwards by going to eat here!

Elmer's fixes the best breakfast. Period.
The employees are all kind. The atmosphere is wonderful, especially when it's 25 degrees outside.

Get the German Pancake (Dutch Baby) combo with all sausage instead of eggs. They get their sausage from Oregon and boy is it good!

Coffee is wonderful diner coffee. My only complaint is that they don't have one of these near me!
Great hotel in Clayton. Staff are excellent. Wish it had 24 hour room service. Fun lobby with sushi and music.

Had my son take his senior photos with Eric. My son was very comfortable with Eric, which reflected in all the great photos that were taken for my sons senior photos. Quality of work is amazing. Thank you Eric!!

Okay, so I keep getting bugged in email by Miller to write a review so here you go.  I ordered  my new F150 from Miller on Dec. 23, 2014. They said I'd have it in 6 - 8 weeks.  At the end of March they told me it was lost and I should order a new one or get my deposit back. I'm a patient man, I waited.  30 days later, at the end of April it showed up.

I brought it in for some things that were wrong, most notably the moonroof making a loud knocking noise.  It got fixed after two trips there, and they having it for a full week. (oh, and the dealer is located 40 minutes from my house so it's no easy trip, and don't ever bother getting a loaner from Enterprise across the street, unless you have a 1/2 day just to sit around waiting for a ride, they are literally right across the highway from the dealer)

Fast forward to March 2016. Moonroof is making noise again, along with a hard downshift from 5th to 4th gear.  They said they couldn't hear the noise from the moonroof, which is really interesting because the noise is frequent. I'm somewhat hard of hearing and I hear it with no problem.  I showed them an official Ford Technical Service Bulletin on the downshift problem, they said they didn't see the problem happen.  I told them it happens once or twice a week, that a drive around the block for 3 minutes isn't going to show it. They said if they can't see it, they can't fix it.  It's a TSB published by Ford, a well known problem with the 2015 F150s and the fix is a simple software upgrade to the truck.  Something they can probably do in minutes, but won't. 

So, for the moonroof they said they found a TSB and it requires a special grease they needed to order.  They said "it'll be in within 2 or 3 days, we'll call you to set something up".  That was over 2 weeks ago, I'm still waiting for the call.

As far as the downshift problem, I wrote to FordService on f150forums.com and asked for support.  They told me to go to a different dealer and they will get it worked out. 

There you have it.  Ford Service on F150forums telling me to go to a different dealer. So why would anybody go to Miller Ford?I'm really struggling here.  I tend to buy new vehicles every few years.  I absolutely love my '15 F150, and will likely have it for several years.  I had hoped to build a good relationship with the dealer I bought the truck from, but it seems they are not interested in that relationship.

And that's just 1/2 the story.  There's a lot more disappointing things but it's just not worth the time.  I'll get my moonroof fixed, and my downshift problem fixed, but I guess I have to go somewhere else, because Miller isn't interested in fixing the issues.

Bob in Riverton NJ

You simply can't go wrong with what you order. Friendly staff, hard workers and a clean place. 

My husband and I go there fairly often and we are greeted with a smile always. 

Take out or eat in, the food is delicious!

Was craving either a sandwich or salad in the area and South Coast deli had the highest average ratings on yelp.  Checked out their menu online and saw that they had Cobb salad and Cobb salad sandwich!!  I went with the latter because yelpers raved about the 'sammies' here.  Guess what? Their Cobb salad sammie totally satisfied my craving and hunger! Yay!!

Their sandwiches or 'sammies' range from $8-$10 and are HUGE (enough for two)!! My sammie had thick slices of tender turkey meat and was packed full with salad! The bread tasted like freshly baked artisan bread! Great taste and value! 

There is a small parking lot located to the left of the shop.

If I could have wiped my ass with the one star and served it for breakfast to Flagship employees I most definitely would have. F___ this place!! They are pond scum and their employees are ghetto shit rats. They have destroyed our credit and NOBODY should enter an agreement with them!! They don't care about you!! The vehicle you want to buy is NOT WORTH IT!!!

This place fits into the 3 star category rather well: it's a convenient place to grab a muffin in the morning, but the one time I actually got cooked food (a 2 egg breakfast with bacon and toast) the eggs were wet, soggy, and unappetizing. The coffee is pretty good though, which saves it from being a 2 star.

What a great service. Once you figure out all the ins and outs of the app this is such a great service!!! My mom just has to be ready to open the door at the appointed hour... The driver brings the bags in and refuses a tip. What a great service for those who can no longer drive and walk the isles with ease.

Horrible! Called to place my order and was on hold for almost 30 minutes. I decided to drive to the restaurant and there was no line. I told the person taking my order who also answers the phone and she laughed. Not a good experience for a pricey pizza. Horrible!

I stopped by the other day to check out some units and Armando was so helpful and kind. He answered all my many questions and walked me through the process. I highly recommend this storage space! Thank you Armando!
This has always been a great spot but they recently redesigned the outside part with fire pits and a great atmosphere. Good spit if you want a drink and a view

Food is absolutely amazing. 5 stars for the food especially the boneless bbq wings and straight fries! 

With the whole curbside thing though, I've had some bad experiences with the woman who walks the food out. I also don't appreciate being given a completely different item that to didn't order just because the bag is tied up and you know I won't check till I get all the way home. The third time I didn't receive the total count of wings I was missing two out of six that I ordered. This place is not cheap so missing items in my order completely ticked me off a bit.

Most downtown restaurants jack up their prices for the tourists, but I always leave this one feeling I've experienced good value. The wait staff is "always" friendly. The bar area is a bit small, but has some old school charm.

Not a real restaurant, it's a ghost kitchen. I ordered it through DoorDash and was disappointed to find out they didn't open a restaurant here in Reno. The food was clearly prepared in a microwave. I tried most things on the menu and none of it was pleasant. I would definitely give a real Wow Bao restaurant a try but not again here in Reno.

We ate here last night, Waiter Liam (?) was very good. Wifey had a filet & lobster tail, (we question the nonround filet) I had 1/2 half rack ribs falling off the bones, Loaded baked potato and unlimited "fried" shrimp, Potato was good ribs were very good, but shrimp were not even close to being crisp. which leads me  to wonder  if outback's actual have deep friers at all. we both had  their clam chowder which is always the best. two iced teas, $65. minus the two $7.99 add ons, would had been $50.00. We will return...

The best pizza in the area! Excellent NJ-style pizza with delicious crust and quality ingredients.

I highly recommend their cheese steaks as well. My favorite buffalo chicken cheese steak in the area.

The only reason I wouldn't give 5 stars is because some of their other items are a bit lacking. The subs are OK, but not quite on the level I would expect from a place with such great pizza.

I don't care for their wings, but I am pretty particular about how I want them. The wings are breaded, and not quite crispy.
Great snow cones and the option for the ice cream is awesome. My husband and I have been their twice and both times great. The new owners are really nice!! Sure hope this place makes it.
Fresh chips, tasty salsa choices.. the chili replenish are my favorite with an order of chips and salsa!!!

Best breakfast yet in Tucson. Breakfast is my fav meal so I'm particular. Hash browns were crispy perfect!  Sausage and eggs excellent and fresh!  I do not normally eat sweets but the snickerdoodle pancake was out of his world!!!!  Husband loved his cinnamon roll French toast.  This could become "our spot "!

This one one of my favorite places I visited when I came to the Philadelphia area.  My friends and I are huge gamers and we love playing Cataan.  The probably is that due to some stuff being worked on at their house, we really didn't have a place we could set it up.  So we wanted to find somewhere we could chill and play.

So the cool part about this place is that they have tons of tables you can use and they aren't going to charge you like some places.  If they are using them for tournaments then there are requirements, but on a regular night you can come right in and play games here.  They have plenty of beverages in their cooler for sale and the prices are insanely reasonable too.  As for store stock, they don't have a ton of gaming stuff.  I would say this place is 80% venue for gamers and 20% stock items for sale.  

Definitely come here if you need somewhere to play, just give em a call first to make sure it's not tournament night.
The terminal is small enough that getting from one gate to another in a hurry isn't an issue. The major negative is the lack of food options. We so desperately need more food choices at Terminal 2.

Short menu, but what they do they do well. A 10 $pot for a good damn grilled burger and half a spud's worth of fries (that are just short of half-a potato wedge by themselves.) No indoor area, but they will gladly bring your order to your car when it's ready. Kick back, listen to the radio and enjoy.

This is a great downtown Tampa location with fresh organic fruits, vegetables and meat. They have things for any type of diet. I tried their lunch today with fresh squeezed juice and a couple of sandwiches. The prices were great and so is their service and quality of food. I will definitely go there again and you should stop in yourself and try it!
They had a lot of different choices for the bbq sauces which was fun to try. The sausages was my favorite and a must try! Go go go! Stafff was super friendly too

I love the doctor and staff here. My dog loves coming to the vet. She literally runs in the door and I trust this place not to jack up prices or try to cheat you out of $. I trust this place with my pups life and I couldn't ask for a better vet!  Definitely recommend this place!
Service Is terrible. Gave us two competently different things than we ordered and we waited thirty minutes for a couple of wraps.

Awesome dining experience. The presentation of the food was nice, I ordered the Seafood Feast, Garlic noodles and Lobster Rice  for myself and my 3 guest everything was real good and we had a box of leftovers.

My husband and I went here a few weeks ago. The staff was very friendly. The clientele was also very friendly. But what was the most surprising was the food. I had no expectations at all for bar food. Honestly, it was the best cheese steak I have ever eaten and I have tried many. The other food was also very good. I really enjoyed the whole experience and also liked being able to be outside. Hats off to Tip O'Leary's I had a wonderful time and it made my day. I appreciate your establishment. Thank you for the highlight of my weekend. I felt like I was on vacation. I will definitely be back.

Came here last night not knowing what to expect, but I was definitely NOT disappointed! I ordered my usual favorites of Philly rolls and crunchy crab and shrimp rolls, and tried some fried crab rolls - delicious!! And best part: I got to end it with some mochi ice cream!!! I've never had any before and was very eager to try. They also have ramune for sale. They're all flavors you can find at World Market - nothing special - but I like the option to get it there!

I had to go to Pat O's for the famous hurricane (especially since I'm a meteorologist!).  The place was filled with a great crowd on a Friday night but we were able to get right to the bar and have a drink in hand in a matter of minutes.  The only reason I give the place 3 stars is that I really didn't like the drink very much, I thought it was wayyy too sweet and honestly it was hard to finish it.  After having a hand grenade at tropical, I think my standard was too high for these fruity concoctions.  If I get back to Nola and end up at Pat O's, I will definitely try another beverage and come back to edit this review!

Sunday brunch **Southern Catfish was great had to get grits / fried green tomatoes... The entire party had a hard time trying to order sides our reservation was set for 6pm. Just a estimate they have at least 10 different sides however there was only like 4 available. Most people in the party had fried chicken that was not seasoned and it was fried hard. We have been to Ella's in the past and we have had a better experience not sure what's going on... Definitely won't be coming back anytime soon.

Started off our amazing dining experience with a warming "WELCOME" from the bartenders (one Tuesday afternoon). Hostesses were nice and welcoming. Started with the naked cheese...IT WAS ORGASMIC. If you don't love cheese then order something else, I love cheese, this was amazeballs. Then fish tacos, don't expect no crummy frozen, battered & fried fish stick, this was real fish. Great flavors with the slaw and gauc. Salmon BLT was great too. Great atmosphere with a classic twist.

This place is horrible... I sat at the bar and finally had to leave because of a weird smell that made me nauseas. The customer service was horrible: the bartender avoided eye contact & it took 10 mins to get a check for sparkling water when he wasn't busy at all, the staff was complaining about customers, and at one point I heard staff yelling complaints about a coworker in the back... I decided not to eat here and went to Starbucks instead.
Excellent food!!  Excellent Service!! Mary is the best!!!! Love the Shrimp & Grits!!!

I was on my way for coffee while running errands in Avon when Smoothie King caught my eye. I hadn't been yet so I decided to try this new health conscious chain on Rockville Road. It's in the same strip center as the new Denny's that's now open too just east of Starbuck's off Gable Drive.

There is a drive through but it was filling up quickly so I went inside. This gave me the opportunity to linger over the menu plus see how their prepared. 

Outside the entrance is an outdoor patio with 3 tables. The interior has 3 small tables, a couple chairs and a 4-top high table. Walk straight back to place your order. While you're in line check out the nutritional products and snacks to the right. The large overhead menu is broken down into categories from Slim, Fitness, Wellness to Anytime with calories and prices noted for all 3 serving sizes. The cups sizes are 20 oz., 32 oz. and 40 ozs. Prices range from $5.45 - $8.95 without enhancers or extra add on's which are $.99 each.

I ordered the 32 oz. Pineapple Surf from the Anytime category. It's blended with pineapple, sweetened strawberries, kiwi  apple juice blend, turbinado and a dairy whey blend. My Pineapple Surf was ice cold, thick, filling, very refreshing and delicious! 

There are many nutritious enhancers, plus fruits and veggies, you can add to customize your Smoothie for your personal health goals from Slim, Fitness, Wellness to Energy Enhancers. 

The staff was polite, helpful and friendly. I thought service was fast for making fresh smoothies. There were 9 people ahead of me and my wait was close to 10 minutes with 7 staff behind the counter handling drive thru and inside customers. 

I enjoyed my smoothie on this hot 92 degree, August day and will frequent again when in Avon.

The pizza was crisp and flavorful. The cheese was a little greasy. The large pizza was $9.99 but was a 14" size.  Back home or anywhere else we call that a small or medium.  Large is always 16".  The owner is very personable and delivers the food himself. I recommend this spot for NY style pizza.
