My nephew had his birthday party here. We had an amazing time. What really made it amazing was Joey took great care of our party. He was pleasant, funny and interactive with us. We all definitely felt the need to come back and share our experience with others.
The woman behind the counter suggested the original cider and I was not disappointed. It was crisp, light, and loved how she filled the freaking cider to the brim!!!

We came here for breakfast because they have outside seating. The coffee is very good and service very friendly. They were very flexible to make modifications for vegetarian options. I ordered the smoked gouda and cheese omlette, which came out looking simple but was absolutely delicious. Fluffy eggs, fresh spinach, just melted cheese and a simple green salad with amazing dressing. My husband had the eggs benedict, they were cooked perfectly. Not cheap, but what is cheap around Rittenhouse square?

It really pains me to write this review. This used to be comparable to any Italian restaurant on the hill but now it seems like they replaced their mozzarella with some kind of cheaper imitation cheese (or provel?!). Last time I was here I had the lasagna. Very disappointed. Grocery store frozen Italian has better flavor.  Service is also slow even when not crowded as well.

I do Escape Rooms all over the country, and I can honestly say this is my favorite. The puzzles are great - challenging, fun, and original. But it's the care and planning that goes in to the story and the set design that really puts these rooms head and shoulders above the rest. Highly recommended for Escape Room aficionados!

Return customer here! Tom is my guy, he always provides excellent service and is upfront about the devices and deals. The guy seriously knows his stuff, and has earned the trust that I give. Would not let anyone else handle my phone! Props 360!

I had a great experience shopping at AutoNation Nissan! The team was very personable and seemed like they had my best interest in mind. They helped me get the vehicle I wanted at the best deal possible and were able to answer any questions or concerns I had. I would recommend AutoNation Nissan if you are in the market for a new vehicle!

Oh my god I have never in my life eaten fried chicken this good and I have eaten more fried chicken than I care to say! Those buttered honey biscuits are to die for and are worth it! The atmosphere is fantastic with a genuinely friendly staff that wrote the book on service. The bright lights and colorful interiors make eating at Willie's all the more awesome.

One of the cutest Mom and Pop stores I've been in within the city. The customer service was top tier. They treated every single customer like family. We initially came in for the Cheese wheel pasta but walked out with loads of goodies and treats. 
I ordered the Creamy Carbonara pasta which included garlic bread and a side salad. The portions were hearty. I couldn't finish it all. Everything was made to order and very very fresh! The sauce was so delicious and creamy and the pancetta was flavored so well it made everything come together perfectly! 
The owner gave us samples of baklava which was so delicious and fresh! We also had some of there house blend called ginger joy juice( brought some for sure! You have to try it )
If you get a chance try the cheesecake brownies they are a slice of chocolate goodness.

We dined at Saffron this evening for the second time and our experience was just as wonderful as our first visit! The food is delicious - we tried the chicken tika masala and Goan fish curry during our first visit and tonight we tried the butter chicken and fish vindaloo. We also tried quite a few types of naan both times - paneer, garlic, roti and one with lamb. We love trying authentic restaraunts and Saffron did not disappoint! The staff is extremely friendly, helpful and attentive. Saffron is our new go to when we're craving Indian food :)

We had reservations and were seated right away. Amazing experience, top notch service. We had some bumps with hot food but the manager rectified immediately. 
Our favorites: beef short rib with potato Rosti, Louisiana shrimp and fish ceviche, gnocchi with pancetta, the steak and the fish special. All were very very good!
Dessert: banana brown butter tart and the flourless chocolate cake with strawberry jam... both amazing!! Would defiantly recommend this restaurant.

I lost my car key and the spare was 150 miles away. After I called AAA it only took a few minutes before Robert from Bob Holzer got in touch with me to confirm my location and shortly after he was there. He was able to unlock the car swiftly and without leaving so much as a scratch and a few minutes later we were on our way, towing my car to the dealer. 
Great service, can only recommend!
Sunday lunch. Relaxing. Godfather flatbread tasty. Albacore roll kinda odd. My only real complaint is cost but sushi always is expensive.

Though I bought a bicycle from them online and have never been to this location, I will say that their customer service is FANTASTIC. They really took care of me when we had a small shipping mishap and if I ever make it out to PA, I'll definitely swing by and give them my business!

Now  that I have experienced   the difference it will be impossible  to have Pancakes anywhere else. No fillers just fresh ingredents  made on the spot. The french way is to have salad with most means and now I know it works with breakfast . The owner was checking things out in the dining area and the young lady waiting on tables was also very helpful. If you want to take a quick trip to France this is the way to go.

Poor service and even worse food. Waitress disappeared and forgot my wife's cream for her tea for so long the tea was cold. When she finally returned to take our order I was somewhat miffed by the unfriendly attitude. 
The photo is supposed to be a classic diner cheeseburger. Classic mess if you ask me. Couldn't find our waitress and located a manager. Manager arrived apologized and offered to try again. Our waitress saw the manager at our table and the manager showed her the food. She started laughing and walked away. The manager did take the item off the bill. What truly has happened to quality control and service in the service industry. 
The food returned minus the fries that had come with the original order. Our "waitress" asked if I had wanted fries!!! Are you kidding me?! Had I not wanted fries I most likely wouldn't have ordered fries. I do apologize for my less than polite comment as I was somewhat dumbfounded at the question. 
Won't be returning to this location even though the Manager tried.

Very disappointed!  Went in with a drawing of my tattoo exactly how I wanted it. The girl who was going to do it said she just needed to "make the flowers tattoo friendly". Almost two hours later she came back with a drawing that was not even close to mine with the wrong flowers. She was hesitant to do my drawing. Said it was "too busy and not tattoo friendly".  I asked for my drawing back and walked out. What a shame!  It should not take an artist over 15m to "fix" a tattoo nevertheless almost 2.

Standard big bar scene good for watching the game. Large list of Long Island selections. Would come here with friends but not co-workers. Breadsticks are great drinking food along with their other bar fare.

Vegan quesadillas, YES!  
Everything is fresh, mostly local organic, and the selection of vegan options seems endless.  Try the kale salad with vegan cheese and it will rock your world.

Absolutely outstanding !  Beers are terrific, especially for the first go around with brand new equipment. 

 Menu is very well thought out and balanced, dishes were executed very well.  I like the portion size, and frankly would not mind slightly smaller portions....this comment in response to some who thought the serving sizes a bit small.

The space is gorgeous, the colors are muted and sophisticated...everything just seems to "work".

Every staff member I encountered was well trained, enthusiastic, knowledgeable and friendly without having to exchange Facebook information !

I think an overall excellent value, the pricing for me was spot on...and I felt was exceeded by the quality of the products, the space, and the service.

banana foster: innovative idea, interesting prep process, good at the first bite. but then it became so excessively sweet, what with the caramel and everything. so i don't know man. (BUT they have very beautiful decorations! it was such a lovely place, i loved it.)

Mercedes Benz of Tampa really gives great customer service. I cannot say enough good things about this dealership. They have a lovely facility, waiting rooms, coffee bar and great employees. I have owned my Mercedes for 1 year. Every time I stop in to have my car washed or pick something up they always call me by name. 
I highly recommend Mercedes of Tampa if you are considering a new or used car.

This stealership sucks.  Past casual shopping experiences have kept me from EVER considering purchasing a vehicle from them, but I have taken my Durango there once for the second routine maintenance (~12,000 miles) as they are the closest to my house.  For the record, I bought my 2014 Durango Citadel from Family Chrysler Jeep Dodge in Philadelphia.  Great experience and price.  But Cherry Hill just quoted me $224 + tax for an oil change, tire rotation and cabin air filter.  Turnersville Chrysler Jeep Dodge quoted me $109 for the same service.  Suffice to say, I am driving the extra miles to go to Turnersville.  Cherry Hill even wants to rebalance the wheels/tires after a routine rotation.  Before even checking to see if they are out of balance.  Absurd.

First off, amazing experience and Karen was fantastic. Today was my first massage, and as a guy who also deals with social anxiety, I was very nervous. The staff made me feel incredibly comfortable through the whole experience. As for the massage, the only complaint is have is that I should have scheduled a longer session. Karen, my massage therapist, was incredible. She immediately developed a great rapport with me and was very good at helping me feel comfortable. And the massage was glorious. I felt like I could run a marathon when it was over. I gave this five stars because I couldn't give it ten!

The service has been solid when I've gone here, but 2 of the 4 times its just been a hassle from the owner. I've never actually met him/her bc he has the servers relay the messages. The one time I invited a friend to stop by and our server came down and told us that the owner was watching us from upstairs on camera (creepy) and said the friend needed to leave or pay $10. 

Why have policies that put servers in awkward situations, like trying to squeeze 1 out of 5 people for $10 if they aren't even smoking.

To the owner: This probably hurts your business long term because college aged people will be discouraged from coming if they're trying to hang out with any non-hookah smokers. Why not let people in on a minimum per table and then make money off of people hanging out and buying drinks? You'd do better long term.
If my stomach could tolerate hot chicken every day I'd go every day. I love the tacos or the Nashville tenders .

This tour is fantastic. My girlfriend and I came to Nasvhille for a brief weekend vacation, and she bought two tickets for this tour as a present. As someone that works in the craft beer industry, this tour is GREAT for people new to the movement or veterans as well. Each brewery was ready upon our arrival to give us samples of their beers and give us tours of their workplaces. They also answered any and all questions we had and were extremely accommodating. The tour company itself gave us fantastic customer service. The company reserved the right to cancel tours if the minimum amount of people (I believe 8) is not met. On this particular day, only my girlfriend and I were on the tour but they took us anyways. That's amazing customer service that my girlfriend and I appreciated very much. The tour also ended at a fantastic brewery with amazing food and even better live music. I would 10/10 recommend this tour to anyone considering it.

Steve is such a great partner to work with! I'd recommend his classes and consulting services for all companies that are looking to improve traffic on their websites. He mastered SEO techniques and helped our company to rank on the first page of Google searches.
In this Wordpress class I had the opportunity to understand the importance of blogs on our website and how to build a functional website as well with a whole bunch os plugins.
I can't wait to start my SEO class tomorrow and help my company develop new campaigns and strategies across the web.

This was our first visit to Liliana's and we were very impressed with both the food quality and the service. After reviewing the menu, we decided to order pizza, which had been our primary reason for eating out that evening. However, the menu was varied and we did find many additional items which we would have to consider the next time we come in eat or pickup.
We decided on the Bianca pizza, which has a white sauce, roasted chicken, broccoli and arugula with a house side salad.
The salad was excellent and the toasted garlic bread was seasoned and toasted to perfection...the serving size was just perfect; enough for us to crave for a second helping, but filled us up enough to know we would have to cut back on our pizza when it came.
When our Bianca pizza came, we knew just by looking that it would be DELICIOUS!
A very crispy, light and flavorful crust; the white sauce was just right on both the amount and consistency; the roasted chicken, broccoli and arugula was cooked to perfection! 
This was a delightful and delicious meal and we knew it would not be our last visit to Liliana's. We highly recommend this place...you will not be disappointed!
Amazing food and great service! Recommend any of the bao buns and the spring rolls!!!

I've gone to the Rib Cook-Off 2x & I've enjoyed it. I'm not a big fan of BBQ, but my best friend is so I decided to check it out. 

There are a lot of vendors & a lot of sauces to try. Most places only take CASH, so go the the ATM ahead of time. There's parking in the area, which is good & there's a hotel on site (for those who want to get their gambling fix). 

I'd recommend going on the weekday (Wed or Thurs) instead of the weekend (Fri-Mon) because of the crowd. My best friend & I were able to taste a lot of the BBQ stations in about an hour - 2 hours. We went back on Fri to buy BBQ sauce for my cousin, & the wait was long. 

I'll probably be back next year. 

Also - don't forget your sunblock...it gets super hot out here.
It's my last rental from Alamo. There are just so many others that do it better. Save yourself a headache. The ALAMO has fallen!!!!
The chicken, apple, & goat cheese salad is to die for!  The ingredients are fresh and delicious!

I've stayed here a few times and overall I'm quite happy. 

First time here, the internet didn't work. Then it worked, but at a snail's pace (I use Lotus Notes... if I'm on the road for work and I can't get online, I get grumpy). Because it was unusable, I paid the extra $10 or whatnot for premium service just to see if I could actually get my emails. It didn't help. I mentioned this at the desk in the morning, and they apologized and said they'd been having issues. I told them they didn't have to credit me back for the premium charge, but I'd appreciate it. When I got the bill, they hadn't (not a big deal, but if I was working there I would have taken it off). In subsequent stays, the internet has worked fine.

If you like small, quiet, boutique hotels - this is not your bag. It's busy, open, big, and boisterous. I like it, but I could see some people not enjoying the bustle when they check in. The rooms themselves are quiet, or at least the ones I've stayed in have been. 

The concierge lounge is big and has lots of seating but I have to say, it's my least favorite Marriott lounge that I've been too. It's a long narrow room and the ceilings are kind of low. The windows on the right just look out onto the rest of the hotel. I've come here in the evening to find they had nothing laid out, not even sodas and water (it seems like they just wrap everything up and shut down after the 5-7p food service sometimes). Also, they seem to end breakfast very early compared to other Marriotts.

Still, it's a nice hotel in a great location and the rates aren't that bad compared to what's in the area. 

Note - I've stayed at the Courtyard Marriott as well, which is a stone's throw away. I would not recommend staying there when this hotel is not much more and a significantly better experience.

This was the worst Mcdonald's experience i've ever had. You couldn't even consider the food "thrown together" it was so bad. Not just that, the food tasted terrible, like it was a couple days old and reheated kind of bad. Everything we got was stale and hard as a rock, we even got the new glazed pull apart doughnuts and it was missing 3 pull aparts!! I eventually had 1 and it also tasted like they've been sitting out all day and looked like someone was munching on them. You get what you get for the area so don't go here if you want good food/service lol.

Disappointed with the service here. The staff threw my money on the counter and didn't eat put my drink in the machine.  They even glared at me, extremly disappointed. Never going come back here again.
This was my first time at this nail salon. I had the pleasure of meeting Tran. She did a great job with my mani and pedi. She did did not rush.  I was very pleased with the results.

Steak was salty & over cooked to the max! I asked for Medium, they came out well well done. The experience was not a steak, it was chewing on beef jerky. The meat was tough to say the least. I gave some to my fiancé & when even he could not stomach it, took rest home for my dog.

They charged me $15 for 3 orders of spring rolls which is $4.78 an order and when I told woman I don't want it, she got angry and started yelling at me. Do not come here, it's not worth it! They are rude and they are unprofessional!

Only reason why I even have a star is because you have to give at least 1 :/ I was craving some Mexican food, and unfortunately St. Mary's already closed. Went here, got a a carne asada chimi with a horchata. First, the burrito was not good at all. The ends of it were way too hard, and there was a pretty good sized bone in my burrito. And then the horchata was really watered down. Next time I come out to Arizona, I'll just wait for St. Mary's. Never going to this place again

Z-Grille is a trendy looking eatery in St. Pete.  The decor was really funky but I liked it.  The strangest piece on display was an interpretation of the last supper where everyone was wearing lucha libre masks painted on skateboards. Don't see that every day.  I assume that this used to be a Chinese restaurant because there are Chinese dragons on a mural on the wall as well as on the bathroom doors.

For an appetizer I was able to try a little of someone's "WTF fries", which are described as having black truffle salt, manchego cheese, and chives.  These were outstanding.  Some would argue that $8 fries better be good but I would order these for myself without question.  

I ordered the chicken and waffles, which was $22.  In my opinion that is tiptoeing into "completely insane" pricing levels for chicken and waffles.  For that much money I would expect a huge portion (no) or some taste sensation that made them completely unique (no).  The included peppercorn butter was different, but I didn't like it and scraped it off.  I recently had some fantastic chicken and waffles at another trendy restaurant with similar food to Z-Grille in Savannah and it was much better and only cost $12.

I would come back to Z-Grille but with these prices it wouldn't be often.

Food was amazing, atmosphere was warm, Jordan was fantastic and rushed our order along so we wouldn't miss a show at the Hilbert.  Braised short rib, NY strip was perfect, portions were large.  Pear old fashioned  and Raspberry mule were strong and smooth.  Crab cakes towered over the table.  Will return and soon!

Great service, great food, and the hookah is really good. Everyone is very nice and accommodating. Belly dancers are fun and very interactive with the customer... Nice chill place to enjoy with a group of friends. I've been to a few hookah places here and this is one of the best services, and the hookah tastes great!! The food is delicious, a bit pricey for everything but it is def worth the extra $.

Update: it's downgraded to maybe a 3.5 star. I've been here a few more times, I feel like the food and service has downgraded. I'm not sure if they have trouble finding employees but it's someone different every time I go now. And service is super sloooooowwww now. Our server can go missing for a good 30 mins, and it's happen on a few occasions. Food is still good but prices are kind of expensive.

Rob and Aaron helped us find and purchase our first home in St Petersburg. They made the process smooth and fun. They spent a lot of time with us finding the right house and kept good communication throughout the buying process. I will use them in the future!

DO NOT HIRE. DO YOUR RESEARCH. My husband and I did not read all of the reviews that were available to us at the time. Regretfully, we hired CW due to his kind nature on the phone and when he came to our house to measure for a quote. DO NOT FALL FOR HIS INTIAL KINDNESS. We were told that we could choose any style wood, deck and railings we desired, and if we could furnish some photos, CW Fence would build to our specifications. Photos were sent, contract was signed and money was exchanged for the deck project. We tore our deck down ourselves, to save a few thousand bucks, on CW Fence & Deck's timeline. We were without a deck for over a month, due to all of the delays on the part of the company. When I called to ask for our money back and that we would go with someone else that could get to the project in a more timely manner, he screamed at me on the phone and told me that his wife had just had her tonsils removed and that he had to take care of his six sick children. I fell for it, felt bad for the guy, and allowed the project to continue, regretfully, waiting another two weeks past the second promised date to start.

MAKE CW FENCE PULL PERMITS AS STATED ON THEIR CONTRACT. READ THE FINE PRINT. We ended up pulling the permit on our deck ourselves, after the deck was completed (yes, per the codes office, that is completely legal, just not preferred).

CW Fence came to our home to build the deck on days when my husband and I were both working, and started the project. the holes were dug and footers poured, but that's the last of the good news. Once the deck was completed, we pulled the permit and the inspectors noted a lot of discrepancies. This is the reason Chris Waller did not want to pull a permit, so that corners could be cut, and work could be done as quickly as possible. The wood is a lesser quality than was promised and the screws and nails (we were only supposed to have screws) are not exterior, they are interior grade (read: cheaper).

The wood stairs leading to the deck start at 18" off the ground. My elderly mother cannot use that step and has to go through the garage to enter the house. There are no railings on the stairs, and the steps that we had agreed upon to step up from the lawn onto the main deck are altogether missing. There is, instead, a 36" drop, with no stairs or railing, to the ground from the edge of the deck. All of this was discussed and agreed to, example photos sent and understood, prior to the deck project beginning.

Needless to say, there are six codes violations that are so gross, that we are in the process of taking the deck apart and re-building it ourselves. The cost of doing so is going to far exceed the original deck cost and at such a great amount of time.

Since the "date of completion" we have been hounded with phone calls and emails to send the remaining amount of money on the contract. We have politely refused to pay for a job left half-done. One of these emails stated that one of his workers had fallen over a rock in our garden and was going to be out of work for six weeks. Chris Waller then asked for our homeowners insurance. DO NOT FALL FOR THIS. He is supposed to be licensed and bonded (insured) for workman's comp. We have also been threatened, lied to and downright insulted. As one other reviewer said, he does include his religious beliefs in both his sales pitch and his threats to us by insulting our religious beliefs after his job was left uncompleted. Please don't listen to this either. 

PLEASE IF YOU READ THIS, SAVE YOUR MONEY and DO NOT HIRE CW FENCE.

LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE this place! As soon as you get out of the car, you can smell the delicious grilling from the side. When you walk in, you can taste the southern home cooking in the air! The wait staff was great, down to earth and friendly. The food was delicious! We ate her several times, breakfast & lunch, and  had various things. We loved it all every time. They're not cheap on their portion either. We also had lots to take home. Maybe because we ate too much of those small, sweet and can't-take-your-fingers-off biscuits :)

One down side, the long is loooooooooooong especially for lunch. We went there early morning one time, and we got in within 10 minutes. We had to wait 1.5 hr for lunch...

We had lunch her 2 days ago with a group of friends. It's the kind of hole in the wall that If I was alone with my husband I would have opened the door and took one look and left. It was extremely filthy. I ordered the ham which was just your basic ham. Finished my meal and went to the ladies room. As I walked in our waitress was in there spitting in the trash can and wiping her mouth with her hands. She then went in a stall and obviously was having digestive issues. I was washing my hands when she came out of the stall and I moved over to make room for her. She just kept walking out the door with washing. I'm sorry, but I seriously almost threw up. It crossed my mind to tell the manager, but obviously cleanliness is a after thought here. I left and will never go back. EVER!!!

Do not listen to that bad review! This place is amazing and we will keep dining in to get this fabulous food! The servers are excellent and like any Italian restaurant, it's noisy and yes crowded. Makes us feel right at home! Thanks Oak Oven for your wonderful food and special homemade pastas!
The food was really good. The service was horrible. I don't think I've ever had such poor service. It's sad because the food is delicious but I will not be giving Banana Blossom my hard earned money.

I came here with my two best friends for my birthday dinner. We knew we had to start with a cheese board; it was the part we were most excited about. We received a collection of six cheeses and they were all fantastic selections. Our waitress helped us to pick a wine, a Côtes du Rhône called "Les Abeilles," which means the bees. It had wonderful fragrant notes of honey that ended up pairing perfectly with the cheese. 

Our meal was a little less than stellar. We shared rabbit sausage pappardelle, which came out too late for us to fully enjoy, and the gnocchi. To be fair I'm not a fan of gnocchi to begin with, but my friend who is liked them. The service was uneven and plates didn't really come out at the same time.

For entrees, we had to get the scallops. I had a bite and they were perfect. For a side we got creamed kale, which was majorly disappointing. They were cold and the kale wasn't cooked long enough for my liking. I'm sure there are other delicious things on the menu and I wouldn't be opposed to coming back to try them.

I've been bringing my cars here for service for about 10 years.  For the last year, Darby Jones has been continuing the great tradition of professionalism, fast service, and low prices started by the original owners.  Maureen is still running the front office.  They don't do smog inspections, but so far as I can tell they can do everything else. This is a great local business.
The food was good,  but the burrito was too small. Too pricey for the size. If you like sauce, I definitely recommend this place. Honey wasabi and spicy aioli sauce were very very good!!

This little restaurant put out delicious food! The best Kurma I've ever tasted. They have a buffet on Friday, Saturday, & Sunday and the menu is well divided between vegetarian and non vegetarian dishes. The staff are kind and attentive. It was so good that I'm writing this review!

This McDonalds rocks. I've never encountered friendlier employees and customers of any fast food restaurant in St. Louis! I walked in the other day for some oatmeal and a coffee and everyone was nodding, smiling, tipping their hat at me -- this place deserves to be next to a Home Depot. I'm going to make it a point to come back next time I'm hungry on Hanley.

Lots of parking, too, and easy on/off access to the road. Just a good setup in general, here.

Steve and team were first rate all the way.  Communication was timely, bike (stock Surly Straggler) we exactly as we spec'd, ready when promised.  Highly recommended, would absolutely do business with them again

Hajimaru has got to be one of my favorite Ramen places anywhere.  Service is fast and efficient and the Ramen noodles has great consistency and flavor.  Living in NY we frequent many of the top ramen establishments regularly but this surpasses all!
Windshield cracked in the car wash.  Contacted Ernie, the owner, and never received a response.  Poor customer service!!

Before heading to the Paint and Sip across the parking lot (Creative Juice), my friends and I decided to get a bite to eat at Sakura. We sat at the grill side for the fun and show. We had dumplings (Gyoza), miso soup, sushi, steaks, chicken, fried rice, vegetables.... the cook was fun and the show is entertaining if you've never done one before.
I love the creativity of the donuts. Always something new to try. The donuts are large in size and the vetnamis coffee is delish!
Excellent religious store.  Packed with lots of wonderful items. Every time I'm in the area I stop buy.  Check it out you will not be disappointed.

Actually; I'll say 4.5 stars, very good pizza for ten bucks. I had a "16 sausage, meatball, and pepperoni for a little over ten dollars, was a good pizza. His specialty pizzas for 13.00 are probably a little better. His thin crust, square shaped, Grandmother pie looked great. He had a nice sandwich and calzone menu. Sign outside said slices .99 cents. He's definitely worth the stop; especially if you don't want to break the bank. cheese or pepperoni pies are 7.99. nice clean place; food cooked fresh to order. nice people. opens at noon.
update:
returned today for three topping special. slight price increase, to 12.00$.
still the best value in Spring Hill. Pizza was excellent.

at first glance I wasn't sure if I wanted to enter, but I'm glad I did! had their spaghetti and something else was quite delicious. Their smoothies were tasty and found out the store owner wrote a nutritional book on plant based diet. They had really tasty looking deserts, I'll have to come back to try!

I truly enjoyed my dinner here. They have nice portion sizes with great food . The service was beyond professional and crazy fast. The prices were decent too, no complaints there. Overall It's a wonderful experience in my opinion
I enjoyed the food, service was great. Not sure why others have complained really.  I ordered a meat lovers and boneless wings.

From first to worst. This place is downright awful now since new owners took over. No one answers the phone, food is overcooked, overpriced and horrible tasting. This place used to be phenomenal, now it isn't even better than Papa John's.

(4) ~ very good overall food & service.  NOTE: For the Korean BBQ ~ They'll cook it at the table for you, but you can certainly help turn the meat to your liking;-)

OUR MENU:
** KOREAN BBQ = Maewon Galbi Kui ~ Hot Spicy Marinated Prime Rib (Beef) = (4.5) Very Good...It came with about (9) sides & Lettuce Leaves for creating Wraps, which they'll refill upon request.  The Sides included (in our order of liking;-) ~ Red Chile Paste & Garlic; Kimchi(cabbage); Kimichi(raddish); Eggplant; Bean Sprouts; Green Beans; Mung Bean Paste; Anchovies; & Tofu.
* Dolsot Bibimbap = (3.5) good

I dashed into this place for a quick bottle of water, and the whole place just felt worn around the edges.  The clerk WAS friendly and greeted me when I came in, which is why I bumped it up to 3 stars. However I probably won't dash in here again.

This is a beautiful historic hotel. Don't miss the history show in the lounge. It is a great light show.   Now for the negatives. The room was dirty -especially bathtub. They did not honor our reservation for a king bed. Instead giving us 2 queens.  The mall it is in is practically empty and shuts down very early. The area around the hotel is a little sketchy.  More. positive. The lady running the Grand Market was very nice and helpful. And they did give us $50 off our room since it was so dirty.

Some hipster rudeness going on with the dudes working inside almost harshed my melmow but the food is rad. Our waitress was super awesome! Highly recommend if you can take the wannabe Venice beach attitude in a Culver city suburb.

My family has been coming to Jumbo Dim Sum for about 5 years now and they are our go to location.

Our go tos always include sticky rice, beef rice rolls, pan fried pork dumplings, steamed pork buns, curried squid (my fave), sticky rice, onion cakes and spring rolls (for the chitlins) and then a couple surprise items each week.  

A side note about the curried squid - it is my absolute favourite dish to order here and the sauce is excellent over sticky rice but if it goes round and round the room on the cart too long it can get kinda rubbery, so be sure to get it fresh or when it first comes out.

The egg tarts tend to disappoint me here which is a bummer because they are one of my very favourite things in the world.

Getting a table here can be tough at times as they are quite busy which is of course a good sign!  

My kids love sitting by the tanks of crabs and lobsters which keep them entertained throughout the meal.

They can accomodate large groups here with a separate eating area as well as LARGE wooden circle table tops they lay down atop the smaller tables.

Service is quick and the prices are moderate compared to other Dim Sum places in town.

We've also ordered take out for dinner and unfortunately, both times items were either missing or wrong upon arriving home and when calling to initially order or try to rectify, language was a barrier.  So, my experience with takeout is definitely disappointing but the Dim Sum keeps me coming back for sure.

See you soon, Jumbo!

Thank you Terry Brown for the excellent experience trading for a new truck.  Terry provided me with everything I needed without the pressure to buy.  I have  been a customer of Bergey's for 9 years and have purchased 3 vehicles.  I highly recommend them.

I decided to try this place since I'm new to the area and a friend recommended it. I ordered just the regular 'Açaí Berry' bowl, which was $9.97!!! I wanted to make sure that the granola they were using was Vegan, but nobody in the store knew an answer, so I opted to omit it. I then asked about the Chocolate Nibs, which they told me contained dairy, and they DID NOT have any non-dairy options available, so again, I omitted them. The worker then asked me if I would like to substitute the two things I had just removed. I asked him what they had available, and he listed items off. I decided to go with almond slices and extra peanut butter. At no point did the worker inform me that adding the almonds & extra peanut butter would cost more, bringing my total to over $12.00. I'm only giving three stars because I don't particularly appreciate that I was charged extra for something that should've been included and untimely NOT informed of the price increase. In the end, the location was accessible, the ambiance was nice, the bathrooms were clean and well-stocked, and the food was good. I'll maybe try again in the future.

I ate here twice while in Santa Barbara this place is small I will tell you that right now but since its order at the counter you could easily get your food to go. The breakfast is AMAZING!!!!  I kick myself for not having lunch here as well but next time you bet your sweet ass that I will have breakfast and lunch here. The service is fantastic the cupcakes coffee just try it please its a great price too my Boyfriend and I had breakfast here for under 30.00 that included drinks and refills

Four of us ate dinner here on a Friday evening after four days of cooking meals! We were immediately greeted a the front desk by four friendly and gorgeous young ladies! One of them promptly led us to our table in a very busy restaurant. Before long our server arrived with our menus (way too large....suggest more pages and smaller size) and asked if we had been there before. We had, so she proceeded to take our drink order. Three of us ask for conventional cocktails and one requested a glass of Malbec wine. That's where the fun began. After awhile she arrived with our order with three shakers that she proceeded to pour. Two two of them were the wrong drinks, She profusely appologized and said that she would have them corrected. To make a long story short, it took her three more visits to get them correct. To be fair, we feel that it was the bar that made the mistakes, not our server. Finally, we got the right drinks even though when the wine was delivered the runner stated "here is your shiriaz sir" even thought he had ordered Malbec. The food was not bad. The Firebird salad was ample and quite good. All of us requested the prime rib medium rare. It was medium rare but, excuse me, it was tough. The waffled sweet potatoes and french fries were quite good. Other than the well prepared sliced mushrooms, the other sides were quite ordinary, The service was spotty but we were in a festive mood so it didn't matter to us.  Throughout the whole cocktail episode our server kept her cool and was genuinely apologetic for the confusion.
Noble crust has a great selection and food is well prepared and presented. We'll be back. Pizza is good and the Fried Green Tomato with Pork Belly was delish.

My sister and I had lunch here and it was amazing! We both ordered salads and it was WAY more good then we could handle! I liked being able to pick and choose what I wanted in the salad and then had seemingly endless options for dressing/sauce. I am looking forward to my next visit! This was one of the best and healthiest meal choices!

After many many months of 2 adults working from home, full-time, with a new (quarantine) puppy, our house needed a deep cleaning, to remedy the dust, finger prints, pollen and grime that we never got to in our hurried weekend efforts to tidy. We booked Life Maid Easy for an initial deep clean and then a monthly touch-up. 

From scheduling through the staff's arrival onsite through invoicing, Life Maid Easy delivers on their promise of making life easy. The pricing is very reasonable and communicated clearly up front, without any vagueness or surprises. The communication is exceptional, right down to a text message alerting you when the team is less than 30 minutes away. The staff can be counted on to arrive on time, with all the tools needed. Each team member we have met has been extremely prepared, professional, efficient, and thorough. After each visit, they reach out to seek opportunities to improve, and we never have any. It's a total game changer!

This location is inside the mall across from the food court. If you enter via the BJ's entrance, it's located basically right outside of BJ's.  Be prepared to stand in line as this one gets rather crowded depending on how crowded the mall is.  Despite being overly busy, they do get the drinks out fast.  They currently don't have seating available, however you could get your drink and walk around the mall or go sit in the food court area.  Drinks are always good and staff is typically always very friendly and welcoming.
The food and service were terrible.Waitstaff acted like they were doing us a favor.I should have known when we waited over 20 minutes to get our menus.

I was super psyched to try this place and was told they have a bunch of vegan options. While they do have some vegetarian options, they only had a couple vegan items and they weren't super exciting. The service was friendly but SO slow. I'm not sure if someone called in that night but after waiting an hour to get a table for two, the server didn't even bring water for 15 minutes, then took our order another 15 minutes after that.
Good work he fixed my steps cheap when a car ran into my house I didn't need new steps.

I miss Gold's Gym. These guys are money grubbing with no customer service. Rather keep billing you for something you never used. Try to cancel, be prepared to wait on hold with everyone else trying to get rid of this membership
I love my children's pediatrician!  They see Dr. Pat and he is always available to see them when they are sick.  They are always communicative, too.  I highly recommend this practice.
This was a great experience.  Service was amazing. Must try the garlic bottomless fries because they were amazing.  We will be back.
Florida Dept of Agriculture found a pump skimmer at this station. Pump skimmers take your credit card information for credit card fraud. Stay away!!

First time having an esthetics appointment for waxing in Tampa. Business was very clean and organized. Front desk staff were very friendly and offered me water while I waited. Wait was very short and Sol was my esthetician. She was very friendly and efficient with her waxing. Services were on par for pricing and should I return to Tampa, I will definitely be back.

This place was so great. We were starving and this hit the spot. We got 3 different subs since we wanted to try them. The pork has a wonderful mojo marinade on it! The do load up the sandwiches with lettuce and tomato. Im not a fan or that so I ordered a pork with only mayo, still awesome! The philly was probably my favorite! The cheese and onions and peppers were perfectly hot and the sandwiches are pressed ( can get them not pressed). The sandwiches are freshly made and hot when you get them. We also ordered the soup, it was not what I was expecting but it was still tasty. It came with a little piece of bread which my 9 month old ate. They have hurricanes ( milk shakes) which I regrettably did not get, but I saw them and they looked killer. 
We did have to wait a bit for our food, but was well worth it. We apparently got there at a rush because we drove by 45 minutes later and it was not filled at all.
There is no inside seating- it's called the strawberry HUT. There is lots of cute covered seating though. We are in the car because we had been outside all day. The parking is decent, they work fast too. Lots of turn over in the parking. 
Go try! Not far at all from the highway!!

I spent a long time looking for a coffee house in Queen Village and finally settled on Red Hook even though I had read about and experienced the dismissive attitude from the staff.  Even though I always said "please" and "thank you" w/ a genuine smile, even though I always tip, they treated me like I was emanating a slightly unpleasant odor.  I decided to keep going b/c the food is quite good (except for the egg sandwich but I suspect that may have been another form of aggression from the staff) and I like the room and the seats outside.  I understand that since I am not emaciated and tattooed that it is silly of me to expect good service in most coffee houses.  

Anyway, the last time I went I gave my order to the arch guy behind the counter upon which he said "Not gonna happen".  I looked at him in surprise and said "I'm sorry?" and he said again "Not gonna happen".  Finally I recovered enough to say "Why not?" and he said "We're out of plain bagels".  Now look, would it have been so hard for him just to say that the first time?  I looked at him and said "Well never mind" walked out and wound up at Milk and Honey on 4th street right above South St.  Guess what?  At Milk and Honey I FINALLY found a coffee house that doesn't act as if there is a velvet rope which I am not cool enough to get past!!!!  The staff says hello and smiles at me.  Go to Milk and Honey!  Let's not let bitter hipsters win!!

I can't believe I haven't been here before.  This is not the most authentic place, but I love their fusion take on sushi.  We came for a late lunch on a Friday and thought it would be crowded, but it was only about half full. The decor is a mix of modern and metal, and yet quite warm and inviting.

We started with a lovely salad and miro soup, both were tasty and quickly disappeared. The beef tataki was thicker than other places, but was served with a great, fresh and light sauce. The kara age chicken was served in larger pieces and came coated in a light, crispy batter.  The dipping sauce was spicy, but balanced with sweet.

The rolls are where the fusion approach becomes more evident.  Interesting additions to traditional rolls and some that are truly original like those topped with seared sashimi.

Overall, it was a very successful meal.  We will be back,hopefully soon.

Visited Outback for my dad's birthday this week.  What a terrible experience.  The service was awful, steaks were tough. I had something floating in my drink and took almost the entire meal to track down our server.  The manager did offer free desserts for our trouble, but really we just wanted a good meal with good service.  The past 3 times we have been to this location the food has been just okay.  Outback used to be my favorite but not any longer.  They are riding on their name from the years when the food and service was excellent.  Hopefully they get back to that soon before it is too late.

What a perfect place to stop for a good meal! A cute place with great food and great service. I had a burger and fries with a local beer, and my husband had a BBQ sandwich with tater tots. Both meals were delicious and there was certainly no shortage of food! In fact, the waiter brought my husband extra tater tots!  I've seen a couple low reviews of this place from a while ago and I'm not sure what was happening at that time but it seems they've addressed it. My only regret is that I didn't get our waiter's name because he was great. Whether you're local or driving through like we were, I highly recommend this restaurant for a good meal.

My fiance and I were visiting Philly for a week and visited Cafe L'Aube because a) it has great Yelp reviews and b) it was uberclose to the apartment we rented. I had the crepe hollandaise, my fiance had a sandwich, we both had coffee, and we stayed for 4 hours. 

My crepe was amazing, my fiance admitted I made the better choice (that's why I'm marrying him-- he admits it when I'm right), and the coffee was strong. We sat there and read and worked, and the owner Jean-Luc was incredibly friendly (but not in an annoying pushy way). We chatted about the economy, politics, American anti-intellectualism, and generally had a great time.

A few days later, we returned for breakfast. I had an apple crepe, and the barista (not Jean-Luc) used chocolate sauce to write "Happy New Year!" on the plate-- adorable! I would recommend the hollandaise moreso than the apple crepe.

Great service, fun atmosphere, yummy food, decent prices!!

My mom and I bought a family membership here back in January to kick off our mother daughter self care journey. We've had 3 sessions so far with Dustin and Charles, and honey let me tell you! I float off that table every time Charles is finished, he has really worked out my kinks and stress that life has thrown my way! So kiddos to him and Dustin for providing such excellent service!

This is what Asian-esque fast food should be. Simple, fresh, and fast. The Thai aspect of the menu is, admittedly, an afterthought. However, the sushi rolls are nicer than most places, even much "fancier" places. If you don't expect too much out of the fried appetizers, they won't disappoint, they are a nice accompaniment to the sushi rolls. Overall, one of my favorite places in Boise, which weirdly has a lot of good sushi places.

For those of you that like clean, quick and friendly customer service, Bella Sera is a welcome addition to 19125.  The coffee is serve yourself and the prices are reasonable.  They have fair trade coffee and a bunch of different varieties.

They also serve baked goods...which happen to be vegan.  They taste good.  

I like the fact that I can always get a seat there and manage to run into a neighbor or two.  (Patrons around may not enjoy this as much!)  

I'd give the place 5 stars if it had a little more decor inside...it's a little boring and cold feeling...some rugs and a different ceiling could help.  But this is my coffee shop of choice for the time being...and for you people that live close to Frankford like I do, you should definitely give this place a try.
Amazing place!  Great atmosphere and very friendly staff!  Tons is stuff to choose from!  Will definitely go again!!

This spot is located in the far bacK corner of Danny's (right off of Curlew) - it's a much needed, and welcomed, concept in Palm Harbor! 

Pros: Fantastic and personalized service! Delicious and consistent drinks, especially the Peanut Butter Old Fashioned made with Screwball Whiskey! Appropriate background music (because there's nothing worse than listening to music that's too loud or too out there when you're visiting a speakeasy). Convenient location!! Stellar happy hour and daily specials ($6 Old Fashioned!) The food looks yummy also (didn't personally  order so can't really comment though).

Cons: Just wish the lights weren't so bright inside (would play in more to the speakeasy concept).

Overall I'm going to still give it 5/5 because I had a really enjoyed it overall and had a fantastic night - I'll be back for sure!

SCAM ALERT 

Prior to arrival we were promised a lot of stuff- $$ and a dinner/show
Upon arrival we checked into the '70's revisited decor UGH
When we awoke there wasn't any coffee
We attended the presentation and sleazy salesman kept touching my partner- creepy to say the least.
They want you to buy weeks of vacation time and miraculously they found us a "great" find someone is trying to sell one for a low low price.YEAH BECAUSE NO ONE wants an outdated condo; it's embarrassing.
After the sleaze-fest we were presented with a check for $80 and they said "You can buy tickets and dinner with  the money "What a hot dog and a coke and balcony seats? 
They ripped our time off and turned us off.
This "resort" is far away from Reno and it's ugly and so are the sales team.

The sandwiches were pretty good. I like the Firehouse theme as well.

I would have given them a 5, however the meals are a little pricey.

BOGO today on retailme not btw.

If you don't mind the price, go give them a try. You won't be disappointed.

BEWARE BUYERS! I took my truck in for a trade in on another truck. Of course they low balled me on trade in. December 1 2020 is when this all took place. Today is January 5 2021 and they still haven't payed off the trade in to the bank. I'm making payments now on two vehicles! I've made multiple phone calls and their excuses are " check is in the mail" it's been 34 days! I should of know better with a used car dealer. They said they sent pay off to the bank December 3 2020 but after talking to my bank they said Auto Ranch called them December 17 2020 so how they of sent a check December 3 but called bank December 17 ? Another lie! So here I'm making payments on both vehicles and Auto Ranch excuse is " check in the mail " BEWARE POTENTIAL BUYERS! No honesty!!

The therapist complained about her life throughout the massage. I had also booked a manicure which they insisted on booking after the massage.  Just as I thought, the manicure was waisted do to the oils from the massage.  Mail nails looked dirty and peeled soon after . This was my birthday present   :( 
Won't go back.  "/

Good cheap food, nice patio with a second bar in it. Pretty sure it's dog friendly on the patio which is awesome (if only I had a dog!) I like the blues brothers statues (although isn't it named for a Dead song?) 
Seems like they are doing a Fast Eddies type thing with the counter food service & their drink menu looks exactly like fast Eddies. They also do the frozen drinks & seem to be pushing that angle. It's cash only which I don't understand. In a high volume place like fast eddies I get because it's just easier & more efficient, but there were maybe 10 people in the entire restaurant. And why not able to rub tabs? Especially if we are the ONLY table on the patio. Trust me, you'll make more in tips & it's less of a hassle for you & the customer. Well hopefully they get those kinks worked out, because I really do like this place & want it to succeed!

Our go to place on Thursday night. The food is delicious And the service is spectacular. Definitely a  gem. Order the seafood skewer. Never fails to disappoint. Special thanks to our server Jadiel. He is awesome.

Amazing meal. Got to sit in a cozy booth hidden from everyone for date night. Beautiful salad bar. Timing on delivery of the steaks was spot on. We got to enjoy our appetizer and salads. Boyfriend loved the fried pickles. HUGE baked potato. And the steaks...each had the 8oz. Filet. Perfect medium rare. He had the add on grilled shrimp. Grilled in the shell. Tender and juicy. Sautéed mushrooms were excellent as well. Another great meal at Hermitage Steakhouse. Loved it!!

Stopped by here because a band was playing music, and we needed a break. Music was great, service was not. It looks like you are supposed to order at the counter, as the sign above it says "place order here". After standing there for 5 minutes and being ignored, we just sat at a table to listen to the music. Finally a waitress came over, and one of us asked for a water, to which she replied they only had bottled water and it was $2. After returning quite a while later with the drinks, we asked for an order of beignets, and I was told I could only prose them from the counter at which I had previously been ignored. After standing directly in front of the girl behind the counter for another 3-4 minutes, she finally acknowledged me and took my order. Our food/drinks were just ok when we got them, but I probably wouldn't come back here based on the poor service.

The food was great! And the ambience was fantastic but we came in at 715 and were being forced to wrap up by the server by 845, first by asking us about dessert before the entree was done and then placing the check on the table even before we were done. Half the restaurant was empty and yet the server Yavuz couldn't stop being pushy and EXTREMELY unprofessional. Isot is a great place for food but do everything you can to avoid being served by Yavuz!
A must-experience restaurant in a beautiful area of town.  You can feel the history when you walk inside. The atmosphere was very elegant, the wait staff was outstanding, and the food was delicious.

I had great expectations given that the restaurant was listed as one of the top ten in Tampa Bay. First two courses were delicious. My main course was scallops on some sort of toast. The toast was burned! All I could taste was charred toast. I tried to wash the burned flavor out of my mouth with shots of very expensive tequila, but that could not even get the horrible taste out of my mouth. Four of us dined, we had drinks and a nice $500 meal, but that last, horrible course ruined my meal!

My friend said, "Let's go get the best ice cream in town." and I said, "Okay."

When we arrived, the line was quite long and something tells me that is always the case.  There's a old-fashioned theme with the place, down to the cash only aspect and the old-timey decor.  All the workers wear bow ties and they know what they're doing.  I was told they make their own ice cream, including vegan kinds, and I could taste that they flavors I got were unique.  I got a milkshake, but it was darn good and with fresh peanut butter.

Don't let the long line scare you - they move pretty fast.  Also, the sundaes look fun but intense - but I'd like to go back and get one when I'm more hungry.

I was genuinely craving a burger and as a vegetarian there aren't many options for me and my father that does eat meat, so when i found this place it was convenient. I had the veggie burger which i shared with my mom while my dad had the angus burger. There's no complaints there, the food was well made and it was unique that we were able to add anything onto the burger free of charge. My mom is not a big fan of black bean burgers which is why she insisted on sharing with me but she ended up loving it, and that's saying a lot for  someone who doesn't like beans. The fries were also delicious. The service there was not bad at all, the workers were all so friendly. We had even ordered a peach shake and when , whom i'm guessing is the manager, brought out the shake he informed us that he had trouble with the machine so if it was not tasting right we could get a refund. I liked that he was honest with us, which made the service better leading me into tipping them. Overall a great experience, I would recommend my friends and definitely come back.

I think the rating of this place is extremely low. 

I saw The Oink my first week in town. Tried it out a couple of weeks later. Wasn't aware that it was a brand spanking new place until I started chatting with our waitress.

We ordered the flight of bacon which was awesome! I mean awesome! Jalapeno bacon was hands down my favorite, but all of them were extra tasty. I don't even remember what the wife and kid got because I went with The Oink Omelet which was billed as a massive 5 egg omelette with Ham, bacon, sausage and cheddar cheese. All I could think about after the bacon flight was an omelet that took up 80% of the plate and was 6" tall since it was stuffed with all that good stuff.

Service was up to par in my book. It was busy as anything on a Saturday morning so I didn't expect someone to be hovering and tending to every detail as I was eating. Don't remember having to wait an excessive time (if any) for refills on drinks and the check when we were done. Overall service was adequate if not a bit better than adequate for a place that had only been open a few weeks. 

Decor was cool inside. 

 My only complaint, which is why I only gave them 4 stars was because of the omelette. I'm sorry, but if you're going to have a menu item named after your business, it better be a signature type of product. So bad ass that legends about it spread thru out the land. The Oink omelette is not that kind of product. 

First of all, it was the smallest 5 egg omelet that I've ever seen. It barely took up half of the plate and was almost flat. For nearly $12, I was disappointed. Instead of there being a massive pile of meat in the omelet, there was a skimpy portion cooked into the eggs and then the egg was just folded over. I mean, it was as if they meat was already mixed in with the eggs first then poured on the grill rather than pouring the alleged 5 eggs on the grill, letting them cook up a bit, then piling the amount of meat that a $12 omelet should have on it which should be at least 1/2 lb in my opinion.

Had that omelet lived up to the hype on the menu I would have easily given them 5 stars considering that they are just getting going. I'll be back and will update things after they've settled in a bit.

Alex Leeder is absolutely wonderful.  He has given me perfect eyebrows and facials for 10 plus years.  I highly recommend Alex if you are looking for someone professional & conscientious.... he will pamper you!!!

The service I received today was just labeled a massage not a deep tissue or any other type of more intense massage. The massage I received was one of the most aggressive massages I've ever had. Pounding my body, smacking it and being super super aggressive to the point it was painful. The woman didn't speak English so it was challenging to communicate how I was feeling. The lady from the front desk told me to say lighter pressure if needed, that should have been my sign to leave. Once the first 15-20 minutes was over, it became more enjoyable where the woman was actually rubbing me in a relaxing way. It's a shame because the woman at the front desk was nice and very welcoming with great customer service. Her massage therapists need to be less aggressive for them to compete with larger companies like Hand & Stone etc. that are much gentler. I would not come back and felt compelled enough to make a review because it was such an aggressive and painful experience. I am worried that I will feel sore in the morning.

Fabulous view, very friendly bartender, delicious drinks, albeit a bit pricey, but something seems missing. Kind of sterile and needs a boost to the atmosphere. Too much competition in the area to be just okay.

Very disappointed. This salon used to be my favorite. I requested a design I wanted and she told me she could definitely do it once she started removing my color (gel I had on previously) she told me it was "too much to do" that she could only do it in "gel color". I told her I didn't want gel color that I wanted the design in nail polish and for her to use gel (clear gel). She stated "we don't do that here".... Strange right? 
Basically she refused to do it. 
So I told her okay do gel color and she told me she was going to do a completely different design from what I had told her I wanted. I told her no I don't want that she said "it's better for me". Which I was very upset because the whole time she refused to do my nails how I wanted. She didn't ask me what shape I wanted or the length... Nothing!! 
Never going back 
Felt very disrespected. 
She didn't even finish my nails she had someone else add the gel to the nails and when I was done I asked her if she could please give me lotion. She said "no, you're done"

Very poor customer service

I waited 5 minutes just to place my order in the drive-through.  I paid $10 for a cheeseburger and fries.  I waited 30 minutes when a women finally handed me a brown bag and just stared at me.  She finally said "check if that's yours, you had the side of ranch?" I said yes and drove away.  I then got home and found I had a regular burger, no cheese, no ketchup and no lettuce like I asked for.. I also had cold soggy fries.  I'm so irritated.. what a waste of time and money.

This place gets five stars just for their setup alone, but the food was great too!  I had a black bean burger and it was delicious and freshly made (not some frozen patty). They have coffee, tea, and a great beer selection.  The location is mostly outdoor seating but also has an indoor bar with a garage door that's open on nice days.  There's plenty of shade or sun for whatever you're into.  On Saturday afternoon there was a good mix of people doing work alone, drinking in groups, or enjoying time with their dogs--four well-behaved pups were there at once!
I love the pizza from here! It's so delicious and their pretzel breadsticks are amazing with their cheese sauce. It's important to support small businesses at this time so go ahead, order!

The beat cupcakes i've had outside of New York City. They're exceptional. GiGi's is awful ... This place should replace all of these GiGi's popping up around town.  

I had the vanilla/vanilla and the red velvet. Couldn't have been happier. 

I will drive from downtown Nashville just to have Iveycake. A+++++

No stars if that was acceptable!

I'll start by saying: I had never been to a dentist before, EVER in my 31 years of life. My gums had been giving me issues so I decided it's time I visit a dentist to make sure everything is ok. I chose this Aspen Dental location because it's less than a 5 min drive away from my home.  9/21/2021- Great first visit, staff was super nice and friendly. I got a teeth cleaning that same day. I set up an appointment to have 2 fillings done a few days later. 9/23/2021-  Got my fillings and they were fine minus the fact they were too close together and I couldn't floss between them. Some days later they start to give me issues. They were sensitive, ONLY when I eat AND floss. No sensitivity to hot or cold just chewing and flossing. Can be the softest food and it just hurts! I had a second appointment for a follow up with my cleaning a week later on 9/28/2021. Definitely mentioned my fillings to everyone I spoke to that day at this location. Doctor looks and asks me questions, I explain when I feel the sensitivity. He uses some spacing things to space the fillings so they're not so close. Then flosses between them which they were STILL hurting. He says in 2 weeks if they're still sensitive then to set up an appointment so they can look at them. Why couldn't anyone have actually looked at my teeth while I was there when I CLEARLY stated that they hurt and how I CAN ONLY CHEW MY FOOD WITH ONE SIDE OF MY MOUTH?-- Today is 10/5/2021, fillings still hurt, still can only chew my food on one side of my mouth. I had been calling since Thursday 9/30/2021 because it started to hurt worse, at that point I couldn't even allow my top teeth to touch my bottom teeth without feeling that sensitive feeling, no one answered when I called so I left a detailed voicemail with my name and phone number. Next day Friday 10/1/2021 I hear NOTHING from anyone, at this point I'm mad because I shouldn't have to wait to be seen when I can't chew with that side of my mouth. I call a few times on Friday, I get no answer. I don't call Saturday because I'm super busy at work. Closed Sunday, I call Monday 10/4/2021. No answer (business hours state they open at 8am). I wait til 9 (I assume these are not correct business hours) still no answer. I continuously call. NO ANSWER. I finally call customer service, they say they sent an email to the office manager there. Not surprising I still hear nothing from anyone some hours later. I legitimately called this location 30 times in that same day and FINALLY got someone to answer just to be out on hold for about 10 minutes. I hang up and call 30 min later. For them to put me on hold for 20+ minutes. They come back to the phone and say they're busy and to either continue holding or they'll call me back. Lol it's the next day 10/5/2021- I've yet to hear from anyone. I guess my teeth aren't really important and neither is the pain that I'm feeling that THEY caused. I'm no lawyer or anything, but this is an example of dental negligence.
10/6/2021- Still haven't heard anything from anyone at this location! Had been contacting customer service, decided to go above customer service and contact their corporate customer relations; in which they put in a refund for something that I asked to be refunded on Monday that was supposed to be put in, but hadn't.. apparently this location thought they would still take my money!

This place is great! My friends and I went for the first time this past Saturday and it was beautiful! Live music could be heard on the beach and the VIP area. We loved VR so much we did it twice. Paddle boarding was fun (we took out double kayaks - way more fun since you stay with your friends)!  I find many people don't realize that this is a residential Lagoon that allows the public in - it's not a water park?? Overall we left the Lagoon burnt and happy, we will return!

Rude, indifferent staff, food is 3-4/10, mediocre to say the least, cheap, do not even serve tea. Cash only!? Are you fucking kidding me? They look so posh from outside and you have an ATM machine inside?
Will never go back

Just plain wonderful. They really do take the stress out of moving junk out of one's house. Tyler and Zach were efficient, cheerful, and careful. If there was any doubt that an item was to be tossed, they checked with me first. The price was so much lower than we expected, especially compared to similar services. We're calling them back to do another job for us.
Fantastic flavors,  atmosphere and the service provided by Kyle .. Outstanding! We had the chargrilled oysters, pork tenderloin and Wahoo and Loved it ALL

We celebrated the fiancé's birthday here. They get really busy so make reservations ahead of time. We arrived around 7:45 and were immediately seated. Our waiter was nice and the service the entire night was great. We started with the pita bread and hummus. It was delicious. The pita bread was warm and even alone was tasty, and the hummus... fantastic with bits of feta cheese crumbled on top. We also enjoyed a glass of moscoto, and seriously it was the best moscato I have ever had. 

We then had the scallops which were divine and cooked really well and also shared the taquitos. By the end of the night I was so full I though I was going to pop. Everything was delicious and perfect. I can't find one thing to complain about in our dinner. 

The ambiance is cozy and romantic. A great place to go on a date or celebrate an anniversary or special occasion. I highly recommend having dinner here and the rest will be history.  I wish I would have tried one of their cocktails because they sounded amazing. I will definitely be coming back for one of those!

At the end of our meal, my husband and I agreed that this was one of the most creative meals we've ever eaten.  At first glance, the menu seemed full of contradictory dishes full of ingredients and flavors that wouldn't mesh well together.  Well, I was proven wrong!  The food was incredible.
My husband's burger was particularly standout, as was the chocolate checkerboard pie. 

We also enjoyed the beer selection and overall ambiance.  It was rustic and very welcoming.  And the service was top notch.  Our waitress was knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful.  

We will be back!

Just went here this past Tuesday and even though I'd read the reviews here and looked at their website, I was still blown away. This is a place my future kids will hear about for years until they're old enough to go.

We spent a good 2.5 hours here but easily could have stayed longer. Didn't go to the rooftop due to the 108 degree heat and our non-water play friendly outfits, but really enjoyed the aquarium (see separate review) and caves. Got a little claustrophobic, not sure how comfortable I'd be with one of my kiddos potentially getting stuck, but I didn't see it happen.
As others have stated, the potential for injury is high and the museum posts several notices saying they're not liable. It is pretty chaotic so definitely make sure your kids are able to handle that. 
While this wasn't an educational museum in the traditional type, it was one of the coolest places I've seen for kids, and they do have interactive learning stations set up with the art and circus areas, to name a few. 
Felt like I didn't have enough time to take it all in, but this place is awesome. Was a little disturbed by how little the admission was enforced. Boyfriend and I didn't put on our wristbands and no one asked us to or checked, either, parents probably know this and may sneak in, which is a shame because this place certainly deserves more funding, and museums are notoriously short on receiving them,

Word of warning though, the 10 story slide is filthy so be careful what you're wearing!
Best biscuits and gravy ever.  Total dive and totally delicious.  Exceptional service from the hard working staff.
We came to this location as a family to enjoy  lunch. And MY HUSBAND  who is mixed had on a rebel flag HOODIE. We even noticed a male in back of house with his phone out taking pictures. UNACCEPTABLE

Ordered a chicken caesar salad for lunch - Absolutely horrible!!!! -  Chicken was like old leather - their pizza is just as bad - you've been warned!!!!
* Gave them one star - because you have to rate least 1 star to post a comment.

Great food, great service, noisy noisy noisy!
I have been here twice, both times at the bar for a drink and a snack.  The fried cauliflower and the potatoes were super tasty and the bar service was very friendly and accommodating. But there is such a roaring, deafening din that it's inconceivable that anyone would come here if they are interested in normal dinner conversation.  Knowing the pedigree of the owners, and the obvious amount of time, thought and money that went into the overall design, it is truly baffling that they would create such an uncomfortable atmosphere.  I think even millennial hipsters would find it off-putting, but to create this atmosphere in a Main Line restaurant is a fail that defies explanation. I may come back by myself (with my earplugs) for the potatoes, friendly bartenders and excellent (though very over-priced) wine by the glass selection, but I would never, ever bring my wife or come with friends. If management wakes up and gets a clue and takes real steps towards sound-proofing, this could be a go-to spot.  But until then, do I really want to spend the evening paying for overpriced drinks, shouting at my table-mates and leave with a headache??

Have visited this restaurant many times and have always had good service and excellent food and service. Have tried most items on the menu and have never been disappointed. With the addition of the outdoor patio it has become a favorite for a late evening drink with friends.  The hamburger with cheddar and bacon is or of the best I have ever had.
Yummy Indian!! Vegetable samosas were my husband's favorite. The portions were generous and delicious. We're moving to the area soon, and will absolutely be back.
Avoid weekends because of the crowds. Lots of fun things for kids to do, but long lines. Strollers should be limited as well.
Fantastic place to eat pizza.  Has a great beer selection.  Friendly cool service and hip music.

Excellent lunch...staff was extremely helpful and friendly.  We came here because of yelp reviews and was not disappointed.  Husband had tacos I had pupuas.  I had never tried pupuas before so can't compare to other places but theses were Fantastic.  Rice and beans were phenomenal.  Highly highly recommend this place, delicious fresh food.

I don't think there are enough characters for me to describe the logistical and planning nightmares that exist at Headless Horseman nights, but let me try. You get there about 50 minutes after it opens (6:20), wait another 15 minutes in line and then graced with tickets for the hayride at 10:15. You ask about the vendor sponsored event you were invited to and after asking 3 people, you get no answer and no help. Cool so that isn't happening. You also get a map THAT DOESN'T EVEN TELL YOU WHERE TO LINE UP FOR THE HAYRIDE. Mind blown. The map is basically garbage. The kids are now hungry because there was free food at the vendor event no one seemed to know about and the options are now like 5 food trucks. The kids have school so we try to do something with our 10:15 tickets we won't use. There is a ticket exchange we find by accident because it's not at the place with the large sign that says Ticket Exchange. No that's a place to win prizes. Clearly makes sense right?! By accident we find the booth that conveniently also says ticket exchange and by golly actually exchanges hayride tickets! What a concept! We leave the 6 unused tickets to go eat. Two stars for the Mystic who was fun and one of 2 things we did in the 2.5 hrs there. Will not come back until you can buy hayride times in advance. Oh and good luck seeing anything after sunset with their lack of lights and poor excuse of a map!

Hotel is nicely decorated, king standard room is pretty small. We did have a nice view of the Truckee River. Room was not overly clean, stains on carpet, peeling paint in bathroom; maids left dirty dishes in the room. WIFI wouldn't connect to any devices. Went for dessert one night in restaurant, horrible is the only way to describe it. Also found it strange that nowhere in the room was there a directory of services.
Won't return here, extremely underwhelmed.

We frequently visit the GSR but hadn't tried this place before.  What a gem. The place was clean, the service was amazing and the food quick and very good. Our server Lyndel was cheerful and helpful. She made the visit fun but didn't over do it. We felt like we were her only table. 

We had the single cheeseburger with special sauce, cokes from the fountain, and a basket of frings. All very yummy. We want to come back for a milkshake later!

I used to love this place... wouldn't go anywhere else to be honest. It seems things have gone down hill. I went recently with my 13 year old niece and they were incredibly disorganized. Not only was the person doing my nieces nails rude and nasty to her, but sadly my experience was not better. Two separate people did my pedicure, because the first wasn't moving quick enough per the management standard so someone came in and rushed the finishing touches... low and behold it chipped less than 24 hours later. During my manicure, I had to remind the person several times what nail to paint. I may have gone on an incredibly busy day, but between the rude behavior and the poor finish, I think I'll be finding somewhere else next time.

So I was pleasantly surprised with DD today. I ordered the iced green tea and it was $.99... For any size so I (naturally) got the largest size. More bang for your buck... When I got to the Window the cashier accidentally gave me the regular sweet tea and not the green tea. So she made the correct one and let me keep the regular one I had which was awesome because my mom was with me and drank it. Great customer service!

The iced green tea was great, my order was timely and the young cashiers were very friendly. I will be returning!

I cannot say enough good things about this store! I stopped by thinking everything might be out of my price range but ended up finding a couch, barstools and some decor for a wonderful price. Such wonderful quality American and European furniture. Got my couch the next day and delivery was only $90. He even came down on the price. I am thrilled.

Best nail salon in the N. County area (I've tried many). Very clean and the staff is extremely friendly. I enjoyed both my gel mani/pedi. For the level of service/professionalism the prices are reasonable. I'll definitely be back!
If I could give zero stars, I would. Trip into downtown was fine. Too bad the location of pickup was closed. I guess it is not reasonable for a transportation company to know about road closures?

Was looking for a good sit down restaurant in terminal A and chose Cibo because it looked really good. Menu seemed broad. We ordered mushroom ravioli, linguini with meatballs, and rigatoni bolognese, all pretty straight forward dishes.  The mushroom ravioli was all wrong...it needed a cream sauce, not the oniony mixture that it had.  The linguini overall was undercooked, including the meatball, and the rigatoni tasted like it had been microwaved.
