The service was lousy top....our waitress was one of those who thought she could memorize everything and forgot salads and entres....which is why the linguini was probably undercooked because she delivered the wrong dish.  Overall, check out the Japanese place down the concourse or the other Italian lace there too. This was not worth $130 for four entres and drinks.

My favorite healthy lunch spot in Tampa! The fresh rolls are great- my personal favorites are the mushroom, avocado, and the Tiger shrimp. The best part is that on Wednesdays, all the rolls are buy two get one free!

Go to the KOP location - I think it may be closer.

No matter when you come here there is always a 2 hour wait - even on Wednesdays! The reason? Their menu covers every cuisine under the sun and they seem to have every type of chef back their perfecting their own dishes. 

No matter who you are you will find something here: pastas, hamburgers, comfort food, wraps and fish. My favorite is the Navajo sandwich (warm pita with mayo, chicken and fresh avocado) or the Da Vinci pasta.

You should never leave without at least getting a slice of their famous cheesecake. In my opinion, the White Chocolate Raspberry is the best.

Really just OK. Very nice design inside. Nice patio, for those rare occasions that Reno plays, Baby Bear Porridge, not too hot, not too cold and not too windy. Really wanted to like the place more. Staff was friendly but untrained. Multiple confusion with communication and table  attention one at a time. They start you off with a small bowl of seasoned garbanzo beans, loved the concept but not the dish. But wife did like it, so maybe just me. The pizzas we got, though done traditionally in the wood oven were ashy and burned in places (pictured), it gave a very ashy and bitter taste to the pies. I looked around to notice that they were similar at other tables. Pizza was also a bit limp and soggy. I did like the ingredients that they have assembled to create their different choices, definitely unique and flavorful. Don't want to bash this restaurant and seems to be liked by a lot of reviewers so maybe just not my cup of tomato sauce. Prices are very high, so get out your wallets, I am a big eater and left still hungry after dropping some dimes.

Late night pizza until 4am!! What more could you ask for! I got tomato pie and the sauce was so tasty and it had pieces of basil on it as well! Bomb dot com! It also only took about 45 minutes which is great!

We have taken our dogs to many groomers, but we keep coming back to this place. The groomers are friendly and efficient, they do a good job with our schnauzers and they like dogs (that's a nice touch!). The store is in good order always - though they could stand to offer more cashiers so lines would go quicker. They also could allow me to just pay for the grooming in the salon - but no big deal. We keep going back because we get treated right at a good price.
I found the food to be tasteless. Couldn't even cut into my English's muffin it was so hard. Very disappointing

The pizza is amazing.  The delivery was really quick and the staff is very nice.  However, I do have a few complaints.  First, they were out of their homemade hummus.  The main thing I wanted to try.  I ordered before 5 pm... Kind of early to run out of things.  Second, the spinach and artichoke dip was very salty.  Third, I ordered the cheese burger and fries for myself.  It was disgusting.  The fries were hard and seemed old.  The cheeseburger was just gross.  The pizza though... It was really good.

This place was really good, 

Very friendly and welcoming

Easy to order 

Decent price 

Great dish selection

I will come back :)

I heart Jeni's so much. I think it just may be the best ice cream I've ever had. The flavors are so unique and I love the toppings that they offer - they just go so well together! The staff are always great when it comes to helping choose a flavor or adding toppings to a certain flavor - and they are so nice/friendly, which is a bonus! 

We live in South Nash so we aren't super close to a Jeni's shop but whenever we are close to one, I make sure to pop in and grab a scoop...or scoops muhahaha. A few of my fav's: bourbon salted pecan, pistachio & honey, and wildberry lavender. I will be seriously heartbroken when I have to move to a city that doesn't have Jeni's. If you're in Nashville and want ice cream, this is the place you need to be.
Rock crab was delicious!  The clam chowder bread bowl wasn't very big and didn't hold very much.  Whoever cut it out didn't cut it out very well.  Service was pretty good as well.
Blue crab roll is the bomb! Definitely try it. Friendly staff and fast service. Definitely a place I would recommend.

Visiting relatives in Carmel...we always come here.  Despite all the fanfare about the big ugly, the burgers are decent and it's a loud, kid friendly place.

Good milkshakes as well and always love a true cherry coke.

Recommend.

Fair Grinds has turned into one of my favorite coffee houses. I love the location and the coffee is great with a purpose because its fair trade. They are always giving back to the community and are involved in making New Orleans a better place for its residents so coming here is like a donation to a cause for me. They also offer local baked goods that are great. The addition of taking credit cards was the deal maker here for me as I am not a person who walks around with alot of cash.

I remember loving this place a few years back but I just hadn't gotten around to stopping in recently. Last night my group was looking for a place to sip a drink and enjoy the outdoors, and the Devil's Alley balcony tables came to mind. There was a table on the street level available when we rolled up so we decided to sit there instead.

I was going to be perfectly content ordering a Tröegs Perpetual IPA for $5.50 until our sever informed us that all bottles were $3 for craft beer Tuesday. Then she pointed out that Victory's Golden Monkey counted towards the special. I love this girl! She then continued to blow our minds with their daily drink specials. I believe it's margarita Monday, craft beer Tuesday, rum punch Wednesday, Jameson Thursday, Absolute Friday, Sangria Saturday and Yuengling Sunday. The prices vary per day but were really excellent based on each beverage.

We weren't planning on eating but then she told us the specials. There was a duck quesadilla with goat cheese and a Mac n Cheese with jalapeño, bacon and crab. Both sounded phenomenal but my friend wanted the Mac n Cheese and I definitely needed an eating buddy since I wasn't even hungry. Amazing call! It was creamy and you got at least some topping in every bite. The jalapeños could have been a little hotter but maybe it was better not to make the dish super-hot. 

Of course inside the restaurant they had the lights and talks trees that make the ambiance cool. I didn't love how the tables overlooked a dying section of Chestnut Street but it's not Devil Alley's fault this once vibrant neighborhood is now a little desolate. 

With such great all day drink specials, I'll absolutely be back soon. Even if it's just for one drink before moving elsewhere, who can resist?

This place is rude, unprofessional and have lazy employees that can't seem to follow simple instructions that a five year old could manage to complete. This place is a misrepresentation of the IMO's brand. If you're looking for a place that is clean and displays excellent customer service then this place IS NOT the place to go!!!

My daughter has business in Nashville and it's become this thing to go find cookies in the evening. We typically go to Tiff Treats, but I went on Yelp for a search and found Christie Cookie. I read the reviews and it seemed too good to be true. But... the reviews were right on point.  They know how to make a truly delicious cookie. We typically just get one a piece but they all looked so good that we ended up with 6 and a brookie (don't judge us haha). Tiffs is good but these cookies are so. much. better.  They're the perfect blend of crispy and gooey. Highly recommend.
Go to this place!! Great beer. God variety of beers. Great drinks. The owner is sooo awesome Matthew . This is a #1 stop in Santa Barbara. Yummy, yes!

Went here with my husband for a nice dinner and we both thought it was just ok. We had the salmon and veggies. We are both pretty health conscious eaters... having said that, the food seemed to be lacking in flavor, even for healthy food. For the price, I think there are much tastier options around town to choose from.

This was a restaurant I've been hearing "you need to try!" For the last ten months since I moved to Indianapolis, and it did not disappoint. The cocktail menu is outstanding, with a variety of alcohol bases to their drinks. I had one called the Rum Diary, which had a couple types of rum and coconut and house lime soda. It was a well made cocktail: smooth from the coconut, a little sweet from the soda, and just enough rum flavor without being overpowering. The bar is also fully stocked with dozens of bottles, and the bartenders seemed very educated and willing to make you something by request if nothing on the cocktail list attract me your eye. 

For the food, I was genuinely impressed with the quality and flavor, and I was also pleased to see a number of healthier options as well! Trying to eat a little cleaner this time out, I ordered the chop salad with a side of the cauliflower, and my meal was really great. Despite all of the great steakhouses in Indy, I would put it in my top five meals here, and probably top three. The cauliflower is a must as a side; who knew veggies could taste so good! I usually don't like capers, but they were mixed in along with a bunch of herbs/seasonings and it was incredible. The salad was also great, and if you get the large size, I find it to be one of the better value items (relatively speaking to other options) on the menu at only $18. I walked away full from the salad and side despite my girlfriend eating almost half my cauliflower. I also always like to review the service, and our waiter was excellent. When we said we were interested in a cheese board, he took time to give a detailed description of each cheese and charcuterie option, making our decision easy. 

In terms of logistical things, I'll note that you have to have your whole party present to be seated, so keep that in mind when planning. The restaurant isn't huge when the patio is closed for dining, but you can get a drink at the bar while you wait. If your party can get seated at the bar in the meantime, you can just order dinner there! 

Overall a really complete, great dining experience. I can't wait to go back!

Ramen is the cure for cool winter nights. We came across this place on Yelp, of course, on one particularly crisp evening and decided to give it a try. What's cool about this place it is more akin to fast casual than some of the fancier ramen spots around town. You place your order on a touch screen when walking in and then your food is brought to you at your seat. The touchscreen interface was easy to navigate, and it was nice to be able to put in your order as soon as you entered the establishment. I got the chicken ramen, which was a generous serving of broth, noodles, and fixins. It had a perfectly balanced umami flavor that was met with welcomed interjections from other ingredients like bamboo and garlic. We also ordered the poke chips, which were good, but could have used some work. The chips were very thin, and we found it difficult to scoop the tuna from the center where the majority of it was congregated. The flavor was on point though. Overall, Wooden Ladle is a great option for those looking for quality ramen in a casual setting. We have no doubt that we will be back soon!

Ordered take out:

Was able to do half and half pizza so we ordered spicy pepperoni and magic kingdom. Both really good options - tasty and not too greasy. Also ordered the antipasto salad which was really good and I really enjoyed the dressing it came with. 

Good service and friendly staff.

Recently visited Kanye Prime. For the most part our experience was positive but the extremely rude maitre d' turned the visit into a very negative experience. I am not really sure why he felt it necessary to make snarky comments, but he did and they were very disrespectful.  If you chose to spend your money at this establishment, I hope you have a better experience.

Went one night with friends to drink outback. Love the atmosphere even tho it was a bit crowded. We got two fish bowls which snuck up on us super quick. For being a fruity drink it wasn't too sugary which is always a relief. Will def be back

Wow, just got back from BurgerMonger and had to YELP about this place right away.  They solved two of our major problems in one fell swoop.  First, my teen son and I were starving.  Secondly, we needed a WIFI connection immediately so my son could watch one of his cyber classes while we ate.  I was pleasantly surprised to see that there was actually free WIFI. We had tried Starbucks down the hall, but their server was out, so BurgerMonger saved the day!  When the burgers arrived, they were a juicy, delicious treat.  I didn't expect them to be so good!  Our server John, was amazing; very solicitous and friendly, asking if we needed anything, and even taking interest in my son's class and some electronic equipment he was using.  He was obviously proud of the products there, and was full of descriptions and very knowledgeable about where the food came from.  Between the service and the food, I have no complaints, and only praise.  Next time we will get fries and a shake......until then, I will dream of BurgerMonger burgers...
So good and the staff is amazing. The crab dip is amazing. Also had the crab cake and shrimp and grits. So much food. Would highly recommend if your in the area.

Paris Custom Cakes made the wedding cake for our reception at Hyatt Regency Lake Tahoe and it could not have been more perfect. All I had to do was supply a picture to my coordinator at the Hyatt of a cake design I had found on Pinterest and they executed it better than I could have imagined.  Not only that but the cake was DELICIOUS. To the point that our photographer had to tell us we were supposed to stop eating it and kiss for a picture.  I walked out of my wedding reception with a plate in my hand to save two slices for the morning (we did not save the top tier) and my husband and I enjoyed them for breakfast the next day. No shame!! It was that good!! We have already decided we will be ordering a first anniversary cake from them because we can't get over how delicious and beautiful the cake was.
Cute little cafe with a cool vibe! I had the banh mi bowl which was fresh, delicious, nutritious and filling. This is perfect to start the day or a post workout healthy meal.

Just had lunch. great food, great service.  As first time customers they had us sample all of the sauces and then gave us a free sample of our favorite.  Very low pressure, low key and enjoyable lunch, we will go back

Next to the cafe part of Turchetti's is a butcher shop with a lot to tempt the carnivore. I tried the beef bacon and Texas red hot links on this trip. Both cooked up beautifully and were flavorful and so good. This is a great place to go for specialty meats or if you are craving something different. The prices are what you would expect for a specialty butcher but you definitely get value for your money.

Wow, lucky Nashville! Silo stands toe to toe with good dining on both coasts and the best part is it feels so natural - nothing they do is contrived or forced. The do what they do very well. 

Now, this seems to be somewhat new to the Nashville dining scene so I can see how this formula may be drastically different to those who are new to it. The menu is small. This is a good thing. When the food you are eating is all farmed, harvested and butchered from your neighbors, would you expect them to have enough ingredients on hand to make 300 dishes? And even if they did, does anyone do 300 different dishes with the same ingredients well? Not making everything fresh to order they don't. And having a small menu allows the chef to dream, test and execute the most perfect dishes available with those ingrediants. 

Consider the deviled eggs - a must have. They aren't just "deviled eggs". They are imaginatie, creative, unique - tell me anywhere else where you have had a deviled egg with bourbon jam, or a piece of chicken fried steak? Not anywhere in Nashville that I know of. If you're concerned about the price per egg, than you're completely missing the point. If you want to calculate the cost for each ingredient and total up what it would cost you to make at home, then I hope you're also paying yourself for the expertise and talent to make something other than a standard home made deviled egg. Just some food for thought, as it were...

If you want farm to fork, precious ingrediant, straightforward menu with a high end touch (very trendy) then this is your spot. If you want a huge menu, lots of salt and "bang for your buck" than luckily in Nashville you have TONS of other options. 

And one last thing that earned their 5th star for me - their attitude is right. They are doing something very cool and doing it well. They barrel age their own cocktails folks, this is not a mimick, it's the real deal. But the best part is that they are glad you are there, they want to explain the menu to you and they want you happy. Unlike other spots in Nashville that try to work this same formula but ruin it with attitude, Silo is the real deal and has an open door for everyone. If you've ever wondered about the food you see featured on cooking shows, or in restaurants in Seattle, NY, LA etc - then this is the closest you will get to it in Nashville.
I love this place...everything we had was awesome. Save room for dessert and get the bread pudding!
Attentive, intelligent service with interesting seasonal food that includes small plates for sampling.  Perfectly gritty atmosphere to go with a great beer selection and good, but tiny wine list.

THE BARDS AGREE
The Carousel is one of the best bars in the country. It's not pretentious, it has a literary legacy, there's lots of room in the beautiful surrounds and the prices aren't egregious. The biggest accolade: eccentric locals love to come here too (see pic).

AND THE HOTTEST BIKE BOYS PARK OUT FRONT!
(See pic) I actually have a similar photo from 1993 at Harry's Bar on the Grand Canal surrounded at dusk by swarthy procuring gondoliers. Could this be a burgeoning hotel amenity?

Just purchased a car from here.  My sales guy was Bobby Webber, and he has been outstanding!  He's been very helpful and accommodating.  He was a no pressure kind of sales guy, which I love, but he was absolutely the most helpful of all the dealerships I've been to. 

I did notice that a lot of the other sales staff seemed to just stand around and chat with one another.  People would walk in and have to get their attention.  That wasn't the case with Bobby.  When the manager and finance guy got involved, things continued to go very well.  I'm very satisfied with the deal and look forward to the free car washes.

Well we just got take out from hear 3 meat combo, the Ribs were tuff not award winning to me 0 stars, and I love ribs but not these, the chicken was pink and under cooked 0 stars, the pulled pork was good 3 stars. the corn bread was moist and had some flavor. price wise was ok , not sure if I will go back.

I like this place. It's a great cute neighborhood cafe. The menu is small but tasty. The coffee is Kahwa which is delicious. I love the decor and music. Today was a mix of 80's alternative. We are always greeted nicely, just like a regular (even though we're not). 
If I had a complaint it would be there's not much variety on the breakfast menu and the seating is small. It would also be awesome to see locally baked goods and pastries. But still Banyan cafe is worth a visit for the good vibes.
Moved down from ny and this has to be the Best pizza I've had in fl..PERIOD!!!! Can't go wrong going to this place
We ate here tonight for the first time. Absolutely great food & service. My wife and I highly recommend Epic Eatery!
Food/coffee is decent. Pastries, especially the FRENCH KING CAKE are super good.

True to the Spanish taste. Incredibly delicious plates. Well worth the trip from Clearwater. The outside deck is beautiful, servers are very attentive and the prices are very affordable. Will come back if we're ever back in Tampa.

Wait a second, this can't be right. Something is wrong about this place, and I had a hard time putting my finger on it. It forced me to think about every pho place I've been to and do a direct comparison, and it finally hit me; it's clean in here. It's an actual place you can take friends to and not feel embarrassed by the stains on the walls/seats/ceiling, et cetera.

And service is good. My father has a habit of tipping less than 10% at Vietnamese restaurants because he says the service matches that of Vietnam... which is to say, nearly non-existent. Here, they're attentive and watch over your table as you eat and make sure everything is right.

And boy is it right, the pho is great here. Beef pho, steak, brisket, and flank, and it was all delicious. The steak was cut thin and raw atop my bowl when it arrived, so it tasted just right when I was finished mixing my ingredients. Broth was nice and flavorful, definitely loaded up with the MSG ;D

Really nothing bad to say about this place. I've been searching for a Pho Ha replacement, and this place fits the bill perfectly.

Everything about this steak house is so good! We had the filet and prime rib with mashed potatoes and veggies. They were cooked exactly how we ordered. The wait staff was so warm, welcoming, and attentive that made the dining experience even better. Someone even came around to each table to take a complimentary photo to take home. So sweet! We loved it and will definitely be back!

It's a very cool place, great to hang out and talk. Prices are Good, and their food is really tasteful. What I didn't like is that they only offer one size of coffee, which is bad for those who are addicted like me.
I usually go to different places for breakfast when I travel and, overall, This was one of the best ones

Bought the Living Social deal to try our the pizza and we weren't dissapointed.  Ordered a build-your-own with garlic olive oil, mozzerella, canadian bacon and mushrooms on a thin crust and the cesear salad (forgot their signature name for it) with chicken and jalapeno cesear dressing.  Since my love and I tend to like our pizza well done (crispy) we put it under the broiler when we got it home.  Ta da!  It was perfect!  Loved the pizza and the salad was pretty good too!  Fresh and perfect balance of chicken, shaved parmesan cheese and spicy homemade croutons to romaine lettuce.  We'll definately try the pizza again and want to visit the food truck soon!

For savory...you can't go wrong with the Turkey, Brie, cranberry, balsamic crepe.

For sweet, pass the Nutella!

During my 2nd visit, i was prepared.  I remembered my 45 minute wait for my crepe last time, so I had ordered an omelet so I would have something to eat until the crepe was ready.  However, 10 minutes after I ordered, they came out with both my omelet and my crepe!  So...your crepe-wait time just depends on how busy they are!  

But anyways.  Good food. A nice little brunch spot when its not too busy!

Tommy does a great job on my nails everytime I come in. Today I asked for more than I normally get and he did exactly what I asked for. He did not use the same method I've seen done at other places and I was nervous of the outcome, but I love my nails.

I'm not entirely a newbie to the spray tan world, so I do have a frame of reference with which to say that Tara at You Glow gave me my best spray tan ever. 

A wedding with a Tampa friend brought me into Tara's studio, and I knew I didn't want to be the obvious midwestern girl by my pasty skin. I was super  pleased by the results.

Tara took the time to explain the way she does her tan, including providing the wipes to get yourself and your skin all set to be sprayed into bronze perfection. The result? The service was bad, the staff was unprofessional. The manager at this place was so incredibly rude when I called to ask some questions about making a reservation that I ended up not going with them. And he had the nerve to try and correct me on what I was upset about when I was calmly explaining what I was upset about. Horrible customer service. Don't waste your money here.

Open later than most Carp places, until 9pm. They are closed on Tuesdays. We found this small, well appointed place after looking at others that were closed. That was a lucky break for us as this place is a gem.

We were seated right away despite a large group. All three of the owners visited us during the course of our meal, made us feel like part of the family.

The food was freshly prepared and delicious. We started with excellent bruschetta. The server offered child portions for our kids that were reasonable and had a good portion. I'd recommend the Chicken Parmigiana or the hand-made pasta dish (can't remember the name).

At lunch time the prices are less and panini sandwiches are also offered.

Our family will go here again, probably this week.

This is my first time in Philadelphia. I don't know if the cheese steaks here are the best in town or not but in my opinion they are perfect!! The best I have ever had!! My son also enjoyed the pizza! The staff was friendly too. Their menu is huge with something for everyone.

I was having a problem with my garage door opening and closing sporadically. The technician Edgar was great. He called to let me know he was on the way and arrived at the scheduled time. He had to leave to get a part which took longer than expected. He called to update me about the delay. He completed the work promptly and tested it several times to ensure it worked properly. My only negative comment is I was charged a service fee and an installation fee. With many companies, the service fee is waived if the company does the work.

I have no idea how long Capri has been in business, but I only learned about it recently. It's off Keystone near 75th, tucked back behind a shopping center. We made reservations for 5 p.m. to avoid the Saturday evening rush - a success, since we were the only people there upon arrival. A business casual dress code was noted on their website, so we expected upscale, but it was even fancier than we imagined. This is the type of place you bring someone to propose to them. 

We were seated at a small table near the window in two large, comfy chairs that invite guests to linger. The menu is full of classic Italian dishes with little twists. My friend got the scallopine parmigiana with veal and I ordered one of the daily specials - homemade fettuccine tossed with pancetta in marinara. Both dishes were great, but if I had to make one recommendation, it would be to soften the butter that comes with the bread to make it spreadable. Our server was attentive and helpful. It's a bit pricey, but in line with the upscale experience. We enjoyed our visit and would come back.
1st visit , I came alone . The food was good . The cocktail was delicious  so I decided to bring my husband back . The food was still delicious. It's a merge between southern food & Italian .
Got to say was a little bummed I called a few minutes before closing to order something to go and they said "they couldn't do it the kitchen was closing". Was bummed

Favorite Thai in the neighborhood! Great for takeout with excellent and diverse offerings. Love ending the meal with the peanut pancake, so glad to have found this spot and the curries are rich and thick (green is my favorite) filled with more types of veggies than one usually finds. Heads and shoulders above any of the Asian spots on the South St corridor.

I live right around the corner from another Enterprise location but have decided to rent from this one from here on out. From the first interaction to the last, everyone was extremely courteous. My car was clean and ready to go at pickup and the return was easy. No surprise charges. And unlike with Hertz and Budget, I didn't get double billed for using my own EZPass. (Even after you add the rental to your EZPass account the other companies often still charge you. I've been fighting that for months). Long story short, this is my new go-to rental spot and I would recommend it to anyone.

I returned to Dr. B after 16 years, he was my childhood dentist. He is by far the best practitioner I've ever let care for my teeth. He is up-to-date will all current practices and equipment. He and his office staff are diligent and thorough and go far and beyond satisfactory service. Dr. B is a big win in the dental field!
This place is amazing!!! The fish and chicken is top notch! People are very friendly and helpful! It's the Uncle Buds I remember as a kid!
The food was AMAZINGGG HERE! I absolutely loved it. I got the peacemaker Benedict. Service was so great as well. My first time here in NOLA!

I love Honest Tom's, and anyone that complains about the vegan transition can fight me. But seriously; I transitioned to a plant-based diet right around when HT did as well, so I've had it before and after the switch and the shop definitely kept its amazing flavors. I personally really like the chickpea and sweet potato burritos--so, so good. The burritos are massive, and could probably be split into two portions, but every time I go I eat the entire thing because they are so delicious. I really wish it was a little closer to Penn's campus because then I think I would go more often, but for now I just head over when I am particularly craving it.

For those questioning how good a vegan burrito can be, think about what's in a normal burrito--there's still the same pico de gallo, the same guac, the same sauces. It's just with some extra veggies that make it a lil healthier. I've heard some of the other burritos (I think the biff?) have a weird texture, but idk, I personally care more about taste than texture but that's up to your own preferences. I might be biased, but it's definitely worth going to try it and form your own opinion.

There are two terminals, one is essentially just southwest, while the other contains the remaining airlines. T

Lastly, the best place to eat in terminal 1 (in my opinion) is grounded in STL, great burgers, fries and one of those cool freestyle soda fountains.

The chicken biryani had one drumstick and one thigh and the dum chicken curry has 2 drumsticks and a thigh. For the price, this was a rip off. And we did carry out.
the best italian joint in its price range, and the service is great! if you're looking to go to the hill but you don't want to spend a fortune, check it out.

This place isn't half bad. The design of the building is pretty cool and they have a beautiful patio/deck area that can be enclosed if the weather is bad, or open-air when its nice out. This is what drew me in. Then I heard from a friend that Wednesdays were bogo pizza night. So we tried it out and the pizza's were tasty, but a little soggy in the center of the pie. I figured it was just because I got a lot of toppings. Our appetizers were really good and their drink section is fair. The second time I went there the same thing happened... soggy pizza. Ok so i won't order that again. I found plenty of other things to eat and drink there that I liked, and the staff has been cool the couple of times I've been there. It's a perfect atmosphere for drinking and dining with some friends and it never seems to be that crowded.

Had dinner there with my coworkers. We ordered several appetizers: the shrooms, shrimp, and cauliflower - all were delicious. I ordered the Korean chicken - very yummy. Our waiters were great. Great and friendly service and they were very attentive. I would definitely recommend this place to friends and family.

Normally I wouldn't take time to review a restaurant in such a large chain, but I was mildly pleasantly surprised by Bonefish. Went with my boyfriend's family on New Year's eve for a late dinner. I'm a vegetarian and he doesn't eat fish so we'd kind of fallen into going due to lack of planning. The table ordered a few appetizers which all seemed pleasant, the edmame was nicely cooked and salted, although the menu did state roasted, and there was no evidence as such. I ordered the house salad and added feta, it was nice, however the feta tasted a little old, and for an extra $1.50, I feel like it could have been better. My boyfriend ordered the Diablo Shrimp Fettuccine, and it was excellent, the sauce was a little thin, but it had lots of vegetables and flavor.
The service was alright, the waiter managed to get everything to the table, just not really in any apparent order. I ordered a drink long after other guests and received mine first. He also brought the entrees out two by two for a table of six.
I try to avoid chains like this, but if I were ever in a bind, I'd go back to Bonefish.

Pizza + an amazing local comedy troupe (Wit Improv)= an amazingly good time.

I didn't even know this Grimaldi ' s existed, the last I remembered,  this was a different store. I'm glad that it is now a great pizza place. 

The waitstaff was very accommodating for our comedy show, I know it isn't what they were used to, but they did amazingly well. The service was great, the food was tasty, and the comedy was GOLD!

If you bring WIT Improv back, I know I'll be back!

Plus...THIS is where all the very BEST local comics hone their craft!! 
It's a can't miss for a great date night!!

I'll still buy their baked goods though.  if it's not out of my way.

Today we got donuts for my birthday!

It's a pretty "hip" spot and definitely clean. They are taking good COVID measures! 
The donuts are delicious but the coffee has a little bit of a soy sauce taste. It is just over roasted - which is probably due to the quality and time of the actual roast from where they source their coffee and not so much the brewing process. 
All in all, pretty good! The coffee could definitely use a boost.

Very good donuts and just about the best fried chicken I've ever had.
What more can you say?
I've had the coconut curry and glazed honey ginger chicken.
Both exceptional.

they don't stock any contacts. i had to wait two weeks and make another trip.

Such a good location for some

Always the Best place to go for Thai food. Friendly and fast service and the Quality of the food is always Fresh.

Clean, cheap rooms located in the middle of what I guess you could call downtown.  Decent walk or short cab ride to nearby restaurants.  We were easily the youngest people there, however this was probably to be expected.
The meat, produce, and bulk items are high quality and competitively priced. Staff members are very helpful and friendly.

Had the crispy tacos last night!! This was my first of many more to come visits!! These tacos were the best tacos I've had ever hands down! The shell was deep fried the chipotle cream was EVERYTHING! Great price and tacos were not skimpy! I definitely recommend this spot

Thouroughly disappointed in the whole experience. On their opening day we of course expected a long wait, we got to the restaurant around 11:00, we were sat within 45 minutes, which was not bad. We then placed our order, & waited over an hour to get our food. We considered leaving many a times. We paid for our entire meal with no compensation. My spouse and I have both worked food for a very long time & know how to handle these situations.

I am very lucky that I have this new BYOB right around the corner from my house. We went there recently for the first time and I'm sure I'll be going back. The decor is nice, simple and clean. They could put in a few more tables, while an open feeling is nice, this felt a little barren.  The wait staff was freindly and helpful, but not very experienced. The food was very good. Our other companion had the parmesan chicken with gnocchi. The gnocchi was so light. I had the stripped bass and I really enjoyed it. Overall a very good dinner and I think this place has real potential.

It's a little bit hard to find if you're following a GPS as it's tucked away behind other businesses off the road.  There is plenty of seating inside with a fire place in the center, a stage in the corner for live music and a  room in the back for private parties.  

They exclusively sell burgers, beef, pork, turkey and bison.  You can either get a pre-made burger with fries or you can build your own burger and ad ala-carte items.  They have a few basic desserts and a root-beer floats.  The burgers we had (turkey and bison) were delicious and cooked to our liking.  The fries were cooked perfectly and seasoned well.  The sweet potato tots were delicious with their house made dipping sauce.  I will eat here again!

If I could give this place 1 star I would. I can't even review the food because we never got any. We went here one night, there were 4 of us, and a baby. And I was pregnant. (okay, never keep a pregnant woman waiting for her food)  The "manager" i assume, seated us, and there was one waitress. It wasn't that busy. About 10 minutes later the manager finally came over to us and asked if we wanted drinks. So finally we got some drinks. The stupid waitress NEVER even ONCE looked at us. It's almost as if she pretended that we weren't there! No one helped us, we were being completely ignored, so we walked out without paying for drinks.
