Your business does not have a good reputation.

We have tried a couple groomers in Franklin and always return to Haute Dogge for their service and results! My dog always needs a nap afterwards from all the socializing but he look darn handsome. I also love the online scheduling.

The Sunday buffet brunch is absolutely delicious! The service is top notch. If there is something on the brunch buffet missing like the "eggs benefict" this last Sunday, all I had to do was tell my server and he ordered it. And the views r also amazing!

Every time I go home to visit family out of town I HAVE to take 4-6 slabs of ribs or I am not welcomed home...lol. My dad even wants me to get them and put on dry ice and send them to him-he is hooked and so am I. A+ service. I think I will go later today 7/20/15 for myself.

Amazing! It's become sort of a tradition to grab a drink and get lunch when I get out early for summer Fridays as I work nearby. I am always more impressed every time! It seems like a group effort from the staff to work as a team to make you feel super special. It never goes unnoticed :)

On the streets since 2011, Drift is pretty much one of Edmonton's OG food trucks. They were one of the first on the scene when food trucks really started to become a "thing." The best part? After a decade they're still probably the best food truck in the city. VUE Weekly named them #1 Best Food Truck 2018 and the show Eat St. featured them in season four. Plus they've been on the Worldwide Faves list on this website this entire time. Locals know that this is the truck that you want - especially for their legendary pork belly sandwich. (If they ever took it off of the menu I think the planet might implode? It's science.)

The best way to figure out where Drift is going to be on any given day is to check their website where they've got an up-to-date calendar of their whereabouts. The truck shuts down for the winter so it's always exciting when the end of April rolls around and you know that you're going to be able to start stalking them again. I went to find the truck on the seasons opening of the 124 Grand Market in Westmount, a wonderful farmers' market. Drift does sometimes sell out, so if there's something in particular that you want to eat from them, I'd recommend arriving early. (This will also help you to avoid waiting in a giant lineup.) It's always exciting when the turquoise-painted truck comes into view.

These days, the menu on offer is usually pretty standard. They've got four different sandwiches - all amazing.  (Although back in the day they used to sometimes do a duck confit sandwich that you don't see anymore and I'd love to see that one make a glorious return!) They've also got some sides that are very good as well. You know the drill, you approach the truck window to make your order with the friendly people inside, then wait a few minutes until they call your name and hand you a brown paper bag filled with goodness. And they do take cards as payment these days.
To drink they usually have interesting local canned beverages and they're often different from one visit to the next. I spotted the Troubled Monk Ginger Ale Soda (from Red Deer) and decided to give it a try. This craft ginger ale was quite possibly the best ginger ale that I've ever tasted. The flavour was so real! You could tell that it's made with real ginger but it also had a very unique and wonderful molasses flavour that I really enjoyed. If you see this soda around you should definitely grab some!

Next, I moved in on the Sides. We were going to have a true Drift feast on this day! There were four different items to choose from and I had to try the Poutine (Made with beef gravy & fresh cheese curds - $6.50) because I think that this might be something a bit new that they're doing. First of all, their hand-cut fries are already super famous and they season them with "Drift spice" which involves cumin, fennel, mustard seed and chili. (They also do their own housemade ketchup made with cardamom and ginger, which is excellent.) So the fries alone are already something special... But then they went and turned them into a poutine. This very well may be the best poutine happening in Edmonton right now. I'm super picky about poutine (as you may already know) and this one crushes it on every level. The fries are ultra crispy and golden (likely double fried) and dusted in their delicious seasoning. The cheese curds were fresh and squeaky, piled on high. And the gravy was hot and savoury. THIS is the poutine that Edmonton needs to know about.

I also ordered the Broccoli Salad (Broccoli, apple, carrot, raisin & herb aioli - $4.75), because health! Loved this little salad. This is a great way to add something a bit more fresh to your Drift meal and I loved the bright combination of veggies and fruit. The broccoli was crunchy and the apple and raisin gave it a nice sweetness. You really can't go wrong with this salad and you'll feel like you ate vegetables.

And then it's sandwich time. The Pork Belly Sandwich (Chili mayo, pickled carrot & daikon, fresh cilantro - $9.00) is truly of Edmonton legend and I doubt that I'll ever be able to get myself to order anything else. This sandwich is everything. I dove in immediately and reveled in the symphony of flavours. First and foremost is the pork belly that has taken on an incredible caramelized glaze which gives it a bit of a crunch. It's sliced thin and the fat is rendered down perfectly. Next, the pickled vegetables and cilantro give the sandwich a definite Vietnamese vibe, and the slight kick from the chili mayo is the perfect way to round everything out. The bun reminds me of the soft and crusty Portuguese type. It's a perfect sandwich. Incredibly delicious and consistently amazing for a whole decade, this sandwich must never, never go away.

I love Drift. They're a major part of the culinary tapestry in this city and they've certainly played a huge roll in making the food truck scene everything that it is today. They've really cracked the code by offering a small handful of items on their m

I witnessed Mason assisting an elderly customer who was having trouble breathing. Mason went to the customer's vehicle and got his oxygen tank and sat with him until he felt strong enough to drive home. We are generally pleased with the food at this location, but witnessing this act of kindness made our visit even more special.

First time and probably my last time coming here. I been a gnc member for sometime now and every time you walk into a gnc they try to sell you a bunch of crap they just got in or try to sell you a different product then what you're trying to get. So I walk in and knew exactly what I want. The lady at the counter ask if I need help and I told her. I thanks I know exactly what I want. Get to the register trying to cash out and leave before they try to sell me something and the lady at the register ask if I'm taking anything else (I knew where she was getting at). I told her no just this (just trying to get out and leave and not buy anything else). So she try to sell me a few other things like vitamins, fish oil and things like that. I responded nicely "no I'm good for today".  The lady at the register has the nerve to say "well maybe you should do some research"... Really? 1) I'm very active, healthy and in good shape 2) that's not something you tell a customer. Hopefully her next job she doe research on some customer service skills.

No doubt about it, cheapest drinks in the Quarter.  Friendly atmosphere, dog friendly, neighborhood bar that is actually clean (those of you who frequent neighborhood bars in the Quarter know what I'm talking about!).  Keep up the good work.
After multiple visits, I am going five star with Tavolo V!  Every visit has seen great service, great food and nice ambiance all within walking distance of entertainment on the Loop.

Great food.  Great value.  Great service and location.  Eating outside at the tables is super cool.  One of downtown Nashville's hidden lunch gems.  I recently had Cobb Salad there that was huge and delicious.  Fresh ingredients.  Most food under $10.

If you're looking for a quick automatic car wash this place is just what you're looking for. I went during my lunch break. Drive up to the speaker, pick what kind of wash you want, drive around into the machine, and come out with a clean car! Quick and easy. I went with the $10 wash since my car was a mess, but they also had $3 washes which I'm sure works just fine. 

They have a free vacuum area as well if you need to clean the interiors. 

Definitely will be back!

This is my favorite local Asian restaurant.  I have never had a bad meal.  My daughter loves trying different items from the sushi menu(I don't eat Sushi).  I love the Walnut Shrimp and Szechuan beef.  My husband does not usually like Asian food, but he actually suggests going to Rice N Roll for dinner.

Today was my first time in the store and I'm very new to the world of infused olive oils. Staff was very helpful. I left with great, personalized gift sets for family and tons of stuff for myself. Lots of local products and so much more than just olive oils and balsamic vinegars. They let you sample pretty much everything as well. Prices are very reasonable especially for the great quality you're getting. I highly recommend checking them out!

I've been here more times then I can count and always have a great visit! Food is fantastic and staff super friendly. Last night had the pumpkin cake and the snickers cake : ) They did not disappoint.

I had a really pleasant experience here, front staff was accommodating and helpful, they got me right on for an appt after switching pediatricians and needing some referrals, Dr Feldstein was a world of difference from my former pediatrician, knowledgeable and helpful.. The only thing that was on the negative side was we did wait a bit to be seen , but it was still less time than I've waited for previous doctor.
Purchased our wedding rings from David. Fantastic service and quality. Friendly and transparent throughout the entire process.
Not the Wendy's of my youth...this place has gone downhill. My last three visits I was met with rude staff and slow service.  I miss Wayne Oldham and Dave Thomas

I came here on my birthday to celebrate with a few friends. I made reservations online, which was super easy and convenient. You can park along State St upwards of Opal, as there are a ton of street parking opportunities. 

The pasta was wonderful and tasted fresh. I've never had green fettuccine, so it was a great surprise! The shrimp was cooked to perfection. I wish the sauce were a little bit thicker, but the savory shrimp made up for the lack of viscosity.

I ordered the Bourbon Blast and it tasted divine. This was my first ever drink purchase, as I just celebrated my 21st birthday, and this was the perfect choice. It was balanced to not be too strong but just enough. The strawberry flavoring was my favorite part.

We had lunch there today and they had  poker. it was allot of fun. The wife ever got in on the poker tournament .  Over all a very small bar, but very friendly people inside and good food.  We will be going back.
I purchased treatments and never got a chance to use it. I called several times to schedule an appointment and NO ONE answered the phone.

I really enjoyed my lunch here. Had their signature quesadilla- can't remember the exact name of it - but it had blackened chicken, black beans, spinach and cheese. It was awesome!! I'm usually a purist when it comes to Mexican food, but this really hit the spot and was a great recommendation by the funny, friendly guy behind the counter.

My husband thoroughly enjoyed his Korean BBQ burrito and my 1.5 year old ate almost all his kid's meal (no small feat!)

Loved the creative take on classic TexMex and look forward to returning!

This place caught my eye on my way to 422. I love local coffee places, so I thought I stop in an buy some ground coffee for my French press at home. It is a very unique spot in Audubon. The decor inside is modern and fun to look at while waiting for your order. The people who run the place were very friendly and easy to talk to.  I enjoyed the coffee at home. I gave it four stars because I haven't tried their brews yet. Once I'm back I'll make sure to order a coffee and update my review.

I used Sustainable Vine Wine Tours when I had a few girlfriends visiting from the East coast; my experience was PERFECT and I would recommend it to anyone.  Before this tour I had been to many Santa Barbara/Santa Ynez wineries and even belonged to a wine club, but it wasn't until I went with Sustainable Vine Wine Tours that I learned a great deal of the history and saw a few of the most beautiful spots in the area.  I was blown away by what I had been missing. 

Bryan, our tour guide, was knowledgeable, helpful, patient, and handsome to boot!  He went out of his way to make our experience unforgettable and put up with our shenanigans as the day went on.  Bryan has wine tasting down to a science.  He knows how to pace the guests so they are having a fun and memorable time. 

FInally, we went to a vineyard for lunch.  I knew we would be getting deli sandwiches and salads so I wasn't expecting much however the sandwich was so good that I often contemplate driving all the way up to Solvang just to grab lunch.  Moreover, the spot he took us to was one of the most gorgeous places I have ever been to.  

My friend said that our day with Sustainable Vine was one of the best days of her life and I concur.  Yes, we had great company, but Bryan made our day unforgettable.

This is my favorite bbq restaurant in St. Louis. I recommend the delicious and flavorful hush puppies which are served with a fantastic maple bitter. The macaroni and cheese is definitely not the type I would normally eat. -it has crackers on top- but it is so amazing. Their fries are also very very good. I've had the pulled chicken, pulled pork, and brisket sandwiches and each were very good. The burnt ends of the brisket can be a bit salty though 

I also love their apple whiskey cocktail

This is one of my mom's favorites places to eat. 
Sushi are freshly made. And verity food and fruit.

I was suprisingly impressed how generous and delicious the vegetarian lasagna was for the great price! I ordered online and it was ready within 15 minutes. As promised, it was hot, rich in flavor, and filling. We will definitely be ordering again!

Came here to pick up dog food. I had to use the restroom. Sign on the door talked about how proud they were for the cleanliness of their bathroom. Bathroom was filthy. Looked like it hadn't been cleaned in months.  I go up to pay for my dog food and the young man working the register definitely needed a lesson in customer service. He was rather rude. There are too many Petco's around to ever go back.
I love my manicure!! I will definitely be coming back next time!! Thanks SV Nails - Lee did them.

The hotel itself is very new and nice. The guest room was comfortable and very clean. The front desk staff was horrid on both occasions I interacted with them. Very disappointing and with so many other choices I'll never return.

My favorite thing about this place is, which I have been coming here for years late night, I'm a bartender/server, is the Bartenders AND the smell of the bathrooms!!! FABULOSA IS THE JAM OF THE SENT OF THE PERSONAL FACILITIES!!! You might think this rating is a joke, but I truly sniff the air every time I walk into the bathroom at Brewhouse south! And it gives me a since of happiness when smelling the freshly mopped floor even if it's been a few hours since it was done...I will say I've always wanted to write this review and I never we remember to! And I'm sitting here, and I've already paid my tab, and I'm currently in the bathroom writing this, as well as Dave walked in saying "im sorry".....because Im writing this in bathroom for last call, in all intention to leave to go home lol Moral of the story is...Love the bartenders Love FABULOSA lol

First time here so they gave us 10% off and free drinks! The food was fab! I ordered the chicken roll up and the cheese was mouth melting and my boyfriend ordered the steak roll up and it was so good!!!!! We wanna know what kind of sauce they use for the dipping sauce :( but for my side I ordered the vegetables and they were really salty. I just won't get the vegetables as sides next time but for entrees I'll definitely come again!

The reviews I saw on Yelp were not positive overall.  However, the building where I live has an agreement with Rogers.  Rogers will pick up and deliver resident's laundry free of charge.  My building's office told me that all the residents who use the service only say positive things.  So, I took a couple of items that needed dry cleaning as a test of whether or not I'd send more items to Rogers.  Both items had small stains that needed removal.

Since, my building didn't have any Roger's bags for me to use the pick up/delivery method, I went to the Rogers location to drop off my laundry.  The service rep was very helpful; when she learned where I lived, she gave me my own bag so that I could use their delivery service through my building.  Further, she noted my preferences (creases, starch, etc.), which I thought was a nice touch.  Then, she let me know that they would deliver my clothes to my building later in the week.  I opted to pick up my dry cleaning instead.  She indicated that it wouldn't be a problem.  Well, it wasn't a problem, but did cause confusion.  When my laundry was ready, someone called to let me know that the items would be delivered to my building.  She also referred to me as "Mr. P."  Uh, I'm a girl...always have been, always well be.  Ok.  So, my name is Martie, which could be confusing, but still...if it's a unisex name, wouldn't you call that person by their name to avoid a flub like this one?  I guess the girl who called me has never seen the SNL skit about "Pat."  Oh, well.

Anyway, despite the confusion, I was able to pick up my laundry.  Rogers did a great job - the stains were removed and the clothes look fabulous!  My bill was nearly $30.00 for dry cleaning a shirt and dress.  Pretty pricey, in my opinion.  However, I'll pay a little extra if I trust that a dry cleaner will do a good job.

Tried something I could barely pronounce, enjoyed it nonetheless. A new and most welcomed entrant into the Saint Louis proper Thai cuisine.

We were happy to find that on a busy Saturday night, our wait for a table at the seemingly small Fork & Stix was equally as small. It's a traditional storefront property that has been converted into a great restaurant space. A space that is utilized quite well with booth seating that lines the north and south walls, with traditional large and small tables spread throughout the rest of the space. The south wall has a giant chalkboard where murals and other earthly quotes are scribbled all over.

Once seating we were happy to enjoy a hot tea accompanied with self-serve bottles of water, the tea in particular was very good. Looking at the menu we elected to skip the appetizers but I noticed the table next to us had the Chicken Sateh which looked quite good. I went with the Pad Ka Prao and ordered it spicy, the waiter did warn me about the level of spice but I already knew the drill. My fiancé went with the Red Curry, not deterring far from recommended Thai food dishes. Both were excellent and offered healthy rations of vegetables and meat as well, you have your choice of pork, chicken, and or straight veggie. My only complaint is that mine had a little too much onion and I found my self sifting through them to get to the rest of the dish.

Other than that, we enjoyed our overall experience and will be back to sample more dishes. I saw many entrees that were intriguing so I feel it's worth it to return.

Every course in the $45 tasting menu was fantastic.  The bread was amazing to start.  The ending dessert was perfect.  Our fabulous waitress asked if we had any dietary preferences and I requested low sugar.  My husband and I were wowed with each dish brought out.  We loved the pork belly buns, the spring rolls etc.  The meal was a feast for the senses.  Service was also excellent.

We highly recommend SiBelle Homes!  SiBelle is very detail oriented, and thoroughly cares about your needs as a client. She really takes that extra special effort and time to help you with any transaction. 

She is also a marketing whiz; recognizing that traditional marketing avenues are over populated and under viewed. And the best way to sell a property is through viral marketing. We attended one of her estate preview parties at a beautiful property and even in this down economy the house sold within weeks that it went on the market. 

We highly recommend SiBelle homes for any of your real estate needs. She cares, and that really makes the difference.
Sarah Taylor and Carolyn Atwood were great guides and we had a great time. Definitely worth it!!! My son's first time and now he's ready for the advance run. Thanks Sierra Adventures for the memory.

Went to get a leg wax, it was great! The place was clean and they were super professional and very nice! The price is right, and the service is great!!!
Totally recommended!!!!

Don't really like to give negative reviews, but my wife and I ate at BJ's and were not satisfied with the food. The staff and cocktails made were awesome! Not a bad atmosphere either! We had a pretty basic appatizer, which was great! Unfortunately, our main courses were surprisingly not good. It was decent food, edible, but for a "brewhouse" and being from a brew- dominant culture  (new Hampshire) we expected some awesome burgers! Unfortunately, the burger was very thin, seemed to be frozen, and really didnt "wow" us. Even some of the better fast food restaurants made a better burger. This is our second time here, and not sure if we'll go back. Maybe for drinks and an app, but not dinner. Again, i want to say great service, fun atmosphere, but not great food. Maybe shrink the menu and focus on better quality bar food, rather than trying to have tacos, pastas, and dozens of other things that the chef/ cooks have to make.

I came to Naamans Animal Hospital at the behest of my mother because my 4 y/o cat has been having issues with squinty eyes/eye discharge for going on two months. I had previously taken him, on two separate occasions, to my long-term veterinarian, where I was promptly charged $150.00 (each time) for them to look in his eyes and not be able to diagnose what was going on. When he started having problems for a third time, I called them up and they told me to simply bring him in for another visit. I was not about to pay another $150.00 for them to do the same thing again, so my mom suggested getting a second opinion. 

I called Naamans on a Wednesday and was able to get a Saturday appointment. Upon arrival I was honestly a little skeeved out because of the location/appearance from the outside. This hospital is located in a tiny strip mall and the lobby is extremely sparse. However, the exam rooms were very nice and I got over my first impression very quickly.

Dr. Mule told me, without any hesitation, that my cat has herpes and he most likely got it from our newly-adopted kitten. He said that my cat was in the midst of a flare-up, and typically you wouldn't do much of anything (in terms of medication) for this sort of problem. Because my cat's eyelids were a little red, though, he gave me some antibiotic drops and told me that the next time this happens to ignore it unless the cat starts to seem bothered.

Best of all, first-time exams are free, so I only had to pay $25.00 for the eye drops!

I am now going to have to deliberate on whether to transition my whole pet family to Naamans, or to stay with the vet who's been reliable up until this point...

This was my 15th LA Fitness location that I have been to. I travel a lot for work and love hitting the gym in the evenings after work. 

This LA Fitness location wasn't too hateful. It's an original LA Fitness gym (it wasn't no urban active or ballys renovation). 

It was a 2 level typical LA Fitness gym. It did have a smoothie bar inside of this location. Most LA Fitness gyms in the Midwest have only 2 smith machines and this location had 3 with all the other machines, free weights, treadmills you need.

The ONLY downside was I thought the gym could have been a little more cleaner. There was trash on the floor, mirrors were dirty and locker room lockers were wore down. They just need a few new lockers to replace the broken owns, clean the mirrors and pick up the trash a little more and this would have been a 4 star rating! Also, location wise I think LA Fitness could have picked a better area than where this gym was located. I would definitely pick the southport Rd location over this one any day! My opinions, go wherever you'd like too !!

And FYI I got great workout in as usual :)

It's not often that food is revelatory.  We ordered the special, ribs on a lettuce wrap, and the pork was beyond perfect, complimented by spicy sauce and chili-roasted peanuts.  Each bite was close-your-eyes-to-savor-the-flavor good.  We had the shaved Brussel sprout salad, mac and cheese and boudin balls, all of which were delicious.  We had the pineapple upside down cake because of the picture and the bottom was crispy, the cake was dense, the pineapple tender, the caramel sauce a perfect compliment and the lime coconut ice cream set everything off perfectly.  

I've been hearing about Cochon for several years, but this was my first visit, and man, am I glad I went!  This will be a must-do for every future NOLA trip!

Went there before the Elton John concert last night. We had drinks, a Ceasar Salad and ordered the filet sliders from the bar hoping to kill some time and just hang out. I was right, 45 minutes for the salad and another 15 for the sliders. The sliders were so grizzly with fat that we couldn't eat them. Changed my order to a hamburger and fry's ($17.00 burger) and waited another hour before we finally left without eating. Manager finally came over when we were walking out the door and apologized. The place looks reallly nice and the bartender was very friendly and tried her best. From my perspective, a great place to open a restaurant with food. Go to Ruth Chris where the filets are great!!

We tried this place out because we had a Groupon.  The food was very good, and the prices would have been reasonable even without the Groupon.  When we got there around 7:00, the place was pretty empty, but by the time we left, it was packed in there.  Overall, it was a good experience, and I would definitely return.  Only complaints are that it's cash only, and because it got so crowded at the end of dinner, it took us over half an hour to get the check and get out of there.  Also, we got a bottle of white wine, and I was a little surprised they didn't use an ice bath... just kind of left the bottle on the table (it was, however, already cold so not really an issue).

Was not a good stay for me . Hair on the sheets hair in the tub hair on bathroom floor. It was a non smoking room but reeked of cigarette  smoke. The room was dusty. The biggest disappointment was they thought it was okay. They offered to change sheets to fix it and spray air freshener but my sister insisted on a different room since they said they could not give refund . Because it was through Hotwire .
Best burger.  The crust on the burger is perfect and the bun stays together till the end. Twisty fries are not my thing.  Great service!

Excellent food and service, although it was very busy due to valentines Day weekend... As vegetarians there was plenty of dishes to choose from : our favorites : garrotxa which was cheese with a savory garlic dulce de leche dip; tortilla espanola,arroz temporado... Try the cocktails! I had the Tie me up tie me down - delicious Book in advance you wont be disappointed

Best mechanic in the country! My whole family takes their vehicles here - Hummer (H2), Jaguar, Ford F150, Jeep Cherokee - and after I drove my 2005 Jetta from CA it needed a lot of work. These folks are not only speedy and efficient, but they have the best customer service you can ask for. I never feel like I have to check their work, e.g. did they replace or "resurface" my brakes, like I've had to other places. I was in the worst situation with the VW needing a new transmission and they not only worked w/ me to consider all my options but even provided guidance on selling/buying. Believe me when I say every vehicle I will ever own will be serviced here. Yours should too.

I will go here if and only if it's late and I need to grab one or two things, and only because it's closest to my house. I absolutely hate going to this Wal Mart. This is the slowest Wal Mart there is. Plus trying to get help with any of the workers there is nearly impossible. I do like Wal Mart due to there good prices, but I will go to the one in Citrus Park if I need to go to a Wal Mart. This one is really tight to get around. They have displays in any little place they can have. They want this to be a Super Wal Mart with the square footage of a regular Wal Mart size.
"SUPERb"! The Superdome "SUPER"ceded our already high expectations. Seriously everything was delicious.

Great spot to eat brunch at but is very little so plan on a wait if you have a larger group. If nothing else get the aebleskivers (pancake balls) as they were the highlight of the meal and the dipping sauce was excellent. I also ate a savory crepe which was good but the eggs were a little too runny for my taste. The classic croque madame is supposed to be awesome so would get that next time. Our friends who live in NOLA love this place so much they got engaged here!

An interesting concept, but I'm going to knock it down to 3 stars simply because if you're going to bill yourself as a healthy restaurant don't jack up the sodium content to compensate for cooking without butter. Other than that the food was pretty good, albeit somewhat bland. I'm not sure if I would come here again, but I guess for Indianapolis it wasn't that bad. I got some variation on a Turkey kebab and finished it. Dessert  was some type of calorie controlled portion of brownie in a tiny glass, but was completely unmemorable.

Must go! Get your reservation! :) The atmosphere is just perfect for a relaxing night out if you're into great live music (without the crowd) and good, wholesome food. Richard, the owner, started the music off and he and the band were great! I could have listened to them all night. The artist that played after him was good, too- all original music.

I ordered the red beans and rice with sausage and selected the grilled veggies as my side. It was a delicious combination and I highly recommend it!! My husband got the special, blackened redfish, and went on and on about how good it was. 

For dessert, we had the bourbon chocolate pecan pie and beignets. Both were decadent. I can't wait to get the beignets again!!!

After a week-long road trip, we had our final meal at Salty at the Beach. The restaurant has one of the best views in Santa Barbara, where you can view the harbor and take in some fresh air while enjoying your meal. The restaurant offers a robust drink menu and a range of appetizers and entrees that will satisfy every diner's palette. The food is made with fresh ingredients and specializes in seafood. The only fault with this dining experience was the service. Staff was friendly, but failed to offer water or check-in while we were dining. Despite the luke-warm service, we still highly recommend Salty. Make sure to try the ahi sandwich and the poke!

Went with another couple and we had a great time  We had a 30 minute wait for our bay, so we headed to the bar for a Bloody Mary.  Once in the bay, we ordered beers and the pretzel board which is plenty for four and quite delicious. The golf is a blast and staff is very friendly and helpful!

A major 5 star update for a TOP SHELF service business - and local! The best of both worlds!

Only place in town to get sushi grade tuna for $14.99 per lb. Excellent tuna, taste is perfect with not a hint of fish smell.

We also ordered a rack of lamb for Christmas and they were able to tell us where the lamb came from plus other needed feeding information. The lamb was excellent.

I highly recommend Dickman's if you're looking for an old butcher shop feel with old butcher shop customer service.

Koula V.is by far the best hair stylist I've experienced in the world. I've been to Japan, Cali, Washington State, NJ, & Pa, and she knocks any color desire out of this world. She understands how to color match to your skin tone. As well as, the specific color you want and tailor it to you. Koula treats you like family and is so personable. 
It's great to finally experience a hair stylist who is so sincere and kind.

The food was good but the service was horrible. Our waiter was Braden and he visited our table a total of 3x. We had a party of 10 so he was getting automatic gratuity anyway I guess that's why we received the service we did. Complained to the manager and he assured us that we would be able to leave our own tip but that was a lie. The bus boy was a better waiter than he was. He even shorten me on my change.

I came with my daughter for my birthday.  This was some place I had always wanted to come when I used to live in the St. Louis area but never managed to get around to it until I left for 5 years and was back visiting family.  

The decor is very modern and the lighting very dark.  Even though the restaurant was far from full on the night we were there is was noisy because of the close proximity of the bar.  The prices are exactly what you would expect at a Four Seasons, a little on the high side for the amount of food.  Portions are small, however, very tasty.

Being my birthday, they brought out a cupcake with happy birthday written in chocolate on the plate.  However, it was inedible.  It tasted as if it had been made days ago.  The icing was rancid and the cake stale.

I am not sure I would recommend this restaurant for anything more than appetizers and a drink.  It's just not worth the money.

I wish I could give zero stars, but sadly that is not allowed. I drive a Honda that I BOUGHT from Audi. So yes, it is a Honda but I have always been directed to go to Audi for any needs. This was the same with my previous car, I had a Toyota that I had to take to Volkswagen because that is where I bought it! 

I was pressured into purchasing a warranty by Fabien (the finance guy). He failed to offer me other packages that normally go along with this warranty and I have been left out in the cold. Don't go to Fabien! Per the warranty I have to take my car to the dealership for oil changes.  I called and to schedule my appointment with the Audi service center. My appointment was made and when I inquired about the price I was told the service would be complimentary with my warranty. The woman who made my appointment confirmed that I did have a Honda. 

I show up for my appointment at Audi at the designated time. It was at this point that I had the unfortune of encountering an Audi technician named Robert.  Robert is hands down the rudest person I have ever met. He treated me poorly. He was snotty about the fact that I owned a Honda. When he saw the Honda he immediately decided I wasn't worth helping. Robert simply told me he couldn't service my car and I would have to take it elsewhere. Robert didn't offer to help me in any way, he didn't even offer to call the service center for me. I called myself, where they found my appointment.  

Needless to say Audi did not service my car and the oil change was not complimentary. There are other dealers in town, go there! Whatever you do, DO NOT go to Audi Tucson. They only care about money.

Absolutely terrible situation. Having paid for an oil change and tire rotation service, my wife returned home with the vehicle and I immediately noticed the tires hadn't been rotated. This was concerning at the time but we were very busy and I was unable to return until this past weekend. This past Saturday, after speaking with a manager- the vehicle was returned, taken into the bay, and they again did not rotate the tires. This was a bit alarming as I had made sure to tell the manager that the reason was beyond maintenance and we has safety concerns because we would be driving with a camper trailer early the next day. This concern was obviously ignored. THEN I spent an hour on the phone yesterday with someone on the main helpline sharing my concerns. He promised to call back once he'd made an appointment at a different location for me to get it taken care of. He never called back. This is absolutely terrible and honestly maddening. It is such a simple thing to just dismiss.

If you like gourmet food, then this is thye place for you.
its not a bad place
food is all right
they have a wide selections from salads to burgers to pizzas to sandwiches.
my only problem with this place is the people who work there can be downright snobby or just plain rude.
called to ask about a band playing there earlier in the week and the woman who answered the phone acted like she couldnt5 be bothered to answer questions.
so again
foods ok
but they need to work on their attitudes.

Why anyone would rate this place below 5 stars is beyond me?    I had been asking my friends to find a similar place to the Bier Markt or Beer Bistro in Toronto where they had different types of beers, mainly of the non traditional kind.  

One of the managers greeted me right away, introducing me to the various types of beers that they had. He mentioned they changed the beer menu very frequently.  The place isn't meant to be a bar but somewhere to relax, enjoy the time with your friends and taste some beers you have never had before.  

I had a hot dog with a salad (seen below).  I wanted to try their special dog and boy was it delicious.  I didn't have to put any condiments on it because it was just that damn good.

The service was great and the manager was very friendly.  Probably one of the better places I've visited to this point.  I would definitely go back in a heartbeat.

By the way, the 3 pics you see here are from when Aditya and I visited.  I gave him props for showing me this place.

Literally the worst Panera I've been to. Crowded and noisy. And the food portions are horrible. I ordered a half tuna sandwich and a cup of soup. The sandwich had one spoonful of tuna (see photo)! And the soup bowl they used was filled.
The ladies here are great. They explain everything step by step and give you options to choose from along with what they think will look best. Kayla did an amazing job. Love my new lashes.

The best nursery I have seen so far. The prices are reasonable, the staff is very knowledgeable, and they are very responsive to questions concerning the health of your plants. Pat the owner has been in this business for a very long time and he is always willing to make any vision you want with landscaping a true reality. Any time we have had issues due to pests or the climate, they have always worked with us to determine the cause and offer many solutions. I always feel welcomed going there and can spend hours looking at all the beautiful plants. I would highly recommend this nursery. It is a cut way above any of its competitors in service, recommendations, and care of your landscape.

I've never had Jamaican food before but I certainly will be coming back! The owner and the gentleman taking our order were both extremely nice and we felt quite welcomed. The place was clean and the decor was cozy but man was the food great.

Even with no background to appreciate it properly I still enjoyed everything in the jerk chicken combo plate. The servings of everything were generous and despite the nice grilled look of the chicken it was perfectly tender. The chicken had a nice blend of spices without the spicy burn and the rice and beans paired well with it. 

I could not have asked for anything more with my first Jamaican food experience. I'm happy I found this place thanks to Yelp and it's community.
You will be waiting forever for food. Whether you order online or in store they are never prepared. The staff pretends to not see you so they don't have to help. Do not recommend this location.

This road is beautiful no doubt about it!! One of my favorites. It is a great alternative to the schuylkill expressway as well and I use it very often. Thing that burns me is the weekend closures of west river drive 7 MONTHS OUT OF THE YEAR.  Now, I am all for healthy bikerides on beautiful roads, don't get me wrong. However, when it shuts down on the weekends for all this time it really burns the people who have to work downtown who need to drive in (with guitars and heavy amps, for instance). When Kelly drive shuts down for the regattas (often in the summer) and west river is shut down on the weekends too, there is NO alternative route  to get downtown and the schuylkill is just jammed all day, constantly. I definitely think when the regattas on Kelly drive happen they should open west river drive. Cars should have at least one alternative open at all times. Poor planning in my opinion.

Awesome! After having travelled all over the south for years, I'm a BBQ snob, but this was great! I recommend the chicken and/or brisket w/o a doubt. Seemed a little tourist-trappy, so I was dubious, even w/all the local recommendations, but I'm definitely a believer!

Great vibe at the oyster bar, highly recommend ordering the baked drum, and their dessert menu is absolutely fantastic! I got the key lime pie but every dessert I saw coming out of the kitchen looked better than the last.

I honestly never really thought much of this place however after trying a pizza one evening I have to say that this is much better than Imo's. Seems like they use fresher or higher quality toppings on their pizza.

The worst experience I could have ever imagined, we live in Texas our kids 19, 14 and 10 are in Tampa and Marriott refused to check them in. Rene at the front desk and general manager Demetrius could not care any less that these kids had nowhere to sleep. How someone so cold, with such a lack of humility, empathy can ever work in hospitality is beyond comprehension. 

Marriott should really train their staff better in handling such situations!

Kona Grill is one of the nicest atmospheres and menus I've seen more experienced...
This is a beautiful place to sit and enjoy a meal.
Brunch was great. Service was friendly and quick. Apple pecan bread was fabulous. Farm egg pizza and huevos rancheros was very good

If you are looking for a fancy resort, this is not your hotel. If you need a hotel convenient to the University of Arizona or vicinity, this is a great choice.  I stayed here a couple times and was VERY happy with the hotel staff, cleanliness, ammenities etc.  You can't beat the price per night for the breakfast they provide in the morning, plus, free wi-fi, parking, cookies (baked on premises yum), coffee and water 24 hours a day.  Very polite and friendly staff - *John*, April and David.  The people above us were a little loud,  but that wouldn't prevent me from staying here again.
Good food, nice selection. A little pricey for a pizzeria. Unfortunately since it's really the only game in town, the wait time for pizza has gotten ridiculous.

I don't usually eat fried chicken but I could eat here every day and be happy. I had the hot chicken sandwich and it was fantastic. the fries were a little stale but the sandwich more than made up for it. The staff was so kind and checked on me several times. I'll be back next time I'm in Nashville.

I used to go to the owner mymy  and I have been a regular client for this place for years.. even when they were at their old location in Phoenixville, and then I started coming to this location as a loyal client usually does when Savvy opened.  Per Mymy's instruction I would text her the day I wanted to come in and she would respond with a time and I would be there.  I recommended 4 of my coworkers, as I used to love this place, to come here and they continue to do so for now.
But I think savvy just lost the customer service skills one day- which was a really weird feeling for me, especially by Mymy who is the owner. Her rudeness eventually just got to me - I even stopped having mymy do my nails and started to schedule my appointments with Lucy, and yet I could feel the cold experience.  
So just wanted to share my long term experience and how eventually they just get tired of loyal faces.  As I move on, I wish all the new and current clients good luck!  Hope no one is made to feel the way I was made to feel when they felt like it.

Full disclosure, I usually never yelp, especially when I'm not complaining.  Brow Therapy is different. Brow Therapy deserves all the stars. 

After a rather traumatic loss of a singular eyebrow from a salon on the Northshore, I was convinced I'd spend the rest of my life looking like a cartoon character. Then I met Kristian. 

My eyebrows have never looked better. She's so precise and specific.  She's truly the eyebrow angel. Outside of her insane talent, her pricing is extremely reasonable. 

I will never get my eyebrows done anywhere else for as long as I live.  

THIS PLACE IS THE BEST. Try it. You won't be disappointed!

Allison is wonderful! She really spends the time and listens to her clients and what they want. I appreciated her honesty about the process of coloring and the time she took to perfect my color. Additionally- her salon is so friendly and comfortable it makes you feel right at home. Would highly recommend this down to earth, talented artist!!

Rip off. No stars.  Bait and switch.  Came with digital coupon, ate, and they would not accept!  Rude about the whole deal too. Food is usually pretty good, servers don't speak English very well, and they do everything they can to get out of coupons.  When we presented the Value Pak coupon on my phone, which they advertise with, they would not accept it.  If they treat customers like this I wonder how they treat their employees!

Blackened tilapia was amazing.  Even a burger was excellent with mushrooms piled high.  Nikia, our server, was knowledgable, prompt, professional and friendly.  Great people watching on the corner of Broadway and 4th.

Filipino/Hawaiian breakfast place? Yes please!

Great choice on the unit they moved into. The large windows gives it a bright morning feel. The open concept kitchen lets you watch the food being prepared so there's no hiding! 

The food is well seasoned, decently priced, and the service is timely and friendly.
They accommodated us even though we weren't on the wait list and we had our 7 month old son with a big stroller. 

It is kinda loud in there because it was busy! Every table was in use and there was lots of energy from the cooks, servers, and guests. 

I will definitely come back here to get my fix of Hawaiian inspired food like the loco moco and spam! And we still need to try their poutines and bennys. 
Stay tuned for an updated review once we go back really soon!
Great atmosphere and great service! The Twisted Mac & Cheese is to die for and the Diablo Shrimp Pasta has an amazing spice that leaves you wanting more.
Get the dog food roll, great for raw feeders and homecookers for the pets also, really nice people that operate this cool university run business!!!!!!!
Get the chicken tenders!! They are very crispy and moist. You get three of them and they are very large pieces. The fries are ok.
I wanted to love the place. I had a grilled chicken salad. I felt like it was decent but way too small. Walked away hungry...the rest of the food looked great but not sure if I will return.
Nothing special. Good cheap food. Restaurant could use a good cleaning and even an update.
Went there for birthday Diner, and The food was delicious and the server was so helpful. Definitely coming back.

Ikura does sushi very efficiently with quick and good service. The kraken roll and Metairie roll were standard. The downside is that the salmon and other items did not look appetizing from the sushi bar. Maybe it was the sight of those that gave me a stomach ache after I left.  I would still come back here anyways because the place is large so there would rarely be a wait and service was quick. Sushi should always be quick anyways without a cooking process.
I haven't tried the hibachi side but it seems pretty good to fulfill a hibachi craving. The best part here is the complimentary salad with fresh fish pieces - lush.

Our grandson was in Horsham Clinic for two days. He was tackled and assaulted by another patient. Horsham Clinic would not move this aggressive patient into another building. For our grandson's safety, we were forced to take him home since we did not believe Horsham Clinic could and would protect him. 

We requested a copy of the incident report which they refused to write while we were present. They did not supply to us an incident report. We called the next day for a copy of the incident report and they said we could not receive it since my grandson was no longer a patient. 

We requested to review the video of the incident and they refused. They said we have to call back. 

We filed a Police Report with Horsham PD and we are considering other options.

We would never recommend Horsham Clinic to anyone.
Ordered delivery to my hotel. Ordered street tacos and ceviche. Really excellent and fresh meal. The Ceviche is one of the best I've had in a long time.

Was craving sushi and Bleu seemed like a good deal for decent quality! They have a 2 or 3 roll lunch special for $10.95 or $14.95 with miso soup or salad side. They have a good selection of rolls so that's why I chose them! There were a lot of people eating when we went, which is a good sign. I like the miso soup, it was more flavorful than others I've had!

A weird thing is they don't offer free tap water, you have to order like hot tea or bottled water. The rolls were on the smaller side but came with 8 pieces, and I was nicely full after!

Having lived in both Chicago and NYC with two dogs, I was happy to find this vet (I just moved here less than 2 months ago). My dogs were both due for their annual check-up and had some shots that were coming up as well. With those reasons, and the fact that my neighbor's old roommate's cat infested our apartment building with fleas, I needed to find a vet ASAP. My neighbor was originally given a referral here, and she took her small dog, and was impressed enough to refer me as well. I called and was given an appointment the very next day, and even received a call back later that afternoon as a reminder for that appointment. I didn't yelp before the visit, which I normally would have, and browsing through these reviews, I've noticed that most of them are in regards to boarding (which I didn't use, but the level of care shown to my dogs would not prevent me for doing so in the future), and one mentions prices, which obviously they didn't price around because the costs are considerably lower here compared to other vets in the area, and a lot less than what I have spent in the past at other vets. I treat my dogs as if they are my children, and am willing to spend what is necessary to maintain their health and happiness.  The credentials the vets have is quite impressive (one of them went to my Alma Mater which is among the best for veterinary medicine in the country), and they boast the same modern technology found at vet's in major US cities. Dr. Brand (my vet) was so genuine, caring, and upfront throughout the visit. During my initial visit, Dr. Brand had diagnosed some dental problems, and suggested having some cleaning done after noticing an abscess on one of my dog's gums. I made the appointment that day before I left, and was given an estimate of charges, for which I had to put down a small deposit. The day the dental work was done, throughout the day, Dr. Brand and the rest of the team made sure I was kept current of what was going on throughout the entire process. Also, when something did arise, she notified me of what was found, the best treatment recommended (she gave several options), and the costs associated with the treatment. The care exuded from the staff was phenomenal, and I would without a doubt recommend them to anyone looking for a vet. I just picked up my dogs yesterday, and have already received a follow up call to see how they were doing. This vet has several "best of" awards from the local paper which they have received yearly, and with the service and care my dogs and I received on our visits, it's clear why they received them! Bravo San Roque Pet Hospital, bravo!

I cannot say enough about All Hours Air, but I will try :)
I contacted 3-4 others needing only a quote and they responded quickly. They are honest, fair priced and stood by every promise they made when we upgraded our 25+  year old heating and AC systems. There were hiccups and they responded instantly and true to their name, at all hours!
Their staf, and I mean each and everyone of them, are the most friendly and courteous even under the most demanding circumstances. I highly recommend "All Hours Air"

The food was below average. My steak was bad, as was my buddy's steak. When the server checked back, he showed her the steak, but it didn't seem like she was aware of what a medium rare steak needs to look like. I guess we hoped for more from a place with "Steakhouse" in the name. Also, the building was downright cold, something I asked about 4 times. The upside? The karaoke was actually surprisingly good (except for really odd rap song selections that ruined the flow of the fun -- and lots of those songs were waaaaaay too long, and unnecessarily offensive. I mean, I know it's a saloon, but still...)

Surprisingly okay Thai food and boba in South Tampa!

I had been meaning to try this place out, but it just didn't happen until last week. Now I regret letting so much time go by.

Chef Thai has really good boba tea. The boba is soft and not too sweet. The drinks are all smoothies, no option for just plain tea. But my family liked the strawberry smoothie and the mango smoothie. They had good fruit flavor.

I ordered the tom yum gai and red curry with beef. The soup was good, a little spicier than acidic, but I found it very comforting, and better than most versions that I've had in Tampa. The curry was also pretty good, and I appreciated that the rice had a strong jasmine aroma. 

The staff is friendly. The owner is Thai, and like Thai people, very gregarious. I'll have to bring my mother to meet him. 

There's plenty of parking in the private lot, although the way the restaurant is located in the mini mall, you might have to walk a bit. The restaurant is practicing distancing (although I got take out), and masks are required.
We need more restaurants like this in Tucson. Had the Arroz co Pollo, great lunch! This hidden gem has been here for 5 years!

This LA Fitness is the best gym I've ever been a member of. Is very complete and they have absolutely everything you need. The staff is super friendly and helpful. Go and join, you will not regret it. Very deserving 5 stars.
Service was absolutely wonderful! And the food matched up! I definitely recommend this restaurant for any outing

This place is really cool.  Friendly service, GREAT coffee, and a fun atmosphere.  I walked up the Monon trail from downtown & really enjoyed stopping here for a few minutes to re-energize with some caffeine.
Food average.  Pasta overcooked.  My husband liked his chicken florentine.  The service was extremely slow.  The manager apologized and took some money off our check.
Chi is amazing! Does excellent work in a timely fashion!!! Highly recommend! She has hemmed jeans, fixer tears, altered pants and everything is done with excellence!

Labor Day marks the end of the season .
Only open on weekends from this point weather permitting till end of season.
Saturday & Sunday Hours Only For Boat Rentals 

2017 rates:

Boat with electric motor $25 hour 
Single kayaks  $20 hour
Two person kayaks $25 hour
Canoe $25 hour
Stand up paddleboard $25 hour
Season pass and camp available

***You cannot use your own equipment in lake*** no swimming

Great lake and water activities rental. We rented a boat with a electric motor on 4 occasion's and kayaks. Prices are great on rentals and run by a family that is super. Service was great to get you going quick. A driver license and 1 minute form and your off. They offer boats, kayaks, stand up paddleboards. The lake is approximately 900 acres of water and super for fishing with a license, State Constable was go.
Plenty of free parking  and a great family value.
Seasonal passes & single day to three day camps. Super service for 1st timers. Highly recommend weekday visit over weekend.... Great family spot .

I liked this airport. The lines were quick, and it was quite spacious. It's not cramped like LAX or JFK, but it's like comparing apples to oranges. In any case, the terminals are connected by a cute little monorail thing. The central lobby area is large and well marked. It was really easy to find the place where the shuttle picks up in front of the baggage claim. Many dining options that aren't too bad in terms of prices.

Lots of bagel options and bagel sandwiches their made in house! Along with variety of Donuts juice sodas waters teas and coffee. I went with a bagel sandwich they do have vegetarian options which was nice. Staff is very friendly and attentive to serving you quickly. Mental note to this place does charge a $.45 credit card debit card processing fee.
Delicious Beyond meat burger!  Highly processed, high in calories and fat.  I won't be having it often but guilty pleasure?  Oh yes.
Donuts were SUPER fresh and the staff was amazing! Love this place and wouldn't go anywhere else for my donut cravings

Normally, they do a decent job but recently it seems like they just gong don't care as much any more. Hopefully it changes before my wife and I decide to take our dog elsewhere. Waited outside as they ignored my car my for over 10 minutes and they took 13 other cars let them skip right past. Maybe they just have a personal issue with me. The shift working closing on 4/8/20 Needs to be trained better. I expected more from this company.

Excellent Italian fare in a very nice environment.  Try the linguini with clam sauce and clam meatballs.

Yummm!

The Manager, Ms. Michelle Hargrove was Professional. Ms. Hargrove displayed patience when assisting me during difficult registration process having booked through Orbitz . Ms. Hargrove worked extremely hard with several people to assist me. Thankfully, Ms. Hargrove never gave up. It was my first time with this company and it definitely will not be my last.

Very good experience where urgent care facilities are concerned. Very good at getting me seen in a timely manner and had the meds i needed onsite. I will use this facility again in the future before waiting for an appointment with my primary care facility.

This is to the worst Wendy's I've ever been to I ordered the Apple pecan chicken salad it came with rotten apple and chicken on lettuce. Nothing else.Service was aweful Horrible horrible will never go there again it's that bad.

Nice romantic atmosphere outdoors in the courtyard, but we were seated indoors right under a twirling ceiling fan, and it got quite cold - along our food. Great bread though. Staff is young and hipster, and not overly polished. Menu surprisingly uninteresting for what it seems they are going for, a modern take on southern cuisine, with the execution just OK, and bill expensive. With so many great places to eat in New Orleans, I am surprised how highly this is rated in yelp, and the crowds that gather and wait for tables, given what we experienced. Didn't do it for us, but maybe just an off night for the restaurant.

This place is a gem ! Absolutely love just getting a tray and filling it up with goodies. They have lots and lots of baked goods. Don't really know what everything is called but it's delicious. Some of them are filled with pastry cream and it's not overly sweet so just hits the spot. The prices are also unbelievable. You won't spend more than $10 for a tray full of yummy treats.
I love this little gem!  The brunch is delicious.  The sandwiches and salads are great too.  The coconut soft serve is amazing.

Excellent service and very clean. They are always busy, but always make time for you. It's the only place in town I recommend to friends. I've been a customer for pedicures and gel and dip manicures for the last 4 years.

Terrible experience last night. They have a server for drinks and another for food. The drink order was taken relatively quickly but she brought the wrong ones.
The issue was the food service. We didn't see her for some time and once she brought the food we never saw her again. We couldn't even get the water refilled.
To make matter worse it wasn't that crowed. Now I have spent thousands her on drinks and meals for work with relatively few issues.
Based on that I requested a manager to discuss the situation. He would not come to the table.....
I will not return for work or pleasure. A simple conversation and an offer to comp the food would have been acceptable.

What a wonderful concept and execution. I went on opening day so of course the donuts were sold out. We were sad but totally understand and are so excited for this new business!

So instead I had the Nitro Cold Brew and truffle Parmesan fries. Both were excellent. My coffee was so smooth and creamy. I could have ordered 3 more! My daughters and I shared the fries and were so happy. The truffle is very subtle and just adds a slightly unique flavor. Our Parmesan did get a bit clumpy but eating a chunky bit of melty cheese never bothers me! 

The location is so cute. Cool graffiti art, fun seating options and an open viewing area to the donut making magic. We will be back and come early so we can try one of those donuts!
I don't normally frequent 7elevens but being a few blocks from my house, we have grown fond of this store. Nice staff, quick service and quite a bit of selection. It is always packed for a reason!

The food is awful. I've been there several times with local friends who happen to friends with the staff so they get "hooked up " but even that is not worth it. I'd rather pay full price for good food and drinks. The manger is terrible unprofessional and usually drunk by 10pm since he sits at then end of the bar drinking cold Budweiser that the bar staff but on ice for him. This is the same ice they use to make your drinks with holding these dirty bottles. It's just nasty. Don't waste your time or money.

All things considered, PHL is a pretty decent airport. Getting to the airport is quick and uber pickup points + cell phone waiting lot make getting back home pretty easy. Within the airport, prices are lower than other major airports like Chicago, LA and JFK (though that doesn't say much), but the new iPad-based restaurants make it much easier to find seating and get a drink before your flight. Actually, with the new centurion lounge that AMEX opened, I don't think I've flown out of here sober in the last year. If you don't have a platinum card, get one!

Let me start by saying I really hate grocery stores and the entire experience.

Trade Joe's has completely changed my view of the grocery store experience. You see, it doesn't feel like a normal grocery store like Acme, Super Fresh, or Shoprite. It feels more like a modern and organized farm market without any of the strange smells.

The staff is always actively running around and ready to help! The selection of items are always of high quality and ensures there is a choice for every dietary need.

My most hated aspect of a normal grocery store is the long checkout line. At Trade Joe's they have solved for this problem. The checkout counters are plenty and properly staffed based on current store traffic. No matter how long the line is, I have never waited more than 5 minutes. This aspect of the shopping experience is incredibly important. There have been many times in my "regular" grocery shopping experiences where I have grown tired of waiting to checkout and abandoned my cart only to walk out empty handed, further adding to my frustration.

Trader Joe's has changed the grocery shopping experience into one that anyone can enjoy!

Decided to try a new spot for lunch. Place was a recommendation from a colleague so we stopped in. First impression- place was dirty. My chair was dirty. The table was dirty. The menu was dirty. 

Salsa and chips came and it was very good. I ordered the arroyo con pollo   It was very tasty. Nice pieces of chicken in a cream sauce. I rolled it up on corn tortillas and chowed it. 

Service was good and quick

I've been here a few times. The food used to be decent when they first opened. Now the calamari is the same frozen boxed stuff you get at pizza shops. After we made our soup choices from the options she gave us, the server comes back and tells us that wasn't on the menu that night.  The service is slow, and the server brought me the wrong Entree. The manager did take it off my check and offered to replace it however, by the time my replacement came out, which I only ordered an app to replace a main dish, my husband was already finished his dinner and even that app wasn't good and I didn't eat it. If they are going to serve pizza shop quality food ,than they should also have pizza shop prices. Sorry to say, but I'm pretty sure we won't be back.

We stayed here for a total of 3 days.  My daughter seemed to have caught a bug on our first night staying and threw up on our bed.  I went to the front desk to ask them to please change the sheets at about 7am the  first morning of our stay when it all happened. The young lady at the front desk quickly dismissed me saying that she would put a note in for room maintenance.   We leave the entire day without a worry at mind.  When we return at 10pm, closer to 11pm we are just about ready to tuck ourselves in and come to find that the genius who does the cleaning of the rooms simply made the bed with throw up and all on the sheets.  I do have a very sensitive nose so when I walked in I smelled vomit but couldn't put my finger on it. I called downstairs and didn't even get a sorry for the ineptness, yet an attitude for having to remove our own sheets at this time and hour take them down because now everything smelled like vomit and then having to go down twice to get the proper bedding to put on ourselves.  Worst experience of my life, had the first young lady stated we needed to change our own stuff to begin with I wouldn't be soo upset.  I will continue to write horrid reviews about this place as I am disgusted with the poor service at such a nice establishment.   Maybe the employees need to be trained on how to treat and speak to a customer, especially in situations like these.

I am just obsessed.  Been here mutiple times and have orderd a variety of things.  Super delicous and probably one of my local favs.  I loved seeing them grow from the small little shop to a larger restaurant/cafe.  They also have a refrigerated section that sells arepa dough and chorizo sausage.

Dr.Park and her staff are wonderful. I made an appointment and they sent all my forms quickly so I could fill them out. I was able to have everything filled out before my appointment and the following day she called me promptly at my appointment time. Since they sent me all necessary forms to fill out the day before I was able to be certified at my appointment. I couldn't of be more happier with my experience. I Highly recommend Dr.Park!!!

Came here to celebrate my daughter's 2nd birthday early and had a great time. Yes, its smaller than your average theme park, which wasnt a problem since the little ones can't handle that much in one day anyway. While we only rode a couple of rides, the chance to the see the parade, the show at Sesame Neighborhood and other activities like Dine with Elmo and painting pumpkins for Halloween also kept us very busy. I was on the fence originally about Dining with Elmo but ended up really enjoying it as we got to get out of the heat, meet 6 characters up close, and do a lot of dancing at the end. Another plus is that you actually get to bring in your own food as long as your cooler is not too big - almost unheard of compared to other parks! Looking forward to going back next summer when the water park is open!

The staff was very nice, but the pressure was a bit much. It was like buying a new car. We went in to buy a new bed in the $1200 range. Yeah that's not really possible, but I feel it should be. They don't have a huge selection and they really push the more expensive brands. We were shown a higher level model with an adjustable base. Let me be clear, it was a Labor Day sale with a "free adjustable base" . The base we were shown was a $2000 base, not free. We declined. They tried to negotiate the tier two base as long as we bought their $260 warranty. We declined. We stuck to the free base, mattress and delivery. After talking to friends, we realized we were tricked into a "platinum delivery" for $150. We didn't know we had options for delivery, even though we asked.

They are going downhill here. I got cold French Fries the other day and asked for fresh. Instead, the cook dropped them in the grease again!! I noted that on a survey and the manager gave me a free sandwich meal. When I came back I got cold fries. I asked for fresh hot ones and this time they were okay. Cook needs some re-training!!

Came here on a Thursday afternoon and did not have to wait for a table for 2. It was pretty busy but we were seated quickly near a window, which was nice. We were greeted promptly and the server was very friendly and knowledgeable about the menu. 

This was my second time eating here and the service and food on both trips was consistent. The server offered to let me try the turtle soup, which was very good. They add egg to this dish which gives it a great taste but I ultimately decided to order the seafood gumbo. I should have stuck with the turtle soup special, we felt like the gumbo was average at best. I've definitely had better. 

My boyfriend ordered the creole shrimp and alligator sausage and I ordered the combination dinner which came with, creole shrimp, Jambalaya and red beans and rice. The food cane with bread which I remember being really soft on my first visit but not so much this time. It was still good though. The creole shrimp were ok, shrimp was a little on the small side. I also prefer shrimp that is cooked in the shell, but that is just my personal preference and not always a popular one. 

All in all, I felt the food was decent and the service was good. Not sure if I would return though when there are so many other options in The French quarter.

May 26, 2021 approx 2:30. This day had to have been a bad day for this crew. It was not a shop friendly place. I've shopped here before and never had much of a problem other than a shortage for product shopped for. Though there was at least 5 or 6 workers on the floor, not one took the time to ask if I needed anything or if I was finding everything needed. After I tried searching for a particular product for a few minutes but decided to leave and shop somewhere else that would offer better customer service. Before leaving I asked for the manager and told her my concerns and lack of service. I left feeling as though she didn't give a hoot either. I'm sure if the manager is like this with most of Petco's customers, District needs to be made aware.

Would definitely recommend as a staple when visiting Nashville. Service was good, food was AMAZING. If you get the bone marrow, PLEASE do yourself a favor and get a luge with that bone marrow. I've had it with scotch - Laphroig 10 and it brought out a nice smokiness to it.

My early 2013 Macbook Pro Retina 13" shut down randomly a few weeks ago and wouldn't reboot. I tried resetting the SMC, holding the power button down for 10 seconds, etc but nothing. I feared the worst - fried logic board. This didn't seem possible since I replaced it back in July 2015 so it was relatively new, but I figured I should bring it to Springboard to get it diagnosed and see what could be done.

They open it up and point to a small stain on the metal housing of the thunderbolt ports, saying my machine has water damage and that I would need to pay full price for a new logic board (around $800) or buy a new machine. I find this a bit suspicious since I always babied my computer and NEVER spilled anything on or near it. I tell the customer service guy (I won't say his name because he was polite and I'm sure it was the "technician" in the back who told him it was water damage, so I won't kill the messenger) that I need to think about it because it's a huge expense.

I'm a web developer and have customized PCs before, so I decide to investigate on my own. Low and behold, no signs of water damage ANYWHERE. Yes there was a small stain on that one component, but all 10 of the liquid sensors found on the inside of the Macbook Pros were completely white. If liquid gets in, they turn pink or red. I decide to get a 2nd opinion at the Apple Store in KOP. They confirm it does not appear to be water damage, so they send it to their repair center for further investigation.  They said that if it's in fact not water damage, Apple charges a flat fee of $280 for any out-of-warranty repairs - logic boards included. 

I'm extremely relieved to say that Apple called me today and said there was no water damage but they did need to replace the logic board and heat sink. That's okay though because I'm only paying $280 instead of $800 which Springboard quoted me.

Moral of the story - always get a 2nd opinion and don't believe them when they jump right to the water damage excuse unless you actually did spill something on your device.  Apple and their certified retailers want you to think ONLY THEY can confirm these things, but if you know how to do a Google search and follow a tutorial (ifixit.com is great) it's not so hard to open up a Macbook and find out the truth. I just feel bad for the less tech-savvy customers that end up unnecessarily paying astronomical amounts for repairs.

And a word of advice to Springboard Media - ACTUALLY TROUBLESHOOT instead of quickly resorting to the water damage excuse. For us customers who are out-of-warranty and no longer have AppleCare, these are huge expenses. You should be doing everything in your power to find out the root cause of the issue to determine whether a full-price repair is in fact needed or not. 

I hope this helps someone.

For me, IMS is my happy place and what gets me through Indiana winters. Just hearing the cars is enough to make me smile!  I enjoy sitting in the warm sunshine incased by the excitement and sounds of IMS with the full race crowd experience while appreciating these incredible race cars, teams and drivers. Pit and Garage Passes can be purchased for the month of May (while they last) with or without your race tickets or separately for practice, poll, carb or race day. Contact IMS ticket office to expedite the process prior to your visit. This year was exceptional from practice days, poll day, and carb day with Indy 500 history being made with two record breaking events for the fans to experience and say I WAS THERE! So exciting!!

Information you need to know prior to leaving for the track:

1) Heavy traffic and street barricades so leave a couple hours early,
2) KNOW which IMS lot, private parking lot or private home's yard parking you choose is CLOSEST to your seats to reduce the amount of walking. The Coke field is enormous and can be a couple miles walk to turn 1 and turn 2. Other parking closer for these seats.
 3) Wear comfortable shoes and clothing,
 4) 14" OR SMALLER COOLER size allowed and ENFORCED NOW,
 5) GLASS of any kind is NOT allowed and
6) BE PREPARED for your cooler and backpack/purse to be searched so pack accordingly. 
7) Want to avoid driving home after Carb day or on Race morning? Camping is offered for 1-4 days. RV, Campers, Tents, or sleeping in your car or truck is available in IMS lots off of Georgetown Road, 25th Street, 30th Street, 16th Street or in private homes' yards and lots surrounding IMS. Call IMS for lot details. The VFW, on Georgetown Road, offers camping and parking plus located directly across the street from IMS. Indy Go Buses, cabs, limo's and hotel transportation is available as well for those avoiding driving and camping isn't your thing. Bicycles must be locked to the fence at this time.

I feel great pride acknowledging all the fame and history IMS brings to Indianapolis and future she offers. The Indy 500 is my favorite event but I'm so glad we have two other amazing races. I love seeing the track used as often as possible throughout the year from numerous fund raisers to Good Guys Speedway Nationals. Hopefully, with IMS's requested funding, we'll have lights installed and a night race to follow. Thank you IMS for this amazing facility and all you do to keep her alive and well. The continuous updates and financial commitment you expend for these sacred grounds are appreciated and noticed.

Each event throughout May brings different experiences. Yes, race cars for all but from practice, poll day, carb day to the actual race, all offer a different perspective of the track, cars and fans. Practice days allow for more freedom of movement within the stands whereas Race Day you have your assigned seat with your cooler underneath. Occasionally, empty seats allow folks to spread out more.

The Museum is a must see from the cars to the trophies. Seeing the track from the tour bus or the Andretti Indy Car will give you a true perspective of her size. Fan Appreciation Day, which is usually the Wednesday before the Indy 500, offers visitors the opportunity to drive their personal vehicle on the track for a small fee. The Dallara IndyCar Factory on Main Street, Speedway, offers factory tours, a Past, Present & Future movie telling the story of IndyCar, racing simulators and the opportunity to ride in the Street Legal Two Seater Indy Car. Check out Main Street Speedway's facelift with the addition of Dallara, new restaurants, coffee/tea, gelato, and frozen yogurt shops plus shopping within walking distance of IMS.

Join the 300,000 plus yearly Indy 500 race fans who love this experience. You'll soon see why we return year after year.

Should you be in need of a new cowboy get up this is the place to come. They have everything to make a cowboy or cowgirl look like a million bucks!

I know with the Reno Rodeo just around the corner you all will surly be planning what to wear and since I'm a Texan imported to Reno I qualify myself as an expert on all things country and have decided to come up with a list of items you will need for the rodeo, and what is acceptable attire.

First of all let me make it clear that you will get beat up by the real cowboys at the rodeo if you wear silver tipped boots, if you wear spurs or chaps as a fashion statement, a bolo tie, fake leather boots from WalMart,  feathers in your hat, or if you walk around pretending to be bowlegged, and saying "YA'LL" "HOWDY" of "FIX'IN TO" at the wrong time. Actually just dont say those things at all or suddenly develop an accent, you'll just get beat up!
