Fellas you will need a pair of the tightest Wranglers you can safely squeeze yourself into. Its even better if they have first been heavily starched with a crease, and even if you dont dip, its considered a fashion statement if you carry a can of Copenhagen in your back pocket. Just dont go around spitting its not at all attractive.

Next you'll need some type of flashy shirt, they are easy to find here at Sheplers, preferably with fancy silver snaps. TUCK THE SHIRT IN so that you can show off your belt - that has your name on the back, and get a LARGE belt buckle with the image of a cowboy riding a bull, or roping a cow - something along those lines and of course make up a story  of how you WON that buckle "back when you used to rodeo" it will impress everyone..... and win you favor with the ladies.

Next you'll need a pair of boots, now this is one of the most important parts of your get up..... boots you'll want them to be genuine leather, or else some kind of animal hid. snake, alligator, the more exotic and expensive the boots the higher rank you'll favor with the others.

Most important is your cowboy hat. Choose wisely my friend. The best is a Stetson and be sure and get it blocked and shaped so you dont look like everyone else, your hat should be unique and you should form some type of bond with your hat, its not just a fashion statement it is a part of who you are, so let the hat pick you, and then love it with all your heart. 

Ladies, you'll want to also find tight jeans, it dont matter how much you weight there will be a pair of jeans you can squeeze and stuff yourself into, just dont let your fat belly roll, hang out over the top of your jeans stuff it in there good! Keep in mind tight jeans usually cause a raging yeast infection so be prepared for that.

You'll want to find a shirt that makes a statement and shows off your assets... but dont scare the livestock at the rodeo so keep it as simple and elegant if possible. You can never go wrong with a fringed shirt.  Boots are also required for you ladies so go with something simple. I suggest a pair of Justin Ropers - they have every color imaginable so pick a pair that matches your shirt.

To the ladies and men..... DO NOT...... I REPEAT DO NOT TUCK YOUR JEANS INTO YOUR BOOTS AND MAKE SURE YOUR PANTS ARE AN EXTRA INCH LONG SO IT COMES DOWN ON THE BOOT THE RIGHT WAY!!!

Ladies you do not need a cowboy hat, because you will want to fix your hair as BIG as possible and a hat will hinder this effort so skip the hat. Big earrings are a plus try finding boot shaped ones or anything western looking. 

Ok so I hope this helps all you wanna-be Cowboys and Cowgirls 

I'll see ya'll at the rodeo!


p.s. I will be posting step by step advice for those who will be attempting to country dance soon!

Everything about our experience was positive... except the actual food

Pros - "can't beat" prices, awesome salsa, good service, and good menu variety
Cons - very average Mexican food (did not enjoy the red enchilada sauce on my chicken enchilada, "vegetarian potato enchilada" option was literally just mashed potatoes in a tortilla shell with queso on top... yuck!)

This place is so overpriced for the quality of food. First off, I ordered a drink which didn't come until after my meal was served...bad service. Secondly, my entree of the veggie eggplant curry was NOT a thai curry dish. There was no sauce, nothing that would make it a curry that you put over rice. Instead, it was a pot full of ok tasting veggies. My friend's drunken noodles were more of a veggie/chicken dish than a noodle dish. Only 1/4 of the dish was noddles, so if you wanted a noodle dish, this is not it. There are most definitely better thai places in NOLA that do not have these prices. Atmosphere was very cool, but the place was SO loud due to the warehouse-ness (they need curtains and drapes to absorb the sound).
Perfect breakfast spot, lunch, or grabbing a treat and coffee!  The girls here are super awesome.  The food is earthy and warm.  Maura runs a great shop!
We decided to try this place based on the reviews. We had a little bit of wait, but it was worth it. They have an awesome selection of cakes and pies as well.

Called two days ago about there all you can eat crabs,the man says,dungeness crab 24.95.great we will be there! Get there,snow crab at 27.99.we ate off of newspaper and the girls bathroom had puke in the sink that they did nothing about.crabs where good,but then they put a 20% gratuity on the bill!! We weren't eating at Ruth Chris steak house !!
The food is just ok but I love them for outside seating and a drink at lunch. I do enjoy their enchiladas suizas.
Ruth Chris used to be one of our favorite steak spots in Tampa but they seem to have changed. The last time we went and got steak it just wasn't the same. It was missing flavor and juiciness.

Just threw my BFF the fanciest bridal shower in the history of bridal showers, in the Mist Pavilion on the rooftop of Hotel Monaco. The bride to be was thrilled with the atmosphere and of course, spending an evening with 35 of her closest friends and family.

The event and catering staff was a pleasure to work with to plan the event, and the service staff during the event promptly brought out tasty passed hd's, girly drinks, and cut and served our cake perfectly. Pricing wise, we came in under budget and the quality of the food and drinks was well worth it. I would highly recommend checking out the rooftop's private rooms for your next event!

BEST BREAKFAST IN NEW ORLEANS! My mom and I came here for a weekend and stayed nearby; when we stumbled upon this place we couldn't believe our luck. We came back for all four mornings we were here and tried something new each time. The pastries, waffles, crepes and eggs are divine and easily the best breakfast I've ever had in my life. 

These people KNOW how to cook!!
Yum, cozy, convenient, pitchers of tea, great decor inside, outdoor patio as well. I love Fair Grinds.

The amount of food that that you get from 1 order is outstanding! This cute little breakfast place is eco friendly in which I love. Prompt seating and the waitress was very attentive. French toast is delicious & the pancakes had the right amount of sweetness. My daughter and I are looking forward to returning soon.

Eh, that's about it. Over flavored, over salted, artificial food with LOADS of salt and sugar. Fried and greasy and overall not good. The corn on the cob and the Mac n cheese are atrocious, I couldn't feed it to my kid as all I could taste was gallons of fake nasty butter. Gave this place a few tries and will not be going back. Looking forward to a turn around, and fast. Save your body the trouble, and go around the back to Jules Pizza or Curds and Whey.

We went on a sea-cave kayaking trip on the Channel Islands and it was AMAZING and well worth the money. The online tips were really helpful with what to bring for the day. 

We met our guide, Kenji, at the dock for the ferry out. The ride our was great - saw a pod of killer whales, and the ferry staff would stop and make announcements about cool things to look at. Really a very fun and informative ride (if a bit early!). Plus you can buy hot food and drinks on board. 

When we got to the island, another couple realized that their tour guide (from another company) never showed! Kenji was so nice, called SBAC and had them join us so as to not miss out on their day! Kenji was just so nice and informative - very friendly and helpful. SDAC had wetsuits in every size, and the gear was all clean and in great shape. They locked all our stuff away while we were out. Kenji is clearly a hard worker and did just an amazing job telling us all about the island - history, wildlife, and especially lots of cool info about the birds and sea life. He is clearly passionate about the area and really has a wealth of information. It was SO great! I learned so, so much. 

He was also a fantastic kayaking leader - we paddled a substantial distance over the course of several hours, but frequent stops to check things out, and plenty of caves meant that it went by quickly and felt like nothing! He was also very careful with safety: we did go through several caves and tunnels - scary and fun!! - but as the tides got higher he was sure to only allow those caves that were safe. In addition he made sure that we didn't disturb any of the nesting birds (spring time). 

It was just a PERFECT day! Adventure, nature, gorgeous turquoise water! We saw: killer whales, dolphins within a few yards of us, seals within feet, tons of colorful urchins and starfish, and the most amazing birds. Highly, highly recommend this tour and Kenji! He was awesome, and made the day even better :) Not to mention the islands are amazing, and after your kayaking you can hike around or check out the museum and historic buildings. 

tip: buy a cheap waterproof disposable camera if you want pictures of the day - EVERYTHING on the kayak gets soaked!
Had amazing charbroiled oysters. Would definitely visit again. The wait was around 25mins at peak lunchtime. Wait staff was okay.. I had to ask a few times for a refill on my drink

This staff and manager (possibly owner) were extremely rude and unprofessional. My friends order was incorrect and nothing was done to correct it. In fact they even attacked her in front of other customers claiming she was wrong. My friend is super quiet and nice and this was the first time she's ever complained about her food in public. 

Not only did they attack her and try to say she was lying but they went ahead and charged her for the item anyways. 
I've worked as a server for a decade and have never ever seen a situation handled this way in my career. Absolutely disgusting behavior by a manager (possibly owner) They should be embarrassed.

1st and last visit. We were looking for a kitschy, non-chain, diner. The parking lot was crowded with antique cars, a band was playing, lots of people. So far so good. It was all downhill after we walked in the door. Many items on the menu, not available (shakes, malts, hot dogs), dining area old and dirty. Not antique or nostalgic just old. Waited 50 minute for two hamburgers, clearly frozen and not what we ordered. Staff arguing and shouting at each other in the kitchen practically non stop.  Very unpleasant experience.

Still great food and I love the pizza and pasta dishes however if you order from EAT24 know that if you ever order condiments like Parma cheese, utensils, paper plates, napkins etc. it will never come you ask over and over and they never include it and at that point I'm so hungry I never bother. So if I have guests over I have to pull out all my stuff to serve I don't know how to get the stuff I request other than that the food is great.

This is our current go-to super market, mostly because of geographic convenience and I like their all-natural section.  I never had to get help from anyone other than in produce and my experience was great. 

I know some of their cashiers from over the years and they are always friendly.

Also, as far as grocery store baked goods go, this place is better than most.

I was surprised when I got such a huge bahn mi for such a good price...until I tasted it. It's what I imagine Jimmy John's take on a bahn mi would be. Which is disappointing, because the service was phenomenal.
Great time on NYE at the rooftop bar. Geoff is the manager has an excellent staff. Heather waiting on us, and she did a great job. We will definitely return. Highly recommend it while in NOLA.

Just spoke to the most unprofessional and cocky person in business i have ever spoken to..cant believe he told me  about being in business for 27 years with that attitude ..on to the next one...................

My pedicure was enjoyable! The woman at the front was accommodating and fit me in for a walk-in appointment. The owner truly cares about his business and is very caring. I expressed that i was unhappy with a service. he asked to take a look at what caused my dissatisfaction while also documenting it to show his staff and fixing the problem. I respect the pride he takes in his business.

I came to Flammer on the advice of a neighbor who was very happy with a purchase of a Ford Escape. My salesperson was Tom Sfero. I needed a car quickly to replace a leased vehicle that my ex-husband had returned to the dealership. I was shown two used vehicles, one of which I ended up purchasing. I was extremely happy with the car, the options and the price and chose to buy the enhanced service plan which I would highly recommend. I recently referred a disabled neighbor to Flammer. We went to the dealership and he was shown exactly the type of vehicle he would need to adapt to his new motorized wheelchair. We both appreciated Tom's professional low-key approach. The service and parts team is wonderful with great communication.  Would highly highly recommend.

I decided to try this place as they are located right near my house.  Having just moved to Edmonton, I wasn't sure what to expect.  While I was impressed that the stylist sits with you first and discusses what you would like to do with your hair, I still managed to get a terrible hair cut.  I asked for something more natural looking, not too severe, as I am trying to grow my hair out from a shoulder-length bob.  Instead, I got ridiculously short layers on the front and sides of my hear and barely a trim at the back.  I didn't think I was asking for too complicated of a cut, which is why I would never recommend this place.  Now, I'll just have to spend even more time growing out my new mullet.

I expected better bagels with the decent reviews but I was disappointed. We went on a Friday morning before 8 and there was only a few people but the wait was ridiculous - and they were out of coffee so we had to wait on that as well. The staff was not rude but they were not friendly at all. I won't go back.

This is the best Fairfield in the country. As a business traveler I depend on these solid Marriott family hotels and this one is great. Nice rooftop bar with a solid menu and nice drink list. Close walking to some of the city's best dining and people watching.

Convenient location in Metairie. Service can be disorganized and slow. Some menu items are better than others. The 5 course meal is your best bet for your money. Restaurant can be so loud at times. Atmosphere feels dingy and old.

I'm not a member of the group of regulars that can be found here throughout the day, but CBs has always been a reliable place to go for a greasy spoon breakfast to either survive a long day at the track or shake the hangover that resulted from a long day at the track.

This place provides a small-town diner atmosphere and is covered in race memorabilia that pays tribute to the town's namesake. The staff is welcoming, and they are happy to either let you take your time catching up with friends or work hard to get out in a hurry if you are short on time.

The menu has a wide variety of options, including plenty of heart-stopping amalgamations of breakfast items that are both delicious and guilt-inducing.

There's really not much more I could ask for from a place like this. Fun atmosphere, great service, and tasty food at a reasonable price. This will continue to be one of my regular stops on race weekends.
Rob did an amazing job! The food is amazing no matter what you order. Rob was funny and talented. Very relatable and made some amazing food. Thanks Ichiban, keep up the good work!
Good old Busch Gardens! Amazing safari and very cool rides. I have off and on been a season pass holder for 10 years or more and would recommend everyone visit this place at least once.

This place is a solid 3, maybe closer to a 4, as far as buffets go. 

I have been here a few times and have always enjoyed everything. First, this place is huge. Largest buffet I've ever seen. They have a sushi buffet, a grilled Asian style meat buffet in the back and a make your own rice or noodle dish in the back as well. You take a plate and pile on all the rice, noodles, veggies and meats you'd like then hand it over to the hibachi guy and he cooks it all for you. You can add in garlic, hot pepper or teriyaki sauce. This is the best part to me, perfect for vegetarians and meat lovers alike. 

They have everything from fresh fruit to ham, salad to calamari along with items you'd find on a Chinese take out place's menu. They even have stuff like Mac and cheese for kids...or for kids at heart. 

The food is average buffet quality but the sushi and hibachi grill really are the stars, here and are better quality than their other food. 

Dinner is $9.99 per person but there is usually a coupon for a few dollars off in the valpak mailers. 

If you're a fan of buffets or just feeling very hungry, give this place a try. 

Did I mention they have a huge fish pond inside? Well, they do! And for a mere $.50 you get fish food to feed them. Still not sure how I feel about this, but, I'll be back!

My wife and I were in the market for a recliner chair. We shopped all of the local furniture stores, checking out our options. While we did not purchase from this store, we wanted to express our appreciation to Oscar Haugabook, the salesman that assisted us while we were in the store. Oscar was very helpful and assisted in showing us our options. If you're ever considering Havertys Furniture, give Oscar a call at the store! You'll be glad you did!

For over 15 years, I have dealt with Discount Tire stores, Traders Point, Castleton, and the new store on North Keystome.  All my tires come from them due to their customer service and the courtesy they have always offered me.  Specially the one on North Keystone. 

Today I was on the west side and needed a few pounds of air in one of my front tires. I pulled up at this store. Almost 6 feet from their air station and hose. I asked the man at the overhead door to please add a few pounds of air to my right front time. It was at 27 PSI and wanted it to be 30. The man said to park my car and they will get to me later. I said sir it just takes 30 seconds to add a few pounds of air to the tire in front of you. Help me out. 

He said he has to get the manager. The manager, Ryan comes over for quite a few minutes explaining to me that  I need park my car then they get to because there are six people ahead of me. I told him that I finding it frustrating that you are spending a few minutes taking to me instead of reaching to the air hose snd spend 30 seconds to get me going. 

Poor judgement on his side I felt.

I am SO EXCITED!   THRILLED is another word that can be used.  Pretty much ECSTATIC.  Much like Chris Matthews when he saw our ex POTUS,  there is a THRILL running down my leg.   Why might you ask?  It's simple: On Saturday a [competitor] (it appears they flag certain words here and that competitors name appears to be one) will be here to install phone and internet and I will FOREVER be rid of having to deal with the most amateur hour telecommunications company I have ever had the displeasure of dealing with... CenturyLink.  Leaving an 11 year customer (multiple services mind you!), who does his business out of his home office exclusively, high and dry with NO PHONE and NO INTERNET SERVICE what so ever for 6 full days... all the while LYING to about when the tech would be out on three separate occasions... has demonstrated the fact that CenturyLink does not care about it's customers,  and with amazing clarity.  That is 11 years down the drain.  I hope it was worth it... but somehow,  I don't think anyone there gives a damn.

This Walmart is home to the slowest, most incompetent, rude people I have ever witnessed. Be prepared to wait because the cashiers are more interested in txting or talking to friends than customer service.

We went at lunch on a weekday. Because the traffic was light, the chef was able to spend time coaching us through the menu and options. My husband loves any sushi, but thought this was especially good. I don't eat raw fish, but there were many options for me, and the veggie lunch special was very good (and huge and very reasonably priced). The women at the next table said they loved the other locations and this one lived up to their expectations.

Cute little restaurant. Great service. Clean and great food. The breakfast was a decent portion size. Parking right in front. They make a lot of their baked goods/breads in house. 

Would recommend to others who are nearby!

Service was good.  Pizza was fine.  We didn't get a wood oven 10" because we needed to feed too many people.  The pizza tastes better heated up the next two days than fresh. They need tray racks to put on the table to elevate the pie and not squish everyone and everything.

Service on point. Too much expensive meat for someone who is not really into red meat, I do partake it's not my go to. Today since it's their specialty I did but also found a lot of amazing veggie options. Mixed Root veggies yay! Oh I love left overs & we both had lunch today. Yeah not everyone's into that but it definitely makes my dollars go further + Enjoy *2 WIN.
Mad mex is just a bad Mexican food chain! Was hoping it would be better! I was left very disappointed ....
Talk about a find.  The raviloi and pizza blew us away.   Nice family hang out.

This was an unexpected treat!  Friendly, enthusiastic, attentive service. 
Great menu with a variety of dogs, burgers, arepas, chicken sandwich, fries and assorted beverages. 
The chicken sandwich was fantastic and puts any of the chain chicken sandwiches to shame. 
The fries were crispy and fresh out of the fryer. 
Looking forward to trying some of their hotdogs. 
Don't miss three beer Sunday!

best mexican fast food ever. 
i miss this place. 
i recommend the veggie burrito.
Not sure they are still open. The phone number listed is disconnected and went by Saturday afternoon and they were closed.
Delicious!!! Wonderful experience, great service, great drinks and delicious food! Excellent
Looking forward to coming here soon

Went with a buddy on Friday after work for a quick bite. Wow, has this place changed since it was Martini's.

Awesome modern vibe and what looks like a great menu. I quite enjoyed my Chicken and Waffles. My buddy thought his Fish 'n Chips was pretty average but, what does he know,...he's an electrician.

I don't have a clue what the late-night scene is like in the room but I really enjoyed my dinner experience and would go back in a pinch; next time with a more feminine companion (I hope).

I don't know WHAT was going on in the restaurant on Tuesday evening.  I ordered the Jesse's special without bread, escargot, and chicken fingers.  I arrived to the restaurant and they had me go to the bar.  The first thing I saw was the server picking up olives with his bare fingers, picking up the little swords, and putting it into a customer's drink.  There were little fruit flies buzzing around the garnishes.  I got my food and drove the 2.5 miles home.  When I got home, my escargot needed to be reheated.  I opened the box with the chicken tenders...the box was full of greasy, the tenders were burnt.  The sauces were honey mustard and??cocktail  sauce?  OK.   After that, I couldn't/wouldnt eat my chopped steak.  If the open area of the bar was that gross, what did the kitchen look like.  I won't be going back,  I don't want food poisoning/bacteria from someone putting grubby fingers in the garnishes when he has touched trays, food plates, dirty plates, silverware, money, credit cards, meal tickets, and anything else in the restaurant that wasn't clean.

We were heading back to SF from SB and yelped this place. It was, in a word, PERFECT for breakfast. Great vibe, good music playing on the outdoor sound system, and, most important, great food. I had French toast with bananas and strawberries with basil whipped cream and real maple syrup.  Husband had In-Yo-Face salmon with a poached egg and fried capers, red onion, and dill creme fraiche. Oh, and we ordered a side of bacon which was cooked to perfection and delicious; it came with honey drizzled over it which I didn't particularly want but could deal with. The outdoor tables are separated from the street by a hedge, which I liked because it made the space seem a little more private and blocked the exhaust fumes. Also, great coffee. Added attraction: across the street is a used car dealer that sells mostly vintage high-end and/or obscure cars (Bentley, Rolls Royce, Porsche 911, Morris Minor woody, etc.) and the owner was super friendly and knowledgeable.  If I'm ever in SB again I will definitely return here for breakfast.
The service was very good. However the food was not very good. It was cold and it is very spicy. I ordered the jambalaya risotto and it was tasty but cold.

Mesh is like an *NSYNC album: There's a little something for everybody here.

"You're tearing up my heart when I'm with you..."

"I drive myself crazy thinking of you..."

Whether you want uptempo dance track or a mid tempo romantic song, *NSYNC could offer that to you. And whether you want a light lunch or a boozy brunch, Mesh can offer that to you. 

"Just got paid...Friday night..."

"Till the day my life is through, this I promise you..."

Whether you want an urban hip hop feel or a schmaltzy saccharine ballad, *NSYNC will have a track for you. Are you in the mood for a fresh salad or a sizzling steak, Mesh will have a dish for you.

"Dirty pop..."

"Gone...gone...gone..."

Play an *NSYNC album for a lady, and you will be put in the friend zone. Take a lady to Mesh, and maybe you will escape the friend zone. 

And yes, this review is a super dated pop culture reference. 

Maybe next time I should write about the Kardashians?

Nope. Not gonna happen.
Great manager. Good selection of bikes and brands. Would definitely purchase another bike from here!

I can't even express how amazing this place was as a whole! Let's start with the most important, the service! Sam and Matt were not only friendly and attentive they were fun and what made the whole experience! Our orders were brought out in a timely matter, we were checked on and dishes cleared appropriately and honestly I could have stayed after closing and hung out with them they were just that great! They recommended inside favorites and staff secrets! Next... drinks, from beer to cocktails we tried it all and boy could we have had more! Food came out fast and hot and cooked to perfection! The flavors were amazingly delicious! We're from out of town but felt so welcome and I can tell you we'll be back again and recommending Hollister to all our friends! Sam... Mattt.... you guys are the best! Thank you so much! As for everyone else, go grab a beer/cocktail and some food. You won't be disappointed!

Best trails for hiking with beautiful views! We make sure to visit Castlewood every season to really enjoy each seasons beauty! You won't find better walking trails in West County! Castlewood is a must!

Maybe it's because I'm not a kid anymore but this place doesn't seem to be what it once was. They have pretty much any toy you can imagine, which is good considering the name. Which is really what earns the stars. The store does its job, nothing spectacular though.  Customer service is always mediocre and store just seems old, dingy and dated. On the plus side the store is very well organized and it's easy to find things. Located near the Westfield mall so parking and traffic gets really rough on weekends and holidays.

Only had a snack and a cocktail here but loved, loved, loved it!

We ordered three different drinks off of their cocktail list and were impressed by the high quality ingredients, unique concoctions and variety. 

I ordered the "Root of all Evil," which called for fresh orange juice. I was floored when I saw the bartender grab an orange, juice it and pour my drink. Let me tell you something, I drink A LOT and I never see anything THAT fresh going into my cocktails. The root liquor, which makes the drink taste like root beer, is an uncommon poison to stock on bar shelves but I liked it!

We also ordered the brisket sliders, which were FANTASTIC! I'd like to go back and order a full appetizer for myself. We shared the three sliders and we were three ladies, which means I did not get enough! Based on the quality of the sliders and the yumminess of the BBQ sauce, they probably have an awesome menu. 

The bartender, whose name escapes me, was awesome too. She listed out some local spots for us (we're from DC) and was friendly yet super professional. 

I'd definitely go back. When I think back, Smokin' Betty's stands out from the many establishments we visited throughout the weekend. And, let me tell you something, we visited A LOT of watering holes!

This was one of the only places that we could find on a Saturday night that didn't have a 1 hour+ wait.  The food was good...I don't know why, but hey, I'll take it!  I don't remember specifics about most of the food I had, except that the soup I had - I believe it was mushroom or asparagus soup - was really great.  I'm not from Philly, was there on business, so I likely won't return, but it's not because of the food or the service.  Great place!
Great breakfast spot. Friendly waitstaff. Good food. I had spinach quiche that came with a bowl of fresh fruit salad and a delicious muffin. Best cup of tea! I would recommend to anyone.
Pricey but worth it. Great salad bar. The meat and sides are awesome. We did find ourselves getting "meated" out but the taste was great. Complimentary 5 layer chocolate bday cake that was awesome!

Great food!!  I had the mixed veg pakora as well as the okra curry and garlic naan. All of it was delicious. I did think that their mint chutney tasted a little bit off. I don't know why but it tasted like banana blended with cilantro. Regardless the rest of my food was great and I will definitely order again because one of the attractions to this restaurant in particular is the Dhabba which my coworker told me was used in Punjabi mostly for truck stops and highways. They specialize in serving local fare and comfort food. The food was definitely comforting. I will absolutely order from them again.

My first visit here was great. The menu was vast and had a lot to chose from. The entrees and appetizers are described in Spanish but our waitress was excellent and explained them perfectly. The chips and salsa were fresh and delicious. The  taco puffs were packed with cheese, meat, tomatoes and were almost too large for me to hold on to.  I tried the the chicken and the beef. The chicken was AMAZING! My wife tried Francisco's Nachos. These were NOT typical nachos. They were large, packed with steak, cheese, onions, and came with lettuce, sour cream and fresh quac on the side! She took 1/2 of this home, too much for one sitting.

 We tried the margaritas without warning. WHOA, were we delighted. From the first, sip, my wife says "OMG, this is good." We compared the drink to La Salsa's and Friday's Margaritas. This was not your typical frozen, over-sweetened, slushy drink. It was clearly the BEST margarita we ever tasted. It was strong with a good, pure, and original. We both sipped them slow for fear of being under the table.

For dessert we tried the Chongas. It's a fried strawberry cheesecake with some type of mango sauce that is spread over the plate. I am not a cheesecake fan but this dish was splendid times 100!  It was light, extremely tasty, and left me wishing for more. My wife tried a piece and here eyes rolled to the back of her head with sheer delight. It comes in two pieces, and two spoons, so it's meant for sharing! 

I did read the reviews, after leaving the place. It appears that they have  been through a complete overhaul. The service was great, the food was delicious, the ambiance is good and that drink was the BOMB! I would give it 6 stars if I could! We just joked about going back tonight for a 2nd visit.
We selected this restaurant by chance, and were not disappointed. The portions were large, the staff was great, and our wait time; even on a busy Sunday, was short. We highly recommend this place.

Horrible agency to work with. Thankfully there are several employment solutions in the area. The owner was rude and treated the office employees extremely rude in front of clients. I can only imagine how she treats her staff behind doors. The workers she would send to us, didn't show up for work more than 75% of the time. I would highly recommend the owner learn to train her staffing agents on the basics of interviewing, rather than looking for bodies who can pass a drug test. Not to mention a training on how to create a positive and uplifting culture in the work place. As a woman myself it was really sad to see the owner talking down to her staff of women. I could literally hear her yelling and cursing at the staff. I will never go back Express ever and would recommend no else does either.

Great Bloody Mary.  Truly.  The food was good, definitely a solid 3 star experience.  The Bloody Mary scored this place an extra star.

The place is cute and trendy.  The crowd is middle aged and casual to nice attire.  The bar area has live music, it was jazz when we were there.  This would be a nice place for an evening out with the spouse or maybe a first date.  Moderately priced, romantic enough without being over the top, and the wait staff was lovely. 

We had tapas, not dinners.  The  Ahi was pretty good.  The tapas were so heavy that we had no room for dinner and actually left in a little pain, bellies full with food-babies.

I LOVE these pancakes, they are so good I don't even need syrup (although the special syrup that comes with these is also fantastic). They kind of taste like banana bread but without the banana flavor, I know that doesn't make much sense so you'll have to try it for yourself! I went on Tuesday at 9:30 and there was no line!
Very good! my son and I both had a cheese slice. I had the house salad with their homemad Italian dressing as well. Both the slice and the salad were huge!  Very tastey!
Awesome beer selection.  Every time I've been a there's been a good crowd.  Zack is a great bartender (if he's still there).

This place has very good sashimi compared to a couple of other restaurants in the area which was a pleasant surprise as an out of town traveler.  The broth for Udon was very savory which is hard to find as most of us Udon lovers know.  I would come back here again next time I'm in town.

Came here before seeing a show at the Pitman theater. Place was packed and so loud you could hardly hear yourself speak. They definitely need some kind of sound barriers. Our waitress was friendly but seemed over whelmed. We ordered three appetizers which were delicious but definitely small portions and really not big enough to share. We then waited a half hour for our meals to come! We were getting nervous we may miss our show however our waitress was very apologetic and gave us a coupon to use which was appreciated. Everyone enjoyed their meals but for the price we felt the portions were small and were disappointed our dishes didn't come with a soup or salad like most Italian restaurants do.
Incredibly slow service. It took over 20 minutes to receive my order of toast, topped with an already made sauce. There was only one order ahead of mine...Also, a little pricey.

We have a 70 year old gas floor heater that stopped working a couple of years ago. I had given up on trying to find someone to repair it so we started using the heat strips in our A/C unit. As a result, our electric bills were higher in the winter than they were in the summer! I finally checked the name of the manufacturer of the gas heater and found out that they are still in business. I called them up and they referred me to Blair's. Scott came out to look at it and told us that he could fix it. He ordered the parts and came back out and had it working in a couple of hours. He really knows his stuff and was very polite and explained to us exactly why it wasn't working and what he did to repair it. Excellent service!

We have been going to this establishment long before they relocated to Lower Makefield and have never been disappointed. Food has always been phenomenal whether it's in the restaurant or take out. Owners are some of the finest people I have had the pleasure of knowing, staff are attentive and professional. If there's anything negative I could state it would be toward the township and not toward the restaurant. Let them deliver !

Great service the food was amazing. We were staying in Madeira beach and this was well worth the drive. Dont be off-put by the esthetic of a sushi joint in a run down strip center. This place is top notch! We were in town when the stone crab was in season and I recommend that highly if you are there when they have it!

Just ok for me.  Food is kinda inconsistent and the quantity and quality to the price is not really in alignment.  Sometimes the service was excellent others it was just so so.  I'd go back but I know what to expect and there are still items I'd try on the menu.

Elizabeth did my first Brazilian ever.. and let me just say: WHAT A RELIEF! She was quick and professional. She kept me comfortable the entire time even though I was very squirmy! I also let her take over my brows and she has created such a masterpiece I will not ever let someone else wax them...ever again. 5 stars for Wax Nola and Elizabeth Carr!

Such poor customer service.   I arrived 15 minutes before closing as was told to wait outside, on a cold rainy night for my ride to show up.  They refused to do a walk around inspection with my, and told me to drop my keys in the overnight bin.  I realized I had left my sunglasses in the car, and when I called the next morning, moments after they opened, they tell me they were not in the car.  A month after returning the car, a charge shows up on my credit card, and when I called to ask, they could not explain why.   My experiences with other rental companies was much better in the past, and I will be sure to not rent with them again.

WOW!  The Dublin location is where we ordered from... WOW!  So fresh & delicious!  We ordered tocos, chalupas, burrito, quesadillas, chips & guac .  Everything was so fresh & delicious!  Will definitely be ordering takeout again!  So glad to have this restaurant in our neighborhood!
Renee and Lauren are so amazing, they saved my eyelashes!  I would go here any day of the week and twice on Sunday. Such great value!

Finally got around to trying this Sabrina's Cafe. When I heard other yelpers say Sabrina's Cafe is better than green eggs cafe I knew I had to try it. Upon enter Sabrina's Cafe I immediately notice the crowd of people waiting. Which is annoying but a sign of good food. We were told 45 mins, but only waited about 25 mins. I had the famous challah French toast with is stuffed with cream cheese. My girlfriend had fried eggs turkey bacon, home fries and a side of fruit. Everything was excellent. The food taste as good as it looks. The portions are fantastic for the price. In fact almost everyone leaves with a doggy bag. The service is surprising fast considering the quality of the food and the crowd. My only complaint which is the same complaint i had for green eggs cafe is the tight seating. All in all I don't find Sabrina's Cafe to be better or worst than Green eggs cafe. To me they're about dead even. Deciding on which cafe to go to would depend more on which one i was closes to or if one provided a certain dish that the other did not have, than overall quality of food. Any fan of breakfast or brunch shoud take a trip to Sabrina's Cafe.

I've been going here since the week it opened about 10 years ago, for good reason. The atmosphere is incredibly inviting and perfect to enjoy time with company. The ice cream is in a class of its own with countless options for the creative connoisseur. They also make great coffee and tasty treats.

Ocean Prime is one of my favorite restaurants in Tampa.  It is consistently excellent. And, unlike some of their competitor restaurants which are big dark boxes (i.e., no windows), Ocean Prime is light and airy.  We've frequented this restaurant over many years and have always sat in the main area (I always prefer to sit in the main area of a restaurant as I enjoy watching the scene) but on Friday evening we were seated in a side room (The Bayshore Room).  When the hostess started walking us to the other side of the restaurant, I was afraid I wouldn't like the table and would have to fight to get into the main dining room.  As it turned out, the room was very nice and quiet; it was also filled to capacity so I didn't feel as if we were "in isolation."  The hostess sensed our concern and immediately said she could seat us in the main dining room if that was our preference but we decided to stay in the side dining room and had a lovely experience. Our server ( his name was Tyler) was a true professional and we got excellent service.
My only gripe with the restaurant (and the entire chain of Ocean Prime restaurants) is that they SHOULD have a dress code and enforce it.  The restaurant is deserving of clients who are dressed appropriately (NO tee shirts, sweatshirts, flip flops, shorts, baseball caps, etc.).  My husband and I always dress nicely for this restaurant and it leaves something to be desired when the table next to you is dressed like they should be eating at McDonalds.

Shaya is truly a gem. Here's an item specific rating of each dish we ordered:
Butter beans Hummus - 5 stars (smooth, rich, with fresh baked bread)
Roasted Cauliflower - 5 stars (simple olive oil & sea salt, but how do they get the texture so perfect?)
Falafel - 5 stars (wonderful cumin kick. Best I've had, and I live in NYC)
Chicken schnitzel - 5 stars (best chicken cutlet sandwich, other than Italian parmesan style, I've ever had)
Desert - cheesecake with ice cream - 5 stars (ok so it's guilding the lily but it's to die for!)

Shaya is a bit pricey, and you can't get a cup of tea for $3-$4, you have to order a whole pot for $8, hence the 4star rating on value.
This small mom and pops restaurant was absolutely amazing! Service is great and I had the chicken and waffles, qrits and waffle cornbread was nothing like before!!!!

This was my first trip to Outback. We had a gift card and went for lunch on a Saturday afternoon around noon. Denise was our server and was the perfect blend of attentiveness and letting us be. We started with a loaf of warm brown bread and butter which was really good. I had the 9 oz. filet mignon with a salad and steakhouse mac and cheese (made with smoked Gouda). The salad was excellent - romaine, cucumbers, cheese, onions, and grape tomatoes. The steak was cooked perfectly as ordered (medium) and the mac and cheese was on point. My husband had the 13 oz. boneless ribeye with the same sides. His steak was also cooked perfectly. The manager, hearing it was our first visit to Outback, came out to see how our experience was. A bonus is that they have Fosters on tap and ice cold. 

We frequent a lot of steakhouses and my one complaint is that they often are only open for dinner. I prefer to eat a heavy meal early and Outback offers that. And at a faction of the price. We have easily paid twice as much for the same cut of meat at other restaurants, where sides are usually a la cart. I had a great experience at Outback and will definitely return. It's not swanky, but the food and service are excellent and for me, that's what matters.

Stopped by after a long day furniture shopping with some friends (this location's right by Structube) and discovered that not only was it happy hour (starting at 2pm on weekends) but also their food is surprisingly delicious. I knew this place was a chain as I'd seen them in Vancouver, and I tend to avoid chains, but was very impressed by their mixed bowls. The dairy free pina colada was excellent also and at happy hour prices what's not to like? I'd like to head back and try their steak, but the tofu bowl was so amazing I might just get that again!  Only dislike - and the reason I never went in Vancouver - they tend to get loud on weekend evenings, and I am not a fan of having to yell conversations. But weekdays and happy hour late lunches, I'm a fan.

Las Fuentes is a great neighborhood restaurant! The food is always great, the service is prompt, and the tacos nortenos are the best item on the menu. The prices are a little high, but the food is tasty.

It's my fault that I had expectations that are contrary to this bar/restaurant's mission. This is the place to be to drink and watch the game(s), but this is not the place for conversation and an extraordinary meal. The food was above fine, and I don't have any complaints about it. But the service was super slow, primarily because we ate here in the middle of Sweet 16 and March Madness; the waitress clearly expected (and she was fair to assume this) that we would stay for the entire duration of the game like everyone else. But we were only here to eat and leave. She could not read our signals that we wanted to leave, and she did not check in with us often enough. We finally had to hunt her down to get the bill. Again, she was fair to guess why we were at the restaurant, so I'm not blaming her. As a sports bar, this place is off-the-hook. But as a restaurant, I was underwhelmed.

Horrible service, no cars for us with reservations, one agent behind the counter chatting on a personal call. Then Dollar corporate wouldnt reimburse for charges above and beyond when we had to rent from someone else.   Never will i rent from Dollar again.  Your competition thanks you

Ordered through Uber Eats yesterday for dinner. 
My daughter and I LOVE PASTA!! This was our first ever take and overall knowledge of this business. Let me tell you, it was so worth every penny! The serving per person was huge! The food was wrapped well and extremely warm when it arrived. We really devoured our meals

Unfortunately, Bon Ton Cafe was probably the least interesting and tasty restaurant during our trip to NOLA.  We went with a number of recommendations made by others on various dining sites, however, most items, such as the creamed cauliflower fell flat, as did the crab dishes, which were simply slathered in american cheese.

The multiple appetizers, which included gumbo, etoufee and turtle were perhaps the highlight of this dining experience.
It took a half hour to get our food. Pico de Gallo was bland and the taco shells tasted store purchased. Disappointed
A beautiful must see cathedral. Amazing the work and detail put into the walls and ceilings. A story in itself that bring the building to life.
Soup and sandwich (roast french dip) was good  hubby had fish street tacos. Food wasn't bad but service was slow and waitress couldn't answer some questions about the menu

This was our second time coming here and overall it was just a big disappointment. The first time we came, it was wonderful and the waitress was personable, knowledgeable and on it. The food was great and the whole evening was a win. Tonight, a few months later, the waitress was definitely polite and knew about the drinks and food. But the food tasted alright, maybe good at best, and she eventually only came by a time or two here and there, even though each time she was still polite. Overall it felt like the second time was a huge let down compared to the first time. So I would say it's currently hit or miss going here at the moment. Not to mention it was my girlfriends birthday I went out of my way to make it memorable and neither she nor I felt like we wanted to go back after we left. She wasn't celebrated or even mentioned even though I made a point of that while making the reservation. We frequent livery and we love cunningham group restaurants but tonight mesh missed the mark completely.
The pizza here is Amazing Tara makes a mean clear water cooler the restaurant itself is super cute and the atmosphere is great !!!

I decided to go against my last fantastic experience with Lowes delivering LG washer and dryer 10 years ago to give HH Gregg a chance based on feedback from my wive's friends.  Please don't put yourself in this position.  I am saddened that HH Gregg has an opportunity to seize the one aspect of appliance sales and delivery, customer service, that can make them become a cherished provider and failed multiple times.  Unfortunately, I had intermittent experiences with personnel that did try to help, earnestly, but the company as a whole failed everyone.  What a shame.  This chain won't be around in 2-3 years.

My experience with the salesperson was okay.  He seemed to know what he was talking about rattling off specs and claims but kept trying to talk me into the "cheaper" option.  Did he know something I didn't?  I don't think so.  I did my research, this was top of the line LG.  I was cool with my choice.  You want my business, I make a decision, hold true to your commitments.

I purchased washer/dryer/pedestal combos without much negotiating.  Free delivery included and I asked hook up hoses and services to be given free.  Cool.  Now the fun starts.  The back order of washers led him to have the unit shipped to the store(his idea) rather than DWH to then be shipped to my house to speed up the cycle...BIG MISTAKE.  The SP gave me the phone number and told him to call him on a specific date at a specific time and he would schedule the delivery and take care of the rest.  We are in a new home with no washer and dryer and would have to wait 3 weeks until delivery...okay, cool, I trust and will wait to call.  I call from out of state when he said...nothing.  Countless times, nothing.  Burnt.  Leave messages with co-workers won't call me back.  He got his sale.  I should have known better.  I call corporate, I call guest services, finally find someone willing to help me after 48 hours of trying.  But wait, you missed your window.  You will need to wait another week.  Damn.  Okay, lets schedule.  Schedule set.  They give you an automated call the day before to confirm delivery the next day...yes, we've been waiting a month.  Then call you hours later to confirm a 3 HOUR WINDOW to deliver...ha, seriously.  You guys are sucking wind compared to your competition but okay here's your chance to deliver.  And...I get a voicemail the next morning stating the items didn't make the truck and you will have to wait another week and a half.  WHAT?!?!  I'm not having LG deliver, this is HH Gregg.  So I am a month and a half out just for a washer and dryer.  I visited the store, had to find a manager to help me(btw they have a swarm of half-trained salespeople standing around to make misleading claims but one or two managers to back them up), and am still waiting on my washer and dryer.  I just got a confirmation automated voicemail telling me my three window delivery period tomorrow.  You get the call after hours.  I feel so valued.  Never another chance HH Gregg.  They don't value opportunity they have to create brand awareness through service and even fail compared to the BIG brand names like Lowes and Home Depot...ouch, this gives them really nothing to stand on.  Only a matter of time.

Absolutely disgusted. I'm writing this review as I walk out of the building. I ordered the charbroiled oysters and they smelled FOUL. Yet, I decided to taste it and my senses were correct. They tasted so spoiled. I eat oysters on the regular. So trust me, I know a spoiled one when I see it...let alone taste it. They literally smelled like chitterlings. I'm disgusted.

This is my local Shoprite and it is one of the better Supermarkets I have been too.  The deli, produce and seafood areas have a bigger selection that almost any other supermarket I have visited.  They have island tables for cheese and a boatload of cold serve items. 

They also have an all natural isle, while it is not huge it is a lot more than others have.  

The lines at checkout always move fast.  The prices are a bit higher on average but you get what you pay for in this case.  My local store often makes me feel disappointed when I end up at other stores.

My favorite meal in Tennessee! 

The biscuits are melt-in-your-mouth good. You don't need to put anything on them, except for the fact that the preserves are so amazingly tasty. (I picked up some jars of the preserves at the shop afterward.) We had an early dinner at 4:30 on a Thursday, so no crowd. I had the catfish entrée with fried green potatoes, hush puppies and yellow squash casserole. 1 word can explain the experience...YUM. If I could go back and do it again I'd get beans or mac and cheese over the fried green tomatoes, but all in all, no regrets. The sweet tea was a nice treat on a hot day as well. If I lived in  Nashville I'd take my friends/visiting family there; but since I don't, I can just recommend that you go. You won't regret it.

I would highly recommend Ace and David. 
He is on time and reliable.
I had him come out to fix some leaky faucets and he ended up fixing light fixtures and helping me with some other problems.
He even went to the local hardware store to get some parts and ended up getting me some other things I needed. I have already booked him for a second appointment.
He's also easy to talk to and explains what he's doing so you can understand.  Highly recommended. I had David out again to do quite a few jobs. He did jobs I hadn't even planned on doing. I am redoing a room and he was an immense help. He put furniture together. Changed all my locks and put in new lighting among other things. I don't understand the negative reviews. He has always been professional and pleasant to work with. All my jobs have been done with care.
Great communication, very honest and fast work. We have used them multiple times. Normally we get same day service unless it is a major job.

Shouldn't have... but I tried the Al'Key Burger...  Figured it was a once on a lifetime experience...  It was!  Too much deep fried...   Knew better, but I've tried it and now I can move on.

My wife had the Chicken Florentine...  It was excellent!

We shared the sweet potato fries...  Awesome!

Here's the deal...  Great staff that really cares about the food they prepare.  They seem to strive for excellence!  I can't wait to return so that I can pass on the deep fried over indulgence and dive head first into the food treasures that abound on the menu!

When I found out this place was the former Vittles, but had changed names, I was a little apprehensive about going there. Vittles has been a destination of mine for years, whenever I have been in Nashville for business. Fortunately, the food and staff are just as amazing, offering up one of the best "meat and three's" in the South.  The only difference that I could see was they now take American Express, which was a good thing for me.

It was a pleasant experience to have drinks at the Elysian Bar.  We went the afternoon after we arrived in New Orleans.  The bartender made great suggestions and allergy adaptations we enjoyed.

The service was good. It was a quaint space. The bar area was rather tight but once seats were available the experience was enjoyable.   

I would gladly return and recommend to friends. I would like to tour the space and learn how the space transitioned.

Bar Louie is an awesome place to enjoy some quality food and drinks. I've been to this place several times and always have a great experience with service. You can sit indoors at a booth, sit at the bar to catch sport games, or sit outside under the fans and enjoy the scenery. They recently changed their menu to appear a little more swanky, very hipster now. They have even updated their plating which I can appreciate. My favorite is the brunch menu for Saturday and Sunday's, you can't beat bottomless mimosas for $10! Amazing, but if there was one thing I would change, it would be a slight adjustment with their food menu. While they are becoming more swanky, I wish they would keep some of their old "bar food" items that everyone loves. I'm all for change, but keep some of the items that made the restaurant amazing in the first place.

First time there, and last...First off All the associates were extremely rude..& When I went to check out I have bad hearing and unfortunately couldn't hear the cashier. I felt bad for making her repeat her sentence but she got extremely rude when She has to repeat "to put the hangers on the clothing rack". I didn't mind doing that, I literally just couldn't hear her. Then I did not  realize I had to pay with cash and When she told me that I told her "no problem!" And asked if she could hold my items..When I was walking out the lady by the door was the rudest woman I ever met and You could tell she was annoyed. For what And why towards me I don't know I know we have our bad days but I was over it at that point. Overly priced anyways

I went here two times in one week. It was really great! Decent prices for a lot of food! They also have daily specials during the week! Friday, the gumbo and half sandwich was delicious! I recommend this place highly if you need a bite to eat for lunch!

Great place in the neighborhood with a good selection of beers. We had the lamb tibs and they were great. Comes with 2 veggie sides. Only thing is that the quantity isn't that much for two people so keep that in mind while ordering - which is different from other Ethiopian places we had been to.

So i am going to tell the full story here of my stay. Started out nice, we arrived early in hopes of an early check in so since they didnt have our room ready they allowed us to stay in a suite until it was ready which i thought very nice and if this was it i would have at least given 3 stars, however we got into our room and got 2 queens instead of a king. Then the room was absolutely disgusting with blood om the wall of the bathroom, carpet that looked as if it had never been vacuumed, a toilet thag didnt even seem to be attached to the floor, unclean shower. Just everything waa gross but we said theyre nice here well just stay its only one night. That was till around 4 am when we were woken by a man banging on the door. So i told my boyfriend to not open the door and he looks and does not recognize the man but the man yells that we need to come to the office that our card was declined even though i had pre paid for the room woth expedia months prior so i call with my cell to the front desk because they had no room phones. After calling twice nobody answered so considering ive seen the movie psycho i called the police. The police showed up so we went to the office and it was the manager at the door the police leave and the desk clerk and manager get mad at us for calling the cops and aa theyre telling us how yall can go on burbon street and get drunk but call the cops for us being at your door at 4 am and how the hotel gets theives all the time that we could have canceled the room and tried to stay for free my card somehow is approved. While i am not sure why they waited until 4 am to run my card that had already been prepaid through expedia this scared us and we were not able to sleep after that. When leaving they did apologize and offer us another night for free but i was not going to stay there another night and i dont recommend anybody else stay there. Pay the extra stay somewhere nicer.

Indie has become my go-to coffeehouse in Carmel! The quality of roasts produced by Alec and his team rival the top coffee shops in the nation and the drinks they make are absolutely delicious. Indie's cappuccino is one of my favorites I've had anywhere and keeps me coming back constantly. 

They have both patio and indoor seating, making it a fantastic summer option! There is sometimes tight seating when it's busy, but I'm always able to find somewhere to sit. 

If you're in the area and looking for exemplary coffee, ICR is really the only place to go around Carmel!

Lots of the same stuff throughout the market. And prices are obviously reflecting tourism when you pay $5 for a gator foot. It reminds me of the markets when you get off of a cruise ship. There's a side with tables (more like a flea market) and a brick and mortar shop with more high end products and prices of course. Some of the little food spots are good here though. try the cheese shop and the organic banana for a quick bite while shopping
Not as much excitement in both the food and customer service. I would have appreciated if there were more accurate reviews done for this place. The location is good. Parking is ok.

honestly i was feeling a little off about this place based off the reviews but i was in desperate need of a gel pedicure so i went anyways and they did so good! there is a little mess ups but it doesn't bother me any, i would definitely come here again!

Ate the Nashville Hot Chicken with Medium sauce (had Hot on the side to try it out) and was highly pleased! The whole meal was amazing but I didn't like their special white sauce (I'm not a fan of horseradish) and had ranch on the side. Food and staff were great.

Only downfall- the restaurant was very hot and didn't feel the AC. Wasn't sure if it was broken or not.

This RV Resort in Nashville is easy in and out, very close to Opry Mills. It is family own and operated, they have good live entertainment on Thrus-Saturday nights. We have enjoyed our stay here with friendly and down to earth people.
Staff were great, food was good, dinner line is much better, just had water, meat on a stick and short ribs the best, peanut butter chicken was very good

eh, the sushi is nothing to rave about. Maybe I'm spoiled by the place I usually go to. So many of my friends enjoy this place and I had high-expectations until I tried it. The sushi wasn't that flavorful and didn't seem fresh. I've given this place a shot 3 times and it's been the same each time. It's mediocre sushi at average pricing.

Store is dark and floor not swept well. Often find their small animals fighting, on one occasion found a rat with a bloody eye. It's clear that they put too many rodents per cage. I've also seen a few parakeets flying freely through the store. "Oh, they got out." they tell me casually, as if it's acceptable to let a domestic bird escape and roam about.

I picked this location to get a brake tag because it was closest to my house. The hours posted on the web are 8 - 12 on Saturdays. I arrived at 10:15. A man with a clipboard approached my car and began shouting at me, stating that they closed at 11 AM. I didn't argue and just decided to leave, but he kept on going and started shouting about a "giant billboard" with the hours posted on it and then proceeded to question my level of literacy. This verbal attack was not provoked in any way - the man was just nasty. I will not be stopping here again.
Incidentally, I drove up one side of Claiborne and down the other on the following day and never located said "giant billboard".

I've had some friends visiting from Back home in NY.  We wanted to go out for a nice dinner one night and had heard great things about Eddie V's. We had to wait for a table even with a reservation for 30 minutes  which was a strike. But once inside everything changed. The ambiance was excellent, the service was really good and the food was so much better than expected. I'm a steak guy that goes to all the best steak houses and must say the steak I had there was on par with Peter Luger's. We had an amazing meal, great drinks and went home happily stuffed.

The food here is fine, but the customer service is off. We stood by the "please wait to be seated" sign for awhile before my boyfriend went over and asked someone if they were still seating because no one had even acknowledged that we there. Like I said, the food was fine but customer service is just as important to the dining experience. If you don't want us there and you're too busy to seat us, it's cool. We probably won't be back.

The first call went wrong. I tried to give the dispatch person (Judy) the location and  the nearest landmark as a tourist, that wasn't good enough for her. She hung up on me. I had my friend call back to try again. We were told about 30 minutes. It was much less. And our driver was amazing! He was friendly, funny and very personable! Sorry I forgot his name! This driver changed my initial opinion.
Those sweet potatoes are to die for. Sooooo yummy. I keep trying to duplicate it and can't. My choice when I want to eat well and do nothing after. Delish!

Big prices with VERY small portions are what you'll get here.  It is a BYOB but we had a big group and no one was happy with the quality for the HIGH price.  Good area though with lots of other options so, go check them out - many are very close to each other.

Just left Outfooters VERY disappointed. I had purchased a pair of UGGS for my daughter for Christmas but somehow lost the receipt. I was sure I would be able to exchange them for a size 7. Apparently they have a no receipt/no exchange policy and would not let me exchange them. They were brand new, in the box with the Outfooters name right on it. To make matters worse, the owner would not come out of the back room to talk to me after I asked to speak to him.  So, go to one of the many other shoe stores in Santa Barbara. I'm going to check with Nordstrom because they would probably exchange them for me and I didn't even buy them there!

After eating the gyro salad at this restaurant I had a severe bout of food poisoning. I noticed that the meat was sitting at room temperature without a warmer on it and ate against my better judgement. When I called the restaurant they were unconcerned and unapologetic. Very disappointing for a place that has good reviews. Also, it is not clean and not friendly.

No one at the restaurant knew what Gluten friendly is.... Pre bussing is a joke at this place. Table stayed cluttered and not picked up. After asking to clean some plates she only took what we handed her and never came back for more. Mind you they aren't even that busy. 
Food is great they just need a lot of work in their serving staff. Also charging 15% on each ticket over a party of 6 is just ridiculous. I've been to way better places that don't charge that.

My second time. First time was great. This time: no stars sorry! 
1. People that ordered after us, got their food long before us. 
2. Cold Tacos. I mean COLD. 
3. All tacos (4 portions) had two cubes of tomato, no cilantro and a teaspoon of raw onion. It's supposed to be salsa. 
4. Tacos were hard on edges. 
5. It rained so we went to sit inside. All available tables were dirty. Even though the friendly girl came to ask us something, she didn't offer to clean the table. 
I was sorry that I brought my overseas guests here. And that after I bragged! Overpriced for what you get. Never again.

This so my second time here and I came back because the reviews are so good but both times I've made an appointment and waited more than 45 minutes AFTER my appointment time for someone to get started. I want to keep coming but it gets very frustrating just waiting and waiting. Why even make an appointment?

The actual nail stuff is great and they take their time for everything to look nice. Just hope I can come one time and get in on time!
Their cream of crab soup and French dip sandwich were delicious!! Service was fantastic!

Social Graces is one of those shops that I always like to walk through.  It's clean, smells nice, and has lots of pretty things to look at.  I've never purchased anything here though, mainly because most of their business is invitations and stationary.  And since I'm not married, have never been engaged, and have not had a baby, I have not had a reason to order really nice invitations.  

Stationary--that's another story.  I do LOVE stationary, note cards, and calling cards.  I'll say though that the reason I don't order from Social Graces is only because one of my best friends (not in the state of TN) has her own note card business and I feel compelled to order from her.  However--SG has a great selection of casual to fine stationary and note cards for all ages.  If you are in the market for this, I suggest you visit them and check out their goods!  The prices could be considered a little high, but the quality is excellent.

They also have some nice gifts.  Not as fun and funky as other shops along 21st Avenue, but nice.  The store is definitely worth at least a walk through, especially if you like clean, smell-good type places!
If you have a service animal just follow there company policy it's that simple anyone can get a vest online I doesn't mean there certified.

Let me put Village Pub first on my list of neighborhood places that are doing an excellent job of serving our little east side community.  The staff is incredibly friendly and accommodating, the food is fantastic, and the beer is...well, it's beer.  I mean, how can you screw that up?  I guess it could happen. But, the point is that it doesn't.  They have the beer thing down, hence the name.

I am so pleased that they moved into the neighborhood and that I finally have a place to go where I don't choke on cigarette smoke and people actually remember my name.  (Except for Zach.  He needs to work on that.)
Baked potato was not hot. Otherwise food was good. Peanuts are a plus.  Line dancers were obviously unenthusiastic and disinterested -- shouldn't have bothered.

I splurged and got an interior detail for my mini van and it was worth every penny. My car, that transports my three messy kids, was SPOTLESS!  I hate to let my kids get back in it looks so nice. Really great job for the price.

I personally love Jack's Pizza.  As a long time fan, I order a pizza from them each and every time I'm in town to visit.   Some of the locations I have been told, changed their recipes, but this one has remained a true Jack's pizza and has never changed....WHICH I LOVE! The staff is friendly and I've had nothing but great pizza and interactions! Love!

They came out to our mobile home village to 'trim trees' and were hired by whoever in the front office. The short of it? Don't hire them. The long of it?....

They butched one of our palm trees by cutting off several green branches throwing them down in our yard ON TOP of our newly planted baby tree. 1. Palm trees don't really need trimmed as they are pretty much self grooming. They use the nutrients in the dying limbs for the newly sprouting limbs. They need those nutrients to remain healthy. Sure, they are resilient and usually come back from bad cuts but they shouldn't have to. The limbs will turn brown and pretty much fall off on there own. Sometimes they get caught up a little bit but they will do all the work themselves without the use of a chainsaw.    2. A property maintenance business should know this and should actually have people working for them who give a darn about trees. Instead there was a group of workers swinging their saws at green branches and throwing cigarettes buts all over our properties. 3. The shade that our palm tree offered to our home was much needed and now we have very little shade as they chopped off the limbs. So, right before summer aka HOT weather they take away our natural occurring shade.  4. They park outside our house, truck running, blocking the neighbor guy in completely (see picture) and leave horrible thumping music blaring on their truck radio. 

I have complete respect for any hard working person who does their job well. There was one worker who was hard at it picking up limbs and doing so as quickly as he could. The others were lazily walking around letting him do all the work they should have been doing. I have zero respect for the other workers. They just want a pay check. How are these guys qualified to know which branches should be cut down? I am guessing they aren't 'qualified' but rather are are warm bodies fulfilling the title of 'employee.' 

Thanks much Alexanders for doing a horribly crappy job on our trees, for harming our newly landscaped yard with chain saw debris and leaving it for me to pick up and for having workers who could care less about it's customers. I wouldn't hire them again if they were the only choice I had. Go elsewhere.
Omg I love the coffee here.  Now I can see why Starbucks is so popular.  Only one coffee in my lifetime has been better than Starbucks, and that was Scot Coffee out of Allentown....

This spot doesn't have the same hype as some of
the other spots in town, but it's possibly my favorite Mexican food in SB. Really, really good burritos. Tip: I recommend choosing only one of either sour cream or guacamole (or neither)- rather than both - in order to maintain the "bean density" of the burrito.
A wide variety of cigars, pipe tobacco, and everything in between along with the supplies to enjoy them.
Went to see Leon bridges. My wife spilled a beer and Marie came to clean it up.  She was absolutely amazing...made my wife feel so much better and refused a tip.  GSR needs to hire an army of Maries

Each of my kids has had a birthday party at Rascal's and the staff makes a great fuss over them - not just a half-hearted bit of singing over cake, but the whole time they're playing the staff makes them feel special by letting the birthday kid have the pick of go-karts, first pick at ice-cream, etc. I've also seen the staff work with a reluctant kid to get him started racing and he had a blast once he got over his initial fear. Finally they don't nickel and dime you - if there isn't a line they run the races longer, and will let a kid bowl an extra game. Note also that they are very safety conscious - if the kid is not tall enough he will not ride the rides, they make sure you are buckled in properly on every ride and if someone on track is reckless or aggressive they will get prohibited from the track. However - they have separate tracks for kids 45" tall to slow race and for adults & kids 60" tall for fast racing. Don't hassle the staff about this, because their safety-mindedness really does make it a better time for all. Finally, the staff hustles - if someone's stuck on track, they run out to resolve the issue.  Check their website for coupons too.
Portions are hella big, food is good. Their fried rice is better than their noodles, FWIW
Stopped in for a meatball parm to go. Service was a little slow and the girl working the register needed an attitude adjustment but the sub was great!  I'll be back next time the craving hits.

So they called me to go in and discuss my issue.  It was a waste of a trip as it's a 45 minute drive just to be told "oh wow, you look great!" And for the doctor to say that he injected more on the side I actually said he did nothing on.  One side still looks uneven.  If you read the other reviews, people have complained about the same thing...about how he places the fillers in the wrong spot.  I didn't bother to read the reviews on this place because I had a wonderful experience at their Grant location, but they were booked.  I should have just waited.  I will say that the person who did my IPL, I believe her name was Jasmin, did an amazing job.  She probably would have done a better job administering the fillers than the actual doctor.  I wouldn't be complaining if it was a few bucks but it was hundreds of dollars that went to waste.

Had they placed the filler in the area I asked, they wouldn't have said I needed more syringes.  I know this because last time it only took one to correct it.  I feel most of the filler is next to my left nostril, which is no where near my under eyes.  Lesson learned.  Please go see doctor Nichols.  The front desk staff at the Grant location, Leah, will also take good care of you.

I went to Whiskey Kitchen on Sunday while in Nashville for 24 hours with my girlfriends. We were STARVING and literally wanted everything on the menu. I cannot speak for the cocktails because we just drank water in preparation for the night we had ahead, but the food overall was just okay to us. 

I ordered the Aristocrat wings because I love truffle oil so they sounded delicious. I was going to split those and the Fried Green Tomato BLT with a friend. When our food came our Mac n Cheese was cold, even the cheese on top was not melted. We sent it back just to get reheated and it was completely different than the other mac n cheese at the table that a friend got. Ours was super soupy compared to the other so that was weird. 

My wings were nothing special, I actually couldn't taste truffle at all. I wish I would have gotten something else like the burger which looked really good at the table next to ours. The seasoned fries were good probably the best thing we had at the table. The fried green tomato BLT was good, I really like sandwiches on toasted sourdough so I knew I had to try that. 

My friend ordered the Hot Chicken and I think she enjoyed that however the green beans had no taste. They weren't seasoned and just were covered in oil. 

Overall, I think the food there is probably really good and I just didn't order the right things. Burgers looked amazing, the hot dog looks really good, I don't know about $16 Nachos but I am sure they are good as well.

what a debacle! poor poor planning.  i get it - it's a new fest and organizers didn't know what they were doing.  venue too small, logistically non-sensical, vendors way under prepared.  i stupidly waited in line in the heat for over an hour (was starving) and only got mediocre food.  the food description sounded so good but they totally did not deliver. they were making the food so fast to keep up with the lines and not focusing on making it good. the vendor i tried served RAW chicken to some very upset people who came back and we all had to wait even longer while past customers were served again! nightmare.  the ONLY good thing was the band lineup, which is why i gave it another star - only 1 star without the bands.

i see there's a new venue for this year and hopefully organizers have figured out how to run it.  i may give it a second chance despite a terrible first experience because this fest has a lot of potential.  if they don't get it right this time, i will be done.

Okay. I have tried to get used to this place but no. Just no. 

Coffee: terrible. Tastes burnt and watered down and always has coffee grounds in it.
 
Soda: Either they always serve diet when you order regular or the mixture of sweetener is off.

Cream cheese: has an odd aftertaste and mouth feel like it is it real cream cheese. 

Cheese on sandwiches: cheese product like those individually wrapped oil things.

It's just bad. I must accept it. I'm done.

I saw an announcement on Downtown Boise Association page and had to check it out. It exceeded my expectations. The Albacore Melt Panini was delicious. My wife had Turkey Bacon Avocado Panini. It was very good as well. 

It's a healthier choice than most places. The portions are "right-sized" which my seem on the smaller side to some people. They'll be filling though. 

I wished their location was more centralized to BoDo or Grove Plaza. I'm afraid they won't get enough traffic in their current location to stay in business more than 2-3 years. Prove me wrong Boise! Please.

This is my new favorite breakfast spot. Showed up here on a Sunday morning to live music and great vibes. If you're reaaaaally tryna eat, the food is pretty small portions. However I got the breakfast bowl and added veggies bacon and feta. The toast it came with was worth the splurge. Enjoy this hidden little gem!!
