I love it here, great environment, friendly servers and the food I've tried so far I loved. I think you guys should lessen the chicken nachos though I ordered this as an app and I didn't order a main dish because I was so full and it was shared but otherwise this place is awesome!

This was my first time at the kick off party as well. It was extremely crowded & it was very hard to see each exhibit or let alone participate in different activities. Everything was all jumbled & there were no lines to see each exhibit. It was a bit disorganized. I felt as if I had to crawl myself in between people just to see the actual exhibit.
I wish I could have participated more but, there was just no way I had any room to do so. Also, I wasn't too crazy about the drinks or the beer (pale ale :( & dark beer ). 
However, I did enjoy seeing the laser exhibit & effects of gravity as well the sound waves effect on fire, There were a few cool things. I just hope things are more organized with the other events.
I ordered a Kale (Harvest) salad by mistake. I didn't read the full menu. I don't like Kale. I loved this!!

Fleming's has now added an AWESOME outdoor seating area, which will offer happy hour! I went to an event there and was very impressed with the space (as well as the food and cocktails). Check out the new outdoor space ASAP...it's pretty fantastic!

Awesome atmosphere at this place! The owner was quick to introduce himself and the staff was so friendly!! The pizza was also awesome! 

The kayak place we had left recommended it and I'm glad they did!! We aren't local so it'll be a while until we are back but we will be sure to stop in when we are in town again!
Overpriced and small portions. Taste was average at best. Nice atmosphere, but will not come back here.

Here for drinks.
It smells like old grease from the kitchen 
Like humidity 

The margarita was large but ..mostly juice or mix

Hey! Free bruschetta with yelp (actually pretty good)

Again..why the smell?

I just had perhaps the worst meal accompanied by even worse service at Mikimoto. After ordering a Mango Mania roll (which I assumed was a special roll since it was $9.50) I specifically asked for extra salmon, knowing that Mikimoto tends to skimp on their fish. I accepted that there would be an up charge of $1 as long as there actually was extra salmon. When I picked up my order and gave a 10% tip (on a pickup order might I add) I was appalled. I had received a glorified salmon avocado roll with a tiny piece of salmon and instead one extra piece of avocado with mango on top. I called back to express my distaste, and was rudely spoken to by their manager saying, "If you don't believe there was a dollar extra of salmon I'll just take off a dollar on your next order" to which I replied, "It isn't about the dollar, but why would I even bother to ask for extra salmon for you to completely disregard my request and still charge me extra?" Then the manager proceeded to hang up on me and did not answer when I attempted to call back. I won't need that dollar back, Mikimoto, because it doesn't look like I'll be ordering from you anymore.

I actually had to cancel my reservation due to a covid positive test in my family. So I called to cancel - bc their policy states that you can as long as you are outside of a 24 hour window. When I called, I spoke to Jane who was nice, but told me that her manager said that there are not cancellations for the holiday weekend. I'm sorry, but no. If the hotel policy is that you can cancel in a given time frame, then why is the manager stating otherwise? So, I was told to call back the next day, that the manager was there between 8-4. I called at noon and the manager was already gone. This is just such poor customer service.

If this happens to you - managers creating policies that are contrary their company's, then just call 1-800-HILTONS and you can cancel. Why this manager had to create more work for me at a time when I didn't have the energy to do so is what I cannot understand.

I ate here years ago, and it has been too long! Now located on Park between Bilby and Valencia, Mr K's serves up hearty delicious portions of BBQ swimming in a pool of sauce that you will want to lick the last drop of off your plate. The pork sandwich that my dad and I both got was just surreal in its deliciousness, with a huge soft bun and brisket just pouring out the sides. There is no way to eat this as a sandwich, so a knife and fork seem the suitable option. Each bite is a delight to the taste buds. At about $7.25 for the sandwich, it's a steal. Topped off with a few cups of sweet tea, I was very full, and so glad I didn't get any sides (I'll have to save room for cole slaw next time) and I have my eyes on sweet potato pie. There is also a vat of Kool Aid to drink. This place is the real deal. The ambiance is simply and totally fitting in character for real down home cooking- I suggest eating in, but obviously take out is a fantastic option. Tangy, sweet, delectable, and I'll be back soon for ribs.
One of the best places to eat some real VEGAN food. Burgers are awesome.

Great tasting classic menu items. Sizes just right. Sushi rice was fresh and nicely seasoned even though we arrived close to closing time. Saw a variety of rolls I want to try another time. Friendly efficient service. Clean and shows pride in ownership. Great location and parking.

Great authentic stuff. What i dislike is how can you have apostrophe S .... in a plural word. I thought indian english had high standards. 
I'm indian btw !

We headed here late night for some Chinese food. It was awhile back, therefore i don't remember what we ordered, but it was surprisingly good for my first visit. I usually stick to the restaurants I never fail with, but this one was a breath of fresh air.

The owner/manager, whomever she was, is a sweet gentle woman, serving great food in a small, quaint place. The XO sauce is homemade!

We came here because our normal go to restaurant for Chinese is out of business. Was this as good? You betcha! We ordered Won ton soup , salmon roll , crispy duck , general So chicken  and a curry hot pot . All of the food came hot to the table. Full of flavor. The staff were super nice to my kids. Joked with them and made them laugh. And on top of that the bill was not expensive. I think we found our new Goto Chinese restaurant.
Tends to bite off more than he can chew.  Not dependable. Very disappointed in service.  Better to go to a major chain such as Sears or Firestone.

I was vacuuming today, cleaning up after my son's usual antics, and my vacuum cleaner almost caught on fire or smelled like it was going to. I looked up the local vacuum repair shop, and I found this gem. But it looks like I forgot to replace a filter that I have never even known about LOL It was an easy $15 repair, and it was totally worth the cost, time and trip to the shop. Thank you!!!

Incredible! Went here for their unique puffer fish tail entree that I saw on instagram! 

Arrived and was (happily) directed to the bar since I did not make a reservation, as seating is pretty limited. Immediate good vibes from the bar. Impeccable service. Every order and question was acknowledged and appreciated. Food was fenominal. From bread service to ny a strip entree. 100% satisfied with the quality of my purchase. Dessert was also amazing (peanuts and banana Klondike). Complimented with a Hungarian dessert wine that was super unique and delicious!!!!

So happy there's a Korean restaurant nearby now! Restaurant is not much to look at but the food was really good. Took the boys on a Saturday for lunch. We all got lunchboxes: beef bulgogi, spicy pork bulgogi and katsu. Lunch box comes with two fried dumplings and 4 different side dishes. More than enough to get you full!

Everyone enjoyed their meals very much. We also got an order of the KFC (Korean fried chicken) to split. A yummy, sticky mess. Do wish the wings were crispier, but they were real tasty. My bulgogi was good, better when served on the sizzling platter though - I love the charred bits!

Service was friendly and quick. There were not a lot of customers there when we arrived (around 12:30PM?) but a steady stream of people started trickling in as we were finishing up our meal. Will definitely be coming back. Need some bibimbap soon!

Shareable, delicious and clever meals. You can make your own unique combinations (we used suggestions from our waitress). Nice ingredients, tasty combinations. Great mixed drinks and nice bet and wine selection. Not surprisingly, I love the sister restaurant, Cafe Patachou.
Really quick, super friendly and knowledgeable. They made sure everything was working at our office and did so quicker than I could have hoped for.

My family and I went here tonight for dinner.  It was a very disappointing experience. We wanted the 40" pizza. We were told that you have to call ahead if you want this pizza. This fact is not stated on the website or on the menu. As a matter of fact it says "dine in only" on the website and menu. We ordered the 29" pizza instead. We were less than enthused with the pizza as well as the service. We will not be returning.

Wild Garlic used to be a hole in the wall, an upscale food paradise located in a former drive in restaurant. It was the kind of place you wanted to brag about but were afraid to let too many people know existed, it was your own food secret.

Now that they have moved locations the secret is out! Still the most incredible food that you can have in Tucson, but now in a restaurant location big enough that it's finally ok to let people know how special this place is.

Tonight we both tried the specials, I had a buffalo tenderloin cooked to perfection with a delicious mushroom sauce and my wife had grouper topped in a lobster sauce. This is the kind of incredible food you get to run into at Wild Garlic incredible, unique, and something you can brag about the next day.

If you are in Tucson and had never been to Wild Garlic, now is the time to try it. New location, same incredible experience.

More than just hair...the best place to visit for a massage! Pam is probably the best massage therapist I have been to in years.  She pays attention to how you are feeling and seems to know when when to pay extra attention to the spots that need it. I will never go to anyone else!  I also get my hair done and Jules does a great job on color and cuts, definitely more than just a hair salon.

THE FOOD OF GODS!!! 

Their store sign was not lit, but THEY'RE OPEN, so don't miss out on GREAT FOOD!

After a crazy day at work, I show up right before they close, which I normally try to avoid, out of kindness, but I was famished. I was welcomed right away with smiles, and COMPLETELY TAKEN CARE OF BY EVERYONE! It appears to be a family business, and they were overly staffed, and SO KIND...
...
then the food... PERFECTION. Perfect temps, perfect plate placement, generous portions, clean tables, and did I mention how nice they are??? I was still finishing my food after closing time, and they genuinely, kindly, refilled my Diet Coke, asked if I needed anything else, offered me dessert. I'll fly to Tampa just for their food, not joking.

We had been looking forward to trying this restaurant for quite a while. We finally had a chance this week. We got there right at noon, decided to sit outside as there were only two other tables occupied. We ordered  fish and chips and a Caesar  salad with grilled chicken. After a very long wait, the food  arrived, the fish and chips were all cold, the chicken on the salad was luke warm. The salad was abysmal, overdressed and chunks of ice on the plate. The fish and chips tasted ok, but was mediocre at best. Would never return. So disappointed.
Since this shop underwent new management, I absolutely love it! Great staff, and as always we love the Port of Subs chain.

Oh my Gosh! The most amazing Jazz band ever!!

Classy, the most amazing band Brass-a-holichs.

A few months ago I ran across a deal on Sharing Spree for Wild Wings Cafe.  It was a good deal for $15 voucher for only $7 so I figured we would give it a try.  My family loves boneless wings and even though we live on the other side of town, it looked to be worth the drive so I bought two deals.   The first time we went it wasn't the best meal.   The atmosphere was great, and the waitress was super friendly, but she was training and was super super slow.   Luckily there are several TVs that kept us entertained.   We had ordered the boneless wings and cheese fries for the whole family to share.   When they finally brought the food, the wings were hot, but the fries were cold (which made the cheese hard and clumpy).  When we told the waitress she immediately got the manager and he apologized profusely.   He then sent new fries to the table.   We then enjoyed the meal.   The wings were fabulous and we left happy.   Although we had a problem, the manager addressed it and made it better.   We were definitely willing to go back again to use our other voucher.

The second meal was much better.   We were seated on the patio on a gorgeous fall day and given another super friendly server.  We wanted an appetizer and convinced us to try the pizza nachos with our wings this time. Although I was a little nervous to try them due to the combination of ingredients I was willing to try them.   I was not disappointed.  They were fabulous, as were the wings.  It was a very enjoyable and relaxing meal.   Thanks to sharing spree for introducing us to Wild Wing Cafe as we will now be frequent visitors when we are in the area.  The food is tasty and very affordable, with wonderful service by the employees.

I am extremely happy with this company and my lawn pro!  My yard was a disaster and they worked very hard to make it beautiful.  Their professionalism and hard work was beyond my expectations.

Thank you so much!

never again,pedicure and tips $85.00,pedi was okay but the owner Victoria did my nails and was so rough,swear she was trying to file my skin!then she wanted to wax my eyebrows,had them done 2 days earlier,money grubbing,hard skin rubbing,non-friendly lady!

The truck taco was so good I went back for dinner.  I was disappointed with the small portion that the waiter recommended it was 3 tacos in a hard shell with a soft taco under the hard taco.  The tacos were minimally stuffed ... take blase portions small.  Don't think you get salsa w this taco  place without being charged an arm and a leg  a small and I mean small container of a salsa to out in your taco is 99 cents each.    For 2 people to eat here it was almost 70.00 we did each get a beer.  That was ridiculous.  DONT GO HERE unless you don't mind being nicked and  dime d.  You het charged for everything and its really not worth the price.. ... food was not so good at dinner ... I'll go on to the place down the street before I go back  here... left a sour taste in my mouth.  Charge charge charge ....chip s charge..teaspoon of salsa ...charge..everything s a charge charge  j

Declan Irish Stout:  light taste for how dark it is. (3/5)
Page turner IPA: very smooth for an IPA.  Really nice hoppy taste without overpowering. (4/5)
Extrovert Red: another nice taste. Hits the sides of the mouth but soon trails off (3.5/5)
Iconic Milk Stout: very deep, dark flavour. Very nice strong notes then again faded off quickly (4/5)

Worst customer service ever. Bought a brand new class c motor home and had some quality issues. Toilet seat hinge broke on our first trip. 5 weeks to get a new toilet seat from manufacturer. Outrageous. Went to take a shower but no one told us we did not have electronic start for water heater. Trip with no shower, cause we thought it was broken?! Probably would have used propane if we knew, we had a 50 minute walk thru that they told us to plan on 2 hours minimum, when we purchased. Had to pick up unit for a trip and will have to bring back end of September when our toilet seat arrives from Timbuktu I guess( 5 weeks).

WORST PLACE EVER...! Walking around looking for a late night food spot we came across this place... We were seated and ordered our food.. We waited roughly 45 min when the waiter came back to tell us he lost our order and wanted us to order again... How do you lose an order when there is only 4 other tables being served... Will never come here again...
Food was AMAZING. Clubhouse sandwich is a good go-to. Trashed wings were fantastic. Service was quick and our waiter Sam was excellent. Definitely a must!

Food is upscale bar food; interesting small plates, great burgers. Waitstaff training needs improvement - our waitress was friendly but forgetful ( I got bottled beer and asked for a glass, but never got it). Buck a shuck oysters on Wednesdays offers a selection of different kinds of oysters - an unusual and fun offering. Noise level is deafening - music is as loud as I'd expect in a college bar, which seems odd for a suburban location. 
I'll return - especially for buck a shuck - but may bring earplugs next time!

Upon entering for my 1 o'clock appointment , I was greeted in a Professional manner by Angel. He listen to my concerns and seemed attentive. Great atmosphere and you could feel the team work spirit. Would recommend this place to everyone. Genuinely interested in getting your service completed expeditiously.

I just had to give this bakery a glowing review. We made last minute dinner plans right before 4th of July for a . I emailed them my order late Monday night since they're not open til Tuesday hoping they could accomodate me. I didn't call them until Tuesday afternoon to check in how my cake was coming along. They didn't check my email yet cos that's for inquiries. Orders must be placed over the phone or in person, and they usually need 2 weeks for a specialty cake. That sucked...

Until it didn't!!  Chrissy was able to make my 4th of July birthday cake in about 4ish hours and the results were AMAZING!! I asked for a red

I was optimistic about The Sample Rack, largely thanks to other reviews.  Unfortunately, this was by far the worst experience I had out of the four total wedding dress shops I visited.

Carlene and I played some phone tag prior to the visit, and perhaps we got off on the wrong foot because I wasn't very excited to shop for a wedding dress and didn't have clear ideas about what I was looking for.  Things got worse when I arrived at the store with my parents and best friend, who were expressly discouraged from looking around at the dresses and told to simply stay put in their seats.  This was the only store where my "entourage" and I were not allowed to browse dresses on our own as soon as we walked in, and it quite frankly made us feel a bit unwelcome.  

I tried on a countless number of dresses, many of which were not my style at all. I'm not sure why this was, but Carlene + her two associates seemed determined to sell me on a style I really did not like; rather than adjusting as we went along and bringing me dresses that I liked more and more, they insisted on having me try what felt like countless dresses with features that I repeatedly stated I did not like.  Some of those dresses looked even worse on me than they did on the hanger, and when I said as much about one particular dress while looking at myself in the mirror, Carlene suggested that I could solve the problem by wearing a corset.  Ouch! 

At one point, one of the associates asked whether I was uncomfortable that my dad was present (the unspoken premises were that (1) it's a women's dressing room, and (2) you have to get practically naked to try on wedding dresses).  I suppose the question was well-intentioned (sort of), but I thought it was a bit odd because I'd invited him to come along with me; it's not like he just wandered into the store randomly and I happened to be there trying on dresses.  I assured her that he was there because I value his opinion, and he is certainly not a creeper.  (Incidentally, no other shop batted one eyelash at my dad's presence.)

One thing I will say for Carlene is that she is extremely persistent, which could be a good thing.  Eventually, she and her team found me a $900 dress that would've worked pretty well with a couple of alterations and adjustments.  I waffled on whether to buy it for a long time, and Carlene added to the pressure by telling me that she was completely booked up with appointments for the next two days and couldn't hold the dress for me past 5 p.m. that day (at this point, it was roughly 1 p.m.).  Ultimately, I decided against the purchase since I still had one more shop to visit, and Carlene asked me to call her as soon as I left that shop to tell her what I decided.

Fast forward to the end of the day -- I ended up finding an absolutely gorgeous dress at the final shop that I knew right away was it.  Before I was even able to get all the way home (less than half an hour's trip), Carlene called me to ask whether I'd buy her dress.  She was polite when I told her that I'd found another dress, but the conversation ended very quickly.

Carlene is clearly good at her job and takes it very seriously, so I can imagine how some customers might really like her.  But she might not be for everyone, particularly if you are not hugely enthusiastic about dress shopping and want to avoid strong pressure to buy.

Cons: 
-Little to no water pressure
-Hot water does not work on an average of once a month
-Sound easily travels if you live under another unit
-Monthly small fees include but are not limited to :: $5.54 service fee, $1.11 pest control fee, $10 sewer fee, $13 trash fee, $10 per-car parking fee
-It's been 90 degrees and the pool is only open on weekends from Noon-6 until later in the summer
-If you lock yourself out or are in an "emergency situation"---$100 maintenance fee
-The property is pitched as "smoke free" but many people smoke on site and in the buildings. During the winter, tenants smoked in the hall by our unit and left 100's of cigarette butts inside. After an entire month of reporting this issue, it was finally resolved.
-Minimal trash areas for dog waste
-Minimal and sometimes no parking during school season
-Our lower level building alarm went off for 3 months straight before anyone addressed the situation
-We were stuck in the elevator once 
-On occasion, the drier will  stop producing heat.  Once I was told to call the 1-800 number to get my $1.75 back and put the work order in to fix the drier myself. 
-Maintenance walked in on me when I was in the shower once, unannounced.  Even when you put a convenient/specific time you'd like an issue to be addressed: maintenance rarely follows suit. 
-A month ago, the entire village lost power for 48 hours. According to the management office-- "It was not their issue, it was the electric companies issue." The only helpful word of advice was "Do you have renters insurance?" (We lost everything in our fridge and both TV's burnt out)
-The employees in most places of business in the plaza across the street are MISERABLE and provide the worst customer service I've ever experienced.  Especially at the post office.

Pros:
-One block from the Chestnut Hill East train stop
-1/2 mile from Germantown Ave. We LOVE having dinner and enjoying drinks "down town" in Chestnut Hill
-Close to Valley Green running trail and Chestnut Hill Academy College
-Apartment offers a decent amount of square footage
-We love our hardwood floors, space and natural lighting in the living area.  
-More closet space then bathroom space (pro or con depending)   
-Our mailman Doug is SO NICE and thoughtful
-Lots of field/running space for our dog

If you are moving to Chestnut Hill, I would highly suggest downloading Trulia/searching Craig's List and looking at All Of Your Options.   We chose Chestnut Hill V. A's because we were desperate apartment searchers and new to Philly.  It seemed like an easy choice.  If you are moving to Chestnut Hill area, try to get as close to Germantown Ave as possible.  You'll pay the same if not less then you pay here and you'll have an enhanced quality of life with more at your fingertips.

Cheers!

If you were thinking about going somewhere different, DON'T. One Stop should be your final stop! This team exceeded my expectations. Fast and Efficient! They even help me see and think of things I didn't. You don't have to wonder if this is the place to get your marketing needs taken care of, I challenge you to try them.  I'm a tough customer, with high expectations and they delivered. I've tried many others but now I have I only have One Stop. They are officially like family, guess what guys, I'll be baacckkk

The Oysters! Order the whole dozen minimum ... The establishment looks awesome with the expansion and the drinks are New Orleans classics! Try the signature Bow Wow! It won't disappoint but make sure you have a designated driver ... every dish is so tasty! My tastebuds literally had an orgasm!!! If you are ever in the 504 it's a must stop! The wait can be up to an hour easily but it's worth the wait ... don't try Acme or Drago's ... if you want chargrilled Oysters come to Neyow's!!!

Was the first time we went since it changes hands.  We had been to Guppys several times in the past and were sad to see it go. A few friends were there and there was mixed reviews, so we decided we would try it ourselves.  Food was delicious, from the mozzarella, tomato and orange app to the pub burger, arugula salad and definitely the banana and Nutella dessert. The only complaint I have was when we first got our table, the waitress, who, by the way, delivered excellent service, stated that they had " drink specials" and proceeded to explain the two. I chose to try one but was quite surprised when the bill came and that " special" was $12.00. When I questioned the waitress, she stated that they weren't specials, as she stated in the beginning, but the "drinks for the night". Had I known that, I would not have ordered it because at $12.00, it came in what I would call, a mini martini glass and certainly not worth the &12.00 price tag, especially if they are"experimenting" with different drinks, as the waitress put it.  One of the complaints from one our friends reviews were that Roots was a little pricey, which we found the prices were slightly higher then other  establishments we frequent, but all in all, worth it, except for the "special"

This expansive selection of cigars and pipe tobacco is in the heart of the Magazine shopping and dining experience. Located in a former brick orphanage, his place will make the cigar lover in your life quite happy! Their large humidor carries all my favorites, like La Gloria Cubana, Partagas, and Ashton. There's even a small lounge for the closet smoker. Stop by, hang out, and puff away!

This is the 2nd stay with the brand. First was in Florida. It's well kept and clean! Always a plus! The rooms are big too! 

This hotel sucks for dogs! It's downtown and no grass for them to go in! My dogs are trained to go In The grass not on the sidewalk! I asked where to walk them and the front desk couldn't tell me. I asked the valet and it was a cold quick answer. Not cool! I just need to let them go and come back to my family. Not hunt for grass! 

There's a valet fee and it's worth it! It sucks but there's so much traffic and construction it's a pain! 

Over all it's a nice clean hotel and we would stay again but not in New Orleans. Not a fan of the town I guess...to much going on in such a small place.

I don't know why people are knocking down on this airport. Sure it's a little bit outdated. I've honestly been to worse from personal-common experience(LGA in Queens, NY). PHI has more introductions to get around and exit than a lot of other airports in the east coast. It was a breeze at 3am. I will admit some workers not didn't speak much and would just point Fingers to get around. But I'm not surprised by some of the rude Philadelphians exhausting from graveyard shift and their personal life. 
Departure from here was probably the smoothest, fastest I've ever experience. I flew with frontier. So I was in the same terminal with Other budget airlines(Including popular Southwest Airlines. If you're flying with them and checking bag in. I would come earlier than usual. I saw the lengthy line wrap around a bit. Next buttery transition was at the TSA line. There was 3 people, not including the agents that would check your boarding pass and ID. Afterwards I'd quickly empty my pockets, take my shoes and belt off. In no time I only had to walk thru metal detector without having to put my hands up. Immediately went through and TSA agent watching us told me have a safe trip. Is this how TSA has the best department award in the country? No swab test or extra Pat downs like Logan International in Boston for my trimmed beard that makes me look somewhat middle eastern for a Mexican? No sweat here at the airport in the city of Brotherly love on a Tuesday evening.
Private yacht club right in the harbor. Great place if you know or are a member. Fantastic food and drinks at very reasonable prices. They get you on the dues.

The name Darling's is fitting because it's such a darling little cafe. It's the perfect ambiance for a coffeehouse, perfect for breakfest, alright for lunch, and AMAZING for dessert!

In case you haven't noticed in their name cheesecake is their specialty, and they take it to whole new levels. the Philly classic looks pretty impressive, but they hook up flavors like bananas foster and perfect pumpkin. As for me I had to go with the White Chocolate Raspberry because it was so damn purple, and purple was on my mindset. So creamy and fruity!

I also picked up a very rich hot chocolate (yes I'm probably the only one ordering hot chocolate during a heatwave!) and it was the real deal.Their breakfast and brunch selection is loaded up with plenty of pancakes, oatmeal, omelettes, sausage and so much more (they even have smoked whitefish Aaron.). My egg and cheese on whole wheat literally melted in my mouth. check it out!
Excellent food for a great price!  Can get menudo every day here, which my husband loves.  Clean and bright. Would go back.

We waited for an hour and a half which was fine. We knew it would be a long wait, so we put our name in and walked around the mall for awhile. We got back after an hour and a half and we're still asked to wait another 20 minutes. We went to the bar and ordered a drink and an appetizer and then naturally our table was ready. Our table was still in the bar area, but the bartender was unable to get the appetizer I already paid for sent to our table. I went to find out who was in waiting on our table because after sitting for 10 mins, we still weren't spoken to by our waitress - we later found out our waitress didn't even know we had been seated. We didn't have plates or silverware after they brought bread so I had to ask for that and then the silverware was dirty so I sent that back.....needless to say, I won't be going back to particular location of the Cheesecake Factory...

Not much of an update. Shannon asked for a call to discuss my review on 
 7/9 (as noted). I left a voicemail, and followed up with an email after not hearing back for a week plus. Still haven't heard back- apparently customer retention is not a priority. I suppose I am lucky that I am not accustomed to this caliber of customer service.
I love there food best fast food nachoes I've ever had makes me want to order then every day for breakfast lunch and dinner can never get tired of these bad boys

I'm not a big Irish Pub fan but I'm all about great food/drinks and great service.  It was our first night in Indy and my girlfriend and I were looking for somewhere to chill and enjoy a meal and some beverages.  Everywhere else looked packed until we came upon 9 Irish Brothers Pub.  Not being a pub person we decided to risk it for the biscuit and I'm glad we did.   We ordered the Irish Egg Rolls(basically Reuben Egg Rolls with the Thousand Island on the side) and the Shepherd's Pie. The food came out in around 10 minutes which I think is good for a Friday night.   The food was delicious!!!! I love Shepherds Pie and they did not disappoint at all.  The portions were excellent.  The egg rolls were also excellent with the ingredient proportionally mixed well.  Our waiter's situational awareness was on point, he knew we needed more drinks despite the crowd and cleared table well.  I definitely will return here.

Service was great our server was amazing and attentive. Only one server, but that is ok. He did great not a lot of people I had the pescado a lo macho and it was amazing! Also we had the mixed ceviche which was also good. No complaints here food was great

Great place to have lunch; the food and service is great here. I've had the Bento Box and Hibachi Lunch Specials. These options come with a lot considering the price of $12-$15 for each. I personally prefer the Hibachi Lunch over the Bento Box. Overall this place is amazing!
Delicious shrimp and grits, the sandwiches are quite large, and the salmon was perfect + a solid selection of craft beer and good service.

This place is snuggled into the street and has a modest but impressive interior. It was converted from an old Foster's and has awesome stained glass ceiling and comfortable lounging. The food was alright and the coffee was great, but what really sold the place to me was the lady who served me who was the owner. She had was wonderfully welcoming and I ended up having a nice conversation with her before I took my seat. 

I'm a fan!

It is true. This is the only thrift store with goods really priced to sell. Alpha thrift has clothes priced higher than new items at Kmart, much of the time, and Salvation army in Santa Barbara pushes in the expensive direction as well.
   Their clothes aren't really well organized by size, but the place is generally clean and sorted

I live across the street from this little slice of heaven now. And having this place just a choke-down 6 iron from my DirecTV dish is bad for both my wallet and my waistline. Who needs to cook when you can get better food than you can make that close??

The only good thing about the red velvet cupcakes is that they're so big, I know I can't finish one and splitting with my roommate is always a necessity. Same goes for the peanut butter ones. Plus the bakery needs the pretzel sticks other Publix's carry. I know they aren't healthy, but they are delicious.

I had a Boar's Head sub for lunch today (again). It ain't Wawa, and it ain't cheap, but it's really, really good. And the fried chicken? OH YOU SUBLIME DEAD POULTRY CARCASS!! I think the skin is covered in the nectar of heaven.

My new recommendation is the pizza with alfredo sauce and sausage. It's $11, and almost Sally O'Neal's level of quality. The marinated grilled chicken and mac and cheese in the cold cooler by the ovens are really good too, but get there before 8:30-9pm if you want them heated up, otherwise you're forced to actually turn on your oven. And who in South Tampa ever does such a thing?? We GRILL, we don't cook!! 

/STD-bag status 

Is the $40 a pound kobe beef tenderloin a bit ridiculous? Absolutely. And who knew buffalo ran over $20 a pound too? Plus there's more organic crap that they overcharge for than I can count. But there's also some pretty amazing food, especially if you're single because it's better, easier, and often healthier than cooking yourself.

Don't come for the grocery shopping, or the wine, or the cheeses, or the beef... you can get them cheaper somewhere else. Just come for the regular food, and let them cook it for you. It's not a supermarket, it's a super place for food.

I  loved this restaurant. The place is small and it appears that you will be moving forever, but the line moved quickly. Our server was very polite.

Between the 4 of us, we ordered:
- The Chicken and waffle. Really good. The gravy does make the waffle soft/soggy, so if that doesn't bother you then I'd definitely suggest. 
- Let's Do The Twist Creme Brulee French Toast. I tasted it and it was really good. My cousin said that it was very filling. 
-  The Hangover flatbread. This was a very interestingly good idea. It's something I'd like to make at home for my children. Delicious.
- Million Dollar Quartet. This was pretty simple. My cousin chose a double order of pancakes, bacon (which she thought was burnt a little), and eggs.

Not sure if I'd ever go back to Nashville, but if fate made it where I had to, I would definitely visit Sun Diner again.
Good service and great attention to detail. Joe, Mike, Chris and Will are the best! A great experience.

Terrible service. I wanted some protein so the staff member whips out the pyramid chart and says I need to buy glucose and 2 different types of protein and blah blah blah. I explained I usually buy my protein online and wanted a small tub to tie me over. Might as well of insulted his family. He was visibly angry that I wouldn't listen to his pyramid chart!!

Crawling out of my skin while I lay here currently. Stayed her based off someone's recommendation and couldn't regret it more. First room was not the king suite I was described on the phone when I booked, it has no pull out couch. Got moved to a different room. Room is very large with a queen bed and a crappy pull out. Found a chunk of hair sitting on top of shower drain, a dead roach on the living room floor, and the ac wasn't working. Ac go fixed, but is still one of the crappiest run down rooms and bedding I have ever seen. Pool is the only redeeming quality of this place, but even that isn't worth the $230 price tag. Wish I would have stayed at one of the nicer downtown establishments

This is my husbands favorite pizza place! It's a great choice when you don't feel like cooking! I always go for the Hawaiian "aloha" pizza but my next choice is the porky pig if you don't like pineapple on your pizza! We always get breadsticks with extra nacho cheese to top it off! My only complaint would be that often the breadsticks are a bit too salty. Last but not least - be sure to check out the pie of the week for 1/2 off!

It is hot and sticky inside the bus on an 87° day. The 1050 bus from nyc to Philly departed at 1140 am. Not a single apology for the lateness. They told us it would be 15 minutes late when the bus was already late by 5 minutes. They were off by 35 minutes. Wifi? Hahaha a joke! They don't even have the courtesy to piss on us and say it is water. Instead, there is no wifi. Seats are tight for anyone above 6ft tall. This is my first time on megabus and I will not be taking megabus again nor recommending it to anyone.
It took a while (maybe ~30-40 minutes), but the food was delicious! I ordered the Monte Cristo and friends ordered the vege po boy, shrimp po boy, and jambalaya. Would recommend!

Amazing customer service- super friendly, polite will be eating here again-
Be prepared to spend some money! Good food costs more, Sorry
Didn't eat here - looked like a filthy beach bar - no social distancing or masks, people crowded on each other - I am not a big Covid rule follower but felt like I would catch here!
The best donuts in town! We've tried a few places but Sweet Sensations is BY FAR the best around! We drive 20 minutes to get them :)

All I can say is blue ribbon special. I love his diner for the 2am munchies after the bar. I will be the first to tell you the food won't blow you away but the prices will. Cheapest breakfast in town, and GREAT service
Great tour.  Worth the time.  You will gain great insight into how cigars are made, differences in hand rolled versus machine made, the history in America, and so much more.

I have never been happier with donuts or customer service in my entire life! 

I saw that Dough had key lime pie donuts on their Facebook page. Key lime pie is my all time fave dessert so I knew I had to try them. 

I went on the UberEATS app and ordered the chef's choice of 3 donuts. It was 4 pm by then so I assumed they may have run out of the key lime pie by then. My exact UberEATS note was "PLEASE FOR THE LOVE OF EVERYTHING THAT IS GOOD AND HOLY, CAN I HAVE A KEY LIME PIE DONUT?! Please!"

My order arrived 20 minutes later and to my extreme satisfaction, my box had not one, BUT TWO key lime pie donuts. I cried. I ate. I cried some more. Thank you Dough!

Ate here about a month ago, it was good but the one thing my husband and I can't forget is how curt and borderline rude the blond teenage gal taking the orders at the very front of the line was.  Seemed as if she was done with people that geeeee, I don't know, actually order their pizzas with her!?  It was our first time there so we had a couple of questions but she didn't seem to be able to want to deal with that.  Even though there was no one behind us, her whole vibe was, "Keep it moving."  Sheesh!  You can do better, Blaze, I believe.  I hope you're reading these reviews, looks like I'm not the one one that has encountered somewhat "eh" service here.  Too bad, because the pizza's delicious.

Enjoyed visiting this cozy space packed with a lot of history. This place has a front patio and two dining buildings. The main entrance is the bar and more lively side. The over flow seating is in the building next door. It's very quiet over there and they just have one large tv. There is a parking lot specifically for this restaurant which is very nice, you don't have to worry about finding a spot or paying for parking. During my visit the owner was there and came to our table for a quick chat. I'm not sure what we did but he gave us feee mozzarella sticks!

Im originally from Philly but have been living down south for 20 years now. I was back home for Super Bowl 52 weekend and our server was very nice and helpful and gave us a lot of suggestions and far a night life and places to shop that may still have Super Bowl gear before the big game!

We discovered Smiling Buddha a couple of months ago. In that time, we've had take out with friends for dinner, and dined for lunch three times...even though it's a 45 minute drive for us!

The first surprise when entering Smiling Buddha is the elegantly-dressed tables and chairs. They are sort of over-the-top in their gold and red satin-y fabric, but that makes it unique. It's a nice change from the stark, no-dressing tables, paper napkin, plastic-ware that we're used to when we think of "fast-food" Chinese. Smiling Buddha is WAY above fast-food fare. The second surprise is the super friendly staff. Someone greets you at the door with a smile, quickly brings you a menu and takes your drink order (and keeps your drinks filled!). All with a smile and an attitude that makes it obvious they appreciate your business. How nice!

If you go for dinner, the menu is extensive and also beautifully presented. For lunch, the menu is pared down but offers great choices at a great price. The dinner menu offers Appetizers, Soups, Salads, Vegetarian, Fried Rice, Noodles, Seafood, Beef, Pork, Chicken, Chef's Specials and Desserts. Some of the dishes that are most popular are their General Tso's Chicken, Thai Spicy Chicken (sliced chicken and spicy jalapeno peppers and veggies in a spicy Thai sauce), Mongolian Beef (sliced flank steak), Lemongrass Pork (pork strips sauteed with lemongrass and Thai chili with fish sauce) and Stir Fried Garlic Scallops. I also recommend the Pot Stickers. They are large, cooked properly, come 4 to an order for $4. Well worth it! Oh, and the friend rice isn't greasy at all.

Their entrees range from $9 to $20 with most being $12-13. Their lunch specials are $7 to $9 and include soup, fried or white rice and a crab rangoon.

Lastly, they have a pretty good beer selection with most being in the $2.50 to $3.00 range. Very reasonable!

Try Smiling Buddha and you'll be pleasantly surprised. John has waited on us several times and he's friendly, attentive and helps to make the dining experience enjoyable.

PS: The ladies room is tidy and that is a guide for me when assessing a restaurant, although it could use a hook to hang my purse and jacket.

This was absolutely the best for families. The pirate crew was superb. They paid special attention to each child making sure each was enjoying the games, water gun fight, the hunt for hidden loot and just generally having a great pirate experience. Wish I could give a 10 star review!!!
Some of the best pizza in Philly!!!! The ingredients are so fresh and yummy! I tasted many of the pizzas they offer and each one is better than the next! I can't wait to come back and try a new one!
Hand washed and shiny new.  Always a great place to have a wash and vacuum.  Friendly staff and you can sit in their very nice beach chairs while you wait.

This is one of my favorite restaurants in Santa Barbara. We love sitting upstairs on the balcony and soaking in all of the Local atmosphere. It's especially fun on a rainy day. One of my favorite dishes Would be the oysters. The staff is always very friendly.
Pierce was our server & was awesome! We sat outside, mask are required while inside. Pierce went through all the specials right away and but I go with the blue motherfucker every time!!!

This Applebee's is a goat rodeo. As soon as we come in we are told there will be a wait of 30 minutes to an hour. However as we scan the room it is clear that the restaurant is half empty. And half of the tables that aren't available aren't occupied, just dirty. We've been waiting ten minutes so far and not one employee has made any effort to clean a table. We came for service and got nothing but excuses.

Just started ordering regularly from Brothers. We were looking for a gluten and dairy-free pizza (yuck, right?) and they had it! The chef even told me that he used a special tomato sauce that has no cheese in it and is very flavorful. They make a special effort to accommodate me every time I go in and the chef  (probably owner) comes to speak to me each time. It's very very good pizza. It's not the same as raised dough though and the normal stuff is better but for gluten free it's GREAT!!!

This was the home of the best food I ate in New Orleans!

We started with the signature drinks and Etouffee Poutine, which was phenomenal- I almost cried after the first bite! I then had the blackened Red Fish Po Boy, which was absolutely enormous! The flavor combo was on point, and it could have fed at least 2 people.

Whether you're getting take-out, or are dining in, I highly recommend going to Mambos!

I originally went to the city cat clinic in forest park, and they were really hateful. So you can imagine how apprehensive I was before I went here. This is the hands down best vet I've been to. They are so sweet and professional, the treat your cats so well. I love how they explain everything to you and teach you without making you feel incompetent (like the city cat clinic). I took both of my cats here to get checkups and shots. I also got my cat neutered here. They were great both times, it was most definitely worth the drive. They make sure you have everything you need for your cats. 10/10

Been coming here since it opened. Service and food quality have only gone down hill. Tonight we waited to be seated for 10 minutes because the host was on his phone in the kitchen. Server took forever for drinks then the bar  wouldn't send beer samples, so we paid for the kids drinks and went somewhere else to eat.

Avoid this place under all circumstances. We will never return.

Love this shop! We had a simple interaction with them that was quick and easy. We needed a wreath stand for a memorial service and we needed it within a 24-hour turnaround.

Though they didn't have it, they were able to get it for us in time! The price was a little steep for our liking, but we needed it so we obliged.

This was our only experience, so we can't really speak to the flowers or arrangements and therefore why we only feel comfortable giving 4 stars.
Absolutely loved the atmosphere & food was incredible. Definitely recommend the scallops!!
Great experience with friends and our server, Johnna did an amazing job. She went above and beyond to make sure we were fully accommodated! Definitely recommend!

I wish I had more hands!!!!!!  Id give this bank four thumbs down!!!!!!!! Every time I have gone to this bank, the ATM was unable to accept deposits or some other malfunction. The inside is no better slowest service I have ever seen in awhile. I blame management for allowing things to be so bad. I dread having to go to this place for anything.

I went during the time assigned for knitting help.  There was a class that had just let out when I arrived. I waited for help, and when I left the shop I was the only customer there. The owner didn't even have the courtesy to tell me she was "too busy" to help me, instead she had the cashier tell me.  If you're a knitter visit Tangled Web in Chestnut Hill.  They have a much bigger selection of yarn and they're actually willing to help their clients with quick questions.
Delicious food    had the lamb shank pot pie and mussels.  Fabulous meal,  the pot pie was enough to share.  Nice table outside to people watch right there on central.

My wife and I have an IKEA Friheten couch that we've pretty much kept clean for about 5 years but noticed that it was beginning to have an odor. I looked up upholstery cleaners and contacted a few but KC Carpet and Upholstery was by far the quickest in response time and professionalism. I emailed them and sent a picture of the couch, they sent me a quote which was the cheapest of all the other companies and all I needed to give them was my phone number and address to confirm the cleaning. We set up a date and they gave me a time window in which the techs would be around to do the cleaning. One day before the scheduled date, I was given a call to confirm the cleaning time. The day of, I was contacted by Kevin and notified that he'd be getting here. Kevin and Gavin were extremely informative and professional. Kevin walked me through their process, explained their products and provided reasonable expectations for the cleaning's outcomes. I asked how much our area rug would be to clean (because I hadn't even thought about them being able to clean the area rug) and he threw it in FOR FREE! They literally took no more than 20 minutes to beautifully clean both items. They left no mess and went off to their next stop. SO pleased with their service and will be using them from now on for all our carpet/upholstery cleaning needs!

Ok hookah.. the place looks very beat up and old. The staff doesn't pay attention  and doesn't recommend much of anything for the flavors. They don't have food. It's. Ambiance isn't so great and too loud to hold a conversation.

Prepare to drive around the parking lot or park at Dante's Fire during a busy weekend (Tucson location). The good thing is they have a waitlist you can join on Yelp which greatly reduces your wait time. I try to support local whenever I can, but Snooze had a fun atmosphere (while being socially distanced), great service, and great tasting food. Our server, Alex, was friendly, helpful, but not cloying and she was quick to serve my friend that arrived later. Check out my food pics. Definitely worth a try!

Have been going to the Toddy clinic in Hermitage for a while now.  I had a two level disc fusion in my lower back.  The surgery helped a ton, but was still having minor nerve pain.  I went in to have acupuncture done.  The acupuncture was a great success.  But what impressed me most about the clinic was the attention to patient needs and never feeling rushed.  I am now going back due to some headaches I'm having from stress and they are taking their time and putting me on a wellness plan for that.  I can't say enough good things about Dr. Liz in Hermitage.

It feels like Postino is the place that everyone has been suggesting recently to meet at to grab a glass of wine and catch up, which I am definitely happy about!
The atmosphere is perfect with inside and outside seating options. Staff checks on you an appropriate amount - your glass is never empty if you don't want it to be but they don't come by too frequently either. 
The food is good, maybe not somewhere I would pick first for dinner, but great for snacks to accompany your drink! I have not yet made it to their charcuterie board night, but that is a goal of mine in the upcoming weeks.

As soon as you step out of your car and the smell from the smokers hit you, your mouth starts to water. The food here did not disappoint. I had the brisket and ribs and both was awesome. There was no sauce needed for either. The Mac and 4 cheese was very good as well. The potato salad was a little different but good. It was no where close to my moms, but no one can compete with mom . It had a bit of horseradish and the red potatoes made for a nice change. The atmosphere here is very lively with lots of TVs for watching sports. They have a very nice outdoor seating area with a firepit. They are right on the Monon trail so you could stop in while out riding or walking the trail. I can't forget about they wait staff which are all friendly, and very helpful.

Caney Fork is the worst, the absolute worst. The food was cold and awful but that's the least of their problems. They'll survive dishing out subpar food with their poor service by catering to the huge tourist traffic from Opryland and that's a shame.  Went their for dinner, it wasn't very busy but it took our waiter more than 15 minutes to come to our table for our drink order after being seated. I'm usually gone by then, but we had already waited 30 minutes to be seated. When my wife cut to the chase and said that we were ready to order our dinner, the waiter acted like she had committed a felony. It's funny when waiters don't think their expressions and their sighs don't say a thousand words. To far in to cut our losses, we forged ahead and made our order. Again not busy, curious that we had to wait so long for both the food and drinks. By this time my daughter was beyond first world hunger having skipped lunch, her fault. Our dinners arrived, cold and awful. Here's the best part, I ordered a rib eye medium rare and got a sirloin medium well to well done, I guess the waiter thought I was ordering steak for the first time. The waiter never came to our table unless he needed to (i.e to get our order, to deliver our order, and give us our bill) so I had to flag him down to point out the "mistake", the only thing he offered was that he make the change in the bill. We couldn't get out of there fast enough. Thankfully he didn't offer to give me the correct cut of steak cooked properly to my request, I would not put spitting on food past these guys. The bill arrives and of course, they still have the charge for the rib eye, we ask for the manager. We explain the mistake on the bill and this guy ask what we want him to do... Enough said, stay clear of Caney Fork
Best deep dish pizza around, made to perfection every time. Owners are always on site and very friendly. Hate that they're moving into speedway.
great experience here. came 3 times. attentive service, great food, great atmosphere.  A bit on the loud side but not too bad at all.

First time I went there and had the chicken parm, it was awesome. The garlic bread was so flavorful and awesome, I could kill all the sparkling "vampires" (because vampires don't sparkle, fairies do) in twlight by breathing on them. The pasta melted in my mouth, I didn't have to chew. Place was amazing, was kind of disappointed about their desserts though, as they're not made there but ordered from some place, in california. Either way food was still good.

The place is better on the inside then it looks on the outside.  I stopped for a quick lunch while working in the area.  I arrived shortly after 1pm.  The place had about 3 tables filled, but I still waited over 5 minutes to be greeted.  When I finally got a menu, it took the server at least 10 minutes to return to take my order.  I was nearly ready to walk out when she came to take the order.

I ordered a lunch special of chicken salad sandwich on toast, fries, cup of soup for $7.99.  The soup was quick to be served and was delicious.  Again, I waited.....When the sandwich arrived it was huge.  Lots of chicken salad with a huge clump of iceburg lettuce.  The crust on the bread was burnt, so I did not eat it.   The chicken salad was bland and very unflavorful.  The fries was abundant and were fresh, hot and delicious.  The server never checked back during the entire meal.  I did not receive a check, but finally got up and walked to the register where she greeted me warmly and took my money.  It took just ofer an hour for my quick lunch!

If you are in a hurry, choose somewhere else.  I would not recommend the chicken salad.  The Italian Wedding soup was the standout of this visit.

I have been here twice and both times it was a success. The servers are quick and friendly when I asked them questions. There's a nice patio on the back side to enjoy the weather and good food. I had armadillo eggs to start which where really good with shredded chicken and jalapeños. And I ended with there bourbon black burger which was jam with onions and blue cheese and a sweet sauce. I personally thought it was alright but my experience was over all great. I would come here to check out other menu items.
Can't really add much that hasn't been said already. Great pizzas, pretty good service for a good casual outing. Their wine is not the best. That would be my only complaint.
Went here for a corporate dinner with some clients and was very pleased. Service was excellent and the food was too. Everyone at the table was pleased!

Shauna's comment is spot on.  Billy is truly wonderful.  I've gotten exactly what I've wanted the two times I've gone to Odabu already.  Yes, Billy takes a fair amount of time for a cut because your hair will be perfect.  However, please respect Billy's time.  If you come late to an appointment you will make Billy late in getting finished for the next person.  Often customers are back to back because Odabu is in demand. 10/10 would recommend, be sure to make an appointment and please be on time.

I'm not usually a big fan of Chinese-Japanese fusion cuisine, but Golden China is an exception. They were on time, hot and fresh. The Thai basic chicken was excellent with tons of fresh vegetables and the sushi is consistently fresh! The waitresses always have a smile on their face which makes me feel good!

I have been in a couple of sweet tooth joints like this one. Orange Leaf is a place that comes to mind. You walk in, pick up a cone or paper container, and create your own dessert. There are a variety of ice creams, toppings, cones, and containers. At the register, you pay according to the weight of what you make. That in mind, I was a little frustrated by my visit. I happened to walk in with a couple of big families, and having really indecisive adults mulling over the myriad choices at each station along with kids playing around with the machines created quite a back-up. What would have been a five minute visit became a fifteen minute one--kind of annoying. Not in a hurry to return but might if I'm in the area and the mood strikes me.

Pizzeria Nonna is a relative newcomer to pizzerias in the far northwest of Philadelphia. I didn't find anything spectacular about my experience with them but yet I'm glad I ordered from them

Let's get to the positives and maybe not-as-positives. On the positive side if you are eating-in,  Pizzeria Nonna is large with few different eating nooks.  It also has a couple of pool tables and a few large TVs. There is also a bar area. On the negative side they like too many pizzerias I know are either total optimists or poor prognosticators of when a pizza will be ready for pick-up.  Twice now they have almost doubled the wait time that I was originally given on the phone. I would recommend trying to improve on this aspect.

Now the best news is that as one of their offerings they serve a style of pizza that I quite like and it has state ties.  In upstate Pennsylvania there is a town called Old Forge which has developed its own pizza style that has become quite well-known in Eastern PA.  The Old Forge style of pizza is a rectangular pizza with a light but crispy crust.  First on are diced or razor thin onions followed by a sweeter tomato sauce topped with at least three different types of cheeses.  A pizza in upstate Pennsy is not called a pie but a tray and a slice is called a cut.  (You can Google for further info.)  I ordered their Old Forge pizza and it was not only huge but also tasty.  Try this unique style pizza and I think you might agree. That's why I am giving Pizzeria Nonna four stars!

After waiting a good bit at the window of the drive thru to get my latte, the girl wasn't paying attention I suppose and double lidded my coffee and didn't seal the lid. I drove off took a sip, just for my BOILING coffee to pour all over my chest and lap. I had blisters on my abdomen after that. That is seriously dangerous. Luckily I wasn't out in the road yet. I was so upset. I emailed their contact email to inform them what had happened so maybe it won't happen again and I was very disappointed that I never got a response or apology from management. Seems like the entire business just doesn't care nor pay attention.

Great tacos, delicious guacamole and their tortas (flatbreads) are really good. Affordable, delicious Mexican cuisine and really happy there's a good Mexican option in the suburbs other than the usual chains.
I can't say enough good things about Jack and Mindy.....they both do an EXCELLENT job!!

Some of the better chinese I've found in the area. We had General Tso's Chicken, a spring roll, miso soup, and some sushi. All the food was good. The prices are okay. The service was good. The one thing I will say is, as others have mentioned, the restaurant needs to be cleaner. The place is a bit run down, and just overall seems to need a deep clean or maybe even new carpet, booths, etc. Wound rate 3.5 stars if possible due to lack of cleanliness.
Stopped in for the iced mocha and iced coffee. Both had good flavors and reasonably priced!

Food and wine.  The new whispering vine location is nothing short of genius.  They got a chef who does the most amazing small plate selection ever.  The shrimp and grits (mind blowing), clans and mussels, and the short rib sliders....were heavenly.  They had amazing wines to with the food.  They are not wine snobs either, beer was available along with great scotches.  If I had to make a complaint it would be the fact that they close so early at 10 pm.
Delicious and closest to Cali Mexican we can get. Huge portions and we love the burritos and salads.

Really good food. It's my first time here, I got the chicken fettuccine Alfredo with an added crab cake. The sauce was really good and the chicken was great. Overall very authentic Cajun food. 5 starts all the way.  Server was very good as well, constantly checking on us, refills when we needed and food personality.

Alright. My name is Jen and I have a problem...
My first review left off with me saying that my husband was jealous that my young daughter and I came without him after we raved about it. So we finally brought him and my older daughter for brunch. French Toast and the Grilled Cheese (darn tasty tomato bisque) were awesome. Tri-Tip Sliders so far, is the only dish that we were not crazy about (yes, we get dishes to swap/trade/sample). The tri-tip was a little too dry and the cheddar biscuit was unable to hold up as a slider.  But the Breakfast Poutine...oh wow. That is a dish that is sinfully amazing. Pork belly and the duck fat gravy will send you into cardiac arrest for more than one reason. 
Went back for another visit today (this time with a much bigger party who had never been) and we were delighted how quickly they accommodated us. This time we were able to try several more dishes and each one was stellar. The Veggi Beni (my 8 year old made it very difficult to share bites as she was loving every bit of such an innovative dish) and the Cubano were the highlights of today's visit.  
This review would not be complete without the mention of the recently added liquor options. I love my booze, but I'm not crazy about beer or tomatoes. So I found it rather interesting that I kept stealing sips of my husband's Bloody Mary (made with garlic infused vodka) and served with a coffee pressed beer back. Even the sample of the Iron Jack beer that we got to try was quite tasty.  The Old Fashioned Mimosa was delightful as well.  
Special thanks to Nathan who always seems to be around checking on his guests and ensuring that everyone is well fed and content. Definitely makes our patronage feel appreciated. 
So my problem?? Well seems that my first visit has turned me into an addict. Will be seeking treatment soon. But only after a few more visits to Prep & Pastry.

If you have a mind to eat at the Macaroni Grill on Oxford Valley Rd. DON'T.  3 of us in one party got serious food poisoning there.  The  management won't answer our complaints.  Look at the Bucks County Board of Health's inspection results from there it is a toilet.  Here is the diagnosis from one in our party who suffered for 3 weeks and is still ill. I am not posting her name.

Hi everyone. So the diagnosis is "post gastritis - IBS caused by a bacteria infection. FOOD POISONING. Just affected me differently. Could be weeks till I feel better. I really don't have the words for what I wanna do to those people at Macaroni Grill.

Probably one of the worst sushi places in Reno/Sparks. All of our nigiri came out warm and was hard to swallow. Tempura items were soggy and all the rolls very small and fall apart. We paid over $100 for our family to eat and left hungry because we couldn't stomachs it. Appetizers were basic items from the Costco frozen section. Also very rude customer service. We had our children with us who LOVE sushi and were asked if we were doing all you can eat before she set anything down on the table near the children - multiple times. Dropped food and never returned, after asking for our bill with 90% of the sushi still sitting there, didn't even both to ask us anything.

This place has a lot of tradition and history, the location reflects that.

Our Waiter was very accommodating as we were most likely not their typical diners.  My kids and I decided during our time in the Big Easy, we were going to attempt to sample the local cuisine as much as possible.  So we all ordered the various platters and asked for several extra plates.  He looked at us a bit weird and once I explained what we were doing, he smiled and said that's a great idea.  

Everything we ordered was terrific, but the Jambalya and the Shrimp Maque Choux really stand out in my mind when I think back to our mid morning lunch.

Going here was like taking a trip to my Russian Grandma's. I have been wanting to go here for a while now and the food exceeded my expectations. It's the only Russian restaurant in the state and the food is beyond incredible. The owner, Gregory, plays the piano quite beautifully as you dine. The owners are a friendly and sweet Russian couple. It's right by the Castleton Square Mall. Not a restaurant to miss. The atmosphere is built for however you would like to dress. It's small and intimate.

We were looking for Asian food in the area. We originally wanted Kooma because my step daughter wanted the food there but they were closed. 

We went a few blocks down and found this gem. We walked in and the decor was beautiful. Being Asian I was skeptical because there were no Asian employees. I questioned the authenticity. 

We sat down and ordered drinks. My fiance took the waiter's recommendation on the Thai basil mojito. It was delicious! We ordered the floating market appetizer sampler and everything was very tasty. 

My fiance and I shared the chicken green curry and  the shrimp pad Thai. We got both spicy and it was definitely spicy. We loved  it. My step daughter liked the flavor of the green curry but it was too spicy for her taste. We were shocked because she is a picky eater and normally doesn't like curry. 

We also had the ubon fried rice and the larb. She liked those dishes too. 

We were pleasantly surprised and will definitely be back. Oh they also had a live local band playing which liven things up on a Sunday evening.
This tour really made our trip to new orleans! lots of great stories! Aubrey was our tour guide and she was amazing!!! I highly recommend the ghost and vampire tour with aubrey!!

Customer service wasn't great, worker seemed annoyed to have a customer. Got a cookie and a blueberry cupcake. Cookie tasted like any grocery store bakery cookie. Was underwhelmed by the cupcake as well. Much better places in the Tampa area.
My favorite nail salon in Philly. Great facility, great staff, clean! Get the signature pedicure and manicure.

Can you say WALGREENS?!!! 

This is the worst pharmacy I have ever been too! Crazy packed, not enough workers, long lines and no communication! I waited in the drive through for over 30 minutes! Then when I got up they told me they are having trouble finding my prescription causing me to wait another 30 minutes. I ended up turning off my car and waiting as I watched the drive through line pile up. Very frustrating! I have never had this experience at walgreens!
If you love high prices ! If you Love cigar smoke blown in your face while you are eating..  if you love average service ( can't blame the help ). You will LOVE this place !!     Cheers !

Ok, so I still like this place, but I have to be honest here- 
I finally visited for Soul Food Sunday and was sadly, excruciatingly, disappointed. I was really excited because my parents are from Alabama, I'm from GA- about as southern as it gets. That being said, I know what soul food is and this ain't that. If anything, this food hurt my soul. 
We started with the Bloody Mary which was good, not my favorite, but comes topped with a bbq rib which was really tasty and unfortunately turned out to be probably the best part of the meal. I ordered the chicken and waffles, collard greens on the side. My date had the ribs and brisket with beans and we split a side of the bacon Mac n cheese. The menu states the chicken dish comes with two drumsticks and one thigh. When I receivedmy order, I was presented with three super dry, boneless skinless chicken thighs. Now, I like chicken, but these were barely edible. Come on guys, fried chicken needs the bone! And where were the drumsticks? The collards were undercooked and overly sweet. The only thing I ended up eating was the waffle, which was really good, but perhaps I was just hungry since the rest of my meal was a crushing disappointment. My date said his food was average. I can see someone who wasn't truly southern liking this. However, If you're a true southerner like me, (sorry Ella's) I'd say to look elsewhere for your soul food fix.

Amazing food and incredible service!  Had a big crowd and they handled it very well.  Also advised that since the portions are big, not to order individual plates, so he made dishes to share (lamb, steak and chicken).  Everything was great

One of the best restaurants Ive eaten at.  The scallops were amazing, with a cilantro sauce and a chipotle mash...  YUM!!  Crab stuffed chicken, was a huge portion I could not finish it.  I wanted to so very much because it was amazing! Twice baked potato was a nice option for the side.  Mu husband got steak and it was prepared perfectly.  Wish I lived closer!

After looking at the Happy Hour specials, my friends are I were incredibly excited to head in. Once arriving, it was lackluster at best. 

We were served two baskets of chips. The first were mostly all crumbs, but we figured it was the bottom of the bag, so it was fine. Once that basket was finished the second one came out identical. It was roughly 40 minutes after the first basket. 

As for drinks, they came out after our tacos had arrived to the table. Expecting the entire event to be under an hour, the whole stay lasted around 1.5 hours or more. There were under 10 people there. 

Overall, I was dissatisfied with the experience. I'd go back for the Happy Hour maybe, but never on a regular week night.

We got an Airbnb right across this place and the first two days we stayed there, we were soo confused as to why there was a line WRAPPED around the building. After researching it, we decided the next day to see what all the hype was about. I will say, it's extremely organized and efficient. No reservations, only standing in line. I stood in line for around 40 min. The pancakes were delicious no doubt. Got some scrambled eggs on the side and hashbrowns. I don't think this was the BEST brunch place I've been to or the best pancakes I've had. But it's cool to say that I've stood in this crazy line and tried this spot. The eating process was a little rushed, which is understandable because the line is so crazy. And then we had to stand in another 10 min line to pay. But besides that, it was good and I'm glad that we tried it.

First time at Cheng's and we were beyond pleased with the food and service. For starters it was very clean inside. We tried the sesame chicken and Mongolian beef and enjoyed the lunch options that came with soup, egg roll, wontons, rice and chicken wing. Looking forward to trying other dishes soon!

When the battery on my wife's car died, and I was out of town on business, I had to scramble to help her get back on the road.  I reasoned that it was better to try local than to pay to tow it to the dealership.  I reached out to the closest place I could find.  Ed Ebert's Automotive is a half mile from our home.

Mike was kind enough to stop by, get the car started, and take the car back to his shop to replace the battery.   When my wife and daughter walked down to pick it up an hour later, my wife reported how polite and helpful Mike and Arlene were and my four year old got a lollipop.

We are appreciative for their service, and relieved to have a trustworthy auto mechanic located so close to home.  

Thank you,
Colin

Chicken bahn mi was super good. I initially wasn't sure because it didn't have pate on it if it was going to be dry, but the chicken was freshly grilled and the scallion oil on it was delicious. I also enjoyed a fruit tea! I love in Brandon but it will be a must have when I'm in the Wesley Chapel area. Just finished my last bite and want another now!
Great Veterinarian and staff, always so kind and helpful they have genuine concern for my pets. Prices are very competitive and easy to handle.
Fat bastard... Don't be fooled. The Bun is literally a honey bun meaning its a donut! Interesting is to say the least.

Spot on. Lovely place. We ordered a salad with a a few of their appetizers. It was absolutely amazing. Salad was refreshing and delicious. The tartar and enchiladas were amazing. I ordered a glass of Bordeaux. Spot on. Absolutely amazing place. The waiter was great the front desk was smiley and welcoming. Would certainly recommend.

Our pups are always happy to be there.  

I love that when we board them we can set up a "bedtime story" so they get one on one time before bedtime, just like at home.

I also love that they get extra activities during day care and we get a "report card" letting us know which pups they played with and what enrichment activities they did!

Normally I would include a photo, But the food was so good and I was so hungry, I forgot! I would describe the decor as urban city meets country home. I would describe the food as very good, but a little pricey for the quantity you get. And yet another breakfast place that doesn't offer hash browns, but that's just personal preference. All that said, I will be back, because the food is tasty!

It's our new favorite restaurant in NOLA.  We experienced the best charred oysters ever and I had my first Hennessy sidecar which was perfect.  The gumbo was out of this world and the fried chicken would battle the best (please don't tell Willie Mae or Dookie Chase!).  It will be our first stop when we return to NOLA for sure.

Very big menu had the fish and chips very good hot and fresh, wife had the breaded shrimp very good and hot and fresh. Kids had the biscuits and gravy and French toast sticks tried the biscuits and gravy and it was very good to bad I don't live in Boise or I would be a regular.

Service is insanely slow.... Like painfully slow. Came here in a Thursday afternoon, was told there would be a 10 min wait. No big deal however the wait turned into 30 minutes. Got seated and waited an additional 15min for a server to show up. Was getting ready to pack up and leave when she showed up to take drink orders. We saw the writing on the wall and decided to order our appetizer and entrée right away. Both courses came out at the exact same time... Mildly annoying. Meal was mediocre, nothing spectacular about it. We kept having to ask for drink refills and it would take her insanely long to even come back with drinks! Asked for the check and waited even longer..... I understand service being slow during peak hours however, this is a Thursday afternoon and wasn't busy.

If you are in New Orleans and are able to stop by Southern Candymakers, they have a very good assortment of chocolates.  Their tortues are amazing.  However, Southern Candymakers are extremely poor in customer service when it comes to mail ordering chocolates. The quality of the chocolates delivered are usually damaged, over priced and not delivered within the standard mailing time.

I have eaten lunch here several times and LOVE it.  Their Tarte Flambe (Gruyere, bacon, carmelized onion) is amazing, as is their Margherita. (a classic Margherita doesn't have sauce...and in my opinon...shouldn't.)  The garlic knots and cheese sauce are very yummy.  It's true that the crust is floppy.  You can't pick up a piece and eat it, but that doesn't bother me.  The crust is thin, but well cooked and I love the texture.

Caveats - wait time for food can be longer than I like.  One visit the pizza ovens needed additional time to get up to the proper temperature (we were given a discount).  The pizzas cook quickly but they can only cook one, maybe two at a time so if the restaurant is busy, that can mean a wait to get your pie in the oven.  It can sometimes be too warm in the restaurant as the oven is right there out on the floor.  Servers are wonderful.  All in all, I'll be back for the yummy pizza.

Love this place! The food is delicious every time! The atmosphere is so cozy. Which is why- Over the weekend I hosted my 40th birthday party here. We had 33 guests. Rented the whole space 11am-3pm. Their party planner was so helpful throughout the entire process. The menu was delicious. There was a pasta dish, a chicken dish and a short rib dish option. The dessert options were cannoli and gelato. Delicious!!! The staff managed the entire day perfectly. The room was beautiful. The food was great as always. I can't say enough good things about how much I loved hosting my party here!

Fun, food and lots of happy people. One of the best fall festivals in the city... larger then most... with a good portion of it on a wider section of Second Street. A great event to be at and experience that Northern Liberties vibe.

Everyone, including the servers at the Bridgeport Rib House were having a blast when we arrived  at this popular local watering hole.
