The beers were flowing steadily and the still service was impeccable. Lots of people decorated the tables and bar tops with good vibes, smiles and laughter. Everyone seemed to be really enjoying (including me) the Grateful Dead cover Band called " Four Lean Hounds ". We were able to find a table and actually could still see the band from their side room under a large fish tank that was reminiscent of a college frat house Fish tank. This spot basically a local is watering hole "dive bar" with a retro basement feel.  There were certainly a few bikers left over from the 'biker bar' days who were probably scratching their heads wondering where all these other people came from. Everyone was getting along swimmingly and the whole night was super fun. We enjoyed some tasty chicken wings and a yummy smoked pork sandwich. The menu and food was to be expected (rib house fare) but good quality and our server was great. She was warm and friendly while she helpfully navigated the menu with us. When we left, in our Uber, we were wondering why we had never been there before. We have been checking their website for their live music calendar ever since and are Looking forward to going back and getting in there early for that premium spot at the bar. I loved it at the Bridgeport Rib House!
This place is amazing!!! I would eat their curry and jerk chicken all day every day but they don't have an open lot next to their restaurant ; )....
Above average meal and during the pandemic the service was above par. We ate early and enjoyed a nice summer day in the shade. We will visit again

Being a big beer guy I'm always excited to visit new breweries.  This place is about a 30 minute drive for me in Downtown Yardley PA.  From a distance, it looks like any other building in the area, but upon entering you realize it's much different.  The decor is very nice, high ceilings, immediate yeasty, malty smell - great first impression.  

The serving tanks are visible from the main seating area behind the bar.  The atmosphere is nice and the staff is friendly.   The menu is small as they mostly specialize in pizza and other finger food.  I was surprised to see the prices of some of the items on the menu.  Beers are $6 a glass and $8 for a flight including only 4 samples.  We decided to go with Pizza (all personal sized and starting at $12) and Beer Flights.

The pizza was just ok, but at $14 for a personal sized pizza I would have expected the best.  When the samplers came out, the person that brought them out had no idea which one was which.  At most breweries, the samples are labeled in some way which helps identify who ordered what, but this place does not label their flights and it caused a lot of confusion.  I ended up with my friend's flight, and had to do a bunch of swapping to get it right.  The beer was also just ok.  

Overall I think this place has a lot of potential.  I have to give them the benefit of the doubt since they just opened up and are probably getting into the swing of things.  They need to make major improvements on their pizza and also their beer, which unfortunately is the staple of their business.  They also need to work on their prices.  I'm not sure what type of customers they are trying to appeal to, but at these prices they might have a tough time appealing to a broader range of customers.  They might consider reducing prices, or consider making portion sizes bigger - and that goes for beer too.

Ok. The food was good. Good burger and decent fries. Wasn't a fan of the expensive drinks that are the bottled drinks from Mexico. The price is the issue. Waited 30 minutes for a seat which is ok I guess if You have the time. As I was entering something on the door caught my eye. A no firearms allowed sign. I normally would not support a business that takes away m constitutional right but we drove all that way just to eat there.  As soon as I walked in I realized why there was a no firearms sign. It was the run of the mill hipster joint. All that aside the food was good and the service was okay to say the least. The no firearms sign will stop me from ever coming back though.

The real Franco's!  Franco has taken his food to new heights.  I've had the pizza, the chicken Marsala, chicken tenders and the unbelievably incredible mozzarella sticks (I've missed them so much since he parted ways with his namesake restaurant: Franco's).  If you were a fan of Franco's and wondered why it wasn't as good anymore, it's because Franco left and started 'Thin and Crispy'.  His food is better than ever and it seems like he's just getting started.
Every time I come to this area from Long Island I stop and grab a early breakfast 5:45am ish. Staff is always friendly, food is cooked fast and the way I ask for it. It's a great all around diner.
Love this place, great ambiance, great food. Nice view of the River ! Nice place to go on a date.

Not going to lie. I was a little disappointed.

Okay, so the ambience is spectacular! I think the high ceilings and the old bank feel give this steakhouse a big push. Really feels like you're in a high end steakhouse. So, I was pretty excited about the rest of my experience, but this is where it went flat.

Service was weak. Takes a while to get to you or flag someone down sometimes, because the place is probably so large. Food was too salty. I mean I love steakhouses and how generous they are with salt and butter, but it was one time I was like "Whoa... too much." What made it a perfect storm was that I needed a fresh drink to wash down the salt, but I couldn't flag a waiter down.

I'd say if you're looking for the grand experience and ambience, go to Del Frisco's! If you want more, then... unfortunately I've experienced better (multiple times...).

One of my favorite brunch places in NoLA. Get the praline bacon. You're safe with any of the entrees. Nothing disappoints. Mimosas are huge and the food is amazing. If I die and go to heaven,there will be Elizabeth's. My favs are the steak and eggs, the burrito and the florintine dish. So good! Service rocks too!

The beer selection is extensive, but I don't think that the Irish Mile explains their draft list well.  I look at places that have 60 taps as a place to go and try a new beer.  The draft list is lacking a lot of information about the brews listed.  For the number of beers offered, I would have thought that there would be more diversity (although there could have been more diversity than I realized because of the lack of information about the beer).  However, if you like IPAs then this is the place for you, as there is a large selection.


Staff was inattentive, inexperienced and uninformed about what they were serving.  When asked about specifics of a beer for a recommendation they often contradicting each other in their descriptions.  

Cheap slices of pizza are a saving grace, but overall there are other bars in the area that have better service and a more diverse beer selection (even with fewer taps).
Not the best just ok. Texas road house is 10x better
So awesome, well done, and easy to find/get to.  Totally recommend it. We felt 20 a person was a fair tip for this lady, she did a great job. I hope all tip her that or more....

I have heard nothing good about Camping World in general. I called and spoke to Josh to consign my travel trailer. They were absolutely phenomenal through the entire process.  They did exactly what they promised to do, sell the unit in a week, and communicated the status on a consistent basis.  A+

Even though I experienced an incorrect order, I still think this place deserves some kudos.  To begin with, I felt their proces were very fair-especially offering sides of things like ranch for a mere 25 cents.  They use quality ingredients & are not skimpy with them.  I ordered the American Psycho & asked for no bacon.  Unfortunately, the bacon was there, but they omitted the avocado & for an avocado lover like me-that was a bummer.  The onion rings were fresh & crispy.  I did not call them to complain about my meal.  I felt that they made up for it in other ways & it didn't ruin my night.  In fact, the cats & dogs were pleased pets munching the bacon.

I just had a cheesesteak at the new Pats select pizzeria in Washington Township. I've had The best sandwich I've had in a very long time. Also the service year very quick I had my sandwich within five minutes of my order with the sandwich they offer free soda and they also offer free side of french fries. That's why I can get this five star rating and I can recommend this restaurant to anyone. It looks more than just a pizzeria it looks Like an actual restaurant. The Decour is also very excellent Interior design and the way the floorplan is laid out very organized.

So glad we asked Diligent to inspect our home purchase before it was too late. 
Dave found several easy to overlook, hard to get to (crawl space) problems that would have been a major issue if they weren't found until after closing. 
The builder appreciated the inspection: it revealed some problems with sub contractors incomplete work. He was grateful to fix before move in. 
Don't buy a used home, even with a down to the studs completely remodeled, without a Diligent inspection. Well worth the $. Thank you.

I went for a late lunch one day with the room mate (a localish dude) and had the Vegetarian sandwich on ciabatta..... OMG it was awesome!  Cheesy, big chunks of eggplant, tomatoes, artichokes..... warm bread and tasty fries..... Does it get any better?  No? Didnt think so....

This place has crazy wait times but worth it if they let you order drinks while you wait in front of the beach! Food was great, customer service is stellar! We had 3 people assist us at some point. Definitely would come back when in SB!

Prior to coming in, I had multiple engines lights on and one that was even starting to flash continuously over and started to make sounds.  As you can imagine I was nervous as to what was going on and if I could even make it to a local Pep Boys that was near my location (I typically go to Pep Boys, rather than a mom and pops auto shops).  Luckily, the Audubon Pep Boys was not that far out and I was able to make it there without my car falling apart.

I am glad I did because it was by far the best experience I've ever had at a Pep Boys location.  I had the pleasure to meet their Manager, Vinny, who helped me identify what was causing the multiple check-engine lights issues (and sounds) with my car.  He identified that it was a faulty thermostat, which was causing the check engine light, sounds, and flashing lightning bolt symbol going off on my car dashboard (never saw that symbol before haha).  

In addition, Vince and his employee also identified that my windshield wipers were starting to peal off and could cause to scratch my windshield next time it rained.  With the heads up I was able to purchase new windshield wipers prior to any damage occurred.

Overall, from start when I walked in, to when they completed the work and finished it took about an hour to an hour and half.  I would highly recommend this Pep Boys in Audubon, NJ if you are in the South Jersey region and definitely recommend Vinny.

LUV this newly opened restaurant.
I luv that nearly all their ingredients are organic.
Both Saturday morns, between 9 - 10am, although they were swamped, all their wait staff were friendly and as prompt as they could be given all the orders in the kitchen...... My wish, they start growing herbs on their property, maybe hydroponically and serve more fresh herbs in their salads and egg dishes!..... I'm over 65 and find the small font, using Times New Roman; they and MANY restaurants need to use an easier to read font like Arial, Calibri, with no serifs!  Ill return :)

I went here with a bunch of derby friends. I don't know why, but some guy came through the back while we were drinking and checked all of our IDs. It was weird. 

Also, they started, seemingly arbitrarily, charging a $10 cover at the door for what amounted to a weird rave-thing. (I'll admit, this was hearsay. I had some friends come in later and they had told me they got charged $10. That was probably collectively, not each. The owner tells me they never charge more than $5.)

I like their selection of beverages. It's vast.

Once a week (I think?) they have a trivia night. That was sorta fun.

Whatever. This is a nice bar.




Update: Besides the above clarification on the cover charge, the owner, when she got in touch with me, said that they come around and check IDs at 10pm because they can't allow minors in after that time.

I didn't know they could let minors in at all! Anyway, if the staff member had been able to explain that at the time, we probably would have been less annoyed.

One of the best kept secrets of NJ! I think very few people know about this restaurant with a gorgeous view almost right out of Monet's waterlily painting scene, and the selfish me secretly hopes it stays under the radar of the general public. The food can be a hit or miss, but mostly good.....The complimentary bread comes with awesome butter with herb, so simple and yet so good! I wasn't that impressed with my chicken paillard , chicken was not juicy enough but accompaying cous cous was tasty. Mushroom pot au feu was better,  I loved the maitake mushroom in it. Tartine had nice ingredients, grilled shrimp and avocado is a winning combo but the sauce flavor was a bit boring for me, I expected more. The restaurant benefits a lot from this beautiful setting, it's very romantic that you can easily impress your date if you choose this place..... you have the perfect setting! The waitress who served our table was very pleasant and accommodating, she is well trained! 

Ambiance : A++
Food: B+
Service: A

If there was  a way to give this place a zero, I would. We ordered the Pad Thai and Spicy Salmon roll. After ringing our doorbell, we watched as the driver picked our  meal up off the floor (he had dropped it). Still, we let that go. Then,  my husband tried the sushi, which he was charged an extra dollar to make "spicy" and it was actually sweet. The fish looked dull and tasted bad. The Pad thai had absolutely no flavor whatsoever. I had to drench it in soy sauce to even eat one small plate. Overall the food was terribly bland and the service was even worse. When we called back to complain, we got not one, but THREE rude people in succession on the other line telling us that we had no idea what food was supposed to taste like. Is that how you run a business? You decide.

Holy Smokes!  What an unbelievable meal.

We had the 7-course tasting menu with wine pairings.  Every course was creative, fun and delicious.  

It takes a special kind of chef to present his sommelier with a pairing challenge like "Chocolate Cake with Hot Buttered Pink Lemonade."  Impressively, the sommelier rose to the challenge with a "Royal Tokaji Red Label" from Hungary, ultimately our favorite pairing of the evening.  Brilliant.

The service was absolutely perfect.  Completely and perfectly attentive, without being intrusive.
WOW small cute delicious and great service

Ordered the pulled pork grilled cheese with tater tots. To my surprise, my meal consisted of two unmelted slices of kraft singles with a red onion in the middle and lukewarm tots. Unfortunately, Yelp will not let me share the video of the sandwich.

My husband and I came in on a whim. We will not be returning.

Right now, there are enough food options, but there are some empty stalls.  This public market has potential in the long run.   A sandwich shop and bakery/coffee would be good.   I'm not sure why some customers are comparing this to the Anaheim Packing Distrtict and Grand Central Market which are much larger and accomdate more merchants and customers.

This place was recommended to us by our tour guide and we were so happy that we took her recommendation! This place is amazing in every way. 
As soon as you walk in the front door you feel like you're in someone's home. The decor is super cool with unique pieces of art throughout. You might recognize it from a series called diners, drive-in's and dives. 
Our waitress was superb. She was very friendly and attentive. We couldn't have asked for anything more. She was great. 
I ordered the hamburger steak with mashed potatoes and green beans. The steak literally melted in my mouth and the gravy it was topped with was delicious. The mashed potatoes were homemade and very good as well. 
My boyfriend ordered the seafood platter and enjoyed it. The portion was huge so he couldn't clear his plate which is unusual for him. 
We did however make room for dessert! I had Miss Kathy's Brownie pie and it was excellent. You can't ask for more in a dessert. It really hit the spot. My boyfriend went for the Apple coble and couldn't stop making sound effects as he was eating it, lol mostly mmm's! We both couldn't finish our desserts, and probably should have just shared one because of how HUGE they were.
We had the perfect experience here and simply loved it!
Amazing!  Service was awesome, thank you Townsend and Zach!

We've been to the Boat House twice, including an unplanned visit - we thought we were going to the previous tenant (Rte 31) to find out they had reopened as the Boat House.

1st visit - lunch for 11 year old son & father.  Surprised that it wasn't a burger stand anymore, but happy to see another Puckett's operation.  We spend around 6 weeks each year in the Emerald Coast area, so we were really excited to see a oyster/fish house concept.  

Boy ordered a regular hamburger & fries.  He really enjoyed his burger - ate nearly the whole thing and later said 'it was amazing.'

For a starter I ordered 6 oysters raw on the half shell - served properly on a tray of ice with horseradish & cocktail sauce - tabasco & crackers already on the table.  These were shucked a little rough - some shards of shell hanging around - but were fresh & very tasty.  Size of the oysters varied wildly - had a couple of really large & 1 very tiny oyster.

For a main I had the hot fish sandwich, grilled.  I'm really not a hot chicken afficionado - I like hot but like my bunghole more - but I really enjoyed this sandwich.  A nice filet, grilled & spiced then hit with a light tabasco/buffalo wing type sauce.  Served on a roll with lettuce, tomato & some homemade spiced pickle chips -- it was just awesome, a whole lot of flavor from a healthy source.  Highly recommend.

Second visit - wife & I, again with a weekday lunch.  Again no wait at all, seated at a table this time (previous visit we just sat at the bar looking over to Dotson's).

Again had a raw on the half shell starter - oysters shucked a bit more cleanly this time.  No crackers on the table this time so we had to ask.  It's a very minor detail but any good oyster house should be sure to serve or offer crackers with oysters - it's just a natural compliment since many people use crackers. Again, very fresh and tasty.

Wife had a fried shrimp po-boy with fries; I again had the hot fish sandwich.  Hot fish sandwich was again excellent -- this is one of my favorite bites in all of Nashville!  The wife's po-boy was packed with hot fried shrimp.  The batter was a little salty for my taste but there were sure a lot of them on the sandwich.  

During this visit we actually had a conversation with the server about the previous restaurants that had occupied the space.  It's a great location, but the previous 2 tenants (Riffs, Rte 31) both were serving warmed up food - there's wasn't much fresh cooked food coming out of those kitchens.  So it was kind of ironic when they served cold, limp fries with the wife's sandwich.  This was quickly remedied with a fresh order and an apology from the server.  Fries were ok, nothing notable.

In summary:

- great location
- really large space.  This is a massive restaurant for downtown Franklin
- with the large space you get good & bad.  Obviously very possible for large groups or big spikes to walk in and back up a kitchen.  Restaurant can also be loud.
- oysters are fresh & flavorful
- Hot fish sandwich is awesome
- Burger was rated as 'amazing' by a 11 year old boy who doesn't say amazing often
- Based on my experience & other reviews, I'd stick with seafood or basics like burgers.  Fried seafood may be a little salty.

We will definitely be back to support a local business and have more hot fish!

Breathtakingly beautiful. Upsettingly gorgeous. 

You will never forget The Garden District after spending the day there. So much immutable history and culture, you can't help but to gaze and be engulfed. 

Grand architecture, multi-million dollar estates, sprawling porches and staircases. Man, the beauty is endless. Not to mention, there's a kick to the surrounding soul and history - cute boutiques and bars line the streets for a more modern feel.

The Streetcar passes through the Garden District, so it's a win-win all around.

It's Historic. We have been here 5 times in the past few years from Florida South FLA in the 305 and only could enjoy breakfast and 1 lunch 3 of the 5 visits. It's worth the wait for the first or second time but honestly 2 plus hours to get seated, well that's a little long and qualifies for a Tourist Trap.  Go to say you have been and then go antiquing up the road. The food is OK but the biscuits are Great, and it's fun to watch them being made. There is a lot to look at on the property. Play Corn hole with the grand kids. Go once and buy a Coffee Mug in the Gift Shop.

Went there two weeks ago with my partner, and we had a blast. Amazing food, amazing service, amazing ambiance. Very, very pleasant and delicious experience! My favorites were the lamb leg and lamb chops - I'm a big fan of lamb and this one was cooked to perfection. 
Salad bar is really good too. 

I also had their sangria and it was really exceptionally amazing as well.

Basically, if you are in the mood for some meat, I highly recommend Chima.
Super reasonable prices and good service. I ordered a la carte but because I was the for AYCE they let me pay the lower price. Sushi was delicious and nice sized portions.

I never leave reviews but after the week I had and how much they saved my family and I from not having a blow out on the interstate. I called them at 6:30 and Jonny told me it would able 2 to 3 hrs but I would definitely get my truck back tonight. Went in did all the arrangements and 3 hrs later my truck was ready. The crew there is very nice and very helpful. I was out and back on the road by 9:30 that night. Definitely would recommend this place to anyone. Thanks guys at NTB metairie for helping me out when I thought we would just have to tough it out until the next day.

Wasn't expecting this good of a pizza, pleasantly surprised by the yummyness.

Almost a cracker crust but a bit thicker so it's not super crispy like the thin stuff (surprisingly good) but if you hate crispier crust this might not be your thing though i wouldn't call it crispy it's going in that direction.

This is the only Thai spot I will go to ever! Thai Taste is completely on the opposite side of town from where I live but that matters not. The food is so worth drive. Every time I dine at Thai Taste is makes me want to travel to Thailand just to feast!

Stop by for a quick beer on a Tuesday evening. The bar area was pretty damn packed by male customers. What's going on here? Come to find out they served up their beers for only $2.50. I wish I would have known this Instead of ordering the Ace cider. Bartender wasnt the best...he wouldn't give us a menu. Instead he pointed out the people seated next to us had menu's? Oh okay...we have to tap their shoulder to get their attention to ask for their menu. Meanwhile the bartender was standing right there?

What a gem. Found it on Yelp, while looking for a place for lunch during a film shoot. Took the crew, and they were ecstatic. I'm no expert on this style of food, but our host was gracious and helpful with our orders. Left full and pleased.

Honestly, this is such an Indy gem that I missed out on for so many years because I wasn't familiar with what they had to offer. Since moving downtown this is walking distance from home, which is scary for my waistline considering how amazing all of their goods are (hahah!), and we keep finding reasons to go back and try more. We had family over a month or so ago and got one of their cheese and meat platters and it was to die for. The pickles and olives it came with were super tasty and our family LOVED it. Goose's bacon is THEE best bacon, period. Sweet, spicy, peppery and perfectly melt in your mouth. It's our favorite. They also sell local goodies, coffees and they have a huge wine cellar downstairs. Love this place!!

Finding the right daycare for my pup was difficult. Frankie is newly rescued, still a puppy and learning about the world. After having a not so great experience at another daycare, I called here and spoke with Dee. Thank goodness she answered. I was instantly put ease and very excited to visit the following day. Frankie spent about three hours and when we picked him up, he was happy! My husband and I were thrilled and knew we had found the right place. Thank you to everyone there!

I tried out @madebymarcus artisanal ice cream shop. I was drawn by the walkway to this shop as it is a narrow alley lit by small white lights , magical really. 

They offer unique flavours of ice cream including seasonal ones as well like the "mandarin olive oil cake" you see on the menu. I missed out on that one.

Instead I tried two popular flavours: the blueberry lemon curd (my favourite-tasted like a cheese cake bite that was perfect in sugar and flavour) and the sea salt goat cheese caramel (in the bottom- tasted like regular vanilla). Two scoops cost me 6$. Super affordable.

Quick and accurate service on our order.  The mushroom burger was very good with a nice crisp grilled finish.  
The spicy chicken sandwich was larger than expected, juicy and full of flavor.

I purchased a Living Social deal for Barone's. (You never know what you are going to get with a Living Social deal....could be a good place just looking to bring in more business or a not so great place that is desperate.) Thankfully, Barone's turned out to be a great restaurant. The food was yummy, the service was good, nice atmosphere, etc. I am baffled by the bad reviews, but I guess there will always be some complainers. All I know is I'll definitely be coming back.
On the Hill and old Italian joint. My grand parents said it was a lot better before a fire gutted it years ago. Hey better than any of that chain crap.

Came 1st time to the Carp, and pleasantly walking in the early morning stumbled upon this place....Growing up in the 80s and watching Three's Company, how the hell can I pass-up saying that I ate at Jack's Bistro? IMPOSSIBLE!
For this reason, persuaded group to sit down in the small patio adjacent to the inner dining area. Its a cute, simple, inviting area.
Friends ordered the cheese bagel with onions and tomatoes, was good. I ordered the green chile breakfast burrito and split with the wifey, with hash browns. It was very good and filing for $9.00. Have many other things to try, hopefully will be back, and doesnt break the bank for breakfast.
Unlimited peets coffee refills by Lupe our kind and courteous server. Thrilled about the name, and pleased at the experience. Now...wheres the regal beagle?

I came in to get a new set of tires , turns out one of my lug nuts was so stripped they couldn't get it off, got a mechanic toremove it , returned at 6:02 after closing and the manager noticed me in the parking lot, he opened back up just to finish my last tire, absolutely great service

Zia's is my favorite restaurant on The Hill. This is the place to go for delicious, authentic Italian food in St. Louis! Zia's has excellent pasta and chicken dishes, and of course, the toasted ravioli is to die for. Their house salad is my personal favorite item on the menu. This restaurant is accommodating to large groups and is kid-friendly.
Good and fresh, just a little on the pricey side. Confetti cookie was so good with the Oreo ice cream
Love this restaurant.. even Indians love it..nearest I've come to a good curry in Indiana ... great service .. great food..?what more does an English girl want

I've eaten here quite a few times and the food and service has always been outstanding. Today not. I've nw been waiting 55 minutes since my table placed our order and we're still waiting. The waitress is avoiding us as well. Unsat. When the food came it was delicious as always. I spoke with the manager and he appologized for everything. We'll be back again and hopefully the service we receive will be back to excellent as it had been on past visits.
Unbelievably delicious. We actually ate lunch and dinner here during our very short visit. Fantastic food.

SO YUMMMMY, must try if you're in Nola! I walked here with a couple of my friends during our trip for Mardi Gras weekend, and it was so far. The walk was very worth it once we got our food. I loved the fresh and charbroiled oysters. Our other entrees were quite delicious too! The service was a little bad, but it was a busy night!

Really good Asian food...so good I forgot to take pictures 
They have good cocktails during happy hour and they are busy during prime hours so I'd advise you to make a reservation. The shrimp pad Thai was really good, so was the duck, and the Brussels sprouts! They are really charred but don't taste burned due to the seasoning.

Fours years ago my lawn was in terrible shape. I did everything that I'd done in years past, but it got worse and worse. I changed product brands and that made no difference. I called trugreen.

After that first year the lawn was resurrected! It hadn't looked that good in a long time and I felt the money ($1000+) was well spent. The next year it was not quite as nice, but I was satisfied. Last year they suddenly couldn't kill the weeds and I quit them. 

This year I started with an outfit that turned out to be totally inept and couldn't even show up or bill me when they did. I quit them.

Trugreen lured me back with a discount and promises (I know, I know). However, they still can't kill the weeds which are spreading. After several phone calls I get lip service and nothing changes.
These guys did an amazing job at returning a crashed screen Iphone back to me as good as new. It looked and worked like it was brand new. Worth it

Fran's Pub  is that kind of place you come to kick back and have a beer, order some wings,a burger, sandwich or salad while enjoying the people watching...This is a very laid back casual atmosphere... The bartenders are so nice and friendly. You can hear the rock music while sitting at the bar coming off of the bartenders playlist...
Fran's outdoor bar and outdoor seating area are truly the best place around for people watching and taking in a little bit of what New Hope has to offer..Their located right on South Main Street in heart of things...This place does have a loyal following with bikers, and repeat clientele, do to the friendliness of this place and its location. I've been here many times and the people come  from all over. I always, always stop here when I'm in New Hope.
Fran's Pub has indoor seating as well.
They have a pool table and another larger bar inside with tables all around. This is the place I discovered my favorite grapefruit beer called Schofferhofer Weizen on tap. I couldn't remember the name and our bartender knew what I wanted immediately!
It is a sweet and somewhat tart beer and it comes in a tall Pilsner glass... 
Fran's has a nice list of unique shots and speciality drinks they make daily . They offer 100 beers in a bottle including IPAs , and 13 beers on tap..
This time when I was here I ordered a large sausage pizza.. It was delicious lots of sausage and melted cheese on top. The flavor was really good. I have in the past tried their salads and buffalo, & garlic  wings, both good.
Monday is "Mexican and Blues Night"  Open Blues Mic - 8-11p
On Tuesdays they have" All U Can Eat Crabs Legs and Trivia Night. The crabs legs are delivered that day rain or shine .Happy Hour is 4:30-6:30p.
Wednesday is "Steak Night" $25 for one or $45 for two includes wedge salad and mashed potatoes. 
Thursday is "All U Can Eat Wings" and music night. Local bands come out and play...
Fridays Happy Hour again and drink specials..
Saturday "Pub Brunch" 10a-12p
Sunday  is "Sunday Funday"another Brunch 10-12p
I come here more for the drinks and people watching then I do the food and service. When their real busy the service can get backed up...patience is a virtue !
If you love Harley's this is the place to see them. No helmet law in Pa. so they tend to come.If that's not your bag, come sit order a few drinks, snacks and relax.. Your bound to strike up a conversation or two....

If this one wasn't the closest to me. I would not go here. One of the employees was mopping the floor. Then decided to start fixing my banana split. I had to ask her to please wash your hands first. Every time I go in there no one is using gloves.

I came with my Monday ladies' group. I wasn't really impressed with our server, especially when she spilled syrup down the back of one unlucky person at our table. She apologized and we all understood that things like that happen. She didn't offer to comp the "spillee's" lunch or apologize again at the end of our lunch. At that point I spoke privately to the manager, who not only comped the "spillee's" lunch, but everyone at our table. That's good management. BTW, I ordered the Florentine omelet and it was delicious. Good management and good food = 4 stars

The chicken and biscuits with white gravy rocked my universe....and I don't even like white gravy!   I recommend ordering it minus the butter. 

Ham, egg, cheese breakfast poboy was good but would have been better minus cheese. 

In Louisiana fashion, these guys have Cajun Chef and Louisiana hot sauce at the tables - bonus!

Very crowded at prime times but totally worth it.  Can't wait to try a fried poboy on my next visit.

Big donut guy here. Other than maaaybe one or two standard flavors, I'll pretty much eat any kind of donut. My first Jupiter experience was when someone brought a dozen to work. Opening up the box and beholding 12 works of art (seriously, they were beautiful) was one heck of a way to start my morning. The decision was near impossible, but I ended up going with the red velvet donut. Dense, dark red cake with a generous glob of neatly placed cream cheese frosting in the center was enough to satisfy both my taste buds and my sugar intake for the next 7 days. But, I certainly was not complaining. In fact, I enjoyed this donut so much that I had to check out the place for myself. We arrived early and there was already a sizable, socially-distanced line that had formed. The employees were noticeably kind and patient with each customer that approached. After all, it is a really, really tough decision when presented with their amazing choices. I ended up going for the banana cream donut when it was my turn. Soft, fresh brioche filled with sweet banana cream was exactly what the doctor had ordered. What sets this place apart from other donut joints is the customer service as well as the freshness and quality of their donuts. Consistency is key when it comes to any establishment that serves food, but after proudly having had about a dozen Jupiter donuts at this point, I can say that they define it.
First time at this location and it's much more spacious than the others. My "Cali turkey" sandwhich was great and my server Natalie was even better and just cute as a button!!

I had a chance to check out this place today and overall it was a good experience. The service is exceptional. The setting was gorgeous...right across from the beach. We managed to walk in after the lunch rush do it was perfect! From 3-6 is the happy hour. Apparently the menu changes up regularly so I would return to see what other surprises they have. The lamb meatballs and chocolate caramel bar dessert were definitely my favorite items!

We came in without reservations, and waited about forty minutes in the front room. Fun atmosphere there, with a piano player and drinks served. Unfortunately, the smell of bleach was fairly overpowering. I can think of worse things for a restaurant to smell like, but it didn't exactly encourage my appetite. If I hadn't trusted Yelp reviews so much, I might have left.

That was the low point of the evening. The food was indeed quite delicious, and the service was warm and friendly, as well as speedy, considering the crowd. We enjoyed the tasty bread and bruschetta, then the lobster ravioli appetizer, which was flavorful, light, and ample to share for two. Then I had the cioppino (based on Yelp recommendations) and enjoyed it thoroughly. Tons of seafood (I couldn't finish it) and a memorably tasty broth. My husband had a black drum amandine that he liked. This is the kind of Italian I like best -- lots of fresh tomatoes and other ingredients, and not so much garlic that you can't taste anything.

Interesting atmosphere. Felt a bit like stepping backward in time about a hundred and twenty years.

Terrible experience. I stopped in for an evening coffee and when I asked if they still serve coffee at 6 pm, I was told yes. I imagine that their carafe of tasted great at 10 am but the coffee that they served me was burnt and stale.

I have been to a few of crabby's location, and they were always spectacular, but this one really hit the floor. I ordered the grouper taco's and im not even sure there was fish in it. Usually the taco's have this big lush strips of fried grouper but on this occasion there was more cabbage than grouper. The beans and rice even tasted as if they came out of a rice roni box definitely a disappointment for one of my favorite dishes. I would have given you 2 stars but even the service was not that good. This was a flop nothing to it...

Had a lovely brunch here with an old friend.  I liked everything about the place, from the decor to the service to the menu.  

We were shuttled upstairs into a quiet dining area.  This is an old, well decorated space that has a great vibe if you like kitsch.  I, personally, am a fan of some fun personality.  My friend and I were able to get comfy and chat in relative quiet (though I know the bar downstairs and the main dining area can get a bit loud).  

The menu was decent for a gastropub.  You had some fun, British themed offerings.  I loved my cheese plate (HIGHLY recommend it, this was a wonderful treat) and my friend had the chicken sandwich.  The drink menu is why you come, though.  I should have gotten the beer, instead I opted for sangria.  The beers on tap are pretty good, plus you can get tastings.  

This was a fun place to have a nice lunch.  The staff couldn't have been any nicer or more attentive.  It is a gastropub and a well done one at that, so don't expect 5 course gourmet.  I can't wait to go back and sample more of the menu and try the taps.
An amazing experience from start to finish. The service is what you expect for the price, and the food is even better.
I have never been fed raw chicken, until today.  My chicken sandwich was completely raw.

I always pass this place but have never gone inside. I had a bit of time before my next meeting and stopped in. I am so glad I did. The service was fast and friendly. They immediately brought out perfectly salted chips with two delicious house made salsas. The menu is a bit overwhelming but I knew I wanted a Sandia (watermelon) juice and it was so refreshing with the perfect amount of sweet! I decided on the chicken tacos and they came with a good sized portion of beans and rice- I shouldn't have eaten the whole thing but I did. I saved my salsa and added it to the meal and then used the chips to scoop up the tacos filling that had fallen. Delicious! Great artwork as well!

Straight ass.. don't come here on a sunday... Fucking weak as shit... waiting for over half an hour while they won't put a time cover on tables... i mean com on were by  mt holly ... the trash travels to watch football games ther town won't play... Fucking bs do better or let scum sit all day drinking water and eating the same wings ordered a hr ago

If you live within 30 miles of this place and take your car to the closest shop.....YOU'RE CRAZY! Rick and Pat will take care of you and will not rip you off, I guarantee it! 
 Been taking my F-150's and my wife's cars there for 10 years and only once did I go to the closest shop(only because Pat was on vacation) by my house. That will never ever happen again. I'm not gonna forget young Brian who also works there. He knows what he is doing too! Customer for life!

Same old chain. I have been here several times to meet friends, and I do like their 2 for $20 deal and healthier options, but I know what to expect from Applebee's.

The food appears to be assembly-line, mass-produced meals. The flavors are not bad, but salt is probably the star ingredient. I get very bored with the same old menu and the quality seems to have decreased over the years. Not much creativity in the dishes.

The service at this particular Applebee's is fine, I have never had a bad experience or a memorably long wait.

Didn't even have the opportunity to eat here but bad service alone will keep me away. I have a business and if you say you're going to be open at 10, continue giving service til 10! My family and I walked in at 9:30 and the little lazy witch working the register said it was to-go orders so food was being served in to-go boxes. Keep in mind I saw 2-3 other couples eating their food at the table. I told her I wouldn't mind having the food served in the to-go box but we're not from the area, my kids have been in the car for over an hour and we have an hour or so to drive after we eat (plus I didn't want the kids eating in the car) so I asked if we can eat at the table (I'm sure we would've been out of there by 10 or 10:15 the latest. She responded with, "Well they're going to start putting the chairs up soon." I said, "Can you at least ask if it's okay?" She gave me a look as if SHE didn't want to be bothered by it and sure enough she says, "Well I'm the one cleaning up." So I said, "Is it going to take 30mins?"  She says, "I'm going to do the tables as soon as I'm done closing the register and wash dishes."  Knowing I wasn't going to get the polite & thoughtful service from her I simply told her that, "I guess if its going to be an inconvenience for you then we'll eat elsewhere" (I was calm and cordial the entire time since I had my kids with me), but I was irritated that she couldn't accommodate us when it wasn't an absurd request. Funny thing is...I hadn't bothered looking at the reviews since I was in a rush to pick something, but if you read the other negative reviews, it seems to be the same complaint.  This is no way to conduct business and although it might not be her business the owners should be aware of her laziness and take care of it (she was rushing everyone to leave because she wanted to be out of there). What a shame!

At first, we were hesitant to dine-in because of Covid-19, but luckily there was an option to dine outside, so we went for it! The food was amazing!! The New York Steak and the Spicy Shrimp Pasta was so good!! Highly recommend. The service here is great as well. Our server Jensen was really nice and attentive. Would definitely come back next time!! :)

NEVER RENT AN INSTRUMENT FROM THESE PEOPLE!  They have taken $300.00 out of my account, put it back, taken it out, put it back and taken it out again.  I finally got an overdraft fee from the Bank for 35.00. After the first time I went to the store.  They assured me it would be resolved but then, it happened again! I'm returning my instrument tonight and will never go back.  Never give them you bank account information.  What a disaster.

Good beer. Awesome patio/park. Nothing beats drinking on a busy intersection and laughing at the pathetic cars rushing to their destination.

Plus, bottle cap openers on every fence post! Yes!
I went back to Crossroads for their grand opening on Valentine's day, and was so happy to see that they've enlarged their scones! :) Yum.

We love this place. At first when you're pulling up to the restaurant, it looks kind of sketchy. It's not as decorative on the outside like other Mexican restaurants. It's vey simple and they only have sign which is "Open".

I've been here a couple of times and they bring out your food SO fast! My fiancé had cheese enchilada with pork on top. MAN. That was so good. The pork pretty much melted in your mouth. You need to order that.

I had fish with rice and they had the white cheesy dip on top of it. I ordered the cheesy dip on the side instead. 

The service is always good too. Cheap food, good service, great tasting Mexican dishes. Check this place out!r

I came into this salon because my roots were way too brassy. Jose took care of me and fixed my hair so well! He knew exactly what I wanted. 100% I will be back and would recommend this salon to anyone. Everyone was very welcoming and the price was average. They do not charge an excessive amount which was exactly what I was looking for!

I saw the cashier drop 4-5 styrofoam cups on the ground behind the counter where they walk with their dirty shoes, so disgusted that she just plopped them back up on the counter without cleaning them.

The Beef Empanada 3.5/5 wasn't made to order like the ones I've had multiple times from another location. It was warm, but not piping hot or as crispy, which was what I was expecting, so didn't live to full potential. After I ordered mine and got it immediately, my coworker waited a lot longer for hers & made us think they forgot & had hers sitting on the overpass the entire time.

This location has tight parking & is popular, so order ahead to save yourself some time! Grab yourself a loyalty card to get a free Empanada after numerous check-ins!

Honestly, 

Brigtsen's is one of the best restaurants I have eaten dinner at in 2010. What makes Brigtsen's special is:

* The genuinely warm attentive service of a family run restaurant. Thank you Jennifer for making our first evening in NOLA special.  

* The incredibly flavorful food which is well presented and imaginative. 

Overall, a dinner experience at Brigtsen's is not to be missed. The prices will not kill your wallet, and the food experience is great. My wife was a doubter before our reservation, and now she is a big fan. 

Frank the head chef/owner at Brigtsen's is a New Orleans local who is consistently taking the Brigtsen's dining experience to new levels.

Bravo Frank!!!! You are one of the best Chef's I have ever encountered.  How has this place not won a James Beard Award????

Fantastic authentic Thai food and they had sticky rice!! We haven't been able to find a place that serves sticky rice since we've been out here. They did say they only make it on Saturdays though. We were lucky to have come in when we did! Very friendly service. We will absolutely be back

Nice little sit down restaurant and one of the few sit down style one in Bush Gardens. Limited menu but enough of a selection for everyone. They have an all you can eat fried chicken or fish fry for $15.99. This cones with broccoli slaw, mixed vegetables and choice of fries, Mac and cheese or mashed potatoes with gravy. All were good and everything is all you can eat. Desserts are few with miniatures (shot glasses) of chocolate mouser, cherry cheesecake, white cake with fruit or key lime pie. 

Food was good and when you asked for refills on anything you could tell it came out fresh and piping hot. For a theme park $69 for four was pretty reasonable for the quality and quantity of food,

Service was good and upstairs dining had nice views of the park and best thing was fully sue conditioned. 

Definitely recommend this place to relax in the middle of a busy theme park day as you can get fed and re-energized for the rest of the day.

They won't seat you until your entire party is present so something to keep in mind if meeting up with people.

One of the worst vendors....i tried to purchase CPAP supplies using my United Healthcare insurance.The number you dial is a call center and you can never reach the local office...the one on Philips Ave in Jacksonville.
They transfer you to the local office and it gets caught in the loop.
After submitting what was requested they asked me for more
after faxing the material to them 4 weeks ago, they never got back to me
i drove to their local office and they said they never received a note from the doctor 
I explained to them they had told me they HAD received the note...and later called me to say they did

After leaving their office I asked them to make sure they did not need anything else....and I was assured I did not
Not more than 90 minutes  later they (Mary) called to say they needed some information from 5 years ago
Their communication skills are awful!....Their call center is useless....Do yourself a favor, do not use Lincare

Worked one on one with Reda Amer...completely dumbfounded by sense of reasoning.   Do yourself a favor...reconsider Tulane , go to LSU.   A complete disappointment.  I agree with other posts "Staff is absolutely Terrible, rude, unfriendly and seem pretty miserable.  Wait times on the phone have been over 25 mins every time I call the office directly.  Front desk girl could give two shits about any patient."  Have called numerous times looking for my results and still no one has returned my phone calls

It was a terrible service that was racist and rude very bad service with the person who worked on the  in front unprofessional front at all, 5-10-2021 7:00 pm
"Restaurant Mexicano" with personal Latino?
Bad service

Sunday night grubbin.  Leading into a week where I know I should be good about eating and less indulging in junk food, I thought why not go to shake shack when my girlfriend proposed it.

We got the ShakeBurger, SmokeShack, Cheese Fries, and a Black/White Shake.  We'd both agree the Cheese Fries are awesome and worth getting two servings if you are very hungry.

I ate the SmokeShack and thought it to be very delicious, bacon and all was delicious and the cherry pepper/shaksauce combination tastes great going in.... The burger is not to die for but I say its worth going to get one and making your own decision.

Shake wasn't great I wanted more thickness.  Its a little pricey for what you get.  Go try it out and I will be back.

Drunk people everywhere, loud and messy.
It feels like I was at a prom after party.
I found a guy sleeping on the floor in the hallways 
Also, the food is terrible. I ordered a spinach artichoke flatbread and they brought me something with tomatoes and jalapeños, the waitress was trying to convince me thar the artichokes were "mixed inside", I ordered something else and got food poisoned.
The room nightstands had coffee stains from previous guests, disgusting!! 
The bathroom is so tiny you could barely get in.
Next day it took me 25 minutes to get my car from the valet parking, really long time considering they just added a $25 valet parking fee without even letting me know.
Don't stay here if you're coming for business, you won't be able to rest at all.

Geno's used to be in the consideration set for best of Philly for cheesesteaks.  Just had one at the Xfinity Center and they should be ashamed of what they are serving.  Looks like steak-umm meat and tasted worse.  I can get a better cheesesteak at my corner deli back in Boston!

Just ecstatic over the personalized attention given from Michelle Davis. Michelle is a very caring and compassionate person who has a deep passion for helping people! 
Highly recommended A+++++

Best cupcakes in Delaware (at least in the New Castle county). The cupcakes are perfectly moist and the ratio of cake to icing is perfect. All the flavors I've tried are great but my favorite is the Dulce de Leche. They're so fantastic that I've bought them to give as gifts.

So I wake up from an epic night in Austin and look at my iPhone 5s to check my emails.  That's when I discover that I had cracked my screen and it was spreading from the initial crack all the way across the screen.  DOH!  

While I am not sure how the screen was broken (like surely it wasn't due to a bar hop or clumsiness due to alcohol?), I knew that I had to get it fixed.  So when I got back to Nashville I googled places and this place is right by my house.  Plus it is right by the tanning place.  And Corner Pub too.  Soooo I made an appointment online and took it on over.

They were waiting for me when I got there and took my phone back.  20ish minutes later my phone was like new.  BOOM!!!  It was more than I thought it would be, but it was better than buying a new phone when I am still under contract after buying this phone.  Sooooooo I'LL TAKE IT.

Got a smart phone problem?  Bring it here and you'll get it fixed quickly.

EXCELLENT!! Been to the one in Beverly Hills a few times, and this one was on our way home - the menu is a little different, but basically the same...the chicken sandwich is the best in the WORLD...it's so perfect - cooked to perfection and spiced just right, the texture, the toppings, the bread...it's perfection! I just made myself hungry. :)

This is by far the best movie theater to watch a movie at in the Palm Harbor/Clearwater area. The theaters have the fully reclining seats, they serve all kinds of food, snacks and drinks including alcoholic beverages. It's always clean and the bathrooms are well maintained.

Car wash itself was OK.  Not fabulous. My front plate bent (I'm from Jersey and was visiting folks in PA).  They didn't even try to fix it.  Not a biggie.  I decided to upgrade to the Ultimate car wash which was $16 something.  I had a $4 coupon.  When I gave it to the attendant he said $17.  When I looked at him like he was crazy, he tried to say something like with tax it's $21, so minus $4 it's $17.  Seems like some fuzzy math.  I had my children with me so I didn't complain but the more I think about it, the more this infuriates me.  For $17 (plus the $2 tip I gave) I would've expected a really clean car.  My wheels look like they barely were touched.  And they missed vacuuming an entire seat -- that's a lot of crap when you have toddlers.
The Sushi is fresh and great!! New fav in Tucson! No wonder I've seen the parking lot full!
Nice banquet hall. Pretty unorganized staff.

Bake'n Babes gets it right again and again. Awesome menu. Every single thing that we purchased was incredibly fresh and delicious. Everyone at the Bake'n Babes was so lovely and accommodating. Totally returning here again for more because one time is just not enough.

Husband picked this place randomly. As a starter we got bottomless chips and salsa for $3 (*per every four people). The chips and salsa were pretty good. Then I ordered the From our Seoul taco and the Slam'n Salmon Teriyaki taco and they were sooo good. I'd probably order them again even though they were $5.25 each. My husband got the Fajita Steak taco, Who You Call'n Shrimp taco, and It's All Greek To Me taco. He said he wished the shrimp taco had more shrimp in it. If anything, he only got maybe two pieces and the rest was the slaw of cabbage and whatnot. Tacos here are pretty pricey, basically $5 for one (most expensive, $6, and the cheapest being maybe $4), which I think it's kind of ridiculous. But taking into account the area we were in, I guess it makes sense. I could think of a ton of other places I could find reasonably priced tacos that are just as good; just my personal opinion. Service was good. Overall experience was good. I'd recommend this place.

Outstanding production of The Twentieth Century Way play by Tom Jacobson, starring two seasoned actors in their best; Peter Andrew Danzig and Thomas Raniszewski.  Very strong plot of 1920s persecutions of gays and lesbians in Los Angeles and their inhumane treatment at the hands of the notorious Vice Squads.  This awesome production also made tangential reaches into the hypocrisy of religious institutions and their "Do as I say" modus operands. The play contained nuances, sexual situations and nudity as well as strong emotional situations.

The venue was literally sold out for this performance.   I've heard reviews about it needing more attendance but this was literally standing room only.  There are refreshments at no cost other than the donations to keep the theater alive.  

Parking in the area is iffy, so it pays handsomely to come a bit early and seek a place in the heart of Fishtown.  

A most valuable idea is for people to bring a seat cushion. The chairs...  Oh the chairs....  I kept shifting my weight on each side of my derriere to seek comfort...  My only reason for 4 versus 5 stars...  Please!  We will be back again with our own seat cushions...

When you sum up the venue, the play and the congenial staff, this is got to be one of the nicest neighborhood theaters despite its logistics.  Kudos to them, even if they need to get some seat cushions....
This is not a safe place. I would not take younger children to this facility. The monitors are not monitoring. The older teens are bullying the younger children.

I've worked at tons of restaurants. Knowing that the majority of the menu is around four dollars, I would bust my ass to make sure the service is on point for everyone. I came in with my sister and two kids around 4 PM and and we ordered about $28 dollars worth of food. The food itself was fine-- hence the two stars, but the service was horrendous. You drop food, drop the check and think you're done? My sister didn't get a refill. We waited needing more boxes because we didn't finish our food. Check out took forever. They didn't even have the right kind of bags for take-out. We just wanted burgers, hotdogs and milkshakes for the kids and steak and shake came to mind. Do yourself a favor, get takeout and skip the "service."

This classic is serving some great Italian and Seafood dishes.  Saturday we both had chef Joe's special and chose crab claws fir our appetizer.  For entree he chose the redfish and I had the softshell crabs. I think Impastatos has by far the best softshells around.  They are a must try.  Both of our dishes were topped with lemon, butter, crab, and shrimp ...delish. I also had a couple of French 75 cocktails.  This used to be a place we frequented.  For some reason we got away from it, but we were both happy we returned. If you haven't been, give them a try.

Summary: DO NOT GO HERE UNLESS YOU LIKE WAITING FOREVER ONLY TO FEEL RUSHED AND HAVE YOUR NAILS DONE SLOPPILY. 

Where to begin? 

Well, I guess I'll say that the only reason why I'm giving this place one star is because of two wonderful people they have there: Jackie and Mary. Both give amazing pedicures and are incredibly friendly. 

That is where the good ends with this place. 

Because everyone deserves a second chance, I have been here twice, and because I have been here twice I know that I'll never be back again. Here is why I'd only make an appointment for my worst enemies:

1. Both times I made an appointment and both times I had to wait 15 min+...the first time the manicurist I was supposed to have was "accidentally" overbooked and they left me sitting in the pedicure chair for 20 minutes (while telling me to wait because someone would be right with me) until I was FINALLY helped...usually I'd overlook this, however, they seem to have a more sophisticated booking system so this shouldn't slip through the cracks. But, if you've been here before, or have read the other reviews then you already know that wait times *even with an appointment* are the norm. The second time, I was kept waiting for 15 minutes before even getting to a pedicure chair or getting to look at the color swatches. 

2. They don't clean up your cuticles when giving you a MANICURE. Never in my life have I experienced this, or been told that it will be an additional $5 to have my cuticles taken care of during a manicure (this is equal to having to pay for ice in your drink). Cuticle maintenance is one of the main parts of a manicure---ridiculous. 

3. On my most recent visit, all of the nail techs were overbooked (I didn't even request anyone specific), which lead to me starting off my manicure with an obviously, very new and uneasy nail tech who was unsure of how exactly she should remove my dip powder. Then, after figuring it out and realizing she needed to wrap my nails, goes on a scavenger hunt around the salon looking for foil pieces for about 10 minutes. A more senior nail tech sees this, kicks her off the job, leaves her client to wrap my nails, then leaves me and goes back to her client. I sit, waiting, for an additional 15 minutes, while no one comes back to the desk to continue working on my nails. Finally, the more senior nail tech comes back, removes the wrap and old dip powder and begins the manicure, where she sloppily applies the bonder and dips my nails with no regard for aesthetics or my cuticles, I ask if she'll clean up my cuticles at the end, she tells me no. THEN another client comes in and she leaves me to do her nails while a third nail tech comes to finish the manicure...which is mediocre at its absolute best or when you're squinting from far away. The whole ordeal took over two and a half hours when for a basic pedicure and dip powder manicure should take 1.5-2.
Great beer selection and yummy food. The staff was friendly and attentive.  Its a beer and burger kind of place.

This is the best pizza in Broomall. The staff is great - especially Alfredo who, no matter how busy he is, always has a kind word for his customers. For the purists the plain pizza is unbeatable in the area, if you like to try all types of funky junk on your 'za - that's great here too - especially the BBQ chicken. 
They even make a great stromboli here which is a rarity in Delco pizza shops. Personally I like to make stromboli's myself at home, and when I do I go to Alfredo's for the dough. 

Alfrerdo's. The best. Eat it.

Horrible service.  Ordered drinks. Could not get a beer on draft... maybe offer a bottle.  After waiting 40 minutes for dinner I asked for a bottled beer .  Oh I guess we have a bottle. An hour to get a beer.  On to dinner.  Don't ask to change something on the menu ( i.e. No tomatoes) because they will forget everything else.  Flavorless, dry hamburgers and New York Steaks was not cooked properly, but we were not going to wait another hour. 
Keep in mind, you  will have to share your water glasses because it impossible to get someone to serve you.  All in all a complete disappointment.

I've lived in this area for over 22 yrs and ShopRite of Haverford Av is in need of much improvements. Its the worst grocery store in this area. It has non Professional unpleasant employees. Poor quality produce, they always have expired food and items advertised on sale are never available or they never stock them. I ALWAYS seem to have a bad experience shopping at this grocery store no matter the day or the time. I wish the owners cared but they are there to make a buck and not be concern for consumers. It's sad this is offered to customers.

Great airport, free wifi, clean, spacious.  What more could you ask for?!?  I didn't go through the security line, since I was in Tampa for a layover but I already prefer this airport more than Miami Airport.  There are monkeys running the airport in Miami.

It was easy to find my terminal, and I experienced no problems while I was here.

If you like a chik-fil-a chicken sandwich once a while, you will most definitely enjoy the Chicken Out chicken sandwich. This is my new favorite chicken restaurant. The prices are a little high considering it's +$4 for a small drink and fries.

I was quoted $400 fee + "seatbelt" violation from Jenny H. I wanted to assess what others was charging to understand the market rate. That's when I stumbled upon Richard P. Davies and his team.

Within the FIRST 2 minutes of the call, I knew exactly what my next steps were - "call the clerk office, ask for the no-point or point option, pay directly." 

We went from a $200 ticket + 1 point to $137 ticket + 0 points within minutes.

No frills. Go with Richard!

I migrated to the Tampa Bay area about 3 years ago and have yet to try the famous Bern's steakhouse, but until then, Capital Grille holds the title as my favorite steakhouse in the area. Service was excellent and attentative, steak cooked just the way we wanted, the lighting is perfect for a date night, and the lobster mac and cheese is as delicious as it sounds!
Maravilhoso. Tapas muito bem preparados,  com temperos bem marcantes.  A bartender é maravilhosa e muito atenciosa e inventou na hora um cocktail para mim com rum e suco de limão. Sensacional.
I love the food here!! The staff is always incredibly nice. I have recommended this place to several of my friends and family.

Fantastic meal.   Lance took great care of us.  Loved the "Who dat shrimp."
The steak was magnifique!

Went here for the first time a few days ago, and I'm already looking forward to coming back.  It was a Tuesday night, around 8:30, not terrible busy. The seating there is a bit cramped, there aren't that many tables, and the bar takes up a lot of the place.  Food was awesome.  Got the Salumi to start (duck prosciutto, prosciutto di parma and capicola) and settled on the margherita pizza (excellent).  Great beer selection.  Overall great dining experience.  I could see it being a bit too loud for my taste if the place were full, but not unmanageably so.  Can't wait to return and try the other pizzas.

Matt was very personable and professional while we worked with him on our very first home loan. He was always available to answer our many questions and did a great job explaining everything to us as we were going through the process. I would recommend him to anyone.

I grew up on water ice, first new York, then Philly, where Rita's is originally from. Go for the water ice...maybe a Gelati. Water ice is what made Rita's what Rita's is. Start with the lemon, that is the reference flavor. If that doesn't do it for you, then water ice ain't your thing.

Five stars are elusive for the picky sort like myself, but the flavors here have lingered in my thoughts long after my visit. The aesthetically pleasing stinky buns are a fine vehicle from plate to mouth for diverse and tasty fillings. The shrimp ones conjure memories of The Point's (former location) bang bang shrimp recipe, now perfected with a further reaching complexity of delightful flavors that aren't constantly fighting for supremacy on the palate. The pork belly filling has such a rich, notable taste. I tried the coconut curry chicken wings whose name doesn't even begin to speak for itself and must be had again, but the Truffle Tots win my heart for being one of my favorite dishes in Tampa when I can afford something on the fried side. I adored Erica our server, and she really made my night so much so that we invited her to sit with us, as we had a spirited discussion regarding the direction of food concepts in Tampa (what a bunch of nerds, I know) for the rest of our meal. I've wrestled internally with the service vs. taste issue in Tampa, and it's really simple with this place: You can slap me in the face and insult my mother for more of those tots, but I'm so glad you won't have to. See you really soon Erica and Singh!

I have been to Seedz multiple times - each time seems to be more delightful than the previous one. Friends who would normally blanch at the idea of "raw food" have become converts - many are surprised at how tasty healthy food really can be!  Plus, with so many places jumping on the "look we're healthy - we've got kale & quinoa!" bandwagon, it's great to see owners who are so creative, passionate and dedicated to clean eating.

Every entree I have tried has been fantastic, IMHO. My advice - make sure you save room for the tasty dessert bites, and try a glass of Monte's awesome organic beer!

All the food I've had here has been pretty good, and normally the atmosphere is pretty classy for a restaurant on Bourbon Street. However, I feel that it is a "tourist" place, not just because it's on Bourbon but because they only gave us 12 oysters. Yes, we ordered 12 oysters, but I feel a little cheated if I don't get a lagniappe in New Orleans, especially if the oysters are tiny and full of shell chunks. Also, the last time I was there, it was very cold and they had a red rope stretched across the door frame, so people had to wait outside in the cold. It just doesn't embody the spirit of welcoming I am accustomed to in New Orleans.

One could not dream up a better Grocery Store/Marketplace for an area with a lack of Grocery Stores.  This Marketplace carries pretty much anything you could think of. Lawn Furniture, bedding, decorations for ones home, Starbucks, and on and on and on. 

It is one stop shopping at its best.  Anything you can think of, I am pretty sure this Marketplace carries it!

As much as I wanted to like this place the food was poor to not good. We had the fish n tots and the fish was dry and tough. We decided to at least with a good desert but when we ordered the Funky Monkey cheesecake they said they didn't have any? 2:00 in the afternoon and no cheesecake?

I have traveled extensively in the US and abroad eaten at a lot of great restaurants. First the receptionist greeted us rudely said they were all booked and just pointed that if we wanted to sit in the bar. The waitress couldn't smile if her life depended upon it. Frankly I usually write really good reviews because I haven't had this bad of service in a long time. I would think for two people for $169 the food would've been better I could've got just as good of a steak at the Sizzler. Very disappointed and wouldn't go back there again. Had to ask for times for the check the waitress kept walking by and looking at us and then she just kept going.

I went to Chifa last night for Restaurant Week and it was amazing! We had sooo much food it was unreal. I went with two other people, so we tried almost everything on the menu. My favorites were the shrimp noodle bowl, pork belly buns, spicy eggplant, and duck tacos. We really liked the whitefish ceviche, but did not like the shrimp ceviche at all. I wasn't a fan of the beef and potato dish, but my boyfriend LOVED it. The vegetarian curry was really yummy too. Most of the food is spicy, even if isn't labeled that way, so spice-haters beware. The sangria is so delicious - it tastes like you are drinking fall! I can't wait to go back

i was here for dinner with my colleagues when we were here for a business trip. we stayed at Hotel 41, which is right behind the wall of the restaurant. 

SUPER fancy dining, very classy and upscale. it is very $$$($). we made reservations the day before. OH! and they also have a bar/lounge connected to the restaurant. so if you want to do happy hour or grab a drink before dinner its right next door. they even carry the bill over to your table. oh yeah, and they have really delicious complimentary popcorn (maybe i was really hungry, but it was really good. not too buttery).

We had a full 3 course meal. we got some appetizers -- i don't remember what we got.  i got the Clam Chowder for starters it was good and creamy. I wish there were more clams in there.

For the main course -- i got the scallops. i couldn't finish it because it was super fishy and i could still feel the sand. i guess that is how you can tell it is fresh seafood? but i heard that Chandlers is known for their poultry and seafood. The scallops also came with hash brown potatoes. i couldn't finish the scallops because the fishy smell was giving me a huge headache.

for desserts, we got a huge cheese plate with fruits, creme brulee, etc. i just wanted HOT TEA which i got -- thank god. i wanted to calm my headache which helped a little. 

i heard that this place plays live jazz music during dinner but there was no live jazz band playing ;(

Parking below the center: $13.50 for the day with early bird pricing.

Clean and bright.
"Terminal" type food options (as in airport terminal....rail terminal). You can book other tours here. The Philly Phlash, Duck Boat tours, bus tours, segway tours.
You also pick up your tickets for Independence Hall here. The line moves quickly, the park employees are helpful and efficient.
Clean bathrooms also available next to the souvenir shop (with a shorter line than the public ones across the street in the square).

There's a reason that Pappy's is said to always have a line out the door, and it ain't because they have really slow service.  I have eaten all over the St. Louis area, but had never yet gone to Pappy's.  And part of the reason is because I had heard there was always such a long line.  Well I finally went for a lunch.  And there was a long line.  At least it moved quickly.  Still took 50 minutes to get to the ordering, though.  But they were well organized and kept people moving to the right places for a multi-part line.  There is ample seating, so once you order, a host takes you to a table, and your food is brought out in about 5 minutes.  I didn't have much time after waiting, though, so I got mine to go.  I just joined the several other people doing the same, and we stood over by a window bar area for the 5 minutes or so it took.  They brought mine out in a big paper bag, and they include two generous containers of sauce (original and smokey?) for each plate I ordered.  Two plates, so four sauce containers.  Oh, there's also a pretty good size parking lot behind the bldg.  But as many people as were eating or in line, it was still overflowing.

As to the food - I thought it was some real deliciousness.  Since I didn't have time to eat there, I did take time in the car to sample much of it while it was still fresh and hot/cold.  That was lunch, and then the wife and I ate the rest for dinner.  Overall, the meats were excellent, most sides were quite good, and the baked beans were okay.

The burnt ends were moan and chill inducing.  They actually wasn't any burnt part that I saw.  But they apparently had been so long cooked that the fat was all rendered and just gave up all its flavor to the melt in your mouth, tender & flavor-bursting meat.  The turkey breast was pretty much the opposite type of meat one could order from burnt ends, so I had a good contrast for how they did that.  And the breast was firm, yet moist.  Cooked so that the spices were prominent on the outside, yet had infused the meat too.  There also was a light smokiness throughout the turkey that complemented but didn't overpower.  Finally, there was a half slab of ribs.  And I see why Pappy's brags on them.  A nice crusty/carmelized coating on the top that still broke apart easily.  The meat had that slight pull and chew, with the outer two thirds pink and the inner part brown, that let you know it had been long and well smoked - but without getting stringy or just fall apart.  Very fine job.  A dry rub that flavored all the way through the meat, with a finishing glaze, and a satisfying easy pull apart and chew.

Sides - Potato salad was right up there, simple yet well executed mustard-based salad without too much sauce. Vinegar cole slaw was really good - it was chilled, the slaw was crisp, and the vinegar base had both tartness yet a hint of sweetness that mixed together just right.  Fried corn-on-the-cob was also good, fairly standard yet tasty.  Baked beans were the only item that I thought was just okay; they weren't bad, just average.  I guess I prefer pit beans with some extra flavor that spices them up, and these just didn't really excite me.  But I can forgive after all the other goodness.

So Pappy's has their local "spinoffs" in Bogarts, Dalies, Adams; and competing joints in Sugarfire and many others.  But for me, Pappy's showed why many consider it the king that deservedly started the BBQ boomlet in St. Louis

Extremely mediocre food and restaurant.  You order at the counter, expensive entree's and small portions.  Reviews are true and nothing to be excited about.  Dry ribs, fatty brisket, cold fries, and 30 min later the forgotten hush puppies balls show up, burnt.  Wasn't terrible experience but not going back, just not good bbq, too bad, great location by the Village.

I went here for a stand up comedy night, and I have to say, I wasn't terribly impressed. The restaurant itself has a chain-like feeling to it (is it a chain?) and the food was so so. 

All I really wanted was some respectable food and a coffee. It was 8pm on a weeknight, but they told me they had no coffee available. A bit odd.

I also got a beer which ended up tasting exactly like Coors Lite. Someone needs to clean their taps... 

Service was spotty, but they were at least nice. This is definitely not a place I'd seek out in the future.

Old school hardware store.  You can't get 10 feet inside the store without someone asking you how they can help you.  They have an older, experienced staff that is very helpful and knowledgeable.  

A very nice small-town store.  Not a hundred faucets to choose from in the plumbing dept like a Home Depot- but a few that will work fine-  and a staff  that will explain how to install it..

Highly recommend them for most any hardware need.

Disappointed!! There was only one staff person taking care of the entire restaurant and one cook. This was during the time frame of a huge conference. As I waiting for my food for over 45 min....I watched as more than 15 potential customers left. She had no support to even help clean the tables. Whoever Manages this store should be re-evaluated as that is just POOR management.
3 stars for the cooks - 0 for service - both times we've been here the food has been great and the service terrible

Robert Redford said, "Health food may be good for the conscience, but Oreos taste a hell of a lot better."   The "natural" & organic selections offered at TJ's are refreshingly tasty for "healthy food."  With the variety of imported chocolates, fresh & frozen desserts, candies, nuts & cookies, I have never once regretted leaving Oreos behind, Bob.

Six years ago I lived briefly in Southern California.  Costa Mesa sprawled a mile inland from my apartment & on one lovely corner my eye was drawn to a parking lot sporting a large sidewalk chalkboard with brightly colored words.  I followed my impulse (& the sign) & entered a distinctly one-of-a-kind grocery store. At the time I assumed it was a funky "when in California" kind of place & I shopped happily for three months.

Who wouldn't want to have fun grocery shopping if they could?  I'm a big fan of fun.  I like this quote from their website: "After considering the options, we're still just big 'ole fans of the neighborhood grocery store where we can say hello when you're looking around wondering - what's for dinner?"  And you know what?  They DO say hello... and tell funny jokes & offer to help, point you in the right direction or escort you to what you're looking for, banter with each other, ring bells to communicate with staff rather than overhead... they actually look at you & smile.

I admit a major attraction is that TJ's is NOT Schnucks, Dierberg's or Whole Foods.  Store buildings are smaller, well organized & shopper friendly.  Prices are reasonable.  Once you learn the layout you can be in & out in 30 minutes.
