Ready made foods (meats, salads, side dishes & more) are delicious.  Frozen foods are knock outs.  In five years I have bought one dish I didn't enjoy... one box of frozen coconut shrimp.  Produce quality & selection have vastly improved recently, dairy choices are excellent, coffees are imported and their wine, beer & liquor stock is actually very good.

Since Schnucks & Dierbergs have transformed their properties into super stores, I cringe when I know I need to go inside.  I would much rather spend my shopping time in the pleasant, offbeat & truly satisfying environment of Trader Joe's.  Hint:  When possible avoid the after school & after work crush.  Late evening is more laid back.

So glad we went with Granite Empire. They did a fabulous job. They work fast & accurate. We got our granite installed two days after purchase. Every single employee was kind & helpful. The guys went over and beyond the call of duty to make us happy. Our granite is BEAUTIFUL, we can't stop looking at it!! We will do all future business with this company!! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

If I could do it all over again, I would have chosen a different apartment. Unfortunately, the storage unit I rent on the property was flooded and the apartment didn't care one bit. They told me I could move my things to another unit. No discount or anything of that nature. Recently my bedroom and bathroom flooded and I was told they'd pay for my dry cleaning. I stay on the first floor and find mice and their dropping in my apartment frequently. I recently complained for the third time and they put ugly mouse traps out in the open in my apartment. That's embarrassing if and when I have guests. Everything needs to be upgraded in the units and there is no way to let guests into the apartment gates without walking out and throwing the card over the gate to get it to open. I gave two stars because some of the staff are very kind and I enjoy the gym.

This is my wife and I's favorite spot to eat since we've moved to Horsham, PA and I can't say enough good things about Lancers.  We eat here almost weekly as our night out or Sunday breakfast.   We are moving back to NC and will greatly miss the food, especially the French Onion soup.  I have posted many picture of our food so I hope that will help in your choice.   My favorite meal is the Chicken Parmigiana or Spaghetti w/ Meatballs.

El Torero has been closed for awhile to repair/remodel. It is owned by the same basic family as La Rua's on Broadway, which closed a few months ago due to Broadway widening. I found out that this week they were having a soft opening and may have grand reopening down the road. Have heard marvelous things about this family-owned restaurant, but had never been. Went today and had the chili verde plate. Excellent! The generous portion of chili verde was nice and tender chunks of beef; the refried beans done in-house for that great home-cooked, not canned, flavor; the guacamole was heavenly; and the house-made salsa was devine! The flour tortilla that came with the plate was delish, (stretchy, for those who know what I mean...) Waitress was very friendly and efficient. As far as the building, fresh paint everywhere, everything nice and shiny clean. Nice decor. I will be back!! Heads up! Street parking generally. Midway down the block of 26th, north side of street, just west of S 4th Ave.
A must see while in SB. The turtles and ducks and blooming lotus flowers...what a little piece of paradise.

I was told that this place was better than my favorite Mexican spot in StL (El Burro Loco - central west end). 

I was not impressed by this place in the slightest. The food is mediocre and lacks depth of flavor. I knew that I was not going to be impressed when I had the salsa that was average at best. 

I ordered the tacos Al pastor and was left underwhelmed. 

The service was fine and prices were fair.

Seemed like it would b a good experience.  Similar to Joes Crab Shack.  The server was good.  My wife and I ordered margaritas to start and they came in regular cocktail glasses and 1.00 xtra for strawberry! My wife ordered Panco fried shrimp which came very well done.  Unedible.  Asked the waiter to for a new order and the next plate came out just as burnt.  Was told that's the way it is.  This establishment needs work to bring it up to a better standard.  Beware.

I'm a Big O fanboy and have used different locations many times.  Always happy with prices and service.  I encourage friends and family to use them to handle basic fluids, brakes, tires, batteries, etc., as I feel they do just as good as dealerships or brand specialists in that regard.  Their house brand tires are very good (Made by Goodyear, sometimes Cooper) at a reduced price.

This location installed 4 new BF Goodrich tires and did an alignment on my car within the timeframe they specified.  The cost of the tires was the exact same TireRack charged for delivery, they're warrantied, and the labor rate was fair.  They did not push hard for (ridiculous) upgrades like nitrogen fill, credit cards, etc.  

The only complaint (which is more with corporate than this location) is that I had originally set up an appointment online, which seemed to work fine.  But this location functions on a first come first serve basis, and doesn't use corporate Big O's appointment setting website thingie.  I do wish the Big O website had informed me of that.

This location rocks - recommended!

I would give this place 5 stars because the food is excellent. I mean everything. The stuffed mushrooms are so good. They are cash only which is a bit of an inconvenience. I've been coming to this place for years and I've always had a awesome experience. Just recently, I've seen roaches crawling on the tables and on the walls AFTER I finished eating. Such a shame because I really love their food. Grossed me out so bad that I will not be returning. Also if you visit, please make sure you give Franky a big tip because she's generally nice until she sees the tip and if its not what she's expecting, she turns into a witch. Becomes very nasty. They are in desperate need of an exterminator! Otherwise they are great!

I've been to this location and the one in Villanova a few times before, but I was incredibly disappointed in my visit today, and the last time my mom went to the Villanova location there was a live mouse sitting on the cushion of a bench style seat next to her. My friend and I arrived around 12:15 and were told there was a 30 minute wait without a reservation despite there being more than 5 tables open throughout the restaurant. We put our name in and were told we'd get a text when it was ready, so we stopped by the nearby shops and looked around. At 1, there was still no call or text about the table, so we went back into the restaurant and were told we could be seated then. We were taken to a table wedged so far in the back corner that our server could barely get to us, yet there were open tables elsewhere that did not fill the entire hour and a half we were there. Our server greeted us fairly quickly and took our order, and we waited almost an hour for two breakfast sandwiches. We noticed the tables around us that had already been seated when we first arrived at 12:15 had still not received their food either. The table directly next to us sat for 20 minutes without being greeted by a server, and were not greeted until one of the guests said something to the hostess. When the manager cane to speak to them she was unapologetic and said there was a mix up and they were getting them a different server. My friend also ordered a side of fries that did not arrive until we had been finished with our entrees for five minutes and were flavorless and burned. We cancelled the dessert we ordered to not be stuck there any longer, and were offered no apologies, explanation, or compensated items for our unreasonable wait. After we closed our check, I walked to the back to use the restroom and EVERY server AND the manager were in the kitchen eating, talking, and on their phones. For the attitude avenue kitchen tries to convey and the prices of the items, this service was unacceptable. We still tipped 20% because we weren't raised in a barn. Most of our food was good but the disorganization and lack of urgency among the staff was off putting. I will not be returning to this establishment.

The best Cuban food i have ever had. Very "mom and pop" type feel with generous servings of your favorite cuisine. I've been to the restaurant 3 x and each time i try different plates. I haven't had anything that I didn't like. My mouth is watering just typing this review. Lovely place to go with the family after church.

I came here for YEARS, since I could drive actually, the owner was great, friendly and they always did a great job. He was soooooooo good! But then they went through a restructuring plan, got ride of the fantastic management and mechanics team. I CAME IN FOR AN OIL CHANGE AND ENDED UP GETTING A WHOLE DIFFERENT ENGINE! Got my oil change and road trip check up before I went to Phoenix for the day, all was good. A week or two later I was heading up first ave. right after river up the hill and my car completely craps out, I had to have it towed, I had to use a company car before my rental came through. The lady at the rental car area they used right next door was rude and made me feel like I was an inconvenience. Turns out someone forgot to tighten a valve and there is oil ALL OVER MY ENGINE! Because of this I needed a whole new engine in my car! They told me they would replace my engine for a new one *cough cough* they didn't give me a new engine they gave me a newER engine, supposedly, that had less miles. Sorry, but you WRECKED MY CAR and made it UNDRIVABLE. Not only that once the newER engine was in I went to get groceries and my car over heated and I had to be towed back to them. Overall, this place is now a nightmare. My car is worth less because of needing an engine replacement than if it had other wise, possibly causing me thousands. I went to a Lawyer and they told me it would cost about the same to hire them as it would to have a NEW engine put in. I used to love this place, I would recommend everyone come here. Not now. My mom and I would come here often and we would always have a great time talking with the management team and staff, not now, after this she will not take a car here. She has a 2014 corvette stingray, dodge srt-10 with a viper engine, and a dodge larime all of which would have been serviced here, until this happened. Now we just pay more to go to the dealer, it's worth it. Don't go here if you care about the vehicle you drive. This was a year or two ago but I am still really ticked off this happened in the first place and I don't assume anything has changed. My car has not been the same since. It does not drive the same as it used too and overall just feels completely different while driving. I paid for one car and got another, simply by having an oil change. Not my cup of tea. Any place you need to replace your engine when getting an oil change isn't good. Don't come here. This was the one and only car that my father helped me to pick out before he died of cancer, it is a very sentimental vehicle to me, and is/was/has been completely ruined since he died of cancer shortly after. I feel like now I have to have either a proper working car, and sell this one, or keep it to remember my father. I wanted to keep this car forever because of the sentimental value, and I hate that because of their screw up I even contemplate selling it. It never was/has been/or will be the same vehicle I bought. Shame on you!!!!!!! Bring back 2007 management team!!!!! 

Apparently I have two Yelp accounts, if you click on the "not recommended reviews" you can see my
Original review of this place. Either way the quality of service sucked and the way they treated my vehicle, and I will make sure my review is heard. This place sucks.

We've been customers since they opened. I think between me and my husband we've bought a dozen cars here. Always walk away happy and always come back happy when we're ready for another car. Comfortable, casual and cool, the staff is friendly and they get it done.

Noise level is nearly painful! Unable to talk among our party of four. Absolutely no atmosphere in this remodel. Very boring space. The "private party room" is a glass box open to the dining room. All private party noise invades the dining space. 
Food is rather uninspired although butternut squash soup was rich and hardy. Otherwise, dishes were no more than so so. 
Excellent service so I give three stars for effort. 
Unless the kitchen improves and sound suppression is installed I wonder if it will be here next year.

This is a cute place with a comfortable and cozy atmosphere. It is small but they give you plenty of space between tables so you don't feel overcrowded. There are also a few tables outside. This place is nice but I wouldn't call it the best Italian in Philly. I don't think you can even compare this place to Modo Mio or Mercato.

Mini crab cake appetizers were actually pretty large and delicious. This was the tastiest part of our meal. These may be the best crab cakes that I have had in Philly. If everything tasted this good, I would have rated this place a 5 instead of a 3.

I ordered the Vegetarian tasting and I guess they alter it by the day since what I got was a little different than the menu. I didn't mind but the waiter never mentioned it. The Farm Salad is a typical side salad- good but nothing exceptional. The Risotto Pattie was fried and didn't have much taste to it- by frying it, the taste of the risotto was lost. I would rather just have risotto. Menu shows roasted potatoes but my meal came with kale and artichokes which were decent. The small cup of mushroom soup that came with the tasting was outstanding. 

My fellow diner got the Penne Ragu. I tried it and thought it was very average and didn't have enough taste. 

The bread that they brought out at the beginning was also very average. They drizzled a very small amount of olive oil on it (hardly enough to add any flavor). I much rather the olive oil be given separate and not already on the bread.

Service was ok. We were only 1 of 3 other tables since it was a Sunday night. The waiter could have been more attentive especially since it was so slow. It felt like we waited a long time for our check.

I cannot even begin to say how horrible this hospital is.... Super scary!
You are suppose inter a hospital to be saved not hurt or possibly even killed. Unbelievable regarding treatment and knowledge or lack thereof.

People!   Read the charts before coming into the patients room. OMG!!! Every time a new care giver came into the room they would ask why you were there. My mother came in as a cardiac patient and they kept wanting to remove her gallbladder. You just cannot make this stuff up. 

My father has cancer and while he was in the hospital I cannot even begin to tell you all of the mistakes they made regarding his treatment. Very serious ones I might ad.

When calling in to speak with my mother, the operator was incredibly rude and proceeded to bark at me regarding how many people she speaks to in a day. Then transferred without saying another word. 

I just do not know how they can run a business this way, while putting their patients in harms way more often then not.

I went here for brunch. The only Moroccan thing on their brunch menu was Moroccan eggs which was a little weird. I ended up getting them and they were great. Waitress was a little inattentive even though the place was almost empty.

I also took off a star because they have gendered single occupancy bathrooms, which are against the law in Philadelphia. When I informed the owner, he didn't seem to care at all.

SERVICE - Friendly staff who offered us to sample some flavors :)

AMBIENCE/DECOR - Chillax. The place is quite spacious and can use some more decorations! Feels a bit empty, especially on the walls. (or maybe because it was literally empty when we got there...)

FOOD - Out of the 3 that I tried my favorite was probably [TARO], which had the richest flavor. [ORANGE CREAM] was pretty good but I'm not a fan of orange-flavored anything. [CHARCOAL VANILLA] looked cool but i couldn't taste anything?! All of them had very creamy texture.

Not really impressed by the flavor selection during our visit. Nothing special that stood out to me.
Shit serivce! Shit atmosphere and not many choices  of cigars. Recommand the place across  the street  fusion cigar lounge.

Worst Service.
Whatever you might think about Mercedes, one thing is for sure, this location/company does not hold up the usual five star service. Buy your car at another location and never use the service/collision department. It's a joke.
Great food and well made, I have ordered two different dishes from them several times, a little pricey depending on what you get but they earn it. The chicken gyro is yummy. The octopus is amazing!
Homemade, healthy Greek food from a mom-n-pop restaurant in North Indy. We walked in on Sunday night and there was an awesome buffet. 5/5

Someone sent something to my address by accident.. I went to this UPS store to have them return the letter to the sender. They asked me to PAY for this, which I declined.. I left the letter on the counter & the girl at the desk threw the letter on the floor as I walked out.  I told her again "this letter is not to me please Return to Sender!" 

To say the least this UPS store's customer service needs a little improving.

The Culinary Adventures of Tom Coghlan, FB
When my friend and fellow "foodie", Laurie asked me if I had a brunch adventure planned for the weekend, my wheels started turning... Having already been on a few adventures together, I wanted to do something that would be new to us both! The Urban Farmer came to mind. My friend, Karl Schappell (See Thirsty Soul. Feastival, and Urban Farmer) is the manager there, and he informed me that they had a weekend brunch worth exploring! THEY DO! We arrived at The Urban Farmer which is nestled in The Logan (Formerly The Four Seasons) on The Ben Franklin Parkway about 10:30. The Bar was packed! We surveyed the bar and asked one of the Bartenders if it looked like any seats would be soon available... Two patrons at the end of the bar were finishing up, so we patiently waited for our opportunity. After securing our seats, we met our server Colleen. Colleen and I recognized each other from my previous visit... We reminisced. The cocktail we chose was Farmer #4, Tito's vodka, St. Germain, grapefruit, lime, Peychaud's bitters. We chose this because it was a bit similar to a Romarin, that we both enjoy...The bitters made it different!! For an ice cube they froze a LARGE block of grapefruit juice and mixed the drink on top! It was very good! I ordered, Shrimp & Grits, poached egg, shrimp, castle valley grits, cheddar, Tasso ham, and Laurie ordered, Shaved Sirloin Benedict, served with house-made English muffin. My shrimp and Grits were served with several shrimps that were COMLETELY peeled... No tail!  I liked that! The shrimp were cooked in a creole like sauce and added to the grits with delicious cubes of ham and then topped with a perfectly poached egg. The flavors worked VERY well together! Laurie's Benedict was "probably the best Benedict" she ever had! We had one more drink and we were off! The Urban Farmer has a WONDERFUL Weekend Brunch, and I would highly recommend trying it out!    https://www.urbanfarmersteakhouse.com/

Tried to have a family dinner Sunday @7. First, a long wait as teen hostesses are apathetic and poorly trained. Then got seated and got a Chihuahua looking man (in his late 20s-early 30s with thin short red-brown hair) to 'serve us'. He was rude and lazy --UBER unpleasant. We finally got our plates that were barely warm. We just got up and left. What a blah place! Surprised that Brentwood has few good food choices and that this lack of quality can survive there.

I've eaten at La Haciendas around town for 15 years, but I've never seen anything as disorganized and incompetent as this location anywhere else. I ordered through Yelp/GrubHub for pickup. After being notified that my order was ready, I arrived at the restaurant and was told it wasn't ready yet.

Ten minutes later, an employee running orders from the kitchen to the pickup table said my order had already been picked up. They didn't ask me for identification and obviously didn't for whoever walked away with my order. How is this possible, you may ask? It's because there is nobody in charge, no manager or other person overseeing things. Worse than that, they clearly allow anyone to stroll up to the pickup table and walk away with an order with no supervision whatsoever. Three people did it while I was there.

I got a refund through GrubHub, but I walked out of the restaurant without my food and without the slightest concern or consideration shown by anyone there. Just "sorry, your order has already been picked up." 

Needless to say, this is the last time I patronize this place. There are too many Mexican restaurants serving the exact same food that are well run and reliable. This one isn't.

I went last week to buy a zinc anode for my boat and they were out of stock but had them at another store and said they would ship them and call me in 2-3 days. Having not heard for about a week I retuned to find they weren't shipped and perhaps out of stock at the warehouse. No call. I canceled the order and bought them at a lower price on Amazon. While was at the store I found dry lubricant in a spay can for over $20, only then did I walk across the parking lot to HomeDepot to find a selection of the product for $4.99.
I love the food. I think they serve authantic Turkish food. Their appetizer combo plate is delicious. Iskender is nearly as good as I had in Turkey.

The General Manger had an attitude the whole time.  If she doesn't like her job maybe she should quit.  I will not come back to this u-haul center because of her crappy attitude.  She wouldn't give her name either.

This was my first time at Spot's and I was so impressed. My dog is older, blind, diabetic, and doesn't get along well with other pups - they were so accommodating, and quick! I initially requested a weekend appointment, but they advised a weekday appointment so they'd be able to keep a closer eye on my pup and get him out quickly since he gets anxious. I really loved the entire staff and Baxter looks great!

I have stayed at this location once before and am still kicking myself for making such a bad decision. Waited 30 minutes for someone to valet my car upon check in. There were others waiting as well and it's like the guy just disappears every now and then. Staff didn't even know when I asked the front desk but they really didn't care. Messed up my reservation and tried giving me a crappy room without deducting the extra I paid for a suite. 
Tried to find someone again to get my bag that the airline dropped off. Waited almost 1/2 hour for that as the bell mans excuse was he was parking cars. 
There was also several rooms with breakfast crap outside of their doors upon going to my room at 6:00pm. Sadly, this crap still existed the next morning (24 hours later). 
The room service food was crappy. Suggest going to the Irish pub right down the street (Tigin Irish Pub) only a 5 minute walk or Tony's Italian which is another good place. Liked Tigrin better with the live entertainment and good bar food. 
Another thing with the crown, my patio door don't lock no matter how much I try. The bed was cozy but the so called suite was outdated and worn. Careful not to get stuck in the bathroom as it's very, very, very small.
Also had a worker walk right in two hours after I checked in. She never even knocked and just stood their when I said someone is in here and then approached her. Seemed a little fishy to me. Planning on scanning my belongings??
Bottom line, I am convinced the Crown Plaza is a crap hole. Had similar issues with two other Crowns in WI. I am done with Crown Plaza's! They are all crap holes!!

Overall was a okay experience. Food was good, I got fish tacos. I asked the waitress for light sour cream and my request was not provided. Waitress was mad that she had to serve 10 people and had to move some tables around. Waitress did not come around to refill drinks.. and the food took forever to come. The place is a small place, but the atmosphere feels authentic due to the Mexican music and of course the workers. I would come back for the food, relatively fair priced tacos.. but everything else such as the rice and chili served on the side seemed very bland.

Went back, ate more, gained MORE weight.  Friend from D.F. agreed that I am a genius and that it's a great meal. Ok, she really liked the dish she had. Our male server wasn't as fun as Norma but did a fine job. Awesome hibiscus iced tea that my expert said was great, too. Flans were nice and dense but smooth. Perfect with a coffee before being sent home to enjoy the impending food coma. Ahhhhh......

Is there a zero stars option?!  This has sadly gone so downhill.  Food used to be delicious and service was top notch. Tonight I went with 3 girlfriends.  Our waitress went missing and we found out she went home I'll. After an hour & no meals in sight, we asked for our food to go because we had no news. The manager finally came over but didn't apologize.  One friend hated her overly salty soup. My food was dumped in a container & when I got home I realized the salmon was raw. I'd recommended this place for our girls night but never again. I was planning a brunch for about 28 people next month, but am changing the plans for sure. Such a shame.
This is the last time I support JC's.  We are quarantined at home and ordered from these people only to be canceled several times.  I guess they don't care if they are in business or not.

My daughter and I were craving Indian cuisine and our town is depressingly devoid so it was time for a run to Tampa.  We were sold on Desi Flavors when we saw it had a weekend buffet because where better for the opportunity to try a handful of new things without committing to a single dish, right?

The food was delicious and there was a great selection.  We got to indulge in our usual favorites (butter chicken, gobi) and try a handful of new items too (curried goat, Afghani chicken kebab).  I particularly loved the chicken biryani and honestly wish I had daily access to it.  Everything was great and the staff were courteous and helpful, ready to explain any dishes we were curious about.

Whenever we're in Tampa, this spot will be on our short list for a good meal.

The place is located off of Broad Street, approximately one half way between City Hall and the stadium complex. Parking is not easy and the streets are tight in this area of the city. I was able to get a spot a couple of blocks away. 

The Entire restaurant feels like someone's dining room, such a warm and comfortable feeling.

Checkout  Anthony Bourdain "The Layover" Philadelphia Episode and see how great this place is.

We sat for over 10 minutes and still no waitress finally after asking twice we get someone who says she was told we seated our self after we got that straighter our she says ok I'll be back in a couple of minutes and still no drinks we finally get our drinks and now she is rushing and this was lace isn't busy at all we fly slot and I promise we will never ever eat here again we just got our food and Surprise its a total flop now a totally different waiter walks up and says sorry we're closing in three days I give up

I'm updating this review because we had a great experience this week with the staff. My dog snagged his side on a fence and needed some staples put in. The vet tech and vet on staff were awesome. Super friendly, kind, and gentle with him. Totally opposite experience compared to last time. I'm really hoping that this is a positive step forward and they continue to hire people like this, while weeding out the bad ones. Parking still sucks though.

New Orleans - The city of food and music!

On my first day in the Big Easy a local gave me some good advice. "If you want great music you need to get away from Bourbon Street and make your way to Frenchman Street - that's where it's at".  He was right. We stumbled into the Spotted Cat Music Club and the sound was right on. The drinks were strong and the place had a good vibe. We listened to a great band play for a few hours. 

We visited  a few other  music clubs before and one after but the Spotted Cat had the best sound going that night   

I know I will be back the next time I'm in NOLA.

I get a little impatient with reviews based on specific experiences: My bread was cold. The service was slow. My chicken piccata was fabulous! 

I'm more interested in the total experience of a restaurant, over time. What's its original intent? How is its POV different? How well does it execute on its intent? Is it consistent?

To really judge a joint, it takes more than one meal. I like to go back a few times before I make up my mind, and I like to bring other people with me. I've been to Jane three times with friends, so now I feel I can make a provisional judgment. 

Here it is: Jane is the real thing. This is very good food, served by a serious wait staff, in authentically unfussy surroundings. It's not about phony elegance, a catchy concept, or a regional theme.  It's about food. 

The dishes are flavorful, surprising, satisfying. They're not amped up, over-designed, or trendy. They borrow from the usual food cultures---France, Italy, California, U.S. heartland---without making a big deal out of any one. They're plain Jane, using "plain" in its most positive Shaker-like sense.

You'll probably meet Jane in the flesh. She told us she's not actually a chef, but the daughter of a couple of chefs who run another restaurant, the Montecito Cafe. Her parents should be proud. I can tell you that Jane and her eponymous restaurant are quickly moving up my list of favorites.
Excellent wine selection and I highly recommend the lamb t-bone ( although I think it may have just been a special for the night). Ask for Frank. An excellent , well-prepared friendly server
The ultimate beer lovers paradise, over 100 beers on tap. Great food, really cool atmosphere, service needs help. But if you love beer then make a pilgrimage here it will be well worth your while.

Not at all impressed with this place.  sitting at an almost empty bar and it still took over 10 minutes to get a drink. The drink was mediocre at best and seriously over priced which seems to be the norm every time I come here.  will not be coming here again.

Hands down the worst shopping store I've ever been to the clothes were alright but the worker were very rude and gave me attitude when all I wanted was to pick up my clothes unkind and rude and sassy people I don't recommend and I will never go back to that place again and neither will any of my friends and family not worth it at all I would rather go to fashion exchange down the road for better customer service and clothes don't waste your time at this place it will only upset you.

Went here for lunch today with my mom and grandma to celebrate my grandmas birthday. Had a really good time. Service was great and food was really good! Had a difficult time picking off the menu since everything looked great. I will have to go back soon.
Just left and mice were roaming around pretty disgusting. Guy there didn't seem to concerned about it.

This Whole Foods Market is located nearby Philadelphia's Magic Garden, in which I had just finished visiting and highly recommend checking it out if you haven't done so before. It is well worth the affordable admission price ($10 for adults and $8 for students with ID). 

My husband and I decided to come in here this afternoon to take a break from the heat, grab something to eat and relax a bit before heading out to another adventure of Philadelphia. 

I really love shopping at Whole Foods and thought this was probably the smallest location that I have been to. But anyway, I really love Whole Food's dessert section, cookie bar, hot and cold food bar and also their in store bar.

On this visit, we ended up picking up a few different desserts, which I thought was interesting to pick and place in a to go container myself, as opposed to having to order at a display case (in which that is how I have always done it at other Whole Foods locations). I ended up getting a cheesecake, a pistachio tart, a cannoli (my husband really wanted that) and a fruit tart. I love the consistency of these $2 desserts from one location to another. 

After we paid for our items, we headed to the small eating area, which is next to their little bar. My husband ended up ordering a beer, Blueblood, $7. This hard cider has guava and passion fruit, making it a little sour. I thought it wasn't bad and my husband liked it. If I lived in this area, I would definitely try to take advantage of the happy hour where you save $1 on a 16 oz beer or wine by the glass, Monday- Thursday, 4-6 pm. 

Service with both cashiers were nice and friendly. Have no complains.Just thought this location was on the small side. 

Please note that there are 2 restrooms by the store room, in the back of the store. You will need a code to use it, so be sure to ask the employee (I think the code that I used today is 245 but cannot fully recall if that it is for sure).

Nice presentation of the food but the food it self wasn't that great. I ordered a chicken sandwich and the chicken was hard as a rock. My first thought was "is there something in my food" but no it was the chicken. How am I supposed to enjoy this when I can't even eat it! My waiter was overall nice but the person who seated me wasn't as friendly. 

Glad my fries were okay it's something that always I could eat but I don't think this is a place I'll visit again.

While the food is tasty the service is horrible. Had to wait one hour for an order that was called in an hour before that. When we finally got the food, it wasn't that hot and soaked in grease. Very disappointed.

Lunch at 11:30 on a Thursday. Had the strawberry salad and tomato bisque soup and both were delicious. There were no empty tables when I left at 11:50 and the line was out the door. The food here is a home run, but the parking and seating can be a hassle. I will be back for sure, but never between noon and 1.

We dined on a weekend which may not be reflective of the weekdays. However, the location presented a problem with parking-not so much the lack of it but where it is. We were almost climbing over barriers in the streets and cars speeding by us. We were seated promptly. This was great. But if a quiet dinner is your goal this is not your place. Very loud. It's hard to hear each much less the waiter. The next down fall was the drinks. They were potent but not very tasty and some odd concoctions. On the up side the food was excellent. All the snacks or appetizers and the flat breads were a hit. The shells hit it out of the park. The fettuccine was dark in color but very good. The ribs were tender and had an Asian flavor. The desserts were average but not bad. The best was the coconut cake. I would have given higher marks if was only rating the food. But atmosphere and the place was very understaffed. A 1 hour dinner took 3 because they were slow and over worked. I will be back but going to try a week day.

Being a girl who knows nothing about cars, I usually expect to get ripped off when I go to an auto repair shop. I was pleasantly surprised that this was not the case with Pit Stop. 

Both the inside AND outside handle on my driver's side door broke off in the same week.  The dealership quoted me a price of $600 to fix it, including labor [!!!!]. No, thank you. After calling around, Pit Stop seemed to have the lowest price of $250. I even called back to make sure that estimate included labor - it did. 

I dropped my car off before work and it was waiting for me at 4pm when I got off work. I even called during the day to confirm that it would ONLY be $250 with tax and labor, and indeed, it was $251.19 with tax. Amazing. The new handles on my car are exactly like the previous handles, AND the guys at Pit Stop washed and vacuumed my car. By far the easiest (and perhaps cheapest?) interaction I've ever had with an auto repair shop!

Both times I went I ordered two coffees and two breakfast burritos. The place was busy with long lines and I waited an excessive amount of time for my order. To top it off everyone who ordered after me got there order before me, when I asked about my order the staff laughed at me and made it seem like I was inconveniencing them. Terrible service for mediocre food and coffee.
I forgot to mention that Erik also has gluten free no not the usual disgusting gf but homemade heavenly gf as in you can't tell it's gf ! Prices are wonderful!

Great cocktails, great food, and great service from everyone!! Our server Michael was attentive and very knowledgeable about everything we asked about in the menu, esp. the cocktails. I recommend the Legacy Smash cocktail if you like a twist in whisky. Other great cocktails are Lucky Frieda (gin base) and Porch Swing (tastes just like sweet tea, ZERO alcohol taste). For appetizers, we had Cajun Queso, delicious with lots of crawfish meat. My favorite dish was the Crawfish Cornbread Casserole, sweet & savory. The shoestring fries with garlic herb aioli is the best fries I have ever had! Ribeye was ok, it wasn't quite medium rare as requested, but not bad to where I would send it back. My man had Chicken and Waffles... BACON baked in the waffles! Sweet butter & good syrup. Basic chicken strips, not traditional bone in chicken, but still juicy. Overall, we would come back for more!

Amazingly delicious hot chicken. Also serve fish and outrageous done-up baked potatoes. Very tasty and generous side dishes. Slaw was outstanding. This is the real thing! Very friendly staff. Eat in or take out to very nearby Beaman park like we did. Don't miss this out of the way gem. Don't wait in line at other places. Support small business!

Out of all the locations in Indianapolis this is the worst when it comes to customer service. I have ordered twice now (called in) only to get there and my food not be ready (I even show up 5 minutes late) the one off of old meridian is always a great experience , maybe I'll just order from there from here on out

Ordered through GrubHub, arrived promptly. The food was "meh". We ordered the bacon egg and cheese biscuit and the biscuits and gravy. The gravy was good! But the biscuits are basically Duncan Hines Vanilla cake. They are SO dense and cloyingly sweet. They do not have the texture of your grandma's flakey buttermilk biscuits. Would have great potential if they worked on the texture of the biscuits, which are also the size of a Costco muffin.

I've always loved the sushi bar at the Atlantis. Not to mention it holds a very special place in my heart. We went tonight for dinner and Olena, our server, was absolutely wonderful. Good food, good service, good atmosphere. Definitely recommend it

Kudos to the crew working here. The food was freshly prepared, the service was friendly and prompt, and my tray was brought to me in the dining area with a smile. I wish all of the McDonald's in Tucson were as good!

I didn't have a great experience with the Perfect Stitch. It started off ok, but didn't end well for me. I went in to meet with Melissa for a dress that was initially "too small". I had gained a little weight since purchasing the dress and was worried I wouldn't lose the weight so I went in to see about getting it taken out. My first impression with Melissa was was a bit cocky and didn't have that great of an attitude. She came into the fitting room and begin trying to zip my dress and said "I can't zip this" and just had this look on her face. Clearly I knew the dress couldn't fit but she is in the bridal alterations business, she may want to be a little more sensitive towards brides. I chalked it up and just explained the situation and figured that is just her personality. Fast forward she ended up warming up a little and becoming nicer. I ended up getting the dress taken out but warned both Her and Her assistant that I plan on losing weight and if I do will they be able to take the dress in. They reassured me that it wouldnt be a problem. I went to my 2nd fitting where she had taken the dress out and noticed the seams on the side where very noticeable and looked as if the dress was taken out. I mentioned it and they reassured me it will be pressed and will look better. I came back to my final fitting 10 pounds lighter! I lost 2 inches from my waist. I'm already a small person and went from a size 6 back to my normal size 4 which is where I was when I purchased the dress a year in advance.  I was very proud of myself. Her assistant Tried to convince me that the dress still fit perfect. I told her I didn't feel it fit well and that even though it was my decision to lose weight I would now like to pay to have the dress taken back in. She kept saying it fits perfectly. I advised her that I lost 2 inches and also reminded her that at my last appointment I told them I planned on losing some weight and they said it would be no problem to take it in. (Taken it out was just a precautionary thing for me). She still tried to convince me it fit perfectly and that I don't need it taken in. I requested to speak to Melissa, the seamstress. She said she was too busy. I feel the seamstress should have gotten involved at that point once she realized I wasn't happy with the fit. Melissa never came to see me at my LAST fitting. I think that should be customary for the actual seamstress to come and make sure it fits well. Long story short I ended up leaving taking their advice that the dress fit well. I got home and I still felt uneasy so I tried it on for my then Fiance. He didn't like it at all and said to take it back to have it taken in no matter what the cost. It's. Mermaid dress for heavens sake, it's supposed to be tight not loose. The next morning I called and spoke to the assistant and explained my situation about not feeling good about the fit and I would like to pay to have it taken in. Their attitudes were very rude and snippy. Melissa finally got on the phone acting high and mighty saying the dress fit perfect when I left. Lady, you didn't even come see me to see if it fit well. Even when I asked to speak to you. That is bad business. I spent about $500 with them ordering my bridal accessories, getting my daughters flower girl dress hemmed, etc. and you send me away with a poorly fitting dress? And then you don't even have the courtesy to come check with me THE CUSTOMER once I express displeasure? A blind man could see the dress didn't fit well. They finally  said to bring it back to get taken in but the fact that their attitudes  were so bad I didn't want to do business with them anymore. The attitudes is what frustrated me the most. They didn't deserve anymore of my business or money. Melissa, needs to have several seats and learn to listen to her customers needs and wants. She doesn't have a great attitude and honestly that's what bothered me the most. If I would have called and she was pleasant about everything vs. rude I wouldnt be so displeased. It wasn't like I was asking her to take it in for free. I was willing to pay whatever the amount for it.  It was the fact that she had a snippy attitude. I don't think her work is all that great in all actuality. I wouldn't say she's the best in Indy. She thinks a little too highly of her work and its not all that. I ended up taking my dress to Yong's alterations and explained the situation and she agreed that the dress didn't fit well at all. She took my dress in for $85 bucks and had it ready within 1 day. Perfect customer service. Great attitude and showed a willingness to help. The last thing a bride needs to deal with is a cocky lady with a bad attitude since we already have enough stress our plate so I wouldn't recommend the Perfect Stitch, ain't nothing "Perfect" about them.

This was the best moving experience I could have hoped for. The truck and men not only showed up on time but early! They were ready to work and worked hard and efficiently. The men were super polite (and strong) and navigated the move a very large bed frame down a very narrow staircase and never complained. I am very grateful to their positive attitudes, promptness, and good pricing for the move. If I ever have to move (this was a move for my dad), I will definitely call them again. Great job men and many THANKS!!!

Decent Neighborhoood bar with a good beer selection.  Unfortunately, the bartenders knowledge does not rise to the level of beer offered.  They wll give you samples, and that really helps here because they are self-professed Coors Light Guys.

Food is decent.

They arrived unprepared to remove and install. No dolly no truck. Refused to look at appliance instructions. Said they never do they just install. Left with important trim parts and returned them without finishing job. Refused to look at directions that said to install the heat vent the doors had to be removed. They conversed in Spanish and left me without working brand new appliance because they couldn't /wouldn't read the installation instructions. Beyond macho and just left. I would never recommend a company that treats customers in this manner. I belong to a large (500) organization of women in Tucson and they will hear my post b

Despite some of the other recent reviews being bad about here, my wife and I chose to come here anyway. And from our good margaritas to our wings and fries everything came out nice and hot. No complaints here. Thanks Ronae for the service

Half full dining room on a Thurs evening.

Waited 1/2 hour for our Buffalo Shrimp appetizer, was actually good but by that point we'd have eaten our napkins.  Can't speak for our entrees, after another 40 min we got rare prime rib that was cooked to well done gray and a chicken steak sandwich I had completely forgot I ordered.  After about 90 min we figured we'd just go.

To their credit our server comped the check. Regardless that doesn't cut it

We've heard great things about Mario's Portofino and after our visit, I can definitely agree and give my own praise about this restaurant. 

Right as you walk through the front doors, there is a coat rack to hang any unwanted outerwear during your meal service. We seated very shortly after entering. Our server, Pepe, was such a friendly and really down to earth guy. Throughout our meal service he would always make sure we were well taken care of. He also had a great sense of humor. 

After our bread service, Pepe came back to take our order. After giving us his recommendations, my room mates ordered the Linguine Corleone, Pollo Marsala, and for me, the Bistecca Di Calamari. 

Before the food arrived, we realized that it was 8:25pm. We didn't realized it, but we came an hour before the restaurant closed. We apologized to Pepe and asked for take out boxes, but he told us that there was no rush. Instead, we enjoyed our meal with haste! Everything tasted fantastic. I loved their calamari steak; it was a generous piece and tasted great with the sun dried tomatoes. The Linguine Corleone had a lighter flavor and their shrimp were tender and juicy. The mushroom wine sauce for the Pollo Marsala had so much flavor. It was probably my favorite of the night! 

The food was amazing and reasonably priced. The service was exceptional. Pepe made us feel welcomed and seemed to really enjoy his job. Granted this was our first visit, but with Mario's only being such a short drive from where we live, I can say with confidence that it won't be our last.

I've been sitting here for 20 minutes at least and still don't have my order. I watched 3 people get theres and leave that came in after me. Watched multiple orders messed up and totally unprofessional counter help take place. This place is a mess. I'm not even sure they have a manager on duty and if he is he is totally inadequate at his job.  Don't come here if you have any expectations of what customer service should be, you'll be disappointed. I only stopped here because I thought it would be fast. I was wrong.
This place is so Great! The hair stylists take their time and such a relaxing Haircut!  My hair looked great! Thank you for doing what you do!

I wish I could give Beach City -10 stars. I know there's plenty of bad yelp reviews on here, which I desperately wish I would've seen before blindly moving into this trash heap. If I had, I never would've moved here - I would've ran far far away. I would've rather lived in a trailer park my first semester of college than here. They fool you into thinking Beach City is a well run apartment complex with caring staff & security. It's the complete opposite as soon as you move in. First, the apartment itself: when we moved in, the apartment was clearly not cleaned beforehand (as promised in lease) & there was also mold growing in many area of the apartment. We also never had and never got a sign for our door that had our apartment number (a small problem when considering the many other ways Beach City has wronged us). We continuously asked for maintenance to look into the mold, with them ignoring our concerns and telling us we were causing the mold, despite the fact it was growing through the walls before we even moved in. My roommates and I were all sick on and off the whole semester, eventually we realized the mold was causing us to get sick. I've had a chronic cough for months which I have no doubt came from living in a moldy apartment. This is just one example of how the apartments are in less than suitable living condition and also how the beach city staff & owners continuously ignore & dismiss their tenants valid concerns. I've heard of worse situations in other apartments - we once had a friend in another apartment stay with us for weeks since there were ants & termites in hers that beach city refused to deal with. Also, let me just add the community here is horrible. Beach City is anything less than wholesome or safe - they allow parties & partying to an extent which I've seen almost cost people's lives. Once, my friends and I had to save a girl who has wandering around drunk & almost severely injured herself. Where was Beach City security, who claims to be protecting us? No where to be found. Lastly, there's a global pandemic happening & while our whole state is on lockdown and everyone I know living at Beach has left, they refuse to terminate our leases instead profiting off this horrible situation. I could write an entire ten page paper on why you shouldn't give this place your money. They made $7000 a month off me and my roommates alone, living in one apartment. Yet the living conditions are almost uninhabitable and they treat you as if you're the dog poop on the bottom of their boat shoes. I truly wish I could take back my decision to live here, but since I can't my only wish is that at least one person reads this & never lives here because of it. DONT LIVE HERE. Please.
Steaks that melt like butter, rattlesnake bites (jalapeno and cheese fried nuggets),price ranges for everyone. LOVE this place and go often.

I purchased a new Mustang here a few  years ago and had a great experience.   It was now time for my wife to get a new SUV so we looked at an  Explorer.  Looked first at  Elder Ford but the prices online seemed slightly better at Bill Currie.  We made an appointment to do the deal but found out that they add a "comes with every car" $1495 maintenance plan on top of the price.  Separate sticker on the window, but claim that they have no way to take it off.  It includes theft recovery (that's what insurance is for) and roadside assistance (which comes with every new Ford for 4 years/50K miles).  We were ready to sign except for this, but they wouldn't budge.  Went back to  Elder Ford and had a great experience.  Awful way to do business Bill Currie, you should be ashamed.
Bad hygiene, the blanket have cigarette hole. For a hotel it's just unacceptable! The heater is broken and the room is so cold during the winter. Please avoid this hotel !
Another classic NOLA restaurant. Has a very old school vibe, and the spaghetti and meatballs are on another level!

Fantastic food, even during the pandemic. I really like that no matter what you get here and when, everything is cooked perfectly.

After a few times of going, I asked if the main lady was "Grace". Turns out, Grace isn't a person, but a value/ethic they hold dear. That was really cool!

Hunter did an amazing job touching up, printing and framing several family portraits that look amazing on our wall.  He also printed a canvas of our daughter which is wrapped with the highest quality I have seen.  All the framing features excellent hangers already on the frames.  A really great company with quality packaging for shipping.  I look forward to working with Hunter again as our family grows.

Best OB/GYN in town. Delivered both my babies, has a doula (who I used for one) who works in there too and Alicia is like visiting your best girlfriend who has all the answers and gets you to comfortably ask all the questions!
I absolutely and highly recommend him for his bedside manners, expertise and knowledge... And as far as experience.. I could go on all day. I feel lucky to have had him help bring my children into this world. Thank You Ralph!!!

Nice food and a good cheap buffet all days of the week. Very good variety for vegetarians as well. Would give it 4 stars but the only thing is the naan or bread there is nt that fresh, if it was this would be amazing. They serve food in traditional style in handi. Would love to visit them again. And dont forget to take the coupons from online. Usually will get some savings from coupons4indy.com

Seriously, how is this place successful? Food is mediocre at best. Ordered a waffle and 45 minutes later it came out cold. The million dollar bacon is tiny and tastes like pepper. This place sucks! Servers should never argue with a customer and to tell me the kitchen is open somehow justifies the food being terrible....pathetic.

I usually get chicken fried rice to go when I pass through Philly. Today I had time to sit and dine. Tried the sushi and pad Thai. Sushi was fantastic! I had the dragon roll. Fresh and flavorful, with lots of fish and no excess amounts of rice. The pad Thai was good, but more sweet than spicy. I probably wouldn't get that again. Love the food here, but it is pricey.

Forget doctor, Andrew is a magician! He brought the life back to a sentimental antique chair of my father's, given to him over 40 years ago by his late mother. I could not recommend Andrew more highly, not just because of his beautiful work, but his caring patience and warm personality.
This was my 1st time having a Sonoran dog. Hands down the best hot dog I've ever had. We need these in Indiana

Another solid Mexican food spot to add to our list. I picked up my food to go along with ordering a Quesabrilla to add to it. After seeing pictures, I need I wanted to try this cheesy, meaty pocket of goodness. The place is set in a non-descript strip small, so there is plenty of parking, and once inside, you'll find a large indoor dining area. 

The amount of food we received was hearty and included a Pambazo (soft bread, lettuce, tomato, and some filling I couldn't place!), a shredded beef taco, a Gordita (corn shell with crumbled cheese and meat) and rice and beans (not canned, gotta be authentic!) I also received a cup of Horchata with just the right amount of cinnamon, although slightly watery.
I enjoyed all the items but would say the quesabrilla was my favorite. Nothing can beat that meaty, cheesy goodness with a oily, slightly spicy dip. Yum!
Thank you Tacos Los Campesinos for your hospitality and great food!

I absolutely love Batter & Crumbs! The staff are so friendly, the space is welcoming and colorful, and the treats are creative and fun. We have been twice so far, and bought decadent cake-batter soft-serve and delicious chocolate cake the first time, and the beautiful flower cupcake and a scone the second. Can't wait to try their savory spinach jawns and other treats too. It's very comfortable to relax there with a chill vibe. So happy they are in the neighborhood and we can add them to our rotation of vegan bakeries/businesses!

101 Beer Kitchen serves updated gastropub style food and offers a decent tap list in fancier surroundings; it reminded us of a slicker, Fishers attempt of approximating 20 Tap, without 20 Tap's comforting local neighborhood atmosphere (or its better draft selection and more solid menu execution).  101's draft list typically includes a sour selection from Prairie Artisan Ales, which puts its list above most north-side/Fishers draft offerings in my estimation. 101 is located in the newer "Fishers District" development, east of IKEA. There are a ton of dining options in the district and 101 falls in the middle ground. It is a less formal option if you don't feel like sprucing yourself up for the 1933 Lounge or HC Tavern, but it is a more formal, sit-down experience compared to the free-for-all, laidback environment of the Fishers Test Kitchen or nearby BIBIBOP.

We recently visited for late weekend brunch after a morning IKEA visit.  I ordered the hanger steak and sunny egg, which came with grit cakes, sautéed spinach and bits of tasso ham in a creamy Creole sauce ($16). It was a pretty tasty lower-carb option, since I avoided the grit cakes, and the price point seemed reasonable for an entree involving steak (especially in Fishers). My dining partner ordered the pretzel-crusted chicken sandwich, which came with a tomato confit-style jam, poblano mayo, and smoked gouda.  He thought the sandwich was decent, but it didn't blow his mind.  He subbed the parmesan fries for the salt and vinegar potato chips, and the fries were browned and seasoned well.  We'd like to come back and try more appetizer and dinner-time options.  The house loaded tots appeared to be a popular choice and I definitely would like to come back for the pork & tomatillo chili with charred lime.

Service was average-friendly, timely, and observant of COVID safety best practices. The bathroom was clean and well-designed.  We sat in a booth, which had wooden slatted seats.  The slats had a lot of food crumbs in the them and needed to be vaccuumed out; maybe not designed the best for ease-of-cleaning functionality.  The green tile on the booth's inner walls had food splatters and stains, and also needed a good scrub.  Plexiglass hanging in between the free-standing tables also were a bit smudged and could have used a Windex application.  Beyond those minor cleanliness issues, the restaurant was in good shape and I liked its more modern design.  We'd visit again if in the area and needing a beer & a pub snack.

I wanted to order a new Ford Maverick truck and as I was sitting down to order it the sales manager started telling me about an extended warranty. He said it would cover the drive train and special coating would be applied to the interior and so on . I told him no thank you I just wanted the Ford factory warranty and he said all vechicles had to have the extended warranty. I said what if I don't want to purchase the warranty. He replied well then I won't order the truck for you. I told him thanks for your time and left. He also wanted a 500 dollar down payment on the order. I proceeded to another dealership and ordered the truck without having to purchase any extended warranty and also didn't have to put down any deposit. I live very close to Flammer and really wanted to purchase local but they don't seem to care about the customer only their bottom line. They lost my business and I will never go back.

Standard cookie-cutter corporate Subway. I like the whole grain or multi-grain sandwich breads.  I usually get the $5 footlong Black Forest Ham, and pile on the veggies.

For those who don't know, Subway makes all their sub buns fresh on site at each store.

Quite honestly, this is really just a sub shop with its own gimmick. Write what you want on a bag. Oooh , ahhh. The sandwiches are ok but nothing spectacular. There are no suggestions as to a good complement to each sandwich. In a word, average.

What a great location, pretty good food too!! 
But the service, give me a break. 
We keep going because:
1) New Castle on tap 2) Happy Hour 3) sometimes bad service is funny
4) New Castle on tap (worth mentioning twice) 5) kids eat free Mon and Tues
The folks there are trying really hard, they just dont seem to get it...accidentally throwing away your order ticket, not bringing your New Castle until 20 mins after you sit down, talking to friends at the next table and eating their food, etc.....
Now I admit we've had good service there, but the waitstaff appears to have high turnover. We'll keep going (did I mention they have New Castle?) because they are close to the house and we like throwing peanut shells on the floor

The worst customer service ever!!  

As with everyone else, my hotel room had a flyer indicating that a pizzeria was available for delivery.  Because the flyer had a website where you can order online, I proceeded to place my order.  I receive an email confirmation with a 45 minute delivery time.  Let me cut to the chase, after a two hour wait and no pizza on site, we remained hungry.  I am not upset because the pizza did not arrive on time, however, I was upset due to the incompetence of the staff.  

At the one hour mark, I called the place and I was informed without any confirmation that the delivery was out and should be there shortly.  I waited another hour and called again... after numerous dropped calls, over 20 minutes combined on hold, I was told that my order was never "ordered".  Remember, I ordered online.  When I asked for the Manager (which he never gave me a name) his customer service skills were subpar at best.  Come to think about it, no one never gave me their name.   

When I asked for a refund, I was told that because I ordered online, and they haven't used their e-commerce in quite sometime, I needed to contact the website.  Funny thing is that the website takes me back to the phone numbers I dialed for 2 hours trying to figure out where was our food. 

If you took the time to read this, do not order from them.  Save some time and sanity and go somewhere else. 

Straight up garbage~!

If anyone from management read this and would like some feedback, feel free to contact me.

Its a strange business model: Hire a bunch of teenagers, buy a 8 or 10 blow up houses, and charge $350 for a birthday party that includes a bottle of Coke and few Domino's pizzas. My kids love it here, but I would rather have a colonoscopy. 
I get it, its not about me. I just think they could do a little more than the bare bones they offer for a party. Their profit margins must be huge. Maybe I should open a franchise.
The burger king serves expired juices and the entire juice pack on the shelf were expired for one month or more
It was a great experience. Kalina was my hairdresser. I showed her a photograph and she got it perfect from the color to the cut and blow dry. Love it!!! Highly recommend this Salon.

My family and I had so much fun here!! What a fantastic way to come together. My husband ,  our 16 year old son and 22 year old daughter did not make it out however we did actually have an amazing time trying to get out. I can't wait to do this again and tell all my friends about it. This would be a great girls night out or a great couples night. It's hard to find different things to do then just go to the bar or out to dinner I loved it and recommend it to anybody.

I was married here last Saturday, August 20, 2016. The ceremony was everything I wanted and more. The staff truly out did themselves by incorporating unique passages, special vows, and even decorating the chapel in pink and white to match my wedding colors. Everything was perfect, my family loved it, the staff was wonderful. If I could rate more than 5 stars I would.

Had the sandwiches Ruben, Cuban, quesadilla and a salad, and when ordering, the server offered two sides each with the sandwiches --- we all heard her say it. When they brought the sandwiches, there was only one side.  we asked where was the other. The other/unfamiliar server, who, by the way had to ask who had what meal (lazy management), said, "you only get one side so you won't be getting two". The original server came back and said you misunderstood me, there was no two sides offered -- just one. But all 4 of us heard the offer of 2.   While I understand the misunderstanding, the RIGHT THING TO DO was for the server to bring the other side of Brussel sprouts.  Instead, you get disappointed customers who will dissuade other potential patrons.
Great place to find those hidden oriental gems. Leave time to looky looky!

Pin Wie is now called "Forever", with the same Chef and some of the same staff.  We love love love this place, just had lunch with 9 co workers, bought 5 entrees, 3 starters, and cost $22 a piece including tip.  You will love it, favorites are double cooked fish, pepper chicken, dumplings in chili oil, Dan Dan Noodles, beef hot pot, fish in chili sauce and the list goes on.

Had lunch here with the hubs on a Saturday afternoon. I had the veggie burger with elevation sauce and an order of fries. The veggie burger tasted familiar. It was a frozen nondescript hockey puck style burger. I would bet money that it was a Gardenburger. Nothing against Gardenburger, but if I wanted one I would have taken it outta my freezer and popped it in the micro for a minute or 2. The bun was nothing special either; just a typical fast food style bun. The best part was the elevation sauce which was pretty tasty.

My hubby had a cheese burger and he said it was average. He also got the elevation sauce and thought it was tasty. The fries were good, but not good enough to make us return. 

The service and employees were great though!

Ive been coming to Parx for years. Each year it seems to go downhill. It was hard, but I was able to find a couple of slot machines that actually paid out. But, this place is really sub-par.

Can we say Smoke? As you walk in, you are hit with a face full of smoke. I asked an employee where the No Smoking section was. It was a small area near the corner. Most Casinos (at least MoSun in Ct and those in AC have designated smoking and non smoking areas.
I went to the non smoking area and people all around were lighting up. In AC, staff will advise those to put their cigarettes out in non-smoking.
Not once did anyone come around to ask for my drink order.
I hear that the restaurants are pretty good as are the concerts.
I left $40 ahead, but totally reaked of smoke in my hair, clothes. 
Parx should at least make an effort to have those that enjoy slots to play in a smoke free area.
Parx seriously does not seem to care, as long as people are feeding their machines.
This will be my friends and my last visit to this sub-par casino.
I have lung issues and dont need to endanger my health.
Shame on Parx for not being proactive in this matter. Perhaps they need to go to AC to get some idea how a casino is run.
Never again
Sat at the speaker for a few minutes . Then a lady comes out the door and says they are closed . It was 10:15 and they close at 11.

DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THESE PEOPLE!!!! This is the most shady property management group on the planet! You will not get any of your security deposit back, regardless of how immaculately perfect you leave the place. 
These are terrible, disgusting people who deserve to be run out of business.

Horrible this place is overly hype , I call ahead to see if anything was available I was told they are able to do 2 pedicures and 2 full sets and soak offs and that they stop taking walk ins at 5:30 . I get there at 5:20.  I get ready to do my pedicure she says she doesn't have time to do my soak off or full set even though she told me she did over the phone . Then she said she could pop my nails off I asked if it would've damaged my nails she said yes why would you suggest something that would damage my nails... So I told her I would like to just get my toe nail polish changed. As I'm sitting there 3 customers came in asking for pedis and manis in which she said yes to even though she told me she doesn't have time and that she stopped taking walk ins at 5:30. Then she charged me $30 which is the same price as a pedi for a freaking polish change even though I didn't get a pedicure. This was absolutely horrible I would not suggest here and I only came here because it had good views oh and she also made a lady who was sitting there before us leave " because she didn't have time " HORRIBLE
None too clean. Salad bar was well used... soup ordered was really late and barely warm. No chilled glass for bottled beer. Menus sticky... ugh!

Christie's Deli is an Art Museum gem with great specialty sandwiches and lunch specials. The owners greet each and every customer with a smile! The deli meats are fresh made by Boars Head. They offer many combinations of sandwiches, smoothies, and groceries. They also sell different types of snacks and drinks! La Colombe coffee is served too! Can't ask for a better neighborhood deli!

Atmosphere and surroundings are great! Food is ok. For the price range Olive garden, outback, and or other chain restaurants are better, by quite a bit. Service lacks as well, as in the waiters and waitresses disappear even when the restaurant practically empty. 

Your better off eating somewhere else, unless you want to get a drink with some friends, then the atmosphere is good for that.

Fries are good, and that's about it.
What a great place.     When I'm in the mood for meat this is where I come.  Food is always excellent and not over priced.
Excellent food and service. Be prepared with cash as they don't accept credit cards. Older diner that looks right out of the 60's. Interesting place for breakfast.

I may be drunk, I may be in love, but surely I am drunk in love with the Getaway. Our waitress wearing sunglasses was well equipped.  The sun was glorious especially this time of year.  Not too humid.

We ordered Key West Rickeys and Mai Tais.  I can only speak to the Mai Tai as being just right for the occasion.

We chilled under shade overlooking the pier.  Watched boats anchored and a few paddle boarders(grinding on that wood) pass though our zen like state.  We caught up watching the sun set, no lie for 5 hours(remember to tip accordingly). We ordered 2 dozen local oysters and calamri.  This was the ideal way I reintroduced a friend to Tampa(well St. Pete, our more attractive cousin).  I highly recommend everything.

P.S.  No more food trucks, whole **new** stand-out menu. They are killin' it!

We've been going off and on to Hometown Cafe for a couple of decades. We used to go more often when they served dinner. Their current hours over the past two or three years don't work with our schedules, really just open for breakfast and lunch. They serve basic cafe food, comfort food. Our family enjoyed going for dinner when none of us felt like cooking. I actually miss not having a local restaurant where we could always count on good food at a reasonable price.

Gina is a FANTASTIC service provider. from the first moment i booked with her she was professional. i received a reminder the day before my appointment which is a great practice. i came in for my appnt and she was so friendly and inviting. she allowed me to chat with her during my treatment which is what i wanted. her touch was deliberate and confident and my skin feels SUPERB! Being in the industry it's very difficult to get a facial without spending the whole time analyzing and critiquing but this was just what I needed and I will be recommending her to everyone!!!

I have lived in Nashville now for about 3 weeks and this place has been recommended to me no less than 5 times by various folks here, so naturally I had to pop in to see what it was all about! 

51st Deli sits on the corner of, you guess it, 51st Avenue and Centennial Blvd in The Nations, which is a small neighborhood in West Nashville. Pulling up to this place, first thing you see is the original 51st Deli street sign, which lets you know this spot has been a staple in this area for a while! This sign lets you know what you are about to get into, but once you walk in...you get that old New York deli vibe, but with a modern twist. The ordering/kitchen/food coolers/salad bar/coffee station areas have all been beautifully updated, and the seating area, drink coolers and beverage station are stuck in the 90's. 

When you walk in, you can do a few things...immediately pop in line and begin scanning the chalkboard menus on the wall or you can take time to pick up a drink or side of choice and scope the fried foods before getting in line. I personally enjoy the popping immediately in line and grabbing a bag of chips once I decided what I want and established my place in line. This place gets busy, so securing that spot is key when you are hungry! Once you order and pay, you are given a number and when they are ready for you, the kitchen staff yells out your number. Everything is packaged as to-go, however you can eat in as they have several tables inside and outside. 

While delis make you immediately think of sandwiches, 51st Deli steps up the deli game and offers a wide variety of good eats and drinks from tacos, quesadillas, burgers, hot and cold sandwiches, salads, pastas, beer, breakfast sandwiches, bagels, biscuits, coffee drinks, chips and queso, elote, fried chicken, friend fish, cheesecake and even cannoli's! This list is certainly not all they offer, but it should give you an idea of the expansive variety offered here at 51st! 

I mean, while they have a wide ranging menu, sandwiches are still king here as the have over 22 hot and cold sandwiches with a build your own option as well. Three of my recommendations called for the #10, Turkey Avocado. This was a hero style sandwich with turkey, cheddar cheese, bacon, pickled onion and avocado. It is a super basic sandwich and they do it to perfection! The hero roll was soft, yet sturdy and coated in avocado while the turkey was stacked high, cheese was perfectly warmed by the crispy bacon and the pickled onions delivered a stellar zing that brought it all together. For my next visit, I have my eyes on The West/Nasty! 

My only "issue" and I use that loosely was overall cost. While everything on the menu is under $10, it is easy to spend $20 on lunch. With the #10, a bag of chips and a fountain drink, I was pushing $18. Seemed a little much, but I am happy to pay it to keep a local spot like this up and running. 

Overall, I am impressed and super happy to have heard about and finally found 51st Deli...a true hidden gem that I will certainly be back to!

I went with a friend who needed some things for her child and she swears by this shop.  Figured I'd go in instead of sitting in the car to wait.  This place is much larger than I thought it would be and full of nice, quality items for babies and children.  Great prices and on Tuesdays if you have their reusable bag, you get a discount on your entire order.  They have more than just clothing: books, shoes and other items that kids use.  If you have kids, you should check it out!
So good! Super duper nice staff. Clean. Very hit get tasted delicious. They were very kind about my toad weary kids being rambunctious!

first thing first- who would ever expected to be full in such an elegant restaurant? 
I have eaten in many very fine restaurants- for some reason, you just don't get enough. But at Franco you can have the most delicious steak and lam shank without eating them slowly on purpose just to save them... The size of the entrees are HUGE- in a good way.
And they have a live band by the bar and the singer is awesome. Get the steak.... I love lovE LOVE it!  Oh and the salted caramel ice cream is amazing too.

We ordered the chicken cheesesteak from Westshore Pizza and it was made just to order and the other night we order the chicken Parmesan made with lasagna noodles and it was excellent . My daughter said you could tell it was fresh chicken it was not rubbery At all Since this new person took over it has been excellent !
Really sweet staff but food is pretty inauthentic and really sugary. It's also way over priced for what it I'd pass on this spot.

FIVE STAR EXPERIENCE!  What wonderful experience my husband and I had  celebrating my birthday, and our 45th Wedding Anniversary.  We were greeted with Birthday & Anniversary wishes by all!  Our FIVE STAR  servers... Nikki, and Princess, took such good care of us!  They made our dining experience a memorable one!  Thank You Ladies!  The food was delicious and prepared to perfection.  FIVE STARS for the Chef!  We had a beautifully decorated  "Happy Anniversary" dessert plate presented at our table...nice touch Nikki!  
Thank you, Jennifer (Manager) for greeting us at our table, and accommodating our daughters surprise.  
The old RC on Broad was always our favorite restaurant when visiting Philly. This new RC will certainly be our "New Favorite" when visiting Philly!  Thank you all for a FIVE STAR experience!   Kingston & Lorraine Ward

Friendly staff! The proprietor is wonderful, very sweet and attentive! Five stars right there... wonderful lady!

I love Mexican food. I grew up in Texas, and have lived in Colorado and New Mexico. I have spent probably a year in various parts of Mexico, eating traditional foods. I also love to cook Mexican food... usually because I have trouble finding restaurants that have not overly Americanized their recipes.

The meal tonight reminded me of some the restaurants I ate at as a boy growing up. Very much like the food I have had in El Paso and in Juarez, Mx.  Delicious. 

I had the signature dish.. Enchiladas with green tomatillo sauce and shredded chicken. Nicely done! Very tasty. I also ordered Cheese Chile Relleno (I love them) and I find them to be a good gauge of how the the food is cooked. The rellenos I grew up with were made with a traditional fluffed egg white batter, that has a distinctive taste... especially when fried in lard. It was very good. Refritos (beans) were good. Spanish rice was bland... but a little salt and some of the hot sauces fixed it right up.

Complimentary chips and salsa rojo were brought to the table while we were looking at the menus. Chips appeared to be freshly made, hot... and still a little greasy as good chips should be. The salsa had a wonderful flavor (appears to also be made in house), and was not spicy at all (so anyone can enjoy it. 

The proprietor asked me if I wanted some hot sauces that they make... and I said yes. She brought a Salsa Verde that was tasty, with hardly any heat. Also a red hot sauce she said was a little bit hotter. It was also very tasty... and had a mild heat. She then asked me if I wanted some really HOT sauce... and brought it to the table. This stuff was probably habanero based... lots of flavor and enough heat to make my eyes water. GOOD Stuff!  I highly recommend asking for the hot sauces... but be careful with the really hot one unless you like spice.

We had Pina Jarritos (pineapple Mexican sodas) to drink... love those things.
