Having eaten all of my enchiladas AND the chile relleno, I was unable to order dessert this time. But if her Tres Leches and Flan are as good as the rest of the food... they will be a must on the next visit.

It was a good meal... and a very enjoyable atmosphere!  

Check it out! (oh.. yea... Five Stars)!

Tuk Tuk WTF 

I'm in food love. Tuk tuk has all the makings of a fat girl check in food situation , complimentary chips and salsa, inventive menu options and spice.

Arrived to a pretty empty restaurant so the open table reso wasn't really all that necessary, but hey I'll take those points.
This place is byo so I grabbed up a drinkable white that would pair nice with some spicy thai-Mexican cuisine.

Heather our waitress was so sweet and very knowledgeable and made great dinner recommendations. She reviewed the specials none really peaked my interest so I opted for the shrimp curry and CB did the chicken fajitas with a side of rice and beans.

While we waited for entrees we munched on the chips and salsa , the salsa had a chipotle flavor and something else that I just couldnt place it was quite good. Our original basket of chips was mostly crumbs so a gentleman grab us some fresh ones and we continued to devour until our entrees arrived.

My curry was the perfect combination of sweet and heat . The coconut milk balanced out all the smoky heat and 5 perfectly cooked shrimp were floating in a delicious broth with peppers , onions and squash. I'm not a fan of squash in curry so I removed the pretty large chunks next time I would order this dish without them. Chris loved his fajita flavor but said that the chicken was a tad over cooked but the portion size was decent for the price.

We both very much enjoyed our meals and left with leftovers. The  damage including tax and tip was 50.00 for two decent size entrees and sides.

I will say I think that charging for sides with fajitas is something I've never seen before. If the option for at least one side item to be included would have bumped this review up to at least 4.5 stars.  The black beans lacked salt but I appreciated the pickled onion on top. This place is in walking distance to my apt and they gave us a coupon for 5.00 off our first online order. 

Take out seemed to be pretty steady we say at least 15 orders go out the door while there for dinner.

Will def return. This could be a great spot for a large group dinner
Don't buy boneless wings. I was basically given tiny chicken nuggets without any sauce (was supposed to be spicy and sweet chili). Ridiculous considering it was around $30! Not worth the money.

Came in on a Sunday early evening and the place was not at all crowded! We were seated immediately, menus brought to the table and the waiter came over to see if we were ready.  We said not yet, he seemed a bit annoyed. We haven't even had the chance to look at anything yet! (I silently hoped things would get better or stay at neutral.)

First, let's talk about the place. It's huge, well-kept and have quite a number of tables as well as a sizeable bar area.  On the other side of the building, opposite to the restaurant is a stage, some darts and pool tables and another bar which wasn't open the day we came in (no band playing) but there were people using the pool tables.  The restaurant side has the actual view of their brewing area! 

Finally we were ready to order our drinks.  He came back a while later and took them.  I had the Peaberry coffee stout and it was good. We then started with some of their hot & spicy wings to share which tasted good.  The wings were big and well-coated with sauce.  For my main entree, I chose the Engineer burger (came with blue cheese crumbles and bacon).  That was actually good! Very flavorful and the patty seemed freshly made (don't quote me on it though as I am no burger expert). For not being a burger fan, I can eat them again for sure.  I got chips for my side. They were okay, nothing special.

It's worth mentioning that our waiter kind of just disappeared and we were then served by a nicer and more friendly waitress.  It was for the best.  He did come back later but only after we had ordered more drinks from the waitress who took over. He asked if we wanted another round then once again disappeared after she said she's got it already. Such a strange thing!

Desserts? No, we were too full.  I couldn't even finish my burger! Perhaps next time. Yes, there will definitely be a next time. For now, I'll go with a 3-star as it was a bit rough around the edges type of experience with pretty good food but there's a great potential for a star bump or 2!

First of all, let me say that I am no hipster, but the diners here were more likely to have recently replaced a hip than to be referred to as "hip".  If you find yourself looking for a last-minute reservation on a Saturday night, give this place a try because the food is good and the service is punctual enough to get you home in time to watch Matlock on Lifetime at 9:00.  All kidding aside, it was a great meal and the service was as it should be for the price tag.  Within an hour and a half we were literally the only table left in the place!  Only negative was that my boyfriend was treated rather rudely by the valet when he parked out front while I went in to retrieve my reading glasses. (Now who sounds like the old lady?)

Came here for lunch recently and was finally able to try the food, however, nothing really stood out to me enough to want to return except for going back for happy hour drinks, and the service was lacking.

I agree with several of the other reviews that the service is just...off.  They dress more professional than other places so it seems like the caliber of service should be better (plus the host was super formal, almost like a maître d'), but it just wasn't.  Like, they just don't have their shit together.  We came during peak lunch hour for a business meeting and it actually wasn't even that busy, maybe only a few tables there besides us, yet everything seemed to take forever.  They actually forgot about us, I think, which is hard considering it was a group of 5.  For starters, the host sat us and dropped our menus saying the server would be right with us, which they weren't in a decent amount of minutes.  When he walked by again, we asked where she was and he just ended up taking our drink orders at least and then walking away.  Then more time passes, we finally get our drinks, but still no actual server in sight, so we remind him that we'd like to order food, since we're on a tight one-hour lunch break for work, so he goes to get her and now returns not one, but TWO servers (presumably her and the guy she's training).  She takes our food orders, then mere minutes later ANOTHER random server comes by to take our food order and we're like umm we already did.  The whole thing was so unorganized for having that many people on staff at the same time.

The food was okay, nothing memorable.  My burger was pretty good but overpriced and small.  Dessert menu is actually very expansive and all sounded delicious, so perhaps that part of the menu is worth exploring.

Simply amazing! We used Delicious Designs for a work event ordering 500 Breast Cancer Awareness cookies. Every one of them were flawless. And adorable! Huge hit with our staff.  Leigh Ann was also a delight to work with, accommodating every need we had.  We plan on using them again, and I would personally use them for my own private events without hesitation.
Love this place! Produce that doesn't cost you qn arm and a leg like most other grocery stores. Shelves are kept stocked and the staff are friendly.

Unlike most folks, I'm not a huge fan of PI Pizza but I love stopping by here after work for a drink with the folks from work. Bartenders are all great. Watched one of the ladies working there squeezing limes for their drinks... apparently all of their drinks are made from fresh fruits. Gotta love that. Recommend for anyone looking for a place for a happy hour.

STAY AWAY FROM THE "CHEF SPECIALS"
I just had a really bad experience here. I took a client here for lunch because I was told it was a good Italian food spot with low prices. Upon walking in I was a little disappointed. It looked just like a delivery pizza spot with some old chairs and tables in a small seating area. I quickly got caught in conversation with my client and we ordered a grilled chicken sandwich and a side salad and a " Chef Special" tilapia meal that was written in marker by the register. All of their prices were pizza shop prices...not high. The servers were really just cashiers and cleaners and they literally ate lunch at the table by us as we were waiting on them. They served my bread and bruschetta after giving me my salad. Never put water on the table. Then, they served the soup on a plate! We waited nearly 45 minutes for our food to be served and almost couldn't make it back to our next appt. in time.  There was only one other table being waited on at the time. I let all this go thinking "Well it's just a pizza joint so you can't expect them to be a 5 star restaurant!" we had to rush finishing our meals to get out of there and look at the workers eating  to get our check. This is when things went bad. They had charged me $25 for this  Tilapia  "chef special". I didn't have time to deal with it right then so I waited until later and called and spoke with the owner. I asked if this was a mistake, that, this "Tilapia Chef special " couldn't have possibly been $25. I mean it is a pizza joint, right? The owner was upset by me saying that and said he gives the finest ingredients and fresh meats and that's why he has priced it that high at his prestigious restaurant! I said, "Sir, I understand that. But your service has to match your product.  You can't serve me a tilapia meal for $25 when all of your prices are no where near that price, and expect me to come back and buy it again.. I can go to a 5 Star Restaurant and get a tilapia meal for less. why would I pay $25 for it at a pizza shop. I feel like they took advantage of me because I didn't ask how much ther chef special was. All of the food on their menu entrees  were  under $20 and I only paid $5.95 for a grilled chicken sandwich, I didn't think the tilapia chef special would be near $25, especially, when they serve the soup it comes with on a plate?! Since the owner wants to charge elegant pricing and think he is a very prestigious Italian Restaurant, I will rate him likewise. Poor service, not very clean, unprofessional servers . I cannot, say the food was bad, but I can say its not worth the money!

Beware cheap fish restaurants. Bonefish Grill, however, is not one of those and I love it It's not overly pricey, dont get me wrong, but you are paying for quality. I've been to this location maybe eight or so times and each time walked away feeling pretty happy. 

Service is good, they seem to be child friendly and considering the crush of customers they are pretty fast on their feet. I've mostly have had sea bass, salmon and tuna here and they are very good at cooking the fish until its perfect--soft, even buttery, hot but never dry. Love the sides, the desserts are criminally good (I hate great desserts).

So, go, but best to try it in the off hours to avoid the rush.

yes their products are nice but the slaes people need to chill out!!!! they are WAY TOO agressive to the point that it is uncomfortable!!! I just want to browse! I do not want too feel forced to buy your products

Despite my terrible allergies, I am in LOVE with this place.

I came here for the ambiance and left here with a bag full of honey pie. To be honest, the food here isn't doesn't break new ground by any means, contemporary American food seems the same from restaurant to restaurant and comes with paying a pretty penny to boot. However, it's a great intimate space to enjoy dinner or brunch while being surrounded by nature (without the bugs).
I love this place! It's a hidden gem for sure. I've enjoyed everything I've gotten on the menu so far, especially the hummus and falafel. I recommend this restaurant to my friends as often as I can!

Exquisite! Small place but has outside seating also. Outside seating is just as nice as inside. Great place for family or a date, dress up or dress down. Desserts are just as great as the food especially the Bread Pudding French Toast Sticks!

Eat their oysters but be wary:
Yes, the food's extraordinary,
But the prices are quite scary.

Do not eat the shrimp pasta: it's quite bland, and could make you ill. Food poisoning is very unpleasant. It is even more unpleasant when it ruins your evening and derails your vacation plans.

As for the rest:
The restaurant atmosphere is posh, but not unbearably so. The waitstaff at Drago's are pleasant and polite, but weekends are busy enough that the wait for service becomes annoyingly long. (Go during the week if you choose to go at all.)

Eat at your own risk!

UPDATE: (12/2016) My dinner partners insisted on Dragos... I can honestly say I gave it my level best, but even though it's been a year, I felt vaguely nauseous sitting in the place. (Eating anything with shrimp or oysters was completely out of the question.) A shame; they said the food was good..

I have been to this restaurant more than any other restaurant in past year.  The service and food is excellent.  Plan on at least 20 minutes to get your food. Food is made to order. Friday's and Saturdays are crazy.   Lobsta roll. Cod dinner, faro island salmon and smoked tuna salad are my favorites for carry out and fresh

I'll start by saying I LOVE fried chicken. I also LOVE hot chicken. I did not love Prince's, unfortunately . It's hot and the seasoning is ok. What really made me sad was just how over cooked my chicken was. It was so dry and parts were tough. Like eating really spicy chicken splinters. Maybe it was an off night, but I've had better hot chicken elsewhere. Although judging by how busy it was, they won't miss me.

Almost every town in South Jersey has 2 Chinese take out places with almost identical menus and price points. This is my favorite take out place, not much ambience, (I've even seen a "broken" trash can sign here) but the food is consistent and good.
Good food and their location in the busy Shoprite shopping center are the reasons they are usually pretty busy.
Egg rolls, wonton and most of the standard dishes we've tried are very good and made to order so it sometimes takes a few minutes longer than some of other places nearby which also have zero ambiance-- take out is the way to go here.
I'm so glad that they opened up since relocating from Katrina.  I loved their Kare-Kare.  Will be coming to dine every time I come back

This is actually the building I was thinking of, in regards to my other review. This is a glorious space, perfect for this new life and happy to see so much of the character in place. Another flight, dark beers and an ESB and each one well crafted amidst this lively new space.
The food is very great! I recommend the curry fries and garlic Parmesan Alfredo crabs.

I was in need of a breakfast sandwich with an ACTUAL egg on it, and this place delivered.  Bacon, egg, cheese, salt/pepper on an ACTUAL kaiser roll.  (No offense Capriotti's, I love ya, but your 'kaiser' rolls are snowflake rolls.)  It was filling and delicious and cooked to order in about 3 minutes.
I've been in the hospitality industry for over 35 years.  Cory, the bartender at the Carousel bar located in the Hotel Monteleone is EVERYTHING that the industry should be.  He is  AWESOME!

What a joke.  We had one prior experience with Victory before last night and it was a positive one.  Yesterday's experience, however, will be out last one with Victory.

We had previously arranged for a car to pick us up from Manayunk at 4:30 and take us to King of Prussia for a 5:30 wedding.  At 4:20 - when, ideally, the driver would have arrived - we received a call that the driver was "stuck in traffic" and would be here at 4:40.  That is an awful excuse.  "He got a flat tire" would be acceptable, but "stuck in traffic" just means he didn't leave in time to not be late.  We waited until 4:45 when we called back to get an update.  "He'll be there in 10 minutes."  Being that we were potentially going to be late for a wedding we told the dispatcher we were canceling the car and drive ourselves.  Rather than apologize, the dispatcher patronizingly kept repeating, "He'll be there IN 10 MINUTES!  It'll take you longer to walk to your car."

Untimely drivers + awful customer service = loss of our business

Went in to get a key and a key fob programmed for my Jeep Grand Cherokee after trying another locksmith that would not cut the key only tried to sell me there key for 235.00, the staff was very friendly and great they did what I asked and works great will definitely go back again the price was great and very fast only there about 15 minutes.
Thank You

Now that is some spicy chicken. I mean holy moly !!!! So freaking good though. Thank you for changing my whole world.. lol. I mean, even the potatoe salad was amazing. Can't beat that. It's the little things that make me happy

Took the carry permit class on 01/06/18 at Guns & Leather ProShop.  One could not ask for a better instructor than Mike Gregory.  He covered everything that the State of TN requires and covered the "real world" aspects of carrying a handgun.  The topics taught were spot on for testing and for the long term compliance when carrying a concealed weapon.  The shooting range is very nice and the setup for the students in the class was very well organized.  I will be back to this location to shoot in the future.

So yummy! Tiny little hipster cafe with delicious açaí bowls and smoothies. They are a little pricey, but everything is fresh and made on spot. Highly recommend for a light snack/lunch. The Nutty Bowl is simply delicious!
We did the gator tour and it was amazing! Although, we did only see 2 smaller gators it was still a blast! Tour guide was funny and knowledgeable. 10/10 recommend and would definitely do it again!

Very disappointed!  Food was just OK but the bartender/waiter was "in your face" rude. I've been coming here for years, even before it was discovered by the world. I can honestly say that I have never had a worse experience. It's become a tourist trap with belligerent servers who seemingly resent you being there. The bartender was so violent that he literally threw my change at my back as I was leaving. His tip, which was way more than he was worth, was $1.15 which he threw across a crowded room and hit me in the back and head. Now, lest you think that I'm just another unfair asshole, I'll tell you that I an a pleasant sort who travels over 200 days of the year and eats out all of those times. I never tip less than 20% even when the service is marginal. But this experience was far beyond your average lazy, pouty server. I have rarely been treated with such disdain and outright hatefulness.

RH is everything you likely expect it to be if you have shopped there before. The food is of very high quality yet definitely overpriced, just like the furniture. However, just like the furniture sometimes you need a bed or desk that costs a couple thousand dollars, and sometimes you need a burger that almost costs 30. I'm not judging, and I'll be back again! .... seriously get the burger.
The kobe burger here is delectable! it's not on the dinner menu, but they will still make it for you! :) Well worth it!

This is some of the best bbq you can eat in Indiana! My family and I have been coming here alot and we love it! The first time we came here, we got Tom as our waiter. This guy is probably the best waiter in the whole place, trust me, when you come here if you can get his section ask for him, he is on it the whole time you are there! He is very friendly and always remembers us when we show up! The bbq is awesome, some of the best meals ever! The sides are delicious and the biscuts and apple butter are excellent!!! I think the price isn't that bad for all the food you get, very pleased with this place!!! They have blues music playing and has a nice relaxing feel to the place. You'll see alot of their awards and trophies they've won for their bbq sauce! I highly recommend this place to all of you bbq lovers! All this talk about it makes me want to go there now!!!

Don't even like dentist; but Dr. Bishara made me consider it. 

Bay Premier removes pain from the process; schedule via online self-assessment.

Liquid courage slowly seep into my gums. Enamel colored crown fills in missing tooth structure. My discomfort swallowed whole.

Walk-in and check-in with front desk attendant; warm welcome, no paperwork. 

Patient-fridge, stocked with slinder, sugar-free seltzer water.

Nurse: "Patient X?" (her lips frame a soft smile)" 
Me: "Yes (ahem; clear my throat as I prep for my trial)." 

The nurse completes my patient profile via a screened-display (interspersing friendly conversations here and there); I add my signature, scratch, scratch, digital penmanship.

Liquid courage slowly seep into my gums. Enamel colored crown fills in missing tooth structure. My discomfort swallowed whole.

Bad past experiences and generally unquestioned dental health has shielded me from regular visits, until pain crept into my mouth and made me a recurring patron.

My presence at a dental office could be likened to the seldom appearance of the Icelandic Sun.

Nurse: "...lie down. The doctor will be in shortly..."

Dread fills my inners; soft reggae, jazz, mild/calming rhythms lower my heart rate.

Liquid courage slowly seep into my gums. Enamel colored crown fills in missing tooth structure. My discomfort swallowed whole.

How they are still in business is beyond me. 

I was shopping for external speakers for my computer and they had an ok selection. 

The problem is the return policy. 15 days. And then, at checkout, they ask if you want to buy the warranty. 

Big box stores (you know who I mean) - well, if at any time you don't like them, bring them back. Maybe on speakers, it's 3 months. But still. 

I guess that's why the store was empty.
Best place for seafood in Philadelphia. Large selection, reasonable prices and great customer service. The food was delicious too. I got the 2 snow crab platter and couldn't be more satisfied.

It was a cute restaurant but the service was not the greatest. The presentation of the food was beautiful but the taste and portion size were ridiculous especially for the price. I have tried almost every vegan or vegan friendly restaurant in St. Louis and this is by far the worst one I have ever been to. When I first heard about this place, I was extremely excited to try it but it was a big let down. I will not come back and I do not recommend this place.
Forced to stay three weeks for work. Located in the ghetto. Almost got run over by a cop in the parking lot doing surveillance work. This is a non-customer service oriented business.

I like these bars because they have great selection of beers.  So, that's nice.  Food is barely average bar fare.  I ate here for dinner and for lunch, and was hoping for better, but it didn't suck.  Servers were efficient, if not overly friendly.  The beef dipper was 100x better than the "kick ass" chicken sandwich.  Fries were crispy.  I thought it would be busier on a Friday night at 10:30pm than it was - but being a solo diner (traveling for work) it being not crowded suited me just fine - made it easier to find a seat at the bar.  I know I will be back in a Flying Saucer again.

Power Plant ended up being the absolute perfect wedding venue for us, and working with Chris was so easy and comfortable.  She totally understood our vision, and helped put us on the right path by recommending amazing vendors to work with.  Everything came together perfectly.

Chris was also flexible, and super available to answer our questions throughout the process.  It was like working with a friend.

On the night of our wedding, people kept commenting on how cool and chic our space was, saying how it was elegant but modern - all the credit goes to Chris and Power Plant!

I would book 100 more events with Power Plant because the space is inherently cool, and Chris and her team are so easy and fun to work with.  Having our wedding here totally set us apart.
This is a nice smallish bike shop along the beach boulevard. They have some stylish and fun offerings. Parking is convenient in the lil strip mall lot. No complaints. :)

This place is amazing! My boyfriend and I were looking for a new place to have brunch and of course I went to Yelp. 

We found this gem and figured we would give it a try. There is plenty of parking our front as its in a plaza area. The wait was fairly short and were greeted by a live band! This band was awesome. The men are incredibly talented. Our impression is that the band is a Sunday thing. 

The staff was exceptional pleasant, patient and helpful. We enjoyed the music as we looked over the menu. It was almost as if this Yelp find was too good to be true. The ambiance was joyous and fun. It was where Sunday morning with the family met restaurant. The space was clean, well lit and well decorated. It felt modern with a jazz decorative feel.

Our food came out it good time and it was delicious!!! My boyfriend likes to think of himself as a breakfast connoisseur and he even he was impressed. 

We found ourselves a new brunch location to bring our friends and family when they visit us in Sicklerville. The hours are just right for a good brunch. As my boyfriend said when we got in the car "Mz Easy like a Sunday morning"

Working with Leigh Anne has been great. As a small business owner, she has a lot on her plate and sometimes it's easy to forget she has to do it all. The beginning of our communication started with an email to her website. After we exchanged a couple of emails, we had a phone call to discuss details of the dessert bar and cake options. While on a call, Leigh Anne shared how much of each item we needed and how big of a cake we needed based on our expected guest count.

After we made the selection of desserts to have, we got a tasting box of cake flavors. Leigh Anne asked us to make a few cake flavor selections from her website and she would prepare a box for me to pick up. Due to COVID she isn't doing in person tasing appointments.

Come the day of our wedding Leigh Anne and her team set up the dessert bar. We got nothing but compliments on all of the desserts, especially the Cheesecake Cups with Raspberry coulis.

I enjoyed working with Leigh Anne and would recommend Delicious Designs for any of your cake or dessert bar needs.
Poor Service, Mixes up the orders, English as a third language

Ordered the Gobble Me Up Salad without ranch, and vinaigrette instead. I was disappointed. :( The turkey was dry, and vinaigrette sour! Mother got the Avis Avo & that was better than mine! Loved the vibes in this place though!

A cool bar at the end of the street. This brewery is a bit hidden unless you're looking for it. We stopped by for a quick bite to eat and a beer. At the time the selection was full of Pale ales, which I'm more of a porter/stout kind of gal. They did offer a nitro stout, but I was much of a fan. My partner enjoyed his beer through, so maybe stick to the pale ales!  

The brewery also offered a variety of sandwiches, burger, and small bites to eat. I got a pork sandwich with their Alabama white (bbq) sauce. It was good. I was hoping for more sauce, but for 8ish bucks... it worked out. My partner got a blue cheese burger, which he loved!!  It was covered in melty blue cheese, so understand you need to like blue cheese to did this burger. 

The menu provided events for the month, which ranged from live music to trivia. Seemed like they had something going on everyday!  This place was a solid joint. It didn't provide to my preferences, but that doesn't result in a bad review. My main reason for the docked star is the service. The bartenders are extremely friendly but you can see they focus more of their time on the frequent flyers which results in a lack of service to us newbies.

This place is pretty good.  The service has always been friendly and the food is good.  It is a bit on the expensive side for a sandwich place, but not crazy.  Wraps are usually good, and the reuben is decent.  Not the best in the city, but definitely not the worst.

Food: Arancini was very good, also didn't feel as guilty eating deep fried items since it was covered in pears 4 stars. Bruschetta was a hit and I'll be giving that 5 stars, I make it myself a lot and loved the sun fried tomato addition. Caprese flat bread fell flat, just didn't have as much flavor as everything 3 stars. Also had the happy hour meat and cheese board which was mediocre but it was cheap so yeah. 

Service: 5 stars. Very friendly and helpful staff helped us pick out a good wine and just made took care of us even while it was crowded.

I will definitely be returning and coming her for happy hour as they have different specials each night and a decent amount of food. That can all be found on their website

I like this place okay, but it seems a little unorganized.. a little chaotic. The buffet for salad seems to be wedged in uncomfortably with the line of traffic of people getting their food and drinks and ice cream. The whole process of getting a fresh plate is a little strange. The salads are pretty good and tasty. I just find it a little frenetic, but that is a personal opinion of course, I just don't feel a huge need to visit here. And why is it a deli exactly..?

So it is with a heavy heart that I write this review. Tonight's experience actually caused me to join yelp. In short I have ordered from Gianfrano's many a time. I've suggested to people their cheese steak hoagies and pizza. Tonight we ordered 2 cheese steak hoagies. We got our order and ran across the street to grab a coke and as we went to sit down realized that our order was wrong. Everyone makes mistakes right? So I called them up to inform them very politely that a mistake was made. In short the woman who answered the phone was rude and curt with me and basically blamed me for the problem even though she admitted making a mistake. Instead of fixing the problem, offering a solution, or even a simple "I'm sorry about that." would have sufficed the woman on the phone blamed me?  Instead of fixing the problem after quite a few times ordering from them and suggesting them to friends and family I got "Well we're closing, I don't know what you want me to do about it."
Not to mention I paid an extra $2.50 and didn't get what I ordered  (they were also the crappiest cheese steaks I've ever had from them) and you don't know what to do about it?!! I've worked in several restaurants and pizza places and the first thing that should be your number one priority is customer service. You could have offered me a free drink the next time I came in, gave me a coupon, apologized sincerely, offered to make amends the next time your open, there are a lot of options you could have offered and you didn't offer any, you blamed the customer (and I know the customer isn't always right, but you even admitted to messing the order up and you still refused to do anything) I unfortunately will never be eating at this establishment or ordering out  from them again and I will notify my many family members and friends of the poor customer service I received this evening. Don't eat here. If they make a mistake they will blame you and you'll receive bad customer service and a bad taste in your mouth.

Much more than I expected! Free coffee and popcorn, good, child friendly atmosphere, safe neighborhood. The lady working couldn't be nicer, very helpful, and she cleaned the entire time we were here! Large machines with good prices and they take credit cards! The building is a little old, nothing to complain about. We will be back!

My girlfriend and I love spicy food. We have had immense difficulty getting Thai restaurants in Reno/Sparks to make things actually, authentically Thai spicy. 

The papaya salad here gave me a religious experience. I will come back every week.

Do not give them your hard earned money, they don't want it anyways according to Matt and Omar.

My wife and I spent two days at precision toyota making a deal on a car. My experience with the sales team was not bad. The sales man tried some of the old school tricks of putting a line on a blank piece of paper, scribbling a bunch of numbers on it and trying to get me to sign it. I told him if that was the deal then he should sign it. It took hours to finally try and get a deal that we could agree on. I went home when we could not agree on a number. To my surprise they called me first thing the next morning to come in for the number we felt was reasonable. After another couple of hours we finally had the paperwork in front of us, then came in Mike. Mike the manager was extremely aggressive, and made me and my wife extremely uncomfortable. My wife asked him to not be so aggressive towards her and he stated "i'm not aggressive this is just me"... Very aggressively. When he finally left, I asked to see the other manager Omar. I only wanted to let another manager know that I felt uncomfortable with how Mike treated me and my wife. I told Omar about the interaction and dismissively he said"there are three sides to every story". And that I should basically just get over it. I let Omar know that the way he was treating a customer who was minutes away from giving them a check was a poor way to get a return customer and that I was going to warn others to not spend their money at precision toyota. Omar said that it takes a bad Apple (referring to me) to ruin the tree. Then very condescending asked if I was that unhappy then why was I buying a car from them. I turned around, grabbed my wife, cancelled the check and walked out. I can not believe that Omar and Matt were so aggressive and prideful that they were willing to let 34k walk away so easily. I didn't want any extras, the price was already set, I just didn't want to be treated as if it was my fault that they were jerks to us.

Paul B was very thorough in his review of the plumbing in my house.  Recommended several potential fixes throughout the house and prioritized what he would do if it were his house.  The most expensive items were NOT at the top of the list.  He wore shoe covers throughout the house.
Clyde is the most professional server this side of the city. Call Clyde if you want a good time ;)

Swung in on a whim and glad I did. I had the buffet everything seemed pretty fresh and the staff changed out two entrees while I was there which is great since I finished up at 2 (they close at 2:30). The food was good and I really enjoyed the hot fresh naan which is brought to the table.  I'll be back

We can't say enough good things about Jay Roberts jewelers. My fiancé and I looked at engagement rings with Jay. When the time came Jay helped my fiancé expedite the ring in time for the day we wanted to ask me- and Jay helped keep the surprise when I came in. It is a wonderful place and wonderful business to work with for a huge life purchase. We look forward to working with Jay in the years to come for our wedding bands and engagement ring maintenance.  Thank you to Jay and everyone at Jay Roberts jewelers!

Pretty good Mexican food. Nice chille rellenos, great shrimp tacos. The guacamole is not fresh and neither is their salsa. Service is ok, not rude, but not friendly. All in all I expected better based on reviews, but I cannot give 5 stars to guacamole not made to order and from a jar.

We just moved to the area and decided to give this place a try for breakfast. It was so good we decided to come back again a few days later. We had the SOS and breakfast skillet and they were awesome. Good food, good service, definitely worth a try if you are in the area.
Nice people, helpful. Good variety of pet products in a small store. Prices reasonable, especially for the area.

Anna, whom is a trainer, went out of her way to help me fix my form, which instantly made my back feel better. Her kindness and professionalism truly stands out. The people/environment here are what makes it a great gym. The cost for training is reasonable also. I come daily and Keith greets me with a smile at the door. The trainers Kevin, Corey and Anna always smile and offer tips towards better health and wellness. I feel very comfortable, motivated, and determined to come to this gym daily and surpass my goals. I recommend this gym to everyone. :)

omg based on the reviews I decided to go to this place to satisfy my craving. I and sure did do the trick and then some the woman there in the drive thru window was extremely helpful, kind and friendly with helping me to find the flavor of the night. This is my new yogurt spot, can't wait to take my little sister when she gets to Tampa. LOVEEEEEEE IT!

Good food...too bad for the service.

We went on a Saturday day, reservations made for 8:30pm. So we get there early, tables were available, but they won't seat us, just a party of 2. Ok. We waited outside for 20min before we reminded the hostess that we're still waiting to be seated. "where's the rest of your party?" she asks. We're sitting right here! But of course, they got the reservation wrong and thought we were a party of 4. How hard is it to take down a reservation by phone?!

Ok, we get seated, and the pretty boy waiter comes over and drops 2 menus on our table. I mean pretty boy; the guys here all look like young catalog models. Too bad only 1 of them displayed any waiting skills, the rest act like they're doing me a favor working there. So we sit for 15min until we finally get approached about our order. And the waiter's attitude once again was flat and unaccommodating, kind of a "what do you want" attitude.

Food though redeemed this rating up a peg. We started with the chicken liver toast and the beef tongue starters. Great flavor, good balance, top notch!

Then the main course. The wife had the Halibut. Good flavor, but they overcooked the fish! It was DRY, and a little crusty on the edges.

I had the beef cheeks. Simply wonderful. 

In summary, this place was a dining experience of extremes. It had so much potential, and it would either excel or fail miserably. I'd give it another try if they get a new waiting staff who aren't waiting to make it big in their other careers.

It was a Friday night when my family and I Walked into Buca di beppo. There was six of us that night all with empty stomachs. Upon walking into the restaurant, it feels like your entering at the wrong door. Because you walk straight into the kitchen while waiting for a table; which is very unique and I loved it. After being seated the smell throughout the restaurant was very pleasing and made me excited for what my taste buds were about to encounter. The lighting was very soft and romantic. The walls busy with tons of pictures. The service was so friendly as soon as we walked in. We were greeted very nicely and the staff always had a bright smile on there face. Our waitress was very down to earth and such a sweet lady. She found ways to connect with each and every table she served. Buca is a family serve style restaurant which was a great way for friends and family to catch up. We first ordered some calamari, it was really tasty. Cooked just right the red dipping sauce completed the appetizer very well. With a sister that is gluten free she didn't have much options on the menu so we ordered a nice large Apple salad and it was a crowed pleaser for sure.  The Apple salad was fantastic the cranberries and apples and blue cheese and vinaigrette complement each other very nicely. The large salad was huge six of us could barely finish it. Then next can all the delicious entrees. My favorite would be the spicy chicken pasta. It was very creamy with a small hint of spicy to it. Next we had the spaghetti and meatballs. The meatballs very big and really filling. The spaghetti had very little sauce, which was very disappointing. Another one of my favorites was the Chicken parmesan it's a must have. It had nice breading and a great tomato sauce with excellent cheese that tops it all off. The one thing that was not amazing was the garlic bread. It was okay, really fluffy and had little to no garlic taste. The broccoli was very watery, wasn't cooked all the way and had little flavor at all. Throughout the meal our waitress did forget a couple small dishes that we did order, which could have been why the broccoli and bread weren't the best. This meal was very expensive and had only a few mistakes.

Last night my wife and I wanted a light dinner. We ordered soup,several tapas and several rolls. All the food was delicious. I really enjoyed the coconut shrimp and the sushi. My wife performed the soup. I won't deduct any stars for the slow service because they were so busy and everything seemed freshly prepared. Sorry we didn't try this place sooner as we have to head back to NY. Will be back the next time we are in the area.

This was recommended to us from many people. OMG! One of the best cheesesteaks I have ever had in Bucks county. It was huge. 1 cheesesteak was enough for 2. The fries and an order of their boneless chicken wings. Everything was great! And huge portions. You need to order 1 day in advance, that's your only hang up, but worth the wait.

This is a fabulous hotel. The only thing that prevents me from giving it an extra star is the Internet. 

Wi-fi is not complimentary, but everything else is fantastic. I stayed here recently and had no issues whatsoever. 

I had a very nice suite with two rooms. My room had a nice king size bed, two flat screen TVs, a microwave, large office station, mini fridge and complimentary Starbucks coffee and Tazo teas. 

Front desk staff does a great job processing our check-ins. The van service was efficient and maids do a great job cleaning the rooms. 

It is a little far from Clearwater beach, but there's a small beach called Cypress beach nearby. My friend and I walked over there  and had a rejuvenating time.

It is also close to the malls for those who enjoy shopping.

Food is always great here, but on the expensive side. I usually go to Thai Basil if I'm craving Thai food, but their food didn't live up to their usual greatness last month which is why we ended up here. Menu is huge- everything from sushi to Thai to Chinese, some Indian, and even an attempt at Japanese. They need to trim the menu down to help trim down their costs.

The #7 was so good I can't wait to go back and order it again. This place is as authentic as it comes. I enjoyed tea while I waited and the food arrived hot and in no time. The staff was friendly and the restaurant was clean.

Got here on a Friday at 11am and there wasn't a wait to be seated. 

We had the following:
- Soft-shell crab benedict: the crab was kinda soggy and cold for some reason... the presentation was cool tho. never seen a crab like that before with the poached eggs.
- Corn beef hash: the beef was good. i'm not a big on potatoes so it wasn't that great for me.
- Banana foster french toast: this was delicious. i loved the ice cream that came with the french toast. yummy.

It was decent breakfast food but nothing that really stands out. they have a great website tho. everything on there looked delicious. haha

Man, I can't say anything negative. always an amazing time when I come. Staff are helpful and attentive. Customer service is always on point. food is delicious and you can't go wrong with anything that you order on the menu. Definitely if you are in the area and haven't been, you should try

This is a nice airport. Bathrooms are very well maintained- great places to store your bag while you use the facilities. Nice selection of food before security and great comfy spaces to relax and charge stuff. Enough Starbucks to make anyone happy and easy to navigate.

Today I decided to treat myself to a pedicure because the pedicure I received a week and a half ago at another salon was awful. I walked in to Luxury nail salon and was immediately put in a chair which was lovely, the nail tech was very patient while I took my time deciding which pedicure I wanted, once I chose she began the pedicure, she was very conscious of my comfort and took her time caring for my nails. I would highly recommend luxury nail spa if you're looking for a salon that will take their time and do it right.

This place is definitely worth trying. My wife and I had a Chinese place back home in Cali where we would always go and pick something up for parties, gatherings, etc. so we would have a lot of food for a good price. It made us feel at home when we found this place. 

I feel good Chinese places can be hard to come by sometimes. This place doesn't really have a lot of room for indoor dining, but good news is... since COVID a lot of us do not feel comfortable eating out anyway!

If you're looking for a good Chinese food for a fair price, look no further! This place has an amazing menu and even pho! Perfect for a family dinner, a quick bite, or even just a cold rainy day!

Brandon Ford pulled a bait n' switch on us and it was an infuriating experience. We saw an F150 on the CarGurus website that was at their dealership. The listing was brand new and didn't even have photos up yet. We drove 3 hrs round trip to go look at it on a Friday evening and they told us it wasn't even on the lot yet...it was in detailing. 

We worked with a salesman (Shane, initially) that evening who assured it would be out on the lot the next day. So we made plans to come back the following day and Shane asked us to give him a call first so he could verify it was available to view. 

Next day, drive 90 min drive to dealership and call to verify it is available and ready to view. No problem. Shane hands us off to salesman James for some reason. 

Arrive, truck is right out front. Quickly into it for a test drive. All is good, really like the truck. We have cash in hand ready to buy. James goes to "manager" to get the ball rolling...

And it all goes wrong. At this point they come back to us very apologetically saying that somebody actually came in that morning before us and began purchase process on that truck. But they'd be "happy to show us some other vehicles that are 'similar' ."

The "similar" list was either much more expensive than the website price on this truck or had far fewer options. Nothing comparable. 

1) why was this not communicated on phone when we called (30 min prior to arrival) to verify it was available?

2) why were we allowed to test drive a vehicle that was "under contract" to be purchased?

At this point the entire encounter felt exploitative/dishonest at worst and incompetent at best. Other Ford dealers in the area (Veterans, Wesley chapel) independently warned to be weary of Brandon because of bait n' switch. We figured it was a dig at the competition. 

Evidently not.  Buyer beware.

I have been using your car wash business for about seven years.  I was introduced to it By my husband who has an auto business, he  also sends the fleet of his cars to your car wash to have them serviced there. Mostly carwashes and usually gas. Basically, we are great customers.  Before today, we have never had any issues. Today I had a horrific issue which I will never forget. The green curry with chicken was delicious; it had the perfect amount of spice and heat with a hint of ginger. My first time here and I will definitely be back. They have a great lunch menu and the service was prompt and nice. A nice hidden gem in the middle of downtown Clayton.
Good food for good price! My second favorite KBBQ in Cherry HIll!

Disappointed that Hilton is not synonymous with quality or service any more.  The room was okay but sofa and carpet were worn out.  The bathroom was designed poorly and very small.   No Executive lounge.   No complimentary breakfast for Gold and Platinum members - offered a mere $12 per day and would expire the following day if not used.  The entire place felt unkempt.  People seemed to be always smoking openly outside the doors near the parking garage which triggered my sinuses followed a migraine headache.  I was upgraded to a river view with my Hilton Honors however the view was limited due to dirty windows.  I would give it 3.5 stars but downgraded to 3 due to no breakfast and functional fitness center or pool.  The only positive is the close proximity to the convention center a few blocks away.

Nothing to brag about. The food was ok. The music was too loud. I preferred the old set up/owners.

My wife and I went to Blanco for something light after a long day.  The staff was very friendly and we were seated on the patio (our choice) after a brief wait.   We ordered the nachos to share and were surprised when then they split the order and plated it so that both of us had a separate plate. 

The nachos were very good with fresh ingredients, we added chicken which was pulled and cooked in a sauce, very tasty.   My only complaint is that the margarita I had was a bit too sour for my taste.  

Nice place, nice staff, good food

UPDATE:  

Went back last night and I tried a Pineapple and Jalapeño margarita, excellent.   We also tried grilled mahi tacos and enchiladas with verde pork both excellent.  Great service and food.

Called 5 different places for a quote on a ring resize and this was the most affordable one! 

Their service was amazing. I was only in town briefly and they insisted on getting it done right away instead of having someone pick it up for me later. They resized it in about 10 minutes and I even got to try it on during the process to make sure the size was right. 

Very nice family-run business, definitely recommend this place!

Very cute find in Brandon, FL! I'm new to the area and was exploring with my grandfather and found this place. I LOVE antique shops and this is a good place to go. The staff is very friendly, helpful. This is a consignment-type antique shop so prices are a but higher but not bad at all. There were a lot of things in there that I will definitely be coming back for! Would definitely recommend!

Great management. Last weekend I had a problem with a to go order and the manager did more than anyone would ever expect. There was a slight error in our order and she delivered the cake we ordered to our home ( 15 miles away) and saved our party. What a great place.

The lunch today was a disaster. The food was cold: our drink order never taken;our water glasses not filled and no manager to tell. The waitress was missing in action talking to her cohorts.  The dirty dishes were left on the table while she threw boxes at our group for carryout not offering to fill them with the leftovers. This is unsanitary. It was not a good experience. This restaurant is going downhill

This place serves a great selection of soft ice cream. They run specials during the holidays (Pumpkin, yum2) and their is something for everyone. Ices, ice cream, floats, cones, they have it.

The prices are good, and sometimes their friendly staff tops my cone with a bit extra ice cream than normal. Not to mention the benches available to sit and enjoy your ice cream.

Solid spot all around.

I needed some emergency work done.  Joe's crew got out here in a reasonable amount of time.  They worked quickly, did a good job, and cleaned everything up right away.  Price was a little higher than I expected but definitely fair for the work they did, and Joe gave me a great price for some follow up work I'm going to need.  Definitely sticking with these guys if I need serious roofing work again in the future.

The service at this location has fallen badly. When me and a friend when on a Monday afternoon we experienced the worst service, we have encountered. When we were seated it took 10 minutes for us to place our drink order, then 15 minutes for us to get our drinks and order. 30 minutes for us to get our food which was somewhat reasonable at a place like this. But when we received our orders the sides were cold and my entrée was cold also. Also within this time frame we never got a refill on our drinks. So, for us get our server back to the table it took about 20 minutes got get someone to get her for us. Then she took our food back and we waited and waited another 30 minutes pass and we finally ended up with hot food. So, everything was fine now, but when we were waiting for us to get our check after we asked for it, it took 15 minutes for us to get it and when we were ready to pay we gave her our cards and then we never saw her again, until 30 minutes later with our cards, then we were able to leave. This was one of my worst experience I've had at a restaurant like this.

Back again for in-person dining, and it did not disappoint. Had the ahi tuna and deviled eggs small plates as appetizers. Both were delicious. The halibut entree with its touch of fresh corn flavor really worked well, and the Korean short rib was another winner. Great service and atmosphere completed the experience. Still my favorite restaurant in Skippack!

I was so excited when I realized that I signed a lease so close to an Aldi location, but after 2 trips there, I can't see myself coming back unless there's a really spectacular seasonal home item on sale.

The first time I was there, the cashier forgot to ring up one of my items that I literally spoke to her about while she was ringing me up they chased me back into store. The second time I was there, I literally spent 15 minutes in a line.

This is an unpleasant and disappointing location. It's a shame because the store looks great from its exterior.

This is my favorite spot in Indy for unique gifts! This store is filled with unique gifts, jewelry, candles, and so much more! I always stop by any time I have a reason to shop for someone. I always leave with the perfect gift, and something for myself too! :) Recently I left with the cutest candle and a Valentines Day card. The staff is always super friendly and helpful and prices are really affordable. This store is a must if you're in the area!

Ok so the food.....ok as far as Mexican goes. Prices are fair. However, service horrible. Our server I guess was new, didn't even know what their menu said. I asked for the cochinita pibil as a burrito, as it says is an option, she said they can't. When I pointed out it was on the menu she stated oh, I guess we can. My son ordered a cheese quesadilla, she asked did u want a side salad or rice? He said salad with ranch. He received a cheese quesadilla a lettuce guac.,sour cream. I said where is the salad? That's it!!!! She said. Ok fine. So we finished our dinner,party of 6. Went to use our coupon for a whole $10 off of $50 or more. Our total Bill was over $100, we were denied because we ordered 5 happy hour drinks. We said we don't want to use the voucher for the drinks just the food. Then an argument persued. We won't come back. In a 26 year veteran in this industry and this type of service will fail this place

We came here because of some of the great reviews of this place. The pizza was good but there was some kind of spice in the marinara sauce, I think, that ruined it for both of us. It might have been oregano or something else. I think this is a good place to try once and check it out but I doubt we will ever repeat it...I will go with 3 stars, taking into consideration the cleanliness of the place as well...

I took in and began hand raising three chihuahua puppies at one day old after their mother rejected them. Everything went well until we began transitioning them to solid foods at four weeks old. One of the puppies, Rigby, began sneezing food/formula from his nose after every feeding. We saw multiple vets who told us "we don't know why, but monitor for pneumonia". For me, that wasn't a good enough answer. So I made an appointment at Mountain View Animal Hospital. Dr. Mendoza and the staff have been amazing. I didn't get the "wait and monitor", but instead a plan was developed and rechecks were scheduled. Dr. Mendoza was extremely understanding with my hesitance in a certain diagnostic test, explained all our options, and even consulted with other specialists to discuss Rigby's case. While we don't have a diagnosis yet, we do have a plan, and Dr. Mendoza and Mountain View Animal Hospital have gone above and beyond for us.

COVID-19 Protocol: You wait in your car and call/text when you are ready. They will take your kid in and the vet will come out to discuss treatment/plan.

Went to the Lark because we heard it was one of the best spots in town to eat.  Upon arrival, instead of greeting us, the hostess asked if we had a reservation.  We did not, and they had to "SEARCH" for a table for us.  Finally, another hostess said she could squeeze us in but that we had to make sure we were done with our meal by 8:00 pm due to an existing reservation for another group.  Mind you, we arrived at 6:00 on a Thursday night and looking around there were few occupied tables.  We sat down anyways and proceeded with dinner.  Our waitress though was very friendly and made up for the ridiculous greeting we received.  She was kind enough to offer suggestions and work around our dietary needs.  We had a pleasant meal out on the pretty, well manicured patio.  We left at approximately 8:15 and saw multiple open tables.  We definitely did not need to be told that we needed to leave.

We were thinking of coming back for a big family dinner event since it is a "family style" restaurant and it's in a cute part of town.  However, trying to make reservations here for a large party has been a nightmare.  You're supposed to use the "contact us" feature on their website where you leave details of what you're looking for.  You receive a standard email explain fees and scheduling, but to talk to someone in person took 3 days after leaving a message for the contact person.  After speaking to that person, we agreed that I didn't need to reserve the large room but rather reserve just a large table.  Unfortunately, she's not the person who handles that and passed me on to someone else.  That person did leave me a message in a timely fashion, unfortunately I wasn't able to answer immediately.  Since that, it has been about a week and a half and 4 messages left for this person who seems to never be there at the restaurant.  Every time you call the number they leave, this person has conveniently just "left for the day" despite trying to call at different times on different days.  

If it takes this long to just speak to someone to coordinate the possibility of reserving a table, I can't imagine how much more difficult it will be after that in planning menus.  I will not return to this establishment due purely to their service.  It's almost as if your business means nothing to them because they'll always have someone else wanting to be there.  I just think back to when we first tried this place and were told we needed to leave at a certain time to make room for others.  No passion for customer service.

We've had a gift card for Darden for about two years so we decided to give it a shot...maybe we should have tried a different place.

It's Saturday at 12:30 and pretty dead...less than half the tables being used.  They take our name and tell us to wait in staging.  Not sure why as there were 30 tables open. Eventually,  an unhappy woman came over and said she would take us to a table.  First table, still dirty from last guests.  Second table, dirty wine glass and silverware...not off to a good start.

We were greeted by a nice server, who seemed a little lost.

We received our raspberry lemonade, albeit it tasted more like lemon water. Then soup and breadsticks for my wife and some pasta for me.

First batch of breadsticks was a bit stale.  The second batch was better.  The soup is always good.  My pasta, although the order was wrong, was okay.  Nothing exceptional, but okay.

Service was VERY slow...almost maddening when we were looking for Togo boxes and ready to leave. This was a 20 minute process alone.

My boyfriend and I frequent the Peppermill often and we have never ate here before until last night.  We ordered the Honey walnut shrimp, lemon chicken and pad Thai.  

The pad Thai was ok nothing special.
The lemon chicken was juice and I loved how they didn't skimp out of the lemon glaze it was great.
Now,if you live shrimp like I do the Honey walnut shrimp is a must!  The shrimp are HUGE coated with a sort of crispy tempura lathered up with the honey glaze. To my surprise the plate also had small honey dew and cantaloupe pieces THEY WERE DELICIOUS.  The combination sounds odd but it was sooooo good.

Our waitress Grace was a gem!  So pleasant and spunky. 

I can't believe this was our first time, we are absolutely coming back.

This is the best dentist I've ever been to in 30 years . For the first time in my life my mouth was really numb and I felt no pain during the process. I highly recommend this Dentist, he listens to your concerns and makes sure you are comfortable. The staff is very nice and considerate and help you feel comfortable.

- Say goodbye to MSG!
- Looking for a great afternoon meal, wok chi provides fresh ingredients prepared daily! Food is prepared once it's ordered! So good news it's always fresh! Staff is helpful, friendly, and attentive to your needs. 

- Now let's talk food! For a "DIY" stir fry, I had to admit my expectations were met and surpassed! Great food, for a decent price. The food was fresh and savory. Kung pow  chicken packs a punch! 
Wonton soup sure warms you up for those (few) cold Florida nights! Definitely a place to go if you're looking for a fresh, cooked on the spot,non MSG  restaurant! Will definitely come back!

Cannon's has ruined all other cakes for me. They really set the standards for what a great cake should be. I've tried Bings, Serpes, and many other bakeries in Delaware and Virginia, where I live now, and Cannon's is still the best. Even their most basic vanilla cake beats some of the fanciest creations imaginable that I've tried elsewhere.

Too many other shops make the mistake of having too sickly-sweet products that taste artificial. Cannon's icing is silky and smooth, not gritty with sugar, and the cakes are always flavorful, light, and moist. It's the kind of cake that will satisfy your sweet tooth, but you can definitely go in for a second piece without getting a belly ache!

Whether you get a custom cake or something directly from the display case, everything is reasonably priced and tastes phenomenal. I've never once been disappointed with the quality. The staff is helpful and will work with you to give you what you want, from basic birthday to elaborate wedding cakes. I recommend them to everyone, and will keep ordering cakes from Cannon's whenever I'll be in town. It's not a birthday without one!
Clean, friendly and quick.  The best in town and I would refer them to anyone I know.

This was my second time in the salon for acrylic nails. I asked for a ombre French with 2 sparkle nails on each hand. Christina asked me if I wanted to try a couple of art nails. I said sure! Anyway by the end I was left with very cute festive nails. It was ok until she told me the price 85.00! With tip was over 100.00! Megan did my nails before. She gave me what I wanted and the price was affordable. Christina is the owner and very money motivated. The salon is kinda a rip off. Probably won't return :(

There are few things more satisfying than a bowl of noodle soup and the ramen here is damn good, I mean really damn good. Well done guys, this place is a can't miss. Only criticism is I would have preferred a fattier piece of pork belly and the location is not walking distance from my house.

We popped in during an off time for tours, but Katie and Mosh went out of their way to welcome us. The building that houses the distillery was refurbished to perfection. The owners have brought their polish technique to St Petersburg. The Starkus vodka is an example of this. Polish tradition is to barrel vodka when a child is born. Upon marriage, the barrel is tapped and enjoyed at the wedding. The Starkus here is aged in a whiskey barrel. It's delicious.
Worth a visit and a taste. We left with 4 bottles.

So enjoyed this buffet. Loved the pho! It was definitely my favorite part of the buffet!!  So much flavor, customize to your taste. Staff very friendly and ready to serve. Dessert bar had such a wonderful assortment, coffee chocolate gelato was to die for! Pumpkin cheesecake, chocolate galore. Very organized and clean. Look forward to my next visit!

These people have the patience of Job!  They are doing an excellent job helping my 87 year old mother in law who has memory problems with her beautiful new dentures.  Their prices are fair and they are caring and accommodating.  My mother in law has had multiple dental issues and extractions and the staff in this office have gotten her through each step with kindness, compassion, and very little pain.  We're pretty sure Suzanne has a Halo!

I called Shawn yesterday and he agreed to helping resolve a problem with one of my major clients! Thank you for your great responsiveness!

Linda

I went in using a coupon. The store is clean and the staff is very nice. The employees are school kids (bonus points). The selection is very nice and the yogurt was very tasty. The price is slightly on the high side however, the owner is trying to make a living and pay local kids (employees) a few dollars at a time. I would love to give five stars and, I'd give it to this business. Its hard to compare this store to a restaurant that needs time and preparation to make a meal. Still, this store will WOW you and your families. Summer youth sports are around the corner. I highly recommend this delightful little froggy store. They will not upset.....

Lenny's is a phenomenal breakfast spot, it's great for being the ultimate "go back in time" breakfast.  Don't expect any culinary fusion, new American, or twists....you are gonna get pure breakfast the way it has been forever.  

This isn't your Florida spot with pretty servers, and fancy food.  Lenny's dedicates itself to supporting the phillies training camp and threshers ballpark goers, so expect blue collar workers serving up great eats.  Expect consistently philly style breakfast done well.  

You can't go wrong with the Danish basket.  The coffee is good and they keep it topped off.  

Try it, you can't NOT like this place!

This place is hands down better than those more expensive sushi restaurants. Coming from Hawaii this is the kind of place close to home and kind of affordable. What is up with putting so much in their poke bowl? In Hawaii it was so simple and affordable. When we bought this everyone kept looking at our food and I do hope they give this place more business. I plan on coming here more often
We stopped in for lunch. Very ordinary and lacking any real exciting menu options.  Service was slow and inattentive to their customers

I was in town on business and I found this great place for seafood.  The service was great and the place was clean.  I asked if they could make me a combo platter of several of my favorites and to substitute onion rings for fried and they did it all without a problem.  I love places where they just want to make the customer happy and provide the customer what they want for the best experience.

Awesome place.  If I am very back on town I will visit this place again!

Josh was a great help today when my friend and I came in 15 minutes before the store closed. It was something urgent and required problem solving. Josh was invested and quickly helped figure out what we needed. On our way out the door, the other employees were crowded around the door mumbling "finally" as we left as if we were the biggest burden in the universe.

Great corned beef sandwich! Reading terminal has an overwhelming abundance of food options, but Hatville Deli is solid. My flight attendant friend stops by reading terminal often on layovers and recommended this sandwich, so spotting the sign felt like finding the promised land! Two friends and I had been eating our way through the market so we split one sandwich. We felt a bit bad about taking up three seats at their counter, but their service was so kind! They cut the sandwich into even thirds on separate plates and gave each of us a whole pickle! It seems like a family-owned joint and it was cute to see the kids behind the counter.

When I was planning my trip to Nashville, the only name for BBQ that I heard was Jack's. But we happened to drive past Bar-B-Cutie and decided to give it a try. We ended up with full bellies and happy taste buds.

I got the pulled pork and mac and cheese. The pulled pork was really good and I loved the variety of sauces at each table. I went with the sweeter one and basically drowned my pork in it. The mac and cheese was good, but didn't have a ton of flavor. I added just a little bbq sauce to kick it up a notch and that seemed to help.

The staff was also extremely friendly, which made our dining experience even better. Almost every single staff member greeted us, stopped by our table to see if we needed anything, and were quick to come grab our plates as soon as we finished. 

I had Jack's later in my trip to Nashville and can easily say that Bar-B-Cuties is much better all around: food, staff, environment, etc.
Food is delicious, portions are big. They remember who you are... Feels like a family restaurant .

This place was awesome. Last time in Philly we ate at John's Roast Pork, they were closed today so we tried out Rocco's. So glad we did. My husband and I both got the Spicy Italian with Peppers, Onions, and Spicy Mustard. So, so good. For $8.50 you get a huge sandwich, chips and a drink. It was more than enough for a meal - I barely finished it. It is cash only, but we went and bought something and got cash back so no problems. Highly recommend.
Very friendly staff. Fresh large portions at great prices. Lots our selections to choose from. I'm looking forwards to going back.

One of the worst apartment complexes in southern Tampa.
If you are in the military PLEASE DONT RENT THERE.
They simply don't deserve your business, I started with them back in 2018 in the beginning everything was fine, they were a bit overpriced but I thought this is a gated community and the stuff was very friendly and helpful, however, one year later things started to change, The police raided the communities several times with large number of officer weapons on the ready, when asked the staff refused to answer then started noticing drug transactions in the community. Additionally the gate start to stop working for weeks, parking became harder to fined and finally I told them ok guy I am out of the military I want out of my lease, surprisingly the new manager said NO you can't use your military order to end your lease I had to call the housing office on base to  and my attorney to force them to follow the LAW... the bottom line is Camden is Overpriced, unsafe, unreliable and untrustworthy.

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!!!  They did the inspection on my house before I bought it. Found nothing. Four weeks later after I move in I find out the house has a bad termite problem and it's going to cost thousands of dollars to fix it. They are scam artists!

I'll admit it, I haven't been as dilligent as I should be in terms of my exercise routine, but I stopped into Lululemon just to browse their selection, and I was immediately welcomed with open arms.  The associates are very friendly and helpful and are quick to familiarize new customers with all the different styles of workout apparel they carry.  Not only that, I also found a shirt that said "Friends are more important than money" (or something along those lines).  Shame I didn't buy it, but still, that means a lot!

Well, very disappointed to say the least. Sent my husband for something quick. I gave him a specific order (via text and he read it to them), they told him "that's a South Philly"...he said ok, I guess trusting they'd make the sandwich like I like. Well, my sandwich was missing my favorite meat that makes a sandwich for me...Prosciutto! Sadly, it made my first experience not that great. Also, the meat is not that great of quality and the mayo is absolutely disgusting. My husband enjoyed his sandwich though, but he is not as picky as I. If I am paying I want it how I want it. I knew I should have ran and just got lunch myself, because I watch (if possible) to ensure they make it the way I like it!

Have I not reviewed this yet!? Well, I will now. It is definitely worth a trip across the river both for the banh mi and the shopping.

The banh mi are priced very, very right and delicious. I have had them several times. It would be more but it is hard to cross the river. Anyway, I brought my mother there for her first time at Hong Kong Market yesterday and we got the banh mi and did some shopping (and it is a grocery wonderland).

We took the banh mi home and ate them in the back yard because it is true there isn't seating in the store. I do want to try the little Vietnamese restaurant with tables and such that is in front of the grocery store one day. Anyway, I asked Mom which of the three places we've gotten banh mi she thought gave us the best sandwich. Her answer, which I concurred with, was HKFM, also the least expensive.

This was our first spot when we got to New Orleans and we were not disappointed. We ordered the char grilled oysters and the seafood etouffee and both were really good. It is a oyster bar so it's not super nice inside but the food was outstanding.

a minute ago

I came in at about 230PM. The meat was cold. There was food and trash on the floor and stayed the whole time. The backed pato was the best part of the meal. However i was charged 1.25 for extra small amount of cheese. The claw saw was real dry and plan. On top of the meat begin cold it was just plain. I had better bbq from o most everywhere else. The television was playing fox new no need for all pollical nonsense while eatting. Now for the service the servers did the job but nothing about the service stucked out.

They did my flowers for my wedding. They were so beautiful and perfect! They are reasonably priced and will take great care of you during the whole process. I would recommend them to everyone for day to day flowers or special occasions!!

Had dinner here tonight before a show at TPAC across the street. Service was a little slooooooow at first, took a while to actually order. Once we ordered though everything went smoothly. Started w some deviled eggs which were delicious - basic deviled eggs, but tasty for sure. For dinnner I actually ate meat! They didn't have a fish dish I wanted so I had my first steak in a year. It was pretty good! Cooked perfectly and definitely a quality piece of meat. Sides were smashed potatoes (YUM) and broccolini (ALSO YUM), both bathed in butter and we appreciated it. Crowd in here was older (white haired honestly) and mostly wearing suits... kind of a little stuffy. It wasn't busy either for a Saturday night. The food was great but the atmosphere could be a little more modern to me personally.
Solid breakfast spot! The Irish breakfast might be the best hangover remedy on the planet

AMAZING! Plain and simple. My dog had the symptoms of a UTI again like she's had in the past. We're new to the area so I called a couple other places in the Brentwood area on a Saturday morning at 8:30am to see if she could be seen and they were all full and couldn't. I called Noah's Arc and the receptionist was very sweet and said she could be seen in an hour. 
We got there and only had to fill out a little bit of paperwork. I brought her old records which helped because it showed what she took before when she had this problem that helped. 
The technician took my dog out to try to collect a pee sample for us but Mabel wouldn't cooperate. The tech was very nice about it and said it was fine. 
When Dr Thomlinson came into the exam room, he was VERY personable and easy to talk to! He checked her and said she looked healthy besides the urinary problem and gave us the same medication that I told him helped before. He was very nice!
Finally, when it came to the bill...I was expecting to pay over $100 for the visit and medication...which I wouldn't have mind doing but my total was only $64!!! 
I will be taking my dog here from now on and highly recommend it!!!

I loved the atmosphere here. The service was great. The waiter was very knowledgeable, attentive and responsive. The food was delicious and very reasonably priced.  I would definitely recommend this place!

Fantastic!  Came here on January 25th and apparently a part of the brewery just opened and now they have food!! I got a flight and the beer pretzel with cheese. Our server was super friendly and had great suggestions. I tried their  sour and a few others, the Florida cracker, gose, invasion -- all were fantastic! If I am in the area again, I will definitely be back! Wish they had some darts or a shuffleboard table  (I didn't see any). You can also  take a tour as well! Good parking too!

I love this place! I love that the portions normally seem just right and all of the calorie counts are posted next to each item on the menu. This place has never disappointed me when it comes to the food.
I went and myself and a friend for the flights and flatbread which was a wine flight with 3 different wines and then you get to choose one of the flatbreads they have on their menu. You also then get to choose whichever wine you liked best from you flight and get an additional full glass of it. All of this and it was only $15! This is by far the best deal if you plan on getting some wine considering a glass of wine is usually around $9. 
I also love that the desserts that they offer are small individual portions so it is just enough without making you feel terrible for eating a huge cake or something.

I think this is the best Steakhouse experience I have ever had. There may be others as good or better, but I haven't tried them. I first heard about Bern's in the early 80"s, they were probably the top place in Tampa at the time. I had the good fortune in those days of an expense account, and got to dine here regularly in the close to bordello like environment. . I have remained a happy loyal customer since then.  I love the steaks, the way they prepare them, the pricing by the ounce, and the ability for 2 or 3 people to split a larger steak. The Caesar salad is awesome, and will be one of the best you have had. All the side items are awesome as well. The wine list is legendary. The servers are all top professionals and take great care of the diners.I have had many people comment about Bern's when I mention Tampa. It is probably the second most famous business in town. The addition of the Desert room made an great place better, giving you a second area to move to for Deserts and after dinner drinks.
I could eat this food every day and never get tired of it. If everyone had access to their food on a regular basis I guarantee the world would be vegan. Spread the love! :)

(30 Jul 2016)

Popped by for drinks and quick meal with a few friends. I've never seen so many TV's inside a restaurant before. 

We got amazing fries covered in bacon, cheese and chicken paired with my newly found favourite range dressing. The alcohol was flowing, we got pitchers of margarita and sangria and few shots.
