The waitress was great, attended to us promptly and checked in every now and again to see if we're good. The crowd was casual and having a lot of fun. 

I thoroughly enjoyed myself and would pay this place another visit in the near future.

Excellent prices on groceries, household items, and gas. A one stop shop for many weekly items. You can't go wrong with the Kirkland brand on anything they sell. And great customer service to top it off! So glad they opened in NOLA.

Poor service!! Waiting for over 25 minutes! They can not handle the drive through along with the dining area. If you want the great food with great service go to any other location. We've never experienced this at any other Chicken Salad Chick.
Amazing atmosphere inside and in courtyard. One of my favorite restaurants. Everything on the menu is good. The shrimp and grits was AMAZING!

Really cool place to stop at if you're looking for nothing in particular. They have two floors with a mix of items for sale from clothes, to board games, and household items including furniture. Nothing was too impressive but the prices were affordable. If you stop by be sure to check out the upstairs library, lots of old and new classics!

This is really disappointed! Got two different small-sized pizzas, and I found that the crust is pre-made from a grocery store. A very dry taste, and poorly seasoned. There are so many places better than this one, and for the same price.

I've been here three times and I always am disappointed by something.

The inside looks nice enough and it's in a great location to people watch. The menu also sounds nice enough although it is a bit limited. The waitresses are always attractive and it seems like it would make a great meal.

However, my mashed potatoes tasted faintly of fish (for some reason I ordered pork with mashed potatoes, but you should stick with the Italian dishes). The gnocchi is okay, nothing special. And their other dishes all seem alright too.

It's a shame - Philly has some great culinary dinners and you really shouldn't waste your time at wannabe restaurants like this oe.

The few negative reviews about not being welcomed or dirty chairs is ridiculous. You don't go to a buffet for friendly chat or atmosphere. You go for good food at good prices. This place has both in abundance. I went on Father's Day and although the line was out the door , we only waited about 25 minutes. Everything was cooked right, hot and plenty of choices. I can't wait to go back.

Love this place! This is my go to shop for the perfect dress for a night out. Last time I stopped in I found a beautiful cocktail dress that I have already worn several times. I love their selection and the staff is very helpful. They have an amazing assortment of jewelry and accessories that range is style and pricing. They also have a variety of gifts for any occasion. It's hard not to leave here with something unique and timeless.
Came here with a bunch of friends for a birthday party. The service was good. The food was good. It wasn't amazing or anything special and that's why I only gave 3 stars.

Solid 4, this is a welcome addition to the neighborhood.  I quit going to the Clayton location because parking at abysmal over there.  I'm a sucker for the lamb burger and fried pickles.  Watch out for the chili cheese fries... They're great, but unless that's you're entree, you'll need about four people splitting them as a side.

Just moved to NOLA two weeks ago and had my first set of visitors this past weekend. They wanted some authentic cajun food so I started yelping. I was unclear on their budget so I picked something that wasn't too fancy and in general, yelpers here thought this place was decent. 

What a HUGE disappointment! First of all, they had beer and wine on their menu and on display but no liquor license to serve it. Booooooooo. 

Two of us ordered stuff bell peppers and our vegan friend got a vegetable po boy. The bell peppers were meh, at best. I'm prett confident I've made better stuffed peppers than the ones they served here. It just didn't wow me in any way, shape or form. The vegetable po boy just tasted like a bunch of stir-fried veggies. Again, nothing amazing. 

While it was all moderately priced, I'd rather spend a little more and go somewhere with waaaayyyyy better food. Can't say I'll ever return.

Walked past the cookies today.  Note to the Owner: There is a sign hung up for customers to read. It say, as was written, "No Tiping Please".  The woman who work there kind of gruff, so I didn't mention it.  It's a personal peeve to see misspelled signage on businesses.  Cookies are good, but really expensive.

We got the food so fast we wasn't even expecting it yet. We used Eat24, which I recommend, they are fast and very professional. The food was hot, delicious, plentiful, delivered as I said, in record time. Everything was so good! Loved it

Second time here. Second time, portions were small to tiny. Funny enough the two in front of us got the "big Leon" and their bowls were filled to the brim. As we were ordering, the girl would actually remove noodles or lettuce out of the bowls she was making (why?). Now if you want to compare apples to apples, my husband got the exact same bowl this time as last time: the hula hula. This time around, there were about 4 pieces of fish and the bowl was half- filled. He told me it's as if they halved everything. He was still hungry afterwards so we grabbed more food at the deli next door. 

I did ask one of the girls after the meal why the portions were so inconsistent; and she just kind've shrugged her shoulders.  Disappointed we drove out in the rain, spent $30, and still left hungry.

All Dogs Poop is the best! They are reliable and do a great job. They communicate with me to let me know when the yard is done. I have been using them for years. They are wonderful people who really love animals and donate back to local charities. I definitely recommend them to everyone!!

nice quiet coffee shop to get things done.  soft, charming music in the background with cool paintings all over the cafe.
they serve pastries and sandwiches as well.

soy latte wasnt the best.  after my first sip, i didnt want to finish the rest.  
green tea latte was better-slightly sweet, with green tea flavor.

I did not read all the reviews before going here and saw a decent rating, but not a high one.   I called on the phone to ask a couple questions and could not understand the person because he had a thick accent, sounded like an Indian accent.  I could tell he was getting annoyed by me asking him to repeat slowing 3 times and still I could not understand.  I thought I would give them the benefit of the doubt and just drive down there.

One other person was in front of me as I waited just a couple minutes.   While waiting, I heard one man raising his voice to another employee.  NOT good to do this in front of customers.   Then, I heard him make a derogatory comment something about Californians and the rip-off prices there.  That's when I got up and left.  That's also not good.   Now I see other reviews saying similar things.

My advice is the business needs to understand to keep opinions to themselves if they want to increase business.  I am from California like a LOT of people up here and don't appreciate the snide comments even though I no longer live there.

After going to another competitive great place, I see I paid 25% less money for the same task.

I came in here because I saw they had Dan Dan Noodles. I just started a new job in this area so I was glad I could stop in without have to drive out of my way. It was quite dark when I came in here and my table was a bit sticky. I felt like there were some things missing from the menu like soups. I asked for a hot and sour soup but it was no where to be found on the menu. I ordered the gyoza as well to start. They have a huge window in the main dining room that you can watch the chefs cook through and it's pretty cool. When my Dan Dan Noodles arrived, it smelled and look delicious but from the first taste, the chili oil just did not sit well in my mouth. It was so oily and made my tongue tingle really bad.  It wasn't necessarily super spicy or anything but just numbing. I've never had an experience like that, it was quite strange. The noodles also resembled spaghetti noodles, so I wasn't sold on it from that aspect either. I would come back but I will not get the noodles again.
I downloaded Yelp just to give this place a 1 star. The waiters and the food are strait garbage. I highly do not recommend it there are better places in the city.
Amazing happy hour! The deals and the food can't be beat. Have already been back once before posting this and will be back again soon!

Broken screen on my iPhone repaired in 20 minutes. It's like new!  Without the wait or hassle of the Apple store. I was skeptical hat it was not an Apple certified repair but after my experience i will never go anywhere else for a screen repair.

Had an amazing experience. The food was fresh, plentiful and always full. This restaurant epitomizes "Seafood" In the local vicinity. I was told otherwise, but am glad I gave Formosa a chance. I am definitely dining there every time I'm in this part of Indy.

We had a surprise party for my wife last night in the private room behind the large fireplace.  The wait staff and the food along with the service was oUtstanding. The manager even helped me unload the decorations before the event started!  
The young ladies who attended to our food and drinks were professional and upbeat for dealing with a crowd of 32 people!!!  Beka and Shea both get hold stars!!!!

I purchased the Eversave for a Couples Massage and for the price, it was a great deal.  Although, I would not suggest the Davis Island location because it was located in a dentists office - and the sound of dental tools was audible over the soothing music.  The therapists, a man and a women, were a bit odd to talk to but overall nice.  The massage was fine, and bit different than any massage I have had before - and not necessarily in a good way.  I can not speak to the main location though.

Kevin and his crew are superb. Kevin is very knowledgeable about his craft. He's pay attention to detail and his work is always amazing. He did my kitchen floors and my basement. He's a great guy and will do an amazing job.
Guy making the sandwiches was not wearing a mask. That is extremely irresponsible and I turned around and walked out
Efficient, clean, courteous and they don't over sell. Support this local small business and you won't be disappointed. :)

A Philadelphia institution and must see for all tourist. Yes when all is said and done the old reliable Terminal Market is still the best breakfast and lunch spot in Philly, as long as you can deal with the constant over crowding and fighting for a seat etc. Particularly good are the Amish restaurants and take out home grown veggies and farm raised chickens. Really to die for! Wonderful other choices , like Dinic's, Salumeria for sandwiches. Various Bakeries are excellent as well, and they even have a wine cellar there?!  Soul food and middle eastern, Asian eateries are wonderful,, really everything (except the Down Home Diner , avoid at all cost) But even arguably better than the restaurants are the various fresh fish, produce, outlets sprinkled thru out the terminal. The best fresh fish fruits and veggies produce money can buy Again if you are visiting Philly, I highly recommend you stop by and visit the ONE and only Reading Terminal Market, a unique Philly Staple that you just wont find anywhere else.

Was here with my vegetarian friend who eats Kosher food. We got the dim sum and the portions were great and just right for the two of us. They don't let you take dim sum home so it's good if you eat it with people who have appetites. The place itself were darkly lit and can get a bit noisy if there are others around. The service was ok as there was not too many people around dinner time when we went.

Came here with a big group and got great service but the food was okay. I actually liked the free chips and salsa more than my meal. They had this dip that treated like sourcream and cheese i couldn't stop eating. My meal.. i tried a lunch combo (#9) and the soft tacos came out soggy so i couldn't pick them up without them ripping. I had to use a fork ... and my friend had the same problem. It was 2 tacos with rice and beans for around $10. Its not the best Mexican food but the service was friendly and the chips were good. Maybe the large group i came with contributed to the soggy food but.. it still made my meal go down a few stars.

This actually is a great museum.  The cost is super high at $20 per person, and they do absolutely zero crowd control.  Very hard to stand and read the pieces when the room is packed.  I guess I would call the price a downtown Nashville factor.  They need to limit the amount of people let in every hour instead of focusing on the profit.  People will still come.. it's the Johnny Cash Museum!
Small neighborhood market. Selection is a bit slim on common boxes and canned goods. Bakery is adequate for last minute party gifts etc. great in a pinch and friendly service.

We made a trek out here based on some of my obsessive pre-trip research -- my husband makes fun of me for this ;) but it turned out great! 

There's a fantastic variety here especially if you have a lot of people in your group with different tastes. They seemed to also have a great variety of vegetarian and vegan options. 

We first grabbed an Americano at the coffee roasters-- because caffeine! My husband and I are self admitted coffee snobs and we approve! Great flavor and it hit the spot.

We actually took a loop twice (it's not a huge place but still has great variety) because everything looked so good. We settled on Chicken and Waffles with cheese grits from Fete Au Fete, which was amazingly tasty! 

The only downside thing here is the location, we actually walked from the French Quarter and it was a bit of a hike, we ended up taking an uber back to the hotel. We also discovered there is another food hall right next to our hotel. I am glad we went to try this one though, it was worth it.

Fast food Asian-Caribbean fusion, loved the mofongo, the fried rice, and the chicken broth soup!  I wasn't expecting all the regular Chinese dishes that were on the menu, things that you would see at a normal Chinese restaurant, like orange chicken.  It was a strange combo to me to have that with the mofongo, it kinda went together, I guess?  I think I need it to grow on me a bit more.  Drinks were just normal fountain drinks, I was hoping for something more Caribbean, maybe a coconut drink?  You can get your food in Styrofoam or on dishes.  It seemed that everyone opted for Styrofoam.  It was a lot of food, I shared a dish with my husband, and we both left completely stuffed.  Prices were reasonable, and service was good.  The cashier knew it was our first, so explained how things worked. It's pretty casual, you order your food at the cashier, then sit down and wait.  It was strange to see how the place has changed since it was Wild Garlic Grill, which was much more upscale.  I would need to have a very specific craving to come back and try this again.

There's not much like coming home to a hot house in the middle of summer, but that's exactly what happened. After calling my home warranty place, they referred us to some random company with poor reviews. After being unable to even get in touch with them, I contacted my warranty place back and said I would like to find my own contractor... and after having Robert with Done Rite come out, I knew we made the right choice. He was very responsive, professional, and was able to fix the problem that same day. I would recommend calling Done Rite for all of your HVAC needs.

If your looking for a cheap place to crash for a night this is for you!

However it's not for me, I travel a lot for work and this is one of the worst places I've stayed!
Although the staff is very nice, this place is so outdated and need a lot of work! It's very hard to find, and the room I stayed in was dirty! There was literally what looked like blood and I don't know what on the bedding, and I don't mean after a washing, I mean it hasn't been washed! I was actually going to sleep on the chair provided, but I looked and there was an oily Boot print on it. I was completely discussed!!! After traveling all day I just wanted a good night's rest, but I was so freaked out by what was on the bed, and it was to late to ask for a different room. 

After reading other reviews this morning, if my card gets ANY charges on it that are not mine I will OWN this Hotel.

Clean your place up and obviously you have a thieves working for you! How can you run a business and not do something about that?
Nice folks, excellent hot chicken even on a crowded weekend

This was the first time we used Gate 1, as well as our first guided trip.  I was a little hesitant in how it was going to be....but it could not have turned out any better.  Our guide Bladj and our driver Tony were the absolute best!  They took care of us and made sure we saw the best parts of Croatia, Slovenia and Venice.  With the added bonus of Bosnia and Montenegro.  Gate 1 is quite easy to work with and they have some fabulous travel deals.  They put the customer first....at least they did with us.  Can't wait to go to Prague, Budapest, Vienna and Berlin next March!
It's  ok I guess food is normal service is the same nothing special n oh yea don't leave nothing in ur car the valet people got sticky fingers not ever going back

I was so happy to find a KFC buffet because I love the food and it brings back memories of when my grandma used to take me to a KFC buffet. This location is terrible. They could not keep up with the buffet and I had to wait over 20 minutes for them to bring gravy out. When they finally did bring the gravy out it was not normal, it was runny. They were out of other things as well and several people were Standing around waiting for food. The food they did have on the buffet was clearly old. The women's bathroom had nasty toilet paper wadded up in the corner and the mens had a huge puddle of what I assume is water. My boyfriend could not use the bathroom because there was so much standing water. A previous yelp review states that they had this issue 8 months ago and it clearly hasn't been fixed. Don't go here.
I have been here several times. Make sure you show up hungry.  This place makes killer sandwiches.

I knew I was coming here for lunch, and so I perused the pictures to see what to order and decided on the shrimp quesadillas.  I grew up in Santa Barbara and hadn't been here for a long time.  The place looks clean and inviting, and, of course, the ocean view is wonderful, but you pay a premium for this view and ambiance if you order food, which is ridiculously expensive.  My shrimp quesadillas were $15.95, and there were only teeny, tiny shrimp in them like the kind you buy in water in a can.  My husband's chowder boat had about a cup of chowder in it for $11.95.  My mom ordered the Shrimpfest skewers, which were the best deal with maybe 10 large shrimp for $12.95 plus a salad and beans.   I guess I have sticker shock that the lunch bill was over $60 including tip in Goleta no less.  I think there are probably better and more generous lunch options in Santa Barbara or Ventura that are less expensive with an equally nice view.

This place is very cool. A nice clean cafe with plenty of interior seating and a few tables outside located in a great area with a great home cafe feeling. They have a variety of breakfast, coffee, sandwiches and more. I only wish it was closer to home. My egg and bacon sandwich on cuban bread is to die for. Why can't more places offer food like this on the go? Luv Luv Luv, and by the way the owner was very pleasant as well. Please go support this place!!

This was one of the places I wanted to visit when coming to NOLA.  I've never experienced Mardi Gras and coming here makes me want to visit NOLA for Fat Tuesday and everything.  

First of all I love this place offers a free shuttle from pretty much to/from wherever.  BIG, big plus.  So, we got dropped off by the shuttle and I was surprised to see that this place was a warehouse.  You are greeted by Jester at the front door and when you walk in there are big sculptures of The Wizard of Oz among other props.  You enter the gift store, which is where you buy your tour ticket and where the tour begins.  

The tour is about an hour long and is very informative in helping people like me learn what Mardi Gras is all about.  You do get the full effect here with costumes and food too.  A place to visit when in NOLA.

The food here was excellent. Although they didn't have any vegetarian options on the menu, they had a great attitude in putting together some side items to make a full vegan dinner for me. The place is formal, which I'm not personally a fan of, but it was a client dinner and that's what they wanted. They all loved the food too.

There is an attached bar where you can buy and smoke cigars after dinner. This is a major plus for a lot of people who are not entirely thrilled by the smoking ban and who like a nice cigar with their post-dinner drink. Good mixed drinks and both red wines recommended to us were great. 

If you're into the pricey formal dining experience, I'd recommend this place.

Ate lunch there this afternoon after walking/driving by this place for the last few months with a coworker.  We had read some reviews and wanted to see which ones were true.

Walked up to the counter and perused the menu.  Since I haven't eaten here yet, I went with a basic double cheeseburger.  The burger was a lil on the small side, but I didn't want to get too full because the wife was making macaroni for dinner, so it was all good...this time.

The burger was quite tasty.  The meat was seasoned just right and their house sauce was flavorful.  The lettuce and tomato, on the other hand, were pretty pathetic.  The lettuce was a grayish-clearish-beige and the tomato was an iridescent pink and lacked any type of flavor, so I took it off the burger.

One real positive was the soda machine was a gazillion flavors.  All restaurants should have one of those.

I will be back.  There were a few items on the menu that looked very good.  I noticed another person's onion rings and was tempted to ask for one, but I will wait until next time.  They looked amazing! 

The biggest drawback to this place, in my opinion, was the pricing.  I don't mind paying descent money for a burger, but I do want to either be full or have leftovers, but as I said, I will be back.

Oh yea...get some fresher veggies for your burgers too.  Tomatoes should be red and lettuce should be green.

Good luck, Burgerfi!

Wine and board games??? I am obsessed! I love this place because it had a nice feel to this place. The perfect place on a Friday night to drink on delicious wine and beat your boyfriend at Scrabble. It doesn't get better than that. 

Thank you Santa Barbara Wine Therapy for a night of fun and great memories!

Steinbrenner Field is a terrific ball park that doubles as the Spring Training site for the New York Yankees and as the home field for the Tampa Yankees (minor league team). 

During Spring Training, the facility is packed with Yankees fans, but ticket prices are very reasonable. The rest of the season, there are amazing deals to be had with the Tampa Yankees organization. Check social media and sites like Groupon for regular deals. 

Parking is free. During Spring Training games, fans park in the lot across the street at Raymond James Stadium (Dale Mabry Highway) and walk a pedestrian bridge to the stadium. The rest of the season, there is parking right in front of the main gate.

Horrible food! Ordered take out, lots of things were missing. When we called back to complain, they were confused and seemed annoyed. Only offered us 10% off our next trip. No way we are going back. Plus the food was dry and gross. Chicken was over cooked, wings were rubbery and overall not good

Stout's Shoes offers a great selection of shoes at an "OK" price. Sometimes you'll find shoes are less expensive here than at the mall, but other times they're more expensive. It's good to shop around. 

My husband had trouble with a pair of Merrill shoes he bought at Stout's, and they took them back and replaced them with no questions. Very good customer service.

It's fun to go in the store to shop, but it's also a great piece of history in downtown Indy. Stout's has been around more than 100 years!

Lunch was really very good and I thought the prices were reasonable for the quality of the food.  We had a semi-light lunch, all going for salads but also trying their apparently famous shrimp & grits.  The shrimp & grits were very good and my salad was good too.  The atmosphere was upscale but not uncomfortable at all.  And the neighborhood certainly is worth the trip.

I have to say our waiter was a bit wacky.  He did a good job, but some obvious things flummoxed him.  He didn't know what dark beers they had and said "I assume we have Amber Bock" (they didn't).  When he came back, he offered up Guinness and then said "that's a pretty dark beer" (uh, you think?).  He was a nice kid though.

had a reservation and wasn't seated until approx 20/25 minutes prior to that reservation time. waitress was very slow and forgetful, she also just kept constantly coming to the table to fix things and refill water that wasn't even half full even though we had a jug of water on the table. we finally were able to order after quite some time and our food did not come out for about an hour. when it came out it was all cold and the soups we ordered as appetizers came out with the main meal. everything was cold or not tasting well and the manager offered to remake it but it would take another 30 minutes even if he expedited it. it was already over an hour that we waited for the food, not worth it. really unfortunate experience to wait that long for food only to have to go home 2 1/2 hours later to make something. two star rating because the bread was good

I have wanted to try this place since it open​. Finally, ​went today​ for lunch and I am glad that I did​.  When I walked you notice how open the area is.         Also, how clean this restaurant​.  I was greeted at the front door by one of the​ team members.  He explained the menu--I selected the squawking​ goat and tea​ as my beverage.  
The squawking​ goat is a biscuit with​ a fresh slice of goat cheese, fried chicken, and​ a biscuit.  Swimming in pepper jelly which is a warm spicy sweet​ jam.  I was pleasantly​ surprised by this sandwich.  The Biscuit​ was light and cooked perfectly.
When you place your order they ask a special question.  Making it interesting when they call out the name.  Today they ask what is my favorite Halloween costume.  I was told that every day​ the question is on the sign outside.
I was pleasantly surprised and enjoyed this biscuit.

This chain is not bad and I've had one particularly good meal at this location. The server who looks a bit like Brad Pitt is excellent and the sous chef from Minnesota (I think?) was great. Took my other and 12 YO J for a mid Sunday afternoon meal, which is the perfect time IMHO to eat anywhere on a Sunday. You really can see what the people are about and at this location they shine.

First time here, and I thought it was pretty good.   Loved the tableside cooking, and the food was delicious!   I felt like it was a lot of food, with all the things you get in the 5 course meal.  Always seemed to be extra, which the chef was happy to distribute amongst all the folks at our table.  
Server was meh - which really didn't ruin our visit.  She didn't know what a bloody mary was .. she kept asking the guest at our table "a broccoli mary?" ..  Multiple times.   I would think a place with a full bar, would have knowledgable servers, especially with a classic drink like that.   Otherwise, I was impressed and will be back.

Can't say enough good things about these guys. I hadn't been in the market for subs for about 10 years, and these guys helped me work on my budget and knowledge level to get a really nice setup at a fair price. It's been a couple months since installation and it's holding up great, no unexpected problems.

I really liked how they were low pressure and didn't just try to lead me to their most expensive gear straightaway--that is MUCH better than the normal car audio experience, which is high pressure and low value. 

I told them what I wanted and they didn't try to pull me in another direction. They set me up for under a grand when another area installer had quoted me more than $3000 for an 'artisan' installation of a kit that would have sounded about the same.

Only other feedback is I wish the 'showroom' were more noticeable. They had some stuff up front but there are more options people should know about as soon as they walk in--even if it means mentioning there's a room in back.

Ohmygawd! This place is amazing! We had a group of 6 and got there just before it got busy. I recommend getting there before the rush! We arrived at 6. I had the Szechwan pot and it was sooo spicy. The bok choy, onion cakes, marble and sirloin steak were so good! Hello! There's a sauce bar and it is what dreams are made of! 
There was some parking in the back. Great place for groups!!

I frequent this location about 3-4 times a week. Friendly drive thru staff, drinks are tasty, and my daughters donuts are normally pretty good. Every once in awhile I notice my cup isn't as full as it could be, but that's about it.

The basket my breakfast burrito came in was probably responsible for origin of several mutants. Burrito was tiny, which was a good thing because 2 bites in a rat darted from the closet at the end of the bar seating. It shot under the stools, skidded on the hairpin turn, and disappear under the prep station. The waitress saw it, I saw it, and I think the table next to me caught it. I wasn't expecting the operation to stop completely, but there was this "That's Mel's For Ya" shoulder shrug that instantly pug this place on the no fly list. Coffee was good, so that's a positive.

This European cuisine restaurant is wonderful, for being busy they always seem to always have great service. I had the croissant French toast, sausage links and coffee. Everything was perfect, I love the orange and strawberry preserves. This is the kind of place that you bring your friends and family to treat them with love.

I love this venue.  The Old Firehouse never looked better.  I loved the nice heavy wood, decorations and the old fire pole.  Unfortunately, The Cheesesteak was a huge disappointment.  It came on a house-made fresh roll that I thought was just not right for a cheesesteak.  It is a very good roll but it is very dense and every time I bit into my Cheesesteak everything squished out.  The other two people that were eating at the bar had cheeseburgers they look really good.  In the cheesesteak I know they use real meat because I got two big pieces of gristle.  It was cheesy.  The Cheesesteak does come with french fries but $18.75, holy mackerel, it needed it be bigger and have everything work together better.  Everyone does get two free house made biscuits and a house made cookie.
Finally got to try this restaurant and I loved it. My husband ordered the frita and I ordered the vegan tacos. We also ordered their original flan. Everything was delish.

Cool place! Very small. I had the Annie's grasshopper and shared it with my mama mom. Cool concept and the guy who made my dessert was fun, and funny & personable. He said the cows milk tastes better than the coconut milk in his expert opinion (I go both ways on that). I'll be back to try more flavors.

Great little joint for getting a sandwich! Make sure you look for it because otherwise you will drive right past it! Sandwiches are hot and fresh and do not skimp on flavor. Service is always nice, friendly, and quick! Make sure to get yourself a Cuban!
I loved my experience at Cafe De Thai the service is excellent and such a great vibe! The coconut chicken soup is a must ! Ever time I'm in Reno I have to make the stop.

Celebrated my 70th birthday, was not able to sleep on the Bourbon St side, asked to have my room moved, and they were more then accommodating, also, my sister, was given a room right across the hall from us, as we requested....The room was perfect, sheets clean and comfortable, absolutely no complaints....VERY Pleased with our stay...

Dawn came to my sister's apartment for a dinner party for 9 of us and she was amazing! We started out with a food demo of how to make ravioli and she didn't mind us bombarding her with a million questions. Then we all sat and they served us course by course, 4 courses total and she provided an app as well. Everything was amazing but I thought the dessert was hands down the best. Dawn was a great way to have a home party without all of the distraction of making serving and keeping the night going. We were able to feel like we were at a restaurant but still comfy at home!

NEGATIVE!!! The beginning of the  name says it all. 
BAD fins...... BAD FOOD, BAD SERVICE!!
I  dont recommend this place.

What a great experience. My relatives were in town from New Zealand... so really they don't have the wild west or Mexican food there! Everyone wanted a wild west experience, and the girls are both under 10, so a good excuse to go to Old Tucson Studios.. which will be a separate 5-star review, .. ah but I digress. There is no Mexican food at Old Tucson, so one of the "players" recommended Los Nopales. We drove to it, and from both the outside and inside, it looks pretty plain. We had 11 in our party, and they were happy to put the tables together for us, and brought tons of chips and salsa. 

Really, eating here is more like eating in someone's living room or den, but don't let that cloud your judgement. The food is wonderful, and several in our party actually ordered an additional entrée to share. 

You will love the authentic flavors, and if you have out-of-town guests, don't take 'em to the "expensive big upholstered booth" places, bring them here. They'll have a great food experience, just as we all did. 
Enjoy and bon appetite

True jewish deli. I had the pastrami sandwich with coleslaw and a Dr Browns black cherry soda. It was fantastic we also bought a bottle of jewish wine Togo. We will defiantly be coming back especially during the holidays to get Challah.

Stopped in for a quick slice of plain pizza for lunch. This was the worst slice I've had in a long time. Pizza was soggy with grease accumulated on top of the cheese. I blotted it off with 3 napkins. The cheese was tough & chewy. The only plus was it was hot.

When u showed up it felt ok. We ordered. I ordered a beer. I almost got up n got it myself. The employees were cool. But they did not have communication. The food.... amazing. Thats only why the place is still in business. Beer was good atmosphere wad good. Service was awful but yeah id go there again.... if im not paying, because food is over priced.

I don't love BBQ, but this place was great! I got the pulled pork sandwich with green beans and Mac and cheese. The pulled pork was delicious; however the sides were nothing to write home about. I'm a Big Mac and Cheese person and unfortunately, this one just wasn't the best. The green beans were super mushy too. 

The decor, location, and ambiance were fabulous though and the staff is super friendly!

My Philly friends made a reservation about two months in advance for this restaurant. To describe it as a small plate vegan place would be accurate, but wouldn't do it justice. The atmosphere is dark, cozy, and upscale, but I didn't feel out of place in a sweater and jeans. 

It was suggested by the server that we order 2-3 small plates per person and share, which is exactly what we did. You do rack up quite the bill doing this, but the food is of such high quality that I didn't really mind. And to be able to go to a place where EVERYTHING is meatless is just so exciting (there are only a few places in my city like that, and Philly seems to have tons). 

My friends were losing their minds over the potato croquettes, which were definitely delicious, but my hands down faves were the artichoke frites and the ramen. The avocado toast, bao buns, ricotta, and gnocchi were also great. The cauliflower steak was maybe the only thing we ordered that wasn't mind blowing, but we all left full and happy. I will definitely return!
Had a very lovely lunch here! Wonderful wine, food, atmosphere, and staff.  Great addition to DTSP!
this was in the Eater top places in Philadelphia- who did they pay off? 4 of us couldn't finish 2 - 10" pizzas and way over sauced over cooked pasta . just not good
Wonderful food with gluten free and vegetarian/vegan options as well.  Free range chicken and eggs.  You can feel good about indulging here!

i just had sitar indian 15 min ago and it made me so full i can't be bothered with capitalizing words or spelling or much puncutation.  ughhhhhh.  ugggghhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh

i jus found out today you can do take out lunch buffet there for $9.95 and they give you a huge take out container to stuff full of samosas paneers tikka masalas naan that other orange stuff n that other green stuff as much as you can fit into your container and then you take it to where you work and nomnomnom and then you write a lazy but glowing reviewof sitar indain and you cant do anythin produtive f or hours but write run on sentences like this one. we cant let the ISIS terrorists learn about this stuff and disseminate it throuhout the US government workers.  the ensuing food coma woudl shut down obama and bring the governent to a stand stil.  i am at a stand sill.

i cant even
Second time I've ordered food from them and they do not disappoint. I'll be back for more! Best Thai food in town!

I vacilate between 3 + 4 stars - and one time 2 stars.
The first few times and also recently the sushi has been swimmingly fresh and wonderful at moshi-moshi, but about a year ago I had a very awful experience during a crowded lunch-hour.

We sat upstairs which I DO NOT RECOMMEND and were nearly forgotten about and the kitchen (cooked) meals came out all wrong.

Meanwhile - they make an addicitve Toro-Giza handroll and believe it or not the "kids Maki" with Tamago and veggies for $4.50 is a delicious treat.

It's not nearly as good as Shiroi Hana and it sure ain't Morimoto - but it is not nearly as pricey either.

It's a mid priced place with middle-of-the-road sushi.

Good location/venue, and an outside patio area.

Great margaritas (could use slightly more fruit added). 

Delicious tortilla chips and salsa, and ceviche served with a leaf of romaine lettuce and avocado along with saltine crackers? (not sure about the saltine crackers  ...was ok with the crackers, but was better with their tortilla chips).

Good wings, lettuce cups, tacos, and desserts, and the prickly pear utilized in some of the menu items adds local flavor.

Service was courteous, friendly and prompt. Atmosphere is casual and the restaurant kid friendly, though primarily an adult venue.

I did a Botox forehead and eyes area. First, overprice compared to other places, second the results were far good. It feels like the professional were saving the product. I don't recommend! And also the follow up has to be paid if you need more.

We were looking for things to do with kids and came across this museum. The people were friendly and helpful. They have a coloring and passport station for the kids. The museum is divided into four halls. Each hall is divided by years and what was happening during that time period. My son loved the racing hall. I would definitely recommend it.
Whoever was making food 5/24/21.... omfg. That shit wasssss fiiiiiiiiiiiiiire. So fresh, so hot and so filling. Definitely my fav. Location. Thank you!!!!!

Although it's hidden, the layout of this location is way better than others I've been to. I came here because I didn't want to wait 45 minutes at the Richmond heights location. Walked right in. Nicki was super nice and did an excellent job. Definitely going back to this location.
I love this place. Sushi is always fresh and so so so good. Sometimes service can run a little slow, but it is worth it.
After getting a citation Dutch bros covered my drink. Thank you so much Dutch Bros. Trevor had helped me out today

I'm not sure where the rest of you stand on this, but I've had my fill of the "chainification" of America. Everywhere you go is the same old stuff that was offered where you just left. Walk in to any mall in the country and you're going to find the same shops and stuff that you'd find anywhere else. One strip mall is the same as any other. What ever happened to local flavor? I know it's still out there, you just have to look harder to find it. 

I landed in Tucson on a Sunday afternoon after flying all day. I had never been to Arizona and was out there on a business trip. I only had a little time to explore, and it was less than two weeks from Christmas - so I wanted to find someplace interesting and Tucson-y to spend the rest of the afternoon. Fortunately, the airport had a wall full of brochures to help point the way. I settled on one for 4th Ave. down by the university. After dropping off my bags at the hotel, I headed downtown. 

I was supposed to meet a colleague for dinner, but after flying all day I was famished! I decided to have a glass of wine and an appetizer to tide me over. The restaurant I wandered in to was Bumstead's. It's cozy and definitely NOT a chain. Whew. The menu is full of interesting offerings with very creative names.  I settled on a grilled portabello mushroom with ceviche, cilantro, and cheese. The bartender came back and told me that they were out of ceviche and asked if it would be ok if they added some grilled vegetables instead. I said that would be great.  The dish that came out was huge and tasty! It was so good that I wasn't able to make myself stop eating it to save room for the real dinner I was supposed to have later. I wish that I would have had some more time in Tucson to explore the Bumstead's menu some more.  Maybe I'll be back someday... Definitely check it out if you find yourself on 4th Ave.

My Mom and Dad purchased a Kia Optima from Zeiser Kia. My son was with them. At time of purchase, they were told that updates to their navigation system would be free. When requested, the response was, "That wasn't in your contract."  Three people-my Dad, Mom, and son-all heard it clearly stated that nav system updates were free.

The important point here is that, if they had never been told the updates would be free, they wouldn't be upset about the fee. So the question is, Zeiser Kia, why not be truthful up front? 

This is not a good way to do business. Now, instead of talking about how much I like my Kia and recommending Zeiser Kia, which my whole family has done, we will be warning friends and family not to go there. As soon as I cannot trust what I am being told, I no longer do business with a company.

This is the third sushi place we went to in a row during one weekend and it was the best by far.

My mother, who is Japanese (but third generation American so I'm not sure how much this counts), absolutely loved this place.  We called her trip the weekend of sushi, because I chose sushi places for almost every meal.  This was the third one we went to, for dinner on Saturday, and was by far the best.

We started with the Seafood Ceviche and it had a great amount of seafood and the ceviche sauce was delicious.  My mom got the lychee martini.  She was sad they no longer serve the alcoholic green tea drink, because they don't have green tea vodka, but she said the lychee martini was delicious.

We then got the Hawaiian Roll and the Spontaneous Combustion Roll.  The Hawaiian Roll was absolutely delicious.  The coconut shrimp was fried to perfection.  The Spontaneous Combustion Roll is very different from your normal roll, but it was a welcome difference and was very good.  At 6 p.m. on a Saturday night only the booth tables were full and when we left around 7 p.m. there were even less people.

If you live in the area, do yourself a favor and eat here!

Excellent. 

1) I love Xi'an Chinese food. I am Indian American, so I love spicy food. Sichuan and Xi'an are my two favorite. 
2) Got the cumin lamb burger and the lamb skewers. 
3) Service was fast. And ambiance is nice.

Partied my a$$ off here my third night in Nola! Only a $5.00 cover Saturdays; good looking men dancing (they want you to get touchy for tips, haha...) and excellent music. Only thing: I'm from NY/NJ, and when I pay for a drink, I'm used to getting the remainder of my drink if there's extra, let's say, in a shot, etc. The bartender argued and wouldn't just give me the tiniest sip that was left in the shaker. That was a minor blip, but a blip nonetheless. The DJ also didn't really take requests. Other than that, I really did get lost in oz; packed club and good time overall. You never know who you're going to meet there, dance with.

Food was very good but service was horrible, waitress didn't even smile once and always seemed bothered when we asked for stuff.  Unsure if my family of 7 and I will head back or not based on such poor service.

We visit this place every time we vacation in St Pete's! It's a fun time checking out all the types of wines they make right there. First off the folks working there are awesome.. knowledgeable and helpful in picking out a wine for your taste. It's not a stuffy place so don't worry if your not typically a wine person.  The wine offered is very different to include watermelon, blueberry, key lime to a spicy tomato. You can narrow your choice down at a free wine tasting that is great!  We had a blast and picked up a bottle of wine which we enjoyed at home. If looking for something different to do and like wine... ck this place out. 'Salud'
Rosie's was awesome!!! Everything from cinnamon rolls to coffee to biscuits and gravy were amazing. The service was fantastic. We will definitely go here again.

This was our first time using Lochel's for a cake order. It was for a 3 year old bday party and our goal was that the cake be large and visually impressive. 
They have a nice photo album of their cakes that I selected from. I chose chocolate chip pound cake and it was excellent. The cake was professionally done, the order was completed exactly as we had discussed and it was ready on time. 

I was excited to show it off to both our 3 year old as well as to the large party that showed up to enjoy it.  We got a ton of compliments about how cool the spider man cake was. 
I have zero complaints and would happily trust them again with a special order.

This place is super slow. Expect to wait an hour on unsalted, hard grits and overcooked bacon. The food is NOT good, better off at Waffle House. Nasty establishment not very sanitary. I literally got food poisoning from the food..... save yourself doctor bills and eat elsewhere

If I could give them negative stars, I would. What a morally irreprehensible business!!! Not a single person was wearing a mask. There was indoor dining, with no social distancing being followed. People were sitting close to each other. Servers, managers, cooks etc. were all without mask....they were not even pretending to wear one. We trashed the food, so really can't comment on food. My friend was too nice to ask them for a refund. I wanted to. I know that I am NEVER ordering from there again, even when things go back to normal. Shame on the business for contributing to the pandemic.

I would have to say the Fork earns four stars but loses a star because my wife salad sucked.  My chicken dinner and salad was very good as well as the service.  The atmosphere is trendy and cool.
My wife ordered a chopped salad and did not like it as it was like a weed salad and not very good.
Overall, I will be back because it was good.

Walked into La Banda and was impressed by the decorations and atmosphere. However, we were seated and waited for 5 -8 minutes before a server even asked us for our drink order. 
We ordered and the server didn't say a word to us. The food was quick; however, it was wrong. My boyfriend's meal came out with ingredients in the burrito that weren't listed on the menu. When we asked the server about it he said "that's how it comes, the menu is wrong". 
They were clearly under staffed, as the hostess was also the table buster. We watched several customers come in and stand at the hostess stand waiting for several minutes because she was in the back cleaning tables. 
They just opened up about a month ago and it's pretty obvious. I think we will take our business down the street to fiesta ranchera instead.

Since this was my first time, I will be kind. It seemed, that they could smell my newbie status and paid little attention to me. I had a decent meal and the price was reasonable. It was the service and attitutde that left me cold. 

When an obvious "regular" came in they were greeted warmly and show to a table, poured some coffee, and their order was started before they were seated. I was largely ignored.

No bike rack.

I made reservations for my wife and I to celebrate our 1st wedding anniversary here, and they didn't disappoint at all! The atmosphere was relaxed but elegant, the chairs were extremely comfortable, the staff was pleasant and very helpful, and the food.....incredible! First tip: order the Arancini! We love risotto, so to try our first arancini was just perfect. It was crispy, and silky, and seasoned so well, and the marinara that it comes in could be eaten by itself it's so good. We both had pasta dishes, which were made with homemade pasta. You can definitely tell the difference in the quality of the pasta. The bolognese was meaty and really delicious. To end the night we shared the tiramisu. Tiramisu is my favorite dessert, and I am pleased so say North Italia delivered! Perfect date night spot!
Fantastic!!! Sat outside on an extremely hot day; however, with the fans and mist machines it was more than comfortable. Food arrived quickly and was excellent.

What a waste of a wonderful, perfect location. The cheapest crap you can find at restaurant depot served for a premium price. Beer priced decent but the selection sucks. Sorry New Orleans, another one of the extremely few lakefront space available, wasted again!

I was visiting the Philly area a few weeks ago for my birthday and stopping by McCloskey's was the best decision I made.
The bartenders knew about every beer on tap and in bottles, they were able to easily suggest a great IPA for me to try. They even have these great beer books with tons of information about all the bottled beer they serve.
After a few beers I ordered the wings (which were the best birthday present to myself) and my friend ordered a burger. In the end we shared our meals because they were too good to just eat one.
Service was great and super friendly, I felt like a regular even though it was my first time visiting.
I'd make the trip from NYC any day to eat those wings again.

The service at this Starbucks is relatively fast.  Baristas have always been friendly to me.  The two downsides to this location are that there is not a drive thru and the interior is small...it can get pretty crowded at times.

Hubby and I came here as a midway point on our biking trip for Sunday afternoon. We were looking for a nice refreshing break and stopped in at Catalina because it was the perfect midway point. Interestingly the brewery is bike themed, Which fit perfectly with our adventure that day however there were no bike racks to tie our bikes up to you outside which is strange. Then as we entered we were there around 1230 on the Sunday and we were the first customers apparently. The bartender was hanging out quietly however he was a little less than enthusiastic. I ordered the prickly pear beer and the hubs got the blood orange Brew. Both the beers were quite delicious however we were underwhelmed with the atmosphere the place. Perhaps if we went later in the day or at a peak time it would've been a different experience. However I would give it another shot next time.

We had a great experience here.  Food was very good. It's a  simple menu sandwiches, soups, breakfast foods, everything was super fresh.  The tomatoes grown by the owners were amazing.  Everything had a home cooked feel to it.  The place itself is charming, especially the outside seating area.  The staff was very friendly.  The restaurant has character and charm that only a small neighborhood place can bring and you will never find In a chain restaurant.    We will def. recommend this place to our friends.
I have been going to Thea for my pedicure for many years. She does an amazing job and is such a sweet n kind woman. Ask for her. You won't be disappointed.
pretty good they usually do better but first day open up after covid-19 so I could complain handmade lizards cheesesteak the trust me it's going to be a 5 star next time

Terrible service. Hair in my salad. NO Bacardi!?!? What bar doesn't have Bacardi?? Was given some nasty substitute - Naked Turtle Rum, that had an awful after taste. No silverware, no drink refills, server NEVER came back so I didn't get to share with her the hair in my salad. Had to track her down to get our check. NOBODY seems to care about the customers. The only positive is the free parking under the hotel. So just come for the free parking and sunset then eat and drink elsewhere.
Zero stars because after being seated we were ignored to the point we all decided to get up and leave. So we cant say how the food was.

Great dunkin donuts for when you are in a rush. I came in this morning around 8:00 to get my iced coffee with caramel and cream & a sausage egg & cheese croissant sandwich. The ordering process was quick and efficient. The manager asked me if I was sure I did not want hot coffee with my sandwich and hash brown combo, which I appreciate because she was covering all of her bases and making sure I was aware of the combo details.
I'm pretty sure I didn't wait past 5 seconds before they called my # with my order, WOW, the speed of lightning!
My sandwich was perfectly prepared which was great. I don't have high expectations when it comes to chains so my standards are lowered when I come into DD, but they pulled through! Also my coffee was perfectly sweet, just the way I like my DD :)

open 24 hours, and food to boot.
30 drafts, that are always being rotated, and also taken great steps to keep the beer lines clean and they make damn sure that the flavors are fresh...

cask conditioned ales
food and beer pairings with J'anita's in the house
back patio open now as well.
when the balcony is open,
a secondline mural takes you on your way, and on mardi gras day?  there just isn't anyplace better than this.
You can rent this balcony, and have your own private mardi gras party.  that in itself?  Is worth every penny.  the krewe of rolling elvis rents this yearly, and that night is always fun, even if your not at the balcony, these guys roam all over the bar.  on ash wednesday?  they feed EMS workers for free, as a thank you for all the things they do.

make sure you have your ID here, because your not getting a drink without it!  even if your 80, they're gonna want to see it...

This place has incredible food but the service is not the best. Every time we come in for lunch, it takes at least 15-20 minutes to get our food. It would be helpful if they hired another staff member to speed up service. BUT...the food is worth the wait. If you have the time make sure you go because the Chicken Gyro Pocket is the best I've had.

I would be in so much trouble.  It is just a tad too far, or I would be there every night!  I love the Hawaiian Tart flavor.  Just tart enough.  They have a great range of self-serve yogurt flavors, and a large assortment of toppings, from fresh fruit, chocolates, candies, and syrups.  Delish!  My kids are also big fans!  Make sure you get a punch card!

I have had some of the wonderful creations from Edible Arrangements in the past so I was really looking forward to an opportunity to purchase something from them.

I went in, in person, on Monday morning and placed my order. I told her I needed it for a 7 pm function on Wednesday. We made arrangements for me to come by and get it between 6 and 6:30 pm on Wednesday so I could drive directly to my destination with it.

When we arrived at 6:20 pm on Wednesday, they didn't have it ready. They said they had it down for a Friday pick up. The lady behind the counter said the best she could do is pull one together really quickly but that would take at least 15 minutes.

At that point I realized they don't have any process for giving their customers an order receipt. It was kind of  my word against the order takers.

So my husband took me to the function and then returned about 10 minutes later to Edible Arrangements thinking it would almost be ready. The lady working that night was in the back and poked her head out and saw he was there. She didn't say anything but returned to the back without saying a word.

He waited there 15 more minutes before she came out front and gave him our order.

The order was great and the product wonderful, but I think they need to look at their processes. This whole thing could have been averted by providing the customer with an order receipt.

I struggled with what star rating to give them because their actual product was great and I don't know if this was just a one-off issue. But in the end, I have to rate it based on my experience.

So friendly, so good on the basic foods.

Not very big but great on the food and the service. The bartenders don't miss a beat and are great for this neighborhood bar.
Definitely coming back.
Just ask for cheesesteaks (off menu) but they make them better than most other places.  Pat's and Gino's can't compete!!

Having had no success with several other area plumbers for a leaky Roman tub faucet, Richard at Jolly Rooter referred me to Mike for help. Mike was able to quickly diagnose the issue and knew exactly what to do in order to fix it. He went, what I feel, was above and beyond to fit me into his schedule. With no trouble at all he was able to swap out the defective cartridges in my faucet and the whole thing was good as new. 

Mike was prompt, personable (we had several hobbies in common and it was nice talking to him), knowledgeable, and his rates were very reasonable. While I hope I don't see Mike very often because I like not having plumbing issues, I will be using Mansfield Plumbing again when issues arise because this experience was flawless.
the postmate delivery from here is absolutely horrible. the fried rice is so bad and so is the spicy chicken rice. they look like left over food. will never go again

Thanks to Yelp, I found this gem on lower level of the Gallery. It's a one man operation that delivers speed and friendly service. And using the battery itself as a receipt is pure genius. 10 month warranty on the battery. 

This place is a real find.

I am torn between giving Legacy Nails two stars or three. My experience started off so well: I called to see if I needed to make an appointment or whether I could walk in, and the person who answered said, come on in, we are here for you! In all my years of calling nail salons to get spur of the moment or last-minute services, I have never experienced an employee saying so clearly: we welcome you here and we value you as a customer. I just loved that line, and when I arrived, there was no wait even though there were many other people getting their nails done. It wasn't like she was being so welcoming because it was a slow day, because it wasn't.

Second strong selling point: my mani/pedi was complete in exactly an hour. Sometimes I hesitate to get a combo because I have lots of other activities I need to do in my day, so doing an acceptable job in that time frame is key.

But my mani/pedi was only acceptable in terms of service and product. I brought my own polish (recently bought, mid-level drugstore brand), and when the nail technican made small talk and I told her I was getting my nails done on a Thursday in preparation for attending a wedding on Saturday, she repeated multiple times that my polish was not going to last until then. I understand that they want to upsell gel polish and get folks back in the chairs when it needs to be taken off professionally, but lordy, just apply the polish adequately and I'll do any touch-ups at home if need be. That's why people bring in their own polishes: to extend the life of their mani/pedi.

My nail technician also felt the need to comment excessively about the preferred length of my nails, which was not cool by me. For my athletic and personal aesthetic reasons, I like my toenails very short. But just because I come in with short nails does not mean that I do not want you to file the corners a bit and to make them look pretty.

Even though I love Paris Nails, their services sometimes take too long and they close at 7 pm rather than 8 pm like Legacy Nails. And I like The Summit way better than the weird shopping plaza in which Paris Nails is located. But their nail services cost the same amount, and Paris Nails has a better "basic" mani/pedi package for $45. Paris Nails also offers a complementary beverage (including wine and champagne), and Legacy does not. So I will be returning to Paris Nails next time I treat myself to a mani/pedi.

A friends took me out yesterday for brunch for my birthday.  It's a nice m, clean restaurant.  We sat inside.  I had coffee (I was so glad it wasn't super strong) and the avocado toast.  She got the burrito that was listed as a special and her six year old had an omelet.  Everything was very good.
Excellent atmosphere, awesome wine selection and the cheese tray was delish.  Service was on point as well.

The crawfish was spicy just like I like it, but they put sugar in their boil. It is a taste I'm unaccustomed to, being from New Orleans. I did not like the sweet flavor. I got the corn, potato and sausage which tasted like it was boiled separately from the seafood, in saltwater. I was hoping it would ooze out with the delicious seafood boil flavor, but it was bland. The shrimp and oyster po'boy was decent.
Not the best hot chicken I ever had. The xxx hot chicken taste like burnt season. It was very oily compared to other I have tried.

Chanced upon this place on the way to South Edmonton Common.  One of the better bubble tea places in Edmonton, I think! They also have a location downtown.  I like that they let you customize your sweetness level (30%, 50% etc) My favorite drink is 3 guys, that's milk tea with three toppings (tapioca, pudding and grass jelly).  It's so good! Try it!

The Bow Wow does exactly what needs to be done, it's doesn't too great but it works if you know what I mean. The oysters were top notch, I only had 6 and knew I should've ordered 12. I tried the gumbo which was extremely fresh, for my entree I had the shrimp creole and it was a little disappointing. The dish didn't have a kick a spice and the shrimp had no flavor, good thing I order the crawfish pasta to go. The pasta was the best thing I tasted, the wait was about 20 minute to sit inside and the food didn't take long to come out. I'd visit again, for a drink and oysters.

Nextitle (Eagle office) Multiple issues, errors and challenges. Never had an experience like this with a title company before. They never seemed to have it together. I will never do business with again.

I went in yesterday to inquire about purchasing new devices for our family for Christmas, put my name on a list, and a friendly employee helped me within 5 minutes.  When I went in today, after digesting all the information I had received the day before and having decided exactly what I wanted to purchase, they checked me in and told me to stand by the iPhone table and someone would help me soon.  No one ever came to help.  Ever.  After 30 minutes, I asked about the delay and discovered that no one had even put my name on the waiting list.  So, I put my name on it (again) and waited another 30 minutes.  Still, never got called, no one came to help us, so we walked out.  We called it divine intervention and have decided to just forego the upgrades for now.  Too much hassle.

Great burger place! Kids items and extras e.g. Onion rings, can get sourdough bread instead of buns. 

Parking can be tricky with traffic and narrow drive to small lot in back but worth it. 

Slightly costs more than standard fast food but way better on taste scale.

Schlafly is my go-to, healthy, and close place to eat anytime!  I love the beer, and almost everything I've tried on the menu...It's hard not to get the greens and grains salad with the beer cheese soup every time though!  The salad is topped with delicious quinoa, and I always ask for the chicken warm.  Very good!  Other favs are the chips and french onion dip, the pizza bread, turkey burger, pulled pork, and oatmeal stout ice cream!  They have some variety on the menu...I still want to try the chicken curry sometime.  They offer a beer sampler, which is nice if you're unsure which of their brews you'll like best.

The only negative is the inside dining is not a very intimate experience...it seems very industrial and loud, not at all a cozy place for a date.

They have a garden on-site, and a lot of the menu comes from local farmers, so seasonal specials change.  An extra star for that!  Come on a warm day and enjoy the outdoor patio!

Since we recently moved to Tampa we had to look for new groomers for our 5 month old yorkie. This place is fantastic. I didn't have to wait and my pup was ready with in 1.5 hours. They were patient with the pup since he doesn't like to be groomed. 
They also offer day car for small dogs. I will definitely try their day care soon. 
My dog looks great!

Complete scam artist at this location. Claim they're open till 4am, false. Claims delivery is fast, false. Claims they use fresh ingredients, false. Avoid this place at all costs and after they took my order and DID NOT DELIVER OUR FOOD I WILL BE FILING AN FORMAL COMPLAINT TO CORPORATE ABOUT THIS LOCATION THAT SHOULD NOT BE IN BUSINESS AT ALL.

This was the WORST pedicure I have ever had in my entire life. After my nails dried, I looked at them and could not believe what I saw. The majority of the nail polish was all over the bottom of my toes. On some of my toes she didn't even get any polish on the actual nail!!! 
I looked up and tried to get several people's attention, but no one would respond! No one came over (even when I asked them to), no one even looked up after I said "excuse me" about ten times.
The woman that did my pedicure was no where to be found.
I stood up and continued to try and get someone's attention, and was completely ignored.
I left immediately, even though I wanted my money back, but sadly the woman I spoke to didn't even understand what the word "refund" meant. 
Do not go here.
Do not waste your time or money.

Lost a star solely because of the months it's not very exciting (late January-March generally), but when the water is flowing or when the lights are up it's easily five stars. Great spot to eat lunch if you work near the circle, plenty of places to sit and all sorts of places to grab food or coffee right off the circle or very near it. Starbucks, Potbelly, or South Bend Chocolate are good choices, plus Rocket Fizz if you're looking for something sweet.
The food is ok but is overpriced, if you're on a budget and want a decent meal go elsewhere!!

The food was very good and generous. The service was also quick and great. However, I want to emphasize my concern about one waitress not wearing her mask during this epidemic, so I give only 1 star. I dined in the restaurants 3 times during this month, Every time one petite waitress  always wore her mask under her chin, but not on her mouth and nose. I was very uncomfortable and upset. The place is not large, and usually very crowded. I don't think the waitress realized how important to keep her mask on in the condition, especially she carried our food around. Honestly she gave very good service. To show her hospitality she chatted very closely to us and our dishes, without her mask on. We also feel they should have their masks on all time, even when they don't serve food. Because there are many people come and go, some people may be infected but don't show symptoms. All other workers wore masks, except this older waitress. I wonder if she is the manager or the owner, so nobody dares to remind her about wearing the mask. If she didn't wear it to serve food and talk to people, why bother to wear it under her chin? I am upset that people know they should wear it, but they just pretend they wear it and not really cover the mouths and noses! I don't think I will risk going back before I get the vaccine.

If you want unfriendly service than this is the place for you...

Let me start off by saying that this review is not about the food. Didn't even get say hello before the  mans attitude started rolling in... 

Walking up to the counter a man looks at us then goes through the back door and leaves us for a couple of minutes. Does not say I'll be back, just up and leaves. I bring up the Groupon I just brought on my phone and place it in the counter. (It was for takeout food not dine in) 

When he comes back he looks at me and says... oh you can't use that here, that's only for new customers. In which I reply that we've never been to this establishment before. (Just moved here a month ago) He proceeded to argue with me saying that we were regulars there. (I don't know who he mistaken me and my fiancé for but I hope he treats them better than he treated us) 

Finally, he says okay since you brought it I'll let you use the Groupon but you have to have a reservation... then repeating several times that we didn't read the fine print. Come back Monday we'll serve you then... really come back in 4 days??? 

If he just lead off with "hello, did you have a reservation? Because I see you have a Groupon and they can only be used with a reservation. " We would have just ordered food without using the deal. 

But the attitude we were greeted with and the accusations of us trying to cheat him. Left me not wanting to patronize this establishment. I am glad there are plenty of Mediterranean places down the street with much better service.

First let me start by saying I will never recommend ANYONE to universal dentistry not even my enemies they did not do a good job on my mouth in fact it was terrible to the point that I had to go to several dentists to get my mouth look at and they all agreed that the work that was done was borderline criminal. They compared the work as a scam, a con, a ripoff. I went to them for implants. they did not give me a choice of the color of the implants or the type or anything before working on me. They wanted the money up front all of it but i said i would give half down and the remaining at the completion of the work. When it close to the third part of the work they said to me the balance was due. The hours that they keep is better than bankers hours Monday thru Thursady , 8am to 5pm they are closed Friday Saturday Sunday. The Doctor at the Willow Grove office Dr. Anne K. does not do all the work it is passed on to the dental assistants who are not quilified to do the job correctly. When my dental implants were done they were two differant shades of color, they did not match, they were lose, two implants fell out, the dentures kept shifting around in my mouth making it impossible to eat any solid foods and they did not  line up with the bite. I had to go another dentist pay money to fix the terrible job that was done. I am currently taking universal dentistry to court to get my money back and exposeing them for the scam artist they are. I strongly recommend that noone go to universal Dentistry. 
William acosta glenside pa

They're high key racist.. The owners tell the DJ not to play "certain kinds of music" aka any hip hop unless it's from the early 2000's so basically the music is much like a middle school dance. The reason for this is that it will "attract the wrong type of people" aka BLACK. 
sidenote: they charge $10 for a slice of pizza that came out of a DiGiorno box... that's embarrassing lol 
Most definitely try Penthouse which is right down the street, all the hot girls went there anyway.

Charming little place in Fishtown..  The walls are filled with sketches made by the patrons. And they give you supplies to make your own drawing. And good food great atmosphere. I tried the farro salad with mixed veggies which was a generous portion and was very delectable. I would go there again for sure. They have a really good black bean burger. Yummers! 

Definitely try their sweet goodies too I tried the salty nut and pecan pie bar. And some of my friends got the little hearts and the dark chocolate truffle. Very very tasty.
Mimi always does my nails exactly the way I want them with every detail spot on. She also takes her time and makes suggestions

If You're looking for quality donuts in Reno, Donut Bistro is the place. I believe the quality of the doughnuts here slightly above doughboys. Not only is the dough fantastic but the frosting is dialed in. Please go see for yourself.

YUM YUM YUM. My first time to Delaware and first restaurant and it knocked my socks off. Started off with a pomegranate martini which came with a little shaker to pour yourself, loved that!
We ordered a small goat cheese salad to start which was simple and delicious. I then ordered a bass special, it had risotto and I substitute asparagus for the spinach. Holy moly I don't think I've ever had fish so tender and grilled to perfection. The sauce they drizzled over wasn't too much and added the perfect amount of flavor. The risotto was also out of this world and when taking a bite of the fish and the risotto together it was heaven on earth. Maybe my west coast pallet is not used to this good of fish but if I have to fly to Delaware to find it, I may be booking another trip soon  My boyfriend ordered the scallops and I tried a bite and they were good as well (except I definitely won the best order of the night but who's comparing). The next time I find myself on the east coast, I am finding a Big Fish to eat at again!!

Had to come here when I lost the wheel lock key for my car . I wasn't able to drive the car in so I took a picture of the wheel. I was pleased they were able to match the pattern from the picture. And the key wasn't a ridiculous price. Everyone was nice and friendly, plus they have refreshments. One of the nice things about owning a Lexus.

One of my GFs had done the haunted ghost tour with this company a few weeks before us (bachelorette party). She had such a great time, she recommended it to us. We are so glad she did! I accidentally booked for the wrong date, but I called right up and got an actual human being to answer when I called. She was very nice and switched our dates for the ones I needed. We booked for a group of four. Instructions to where to meet were clear and easy to get to. Our tour guide was Theresa and she was just hilarious! Theresa was a bit late and I honestly cannot remember if she made up for the time, but we all had such a great tour we forgot about it.
This company just makes you feel like a straight up VIP! Mainly because it is such a small group, which makes the experience so much better!! We booked for a group of four and that is exactly who was on the tour, just us four! Theresa had so much information to give us. Tons of stories and history of NOLA. We made stops for the bathroom and to get some adult beverages for the journey. She is willing to take additional time at certain places and answer any/all of your questions. She took us up, down, and around the French Quarter area. This was even more helpful for us to then come back to places we wanted to further checkout. At the end she gave us the "key to the city", which were these super cute small keys as a keepsake from our tour. Anything that we needed to know...we learned from her. Just very informative all around. Like I said before, just felt like a private tour for an affordable price. I will definitely be looking them up for one of their other tours the next time we are down in NOLA : )

As a heads-up to folks that live in the Tampa Bay area, this UPS Store is open at 8AM on Saturdays!  Most of the other UPS Store aren't open until 9:30 on Saturdays.  However, it's in an out of the way location on Island Estates.  It's just off of the Memorial Causeway which is between downtown Clearwater and Clearwater Beach.  It's in the same strip center as Publix right off Island Way.

Although this location is a bit smaller than other ones, there were plenty of supplies and mailing accessories.  The lady working there was friendly and helpful.  Her cute little dog was helping guard the store.

I can definitely recommend this location if you need to get you parcel sent early on a Saturday.

I can't recommend this place enough! I was looking around town for a place to tint my car windows, and couldn't find anyone to schedule the job sooner than a month out. I saw this place while driving and thought I'd give them a call. 

Dan was so helpful and answered all of my questions. I even went up to see him and better understand what percentage I wanted before scheduling the work. My appointment was scheduled with a few business days and my car looks great! No more harsh glare inside and I love the stylish look outside. Plus the work was done within a few hours and it's flawless. 

Thank you, Dan!!

Hudson Beach Glass is always a guaranteed stop of mine during First Friday. The bowls, glasses, jewelry, and art pieces are breathtaking. The one setback is the place is a tad on the small side, and I'm always terrified to knock something over.

They also have events throughout the year including tastings (where you get to keep a glass!) and my all time favorite, the Make Your Own Ornament. For $40, you have a one of a kind present that even the most klutzy, uncreative person can handle making. I recently made one for my mom for Christmas and I am expecting nothing less than tears.

If you're interested, the studio also hosts classes with different levels of expertise to learn how to do your very own glass blowing.

If you've never been here before, seriously make the extra effort to check this place out. It is located on Strawberry street, in between 2nd and 3rd and Market and Chestnut.

Great atmosphere with plenty of seats. Wide selection. Welcome addition to downtown Media. Peach oolong tea with bubbles had actual peach chunks. Cant wait to visit when Dining Under the Stars warms up.

I brought an oil on canvas to be stretched to Lindsey a few weeks ago and I am very impressed with the results.

On our initial meeting Lindsey was very friendly and seemed very knowledgeable about the stretch/framing process.  This is because she is the one doing the framing!

She called me a couple of weeks later and the stretch had been done professionally and looked wonderful.  The price was great and the service was friendly and efficient.  I couldn't  ask for anything else and I will certainly be bringing her more of my business.
