Many thanks!!

We really like this place.  The staff is friendly and the food is good.  We've never had to wait to get a seat, and our dinner has never been rushed.

When we have out-of-town guests, we like to introduce them to down-home, Southern-fried, comfort food.  A big part of Black-eyed Pea's menu includes fried food, including the fried green tomatoes appetizers and fried pies for dessert, but they are delicious.

I recently returned to Zac's and noticed that my one and only complaint from my initial visit had in fact been remedied. The first time around the place had been uncomfortably warm. Well, now they've cranked up the AC and it's perfectly cool and comfortable. I appreciate that they listen to and act on customer feedback! Now, I'll def. be returning often for the juicy, halal burgers.

Rolled ice cream is a popular "fad" right now. I know a lot of people like it, but I just think it's average. I would take Ice's Plain and Fancy or Ted Drewes over it every time. I've been twice now and both times have left disappointed and a little angry that I spent $7+ per cup for mediocre ice cream. To me it just doesn't have much flavor and is not very creamy. If you go, be sure to get toppings otherwise it will be pretty bland.

So glad to see this little neighborhood gem  re-opened. The coffee is delicious! It's perfectly brewed at just the right strength with a perfect finish. The woman behind the counter couldn't have been nicer. Good luck new owners!
Okay museum, not the best value out there considering some of the features are a bit run down and out-dated. But will keep a toddler busy on a rainy day.

I had my reservations about this place when I walked in, solely based on the fact that this building has been host to about 5 different places in the last 7 or so years. But I was pleasantly surprised! Not only was there a large selection of dishes and rolls, the food (read: fish) tasted very fresh. The service was good as well. I would definitely go here again!

One of my favorite PoBoy shops. It is a tourist attraction but the food is actually really delicious. I was craving a shrimp poboy and knew they would hit the spot! 
I ordered online and rolled in to the parking lot Sal, whose stationed at the entrance checked us in  and got our food to us quickly. I love this system. 
My food was mmm mmm good ! I ate it right up so
INCREDIBLE. I can't even express how good this pizza is, you have to try it. The waitresses are amazing

If you like wings, make sure you try OB Clark's wings.

I got introduced to them years ago from my stepmom who would always bring them home after her shifts at the hospital.  I've now extended the experience to my husband and he's on the bandwagon.

We stopped by for the Rams game - the bar side was packed, the other side not so we found a table right in front of the TV.  Unfortunately our waitress wasn't very friendly and she seemed in a bad mood - not sure what we did as she was very talkative with the older men at the table next to us but we were friendly with her with nothing back.  Very disappointing!

We ordered an appetizer of cheese garlic bread (to die for), wings and grilled cheeses with fries and chili.  Perfect foods for game day and a cold day in the 'lou

My girlfriend Suzanne and I make Ryan's are "must stop" when we are in NOLA. We have been going there for years, and its a great sports bar, with friendly locals. Jessica, Mike, and Christina are great bartenders, and they always remember us even if it has been months since our last visit, and thats saying a lot for a tourist town like NOLA. I recommend this place for any sports "nut" who visits New Orleans. No food, but a spot across the street, and usually a Lucky Dog cart outside of the door. (If you haven't had a Lucky Dog, you haven't lived!!) A great place to hang out, watch sports, and have a few good drinks.

Best Cajun food I have found in Nashville so far. The atmosphere was great. Lots of people in that night cheering on LSU. 

The food was fantastic. We had gator, crab claws, the shrimp diablo pasta, & the bourbon street pasta. It was all really good & made me feel like I was back in New Orleans.
In town for a comfy and found this place online. Great food nice and friendly owner and staff.  Would recommend this place
Nice and clean - good value place to stay. There's a bunch of ducks hanging out outside though and they can be a little aggressive - almost daring you to run them over as you drive onto the property.

Went here straight after a conference with only 30 mins before closing. Since they only sell beignets about every other day of the week, I thought they would be superb. When I got them they were super hot and covered in yummy powdered sugar, for that alone they get a 4.5, but in the taste department they weren't that good, and for that they get a 3 out of 5.

I think they're very underrated. The place is always clean, and the option to have your steak chopped or in slices is great. It's always made fresh and hot, and I can't really complain. Basically the same thing as Steve's Steaks, but I  had a lot more meat on my steak without the price or the wait.
Clean, quick service, fresh food, plenty of healthy options, great prices.  I've been here at least twenty times and have had a great meal every time.  It's a winner.

Read a lot of great things about this place and it didn't disappoint. If you make something called Chronic bacon...I'm going to order it. Luckily this stuff delivered on the hype. Sweet, spicy, smoky, savory and perfectly cooked. It was the truth! I also loved the "Bonuts" -fried biscuit dough served with lemon mascarpone and blueberry compote. A definitive culinary highlight of Nashville.
Food aaa tasty. Staff was friendly. Loved the environment. Not sure if it was worth the price though.
This place is awesome! The food is so fresh and good, all the workers are very friendly  and it is definitely my new favorite place,  and the prices are affordable...

I stopped coming to this place once this new girl Jennie started
She has an attitude and talks Vietnamese about you while you are there. 
She makes you feel uncomfortable while this is a place that is supposed to be relaxing 
Nail places are a diamond a dozen 
Save your time and go to somewhere that you will not have this experience

Authentic Puerto Rican and Latin cuisine in Nashville, whoo hoo!!

The mofongo was AMAZING...I have not had any this good since I was last in PR...wow. Blown away by the flavor and moisture, spiced to taste just right! We also had delicious tostones and loved every bite of crispy goodness.

We went on a quieter night, sadly for us, but they are known to have fabulous live bands play music you can dance to, and then it turns into a DJ-driven dance party as dinner service winds down.

Lots of fun, casual atmosphere, just right for a great meal and a good time!

Found this place online their website was really nice and informative. I scheduled my appointment online which took less then 5 minutes which was nice. The day of the appointment my boyfriend and I were greeted by the very friendly and nice staff. This place is really nice and inviting. Our tech was equally nice and made us feel comfortable. It was nice seeing our baby on a 70inch T.V. There's big couches available in the room for family and friends to enjoy that special time with you. I really recommend this place and I can't wait to schedule our next appointment.
Don't go when they are busy. You don't get as good of detail when going on a slower weekday. Most of time they meet expectations.

Highly suggest this group! I had a lot of trouble with a case involving a DUI. Nima really took care of me and made me feel so at ease with everything that got thrown my way. The team he works with also made sure to keep me updated so I did not have to worry about what was going on. 
I had forgotten about my court date and was in another state traveling for work. I did not have my documentation ready that the court needed. Nima showed up on my behalf and worked to make sure I had the documents I needed to be ok with the courts.
They truly do care about you and making sure they make the best of your situation. 
I can't even count how many times I thanked them for saving me.
Use this group and you will be in good hands!

I've been hearing about this place called talk of town. We you get  good service and  great food so I decided to order from them while I was visiting a family member not only was the food great my order was correct. . They also have great customer skills which is a plus for me. So I didn't mind the food was on the pricey side and besides that you're paying for quality and service ..
And we also had a great experience with the lady that delivered the order I believe her name was Debbie she was very  polite and had a sense of humor..I  would  definitely  order  from  this  place again . Thanks for the great experience and great food.

The Indy Zoo is always a great choice, whether it's a trip with the family, a day out by yourself to practice photography or any number or their fun events like ZooLaLa or Zoobiliation! 

I feel a sense of home at the zoo from all the times I've been as a kid to working there in catering to having a membership there with my family. Our favorite times to go are opening on Sunday mornings when it's cooler and less crowded. We also love going during their off seasons because we have a chance to interact more with the animals when there's less of a crowd. 

My favorite animals to visit are the bears because they look so fluffy and huggable! I could watch them all day. My daughter loves the dolphin show and I appreciate the conservation information they teach during the performance. The playground is always a big hit with our family and you're welcome to pack a lunch or eat at one of the many locations inside the zoo. 

While you're there, don't forget to check out the White River Conservatory and Gardens. They're STUNNING and such a peaceful spot.

This place is so good!  The owners are so nice and they have all different types of crepes and if you dont see something or have an idea of what you want, they will help you custom order one! I love the food!

Absolute boozapolooza! Think average sized supermarket, but with aisle after aisle of liquors and beer. Whatever your poison, Randall's has it. I don't know what else I can tell you about a giant liquor store, except WOW! Lots of liquor. Great prices.

I did the demonstration course here and it was amazing! They taught us about some fun facts about NOLA and about cooking good Cajun food. I did the jambalaya,  Bread Pudding, and gumbo class and it was all delicious.  I loved that they gave us some free samples of the pralines too...which were amazing!! thank you!

I would never recommend this company.  I had a complete a/c system installed about a year and a half ago. After the installation,  I had to call them back out over 10 times. AC was not cooling.  Still to this day, I am having issues with the system.  It is off of warranty now and I have to pay if someone comes out. My advice to anyone,  stay away from this company.
The hotel is in downtown, so the view is not that great. I love the service. Every associate is nice in there. It is also close to the food and other places.

This location couldn't be more of a shithole. Prepare yourself for people watching at its finest and enough garbage in the parking lot and store to make you want to burn your shoes. Walking in on an average stop to get gas and snacks you'll get to hang out with an armed security guard and be begged multiple times for beer money. I would highly discourage women to shop here alone after dark. QuikTrip has always been my go to when it comes to gas stations but I can assure you I've never encountered one even close to this mess. Horrible image for the brand.

Overall this place was great, but definitely has room for some easy improvements.  Rode our bikes up from downtown and was well worth the 4.5 mi ride in the cold.  I got a DELICIOUS breakfast panini; this thing isn't the flat-pressed kind you'd envision.  It was served on 2 large, thick pieces of ciabatta bread, with eggs, bacon, cheese, and honey mustard.  My hubs got the sausage sausage gravy, which had excellent flavor but was served lukewarm.  The 2nd negative was that the restaurant was clearly understaffed; it was Saturday around 1:30pm and there were many open tables.  Despite that, we had to wait about 15 min and there were several other groups waiting as well.  Finally, the service left something to be desired.  Neither the hostess nor our waitress was very friendly or helpful.  It took away from the overall experience.  My advice to mgmt - hire people who want to be there!

Will definitely come back - the food was the best part, and there were many things I want to come back and try! - but think there are some easy fixes that could be made to improve upon the overall experience.

Delicious, HUGE portions. 
Greek salad With added Chicken was so filling. Very friendly, diner-style.

have gone several times and have had a great meal each visit. service has always been really friendly and fabulous! went to a drag show on a sat. night and had to wait for about an hour to be seated....but that's because it's such a fabulous show! worth the wait, so get there early. burgers are huge, so the portions are worth the price. you can choose any style of burger (diff grades of beef, chicken, bean, tuna, etc) which is nice for vegetarians. awesome bartender too! great music is always playing all day, every day!
Hi Errol! I did not try your bread pudding - I typically eat everything until I explode. Nice touch with the personal contact!

Really cool place.
Had a lot of fun there. Good atmosphere and friendly staff. Only thing is make sure you watch your time so that you won't be charged. 
Oh and everything is more fun when you're drunk!
Yeah so I recommend stopping and getting the Carne Asada taco's. Nice little place with great food...

I like their beer, like it don't love it. 
As for their food I never find anything that really catches my attention, I always pick what I think is the best option.
Over all it is an ok place I don't love it I don't hate it either.

It's been a minute since I've been here...which reminds me that I need to get my shit in order and make the trip way out to the sticks of Antioch, and I do mean WAY OUT.

You won't find a better place to eat in Nashville for so cheap.  La Usuluteca specializes in pupusas.  For the not so inclined, pupusas are a Salvadorian dish made with thick corn tortillas filled with a number of different fillings ala soft cheese, pork rinds, beans & such.  It's served with a side of curtido (lightly pickled cabbage with tomatoes and chilies).  


This place does it BIG...you should really check it out.  The service is quick and cheerful...and at these prices, they are practically giving the food away.
I've gone many times and I'm never disappointed. The service is great and food taste fresh.

Would NOT recommend this hotel at all. Which i have stayed here in the past, love the area and hotel. We have reservations for May 1-5 2014 got hit on or motorcycle husband can't walk.  Want to take trip later in year. Left 5 voice mails 1 week before stay asking for manager (Valarie) to contact us about credit for staying at later date (NOT refund) WILL NOT RETURN OUR CALL! BAD CUSTOMER SERVICE!
The food was okay. The drinks were fabulous. The server came to the table 2 times the whole times. Won't be back tho.

Basically a nightclub that serves excellent food by day, don't let the DJ booth dissuade you! Full bar and many juices like maracuya but draft selections at Viva el Caribe are limited, I got a draft Negra Modelo (just $3). 

An arepa app was freshly griddled and served with Dominican sausage links, outstanding and just $5. The mofongo (plantains and meat) was yummy and *enormous*, could have fed 2, garnished with a crisp plantain chip, you'll need a nap if you eat it all. I opted for a fine Cubano sandwich ($7 for the pequeño version), piled amazingly high with tender roast pork, untraditionally garnished with tomato & lettuce, so much food omg, delicious. 

Vegetarian rating: 3 stars for the soy veggie burger, plain mofongo, arepa relleno with cheese, chips & guac, etc.

Peanut butter milk stout  :) yum!!

The variety of beers is fantastic and a great price on their tasting flight. First place I've tried a bitter/sour beer and was surprised, it was so good!  Food options are few, but good enough to put some food on your stomach while you sample. Beer is definitely the star here so don't go expecting super fancy eats. It's just down the hill from me, so I plan on going more often. 

Side note, DO check their calendar as it can be super busy on random days/times if they're doing a game night or live music or a sporting event is on. Plan accordingly. Also check for Groupons to save some cash. 

Love this place!

AVOID THIS COMPANY!!!!! If I could give this company zero stars I would. We booked a tour in advance, but on the day of the tour there was extreme weather (lightning/flash flood warning). I tried to get in touch with the company, but they did not answer the phone. I contacted Chase Travel for assistance, who also could not reach the company. Eventually, the company reached out via email soliciting a good review. I responded that we did not attend due to the severe weather and requested a refund. Their response was they did not give refunds for completed tours. This company prioritize their profit over customer safety by holding the tour during an extreme weather event. Additionally, they are IMPOSSIBLE to get a hold of in the event something goes wrong. AVOID THIS COMPANY!!!

UPDATE: after much back and forth, the company agreed to refund us, but I get the feeling this was an exception and not their practice.
First time trying "waterice," didn't know what I was missing.  I tried the gelatini and it was heavenly..creamy custard with the waterice, soo soo good.

I was in philly for only a day and came across this beautiful coffee shop here. It is by far my favorite coffee shop that I have ever visited. The woman who took my order recommended the philly English muffins and boy was I happy to try that. It was so delicious. Their coffee is amazing. The ambiance is perfect.

Went in on a slow part of the day. Asked for a booth. There were plenty but we were told we'd have to wait, so we did but we could see the staff rolling their eyes about us to each other when they thought we couldn't see. They miraculously found a booth right away. The bench had crumbs all over it so my husband asked if it could be wiped down. The server got all huffy about it so while she walked away muttering, we decided to go. Customers are obviously an inconvenience to the staff and the place was not an inviting place to eat. Worst IHOP I've ever been to.

Desmond was the most amazing server. Every time he approached our table it was with superb customer service and warm smile. I ordered the stuffed shrimp which was delicious. The Mac and cheese was different than what I'm used to but still good. The stuffing was good too. Also, it's black owned  a local recommended this and I will forever be grateful for this amazing food lol

Tried to give them a second chance after terrible customer service first time around where the person forgot our order and then got angry that I had to remind them after waiting for 20 mins. Tried ordering takeout second time around but only got as far as talking to the rude manager for about 30 seconds before he started telling me as the "manager of the store that they don't have steak fajitas on their menu" no wonder you have such terrible customer service reviews. Will never bother to try again. Also, maybe you should update your menu because it clearly says steak fajitas.

I'm new to the area and it turns out getting an oil change for my Ford in this town can be a challenge.  One thing this Jiffy Lube has going for it over the competition is that they actually got me in right away (Big O said 2 hour wait , Ford dealer said make an appointment for 8 days from now for a freaking oil change). These guys are friendly and quick but I can tell they didn't do everything on their oil change checklist since there's no washer fluid in my car's reservoir.  Makes me wonder what else they didn't do but charged me for.  Also are all oil changes out here so expensive? Over $100.00 out the door for full synthetic- double what you'd pay in Michigan.  Side note- great place for a smog check if you have the coupon.

It's so nice to receive such great customer service. Ginger Beard is a unique coffee shop that is located inside of a beer pub called The Pour House. Ginger Beard is open in the morning hours. I go there from time to time with my daughter because we like to go to coffee shops to write. Can I just add that my daughter works at a local Ybor City coffee shop and she loves coming to Ginger Beard. That's high praise from a fellow barista. 

I was shocked the second time we went in and Josh recognized us, got a big smile on his face, and even remembered our order from before and asked us if we wanted the "usual". It just makes you feel good to be remembered and there are not many places at all anymore that treat their customers so well. 

Besides the great customer service, the kombucha is really tasty and so is the chai latte. These are the only things I've tried so far. 

The music is tasteful and not too loud, perfect ambience for getting some writing done.

We are looking forward to returning.

Very solid Korean dishes with exceptional service and very comfortable seating.  We came for a late dinner and were very happy with our food and even more impressed by the service.

Some food highlights:
1. Japchae - Fantastic with flavorful seasoning and plenty of shredded peppers, onions, beef, and mushrooms, topped with a sprinkle of sesame seeds.  
2.  Stir-fried udon with chicken - I personally loved this dish and found the noodles to be very flavorful and perfectly balanced with a nice array of vegetables and chicken slices.  They amount of chicken was very generous and the noodles were soft and had a great chewy texture.  Definitely recommend.
3. Cod roe and tofu stew - Another great version of  classic soondobu dish.  Plenty of cod roe in a flavorful, spicy stew with soft tofu.  The roe was very fresh and I was pleasantly surprised by the generous portion.  It's topped off with a clam, as well.
4. Tofu dolsot bibimbap - Solid but make sure you ask for an egg.  I accidentally ordered the vegan (?) option without the egg (oops) which was still good with a very generous portion of tofu but I did wish that I had ordered the regular version.  Still, the charred rice was great!
5. Korean pancake - This was complimentary but we will definitely get 2 next time.  Perfectly chewy on the inside with a slightly crispy exterior and plenty of aromatic veggie fillings.  Love!

The banchan was solid and I definitely recommend asking for an extra dish of the stir-fried fish cake and surimi.  They also give you a complimentary dessert of sweet rice water and cut fruit.  Service is extraordinary and our waiters were very helpful and extremely attentive.  Portions are also very generous.  I am often called a bottomless pit and between the two of us, we had at leftovers to last another meal.  Will be back for sure!

90 reviews, well then I'll be 91. 

In town for a business "retreat" I wanted local flavor, that is barbeque.  Residing in eastern North Carolina where the standard is vinegar based barbeque (which I don't like) I craved sweet, tangy molasses based barbeque.  Jacks was so highly touted, I had to see what all the touting was about.

I had the half chicken (smoked) plate with cinnamoned apples and macaroni and cheese.  I was disappointed that the chicken was not cooked in the barbeque sauce, hence the smoked, but dipping it in the barbeque sauce sufficed and it was good nonetheless.  

My dining companion had the 3 meat meal for $13 - he didn't recommend the turkey, "it seems processed" and "the brisket is just ok, good, but really just ok."  We both agreed that the cornbread was sweet and good but rather dry.

I liked escaping the front restaurant scene on the back patio, the perfect retreat from the "retreat."  Would I return again? Yes.  Would I rave about the food to anyone willing to listen? Probably not.

Although they have the best salsa here the service is horrible! I've given this place too many tries to redeem themselves and I will not be back. We had to go up and ask for chips and ask where our food was after a good half an hour even though the restaurant was was pretty much empty. Our waiter even brought our check out 5 minutes after we started eating which was a big turn off! However the other Los Arroys in Santa Barbara is a lot better :)

We were in a rush to eat and get to a concert. The manager Jeremy. Came over to help bus a high top for us our waitress was at the table shortly. The food came out quickly and hot. The service was top notch. And we made it to Amalie arena in plenty of time. My new go to spot for a quick drink and app before an event. Thank you.

Unprofessional... worst service i came by. I called this IHOP to set up my order , not only did this person answer the company phone as if it was his personal phone he was really unprofessional. I had to reassure myself that i called IHOP when i ask this employee "is this IHOP"? He reply yeah . I said i will like to place an order, he reply saying only taking order online ... i ask can i call back and edited my order ? He reply saying no what's on online is what you get . Since they so call couldn't take phone order i call Aramingo IHOP and they happily help me over the phone with my order . All that had to be edited was my side order . I'll never order or attend this place i can just imagine the customer service in person.
Outstanding quick service. Quality repair.  Very fair price for screen, battery and screen protector.  Work done while I waited.  I will be back...when my daughter breaks her phone again.

I would give this less stars if possible.  This is the worst service I have had in my entire life.  When I asked to speak to the manager about our extremely poor service he didnt once apologize but instead made excuses.  I have worked in restaurants before so I understand being busy and tht it was dollar beer night but this service was so beyond unacceptable

Edit: I bumped up my review to four starts because after I was unhappy they took off my tax (4.95). But then I put it back down to two when I found out that the kids meal was actually nine dollars because they gave us a three dollar up charge for changing the fries to fruit. They also did this to my mother-in-law. So we paid nine dollars for that kids meal....

Mixed feelings. The Wienerschnitzel is good but I wouldn't order anything else because the portions are just ridiculously small (besides the Wienerschnitzel) it was $6 for my daughters kids-meal. We ordered her a grilled cheese. They literally served her half of a grilled cheese that was cooked on really small bread so really it was more like half of a half of a grilled cheese.... not really willing to help you if you're unhappy. I really enjoy the atmosphere and getting coffee here so I'm very conflicted. Good pastries. The kids meal was not enough for my two-year-old, I couldn't imagine bringing my five-year-old here and ordering that.

Just moved to Lansdale and this is the best Chinese restaurant around here. My wife and I always get take out and she usually orders General Tso and I get the Sweet and Sour Chicken with pork fried rice. Overall service is great, place is clean and a lot of parking.

We had a huge wedding planned for 250 people at our home. I had thought I could get the house ready in time. One week before the wedding, I realized that it would be impossible. I called frantically to several housecleaning services, to no avail. Molly Maids answered right away and gave us an appointment. Since it was so last-minute, I assumed that it would be a quick touch-up job. 
It was the best professional housecleaning we have had for many, many years! I cannot say enough about how thorough they were. They brought a team ready to work! 
I am very pleased to highly recommend Molly Maids for your housecleaning. You will not be sorry. They were amazing! 
And, the house looked perfect for the wedding!

I know I will be in the dog house for this, sooo many will disagree.  I don't think their Sonoran Dog is as great as most claim, at least as is.  The bun it comes in is fantastic, so soft and light, kind of buttery it just melts in your mouth.  The dog wrapped in bacon, yes it's tasty.  I don't think the beans and all the toppings really do it justice.  Honestly I am a big Chicago Dog fan... so kind of hard to top that.  BUT WAIT keep reading, I'm getting there.  

What makes the Sonoran dog better is by topping it with your favorite salsa, I prefer the red (not the green or the pico).. but that's totally up to you.  So next time you're there, try it with some salsa.. WAAY BETTER!  I won't do you wrong, I promise.  So, because I can doctor up my dog.. I give it 4 stars and because of the other things I like there too.  

I do also like their Caramelos.. if you're in the mood for cheesy goodness.  You can't go wrong with the Asada tacos with corn tortilla either.

Very unprofessional. We got a minivan a week before hand and when we went to get out mini van they tried to sell us on an explorer for several more dollars a day. After saying no several times they finally told us they didn't have anymore mini vans. So not only did they essentially lie they tried to get us to pay for it. The girl who was helping us proceeded to play candy crush while helping us and was very unpleasant to work with. Wish I got her name because I would love to make sure she got credit for the way she acted. Not the way customers should be treated

I don't know why I thought it was bigger inside.. it's not as big as the one in St. Pete but it has everything you need. Veggies are cheap and meat and seafood are super easy to come by! People are always friendly even if there is a language barrier. I want to get there earlier to get some hot and ready food because I heard that's where its at! Any asian spice you were looking for.. you can find here!
What an amazing place. You feel like your in New York or California spa. Such class and elegance. 1st class service.
I love this place. Great atmosphere and very interesting selection of sushi and rolls.

What a nightmare of a store. Shelves unstocked and only one overworked cashier to serve a line of customers that was at least 10 people deep. The lack of customer service or just plain caring was palatable. Adding to this the zombie-like nature of most of the customers and you got a recipe for a nightmare. Stay away!

I came here straight from court after getting married and had my new husband's family in tow. I selected this place after a quick glance at Yelp solely based on Yelp ratings and number of reviews without actually reading the reviews. I regretted it once seated but my group didn't want to go through the trouble of finding another place, but by the middle of our experience wished we had left sooner. We were provided with the limited lunch menu and everyone at our table was displeased with what was on the menu, that's what caused me to want to leave. No one was slightly interested on anything on that menu. All the good reviews for food seem to be based on breakfast. And although we saw the server with pancakes and other breakfast food, they insisted it was over though it didn't seem so. Why were we not provided a regular menu, at all? We had to borrow the menu of the other group in order to place our order.

The service was incredibly off. Our group was told we could be seated in two booths. However, the entire time treated us as two separate parties though it was their suggestion to seat us that way and although we talked to each other, took photos together, etc. 

There were about 3 other groups who received their food, including the table apart of our group. We only ordered simple items such as burgers and pizza. 

At some point they were informed we just got married, and the response was yeah, a lot of people do that this time of year. By the time our table finally received the food the other table had finished eating and was getting their bill. If it was just me, I would have left. It finally got to the point the other people at the table was on board, then they brought out the food. I wish they would have just let us leave...

Something as simple as a burger? Burnt on the outside, slightly pink on the inside. I would rather eat a bowl of cereal. Don't believe me? Check out my pictures. 

Coming here was just a huge mistake and a regret of mine, especially since it's the first place we went after getting married. The massive delay in service contributed to us being late for the wedding reception. I didn't even have time for makeup on my special day and it increased the amount of stress as well. I truly hate that they received any business from our large party and just hope that this review will discourage you from doing the same.

Great place. Try THE SINK pizza. You won't be disappointed.

#G2TriviaNight is on Thursdays starting promptly at 8pm! LOVE IT.

Great burger, wings and super kid friendly atmosphere! The staff was attentive, milkshakes for the kids were yummy and the Legendary burger and brownie sundae was was top notch!  Highly recommend for a quick night out on the city, with fun and good ole American food!!

An odd place and finding something good to eat here is like finding a needle in a haystack. If you'd like to have a very expensive disappointment this is the place to go--better yet take my advise and DON'T GO!
Worst breakfast I have had in a while. I won't be back. When they serve you food you know they wouldn't eat themselves it's bad. I won't waste my time here again.

Joe's son Matt came out to service my house. He laid down an outside perimeter spray and put spray and gel inside explaining everything as he went around. He's very knowledgeable and friendly. The treatment is working well and they will be coming back quarterly to maintain my bug-free house.

Wonderful dinner!  Food was excellent and our waiter, Ricardo C, was the best.  He was courteous, very friendly, knowledgeable and handled our table and several others without missing a beat!  I will definitely be back and will ask for Ricardo C!

My husband and I went here for our anniversary dinner.  It is a very romantic place to spend an evening with a loved one.  It is small and the tables are tightly packed in the place but that kind of adds to the feeling of coziness.  I had the Chicken Parm and it was very good and a large portion.  It was a very enjoyable meal and I would definitely go back again.

Milky Way Farm has the best ice cream around! My family and I have been coming here ever since I was 5 years old and it continues to be amazing. Today, we went for their fall festivities! They have a pumpkin patch, corn maze, farm animals to look at, and of course... ice cream! Usually, you can come and go as you please, but because of COVID, they require you to purchase a timed ticket. They are only open on weekends in the fall.

They give you a wrist band when you check in that gives you access to the farm! We picked pumpkins and had lots of fun in the corn maze! It is the perfect place for fall photo ops! Masks are required and everyone adhered to this rule. We felt very safe!

Now onto my favorite part, the ice cream! My go-to is usually peanut butter fudge, but in the fall, I love their harvest cheesecake ice cream! I got that today and it was as amazing as ever! Their ice cream is made fresh from the milk from the cows on the farm. It always taste amazing and each flavor is packed full of flavor! I definitely recommend the harvest cheesecake if you like pumpkin cheesecake!

Overall, this is a great place for little ones and adults alike! Come here for great ice cream and fall fun!

I arrive at 7:50 PM.  Order chili, fries, nuggets.  I see them take nuggets from a bin, who knows how long they were sitting.  The chili bin was empty so who knows where they got mine. At least I think I heard my fries being cooked so they were hot.  I asked for chili seasoning.  The worker gave me some after saying "I already put some in there.", but I did not ask her that.  I check my bag.  No ketchup.  I asked her for some.  Then I notice no nugget sauce.  I was not even asked if I wanted any.  Manager guy comes and gives me two.  Here is where the fun begins.....

I go to leave and find both doors I came I are now locked. I ask out loud can I be let out please?  The worker said the doors were locked on that side. I need to use the ones on the other side of the building.  I said but I came in those doors - let me out so I don't have to walk around the building.  She calls manager guy who tells me the doors are locked from the outside. So?  Open them and let me out. He protests.  I said I'm not going to be inconvenienced.  I'm the customer. Let me out. He finally sighs loudly and says fine, he'll let me out.  At this point I say forget it.  Give me a refund. He says but you have your food. I say yes, but I'll go someplace else where I'm treated as I matter.  He gives me the refund after protesting a few times and still does not unlock the door. I let him know I'm sure his corporate offices will enjoy hearing how they lost a sale due to simply not opening a door- the ones I used to enter.   I then went down the street to a competitor. 

I did let corporate know and will never visit this location again.  Based on other reviews here, does not look as if I'll be alone.

What a gem! The decor and overall vibe of the restaurant was amazing- really vibrant and young! 

The best seats in the house are definitely those overlooking the kitchen. You get the chance to get a good look at the dishes and also get a bit of entertainment on the side (there are very few of these, so arrive early). 

If you are a student on a budget, do not fret! They offer a happy hour Mon-Fri 4:30-7pm that is extremely reasonable ($2 and $4 dishes!!!!) and provides you with the ability to sample some of their most popular appetizers (be advised that the happy hour menu isn't as extensive as their normal menu).  

You cannot leave without trying the crispy rock shrimp- succulent, well-seasoned, and fried to perfection! I also tried their korean BBQ beef satay (okay, but nothing to write home about); their pork bao buns (very delicious and highly recommended); and their cream filled donuts (so divine- not too sweet and made fresh to order!). 

The "Philly Cheese Steaks" looked amazing and were flying out of the kitchen. I'd recommend ordering those!

If you are in the mood for a sexy, refreshing cocktail, you MUST try the drink infused with pineapple, vanilla, and basil - absolutely divine!

The only criticism I have is regarding the slow and disorganized service. My table had to wait for quite a while before everyone received all of their appetizers and we were handed the wrong dishes from other tables 3 times. The servers were very apologetic and patient, but service could definitely be improved. 

I plan to come back many times in the future. Sampan is absolutely a top 10 Philly restaurant for me!

Disgustingly overpriced for what it is. I'm solely basing this rating on the food. I payed 17$ (+3$ for extra meat) for a burrito that in my opinion lacked taste and contained a surprisingly low amount of meat even tough I payed 3$ for extra meat. The meat itself is shredded and too salty. After finishing this burrito I felt pretty much disgusted with myself which led me to writing this review.

So disappointed.

I have a mixed review here. The first time I used them to get me to the airport for a 6 am flight, the driver was punctual, but his cab reeked of cigarettes. He was nice though, so that is the reason for the 1 stars. The 2nd time I used Yellow cab to take some out-of-town friends to experience Broadway.  The driver took forever to show up, then proceeded to insult me and my guest. I couldn't really believe what I was hearing, I'm pretty sure he called me a dog beneath his breath. He also made some sort of racial slur towards my friend. After my 2nd experience and from what I've read online about Nashville Yellow Cab, I would recommend avoiding this company like the plague. Not a fan at all.

Location is confusing considering it's definitely located in Sunset Hills, MO and not Kansas City, MO. Aside from that small setback, this is a standard Burger King from my experience.

Went on a Sunday evening. I had received some coupons in the mail and redeemed one with no problems. The restaurant isn't the cleanest or most vibrant environment, but there certainly wasn't trash all over the place.

Went there for a graduation dinner. Pam, our waitress, was lovely.  Brandon was helpful pulling off a dessert surprise. The meal was great: chicken parm, pizza, lasagna, penne with vodka sauce and meatballs.  Good salad too.  The tiramisu was still frozen ~ hopefully they will let it thaw a bit next time.  We'll definitely be back!

The food here is always fabulous, it's fresh and you can customize things as you want them.
It is made quickly by employees who are always super nice!

Let me put out there that I am not generally a fan of buffet so read this with that in mind - I did not like it all -- the food was cold and tasteless but i do love grand Sierra and all the other restaurants are great.  A positive about this place is only that one of the waitresses was having a great day singing along to the music :)

Since my last post about Maypop, I went twice more. Once for a quick bite and tried the Sweet Corn Tom Yum and their Bread Service. Starting this post off positively, the Tom Yum soup with egg noodles was a perfect blend of ingredients to make my mouth sing with pleasure. Not too filling, just perfect size for someone who isn't too hungry. 

This would be my second time around trying the bread service. The first time didn't impress me. But, perhaps it was a fluke, considering everything else was delicious. So, I tried again. Their bread was slightly different this time around because they added annatto seeds to the top. I am still not impressed. Come 'on Maypop! Get it together! You are an award winning restaurant. I cannot believe you can't get something as simple as bread to taste as heavenly as the rest of your food. 

The bread during this service was coated in so much oil and/or butter that it was oozing out when I pulled a piece off. This oleaginous mess coated my fingers, which then in turn collected a layer of annatto seeds that were shingled on top of the bread. Every bite resulted in the same messy fingers. I had to brush the seeds off my fingers after every bite, then wipe them on the napkin. I imagine there is a layer of annatto seeds littering the floors after nightly dinner service.

The next time I went to Maypop was for brunch with family and friends. Since there were four of us, we ordered several different menu items and ate tapas style. 

I didn't imbibe on your typical brunch drink of choice. Instead, I tried the Café Hoodoo Sua Da which is expresso, hoodoo chickory liquor, and mole bitters. It is a frozen delicacy that is now probably my new favorite drink. Be forewarned, drinks that taste like dessert can be dangerous because the alcohol sneaks up on you!

For starters, we tried the pork and cane syrup sausage stuffed sesame balls, crispy calamari with tamarind fish sauce and Thai chili, "the Baodin" which is a pan fried, cheesy boudin bao bun with citrus mustard. These were the perfect blend of Asian meets New Orleans. We enjoyed the sesame balls so much we ordered it twice. 
Next we ordered the crispy fried oysters with bourbon barrel soy aioli, manchego cheese and spicy cucumber. I wasn't sure what to expect from fried oysters, but the coating was delicate and it wasn't greasy at all. The braised lamb made with harissa spice, coconut milk, fried egg, ginger marinated green tomatoes. It is presented in a serving dish with roti bread in accompaniment.  For me, lamb could go either way, super delicious or too gamey tasting. This lamb dish was superb. The roti bread, however, was not. The first time I ever came to Maypop, I had a different dish with roti bread and it was very good. This time, however, I was sorely disappointed. It had been sitting out under the heat lamp for too long and was hard. Roti is a type of bread that is meant to be used to pick up food and eat it. Can't do that if the bread is too hard to even be folded in half. Maypop, you are not impressing me with your bread skills. 

We also ate some of the Head Cheese and Blue Crab soup dumplings. It is little dumplings with soup inside. Impressive, flavorful and honestly, I am running out of adjectives. That's how delicious is the food. Now if they could just get on board with the bread, you'd have one happy camper here.

One of the worst customer service experiences I have dealt with.
told by the woman on the phone to bring the car over ANY time after 7 am, and showed up at 9. 

The "gentleman" at the counter was the rudest and most sarcastic employee we have dealt with. An "I'm sorry they told you that, but it was an appt at 7, and I'm not sure we will be able to get you in" goes a lot further than the attitude and anger he expressed.

Interestingly I called BMW and the were extremely friendly and actually took the car immediately! (With no appointment!). Haha.

No longer going to be heading here for anything, and I will make sure friends and family do the same.

Amazing food and A++ service. One of my favorite restaurants not just in SB, but most anywhere. Drinks, tapas, and desserts - they have excellent choices. Mind you, the prices are high and the portions are small, but the food is really perfectly prepared. The decor is exquisite and the ambience is just right for a nice night out with good friends or loved ones. 
Very highly recommended. All of tapas are great and definitely get the paella (3 kinds) and try the Spanish coffee and any of the deserts.

This is a great find. Pedro was our server and he was outstanding. He recommended the Prime Rib and was spot on. My associate had the half rack of ribs. The carving area is visible and the smells are divine. Reasonable priced and a great meal. Highly recommend!

Really really good tacos! The corn tortillas are so good and they don't fall apart like a lot of them do at other restaurants. I wish they had more vegetarian options but the carnitas tacos are some of the best I've had. I highly recommend (:

I wish I could put zero stars for this company.  They have every rule in the book where they will get their money.  My husband and I wanted to downgrade our plan and they said it would be $99 just to downgrade.  Of course they charge you another month's billing cycle when you cancel because you need to pay when you aren't using their services.  Even when we froze our account because my husband was hurt and wasn't able to use his membership, you are still charged half when the account is frozen.  I have nothing good to say about this company.  Nothing.  Oh yeah, when I called the general manager of our local gym, after he sent an email saying contact him for anything...he never called me back.  Joke!!!!!!  Don't sign up unless you want to get ripped off.
I love this place. Giant drinks in mason jars, nice local people, and friendly bar tenders. A great place to cool off down in the Mariginy.

I like the bagels and their cream cheeses, so I'll give this a solid 4 stars. My main complaint is the ordering system here. You have to wait in one line to order and get a receipt, then go to an even longer line to pay. GAH

Also- is anyone else bothered by the ROW OF MICROWAVES they cook everything with? Eeww. They need to limit the menu a little bit. Also I have yet to get any type of bakery good that actually tastes good other than the bagels. Skip the cookies and cupcakes. Not worth it.

This was the first time I've been to this location and it was so nice! I would recommend the crispy chicken Thai chilli appy and the Big Mac inspired pizza!! If you can't decide between a burger or a pizza then this is the perfect combination. This location has a great atmosphere for after work drinks or meeting up with friends before an oilers game. There is underground parking nearby so you don't even have to walk outside to get there if it's cold. The staff was very friendly and always kept our drinks full. I would definitely be happy to come back here!
This place was good but it wasn't anything special there are MUCH better pizza and pasta places in Nashville. It was overpriced and underwhelming.

This place has the best bun bo hue I've ever tasted other than my mom(and that's hard to top). I've been to its competitor numerous times before as it was my go-to for bbh(Diem). But once I leave Diem I always noticed that I would get the MSG effect in which the back of my neck would have a heavy feeling as if someone was constantly applying pressure to it.  Despite the effect I would still return considering that WAS the only place I knew of that offered delicious bun bo hue. Until I found this place. And boy oh boy am I glad that I did!  Her bbh is so amazing. The broth is flavorful and you can tell its of substance and not just full of MSG. She gives a very generous amount of beef with each bowl. I always leave super happy and without the MSG affect. 

This review is solely on the bun bo hue. I come to enjoy this so much that I haven't had the heart to venture out and try other items on the menu. But if you're a BBH lover like myself---you won't be disappointed. =D

Despite the fact that I am not vegan, I have heard wonderful things about Vedge and it has been on my list of restaurants to try for years. When one of my best friends, who does happen to be vegan, wanted to get together, we decided that was the perfect opportunity for me to finally try Vedge! So off we went.

Let me start off by saying I LOVE the interior of this spot- the bar is adorable, the decor is minimal while still being sophisticated and the whole restaurant just felt cozy and inviting. 

Service was decent- there were a few times we felt like our waitress had disappeared but my friend and I were also busy chatting so I think she was giving us space. She was happy to help us with our menu selections and gave very good recommendations. 

I can't comment on the drinks as I was doing dry January at the time BUT I have heard they are wonderful and unique and will definitely be back to try a specialty cocktail. However, I can most assuredly comment on the food which was spectacular.... here's a rundown:

1. Rutabaga fondue- definitely one of the stand-out dishes of the night. This is a must-try dish. The pretzel bread was warm and fluffy while the rutabaga was decidedly cheesy without, obviously, being cheese! Really delicious.
2. shaved brussels - delicious take on brussels sprouts. The crispy shiitake makes the dish!!
3. roasted carrot - this one blew my mind... carrots are one of my 'do not eat' foods. I hate carrots in almost every way. I have come to tolerate cooked carrots and I am always adventurous with food so when my friend suggested we get this dish to split, I said OK. Shockingly, this was my favorite dish of the night after the fondue!!! I liked it 10x more than the gold beet. The carrot was cooked perfectly and charred, just right, on top- it wasn't mushy and it wasn't too 'carroty' tasting. The crushed garbanzo spread that comes with it is the perfect accompaniment although I would've eaten that with the pumpernickel on its own!
4. gold beet -  this was the second main we split. Don't get me wrong when I say that I liked the carrot much more... the beet was also delicious. I did, however, find it to be a little too thick. I also liked the accompaniments of the carrot dish more so than the beet dish.
5. sticky toffee pudding- oh my word. definitely another star dish of the night. This tasted exactly like sticky toffee pudding with dairy based ice cream except, of course, it was all vegan! amazing!! my friend ordered the cheesecake which I did not try (I don't like 'real' cheesecake either) but she said my dessert choice was much better!!

Overall, spectacular meal. For someone who is vegan, this is a great spot to go and not have to worry about what you're ordering and also get dessert which my friend said is almost impossible to do at other restaurants. For someone who isn't vegan, this restaurant is equally as amazing and is definitely a must-try!

This will become a regular stop for me and my girls. The service was the BEST. Dana and Dan took very good care of us. The surprise of the night for me was the beet salad. I look forward to working my way through the menu!

The freshest sea food I have ever had in Tennessee. You can tell because crab, scallops, and salmon usually has a fishier taste. This was were clean tasting.The only negatives were service was a tad slow and portions were smallish. For instance, that's a decent amount of money for 3 scallops but it was very good. The strrp loin had great flovor but was grisly. The salmon was a decent size and was really good and fresh. The burger was pretty darn good and seasoned well. The crab cake and mussels were both fresh and tasty. Its more of a 4 plus but the freshness cause me to round up.

Compared to other reviews I've had a much better experience at this Walgreens than most. I've yet to deal with the pharmacy so I cannot comment on that yet. The employees were friendly and courteous. I went in to get passport photos taken of my daughter and somewhere on my way home I lost them. I called the store to see if they were there and they took their time to check in the parking lot in case I dropped them on my way out. Even though they were not found I went in the following morning to get new ones printed and realized the employees from the previous night went ahead and made me new prints free of charge.

I changed my rating to a 4, mainly because there may have been a change in staff or because of the season; regardless employees are less interactive with customers.

I enjoy a staycation on occasion to check out the hotels in our lovely city. This is exactly what I did when a group of sorority sisters arrived for a visit. They wanted me to be a guest too and not a hostess. I liked the idea so I checked all of us into the Epicurean.
 
This Marriott property resides on Howard Avenue in the trendy SoHo area of South Tampa. The location is perfect and so much is within walking distance. The upscale hotel has many amenities that you will not find at most hotels. There is a wine shop, they host cooking classes in another room, they have a dessert shop, spa, pool, gym and a roof top lounge with awesome views. Pool parties during the summer for locals and guests alike. The restaurant, Elevage, is nice and offers a great happy hour.  I would suggest you checking out Bern's Steakhouse across the street,  if you have never been.  People say the hotel is rather loud at night and many find it hard to sleep if you are a light sleeper. Although a light sleeper, this girl had no problem after a night out with the old crew. The hotel is also a stones throw from Bayshore Blvd. which holds the title of the longest unbroken sidewalk in the world. A great way to get in some exercise, sun and views of the bay.  

The staff is welcoming, professional and accommodating.  Glad we stayed here. A real treat. I would not hesitate to return.

Not gonna lie this place always seemed like a grand slam bc it's based on a pic a lili ownership. Only problem with being in the middle of nowhere is your clientele really has to have some committed regulars. The food was solid although unfortunately buffalo mozzarella were lukewarm to cold. All other things were pretty normal pic a lili staples (tails and egg rolls). Unfortunately this place seems pretty greedy. I had over 7 dollars in up charges during this visit. If you want extra sauce for your tails it shouldn't be a charge. Marinara should come with buffalo mozz or at least ranch since its buffalo. Never even got the marinara. Hot sauce for 2.49 is a travesty. Kitchen closes way too early for being open till 2. Not many local craft selections on tap. Will probably not be back here and stick to pic 3 or pic a lili.
I love this delicious local bakery! Don't overlook their sandwiches when you stop in! They are delicious and will heat them up. So amazing!

This place was AMAZING. It is a bit hidden off the main streets but it is so quaint and dog friendly on the patio! The food was WONDERFUL - my hubby had their famous fig burger which he said was perfect (this man rarely says this :)
The server was friendly and on it! I never had an empty water cup and he made us feel at home. I had the caprese heirloom salad which was yummy and filling. The ambience was beautiful as I loved the restaurants decor, WE WILL BE BACK! Thank you!!
The service here is exceptional. The food was done in a fast manner and the bathrooms, inside and outside were clean. I will be returning

Great caring eye doc; very thorough and explains everything, good or bad. Reception was fast and efficient (!)
I didn't price new frames or prescription but I'll probably be back rather than waste time with one of those try and buy websites
I got lucky finding this place 
Ask for Dr Hunter!

Smells like meat from the moment you walk in!! There are many cheese steak places to choose from but this is the tastiest!! The beef is chopped up for easy biting, chewing, eating, and well seasoning!!!

This place is very ok. No clue what the hype is about. I had the beekeeper pizza and it was underwhelming. While the sappressata on it was very good, there was no honey to speak of so the jalapeños were not balanced out. My husband and children's meals were equally mediocre. Nothing was bad, nothing was great. Our server was very sweet and attentive with drinks but our breadsticks took 30+ minutes to come out, and my daughters pizza came out 15 minutes later than the rest of our pizzas. Also I ordered a "side car" which is a trio of dipping sauces to dip your pizza in. They also came out 15 minutes after pizzas were served (our waiter did comp this w/ out me asking which was nice), however they had visible skins on them and were gross. It's a great idea with poor execution.

Such a cute little store right on Haddon Ave.  Haddonfield and Collingswood are chock a block with these adorable shops that are filled with unique home goods. I thought the mix here was so much fun.... from old medicine bottles to knick knacks, furniture and old books.  Stopped in on a somewhat busy summer weekend during a festival, and I was not disappointed. 

Kind of an upscale and better thrift shop. Don't rush, take your time to peruse everyone displayed so wonderfully throughout the store.

Great location and really fair prices.

I have to agree wholeheartedly with reviewer Nicole C. in her assessment of Bassetts.  I was really unimpressed with their ice cream.

I ordered a Guatemalan Ripple which is described as "Guatemalan-sourced coffee ice cream with mocha fudge ripple, blended with mini-coffee filled chocolates".  

The ice cream is dense but ICY.   I zoomed up at the picture I took of it and can see that it's not a smooth, creamy consistency.  I had sampled several other flavors and actually didn't particularly like any of them, but chose the Guatemalan Ripple after the girl behind the counter recommended it.  In fact, I really didn't want to order anything, but only felt obliged to since I had tried 3 flavors already.   

I really found nothing that differentiated their ice cream from something that you could buy from the supermarket.  In fact, I would dare to say that Haagen-Dazs is better.

Highly recommend!  Cool relaxed atmosphere, friendly service and amazing tacos!  The pollo diablo is HOT so be ready!  My favorite was the Baja shrimp.  If you are down by lower Broadway and want something besides bbq or bar food, definitely check this out!  It's just a block or two over and well worth the short walk!! So delicious!!

OMG, the worse espresso and the worse dark roast ever!!!! and I thought they follow a standard process!
how can you mess up espresso? just push the button on the machine.... 
and the dark roast? worse than mc donald!!!
The food here is sooooo fresh! We also really liked that everything on the menu could be made into a vegetarian dish--just ask! Going back tonight actually.

This was my first time dining here and overall I loved it. The lemonade OMG was so good. I ordered the omelet and that was delicious as well. I loved the setup of the resturaunt and the staff were very welcoming. The only downside is that they ran out of lemonade and the sitting was very limited. Other than that everything else was great and I will be going back.

My girlfriend and I booked a couples massage, and while the massage itself was pretty good, there are several aspects of this spa that make it the worst experience I've had. Firstly, the woman doing my massage left the room for minutes at a time to talk to some man who was there. I found out later that the person massaging my girlfriend took her panties all the way off below her butt and left them off the whole time, then massaged and moved her butt with the panties off. She said she felt molested. She noticed the door was open when the other person was talking to that man, so she was just on display, naked, for whoever that was. We get home, she takes her clothes off, and finds that on top of all this she has a rash on both her legs.

The food was nothing special and it's not the best place to go if you're of color which is sad to say. After walking in we were greeted with dirty looks,rude racial charged remarks that people thought we couldn't hear, and bad service. I do not recommend this place at all and will not go back there.

Went on the first night. Buzzing with energy and excitement; great to be part of the event. There are service staff everywhere; not just like a Roman trattoria. We suggest they calm the service down. That combined with the elevated prices and the diminutive plates really does defeat the potential this great space has to be a place to frequent, to be in regular rotation. 

Something Vetri does with his heavy handed use of lipids really gets to this diner. Ordinarily strong stomached, I have had adverse reactions at both Amis and Osteria. He needs some fresher, cleaner options and to intensify and clarify flavors. Pasta dishes were weakly sauced, though the pasta itself was fresh and tasty. Artichokes are a winner. Fresh ricotta dish also nice. Suggest bread not be soaked with olive oil, as olive oil is pooling in many dishes. Desserts were not marvels--all were heavy with cream, butter, oil--like what preceded them (except fruit pudding which tasted like my homemade applesauce). Would like to try it again, as we are so nearby. In Rome they do this so effortlessly. Here it feels like an overwrought, yet "well-oiled" production. Regardless, service staff were all very skilled and pleasant. Dial back the fine dining and dial up the flavor quotient on the food. But it will be popular whatever they do. Amis, a near miss.

Pizza was standard Pizza Hut pizza...don't dine-in it will make you sick to see where your pizza is prepared. Dirty, dirty, dirty. The bathroom doors were completely sticky from filth. The kid that waited on us (Nathan I think) was very nice and attentive.

Had great service today with Cornerstone.  We purchased a unit last year and scheduled to have the unit serviced today.  Matt F came out and did a great job.  On time, polite and efficient.  Let us know what he was doing and was nice enough to wear booties inside the house.  Loved these guys last year with the install and their follow up work was just as impressive.

THE BEST Thai restaurant I've ever been to. I've eaten at five Thai places in Reno and this one is by far the very best of them all! And, of course, better than any place in California, Washington State, and Idaho. The Pumpkin curry and Panang curry are my favorites.

My family and I love Potbelly and go there quite frequently. We went out of our way to come to this Potbelly and they said they weren't open until 1:00pm on their door. That is unacceptable that it was not on a website and there better be a good explanation for this. I was late to my daughter's soccer game and missed her goal because I had to go to Jimmy John's instead because of the poor service. Another lost customer.

A great place to get work done or catch up with a friend. I love the coffee & the freshly made chocolate croissants are to die for. The atmosphere is lacking a little, but never too busy or loud. The baristas are always friendly. Love the prices, not too expensive.

Yayy for my first ever yelp review!!!

Well, today was my second time dining at Eureka, and I was impressed yet again!  Even though the place looks quite busy, I've never had to wait more than 10 minutes to get a table here.  The vibe of the place is very "hip"--good tunes, employees with unique looks, and an awesome beer list.  The first time our server Christine recommended the Fig Marmalade burger for me which honestly changed the way I look at burgers forever.  She was very attentive and friendly and made sure we had everything we needed.  We were lucky enough to sit in Christine's section again today, at which point she immediately recognized my friend and I (and even what burger I ordered last time--what a memory!).  Although I absolutely LOVED the fig burger, I wanted to try something different.  Christine was extremely knowledgable about the menu and recommended the Lulu (lamb) burger this time.  I was a little skeptical because I had never had a lamb burger before, but it was seriously amazing!  I had the hand-cut fries with a side of their jalapeno/bacon jam (which is off the hook).  Our drinks were refilled before we had to ask, and all the servers seemed to work together to make sure everyone was taken care of.  Everyone who works here always seem genuinely nice and happy to be helping you (big smiles all around!).

Tried Sax because Cafe Rakka was closed Monday.  I took Yelp advise on this one.  I give them 3 stars.  I asked the girl taking my order what she could recommend and she said she had never eaten there-that concerned me to start.  I had the "cajun" chicken sandwich with fries and also tried their chicken tortilla soup.

I took my number and found a seat in the back dining room, but had to move because it was frigid, and I like it cool...The cajun chicken sandwich was good.  Nothing that blew me away but a good sandwich nonetheless.  They give you a ton of fries-one small order is enough for 2 people but I was unimpressed....they were underseasoned and I had an inordinate amount of tiny pieces-as in, so small I couldn't dip into ketchup without getting it on my fingers...

Last was the tortilla soup.  I could describe it as a brothy chicken chili. Not bad, but not what I was expecting or hoping for. 

All in all, if I'm in Hendersonville I may go back but is not a destination by any means.

Terrible service! Waited for 30 min for a quarter pounder!! They do this every time people start coming because they don't want to serve them, so they make the wait time long, to discourage customers from stopping.

They used to be great, however there's a new cook in town. If you want Tikka Masala- do it. A bottled drink- do it. Any type of hoagie or steak- run away. It isn't well stocked half the time and is almost always empty. Don't waste your time head down the street on the right and get you a sandwich from the Countrymaid.

Got my hair cut and colored by Rachel a couple of months ago, and she did an amazing work! I came in with thick Asian dark virgin hair so I knew it would be hard to color. I wanted ash brown balayage and she delivered, and made it look very subtle and seamless. I love it! Even the haircut itself was exactly how I wanted it (and I'm usually very picky about haircuts), seamless layers throughout and bulk taken out where it's needed. The staff there were all very nice and friendly, great atmosphere!

Been to this place five times now, first two were amazing the calamari and the pico de Gallo hamburger were to die for, but now service and food quality just fell off a cliff. Very very pricey for what you get, might as well just go to Judds. And just a hint maybe you could get your hostess to take a bath and shave every now and then i'm just saying

This place is new and it is absolutely delicious! They have food and groceries but the food is just out of this world good!

If you've never had a traditional torta this is definitely the place to try it. They also have an array of meats you can buy to try to make your own at home! There's a grocery store here where you can get a lot of authentic ingredients from a local business where you can feel good about supporting the folks in charge. Every single person there is really kind and they're willing to explain everything to you which I really appreciated because I had quite a few questions the first time I came in. I've tried almost all of the tortas and each and everyone of them are absolutely delicious!

This is 100% a cool new thing for you to try if you haven't had anything like it before. They also have delicious guacamole which I would highly recommend it's a little spicy just the way I like it. Of course it depends on your taste if you really think it's spicy but there's a lot of great veggies in there. 

Well here please don't forget to check out the back left-hand corner where they have a Lotta cool drinks and things from that you can't find at a typical grocery store. This is the perfect way to expand your horizons or if you I have had it before to get right to the heart of what you love.

I come here often with my family when in the area because we think it's one of the best brunch spots around. Today we came and were not disappointed. It is was a little crowded but they did a good job of handling it and provided good service. I ordered the breakfast quesadillas, my father got the veggie Rueben, my grandfather got the three egg omelet, my sisters got short stacks of pancakes, and my mother got the Creme Brûlée French toast. Our food took about twenty minutes, a normal wait time. When it came it was very good. The breakfast quesadilla was stuffed with scrambled eggs, peppers, beans, etc. On the side was some avocado salsa. It was delicious and very flavourful. The creme brûlée French toast was also good, with thick slices of creamy french toast thinly covered in creamy sauce. The veggie Rueben was good too, with potatoes, imitation beef (which was amazing considering some i've had) and all the classic elements of a good Rueben. My grandfather claimed the three egg omelet was good too and well cooked with the perfect amount of spice. My sisters both seemed satisfied with their pancakes and quickly devoured them. The drinks were good too. I got raspberry tea and they provided lots of hot water which I liked. (I've been to places where they barely provide enough water for a full cup of tea.)
Caleb's is a delicious breakfast spot in a nice location.

2 1/2 Stars.  Reliable, quality Italian fare in a cozy Olde City location (but located far enough away from the noisy debauchery of Olde City) amidst worn brick and stone.  Friendly service, hearty food, and like another reviewer, I really enjoyed eating downstairs!  Good for a date where you want to sit across the table from one another, engage in deep conversation, look into each other's eyes over the candlelight... (excuse me, I just vomited - kidding)  Doesn't promise too much, but delivers what you expect at a reasonable value without being a dreaded chain restaurant.  (And of course the food quality is better than a chain.)

My loan was bought by this company.

In early march we decided to refi and they offered a great deal. I didn't end up saving as much as was pitched and the whole process was a disaster. I literally stop hearing from them in the middle of it for three weeks. Granted pandemic just hit but that was not the cause of the non communication. They just didn't have it together. The lack of response continued through the whole process which took 3 months. So okay. But then every communication with them since has been awful.

After my refi I got a call from my insurance company that they had not paid. My loan officer told me that I needed to pay my homeowners insurance out of pocket because I had nothing in my escrow account after my refi. And then when I called the escrow dept. they said I had money in my escrow and sorry they could send a check out. This went back and forth until my insurance guy took over. Finally I talked to one gentleman at Shellpoint and he assured me he himself dropped a check in the mail and I had the escrow funds to cover it and to ignore the calls and emails from his co-workers saying the latter. They finally paid it weeks late and I almost needlessly wrote a check.

Now I am waiting to hear back for them to adjust my taxes and its been 2 weeks since my last email. I initially emailed about this almost 2 months ago and heard nothing. 

Next time I will use my credit union.

The price is well worth it. 5$ will fill you up for sure.
Plus the owner is probably the nicest person I have ever met! :D
$240 for a highlight that was half done- the color didn't sit long enough, 3 minute trim, and blowout. Overpriced. Save your money.
I performed at the Keswick when I was 6 years old. It is a great place for families to see shows and great for kids

I frequent this sushi restaurant...by frequent I mean I go about once every few weeks because I crave it. All I can really say is holy delicious! Its a smaller sushi restaurant with a super cute ambiance and friendly service. The sushi chef's don't yell at you when you walk in and thank God for that! I jump everytime...and being frightened when wearing 5 inch heels isn't usually a good situation. I also like the fact that the rolls are smaller in width (not in the amount of food you get). So I don't feel like I'm trying to shove an entire salmon in my mouth. The service is very friendly also. I'll be heading in again when my craving timer starts going off!

We had Sonny's on our dinner out rotation but after tonight we won't be back.  No more 2 for 1 drafts.  Fewer ribs on the special plates as well as the food being cold.  They were not busy so there was no reason for cold food and slow service.  Manager blamed corporate and we hope corporate sees this review.

Went here for breakfast for the first time today. The place was PACKED! I ordered the eggs Benedict which I thought was very good. The potatoes were under seasoned but cooked well. The prices were very reasonable, breakfast for two ended up being about $15, tax included. Not bad for a breakfast joint.

Made plans to go with another couple. Everyone else seemed happy. As Tuna D said...to much mayonnaise in the Bang Bang Shrimp. I don't like mayo on hot food but I tried it and other than the mayo it had a nice flavor. Not many selections on the menu. I opted for the Kobi burger. Kinda bland but it was a huge piece of meat it just needed to be seasoned. Corn chowder with crabmeat was also bland. The crabcakes were delicious but like $16 for two..and they were small and accompanied by some sort of garbonzo bean salad.  My date would have still been hungry had he not ordered bang bang shrimp and chowder.  Also there was no basic salad. Most basic was ceasar. I will pass on this place but as I stated everyone else was happy. Oh the service was prompt, polite, and professional.

Very positive experience. 

Bob and his helper put in a new water heater which given its location was a complicate task. The job to 4.5 hours, more I am sure than they had expected, in part because some of the plumbing being connected caused failures and leaks in another location.  That caused a partial rework of the install. However they plodded on until the install was completed in a thoroughly professional manner.

He is in demand and I can see why: professional, through, quality work, and a good humor to go with it. I will use him again.

I've been to this location twice now. People are super nice, but the floors & tables aren't clean and everything seems dusty.

Fair warning - for dip manis, they actually dip your finger into the pot of color, and don't ask people to wash their hands first. It's incredibly unsanitary.

Prices are on par with other places in the area.

NEGATIVE STARS!!
If you want a huge dent on your car and for them to assume no responsibility for it, use The Nuggets valet parking! And they won't even tell you it happened! Now they have to "investigate"! BEWARE!!

UPDATE::::
They are refusing to pay for it! They are denying the whole incident! Thank you DEBRA YOST you have been absolutely useless and your customer service skills are severely lacking! All you have to do is review the video!

This is my favorite store :) Staff is very friendly and helpful, and they have a wonderful selection to choose from. I always feel welcome and comfortable when I shop here unlike so many other alternative stores. I am from out of town and make sure to stop by every time I come to Edmonton. Their prices are always reasonable,  and they have wonderful sales.

They are also great for taking special orders.

Penda at the front desk was AMAZING. She provided exceptional customer service and was very personable. She even made me a coffee bc I'm a goof and didn't know how to work the machine. lol I came in because I have had a nasty cold for about a week now and Abby and Dr. Sparks was very engaged and helpful in getting me what I needed to feel better. The staff there is very friendly. I highly recommend them to my friends and family! There is street parking and also parking garages if you are not walking to the office.

Hubby and I ate here a couple weeks ago when we were in SB visiting the in-laws.  I had made a list of potential spots for lunch/dinner based on Yelpers' comments for the time we'd be in town and Saigon In and Out sounded good for lunch one day.

Hubby and I shared a starter of the Green Papaya Salad.  It was very good.  It wasn't as spicy as some I've had other places, but it was tasty nonetheless.  For an entree I had the Bun Tom - Bo Nuong Xa (Shrimp & Lemongrass Beef w/ Rice Vermicelli)  and hubby had the Tom Xao Dau Bokchoy (Shrimp stir-fried with snow peas and bokchoy).  Yum!  Yum!  Yum!  I love bun.  I love it so much, in fact, that I almost always order it when I go to a Vietnamese restaurant.

The restaurant is cute with lots of tall plants between the tables (gives a feeling of privacy).  It was also very clean (even the bathroom was spotless, although we were there early for lunch (11:30-ish).  The service was also friendly and attentive.  This place is on my list for a return visit the next time we're in town.

Hmmmmm... I guess I didnt realize that this spot is a bit of a tourist trap before coming in. I just thought to the brunch drinks were supposed to be, ahem, "litty."
