Food: Not lit. Sure it's been a month or so since I dined here, but even the next day I couldnt remember what I ordered. After some soul searching, I believe it was the chicken biscuit with gravy. Nothing was necessarily bad about the taste... I just despise lukewarm food. Ya can't really send it back, and unless it's got an amazing flavor... It's not appetizing. My dining companion had a sweeter option and I believe they enjoyed it. Meh. 

Drinks: Okay, this is what I came for... Let's be real. What's brunch without booze?? The sangria carafe is ice...and more ice. We got a solid two drinks out of it. The bloody Mary bar is what my eyes were set on. Admittedly, they had a nice spread of items. The drink prices just seem bumped up for the tourist. I get it, but even those bottomless mimosas seem like a well marketed trap. Meh. 

Service: Meh. 

Live music: Nice touch! No extra stars bc it's music city.

Could've been four stars, because the food was actually not bad. But I ordered a coke, and they sent me a paper cup full of flat soda. By flat, I mean zero fizz at all. And since they poured it into a cup, that means they saw that there was no fizz, knew that it was flat, and sent it out that way, regardless. Blatant disregard for your customers.

Have always tried to eat at Rick's whenever we get to the Indy area. Have eaten there many times and have always had a pleasant experience. Food is great, service is A-1, ambiance is perfect, prices are good.....It is ALMOST worth a special trip from Chicago to enjoy a good meal....
They live up to the hype. Front desk customer service was great, I forgot her name but she was extremely helpful. The tint looks amazing. Overall great place!
Alabama fans not welcomed.  Got a big FU BAMA from the band.  Moving on to better bars in midtown....

Huge stage & seating area for concerts. Nice little store attached with souvenirs that has very reasonable prices. Only stopped in for an appetizer, which was great, but would come back again. Later at night a line starts to form so there may be a wait. Wouldve been nice to have a larger selection of craft beer. You have to try Line Dancing lessons before you leave!
Got all of your drip needs: craft beer, kava, kratum and cbd! Chill vibes. Great place to hangout with friends.

Myles and his crew are fantastic.  He is responsive, rates are reasonable, and most importantly does excellent work.  I have referred him to friends and will continue to use him in the future.  Highly recommended.

I gave this place about 5 chances because of the proximity and delivery. The pizza isn't terrible, it just isn't good. Lacks flavor. I even went so far as to design a pizza with toppings I thought could be IMPOSSIBLE to lack flavor. Apparently it is possible and all the salt and red pepper flakes in the world couldn't save it. Sorry but when I spend $37 on a pizza and a salad it needs to be good. No matter how hung over I am I will never order from here again, always wind up disappointed.
This place is delicious. It's like chipoltle but better because they give you more meat options.

Who knew the East Side would become so bougie that we'd have a little French cafe nestled in between The Family Wash and the railroad tracks? Blink and you'll miss this small and unassuming restaurant and bar. It's true that it's not in the typical spot where you go to dine in East Nashville, but don't overlook this divine and delicious little gem.

The service is superb and the ambiance relaxing, but what I love most about this place is that nowhere else in Nashville have I had food like this. We started going here for dinner, where my fave is the pan seared trout (can't remember the French name that's actually on the menu). Dinner is amazing, but being the brunch folks we are, have been here more often on weekend mornings recently. I usually get their house omelet, which simply has gruyere cheese in it (addl. ingredients optional for $1 more). I'm not sure where they get their eggs, but they're some of the best I've had. Start off with an order of the duck fat biscuits (listed in their specials) and you will thank me. In The South where the biscuits are plentiful and delicious, I don't think I've experienced any quite this fabulous. I actually get sad once they're eaten. Today I swayed from the usual and got the frittata from their specials, which had kale, tomato confit, and ham. It was excellent. Their coffee is great as well.

Because of the location, they are not impossible to get into without reservations on a Friday or Saturday night, so a great option if you're not a planner and didn't make reservations a month out like you have to for some area restaurants.

I recently found myself here to do some wig shopping with my mom.

Life throws crazy things at us, and when she recently started losing her hair as a result of chemotherapy, she shyly mentioned to be that she'd be needing something.

We rode into the city armed with a list of different wig shops.

The thing that House of Beauty had that the others didn't was Albert.

We walked to back of the store together where there is a whole corner dedicated to wigs.  Albert was helping someone before us, but once he was finished with them, we got 110% of his attention.

He gave great recommendations, and showed us some fun tricks on designing your "hair" different ways every day so it's still similar to real hair....  

But the thing he did that was truly special was he made what can easily be an awkward and uncomfortable situation for someone a blast...

He kidded that she should get crazy wigs, things she's never had before, and change it every day.  He called all of the wigs by "she" or "her" as if they were their own personalities.  Which, they kind of are!!!

At one point he put all of his joking aside and in a very gentle and sweet voice reassured my mom that she'd be ok, and told stories of women who lost their hair, and once it grew back, would have beautiful locks they never had before!!!

He calmed her down and made her feel good.  She walked out with a wig that was stylish, looked real, gives her options to change it up and keep things fresh (changing the part, etc.) all the while resembling sort-of how her hair was before all this. 

The only thing that was kind of jarring was what seemed to be the owners.

From the back of the store to the front, it went from a 5-Star Experience to a 2-Star.  They're making tons of money, they need to lighten up!

Incredibly, despite having GrubHub screw up multiple parts of this order (which was already an attempt from GrubHub to compensate us for an issue from an order the night before), we have throughly enjoyed our food that was delivered from you all. Your person on staff today (1/12/20) that I spoke to was friendly and very helpful in correcting the mistakes GrubHub made with our order today. I believe his name was Adam. Thank you Adam and thank you Tenn for a delicious meal despite the GrubHub headache.
You can social distance here. Good chai eith a shot. Tasty fig pastry. The atmosphere is great.

Yellow Belly is one of my favorite spots in town due to the good food, service, and the outdoor seating! I love this place! I have been here for happy hour, dinner, and breakfast. Each time I have come here I have had delicious food and have enjoyed myself. 

During dinner/happy hour I have had many different items on their menu. I have had their brussel sprouts, pizza, wings, burgers and fries! Everything I've had has been delicious! The brussel sprouts were cooked to the perfect crispness giving them alot of texture which I loved. I loved the sauce on the wings and they even gave us blue cheese dressing to go with them!

The burger was cooked at a medium temperature which was perfect and what I had ask for. The fries were so good! The put garlic and parmesan cheese on them making them just so delicious! The pizza was crispy and cooked perfectly with fresh veggies as the toppings!

The brunch here is always the best! Their mimosas are super fresh and not expensive at all! They even have beers during brunch too which is great! I've had the breakfast sandwich and changed it. I made my eggs scrambled with bacon. It was so good! The bacon was cooked perfectly crispy and had a nice crunch to it. 

Overall I love this place and I can't wait to check out the live music they have here! Thanks Yellow Belly for being great, I can't wait to come back again soon! :)

Wow. Worst Chinese food ever! Pork Fried rice was sticky and stale tasting. Holy Cow man... how to you screw up RICE!!! Also, Shrimp does not belong in a SPRING ROLL! Avoid this trash can filler at all costs.

We highly recommend Dunedin Plumbing Inc. This is the second time this winter that we have needed this company's services. They are excellent from the moment you phone in a problem. The answering service is great dispatch is great, the service techs are well-trained, neatly dressed and clean and friendly and professional. Dunedin Plumbing is a very professional operation from start to finish. We also find their prices to be reasonable - not cheap - but you get value for your money.

Tried chicken with wonton soup - no heat- broth was flavorful and delicate as were the thin skinned wontons, delicious.

Also tried the pork w pickled cabbage soup. Rated 4 in heat, this was robust, but not overwhelming. The pork was very tender, pickled cabbage bright and crunchy. Broth was flavorful. No noodles in this soup.

Fried dumplings were a waste - although quite good, there were too many interesting things on this menu to waste a choice on something this pedestrian. Good choice if you have an eating-challenged person at the table.

Had the dry pot pork (rated 10 for heat) for my entrée. Lived in Asia for three years, two other trips to China, rarely had anything this good. The thinly sliced vegetables had no salt, but the tender pork pieces had a nice burst of salt in every bite. The dish was mixed thoroughly with chili oil, leaving a puddle of it on my plate, but the oil is very light, not greasy- and delicious. The dish was not over the top hot and had a plethora of flavor, including five spice and toasted chilies.

Service was great; young, efficient and helpful. 

Almost unbelievably diverse customers and staff, plenty of Asian people eating there (I try not to eat at Chinese restaurants that don't have Chinese patrons- or Mexican restaurants with no Mexicans), was told cooks are all Chinese.

Can't wait to go back.

Scoundrels.  Don't be mislead by their advertised prices or the bunk they tell you over the phone.  Needed data recovered from hard drive.  Was told verbally by their representative Daniel Maynard that they were extremely confident they could recover my data -- said no data was damaged, just the heads on my drive.  Their advertised prices are highly misleading, too.  The cheapest service they offer is $1895.  Mr. Maynard's verbal assurances were the only reason I moved forward with their $1895 fee.  Who would otherwise take this chance?  Well, guess what?  I eventually received phone call that "nothing could be done."    This $1895 fee supposedly covered things like parts for a new drive, etc, but there is no evidence of that.  Where are the parts I supposedly paid for?    Not to mention that I asked them to wait to perform the services until hearing from me -- I never actually signed their credit card authorization form.  I realized they charged my card and went ahead anyway.  Totally unprofessional and a complete scam.  Save your money and avoid Fields Data Recovery!
Great service! Delicious food! Ambience is casual. Cinnamon butter on the rolls is scrumptious! Best santa fe cattle co I've been to!

In an attempt to patronize our neighborhood restaurants more, we made reservations at SoWe on a Sunday evening. We got a table in the back room but there was one other table so we didn't feel isolated. The whole place is pretty small which gives it a nice neighborhood feel. Our server was over-the-top friendly and gave us several recommendations. We were pretty impressed with their bar menu and both ordered one of their specialty cocktails which were great.  For dinner, my girlfriend ordered the special (a coconut inspired fish dish) and I ordered the SoWe burger.  We both enjoyed our meals and agreed we'd be back for more.

A few weeks later we came back to watch the Oscars in their bar area. We ordered drinks and split an order of sweet potato fries. The food, drinks, and service were great on our second visit as well. When they made me a gin martini instead of a vodka martini they didn't give me a hard time about making me a new drink. They even had a contest going as to who could guess the most Oscar winners. Their was a prize but we didn't win. They also told us that they often have weekly movie nights so we'll be back again soon.

She was awesome. I had Botox and filler done. I saw a difference immediately.she took great care to ask me where I thought I needed her to put the rest .she was like ok you still have a little bit left where do you think you need it. She is not trying to cheat you on your units like some dr. You have to watch.she was also very very gentle. I'm very very pleased.

My wife and I stopped here for the first time, based on the crowds on Friday and Saturday nights.  It was Thursday at about 6:30 pm.  Waitress was very attentive, keeping my sweet tea coming.  Placed our order and waited... and waited... and waited.  I ordered double pork chops "Stagecoach."  They were hot, but the only juice when I cut into them was from the gravy and pineapple on top.  WAY over cooked...  My wife knew I was not satisfied when half my meal went into a carry out box.  I'll heat it up tomorrow and throw on some salsa or something to be able to eat them.  My wife had the chicken-kabobs - too dry, as well.  My guess is they are training someone to cook and use the Thursday crowd to give them experience... I would hate to think a manager would cook that bad.

We will not be back.

I wish there was 0 stars. It was the worst experience ever. The manager yelled at me and had attitude. They didn't make the twist the way I normally get them. And it had no cheese,it was just garlic and bread. It was also burnt.

Eggs in a Jar. 
That's all I'm saying. Order it now.

I stumbled upon this place because of Open Table. I wanted to eat away from the W Hotel for breakfast and this place was a block away from my conference hotel.

UM, I arrived a few minutes before the place opened and there were two other foodies waiting for the place to open. The other foodie told me that I had to get the beignets in a basket. I told him I was going for the eggs in a jar.

The place reminds me of a French bistro. 

The service was great. When the eggs in a jar arrived I couldn't believe how amazing it was. Fried shrimp, poached eggs over jalepeno grits. AMAZING. I know it sounds crazy and so heavy for breakfast but it is so good.

I decided to go somewhere else the next day for breakfast and regret it but will definitely come back to LUKE.

Just got done Bates Manor...amazing!

Different than any escape room we've ever done!  Instead of a million lock boxes, there are all sort of props you use to navigate through the room. The room was so detailed, you can tell the owner put a lot of time and effort into creating such an amazing experience. We were also showed the tomb room which looked amazing!

We will be back for more. Can't wait to return!

The negative reviews on here don't make any sense to me? Which restaurant did you go to? The staff was incredibly sweet and attentive, repeatedly checking on me, but not to an annoying level (hey, it happens lol). I had a fish taco and the Korean BBQ.  Both were great flavorwise, the only advice I would give is to pull the KBBQ meat a little more. My first bite took half the taco out, but it tasted good enough I'm OK with it lol. The kimchi was good quality and compliments the KBBQ well.  I also received a comp order of chips n salsa due to an order error at another table, thanks to the owner!!  Salsa is sweet, pineapple style, not Mex restaurant style, but I think it was delicious. I ate it all.  Now these aren't your plain ol, run of the mill tacos, if you want that, then go to ANY other taco place. This place is literally called tacos with a twist. I expected something different, I wanted to see what the twist was, and that's exactly what I got.  Taco bell it ain't, so don't expect ground beef on a tortilla, but what you order will be good. Step out of your comfort zone and order something you normally wouldn't!!  Also, The owner is very nice and this is his only location.  Support local businesses,  I will be telling my friends and I'll definitely be coming back.  Thanks T.W.A.T! (sorry, but if you didn't notice before, then that's on you, if so, then well played )
Great service and amazing food! It's definitely a foodie establishment so come hungry!!

Love this place right next to the aces ball park smells great and great place for the family the decor is something to look at as well very original would come here again and recommend everyone to come the staff is friendly as well
Great place! Never disappointed in food or service. Took my bf here for his birthday as he chose bascoms over Berns.

So happy they are doing well!   The place has a great relaxed vibe.  The staff is friendly and efficient.  And the food is good.   Ample free parking, nice outside eating area and now a full liquor license,  
I'll be a regular for sure.

Casual, natural, charming and hospitable.
One of the loveliest Ritz Carlton properties.
Beautifully and strategically built to enhance and not detract from its incredible mountain location. Everything here is near perfect, especially the staff.
Janice Macy, Jason in customer relations, Jose in the dining room (and guard house), Briana, Ashley in Core are all standouts.
Ranger Coz as a mountain guide is a wealth of information.
We have stayed many times over the last four years and we would never stay anywhere else in the Tucson area.
By the way, great breakfasts and excellent wine cellar and somelier.

I will be honest with you. I remember the first time I drove by the Melting Pot and understood it to be a fondue restaurant. I was sure it was a passing fad and it was not going to last more than ten minutes. Imagine my surprise when after 15 minutes, it was still there. This is what incited me to go to the Melting Pot the very first time.

I promise you they have made a one meal novelty into a dining experience. Each booth has its own cooktop. The servers compose your dipping bases right at the table. There are a wide variety of bases to cook your items and a cavalcade of items to cook. One opens with the traditional salad choice and then it's all fondue from there.

The menu is extensive and flexible enough to come for just a snack with a cheese fondue, the full kit and caboodle through to dessert or just dessert. They have a respectable wine cellar and competent sommeliers.  

This is a very intimate dining experience. One way it is very different from other restaurants directly concerns the issue of your dining companion. Because of the nature of fondue, if you are going to dinner be sure your companion is someone to whom you do not mind talking. The design of the experience is such that you will likely be facing your companion and because you are cooking your food there is a lot of time for conversation; which will be distinctly awkward if you don't have any.

The portions are generous and there are varying levels of commitment in terms of how much fonduing you will do. There are a wide variety of meat and vegetables for fonduing and the vegetables and bread are all you can eat. With the standard serving you are unlikely to leave hungry. 
 
The wait staff is amiable and helpful. The facilities are tidy and comfortable. While it is not a black tie restaurant, I have been told by someone that they would like this dining experience to be more on the formal side. That being said, many come quite as they are. This is definitely appropriate for date night. While there is not a prohibition against children, one must remember the table is also a cooktop and represents many chances for injury to the rambunctious or easily distracted child. The amount of time that it actually takes to dine might also make this an inappropriate choice for some families with children.

While there are some menu staples; they usher in and out various options of each course throughout the year. I have never had less than a delicious meal in a wonderful atmosphere delivered by competent and friendly staff.

I had pretty low expectations for this place but it turned out to be quite good! Of course, there weren't many items on the menu that appealed to me but I actually ended up ordering the spaghetti and meatballs, which were quite good! The spaghetti tasted very homemade and fresh, the sauce was very flavorful and a bit sweet, not salty or oily, and the meatballs were cooked well, tender on the inside and very flavorful, except were overly salty. This dish was huge so I actually got two dinners out of it and lots of extra pasta/sauce. Only thing I wish it had come with was a side salad to balance the meal out. I was there on a Saturday night and it was super packed but we were able to get a table for 2 in just a few minutes which was nice and although it was pretty loud, I could hear myself speak and didn't feel like the noise was too overpowering that it prohibited conversation. I would give this 3 1/2 stars.

This was the worst dinning experience ever! We got there it was a beautiful day and we noticed there was some outdoor seating so we said we would sit outside one table was broken and was told the umbrellas were damaged the night before. When we were finally asked for out drink order 15 minutes after we sit we are told that coffee would have to made from a play claiming to have brunch until 2 when we got there around 11:30. When asked the size of the omelettes the waitress replied I don't know. When we finally got our meals my Eggs Benedict was cold and the sauce was half melted butter and nothing else. SO GROSS!!!! My friends pancakes were burned, they forgot my wife's grits and my other friends hash-browns had green peppers in them and were so greasy that they were inedible. Instead of apologetically behavior there were rude. Such a bad hour and a half of my life that I will never get back! I only wish I would have read reviews before going there :((((((((((((((

This guy couldn't fix a toilet button. I fixed it in 10 minutes myself with less than $10. Seriously man...

Maybe I, a finance guy, is more skilled than the professional handyman. Very odd.

Love this place!!! Moved from Pennsylvania about 7 months ago and love diners!! This is the best diner we have been to ever!!! Love the atmosphere and the food is good and very reasonably priced. Fantastic place to go if your just visiting Tucson or live here!!!

Bought my first bong here, brand name US tubes, years ago when I lived in Isla Vista. 
Staff is absolutely fantastic, and the shop sells the top of the top glass pieces, bongs, etc..
The U.S. Tubes I bought was slightly unbalanced, so instead of the 450 price tag, the staff member gave it to me for 135 dollars. 
It wobbles when you set it down ever so SLIGHTLY, but since it wasn't perfect, they gave me that amazing discount, and also let me know that U.S. Tubes almost never messes up a bong like that (most of their work is perfect).
This was all years ago... When I was 18, and I'm 22 now... So I don't remember staff name, but I remember how courteous they were.... Which you don't find in headshops very often.
Going to try to make it back up there for their Black Friday specials on glass and clothing... But it's a 2 hour drive from Orange County  
I truly hope they set up shop down here, because I don't know a single store that would be able to keep up with them.

Thank you Fuzion, and hope to see you soon.
Waited over 25min for my order which was inedible  when I got it. Avoid this place at all costs.

This should read 4 stars...Yay! My wife's a fan.  But if she's a fan in this case then I'm a fan.  In all honesty I appreciate the deals you can find.  It's not super big so the selection of finds diminishes, but deals can still be found.  The location I went to in NYC is much bigger and I got a great deal on some shoes.  Betty stops in here on occasion usually looking for some parts to a new outfit.  She likes, so do I.  I can't believe I just wrote that...

Another first for me. I was 50/50 based on the reviews I read online but came with an open mind and positive hopes as per usual. Thoroughly impressed with the starters! First dish, first bite; delicious. Miso soup tasted great (yes there's a difference between good and meh miso soup). The side salad was different and delicious with their mayo/ginger dressing (I'm guessing that's what it was); well done on that. 

  The mussels were awesome and had a serious kick, so greatly appreciated those...I could eat a dozen of those easy! The fried oysters were just as solid when they came out next. Some of the top I've had in a while anywhere; impressive! The beef negimaki on the other hand..hard pass! Dry and very unappetizing tasting and looking. I was shocked after loving everything that came out up until that point ..

  Onto the mains: most of the sashimi plate was good imo, tuna, salmon, white tuna were bien..the other cuts of fish were sub par in quality or prep. The salmon bento box ..california roll was nice and fresh. Fried rice was below average compared to similar I've had in the area and would do without next time ..salmon was a bit overcooked from my experience and liking but the shrimp tempura was A+ quality and prep. So..a mixed bag overall but impressed with what I did like; I may be going there again for perhaps different items and consistency. Thanks for being there and surviving the pandemic economic woes.

Came here for dinner on a visit to Philly. Was a little confusing to find as the location sits on top of a Halal Guys and they share the same entrance. Good and service was great and the waitress was super friendly and explained anything we had questions on. Food came out hot and super tasty. Would definitely recommend.

Came to indy to visit family and we tried the food at flashbacks.  
Let me just say, "Wow!" 
 The food was incredible.  We ordered for  6 people and everything was made with love and it shows. I highly recommend anything on the menu. We tried the burgers, chicken strips, steaks,onion rings green beans, etc... 
My personal favorite was the pork tenderloin supreme with ham and swiss cheese.  Thank you flashbacks for such a great dining experience!!!

Line was long. We were hungry. Sun was hot. Rarely do self proclaimed  "best whatever of the wherever" pan out well. I hoped this experience would be one of those rare instances that it did. 
I'm a fan of fried chicken, all types. Willie Mae's was different from any fried chicken I've had before. It was also the best. The crispy, light batter, the steaming tender and moist chicken and the flavor erased the crankiness caused by waiting about 45 minutes to get a table. 
All of that annoyance was forgotten wth every tasty bite. Worth it. Wish it were closer to home but glad it isn't or else I'd be here way too much for my own good.

First stop from the airport...why?  Because they served breakfast and had mimosas and bloody mary's!  

We had great service...and delicious food!  We all enjoyed our omelettes, benedicts, avocado toast, and skillets!

We went out on a half day trip a couple weeks ago and had a great time, Larry was great to talk to and and very helpful.  The boat was clean, we caught a decent amount of fish and saw some porpoises.  Larry did a great job of cleaning the fish quickly, which we then had cooked at the nearby restaurant based on his recommendation.  Thanks guys for a great afternoon!

I've never not left this place grinning saying how much I love the employees. I don't know why the rating is so low. The weed? Gas. The people? Phenomenal. The vibes? Immaculate. I could also be a little bias after claiming my free ounce

I'm not really sure where to start, but basically if you have any choice in the matter at all do not stay here. Ever. 

I'm serious. 

I actually feel bad for people who work here. I imagine they continue to show up to their jobs out of some kind of Stockholm Syndrome that this terrible building has inflicted upon them. While they seem like solid stock Midwesterners with hearts of gold, there is something missing. There's a strange vacancy behind their soulless eyes as they slowly wander the noisy halls which are perpetually littered with laundry, trash, and room service trays with less than half the food eaten. 

I'm told the old airport stopped operating circa 2008 - it appears not one cent has been spent on the upkeep of this horrible facility since then. This poorly designed waste of space and building materials should actually be torn down. This building doesn't have a single redeeming quality and is the absolute loudest hotel I've ever had the displeasure of staying in. The layout is insane and I strongly suspect a 1960s American hubris along with hallucinogenic drugs were the two primary factors in the overall design philosophy of the building. 

The mind numbing ambient noise level isn't just planes from the new adjacent airport either. The walls are thin, it is close to the highway, there is constant trucking in the area, and lastly the road just to the north of the hotel appears to be a popular spot with Indy's illegal street racing scene. Did I mention that housekeeping seems to be happening perpetually? So while they're not knocking on my door due to my 'do not disturb' sign they are knocking on other doors in my hallway at all hours of the day "Housekeeping!?"

The hotel has guest laundry and an arcade, but no change machine.

I stayed here for something like ten nights in April of 2016. 

An Uber to downtown is only about $12

I got the worst manicure ever from this place. The manicurist had the longest and most disgusting nails which grossed me out. He then cut into me when removing my cuticles and it was so painful and started bleeding!!! The whole experience was just god aweful.  He didn't even apologize for cutting me (although he knew, because he said "oops". He was too rough with my rest of my nails too. I was cringing in my chair the whole time and it was one of the most unpleasant experiences I've ever had in a salon. Never again!!!!! I swear this place is still in business only because of the location and it gets tons of foot traffic from randoms. I went because they were offering a 20% discount that weekend for SB Shopping Spree weekend. The torture was not worth saving $2.

Literally the highlight of my trip to philly. I loved the whole town but this experience was the icing on the cake. Nicest woman I've ever met and the food was absurdly good. If you don't go here it's your loss.
Best hotpot place in Nashville, amazing flavors and multiple choices of ingredients to add in your hotpot.

On our visit to Nashville we accidentally walked into the take out area and ordered slices. When we asked to move into the restaurant we were told it was only for people ordering full pies, so we had to eat at the bench facing the window. Not a horrible experience but I wished they would of accommodated us. The pizza was very good thin crust but not great. I'm spoiled with the ample supply of pizza places in the Chicago area.
Sloooooooow. Fast food? Nah. If you wanna wait come on over. Staff wasn't thrilled lol. Give them a raise.  Maybe it'll cheer them up.
Italian breakfast sandwich is delicious. Perfect breakfast sandwich that hit the spot. Will definitely bring my friends to try it out

The best tacos I had out side California.. Their menus was good also.. Planing to go back while out here in St Louis .. Great job guys.. I travel for a living so there is not a lot of good tacos outside California .. This spot nailed it..
Super cute environment. Great service. Comfort food galore!!!not some where you could go too often but when your in the mood for something heavy and delicious this is the place.

I adore Mckay's! They have a great selection of used books and media. I've found numerous fantastic deals there. The children's book section has a wide range of options. They had also added things like video games, board games, toys, and more. Trading in your items for store credit is a much better deal than taking cash. Note, if you are looking for something specific and uncommon it may be a challenge to find it because the organization system is not super detailed. Overall, Mckay's is fantastic!

I  Purchased rims from them In 2016 . I was still paying on them when one got a crack in it.I had their insurance 60 mo , they ordered me a rim and tire both the wrong size and I've been waiting since then for the correct items .Every time I call they give me the run around every time my husband calls they do the same thing ,where almost done paying off our 2nd pair of rims and tires and I still haven't received mine. I've spoken to Corporate office in California and also the Tampa location still nothing I will never do business with this place again.

Get the char-grilled oysters! I repeat, get the char-grilled oysters. I tried the char-grilled, bienvielle, and Rockefeller, and the char-grilled were BY FAR the best. And might I add, some of the best oysters I've had on my life and I've eaten them all over the world.

I am so excited I got to share one of the first workouts at this new Barre Code location.

I'm not sure what will happen in the future, but it's not easy to find from College Ave! It is in the old Milano Inn building, but you enter from the back/east.  Some parking on College and side streets and limited parking in the lot behind.

If you've gotten this far in my review, you might be curious about Barre Code because you never attended a Barre Class elsewhere... I have done Barre but was not able to try the traditional Barre Code class, but I will speak to the class Brawl! It is a Cardio Kickboxing class...I felt as a beginner it was challenging enough...I probably got 80% of the choreography. And, the strength section in the middle was nice.

Jen was an energetic, encouraging instructor who adds some detail to help you get the right form.  I hope to try it out again and add to the review to talk about the traditional Barre class and see how this studio evolves!

Stopped by Thai Basil determined not to order our favorite dish...again. This time, I tried the Pad Thai. It was all that is great and good in the food universe: warmly tasty, sweet and salty, and ample in portion. Our waitress was charming and the atmosphere quaint and, somehow, de-stressifying (maybe it's the overhead, mood-ringesque Ikea lamps that change color). Anyway, I like it here and I'm coming back.

Despite reading the poor yelp reviews my boyfriend and I decided to try genos for lunch on a mission for a Philly cheesesteak. The best way to desribe this place is "meh." Tourist trap - there are better cheese steak jawns at the reading terminal market.

This store is a joke stay away. There are far better stores than this place. First of all the customer service sucks. Actually they dont even have a customer service. The number is just there to make you think they have one. I ordered a $250 dollar jacket, waited 2 business days since that is what it states for processing on their FAQ, sent them multple emails about the status of my order. They never replied. I waited another 2 days, then I tried calling all day. They dont ever pick up. I had to go through twitter and ask them what was going on. The person that was incharge of the Ubiq twitter account told me that customer service will get in touch with me. After 1 hour, I get an email saying my order got cancelled. 

I dont know how that is getting in touch. I dont understand how they can sell something that is already sold out and waste my time and tell me 4 business days later that the coat I bought was sold out. The professionalism at this place is pure shit. The customer service here is fake.

IF YOU EVER ORDER SOMETHING, BEWARE THEY WILL CANCEL YOUR ORDER WITHOUT CONTACT. THEY WONT EVEN CONTACT YOU BEFORE OR AFTER THEY CANCEL YOUR ORDER. THERE ARE MULTIPLE CUSTOMERS THAT FEEL THE SAME WAY. READ THE REVIEWS. STAY THE FUCK AWAY.

I really enjoy the wings here but won't be back until they start to follow guidelines and wear masks, especially when a customer comes in to pay and pick up their food. Other restaurants in the area are going beyond minimal guidelines in order to ensure the safety of their customers.

NO WAY this is a 4 star spot

food is HORRIBLE! worse SUSHI i have possibly EVER had.  well except for maybe this other spot but its 12.99 and its ayce sushi, and other asian food.  

First off the service is bad.  Host did not want to sit our party.  Was told 10-15 minutes then was told that we could no longer be seated at the table and had to do bar...um are you kidding me!  I am looking at the party of 7...While we eat another party of 7 was able to sit at the table...so are you ever going to remove the plates stacking up?  you put 5 people at the bar and there is no open chair. I was told it was coming...never arrived.  The people are disorganized. grilled eel-ok
tuna-the worse ever
salmon skin roll-very bad
the mountain-almost edible

I usually murder it at ayce, but there is no point.

I was referred to this place by a friend.  My previous dentist's office was ok, but inconsistent and seemed to be trying to sell me treatments for issues I wasn't convinced that I had.  Going to this office and seeing Dr. Amaral confirmed my suspicion.  Very thorough exam and explanation and the hygienist, Cindy, is a riot!  I would recommend this place for anyone looking for a 2nd opinion or anyone who experiences dental anxiety.  The receptionists and dental assistant, Yun (sp?) were so friendly and sincere.  I will not be nervous at all when it's time to see them all again.

Slim Goodies is one of my favorite breakfast spots in NOLA. I love sitting at the counter on a weekday, drinking my coffee, reading a paper, and watching the cook do his thing on the flattop griddle. I have never eaten breakfast here with my dad, but it always reminds me of him. Our favorite breakfast when I was growing up was eggs and pancakes. This combination is harder to find in restaurants than one would think. Fortunately, Slim's has the Doc Horn; pancakes, eggs, bacon, and coffee. This is exactly what I want on a slow morning or when I'm missing the family a little. Slim's gets crowded on the weekends around the normal breakfast hours, so plan accordingly. I personally like my breakfast in a slow paced, easy going environment so I stick to the weekdays. They have other good options here including lunch and great milkshakes. It's a cool diner on Magazine to have a decent meal. But I thank them for the Doc Horn most of all.

Arrived at 11:10 AM. One of the two individuals at the front door advised that there would be a twenty minute wait due to only having one waiter working.  Seems like it would make more sense to have one hostess and two waiters working.
On time comfortable and wonderful driver. Used to use Pacifico but this was so easy and quick!!

I can't tell if each chicken joint has its own version of Nashville hot chicken flavor but I like theirs best. The chicken doesn't feel as greasy. I usually get the third hottest. That one has a nice slow burn with hidden flavors. The service is a little slow but I am okay with it because they cook fresh on order. Everyone is friendly in the restaurant. I found it by chance but I visit whenever I am on that side of the town.

I see Katie at Salon Nouveau.  I've lived in big cities...and I truly believe she's the best hairstylist I've ever had!  She's fantastic at color (my hair has red in it so it's very easy to either make it brassy orange or bleach it to platinum which always makes me anxious about trying out new stylists), giving cuts that are stylish plus grow out beautifully.

Personally, she's also the friendliest and sweetest person, but HONEST which means she won't steer you into something that wouldn't be flattering on you.

Absolutely horrible! Do NOT go here. Needed an emergency crown cap and charged me 75$ for an exam and refused to give me a temporary crown cap- the literal reason why I came. Asked for a refund because they charged me for services I did not need and didn't even do what I came for. Refused a refund and walked out. Do not go here. Dental hygienist had no idea what he was doing and had to do everything multiple times to finally get it correct. Go anywhere except here.

Before my flight back to Chicago my friend and I were debating on what to eat as my final send off meal before returning home to the windy lovely. At first I had my doubts about trying a BBQ in Philly (more noteable in Manayunk), but man was I happy to explore the BBQ genius of Tommy Gunn's.

I've had some quality top notch BBQ in my day and I gotta hand it to Tommy Gunn's, when they do BBQ they do it right. We ended up ordering about 50 dollars worth of food between the two of us and I gotta say for two young men with fairly healthy appetites we polished everything off.

Baby-back-ribs. Nicely smoked with a nice rub with a little kick to it.
BBQ Chicken Wings. OMG. This was my favorite dish out of the meal. So tender yet not overly smokey in flavor, just the perfect combination of sweet, tasty, grilled delicious chicken.
Fried Mac-n-Cheese. Deliciousness in a clever corn muffin like package.
Fries. Eh. Not the best seasoned fries but consumed none the less.
Cole Slaw. Slaw as it is, nothing out of the ordinary but sweet and creamy enough to balance the palette in between bites of bbquey goodness.
Lemon Garlic Potato Salad-acidic vinegar dressing but counter balanced all the sweet, meaty, salty goodness.

Yeah, so the next time I'm in town forget Pat's, forget Rita's water ice, I'm heading straight for Tommy Gunn's to get my Philly BBQ fix.

The only problem before was that it was so hard to get through to them on the phone to place an order to-go. Service is always good besides for that...now they finally have online ordering! 

Sbhabit.com

What a pleasant surprise! Everything we ordered was delicious.  Restaurant offers sushi, Vietnamese, Thai and American food.  A great option for when the family can't decide where to eat.  Everyone there is very friendly.I wish the family business much success.

This is probably one of my favorite restaurants in Tucson. My boyfriend and I come here all the time and always have a pleasant experience. I wish they would branch out to more areas. Most of the time Snow Peas is empty, but I think it is because a lot of people in the area have never been to try the delicious food here. 
My favorite is the Lo Mein with tofu and my boyfriend always gets the Pad Thai. Sometimes they have special deals- such as buy one get one free, (only on certain dishes, so bring a friend) they have military discount, and if you check in on Facebook, they give you a discount. 
I am craving Snow Peas right now!

Not sure why I continue giving this location a chance!  Such a joke!  I know Taco Bell is inexpensive but when they cut back how much food you get it is no longer inexpensive.  Employees here are rude and managers lie to you when you finally speak to one.  This crew gives the company a horrible name.  $15.00 an hour?  Please, you should put most of this staff out on the street! I would say unemployment but they would like that.  Upper management, if you read this...you have a huge problem here!!!

Great food, good coffe, and a beautiful location just across from the Anheuser Busch brewery. I stopped in for breakfast, and my Benton Park Slinger (biscuits, bacon, gravy and eggs) definitely hit the spot and miraculously cured my hangover. However, I was burdened with a belly full of food... Tasty, glorious food.

That was served with loaded hash browns, which were just hash browns, sour cream, chives and a bit of cheese. That was kind of lackluster, but it's hard to meet perfection.

My service was decent. I simply ordered at the counter, so I really didn't get the full experience. I saw people on the patio enjoying a Saturday morning with waiter service, so I think it might be standard.

Parking is a bit of an issue. I hate walking more than a block to get breakfast, but I think Benton Park Coffee is worth it.

On a rainy Saturday after some hardworking craft fair walking, we passed Prezel Boy's.  I'm like hey sister I have that bookmarked on yelp to try.  My sister from another mister does a quick u-turn cause she's a sucker for anything bread.  We walk in and see lots of to go orders coming and going.  Plus their racks were full with prepared pickups for later in the day.  I'm thinking ok so the pretzels must stay relatively soft? I ordered a bag of nuggets and a pup (aka hot dog in a pretzel) based on the cashiers preference over the brats.  We added both cheddar and white/jalapeno cheese for dipping.  Got our order and were instant fans of everything but the jalepeno cheese.  Just skip it no flavor.  However, if you're not a fan of cheese they have plenty of free honey mustard (absolutely delish) and a variety of spicey, horseradish, yellow mustards etc to choose from and with to go cups.  That's what I'm talking about!  We ate a couple of bags sitting there with our nephew who scarfed them down.  The turnout is quick, the crew was friendly, but they could wipe down the tables a lil more often.  Next time I need to ask for no salt.  Hope that's an option. Prices are great in my opinion.  Will make great convenient cheap party snacks IMO.

Horrible office.  10 days to receive a TRIAL pair of contacts. I had to call them to see if they were in.... I can order contacts on the internet and have them in 2 days.... then I called to obtain a copy of the prescription, the staff told me that they couldn't find my chart and that the file room was a mess..... I called 4 different times.  When they finally found my file, they informed me that they would fax me a copy of my prescription.  Guess what? I AM STILL WAITING!!!!!!!!  I will NEVER go back to this office. VERY UNPROFESSIONAL.

One of the best airport restaurants i have ever experienced! Food was excellent and service was amazing! I had some dietary restrictions which they handled beautifully! My server, Lauren, was really great and took wonderful care of me. Definitely try this place if you are in the Philadelphia Airport.
I finally tried this place. It's very clean and quiet. Mostly elderly customers when i went. I recommend the crispy chicken sandwich. Service was good.

In for the first time for dinner. 
Indoor or deck seating is nice. And a musician/singer was a nice touch on the deck. 

App: Poutine - fries in a mushroom sauce with goat cheese and parsley were great!!!! Maybe a little less pepper and I could have eaten much more. 

Meals: Scallops - good flavor, a little small. Pilaf was also taste. Yum!!!
Knife and fork - shaved steak burger with caramelized onions and havarti and aioli was scrumptious. But couldn't finish it. No problem. Will take a doggy bag. 
Brisket - beef brisket with smokey sweet bbq sauce on Texas toast was very taste but a little overpowering flavor in the sauce. 
Salads were very fresh and delicious. Very refreshing on a hot day. 

10-01 Mule was tasty, but the ginger in the ginger beer was a little stronger than my liking. 

Service: Were very patient, tolerant and offering to help in any way they could for my young child who was screaming at times due to teething (sorry other patrons!) Service was pretty good. Just a little slow when we were finished and waiting for the boxes and Bill. (But anywhere may seem slow at this point when you have a fussy child. Again, sorry.)

Nice and clean. 
Great place. I'm sure we will be back. 
:)
Billy's is just a class act all the way around!!  It's just a cool, easy going place for a guy to get a nice cut.  I like that you do not need an appointment and they get you right in!!

Just had lunch there and the BBQ chicken salad is DELISH!  Perfect size, with crunchy tortilla chips and a perfect BBQ sauce with a little kick to make this salad go beyond just ordinary.  Then, we split the apple pie pops dipped in white chocolate and served with carmel sauce: DECADENT!  The menu is inventive - can't wait to go back for breakfast and a bloody mary!

The first time I went here, I would give it 5 stars. Both my mom and mother in law are from Vietnam, so i know my viet food! The pho was great the first time, full of flavor, well balanced. The shaking beef was really well flavored, with watercress and all! The second time I went, the pho was a watered down bit of disappointment. The place was kinda dirty too, with food on my napkin from some previous meal, and dirty silverware. I was really hopeful that this place would be my go to place out in the suburbs, but alas, I'm afraid it won't be.
My husband and I both got horribly, horribly sick after eating here. Never, ever again. It wasn't even good, either. And heads up, the guacamole is the fake kind.

This was My first try at Juans Flying Burrito. I had nothing but positive reviews before entering. I got a couple of Pabst Blue Ribbons (PBR) for a buck each and a Veggie Punk Burrito for $6.50. The burrito was bland at first bite because the top end only had rice and red beans. I soon got to the jalapeños and other spices in the middle and the seasoning and flavors began to muster and enlighten my taste buds. My food-mates got  Tecate beer in a can  for $2.00 and a $6.00 double pour margarita and Juan's Flying Burrito with shrimp,  chicken and steak. Alcohol prices were happy hour pricing. I will go back and try another burrito or taco for sure

Kara is the best at what she does and couldn't care more about her clients.  I've never met anyone who cares more about client satisfaction and making sure everyone leaves happy!  Will be back again and again!#manzillian

Thought I'd give Italian Pie on Bullard a second chance at a Spinach Pizza. Never ordering a spinach,feta and artichoke pizza again from them. Theres barley any spinach and they also used a marinara sauce. Like Really?? 

Who puts marinara sauce on a spinach and feta pizza? There use to be an Italian Pie on Read before Katrina, really wish they'd come back to the east or the one on Filmore.

Delicious burgers! Amazing charity.

When I used to work around this area, we often came here for lunch. It's a small little restaurant on 12th which is often ignored by many. But if you are looking for simple menu with great food, this is the place for you.

Food: I really like their burger. Their burger is so good! It's always cooked perfectly the way I always ask for. I also enjoy their chicken wraps and it comes with three different sauces! It's a little overwhelming at first because there are so many choices but just ask your waitress which 3 goes best with it. I always enjoy the peanut sauce!

The revenue that they get from this place goes to a charity which serves Nashville's homeless people. So you are not only buying food to satisfy your hunger, but also feeding those who can't afford their daily meals.

While the food was alright (I was expecting a little more punch from the Narvatan Curry), the ambiance of the restaurant was confusing. There were slick, mahogany tables with flowers on them. Everything looked fresh and new. However we ate on paper plates and used plastic utensils. It was just an odd experience. I couldn't figure out if Minar was a restaurant or a fast food place.

Enjoyed my first visit tonight with a large group around 5pm on a Saturday night. The venue is not very large and our group took up a good portion of the restaurant. However, we were welcomed and accommodated without feeling like a burden! There is individual table seating as well as barstools at the bar where you can eat too. The interior is extremely loud and I think it's because of the high ceilings and material used in construction. If you don't mind this, you're good to go, but if you want an intimate dinner to talk with others, this might not be your jam. Outside seems much quieter as an option. I have been to the Ciccio location in South Tampa and have ordered take out from this location before. Previously, the takeout order that I had was enormous!! So much food. Today I ordered the same dish (Napa Blue with Spaghetti Squash) and it was not as large. Mostly meat, which I can't complain about! But not the same as the take out order I previously raved about. The food here is very unique which is what keeps me wanting to return and try out other dishes. Pizzas are large, bowls have great combinations, happy hour specials are great. What's not to love!? Our waitress today was Danielle and she deserves a big kudos!! She took care of our large party with ease. Delivering everything promptly and accurately with a smile. Not one item inaccurate and very friendly. My Napa Blue Spaghetti Squash Bowl was really tasty and I will definitely be back again! Happy hour is every day beginning at 3pm with $3 mimosas and other drink specials. Stop by, you'll find something you like!

I really wanted to like this place because I love both Korean and Jamaican food but unfortunately it's one of those places that I wouldn't really go to again. The workers are nice and the atmosphere is chill but the food just did not do it for me. I expected a fusion with two cultures that's known to have flavor that my food would be bursting with flavors but unfortunately it was just alright. I got the jerk chicken bimbap. First off, the jerk chicken is not jerk chicken lol idk what it was maybe baked with some black pepper but definitely not jerked. The rice and peas was good though thankfully but we had to ask for more rice because the initial amount they gave was just...no. The sauce that they gave for the bibimbap was definitely not gochugang I think that's what threw the taste off mostly. My boyfriend had the burger he said it was good but you can't really mess up a burger now can you. Originally I was gonna give 4 stars but I had to take off an extra star because there were flies in there and one landed in my plate and I had to stop eating. Overall, I think it's a good concept but they need to work on the flavoring.

This place has the best food, it's fresh, organic, and so good! The restaurant it's self if so clean and they have so many plants . They have a pick up order drive through if you order ahead of time which is genius! Everyone is so friendly and attentive. This is the second day in a row that I've been in, safe to say I'll be back again and again!

So far so good... for a BBQ place, they have a nice selection of lunch items (sandwiches, etc) so you don't need to drop $15+ to get your bbq fix at lunch.  Food seems to be good from what I've tried.  Pork belly sandwich with cajun maple syrup?  C'mon now.  Mac and cheese did leave a little to be desired however.  Solid place to check out.

MMMmmmm.  Really really good.  I came right at 12 on a Thursday, about 2 minutes before the crowd got in.  IM glad because even though I researched ahead of time on how to order, it was still a little bit overwhelming when seeing all the bits in person. I would of held up the line with my indecision.

All in all it was good, a little pricey but the ingredients look to be top shelf. I avoided the guac cause I seen the guy in front of me get a scoop and it was tiny. I'll bring my own ;-)  

Even with the lunch crowd in full swing when I left, there was plenty of seating available.  The staff was friendly and not pushy at all.  

Ill be back for sure. 4 stars cause im a cheap bastid and I was tapped out for money after this lunch. I didn't have enough for my afternoon Monster drink :-)

A couple of Kirin beers, bowl of shishito peppers, plate of lettuce wraps and a spicy california roll.  Brunch at the bar along with the Rams game on a Sunday.  Definitely the thing to do.  Now these are folks who know how to do Happy Hour - 7 days a week.

The store owner is super sweet and helpful, but the selection of plants is just not there. The store is super small--probably 15'X15'--and most of the shop is cacti and succulents. Their plants are also somewhat overpriced for what they actually are (common plants you can find at other greenhouses). I love their other items (pots, shirts, macrame), but they are so expensive! I understand that the owner is trying to make a profit to run her business, but as a consumer it's hard to spend that much when I know I can find the same items elsewhere for cheaper

I definitely suggest going for the salads. The pizza is also delicious but a lot less filling. 
It's also a cute restaurant that's great go hang out in. 
Their nutritional information is pretty easy to access  which is great if you're health conscious. 
Overall I've only had positive experiences with good food and service.

Awful they let 16 people in the pool with a 10 person limit w we even told them 3 kids are unsupervised of the 16 no one came they dont care maintenance doesn't fix anything this place is awful i can't wait to move out

Native Philadelphian who is well versed in steak sandwiches. I recently moved down to New Orleans, so once in awhile (every day) I feel the calling of a cheese steak.

I judge my steak sandwiches on 3 criteria; the bread, the meat quality, and the cheese. All three here are just eh. Yes, I understand that the bread quality will be hard to duplicate when its not coming straight from the Italian market in South Philly fresh each morning. The meat and cheese quality are just about average for any place outside of Philly. It tastes like they put a bit too much seasoning on the meat that kind of ruins the taste of the meat for me.

All in all, this place satisfies my cravings, but really makes me appreciate whats back home. If you're ever in Philly here are my top 3 Cheesesteaks.

1) Steve's Prince of Steaks
2) Jim's  Steaks
3) Tony Luke's

Best sandwich you can get though is the Roast Pork at Dinics, better than a cheessteak. Go for it if you're in town!

My wife and I come here at least once a week. Love all of it. Great atmosphere even when nothing is going on. Margot is one of the best people you can interact with. You'd be lucky to have her as your server. All of the workers are great. Foods good too.

I always try new places and since El Camino is close I thought I would check it out. Very friendly service and I like the set up. If its busy I imagine the table by the front door would not be a great place to sit but maybe they will change it to a lounge. Other than that it is a good place to go. Margaritas and food where good. It is like Taco Mamacita so if you like that place then El Camino's is a nice change of pace. Its definitely a place I will come back to.

Holy cow that's a good burger.  I've devoured eight Haps burgers (patty, cheese, bbq sauce, fried egg, bacon) in the past two weeks.  I'm addicted.  The line is long, but moves briskly.  The cashier can be a bit short at times, but if you crack a joke, she'll roll right along with you.  The line is very efficient and they plow through tickets without sacrificing quality.  I do a half and half on the fries.  They don't try and make them crispy, but they are fries, so it's more firm potato sticks.  Not overly greasy, and I think they put sugar on the sweet potato fries.  Lots of condiments available including spicy ketchup and wasabi mayonnaise.  The fruit tea is simple and delicious.  Parking gets a little tight, but I've parked along the building next most times and haven't been towed yet.  The guy who owns it is super nice and really making an incredible and tasty effort to make his dream come true.

We went here because of the excellent Yelp reviews. It must be self-reviewed or they were having a very off day. Taco Bell would have been more satisfying. We ordered pretty much everything off of the menu (7 people) and a pitcher of margaritas. The margs were too sweet and the food was mediocre. Do not believe Yelp, do no go here.
Also, they don't have their times listed on their website or on Yelp (should have been a tip off to their lack of attention to detail) - they close at 10pm.
Animal lovers do not use this business! They keep dogs outside in blizzard freezing conditions.  Absolutely disgusting !

Verti Marte, you were down the street from our bnb and you were so good to us. Gallons of water, so many other beverage options (like yoohoo and energy drinks and iced coffees and tasty orange juice), delightful dude behind the deli counter who made silly conversation and a point to get our names/orders straight... We roamed the tiny shop as our eight orders were prepared. We took turns using the ATM in the cramped front corner. We stood around--retelling the last night's adventures, picking up oddities, cradling bottles of salvation in our arms--while waiting for for our unassuming feast. Oddly, you can't pay until you get your food, so there's a funny inefficient shift of customers ordering, to standing in the little spaces, to paying at the register, to spilling out of the shop to find those ahead of you in the process have half-devoured their food sitting right there on the sidewalk. Verti Marte, we loved you. Apparently, so did everyone else, because on Easter Sunday there was a line out the door for your delicious deli offerings.

I usually order stir fry but yesterday I decided to go with ordering a Cobb Salad because with the gyms closed I wanted to eat on the lighter side. So as I'm slowly digging into my salad, my awareness kicked in and my eyes zoomed in only to find a dead gnat smh. I'm just kinda disappointed I wasted $16 on a salad with a dead fly inside not the kind of surprise I was looking forward to. Be careful what you eat I guess

Three words...ALL THAT JAZZ

It is probably heaven if you are drunk. They open 24hrs and delivers within the French quarter!

I've been putting off writing a review for Tattooed Mom's because I want to be able to give an accurate description while also conveying my love for it. So now I will try:

Atmosphere: Tattoed Mom's is a niche bar with generally very specific clientele. With a tasteful painting of a woman exposing her breasts above the mirror in the bar, paintings of demons, goblins and ghouls thrown on the walls, lolipops and toy plastic rings and spinners on the bar, and old victorian furniture and race cars as seating (yes, decommissioned race cars), this place is what I would imagine it's like to be on LSD...but in the best way! Every time you come there will be a new piece of art to explore and little details you missed the for 10 times you came here, and this makes it feel novel yet familiar at the same time. I love this place for many reasons and the atmosphere is absolutely one of them. It's warm and inviting in that scary dark part of your brain type of way. Like you're afraid but with familiar fear that hides in your nightmares. 

The Clientele: This is not the type of place one would normally venture into after work- if that person happens to work in an office. That's not to say you can't, because lord knows I have, but expect the weird looks. If the above description didn't give way to the types of folks that frequent this place then I don't know what to say. They are quirky, they are odd, they are you high school best friends, they are those kids who hung out under the bleachers and smoked and listed to Pink Floyd while squares like me studied. Now, that isn't to say you HAVE to be that type to eat there. I was a square who studied, was a very good student, and wears suits to work and I love this place. It's more of an "FYI" than anything. I love the people that go there and am secretly one of them, I just also happen to be a bit too lame to commit to the whole lifestyle. 

The drinks: Beer and liquor. I don't know about wine (it's really not the type of place you order wine). I usually just stick with beer

The events: So I am told that they have arts and craft days on Sunday where you and your friends and kids (yes, this place IS kid-friendly esp. during the day). They also have a monthly comedy show called "Tattoed Momedy" that I'd like to see one day. I think it's on a Tuesday. Other events throughout the week/month as well.

and finally....the food: This place is an absolute dream for me because, while I'm not a vegan, I love vegan foods. They have vegan pierogies with vegan sour cream (!!!), a blackened chick'n veggie burger with vegan cheese (!!!) and so many more options. I mean it's like vegan late night drunk bar food! Who could ask for anything better? I've also had their wings which were phenomenal (very spicy in my opinion). I am so excited to try all of the things on their menu. Be forewarned that their food is served on paper plates with plastic forks and knives, so if you're looking for fancier then this is not the place for you. 

Overall, it's one of my favorite places in the city because it's solid, reliable, convenient, and I feel right at home. There is no pressure to order food, nobody bothers you if you're sitting alone at the bar (as I have been known to do), and the staff are the perfect mix of attentive and non-attentive in that they will generally only acknowledge you if you do so first. Check it out!

Granted, food was incredible. But the service was really poor. The server let me waiting for a very long time before taking my order, and had to wait a good 20 minutes after asking for a drink refill. I felt the manager, who was going table after table in the room, just avoided talking to me.
Ordered 2 bagels and one breakfast sandwich and all of the bagels were completely burnt. This isn't the first time either.

Generally this hipster lunch spot is always on point. The decor is bad ass and has fantastic "skate punk" art and it's all wrapped in a high end package called the Signature bldg. 

The biggest issue with the dishes as of late and overall seems to be that they are very salty. For this blunder I take the wonderful Z-staple of St. Pete to a mere 3 stars. 

Man I wanted those Brussels spouts to taste as perfect and balanced as they looked! 

Get in there chef and crack that Mexican whip of yours, and crack it real hard and swift before the new big boys rolling into your Burg "eat your lunch" (pun intended). 

There's still time...St. Pete needs you!
So amazing! Went here with my boyfriend for breakfast. Love how every server is your server. Food comes out super fast and cheap food for how quality it is. Will definitely being returning!

The service is good! I received a message after my tire change was done. I prefer message rather than a call - simple and easy, and you won't miss it. But not all the businesses use auto text message. 

I did not give 5 because when I brought my truck in I was told I need to pay for the tire change fee which has been free for me for years since I bought the winters tires from KAL Tire. The explanation was that there had been service discrepancy because no customers would bring in their Customer Care package. Then I said I should have been told about the service policy change when I called in to make the appointment. The customer service immediately waived the cost and  told me there won't be free tire change next time. I don't agree with this policy change because to me the Customer Care package is an agreement and should not be breached without customer's consent. This change should not affect existing customers with Customer Care package unless the package stated that 'can be changed by KAL Tire' etc. 
So far, I have my tire services at South Common Kal Tire for several times. The service has been always good.

We hired Chris to do a family photo shoot while we were visiting Tucson. He was truly exceptional. Photos turned out beautifully and he made the shoot really fun which is hard to do when you have a range of ages from 3-70! He was easy and fun to work with and the photo quality was fabulous. Would highly recommend him for a family photo shoot based on our experience and results!

This was a nice little spot. We stumbled upon it on Yelp looking to grab one last dinner out before the end of our vacation and the Cajun crawfish theme really drew us in.

When we got there we also found it was Taco Tuesday! Score! Two Tacos and a pound of crawfish and we were off!

The tacos are delicious! Several types of fresh seafood to choose from, with lettuce and spicy roumalade sauce that was excellent! 

Then we moved on to the crawfish, and even though we knew we were going spicy, but wow! It will absolutely clear your sinuses! The sauce apparently is cooked the same way no matter what the spice level, it's the concentration of the heat. Well, i got a good batch of spice in my medium and had me sweating! I don't mind but the girlfriend was struggling! Despite the heat, the flavor was still great, and I really enjoyed the place.

If you're a fan of crawfish or cajun food, I'd give this place a shot!
Solid selection made awesome by the fact that it's right next door. Nothing amazing, but you'll be full.

I spent weeks looking for a used car for my family and with any large purchase I always make sure I do my due diligence.  I visited no less than 12 dealerships and saw at least 25 cars in my search.  Fred Beans Subaru was my first stop mostly due to its proximity to me, but they were also my final stop.  The first time visited none of the vehicles were exactly what I was looking for (I also had many other stops to make).  After a few weeks went by I saw another car from their web postings that interested me, a 2004 KIA Sorento with under 60,000 miles and 4WD.  When I went back they treated me like an old friend practically.  The sales person I ended up working with Josh was professional, knowledgeable, and very easy to talk to.  I am not an easy person to sell to and I almost go out of my way to make things tougher for sales people, but Josh just rolled with the punches and we fairly quickly came to an agreement on a car that I've now proudly owned for 6 months.  The service center was helpful and accommodating with any issues I had initially and made sure I was satisfied with my purchase.  After experiencing a couple of nightmares of customer service in my search I really did appreciate how I was treated and handled by Fred Beans Subaru and Josh.  When it comes time to do my next car search you can bet that they will be my first stop again.

Went into Dennys to get their chocolate berry pancakes. Told the server that I would not like bananas on my pancakes. When she came out with the pancakes they had bananas on them. She returned the plate to the chef where I assumed they picked them off. When I started eating there was a banana in my pancake. I was going to be charged full price if my boyfriend did not say anything and even then they took $3 off. Totally dissatisfied with the service. Won't be coming here anymore.
What can I say.... Great experience every time I have gone in... Courteous and friendly staff, excellent service and pleased every time I leave. Def a place to go if you haven't been yet!

I'm from Texas. Pappy's has some amazing pork ribs. Goodness. Getting hungry thinking about them. They're AMAZING. Delicious, tender, seasoned perfectly. Got to meet the owner the two times we have been there and he's super nice and personable! The only thing was that you HAVE to get their early, or else you'll be standing in a long line and food runs out.. And You DON'T Want To Miss Out On Pappy's BBQ.

Gloria. F
       I had a facial with Adrienne. It was very relaxing and refreshing. It was my first time having dermaplaning and I loved it. Looking forward to my next facial with Adrienne.
Man this place was a nice treat. First the service was excellent! They were diligent and kind. Second the food was awesome. The Tandoori chicken was definitely worth the wait.

Unprofessional and unreliable service. Quoted one price, came there a month later for an appointment, the number magically increased. Don't trust this place, it is very shady. Svetlana business owner and a practitioner never there, always on vacation.

Stopped by for brunch over the holiday weekend and walked away with a very positive experience.

The structure of the restaurant itself is beautiful and set up well. We ate upstairs, which I was happy about because it seemed to be surprisingly cooler than downstairs during this very hot weekend. Additionally, there was a bar, tvs (great picture) and it was a little quieter. 

We ordered small plates to snack on before ordering while sipping on some drinks. Half of the party started with fried green tomato (only comes with 2) while the other half had the sticky bun - both highly recommended. The raspberry sangria was  the favorite cocktail of the morning.

While moving onto our meal, our waitress was also acting as the bartender and therefore seemed distracted even though our table was right in front of her. She asked for our order without giving us the specials, which we thankfully overheard from another table. We asked for her to repeat them again and we are so happy she did. One special this weekend was a fried soft shell crab eggs benedict- of the party of 4, three of us ordered this dish. No one of us were disappointed. It could have used a little more hollandaise sauce but it was a very generous portion with a side of home fries that none of us could really even eat by the time we were finished with our eggs (although upon tasting, they did have a little kick). The last member of the party got the short rib hash which was also polished off.

I would definitely come back here for the food and pleasant experience and atmosphere, despite the slightly slow service.

Soggy cold wings 
The worst soon du boo you've ever had 
And a complete rip off... and an uber eats service fee.

I will never order from here again. 

The wings there $5.99 for 5 or $10.99 for the platter. Now the description looks great, 5 crispy korean wings, side salad, edemame and fried rice... I opted for the platter which will be shown I yeh photos. 

0/5 Korean wing platter - Soggy under cooked wings. Crispy was probably the polar opposite of these things. The platter was a joke, extremely underwhelming not to mention the entire thing was cold. 

0/5 Soon du boo or Sun tofu chige- for $11.99 you'd expect a full size bowl of soup... well this was half filled and upon trying my first COLD bite of soup, it was all water. The soup broth/base was a joke I mean this is probably something out of a package. Nothing here was home made. 

I highly recommend staying FAR AWAY from this place for any type of korean food. 

Now everyone is thinking well it was delivery. The only thing that was acceptable was that it made it to my apartment in 25 minutes from the time of order. The food should still be HOT! 

Again stay away from this place.

still getting food here months later and the deliver is even faster sometimes I swear he's here in less than 15 minutes! The lady is super nice and always very sweet and remembers my order! Love this place!

I was referred to this place by a co-worker who had previously had their windshield replaced, and I needed mine replaced as well due to chip sealing the streets and I caught a rock and it cracked my windshield. So I gave them a call ( the customer service was great as well) and they came out the next day while I was at work and I got it fixed. 2 guys came out, and they were friendly, professional, and got the job done fairly quick. If anyone needs a windshield replaced I recommend them, plus they have mobile service which makes it way better.

So I'm sure my review would be a bit different if it wasn't for the timing -- COVID-19 is impacting a lot right now and at the time I visited, the ball pit had been closed and they were doing additional cleaning because of the pandemic. That said I brought an infant to this location for a baby's first haircut and it went splendidly! This infant no longer has a mullet to get food stuck in! And the staff were really accommodating even though we showed up at the spur of the moment without an appointment (hard with an infant). They offered to give us a bit of hair but we just accepted a certificate commemorating baby's first haircut instead and that was great. I can't imagine that cutting kids' hair is very easy, especially kids as young as the one we brought in -- who cannot even sit up on their own. I'm quite thankful that this place exists and I'll likely return in the future.

My wife and I have been going here for 3 or 4 months now. It's so delicious that we have literally attempted to go once a week, every week. The food is outstanding, full of flavor. The pancakes are the best I've ever had. They are exactly what you hope a pancake would taste like. The seafood Benedict was to die for. The Carnitas Huevos Rancheros is my absolute favorite dish. 
On top of it all, the absolute best staff in the Reno area. Always friendly. The food is served, often within 10 minutes or less. Drinks are never empty. Great place. Do yourself a favor...
Overall great atmosphere, everyone there is super chill and i always feel comfortable being in there, 6 tattoos from them and plenty more coming!

"It's not that it was bad, it just wasn't any good."

The Millennium Maxwell House Hotel in Nashville, TN is a humble hotel, with a bit of a faded flower appearance, but a truly warm staff.

The rooms are nice enough, although, smoke sensitive people would want to assure that a non-smoke smelly room will be available for them upon arrival.

The shuttle service is essential given that a Taxi Ride from the airport would be very costly.  The hotel is about 5 minutes of drive time to the   downtown area.

Rental cars are not available in the hotel as stated - Enterprise has closed up its desk, but an office is easy walking distance from the hotel, and a drop box is still available at the hotel.

The restaurant at the hotel, was a bit of a fright to look at, but the food, for a weary traveler was quite nice, and again, the staff was nice and attentive.

If you can get a good rate, and don't mind keeping a car rental for ease of movement, you can do far far worse than the Millennium Maxwell House.  It may have once been a 4 star hotel, but due to updates not done, the hotel is currently a firm 3+.

We came in with a party of three to get our nails done before a wedding. Each three of us had very different experiences which I thought was interesting. 

My guy was great and helpful, although he walked in smelling like smoke which was not the most ideal scent when he's going to be inches from my face while doing my nails. 

We had all picked colors before we sat down and two of us were told that they were out of the color we wanted so we needed to pick something else. I picked a new color and he brought ANOTHER wrong color, but it still worked for me so I went with it. 

The man who helped me was quick which was great because we were already on a time crunch, but he ended up leaving a lot of the primer and top coat polish on my actual fingers which always burned the 4 times I put my hand under the UV lights.
