My SiL found a new color she wanted after they did one or two fingers and they told her they wouldn't switch it, even if she paid extra for the color change. He also spent half of the time making personal phone calls and did a sloppy job on her nails. 

Although the establishment was very clean, we felt a bit rushed and I felt that the quality of service wasn't worth the money we paid. They were more expensive than a handful of other salons that had great reviews, but we went where the bride told us so we didn't get much of a choice. 

The third member of our party thoroughly enjoyed her experience but still felt it was overpriced. 

For the price, I would not return to this salon.

Came here for my birthday because I wanted s good pasta. This place was amazing and it had a nice ambiance. The food my husband and I got was delicious!! The prices were reasonable and worth every penny! I'll be back!
Just moved to Tucson, they were about to get all my windows tinted quick. Great deals on their website too!

This is one of my favorite places. It's not just a place to go eat, it's an experience. Don't go here if you're not willing to experiment and try new things because that is what this place is all about. I just go and have the waitstaff  or chef surprise me. But I have to get the ribs with ginger ice cream...AMAZING! If I was on the show "best thing I ever ate" I think this might be my pick.

Probably my best wolfies experience I've had. I came with a group after another place had their patio closed and I suggested here. We were seated quick. FYI this location is 21 and over only. Service was adequate. I had the fish and chips which were very good, but seemed a bit expensive at almost $15. I don't order fish out a lot so this may be standard. My friend really enjoyed the other fish dinner she had. The pretzel appetizer got positive reviews as did the country chicken. All and all not a bad meal. The patio could use some additional lighting.

I agree with the crowd on this one.  Jules is a staple for us.  We can trust the quality and sustainability of the food, there are a lot of locally sourced options, and it's consistently delicious.  I like the greek salad-style pizza and the edamame/ricotta/honey slices as well.  The meat slices are decent but I think the veggies are the stars here.

Highly recommended.

UPDATE (2020-07-24): Andrew, the area manager, contacted me right away. He apologized and offered me a rewash. Thanks Andrew, I appreciate taking care of your customers and your business. I will definitely be back again as long as responsible people like Andrew are managing the place. I will change the 1 star to 5 now.

--------------------------------------

The most terrible experience I had in my life. The car went in and came out with the same dust on it. I paid for the ultimate and got no service. The girl there was very rude, I showed her that my hands are black from the dust, she said you already went in. I asked her what is the objective/goal of this place? To drive the car in and out? Or to get the car cleaned? She said to get the car in and out. The whole car was covered with dust without any difference between before and after. I would never recommend this place to anyone. Save your money, save your time.

After two years in pain, 4 MRIs, a CT scan, visits to a rheumatologist, infectious disease specialist, ENT, Internist, a referral to a neurologist, and tons of advil every day - Steve Kravitz not only knew the source of my facial pain (trigeminal neuralgia), he treated me and I feel wonderful!! I could cry from relief! He's a genius and so kind!! I really don't know why no one else could diagnose this but he is truly a pain specialist. Best of all, no drugs with horrible side effects! I give him 10 STARS!!!

Great ice cream at Reading Market!!! I love their Guatemalan Ripple!!! Also love their pumpkin when in season. I love returning to this place after strolling or moseying around Reading Terminal. They give generous scoops which is another plus!

My husband wasn't feeling well so we decided to order some matzo ball soup from Grubhub.  We both ordered the soup and 1/2 sandwich combo.  Food was fresh, delicious, and quick!  The sandwich was packed with meat and came with a big pickle and a bag of chips.  The estimate for delivery was 40-50 minutes, and it showed up in about 25 minutes.  Will definitely try it again soon!

Excellent.  Went during Restaurant Week.  Everything was fantastic.  Had the skirt steak and the caraspulla (sp.?) rice.  This more than compensates for the nasty Rest. Week meal we had at St. Tropez.

What a lovely restraunt! Very intimate, quiet. Perfect candle light dinner!

I'm generally not a fan of most Italian restraunt food. Most taste like chain restraunt food, heavy on the red sauce, over cooked...you get the idea. 

This place was a nice surprise! Romantic atmosphere, soft lighting. It was very cozy.
We ordered a ceasar salad and upon request they spit it between the two of us. Half s portion was nice.  Flavor was tasty, lettuce cold a crisp! A bread basket was placed on the table with bread and bread straws. Two parmesan cookies were served  on a plate , these were very good! I need to find a recipe for these.
I ordered the Chicken Cannelloni. It arrived steaming hot! It did come with a little red sauce, which tasted fresh made with ripe tomatoes vs coming from a jar or worse made with tomato paste. The flavor of the sauce was wonderful! Slightly sweet but not overpoweringly so. I was able to savour the flavors of cannelloni filling. The cannelloni pasta was perfectly cooked, and filled with a devine chicken and cheese filling thst was seasoned to perfection!  
We did not order desert. But we were given two heart shaped cookies. Nice touch!
I may have found my first favorite Italian restraunt! Can't wait to try other items on their menu!

I love this place, the drinks are 5 star delicious and the prices are quite reasonable. The staff is always so kind and very attentive. Relatively speaking, there are not a ton of coffee shops in this area of town and I have colleagues I have to meet frequently who work nearby so I'm here every few weeks. I've never had a bad experience with staff or yummies. The have a very homey feel. If your drink is "for here" they'll serve it up in a real mug. You could eat a bowl of soup in the size of the mug they give you for a large coffee! They also serve donuts, pastries, and bagels.
There's plenty of parking. There are about a half a dozen tables so it's not a big place, but they're spread out so you won't feel like you're right on top of others. I doubt any of the tables could accommodate groups larger than 4 so if you need to seat a bigger group, you'll probably want to meet elsewhere.

[1127]

10/2020

Drool.  Probably the coolest supermarket I visited.   

Plenty of parking in this mall 

This place had tons of items to choose from.  They even had a 'wing bar' which is good on football Sunday.

I picked up way too many items.

I'll definitely be back!

One of my favorite burgers. Cheeseburger combo with drink is about $8. It's made to order with fresh veggies. There is a wait, but they cook it right in front of you while you wait! It just takes time. My order has always been spot on, too. Friendly folks!

Do not hesitate using Nola Flora for your flower needs! Great product, great service, fair prices and the most beautiful arrangement was delivered promptly as scheduled.  This was an gift for my husband, so I asked for something more masculine in design with orchids.  Nola Flora hit the mark perfectly and he absolutely loved it!  The design included a wooden box and Japanese-style bamboo support which was right up his alley.  Can't say enough great things about this shop.  I'm so happy that the first floral designer I called did not delivery on Mondays because I would not have found this gem of a business.  I will be using Nola Flora exclusively for everything floral in New Orleans from now on!

ALWAYS friendly and excellent service. The food is delicious. The location is always super busy, but fast and clean. Extra shot out to 'Katie' who is very professional, nice, and helpful. Lemonade is fresh daily, and amazing. Tea is fresh brewed! Love the nuggets and the mac and cheese. Highly recommend.

On Saturday evening, 2/8 at approx. 8pm, I stopped in to pick up a few late night snacks for movie watching with the family. This was maybe the 3rd time I've been in the new Zuppardo's as I do not do a lot of grocery shopping.  After getting my items, I went up front to find only 3 cashiers open. I waited in line for one particular cashier who was checking out another customer and a after a few minutes both the customer and the cashier began staring at me to the point I started to feel uncomfortable. I must have had a perplexed face, because the customer finally said, "She's closed" after what seemed forever. I said that I didn't realize that she was closed and the cashier snarkily replied, "Well, you see my light is out!". Taken aback by the extremely rude comment, I walked over to one of the other cashiers. Looking back, I saw both the customer and the cashier talking to each other while making glances over their shoulders at me. This was not the quality of customer service I expected from a family run business, especially since this was only my 3rd visit and I hadn't even noticed the streetlights near each register. Apparently, it was my fault for not realizing the store's lighting code system and for this mistake I deserved to be scolded like a child for inconveniencing this employee. After checking out with the other cashier I went to the service desk to 2 employees who were chatting with each other and asked to speak to a manager. A gentleman said he was the manager and I told him about the situation and how I didn't appreciate being spoken to that way while trying to spend money at their store. He explained that the cashier had been told she could go home early and her ride was already outside. Not understanding how that explanation justified me being spoken to so rudely, I debated whether I should ask to return all my purchases and go to a Supermarket that actually cares about its customers. I decided, that since my wife and children were waiting on me to start the movie at home, that I did not have the luxury of making my point by forcing them to refund me. Instead I walked out and make the mental note that I would be much better served to take the extra 10-15 minutes to drive to Rouse's or to go to Robert's the next time I need to go grocery shopping.

So let's just get right down to brass tacks. Showed up for lunch, got the flautas plate. I got taquitos so I was a little disappointed. As a side note, I realize that in a lot of latin cuisine the terms are interchangeable so it's really my bad. Unfortunately, they were way overcooked. I think they would have been really good otherwise so I might try again. I also got a papusa and honestly, that was pretty good. There was a really good salsa bar with all the fixings that was clean and in good order. The side of rice and beans was passable and overall the service was good so I'll definitely go again and if it's better I'll adjust the rating.
Amazing coffee served by friendly staff in a cute little shop. We hit this place every morning of our vacation, and I can't wait to visit them again!

Stayed at this hotel over the weekend and I wasn't impressed. I am a Silver Elite Marriott member and still got treated poorly. I'm am pregnant and they messed up my reservation and told me they would fix it and never did. Also, they have zero service they never answer the phone down stairs and therefore whatever you need you must go down 15 floors to get it. Wouldn't recommend to anyone:

Your average Delco thin crust pizza. Good sauce to cheese ratio. The service is really friendly here which I appreciate. I wouldn't go out of my way to come here but I'd happily stop in while passing through the area.

Took my rv upon the suggestion of what I thought was a friend.  Had them check my a/c unit in the coach , they recharged it, no problem.  Had them check a brake light that was out.  They charged me $50.00 to replace the light bulb!! I called and asked them about it and they said "well it wasn't just replacing the bulb!" OF COURSE IT WASN'T. 
I will NEVER go back to them nor take the so called friends advice.  After I told "the friend" what they charged me to replace a bulb he said "oh I guess I could have done that for you, sorry " 
Not as sorry as I am bub!!! And he calls himself a car guy , WTF , he had no problem spending my money

I did buy there best wash 12 dollars The worst car wash I have been to in the Reno Sparks area after going through twice my 2011 gmc was still dirty I would have understood if it was baked on but you could wipe it off with your finger . I asked for my money back and I would take it somewhere else and get it washed. I was told he could not do that he had already run it through twice he would run it through again. As he walked away he told me not to get an attitude because he could get one to. Would never recommend this place to anyone.

Where do I even start?! This place is mind blowing. This was the most horizon expanding and awesomely fun dining experience that I have ever had. I have been to some chef tastings that were experimental and great but this place is a whole new level. We went here on an anniversary trip and it was perfect. My wife arranged a menu signed by the chef and the whole team signed it. How cool!! We went with the chef tasting but also wanted to try an item on the app menu. We were going back and forth and ordered the potato beignets and the kitchen gave us a sample of the other to try. So we thought that the 2oz courses might not be enough which is why we added another. We were oh so wrong on that account but the dish was so tasty it was hard to regret. The beignets were light and fluffy with a rich miso aioli. The Caviar dish that we sampled was amazing!! It had so many different layers of flavor yet without being overdone. Wow. The flavors of the harrisa and the caviar and the crunch of the chicharrones. The first course of the tasting was a mushroom tea and English muffin with cheese. So unexpected. So good. Loved the presentation. The pouring was an experience. A bread and charcuterie board was served to enjoy throughout the meal. The pickled items were a perfect touch between courses. Next the soup came out with all of the additions in the bottom and then the soup poured in as they explained it. Again an experience with such a fun combination of texture and flavor. The next dish was an adventure. Maple Mousse with crispy mushrooms and smoked salmon roe. Just wow. The flavors the texture. So so amazing. The Asparagus salad was a neat dish. Lots of flavors going on again. The Pork was served with a Sorrel Ice Cream and Candied Buckwheat. Wow. Just throw away everything that you know about food. They had a whiskey ginger Popsicle as the pallet cleanser. Yum! The Prime Rib was tasty but the picked shallot and greens really made the dish. We added the cheese course and were so glad we did. It was decadent. Then two courses of desert. The mousse and meringue was amazing and the semi fredo sandwich was tasty. The bill was served with a candy spread. Tasty with some exciting touches. We opted for the wine pairing which were so worth it. Paired exquisitely with each dish. Service was exceptional. This place is very pricy but to us it was worth it. The only thing that was odd for me was how casual the place was. Definitely a special occasion place but worth the trip.

Greg and his staff are very detail oriented. They'll make sure your vehicle is repaired fully despite car insurance policy practice.
Our car had front end frame damage and drives like new; thanks to Primo!!!

This is a neat place. I thought it was just a typical farmer's market, and was surprised to find that it was actually also a food hall a la Ponce City Market in Atlanta, or Pike Place Market in Seattle. We were walking around downtown exploring the city during the day, when we happened upon a deconstructed tomato bike rack. I'm only mentioning this because it was absolutely charming, and a clever way to brighten up a typically boring, gray, industrial rack. Kudos to the artist who rendered that.

At any rate, this place is pretty spacious, with many food options from sweet to savory. I was delighted to see Jeni's there, which is my absolute favorite ice cream shop anywhere. That, plus the farmer's market selection makes this a great place to go for both lunch and groceries. There are a ton of places to sit, as well as a public restrooms, so once you've walked around the park a bit, it's nice to know you can just mosey on in here for a wee. Oh, and when we were here, it was blessed to just sit down in the AC, drinking from our water bottles, as we decompressed from the immense heat that engulfs Nashville in the summer months.

The food was amazing!! The atmosphere was good. The service was not so great.  We had to wait quite some time for drinks and our order came out incorrectly. The restaurant was not even busy at the time.

This place is awesome! Fresh ingredients and fun to put together your bowl. I don't eat raw fish, so I used the cooked shrimp on a base of spring mix, with all the veggies and the sweet sauce, spicy mayo and spicy crab. Delicious! We'll be back!

We bought our poor dog here after a dog attack. Needless to say, the staff was unprepared, lacked empathy and experience. A student performed her surgery which we were lied to about by the primary vet. Her stitches were poorly done, and bandages were too tight which resulted in another trip to a more experienced vet (I would highly recommend going to VCA over this place) and yet another expensive vet bill. We had to make 2 trips to Noah's in the same evening because the staff thought it would be ok to send our dog home smothered in blood and open wounds. this place is horrible.

The experience starts walking through the door, the ambiance sets the tone of a prohibition time. Seeing a claw footed tub amongst classy decor of a different time.  This is not a typical bar in any sense and that to me sets it apart from the average Rum and Coke or Coors lite bar.  Watching the mixologists handcraft each drink is where the fun begins. The passion shows beginning with the hand crushed ice followed by high end libations accompanied by fresh herbs and fruit. 
I enjoy their motto used "Pouring our spirits to raise yours"   very clever and true. 
Mandarin Hide offers more then hand crafted cocktails, they all so have an extensive craft beer selection along with wine. I will definitely be back soon to try more.

My normal cat groomer wasn't available so my daughter suggested SSGS. I got in within 2 days, they were easy to work with, very nice and welcoming, did a great job on the cat, cat wasn't stressed at all, and they had better prices than I've seen anywhere else. I had a good experience, so I'd use them again and recommend them to others.

I have been living in Nashville for 5 years. I have been to every Vietnamese restaurant in town and Miss Saigon is amongst the best. I get the veggie pho with the fried tofu and add brisket or filet minion.
Great experience with food tasting. Casual ambiance BYOB. Creative tasteful courses (we did the tasting menu) with excellent service. Highly recommended.
If you have not been yet, you don't know what you are missing. The best Cuban Sandwich in town.

Just had breakfast there. did one review right when it opened and had to do another on its breakfast.  I ordered the Shrimp n Grits and they were amazing. The grits are combined with Gouda cheese to give it a creamy consistency. Spice? dont worry they have it covered. if you pinch the shrimp with your hands then your fingers will be covered in their cajun spice. FINGER LICKING GOOD. 24-35 sized gulf shrimp i believe. Just got back from Europe and wanted to have a beer at 720am which i did. beer selection? its up there with World of beer honestly. to give you a gauge of their selection compare it to New World brewery. i read the review about the 12$ burger, Mike M if you have the chance order it. Flavor wise its better than 2 7$ burgers. i would rank that Haus burger up there with Engine 9. 
this place is perfect for you late night workers looking to get a beer in the early morning.  
Breakfast starts @ 7am. give it a shot you wont be dissapointed

My friends and I went to the Atlantis spa over the weekend. We would have had a 5 star time if it weren't for the lack of customer service provided by the staff. We got there over an hour early for all of our treatments and the staff acted as if we were a complete burden for them to get all of us set up. They asked us to share lockers. Which would have been fine, but when we asked for one more locker, they acted again as if we were a burden. We weren't offered a tour so we had no idea what was in the spa or where we could relax besides the locker room. After our first treatment, we asked for a tour, and the man giving the tour was completely unenthusiastic and again acted like we were a burden. 
After my first treatment at 11am, the masseuse  mentioned how much I am going to like my next treatment which was at 3. After my last treatment she saw us walking down the hall and said, "Oh, you are STILL here?" Of course I'm still here, you knew that. After paying over a grand to have a relaxing day, I didn't expect everyone to have such a horrible attitude. 
All of my friends said they enjoyed their treatments and we all did have a relaxing day using the other services the spa offered. I just wish the staff was more genuine. 
I liked the Atlantis Spa more than the Peppermill in a few ways, like their therapy lounge is gorgeous and the herbal steam room is better than the Peppermill. But you have to share the pool with the hotel guests which isn't the worst thing, but the Atlantis pool is already too small for how large the hotel is, so we didn't even use the pool. We stayed in the aqua lounge, which also really cool, but not great if you'd like to cool off. Overall, great amenities but I probably won't be returning.

Service 
Cigar selection
Price 
Accessories and pricing 
Upstairs lounge on point! 

What a great find... they accommodated us, put on the derby, grabbed some beverages and food and hung for a couple of hours. 

We will be going back!

First time here and these employees had a snark attitude with a rude tone. They were by far the most impersonal baristas I have ever experienced. After they rudely took our order they then scuffed at our request to fix the order they wanted to blame us for not saying "iced". If a staff member hates customers and their job that much they shouldn't work in the service industry! Horrible staff okay coffee!

Ordered take out here for the first time and the food was delicious. My husband and I live near this new location on Freret Street and were excited to see a healthy option open up in our area. It was Saturday night, baby was asleep in her room, so we thought we would give take out a try. He ordered the bbq chicken wrap and I got the mushroom and rice bowl. Ingredients were all fresh and portions were great. I felt full after but not a bad full like I just ate a burger and fries...a more healthy full! We will be back!

Overall, this place is cool. Tiny bar downstairs so not much room for a crowd, but more table areas outside and upstairs.

Beer selection: 5 stars
Food: 2 stars
Waitstaff: 5 stars 

The burger was excellent! Definitely get that if you eat here. I would absolutely not recommend the wings, though... they were so bad we each only ate one. The chicken sandwich was bland and not enjoyable either.

Had my first wine tasting at this winery. It was a nice selection and I was impressed with the level of care and information I received about each wine by the staff. What impressed me the most was when I bought a bottle of wine that was charged a bit cheaper than the actual price. Rather than make us pay for the difference they ate the cost themselves. The bottles of wine easily can go between $10 to $30. Well worth it for the taste alone.

We went for my son's birthday and everyone at the table was blown away by how amazing the lamb was. I typically do not like lamb but I was convinced to try it and honestly I would go back for the lamb alone. Everything was delicious, including the sides. The staff was quick and friendly. I highly recommend.

Went here for the first time today and it was super busy as I've always heard. I got the veggie plate that consisted of cabbage, Mac n cheese, candied yams and corn pudding along with chocolate chess pie. Cornbread, rolls, yams, cabbage and chocolate chess pie was delicious. The Mac n cheese could use a little bit more cheese, but other than that it was okay.

I am a fan. Little Fish is actually quite little -- probably seats about 24 people. Cozy, friendly atmosphere and great food. Oysters, octopus and striped bass were all excellent. Octopus and the fish were both perfectly cooked -- food was interesting and delicious. Would return.

The people at whiskey Richards were so friendly and helpful after all their recommendations I just ended up staying there and getting plastered. The bartender Dana mixed me a old fashioned and I was on my way to the moon. Dana hair and customer service were exemplary to every other bar and hair in town. Later in the evening punk on vinyl began which consisted on Dj crash playing all old school to 90's punk records and I was so thrilled. It is so hard in SB to find a place like this with character and hair better than Matt's. I was back to the bar for more shots and it quickly became tequila Ricardo's. The staff was so great at the end of the night they slumped me in a cab and I got home safely. Out of five stars I give this place a ten.

One of the better breakfast places in the city. Everything is good. Lunch and dinner are great too. 

Top of the hill is my favorite breakfast item. The pancakes are good too. 

Their super/ ultimate club is huge and delicious. 

Great for kids...

Wait usually not too long for breakfast....
This is specifically a rating on the Awful Awful.  Place has the best hamburger.  No doubt.

Ordered delivery, and when it was a half hour late I called to check on it. They told me the driver was 5 minutes away. After another half hour, for a total of 2.5 hours after I placed an order, they told me they had already delivered it. Which they hadn't. They claim they gave it to a man at my house. No man at my house, no offer to send the food to the correct address.  Awful.

In town on for a business convention. Tried several restaurants before finding this gem. Great ambience. We had a very large party and the sound in the restaurant was quiet enough that we were able to talk to people a few seats away with no problem. The food was spectacular! Our favorites were the lobster salad and the BBQ shrimp appetizers. Favorite entrees were scallop/shrimp over summer squash orzo, and the pork chops, for dessert the cheesecake was over the top best I have ever had! Great chef!

I love Panda Express, but not this location. The food is never fresh. It look like they never stir their noodles or rice during down time so the top always get hard and stale, and they will serve it to you knowing it's not right. Also it's always more celery and onions in the chow mein than noodles. I would recommend the O'Fallon, IL location instead.
Great bakery & deli. They carry Miss Hulling's split layer cakes. Staff is knowledgeable and friendly

This is not your average bar. Very nicely decorated and nice ambience. Server was very attentive. Food was great. We had the sampler with small portions of 4 of their regular menu items, we absolutely loved it. Hood experience over all.

The only thing bumping this up to a 3 was the decor and that my egg bowl was pretty good, but the side of bacon was thick, hard and too chewy and teared up my mouth. 

Sadly it took over 25minutes for our food to come out and this was after waiting for 30 minutes to even get our food order taken (we tried to signal the waitress but kept getting ignored). 
It wasn't busy at all, the place was really quiet with only three tables occupied and there were multiple staff on. They also didn't have a couple items on the menu in stock which was a shame, as it was the two things I wanted to order.

Hate to say it, but I think it's a bit hyped up and while it looks pretty and the food was tasty, you don't get much in terms of service or amount of food for the price you have to pay.

As a Chicagoian, this was a disgrace to the 'Chicago Dog'.

I will never ever return here to eat again. I had 2 ant crawling out of my food that had just gotten done. GROSS! 

The hot dogs don't taste like all beef or have that snap when you bite into the hot dog like real Chicago dogs do! They put 2 small quarter pieces of tomato which wasn't even right and one sport pepper when there should be 2. Not to mention the pickle was cut wrong...

It's like they are cutting corners to make a few extra bucks. 

Disgustingly disappointed in their Chicago Dog!!!

See picture I posted.

Came here on a Sunday a little before noon for brunch. It wasn't too crowded yet I think we just beat the noon rush. They have good coffee and a nice atmosphere. I enjoyed watching all the doggos come and go. I ordered the Miller Hotel Eggs Benedict. It was good. I didn't like how huge the meat was but everything else was delicious. It's very cute inside and out and the waitstaff is very friendly and helpful.
Wife and I went for lunch today with my four kids.  4-9 year olds.  Was great food for the whole family.  And they were so gracious despite us being the loud and unruly bunch we are.

Back up yo 4 stars from 1.  Yesterday I forgot my card when I left.  Regina, a very sweet African American lady chased me down to return it to me.  She had also been very friendly towards me at the register.  Thank you.

Want to do business for your car with an honest, friendly place? This is the place. I used to have my Subaru cared for by the dealership. Then they moved. Started having Parker care for my now senior Forester. Over the past several years, have not had a single less than good experience. The staff are caring, friendly, and do a good job the first time, AND they stand behind what they do. Their prices are reasonable, less than the dealership, and the environment, should you wish to wait, is clean and pleasant.

Meh. That's all I can say. It's not like there's stiff competition out here in Gloucester county for bagel places. Service is slow...so if you are looking to grab a bagel before work, an appointment, a class etc... expect to show up late.

I know it's a popular place, it's been open forever, but in my 4 visits since I've moved back here to Tucson, I have not been very excited. Food is kinda sloppish. Simple and not very good actually. Don't think I'll rush to get back there. :-/

Just went there, not too crowded, got seated and sat there for over 10 minutes as no one came by to even say hi. Of course several workers walked by, she even asked the people sitting next to us if they needed anything,  horrible service. I should have read the many reviews of customers being ignored, and don't believe the managers comments that this is not the norm, IT IS THE NORM.

Solid option for inexpensive pho. It was Sunday afternoon, cold and rainy and we always get delivery on our lazy Sundays. Unfortunately it took 1.5 hours to receive our meal. When monitoring the app, it took quite a while for the food to be prepared. 

The pho was only $7.00 which I thought was a good deal. I wish it would have come with srirachia for spice but all in all it was a good flavor broth. I have had richer flavor broth but I would reorder. My husband absolutely loved the fried quail. They were tasty. 

All in all worth giving it a try if you are in the area or don't want to leave yoir couch and have that awesome food delivery app.

Disappointing...Went here for brunch and was let down by the quality of food. 

I ordered steak and eggs and my wife ordered the crawfish étouffée omelet. The first few bites of steak were cooked medium, and tasted good. The steak gradually became more rare as I ate and by the time I reached the middle, was completely rare. The back half looked like it had been pan seared for 2 seconds and was not cooked at all. 

The crawfish étouffée omelet was decent, but with all the great options for brunch in NOLA, 'decent' just doesn't cut it. 

They also brought french fries with my meal instead of home fried potatoes, as I had requested, and the fries were also undercooked and mushy. Home fried potatoes were ok though.

The second cup of coffee that was served had a lot of coffee grounds in the bottom of the cup. 

Overall, I am sad to see the old Fat Hen has left for good. And that the new Fat Hen does not live up to any of the standards this amazing city has set for food & drinks. 

We gave it a shot, but will not be returning.

If I could give 3.5 stars I would. I love their breakfast sandwiches and their bagels (donuts too, of course but I rarely ever get them) but I don't like their coffee. I have tried several kinds: lattes, regular, flavored, iced, etc. They ALL have needed something else added to them. More milk, more sweetener, etc. I don't like that. I want to order it and it be perfect. If I wanted to doctor it up then I would just make coffee at home. Also, last weekend when I attempted to try a vanilla latte that mother effer burned the shit out of my tongue. I took the tiniest of sips (a good 7-10 min after receiving it) and it was so scalding I had to spit it out in my car. Seriously. I couldn't even swallow it. I was not pleased. My tongue hurt for the rest of the day and I had to wait until the coffee completely cooled then add ice (AND sweetener!) to make it an iced coffee to even be able to consume it due to my badly burnt tongue. I understand coffee is supposed to be served very hot (duh) but that was at a dangerous temperature. I will never order any type of coffee drink from them again. On a nicer note, I like that they will toast your bagel and add the cream cheese to it themselves. That's important if you're eating it on the go.

These guys are the best !  They came and rescued us after West End Lock changed locks at our house - after they left and we returned from work- our keys West End Lock made did NOT work and we were locked out of our house . The locksmith from WE Lock told us he was off the clock.  No one would respond to the emergency # on their website . Empire promptly came , changed our locks and repaired a deadbolt that was broken in the West End Lock lock change .  Thank you EMPIRE!! Call Jason or Larry. 615-662-8888. 24/7

I'm giving them a 2 cause the food does taste good but the service has left a lot to be desired. The last two times (at least) that I've ordered for delivery they have messed up it up, usually forgetting something I ordered. This time we decided to pick up our order to avoid that. I ordered at 6:38pm with an expected time of 7:03pm. We live 5 min tops from there so he left and got there right about 7. Order wasn't ready. They hadn't even started the pizza! My sub and the kids meal sat on top of the oven for at least 20 minutes while he waited for them to make the pizza. And to make matters worse, when he asked when it would be ready the lady at the counter was rude and said it would be ready when it was ready. Being 5 minutes away, I certainly wasn't expecting it to take him til 7:30pm to get home with the food. Food was fine which is why I didn't ask for a refund but their lack of urgency, customer service, and keeping to promised times means I will take my business elsewhere.

A few weeks ago my wife noticed that Ijji was slated to open a new place in the Walmart shopping center on Steamboat.  We like the other Ijji locations OK but they aren't places that draw our sushi dollars.  One of the things that makes us return to a sushi place is that we make a good connection with the staff.  And sadly we haven't made connections with anyone at either of the first two Ijji restaurants.  And in fact the one time we went to Ijji two we had a great food experience, but just no connection with the chef behind the counter.  It's been business and silence and business.  My sushi requests filled dutifully and expertly....but now I have Ijji 3 to review.

Great first impression.  Ricardo gave us the same high quality service we have gotten from the other Ijji properties.  He also gave us some of his own off menu selections, designing some nigiri choices and roll choices based on our dietary needs and likes.  No cream cheese, no scallops and some spice.  His two chef's choice rolls built specifically for us were spot on.  On top of that we had the excellent Godzilla Deluxe and the sweet hot and wonderfully light Jamaica Hot roll.  
For Nigiri we had some cajun tuna, two tasty chefs choice nigiri with a little fresh jalapeno for personalization, My Rainbow handroll was customized happily with cilantro and green onion, my wife liked ocean fire and next time will bump the spicy just a step more.   I also the quail egg shooters a great no soy sauce version, moon dog stars - a special version of crab rangoon, one order of mussels medium size and regular fare. And finally some Ikura, My thought was, freshly opened sushi bar means freshly opened package of Ikura.  I was right.

For dessert my wife had the green tea ice cream, still not her favorite version.  No biggie, just a personal preference.  I had the dessert orange, tasty tart and a perfect ending to a great first meal in a new restaurant.

$22.95 for dinner $15.95. $12.95/$15.95 children's prices.

Windows are blacked out so don't let that confuse you.  They are open.

With the excellence of this first experience we will be returning soon, hoping to build a rapport with the new guys in our neighborhood.

Everyone's favorite Iceman recently moved to Idaho from Austin and has eaten at this establishment on four occasions, each visit more disappointing than the prior one.

This past week, Ice ordered the Kung Pao Chicken, which was served atop a bed of diced veggies you'd find in the freezer section at the Albertson's across the street. 

Not cool, Rice man. 

How can you rationalize charging what you do for something like that? Not only is it insulting my intelligence as your customer, but it devalues your restaurant and I have to think embarrasses the hell out of any employees who actually care about what they're doing. 

Iceman is taking his tastebuds and his cash elsewhere, never to return. 

Danger zone.

- Got the cheese-steak with American cheese
- Definitely have had better
- Cash only
- Outside seating only 
- The have chili's and condiments available
- There's another cheese-steak place nearby so there's definitely competition. Will try out the other spot next time.

Rip off organization, be mindful.  
Anthony the technician came to perform routine heater maintenance per my contract.  He was wonderful, as are all the techs that have been sent to me but the Horizon orgnaizaion.... horrible.
I requested if I could be given a free estimate to replace my water heater, as Horizon charges for estimates!!!  He informed me that practice had stopped.  Anthony contacted his off, told me they were expecting my call, to call the number on his card and they would have an estimator come out that day.
I called the office, got a very nasty girl on the phone with a major attitude.  She told me there is a charge to dispatch an estimator.  I explained the background and said either Horizon could have an opportunity for my business to install a water heater as I collect several quotes (all for free) or miss the opportunity.  With major attitude, she told me I should have asked a different question!!  I apologized as just a stupid customer without a script as to the correct question to ask.  She remained indignant.  I was scheduled for the next day and the person that came was on time and professional.  He reviewed the quote with me on his tablet for a 50 and 75gal water heater.  I made an assumption I would receive both via email, as I couldn't remember all the information.  I never received in writing!!!

I suggest looking elsewhere.  The only advantage I see to this group is for an emergency, they can usually get there pretty fast but they seem to overcharge for everything.  i had toilet innards replace and they charged $300 per toilet.  I realized later this was a complete and total rip off.

A wonderful experience! I was in town on tour and my parents had flown to meet me for a few days. We weren't able to eat until late because of the show, but the hours were great! Serves until 1am! 
Our waiter was very knowledgable. Wine was wonderful and the cheeses were delicious. I recommend the hummus dip and the olive dip. Both were made in house and were very tasty. Lots of great beers on tap! Local cheeses! The decor is beautiful. A very cool place to sit, chat, and enjoy some tasty bites! Cannot wait to visit St. Louis again!
The Roxy Theatre is a nice theatre.  My daughter took me there to see Sex and the City.  It was a very memorable evening.

Love love love.
Sometimes I like to pretend I have a green thumb and all that jazz...but let's be real, I can't keep any plant alive. Thankfully, Terrain has fake ones which fits the bill for me!

I came here primarily to spend time with a friend and have brunch. As soon as I walked in, I was overwhelmed by how beautiful and so ANTHROPOLOGIE everything was. It was screaming Anthropologie. Silly me, I didn't realize it was actually the same company until I left the place and looked it up in the parking lot =P 

We had a reservation for 2, which they were able to accomodate us when we specifically requested to be seated in the greenhouse. The weather was a little gloomy so unfortunately it wasn't too bright, but it was still pretty inside.
Their bread that is baked in a flower pot is PHENOMENAL. It was so soft, with a subtle sweetness. Add the sweet butter and I was in carb heaven.
We both got the crab frittata, my friend who has celiac disease, had to substitute her potatoes for more salad. It would have been nice if they could have given her something else, because who really wants more salad??
I also had a cappuccino, which is average in my opinion. At least it wasn't bitter and they did a decent job on the foam.
It's a bit pricey but for the decor/ambience/concept, it fulfills every basic girl's dream(lol) & it's worth it :)

Let me start off by saying when you want to go to this restaurant you better make a reservation. You walk through the door and are surrounded by full tables on the left and right which you have to walk through to get to the hostess. There is no waiting area, you are standing in the middle of the walkway which the waiters and waitresses are bustling through to get to their customers. Luckily, we had reservations and our table was ready. The decor is cute, a white picket fence lining the wall, bright colors for the painting scheme. It's crowded, but comfortable. We waited over 10 minutes before our waiter finally came over to greet us and asked if we wanted bottle or tap water. We heard the specials, ordered a soup (butternut squash), salad (beet), and an appetizer (lamb ribs). Several minutes later a freshly baked wheat roll was placed on our plate, followed by an amuse-bouche of apple, goat cheese, fennel, cranberries and some spices. The roll and the amuse-bouche were both delicious so we had high hopes for our meals. My soup came out and it tasted like pureed squash. It really lacked the dimensional flavor a good soup should have. The beet salad came out with almost raw beets on the bottom. Not our favorite, but not terrible. Next up was our appetizer and we also ordered our entrees, pork porterhouse for my guest and the duck breast for me. Our ribs were where things really took a downhill turn. They were chewy, very fatty (which I wouldn't mind as much if the fat melted in my mouth) and the grits were undercooked. Very disappointing. Our entrees came out finally (we had been at the restaurant for almost 2 hours at this point due to very slow service) and they weren't much better. The pork was very overcooked (requested was medium-rare, what came out was almost well done), the cranberry risotto was cold and the wilted spinach was exactly that-wilted spinach. Nothing special. My duck breast which was requested at medium came out very rare, but still somehow very tough? I had trouble cutting through it with the butter knife I was provided. My goat cheese risotto was barely room temperature and tasted like pure goat cheese. The brussel sprouts that accompanied my duck were sliced and cooked very nicely (and the only thing I finished on my plate). We opted to try desserts and I ordered the mocha cheesecake (very delicious) while my guest ordered the pumpkin tiramisu (which tasted like pumpkin out of the can). We were given a taste of homemade limoncello (I thought this place was BYOB??) and waited AGAIN, this time for our check. After another 10 minute wait, we immediately paid and left.
Garbage. Can't fill simple prescriptions month to month. Garbage. Can't fill simple prescriptions month to month.

I enjoyed the atmosphere and friendly wait staff. The menu is full of variety, I would like to go back and try more from the appetizers section.  I ordered the Salmon Burger.  It was very flavorful and not overly breaded. The homemade bun was awesome...Mmmm!  My friend got the fried seafood bucket and he loved it. He commented that it was seasoned well. For him to say that being the sea food lover he is, well that means something.  I would definitely recommend!

We live in West Chase and this is our favorite brunch spot on Saturdays. Live music, dog friendly, great food, adequate shading on the outdoor patio, and awesome Bloody Mary bar. The staff is wonderful, to the point where the host cleaned up after my dog had an accident in the middle of the patio  and was so extremely kind about it. Never had a bad experience. Highly recommend.

I do my best to always try and support local businesses, especially new ones, but this was unfortunately not a good experience. Here are my thoughts on Schussboom.

The Good:

Cool building with a very impressive bar top.

The Bad:

The parking is weird. I wasn't sure where the front door was located. I think we came in through the backdoor.

It's strange to have to go and get your own food and drinks versus having someone bring them to you. You can get drinks brought to you if you sit at the bar, but you have to get up and walk to the other side of the building to get your food.

The staff was nice, but it seemed like everyone that worked behind the bar had never worked in a bar before. They weren't really sure what to do.

The beer selection was so so at best. I think it's weird that they are a brewery yet they don't have any of their own beers on tap yet. Whoever selects the beer they do have must really like Acai because every cider and the sour had Acai in them.

We ordered two beers, a soft pretzel, and Big Bleu Poutine tots. The bill was almost $40. Pretty pricey for what you actually get. The tots were good, but the pretezel came out cold. I mentioned it to the bartender and he said, "Oh that's weird." He then walked to the end of the bar and leaned on it and began having a conversation with one of his coworkers. Not, "Hey, let me fix it for you." or "I'm sorry that happened." I decided to handle it myself and walked back to the kitchen and let them know. The young lady who helped me was very apologetic and walked with me back to my seat at the bar. She took the pretzel and said she would bring us another one. 15 minutes later she brought us a new pretzel. This one was hot, but it was half the size of the first one which was a bit of a head scratcher.

Final Thoughts: 

All in all, Schussboom is a bit of a strange dynamic. My hope is that they are just working out the kinks. I'm going to come back in a few months to hopefully give them some time to get things on track. If they've up'ed their game, then at that point I will adjust my Yelp rating accordingly. Reno always needs good new breweries, so here's to them turning it around. Fingers crossed.

We have been to Pita Jungle 3 times.  All 3 times the food was very good.  Be careful about the calories in some of the dishes.  We ordered the cauliflower and it is a great tasting dish.  Then we asked about the calories.  Way too many calories for someone watching their weight.  So sharing the cauliflower in combination with a salad was acceptable.  The service was good enough.  Also, they give you a "to go" beverage when you are drinking tea.  Thank is a nice touch.  For a "Fast Casual" restaurant, we would recommend and return to Pita Jungle.

We just finished dinner at Latitude. And once again, a delicious meal. I opted for the smoked salmon special. My wife had veggie fajitas. The salmon was flaky, juicy, and delicious, a great smoky flavor to boot. It is served with chutney. I ordered it with veggies and beans as sides. I'd swap the beans for rice though. Fish just goes better with rice. my mistake. My beverage of choice at Latitude is Sol beer.  My wife has a house Margarita. They're among the best is St. Louis. 
When you go to Latitude, ask about the smokehouse specials.

Hit or miss. Lean inventory on most items but if you want a wide assortment of items for a party (especially a kid's party) or for a large food gathering (more disposable aluminum tests than any grocery store) this is your place. 

Usually only one person in the store and they often know don't where much stuff is located. You just have to go around and look yourself.

Do not park here. I parked in Lot D add stood by the shelter at which was claimed I'd get picked up. Nobody came, after 25 mins I dragged my bags to the front to miss a shuttle that only went to the front. Finally another came 20 mins after that. This service also has signs telling you to call to get the shuttle and the lady is horribly rude.

BRING CASH/NO CREDIT CARDS ACCEPTED!

The food here is absolutely amazing. It's 5-star food. I highly recommend the House Special Beef on cabbage. The fried rice is also really great. The people are great and they kept our teas refilled.

The only reason I rate it 4-stars is that they don't advertise cash only, and the dining atmosphere is 1980's diner... Very plain.

Ty was fantastic!  She fit me in at the last minute on a Sunday. I had a haircut from another studio earlier in the day and it was not what I had asked for at all.  I am not overly picky.  This is only the 2nd haircut I have ever had to have redone.  Anyway, just like with the last stylist, I showed Ty the pictures of me with the haircut.  She looked at my hair and said it would not take much to fix the problems.  She did an absolutely fantastic job.  The cut is even better than I had hoped for from the first stylist.  I am very happy with the haircut and with Ty's wonderful customer service.  She rescued me from a bad cut and did it very quickly. I highly recommend her and I will return to see her again!

Best place to bust a move or just hang out. They don't seem to have an official line-dance leader anymore last time I was there, but if you don't know how, just ask someone that looks like they know what they are doing on the dance floor! Lol. 
Also, they don't just play country music for the record! Especially after midnight, it's normally just good music to dance the night away. 
Bonus: all of the bartenders are wonderful people and super nice--as long as you're not a jerk! :)

Banner UMC is a horribly dirty place. The rooms where they do some of their procedures are not clean when this should be a sterile environment. They also call and tell you that you have to give them all your pertinent information over the phone along with the credit card or you wont be seen. I would recommend going anywhere else because the entire Banner group is dirty and they are all rude, from billing to nurses and even some of the doctors. Very sad

Conveniently located in the piazza. The staff is always super friendly and they make sure you have everything you need. The store is clean, organized, and well stocked. The selections is wide including food, housewares, medicine, toiletries, and greeting cards. Prices are awesomely cheap. Great for when I need a few items or something in a pinch!

This place is definitely not an authentic Japanese restaurant. Sushi is ok, on a smaller roll side, and a bit overpriced.  Not real sushi rice - can't taste vinegar in the rice. Staffs are attentive and accommodating. Asked for hot rice tea but don't have it. Shouldn't the rice tea be part of a Japanese restaurant?

I ordered the teriyaki chicken breast, noodles and veggies. This had to be one of the worst meals I have had in a long time.

1. The chicken was tough and chewy
2. The chicken was barely sauced 
3. Unlike the pictures, the chicken was not grilled after saucing causing it to lack a traditional teriyaki chicken flavor
4. The noodles were clumpy, crunchy in parts and mushy in others
5. The veggies lacked any flavor and were overcooked

The one saving grace was the very happy young lady who took my order. She just couldn't stop giggling. She was a new employee in training.

I will not return to this restaurant. There are many more places in the area to get a much better meal.

The service was outstanding and everyone seemed legit from the front door to the bar. 
Food was good and drinks were better.  I'll make a point to come back and bring some friends with me.

The food is pretty good, and most of the staff is good, but they are very expensive for lunch and breakfast food! They also do not budge at all - no substitutions even if you are willing to pay extra. We had a horrible experience with our server not being able to split our bill in half, directly down the middle on the credit card machine. He kept claiming the drawer would be off if he split it. (I have worked in many restaurants, and there is no way this could ever be true.)

This is one of our go-to neighborhood spots for lunch and dinner. Just about everything on the menu is solid, there's plenty of beers on tap, and it's not too noisy. A solid 4/5 only because sometimes service can be slow or small mistakes, but nothing that would deter is from coming back- just minor inconveniences. The only thing that bothers me is smoke smell wafting in every time there are smokers outside.
salsa is great on mondays. it's a nice fancy environment, but it's pricy. I recommend this place if you are learning salsa, you will find people to practice with.

Horrible.

Another restaurant that makes "pretty" looking food, yet totally devoid of seasoning and freshness. Everything tastes like it was prepackaged or mass surplus. Had southwestern Cobb salad, completely bland tasting with the waxiest tasting Avocado I have ever had. Onion soup tasted old and lackluster. Cheese omlette had no seasoning to eggs and cheese was completely bland and devoid of flavor and was served with burnt homefries and watered down lackless coffee.

Big portions of good looking tasteless food, would not recommend for breakfast.

I was visiting on vacation and I really wanted to explore the area by water and visit a island. The guide was great he is super laid back and he sets whatever pace you can handle. And if there happens to be slower people in your party he makes big loops so you maintain your pace while waiting for the others to catch up. It really doesn't feel like a typical jetski rental. I Feels as if your just out riding with your buddies. We had a blast. Saw a couple dolphins, and found a few sand dollars on the island. I would recommend this to anyone looking to do something different. So much fun.

Wondering why this place has no local reviews? The answer is probably the tourist trap menu: red beans, jamabalaya, gumbo, po boys...typical fare.

That said, I think this place is all right.  I stopped in here for a drink a while back and had a very pleasant time.  The doors were all open, and there was a delicious cross breeze.  They had WTUL playing the nightly jazz show, and it was very quiet and peaceful. I hadn't been to the quarter in a while, and the ambiance was very nice and FQ quaint.  Mind you, it was 6:30 p.m. on a Wednesday, but I had a nice time.  The bartender was super friendly, charming, and quick.  Don't know if I'll go back for a meal or anything, but it is definitely a decent place to catch a drop.

Love this place!

Went for my first time for restaurant week last year and my friends and I STILL think about the philly cheesesteak bites and how we'd be happy eating that for the rest of our lives.

The fact that I can still remember the edamame dumplings, brussel sprouts, and crab wonton tacos from over a year ago, means there's something wrong with me and something amazing about Sampan.

I've also been back outside of restaurant week and found ways to eat a decently priced, filling dinner- go for the pad thai and kimchi fried rice-big portions, cheaply priced.

The drinks here are also good, when we went for my friends' bday and had about 20 people come they made them a special signature cocktail.

 The graffiti bar is super cool too and a great spot for the summer. The fishbowl drinks are stronger and bigger than you think.

GO HERE.
Go somewhere else not clean at all prices are a complete ripe off! They played the same songs over and over for hours!

I tried this place last weekend for takeout as I didn't feel like cooking. I ordered the Panang tofu curry and Silver noodles with chicken. They were both amazing! I have been having a really hard time finding a good Thai place in the area and Panai Thai is probably the best so far.  Service was great and my food was ready quickly.

Awful! This place is in desperate need of updates and has been long neglected. Visible mold around the vents on the ceilings, dirty bathrooms. We were there for several hours talking with friends and witnessed the same food left on the buffet during slow business. I don't predict this restaurant to remain open much longer.

The mint and jazz museum was a little disappointing. Two small rooms dedicated to Luis Armstrong, and two other rooms to a few other jazz artists, but soo much more was missed. The mint had about two dozen pieces but no real descriptions of the history or how the building worked. I would skip it.
Worth the wait if there's a crowd. Got a cut and straight razor shave and they did a bang-up job. Will certainly be back

Italian heaven. The Italian Disney world. It is THE place to go. Ever since I moved to tampa bay, I had been searching for an Italian bakery. I was always disappointed. I begrudgingly tried this place and was blown away. But the pastries aren't even what brings me back. 

Get the homemade spinach ricotta ravioli 

Order a cappuccino and eat your pastry at the coffee bar

Go to the cheese room and speak to the artisans about pairings while they give you sample after sample. 

Go to the meat section and ask for a half pound of the best prosciutto they have. 

Go to the pre-made food section and have some eggplant lasagna or a fresh sandwich. 

Get some groceries there too. This is where we buy are Italian flour to make pizza. Arturo cero cero. 

Try all the pastries and gelato. I get a bag of the biscotti and I like the wet desserts. The dry cookies are the only things that need work. 

This place is amazing and may just be the best place on earth. My Sicilian father goes there for hours to take it all in. 

We make the special trip out from tampa for this place.  I have frozen loaves of their bread in my freezer as I buy in bulk. 

Love love love!!!  Note that the hours are very short. Closed Sundays and closed early on Saturdays. Around the holidays, it is packed!  Shop early as you may get annoyed with the crowds. Tons of parking available with parking attendants. 

The building is huge with many sections and exterior painted murals.

First time stopping by Rick's since it opened. These guys have great local/commercial beers on tap and have a really cool setting. David the owner is super cool and laid back. This place is awesome!! We will definitely be back

Apparentlyj if you dont biy their over priced ass protection plans you get no warrenty whatsoever! We had that piece of crap tablet for 1 day and it quit working. They say it's damaged when we did nothing to it. We had it in a case with a glass screen protector. Worst customer service ever. Highly recommend avoiding this place at all costs!!!!

Expecting a little more chicken was a bit dry for me. 
Although quick and nice staff and service 
Will give it another shot!

This was a very good cheesesteak.  It ended up traveling pretty far and held up really well.  Jem's is takeout only and I didn't see any microbrews nearby where I could eat.  $9.49 before tax.  It is a good size.  Liscio's roll, so you know that was good.  The meat was a thicker slice and a bigger chop.  It was a very good eating meat.   The cheese had a good amount and melted through nicely.  The extras disappointed me.  Seeing Deli and Catering in the name I was expecting the extras to be a little nicer.  The mushroom were visible but I just didn't taste them.  With all that said it was still a darn good cheesesteak.

This is my go to place. Employees are on top of everything! Joey is so humble and loves to interact with customers, every time I walk in  here he comes over to check in on me. Best place for anyone who works in hospitality!

Small, hole in the wall, decorated with historical photos and news articles. Meat balls are fabulous. My ravioli was so undercooked the noodles tasted like dough and the filling was cold. Flavor was good but a little too al dente for me. Lazagna is a large portion of cheesey goodness. All in all it was a fun experience.

We go there probably once a week. They have super delicious food and they are very very cheap. Just like most Asian restaurants,  the service is a little lacking. Their lunch time is very very busy. We tried to go around 12 on a Wednesday and they even had a waiting line. Sometimes their dinner times can be busy too because they have so many take outs. But again, their food is so delicious and they are super cheap. My favorite is pho( you really do not get any good pho around here) and glass noodles. Also, they have bubble tea!!!!
Good food....I have tried this place twice now and everything I have ordered(take out) has been excellent... would definitely recommend

I really really really wanted to love this place. The location and their set up is amazing. Its right on the southern part of Mass Ave where it tends to be the busiest so the people watching from their open patio was prime! The fact their restaurant has a front and back opening with a patio on the back is amazing in the summertime. 

Maybe I just had high hopes walking in but the service was slow and the food was very underwhelming. I went on a Sunday afternoon and they might have had 6 other tables. Our server actually sat us at our table and then it took about 10 minutes before she came back to let us know she was serving us and asked about drinks. I am assuming this is due to not having assigned sections and doing a rotation and she forgot she was next on the rotation. I will say the offer a "float the keg" special for beers they are trying to remove from their taps... it was a good cheap way to drink on a Sunday.

The food took foooorrrreeeverrrr. Luckily we ordered the pretzel before our food and it was really amazing. Honestly this pretzel and the layout of the restaurant is why they got three stars vs two. We also were never asked if we wanted another beer until after we finished our meals and were ready for the check (even though our beers were empty before our food came out). My girlfriend ordered the shrimp tacos with mac n cheese. The tacos I felt like were VERY bland minus the tortilla being grilled to give it a little burnt/char coaled flavor. The man n cheese was okay but had bacon bits on top and they were not listed on the menu... my girlfriend does not eat pork so this was very disappointing when she got her mac n cheese and had to scrap off the top. I ordered a brat and tater tots. The brat came covered in peppers and onions and in a massively huge bun. I ended up taking off half the bun and using just one side as a full bun... it was that big I could wrap it around the brat. Not sure if this is because the brat was so small or the bun was so massive it just was not a good ratio. Luckily the food is not crazy expensive so 8.00 on a brat that was less than did not make me worry to much. 

Overall, I would drink here again because they did have an impressive beer list but do not waste your time with food. Also, order two beers at first so you are not waiting on your second. 

CHEERS!

I received a microdermabrasion at their new location. I was very Satisfied with the whole experience. The woman at the front desk was polite. My aesthetician was recommended the microdermabrasion after a short examination my skin. I will definitely return for other services.
Wow were we in for a treat coming here. Actually walking to a different restaurant when it started snowing and we saw this cute place tucked away so decided to pop in. The food was amazing!

Holy cow! This place is excellent! The catfish was perfectly cooked! The red beans and rice, crawfish Mac n cheese and deviled egg potato salad were all delicious! Add to that great friendly service from Gabriella and this was a great late lunch. We are just disappointed that we did not have enough room for any dessert!

Perfect place to get a jumbo slice of pizza. And I do mean jumbo. I ordered two thinking they would be about the size of a Costco slice - boy was I wrong! I now have a delicious slice of greasy, cheesy pepperoni pizza waiting to be devoured as a midnight snack tonight! 

The prices are very reasonable too! My wife and I split a soda, I got my two jumbo slices whereas she only ordered one and the bill was roughly $13. Can't beat that for the quality and quantity. 

My 11 month old daughter loved the small pieces we gave her. I don't think I've ever seen her want pizza so badly before. 

We will definitely be coming back and trying out more of their delicious looking menu items.

Spring rolls!  We were running amuck as I was touristing this great town of yours folks!  And the incredibly beautiful day complete with the farmers market and bright fall colors all abound etc. Yet, I had to stop in my tracks and find me some food quick as shopping is exhausting! There it was beckoning me with the smell of  barbequing chicken skewers, but HORRORS.. as I don't eat chicken!! I headed up to the counter and to my delight what do I see - spring rolls! YAY!  

They hit the spot and we sprung up from our seats and rolled onward to more fun destinations now that we got our spring back.  (All puns intended).

I have all of my family buried here as well as my plot.. this place use to be very uptight with how pristine every inch of the cemetery looked. I came to pay my visits earlier today and was not thrilled on the decline of the high standards that were set some time ago. Please result back to not having a typically cemetery.. this cemetery was a place everyone wanted to be buried in because of how it was presented and taken care of. 
(These are areas I have notice)

The service at the Lutz location is great! The food is  pretty descent, though it is a chain restaurant, so don't expect something out of this world. Overall, I have been pleased with the level of attention and service I have receive when I visit this location and would recommend it, especially after a busy shopping day at the outlets! (If you are into avocados, try the avocado egg rolls)

I had a good experience at Lela's last week.  I made an appointment in advance and when I arrived on time, they started on time and at some points had two people working on my braids.  It was a bit warm inside (one of those 90+ days) but not unbearable.  The shop was clean and the employees were professional.   It was very convenient to get to on the subway.  I am taking away 1 star because I asked her to curl the ends in loose curls/waves and they ended up as tight curls which made me annoyed.  I had been there 5 hrs though so I just wanted to get home and was able to somewhat fix it myself.  This isn't unusual for braiding places--I find they never quite do my hair how I want; I guess I need to bring more descriptive pictures with me or something!

Parisi Speed school has been great for our son. This training helps with conditioning, strength, speed and agility. It is a great way to cross train even through sport seasons. They offer a variety of class times and days.

I have only recently started coming here because I have seen their work on instagram. I left my first appointment obsessed with my dip powder nails with stickers! One of them ended up breaking (probably my fault) 4 days later. I called them and was able to get in the next day. The only reason I won't give 5 stars is because I seem to have to wait a long time before my appointment starts. I usually end up waiting 30 minutes after my appointment time before I get seated. They seem to overbook and try and rush through.

Went in on a whim because we haven't had a decent Gyro in a long while. I cannot stress this enough- stop what your doing and eat here. You WILL NOT be sorry. The gyro wrap is absolutely delicious and cooked to perfection. The chicken platter was just as amazing. Fresh and filling. We live an hour away but will be stopping here anytime we drive into NOLA. Also don't forget to grab some baklava. It's all so delicious.

I am a New Yorker and I am in the food biz.  Although this is not as good as NY pizza (mainly die to the sauce), this place is pretty darn good for SB. CA.  Sauce (in my opinion) can be a tad less sweet and the sausage needs to be cut a little thicker.  The sausage is good, but when a pizzeria slices the sausage so darn thin it loses its flavor and shrivels up. Good alternative for our area.

The biggest downside to Boise is the size of the airport. Because it is so small, there is often just a single flight out each day, and if you miss it or the flight is cancelled (as mine was), you're screwed. Speaking with other passengers, this seems to be a fairly common occurrence and I may have been better driving to Salt Lake and having more flight options from there.

Also, due to the size, there are not many options for food and entertainment when you have hours to kill at the airport. Because the airport is old, it's also fairly inconvenient to try to find a plug to charge a laptop or phone because you've been on the phone with Southwest since 6 am trying to find a way to get to Denver.

In the future, I'll remember the Boise airport is better avoided. The extra few hour drive to SLC for peace of mind and more flight options is definately worth it.

We had a weekend trip in Philly for the Made in America festival and stayed near Chinatown so we ate in the area every day.

This is a typical no frills Vietnamese joint (run by Cantonese people as always).

Our pho came piping hot with generous portions of beef and noodles, while prices still reflect what you'd expect - cheap! Throw a handful of bean sprouts, lime juice, sriracha, and hoisin sauce in there and BAM, you're golden.

It was so delicious. Their Viet iced coffee also hit the spot.

Upon sitting down at The Front Door, we were informed they had the BEST pizza in Boise, so of course we had to put their claim to the test. I've been to The Front Door for drinks before, but had never eaten, so I was excited to try something new!

Food: We started with a la carte wings. They offer several different flavors of wings, and we tried the Thai Peanut and Buffalo versions. They are saucy and amazing, costing around $1.65/wing... super reasonable. I also had a side organic greens salad, which was a big stack of greens, topped with croutons, a tomato and cucumber. It was very good with their balsamic. Finally, we tried a personal Boss pizza (basically, it's a pepperoni pizza). It was absolutely delicious. The crust was puffy & crunchy, the pepperoni was thick and salty, and the cheese--OH THE CHEESE~it was like a cheesy pizza commercial... absolutely amazing. Now, I don't know if they have the BEST pizza in Boise (we love Lulu's!), but it's definitely worth a return trip. 

Drinks: n/a

Atmosphere: Upbeat and fun. They have tall tables & booths, TV's, and an open view of the kitchen. It's not a huge space and can really fill up, but we like it a lot! It feels warm and cozy.

Service: Fast, friendly and helpful if you are not a pro at ordering or are going in for the first time. Thanks guys!

Happy Hour Offerings: M-F 1/2 off apps, $3 wells and $1 off wines.

Healthy Hack: Their side organic greens salad is a great item. Add it to the side of your meal or eat as a stand-alone with a la carte wings.

Tips: n/a
fast and cheap cleaner in town! I got it within a couple of days nice and clean. Highly recommend!

One of the best mushroom Swiss burgers I've had! They put a spicy thousand island on it for me and it was simply delightful. The owners are extremely friendly and the cafe has such a welcoming feel, even with all the gun decor! Whenever I'm passing through the area, I'm making sure to come back here.

Looking for good sushi in Brentwood. What a challenge. 

So on a lazy Friday afternoon we went on a search. Luckily we found a place in the back of a small apartment shopping center that
Provided some relief.  Although it's a bit deceiving as it is a Korean Place. The place was empty but the hostess/bartender greeted us in her masked facade. The decor and ambiance was nice, and in the background Korean Pop music was playing. I really liked that they had several draught beers available.  I went for the Sapporo and it didn't disappoint. So we ordered a few roles (see pics) they were fresh and tasty. When you order
Two roles you get a salad and soup. This was the only real negative the soup was cold. I Had to send it back. I will be back hopefully I will then try the Korean chicken.

Incredible customer service! Seriously every person we encountered was genuinely happy and friendly, it was quite pleasant. 

Lovely salad buffet and tons of meat options, I just got home and am preparing for a nap from my meat coma. The meat is mostly good, some of it dry and over cooked, but quantity outweighs the quality here.

It's 5 Guys! I haven't been to one that was any different yet, but that just means they all have amazing burgers, service, french fries, and of course the peanuts while you wait. I love them! I usually get a burger sans bun and they do an EXCELLENT lettuce wrap! Order online to save you some time because this place is always hopping!
Margaritas are on point, food leaves much to be desired. Not much flavor to any of the menu items. Tortillas aren't fresh (hard crunchy edges). Menu is pretty basic.

This place has flavor without even tasting the food. Everything is dirty from the walls to the seats.  If you use the bathroom you will see them cooking out the back (cook has cigarette hanging out of his mouth.
Waitress was delightful. Food was loved by all 5 of us.

Yea .... fast food.... eye roll. Ten fucking mins to get my fries. Ridiculous. Won't be back.
Kids sitting their just jabbering away. While I'm. Waiting in drive through wait for fries.
Finally got 11 mins later (from time stamp on my receipt) I grow tired of it and walk in... and force the fries being hand over. I don't doubt I would of been in car for another 5 it was obvious the customer service was beyond sub par.

I had the fried chicken with fries and coke slaw. My wife had the pecan pancakes.
The pancakes were generous in size and filled with an abundant amount of pecans.  The edges were crispy (in a good way) and fluffy 
My fried chicken was good, not bad, not great. I do wish the skin was crispier.
Overall, the service was good enough.

You gotta visit this hidden little gem. GREAT BBQ & BPT. Nice variety on the menu. Nothing fancy just a solid place. Ernie is a great guy and an awesome Pit Master. Also have a little Specialty Market where you can buy all kinds of goodies. Sauces, rubs, BBQ supply, meats, sausages, etc.

I'll be dreaming of this pasta for months! Given the stellar reviews and limited availability weeks in advance, I had high expectations for this gem of a restaurant in West Chester. They were met, and sometimes exceeded (both pastas and the fish). The service was great - knowledgeable, friendly, but not overwhelming. Charged 2 corkage fees despite barely drinking the one bottle, but I understand, putting our tab around $200 including gratuity. We had a wonderful date night here. Thank you!

Best pizza in town hands down!! Early or late, they have your back!! I'm born and raised in STL and this place has the best of everything. Rather it's pizza, subs, sandwiches, wings, pasta, salad, burgers, fries, toasted ravioli, they have it! All day and all night! Cheers!

So I've been to SoFresh before, and it's was amazing, and I wrote a great review,  but today was so bad that I felt I needed to write review number two... I walk in around 8:30, order my food and it was good. BUT what disrupted the great vibe of delicious food in my belly was the awful language I could hear coming from the kitchen! They were using racial slurs and f*ck this, blah, blah, blah. Then at 8:45, which they close at 9, a women walks in and orders, steps outside and they were complaining (loudly) about her order saying it better not contain certain ingredients because they already packed them up. The crap talking didn't stop there, but I feel you get my drift. If you're going at night between 8:30-9, rethink your dinner choice! I felt very uncomfortable sitting there that I left without finishing my food.

got my septum by chaddillac and it was virtually painless! super fast and friendly staff too. was nervous but they walked me thru all the steps with bit of humor to make me relax :-) septum is healing exceptionally well too!

A friend and I traveled to New Orleans from Houston, TX for a girls trip. We called around looking for availability for a same day spa treatment and we found Embodyment. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with friendly smiles and amazing customer service. The staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed, comfortable and relaxed.  Our masseuse Laurie was extremely attentive, and personable. She personalized each of our sessions based on need. If you are ever in New Orleans and looking for a great day spa Embodyment is your place.

This is my third and last time eating here. Ordered the turkey pesto that was not "cheesy" and made with the cheapest quality deli turkey meat. BUT the worst part was the spicy pie sandwich came out with NO pepperonis on it. My wife discovered this after she had taken her first bite. I brought the eaten sandwich to the counter where the cashier said nothing when I told her it had no pepperoni on it. THE WORST PART is they brought the same already eaten off of sandwich back to the table with the pepperoni added, and hormel pepperoni at that. What did they do!?
