Put a sandwich that had a bite taken out of it back on the grill!? Between this and all of the flies in the place we will never return.

yes, it's the best we've got and I tie it with hi volt for my favourite in the city. great food/healthyish snacks and really good coffee (nice clean bathroom too! super important). I loved it during jazz fest when they we're open until 7 but totally respect their 4pm closing. the staff are friendly and seem to get along and it's a gorgeous place to sit out in the shade and compose badly written reviews for yelp so, viva the pagoda, I'm here all summer.

Such a disappointment. My friend and I went in for dinner (9/5/15) and sat at the bar. The bartender was pretty unfriendly and seemed annoyed by our presence. The bar was maybe half full, not that busy. My friend asked how the Moscow Mule tasted, to which the bartender replied, "It tastes like a mule." I just found that to be incredibly rude, clearly if my friend new what exactly a mule was he wouldn't have asked. My wine tasted old but I didn't want to complain because the bartender already seemed aggravated with us. The service aside, the food was pretty disgusting. The Oysters Rockefeller tasted rancid, we ordered 3, each tried one, and asked the bartender if he could take them away because they were inedible. He acknowledged our comment and didn't really say anything in response, he also didn't remove them from the bill which I thought was a little surprising. The shrimp stuffed with crab special were incredible, and probably the highlight of the entire meal. The bang bang shrimp was ok, and my friend ordered the Corn and Crab Chowder. It literally tasted like flour, like they had tried to thicken it, but were unsuccessful. I thought it was absolutely disgusting. The crab fried rice was also nothing to write home about. Overall, really really disappointed with the entire experience. I will probably never return to a Bonefish again.

Hi staff is so nice and friendly. Trianna at the front desk was so helpful and made sure our stay was excellent,  great location to everything you want to see in city. 

Double queen room a little small for two, but made it work. Nice beds and service.

I couldn't pass up on trying the original hot chicken, and you probably shouldn't either! Waited about 40 minutes, but it was worth it. And come on guys, it's not THAT ghetto. I've seen worse, although granted I did go during daylight hours. Someone really should empty the fly-ridden garbage cans outside though. Friendly service, but you have to buy your own drinks (or water) from a vending machine. 

Medium spiciness definitely had a kick. I wouldn't go any higher. Seemed a lot greasier than other chicken places (particularly Bolton's) but that did not detract from the tastiness. Good sides too, although the hot baked beans (temperature wise) did nothing to temper the spiciness from the chicken.

Also, a random chinese guy materialized in front of us and asked for help ordering. Last thing I'd have expected at a place like this, but apparently people travel around the world for this chicken.
Thank you so much for providing the pick up service during this pandemic.  So happy with my order of healthy herbs & tomatoe plants. I'll be ordering my flowers in a couple wks.
Better than I expected. The Yucca Fries are one of my favorite foods on the planet. TOP TEN!

NEVER EVER GO THERE!!!... They are very UNPROFESSIONAL and SLOW!!!!... I've been there twice and both times never got services even with an appointment made with JIMMY "OWNER".. He's picks and chooses who he wants to service next, regardless how long you've been waiting. I would love to write a review about the performance of the job, but never made it that far..  I guess I wasn't as important as the next customer

This place has some of the best pizza in town. It is in the NY style and just delicious.  The restaurant itself is rather tiny but there are a few tables inside to enjoy your meal. In addition to pizza, sandwiches and salads are available as well.  The pizza is the standout here.  The workers are friendly and the pizza is consistently good.
Went today for first time ever.  Wish I had went before. Found some great philosophy products- enjoying the lotion on me right now. Bought so nice soaps. Great local shop.

If I only come to New Orleans and eat here, my entire trip would be worth it! I have looked at so many YouTube videos about this place, and couldn't wait to finally try it! We got there early 10:30 they open at 11am. Once getting out of the Uber there were tons of people already waiting. There's a QR code on a sign outside which you scan, then add your name to the waitlist. At first the waitlist said three hours but immediately changed to minutes. It didn't matter to me, I would have waited the 3 hours, I didn't come all the way to New Orleans to not have lunch here. The wait went very quickly because of all the people waiting outside are very nice, met some guys who always come here from Texas. The cook came outside at 11 to let us know there's a delay because he is waiting the chicken batter delivery, but he was very funny, stood in the middle of the street and ask everyone where they were from. Once inside out waiter was the sweetest man ever! So soft spoken, and always smiling. Each of us got the chicken plate of course, white meat, I had mine with mashed potatoes and had shrimp on the side with macaroni and cheese. My friend had hers with the buttered beans and rice. 

You ever heard the food is so good you want to slap your mamma? Well that's exactly how to describe the food here! Jesus Christ the chicken was delicious, now I've had some good friend chicken before in my life but I have no idea what they are doing in the kitchen here! The outside wasn't just seasoned but so was the inside, it was so crispy and juicy! Had a hint of spice but not too much. I usually prefer macaroni and cheese over mashed potatoes but here.....the mashed potatoes are absolutely outstanding! With the gravy on top, don't get me wrong the macaroni and cheese is also good, but the potatoes takes the cake! The buttered beans with rice, which I never had before were also so good! 

Cornbread so moist....fresh....delicious....not dry at all! 

I have no idea how we had room after all this but we had to try the bread pudding, it was so good my husband ordered a bread pudding at every restaurant we went to afterwards, but it was never like here! Willies was always number one! 

It was so good we tried to go back on Sunday but when we showed up and seen no one outside we realized it was closed. Major bummer!!!!! 

Overall this place is a New Orleans staple, that's why it's been there forever, and believe me I will be back!!!!!

This is indeed as good as it gets, in Reno.

I regularly stay here on my way back home from Burning Man, to wash off the dust, enjoy the spacious hot tub looking over West Reno, to work out at the gym, to entertain myself in the tacky casino (all casinos are tacky) and to sleep.

The staff are always helpful and most recently I had a problem with the ATM in the front lobby and a cleaning lady helped me out (if it doesn't work, it will on the second try).

The only negative thing I can think of is that you have to pay $10 for Internet per day but you can pick up the odd free wi-fi in the area by chance, or go to a place nearby to pick up free net access. And sure, there are some working ladies and rug dealers in the area, which is expected near casinos. Because where there are tourists and money, crime naturally exists.

Other bonuses to staying here is that it's a block and half away from the Greyhound bus station, close to the Truckee River and a few restaurants in the building. I'll continue to stay here, but I'll always ask for the Empress tower because that's where the hot tub is.

First thing that hit me when I walked in the door was "that smell".,,, the smell that makes you question the cleanliness of a place, ya know kinda musty. Entering the main entrance, there is a bar to the left  a dance floor center (along with table seating) and the sushi bar to the right. I sat at the sushi bar and found the dude was un-attentive. It was all about the to-go orders or the orders for the few other people in the place. There was a sushi special when I was there, 2 for 1 that he didn't bother to mention either, among the lack of customer service attitude. The sushi was OK but it was coming apart because he put it together in about 45 secs...I guess so he could get back to the to-go orders.

My mom and I went on Tropics dolphin cruise this past Sunday. We had a great time, crew was friendly and weather was amazing. No Dolphins, but we get to come back and cruise free until we do see them. I'm originally from Clearwater and moved to NYC about 10yrs ago. I miss FLA and this was a great way to reconnect with the city and all it has to offer. Will definitely cruise with Tropics again.

I consider myself a little bit of a "foodie" .. If you like Mexican food and you're in Tucson you have got to stop here. The Carne Asada Package was amazing and the Mitchelada may have been the best that I have ever had. 
I almost did not go in because there was no cars in the parking lot...... I am so glad I did go in.

La Dra. Mayra Lopez es EXCELENTE! Es muy amable y atenta con sus pacientes. Se la recomiendo a todas las personas que estén buscando un doctor de familia en Tampa, FL. Definitivamente seguiré atendiéndome con la Dra. Lopez. 

Dr. Mayra Lopez is an EXCELLENT family doctor! She truly cares about her patients. I definitely recommend her to everyone who is looking for a family doctor in Tampa, FL. I will definitely come back!

I had an electrical problem and called Electrical Plus and they were able to come over almost immediately. Loved Jeremy - he was polite, on time, and solved the problem.  They did need to come back for a second time to fix a secondary problem, and it was over $500 total bill which absolutely crushed me this month, BUT I don't know what the going rate is for these types of trouble shooting issues.  I would highly recommend for any emergency/troubleshooting issues, they were great. Jenna handled my scheduling, and invoicing and she was a pleasure to work with as well.

On our first visit, we had high hopes. Although my expectations were not met entirely, I will return again. Slices of pie and cake are around $7 but they are large portions (easily shared). I ordered the white chocolate cheesecake which I was told is a customer favorite. I was asked if I wanted a berry sauce and opted for it. But, it had alcohol and it was very strong. Had I known, I would have opted not to add the sauce. They were very accommodating and quickly served up a plain slice for me. Both my husband and I really loved it. My husband got a slice of turtle cake. The actual layers of cake itself was very good - moist, good flavor but overall, the cake was very bland. No strong taste of what you would expect in a turtle cake - carmel, more chocolate. I do think that probably it is hit and miss with the menu. I'm sure that items will improve too. I love that they are open late and the atmosphere is top notch. We did feel pressure to order right away as the woman kept following us up and down the counter talking about every single item. We would have preferred a little time to peruse and look without feeling like we were followed. I would recommend giving this place a shot and stick with customer favorites for the time being. I still have high hopes for Frona Mae!
The best pad Thai in Nashville!! I've tried so many places but this is always consistent with their food. The spring rolls are fire also!! Definitely have it all the time!!!

The best wing place I've ever been to. Me and my buddies used to always go there every single weekend to get their immaculate wings. The red hot riplets wings with their loaded fries were my favorite meal. I wish they were still open because my friends and I always try to go there when we link up during college breaks. There wings are perfect and I pray that they open up again soon.

The food was pretty good but I ordered through Grubhub and they left out 2 orders of fries and 2 cookies. I called and they said, "what do you want us to do?" I said I'd like to be refunded for the fries and cookies. They told me they couldn't do that and apparently Grubhub can't either. Poor customer service.
They also didn't even put my order in until my delivery person had shown up to pick up the food. So it ran almost 30 minutes longer than it should have.

We came to Indy for a special occasion on a Wednesday night.  We called to inquire about parking.  We were told we could valet park at the Hilton for$14.  It ended up costing us $46.  Then we had to wait over an hour and a half after ordering for our food.  We ended up being late for our concert.  The food, once we received it, was good. However the timeliness of the service left a lot to be desired.

Amazing tacos. Really inventive combinations. Last night it was a poke taco with tuna, seaweed salad and topped with generous slices of avocado. Homemade salsa bar is inventive (guajillo peanut). Fresh cantaloupe juice is delish. A must go. Open till 2 am on weekends is a huge + !

Building & staff...
I came here to see A Raisin in the Sun. The production was amazing, from costume to actors. The actual theatre is very cozy, and despite how small the space was, the set was nicely done. The bartender and ushers were very nice. 

One warning about the theatre is that there's no way you can get a potty break. I suppose you could, but it'd be extraordinarily awkward. Just wait till the break. 

The drinks & snacks...
They serve wine, water, and soda. Of course, it's overpriced.  There's also snacks to be had like crackers and such. 

Overall, I loved this theatre. It wasn't what I thought it would be, but it was pretty awesome.
I thought that I was going to get a great down home meal before I got on my flight. I did not. It was pretty blah. I could have saved my money and went to subway.

I came here on a quiet Wednesday night with the family. I wanted to try this place again after going to the UK location. We ordered the 4 robatayaki combo : Land, air, garden and sea; each came with a vegetable of the day. I do like the concept of the wording on the menu. I recalled that I asked the waitress what was the vegetable of the day and she say "mushroom". However one came with mushroom, another came with asparagus and another came with eggplant and the "garden" one was missing the extra vegetable. It would've been nice if the waitress was more vocal about the dishes especially when there wasn't many customers around.  But overall food was fresh and delicious so I didn't mind at all. I ordered the American street roll and the waterfront roll. I love the fresh sushi; the sushi itself deserves 5 stars. For the robatayaki, I recommend the short ribs and the avocado. A bowl of rice is $3 but I have been noticing that a lot of restaurants are charging for rice so don't be wasteful.

I can't say enough about how well this place is run. Incredibly friendly staff, clean property, low rates, great location, gate security, moving tools available, etc. Shelly set me up with a perfect unit and I was all set in no time. I feel great about my decision to move into Vassar Self Storage!

Ordered food to go , it was cold . Everything was cold . I only have a 30min lunch break , so I didn't go back to return it. I did not enjoy it at all one bit. Pretty upsetting. I payed $20 something for food and drink . The drink tasted pretty flat , no flavor. Plz go somewhere else for Mexican. Los Arroyos or Los Agaves is better and tastier. I rather do NO STARS on this place , but looks like I have too . Sucks I payed soo much and for nothing. I am not returning, however I will let my friends and family know my situation there .

This was an amazing experience all around. Levi, our server, was absolutely awesome and attentive. He suggested the deep dish and even explained the wait time. We also tried the sweet and spicy wings, which were definitely something we will be back for. The establishment was very calm and clean. Definitely worth 5 stars. We will be back for sure!

BUYER BEWARE the salon was closely located To my home and looked very nice inside .... however my hairstylist was abrupt not personable and frankly pretty rough with a hair brush ... at first the hair cut and dye job were nice enough def not worth the price tags but I was accepting of it but I wasn't furious  until I got home and noticed all the dye left on my skin I usually go to edge but unfortunately I needed a last minute  dye job not only were they were more professional personable and a good hair cut and dye they  never left dye on my skin and they never had a whooping price tag of 248 dollars outrageous will never be going back

Moro is a great place for a special occasion. It's a little on the pricey side but they often have living social coupons which we'll take advantage of to offset the price.  Take note that the menu listed online pretty much never matches what the restaurant menu actually is.  They do always have a wonderful tapas menu, but our go to order is for steaks.  They used to feature 2 steak "specials" but our our recent visit they changed it to an a la carte option.  
My favorite starter is the Caesar salad, due to the amazing polenta croutons. They don't charge for sharing and will put it on 2 plates.  This time around my husband got the filet and I ordered the Kobe pork chop.  We shared the parmesan Mac & cheese, the bacon Brussels sprouts and the whipped potatoes. All three were outstanding!!  His filet was amazing. My pork chop was a tad chewy and the iberico pancetta sauce was tasty but the ham was really tough.  
We'll go again and again. Great service and amazing place.

I never review anything.  I am naturally lazy and really don't care too much, especially in regards to a national fast food chain.  If you've been to one Wendy's you have been to them all, right?  So, the fact that I've gone out of my way to log on and find a way to give this particular location a bad review is shocking, even to myself.  However, my experiences here have been so bad that I wanted to take some action. 

 I wouldn't have thought that the few minutes of interaction I have in a drive up window could be so negative that days later I am still frustrated. Every time I come here, the staff makes me feel like I should apologize to them for inconveniencing them.  They are rude and don't make any attempt to hide it.  I don't know why this location is so terribly bad but if you feel like your day is going too well and you want to soak up some negative energy this place in Eagle is just what you are looking for.

I visited for a consult and the PA who saw me was wearing a poorly fitting cloth mask. She told me when I asked that she was not vaccinated, but had recovered from Covid and tested frequently. After 10 minutes of explaining different injectables she had drawn up an injection, even after I told her I hadn't signed a consent, and when I decided to 'think about it'  she injected it back into the bottle. At no time did she wash her hands, but had gloves on when I walked in.
I gave 3 stars because the staff was friendly, the place looked clean, and it was easy to get an appointment, but the other issues were concerning. I also asked if there were any specials and she failed to mention the 1st time visitor $50 off promotion.
Caveat emptor.

The worst facility a pregnant can go to. Every single office the receptionist are ruder than the last. They are condescending, stuck up & honestly don't care. As far as doctors they get you in and out, don't really answer concerns or questions. I would choose another clinic than any one of EXODUS. They all run the same!!!!!

This place is a great place to go and enjoy the day. The mansion, gardens, art, and walking trail are all worth the trip!

I am not much of a museum guy but I must say this place keeps your interest. There is always something neat to see no matter what season it is. I also enjoy the fact that there is a restaurant " the pineapple room" on site to top of the walk. Can't wait to see the glass sculptures next time I visit!

I have to say that my kids thought it was the best thing ever.  However as a parent it was a little scary.  There are no maps provided and you never know where your kids will end up when they enter an area.  Some areas were very dark and I was unnerved trying to keep up my two kids. Very few staff members available and I spent the day worried my kids would be lost.

We were there for over two hours.  Lots of dead space and I don't know why it's even called a museum.  One room has a variety of bugs in cases and that was the only thing museum like there.  We paid $5 extra to be on the roof and the Ferris wheel was fun.

There was a threat of rain but there was none and they had closed all of the outdoor slides.  That was disappointing after paying over $70 for our family of four.

I can't disagree with any of the raves in the other reviews, save one, and for me it's a deal killer (maybe for you as well).   Tipitina's is NOT a smoke free environment, regardless of the policy.

We went to see Galactic on a Friday night, and while the DJ got the crowd going, I was just lovin' life in this awesome venue.  In the break before the band started, the crowd started lighting up.  When I politely let a guy near us know that there was no smoking inside, he explained to me that "the rule only applies to cigarettes, it's a New Orleans thing".  That certainly has not been my experience in other 'let's be totally clear' smoke-free establishments in NOLA like d.b.a., but this was most certainly a lot different crowd (about 40% Bourbon street mixed with 40% local and 20% people looking to hear good music).

I was hoping just moving away from the one group would solve the problem, but it was pretty endemic, and after just three songs my asthma kicked in so hard I had to leave the show (and drag my husband out with me).  

BTW - the staff made no effort whatsoever to enforce the policy; I saw no sign of security even at the door (unless the 90-pound blonde chick in the pink Power Ranger outfit was actually not just wearing a costume!).

Poor Happy Dragon! They've caught some flack on here. I can't speak to anyone else's experience, but mine have always been STELLAR! I will say that I have never dined in, I work in Fishers so I have them deliver occasionally. I can't bring myself to try anything aside from the Sesame Chicken and Pork Egg Rolls because they are just so good. I mean, LOOK at that sesame chicken! It's incredible. 

Happy Dragon is fantastic at what it is, pretty quick Chinese food. My experiences are, again, limited but I would seriously encourage you to give them a try.
Staff is great.  Really friendly.  They make you feel welcome. Doctor is also great.  Never really was a big fan of going to the dentist, they changed my view.

Do not come to this place. I got a cleaning and had front tooth filled. The front tooth was unnoticeable minor chip you could barely see. Now I'm not sure what they did but after a week or so it ripped an extra big chunk from tooth and just fell out. I still don't get it. They should have never did it in first place. I went back to them an guy at desk says "well I can put a cap on for $500". WTF. Not even offering to fix it. Sounds to me guy tried to hustle me. Not cool prime time. DON'T GO TO THESE SHADY FOLKS.
Yummy! Yummy! I got a scoop of the tiramisu and the pistachio. They have so many flavors including sorbets. Conveniently located in the International Plaza, but no indoor seating.

I spoke with David Glassner about viewing a place to rent and he seemed very helpful and responsive at first. He ended up standing me up for the viewing TWICE! I would NEVER rent from someone who is so disrespectful to people who haven't even signed a lease yet! I have heard nothing but horrible stories from a friend who rented with them as well. Avoid at all costs!

The only boba shop around the new tampa area and luckily it's amazing (tbh it's been my favorite ever since I tried it!) 
Drinks are custom made from the flavor, type of tea base, toppings to the amount of sweetness. There are a few popular drinks to choose from as well. 
The music they play is soothing, the shop is aesthetically pleasing and service is always great. One of the things I love most about Sweetea is the tiny speckles and amount of ice that they use - their large sized drinks are actually a large :)

Looking for a good location for a mini Cinco de Mayo lunch with co-workers we chose Vida. The hostess was quick to accommodate our group of 7. Our waiter was courteous and happy to oblige when we told him we only had a lunch hour and we needed to be quick. He swiftly brought our drinks along with baskets of chips and salsa. Once we ordered,  our food was delivered to our table what seemed like moments later. The food itself was beautifully presented and just as delicious as it looked. The waiter gladly split our bills into individual tabs and was quick to run our cards and return them to us. While it was a quick meal everyone at our table was very pleased with the service, the food, and the overall atmosphere. We will return, whether it be for a quick lunch or a fun night out with friends.

This place was so much fun!! I definitely recommend for large parties, groups of friends, work parties etc. They give you your own coach and you can bring in your own booze! They taught us a bunch of axe throwing games, styles of throwing, trick shots, etc. if you're looking for something fun an different to do, this is definitely it!

We enjoyed a very good dinner at The Southern while visiting Nashville.  We made same day reservations on a Saturday and were able to get an 8:00 PM table for two.  We started with some oysters from the Raw Bar menu.   They were all perfect.  No grit or overly brine-y taste.  I ordered the chicken fried chicken which was served over Mac and cheese and collard greens.  My husband got the dry aged New York strip steak which came with whipped potatoes and green beans.  Both entrees were cooked and seasoned perfectly.   My only complaint is that my Mac and cheese was a tad cold.  We ordered peanut butter pie to go which was also delicious.

I'd been hearing wonderful things about Embellish for many years and finally made time to stop there today! It is currently open from 11am-3pm. 
I was on a mission for a gift and had something specific in mind (featured on their Facebook page). I walked in and was warmly greeted. I found the cactus ring holder and explained I was mailing it and asked for recommendations so it remained intact. I was so taken care of with suggestions and extra bubble wrap for safe keeping. If I wasn't on a time crunch, I could have spent hours in this darling shop. It is full of lovely items and a perfect place to find a unique gift. I look forward to my next visit of exploring fun finds!

Some random dude at a bar we were at told us to go here when he found out we were from out of town. What kind of tourists would we be if we didn't check out some drunk guys recommendation. So glad we did. 
The sandwiches had enormous servings of meat, came with chips and pickles. The pickles were so good I had to ask for extras. 
The meat was hot and delicious. The bread fresh. Everything was really good. 
The place was a bit dark, and even though they had some arcade games, i wouldn't exactly say that this is "good" for kids.  It would be fine, I'm sure but we were glad we came without the 3yr old. 
We came for lunch on a Tuesday. Service was good, good came quickly and soda was refilled when needed. 
Really wish we didn't live on the other coast of the country.
Such an amazing happy hour! Great service and amazing margaritas!! The chips and salsa are great and it's such a good location. Try this place!
Loved the atmosphere and the farm to table concept! I thought the vegetable wall was a cool idea. Our waitress (I think her name was Sarah) handled our large party expertly!

We stopped in today about 1:00 & no one would acknowledge that we were there. I Had to ask to be seated. They gave one menu for three people. Did not bring us anymore menus when requested. The chips were stale and the table had dried food on it. The floors and walls had a long term dirt and grime build up. Service was terrible and seemed to be annoyed to have to do anything. We won't go back and recommend every one to stay away. 
Just to be clear, I paid for a ice tea and we left without eating their food

Loved it!  That is my kinda breakfast!

Bacon - A+
Blueberry pancakes - A+
Eggs - A+

Wonderful!

Baja Cafe was so delish! I had the Pineapple Express comb . Which more enough food. The pancake was so  soft but crispy on the outside. The sauce on it was so delish it was a shame . I thought I escape to topical island. The server was so helpful and pleasant to talk with. I really enjoy my food. So did my family member as well.

Five star pizza always with 1-2 star service on most days.  The best pizza outside of NYC.  I just wish they could have left the typical NYC "soup-Nazi" attitude on the East Coast.  The perfectly charred & seasoned thin crust pie is so consistently amazing, that I will do my best to ignore the ambivalence (if not open contempt) with which they treat their customers.  The employees are clearly enjoying one another's company.  Its just too bad we seem to ruin the day by walking through the front doors.  Best advice I can offer is to call in your to-go order ahead of time, and enjoy a pizza unlike any other available in Reno....at home.  That way, you only have to endure a disinterested voice on the phone for a few brief moments (yes, this has happened more than once as well).   All things considered, I admit the pizza is worth the hassle.....so far.

What great taste and value!  I went with 7 others and we had a variety of items - tacos, enchiladas, fajitas, and more.  Every dish had it's own great taste, was served hot, and came in portions that left everyone full or with left overs.
Great service. Excellent atmosphere. Coffee is the best, iced tea is amazing. Is there any better place on a Saturday morning for us local people? Prob not..

I came here for dinner with my man and I was looking forward to some yummy sushi,

This place was pretty good. The server was nice and the manager stopped by the table to see how everything was going throughout the meal.

I got the udon noodle soup. Tasted pretty gross so I told the server and he took it away and took it off the bill.

I got the salmon roll and a seaweed salad
my guy the avocado roll and the sweet potato roll.
both were good, the prices werent outrageous.

They take the whole order on an i pad and you sign your bill that way too, 

cool and with the technological times.
Good service, a bit slow and not even busy yet but the food is as great as any of their locations! Definitely will come back as my office (new location for us) is not far away.

Don't get you're car towed by these guys, they will friggin charge you an outrageous tow fees and $80.00 a day storage. Get your car ASAP because they will screw you over big time! Oh, if you want to get your car out on a weekend they charge you extra to have some moron tow truck driver set your car free. Beware this place will rip you off and not even bat an eye, crooks!

Cafe Zuppa was a lunchtime favorite of mine, even before we moved our offices two blocks away! I often get the panini and salad combo. They have great daily specials and their Sunday brunch is the best one I've found downtown yet!

I was craving for some jamaican food and found this restaurant on yelp so my husband and I drove to this place. This place is next to a Mr. Tire and is in a small shopping center. It turns into a night club at night and I guess we came when it was switching from a restaurant to a night club. It was a little weird but after our initial WTF moment, we sat down at a table and was helped.

We ordered a feast! I had a two item plate with goat curry and ox tail. My husband had the three item plate with the curry chicken, ox tail, and jerk shrimp with vegetables. We also ordered the spicy beef patty, and pork ribs.  EVERYTHING was DELICIOUS BUT the jerk shrimp. A tip our waitress shared with us was to dip our beef patty into the ox tail sauce, OMG best idea ever! 

We've been trying to plan a trip back to this place since we left and that was over a month ago. But we feel silly if we drove two hours just to eat and then come back but it's crossed our mind plenty of times.

I don't get how restaurants aren't highly focused on the guest experience?? I walk in (first time at a Noodles & Co) and never get acknowledged until I order, I have to hunt around for a clean table and then the person delivering my food just drops food off and walks back to the expo area. The restaurant is a mess, only two guests and it's 4pm on a weekday and none of the workers care about lifting a finger. Also, if you have a promotion sign that states "go ahead and peek into our kitchen" you better have a clean kitchen. Maybe I just have higher expectations than Noodles and Co.

Do not, I repeat do NOT do business here. The entire staff is welcoming and supportive prior to sale (as all good sales people are). The moment they got our check our calls went to voicemails, emails didn't get replies. We're almost two months post purchase and still don't have the check for the money we gave them to pay state taxes and registration. When we call and finally get a person, half the time we are hung up on. Save yourself the headache. DO NOT DO BUSINESS HERE. Sounds great, until you have expired tags because the finance department doesn't know how to do simple math, check their mail or return calls!

I've holding off writing this review, hoping that time would heal my experience, but to no avail.  Bottomline: it just wasn't very good.  I am addicted to Chinese buffets.  I like Chinese food and I'm a Midwesterner, ergo the addiction.  I made a list of all the Asian buffets in St. Louis and set out to visit all of them.  This was one of the ones that I had never been to ... so I went.  It's a big place but it was all gooey brown sweet sauces. Yecch!  Not a fan!

Green Tea Macha with Red Bean is definitely a must try at Kung Fu. Although this is a chain, the Fowler Tampa location is my favorite. I've tried Las Vegas, New York and Atlanta location and I have to say... There's just something in the Florida water that makes the boba drink extra yummy. The place is small and is a great place for students to come by and study while enjoying a good drink. Prices are affordable for the amount and quality of the drink.

The food here is AWESOME. I seriously can't say this enough.

 The breadsticks seem to be one of those things one would normally pass over in lieu of cheese sticks or wings or something...but don't. They should patent that stuff. Fried fingers of dough doused in garlic butter then covered in parmesan. Amazing. 

The pizza is great. We live close, so we walk over sometimes for a family dinner. The dough is excellent, the sauce is fantastic, and the toppings never cease to amaze. So why 4 stars instead of 5? The only booth big enough to fit us and all 3 kids in is off in a corner and hard for the wait staff to see from behind the counter--impossible to get refills on soda unless you get up and walk to the bar--also in a general state of disrepair. This booth in particular looks like it could fall apart if you looked at it wrong. Otherwise, the place is fantastic.

A great local chain with friendly wait staff and delicious goodies? It's a dream come true in times like these :)

We frequent Senor Pique on a regular basis for dining, but we have also used their catering for a few of our dinner parties at our home. They have yet to let us down on the quality of the food and the amount that is included! They are always very accommodating with having our order ready when we get there, as well as making sure we haven't forgotten anything in our planning. The only thing I wish they would provide more of are the tortillas, as we always seem to eat more of them than are provided. Otherwise, they are fantastic for catering!

Kim is the best however she is very popular with the clients considering she does an amazing and I mean amazing job so if she's not available then schedule with Lan Kim's protege who is very talented (working along side Kim how could she not be) I have serious issues with my cuticles Kim has seen every type of hand thr is with over 15yrs experience working on all the various nail types e.g. short nails, cuticle issues, special requests if you can dream she and Lan can do it! I have been everywhere trying to find the best of the best, North side downtown Indy, north west, west and so on  finally I have found my nail salon home :))

This new Indian restaurant seems large and professional. It was hard to find if you parked on Bayberry since it's on the opposite side and you have to walk around. They should have a clear sign directing to the actual place. The Buffet is a great idea, but the staff don't seem to check the situation unless customers complain that there is no more rice and other missing items that others have eaten already. I suppose the food choices should have included more options, and that more bread should have been offered by the restaurant staff. The amount we paid felt somewhat pricy for what we got. I don't even recall them having enough napkins. I wouldn't run back there any time soon, and that is quite unfortunate as I love Indian food.

DO NOT GO HERE!!!! If I could give ZERO stars,I would. I will never have my dog groomed here again. The worst cut he has EVER had. They SHAVED a patch in between his eyes!!!!! WHY?! His ears don't match- one side is longer than the other. His back has one long patch at the top that is sticking up. Hair is sticking out everywhere. His hair has never stuck up like that. Only half of his stomach area was cut. The list goes on. The whole thing is all choppy. It looks like a toddler got a hold of a pair of scissors. This is the most half ass job I have ever seen. Clearly they don't know what they are doing or just don't care enough to even do a DECENT job. This is why they make you pay and tip BEFORE you see your dog. Because if you saw the terrible job they did first, you wouldn't pay them a dime. This job they did on him isn't worth $7, let alone the $70 that was paid or a tip. I have a small yorkie who is the most well behaved dog ever. He doesn't even bark. He's very still when he's being groomed and doesn't move a lot in general so I KNOW it wasn't because of him.  After reading these other reviews it's clear that the owner doesn't care about the type of service that she or her employees are providing to their customers. Based on what others have said about their experience when trying to express their dissatisfaction to the owner and manager and being treated so rudely it's not even worth the headache. This place has definitely lost another customer. I will be taking my money elsewhere. And I will be sure to spread the word to everyone that I know who has a fur baby.

Hummel's Pub is a place where all are welcome. It's patrons are from every walk of life- professional, blue-collar, straight, gay, lesbian, and trans. There is a beautiful outside patio filled with flowers, umbrellas, firepits, and misters over the custom-tiled outside bar for those hot summer days. It's a great place to hang out with friends, or to make new ones. On any given day, you might be invited to join in for BBQ, chili, ham n beans- you just never know what might be in store! The bartenders are friendly, skilled, and fast, and the drink prices are reasonable. It's definitely worth checking out! It might just become your favorite neighborhood bar!

I am so excited to review this place. My husband and I went for dinner last night and had an amazing experience. They JUST opened, it's exciting to go to a place that is only a couple of weeks old. 
This is a pretty unique place. First, it's an olive oil store. They have amazing craft products and you can sample everything. In the back, there's a wine bar. They only purchase wine from small boutique wineries. Don't expect to find any major labels on the menu. Since you're likely to encounter beverages you haven't experienced, the serve your selection by the "taste" the glass, or the bottle. I call that a win-win, because I enjoy going on a wine flight via tastes (because I still want to be able to walk out of the establishment when it's all said and done). 

Let's get to the food, because that's what brought me there. My husband was really eager to check this place out and in the back there is a small dining area. It's quaint, probably only about 10 tables- seating for 50 probably (two-tops, 4-tops, I think an 8-top was the largest). I really appreciated the intimate feeling for a Valentine's night dinner. The ambiance is tasteful, music, perfect lighting, candles on the tables, and calm, very calm. There was a special with a bottle of sparkling wine and either a cheese plate or a "sweets and treats" plate for $50, so we got a bottle and concluded with a sweets plate. For a couple of our glasses, they enhanced our sparkling wine with various drops of olive oil and it turned into a sangria tasting beverage and aside from my mind being blown (I've never considered putting oil in a drink) I was taken back by how delicious it was. We ordered all over the menu, green olives, panini, kale salad, flatbreads. ALL of the food was to die for. It was perfectly crafted and prepared. What's super cool, is they make their food with the products that they sell. So if you like it, they are really transparent about the ingredients and preparation so that you could go home and duplicate if your heart desired. Our eyes were much bigger than our stomaches and about half of everything is in my fridge. THIS PLACE WAS AMAZING. Appetizer, a bottle of wine, an extra glass of wine, two entrees, and a desert plate = $83. I will be back. Fighting the urge to go back tonight actually.

Richies Prime Rib is a typical hometown bar that hosts a welcoming feel.    The prime rib, whether a king cut or queen cut is delicious!  The food is always fresh with many mouth watering daily specials!  The service is great and the bartenders are friendly.  Weekend entertainment varies to satisfy all generations.  The night I was there I had the opportunity to meet the owner and his wife.  They were very kind and made us feel at home.

Took my Woman in to get some steel toe work shoes after she was sold a bill of goods by another store. After she met  with Analie  she decided on a pair of low boots that fit correctly!!
She also got orthotic inserts to go with the new ones and inserts { my idea } to possibly salvage the other shoes for possible limited use around the house or perhaps we'll give to Salvation Army or?? Analie is knowledgeable and waaaaayyyy patient too. This store puts the " Branded " stores and the big boxes to all kinds of shame!!! PLUS: They do repair work if needed!!!!
Marc. D

Sat out on the patio for brunch. It was a little noisy with traffic but didn't take away from the great food. Enjoyed the breakfast burrito which was nice size and very tasty. Not to spicy. Got a side of the Gouda grits were awesome. I'd come back for the grits, a healthy portion. Can't forget the robust coffee selection.

Arrived on Wednesday and it was like a ghost town!  It almost seemed like we were on the hotel room floor alone!!  Thankfully, there were other people on the same floor.  It was a nice and quiet stay overall.

No complaints about the room.  But then again I'm not that picky.  It's an outdated room that looks like the purple monster threw up in it and tried to cover it up with stripes.  Lamps are mounted/glued to the tables and desk making it hard to put things down because you have to balance things around it.  Lighting in the shower isn't that great (actually non-existent, theres NO light in the shower), but if you leave the curtain slightly open in the other side of the shower it allows some light to creep in.  A/C is strong ... we had to lower it and turn it off even at some points!  

The view from our room was nice.  We got to look at the top of the Midway and Silver Legacy.  I would think that most of the views from this hotel are pretty similar.  

The only downfall is that this side of the hotel (SkyTower) is dead.  There's nothing much downstairs so you have to walk to the main part of the hotel.  Which ... even then isn't that great, but better than most other parts of Reno!  You have the midway, the casino and restaurants.  Luckily Circus Circus is connected to Silver Legacy and El Dorado so if you don't think any of the restaurants are good in this hotel, keep on walkin' to through the other 2 hotels to see what they offer.

I will say that I think an actual brochure with all of the restaurants and their hours of operation would be helpful.  The hours for the restaurants are ALL OVER THE PLACE!  It was confusing and we ended up at most of the 24 hour places just for the ease.  When you're hungry at 8pm at night, you shouldn't be figuring out which ones are open or closed.

I think Circus Circus is good if you are on a budget or if you have kids.  It was cheap which is what I loved about this hotel.  Next trip, maybe we'll splurge $10-$20 a night for the Peppermill or El Dorado. 

It's a Reno Circus Circus Hotel ... don't expect much except a really good room rate.  I was happy with that.  =)

Pleasant surprise:  Power strip mounted to the side of the drawers/tv unit.  You don't have to unplug lamps in the room to charge 2 phones and a laptop!  High-tech for this hotel actually ... Yay Circus Circus!!! 

Shout out:  Congrats to all of the weddings taking place this weekend in this hotel!!!  There's a lot apparently according to our TV Hotel station.

Being served by a neglectful liar is never fun. First we watched the awesome busboy take our coffee cup and soda cup to Samantha our pointy nailed server and show her who they were for to refill. 20 minutes and no check up or beverages. There were two waitresses and five tables so it was not even remotely busy. After 30 minutes she came back to FINALLY check in us. When we told her we were unhappy she claimed to not have known. First, if she were a decent waitress she would have because she'd have been checking. Secondly, we saw her being told so she was caught in a lie. Then she managed to refill our drinks. Yeah, I did not order diet the first time so, I don't want it for my refill. Then she concocted some story about how earlier in the morning the lines were crossed. When I explained how that couldn't fly since she managed to get the order right the first time.....you could hear crickets. She never acknowledged her lack of truth telling and of course the manager, Fred, was unavailable and there was nobody above her to discuss her lack of honesty and service to. After all that.....she asked if we wanted changed and charged us for waiting on her for our drinks. Not worth the money, hassle or time. So sad that the Sparks location is THE WORST!

Our group of 12 retirees arrived at 5 pm Feb. 1, 2019 (a Friday).  That was a wise decision since it is a popular place.  By the time we left,  it was going full speed.  Since it's a sports bar, TV screens are everywhere and the crowd was noisey, but not too loud for conversation.  The food was great with ample serving size.  Our group ate many of the items in the menu.  The highlight of the evening was our waiter, Phil, and his incredible memory.  He remembered and brought to our table of 12 retirees ALL our orders exactly AS REQUESTED-- WITHOUT WRITING ANYTHING DOWN.  So ask for Phil if you want to be amazed!!
Arrogant, Democrat Owner. More concerned with self promotion than quality of food.  He needs to worry more about his customers and less about putting his face on mustard.

Have been to this place before and after pandemic. They used to be so good but post the pandemic, this place started to look more like a mediocre Chinese buffet. Comes with the drink, which is a plus. Decent buffet options and some which could taste little better. 

Went for dinner, which is $2 more than lunch. Would suggest to go for lunch.

Worst tour ever. We took the 8 pm Ghost Tour tonight and it was unprofessional, uninformative, and a complete waste of time. Our guide, Tyrone, started the tour almost 20 minutes late, ended early and displayed a blatant lack of historic knowledge (outside of Kathy Bates/Nicholas Cage themed info) in between. We saw three or four sites, total, and has to use Wikipedia to check/counter/fill in the blanks in Tyrone's narrative. We walked for blocks between stops, passing many other tours and supposedly haunted spots. Our guide wanted to stop for drinks partway through despite the fact that none of the folks left on the tour (8 of the 14 who started left early in the tour) drink. In the end, we got a bad American Horror Story commentary and a couple blisters. I want my money back.

This is a dive bar at its finest. Well, a dive bar where the craft beer selection is top notch and the menu features tater tots with bacon and blue cheese. My husband and I come here on date night when we want to have a drink, eat a sandwich, and chill out sitting at the bar. The menu features something for everyone: the salads are fresh and simple (the Hob Cob), the appetizers feature exactly what you would expect (think wings and fried pickles), and the sandwich selection runs the gambit from grilled chicken with garlic spinach and provolone on a roll to roast beef to a (very) good burger. Nothing is fancy or trying to be fancy. This is a place where you come to hang out, drink, eat, and savor the small town feel of Bordentown.

I have been going here for 12 years and the food has always been good and fast. Best margaritas ever! It gets very busy so plan to wait for dinner.

UPDATE. Just revisited my beloved Cinco and sat at the corner of the already full bar. Then there was a seat jammed next to me by the bartender and the bartender asked me to move over so two other people could squeeze in, which was now overly cramped. Then the lady next to me (who he had me move for) distracted the bartender again while I was ordering and he tended to her. There wasn't enough room to eat a meal so I left and won't be back. How rude.

I guess I should continue, since this wasn't enough. The older lady next to me was so close that she hit her drink and her straw flew at me, as she and her husband loudly guzzled margaritas like nothing I've ever seen. To leave my seat was virtually impossible since the seats were now jammed together and laughably awkward. Their behavior should have been addressed, and I suppose that was also the bartender's fault, not the restaurant's. I will visit other cinco's, as this bartender is almost daily.

This place has very good breakfast! I've never had lunch here. However they are little pricey. My mom and I went and I got a breakfast combo and she got French toast and a drink and the total was about $17. Also, if you go between the 9am-10am on a weekend it is PACKED. It's very cute inside. They have a very tiny home accent store and also a good selection of desserts near the registers

The Franklin Fountain has really great, high quality, delicious ice creams, sundaes, & shakes.

* They offer hard to find flavors such as ginger, green tea, teaberry, etc. 
* They have flavors completely unique to their shop such as the Whirley Berley - chocolate ice cream, salted caramel, and cocoa nibs (my personal favorite!)
* They've mastered traditional flavors - awesome butter pecan and probably the best vanilla bean and chocolate ice cream you've ever had!

Prices are high, but you get what you pay for - super rich & decadent artisan ice cream. 

It's true what they say about the long lines. But they have a good system in place, a ton of staff behind the counter and typically the line moves pretty fast. I frequent more often in the cooler months when there is practically no wait and all of my other favorite ice cream spots are closed for the season.

Love this ice cream parlour!

Minella's is a solid 3 star diner and has been for more years than anyone would like to count.  Great eggs, OK coffee, diner prices and usually quick service, which pretty much says it all for a diner.  They've never had pretensions to be anything but what they are.  Never had dinner here but I suspect it too is standard diner. Gets very busy, understandably on Sunday mornings.

I love the Number 27 or 24. It's a great thing to eat on a sick day. Sweats away all the sickness :P 

I am a Fan of The Beef Pho: 23, 24, 25 and 27 all come with beef. 
23: comes with all [well done briskets, rare beef slices and meatballs] 24: [same but NO meatballs] 
25: [JUST meatballs] 
27:[Just Rare beef slices] 

They are all delicious in my opinion. However the pricing for a student is kinda expensive. I wish there was different bowl sizes with less prices. The Pho sizes are Huge but again very yummy. 

Also the baguettes are good. I love the BBQ pork or Chicken. The prices for bag. are student friendly :) 

There is a Wide variety of amazing Veggie foods, which great! 

Fav. Smoothies: Lychee, Coffee, Taro or Mango! The boba's can be good if they are fresh. Too much in a cup then later it tastes digusting. Also if you wait to drink the smoothie, the water separates and ew. 

So from the first comment by Eva...I think the place has really become better! :)

I've been inside the restaurant, but during this dinner visit the electricity in the entire block went out after we placed our drink orders. Our server was very nice and brought out our drinks and bread for us to nosh on while waiting for the power to come back on (no electricity = no hot food). Unfortunately, after about 45 minutes, the lights were not coming back on, so we had to leave as the restaurant was getting humid. My drink was very delish though - pink Sangria I believe.

I've been to the bakery next door about 3-4 times. I LOVE their ice cream selections. Reminds me of Cold Stone ice cream mix-ups but with a less fattening feel. If that makes any sense. My fave is the birthday cake - vanilla or chocolate ice cream with bits of yellow cake and sprinkles mixed in. AND a small cup is only about $2! I've also had macaroons and fresh squeezed orange juice there. Yum. I love grabbing an ice cream and sitting on the bar stools staring out at Beach Dr.

Will try to go back and actually eat food inside the restaurant. Menu looked delish!

It took me forever to decide what I wanted because they have so many flavors. Typically, I try two-three and only end up liking one at ice cream spots. I liked all three flavors that I tried. I ended up getting the pumpkin praline on a cone because I felt like it fit the season. It was everything I wanted. If I had more time I would've come back every single day to try a different flavor. It's cash only so come prepared.

If you're going to sell an avocado toast for $9 it definitely should not be using fully ripened and bad avocados. I complained about this to the staff which masked it with spinach on top, but they are refusing a refund. This is not good business. I like Caffeine and want to support local, but don't sell rotten avocado toast guys.
Good food, tender meat in the gyros and friendly service, but a tad slow.

This place is top notch!! All the beer kicks ass, great clam chowder is delicious, and the service couldn't be better. Coming from decades of service industry experience, I'm hella critical and I don't have anything negative to say about edge!
Wow- seriously amazing pizza!   Very cute bar.  Garage doors indicate an amazing outdoor seating option when it's warm.  Best experience I've had in a long time! Great waitlist option on yelp too.

We decided to go to Dave & Busters to get dinner, a couple of drinks, and play some games.

The food - We had a short wait before we were seated at the restaurant.  The waitress came and took our order.  My friend ordered a chicken parmesan, and I ordered a chicken quesadilla.  Our food arrived, and mine was mediocre, and it could have been better.  My friend had two pieces of chicken.  The first one was overcooked and was hard to chew.  The second one tasted okay till the center of the meat, which was RAW!  We called over the waitress, and she did not apologize or anything and took our entrees away.  She later dropped off the check and disappeared.  The entire time we were wondering how come no one apologized or offerred us something else to eat.  My friend was still hungry!  The check came, and the chicken was comped, but still no apology.  We paid and left the restaurant area.  Needless to say, we will not be eating here again.

The drinks - The drinks are overpriced and not much alcohol.  The cocktails are loaded with ice and not worth the money.

The games - The games were pretty fun hence the 1 star rating.  It does get very expensive to play here though.  The two of us spent around $60 for 2-3hrs of games.

This place is cool. 

We stopped in for some late (around 10 p.m.) snacks. The atmosphere is that of an upscale party that would also have a keg of PBR. It had a fun vibe without being overly loud or "trying too hard." It was not at all stuffy, but not the kind of place to wear your stained sweats. It was just right. The Tennessee bacon cheddar ale soup, firehouse chili, and calamari were all flavorful, not typical "fills the empty spot" bar food.

As great as the atmosphere, location, and food were, the service topped all of that. Our server, Larissa, was not only attentive and helpful, but she seemed to really take pride in answering questions about menu items and ensuring what we received exceeded our expectations. A+ 

We look forward to returning the next time we're in Nashville.
Food is always good and if you're in the market for a regular staff member, David is fast and friendly!
Fabulous hidden gem in Clearwater.  Great food and wines.  Definitely will be back! The Turkey and Brie Donut Hole Sliders and Prosciitto, Fig and Goat Cheese thin crust pizza are wonderful!

Excellent food, reasonable prices, reliable quick service 
I have been going here since it first opened, way back over 30 years ago. 
My favourites have come and gone but my newest is the spare rib. It comes with veggies, mashed potatoes and gravy and it's so flavourful! Nummy. They keep the water flowing. They post their health inspections. What's not to like?
The salty pimp is a MUST try!!!! Great ice cream, ok service. The price is a bit steep, but it worths the money. You will realize it after the first bite of the ice cream :)

I wish I could give zero stars. I would not recommend THIS location. EVER. The other location is fantastic. My vet advised me to stay away from the rockville road location. Unfortunately, we only had this conversation after my dog was neglected while being boarded here for a weekend - leading to multiple vet visits. 

If you care about our horror story, you can read below:

*My dog was given back to me with blood on his face and shaking (from self inflicted wounds due to a double ear infection that developed while we were gone). 
I cannot even fathom how little attention they were paying him for it to get as bad as it did in 24 hours. (We had received a photo of him the day prior doing great!)*

We were contacted on Tuesday with awful photos of our dog's ears swollen and bloody. An employee (who we love) took him home to keep an eye on the wounds. The next morning we asked that he be taken to our vet for examination as we would not be home until Thursday. 
Management took him to our vet (That's a positive) and then volunteered to take him home to their house following his appointment. (Also a positive, although we would've preferred he go with the original employee for reasons to follow...)
They kept promising to give us updates, and only did when we asked multiple times to know what was going on, after several hours of waiting. I finally called my vet to get the information, and after a long conversation I was told "He was given pain medicine today, so you can give him more in the morning." 

Unfortunately, that's where all positives end. At the manager's home on Wednesday night, our dog was overdosed on his pain medication due to the negligence of said manager, who claimed my vet "did not write down the instructions" for his 3 medications. Allergy pills, antibiotics, pain medicine. Start the first two at night, and the third the next morning. 

I struggle to see how the vet "not writing it down" is a valid excuse for someone whose profession is dog watching. They were all three very common medications that I only had to google to tell apart. And if the vet was half as thorough with her as they were with me, the verbal instructions were plenty clear and easy to follow. If you are going to VOLUNTEER to take someone's pet to your home, wouldn't you be as thorough as possible, and perhaps even write down the single most important instruction YOURSELF? I stand by my vet not being the issue. 

So, yes, the manager then confused the antibiotic and pain pills (which, again, only took a simple google search to identify) and gave our dog the pain pill before bed. Humans are humans, and mistakes happen. But my dog is NOT big and an extra dose of pain medicine is the difference between living and dying. 

The next morning - Thursday - when we picked our dog up, still with blood on his face, he was a zombie. He did not move and could not stand in the afternoon. I noticed there were 2 doses of pain medicine missing, and chose to not give him any more before calling Puppy Playground demanding an explanation. The manager avoided my calls (because she was out to dinner with family - LOL) and I actually had to text another employee to get the manager to finally call me. 

Overnight, he had an accident in the bed and still did not move a muscle as we cleaned. Terrified, we called our vet and were instructed he would have to come back in to flush his system and start the antibiotic process over. Had I given him another pill on the schedule outlined by the vet, I am confident he would have died. 

He then lived miserably in a cone for 2 weeks and had to be carefully watched and cared for at all hours of the day, which was not at all convenient during work. 

In the end, I recorded a confession from the manager who admitted to administering the wrong medication. She comped the dog's stay and paid his vet bills out of pocket (Great, I guess. Arguably to hide the situation from the business owners). I chose not to say anything in the midst of covid, but I feel it's time to voice this so that others do not experience the same. As I mentioned at the start, our vet has received multiple injured and sick animals that were boarded at this location and she advised to never take our dog back. Negligence all around. 

Our family has been Puppy Playground regulars for over 6 years at the other location, so this was shocking and disappointing to say the least. 

It seems as though the owners attempted to expand and are failing to maintain the rockville branch. 

In summary - 
Negligence, no urgency in communications of any kind, unprofessional, NEVER take your dog here.
Loved the service and the Mojito but I was unimpressed by the quality and size of the sushi. I won't be back.

I would think twice if considering Southwest to fly.  Had an issue with an item left on a plane and struggled to even find an employee to help.  Only after posting on social media was someone "willing" to help.  Even after that I was unsatisfied with there their service, very impersonal and unhelpful. They could literally only say, "we're sorry you feel that way" and would only refer to company policy like a robot.  Rather pay more for a service that is actually that, a service.

I was driving by and saw the poke sign and immediately decided to stop by and I'm glad I did. This spot just opened today and I have to say I'm already hooked! I love poke bowls and there really isn't anything around here in Wesley Chapel where you can get some quality ingredients and this place has it! You can build your own bowl however you like with tons of bases and they also have seaweed and soy bean wraps. Then you get two proteins (the spicy tuna was SO FRESH!). And then tons of toppings to choose from like hijiki seaweed, edamame, krab salad, and avocado and over 10 sauces. Everyone in there was really nice and helpful! They have a deal going on right now for 50% off bowls for their grand opening and I'm not sure how long that'll last but I'll definitely be coming back this week for some more. 10/10.

Great Cuban food restaurant. Know for their breakfast and lunch specialties. Limited daily menu with a great selection, freshness, taste. All serve very casual. You can eat in or take out. Friday's they have delicious fish soup, fresh fish prepared to your liking. No liquor. Modest prices and great service by the owner and his staff.

Stopped here for gas, then went inside for caffeine, where I discovered they have a BoarsHead deli counter! Ordered a fresh made-to-order roast beef sandwich with extra pickles and was a happy camper. Other customers were coming in to get sandwiches, too. This gas station also sells cold alcohol and lots of snacks. Friendly staff, too.
Excellent Pho, in a small family run place.  Food, service, and quality all very good.   Cant go wrong here.

This is one of the better U.S. airports with a nifty little tram system and good restaurant offerings, sculpture, and stores. Convenient. Free shirt term parking to pick peeps up. Cell phone lot. Post office out by the airport with a passport office. Some international flights.

Not satisfied.  I was forced  to go here on NYE because my favorite place (Uncle Joes on B-Pike) was closed.   I called ahead to place my order because it was going to be a large order (over $200) and wanted to be certain they had enough and that it would be ready when I needed it.  The girl that answered wouldn't take my order and said I had to come to the store.  Upon arrival I found her on her cellphone holding a very loud and personal convo which was very unprofessional and not to mention she was using profanity.   This was a turn off.  And to add insult to injury after placing my order (which btw was over $250) I had to wait an hour for it.  And the food was just OK at best.  Save yourself the aggravation and just go to Uncles Joes around the corner.   Better food and much better customer service!

The fish tacos are 5 star but the staff are horrible. I have been here many times and the staff are badly trained. The manager rolls his eyes when you are uncertain what to order. 
The lady at the cash rolled her eyes at my colleague when she asked questions. Poor customer service! Our waitress was very nice and friendly, but she is in the minority at this restaurant.

I obviously love this place since I am here 4 days a week for something regarding the house! 

They always have friendly service and anytime I need to find someone or get advice someone is always there to help.

You can bring your dogs to the store and it's such a huge location you never feel crowded in the isles! 

Good time, every time!

We went as a group of 11 to celebrate 4 birthdays at 1130am...and the restaurant was not busy!!  It was a terrible experience. One person's food did not come out until after everyone else was done eating. Another person ordered dessert...which NEVER came. No one in the restaurant seemed concerned with the horrible service. VERY disappointing!!

I lost my car keys, and this place, unlike the other overpriced places I contacted, got me 2 new keys in an hour without them having to come check the car! All I had to do is give them the Vin number and insurance to prove ownership. I used the $125 for $95 deal. Highly recommended if you lost keys.

I came to TaxGenuity with high anxiety due to major tax issues that I simply didn't know how to deal with.  I had had my head in the sand just wishing the problem would go away.  When I finally came to Denise and Jeff, what I found was the perfect combination of professionalism and comfort.  They solved my problem and gave me something that was worth so much more than what they charged -- peace of mind!!  And it was amazingly affordable!  In the end I wondered why I waited so long.  I now have them handle all of my taxes, and I haven't been disappointed.  There is no one better than this amazing team!
One of my favorite places to go to for EPL games, beer plus steak and eggs!  Happy hours are also a good choice as they have pitchers of sangria for $19!

We rented two bikes here for a half day. They were city cruising bikes and we biked 20 miles on the Greenbelt with them. The bikes were great! They seemed almost brand new and rode really nicely. It was only $15 for a 4 hour rental, which I thought was really reasonable! The bike staff were super helpful and friendly. I would recommend renting bikes here!

Check out the fair trade coffees, chocolates, teas, jewelry, recycled glass products, hemp leashes, candles, mobiles, cards, cute little gifts to give "just because."
Mark is a calm, kind soul that has infused this store with good vibes..
Beautiful fragrances to walk around and shop in.
Colorful eclectic variety of recycled, fair trade, and organic goods; a reason to support local business owners.

Stroll around Fatherland and 10th and enjoy local business owners and what they have to offer.

This is the worst hotel I've ever been to and I don't think they even deserve a 1 star. The front desk employee is definitely not the right fit to be in the hospitality business. I realized that when I first came into the hotel to check in where I had to finally greet him instead of the other way round. He gave me a room key, I went up to the room and once I opened the door I get yelled at by people inside the room! He actually gave me a room that was not vacant! I was totally shaken by what just happened so I apologized to the folks in the room and went downstairs to talk to the guy at the front desk. He blamed his system for the error and did not even attempt to apologize. I asked for a manager who came to help but I was baffled by the lack of management skills that this manager had when he allowed the front desk guy to yell at me right in front of him. Although the manager gave me a key to a different room I was so uncomfortable staying in that hotel and decided to look for another hotel to stay in. In summary, Clarion a trashy hotel and I don't advise anyone to stay there.

Another true hidden gem in SB I wished I'd known about sooner!

This place is not exactly "hidden," per se, as it's located on a busy, traffic-laden street corner on the outskirts of downtown. That being said, I feel it is one of those businesses that people may just glance at and drive by. It looks like nothing special from the front, and the interior is also no frills - with several remnants of its prior tenant, an ice cream shop. The food and service, however, are what won me over.

Garrett's is known for their blueberry pancakes, and they certainly do live up to the hype. They are my go-to entree whenever I dine here. I overheard the owner mentioning to another customer that the blueberries come straight from the local farmers' market - neat!

This is your typical diner establishment with an assortment of made-to-order breakfast items along with a host of daily specials. The food I've ordered each time is turned around at record speed, and always tastes flavorful and fresh. Make no mistake, though - this isn't a health food restaurant, so be prepared for a deliciously greasy meal. Perfect for a Sunday morning after a night out!

The service is typically good from what I've gathered. The waitresses aren't always checking up, but I feel that they are very friendly and personable, and are always good for solid conversation. Love it.

The next time you happen to be at the corner of State and Mission, give this deserving spot a try!
Incredible selection of chocolate desserts.  Large dinner portions.  Seems like would be great for groups as we noticed there were quite a few groups celebrating different occasions.  Fun decor.

We had a delicious lunch!  I had the finger steaks, they were tender and perfectly cooked. My husband had the Capital Club, very generous sandwich and delicious bacon!  What a great local place, where they take the time to lean everyone's name and their favorite menu items

Really nothing great bout this place. Just typical way to overpriced for quality of food you get.  $9.21 for just a buffalo chicken wrap that a 9 year old can make way better.  Cheesesteaks are just typical, nothing fancy.  In the same category as a wawa. Meatball parm, just in the same category as wawa.  When working and need lunch I'm not to picky.  But for the price of these items, adjust accordingly to your competitors. Would have been better off going to a local bar getting a sandwich and a beer and only be paying about 11 bucks.

This small and characteristic BYOB, cash-only restaurant is in the heart of the city and their food is just delicious. They have seafood and meat dishes and they are all well prepared and portions are abundant. Some items on the menu are quite pricy, but they are generally worth the money. Their specials, grilled Branzino and ribeye steak are a must to have. Their ribeye is one of the best steaks you can get in town. Come here with your date or friends, you will not be disappointed

I was having an emergency and I was trying to reach out to my relative who I knew was working out there. I called to see if they could page or go find them in the gym. They would not help me. 

What if this was an injured child? What if someone died? You won't get off your ass and go find them for your customer? Terrible service. Very glad I never joined this gym. I'll speak with my relatives and see if they'll join a different gym. 

By the way, my car got more damaged because you wouldn't help. So I had to drive it 16 miles more to get help. Thanks. A LOT.

This was a true fine dinning experience! They were super friendly and helpful when I told them I was vegan. The chef made me a special, not on menu, vegan meal and it was amazing!! I appreciate their willingness to accommodate!

【if you want real sushi, do not come here】
Worst sushi in Tucson, this is not even sushi.
1.Ridiculously huge nigiri .
2.Tasteless and sticks-on-your-teeth rice.
3.Not-so-fresh seafood.
4.Fake Wasabi .
5.Just OK services.

The most terrible thing is, they mess you up on the tips. Me and my friend total check was $60, we have it separated, so it's $30 each. 20%tips should be $6. But on the receipt they gave us, they printed "20% $12" .

【Guess what】
After I wrote this review, I got a message from the owner, Scott K.
He mocked my math and grammar. Which I'm OK with it, I'm Asian anyway.
The different between me and the owner is that I can take criticism and I'll try to fix my own problems.

Best burgers ever. Waaaay better than 5 guys or zac's. The only downfall is that they don't have French fries. Tip for ordering: don't bother telling then what you want on your burgers, they will ask you when the burgers are ready to be served. If you are looking for a good cheeseburger or milk shake this is definitely the place.

Literally a block from home, yet today was my first visit in over 10 years.

The monthly coupons in my mailbox offering endless lunch and a fountain beverage for under $10 finally got me back in the door.

Little has changed. Unfortunately the decor could use it at this point, but I know that is unlikely to happen. Sitting here reminds me of being back in college on a meal plan where there were so many options to satisfy my hunger.

Of course, there is no meat at Sweet Tomatoes and even the days when you could get some chicken with your salad are long gone.

Still, it was a very enjoyable lunch for a person like me who regularly enjoys salads, soups and a little starch in various forms. (The sweet potato was a nice compliment)

The salad bar was spotless and wonderfully maintained. Not even the usual drip of one salad dressing into the other salad dressing was evident. That takes some work and clearly employees were keeping up.

To be honest, I found virtually nothing in the presentation of any of the food areas that was not clean and inviting. At one point, an employee even excused himself to place a new plate in front of one of the many types of muffins just to put the tongs for that specific type of muffin on it. That's attention to detail. The margarita muffin was very good...and I do not like margaritas except when they are being consumed by attractive women looking for an excuse to do things with me they would never otherwise do.

Of the eight soups, I tried three of them. I'd enjoy all three again and the bowls you use for them are perfect size so people don't spill or waste food. They even offer a chili as one of the eight, but I saved that for a future visit.

My interaction with employees was limited to the cashier and one other who was maintaining food prep and grabbing empty plates/bowls off tables. Both of them were very polite.

No chance I had any room for chocolate mousse or soft serve ice cream before leaving, so I just grabbed a handful of grapes and felt I received more than my money's worth.

Funny, I'd been thinking about hitting that Ruby Tuesday's Garden Bar just a few blocks south the last month or so. Now I know not to bother with them when I want a lunch salad experience close to home. Sweet Tomatoes offers so much more for the same price.

Oh, and I couldn't find Sweet Tomatoes offering free WiFi (I didn't ask for a password), but I managed to connect to the free Dunkin' Donuts WiFi right next door. Normally, that doesn't work through walls, but it did here.

Anyone else been in Tampa long enough to remember when this location opened as a Red Robin? Yes, I knew I wasn't the only one...just one of the very few.

So its more like a 3-1/2 star and if I had the food I probably would have given them 4 stars if it was warranted.  They are located inside the Canary Hotel but do have a separate entrance.  Very convenient if you are a guest at the hotel.

Positives
Lovely layout and decorations with a variety of seating.
Live music - while I was there it was jazz.
Serve Oyster Shooters with a generous pour of vodka.

Negatives
Drinks can be a little pricey for the quality.
Oyster Shooters have shaved parmesan in them - had to try and not choke on that!
Considering the prices they are charging I would have expected a little higher quality in the service.

I would love to come again and give their Sunday brunch a chance, its a combo entree and buffet style.  So you order from a selection of appetizers and entrees but have a desert and cereal buffet with a selection of discounted drinks.

Ambiance is nice...overly nice for the quality of food.  Food tends to be bland...overpriced for what you get...the chicken is "OK"...steaks need to be upgraded...TOO MUCH FAT on any steak...and the sides are from sorta okay to bad bad bad.  Save your money and go to chilli's, logan's or the catfish house...even Sonic has better chicken.
