Great service and great food, the only thing that keeps this place from getting 5 stars is that it's not big enough for multiple large parties at a time and that I had to order my food and choose my own table afterwards. I'd rather be seated first so I don't feel rushed to order and get a table afterward, but don't get me wrong they did a pretty damn good job getting everyone's food out as quickly as possible and it was great quality food. Don't think I waited more than 10 min and I don't think multiple parties of 7+ waited any longer than 15 min. Glad I chose this place to grab a bite to eat on the way to Anaheim from San Francisco.

Horrible stench coming from the walls of this place. It's was so hot the fans they had were just making things worse. Came in for a price quote since I could not get thru on the phone & before that always a note on the front gate back in 10 minutes? Is this place ever open? I didn't feel comfortable leaving my art here. Went somewhere else. Creepy area.

I've been going to Belle Meade for several years and I have always been pleased with the service, results and love that they have added the Laser Spa over the years.  Kellie is wonderful!

What women doesn't need to have access to some good prevention or if one is so inclined; some potent and techniques to try to turn back the hands of father time.  While I can say I have not succumbed to Botox or Fillers; not saying I will not at some point; I understand that she is the best and is actually one of the NP's who teaches this technique.  And speaking of potent; they have some great deals on some of the greatest skin care lines as well as tools to use at home.  

And for those ladies who like to host parties, fund raisers or just gathering the girls for some wine and gossip; they can host private parties and offer some great prices for the host as well as the guest.

For those not so glamorous reasons we all see our Dermatologist; I have been very pleased withe the PA's as well as all the doctor's I have seen.  I love that they greet you; get you to your room and you don't spend another hour sitting and waiting.  They are very efficient and respectful of your time.

The services that are offered and prices are fair and the results good.  I would recommend them to anyone!

First time visiting and it was AWESOME experience! Dionne is the best! It's very pretty, the music selection was very good and the entire staff was friendly and attentive. My girlfriend and I asked for restaurant recommendations and Brandy suggested a great spot and called ahead to find out how long our wait would be. The personal touches is what matters most. I will definitely be back!

My go-to Asian place many times over.  Here's more food you should order: Tom Yum soup is banging!!!! Wonton soup is banging!  Dumpling vinegar dipping sauce is banging!!!  Always packed, no matter what time, and always quick and well serviced. Singapore noodles was average, but maybe that's because after the depth and spice of the Tom Yum, nothing would compare.  Only thing that doesn't make sense is their "sushi bar" area. Since no one is ever doing anything behind the counter there, and it's only filled with cardboard boxes and extra togo containers, would make sense opening that space up for more seating since space is definitely at a premium.

Flew into Reno on a Sunday morning and wanted a good breakfast and a nice walk with a girlfriend, we decided to go down by the river and saw JB Mapes (open again under new management and a great new look) such a fantastic Sunday morning! We shared the bacon and gruyere egg sandwich (nice thick bacon done perfectly crispy) and the pecan French toast (think candied pecans so sweet syrup is optional!) and of course a few mimosas! Perfect jumping off point to enjoy a walk to burn off the indulgence! Excellent service and amazing food! So good in fact I took my mom back later in the week for dinner! Also great n'orleans style comfort food!

(4.5) ~ Very Good Overall Food & Service, and Definitely the Best Thai Restaurant in the Area!  Everything we've tried has been Consistently Very Good!  And when you get the Pad Thai, they don't automatically add Tofu, unless you ask for it, which is a pet peeve of mine, b/c other Thai restaurants just add Tofu without telling you.  Lastly and most importantly, if you request it, they'll provide you with a Thai Condiment & Spice Rack, so you can add some more Spice & Heat to any of your dishes, as well as Mushroom Soy Sauce(good for rice) and sugar.  Getting a Spice & Condiment Rack at a Thai Restaurant around here(PA) is a rare treat and definitely more authentic.  I can't tell you how many times we've asked for one at other Thai places and they look at you as if you have (3) eyes;)lol  

NOTES:  The Restaurant is kind of hidden & there's limited parking in the front, but you can still drop people off at the Door, & then drive around back and park at their Gift Store Parking Lot, called "Yaowapa Thailand Treasures", along Rt.113(Kimberton Rd.)  It's owned by the same Husband & Wife Team ~ Jerry & Yaowapa Kowal, who are extremely nice and love to discuss Thai culture;)  Once you park, there's a Lighted Walkway along the Right side of the Building, with Steps back up to the Front Door.  The Restaurant is beautifully decorated with Art from Thailand, which coincidentally is sold at their Gift Store below;)lol  ***My one wish would be that they get on OpenTable, but for now you can make reservations by Calling, which is recommended for Fridays & Saturdays;)

DRINKS:
** Thai Iced Tea = (4.25) Very good
** Water(tap) = (4) very good, must be filtered;)

FOOD:
** Thai Condiment & Spice Rack = (5) Excellent, IF you request it for your Food:)
** Pad Thai(w. Chicken) = (4.5) Very Good!  As mentioned before, glad they don't automatically add Tofu, unless you want it;)
** Tom Kha Soup(w. chicken) = (4) very good
** Mango w. Coconut Sweetened Sticky Rice(dessert) = (4) very good
* Crying Tiger(medium) = (3.5) good

TREAT(AFTER DINNER):
** Butter Mints(w. Check) = (5) Excellent!  LOVE Buttermints!:)
LOVE THIS PLACE! I always come here, and I'm one of those people who always wants creative designs and different looks on each of my hands, and every time the nail artists here amaze me!

Our experience was awesome...easy to schedule appointment! Andrew came out to give an estimate and was professional and knowledgeable.  Making changes once I placed my order was also a breeze.  The two installers came out and were extremely personable and professional.  They completed the job quickly with no mess. Very happy with product and can already tell a difference!!!

The Soda Shop is a cute throwback to the 50's. It is located in the National WWII Museum.

It's cool that I had uploaded my pics when I was there in September 2014, but didn't do a review. I'm here to fix that issue. =)

I had spent five hours walking, absorbing, and learning so much during my time at the museum. I was hungry and needed some lunch. I saw this place and went in.

The air conditioning in this eatery was highly efficient. If you get cold easily, you may shiver while enjoying your food.

The person at the counter was friendly and helpful. I ordered a chili dog. I got shredded cheddar cheese on top. It also came with chips and a drink.

I got hooked on Zapps potato chips on this trip. The brand is local to New Orleans. They are kettle-style chips and are yummy. I went with the regular and it complimented my chili dog nicely.

I love a good hot dog. Put chili on top and I am a happy camper. Sure, it was messy, but it didn't bother me. I was armed with napkins. I enjoyed my meal. It hit the spot.

Prices here are higher than you would pay at a food court, which wasn't surprising. When you are hungry and you don't have any wait time, it all works out.

(55)

We didn't make reservations on a Friday but still were seated right away despite a packed house.  Our server was a little slow to the table, but the manager noticed and comped our appetizers.  No complaints here!  The mussels were delicious.  The sauce is almost like a mild thai curry but on the sweeter side.  They were perfect.  The rolled grapes are one of my favorites.  They are the perfect mix of savory and sweet.   I had the filet as my entree.  It was cooked perfectly and the bleu cheese mashed potatoes pair perfectly with it.  My fiancee had the salmon.  Also delicious from the one bite I got before it disappeared.  All in all, this is one of my favorite restaurants in Seminole Heights.  I love the atmosphere (live jazz) and the food never misses.

This was the only place in the Reading Terminal that had any cheesesteak left. Most of the other vendors were closing or simply sold out. I stopped in for dinner on a Sunday night and there was a long line. 

You can see the guys grilling the cheesesteak which was cool. When you order, the cashier was really friendly and made conversation with me. I smiled and ordered the Italian cheesesteak with provolone, broccoli rabe, and added mushrooms. 

Glad they were quick to order. I waited about 10 mins for my sandwich. There are stools to eat your sandwich but they get really busy and filled most of the time. 

The sandwich was good, but I didn't have the taste for the rabe. Left a bitter taste in my mouth. I would have loved my bread to be toastier and maybe a little more meat. Otherwise, overall my first Philly cheesesteak in Philly was A-OK!

get the PASSIONFRUIT YOGURT!!! I tried both the strawberry yogurt and the passionfruit yogurt but the passionfruit flavor is at least 3 times better. I've tried their phresh fruit tea and ube milk tea too which were pretty good, but both drinks still doesnt compare to their passionfruit yogurt. I thought the yogurt drink was was going to be like a liquid (like yakult) but it's more like a slush/smoothie. 

There aren't that many good boba places here in Goleta/SB/IV, but phresh tea is definitely one of my favorites. They are very consistent with their drinks and none of the drinks that I tried from there, including both the ones I ordered and what my friends ordered, disappointed me. The employees are also really friendly and they have a wide selection of games you can choose from to play with your friends while you sip on your drink! 

If you're tired of the boba in IV or are looking for a new place to try in Goleta/SB, Phresh Tea is the place!!

I ordered a regular plate with gyro. I got very salty beef grounded with lettuce, tomatoes, and tasteless rice. I paid 10$ for a small size meal. It was below my expectation. Meat was greasy and didn't tat good. 3 peices of triangle shape soggy pitta bread. I think they could do better! Staff was nice and respectful, but good was over rated.

Let me tell you this place is "firemen hot."  I took my family there on New Years day and the place was packed.  The scanner going on in the background while the tvs were tuned to football and the movie Backdraft.  It was great seeing the local TV show from Channel 5 ..show me stl. doing a show.  We had the pretzels with cheese dip and an awesome French Dip with the great Irish Chips.  A great family rest during the day and a growing bar which fits perfect within Lafayette Square.  What a true breath of fresh air

This place was terrible.  Way over priced.  The food was slop.  Mid summer and the menu was like a hearty winter menu.  It's a place for catering that really does not expect anyone to ever go there to pay for a meal.

Love this place for delicious, just out of the oven, cookies! They're so delicious. With s couple standard offerings (eg chocolate chip) and new creations, you'll always be able to get your cookie fix. 
Party boxes are also available for those special occasions.

You can never go wrong with some Coopers Hawk. Took my gf for her birthday and it was amazing. We started off with a tasting which lasts about 30 minute, so get there well before your reservation time. We had several types of wine tastings and they were all delicious even for those that don't enjoy wine that much. 
Dinner was phenomenal, I had the short rib risotto which was savory. She has the gnocchi carbonara and it also was so good. We ate off each other's plates bc we couldn't get enough of each other's dish. 
After the bread and dinner and a nice bottle of Coopers Hawk Chardonnay we were too full for dessert. Definitely recommend this place for any occasion. Tell them Alex sent you! Just kidding... don't lol

HOW COULD I FORGET. THE LOBSTER SHRIMP BISQUE IS FIRE!

I think this restaurant is very good for a small place in a typical shopping center.   I'm not a huge fan of Thai food, but I enjoy it now and then, and I have had some excellent dinners and lunches here.    

The staff is very friendly and attentive, and will gladly adjust the dishes to your liking (more or less spicy, rice rather than noodles, vegetarian, etc.)

Don't let the outside appearance or a few bad reviews deter you, this is a decent Thai restaurant.

The Metro Diner is my go-to spot!! It's my FAVORITE local place to go and where I like to take all of my out-of-town guests for breakfast!! They have the best menu and prices!! You get sooo much for your money and the food and the staff is AMAZING!! You will never go wrong at Metro Diner!!

It's very affordable especially when they have weekly specials. We stopped by after going to Happy Fish next door in the same plaza. If you don't mind waiting in line to checkout - it is worth the savings. A couple days ago, we got 10 likes for 0.98! Again, I can't stress the promotions because it really is the best deals especially compared to Publix whether it's meat, juices or vegetables although it's a limited selection.

3 stars because checkout is slow and this is an older location where there's only one entrance for entering and exiting, so pretty sure it's a safety violation.

I've stay at this hotel twice. This past time was terrible. 

a. It took us forever to let the front desk check us in. I "checked in" at 3 and they didnt let me go into the room until 5. 

b. Billing was a nightmare. 

c. My fiance was drinking at cocktail from the lobby bar and there were SHARDS OF GLASS in his drink. 

Needless to say we were not very happy.
James is the best! From shining to repairs he does a great job. Honest and fair prices.

$6 bucks for a flat blue moon draft? Could've gone to the brewery for a tasty, fresh beer at that price! The only thing Caddy's has going for them is the atmosphere and beach! Food, service and prices are terrible. Sincerely, a TI local.
Not very friendly or accommodating. Will not substitute or add any sauces that are different than their menu. Not impressed. There are better Italian Restaurants.

The management should be ashamed today after the way they treated their older customers. I watched at least three parties with elderly people  treated with such discourtesy and disrespect that they left because the staff wouldn't help them find a table with regular chairs. The problem was that they'd shut down half of the dining area for a private event. The side that was open was furnished with mostly high tops and high-legged chairs that the seniors couldn't climb onto. The private event wasn't until later in the afternoon, but management couldn't be bothered to swap out a few of the high tables with regular tables and chairs from the empty side. Instead, they made the old folks fend for themselves. Particularly horrendous: One family struggled to get an elderly woman with a walker into the restaurant only to find it wasn't accessible for her and then they struggled to take her back out. Eventually, they posted a note on the door that they had limited seating, but this was after they'd ruined dinner for these old folks.  The food is ok here, but NOT good enough to overcome the poor service. Seriously, the management should be ashamed of themselves.

Great Irish restaurants! The food is what you want when you are craving traditional Irish fare. The atmosphere is perfect with live music playing. I would recommend the lamb, the spices are perfect. Try the corned beef bites, gives you a great chance to try their beef.

Since the original post a few exercise bikes were fixed, they finally cleaned the carpet in the mens room entrance (thanks for reading) and are doing some maintenance here.  An extra star for the effort and for paying attention but it shouldn't take a member who pays every month having to go online to finally take notice. 

Will keep updating as needed.

The music in the place is absolutely delightful and the interior design is impeccable. The food that was served was absolutely delicious, by far the best bbq pork sandwich I've had. 10/10 would highly recommend

PLEASE DO NOT GO EAT HERE ... The food is HORRIBLE ...very over rated and over price .. Me and my friends ate the the Elizabeth .. Crab cake .. And pork chop ... Well my pork chop was bland the biscuit was over cook .. The crab cake tasted like it was a day over due .. And the potato was hard .. Are you for real ?? 
For such a highly rated restaurant on yelp 
I didn't expect this 
I would recommend eating at Stanley's for price and quality and service .

YUMM!! My boyfriend and I enjoy our mai thai but usually take it to go! Still super yummy but we went in for dining and it was amazing! We had the pineapple fried rice which came in an actual pineapple! It was delicious, great service and our waiter was super friendly!!

I could eat just cheese fondue here and be perfect fine with that. But for a nice night out it's a great way to spend a few hours. It took us 3 hours to get through the 4 course meal (cheese,salad,main, chocolate) and it was really good. But I like to cook my own food...I know it's not for everyone

Disappointing.  The Sichuan Region is all the way to the west in China and Taiwan is a pacific island to the east of China, so this felt like a failed mashup.  The fish soup tasted like the skin of a slightly familiar Taiwanese shui jiao (水饺) covered with some kind of Sichuan-type hot sauce.  Very confusing.  The green beans were a bit bland, though I liked the flavor of the cucumber.   The pork felt like something you would get at your neighborhood takeout place.  If the theme of this place was "Chinese American" I'd say not bad.   There's a bar.   But, the mask of authenticity is exactly that, a mask.
A great variety of toppings and the yogurt flavors are always changing. Staff is friendly. Cant go wrong

This is one of my favorite Starbucks. It is a convenient location. Lots of businesses we use are close by it. The one down side about the location is that it's busy so it is sometimes hard to park. The drive thru is accessed between buildings and could be easily missed. 

The workers, however, are always friendly and helpful. They are quick. They are always efficient. The store is near and clean. I stopped on Christmas Eve while out running a last minute errand. I was nervous about stopping on a holiday like that. The drive thru moved quick and the workers were more than friendly and made my Christmas Eve great!
Thought the poker room was very nice.  Like the setup.  Can't wait for tournaments to start here.
Very speedy on a desiel smog check. Not a lot of businesses in town do them and this open c and recommended.  They loved up to their recomendation. I have not done any other services with th am

I was a bit disappointed for I had heard good things about this restaurant. For the $30+ it cost for 2 of us to have lunch (with no drinks), it should have been a dining experience but it wasn't. The place was pretty empty when we arrived and our wait person was OK in that she had a "disinterested" demeanor and wasn't real attentive.
I ordered the pan-fried salmon sandwich.  I think the fish was not fresh for it had a bitter taste and it fell apart when I bit into it. Not what i was expecting.  A person could do some serious staining damage to clothes with such a dish as this. 
The tiny pepper-covered onion rings that came with it, however, were delicious. 
My friend ordered a garden salad  with lime-cilantro dressing and found it very good. She had asked for the dressing on the side but our server put it in the salad instead. The corn-covered fries we ordered as an appetizer were  cripsy and prepared perfectly.
Prior to our meal arriving, we were given a plate with 3 slices of sourdough bread and butter. Nothing special about that.
We tried it once, found the food just so-so, but the prices quite high. (Draft beer prices were twice what we usually pay.)
Once was enough. We won't return.

Do you like wall to wall rugs so old you're instantly greeted by dirt and sweat all over them as you walk in? That same rug material also covers where you sit in the locker room, holding in all the ass sweat and water from showers of years gone by, coupled with the smell that comes with it. Daily. The locker room never smells ok. Totally gross and easily fixed by just removing the rugs off the benches when it gets hot and humid in there from the showers and the sauna, and no ac. And if someone poops too? You can't get in and out quick enough. My great aunt's old phone mouthpiece smelled better. But why bother sporting the elbow grease? They have no posters or art hanging on the walls anywhere in the gym, but what they DO have is a cleaning staff that has allowed someone's booger to stay on the exit of the men's locker room going on 3 weeks now. You can't miss the thing as you walk out. 

But speaking of cleanliness, they had 2 soap dispensers for 3 sinks in one section of the locker room. One dispenser was removed over a month ago, and I guess the going experiment is if it will grow back on it's own. The soap dispenser next to it? Empty for over a week. The broken lockers are never fixed. They just hang on the hinges that are still connected. My favorite one was a recent victim.

Do you like a weight section that smells when you bend down to pick up a weight? Do you like a gym where the owner puts 0.0 dollars into the place? Then this is the gym for you! It's easy to see why this gym touts its success to its members, constantly, asking for new members all the time. I have underwear 15 yrs old in better shape. I go here out of convenience to proximity. That's what I hear from other members as well. They've threatened to open a new gym in Broomall, but I'm starting to wonder if that's just an old wives tale. Seriously, shame on the owner. Don't they have to adhere to some sort of franchise guidelines in order to stay aligned? They have the balls to play a franchise blanket LA Fitness video touting the "staff" has had enough of members stinky bags and for us to be cleaner. Right, we're the problem.

The staff is always pleasant, and some I really enjoy talking to. And for the most part, I'm sure they're powerless to effect change. But most of them don't stick around long enough anyway. I'm always surprised that there is always an influx of forever changing faces. This phantom new facility can't open quick enough.

Lastly, only the last 10 pics in the photos section are of the actual gym. It's the very first one in PA, and you can tell. I would KILL if the gym looked like those other pics.
Amazing food, amazing vibes, very generous! Their soup may be the best soup I've ever had. Recommend the dolma plate

I don't know what the fudge they're doing in Southampton. I've eaten at the newer Las Margaritas on Second Street Pike a few times, and was never satisfied with any of the food I sampled there. I was expecting tough meat, indifferently prepared veg, and too much cheese.

I don't know why, but the quality of food at this original location is far better. The salsa and chips are even fresher! It might be due to the huge turnover (20 minute wait on a MONDAY night), or maybe the owner keeps a closer eye on things over here. Regardless, at this location you will find properly prepared Tex-Mex food that relies on the quality of ingredients rather than adding a whole bunch of cheese and sour cream. This includes perfectly charred veggies with your fajitas, fantastic Mexican rice, well-seasoned beans, and burritos/tacos/what have you with good fillings. You'll also get fantastic margaritas (as the name implies) as well as other cocktails. Even though they're not made to order, I even recommend their house margaritas, as they're a perfect balance of sour, sweet, and tequila.

Everything about the meal wasn't great, the steak in my fajitas was overcooked (though still juicy), the guacamole tasted jarred, and service was slow. Still, this spot is likely the best Tex-Mex in the area, and worth a visit if you're in the mood for this kind of cuisine. It's not authentic, but it hits the spot well.

Had to send my meal back the last time I ate there.  For a place that prides itself on steaks and seafood you'd think the delivery would be flawless.  Too many other options out there for average performance.

For me, this is THE BEST Thai food in Nashville. Lots of flavor and everything is really good. So many of the other Thai restaurants over sauce the food and drown it in goo...not these guys. One of my favorite places to go on a "Date Night" with the hubby when our little boy is the grandparents!

Amazing food! I had a turkey burger and loved it. The brioche bread it's on is to die for. The sauces, onions, turkey cooked perfectly, loved it. My boyfriend got the tritip sandwich and it was gone within 10 seconds. He talked about how good it was all night! 
They also have free cornhole to play and cute lights above. The ambiance is relaxed but still fun! Decently priced for a brewery spot. Would definitely recommend for a cool spot with some friends.
Reducing my score as they no longer play Christian music which was the basis for this restaurant.

I got a Mani-pedi for $55 and it is totally not worth the price!! First, my nail tech dropped the sponge she was using to scrub my feet on the floor and then continued to use it on my foot; I'm not a huge germaphobe but that definitely grossed me out. Next, I got the holographic gel on my nails that was extremely over priced. After I told my nail tech to only shape my nails in a square shape, she continues to file my nails down to short numbs, not what I wanted at all but it was my fault I didn't speak up. The was nothing special about the manicure, no massage, no lotion, just a too hot towel. Then when it finally came to the manicure it came out extremely thick and dented with my cuticles and the side of my nails flooded with the gel polish. My nail tech did not clean up my nails what so ever. The holographic color was beautiful but the application could have been improved. Also, I proved that they overprice the chrome/holographic powders because I just recently bought they same exact holographic powder they used for $7 that will last me about 50+ manicures! I applied it myself and it looks way better then what they did and it was a lot cheaper than a $35 dollar subpar manicure! Will not return!

We love the Sparks Costco! All employees are so friendly. My kids always love seeing Julie when leaving the store. They love receiving her adorable hand drawn smiley face on the little pieces of paper. It makes them feel special!
We love that the Sparks Costco updated their gas station and sells diesel fuel! Keep up the good work!!!

I am from Philadelphia, and my family and I randomly stumbled upon this place. Their brisket,  and ribs were mind blowing. They have a record player going non-stop, and the staff were more than hospitable .. they became friends. We can't wait to come back! They also have every ingredient listed for all recipes. So it is very gluten-free friendly and allergen friendly. Best meal in Nashville so far. :)

Came here to get a vacation tattoo with some friends.  3 of us ended up getting work done - the other two girls were first timers whereas I've had a minimum of about 37 hours' worth of tattooing in my life.  I've been around the block, I've had extensive work by a top artist, I've been to many shops over the years, etc.  

First off, the person working the front desk was acting like a straight up smug / dismissive / snobby bitch until I took off my jacket and she saw that I do, in fact, have a LOT of tattoos (probably more than a lot of the artists) and I know wtf I'm talking about.  I almost decided not to get a tattoo at all because she was so shitty.  

The visiting artist who ended up doing my tattoo was very cool though, she did a nice job and was very friendly.  

I wasn't impressed with the work my friends got on several levels (they had different artists) but they liked it, so that's the main thing I guess.  The execution and design were lacking but oh well.  

My tattoo was obscenely overpriced - even for what you'd imagine to pay for an overpriced touristy tattoo.  But my artist was nice and did a good job, so I tipped her anyway even though the price was ridiculous to start with.  

Okay shop but I'm sure there are better options around NOLA.  

To clarify, I'd give my visiting artist probably 4 to 5 stars for her service and work, 

And the shop desk staff and other artists and price -- I'd give like 0-2 stars, maybe 3 at best.

Love Taziki's! I just tried Taziki's a few months back and now I crave it all the time! My favorite is the grilled chicken roll ups. I always get the fruit as a side and it is always fresh! I have also had the grilled chicken feast, so good! I've never heard a bad thing about their food!

Top 3 Italian resteraunts on my list. I come for George, the fettucine alfredo, chicken noodle soup (wednesdays) and creamy potato (mondays). Their soup alone is to die for! Service lacks a little. I had a waitress totally botch my order and made the worst ceaser salad I have ever had there (ive had atleast 25 before). The atmosphere is great. Although the booths are lovely...get served at the bar!

The food was delicious! I brought my fiancé and he really enjoyed it all. We shared the Pho Ga and Banh Mi Ga. The pho broth was so light and yummy. I had never had Banh Mi Ga and I am glad I did. Their bread was perfectly crunchy and soft. They sat us down quickly and we didn't have to wait long to have our order taken. Shortly after it was brought out with bowls and plates to share. The waiter was friendly and warm. Everyone should try out this restaurant, given the chance.

Called the mover at 9 am on the day of the move as I was instructed the week before. Told me they'd have 2 guys and a truck to move my 1500 sq ft home at 10:30 Sept 28. Ten minutes later I receive a text saying they'd arrive 12-1 because of an issue w one of their trucks. I called and they said they could send two laborers, but I'd have to rent a truck. I got a uhaul and had it at my home by 10am. Noon came then 1, then 2. Still no one calling to say they were running late. I called and was assured someone was on the way. 3 o'clock and nobody. I texted and was told someone on the way. Still no one. Finally, 1 guy shows up at 4oclock. If it weren't for my friends and neighbors helping my family move the entire day would have been a disaster. I'll never trust a company who assures me that "we do same day moves all the time, no problem." The guy who showed up actually instructed us how to load the truck while he smoked and talked on the phone for nearly half an hour (I'm not making this up). I still got charged hourly labor and for the use of the dilapidated truck he drove because we didn't place 6 or 8 items on top of the load in the Uhaul. I honestly don't recall ever feeling so let down by a company before.

Went for breakfast this weekend and had the hot mess biscuit and Nutella latte. Both were awesome. This is a great spot and great addition to the gulch. I am looking forward to trying lunch and dinner there as well.

Love this restaurant. Delicious food. Charming atmosphere and caring service.
Highly recommend

Unfortunately, after coming here frequently over the last year (we brought all our out of town guests here), the service has forever turned us away. 
Like someone else stated, the food can be ok and you will still come back. Bad service and it's over. Well, it's over. I won't go into any details, because really, what's the point, but the server and manager were so bad I was actually kind of embarrassed for them. 
It's ok though. It's a buyers world as far as restaurants go in Nashville.

Two stars, not one star because of previously positive experiences.

It pains me to write a low review for Magazine Nails & Spa because the service and finished product has been good in the past. Except for the last time. 

The woman doing my nails said that she would stop soon because she had an appointment coming in, but not to worry because the gentleman (the only other employee there) would do my nails. Then a funny thing happened, the guy's appointment came in. So there I sat for about 15 minutes watching them do other people's manicures, waiting for either of them to complete my nails or at least give me an update or an apology and I got none of those things. I sat there  like a dope for a while before I gave up and left.
Drinks were good, service was awesome, burgers were AMAZING. Patio only, for us. Too dark and smoky inside.

This is my favorite Mesa Burger location in our area! Just the atmosphere at the Camino Real Marketplace is so spacious and festive especially this time of the year! Ample outdoor seating and if you go on the weekend you'll be able to catch the farmers market as well. 

Beers are cheap (M Special on tap!) and the burgers are fire. If you ever need a pick me up, the Montecito burger (mushrooms, truffle aioli, onion ring, goat cheese) will pick you right up. I've tried other burgers but I always have to go back to the Montecito! It's unparalleled!

This was the last stop on our New Orleans food tour.  We heard this place got pretty packed for breakfast, so decided to go a little after lunch. No line, but still packed. The burger and onion rings were great! But the best was the Pecan Pie for dessert. They actually heat it up on the grill. It melts in your mouth.
The food is fresh and very delicious.  The price is decent and fair for what you get.  And the service is impeccable.  You won't be disappointed here.  Hidden insider tip: try the chicken chashu bun.

Been associated with this UPS location since 2006. Always excellent and hard working folks, great service and super attention to detail.  Cannot say enough about the small town care making a difference in both the personal and the professional experience. Keep up the great work.

Terrible experience and will never go back. I ordered two orders of cheese curds and two blizzards in the drive thru close to closing. When I got my food home one of the blizzards was wrong, and both orders of cheese curds were inedible. They were cooked so long that the cheese had exploded out of if and all that was left was a stuck together clump of empty breading shells. By then it was past closing and too late to take it back. When we called this morning to get our money back we were first hung up on, and then when we called back were told they could not refund our money and that their only option was to remake our order. They obviously lack the ability to look at the product and adequately judge the acceptability of its quality before handing it over to a paying customer so why in the world would I trust them to remake it? All I wanted was my money back and they couldn't be bothered to give me that OR a simple apology for their terrible work and apathy.

Live jazz music is such a nice change from the typical shenanigans that happen on Bourbon St. The band was probably in their 50s and attracted a crowd of people from their 20s-70s? The older people in the front row were tapping along and swaying to the melody, which was a really sweet sight. They had a tip/donation jar in the front that was meant to benefit jazz performance/education. 

The only reason for docking a star was that our server was getting pushy and judgmental about us ordering drinks. We took a little longer to decide on what we wanted, but he made sure we understood that there was a one drink minimum...

Went to see Idina Menzel with my wife for a date night and the facility is not well kept. Very dirt all over. Attendants were rude and not courteous at all! The most annoying thing about this concert pavilion is the parking; this was not a big event and the parking was $40.00! That is the most ridiculous parking price I have ever paid, even for Philly concerts I have attended and like I said this was not a big event. I'm usually not one to complain, but this  place just made the entire night extremely dull. My suggestions: hire more courteous staff, clean the place up, and have more reasonable prices for parking, food, and drinks! I more than likely won't go back to BB&T Pavilion ever again. Idina was good, but the venue really made it a horrible time. I would not recommend this place unless a big time performer was performing here and it was worth your time and money!

I absolutely love this place!!! I do everything here... hair color, cut, nails, lashes.... amazing. Everyone and I mean everyone is so friendly, and warm! I highly recommend anyone in this place WITHOUT ANY HESITATION!

Another solid choice in my lunch rotation.  The menu is very limited and there was only one server at lunch.  The best dish I have tried here is the Lemongrass Chicken.  The Beef Pho is good but cannot compare with any of the Vietnamese dives on Charlotte Pike.  It is small and nicely decorated with a patio.  Prices are reasonable.  There seems to be inverse correlation between atmosphere and food quality when it comes to Asian restaurants.  When I think of the best Asian restaurants in town, they are all dives like Thai Phooket near the stadium.  This place would probably be a good choice for dinner.

We went for dinner on 8/05/2021. It was absolutely awful. We use to like Golden Corral but not anymore. We're done with Golden Corral. We paid over $16 per person for garbage. The place was filthy. There's was food all over the counters and no options on where to sit because they were mostly dirty tables or the sections were closed. There was kids running around unsupervised and getting food with their dirty hands leaving the serving spoons SLIMY. There was barely any food. The buffet was half empty and whatever food that was there was super old. Everything was past the display time by over an hour(I Saw the tags with the time/date). We waited for meatloaf for forty minutes. Everything was outright dirty and unsanitary to the point they should be closed down by the health department. I liked GC but after tonight we're done, we're not going back.




I would have took more pictures but didn't think about until we were leaving.

I really like the people that work here.  They are extremely friendly and talented.  The food is AMAZING, the prices are perfect, service was great and the food was AMAZING again.  Fried chicken, greens, mac and cheese.  Some serious comfort and soul food at it's finest.  This place is definitely worth a visit.  It's kind of hole in the wall meets absolutely fantastic food that you just can't get anywhere else.

Love love love this place. Perfect staff and delicious food every time. I have never had anything go wrong here. The pad Thai is one of my favorites dishes I get when I visit here. They also have a variety of sushi rolls that are quite good as well. Definitely recommend checking this place out.
Unique, locally grown, delicious!!!  Love the atmosphere and of course the custom-made pancakes!

I am a Hilton Honors Member, my stay here at the downtown Hilton was truly a unforgettable one, but by the grace of God my husband is doing much better. We book our stay from Las Vegas and chose this hotel for our 5 day stay. First day of our stay we found a roach next to the table lamp so we got switched to a higher level ( almost at the top) no big deal, we moved room. Three days into our stay my husband and I decided to head downstairs to grab something to eat, we took the elevator and all of a sudden the elevator broke down with just me and him in it. To make matters worst, my husband has health issues, including being claustrophobic and  having severe anxiety attacks. As we were stuck in the elevator I started panicking because my husband was experiencing breathing issues in which he started taking his clothes off trying to catch his breath. I tried calling the hotel to let them know we've been stuck for a few minutes by now the elevator had no signal and I could not make no phone call, I tried using the emergency button but it wasn't working (fire code violation).  We tried the call button and that didn't work. I finally started screaming at the top of my lungs for someone to come get us out, no one came. I finally decided it was necessary to call 911 so I did. For the meantime I continued to pound on the door and screamed for help. About one hour later the ambulance arrived they were able to check my husband and check his vitals, he wasn't doing well, but he also didn't want to be taking to the hospital because of the high risk of COVID infections and we also had a funeral to attend the next day. My husband and I managed to get a few reports (written and signed) from two employees stating that it has been a previous issue, and has not been the first time the same elevator has broken down, including the hotel continuing to have this safety code violation. God bless the people around the hotel that offered us great service, specially the Hispanic man doing service/maintenance around the hotel that was able to help us. I'm thankful we were safely taken out of the elevator, glory to God. 
Overall my review for this hotel was based on our experience. This hotel is located in the  center, walking distance to the water side, great location.

We have been to Clementine's three times now and each experience has been great. I like to order different things every time I go and that is not difficult since the flavors change and everything is so uniquely delicious. When you initially walk in you are taken by all the choices.  The employees are so helpful, knowledgable and patient, We were able to taste many different flavors before making our final choice. There are just a few places that I enjoy as much as my kids this is one of them. I love "cup is sunshine" and "the mojito". It's a must.

A++++++

My wife and I stayed at the Golden Plough Inn for one night during the first week of September.  We booked the vacation on a whim through Trip Advisor, and received a decent rate for what was advertised as a suite.  When we arrived, we instantly were impressed with the Inn as it offered a look similar to a B & B.  We were initially placed into a single bedroom, which was nice, but not exactly what we had expected.  The folks at the front desk were incredible and accommodating, and advised that they would upgrade our room free of charge.  We were also provided a complementary breakfast and carousel ride.  They were just so incredible and kind to us, and went over and beyond.  We would definitely recommend and stay again!

Breakfast was also terrific, and our server was very friendly and sweet.

Went for dinner 8/25/17 with 2 girlfriends.  Girls weekend in Carp! We rented a condo by the beach and wanted some din din! The restaurant is sooo cute! We ate outside in a little covered wooden booth. Tea house vibes. The wood had carvings in it.  I had the Asparagus and Mushroom with Beef. The veggies were crisp and beef tender. One friend had the Yellow Curry with Chicken. Love the coconut milk in the curry! It was very good with a LITTLE kick.  My other friend had the Chicken Satay with dipping sauce. My friend wanted to rub the peanut sauce on her face it was sooo good. The combinations has ample food! The soup  and sides were good sized. Service was timely and attentive. Food was delicious. They are pet friendly. Def coming back!

The service was disgusting tonight. The cashier was very abrupt and unfriendly. No such thing as a smile, please or thank you. 

I paid extra $2.00 to have all white meat in a 3 piece combo. I got one piece of white meat. There were a total of 8 French fries in the box for the side. 

The chicken contained a lot of fat and was very greasy. 

The restaurant was very dirty and unkept. The washroom was also very dirty. This place needs a good inspection by the franchise owner and the Dept of Health inspection.

I stop here once in a while when I go to visit my family in VA

On the way home and after driving for 4 hours I stopped here.

I order a meal which came with a salad. I forgot to ask them to omit the croutons and when I asked Tim to give me a new salad because I have a allergy to wheat he said just take them off
I apologized and asked for a fresh one.
He came back with what I thought was a new salad but once I dug in found crumbs....

Make sure you let them know you have an allergy because they don get it

Otherwise a predictable good meal

We ordered the black and blue salad and a chicken pesto pizza.   Both were flavorful and filling. The salad was huge and the pizza was thin crust but held a nice helping of toppings.   The Pima county food department was doing an inspection so I don't know if it was scheduled or a result of a compliant? Lol!  The place was clean the staff were friendly and fast and the bathrooms were clean and huge for single toilet restrooms!  (You could fit a few stalls in there if they wanted).

Heard good things about Wasabi so I decided to stop by and check it out. I originally planned on getting sushi but then I saw ramen on the menu! Ramen is starting to get popular in Chicago but I definitely didn't expect to see it in southern Illinois. I ordered the ramen with beef broth and added shrimp.

With ramen the noodles are key..can't be over cooked but can't be too firm. Actually came out pretty good. But wow...the broth was the game changer. Definitely different than what I had in Chicago but in a good way! I like strong broths and this one definitely had flavor to say the least. If you haven't tried real ramen (meaning instant ramen doesn't count) then Wasabi's ramen is a must. The shrimp was fresh so there wasn't a funny smell. 

Cody was our server and I had no problems. He checked on us constantly and treated me like I was a returning guest. I felt at home and that is what makes a good experience. I'm glad I stopped by...got surprised with good ramen and the service was great. You know I'll be back.

Food is SO GOOD - But the hostess service is awful!!  We've come here a handful of times, usually with a party of 8 or more.  Every single time we come with a group you can practically hear the hostesses eyeballs rolling into the back of their heads. They make seating big parties so much more difficult than it should be (coming from someone that was a hostess for over 5 years and server for 10).  But I'd still give Awe Daddy's 4 stars b/c their food will keep us coming back!  I haven't had a single dish that I didn't love.  The atmosphere is great, especially when the weather is nice. Suggestion: try the mozzarella sticks, you won't regret it!!!

My wife and I attended this festival.  It's the first time that the two of us had ever been to a beer festival and it was a BLAST!  Great people, great beer, free stuff, and so much information about the beer.

I plan to attend this festival every year.  There are two sessions.  1 in the afternoon and 1 in the evening.  I went to the afternoon session.  It was a little hot.  Next year, I will take an umbrella for shade.  I can hardly wait.

The food here is amazing! It's hard to find somewhere that is as authentic as this place across the board. You can't really go wrong with any of the dishes flavor wise. However, the portions of meat for the curries were incredible small. Of the pieces of meat in our curries, they were 90% bone. If it wasn't for this, I definitely would have given five stars, but the portions of actual meat left my friends unsatisfied.
Small, crowded but great service. Probably the best shrimp and grits I've had. Parking was a problem.
Love the $5 Tuesday's and cheap early Friday movies and seniors get a discount. Seats have been renewed. Sooo comfortable just make the popcorn fresher

I've been to many nail salons in the area, and this salon is by far the best. It is warm, bright and very nicely decorated. Above all, it is super clean which is really important to me.

Zack, the owner, and his wife are very customer service oriented and make you feel at ease and relaxed. Each nail technician is very precise and professional and I've always left very happy.  Today, my polish started to bubble when I was at the dryers. I let the technician know and she immediately fixed it and my nails were perfect by the time I walked out the door.

The express manicure and pedicure are a great value and I love how they have such a big selection of colors.

One piece of advice: This place is popular and gets very busy, even at times you wouldn't expect. Once I went on a Monday afternoon in the summer and it was packed! I watched several people come in that Monday who couldn't get taken right away because they had appointments booked. Frankly, I really appreciated how loyal they were to the people who made appointments and were committed to not taking a walk in if it would mean that the person who made an appointment would have to wait. Ive been to other places where an appointment meant nothing. So I highly recommend calling ahead before you go.

We had a nice time at Long Bridge with our 3 kiddos.  There are nice paths to walk, a long bridge (as you may have guessed), and a decent playground.  It is free, so that is a plus of course, and it really nice for a visit, especially on a weekday when it's not busy.

Don't do this for restaurant week. 

Yea..it's your ticket in when you clearly don't have enough dough to actually dine here.  BUT expect to be herded like cattle.  Seated. Order taken. Bread offered. Wine Served. Ap. Entree. Dessert. Check. 30 minutes. Tops. 

No offering of a second glass of wine. No checking to see how the food was. Only one pass at bread. No coffee offered with dessert. Bing-bang-boom. Done. 

Yes. The food was super delish. I even soldiered my way thru snails. Had some steak (with beet puree -- actually really tasty!) and some chocolate cake. 

But, really?  Even though I'm only in your restaurant for this trial thing, please treat me like I would actually be treated in the real dining area so that I would WANT to come back and spend the money I will eventually earn.  And, don't sit me on top of two other couples. 

Note to the dude in the corner taking pictures of his food - you're supposed to do this in a clandestine way. And you shouldda noticed the waiter glaring at you for 30 minutes while you picked the right shutter speed.  Have some class. This is why we're being herded thru this place.

I asked several times if they could turn the AC to a more comfortable temperature. The manager insisted that it was set at 70, however as you can clearly see.. it's at 82.  He said, "the AC is not broken. It is just humid outside."
Hello. This is Tucson. It's not humid.
Fix the AC!
My friend said the food was good. I couldn't eat because my stomach was getting nauseous as it was so hot in this restaurant. People started clearing out quickly.

I recently took my 2013 Corolla into Ron Hibbard for a popping sound coming from the right front passengers side of the car.  Upon inspection from their service department, they found a weld that had come loose and needed to be welded back.  Since they do not have a bodyshop onsite, they gave me a loaner vehicle (2017 Tacoma 4x4 sweet!!!!) and said they would call me when the work was completed.

Day two with the loaner vehicle, the service department called and told me the work had been completed by Miracle Ford's bodyshop and the car was ready to be picked up.  I gave back the loaner vehicle (sad to say), and was greeted by Jordan Clay and Randy Hughs.  They both were very attentive and told me that I was, "good-to-go".  I asked about a bill, and was told nothing was due.  I was in shock with nothing being due, an no I do not know anyone personally there.  They told me Ron took care of this one.  This is what surprise customer service is.  Now if I could only get the 4x4 Tacoma for the same price I bought the Corolla for.

Thanks again Ron Hibbard Toyota and his crew!!!
Me and my wife come here at least once a week great pizza ! They take great care of us aswell

okay. i get that the point of yelp is to be honest but again...i ALWAYS feel bad giving bad reviews. 

however. mi lah was a super super bumout. i went with a group of 10 to celebrate a special occasion...and we ended being entirely disappointed. we made the reservation for 8 p.m. and asked to make sure that it would be enough time to eat, and relax, and drink the multiple bottles of champagne we were bringing. they assured us it would be fine. this turned out to be...not really true. 

so time to order. i decided on an appetizer and a salad for my meal, and to bring it out when everyone else was served. the server came back to say that he wrote over what i ordered and needed it again. hmmm. okay. then my food came out like twenty minutes before everyone else's, and everyone else's came out at different times too. they sent out the wrong appetizer to one person, and forgot someone else's entirely. 

as for the actual entrees? they sent out four of the same dish (??) but only two of them had been ordered. so two people had to just sit around like dicks while everyone else ate. the two people that ordered the grilled seitan with tamarind were super unhappy (it was horrible) and tried to send it back, but the server argued that he had just had it for lunch and there was nothing wrong with it. by the time he agreed to send it back, he said they would be closing and wouldn't be able to put in an order for something else, and also refused to take them off the bill because "more than one quarter had been eaten". actually about three bites had been eaten, and the plate was almost entirely untouched. 
??

finally we asked to speak with the manager. he disappeared and when he came back, he said the manager said they were too busy to speak with us. we were...the only table in the entire upstairs, and there were maybe two or three small tables occupied downstairs. soooooo...the good? the crispy tofu appetizer was pretty delicious but not enough for me to go back. the sweet potato patties were good. the brussels sprouts got a thumbs up. the service was...well, the crispy tofu was good!

an aside-we ended up going to mamma mia's to feed the people who never got their meals and popping the champagne there instead, and this ended up being the best part of the night. 


: (

Phoned to make reservations for about a dozen friends and myself. Received a slightly hesitant response (please read-on). 

Arrived about 30 minutes early to a near-empty restaurant - only one other couple (please read on).

Rather austere, albeit modern decor.

Our server "J" was very attentive and offered drinks and/or starters. I chose the Papajack (Passion Fruit Sangria); sweet, but thin on alcohol and flavor. 

Ceviche...muddled, opaque - giving the appearance that it was not as fresh as could be...a bit off-putting. Tostones accompanying it - excellent.

Mofongo de Yuca - crispy outside, creamy interior - very good.

Trip Around Puerto Rico {description from their menu}: "Choose three of the following: (Served with two sides) Portions of Pastelon de Amarillos, Carne Frita, Ropa Vieja and Pernil. This is ideal to be shared.

So we ordered Carne Frita (pan-fried pork with demo-glazed onions) - good; Ropa Vieja (pulled flank steak) - bland; and Pernil (slow-roasted PR-spiced pork) - meh and ugh...very fatty and not very well seasoned. When we left nearly a third of the fat on the plate, the server politely asked if we didn't want to finish that. Uh....I'm not really a big, lightly-rendered fat fan. PLUS....the overall portion was really the size for one unless shared as an appetizer)

Steamed veggie side - I should have known better. wilted veggies with no snap and little seasoning.

If you've read this far, then you've come to the good part....the place suddenly filled up (I mean FULL) with lots of young people. And we were invited to stay (we were the only people left eating) and join the free Salsa-dance Session.

Considering all the positive reviews I've read - maybe we hit an "off day."
SO GOOD.  so thick and a lot of toppings. The BEST açaí bowls !!! I could eat these everyday

Stayed here for a week and location is perfect. Steps away from the beach, boardwalk and restaurants. View from the 7th floor is wonderful. Hotel is updated throughout - minus a few minor things here and there (the ac unit in the room, the vents could be cleaned in the bathroom) but the room and bathroom were clean and honestly how much time do you spend in your room when you're staying at a location like that? We ate at the poolside bar the first day and Ashley was great. A few other days we ordered drinks at the pool and it seemed like during the week they're under staffed and or busier then usual. It was pretty irritating to order a drink and wait 20 minutes.. Even just for a beer. Another day we ended up getting a cabana for the day on the beach and you have it the entire day until 6pm and it's great (just get there early or they're all gone) Kyle at Boucher Brothers helped us with the chairs and everything and was very accommodating. Keep up the hard work! Also their breakfast is served until 11:30am with a great variety. The first day we had Miguel as our waiter and he was one of the most personable people we have met there. He did his job extremely well and when he had a few moments he stopped to talk to us. We asked to be seated in his section each day but it was busy and there was a wait but we ended up getting him again on the last day and once again, amazing service from Miguel - thank you! The few days we didn't get him we ended up sitting outside and the views were great. Overall good hotel with amazing location and great staff. Oh and you can get Starbucks coffee in the lobby!

Three years ago, i wrote a review on this Cheddar's, so it's time for an update. When we entered, we were absolutely the first patrons in the door. Our super server, Kylie, took care of us the entire meal.

Like last time, I ordered the Monte Cristo with the powdered sugar and, for dipping, raspberry preserves. It was as good today as it was in 2016. My wife's baby back ribs looked as good today as they had all the other times.

Incredibly, not much has changed in three years. The food wasn't fancy schmancy, but it tasted good, the portions were large and the prices  were reasonable. Oh, we got über good service from super server Kylie, but I'm not changing Cheddar's four star rating.

Today was my first time visiting Melba's, and it will be my last. One word that describes my experience today was a circus, while waiting for my corn grits and shrimp which took thirty minutes, I overheard a conversation between a local and two tourist about how "food outside of the French Quarter was the real taste of NO". Sadly this wasn't the case today for my girlfriend and I, and the worst thing about was the dining experience in itself. 
While I waited for my corn grits and shrimp, the staff were severely behind on orders, arguing in front of customers ( and I mean yelling) with each other, and EVEN with customers who had every right to be frustrated with the unpleasant wait. I've never felt more awkward eating in my life a restaurant in my life until Today. I'm giving my experience two stars instead of one simply because it was apparent that locals still choose to eat here so I couldn't overlook. I was truly disappointed.

Bar hoping in the FQ we came upon this place. If you're a beer lover this is the perfect place with lots of beers on draft. I really hate the fact that there are not many places in the Quarter with decent beer so this place was a nice experience. A few drafts later we ordered the Saint burger which is like a burger and bacon between Texas toast.  Passed on the fries and got the grit instead. Now, I'm not from the South but those were some damn good grits. Grits, burger and beer it is! The bartender was very helpful and attentive enough to notice the food wasn't timely and went back to resolve the issue. Shortly after the food arrived. This is my new home for real beer!  On the weekdays HHs are 2-1 beers (even draft) and game day its $10 a pitcher. There are lots of TVs making it a great place to watch the games.
This pizza is horrible. The cheese and crust are NOTHING. I only ordered it because it was one of a few things that would deliver at the time. Please get the other thing.

Very cool restaurant concept! Everything on the menu starts with the letter "C". I went for brunch on a Sunday (which I found out Sunday brunch has the most limited menu) but I was still able to find items on the menu that were interesting. On our table we had the Country Steak and Eggs as well as the Cheesy Sandwich. The cheesy sandwich was paired with an apricot jam as their rotating jam. Both were delicious. The steak was a bit chewy but the meal was presented well. The highlight is the cheesecake! I had the classic with the mixed berry...nothing short of amazing. 

I love the vibe as well. There is outdoor and indoor seating. We opted to sit indoors as it was cooler than normal that particular day. There is live music if you opt to sit outside. 

Biggest problem with this restaurant, I wish I can take 0.5 stars off  and it cannot be overlooked is the parking. The parking lot is small holding maybe 10 cars. After that you are awkwardly parking in front of people's homes in a neighborhood.

Ella's never disappoints and is one of my top 3 restaurants in town. The pork chops are melt in your mouth good and the pizza and burgers take those genres to new heights. Do yourself a favor and go to the soul food Sunday brunch and get the chicken and waffles (with bourbon gravy) and wash it down with a spicy and smokey Bloody Mary that is served with a BBQ rib in the glass.

Goat cheese balls, deep fried and drizzled with honey (or croquetas if you're being proper) make everything better. Seriously, since moving to New Orleans, I've noticed that anytime my mood swings little low I start to crave the crispy, creamy, sweet and tart deliciousness of those goat cheese balls. And miraculously, they never fail to make me feel like things are gonna be okay. 

Also, the mushroom manchego toast is amazing and has a similar impact. I love the exposed brick atmosphere, and with the windows open, it's a fabulous place to come grab a meal and drink. I just wish the hipster vibe could get taken down a notch. Surprisingly, I have yet to come here for DJ Soul Sister on Saturday night but am seriously considering Mimi's as the venue for my first ever birthday celebration in NOLA next month! Great food, drinks and dancing? Yes, please.

We stopped here for lunch while doing some shopping. I had a blackberry Mule which was excellent. The 3 of us ordered lunch and it was amazing. We had the chicken farm to table bowel, cheesesteak sliders and French onion grilled cheese. The service was fantastic and prices were more than reasonable. The restaurant and restrooms were clean and well decorated. 
. If I lived in the Tampa area I would go once a week to sample everything on the menu. 
Can't say that I enjoyed the food as much as I did here.
Food is overpriced and mediocre. Cashier could not crack a smile to save her life. With so many other choices, I'm kicking myself for eating here.

CASH ONLY

Very affordable, delicious menu with unique items. I got the chai pancakes and they were amazing! I typically get savory brunch foods so I was quite surprised/happy with my choice. I went with a friend around 1:30 PM and the wait was only 5-10 minutes but the food took FOREVERRRRR to come.. I don't know if the kitchen is normally that slow or they forgot our order... but fair warning. The place is a little cramped, but there's this semi-outdoor extension in the back where we were seated. They had heaters out since it was January when we went so that was really nice of them!

A lot of fun! This restaurant had such a great vibe with the live music. When we arrived around 7:00, there was about a twenty minute wait for the covered patio to hear the music, but we went to the outside patio and relaxed there for awhile, so it was a pleasant experience. There was also plenty of seating inside. 

The music was awesome, the food was awesome. We started with fried pickles ($5.99) and while you can't go wrong with anything that's been fried, the white BBQ dipping sauce was the real standout. As our Nashville relatives put it, the pickles are really just the vehicle for that barbecue sauce. 

One thing that I thought was cool was that you can order off of the lunch menu even at dinnertime. Since I was feeling (sadly) stuffed from all the rich southern food we had been eating, I appreciated being able to get a smaller portion size. I had the "lunch" pulled pork tacos (with a tasty slaw and pico) and bourbon mashed sweet potatoes as a side. The bbq was solid, but I was most wowed by the sweet potatoes...they were so sweet and I loved it. Definitely order this side.
Really good food. I was full before the chips and salsa. I had low expectations because it's so it's too close to my house and it was great

I honestly don't know how this location has managed to stay open when they don't know how to make the sandwiches on their own menu- I have not received what I have actually ordered from them in years. I foolishly gave them another shot and as expected, my "turkey grinder" sandwich was nothing more then deli meat, lettuce, tomato and cheese- no salt, no pepper, no onions, no sports peppers. If I just wanted some meat and cheese thrown haphazardly on bread, I could have made it myself.

Absolutely lovely hotel ! I stopped here to have a quick cocktail and loved the inviting aroma in the lobby, coupled with the beautiful decor. Next time I'm in Philly, this will be the hotel to spend the night.

I came here during vacation.  It was closed Wednesday and Thursday the week we were there.  Every time we peered into the courtyard while it was closed, we became more and more obsessed with the place.  The courtyard with a fountain was so charming, almost enchanting.  

When we finally did eat there, it didn't disappoint.  We ordered a muffaletta and shrimp and grits to share.  Once we dug into the shrimp and grits, we instantly felt we needed to have our own bowl.  The grilled shrimp sat on a cloud of creamy grits.  The sauce had a good amount of heat and the corn added a lil sweetness.  I will forever measure other shrimp and grits against cafe amelie's.  We also had the hibiscus tea which was refreshing and not too sweet.  

On our way out, we saw the cutest little salamander sitting on a wrought iron bench and then it jumped into the garden.  This place is truly enchanting.

Telaya is awesome!

Some of you grouchy-pants need hugs.  Giving Telaya a negative review for customer service is HILARIOUSLY misguided and inaccurate.  More on that later in the review...

This review has nothing to do with the way their wines taste.  For what it's worth, I really enjoy their wines.  But wine enjoyment is so subjective, and I am not qualified or sophisticated enough to tell you why I like their wines.  I just do....

My wife and I have been going to Telaya since we moved to Boise in 2017.  From day one, I was impressed.  Their staff was super friendly, knowledgeable, and FUN.  Their building is clean, temperature-controlled, inviting, and comfortable.  The property is right on the greenbelt, and there is an amazing outdoor area -- great for people-watching, nature-watching, and relaxing while enjoying a glass or two of wine.  One of my favorite aspects of Telaya is how pet and kid-friendly it is.  Usually there is a collection of happy dogs and happy families enjoying the outdoor area.  

I couldn't speak more highly of the staff (which includes the owners).  Everyone involved in this business is so friendly and accommodating.  Watching them hustle around the property taking care of the various patrons makes me smile.  They have been so good to my wife and I over the years.    They are engaging, efficient, and (again) fun!  We always walk away from Telaya with a smile.  

Unless you have been living under a rock, we are all aware that the world of customer service has been tricky to navigate over the past year.  I couldn't be more proud of the Telaya team (from the top-down) on how they navigated what amounts to the toughest retail restrictions that I can recall in my lifetime (I'm 42).  During the past year, we went to Telaya often. I am so thankful that the ownership and staff provided a safe and comfortable place to enjoy ourselves in a world that felt unsafe and uncomfortable.  

Looking over some of these negative reviews, I am so confused as to why a very vocal minority are taking issue with Telaya's handling of Covid.  Your writings indicate that you think that the Telaya team enjoyed having to put restrictions on how people experience their winery/tasting room.  I can assure you that they didn't.  Telaya is a family-friendly environment.  The staff interacts with one another like a family.  They treat their patrons like family.  They have spent the past year operating their business in the best way they can manage in order to protect their "family."  I highly doubt that this was political for them.  They followed the guidelines given them to protect their staff and patrons.  They took extra care to ensure that they could continue to operate and provide the best environment possible.  They were kind, respectful, and thoughtful.

I can't tell you how many times at Telaya over the past year, I got out of my seat without my mask on -- I am forgetful and thoughtless sometimes (often).  The staff was so kind in the way that they reminded me to please put my mask on (trust me, their reminders to me were much kinder than my wife's).  I highly doubt they liked having to be the mask police, but they had to ensure that their business stayed open to provide income for their staff and a great place for us to enjoy their wines.  

As a member of the Boise community, I am immensely proud of the way that the Telaya team has handled themselves.  Their staff should be commended for the grit, grace, and smiles that they brought to a really difficult time in the world.  I am proud to be a part of the Telaya "family", and would strongly encourage anybody to wander off the greenbelt, grab a seat, order some wine, and make some friends at Telaya.

Love this store! They are very selective of the clothes they purchase so the inventory is excellent- all newer styles and upscale brands. Don't go here looking for juniors type brands since they will not have it. They have jewelry, accessories, shoes, purses, and maternity too! I'll be back to sell and shop!!

I had lunch here for the first time yesterday and it was fantastic.  Now I'm not very knowledgable about Thai or Viet food, but I can tell you that I ordered the Chicken Pad Thai and it was outrageously delicious!  And I mean outrageously!  I've never even tried Pad Thai before but the server talked me into it when I said I would order the Lo Mein because that was the extent of my knowledge of this type of cuisine.  Great Job and thanks for steering me in the right direction.  My office is right upstairs and now I know that I've added a new menu option to my daily ritual...

Kinda of a tourist trap. The setting is nice and the music was ok (although not really jazz). The food was good however really small and expensive. Paid for example $10 for a tiny salad (which had 3 leaves of lettuce and 2 radishes on the plate) or $14 for 2 scallops. On top of that after an hour and half there,  and in the middle of one of the band's songs, the door man came to tell us we had to leave because they needed the table for other customers. Nobody told us that when we made the reservation. 
We won't go back. No worth the money to me.
I checked in & we left. Waited 20 minutes & only got water. No one came by to take a drink order forgetting food. A seriously awful band was playing. No food. Bad music. Time to go.

I got an array of items from here including seasoned rice, chicken korma, paalak (spinach), squash subzi, cholay (chickpeas), diced tandoori chicken, a spinach and feta puff, and a samosa puff (puff because it was made with PHILO DOUGH yum), and tandoori chicken wings! My favorites were the tandoori wings and samosa puff. Definitely desi style fusion food. The spinach puff was creative as well, as it had a spicier flavor than a typical spanakopita type of puff. The chicken korma with rice was awesome as well, loved the sweet flavor with chicken and rice. Only thing I would say was that it would be great with a white sauce or yogurt, which I crave as a brown person with my South Asian foods.

Coffee is super good! They have an insane menu and you could spend a solid 20 minutes choosing something to order. DONT FORGET TO SAY YOU WANT SUGAR!!! Especially if you normally go to like Starbucks or dunkin, some drinks only come with sugar when requested.

The best place to go to in New Orleans. Excellent museum with a lot of detail regarding America's involvement in World War 2. I go there every time I visit New Orleans. Be prepared to spend several hours  in the museum.

I'm at Ryan airfield almost every other day flying. Us local pilots were happy to see a new restaurant at the field where we can grab bfast/lunch and brief flights....the waitress who waited on us today was amazing! Very kind and attentive and the food was wonderful as well! Our meals were  out in a timely manner, food was hot & yummy, coffee was refilled regularly....A++++ experience.  I'm not sure why some of these other users who left subpar reviews would be so quick to judge a restaurant that literally just opened their doors, everyone knows there's bound to be a few hiccups the first week. My overall experience was great and I look forward to returning soon!
Food, service and ambiance were all perfect! Enjoyed the food, especially the guacamole. My husband had the chicken enchiladas and loved them as well.

Great patio, we come here often to enjoy it.  However the food is very hot and miss. Service is always pretty good.  The last two visits the food left us a bit to be desired. My plate was like warm but the wife's was fine.  I'll go back but there are indeed some better options near by. Hopefully it's just the challenges with staffing right now.

I will change my review when this issue gets fixed. I have tried to use discover at this location on 2 separate occasions and both times the card is declined. However I called discover to see if there was a freeze on my account but no. There wasn't even any indication that they had tried it at 5 guys. Something is wrong with the machine and it's very inconvenient.
Everything was super salty.  Overpriced food with little authenticity to the real thing.  Did I mention how salty the food was?

I was searching for good custard and didn't want to go the traditional fast food route. This place was located not too far away so we tried it. Nearly $7 for a banana split that was not plentiful and $3.50 for a root beer float. Good treats, fair pricing.

This is a small Mozzi's pizza shop and is carry out or delivery only. Their pizza's are very similar to Pizza King, and if I recall they used to be a part of the PK family maybe 20 years ago, then changed the name but kept similar pizza's, haha. 

The staff seems okay here, not that I talk to them much being carry out / delivery, but they get the pizza's made, and usually everything is made correctly, the pizza's look very good and taste pretty good, but not the best. And they are more on the expensive end of pizza's, when their pizzas are more of a middle range taste, haha. 

They do have another large location on hwy 40 that has a pizza buffet during lunch hours and it is pretty good, if you're looking for an eat-in location. 

I recommend this place because the pizza is good. Try BBQ sauce instead of standard sauce for an extra kick of flavor.

This is by far the worst Dunkin' I have ever been too. Unfriendly and unprofessional employees, long wait times for drive thru, inside ordering and mobile orders! The store always seems dirty and the employees never look happy to be there. I'd rather drive farther to another Dunkin' to avoid the horrible customer service at this one.
Most amazing steak. Delicious appetizers. Staff are seet and personable. Must try when you visit.

I have been here a half dozen times or so with between 2 and 8 people seated at our table.

When we walk in we are always greeted and welcomed. 
We eat out a lot, and I wish other restaurants treated us as well when we walk in the door.

We usually are served by Sal and he is attentive and a class act. 
He is a great server.

I wish they had a bigger selection of appetizers, however, we tried all of them  in the course of our visits and they are all well prepared and delicious.

The dinners are great also. Everyone that we have eaten here with has raved about it. They are tasty without being over spiced, never bland. The portions are generous. Just how you want good food to be.

Everything I have eaten here was cooked perfectly. 

The desserts are always great.

The only thing that I have to knitpick about is that the tables in the middle are wobbly. 
I understand that this has nothing to do about the great food and service. I tried thinking of anything that I could criticize about the place to be fair, and this is the only thing that I could come up with.

I always left Pasta Fazool feeling that I was very satisfied with the food, service and prices.
Super generic mexican food. There was cauliflower and broccoli in my veggie burrito for example.
The combo pho was very good--everything tasted very fresh with amazing broth. My husband had the pork belly sliders and we loved them.
Very very slow service- do not recommend. Terrible - extremely slow. Go somewhere else.. 40 minutes for the waitress to even take your order!!!!
We had a great time with friend from the Cayman Islands. They really enjoyed your atmosphere and food.

This place was amazing when I arrived for check in. I attended a conference and stayed for an entire week. The view was amazing and would recommend anyone for a balcony room to maximize your view. I've stayed in the Gaylord in National Harbor outside of DC and this place is twice the size of it. The only thing that was not accomodating was microwave. The rooms had refrigerator but no microwave. The front desk couldn't even offer a microwave for guest to use. Any 4 star hotel should have a microwave in the room. If you look at the price of the restaurant inside the hotel you would wish they had a microwave in the room. A small bag of potato chips was $4.25. Come on! The rooms was great and really met my expectations. The Opry Mills mall is 5 minute walking distance to the hotel and they have plenty of restaurant to choose from. The other down side is that the hotel is a 20 minute bus ride from downtown Nashville where all the tours and sightseeing are located.
