Double check the wi-fi, my conference was able to get a deal with hotel management on wi-fi access and I got a conference deal of $107/night for my stay and had my resort fees waived.
I'm so glad they are still open during this pandemic. Great customer service and even more amazing food. They have the best blue cheese in the city to pair with their amazing fries mushrooms!

My husband and I are at Brio now and was just so impressed by the great service ONCE AGAIN, that we looked at each other and said, That's it! We must write reviews -Now! Mind you we RARELY write reviews. But Brio is just exceptional! The food is always fresh and consistently amazing not to mention the huge selection, whatever you're I the mood for, they have. But more then that is the service and the MANAGERS willingness to go above and beyond to keep the customer happy. Who ever trains their staff, what ever modality you use, it should be taught to every single restaurant and hospitality establishment there is. I moved here from living in Manhattan for 16yrs so know, that I KNOW a thing or two about 'good food and great service' And I cannot say enough good things about Brio. From the beginning of your visit, RACHAEL at the front desk is a GEM to every server we ever had to the managers -Impeccable service n accommodation. I highly recommend BRIO to you you as a couple or to host a large event. They were voted #1 in all Restaurant Chains in the country FOR A DAMN GOOD REASON :)) (Else Roderick)

Living at Summit was simple, smooth, and a piece of mind. Yes, there were some things such as maintenance not being timely and the front desk receptionists not being very helpful, but Taylor V. from the Leasing Office made sure someone saw the issues and complaints to the end. Overall- reasonable price for nice living accommodation. Would recommend for 2nd year and above students looking for a place to stay.
Really big nursery with friendly and knowledgeable staff. Decent prices and a wide variety of plants and more.
Dr. E seems really sweet! Her pressure (for me) is perfect. I'm excited to continue receiving her adjustments.

One of the oldest bars in american or even possibly the oldest... how can you not check this place out???  Granted, this place is located near the end of bourbon street, its only like a 5 minute walk from all the action.

first thing i noticed about this place was how dark it was.  apparently, they only use candle lights inside on the tables to light the place up.  i thought it was extremely cool to stay "true" to the olden culture.  they also had a piano player on a sunday night and it was very entertaining.  they also had a outdoor patio as well, but everyone was inside listening to the piano dude.

the bathroom was extremely small... if my memory serves me correct, you can not close the bathroom door if you need to go #2.   lol.

they have your typical bar drinks as well as daiquiris.  be careful though, the daiquiris are extremely cold and will give you a painful brain freeze if you drink them too fast.  drinks are mellow, but not too expensive. 

the only bad thing about this place, is that they allow people to smoke inside.  (i thought that was banned nationwide)???

if i do come back to visit NOLA, i'll definitely stop by again.

Very small and busy, so be prepared to wait, and wait, and wait, and wait some more. Also very loud. Food basically good, but very inconsistent. Food can at times be horribly prepared. The highlight of our dinner was beer, chips, and salsa. The salsa was quite good. The rest was rubish. What kills me is the terrible service. Abrupt,  rude, and angry. Owner couldn't care less - must get complaints all day. Never going here again.

Full Circle Flooring is the epitome of a small business. Period.  The owner, Jason Hopp, and his team consisting of Cory, John, Sam, Brian and Luis are customer service dynamos.  Their flooring products and installation services are unparalleled.  When I initially decided to completely upgrade my one year-old home's flooring (builder's standard tile and carpeting), I visited nine flooring companies in Reno, Sparks, Carson City and Truckee.  I was looking for very specific high-end engineered hardwood flooring and carpeting.  I could not find exactly what I was looking for until my ninth stop which was Full Circle Flooring in Reno.  I was greeted by Cory and within the first ten minutes of talking with him, I could tell this was the business with which I wanted to do business.  

The store is packed with the highest quality materials. During my cursory search of the inventory, I discovered the exact materials for which I was searching.  Full Circle Flooring was the one store (out of the nine I visited) which carried the Independence Hardwood line and that is what I wanted in my home.  I visited Full Circle Flooring many times to evaluate different carpeting selections with the wood flooring I wanted and Cory let me take home their various display samples so I could match the different materials/combinations in my home during day and night lighting conditions.  That was very important to me.  Full Circle Flooring also carried the exact carpeting I wanted, a beautiful Tuftex Stainmaster (Shaw Floors).  The staff could not have been more helpful, accommodating and knowledgeable.  Both Jason and Cory answered all my questions and explained exactly how engineered hardwood and carpeting are installed.  They gave me several very helpful recommendations, which I heeded. 

The hardwood installer, Brian, did an absolutely amazing job.  I cannot say enough about his dedication to my project.  He is extremely professional, hard-working, knowledgeable, conscientious, and detail-oriented.  He takes enormous pride in his work and it shows. Throughout the hardwood installation process, he offered me recommendations, advice and options when a choice in how something could be installed materialized.  The original tiling cemented to the foundation was an absolute bear to remove.  I believe it was the most difficult yet encountered by Full Circle Flooring.  A special, heavy-duty tool had to be rented to accomplish the demolition.  

It took Brian days to remove that tiling and then prepare the surfaces for hardwood installation.  It was an extremely labor-intensive process and Brian did it with a smile on his face.  He went above and beyond several times which not only made the final flooring installation near perfect, it showed me that he truly cared about my total satisfaction. The Full Circle Flooring carpeting crew, led by Luis, did an absolutely fantastic job.  I gave very specific instructions for the how the "grain" of the carpet was to be oriented throughout my home and those instructions were followed to the letter.  My carpeted areas could be showrooms for Shaw Floors.  They are just beautiful.

The Full Circle Flooring family helped turn my really nice track home into an absolutely beautiful custom home.  I cannot say enough for their efforts and dedication.  The results speak for themselves.  If you want the absolute best home flooring products and installation available in the greater Reno area, visit Full Circle Flooring.  

Sincerely,
Mike S.

Four stars because the menu options are prevalent, and the food is goooooood; there's something for everyone. If you want to be attended too, maybe this isn't the place for you after all it's a sports bar. It is very loud, the food takes forever to come and the waiter was definitely quite busy he may have been the only one. I guess being a New Yorker when you come to the South you have to bring it down 1,000 notches. But the popularity of Bourbon Street don't take the window seats....
Larry's is always a absolute blast! They have lots of flavors, along with a new food item called "mini donut". They are an amazing ice cream and gelato establishment!

I ordered a filet for pickup today for the holiday . Went to pick it up and it wasn't ready.  The butcher got one in kryovac, sliced the plastic, drained the blood, stuck it in a baggie bag. Handed it to me.  Didn't clean it up, remove fat or the silver.  $100.00.  I should've said something but I was so dumbfounded I got into the regular line and had them clean it.  My blood pressure is rising as I'm writing this.
Pretty and clean. Very pleasant and accommodating staff. Food expertly prepared and delicious.

Leroy is my contact and has been for years, great customer service. However, have come into the store when he is not around and the rest of the staff is just as professional and have great customer service as well, other retail establishments take note! Great selection and always get great suggestions, stand behind the product they sell and also do great repair!  No hard sell. (No annoying ads either, like the Subway sandwich customer, Jared's!)

What a shame that a retired with over 24 years of military service with disabilities from combat and 
long deployments only to suffer financially by Gary. Right after I shook hands with Gary my credit score drastically taken a nose dive right before I  was about to purchase a home and now thanks to Gary my dreams of having a home is on hold on the verge of the loan being rejected. This unjust have caused me to increase my anxiety and depression medication due to this undue stress caused of this situation. This is a mess and hopefully this issue can be resolved at the lowest level. I never owned a Kia in my life and loved my Kia this is why I came back for another Kia

The food was superb! I walked all the way from Chicago for this food and was worth every step! I can't wait to come back and try those lamb chops that everyone keeps talking about! Great customer service! Drew is amazing!

Bud & Marilyn's is such a solid midtown spot. I used to go with my coworkers for celebratory lunches, a quick dinner, or for brunch on the weekends and it functions perfectly for all occasions. 

I'll start with food. The fried chicken sandwich, crispy cheese curds, funfetti cake are all must orders if it's your first time there. I've also had their chopped salad which was on their lunch menu for a short while, the hot chicken buns & the double patty burger. While some menu items are more impressive than others, I've never had a meal here that I was disappointed by (except for the time I tried to order the Autumn Salad as an entree and was starving, but that's by fault and it was still good). Whatever you do, don't skip the cheese curds. 

My only cons would be the location and their cocktails. The location is super convenient and close to other bars and restaurants which makes it a good dinner spot before a night out on the town but unfortunately dining out in midtown during COVID just isn't the most pleasant experience. Again, not their fault, but there are other places in the city to check out if you're looking for scenic outdoor dining. I also usually stick with drinking wine here. I've tried the frose, "the real housewife" and a few of their other cocktails and have always found them too sweet. 

Pro: Convenient location, good interior, tasty food
Con: Not the most scenic for outdoor dining, meh cocktails

I went for brunch during my stay in New Orleans for the Jazz Fest. We were greeted by a very kind gentleman at the door and escorted to the back. I recommend you get reservations for this place to make sure you are sitting in the court. That's where you want to sit to get the full beautiful experience. The food is great!!! You get good Cajun cuisine...crawfish, shrimp, egg Benedict with crawfish etoufee, pasta salad, fruit, jambalaya and much more. Then you can top it off with a mimosa. Next time I want to get the Bloody Mary it looked delicious. I would return here every time I go to New Orleans. I love this place!
Yolis deli is the best burrito in the city.  The Chorizo is cooked perfectly and it can create that transcendent moment every person who enjoys food, seeks out.

I can't review the place specifically because I never went there but now will never go there based on my conversation with sales man named Bruce. We didn't have a ton of time to look at a bunch of dealerships and cars as my husbands car quickly and unexpectedly became unsafe. i was very close to making a decision by the time I called them but wanted to just inquire if they had what I was looking for. They didn't really have what I wanted so I wasn't going to bother stopping in. He sent me his business card via text and I was gonna look back into them on our next car purchase as he explained the no haggling, etc. Saturday as we were driving to buy the car we decided on, he called. I didn't recognize the number but it was coming from the area we were buying the car so I assumed it might be the dealership. The manager at the dealership where I was buying the car is also named Bruce so I at first thought I was talking to my car people and said we were in our way. When I realized my mistake I apologized and mentioned we had decided on a car. Mind you, I never met Fitzgerald Bruce at all! Instead of being a decent person and saying something like "great! Congrats hope you consider us for your next purchase". He got really defensive, literally said "eww" when I told him the type of car and mentioned all these recalls and lawsuits. I am an informed buyer so this was already checked on. When he wasn't getting the reaction he wanted from me he giggled sarcastically and hung up. I texted him to say how unprofessional that was and he texted back denying he hung up. Super immature and unprofessional from a salesman I never even met. I can't imagine how pushy and annoying they would be in person. News flash- there are lots of great choices out there for a consumer so it's best to be professional at all times and keep your puny ego out of it. I guarantee if my husband had answered the phone, that conversation would have gone differently so as far as I'm concerned this place would have treated me like I didn't know anything which is the exact opposite of how I was treated at lowkey Nissan.

Don't order from here.  I ordered ramen and found a bag of broth on my doorstep.  Not only was it just broth & nothing else, but it was all in the bag and none in the container.  I called and they kept saying they would call back and they never did.

DO NOT GO TO THIS NAIL SALON. My friend and I are visiting from out of town and we called to find the cheapest nail place. The manager (male) proceeded to tell me that he cannot disclose prices over the phone...... shady. When we got there, we asked for normal polish and they pointed us to the gel polish to up charge us when we didn't know there was a difference. Then when we walked in, the manager was not wearing a mask sitting in one of the clients chairs, yelling at his wifi company. Very unprofessional. The women did a great job on our nails and were very kind. We just know the manager treats them poorly and it should not be a supported business. After we finished, they told us my friends nails would be 57$ while on their wall it says it is only 31$ for a full set. They did not once speak of uncharging her. Overall, it is a poorly run business that should not be supported. The woman involved are talented and kind, but not taken care of and should reflect on how the manager is running the business.

We wandered here on a cold night after the theater; we left warmed, well-treated, and full. Almost everything else is commentary, but what I will say is that Ken Shin offers a nice mix of Chinese, Japanese, and Thai cuisine, sufficient options for vegetarians, decent-sized portions (except sushi, but what can you do), and excellent prices and service. For example, we had to ask for water twice, and the waitress brought us dessert on the house (green tea and mango mochi) to apologize. When's the last time you got an apology for bad service in Philly? It's not the most imaginative menu, but the choice of hot food, sushi, and appetizers are ideal for a light, casual dinner. And the price doesn't hurt: 35$ for dinner for two.

Cinco de Mayo at a Mexican restaurant is not a quick event. I called at 4pm to request a take out order thinking it would be at least an hour before I could pick up food. After I placed my order however I was told 20 minutes. I waited for 30, drove over and checked in. The food was not ready. I offered to wait outside because we are supposed to be social distancing but I was told I could sit inside and wait. While I waited I had nothing but time on my hands to sit and observe. All of the employees had face masks on but none of them wore the masks properly. A couple employees just had masks around their necks. This caused an irritation within my soul. Don't bother with the mask if you're not gonna wear it properly. Anyway this is supposed to be about food.

10 minutes after I arrived my food was nowhere close to being ready. If you recall, I was told 20 minutes. I heard one employee tell another employee that she should tell people over the phone it's a one hour wait. I then hear the employee on the phone tell the customer it would 35 minutes! Does she not know how many minutes are in 1 hour? Maybe not.

I get my food at the 50 minute mark. I'm happy because I wanted to be able to grab my hot food and leave. My biggest worry was that food would be sitting for a long time before it got to me. 

I got home set up dinner and it was better than we expected but there was one teeny mistake. I ordered 2 carne asada tacos and 1 crispy pork taco. I receive all 3 crispy pork. Those things are salty! That's why I only wanted one. My ticket was accurate the cook just didn't read it correctly. I was pretty bummed because their carne asada is really tasty. My husband had a #4. His was too messy to replate (not a complaint, see attached photo). He ordered a cheese enchilada and a pork tamale. We also received chips and salsa and $5 margaritas! Those margaritas were perfect for my tacos. The sweetness helped cut the saltiness and also helped me forget I was upset. 

I really liked my food and my husband enjoyed his. My tacos were packaged individually and separated from the rice and beans. This was very much appreciated. The rice and beans were also a nice break from the tacos. The rice was fluffy and the beans were creamy. I actually mixed them together because I play with my food. The enchilada and tamale were both delicious. I liked the sauces for both. These were also served with beans and rice. 

I would recommend this place to everyone even on Cinco De Mayo on a taco Tuesday during a pandemic.
The donuts were to die for. The Cooke and hot chocolate was good as well. Go early in the morning to beat the crowd.

Great food, great ambiance, great customer service. This was my first time in NOLA and I want to make sure I go back just for this place. I had the pasta lenora with grilled chicken and a side of fried chicken. I still dream about it, and it's been at least a week since I've been. The henny Rita is great too. Worth the visit!!!
Good Italian food. Fresh pasta. Great specialty martinis.  Awesome service. A decent wine selection. The gnocci was great. They also had bottomless mimosas when I was there.

I've been wanting to come here for a while now. Being as I come to philly often it always happens to be closed. This time I would not miss my opportunity to eat this amazing barbacoa. The line was long. It only took about 30min to get my order which is not bad. I got the consume which was very flavorful. I added some cilantro, onions, lemon and hot sauce and it all came together nicely. Now the tacos. I got 3 pancita (pork) and 1 barbacoa (lamb) the freshly made tortillas are definitely a another reason this tacos rock. Both meats are full of flavor I tried with any fix ins and then I went to town with lemon and a pineapple salsa that goes great with both meats. My girlfriend had a quesadilla she loved it so much she went to order another one. Also, they have fresh squeezed orange juice as well as agua fresca which so happened to be strawberry my favorite. A cool thing about this place is that you can see both owners running around and taking orders.. So cool to see they still care about there product and making sure everyone is enjoying themselves. This is a MUST stop when in philly you won't be disappointed
If you're from Singapore, Malaysia or Indonesia, you probably crave kaya at some point in your Canadian life. They make their own kaya here, also kaya cake.

Finally dined in! Clean, comfortable restaurant with attentive staff. Fried wonton and drunken noodles were both delicious - perfectly seasoned. We were there at a busy time and the service was efficient and friendly.

Few bumps and run around from other tire shops trying to get a quick order of tires to replace on my truck.  Chris, daniel and service crew at 4WP did an awesome job getting me new tires ordered and installed in a real quick manner.  Awesome customer service and professional installation, very well knowledgeable in their line of work.  Definitely recommend and will be going back for future projects.  Mahalo 4WP

I received a last minute office meeting request for pastries so I googled for a bakery and found this shop.  I was really impressed.  They have a large selection and everything was super fresh. They were extra friendly and very helpful.  I would definately return to this lovely shop for desserts and breakfast.

Great service the first time and when I requested annual service all was good. However, when I had a serious problem with wasps/bees in the walls of my home, they were a no show on the scheduled date and time. I emailed and called and spoke to Wendy Herrold. She told me I had the date/time wrong which was absolutely false and somewhat impossible since I would be out of town on the supposed date she had recorded. She went on to say there is no way my appointment was today since her HUSBAND is the only one in and he does not get on a ladder!  Huh, did I really have the date wrong??  Or, is it b/c he doesn't do ladders?!  She was incredibly rude and even had the audacity to call me back after I said to cancel my contract. I want to support small business, but this is the problem when you are dealing with incompetent family members of said small businesses. Too bad Herolds, I would've been a customer for a very long time.
Awesome tacos + cheap-ish + lots of yummy hot sauces (even for people who don't like anything really spicy) + COOKIE DOUGH FLAUTAS = yum!

We waited the expected 25-30 minutes for our table, no problem. Once at our table, we waited another 15 minutes until the hostess took our order....never once hearing from our server.  Waited another 15 minutes for our drinks until the hostess once again came around to help us get our drinks (still no server).  Food came 50 minutes after being seated and was completely cold...not even lukewarm.  Sent the food back, again through the hostess, at which time our server finally arrived acting annoyed with us.  I asked for a manager at which time she informed me "we've been busy...but a manager is on the way."  We waited a few more minutes without the arrival of a manager and left.  Poor service. Cold food.  Not cheap.  Not recommended.

I was a visitor to Nashville and some of the locals told me that this is the place to go.  They weren't wrong.

The place was nearly empty in the mid-afternoon and I was greeted by a gaggle of young people at the cashwrap.  I was immediately led to a table and served by a reasonably attentive server- although she did seem a bit interested in her phone and the sports on the multiple TV screens when I might have wanted a water refill.  

I ordered 1/2 Nashville Hot Chicken.  Being a spice LOVER, I asked for a sample of the Poultrygeist sauce and then opted for Nashville Hot with the remaining sample as backup.  Just so that you can compare, I grow Ghost & Carolina Reapers & my favorite sauce is Reaper Squeezin's.  Nashville Hot was just enough.  Hence the need for a water refill.

I would absolutely return, it's a good place.  One star deduction because my credit card has "CHECK ID" in the signature box.  No verification made. She missed a $5 bonus on the already-good. tip also.

Since I had just taught a class on fire safety, I'd be interested to see what the Nashville Fire Department has to say about the pallet wall coverings.  Not my jurisdiction.

I'm in St. Louis for my daughter's Law School - -Wash U -- Graduation and she recommended Pappy's Smokehouse! 
I called in the order and picked it up within 30 mins!The flavor of the ribs, chicken -- that smoke flavor was something that can't even be described!  Off the chains!!! All the sides: cole slaw, potato salad, baked beans, fried corn on the cobb and green beans were delicious. They are all win wins! 
I'm was totally 5-Star satisfied!!!
I forgot to check-in and take pics of the food but trust me it was da best!!!!

This place is amazing for a number of reasons and I give basically all of my gardening business to urban roots. But as I type this I am watching an employee change my flat tire for me that I almost drove away with unknowingly. I am ashamed to say I don't know how to change a tire myself but the kindest man, kelvin, jumped in to help me before even seeing me start to struggle. These people are the the absolute salt of the earth. The kindness they show their customers is unbelievable and it explains why they have the most gentile animals that wander around and such gorgeous plants. As if I didn't have enough reason to give this place my business, they just added another reason to the list. A huge thank you to a business that was already amazing before they saved my day.

Our stay at the Bayview Plaza Resort was awesome. The room was nicely decorated, clean and cozy. It had 2 double beds, very comfortable with fluffy pillows. A/C worked great. Kitchen was clean, had a nice size refrigerator, stovetop and sink with a window for light. Sofabed looked brand new. Tiled floor were spotless. Staff were very friendly and accomodating. The pool was clean with plenty of seating. There are areas of shade for those who do not like sun. This is definitely a great place to stay.
Good food and service. Food was a bit slow but we killed time playing games. Our server, Tammy was very kind and generous taking care of the kids.
Love the buffalo wrap with jasmine rice! Tastes so fresh, every-time. The drive thru is quick and easy.

After Bethany and I enjoyed the Elite event of "Cheers to the New Year" at Galatoire's "33" Bar & Steak we left to visit the place I asked her to marry me five years ago. That was done at the Carousel Bar in the Monteleone. And while there we decided to have dinner at Criollo Restaurant. It has been some time since we broke bread there and now we had the opportunity.

The hotel and restaurant caters to visitors of course. And because of that it makes them very happy to have local citizens come in and enjoy all that they provide. This is a first class operation at all levels; food, service, ambiance, atmosphere, management, liquor, and entertainment. All done at one stop and we shall return. 

As to the restaurant it is necessary to highly recommend as Appetizers the Char Grilled Oysters that are served in Garlic and Herb Butter with a Parmesan Crust. Six delicious oysters come with this order.

Next for a starter should be the Sautéed Red Snapper and Crab Cake. Served with a Fried Quail Egg, Sweet Tomato Jam. You will want the Jam on everything you order. My wife and I decided to go home and attempt to reproduce this scrumpdiddlyumptious jam.

For the main course do enjoy the Baked Stuffed Créole Redfish which also comes with Crabmeat and Green Tomato Crust, Angel Hair Pasta, and Créole Tomato Jam ( that jam again).

And for me I went with the Baked Gulf Shrimp Bienville. This culinary delight comes with over Stuffed Jumbo Shrimp, Lump Crabmeat, Roasted Peppers, Shallots, and Tarragon Butter Sauce. This selection was about the best of the night. 

Cocktails are well poured and the Wine List is reasonable for a restaurant. Enjoyed a Sonoma Cutrer with this meal and that was another plus for the evening.

Be aware that some wines are available for only $20.00 on Wednesday nights. And while dining from Wednesdays through the weekend live music is being played in the Carousel Lounge that can be enjoyed.

And I have to also make as part of this Review my experience with the front of the house. Bethany and I were served as regulars by Dwayne and Caleb. These guys provided not only professional and attentive service but were a pleasure to meet that night. After we decided on what we were going to order we asked Dwayne what would he recommend? And his recommendations were exactly what we were prepared to and did order. 

In addition to the servers Michael DuPreé is the Manager that you would want to manage a restaurant that you would own. So nice to walk into a place without reservations and for the first time in years and be treated at the level we were during our entire dining experience.
I love Subway, especially this location.  The service is friendly and quick.  The food is always fresh and delicious too.

Today was hot to even think. Luckily one person in our party suggested MeiTing.  If you haven't had the pleasure of authentic Chinese Cuisine, this is your opportunity.  I'm not a traveler.  But my companions are. I've had food of this genre before, but nothing like this.  It's the Next Level.  If you can't get to China, or if you're a homebody like me and cant drag yourself to Chinatown, do yourself a favor and go to Warrington, snag a bottle of wine at the liquor store (just next door!) and enjoy the fresh beautiful fish, vegetables and expert preparation. I'm a snobby home cook and I was blown away.  My companions were awestruck.  The owner is there full time and her husband is the chef.  Bucks County dining at its finest!  We will be back again next weekend!

While I respect Matt's review and his opinion, I will say that we have had nothing but great experiences with this place.

I will add, however, that we have only ordered the "White House Pizza" and the garlic cheese bread for delivery, but it has been wonderful and consistent every time.  The crust is incredible!  If we want a good pizza quickly, cheaply, and delicious, we order from these guys.  

Perhaps they have improved since Matt's visits and I am sorry that his experiences have been so bad.  We have been very happy with these guys.

For a buffet, this place is legit.  The Asian food tastes quite good, and very fresh.  They are constantly cooking up something fierce back there.  The selection is quite good too - cooked goods, your normal, cold bar, fondue, carving station, noodle soups, sushi...


The docking of the star is for the dessert.  All buffets should have either scooping ice cream or soft serve.  Here, they scoop it into a bowl for you in a freezer.  No good.  I didn't even eat any =(.  

Otherwise, well worth it!

One of the worst Starbucks I went too. They messed up, not one...but TWO of my hot coffee orders. It wasn't until later (since the drinks were hot) that the screw up was found. 

Ordered a grande pumpkin spice latte and a cinnamon dolce latte. Pumpkin spice had absolutely no flavor, and cinnamon dolce tasted like it had all of the flavor. In addition, they left about an inch of space from each coffee.

No wonder though, seven employees all standing around bullshitting....and only one customer in front of me. It still took 10 min. 

Avoid this Starbucks if you want any service, and if you  actually want your drink made properly the first time.

I'm not really a fan of malls, but I am a fan of water parks, roller coasters, mini golf, pirate ships, bowling, ice skating, underground aquariums, sea lions, the fact that this mall has not one or two, but three mascots (Sharky, Cosmo, and Shelly), full-sized dragons, bingo, radio stations, haunted houses, skate parks, comedy theaters, dueling pianos, and musical acts doing mall shows.

I think they have every store any mall has ever had and all the above. Maybe I'm just seeing it through a tourist's rose-colored glasses, but this is more like an amusement park where you can shop and less like a mall to me.

WOW! I have lived down the street for 6 years and have never tried this place. Food is really good and portions very generous. I had the butter chicken combo. So good. The naan bread was a little bit too charred for my liking and the dessert that came with my combo wasn't the best, but the main meal was DELICIOUS! Can't wait to go back and try something else.

Typical hair cutters.

It's located next to CVS and the old Publix that moved across the street.
The place itself seems a little run down, but the staff is always friendly.  A little turn off when you park and walk up and the hair dressers are out front smoking... but that's just my opinion.  
Parking is never a problem since the Publix moved.  Lots of parking.

They must have found a secret ocean in the middle of Indiana, because that fish is fresh! I went with the Caplinger's Special Sandwich and made it a combo with Hush Puppies and YUM! The fish was a large size, lightly breaded, not heavily oiled, with a fresh flaky center. The hush puppies had the perfect mild seasoning that complemented the fish to perfection. We hit Caplinger's over the lunch hour so they were full but they kept the line moving (it took around 10 minutes to get our food after placing the order and they even brought it out to our table). Price was very reasonable with full meal less than $10, and the lobster roll being around $15. This is a great restaurant to introduce even those weary of fish because the quality is outstanding. Absolutely will return!

We were driving through here on the way back to LA and saw the great reviews from this place. There was a line out the door (good sign!) and we quickly saw why. The service was fast and friendly, and they offered a decent variety of tacos. The food itself was high quality for dirt cheap, and there was a toppings bar where you could get cilantro, onions, salsa, different sauces that were a la cart. Delicious!
They have the worst hours! It says they're open and they're not, food is good if you can get it...

It is just your average goodwill but the inventory turn over is pretty impressive. They seem to have a 50% off sale every other week. And, this must be one of the busiest drop off donation locations in the area as traffic is always out the lot. Avoid the parking lot!! and find a street spot. It is really not worth the hassle of trying to get in and out right next to the busy intersection.

I really wanted to like this salon.. the interior is beautiful and it was very easy to make an appointment. When I arrived at 10am on a Monday, the place was empty. I told the front desk individual that I was there for an appointment with Lin, he pointed me in the direction of the nail tech and didn't say anything else. I awkwardly walked over to Lin, who didn't say a single word to me during the service besides confirming what color acrylic and what shape.. extremely weird considering I was a brand new client to him. He worked very fast, but I left with uneven nails, and four days later they started to lift.. so I'm not very happy. $60 for an ombre acrylic set and they can't even last a week ? I will take my business to another salon.
Great food and very inexpensive. The service was excellent as well. Spaghetti and Meatballs, mussels in red all top notch. Loved the homemade cheese cake as well.
Got my stamp of approval. Tacos were well made and tasty. Margarita was okay tasted more bitters than anything. Great atmospheres and friendly staff.

Being a dude, hair beyond a buzz can be overwhelming. Salon 6 folks are very friendly, paired me with Megan G., a stylist whose experience includes men's cuts. Her shampoo and head/shoulder massages are incredible. Cuts are great. She's taught me how to use specific products to get the styled look I want on my own. Will definitely continue to get my hair cut and styled here.
Absolutely amazing. Loved everything about it. From the sushi to the appetizers. Everything was good. Would go again.

Rung is a fashion resale store that sells nicely merchandised clothing and accessories.  BEWARE.  I recently bought shoes that were broken in the arch and they refused to take them back as a return. The manager handled the issue poorly and with serious attitude while she pointed out that the return policy is posted.  So, I guess they think its okay to sell $25 shoes that can't be worn, all in the name of non-profit.  I won't be back.

This was such a great find, located at International Plaza. We sat outside on a busy night. We got there just after 9, so it was happy hour. Everything is just about $6, food and drinks.

For drinks, the guava gimlet, it is a must have. I am a sucker for anything guava and this definitely did not disappoint. My husband had the old fashioned, his favorite, which was equally delicious. 

We shared a bunch of small plates. We had the mini local board, the pimento cheese was dangerously good. The hummus and veggies/bread was so flavorful. It wasn't your typical hummus, you can definitely taste the turmeric. We also shared the bacon and egg salad, which was great. 

Last but not least, the whiskey cake. This is my new favorite dessert. It was amazing! The cake was soo delicious and the vanilla whipped cream was amazing. You have to save room, I promise you won't be disappointed.

This event was really fun! The wood items were all really cute when we were finished and start to finish there is amazing support and the assistants have a lot of patience.
At first they tell you all the directions but not to worry, there is an assistant who is basically assigned to your table to help you. On this particular occasion we had Victor who was super supportive and extremely helpful.
There are literally an infinite number of stain and paint combos by the time you add in all the dry brushing colors.
This event was fun because they played great music, it was a great atmosphere and no matter what, Victor said, "we can fix that" or "that looks amazing". 
Super fun event and I can't wait to go with my friends!!
Thanks Michael!!

We recently stopped for dinner at Pub 1922 on a Wednesday. Turned out to be Wing Wednesday - bone in and boneless wings are on special. Typical pub menu with wings, salads, burgers, Mexican food, sandwiches, and many beer choices. Love the layout of the place with an open air bar, plenty of room throughout, and empty kegs hanging from the ceiling! Service was very good and food was very good! Want to go back and try the burgers - had boneless wings on this trip. Definitely recommend - next time inviting some more friends along and trying the patio!

One of my favorite South Reno lunch spots! 

If you've never done lunch at Southcreek Pizza you're missing out. If you're dining solo or with friends who don't like to share, the lunch specials menu is perfect! From pizza and salad combos, to sandwiches on their wood Fire oven baked bread, there's something for everyone. 

Normally I order the Ian's Italian sandwich, which is stuffed full of top notch charcuterie, fresh greens, tomatoes, mozzarella, light dressing and crushed cherry peppers!

On this last visit I had two companions, both enameled with the regular menu... nay... the daily specials actually! So we three shared their house ribs (so freaking delicious and different), the pizza of the day, and the house ricotta app. Perfect combination of flavors all around and a most satisfying lunch! 

If you're with good friends I highly suggest sharing food here!

The staff deserves 5 stars but the Manager got -3.  We had a terrible first night because of the loud AC unit above our head.  After an early morning and long drive we had to move out of our room at 1:30am because it was impossible to sleep. We packed up our things and carried them to our new room. It took us a long time to fall back asleep.  Our new room was comfortable but had a broken TV remote control.  The next morning the AC was not working in the fitness center.  It was cooler and more comfortable to run outside. 
We mentioned something to the front desk and the gentlemen working was so sweet and seemed to really care. He told us he would let the manager know.  That night we received two vouchers for a drink.  Thanks but no thanks. After spending over $200 a night for a night of restful sleep I was offended with the managers customer service. There are so many other options in the city. I suggest to finding another place where the management cares about your stay.  Just dealt with a woman at the front desk who was obviously trained by the manager Robin. She wouldn't make me a extra room key after mine got lost.  She was also aggressive about paying for my valet parking. Not too impressed.  The other staff was great but these two people ruined our experience.

La Citadelle is a cute, simple little place that I recently discovered on 16th and Pine.  I will update after I've tried the cappuccinos. Today I settled for a regular coffee because they don't take credit cards and I only had 3 bucks on me. The coffee was strong and good. They use La Colombe coffee which I've never actually had until going here, and I liked it alot. I will be back!!!

Went with a group of 6 during restaurant week.  We had enough people to order EVERYTHING ON THE RW MENU. Go with a large group. Totally worth it.

Next night, I WENT BACK. With Mr. R, who missed the group dinner. I was totally prepared with the selection of the best dishes. Cheese plate and eggplant antipasti; funghi pizza and duck salad; lamb ragu parpadelle and hanger steak; pumpkin mousse and the mint chocolate bombe.  The dishes were well though out, down to the small details - fragrant toasted pine nuts in the antipasti, the hint of mustard heat in the fruit marmalade that accompanied the cheese, the fresh mint infused through the dessert, etc.  

Service was good the first night, excellent the second night. Our second night server - don't remember his name, but awesome rowhome tat on his left wrist - was attentive, smooth, and had a great, comfortable vibe - no hovering, but always available.  

I'm already hankering to go back.  Mr. G, keep doing what you do.

How does one choose which market to shop at? Redding or Italian market... I guess I will go to Italian Market on warm days and Redding on snowy days.

The aroma is what gets me. Every few step the aroma changes depending on which store you are passing. Spice shop, coffee shop, butcher shop, fish market, cheese shop... you get the picture. It just draws you into the stores naturally. 

And a few blocks away on Washington are the Vietnamese grocery stores. Where you can get live seafood and asian vegie. 

This is as good as it gets!

We ordered take out. Everything was really fresh/hot. The wonton soup was extremely salty. The dumplings were awesome, but the sauce was really salty. The fried rice tasted bland, but I'm pretty sure it's because the soup and sauce were so salty that my taste buds were off. I think otherwise it would have tasted great. The beef with vegetables was pretty good. We didn't care for the egg rolls, though. 

I think we'd try it again; nothing was terrible. The staff was super nice and lots of care was taken in packaging the food to go.
Customers are rude...not social distancing! Not being enforced by employees. I will not be back!

Just finished a half sleeve from Las Vegas Tattoo with Randy. Great quality work; strangers were complimenting the work before it was even finished in the third session. I couldn't even get through the line at Chipotle without three compliments! I brought a few images I wanted incorporated into the piece then Randy pulled the images together into a beautiful design, full of high saturated color and contrast, so that no images turned out looking like a blob or blurring together. He asked questions and was open to modifications; and pushed back when he thought something might not be a good idea from a tattoo/color/aging perspective. Environment is super clean and open. The staff is accommodating (I had to reschedule an appointment) and make you feel right at home when you're in the chair (brought me water and offered to go get me food). I also liked that other artists would pop in and compliment each other's work and collaborate on some pieces of the draft so that I had more eyes and fresh ideas to design a perfect draft. Randy is very attentive to how you are feeling in the chair; he lets you take a break or stop session whenever you want to call it quits. He knows which parts are more painful than others so he strategizes his time around this (starting in the painful spot and ending with less painful OR taking a few second breaks so he's not constantly irritating sensitive areas like the armpit). This approach helped me maximize time in the chair per session. As a result I've also had no scarring or white spots in the piece. Will be posting pics as soon as third session is fully healed. Can't rave enough about my experience and am already coming up with new ideas for an excuse to go back!

I usually don't write reviews, but this really irked me. 

I ordered for take out and selected 6:30pm as my pick up time. I came in at 6:45 and when I said I was there to pick up my food, the hostess asked me to stand off to the side and wait (in a very awkward place between where people were coming and going) while they "paged the girl in back". I stood there awkwardly for 15 min while people passed by. There was a waiting bench on the other side so I wasn't sure why they asked me to stand where they did. Finally, the hostess told me that the cashier was ready for me, and pointed me directly next to the hostess area. The cashier proceeded to tell me that her pager wasn't working properly and then pulled my food out from the warmers directly behind her and the register. My food had been ready that entire time I was standing there waiting, so I'm really not sure why one of the other hostesses couldn't pull the food out and ring me up.

Was hoping that the food would make up for the poor service, but sadly, my food was soggy and subpar. Really disappointing.

Maybe things would've been better if I dined in.

This newly opened wine bar was a pleasant surprise. During happy hour the house wine is very good for $4.95 per glass and the small bites were just enough to tide us over until dinner. The staff was pleasant and the ambience was nice. I'd also recommend looking at the wine list as the prices are very reasonable. A good addition to St Pete's growing social fabric.

The servers were friendly. Its take out only and they had limited knowledge on the menu. The pulled pork special was recommended. The sandwich was chopped pork with barely any sauce. The sauce taste like ketchup with some brownsugar mixed in. The only good item was the fried mushrooms and that is because they are not made in house. Will never go back.
Great family style non-chain Italian food.

What terrible pho--watery and flavorless broth with frozen vegetables from Costco. The grilled shrimp with vermicelli was a little better, but not enough to redeem this place. The server was aloof and brusque. Last meal in NOLA last night was a dud, but at least we had some good food for most of our other meals.

Love this spot. Looks like a blast from 1960.  The Orangeade is good, the Brosted chicken is amazing. 
Today we are on Coronavirus lockdown but it's clean and even tho the dining room is empty they are still cooking up fresh burgers and amazing chicken.
Came to visit Reno from Stockton and decided to give this place a try. Absolutely loved their food and especially their customer service. Will definitely be coming here again, staff was amazing

One of those places you went to in college because you didn't know any better. The food, upon returning after a few years, is nothing special. Add to this the last two times we were in there it was empty so the owner decide to talk to us, which is fine...but he insisted on talking politics. This is always bad form at a business, no matter your politics (unless you really know your audience), but for someone like me, who is not some nut job prone to neoconservative ramblings, it made us lose our appetite. Lots of offensive things came out of this guy's mouth. We won't ever be back. I felt guilty not doing a dine and dash.

As soon as you pull up this place is Amazing! I went there for lunch to give it a try. Once I got there I couldn't decide what to get so my wife got sushi and I decided to get the pizza. They both were awesome! The staff is super friendly!
I have been back multiple times and will keep going back!

Unbelievably good. Great place. Casual night out or special occasion - anything goes! food was outstanding - try the short rib appetizer and the beet salad - they are not to be missed. Extensive bar. Great menu - so many things still to try. Will be back for sure!

First time here while visiting for work. The two for one happy hour specials are a great perk. We had a group of 5 so we tried a few different things. The Nashville chicken sliders were yummy but the southwest egg rolls were top notch. For dinner I went healthier with the teriyaki salmon. It was not great. Pretty bland and could have been cooked a little longer. The sweet potato fries and Brussel sprouts were delicious made up for it. My coworker had the Caesar salad and it was nothing special. Another at the table got a pizza and raved about it. Overall good food and good service. Will return to try the pizza!

No I did not attend Boise State University but like many other people I was intrigued by the famous blue football field. If you watch college football you will probably know about the field. To see the field go to the Allen Noble Hall of Fame Gallery on the south west side of the stadium. Inside there you can walk around the gallery to see the replicas of some of the trophies their sports teams have won throughout their history and other good information about the school. One of the volunteers will give you a tour and give you some history and more information about the field too. Unfortunately visitors are not allowed to stand on it but you can get to the ground level and see it in all its blue glory.

The volunteer Andrea was very knowledgeable about the field and answered a lot of my questions about it. She also told me other cool tidbits of information. There used to be a track field on the same location but they put one of the bleachers on top of it. She also mentioned that they actually have an international trademark for this type of field and that if you want to put a non-green field for entertainment you have to request permission from BSU. She was telling me so many stories and other gems that she heard from Gene Bleymaier himself, the athletic director who came up with the idea of putting the blue field to begin with.

It's cool to finally check out the field that I had only seen on TV for so long.

THEIR RIBS and BURNT ENDS are unique and mysterious and wonderful.  JUST DO IT.   And I got to miss the line (went around Xmas 2015 when it was raining for several days straight while visiting family in St. Charles).  Found the sides average but hey, the meat transcends it all.  Be it known, though, that this is the only ST. Louis BBQ I've had to date, so it sounds like there are other good things in store and 4 stars feels right.  Can't wait to get back and try a few other places--and I'll kick it off with Pappy's.
Delicious food, very cool atmosphere, and friendly staff! Fresh and yummy spice blends; we loved every dish we ordered! Hope to come back soon

My husband and son got the spicy tuna rolls, they ate it so fast I didn't get a picture! The guy at the counter was extremely nice. They eat sushi a lot and said this was spectacular, they even went back and got more.

It was my first visit to Franklin Soul. I'm in town for work and saw they had red beans and rice (not always easy to find). As my server stated, how can you go wrong with protein and fat?!?? I agree wholeheartedly, it is an EXCELLENT choice! I look forward to going back very soon when I'm not rushed and can actually hang around and take my time and enjoy a couple beers too!
Excellent service. Joey (I believe that was his name) was incredible friendly. It's nice to find a great neighborhood spot with authentic bubble tea.

I have been a member here for a long time and enjoy all of the equipment, classes, pool, etc.  The staff and gym goers are very friendly and supportive.  I pay around $30/month (negotiated it) and leave them a few days to a weeks notice when I have to freeze or stop my membership for school/work/travel.  My gripe is that the pool water could be warmer and there should be additional mats (cleaned more often too) in the workout rooms, but overall the gym has suited me well.  I checked out Future Fitness recently in Cherry Hill and felt awful about myself after the sales spiel and left dejected.  I always feel good about myself at LA Fitness in Somerdale and appreciate the supportive environment.  I would recommend this gym for the pleasant workout experience (the class instructors are GREAT as well)!

By far the best Coconut Crusted Mahi Mahi I have ever had...in my life! That is saying a ton, because I am a foodie! Great atmosphere, amazing customer service and beyond incredible food! Summer time is the best time to go, because you can sit outside and listen to a live local band next to the river. And did I mention the drinks are great too?!!

HUMILIATING RACIST OCCURRENCE. 
              Who Would Have Thought This Would Happen To Me

So, I arrived in town today (11/7/19) for a conference and after a long day thought I would go out and get a quick drink. Close to my hotel was the Toasted Walnut. Karaoke was happening so what fun I thought to myself. I entered and the doorman was very pleasant. I walked over to the bar stood in line behind a young lady patiently waiting my turn to order. After I received my drink I stood by myself against the wall near their ramp. The bar wasn't really crowded. after a few minutes, I notice a lady frantically looking for something on the floor. Clearly she lost something. I watched her, finished my drink and left the bar saying goodbye to the doorman. a few seconds later a guy in heels calls out to me and asked is there a reason why I am leaving so early. I thought he might have been approaching me out of flirtation. NOPE! Instead, he not only implies that I may have stolen his friend's wallet but wants me to empty my pockets in front of him. Now, this is a young white male and I am a middle-aged black man. So, out on the street, I am harassed by this man, this young white man in heels, and accused of stealing his friend's wallet. I can't tell you how embarrassing and socially, racially loaded this is and humiliating it was for me. Nothing about me would resemble a person that would hold the slightest racist image of being a thief. Then the doorman calls us both back and asks me to empty my pockets, right there in front of him. Again, humiliating for a man of 53 years of age. I complied just out of disbelief and complete shock. Once they both see that I had nothing of the girl's in my possession he (the doorman) apologizes, and in my calm inner rage, I insist the young man apologize as well. The doorman then insist that he is going to check everyone as they leave, but let's face it...we know that's not happening. 
Sorry to say that out of all the gay bars I could have walked into, I had to walk into that one leaving me inraged, violated, embarrassed and filled with contemporary pain that demonstrates how divided we are and how much racism we still hold for each other even in our marginalized groups. Shame on them, shame on that young man, and same on that bar. I am certain that this young man will find a way to sooth and forgive himself for his assaulting actions as his friends will comfort him too without challenging his stuff, or really asking why he chose me to accuse. Or he'll find a place where he becomes the victim for validation.
If you are from out of town and of color...DON"T GO!!! it's not worth it. 
Never in my life have I experienced something like this. Horrible and offensive!

I confess, I am in love with something here and it is not just the cheesecake; it is these amazing zucchini sticks; diabolically good. Although food is always good here and I almost always get cheesecake, the zucchini sticks are far and away the best I have ever had; take my money and shut up.

Stayed only one night. Checked in around 11:00 AM and out around midnight. The life of an entertainer coach driver. The bar/restaurant was closing when we checked in and refused to even think about service for us. Told us they open back up at 5:00 PM. That's fine for some. But not for those of us that have to sleep. The room was nice except the bed and dresser were on the side of the bed and it's hard to watch tv on my side. The shower didn't have a lot of pressure so I had to put it on the pulsating setting. The bed was comfortable and it was quiet on the end of the hotel. There are no restaurants within walking distance. Probably would look for something closer to eateries next time.

Beautiful evening to sit outside and enjoy some lattes. Or your favorite hot beverage of choice
Tonight we got a Monkey Mocha and a Havanna Latte (think a Cuban with sweetened condensed milk, star anise, and cinnamon) . 

The Frothy Monkey drinks we enjoyed: The Monkey Morcha has a taste a banana.  And the Havanna Mocha has a nice spice flavor. 

The barista was really friendly and gave recommendations

Finally got my hands on the popular jumbo hot dog and onion rings. DELICIOUS! They didn't prepare my friends sandwich order correctly, but were prompt in giving her the right sandwich with no fuss. Will definitely go back to try out the cheese fries!
They have friendly staff, yummy sweet and the cutest bakery I've ever seen. They also do cakes and I'm looking forward to ordering one for my birthday!

Just moved to the area. Tried a couple other local places and was unhappy with results, then I went to happy nails and I can assure you I'll be a repeat costumer. . They did a fantastic job on my shellac manicure. Jenny, is very personable and does exactly what you request. Everyone is friendly and seem to be on a first name basis with all of their clientele, that means they must be doing something right! Definitely recommend

Great Steak House if you are ever in Tuscon. Nice atmosphere, helpful wait staff, and a very enjoyable meal. Escargot appetizer was very tasty, but if you are expecting a typical escargot appetizer you will be surprised by this steak house version.

Had been to the winery a few years ago before it became a full service restaurant. We were actually on our way to Peddlers Village for dinner but decided swing on in to the Pour House instead as it was closer and we were starving. First, there was no music on this Saturday so it was nice and quiet. We opted to sit at the bar and were quickly greeted by Tess. Tess was a delight. We were looking for a crisp white wine. She provided us with various samples before we committed to something. We agreed on a bottle of pinot gris. Tess explained the specials of the evening. We opted for a date and blue cheese appetizer. For entrees I ordered the mixed grill which was a combination of pork, duck and beef. The appetizer was an amazing combination of sweet and salty and crispness of the wine was a great compliment to blue cheese. The mixed grill was meltingly tender and moist, all cooked perfectly. My dining companion ordered the grilled salmon which I am not fan of but he raved about it. We were blown away by how delicious everything was and plentiful as well. Since we were at the bar we chatted with Tess throughout the evening as well a charming young barback from Switzerland. I apologize but her name escapes me right now. She shared pictures with us of her artwork which was amazing. In any event, the tab for a bottle of wine an appetizer and two entrees was only $77 with tax. We thought this was incredibly reasonable given the amount and quality of the food. We don't get to the area all that often but when we do we will be sure to stop at The Pour House!

Noodles & Company is a fantastic alternative to the same old fast food.

They have awesome pasta bowls made fresh and cooked to order. I absolutely love this place!

One thing I am not happy about is a couple years ago they changed their Ciabatta rolls from amazingly the delicious Ciabatta rolls to just cutting a sub sandwhich roll in half and calling it a Ciabatta roll. This constantly annoys me as it is NOT a Ciabatta roll its a sub sandwich roll cut in half.

I have no idea what genius decided they would save a few pennies by discontinuing the delicious Ciabatta Roll and replacing it with half a sub sandwich roll but Id sure hope they have since been canned. BRING BACK THE Ciabatta Rolls!!!

Other than the Ciabatta Roll FUBAR Noodles & Company is fantastic EVERYTIME, their tofu is amazing and unlike Ive had anywhere else.

There are so many different choices and combinations you can always have something new and different!

One hot tip is order the small portion because the "regular" portion is HUGE!

Date: 12-27-18
Time:1115

Brief: An authentic taco spot with friendly service, a broad protein selection and great tacos!

A little taco trailer on the side of Dale Mabry that is worth the stop. The tacos are made either authentic or gringo style (opt for the former) and have a wide variety of meat options (lengua/cabeza/pastor/campechana) to name a few. I got a good selection (this means 4) and a water and my bill was just under $10!  A bargain in my book. 

Food was made fresh to order and I tucked in. 
My two favorites were: Lengua/pastor/chorizo. Yea that's three...they were darn good. 

Sauces: They have a spicy red and fresh green...get both and use both...they work great together. 

Good portions of protein, a slice of lime for each taco, double perfectly cooked shells and a great price....what more could you ask for???

The butterfly lady (I think her name was Courtney?) will change your life.

'Nuff said.

update:

They're sadly longer doing 30% off sushi on Sunday or Monday. So, it's essentially  just like every other sushi place in the area, except in a very difficult place to access. With at least a dozen options between Collingswood, Haddon etc, we can't warrant the drive. We used to frequent once-twice a month at least, but won't be back.

Wow wow wow. So good! We had such a great time celebrating even with Covid. My friend enjoyed and so did we! The burger I got was amazing, and the peach ice cream after was phenomenal to end the night.

Definitely will come again!!

Teetering between three and four stars here. But giving the benefit of the doubt before our return again. This is my first visit to this particular location, I love the decor it was funky and fun.

We were greetd promptly and our server could not have been more nice. She did a great job. My daughter and I shared half buffalo chicken pizza and half white pizza. We also opted for the meatball trio for an appetizer. The appetizer took quite a while and when it arrived the meatballs looked old. I've always loved the marinara sauce so that was as expected but the meatballs were just okay. After we had waited for so long for our pizza I looked at the time that I checked in on Yelp. 35 minutes later and we still had not received our pizza. It was approximately 2:00 on a Saturday and the restaurant was not busy. We did not mention this to the server however when she delivered our pizza she took notice of how long it took and discounted our pizza by $11 without me even mentioning which was very thoughtful and appreciated.

I will return hoping for a better turnout for the food and will update my review accordingly.

My friend's family is Lebanese and we have come here multiple times together! The food is authentic and delicious! I like trying something different every time we go in, but almost always get hummus or baba ganoush with my meal!

To start: special thanks for letting me in at 8:03 when you closed at 8! I wish I knew the hours were reduced for COVID and I'd have made it over prior to closing! They were very kind and gave me what they had that was easy to make. They even threw in a bag of fresh bread. 5 stars for service, no question about it. You are well served to go a block off the main drag to get some non-chain food.
So, I feel a little guilty only giving 4 stars after that. But I want to be honest about it all. The Mediterranean salad - it's salad. Chopped up stuff with oil, standard fare, a good portion. It's pretty much the same everywhere you go, so call it 4.5 stars. The eggplant (zaalouk) was not very smoky, which is the taste I'm more used to with it. The dish was pretty smooth overall and went well with pita bread. The pita bread, I don't think was made here, since they went out of their way to note that the other bread was homemade. It was served in quarters, whereas I prefer a whole pita to be able to tear small pieces or stuff it as desired. Personal preference only, does not impact rating. The bread that was homemade wasn't bad, probably was leftover at the end of the day so I also don't want to judge them for it not being hot out of the oven. Finally, chicken tagine is not my usual food order. It was flavorful, a little sweeter than I might have liked (I think honey, then lemon, then olive in terms of flavor, not quite balanced enough), and there wasn't as much chicken as I might have expected - then again, it's a low price for the entree, which is why I got two sides, so perhaps that's the right amount of meat for the price.
Overall it was a good experience, a couple of small points that kept it from 5 stars, but when you look at what else is in the area (hint: nothing good), these are not at all dealbreakers.
Great bar! Easy to be alone, sit and have a cocktail, and fabulous food!

Please, please, please bring back the crinkle cut fries for the prime rib, queso cheese, and fries appetizer and my rating goes up to 5 stars.  The change in fries to shoe string fries made my favorite dish turn into a puddle of mush.  I used to have several business dinners a month with people from all of the country at Woody's.  Not now, I do not go at all.  I miss Woody's.
The "daiquiri" we got was a cocktail in disguise. A Smokey pineapple with a bit of spicy was insanely good. Raw oyster deal at happy is good too but for me, they were secondary.

I love this place! I've been going here for years and have always experienced great customer service.  The staff is really friendly and their dry cleaning is both quick and affordable. I spilled red wine all over my new coat and they did an amazing job making it look brand new.  Thanks, Burlington Cleaners!
Best pizza in the Philly airport. Everything is fresh and pretty decently priced. You can get two slices for under 5 bucks.

Best wine for the price in town hands down. I've been a club awesome member for over a year now and love going there for my free wine tastings. It is cool to hang out and drink a bottle on the patio. Their wine is great on its own, good with food too but is drinkable anytime. Did I mention that I love this place!!!! LOVE THIS PLACE!

Not as clean as I'd like. (no liners in the jetted tubs and it's my understanding the tubing can carry the bacteria and spread fungus)

The lady doing my nails soaked my finger in acetone for nearly an hour while doing my pedi and then still resorted to completely grinding my nails (cutting 3 of my fingers around the cuticle and grinding layers of my natural nail bed). My nails looked more battered coming out. 

I wouldn't recommend.
Best breakfast burrito ive had in a long time, hella bomb!!! Service is excellent they greet you as soon as u walk up the front door !! Awsome place !!!

This is a really hard one to score for me.  I've had one great experience here and one experience that I wouldn't wish on my worst enemy.

The first time I came here, I was meeting my wife for lunch and we had decided to try a seafood place to break up all the bbq, italian and bar grills that usually go to.

We could not have had a kinder server.  She helped us navigate an unfamiliar menu, made a couple of suggestions for us newbies and took great care of us the entire time we were there.  The food was delicious (the battered fries were especially good) and came out in a timely manner.  We had a great visit and decided to have the whole family out the next week for my wife's birthday dinner.

It was like going to an entirely different restaurant.  I called the day before to try and make a reservation and was hung up on.  Here is how that conversation went.

Gulf Shores Hostess:  Gulfshoreshowmayihelpyou?

Me:  Yes, do you take reservations?

GSH:  Yeswithpartiesofsixomoreand24hoursnotice.

Me:  Gotcha.  I ...

GSH:  Okthanksbye.  *click*


Ok fine... I guess I won't be making a reservation...

We decided to all meet up at the restaurant at 5 the next day for the birthday dinner.  I got up there 15 minutes early to put our names in with the red headed host as I was sure there would be a wait.  I walked in and told the host that there would be 12 of us and watched his eyes bug out of his head.  

"Really?  Are you serious? 12?  Um .... uh ...."

He ended up telling me that he wouldn't seat us together but could put us in separate booths.  I told him that was fine, watched him visibly cringe at the fact that I didn't leave and waited for him to take my name for the table, only to be ignored.  I asked him if he could go ahead and seat us as they had already set up the tables for us and he pointed to a sign saying that they will not seat a reservation until all party members are present.  I pointed out to him that we didn't have a reservation but still he refused. 

Once we finally get seated, we asked for a high chair for a 2 year old that was with us only to be informed that they couldn't provide that as it would be a "fire hazard".  I'm sorry, what?  A fire hazard?  This is starting to become almost comical.  I was able to locate an entire stack of them when I went to use the restroom.  It's almost like he was doing this on purpose.

To their credit, our server ended up being the lone bright spot in an otherwise dismal visit.  She quickly supplied us with the kids menus that the host from hell had decided not to provide us with and got us our drinks and orders squared away. The poor lady then ended up having to come back two different times to tell my son that they didn't have what he wanted on the kids menu.  

As we were there for my wife's birthday, I didn't make a scene as I didn't want to ruin the meal for her.  I was able to screen her from all the stupidity so she was able to enjoy her meal.  The food that we were able to get was actually really good and had it not been for the host from hell and getting hung up on, I could have looked past everything else.

I am hoping that they have an engaged owner and that they see this.  The restaurant has some great food, but they could do themselves a huge favor and relieve themselves of a certain red headed host.

Very friendly staff and a very clean hotel. I love the happy hour that they have that's totally free (beer, wine, hard liquor, snacks).  Breakfast in the morning with fresh eggs, bacon, sausage, fresh fruit, toast, donuts and bagels is also amazing. They also have made to order omelettes or any type of eggs that you'd like to have.

I was placed on the 16th floor and the Wi-Fi signal on the 16th floor is very very poor. I also found that cell signal was also very poor on the 16th floor, but perfect on the ground floor. I suspect that this being one of the taller buildings in the area that the cells are actually on the roof and that made my signal not so good in my room.  I'll certainly stay here again but I'll look for a lower floor room. 

My only other complaint is that parking is $11 per day for self parking. Which seems strange seeing as we're not in a very busy area (like say downtown New York).

I'm not into this market at all. It has really gone downhill over the years. The prices are very high on common items that every other grocery store has, so why bother? It looks dingy and dirty throughout and the employees aren't very friendly.

The produce is always pretty bad looking. Everything rotting. Years ago this was a much nicer place. It's a shame, really. I would rather go to Net Cost Market at Welsh & Bluegrass.

Boring and bland. I think this place is good for kids with sensitive taste buds to eat at. My favorite part was the soda. 

Dry food with little-to-no flavor. I've only been here once and I think that in this instance, once is enough. It could use with a lot of improvement, but it's still got some potential to be pretty good.

WARNING about this restaurant! BLOODY BAND AIDE FOUND IN FOOD!  I have been eating at Rouge for 15 years and have always loved it.  This all stopped this past Saturday night....when...as I was eating my endive and bibb salad, I came across a used bloody band aide!  I was disgusted...not only because this is disgusting, but also because I am pregnant and it just makes the whole thing even worse!  I immediately told the server who promptly removed the salad.  The manager apologized and comped the meal...which I didn't eat anyway!  I tried to inquire about any communicable diseases the wearer of the band aide may have had but have not heard back from the manager or the general manager, like they said they would.  Hence...a review on YELP, which I have never done but now feel the need to since this whole experience is just awful and I wish it on no one else who is trying to enjoy a meal out.
Biggest and tastiest stromboli I have ever eaten. If I would not have lost my foot, I would come back.

Best Chinese food so far in Chinatown.  Good hot and sour soup, good dumplings.  The lemon chicken was not exciting but still well-prepared.  The show pea leaves were delicious, with lots of garlic.

On our recent visit we tried some new things, things we'd never eaten at other places.  There was a salty squid dish that everyone loved.  I wish I knew what the other dishes were, but trust me when I say that nothing I've ordered has been bad here.

They also serve on dishes created as a local art project.  Worth checking out.

Ordered take out.  Everything was cold. The chive dumplings were soggy and full of grease.  Took one bite and threw them out.  The egg rolls were the same.  
The chicken teriyaki was rubbery.  The texture was tendon like.  All the sauces tasted burnt.  Very disappointed. Waste of money.

This is probably my least favorite nail saloon. To start off, the atmosphere and customer service felt awkward and rude. They don't have many nail technicians working and when potential customers came in (if all the nail techs were already helping others) then they would tell the potential customer to come back in an hour. They did this for multiple people and I do think it's nice that they were being honest however one women came back an hour later and was told to come back an hour again because nobody could help since they were all busy. Just seems awkward and rude that they told a customer one thing and then didn't live up to their word. 

Besides that I got a regular pedicure and a gel manicure. I only get manicures done on special occasions and figured I would go to this place because it was right near where I get my eye brows threaded. A regular pedicure and gel manicure took about TWO hours. My nail technician was very slow but didn't pay attention to detail. I was very disappointed on her paint job in my toe nails. I was considering leaving and not getting my hands done but since I needed my nails painted for the special occasion that night, I figured I would give them the benefit of the doubt and it would go better. 

But I was wrong. After being very displeased with my pedicure, I asked her to fix my painted nails. She left part of my toe nails unpainted! She didn't seem to realize that they looked horrible. I was not satisfied. 

Then when it came to my manicure, she cut two of my fingers and made them bleed. I understand that cuts do happen when cutting cuticles but she offered NO APOLOGY (even after I made a noise for cutting me). Most nail techs will say something if that happens. 

To top it all off - I asked how long the gel would last and she said TWO weeks. My gels chipped within FOUR days and the when it was a week and a half - I was so fed up and annoyed with the gels - I went to another salon to take it off. (6 fingers between the two hands have chipped). If I am going to pay over $60 plus tip (which I tipped too much for that service), then I should get quality work. Just a huge disappointment because I was hoping that the nails would last me till my upcoming vacation.

I went to breakfast at two different spots on Magazine Street during my last visit, and I have to say that I loved them both, for totally different reasons. One breakfast was frou-frou, the other was just a cool place to eat with solid food choices that delivered. 

This was the cool place. 

We walk in, and the staff is kinda rude, but in New Orleans, staff is either really nice or jerky. We got our menus, and had such a hard time ordering because so many things on the menu sounded great and were reasonably priced. 

I chose the Creole Slammer (chili and cheddar cheese poured over hash browns, bacon, and scrambled eggs with a biscuit on the side) and a sweet potato pancake that I was dying to try. 

Other than the biscuit, the breakfast was top notch. The chili was made fresh, hash browns and bacon crisp (even though they were buried under chili, mind you), eggs buttery. The sweet potato pancake was better than awesome. 

As I mentioned, the biscuit was the downfall. I like flaky, warm biscuits - this wasn't either of those things. I wouldn't sell the place short for a bad biscuit that I didn't even care about, though - when I ordered, I was excited about the slammer and the pancake, and those were very well worth the wait and rude staff! 

No one at my table was unhappy with their meals, which should say something about a place. 

Cash only, as others have mentioned. You have to write your name down on a sheet of paper outside and then wait for them to call you, but if there isn't someone outside to tell you that they aren't going to run out and give the info if they see you looking at them hungrily through the window, either.

Stayed one night while traveling through Indy. Had our two dogs with is so had to choose a hotel that was pet-friendly.
Thankfully, we booked our room through hot&ls.c@m, so we didn't pay full price.
Pros: Location-close to interstate, some restaurants and Costco.
The bed was very comfortable
The staff was friendly. 
Cons: Our first room was so smoky, I seriously think someone was smoking in there moments before we arrived. The second room was fine. 
All the hallways smell like smoke, even though it's suppose smoke free. We ran into a guy who said he switched rooms twice (one room had standing water and the other one was full of ants)
Furniture and decor seems to be pieced together. The pullout in our suite was too big for the space so when it was pulled-out for our son to sleep on, it blocked the bathroom. The bedroom had an almost empty wall where it looked like there was missing furniture.
