Jerae.. you are so amazing! you were kind from the beginning of the entire process and you saying that you love what you do, really helped ease some of the awkwardness!!! i already booked my next appointment

How could you give anything but five stars to the Katy Trail?  It's just the perfect weekend recreation for St. Louis if you have a bike or don't mind springing for a rental.  Okay, it's not the place to go if you want a challenge.  The hills are, well, non-existent pretty much, which makes it a great ride for the whole family.  

Pick your spot to set out.  We recently took off from Klondike Trail Head and rode down to Augusta and back.  It's a short ride, and the Augusta Brewing Co. has a great patio area for you to enjoy a craft beer in the shade.  

On a previous visit, we headed west from Augusta and that was a fun ride, too.  Lots of farmland.  

If you don't have a bike, it's very easy to find a rental spot, including one we used in Defiance and a new one on the Trail in Augusta.

Southern Cross never lets us down. The meals are always fresh and delicious. We Just ordered the Valentine combo dinner and it was DELICIOUS.  The Halibut was a perfectly seasoneand cooked along with its accompanied risotto. The other entree was Veal & Shrimp Scallopini and it too was wonderful. The veal as so tender as was the shrimp over pasta. Delicious.  You can't go wrong here, eat in or curbside. Don't hesitate to try Southern Cross.
Waited 45 min on the wait list and our seat was given to someone else who just arrived. They did reseat us and apologize. Food is amazing!

I guess Walmart is trying to help immigrants but really - the service at this store is atrocious. The employees are either untrained or they are unable to learn because they know little to nothing about their inventory. Almost every time I would go there and ask where to find something I was told they didn't have it. When I looked on my own, for 15 minutes, it was there. What prompted me doing this review is because I just called to ask if they sold a particular copy toner and was put on hold - for 20 minutes! until I finally hung up. Guess I'll go to London Drugs where they actually provide service. This store is going to go broke if they keep this up. I went to return a $7.00 item one day and waited in a short line for almost a half hour due to complete incompetence of the clerk helping one customer.
Excellent fried chicken! Discovered this late night and then got it the next day too!

A great place to stop for a quick & casual meal. Their addition of sauteed veggies in the tacos is right up my alley...I love little unique additions to a usually straightforward dish. They nailed it with the veggies. Good chips...fresh & crispy. Definitely eat on the patio and people watch in downtown Boise.

We visited St. Louis 2 weeks ago and Pappy's was so amazing that I am trying not to get saliva all over my keyboard.  OMG!  The ribs!  The brisket! The chicken!  The frito pie! Great sweet potato pies, terrific baked beans and fabulous sauces too.  The staff was really nice and we were lucky to come there on a Monday rather than on the weekend before anything was even sold out.  Actually, the burnt ends were gone but who cares if you can eat those ribs!  I wish we had places anywhere half as good as Pappy's on Long Island or even in New York but alas, that isn't happening - although the baby back ribs at Houston's and even Costco aren't too shabby!

I left with a huge smile on my face, tighter pants, a cute T-shirt and several bottles of their BBQ sauce which I brought back for my family.  I don't know when I will be back in St. Louis but I know Pappy's will be one of the places we will certainly go back to!

I moved to Nashville in April and have talked about cutting my hair. I had really long hair and was pretty tired of it, but decided to keep it until Christmas. I went to Cognito this past weekend to get it all cut off and donate my hair. I was greeted as soon as I walked in by Lily, a small shih tzu dog. She was so sweet! The staff also immediately greeted me and asked if I would like anything to drink. So I had coffee whole I waited for my appointment since I arrived early. The stylist was awesome. She made sure to ask a few times if I was ready to cut my hair and she also took care of donating to the Pantene foundation as well. My long bob looked fantastic and I'm so glad I happen to give them a try. I'll definitely be going back!

Chain breakfast/brunch. Not bad, not great. I'm an eggs Benedict slut and that's something hard to mess up. The eggs were poached beautifully, English muffin had a perfect crisp, and the hollandaise was good enough. Nothing to write home about, but a good spot for fast, consistent breakfast!
Great salmon sandwich. My family really liked their selections except my husband. There was more bbq than salad almost which some people would probably not mind.

Amazing Experience!  Kaylyn at Darque Immersion did a fantastic job on a spray tan for me!  They have a wonderful facility near downtown St Pete..  She was knowledgable, friendly &!very accommodating..  They have earned a repeat customer in me!

One of the best slices of Pizza you can get within Tucson. They have a nice crust with plenty of room to hold onto. It's also kinda stretchy which I like. It could use more sauce though, I also find it quite odd that they charge different prices for meat and vegetable​ toppings. However unlike the last pizza place I went to the crust on my 2 slices were not burnt . Very impressive I just wish it were a little larger slice maybe cut into 6 instead of 8 so you have more foldability. You got the New York flavor but need the size to go along with it.

I ate dinner at this restaurant one year ago and the food was outstanding as the service. However, today was very different. I had reservations which wanted to repeat the experience but that was not the case.

The waiter seated us but that was just it and nothing more. She never came back after 20 minutes of sitting there to address anything on the menu or specials. I went an address it with the manager but all he good say was "ok". 

Thanks for the first experience and definitely the last. Customer service is everything to me and without that what is the point of being in business.
We absolutely love this food. We use Grubhub takeout. The pita is homemade and fabulous. Chicken kabob. Salad is delicious

We were in New Orleans for 5 days and I made a promise to myself that I would try as many of the oyster houses as possible while visiting. Acme did not disappoint! We were slightly concerned when reading all the reviews about the line being out the door. Quick tip for eating in New Orleans: if you don't want to wait Outside in line, go around 5:30,have a few beers and a appetizer....you won't wait long and still have a peaceful dinner without a ridiculous crowd. But back to acme, oysters were outstanding. Also had andouille sausage, red beans and rice. 
Service was fantastic ,wait staff was very prompt and courteous.....

Best pizza in town and a good contender for other towns. 

Love the bar, which is a great place to eat the pizza. It's got the perfect ambience for a good fella to be found.

Literally 10 minutes in the drive thru with one car. I ordered a root beer float and the ice cream was liquefied, just turned into milky foam. The girl said nothing.  When I said something, she said the ice cream soft, so she knew it wasn't right.  I  asked for a root beer only, she did not give me the difference back. Just say the floats aren't ready or something, don't serve that garbage.

Shrimp grits breakfast is delightful! Perfect balance of ingredients and flavor. Casual, relaxed atmosphere with friendly, attractive staff. Modern, trendy decor ... sitting here makes me feel cool again. Comfortable spacing between tables. Attractive outdoor seating areas. Only minus I could find was locating the restaurant in the hotel. Could not see signage, elevator doesn't indicate restaurant floor, and there were no staff in the restaurant to welcome diners (they were in kitchen). Perhaps this was related to time of day, 9:40am.

Dined in on Monday night. Ate dry ribs entree, 4 piece with 2 sides for only 9 bucks. Great meal! I was also impressed with their sauce selections---4 kinds. It was hard to pick the best, every sauce was good! Will come back again if I come to St. Louis.

Disappointing. I was looking forward to trying this new restaurant. Sat a the bar and had to ask for a menu and someone to wipe the top a couple of times. Ordered soup and salad. Had to wait over 20 min for my soup and when u finally got it, it was cold to I sent it back. The service is awful and the food is somewhat bland.

The menu is simple and yet fill with tasty foods. You can order the bab either cold or hot. I specifically love my foods served hot, taste better. I recommend the wings they have there. Very good! If you're unsure how to eat or order, there is a video to tutor you how to. I like its simplicity.

Came here just for the affogato flight!!  It comes with classic, matcha matcha, tiramisu, and cookies in cream. They ran out of cookies and cream so we replaced with Vietnamese coffee.  My favorite flavor was the matcha matcha! It's something everyone should experience. The Vietnamese coffee was on the bitter side and very strong. Classic was my second favorite. And tiramisu kinda just tasted like classic. 

The inside is super cute and the staff are so helpful and welcoming. There's only like 4 tables and a bar. We still found a table on a weekday afternoon. 

You have to street park and pay. But that's every place downtown. We paid $3 for an hour.

A nice place to grab lunch or something on the go--I especially like their hummus platter that comes with the most amazing baked-on-site Cosi bread ever.  I also like their tomato, basil, and mozzarella sandwich but since tomatoes make me gag, I just get it without the tomato.

Adam was our server and he was so informative about the menu and also other places we should visit while we were there. The BBQ was really good but the sides we just average. It's a cool hole in the wall bar if that's what you are looking for... Adam made our experience exceptional!!

We had a great late lunch here. The burrata platter was loaded and delicious. Big slices of tomato with balsamic and pesto. Yum. The meatball salad was outstanding. A huge meatball in a salad with ricotta galore. Got the margherita pizza to go. The dough was fantastic and the sauce tasty. All three dishes were bountiful with fresh ingredients. Truly outstanding.
Best vegan pizza and impossible burger around. The Get Figgy with it is out of this world!!!

I love Breweries.    I've been to this one many times and never left a review.  Shame on me!  My wife and I ride our bicycles to Dunedin and do mini brewery tours every now and then.   This one is usually one of the stops.  Especially if you want to eat.    The food here is really good and the beer is even better.    On the last trip here we had the Nachos.  They came out looking awesome and they tasted even better than they looked.  They have indoor seating as well as a huge patio with plenty of picnic tables.  Servers work the patio and bring you everything you need. This place also has live music on the weekends.   Its a fantastic spot to have a few delicious beers, listen to a good live band, and drink some great beer.   What more can you ask for?

Pain centers in general are tough places for the medical and support staffs. Clearly there are patients who just want a magic pill or narcotics to ease their pain. They have to be tough on dispensing narcotics because of the horrible abusive environment in which we live. Their philosophy will (and should be) multifaceted treatments to ease and manage severe and chronic pain. This requires a patient's participation. When I read some of the nasty reviews I wonder if the writers are only looking for pills. Anyway, I have had mostly positive experiences over the last five years. The only negative is that the wait times on some days can be long. To me, this means they are taking care of someone that requires a bit more time and sometimes that is ME!  Best to go early. 

I totally trust my two care givers, Mr Donald Hair and Ms Roberta Bush. I have spent more time with Mr Hair over the last five years and he has gotten me through some very traumatic and painful surgeries, chronic pain and a very active auto-immune disease. He looks at the whole person. And he listens to me. 

The support staff are always friendly and helpful.

Super busy place in Tucson. It may be the only nice restaurant in the area. We ended up sitting in the bar instead of waiting for our table. The bar seemed like it was filled with older established men waiting for their younger dates. It was a little uncomfortable. The food and dessert was great.

Love the decor.  Food was very good but find it annoying to have to listen to the gaming machines while trying the enjoy the atmosphere of what would otherwise be a pleasant experience.  Maybe the sound on this machines could be turned off if these are a must.
Great service, great food, beachy vibe, reasonable prices for a gastro pub. Nice selection of craft beer.

Well its Olive Garden one of my favorite place to eat thats just simple.
I must say that i enjoyed my visit to this Olive garden restaurant  over here
The food and service is very very good i enjoy it lot.

I had high expectations for this "Patty sue" at shear west. all the reviews on her are great and i also bought a groupon.  a few complaints:

-booking with her is a nightmare, you can only call when she is there which is half the days of the week. the other receptionists at this salon were very rude

-it took her 20 minutes just to set up my manicure (she knew i was coming?) because she was constantly running around like a schizo not paying attention to her client

-clearly unprofessional, from her personal appearance to her manicure space at the salon (kept looking back in her car to see if her dog was okay) seriously thought she was going to stop my appointment to go take her dog out. 

-she was making strange comments about surrounding peoples conversations that she wasn't a part of, and made me feel very uncomfortable

-she was very intense and wanted to talk about her life/gossip/problems instead of just doing my nails. it took her over an hour for a simple manicure. 

-didn't even soak my nails before my manicure or remove my old polish......
also didn't know how to file them that well

-the polish looks good and im not unhappy with my nails, but more so the overall experience with this bizarre woman and her disintrest in helping me have a quick relaxing mani pedi.

The Tucson Music Hall is the shoddiest concert hall of any U.S. city. Lousy acoustics and sight-lines, and how about that lovely sight of exposed wires draped on side walls. Way too long rows of seats unbroken by a center aisle -- which really needs evaluation by a fire marshal for potential issues in exiting in an emergency. The plaza outside is a Brutalist concrete horror of uneven pavement, broken concrete and dangerously poor lighting, plus that broken disused concrete fountain in which litter gathers. Not somewhere I would take a visitor. I am assuming that the reviewers who gush over this sorry dump don't travel much.

My curly hair and I have been struggling for years. Our biggest mishap happens annually when I begrudgingly go and get my haircut by someone new who deems themselves a "curly hair expert". Each year, my hair and my new hairdresser fail me. 

Until this year. 

I went to Capelli after hearing countless Main Liners deem this salon the best in the area. They didn't talk it up enough. 

My hair looks amazing; the shape is phenomenal, the curl definition is perfect (thanks to the product recommended to me by Mario), and, most importantly, the length of my hair isn't much different than when I first walked in. 

I literally never go back to the same salon more than once, until now. If you want to make amends with your hair and look 100x better than you thought was possible, go to Capelli. It's worth every penny.

Wonderful customer service, subpar room overpriced and outdated...cleanliness was iffy didn't seem fully clean in a lot of areas, found a wad of hair on the bed it wasn't mine...we have just arrived...sticky stuff on the night stand....bathtub looked dinghy, tile broken, the room smelled musty...definitely remodeling/upgrading is in order or it will completely lose its charm sooner than later...
 
Food: eggs were good, decaf coffee was sour!! I drink decaf at home and it doesn't taste like that, toast was edible....

Wouldn't recommend unless you opted for the newer suites...in general I wouldn't comeback unless it gets a new revamping or at least better quality cleanliness.

Nice coffee & lounge spot in the CBD. We had a meeting in the area & needed a place to relax & have coffee before it started. Very bright and comfortable ambiance. I ate my delicious Breakfast Crepe with some Tea and read my paper and people watched.  Fiance had some hot drink (can't recall what he ordered) that he thoroughly enjoyed had There was quite a crowd but the line moved quickly. I would love to come back for lunch or dinner.

Maybe I'm just really excited for a new local restaurant to pick up dinner from, but despite the few kinks we experienced, I have to say we were pretty pleased. We must not be the only ones happy to have a new local restaurant, because this place seems to stay packed since it opened. But that brings us to our biggest complaint...there's no designated pickup parking. After driving around for some time, with 5-6 other cars also watching like hawks for someone leaving, I finally got a spot. 

Our son is on the Autism Spectrum and sensitive to loud places. That's why we often pick up dinner and bring it home. This place will definitely not be a place that we will be able to ever bring him because it was so loud that it even bothered me. Staff could barely hear and everything had to be yelled back and forth. Definitely not my scene. It was also pretty frustrating trying to call my order in, because they could barely hear me over the noise in restaurant. She was extremely polite and apologetic and tried her best, but it was frustrating, none the less.

The food was good. My nachos were VERY good, once I realized all the queso was at the bottom of the pan and I just stirred everything up and added the sour cream and salsa. Lots of jalapenos and plenty of chicken. Next time, I would order it with the queso on the side. They aren't kidding when they say it could feed 4. Hubby and I split it between us, and he also got the chicken tenders basket. The nachos were more than plenty for me. 

Hubby said the tenders weren't good and he didn't care for the fries. Our son was pretty annoyed that they made the mistake of giving him tater tots instead of fries, and he said the burger was just ok. Needless to say, they weren't as pleased with their dinners as I was.
Some awesome local Mexicana food here ! I had the  special platter with beef, so good and they give you the hot sauce on side! What an amazing hot sauce it was!

I love this place. Fun atmosphere. They almost always have live music when I come. The sandwiches are affordable and delicious. The staff is always cool. It's great for kids.. I love that they serve a really cheap dish of fruit that is perfect for a small child.

Everything I ever ate at Hunan Restaurant was very good, but I will limit my review to the one truly exceptional dish I had there, i.e. the Hunan Chicken. First, who can say no to fried chicken? How about when it comes with lots of peppers that give the dish a serious kick, only to be delicately sweetened by the sliced oranges that line the plate? Yep, the result is a dish you can't help but order every single time you go to Hunan...

Had lunch there with a girlfriend while on a break from work. We sat outside and I love how they have it set up. 

Food: we just ordered apps to share. Brussel sprouts, prawn with homemade kimchi, roti fries, and fried plantains. Brussel sprouts were perfectly charred and the extra toppings added nice mix of texture and taste. The prawn was sweet and delicious. The kimchi was good. The combination was alright, nothing exciting. The roti fried were good but the sauce lacked a little salt. The plantain chips were great even without the dipping sauce. I also had a mocktail that was refreshing. I think it was the raspberry and ginger. 

Service: the service was nice. Not hurried. Check in on us here and there but mostly left us to enjoy our meal. 

Definitely a great spot.
The food was so good. The service was amazing. The portions are generous. We will definitely be back. Five stars all around

If you order the burrito that is named after the restaurant you are eating at, you would kind of expect it to be not bland and wishing you were at Taco Bell.  Covering the burrito with a half bottle of Cholula could not overcome the cardboard flavored blandness.  The server was not friendly and seemed bothered that we wanted to sit down and eat there.  I will not eat at this location again and will patronize Juan's on Magazine from now on.

This is our go to spot for casual, fun atmosphere and great food and service.  Our server, Kayla, always greets us with a smile and we never have to ask for anything.  She's always right on top of it all.

This Ghost Tour is not only educational but fun too. An activity worth the the money. Now whether you want a more family oriented event or looking to booze it up a little during the tour, both can be accomplished here. It's a 2 hour tour but I assure you that it goes by quickly.

Once you book your tour, you meet up outside of Jax's Bistro Bar for the check-in process. 
My wonderful friend and I decided to grab a couple of drinks at the bar before the tour started. It was also encourage by the very energetic, outgoing, jolly, comedic,Tour Guide DJ. 

Once you get started, you will find yourself amongst other walking tour groups on the streets of NOLA. I would suggest wearing comfy shoes because you move around a bit. The tour will stop at a bar with Ghost history and if there's time you can go in and grab a drink, use the washroom AND ultimately, you will end at a bar so what's not to like?  Don't get me wrong, it's not a drinking Ghost Tour but the drinking doesn't hurt and it made DJ a tad bit more funny. ;-)

If you decide to stick around after the tour, DJ will in indulge you with more ghost stories. 

All in all. It's a fun tour. Just do it.
Even the kids liked it! I got some Damn Hot chicken and it was great. Online ordering made the line no big deal. Good people working there.

I've used full circle services for cleaning and re sealing my slate floors, carpet cleaning, and upholstery cleaning and protection. Every single time I'm completely satisfied with their work they perform. In fact I'm always above satisfied, especially how they take the time to care for all areas of your home as they are working in it. Always protecting stair banisters, walls, doors, furniture...etc. making sure no moisture is left behind on the hard surfaces, and leaving extra shoe booties for me and my family, so we can enjoy our home right away. I highly suggest and recommend using full circle services if your looking to clean your carpets, clean and re seal your tile or stone, and for cleaning and protecting your furniture. The old adage, "you get what you pay for"... Well you get much more than what you pay for with these guys. 
Thanks James!

Having just had surgery, I needed to pick up some medical supplies for the healing process (band-aids, Neosporin, etc.). CVS was in the area so I popped in. Funny how you go in to buy 2 or 3 things on your list but end up walking out with everything from low-salt Pringle's potato chips and $1 notepads and Burt's Bee products. HELP. I just zipped in and out, no wait, no fuss.
Another excellent taqueria hiding in the heart of Tucson! Cabeza, asada, and al pastor all fantastic. Go there. It's delish.

A group of family and friends and I had a really great experience at Firebirds in Moorestown in early December. We arrived right around 4pm, the beginning of happy hour (which lasts until 7, by the way - heck yes!), and sat at some high top tables by the fire. The bartender was our server and she was great about prompt drink orders and water refills throughout our stay. 

Happy hour specials are pretty solid, and we ordered several rounds of drinks and a bunch of apps to share. Favorites were the soft pretzels with beer cheese and chicken tenders with all the sauces they have available because your girl right here loves some sauce options. 

We did notice that the buns for our sliders were really hard and we mentioned something to our server about it. The manager came over to chat with us and graciously sent out another plate of chicken tenders and removed the sliders from our check. Such a nice gesture and definitely gave this place points in my book. I'm sure we'll all return for another happy hour sesh in the future!
Excellent service and easy. Loved everything about this experience. Being a confessed "watch addict", this place WILL be a problem. Enablers!! )))

Seemed OK but couldn't even enjoy it due to the fact that their bouncers started demanding paying customers to get out of their seats so they could take them because it was going to get 'packed soon'. This business obviously doesn't care about their customers or their bartenders getting tipped

Let's start by saying that this was a memorable 1st visit. There were some mix-ups but the customer service was flat put top-notch. Not only was my order corrected, I got a tour and a discount. The manager as well as the staff are so friendly. All smiles, even under the masks. They are very knowledgeable of their product as well. 
The food was delicious, unique, generous, and fun. The names they have for the sandwiches are awesome. They have a large variety to choose from and they have KETO bread! They also have breakfast pastries and chips. They have a huge variety of drinks! We tried the smoothie and the Vietnamese iced coffee and they were amazing! Not only will I go back to this place, for the outdoor seating, their lounged out meeting room, and the food, they are expanding. Yes, more space in the building for you to sit, sip, and socialize. This place is a diamond. Don't miss out!

Went to marios to pick up dinner for my girlfriend s birthday as I explained when I ordered. (Girlfriend requested pizza). Figured I'd try marios for the first time. Ordered a large carnivor and a medium fantastic 4. Waited for a little while got my pizza and rushed home. Opened up the boxes all excited for some good pizza to find something that looked microwaved after coming out of a walmart freezer! Girlfriend ate half a piece. The dough was also still wet. Had no substance what so ever for 45 bucks! also got a steak sub and a piece of "NY cheesecake" again both sub par store bought. A new yorker would laugh at this! I called and spoke with the manager and I explained my disappointment. She tells me she personally watched them come out of the oven and they looked great! What did I expect? Told me she would take 10 to 15% off my next order. Told her there would be no next order! I would be embarrassed to send this out to a first timer for a birthday dinner.

So disappointed on all levels.  We were getting "gourmet" cupcakes for an event.  The customer services was atrocious.  When we walked up to the counter, we were asked what we needed help with, we told the woman and she literally turned and walked away from us without saying a word.  A little while later, a young girl asked what we needed, all while the initial, older woman stood and looked on while chatting with a coworker.  They then joked with the younger girl, saying she was so busy while they had nothing to do.  We were left alone with a book for what seemed like an eternity until someone who introduced herself as Ginger's daughter brought us her daughter to help us, since they were "short staffed".  The poor girl (in her 20's) could not so much as tell us what flavors of cupcakes they made, nor the price without going into the back to ask someone else.  After our 90 minute ordeal, I was assured the cupcakes would be both beautiful and delicious.  I walked out telling my friend that after all the aggravation, these better be the best cupcakes I ever had.  Later in the week, I called to add additional cupcakes and was told that they only make mini cupcakes on Tues. and Wed.  Um, does that mean if I buy mini cupcakes on display on Sat. they are 3-4 days old?  We picked up the cupcakes for our Sunday event on Sat. since they are now closed on Sundays and I was not only disappointed with the look of them. (I honestly could have made a prettier cupcake.) AND the tastelessness of them.  I only tried the one that was supposed to be red velvet, but it had zero taste.  I was told by those that had the carrot cake, vanilla, and chocolate that I wasn't missing out on anything, so I saved myself the calories.  Needless to say, I will find a business that will appreciate by purchases and provide quality product.

A decent place for kids to get their energy out, but the staff is lacking. Wonderful friendly staff at the front desk, but everyone manning the floor is unhappy that they have to work. They spend most of their time drinking sodas and flirting with high school kids, and any actual supervision is in the form of yelling at kids. 

I understand it's a loud environment and you have to raise your voice to be heard. That's not the issue.  It's more the manner in how they speak to the kids. 

Seems like a sweet job, if you don't like it, quit.

Page did my make-up & hair for my wedding on 11/6/16.  I live in San Francisco so most of our communications were by text or email.  Page has a warm and uplifting personal which made me feel at ease.  She is a pro with many years of experience.  She is punctual and her assisting team was great as well.  They did a great job on my family and friends hair & make-up.  I loved my make-up and hair.

I had a great experience buying my Camry from Nikolaus! He (and the whole Price Toyota team) made me very comfortable buying my first car, accommodated my unusual scheduling needs during quarantine, and made the whole process smooth and easy. They were honest and upfront about costs and options, which I really appreciated, and I got a great rate from them. Would definitely recommend purchasing from Nikolaus at Price Toyota!

Great service.  Yummy food.  Donut holes are huge!  We tried three of the four varieties:  Cinnamon Sugar, Powdered Sugar, and Glazed.  Mulligatawny happened to be the soup of the day, and we all received a sample.  It was great, but a bowl was $4.95 so we decided to pass, since we ordered the donut holes.  My friends and I all ordered a different breakfast entree.  You really can't go wrong!

Dr. Birken is a caring, compassionate and knowledgable Doctor . I have no reservations in recommending him . I feel it's worth it to pay the $200 annual administrative fee as I do not have to wait very long to get an appointment when I need to see him.
Great food.  The people who work here are nice.  Must try the pho special, it's delicious.  I can eat it every day of the week.  Good prices on their food.  Highly recommended.

I ordered the Mediterranean Chicken Pasta and let me tell you I was not disappointed.  I paired it with the house Cabernet.  My husband ordered the Jalapeno mozzarella sticks and normally I cannot eat anything with jalapenos. They were fantastic, I was able to eat two. I ordered dessert and the Mud Pie was the best I have ever tasted. Even if the food had not been excellent I would go back for more Mud Pie!
How unprofessional. Buddy with the flat brim hat was sarcastic and condescending . Would NOT recommend this place.

Yes and no. Cox's broadband service is very high-speed (for the USA, not so when compared to faster Canadian and European broadband services) and reliable, with a data cap that is so high it might as well be non-existent:  you'll never exceed it unless you download everything that comes over your wire.

On the other hand, Cox's ID and password authentication and webmail services suck big time.  I've spent the last two hours trying to get the user names, passwords, and Internet settings coordinated to work on two computers, and still haven't succeeded even with one!  No, I do not want to chat about it with an uninformed service rep, I want to be able to rely on the instructions given online. Problem is, there is no consistent set of instructions on line. Instructions change whenever someone at Cox wants to add our update information, based on ... ?   

(PS I finally figured it out myself.  I had to.  What do Cox techs know about the iCloud?  I mean, only a billion iPhones and iPads and Macs now use it.)

As others have noted, at this point, there is no competition for Cox in its service area, and the jurisdictions supposedly monitoring service quality aren't doing it.  Can't wait for AT&T, Verizon, and the other wireless carriers to provide 5G service (in a year or so) that will provide reliable high-speed wireless broadband.service.

PS Cox is among the carriers that recently, successfully lobbied the FCC to revoke its prohibition on the telco's and cable companies collecting and giving out our personal browsing and online activities to third parties, like marketing firms and government agencies, at home and abroad.  The telco's and cable companies not only want to make money on our use of their service, they want to make money on the things we do with that service.  That's a raw deal.  To preserve your privacy once deregulation takes place, you should subscribe to a VPN (virtual private network) that routes your service in secrecy.  It's cheap and will cloak your browsing from self-interested broadband providers ready to sell us out.  I use NordVPN which costs about $3 a month if you buy it on a two-year basis, a little more for short-term contracts.  Very fun and easy to use.  For more information on VPNs, see:

http://www.techhive.com/article/3158192/privacy/howand-whyyou-should-use-a-vpn-any-time-you-hop-on-the-internet.html/

I was told by the massage therapist that she could treat my lower back pain and that she had done it for years with athletes and patients that suffer from sciatic pain and disc issues. I was completely upfront about these medical issues and she assured me she had the perfect treatment. Two weeks later I am unable to walk without excruciating pain as a result of my massage. I have been to urgent care and now have to see an orthopedic and spine specialist for an evaluation and medical treatment.

Where to start. I'll just end it with this...45 mins for fries, tots, and a wedge salad, but they didn't being the tots. 

5 mins prior to them bringing it out I asked to just cancel and I'll pay for the drinks. 

I waited 15 more mins for them to bring the manager/check.  The manager never came out...the server tried to make it right but it wasn't enough. I'll never go back.

Had a haircut and coloring here yesterday! Walking into the salon, I didn't expect much. I've been in the US for three years, and not a single hair salon has been great enough for me to come back... But Kevin's Salon was a totally different experience.

The staff know their work to perfection, and even if they don't speak perfect English (not all of them) - they certainly know how to do miracles on your hair Vivid color, and they cut my hair very evenly and with care. 

One of the best hair salons in the area - and while the surroundings are not that glamorous, the quality of service and the final result are top notch.

Thank you so much to everyone - needless to say, I will be coming back!

Tonight, I had a terrible experience at Salt Rock Grill. I think that it should be named the "Coco Grill" "COVID Grill" "Corona Grill" or "Coconut Grill." because of their terrible handling of the recent COVID-19 pandemic. 

I had some friends recommend this place to me, and we drove about 45 minutes total to the restaurant, what a waste of gas money and time.

I had called ahead to make reservations for the OUTDOOR PATIO because of COVID. I got to the restaurant after the long haul to get there, and the sassy hostess informed me rudely, "You can't sit out there it's raining." on a super sunny day.
She said she would sit us in a "private room" to make up for it.

Everything was fine until we noticed our waitress, and all of the other employees in the restaurant wearing their masks all wrong. I'm talking on the chin, under their nose, etc. Not a single person cared about their customers enough to wear a mask during a worldwide deadly pandemic.
Then all of a sudden they sat a random party of 11 in our "private room." We felt so uncomfortable. Their table was super close to us, definitely not 6 feet. 
 
I ordered the Kids Steak and Shrimp for my kid, to-go. They didn't even include ketchup in the bag, so my kid was stuck eating nasty soggy fries and shrimp with no ketchup. The steak was nasty and tasted like smoke.  Un-edible. 

Overall, if you want to get COVID-19, and deal with bad customer service and nasty food, this is the place to come!

Stopped in Panera's Brentwood location for a sandwich on a Saturday (5/26/2018). The woman who took my order was friendly and efficient, which is why I am giving two stars instead of one. When I walked back to get my order however, the young woman who was making my sandwich had a scowl on her face, wrapped it up and kind of threw it my direction. When I got home, the sandwich was not only uncut, but the pickle was missing. Not a good experience! I will not frequent this location in the future.

Without a doubt the best sandwich shop in Delaware. I was born and raised here and I have been eating Olympic subs for many years. Although I now live outside of San Antonio Texas I always stop at Olympic sub shop whenever I go home in fact I always get two for the Road. If you're ever in northern Delaware I strongly suggest you put Olympic on your to do list you won't be disappointed.

We just left here because the girl working the orders, in the drive thru,  literally asked us three times for our order and the proceeded not to respond when we gave the order. I'm sorry, the main reason some of these places are failing is service, please coach and develop your team.

Had to try this place as recommended by a client.  My wife and I were a bit under dressed. If you like too notch service, this is the place.  We were treated with 100% A1 service. Never had to wait for anything.  The food was impeccable. Will revisit this place again.

One of my favorite restaurants in St. Louis, by far! 

It's especially great when we're able to snag the curved booth in the back corner -- perfect for people watching, especially since it seems to be a hot date spot. Let's face it: there's really nothing better than over analyzing a first date from across the room. 

I have a tendency to always order the same thing...and in this case, it's the smoked chicken (which ends up looking like roadkill on my plate by the time I'm done). The boy is more adventurous, but has been sticking with the duck lately. Either way, no matter what has ended up in front of us, it's always been topnotch. (They once offered pork wings as an off-the-menu appetizer special...can't beat 'em...whatever the heck pork wings are.) 

The Shaved Duck is relatively easy on the wallet, too, considering that they have a pretty good wine selection and the atmosphere can't be beat. And the staff is always at the top of their game. 

If I had a complaint, it would be that the nights with live music can get pretty loud -- not exactly conducive to dinner chitchat. 

Last but not least, do NOT -- seriously, don't -- leave here without ordering the gooey butter brownie for dessert. I promise you, it will not disappoint!

I've come here easily over a dozen times for all meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner. They're all incredible, but my personal favorite is breakfast. I always get their Printer's Plate. Their sausage is amazing, they always make a perfect over-medium egg, and their breakfast potatoes are to die for. If you're there for a weekend, get the donut platter. You won't regret it.

This is quite the snazzy little bar tucked away in the International House Hotel.  It's a favorite of traveling professionals, local businessmen-types, and New Orleanians hoping to sneak away from a more "upscale" bar experience.

The bar is very dim, illuminated by candlelight and there's a fair amount of cushy velvety sofas and intimate tables.  This is a perfect place for impressing your date or wooing your client since it's pretty darn sophisticated.  And quiet.  Yes . . . far away from the mayhem of Bourbon Street, thank your lucky stars.  

The service is impeccable and the cocktails have always been pretty darn tasty.  If you get a little woozy with the delicious cocktails, the bar does offer a little snack mix, which is nice.

Queen used to be great but I went recently and I was very disappointed Pedicure with no foot or leg massage...manicure took about 10 minutes so no cuticle cutting or hand massage. If you are in a rush, go here- they do a quick job but just not quality :(

If Atlantis is a beautiful lost underwater paradise, then the Motor Lodge is the decaying shipwreck right next to it.  I booked my trip using Mobissimo, and was redirected to a German hotel website  (and could not cancel later due to them only being open M-F) where a room at this 3.5 star resort could be had for about $109.  Since it was a spontaneous trip, this rate seemed reasonable to me, given the comparable rates from Silver Legacy and Peppermill.  

We arrived late and checked out a show at the Eldorado, then came back to regroup and drop our bags at the hotel with the premise of going out later to continue the evening.  However, the walk to this Sinatra-era backwoods location at the other side of the parking lot quickly killed our spirits.

Take every cliche from every generic off the Interstate motel you've stayed at, and you have this place.  If I were a truck driver hauling corn thousands of miles and needed a place to crash, this would be fine, but not for the rate we paid in this city.  The decor, pillows and mattresses felt like they've been recycled since Ted and Maude Okie rented a room here to go see Bobby Darin live.  

My memory is fresh, as I'm in the actual room now, and am continually reminded of its inadequacy.  Such as when I went to go plug in my laptop, I could hear the walls shake and the TV rattle as I walked.  This is not to mention that the walls are about as hollow as the deceptive marketing Atlantis used to get me here.

My advice to them is this: sure, you might have a 3.5 or maybe even a 4 star hotel, but allowing people to book for the motor lodge using sites such as travelocity, expedia, or wherever, when they don't know what they'ere getting into is bad business.  Just putting a guest services directory and a $11.95 movie option in a motel room does not magically make it up to par.  

On the plus side, the bathroom was clean, with newly replaced faucets and showerhead.

EDIT:  After looking around, it appears that some sites do in fact call it the motor lodge.  However, the site I booked from did not.  However, my point remains that the economy class accomodations here should not be considered to be nearly the same star rating.

So, now that I've finally visited Gordon's I'm hooked. I've been several times now & will likely keep being a repeat customer. They have so many flavors & combinations! It's not just milkshakes either. Other options are pictured in my photo.

Really good poke bowls at this place.  Its quick in and out and they have all the poke options you could want. Good location in downtown St. Pete.

I've been to Charlie's twice in the last few weeks and am happy to say that it's  trending up with me in a big way. On my first visit, I got fries and a roast pork sandwich (with sharp provolone and broccoli rabe, of course). At least on that day, they were fine, certainly enjoyable...but nothing that wowed me. The pork sandwich just lacked some element of the juicy, garlicy flavor wallop of the best ones I've had.

But I was there again over the weekend and this time sampled two different beef-based sandwiches. Charlie's might have named itself after their pork sandwich, but they really excel at making cheesesteaks and roast beef sandwiches! I split one of each with a friend, and we agreed that the roast beef (with the same fixings as I mentioned above for the roast pork) and the cheesesteak with provolone and long hots were exceptional, especially the latter. The roll was excellent - seeded and substantial, but not excessive or hard; perfect, really. And the same was true of the cheesesteak in general - the meat was good quality, the long hots (which I'm pretty sure had been chopped up rather than lain across the sandwich whole) lent a pleasant, relatively mild heat to the proceedings, and they both worked like a charm with the provolone (and I usually am a whiz guy!). The roast beef was great, too; I'd never had a hot roast beef sandwich given the Philly Roast Pork Italian treatment, but after this one I can't believe it took me so long. 

My overwhelming enjoyment of the two beef sandwiches made me an instant fan and makes me want to revisit the restaurant's namesake, but I have a hard time seeing myself ordering anything other than another of those brilliant cheesesteaks ("The Official") next time I go. I'm curious about their pizza now, too.

Besides the perfect view, amazing food, they know hospitality! We went there 4/10/21. I thought I had a res. for husbands birthday through open table app but it didn't save. Realized this on our way. Spoke to the hostess about what happened and she found me a table right away. Then came Abby our super server. She is perfectly attentive, funny, a menu expert and a total delight. As I am pretty sure all the servers here a trained in this flawless service any of them will be great but ask for her if you can! She really made our experience uncommonly wonderful!

Starbucks coffee is a staple in my morning routine and this practice doesn't change just because I happen to be in an airport when the JOE bird calls.

I picked up my morning nectar with NO wait.  Yes, not a soul in front of me, which is usually unheard of.  I grabbed my joe and headed directly to my boarding gate.

Staff was friendly and efficient.

Prices were higher than the non-airport kiosks, but that's to be expected.

So happy I tried this place! Had to be the best to-go order I've ever placed. I ordered the Bella's Famous Chop Salad and the Pera Sachet Pasta and let me tell you neither dishes disappointed! The flavor profile that fresh pasta I had was nothing like I've ever tasted! The saffron cream sauce mixed with pancetta and peas was the perfect combination! I couldn't stop eating it! The salad was delish too but I can't wait to go back and try some other pasta dishes because this place here has the best pasta in Tampa! The salad was packed with toppings and the Dijon dressing was very tangy and tasted great! Definitely looking forward to visiting Bella's Italian cafe again!

We went today for dinner after reading so many good reviews. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming. I would give 5 starts but the staffs didn't wear mask during this sensitive time. 
We decided to order the most popular dishes based on reviews. 
Scallop Carpacio: MUST!!! SO DELISHhhhh. Very delightful with citrus and pepper touch, creamy and melted in your mouth. 
Salmon skin salad: I order this dish at every sushi places but this place gets the best decoration. Portion is huge for $6. Great appetizer. Flavor is great but decoration makes it extra delicious.
Surf and turf: ok y'all needs to order this roll. I did medium rare for steak and it was so good. Ingredients are well combined. Great decoration again.
Filet mignon roll: wow!!! Meat is tender, juicy, so creamy  Must try dishes here.
Squid steak is fair, not impressive but not bad either. It's because i had the best squid steak so I have more expectations for it.

And In Conclusion....
After an hour of trying to decide where to a late dinner, and stopping by regular restuarant after regular restuarant, I'm glad to have found this place on Yelp. 
Live jazz played until 11pm, with a lounge that takes you back to the 40's, this was a great place to end 5 days in New Orleans. 
The food was the quality I'd expect for the price, and the service was great. 
I highly recommend the experience over your typical restaurant.
When we arrived for lunch the place was pretty busy.The cashier Glenn,was very friendly,and knowledgeable.Are service was great we got our food fast.It was a great experience.

I was really anticipating eating here after the 5 star reviews so my granddaughter and i went for late lunch about 2 p.m.  To say the food was mediocre would be an accolade.......obviously people who have eaten here have little to no dining experience for falafel and gyros at any other restaurant in the metro area........tasteless food and dismissive service.......try instead Hummus and More, Byblos, 1000 Figs or Monas...please as this does not qualify as acceptable Mediterranean food or cuisine.

This is my favorite place to eat in St Louis. The Shaved Duck has a much more diverse menu than most other BBQ places in the city and the food is always amazing! This place is a bit of a hidden gem tucked away in a neighborhood. When you walk in the place feels like an inviting pub and they even sometimes have live music. The staff is always great and attentive to whatever I need. The food itself is delicious! You have to get the smothered fries. They are covered in pulled pork and two kinds of cheese! The wings and traditional BBQ items are also very good, in addition to their sides. Do yourself a favor and go here!

Awesome location (right down the street of my house) and great idea for Cass St. Love the concept of having more than one vendor inside so guests have different items to choose from. I got the chicken salad sandwhich on white bread and a side of french fries. Best chicken salad I have had in the Tampa Bay area! Homemade, fresh and delicious. I am from the North East, the home of real delis, and this place reminded me like I was back at home!

Came her for dinner our first night in town and it surpassed all expectations! 

Parking is directly across the street. You have to pay, but it isn't expensive at all, like $7. We arrived fairly early, so it was pretty empty -- just one guy at the bar. We were seated in a room directly next to the bar. It was the perfect place to host a small gathering at the restaurant with friends or family. As the meal progressed, more and more parties began to show up. 

The waiter was absolutely amazing. I'm not sure if he doubled as the the waiter and bar tender to begin the night, but he was great. Everything was delicious and came out in a timely manner. The drinks were strong enough to creep up on you if you weren't careful lol, which was perfect. 

Overall, we were very pleased with Más Tequila Cantina as our first dining experience in St. Louis. If we're ever visiting or passing through, this place has my vote!

I received a spa finder gift card and decided to treat myself to a pedicure after a very stressful week. These guys were able to get me in and took me back on time. Overall, the experience was not relaxing and the staff seemed very disorganized. They also had very little choice for colors of nail polish. It got the job done, but was disappointing, overall.

Very clean and appealing location, staff is great.
Pancakes, syrup and bacon are highlights.  Disappointed that scrambled eggs didn't seem made to order and arrived cold.
Fresh OJ is killer.

Definitely a go-to  brunch place. Such an eclectic yet cozy atmosphere. I typically don't go for big meals here but when I do, I always have the black bean burrito.
Most of the times, it's just drinks and apps (somewhere in the realm of guacamole and salsa).

Not only does this place have spectacular food, but great customer service as well! I went in here today and ordered ribs, but heard they were out, which was fine, so I ordered the pulled pork. I got to talking to an employee later and mentioned this to him jokingly, and he went and got a coupon for free ribs for the next time that I was here! I was so happy that I could have cried!

My my my, this place is just too sweet. Located right off the busy corridor between lake side mall and fat city there's so many spots to pick a great bite. This cute and cozy spot offers parking lot but off street is also highly likely since the plaza parking lot sometimes gets overwhelmingly crowded a lot.  

Once you get your nice spot and walk right in the goods are right in front of you! The choices and and endless variety is all up front. Their cute pastries, buns, and also hot foods menu is right when you walk in. 

There is some space for dining but not to worry they're  practicing the socially distance of 6ft. 

Greeted warmly my eyes straight away went to the display case and I couldn't help but buy more than a couple treats for myself. The staff professional and friendly and took the time to explain what they offer and how to order. 

I went went the rainbow crepe slice, taro cake slice, and their chiffon fruit cake! 
Rainbow crepe cake- flaky, creamy, a little bit on the denser side  I didn't know what flavor to expect but I should have gotten a specific flavor, the rector is really wild. Like stacks of mini pancakes and creme. 

Taro slice cake- very light, not too sweet, and you can def taste the earthy smooth texture of the taro itself. The cake light fluffy the creme so good.

The fruit chiffon cake- MUST TRY. The fruits are refreshing, cake itself fluffy and airy, not too sweet but the perfect balance.

Best gel manicure I've ever received! (I've had a lot.. dip too!) I came in at 4pm on Christmas Eve and honestly wasn't expecting them to be open, let alone provide such great service. Kevin took his time and made sure each nail was perfect! I don't know why I've never come here before but rest assured, I will be back and recommend all my Clearwater friends!

Heard so much about this place that I needed to check it out.   Was surprised not to see a line after all I have heard.     Wow, were we disappointed.   First of all, I didn't expect cafeteria style service.  Guess I should have read the reviews first!    Food is good, but nothing special.   Staff serving the food were not very pleasant although waitstaff who seated us and served the table were extremely nice.    Ordered the smothered pork steak which was good, but not hot.  Fried catfish was tasty, mac and cheese was good, but corn bread was just alright.

They do good work, but they charge a fortune.  I had two light switches installed which I supplied, and it costs $178 for 20 minutes of labor.  That's roughly over $500 per HOUR.  

I'm sure there are less expensive electricians out there, so beware!

To the management.  You are correct.  I was not referring to Monday's work, but rather the 20 minutes of labor on Tuesday for replacing 2 light switches.   The bill was for $178.00.  

Please advise is this is your normal billable rate.
This place is a joke you go to dinner at 630 they are out of everything not just the bar drinks the food as well no cornbread good grief

We went in three twice, trying to find out information regarding saunas. The salesperson was never there - just a poor gal at the register trying to run the place on her own. After three messages, the salesperson (weeks later) FINALLY got back to us with a quote, and still called my husband by the wrong name. They also claim that retail for set up and delivery is $995.00, then discount it for you. Good Grief!

A good bit more than I like to spend, but thanks to Groupon, we gave it a try.
I had Veal Marsala. I think the wine sauce could have been cooked down a bit more. I don't drink wine, but I like food cooked with wine. This dish was a bit boozy tasting, but not intolerably so. I had the creamed spinach for a side and it was very tasty.
My wife had the Filet Douglas. It was a huge filet, cooked to medium rare perfection with a decadent cream sauce on top and a small portion of lobster. I don't care for lobster but my wife loved it. I do enjoy a great steak and I have to say this might be the best filet I have ever tasted. 
Based on the unbelievably good filet, I give Kemoll's a 5 star rating. As soon as we got home, we bought another Groupon. I look forward to going back for a filet of my own.

Great steak and even better drinks. We got a burger and steak. Our bartender said they get the beef fresh everyday, love to see it. Drinks are strong, food only took maybe 10-15mins max. Our soda was watered down but the Red Turtle saved the day. Happens. What a meal. Reminds me of the laid back Florida keys bars. Definitely coming back to try the rest of the drinks out

Whenever I visit Tennessee I try to get as much O'Charley's in as possible since it's what I always had with friends in high school. So it's lucky for me that there's an O'Charley's in the Nashville airport. I've been a few times and it's always just pretty standard. Employees seemed like they were ready to go home on my last visit. It was past 7pm but they didn't close until 8pm. By the time I was seated and a server came by I didn't think I'd have enough time to order and eat before my flight so I asked if I could order to go. I was told to go to the front to do that. Minor inconvenience since I was already seated for a while but it was fine.

I ordered a couple appetizers to go and had them both boxed and ready within 15 minutes (probably closer to 10). Make sure to ask for extra napkins if you do this and plan to eat on the plane! It's not always the best service here, but the food is pretty much the same since it's a chain.

I ordered 3 tacos , Aguari , ace high, & longrider . They claim the are #1 taco in the south east! 
I will start by at the end of my order I told him I would like to add a soda she said I would have to wait pay for this one and then she'll bring me up for a soda after but I never even gave her my card yet so I don't think she knew what she was doing I also got an A Austinite taco rather than the Ace high I ordered! As far as presentation three tacos rather small especially considering the price per taco nearly $4 bucks a taco!
The Austinite was soggy messy and a little slimy, it didn't stand out I have had carne asada at numerous taco places and this one was by far are the bottom of the list! The Longrider which was sitting next to the Austinite fell victim to the Soggy sloppy Mass that was the Austinite! Once I got past that the tuna itself was good the taco had nice flavor but nothing that I will crave! The Aguari the steak was good juicy and tender with a nice crust but only 4 small diced pieces, in other words the steak really only covered half of the taco in the tacos are small to begin with. Buy a Longshot Taco Tuesday at Cicco Cali on Bloomingdale is much better all around ! Unfortunately I can't even put them ahead of Jimmy Hula's on 60 in Brandon let alone the best taco in the Southeast or one of the best or the best in Tampa they're not even on the same page they got one star for a decent variety they really should have an Americano maybe one taco with ground beef just a basic taco although it's not authentic I get it have a stuff on your menu was not authentic so one ground beef taco won't hurt! For what you serve you really have to change the price or have a value of three or four tacos something because three tacos 12 bucks is a little rich for three small tacos!!!! The other star was the food came out quick very short way and you were fairly busy however it lacked the quality when it came out also it was a juicy sloppy mess. With that being said the flavor was maybe 4  star out of 10. Saying you have one of the best in the Southeast you better bring it and y'all didn't bring it you didn't bring it on flavor presentation price or value. I also can add that I ordered a street corn that was barely thrown on a flat top ... I counter 12 kernels that actually we're grilled. So on top of it being pricey sloppy mess they can't grill corn ither...PS paying attention to detail is key I'll let Rich know! Untill then to I'll stick with La Ville , Jimmy Hula's Tijuana Flats that food truck trailer on the corner of Lithia Pinecrest and 60 Ciccio Cali, fuzzys ,chipole ,Qdoba!

Oh my - I found this bakery on Yelp and because of the reviews here, decided to try it out.  My intention was to buy some cupcakes for my mother-in-laws birthday dinner.  Once I got there, I saw the cakes.  I was in such a dilemma as to what to buy because EVERYTHING looked awesome, I ended up buying 2 cakes because I would have just gotten older before finally making up my mind.  Then I topped it off with some baguettes for good measure.  Well the bread and cakes were a hit!  I try hard not to partake but these cakes were just so beautiful and the reviews were so good that I hade to try it all.  And I was not disappointed!  One of the cakes was a buttery cake with strawberry buttercream inside and the other my favorite of chocolate with buttercream.  Both were the moistest cakes I've ever eaten and the buttercream was light and buttery that just paired so well!  I ate a piece of both unable to resist.  The bread was crunchy and just perfect!  I will be visiting again and again - next trip will be for cupcakes but I'll need to decide which of the 15 varieties to buy before I go or else I'll be bringing them all home!

Another 5 star rating for KitzMo! 

Last time I tried a new sushi place (Sushi 7) I ended up desperately sick, so when I suggested we try KitzMo my boyfriend was surprised. Funnily enough, KitzMo is located at Sushi 7's old location on the corner of Kietzke and Moana which is where the name KitzMo comes from. 

First of all, the place was close to empty so we were seated immediately by a really sweet hostess who kept our drinks refilled tirelessly. 

Second, I have never encountered a more friendly staff in all of my all you can eat experiences. Jason was our chef and he joked around and chatted with us about the restaurant and where he was from. Steven, the chef in training, makes great edamame beans and was also smiling and joking with us.

The rolls are really great. they are small with not too much rice and Jason will happily customize rolls for you which is great.  

They are completely family owned which is awesome because everyone is so friendly and the atmosphere is relaxed and fun. I think it's safe to say I have a new favorite sushi place!

Initial review:
Never been to Santa Barbara so since we're here, me and my hubby wanted to order delivery for our first night here. I ordered a 16 inch pesto pizza with a few added toppings (see picture below) and an order of cheesy chicken pasta. After tax, tip, and delivery cost, the total cost ended up being about $45 for two items. And when the food arrived, my pizza is cold, hardly any pesto sauce, and it's mostly burnt. And the pasta arrived with no utensils to eat the pasta. Really wanted to love this food but I'm not excited about it at all 

Updated review: 
the owner personally contacted me and rectified the situation. And the staff in the restaurant were very kind and accommodating. Happily changing my original review from 2 stars to 5 stars because at the end of the day, this place could've just let the review stand and not tried to make things right. But they did and the next time I come to Santa Barbara, we'll definitely be back

Frankie and his crew did a great job painting the outside of our house, dealing with the difficult environment as we entered social isolation for COVID-19. They were professional and considerate at all times and the house looks really good. Wishing the team well in this crazy time.

Awesome place and a hidden gem centrally located in Chinatown. Family friendly, lots of seating for dine-in, free parking in the back and buffet ready for 5pm, including endless Naan. There are also takeout options.

You have to stop by for what makes this place special within the Edmonton Indian fare options. Just ask your server about their specialties and enjoy the service level as it is unbelievable. Thanks for a consistent 5 star experience Namaste!

I say I been going here since I was young and form what I know Hong Kong market have a lot of more item that other Asian store... and i come here for the duck and pig. And I love it, the banh mi is off the chains, compare to other Asian store I been going

They were more interested in their phones than getting us a drink. Also the managers wife and screaming kids being fed with the rest of the staff rolling their eyes were the kiss of death for us. Go to the end of the block and hit the District. Classy and attentive.
Did not get any sleep with the noisy AC unit. Front desk was suppose to send someone to check it, never did.

Environment was definitely nice and clean as we sat outdoors. We watched homeless get into a scuffle but since they were drunk, they were comical. Entertaining indeed. 
They have a huge variety of alcohol but for sure, this is not where those homeless drunk fellows went cuz this place was expensive.
This place has a little tease of Vietnam my wife and I would highly recommend this place. Looking forward to coming back and trying something different.
Ate at the hub for my anniversary. Food was absolutely great and the ice cream and sorbet delish. Highly recommend!
Called 4 times to setup and an appointment...No one answered. A receptionist would help.

My God, these tacos were amazing. I walked in randomly on a Sunday afternoon, ordered and was out in less than 10 minutes. There's a small bar and a few tables, along with a nice patio. For reference, it's right next to the Dam. 

I tried the queso tacos, essentially fried tacos with oozing cheese and your choice of meat. I ordered two w/ some Mexi fries but could only eat one. Service was top notch and I'm looking forward to going again.

Wow! One of the best vegan restaurants I have ever been to! 

The Nachos are a perfect appetizer for a a group of four, it's a large portion! The nachos also has an option to add avocado or make it fajita style. I also really love the spinach and artichoke dip. My favorite bowl is the OG beans and greens bowl, which has garlicky kale (amazing), pinto beans, and brown rice, but can substitute quinoa. I always ask for their cashew Parmesan to top off my bowl. The chipotle and black bean burrito is delicious. It has chipotle seitan, black beans, all the veggies, and vegan cheese and sour cream with a side of black bean corn salsa and tortilla chips. The French Quarter Dip is a nice sandwich with portobello mushrooms, seitan, asked for no cheese, and a side of hummus and chips. 

There is so many more options on their menu! I can't wait to come back and try another delicious vegan dish!

I've been coming to this location for the past couple years. The employees here are consistently rude and unfriendly. I did on the go ordering and picked the drive thru option so I could get my drink and be on my way. I drove past the speaker and pulled right up to the window. The woman looked dumbfounded when I said "on the go ordering for (insert my full name here)." She didn't say a word to me. She pulled my ticket that was on the printer and made my order while I was there. The whole point of on the go ordering is for the order to be made BEFORE the customer arrives. She handed me the drink without a smile, without an apology, and without a thank you have a great day. It's a shame because Dunkin has really good coffee and food, but consistently choose to hire employees who have no business being in the customer service industry. I will not solicit a Dunkin location that makes me feel like I'm burdening their employees just because I ordered a coffee. I won't be returning to this location, and will drive farther to the Collegeville location where I haven't had a negative experience at yet.

Visited last week for lunch, there were 4 of us and we ordered 2 x 16" pizzas, one margherita  and the other with pepperoni. The pizzas arrived within about 10 minutes and were delicious! The margherita was the best I ever had, You could taste the olive oil , and garlic , fresh basil  just the perfect amount of Pizza :)
The pizza chef is a true professional. My sons enjoyed watching him spin the pizza in the air.  This place reminds me of the old mom&pops pizzerias of yester-year.
I highly recommend to all.

Love the food, the drinks and the location, however here is the thing - you can't go here. There is NEVER anywhere to sit. There are not enough tables. There is a massive open floor space and they could easily DOUBLE the seating. I have been there maybe ten times, the last five, I had to leave because there is simply NEVER anywhere to sit. People who take up a four-top with a laptop for HOURS are just lame. Move on people. Go to the library. Rent an office. I fear that these campers will put this place out of business with their selfish desire to do their taxes for three hours while paying patrons like me are turned away in droves.  I suggest adding a bunch of two-tops or a set of singles anywhere in that large open space, or in the front near the window. Love you guys, and miss going there. I have given up.

I love this restaurant! A little slow sometimes as far as waiting on food to come out, but the taste makes up for it! Super sweet staff, great views, amazing food! Crab cakes are my favorite!! Definitely one of Hendersonville's hidden gems!!

Aimée first had me tell her about my hair and what I wanted out of my haircut. I felt like she really listened and talked me through everything she was doing. I am never happy with change and usually get upset about my haircut even if it's a good one, but I was happy with my hair before she even styled it. She didn't get scissor happy and take off too much and she was thorough and professional, but still fun.

When I waked in I wasn't greeted, just looked at. I told them what I wanted and still just looks...finally got in a chair and he just started filing my nails once I sat down. I said I wanted the manicure and he said "next time" uhh ok.. he rushed through and then said "$15" that's the extent of conversation. It was fast but you can tell. The nails look ok but could have been better. It's right down the road from my house, but I'll continue to look to find a place. I won't be back.

Wow! Just wow! Skip the "Hill" in St. Louis!  And skip the Italian chain restaurants!  This place has incredible service and even better food!  Off the menu Lasagna and the Salmon Rigatoni! Incredible!  Wish I had taken pictures!! Delicious food! You won't be disappointed!! Old school charm! Romantic! Loved it!!

Would not recommend as a place for a large group. I had a group of 20 on a Sunday evening, and even though reservation was made more than a week before, service was horrible. Had to hunt down a waitress to take orders from us one hour after the reservation time, and then beg to get our checks at the end. Waitresses stopped by not even once in 3 hours to check up on us. I tipped how much I thought the servers worked for (actually, I thought I was being generous with what I tipped given how little they did), only to face a waitress confronting me at the end with the elusive "was everything okay? because we live on tips". LOL. COME ON. I had asked for tables conducive for socializing and even though there were tables in a corner area perfect for the purpose, I was instead given a looong linear table in the middle of the restaurant. Given the perfect location and views they have going on for them, I think they would do sooo much better if they hired the right people to attend on clients. *end of vent*

Rating this restaurant with 5 stars is a total no-brainer.  The food is fresh, delicate, and perhaps has crack in it because I've wanted to go back there every day since my lunch visit.

OK, let's get something straight.  This is not some trendy, swanky, jazz-playing creperie.  Quite the opposite, in fact.  This place is charming, quaint, and simple.  The walls are decorated with personal keepsakes and antiques, not blown-up posters or French sayings.  Think of it more as your grandma's restaurant.  If you do that, you'll be delighted by the atmosphere.

People have complained about the servers speaking French.  Really?  Seriously?  In my opinion, it only adds to the experience (and isn't that what dining out is all about?).  Unfortunately, I think these ladies may have read these reviews because they spoke little French during my visit.  Too bad, really, I was looking forward to it.

The food was downright scrumptious.  If you're craving crepes, this is the place to go.  Look no further.  We ordered two crepes during our visit--the lemon squeeze and a custom crepe I requested (because I can be difficult sometimes).  The lemon squeeze has lemon juice, butter, and sugar on it.  It was slightly tart, sweet, and had a bit of a crispy texture.  So good (and only $4!).  My custom crepe contained strawberries, bananas, chocolate, and whipped cream.  So, so tasty.  It was so good, in fact, that I would only let my husband have one bite.

Husband loved his turkey/cheese/avo sandwich on a French baguette.  He couldn't get over how soft the bread was.  (I tasted it--He wasn't lying!)

Oh, how I wish this creperie was local to me.  Instead, I have the over-the-top trendy swankster.  So unoriginal!

So this Was a disappointment like no other. I've been to Texas, north Carolina, South Carolina, Florida and all over the world for barbecue but this was the definition of a tourist trap. They barely wanted to cut out a new piece of meat because there wasn't a long lineup. Yes they have six great sauces to choose from but the meat might as well be cock meat. Fucking awful but great location!!
This is the best turkey, bacon, avocado sandwich in Nashville. And I mean best. And I mean Nashville.

Such a cool building!! So neat, all the dark wood, the balcony, the brewery vats, so respectfully awesome. We lucked out having this place three doors down from our hotel (French Market Inn) and I must say, the beers are excellent they brew and just seriously,the seafood cheesecake sounds so weird but holy smokes...it was super good and rich. Share it, definitely. It isn't that huge, but the flavors are. Just an Excellent one of a kind creation. The crab cake was equally superb even though we both voted we like did like the crab cake slightly more. Probably more so because I swear, people in AZ don't know how to make a crab cake, this all killer, no filler...so much crab, so rich and the fried green tomato just tied it all together with that apple slaw and made for such a cohesive, flavorful, rich meal. 

Excellent...five stars :)

Not a swimming beach, and be careful about high tide. However... sunsets from here are amazing, and the views during the day are simply world class. I've gone here for lunch breaks, breakfast walks, sunset, everything. It's just incredible. I've watched whales, dolphins, etc from the steps. Seriously- very very beautiful. Just go and have a walk. You'll be happy you did. You'll leave relaxed.

Made 2 trips due to quality over our 2 day visit to Santa Barbara. 
I'm from the east coast and spent the majority of youth summers in New England so I know high quality seafood and SB Shellfish is at the top of the game. 
Seating for about 40 inside and they have 5 tables to sit 4 adults and possibly squeeze in 2 small kids as well. 
Peel and eat shrimp were as fresh as it gets, clam chowder bread bowl is awesome, scallops pasta and onion rings very tasty and perfectly made. 
The view off the wharf looking southwest to the SB boat harbor and the vast Pacific are added bonuses.

Apple cider = yum.
Fish and chips = not bad.  The fish could've been seasoned a bit more but the fries were awesome.

Great service!
The salon is very dirty, dingy. The whole place is a banged up mess. Run a mop along the floor every once in a while! Light bulbs are out or flickering. The workers are rude.

I came here with a large group for a bachelorette party and had a great time! Thank god I ubered because I had a couple of drinks and would not of been able to drive because the drinks were strong! 

somehow I ordered three things which doesn't seem like much but it was:
pork cheeks with grilled squash, english peas & spring onions $12
macaroni & cheese casserole
chicken & andouille gumbo $8

First off, I want to say that I am well aware that this is a chain. However, I once went through a series of job interviews here and I personally know that they hold very high standards for both their servers and their employees in the kitchen.

This was my first time at this location in quite a few months. I arrived with two friends at approximately 10:00 pm, two hours before the kitchen closes, and waited seven minutes to be acknowledged. I actually had to get the attention of the bartender, who made eye contact with me twice before I decided to speak up. I politely asked if I should be seating myself;  she apologized and told me to wait a little longer, as she was getting someone "right on that." 

The server appeared and sat us without introducing herself, disappearing again after tossing us menus and not offering us drinks. I immediately didn't like her sour attitude. When she finally returned after a few minutes, I asked to be seated where my friends and I could view the televised football game. Obviously annoyed, she asked for the menus back and said: "Well, I only have a high top or this seat right here," pointing to a booth directly under the television. We chose the booth, as it was more secluded than the exposed high top awkwardly in the middle of the bar section. 

We ordered our food around 10:15, and the meals came out at 10:39. It was a little longer wait than I anticipated, as the restaurant was not very crowded, but I remained patient. My boyfriend and I both ordered a cheeseburger, and my other friend ordered the Jack Daniels Chicken. When the food finally came out, it was tasty, but the nameless waitress still had a bad attitude. She slammed down drinks every time one of us asked for a refill and didn't smile. Really. She didn't smile. Not once. 

The food was great, but I really value good customer service. If I'm going out to pay for food on a special occasion and I have to tip, please at least smile and act like you want to be working your job. News flash: working is a privilege, not a right! You should appreciate your customers, not make them feel unwelcome. Get your act together, Friday's!

Spare the flight to Italy and walk right upstairs while doing your grocery shopping at DiBruno Bros!! Absolutely love the new restaurant on chestnut street. A hidden gem! Hasn't officially opened yet but it will be a hotspot in town as soon as it's released to the public! Waiter was so wonderful as he was extremely knowledgable about the menu and offered some great recommendations!!
