Our food was made with the most fresh and authentic ingredients available in all of Philadelphia! Good Italian food made with lots of love! Love how they carry some local beverages! I've been looking all around town for the 2 robbers seltzer that's made here in Philly! To my surprise I was able to find it here and it paired wonderfully with my meal! We started with the salmon avocado bruschetta, a small plate that set the tone just right! We continued with the Rittenhouse... Arugula, a heaping serving of prosciutto that was so flavorful and a creamy tasty burrata. We finished with a slice of the burrata pizza that was perfectly crunchy! Love the thinner crust that goes well with lots of toppings to create a unique pie! Will definitely be coming back here often! Also love how they carry the authentic Gelato from the wonderful Italian restaurant next door! A great lunch or dinner spot. Great for a date or with a group of people! Take a comfy seat in the lounge and enjoy a drink or sit in the dining room and indulge!

Went here with a party of 9.  Stuffed mushroom appetizer was pretty bad, salad they give you is average.  The eggplant rollups were good! Figured for dinner a classic shrimp fra diavlo would be great, until the shrimp were rubber and SO overcooked. I ate one and didn't eat any others. Pasta sauce was like water and barely held on my pasta. SO disappointing.  My cousin got the rigatoni bolognese, which was very good.

A great airline it has cheap fares and my flight was great. My flight attendant Jannette was so funny! It was a great experience and I will fly this airline again. If you want a cheap but great experience then I recommend it all the way.

We went here before a friend's birthday and were very promptly served. It was a cute little place and it was very accommodating for us! Our waiter was very attentive and even recommended us a good wine to pair with our meals!

Seafood Ravioli- Off menu
This dish was wonderful and had a great combination of lobster, shrimp, and scallops. The sauce was a little thick and slightly too salty for my pallet. The noodles were also a little thick and over cooked as noodles were breaking off my fork. But the filling was outstanding. It makes up for the rest because it was a delight, the meat was not overly salty and had the perfect mixture of seafood.

The quality of service this "business" provides deserves less than a one star review. My husband brought his phone in there to have his screen replaced, this service was supposed to take one day. They called at the end of day one to inform my husband that they shattered the back of phone while replacing the front. They wanted to hold his phone for another 2 days or so while they ordered the back part. Due to the phone being flexible (from the back being shattered) the newly repaired front screen cracked again without being dropped. Now this joke of a business wants another $160 to repair what they broke. The biggest issue is their management and customer service skills. They refuse to accept responsibility for their actions. Mistakes happen, but own up to your mistakes and make it right. That's the bottom line. They refused to issue a refund. I have already disputed charges through my credit card company and will leave this review on every site possible to warn other potential customers.

Brunchies is an modern, upscale brunch restaurant along the lines of KeKe's and a few others. Creative menus and new food ideas offer specialties beyond the basic eggs, bacon, and omelets menu.

As a fan of pancakes, I couldn't resist the blueberry pancake offer from Brunchies. Although not exactly a unique offering, the pancakes were huge! And, excellent. 

Service here is very attentive. The decor is a little dated, now that some new entries in the upscale brunch arena are sporting granite tables and subdued lighting, but looks aren't everything.

Went for happy hour apps. Ordered the corn dog pops, smoked chicken nachos, and brussel sprouts.  Corn dogs and Brussels were awesome! Chicken nachos though were really dry; Would not order those again. Service was great. Three apps and one drink each was still $40 and those metal bar stools they have are really uncomfortable.

Very happy with my experience at Jules Thin Crust pizza. I have been putting off trying their type of slice mainly due to typically craving a basic cheese pizza. Finally one night my husband and I decided we each wanted a different flavor of toppings so we decided it was time to give them a try. 

We called in our order and was told it would take 10-15 minutes. We got the Veggie #7 and Veggie #14. My husband is a sucker for the mushrooms and I was happy with the poblano sour cream sauce because I enjoy tangy. We were both very happy with our choices. Plentiful amount of toppings especially because it is not cheap pizza. 

If you have no time for thin crusts than do not come here. It is like eating a cracker with pizza toppings and that is something I do like. I would recommend either one of the veggie options we tried. If you really like subtle spiciness and a white pizza then definitely get #7. We went in exactly 10 minutes and it was ready to go and piping hot. We each got a mini size but it was plenty. It's equivalent to about 2 slices of regular pizza.

Definitely the best tacos in Nashville - the freshest ingredients and the best pricing combine to make an experience that's hard to beat. Bring cash and buy the sweet potato tacos and the elote (street corn). Their tacos' tortillas are small but loaded and flavorful, and I have had nothing but excellent experiences.

I've been here the past three years (and can't wait to come back this August & September.) Seafood - delicious. Drinks - delicious. Outdoor space - amazing. We sat indoors once and I hated it (not for any reason except I missed out on the open air/breeze.) 

I just felt like dropping in & leaving my Seabreeze Island Grill love - I hope I get to go to the luau on 08/17.

A great find!

Randomly picked Xiandu as something different before our show at the Walnut St Theater. We were not disappointed. 

I usually only get Pad Thai at Thai restaurants, and asked our waiter for help picking out something else. He suggested the Massaman Curry, and it was out of this world. My husband had the Sen Mee Tom Yum noodle soup, which he loved as well. We also got the Fried Calamari - I did not like the Mango Lime sauce, but there was another sauce that came with it that was really good. Our waiter was very attentive, constantly refilling our water and asking if we needed anything. 

My only complaint would be that the bathrooms seemed like an afterthought, and although this isn't the most important thing, it made a poor impression before I left. The toilet seat was broken, the cleaning products were all over the floor. It would be fairly cheap and easy for them to have invested in a cabinet under the sink. This isn't a reflection of the wonderful food or service, just left a bad impression after the restaurant was so sharp looking and well kept.

We'd definitely come back.
Music is always amazing .. gumbo not so much!  Perfect jazz bar with some of the city's finest!

Better Life Maids and Nma and team equal a terrific cleaning service! Everything is spotless and attention to detail was superb. The team was fast and efficient, plus none of the cleaning products smelled like chemicals.

My wife has been going to this place which is now called Ace's Beauty since it was just a kiosk. It has been a storefront for awhile now. The last time we went we got there a little before 10:00 (when they open) and the woman sauntered up at 10:20 with shopping bags to open up. There were several women waiting by this time. The worker here didn't apologize for being late, didn't wish anyone a good morning and actually didn't say a word as she put away her shopping bags. The wife says the people working here used to be friendly and seemed to care about their work but that has fallen by the wayside and now the workers are unfriendly to the point that she has decided not to come to this place anymore. My wife has always been a big tipper, tipping $5 here on a $10 service. This last trip she tipped $3 and felt like it was $3 too much. Such a shame, this business is letting their workers run off their long time customers with their being so unfriendly it borders on hostility.

The pizza here was good, the price for a pitcher of beer ($7, even on big event nights) was even better.  I found the staff to be very friendly each of the three times we were here, and I though the crust was particularly good.  There was always a diverse mix of people here and outdoor patio was a big hit.  The pizza might not be worth making a detour for, but if you are walking to or from the Superdome and you want some solid pizza and cheap beer this is your place.

So after getting into NO late...we were famished. After reading reviews about this place we decided it was the place to try. Our server was great but the food was less than exciting. My sons catfish came out flimsy and had no taste. The seafood had no taste and the best thing about the experience was my martini. And the gumbo was the highlight of the meal so I will increase my rating to 2.5
Building is beautiful. Food is average at best. Nothing extremely unique or "New Orleans", except some omlettes with sea food. I had poor service, but they were very busy with a tour group.

Without exaggeration, one of the worst bars I've ever been to in my life. 

I went there toward the end of a night with some friends, and just wanted to have a water. The bartender said that they don't pour free waters, and pointed to a fridge with ridiculously priced bottled waters that I could purchase. This, on top of (1) having a cover charge, (2) having a card charge minimum, (3) overcharging for drinks, and (4) having the unadvertised policy of automatically adding gratuity.  Really, the last one is the most offensive of all, because the bartenders have no incentive to treat you well. 

Also, the place is full of messy drunk people and they play terrible music. In a city like New Orleans, where there are a zillion better options, I don't know how this place is still in business.
This place was amazing! Excellent service and super fun staff! Thanks for a super fun time!

Using a phone taken from this store's inventory, an unauthorized line was opened on my account. Over a month later, that line is still active and I haven't been refunded the costs. This is unacceptable.

Ray's has been around forever, and it's a no-frills kind of place.  They open at 7:30 am - and I suggest going on a week day - because weekends are packed and it will take awhile.  I've gotten 2 sets of 4 tires twice over the years, and paid under $200 each time and that includes installation.  I've never had a problem, and they have always been honest and forthright with me.  They don't try and sell me something I don't need like the other places around town.

I ate dinner here last night with my boyfriend. The dinner was awesome! The drinks were great! And Justin our server was soo nice and incredibly knowledgable!! I could not have had a better experience
Employees were all wearing masks either hanging on the side or with their nose uncovered. No wipes or sanitizers. The parking lot look like mayhem. Just awful. A true petty dish.

I went in there and had cisco do my hair I wanted a angled Bob I have about 5inches cut off my hair the Bob is nothing what I wanted my Back is two different   length and my front are to different sizes so uneven I hate now I has to go thru the grow out stage or go to another stylist to try and fix it so disappointed

Loved this place.  Great music, cozy venue (reserved seats were nice) - only about 30 reserved seats in the whole place.  Band was fun, really seemed to love what they were doing.  Be if the highlights of our trip to New Orleans.

Ordered to go during quarantine.

I ordered the Sushi Nachos, which are thin slices of seared tuna & escolar on top of a crispy wonton crackers. Comes with  avocado topped with hook's pico de gallo, a drizzle of eel sauce & spicy mayo, and sesame seeds.

I also ordered the Krab Rangoon, which is krab, cream cheese, broccoli, wrapped in egg roll paper and fried. These were amazing! Different from other crab Rangoon's I've had and very good! 

Additionally, I ordered the First Love roll, which is eel, cream cheese, avocado, and salmon on top with hook's eel sauce. Very good and fresh!

Walking around Media & discovered this super cute shop! They sell homemade items, all types of unique things you wouldn't see in other shops. They have the Mancala game & a mini chess game, throw rugs, china, and so much more!! There's even a small section with different types of chocolates (including organic). There's a scroll where you write "the best advice given to you by a woman". So many inspiring & positive message throughout the paper to look through. Some items are VERY expensive, including the throw rugs. Very unique & cultural.
As a newbie to Cajun food I will say that this place was great. Had the Boudin Ball that were delicious with a little heat. Next was the crab boil. OMG I could really get addicted to this.

I love this place! The owner is amazing as well! They have 7 kitchens with different themes. Tonight I had a Poke Island Bowl with Organic Chicken, topped off with caviar! Then a fried cornbread with maple syrup. To end the night, a masala chai thai tea! Next time I will try the Mexican bowl!

I had dinner here.  No complaints on the service.  Food was excellent.  Everyone found something they liked.  I am normally a meat eater, but went veggie with no complaints at this place!  My wife had the trout poor boy, and the trout was cooked to perfection and not greasy.  

Nice outdoor seating in a very new "walkable outdoor mall mixed use development."  Drove all the way from Eagle to try it, and I would go again.  Nice area to walk around before/after dinner.  Accessible from bike trails in the area.
Best pizza in reno at a great price. I love the garlic chicken Alfredo and the meat meat and more meat. They deliver too! and our delivery guy Gauge was fast and nice!

Always enjoy a meal at Tavolinos!  While loud, the ambience is fun and hip-you always run into people you know here.  Service is generally very good.  I had the grilled octopus appetizer and a beer salad.  Both were very good, although the octopus was a little shy on the octopus.  My husband's steak was cooked medium rare to perfection.  Our friend enjoyed his cioppino as well!

Everyone's heard of canteen for brunch but it's not as well known for dinner and that makes no sense to me because it's sooooo great! Our server Karen was amazing as always. And we loved the meal. The apple cinnamon cake is a perfect fall dessert.

We had an early morning weekend appointment and waited while our car was tinted. Rosemary was really helpful in deciding which tint to go with, and overall was really friendly, professional, and helpful. The customer service at this place is hard to beat, and the adorable dog is an awesome bonus.

It's honestly really hard for me to give this place less than 5 stars because the customer service is so good, so I waited a few weeks before reviewing so I could be more objective. The reality is that the tint job we got was not very good. I've never used another place in Tampa, so I can't compare there, but I've had several cars tinted before elsewhere and never had the same issues. 

So the job was this: remove the tint from a 2010 Civic, add a new tint. I know it's an older car and isn't going to be treated with the same care as a new car in many cases, but I can really only judge on my own experience. When we initially got our the back, there were a lot of issues with the quality of the tint, and there was glue residue and chunks of tint all over the inside of the car. The person who did the tint came out and looked at the car and honestly didn't seem very happy that we had issues, and attributed to the issues to his guy who was newer having messed up. But they were happy to schedule a day to redo the parts that were messed up, which I really appreciate.

That day I took the car home and spent over and hour trying to clean up the car. The residue was all over the doors, and it still remains. I scrubbed and scrubbed, used three different types of cleaners, nothing worked. When we went back to get the bad parts of the tint redone, they tried to remove it too and couldn't. So there are permanent stains on my doors. Since I'm not a car person and my car is older, I'm relatively okay with it, but it sucks to spend hundreds of dollars to end up with permanent stains on your car. They said it happened during the tint removal, which was a separate fee, and there was no offer of refunding that or anything. Had this been a newer car I probably would have wanted at least a partial refund, which they don't do, so I definitely would not get a newer car done here. Weeks/months later I am still finding random little pieces of tint in my car. I really feel that when you're paying hundreds of dollars, even if your car is older, some level of care should be taken.

In addition to that, the radio in our car no longer works when the rear defroster is on. This seems to be a relatively common issue when getting tints done, but worth mentioning as I didn't know this until it happened to my car.

I do see that I'm in the minority in my experience. I believe this is at least partially because most people are going in to do a new tint and not to remove an old one.

Again, their customer service is great. Had the job itself gone more smoothly, this would definitely be a 5 star place. But overall, I sadly couldn't recommend this place to a friend due to all the issues with the tint removal and tinting, the cleanup time I had to put in, and the permanent stains on my car.

Just had another delicious meal. The chicken and waffles are the best in town! In fact, there were five tables seated when we got there and I saw two other orders of chicken and waffles. The fried chicken is also delicious on the fried chicken salad. My son devoured the tri-tip torta. Good beer selection and the beer price is notated on each of the taps - genius!

I guess there is no better alternative than la around, so apparently there is no other places I could switch. But. Just want to let you know few things about la fitness, so your experience will be better than mine.

1. If you want to cancel membership - make sure they really cancel it. What happened to me - la kept charging me for next 3 months after I request cancellation.
2. If you wish to freeze your membership, talk to few people. Make sure you will get right information. I wanted to freeze so talked to a guy on reception desk in 1 month before I wanted to freeze. He said no no, you have to do it before you leave, come on monday-friday 9-5. But call before you come. I did so and guess what, they said I should do it in advance because of billing period. 

Good luck!
Run of the mill American pub grub. Not my go to place for eats but it is fine for business team lunch. The staff is always friendly and the place is clean.

I stopped by here yesterday and ordered a cheesesteak. Their bread is on point. Perfectly baked. I liked the ratio of meat to cheese sauce. I should have been more creative and added fixings. I really like the atmosphere of this place. It's definitely a true corner store. I want to come back soon and try one of their breakfast sandwiches that everyone is raving about!

Joe's Crab Shack use to be one of my favorite restaurants. I was disappointed that the  menu had changed because they are under new management. The new owner is Landry's which we are members, and we love their restaurants. However, changing the drinks and seafood steam-pots wasn't a good idea! 

We left our Landry card at home and at other restaurants we are able to give our phone number and they add our points. I have done this in various States and Resturant's. However, this location wouldn't allow it citing they did not have the capability and just became part of Landry's. They told us to call and get our membership number then call them back. It would have been nice to have the points, but the runaround wasn't worth it. 

This was my second time visiting this location. My first time was Summer 2017 and the menu hadn't changed. This location sits on the River Walk in Wilmington, Delaware. It has a nice view of the river and people walking the river walk. It is relaxing and we always sit out on the patio.  

Overall, it was a good experience but I wish the manager would have found a way to resolve adding our points. Perhaps by calling Landry's and helping us while we were there. Good customer service goes a long way!

This place was a bummer because I had heard good things from my family, so since my experience was not that great, I had planned to come at another point in time. But after I had to do the server's job, who I found out was the owner Susan, I was annoyed. We were the only table, but she never came around even though wine and water were empty, had to stop her from leaving to ask for specials, appetizers, entrees, refills and dessert. She was super nice, but obviously has not been trained as a server, maybe she should hire one for weekdays. I asked for the check, waited for a time, and when she came back, literally said she was dealing with a catering order and forgot about us. She figuratively said, I took your credit card, then gave the only other table their food, and sat down and forgot about you. Thanks. On the food side, the date appetizer was amazing! But the pork and chicken were dry, cheesecake was gritty with a mushy crust. Sad that had the service been decent, I would have given this place so many more tries.

Ordered $70 worth of terrible fajitas and stale chips.  Never again!  Couldn't believe the under cooked vegetables and over cooked, tough meat and chicken.  Absolutely the worst fajitas we've ever had.

2nd time eating here....  first time Italian beef was pretty good. Service was good and personable, food took a long time but we had time. 3.5 stars. 

2nd time - .25 stars. a group of us go in Sunday afternoon. Only group there. As opposed to first time Service is marginal, slow, and unpersonable.  Start to order and are informed that they do not have Italian beef or any of the rolls that all of the sandwiches are served on. Order a "chicken parm" sandwich and opt for it in a pita. After 25 min the chicken fingers are waaay overdone, fries are cold and multiple orders were wrong. At the end, owner could barely make a fake apology. Won't be going back. Hope the owner gets a chance to manage the next restaurant that goes in the space.

Very tasty food at very reasonable prices.  Warm, friendly atmosphere, and sanitary to boot, even with a dog-friendly outer patio.  Waitstaff was very prompt, courteous and sharp.  British nostalgia decorates the interior and exterior, yet stops short of tackiness.  

Great place for a contemporary date or business luncheon!

I love this little place. It's all the way at the end of 10th street, and nothing fancy. But the women behind the counter are always smiling and helpful; and they sell the most delicious moon cakes. I first tried these desserts in Shanghai, and literally spent years trying to find them again here in the states.  Was so happy to come across this bakery. They don't have a huge selection of other pastries, but what they do have is yummy! Nice smoothies, too!

Chris was our server at the Oceano, and he was very outgoing and happy to be there. The peppermill never disappoints with server hospitality. He always refilled our drinks before they were empty, always checked up on us, and made out experience way above average.

Kind of surprised to see that I haven't reviewed Bee since I work in the same building as the shop downtown (in the Pan Am building). There is a Starbucks across the street, so when I ask myself what I want in a cup of coffee I work through the following pros/cons to decide between the two:

Pros for Bee:
1) the coffee is freshly roasted and freshly brewed
2) the person making your coffee cares about you and your cup of coffee 
3) it's in my building so if it's raining/freezing outside I don't have to leave 

Cons for Bee:
1) if they don't have drip coffee ready (like in the afternoon), it will take at least 10 minutes for them to make you a pour over. It is a science experiment, because they insist on making a perfect cup of joe. 
2) the costs can be quite high if they don't have drip coffee ready 

Overall I split my time between Starbucks and Bee. If you've never been you should go. If for no other reason, the staff is very pleasant. If you're in a pinch they also serve some breakfast and lunch items, but I've never given them a try.

A great place for the weekend date nights or business dinner...

Quality of Food: 10/10 (Steak Diavola and Lobster tail are prepared with a perfection including exquisite caviar, tangy salads and tasty turtle soup - we asked a chef to make somethin' special - after 7 courses later, you'll be satisfied)

Presentation: 8/10 (Standard upscale American flavor)

Service: 10 / 10 (Ridiculously attentive and pleasant, yet making you feel comfortable)

Ambiance: 9 / 10 (A bit too traditional steak house feel but very classy at the same time)

Price: 10 / 10 (Great Great price for what you're getting from A to Z at Tony's)

Parking: 9 / 10 (Valet service - don't know about the self parking?)

Intangibles: A great value for 4.5 star restaurant if you like a traditional steak house or classic American cuisine for food, wines and service.

Delicious vegan breakfast!

Came here at 1pm on a Saturday afternoon and sat at their counter. I ordered their Tofu Scramble with the signature potatoes. The tofu scramble was so flavorful! The scramble was flavored with curry and lemon. I absolutely loved it. Honestly one of the best tofu scrambles I've ever had. The signature potatoes were also super satisfying. I loved how the potatoes were cooked with peppers and onions as well. 

Service was excellent and our food came out very fast. I'll definitely be back!

Being from New England, it's been hard to find a good pizza place even slightly comparable to the pie from back home! My boyfriend and I popped into this little pizza place one day doing errands and saw that the Monday specials was $10 for large cheese if you dine in. The staff was very friendly and it was decorated much like any other pizza takeout place. Our pizza was hot and at our table about 10-15 minutes after we placed the order and even for being just cheese it was SO good. They had the usual Parmesan cheese, red pepper flakes, garlic powder, salt and black pepper available at each table. The pizza was a good size for a large with 8 big slices and it was cooked perfectly, crispy but not burnt. 

We saw a few other things on the menu we'd love to try next time but we'll be coming back to get more pizza for sure! It's a little hole in the wall in a plaza but it's worth a stop in to get some great Italian food!

An excellent fine dining experience.

Everything we tried was great. Definitely recommend the crab beignets. My wife had the lobster gnocchi and I had a steak. Both perfectly cooked.

Excellent service throughout dinner from recommendations on wine and dessert to friendliness overall.

Best dessert I have ever had..and I have had a lot (painful to admit) bread pudding creme brulee on cheesecake.  They have combined three desserts and made a super dessert.

Went there last night. It was the WORST  it should not take 25 minutes to get your food. Only ordered 2 soft tacos and a bean burrito. How hard is that??? They have really clean trays though. That's all the one worker was doing. REALLY????

Bagel breakfast sandwiches are good, but if you're into sweets you have to try one of the croissant donuts. It's so delicious that I didn't want it to end so I definitely took my time to savor the last couple bites haha. I'll definitely be back!
I loved it! The chips and salsa started off the meal great, and the fajitas were VERY tasty. I'll be back!

'No Green Peppers Please'

Three months ago, I read reviews, scanned the menu, stared at the downloaded photos... shuffled me feet, and finally grabbed my phone and placed an order. Amidst the 'mmmms' and 'yummm', and, 'I can't believe how good this is', it occurred to me that I should take photos. But, I didn't want to stop eating and considered it could just be a fluke. 

Since that time I have ordered either Delivery or Takeout about 8-9 more times. I've called in during busy hours, evenings, and both Monday and Tuesday's afternoons (usually the worst time to order Asian food). What has surprised me is how consistently delicious the meals have been. Not always 5 star perfect, but never lower than 4 stars.

Absolutely every time I've called, the person assisting me has been helpful and pleasant. And, every delivery/take out has been steaming hot, tasted freshly made with quality ingredients!!!!

I had intended to write one sentence, 'SERIOUSLY PEOPLE...ORDER/EAT HERE!!'. However, I changed my mind after recalling how not once have they slapped down something easy. From order to delivery and all the bites in between my experience with Golden House has been satisfying and excellent. Even the delivery guy is awesome. They give abundant portions at a very reasonable price!!

I can't recall all of the menu items we have enjoyed nor can I choose my favorite. We eat meat, but I prefer all protein to be surrounded (up and down and all around) with fresh veggies, and they always come through. The beef dishes are made with slices of tender lean cuts, never fatty or gristly. The chicken has always been perfectly cooked, tender slices of white meat. The pork has been moist lean slices. And my favorite are the shrimp dishes, always loaded with luscious large shrimp, always perfectly cooked, always yummy. 

All of the different Beef, Chicken, Shrimp, and Pork items are loaded with both the protein and vegetables. At their low price point, I do not know how they can do this and I don't want to ask!!!

Under Vegetable dishes I love the Chinese Vegetables with Black Mushroom and the Stirred Fried Chinese Greens. I plan to try others but these two dishes are so delicious, I didn't want to not order them. 

Their Fresh Tofu Skins with Chinese Greens is also tasty. Oh and I'm obsessed with their Vegetable Egg Foo Young, never saw where's it's at on the menu, but Oh My...it's my new happy food. Also enjoy their Vegetable Lo Mein, one time it was a little dry, all the other times it was excellent.

The War Won-Ton Soup??? YES! Just Yes! Chicken Won-Ton? Yes Please. Both are loaded with crispy fresh veggies and delicious wonton bundles of joy. I usually love Hot and Sour soup, haven't tried theirs yet, which is weird for me. But, I've been stuck on those Won-Tons!

If you like appetizers try the Meat Combo!!!!!!!!!!!!! We ordered this once, and each of the items were perfectly delicious, crunchy, but not greasy. I love their Crab Puffs, guessing they don't contain real crab, and I don't care. Man those things are good. The Egg Rolls in the Meat combo were one of the best I've had. The Vegetable Egg Rolls are smaller, more like a spring roll. We've ordered these several times, one time they were 'okay', but all the other times they were crispy and tasty. 

Some of the specific meat dishes we've enjoyed are, Thai Shrimp (on the sweet side, but we like it), Curry Three Delight, Almond Chicken, Mongolian Beef, BEEF W/TRIPLE MUSHROOM, Shrimp with Lobster Sauce (hubby wasn't impressed but I liked it), SHRIMP CHOP SUEY. And several others, but these have been my favorites. 

We have never ordered from Menu with the Lunch or House Specials. Because we are remodeling our kitchen/house, I always order enough for a couple of meals, thus the reason we could try so many options multiple times!  Hooray for me!!

I could literally eat their food for every meal, a few times my husband has opted for something else. I consider those meals as my loving sacrifice :)
Awful customer service, our drive thru server was Andie C. Waited in line for 10 min. for a hot dog and grilled cheese. Felt very disrespected and u wanted as a customer.

Don't waste your time. Little girl at the register was sweet but had NO idea how to make a Cafe Con leche. Which should be a pre requisite to work in a "Cuban" place, no? Another girl making sandwiches at the grill press had her VERY LONG curly hair in barely a pony tail hanging down her chest all while ON HER CELL PHONE while she made our sandwiches. Bathroom had a ceiling leak and paper towels on the floor.  OH! and ive attached a picture of the "hot sauce" bottles.. that havent been cleaned in... ??? -- Best thing about our experience? The bread was crispy.

  Won't be back. Sorry Floridian!

Just finished the Jean Laffitte swamp tour, and came here for the biggest pop boys ever. Had the oysters,alligator,  an d soft shell crab, all outstanding. Each could have fed 2+ people. Local joint, great food

We used to go to the one in the south loop of Chicago all the time but the food became subpar. Decided to try this one for nostalgia. Nice new big interior, crowded but not terrible. The front hostess told us 30 min wait so we sat at bar but then I got the text our table was ready ( surprised they were this wrong w the estimate). Service was ok- our bartender was good but could tell he was busy. The loaded fries were good but buffalo wings with hardly any sauce and the blue cheese was like congealed into a hard cheese ball.

Love this salon!  They just moved and are now called Salon 724.  This is the best salon I have ever been to. Everyone is friendly and professional and I love my hair every time--I've never had to many compliments.  I see Amy---HIGHLY recommend her to all. She's efficient, colors my hair and cuts it perfectly---every single time!

I also get my products there--they have sales a lot, 20% off etc.
LOVE this place!  It is exactly my kind of place.  Unusual food that you would never find anywhere else. Very reasonable.  Just had an amazing meal there.  Lovely staff, too.  Courtney is fabulous.

FANTASTIC experience, only reason for 4 stars is that the service center isn't amazing and kinda pricey.  

After a horrendous experience at Suntrup Pre Owned center (see review), these guys made it right, and got me into a quality car for a great price.  From the initial call about the car to the final drive away, I was extremely impressed.  This process did take a little while but it was mostly due to financing issues that were caused by the other dealership.  They took in the lemon of the vehicle I bought from the other location and didn't extend the price negotiation.  My wife and I will buy all of our future cars from there (I wish all dealerships realized this when young people buy cars), and I would suggest if you're looking for a Volvo, check them out.

FYI, they may be listed as Suntrup on some sites, but that is only due to sharing advertising revenue.  These guys hate the other non volvo Suntrup dealerships as that family is apparently pretty screwed up.  I love my 2007 S60, and can attribute a lot of my satisfaction to the process through which I got it.

The food at Maria's was great until they converted to a partial pizza takeout place. The menu has since been drastically cut and quality has dropped. It's a shame, too, because certain meals (homemade gnocchi, chicken cutlet) were amazing.

I have been wanting to try this place out for a while and my overall experience was just okay. We went for lunch and got $5 apps because it was a Wednesday so that was good. The cheese dip was very very good. I would definitely recommend it. We also ordered the toasted ravioli which was just alright. For lunch I ordered a grilled chicken house salad so I understand that it's hard to do a lot with that. Nothing bad happened but this place didn't blow me out of the water. It gets 4 stars because the food was okay, the place was clean, and the service was pretty good. I think I would enjoy the experience more if I went back for dinner and sat in the dining room.

We had guests staying at our vacation rental and their daughter and her friend were harassed by the bouncer and the one girl had to pay $20 to get her ID back.
Dont think thats legal?

They have moved the truck and now located at Da Bine Brewery 993 Florida Ave, Palm Harbor, FL 34683.  We came and got the Cinna-beast on Sunday.  It's a cinnamon bun with beef brisket, bacon, 2 eggs, cheese.  Omg !  $11 and we split it.  Highly recommend.  Everything was cooked to perfection.  Had a couple of drafts and started the Sunday off right!
This place is HORRIBLE. Guy at the drive through was so rude to me and yelled at me to order. The other time I went there was no beef in my taco, only lettuce. Will NEVER return

So Curbside Takeout is a bust. No parking for curbside. Oh no. I'm late picking up my order dictates by the website. That's ok. They have met even started it yet so I wait another 15 minutes. Poor service is an understatement.

This is an excellent place to stay with kids. We got a 2 bedroom suite with kitchen and living room and it was great. Very comfortable. Not only was the room functional as a home away from home, but it was also tastefully decorated with nice quality finishes. Big plus too for the awesome bedding. 

Two downsides were the free WiFi and the free breakfast. The WiFi quality was absolutely terrible. After waiting for page after page to load, I ran a speed test and it showed 0.5 megs and 0.33 megs respectively. It was so slow in fact that I could not send email with attachments, play a short YouTube video or upload photos. When I asked the desk about it, they basically had no answer and told me it is what it is. Here's a tip; just disable your WiFi and use your mobile network. It will save you a lot of aggravation.

As far as the breakfast goes, yes it was free, but the quality was absurdly poor. Everything was either old/stale/mush or full of artificial flavors, colors, and preservatives. For example, their fruit plate looked like it was sitting uncovered in the fridge a good 3 or 4 days. The eggs were tasteless slop. The "Light and Fit" blueberry yogurt had artificial colors and sweetener in it. The cottage cheese and cream cheese had controversial preservatives like TBHQ in them. The Wolfgang Puck coffee was absolutely undrinkable with the primary notes being pennies, stale bread, and inexplicable Diaper Genie funk. Tip # 2, there's a Starbucks 2 minutes from the hotel.

Anyway, horrendous breakfast and unworkable WiFi aside I would definitely stay here again because the rooms were so good. Second to none in this class of hotel. Recommended despite the issues.

Amazing burger! Best burger I have ever had in my life! My new favorite! Super small joint with some outdoor seating 
If u blink you'll miss it! Can't say enough of our great experience!  A must on your burger list!
This was the dirtiest Walmart I have ever been to. Very unorganized and rude self checkout attendant.

Ok, credit where credit is due. Were it not for Yelp, I never would have found this tasty place. So, thank you Yelp universe.

Yes, it's in a very old strip mall, around the corner from the main drag (U.S. 41). You have to know it's there. But the minute you see all the cars, you know it's a word-of-mouth sensation. I was there around noon on a Sunday and the joint was jumping. It's small inside, about 12 tables and a few booths-with beautiful murals on every wall. The thick chips and both red and green salsas came right away. My server was so sweet and attentive, despite the busy room. She was on it! It took me awhile to decide, because they really do have a lot of options. I finally went with green enchiladas. I chose cheese-and doubled up on the rice instead of beans. Wow! The green sauce! I think the word yum was invented for it. So, so, so good-it walked the fine line of spice and nice beautifully. The rice was so good-moist, not crumbly-or overdone or too tomato'y.

Nothing on tap or in a fountain here-beer and juices in bottles-soda in cans. I believe the margarita is wine-based. I'll come back and double check!
Great place to eat! I've never been disappointed and the sandwiches are always done right! I love going here.

Too loud ( crappy, trite classic rock ). Too expensive. Too long a wait ( when there was not much of a crowd even during noon hour ). No outside waste receptacle. 

Shoulda gone to Fuddruckers.

After calling ahead, I brought my car for an oil change. Said it would be an hour or hour fifteen. It's been 2 hours and I just checked. They haven't even started on the car. I guess I should have taken it elsewhere.
Okay place.  Staff could have been friendlier and more organized.  Staff behind the bar were nice and the most friendlier and inviting.

Local place with a great Mexican Lager (Salida Del Sol). Slight hop to start with strong malty finish. Was so good I didn't order anything else!

Lunch specials until 3PM. Got the half salad/Basic B Mac and Cheese but upgraded to pulled pork Mac and Cheese. 

Upgrade got me shredded (light smoke, slightly sweet, extremely tender), red onions (raw, "rustic" slices), diced jalapeño (finely diced), with a broiled cheese topping (could be a little more crisp).

Noodles were al dente, cheese sauce was a good base with the right consistency, but took a back seat to the bbq sauce on the pork.

Follow my lead and upgrade yo Mac and Cheese!

Add a pint for $3.50? Yes please!

Will definitely come back next time I'm in town. Avoid my mistake.  Skip the salad and double down on the Mac and Cheese if you request crisper red onions and cheese topping. Oh and a just a little bit more jalapeño (I like it a little spicier).

Salad wasn't bad, only complaint is carrots were too finely diced. Bottom of the bowl was all carrots too small to be picked up with a fork.

Why four star? Food is great and have always been good. They are good for groups. They can always accommodate big groups. The only downside is that when they get busy they tend to forget the other costumers that they have but you just have to get there attention to get service. One of the best chines food place Tampa has to offer. During the busy days and time you just to wait for a while to get seated. But they are always quick to get everyone seated. I love there fried calamari one of the best in Tampa I guessed because of the combination of the spicy flavor and the freshness of the squid makes it different. 

Location is not that awesome and have hard time finding parking when it busy. But if your looking for a great food with cheaper price then this fits for your needs.

Donkey's is always a home run choice. I'll sit at the bar, order seven to go, and a Guinness while I'm waiting. Come home, give the neighbor one, then the two kids, their significants, and the wife and I enjoy the nice taste of what I only can only assume as heaven. "Mm, mm, it's so good".

I was new to vaping and tired of hunting down and then paying an arm and a leg for a certain large name brand disposable pod and wanted something easy, reusable, and cost effective. The gal who helped me was super friendly, helpful, and patient. I highly recommend this shop and will be making it my go to stop for juice and supplies.

Was really pleased with dinner at this newish spot on south street. It was a beautiful evening and we were able to sit outside. I love that this area is now full of healthy quality options to grab a quick meal. I had the Cobb salad, it was full of all the typical ingredients and topped with a tasty white balsamic dressing. He had the burger, topped with cheddar and bacon, according to him it was perfectly cooked and the fries were pretty amazing too. Our server was super friendly and accommodating when we changed our order from to go, to eat in, to eat at the table outside. I only have two comments- 1. My salad was a decent size but it was served overflowing in a shallow bowl, it was really hard to cut up the chicken and I think I left at least a few bites of lettuce on our table trying to mix it all up 2. The owners kid was outside being a pain and standing in front of the door blocking people from coming and going and it was a little annoying while we were trying to eat (not to mention he was by himself and I was afraid he was going to get kidnapped or run in front of a car on south st). That isn't enough to keep me away, I am looking forward to trying breakfast sometime.

My man went out to run some errands on Friday and came home with a box of empanadas from a Jezabel's pop-up. We received two each of four different kinds and the box came with three side sauces/pickled veggies. 

We heated up half the box for lunch on Saturday, but everything was so delicious that we decided to heat the rest and go all in! My favorites were the chicken with olives and beef with raisins, but the empanada with leeks was great, too. I especially loved the chimichurri sauce - I could eat that with everything! Looking forward to more empanadas in my future!

It is hard to find magic on a Wednesday, but if you go to the right place with the right company (and order the right bottle), it can be done.

I found magic at Mica.  From the amuse bouche that was a play off of peanut butter and jelly to the last course, there was something special happening.  We went for Chestnut Hill's restaurant month and the prix fixe menu was pretty amazing, we didn't feel the need to stray.  

I started with the tuna crudo, which was fresh and light.  We did try a few things off their regular menu like their 6 hour sweet potato.  If this is what happens when you cook dishes for 6 hours, then I think all root vegetables are going to need to up their baking time.  It was the best dish of the night.  For the main, I had the chicken confit and it was perfectly cooked with crispy skin.  I am not sure it is on their regular menu, but it should be.  For dessert, a light but indulgent custard with cardamon and coffee crumble.  

The maestro of the magical evening was our waiter, who was attentive and had a great personality.  He definitely helped make the evening perfect.

The only negative observation I have is that each dish came with micro greens - from start, all the way to dessert.  I understand that micro greens have a place, but not with every dish. It is such a small thing to notice I suppose and as you can see from my rating, it doesn't really affect things.  That observation aside, I can see why people are now trekking out to Chestnut Hill for one of the best dining experiences around.
Pizza is tasty, garlic knots to die for and exceptionally friendly staff and service.  We are from out of town and ended up eating here two days in a row.

I just moved here from Washington DC and This is a great addition for West Chester!  Heck, this place would be great in DC!  A wonderful menu that's a combination of sushi and Thai, both of which are tasty. The staff was very efficient without hanging over us and they were very friendly and warm as well. We were a party of four and all got sushi for appetizers and then Thai for main courses. I will be getting sushi for my main course next time bc what I had as an app was amazing.  Can't wait to go back.

Went on Chinese New Year festivities were really spectacular with two lion dancers . Family style Chinese Food wowed all in my family.  Unfortunately our server was greatly overwhelmed with the number of tables he had. Understandably this was a huge night for the restaurant so I'm not going to knock the restaurant too hard for this one server.  Our drinks were forgotten (tea, beer) and waters sat empty for a long time until I begged a server in another section to refill . He never checked in on the food, not until we were ready for a box. We received the wrong fried rice but under the circumstances I wasn't going to send it back for another one!
We loved the salt and pepper shrimp , sesame chicken, fried rice. Shrimp dumplings were delicious. The kids loved everything , we will be back to try dim sum soon!

We came here after a rough day and had the greatest server ever, Ceasar. Ceased made the experience 5 star for sure!!! We had the Italian Trio, Spaghetti and Meatballs, and the farfalle and it was all 8/10. I hope everyone who comes here gets the amazing service we did!
Food was good.. servicer was nice.. food took.a little while but home cooked.  They have a map to plot where you are from. All and all a little hole in the wall with good southern cooking.
This place came recommended from a friend, but after going with my coworkers for lunch one day I won't be going back. The service was fine but the food itself was mediocre across the board, at best.

Service is amazing oysters delicious our mains not so much. Gumbo was watery and lacked flavor. Blackened chicken was rubbery texture very unappealing. Salad Greens were fresh and green beans were great.

Worst hotel trip ever! In three days not a single person cleaned any of our rooms. It was over Thanksgiving, no clean towels or sheets. Can't wait to go home to feel clean again! We will never stay here again.

So many better places to go for Pan-Asian. Came here for dinner....was (as usual) rushed. We ordered 5 things and they came out within 10 minutes of ordering. That's fine for fast food...but we are supposed to spend some time at a a restaurant in this price range. Impression is...they want you in and out as soon as possible and they want to turn the table. For the price, go to Chinatown and you can get interesting takes on Asian food for a fraction of the price and not be rushed out of the restaurant.As with many Schulson restaurants they had multiple servers/ vultures standing around trying to swipe up your plates the minute they sensed you might be done. honestly, the entire feeling was " can we get you in and out of here within a nanosecond"?" They would do better to focus on the overall experience and less on the transaction.

This place is the real deal.  Outstanding steak tartar started our experience followed by fresh oysters and chicken meatballs.  For dinner we had the Dover Sole for 2 and the dry aged strip steak both just great.  Don't miss the cauliflower side.  The snap peas were just OK but the kale salad delivered as expected.  Owner Matt stopped by, thanked us and chatted a bit, a nice touch.  We sat in the back but felt that the front bar would have been more fun.  Nice layout and decor.

A year ago I said the same thing about this location and what do you know..... I STILL STAND BY WHAT I SAID!!!! THIS LOCATION HIRES THE WORST EMPLOYEES AND THE MANAGERS ARE BEYOND RUDE. It starts from top to bottom, the employees will not give great customer service if the managers don't enforce it. Smh

Stopped in Sunday afternoon for a to-go order to watch Blues Hockey at home. Bartender was friendly and I ordered the BBQ Flatbread. Chicken, Bacon bits, BBQ sauce, and french fries on top. Smelled delicious tasted of the cardboard box used as the to-go box. Puzzles me why places wont lay a piece of waxed paper,parchment, butcher paper...whatever to halt the taste of cardboard box. Come on you can do better.

I called them on Monday, 8/1/16, to get a quote on a large order for a pizza party I was throwing for my 9 year old campers. They gave me the best price in town so I thought I was good to go and even told other counselors from my camp to order from them for their parties. They told me to wait until the day before the party (which was that thursday) before placing my order of seven large pizzas and 2 sodas. I call them on Wednesday, 8/3/16, and place my order. I inform them on the phone that the order has to be at my camp by 11:20am because the kids only have 40 minutes to eat, and the lady on the phone assured me this would be no problem.
The next day, I called them to confirm my order and the time, and was assured yet again that it would be there at or before 11:20. 11:20 rolls around and its not there. So I call them and politely make sure they have the correct location and that its on the way, and I'm told that the delivery person just walked out the door and would be there in 5 minutes. 15 minutes later, still no pizza to be found. I call again and I'm told yet again that they "just left" and it would be there "any minute". At 11:50 (thirty minutes after I was promised my order) my campers are STARVING and have now missed most of their lunch time. I call them again and I'm told the exact same thing I was told previously. They just left and will be there any minute. Keep in mind my camp is at Rowan University, a 3 minute drive from their restaurant. Little did the person I spoke to know, but at the restaurant was another counselor from my camp who saw the struggle I was having and decided to pick up his order for his party that was an hour after mine. This counselor informs me that my order is still in the restaurant, now forty minutes after I was first told that it had "just left". 
At this point, my campers have lost their entire lunch time. Luckily, the director of my camp was able to let us extend our party due to the circumstances (which displaced two other scheduled parties). My order finally arrived at 12:15. The driver tried to lie and say she was lost on campus since 11:20 (which I know is a lie because my order was still at the restaurant at 12) and that she called me (which I know is a lie because my phone did not ring, had no missed calls, and no voicemails).
I am furious that my campers had to wait almost an entire hour for their food, missing their whole lunch time. I am furious that I told others to order from them, giving them more business. I am furious that I was not offered a refund, full or partial. I will never order from this place again, and I highly encourage others not to as well.

*review is for Sonoran Spa only * 

I was invited here by my mom to join her for her prescheduled facial & mani/pedi  service. I walked in without an appointment and the friendly receptionist fit me in for a mani/pedi (with their on-call manicurist) at the same time as my mom. The vibe at this spa is very zen, very peaceful with low lighting and calming music in the waiting area and dressing room. The nail room is brighter and not as quiet, as expected. Great service and friendly staff. Prices are moderate, not like the more upscale resorts in the area. Manicure and pedicure were pretty good, so I'd most likely return.

Was told break job would only be and hour and a half at 11:00.  Now it's 2:00 and still hasn't been touched and the best part is that it cost me $475 just for the back breaks. And it was just one other person at the store when I arrived.  Very disappointed. Do not recommend. ‍

I had to stop by and try the famous Crumbs that is so often mentioned on Yelp in the form of "this cupcake was good but it's no Crumbs," and my experience was pretty mixed.

The good: Moist, fluffy cake. Tons of flavors to choose from. Icing is just the right amount for the cake.

The not-so-good: Huge (sorry, I like my cupcakes to be a single serving). Icing is drenched in sprinkles or nuts or whatever so there's too much texture going on. Flavors didn't pop.

The WTF: I got a Peanut Butter & Jelly and was told it was filled with strawberry preserves. There was literally A bite of said preserves, which out of approximately 100 bites of cupcake is a pretty sorry ratio. Also the PB icing had ZERO flavor. Sad face.

The bottom line: If someone brought me a Crumbs cupcake, I would probably eat it and not throw it across the room. But if I'm buying, I'm going to keep my money in the local Philly cupcakeries that wow me.

Price is always a factor for the consumer. That said, just because something is inexpensive does not mean it is good.  Cheap means cheap.  However, at the end of our meal here, I was more than pleasantly surprised when I received the check for two Sunday afternoon buffets under $18.  With tax it was still under $20, and the $5 tip was worth it as well.

It felt good to enter the warm, dry venue from the winter rains.  The aromatics wafted forward and made me think of great restaurants of the past.  How good could this place be?  The buffet was in full swing, rare for a weekend.  Both meat and vegetarian options were on display, as well as a full array of chutneys and other condiments.  The friend onion pakoras was delightful in their texture and toothsomeness, their flavor very well met.  Chicken in tandoor sauce was a marvelous mix of smooth and savory, with the rice being a proper basmati type.  Onion chutney was at once both spicy-assertive and bitter, being a perfect foil for the rich sauces.  Kheer and fruit for desert rounded out a marvelous afternoon feast.

Service was solicitous, down to earth and never cloying.  A great place to enjoy!

Will never visit this restaurant again. I visited Desi Tadka today. I ordered Dal soup, chana masala and 1 Tandoor roti.
Here is the frustrating timeline, he took 5 minutes to give me water, then 10-15 minutes for Dal soup and next 20 minutes for Chana masala and Roti. In the same time, there were 3 customers together they gave order of 3-4 dishes and then after 5-10 minutes new 2 customers came and ordered couple of dishes. Both of the customers got their dishes and where almost half done eating.
I asked the Waiter why my dish (which was just one dish) took so much of time, he reasoned he orders as per customers come in. I told him i don't want to eat now as the order is too late. He charged me FULL for the order. 

The reason I am giving 1 star is not because of the taste, which I dint get to taste except the dal soup but because of the attitude of the waiter and lack of respect to customers time. The Waiter himself said that the orders come as per customers give their orders and when I asked him then how come the new customer got their orders ahead of me he started giving excuses that he don't know somehow something in Kitchen went wrong. I told him that then it is your mistake and not mine that the order is late and you still charged me for it (even when I have not touched the dished)

Restaurants should not think that customers have whole time in the world to wait for the order. If they cannot respect customers time then they better should close the shop.
Food was average. Ambience is poor. Staff is untrained and not professional. Hope food quality remains consistent. Will definitely try again.

Be careful. Our server scammed us. First, he overcharged us from the start. Then, he "forgot" one of our items and, when we asked for it, he tried to charge us for it again. When we started adding all of our items up, we realized he charged us too much even if he did add the "forgotten item". He argued with us about it, too. I won't go there again. I'll just go to Cafe Du Monde. It's better anyway.

Ordered breakfast from here and was very disappointed. Portions were very small and the taste was not good at all. My eggs were burnt, my belly buster was nothing remotely close to a belly busting portion and one of the main ingredients on one of my sandwiches was left out.

Looking for a cute, safe, dog-friendly neighborhood? Look no further.

The cow dog gives Hyde Park Village four stars for the fun pup-related events, plentiful water bowls, nice people and pit-friendly atmosphere. What else could you want? We've been to numerous events at Hyde Park Village over the past few months including the Sunday Market and a few fundraisers- and we have always had a good time. I have noticed that it has only gotten better since I first checked it out about three years ago, and keeps improving. 

As a human, my only qualm is that the stores and restaurants, while charming and aesthetically pleasing, are a little beyond my price range. For that reason, it's more a window shopping and dog-walking venue for me. But if my dog can come with me, she's happy, and when she's happy, I'm happy. Maybe we will move here one day. For now, we'll definitely be back as soon as possible.

As an avid fan of most things beer related I was very excited to have a chance to visit this brew pub during my recent trip to Indianapolis. When I was there I tried the Golden Zoe IPA, Centennial Martyr Double IPA, and the Snow Bunny Blonde. Both IPAs didn't disappoint, both giving excellent hoppy flavors that I was more than thrilled to have tried. The Snow Bunny however tasted very similar to Miller Lite or Mich Golden. and was a little disappointing. 

I was very thankful that they offered me a free bowl of freshly popped popcorn upon my arrival. As for food I only had a small order of breadstix. The dough was fantastic, and made me curious about what their pizzas and calzones may taste like. 

One strange thing I noticed when I was there was that the place is incredibly dedicated to the beer aspect of things, which isn't necessarily a horrible thing, except that it certainly takes away from the amount of space they have available to feed diners as they come in, also most if not all of their tables were picnic tables. Which gave a strange vibe to the place overall. I felt like food was certainly an after thought to the place or an "also ran." Aside from that small caveat, the staff was helpful, though it was a slow time. And they let me charge up my phone while I was there, which kept me from getting lost later in the day.
Family Day at the Beach. Indian Rocks Beach is my ultimate favorite beach. I love each spot where you can enjoy the Gulf. We found the perfect spot and enjoyed an awesome day.
Amazing craft beer and high enjoyed our appetizers. A small brewery with a comfortable bar. Highly recommend.

I had dinner here this past Saturday with friends. The restaurant was very small and intimate which was perfect for me. The food was unbelievable. I would definitely go back and highly recommend this spot. BTW you may want to make reservations months in advance and its BYOB #enjoy

During my short day and a half in Tucson, I found Jerry Bob's through Yelp. It was conveniently within walking distance from the airport hotel I was staying at, so I came here for breakfast both mornings I was here.

It definitely is a busy place--almost all the tables were occupied when I came both times, but I didn't have to wait at all for a seat at the countertop. As soon as I sat down, the waitress asked if she could get any drinks started for me. After being handed a much needed coffee, I was presented with a menu. The first day I ordered the Huevos Garcia and the second day I ordered a Denver omelet.

Both days, the food turned out great, and the portions were generous and fairly priced (at least compared to what I'm used to in San Francisco). 

The staff here are efficient, yet friendly. They are constantly zipping around making sure coffees and waters are topped up -- I don't think my coffee ever dropped to below half empty either day. But while they're moving about, they take time to chat and catch up with their regulars and also to check on how everything is going with the meal. 

This restaurant is a bit out of the way from downtown Tucson, but if I'm ever staying by the airport again, I would definitely drop by next time!

I had such high hopes for this place, seeing all their nice nail pictures on Instagram. I came here earlier tonight. It was pretty empty so I was taken right away. I don't know the girls name that did my nails, but she is going to school to be a nurse. She was very nice, however, my nails aren't. She did not seem very knowledgable on how to do acrylic nails. It seemed like she was just smearing the acrylic around and then even did another layer of it on top of the first one which I know is a big no-no.  My acrylics are extremely thick and they are bulky/lumpy under my nails. They do not look good at all. I wanted a yellow/pink ombré with a butterfly accent nail. The "ombré" looked more like someone took spray paint and aimlessly sprayed my nails. All she did was dab my finger with her finger to smear the polish around. I'm pretty sure that isn't how you go about an ombré style nail. There were many missing spots that I actually had to polish over myself when I got home. Thankfully I have similar colors.  The butterfly design was mediocre. I definitely feel as if I was overcharged for the quality (or lack of). She said she has 9 years of experience doing nails, but judging by mine I really don't know how true that is. Whoever does the nails that posts all the pictures on their Instagram page is the person I would recommend going to for a nail service here, however, personally I would probably not come back here again.

Cool Cajun joint! My buddy, Josh brought me here for a quick brunch. Management and the bartender were super friendly and fun to be around. Good amount of people in here, too. 
+++ the mimosas!!

Great cocktails and the rooftop deck was really nice.  The short-rib grilled cheese was so decadent.  Nice little selection of bar snacks - especially enjoyed the Fried Pickles and Fried Jalapeno Cream Cheese Balls.

I was here for the first time this past week for a business lunch event, so I think this will be a pre-review since I didn't exactly experience the full restaurant dining experience.  We had a party of close to 50 people and were seated at tables in the downstairs banquet hall.  The upstairs looked like a really cool atmosphere with a community table in the bar area.  One of my co-workers was raving about this type of setup; great way for people to meet new people kind of thing.  

While our interaction with the server staff was limited, they were very polite, smiles and welcoming to our party.  We had a really awesome spread of food including sopresetta, salami, olives and caprese salad.  A mixed salad which was also good but just a tad too much dressing.  The main courses were baked ziti, eggplant parm, chicken marsala, meatballs and roasted veggies.  All the food was really good and they were kind enough to allow us to take home any leftovers.  You typically don't see that in a buffet event, or at least I haven't.  Oh yea and those garlic knots, warm, fresh and so dangerous!  

It was a really pleasant experience and I would definitely consider coming back with my gf for a dinner.  They did an excellent job at handling our very large party so I have confidence they can handle a party of two with ease.
Food is amazing but OMG 23 minutes for a gyro plate with short line. Do not go here if you are in a hurry!!!

Brand spanking new ice cream store in the Central West end.  I was lucky to miss the grand opening tonight where hundreds lined up for the free ice cream.  
Thank you to YELP, Aaron and of course Jeni for inviting me for the sneak peak event last night.  I had the incredible opportunity to learn about their practice and taste a number of ice cream flavors.  This is Jeni's ~20th store.  Based out of Ohio, they get all of their milk from a group of farms in Ohio, thereby allowing them to control the quality.  Lets see there is probably a shorter list of things I didn't try.  
That being said my favorite flavors were "sun popped corn", "brown butter almond brittle", "Pistachio and Honey", and the ever interesting Wildberry Lavender.  The sun popped corn took the crown though for me.  It was the perfect umami taste.  Loved it.  Close second would be the almond brittle.  
Try them alone or in a sundae.  
I tasted the Caramel Corn Sundae and The Charleston Sundae.  I have to admit the Charleston had a little too much molasses but had a very interesting bite too it.  Admittedly this was a preview night and the employees were new at this too.  

I love ice cream and Jeni's easily pleased my palette.  I will be back with the entire crew next time... but I'll probably wait for the crowd to subside before heading back.
Great new management and staff.  Ownership does not care about locals and regulars.  Would support people that work their but not ownership.

Recently just visited Haus Of Hoodoo and had a wonderful experience. The inside of the shop is beautiful. Great ambiance. Justin has excellent customer service. Very informed and warm energy. Highly recommend anyone who's interested in the authentic experience and not touristy.

Great service and close to my job, near USF. It's pizza week in Tampa and I plan to try and find some of the best pizza out here. lol his was my first stop for lunch. It does meet New York style pizza criteria. Flat and thin crust, cheesy and greasy top and of course, foldable! Where this just misses the 5 star mark is when it comes to flavor. I did feel this was just a tad bit too bland. The crust was a very cardboard like, which some will say IS New York style, but it's a little to stiff, dry and a little too bland. It's not a bad option at all. I had pepperoni as my topping and noticed other pizzas being sold by the slice that certainly drew interest. Not my favorite so far but far from "bad pizza".
Went to Maria and got a fabulous haircut. She recommended great products and explained how to style my hair easily. A month later I am still in love with my haircut!

I have only been living in this town (Carpinteria) for about a month but have already been to this cafe 3 times. Because the food is yummy, with reasonable prices, and a mellow atmosphere.   When friends come from out of town- this is where we end up for breakfast.

My all time favorite so far has been the Jalapeno Scramble. It is simply "dee-lish."  

Must admit that I have only eaten breakfast here, so I do not know what their lunch menu tastes like.  But I do love the fact that we can be lazy in the morning and know that breakfast will be served all day (and apparently so is lunch- so if you wake up jonesing for lunch at 7am, Esau's is your place).  Bonus.

Make sure you are not in a hurry when you come to eat at Esau's Cafe as the staff is laid back and mellow (meaning it takes a while to get your order in) but the food is definitely worth the wait.

Love the tables on the patio. The tables in the front are good for people-watching down Linden Ave, but you tend to get exhaust from anyone parking their car a few feet from you.

Oh, and don't judge this place by its bathroom. Yuck.

Is the Feasting Fox good? Yes!!! I will definitely be back! I had the cheese puffs, potato cakes and the stuffed shells. I'm a vegetarian so my food options are limited but I was satisfied with my meal. The potato cakes and applesauce was definitely something new from me and the applesauce added a nice flavor to the potatoes. The cheese puff was good. French bread and a cheesy spread. I tried a whisky and ginger beer drink but I didn't like. Nothing against the bartender but it just wasn't to my liking. Feasting Fox was a different experience and I would definitely try it again. Oh my husband had some chicken entree which is a chicken breast over mashed potatoes with a white sauce that he said was really good. I'm tried the potatoes and the sauce and I was impressed.
It is the worst Mexican food if all time. I grew up in so cal and have had a lot of Mexican food and I've never had anything as bad as their food is.

This is a mixed review, the restaurant and staff were great.  We had issues with 2 of our 4 orders.  The airline chicken over Spanish rice and the salmon over Spanish rice.  The rice was mushy with hard bits of undercooked rice.  They redid our order, however after trying the rice herself the manager realized that the rice was still not up to par.  We ended up switching to potatoes.  

Great customer service!

My most recent visit to this lovely courtyard was for brunch... in June. And our large group was outside. I thought one of my colleagues makeup was going to melt off. I don't think she realized that we would be dining outside when she made the reservation.

As always the food was delicious. We sampled the baked oysters and I had the Amelie salad which was perfect. For my entree I got the breakfast sandwich without the ham and it was huge and filling. I had an orange blossom cocktail with brunch and it was lovely. Service was great service. And they were on it for our large group. But OMG was it hot since it was after 1 when we left. Whew...

We ordered a dinner for 4 for take-out, planning to feed 5 hungry people. We felt like we could probably have fed two more with the amount of food received. I would describe the food as the prototypical Chinese take-out. Everything was saucy, and well fried. Happily, no one ran into any grisly bits on the chicken, beef, or pork. The delivery was prompt, and we all agreed we would happily order from them again

Fun and interesting way to learn some o the history and folklore of New Orleans. It's not often you get a chance to take a history lesson while walking around with a beer. The tour was about 2 hours with a 15 minute break in a local watering hole. Our guide, Drew was animated and fun. Great for fans of the macabre or a family activity (Some of the conversation, like the history itself is a bit off color.) A great way to spend a couple hours in the French Quarter without taking your clothes off.

Absolutely del ious pad Thai!!! One of the best places in tampa! We started with the firecracker shrimp- amazing! So light and crispy and great sauce! We also have the cold apple sake which was perfect with the pad Thai! Can't wait to go back and eat here again!

This is the 'NEW' TJ Maxx . It moved from its old location on street road and has now made its home in the old Sporting Goods location. My visit was during opening week and the first thing I noticed as I walked up is that it was very bright. There was also a strange chemical smell (probably from the construction) that was lingering. There were a lot of shoppers around 7 at night. They had displays of trending seasonal items in the front as they did at the old location. To the left was purses and to the right was cashiers. Behind the purses were winter accessories than the fitting rooms, then hosiery and shoes and lastly pajamas. The whole middle section was Women's clothes and kids and men's clothes to the right. The right wall was filled with toys. There is definitely a more open feel to this store. Higher ceilings, and as I had previously stated - more light. There were a lot of clothing racks but they were all extremely light. There were hardly any of the good brands they normally had. A lot of repeats of the same denim and sweater, etc. I tried on a few things and the fitting rooms were mostly clean but there were not a lot. I don't particularly like the fitting room area. It's just one line of rooms rather than rooms on either side. After checking out clothing I looked at home decor. There was nothing. All the home aisles are very short and they're all in the back of the store - as they were in the old store. But there are a lot less. There was also really no "decor". One small aisle of picture frames, one small aisle of sheets, one of stationary but no aisles that had the great kitchen ware and decorative goods that they used to. Maybe it's because they were starting to set up the Christmas aisles? I'm not sure. There were some large boxes left out obstructing paths. 
Overall its bigger brighter and yes newer but I do prefer the old store, as do some of the cashiers - that have moved with the store - that we talked to.

Hard pass on a hard sell.  

My story starts similar to others: two guys knocked because 'they just finished work on a "neighbor" and were doing quotes'.  Except these guys weren't construction, they were sales with all the same scripted lines others have mentioned.  They wanted my partner to be available for the consult, but said it would be OK if she wasn't as long as I told the confirmation person she would be.  Sketchy but I went with it.

They called someone to take my info and passed me their phone.  While giving my info, there was a popup notification for a very disgusting snapchat group.  I'll spare everyone the name.

The rep shows up wearing a mask on his chin so I have to ask him to wear it properly.  Not the best start.  I explained my partner was working but I was well versed on construction and could handle the discussion.  He insisted anyhow and wouldn't take no for an answer ... so I thanked him for coming out and said I wasn't interested.  When that didn't end the hard sell I flat out asked him to leave.  First once, then twice, and then three times.

...and when THAT didn't work I had to threaten to call the police before he got up and left.  Dodged a bullet as far as I'm concerned.

Service fantastic,  food above my expectations.  Zinburger is an eclectic burger place with casual decor and a warm inviting atmosphere.  The beef used in the burgers is top notch and the chefs know the meaning of a medium/well burger (no bun).  I paired the burger with a glass of red blend wine.   I would definitely try Zinburger again.

Blue Cross said this was the closest doctor to my work, which was the only reason I originally chose them. However, I really like this group. I feel like I know what I need (Rx refill, etc) and they can get me in same or next day. I've seen Dr. Monica Davis and Katie Reiff, FNP-C. Both are excellent and Katie is VERY sweet. We were laughing together about something my bf said with my legs in stir-ups. How often does that happen ladies?!

They have an online booking system which I LOVE and a patient portal. I can review the visit and get lab results through the portal. 

I've waited well over an hour past my appt time and have also been seen right away. I guess the wait times are hit and miss due to their schedule, walk-ins, etc. 

One thing I didn't really like was their intake form/system. It's done on an iPad and was cumbersome compared to paper. I know there's an electronic medical record thing going on, but I just had a hard time going through the screens and using their little stylus. Very minor complaint.

I need to come back for dinner, but I'm basically hooked and definitely a fan.

We stopped in for brunch one Saturday. 

Started with a cheese plate, our choice of three. One of the cheeses we got was Hazen Blue, and it is still one of my favorites. I've got a few ounces sitting in my fridge right now! I couldn't pass them up when I spotted them at DiBruno Bros. 

The cuts are a little small compared to other cheese boards we've come across (Jamonera, Zavino etc), and the accompaniments were nothing too impressive. 

Since we didn't have a bad cheese, I would have to say their selection is redeeming.

I ordered a crab benny because I'm obsessed with poached eggs and hollandaise sauce over anything. 

They gave me an unbelievable amount of sweetly fresh lump crab meat. 

I didn't come across even a trace of shells, so I have a lingering suspicion that it came from a can. Even if that were the case, they have a great source, and it was well prepared and well seasoned-- I have no complaints!

They have an extension whiskey list. I wanted to try the Civil War flight, but we had already committed to a pitcher of red wine cooler, so I just blindly chose a whiskey featured in the flight.

Big mistake.

Elmer Lee tastes like the cherry pepto bismo pink soaps standard in a lot of restaurants and other public spaces, plus fire. I don't know what that is in technical, liquor note, terms-- dry? Spicy? 

Just imagine the smell of that liquid hand soap and a burning, stinging sensation from your tonsil to your upper stomach. You live and you learn, at least I lived.
