She could have sat us, sorry Honey your place isn't that ballin that people wait months to get a seat and will come in no matter the weather. I can guarantee more than a few never showed up for their reservation.  

And the thing is we wouldn't have a problem with this except for the little snot of a hostess they had on. The low score is based on that and the fact I will probably never get my fiancé to agree to trying it again, even with a reservation. Oh well, I guess that's what you get for trying to get a decent meal outside of Philly.

I recently had the best restaurant coconut soup of my life at Farmhouse Kitchen Oakland 2 days ago and then I ordered this..."Dishwater" is what my son said.  I usually don't write reviews but for the greater good it is necessary.   Curries are not worth ordering, literally my husband put his in the garbage disposal.  Satay is fine.  I would reorder the fish dish, but probably won't ever go back. WTF

My mother and I came in to purchase new phones about 2 months ago. We were helped by Doug. He was truly amazing! He helped us choose which phones we should get and was very informative about the different phones (even convinced us to upgrade to a different phone). He helped us convert all our pictures, texts, and contacts over to our new phones. He even recommended a few apps we might enjoy. A few days later we brought my dad and he helped upgrade him too. He was just so helpful and nice. We definitely recommend this location and Doug is awesome!
Great waitstaff. And great stuffed crap!  Awesome bread pudding with chocolate and whipped! Best part because it was free with a check in coupon from YELP!!!

Outstanding place. Classic Nashville spot in the famous Printer's Alley. I love that there is a decent-sized local crowd. Not swarmed and ruined by throngs of tourists. Love dishes here like foie gras, scallops, and carpaccio. The lobster bisque is great. Cool, unique place with so much Nashville history. Absolutely beautiful job by David in renovating this place a few years back the cocktails and draft beer selection are excellent.
The food here isn't what it used to be place needs to train their staff!!!! The workers don't seem to care about what they are serving customers!!

Rounds has been on a roll lately, and their products are being seen just about everywhere in town that you can think! It's pretty amazing what Sean and Anton have done, and they deserve mad props for taking the business to the next level.

Every coffee shop and small cafe in town has a virtual Rounds Mini-Market inside. The cream cheeses they make are being packaged as small as 2 oz. for single servings with bagels, and their product line just keeps expanding.

So why am I bumping them down a star? Well, with growth comes challenges, like maintaining consistency, and this decision comes after three recent visits. On the first, I was there for lunch and ordered a Turkey/Avo sandwich on an everything bagel. Nothing wrong with the sandwich, but the cucumbers that were served with the hummus were slimy, and visibly so. I was gonna let that slide as an honest mistake, but the following week I ordered an everything bagel with chive cream cheese on the side (I don't like cream cheese to melt on a bagel and I like to pull the bagel apart and apply cream cheese to individual bites) and what I got was a slightly underdone bagel with a very light exterior and a half filled cup of cream cheese that barely made it all the way through the bagel. The last time I came in, I wanted to get a half dozen bagels and a small cream cheese, but all they had was plain available in the 8 oz. size and naturally I wanted Sriracha. 

The only reason I bring this up is the fact that I want this business to be uber consistent and super successful. I hate when I have to adjust my rating, but sometimes it's just necessary to point out some inconsistencies.

This has to be one of the dirtiest, slowest starbucks ever. 
My wife had to use the bathroom she said it was so disgusting she just held it. We walk up and three people just look at us with this dumbfounded looked of like what. Drive-thru guy comes over to help us it takes over 10 mins for two drinks and she waited for everyone to see my drink because she made a heart. I don't give two shits now my coffee is cold. Customer service is very lacking at this location as well.

Its a really nice local spot with great outdoor seating.  The place is very family friendly.  The vibe was casual and relaxed.  The staff was all nice and very helpful.

The food was unique and worth a try.  I had a very amazing kale salad that was well balanced and filling.  The beats with egg and bacon added a sweet richness that made it a treat.  I also shared some wings and mussels.  Both of the dishes were good as well but the wings needed more sauce and were a little dry.

I will go back for sure and try some other dishes.  This spot is only a very small distance from the pinellas trail.  Very few people know that so its kinda of hidden gem if biking the trail.
When you forget all the sauces and they come back to bring all that plus more. You deserve all the starts. Chick fill a never seems to disappoint.

I went to Jessica at Ulta Beauty in the Clearwater Mall. After a not great at all cut (grew out uneven) somewhere else.  She saw the picture of what I wanted (touch up the layers, and fix my bangs).  She discussed with me what was going to work and what wouldn't. She asked before putting product in my hair.  All of these little things made a difference with me.  I felt like it was a true consultation, and on Election Day it was slow, but she didn't rush at all.  The cut turned out beautifully- the layers were defined and blended, the bangs were what I had in mind.  I will definitely be back to see her in 6 months!
Terrible service: rude, no greeting(EVERRRRR) , no napkins, but the fries are always good, lol

Food was really good, service kinda sucked when there wasn't that many people.
I came back again tonight and the servers were not attentive and I ordered at the same time another couple did and waited and extra 20 minutes.I went to the manager nicely and attempted to explain the incident tonight and he cut me off a bunch and made me feel horrible for having a complaint and didn't let me even explain the situation. The girl server was so rude and everyone noticed. 
No denying the good food, but the customer service was horrible

I've gone to eat here several times when visiting my brother in St. Pete, always a delight. I can't remember what I ate the prior time here but this time I made sure I posted what I ordered.

I ordered a Carne Asada torta, which is basically a mainly Mexican sub...it is pico de gallo, guacamole, sometimes chopped radish, lettuce, tomatoes, cilantro, cheese, carne asada beef, lime all on telera bread, DELICIOUS!

I also ordered 2 beef tacos, also exquisite. I've posted pics. Service is always fast and courteous, they serve beer also, and all the food is always good!

Stayed here overnight driving back from Ohio. Booked online. Front desk was very nice and accommodating. The smell, as mentioned in other post, was just mildly annoying. It wasn't a bad smell, just disinfectant type smell. The bathroom was soooooo clean. Looks as if it had been recently remodeled. My husband was not happy with water pressure.

Bed was comfy and ac worked great and not noisy at all. Breakfast was plentiful and good, cold milk, hot coffee.

Would stay here again.

29 Armstrong is a wonderful place for mid to high-end modern decor and furniture. 

From light fixtures to bedding, lotions and creams, and knickknacks, the product selection is impressive. Most of what they carry is well-designed, novel and progressive. 

The staff have always been conversational, and come over to tell you about the pieces you're looking at, and explaining their current promotions and sales. 
 
It seemed that during my last visit, the clearance sale was in full swing, and most of the things that I wanted were marked down. I will definitely be back to scope out next purchases before this promotion is over!

Can't recommend.  The company had wonderful reviews and was recommended by a coworker.  Our furniture was treated with lack of care and many pieces have scratches on them from the move.  The company sent a nominal check to compensate but did not follow up with us at all about the poor job their movers did.  Nice fellas but not a good experience for us.

you love beer and better-than-average pub food.  eat at monk's!

a few things:
1.  it's really crowded on the weekends (but you already knew that)
2.  the frites are great (you knew that too)
3.  they have a great selection of lambic beer, and not just the sweet stuff.  they'll pour you the sourest of the sour all night long.

frites + lambic = 4 stars

My wife and I went to look at the Forester and Outback, because we didn't know which would suit us better. Our time frame for purchasing is June or July. It will be a cash deal.  We were there for a total of 25 minutes, looking, sitting in, and looking at the colors.  While there not a single salesperson approached us. They helped others, who came in after us, or went on break, not to be found.  We left there and went to Webster Subaru, where we were treated very well. We were able to drive each vehicle, ask questions and treated as if we're family.  We found the prices were better and they didn't charge $995 extra for items that come standard from the factory.  In the past year Lou Fusz has changed for the worse.

So it starts out, they are out of sake, white wine and the craft beer I ordered. They only had one Japanese label, Asahi, which I like, but still...
The Godfather roll was really good, the Dragon was good, the Orange roll was ok.
One sushi chef took some time.
Our server had to be new, bless her heart.

So  for now.

Bonefish is probably one of your best options if you're looking for properly cooked fish on the south side. Why three stars then? Absolutely go if you're eating in. 5 stars for in-restaurant service. Skip Bonefish altogether is you're carrying out. 1 star for carry out. Hence, three stars. 

My in-restaurant experiences have always been good. Of course, the Bang Bang Shrimp is always a hit as an appetizer. They also have a delicious house salad with a unique dressing that I really enjoy. For my meal, I usually stick with the salmon cooked pan Asian style with broccoli and rice. If they have the Saigon sea scallops and shrimp while you're in, it's delicious. Portions are good and the staff is usually helpful. 

I've ordered carry out twice in the past month or two and both times have been major let downs. Both times, I've ordered the Saigon sea scallops and shrimp, which comes mixed in with noodles and sauce, and both times, I've been left searching for even one drop of sauce (or flavor). Interestingly enough, both times I've also been having dinner with someone else and they got the same thing and theirs has been totally dry as well, so I know it isn't some kind of mistake just on mine. This dish is so excellent in-restaurant, so it's a huge let down to get hyped for it at home (and spend that much money on dinner) and then it have little to no taste. 

I've been let down one too many times, so I'm not sure if I'll be coming back any time soon. I'd love to, but I don't want to waste my money on bland food when I could go elsewhere. I wish Bonefish Greenwood would do better by ensuring the quality of its food is standard across the board for take out and eat in.
It's so busy but worth the wait! I love the hash browns and have liked every breakfast item I've tried! The Croquet madame is to die for!

This is a review about the timeshare scam and the nonexistent customer service from the "general manager". Malika, the "concierge" is a con artist. "Oh, it's Wyndham's 75th anniversary and NOLA's 300th - that's why we're giving these (tour) discounts and free breakfast", she says. "I just need $20 to secure your spot and be at the lobby at 930 for breakfast. We'll refund you at breakfast." She was so sweet. Then she asks you to sign a paper, and then you take it with you and written somewhere in the middle- "YOU HAVE TO SIT AT A 120-minute presentation!" Then you realize you've been scammed. I called the general manager to help me get a refund, after arguing with the same lady the next day, but this "GM" just said "Hold on" and then transferred me back to the same scammer without any warning. This whole situation ruined my vacation at #NOLA. Please be warned, unless you're willing to spend 2-3 hours of your vacation time being pitched for timeshare , don't talk to this lady at "concierge". And be warned, the manager won't have your back. Better stay somewhere else.

Swiss Haus hazelnut sponge cake has been our family's go-to birthday cake for half a century. Everyone looks forward to celebrations because they know what's coming at the end of the meal, and every now and then I even get one when it's no one's birthday. It is that good, and quite unique. Light and fluffy and extraordinarily delicious with the trademark gel icing. And you can always count on friendly service. Best birthday cake on the planet!

Good customer service is not dead!! I just had the greatest experience with a representative from Dyson in KOP. I had lost a piece on my vacuum and called to see how I could get a new piece. The guy's name was Jim and he explained how I could either drive to the KOP mall and get one for a few bucks (ugh) or order one which would take a few days. I explained how I have 2 dogs and haven't been able to use the tools or wand on my vacuum for 3 wks since I lost it and how my house is completely covered in hair. He asked where I lived and 3 hrs later, on his way home from work, he not only comes to my house to drop off the piece but installs it, checks out my vacuum and gives me some tips on maintaining it and then didn't even charge me!! What a genuinely nice guy. He totally went out of his way for a complete stranger and made my day. I will be sure to pass the good karma on. Thanks Jim!!!

Ugh. Heavy, super sweet sugar bombs. A dozen plus two coffee drinks and a juice cost us THIRTY EIGHT DOLLARS. And we ended up eating half and throwing out the rest.  Just way too heavy. Each is priced a la cart and they just aren't worth it. I wanted to like this place so much but it just ended up a bougie mess. Props and third star added for masking, distancing and covid precautions.

So, I've been here exactly once. One time. Tonight. I watched the Melvins, a life long dream, and it only cost me $18 to get in the door. I had seats that gave me an amazing view of the stage (I have grown too old for mosh pits, but I love to watch) the band was amazing. The food was exceptional, and the staff was outstanding. The venue was clean, and small, the best I've seen in a very long time, and I go to stuff like this a lot. 3rd and Lindsley will have my business at any point and time that someone is there that I even kinda wanna see. They are top notch!!

J'adore les restaurants français! I've spent a bit of time in Paris years ago so when I stumbled across this restaurant, a flood of memories came rushing back. I had the moelleux au chocolat and the café vietnamien. The cake was heavenly!

If I could rate the Tarpon Springs Trulieve I'd rate it a -10 everybody there acts like they just escape Dahmer's apartment with a hole in their head these people literally run lobotomy city if I'm wrong please ask them a simple question such as what is the Wi-Fi password? These morons are unaware there's even a trulieve guest Wi-Fi connection this is how pathetic the staffing is at Trulieve Tarpon Springs. It seems like they're uneducated about the products and for some reason there's always a 15 minute wait when there doesn't need to be I have literally sat in that lobby with nobody before me waiting 15 minutes only to go into the back room and nobody be back there either.

Parking... argh. What a nightmare. This is probably the only reason Phil's gets 4 stars instead of 5. 

We actually attempted to go to the Harahan location once, a couple of months ago. After driving in/out/around the parking lot a few times, we gave up and went elsewhere. 

The parking at the Metairie location isn't much better. Their entire lot was full, as was the on-street parking. We just parked next door at the camera shop, despite the signs warning of being towed.

Anyway, the important part is the food. The boyfriend and I each built our own burgers, using the provided selection sheet and pencils. They were absolutely delicious, and I used my free topping check-in offer from the Yelp app too! The baby had a grilled chicken sandwich kids meal. I'm SO glad they offer a lower-fat kids option, especially since she will be chowing down on fries as the side order.

Everything that we ordered was perfectly cooked - mine, medium well, and the boyfriend's medium rare. The drink refills kept coming in a timely manner and the service was great. We will definitely be returning, provided we can find a parking spot and don't get towed if we park next door!

Had a great meal at the Red Lion. I ordered the Fish & Chips with a Guiness and my wife got the BBQ Burger and a grog. The food was really tasty, well prepared, and served piping hot. The waitstaff was very attentive and the experience was just a good one.

Other reviews' complaints about parking are fairly valid. We found a spot just fine, and it won't be an issue if you're in Fountain Square already for a show or night out, etc. But if this is your destination, you might have a bit of a walk from your car to the restaurant. The restrooms, as mentioned, are shared. We lucked out though, because they're shared with the Hi-Fi concert venue next door and we were having a pre-show dinner. So by taking a restroom break, we wound up backstage of the concert we were going to go see. That was actually kind of awesome! However, they aren't the best restrooms if that is a concern.

Overall, I recommend the Red Lion. Good food, neat atmosphere, and attentive waitstaff.

My 5 year old car was looking pretty shabby because the sprinklers use reclaimed water. After Mr Rossi worked his magic, my car looks refreshed. 
He communicated quickly and answered all my questions.  He worked with my crazy work schedule. 
I am very pleased with the results.

Had a good experience as I went to upgrade my phone. They gave me clear information on the upgrade, price, process and made sure my phone back up regenerated on my new phone correctly. I like that there are printer stations built into the table stations. Definitely a well oiled machine. Everyone has their roles and it works!
Went they for my birthday last night for the first time. Food was good and the service was great.

We went there to check out their Thursday dinner special for two.  The food was good and plentiful for the $42.00 cost and the half priced wine was nice addition to our meal.  The extremely frustrating problem was with how quickly they want us in and out.  We had chosen this place for our date night and ended up feeling frustrated and not truly able to enjoy our meal.  If you are in a hurry and just want to gobble down your food and get going, then I'd tell you to head here.  We arrived around 6:00 p.m. and were seated promptly, which was nice.  We had just sat down and we're settling in probably less than two minutes and our waiter arrived wanting to take our beverage order.  We hadn't looked at any menu at this time.  We informed him that we'd need some more time, he arrived back less than two minutes later.  He wanted to know if we had made a decision on our beverages and if we had made a choice for our meals.  We mentioned that we were curious to try the Thursday special.  At that point he asked if we had decided on our starter, again we hadn't had the opportunity to look at our discuss the menu options.  We looked hastily, made a decision about the starter and asked for the wine.  He then said that the special came with two sides and if we knew what we would like for them.  We said we hadn't decided yet, he left, returned again in less than 2 minutes and asked what sides we had decided on.  He left again then in less than 5 minutes our starter arrived.  It was yummy and we were enjoying it with our wine.  We were about half way through our starter and our dinner arrived. Now the choice was, finish our starter or start eating our dinner while it was still hot.  We had just taken the last bite of our dinner and our dessert arrived.  Not a enjoyable relaxing meal.  We were in and out in about 55 minutes.  Not a date night experience.  Will come back for lunch, when you need to be in and out in an hour, but dinner if off the list.

Switched to the Walgreens pharmacy after CVS stopped being 24/7.  This is less than a mile from my house, they have a drive through, and easy pay is a breeze, so it makes prescriptions really easy.  They always have everything I'm looking for inside.  I'm not going to say the prices are amazing, because they're always a little higher at a pharmacy, but they're not bad.  Staff has always been friendly.  Store is well maintained.  Photo developing is simple with their online ordering and quick pick up.  No real complaints here.  No need to go out of the way to CVS, I go to the corner of happy & healthy!

Love love love! Just went there for the first time today. Ordered a Raspberry Chiffon cake for my co-worker's birthday. Beautiful and delicious! Also grabbed a cold brew coffee for the trip back. Ambience is super cute, they have a polite staff. I look forward to returning and recommending it to everyone I know. Docked one star because my cake wasn't ready at the specified pick-up time and I ended up waiting 30 min. Other than that - perfection!

9/2/19-early evening.  

I really really enjoyed my experience here at Ruth's Chris Steakhouse.  I came off a mediocre experience here quite some time ago- so I wasn't sure what to expect. I was pleasantly surprised through and through.

We had a private room in the back and we were served by Kim and one of her team members (soo sorry I don't recall his name but he was very attentive too) I just happened to interact with Kim more.  All the staff I interacted with were polite and attentive. Kim made wonderful suggestions and she's an amazing up-seller too. She was quick to refill cocktails and gave us excellent service. 

The prices at this restaurant are totally obscene and I would never eat here under normal circumstances, but I was being treated by my very generous parents! We were celebrating my mom's beautiful 75th year Birthday! We had a party of 14.

I'm not much of a steak fan but I simply had to try the 11 ounce filet- it was going to be that or salmon. I opted for the filet with a generous tangy blue cheese crown that was amazing. It was so tangy and mouthwatering. My daughter tried and loved the filet with horseradish crown. She was thrilled with hers.  

Naturally the sides are ala carte. We tried the garlic mashed potatoes, the sweet potato casserole, roasted Brussel sprouts, lobster Mac and cheese- OH MY GOD that Lobster mac, creamed spinach, & potatoes au gratin.  Everything was delicious for sure.  I mustn't forget to tell you about the Lobster bisque! Pieces of lobster in a creamy orange bisque savory soup.

I would enjoy going back to this fine establishment but I have my doubts if they could top this experience!

While on our honeymoon the husband and I HAD to stop at South Coast Deli while roadtripping up the coast.  We both got the same thing: the Cajun Turkey sandwich, which is (from the menu) "oven roasted turkey with garlic-tabasco mayo, Dijon mustard, tomatoes, red onions, pickles, and shredded cabbage".  Husband got his as described while I had mine with everything except the mustard.  Wow what a delicious flavor combination!  The sandwiches were massive and I couldn't finish mine.  We also bought some smores chocolate bars from the counter for our desert and those were tasty as well.  (So to be correct I could have finished my sandwich but then I would have skipped desert!)  

Eating in is difficult since the shop is far too small to accommodate demand.  We managed to snag a cramped table right next to the door.  That was uncomfortable but that is how it goes in the deli world.  

There are many nice touches that I appreciated however there are two things worth mentioning.  The first is the waste disposal system, which allows customers to throw out recyclables, compost items, and trash.  I like a company that clearly states what can be recycled and what cannot.  (For example, one pizza box can contaminate a whole bale of cardboard and should not be recycled with paper products.)  I threw out all my trash in the appropriate bins.  The other nice touch is the décor.  It's a but industrial inside but the bright colors liven things up.  The bathroom is especially cute.  It's these things that enhance the overall experience in addition to the big pile of delicious food.  

Bottom line: it's a four star deli based on eating-in comfort, and a five star based on sheer awesomeness.

This breakfast spot was recommended to us by a 30 yr long resident of the Bellaire area.  We are certainly glad we stopped in to give the delicious menu a try.  The creme brûlée French Toast was indeed close to perfect as mentioned in other reviews. As a self proclaimed biscuit connoisseur - the biscuits were good but not the best I've had, the quest continues...  Diner feel, coffee cups kept full at all times, small place, worth the short wait

Returned for a comped meal because the first meal was not on point. We were invited back by the manager Carolyn to dine at dinner time "on them" and try it again. So we did and we were glad we did. We ordered the Lovebird sandwich, fries and cold slaw and the miso-glazed chicken salad with quinoa and brussels sprouts and beets. The slaw is to die for. Best slaw around. All I can say if the staff redeemed themselves. Although a different staff then the first time we ate there, they were very attentive and not just to us before we were there for a do-over. The front end of the little cafe was run more efficiently. The first time there was a misunderstanding with the fried chicken vs. the miso-glazed chicken and let's just say it was not handled well. However I can honestly say that the staff on Friday evening April 12, 2019 was wonderful. We will be back. Get there early if you want a seat. Very limited seating.
Okay food. Not worth the price. Service was good but that's about it. One member of our party got food poisoning. Not sure if it was her steak but I'm not coming back.

I always forget Olde Heights Bistro exists but when I remember, I'm very happy!

It's a small restaurant in a small shopping plaza along Nebraska Avenue.  Don't let that fool you though- their menu is quite extensive for such a small place. Sandwiches, salads, steaks, sushi - they've got something for everyone. 

Great place for a business lunch or a date night. 

Only thing I wish they would do is upgrade their patio area a little bit - the weather is so nice here so often that they could double their seating space if the outdoor area got a face lift!

I have no idea why they have a listed phone number as it seems like a waste of money when you never answer it.  Three phone calls across different days with no answer or even a message option.   I'll look elsewhere for my pond supplies, fish,  and reef system livestock.

Set Appointment Thursday night for for Friday morning. Received a call from dispatcher giving me a window of 10-11am, at 11:45 I called to see where they were and dispatcher said they weren't able to come until later, she called me back and said they would be there between 4-6pm, they didn't show up. Now I get to go through a weekend with no toilet or pay overtime rates, don't waste your time.

This restaurant is WONDERFUL!!!
I had the ribeye!  Cooked to perfection!!!
The table prepared Cesare's Salad and Bananas Flambé are to die for!!!
The family that owns this restaurant loves to serve!
We met both Michaels, father and son.
Felt like I was in South Philly without the parking pains!
Going back soon!

I stopped by here for lunch with my daughter, and we had a fairly good experience.  The line was long, with about 8 people ahead of us, but it moved relatively quickly.  The customer service was friendly and professional, and the portion sizes for the meals were excellent. As at all Chipotle restaurants, customers should just be prepared to pay higher prices here than at other fast food establishments.  
 
After we ordered our meal, I was then frustrated to find this place was not as clean as I would expect, especially for an eating establishment.  In fact, the lack of cleanliness was contrary to my expectations at this time, since I would expect a heightened level of attention to cleanliness right now, just after the COVID-19 pandemic.  Although they had nice seating outside, my daughter wanted to eat inside.  Unfortunately, several of the tables inside were dirty from previous customers, so I actually had to clean off a table for us to eat at.  In my opinion, it is unacceptable for any customer to feel the need to clean off a previous customer's trash from within a restaurant.  During our entire visit, I never saw anyone assigned to clean the dining area, the restrooms or the soda fountain dispenser. 

Although I was annoyed with the lack of cleanliness within this restaurant, I must say that the meal was excellent overall.  Based on a mixture of good and bad qualities during this visit, this establishment just barely earned 3 stars.

I never review places while in them. I also am way behind on reviews in general. But I need to review Elixr as I sit in it-
I have been craving hot chocolate for weeks now, and it got much worse today given the random blast of freezing cold weather again. I went to a Starbucks after having to be outside for a while (only to charge my phone and use the wifi to search for a local coffee shop that may be able to give me my hot chocolate fix in the area. Behold-Elixr is found on yelp and I ventured over. Walking in was so warm, comforting, and the place is spacious and adorable. The barista at the counter looked at me as if immediately prepared to take my order and I said I was undecided. "No rush take your time!". I can't have dairy, so I asked about their milk options. Soy-sold. Is the hot chocolate milk chocolate? Cocoa powder and nope. Double sold. I rarely buy hot chocolate anywhere, usually make it at home, and am very picky about it in general. Kind of a hot chocolate snob. The shop has such good reviews, its freezing out, I've had a rough few days so why the hell not? Go for it, treat yourself. I am glad I did. It was delicious to the point that I scraped the mug clean. 
Elixr is so warm and welcoming, spacious for people to work, hang out, sit solo (like I did), and relax. Added bonus-all the guys working are adorable and sweet. I wish my chocolate had bit hotter (it was warm), but other than that I am very please with my decision to come in here on a whim

Everyone who got food while I was in line returned it for being incorrect. The customer service is ridiculously bad and takes forever to get the food out. I would not recommend coming here for good service.

Ate here a couple of days ago. The food was delicious and our server was great! However, we witnessed a very rude, and unprofessional manager yelling at her employees in front of all of the customers. It was really embarassing. The way she treated her employees showed poor management qualities. After one of the employees was finished being yelled at, I asked for the the managers name and they told me it was Tamika. I asked if they were always treated that way and she was hesitant to answer because she seemed scared. Anyhow, the employees were great along with the food. But Tamika was rude and undeserving of a management position.

So as part of getting ready for my drive down to Atlanta for my sister's graduation, I went here to get some new parts for my car. Specifically new wipers and a new air-filter, as well as some fuel system cleaner.

The people here are so helpful and nice, I just rather not go anywhere else. After nearly ripping my thumbnail off (OWWWW!) trying to remove my old wiper blades and put on the new ones, they were nice enough to come outside and help me out. Afterwards they even let me use their restroom to clean up. I had to circle back after leaving to return the rear blade I got, as it was to tall to safely work on the rear windshield. They swapped it out for a more appropriate blade, no questions asked, and after I installed it, I was on my merry way to my next stop on my to do list. Seriously, I won't go anywhere else for my automotive parts needs, period.

I'm all for supporting black businesses. Buttttt, @keshaskitchen_ food was disgusting. They charged me $12 for 3 Ethiopian Wings that were still pink inside, hard-ass yellow rice, disgusting asparagus, and baked macaroni that tastes as if a child made it. I should have left @keshaskitchen_ the moment I realized that their kitchen door was hanging off the hinges and had to be lift up to walk in or out. I brought two platters at that. Needless to say I feel like I'm owed a refund. @keshaskitchen_ #YouRobbedMe #StickToChildCare

Our first experience here.  Horrible.  Made a reservation on open table.  Waited 1/2 hour there to be told they we had to wait longer because 1) they didn't limit open table reservations (its somehow open tables fault) and 2) they took on all their sister restaurant reservations cause they had a power outage.  Super poor management.  Excuse after excuse.  No one moving.  No tables with more than drinks.  Pathetic management.  Won't be back ever.

Great Food and reasonable prices!  I had the grouper bites and they were delicious.  They have an early dinner special also before 5 p.m.
Wait Staff excellent also.  Enjoyed the food !

Staples is my preferred go-to place for office supplies in the Tampa Bay area. The stores are laid out in a logical fashion, making it easy to find what you need without walking up and down the aisles calling out for someone who knows where they hide the Post-It notes.

They have a huge selection of home office supplies plus a big copy & binding center within the store which is great when you need to print off last-minute copies of a presentation.

This Staples is located off of Dale Mabry just before you get to the I-275 intersection. You'll find Staples tucked behind a McDonald's and located next to Best Buy.

The staff is friendly, and the checkout process is fast. They're very good about opening additional cashiers if there seems to be a delay in checking out. These folks really understand customer service!

I can not be more pleased with this service! Had a fridge repair and there was no extra BS- he took a look, told us what was wrong and steps to take. He had to come back - proper parts not there. Then he can back a couple days later and fixed. Not a crook, he is very good!

This review is over my two experiences here. My first was a few weeks ago. I had a party of 5 and I was the first to arrive. Naturally, I walk up to put our name in for a table. I tell the hostess that I had 5 people and she says, "The rest of your party obviously isn't here so we will deal with it when they show up." and she walks away.
Ok.... In the meantime, several other groups arrive and she is still no where to be found. Several of them leave without being seated. My party arrives a few minutes later and we walk up to be seated. She looks around and says, "It will be about 20 minutes." 
Ok.... I had already waited 15 minutes in the sun sitting on a rock with no shade or water. So I was a bit annoyed. We eventually get seated. The food was great and so was our server. That part I would rate at 4 stars.

A few weeks later my girlfriend and I decided to go have breakfast there. We hop in the car and since it was a Sunday morning and I assumed they might be busy, we decide to call to either put our name in or  see how long the wait will be. Here is how our conversation went...

"Stonehouse Cafe."
"Hi, there will be two of us and we would like to sit outside with our dog. How long do you..."
She interrupts, "Hold on"
She puts us on hold for a minute or two...
"Stonehouse Cafe."
"Hi, there's going to be two of us and we want to sit outside, how long of a wait do you think it will be?"
In a not so friendly tone, "How am I supposed to know where you are and how long it will take you to get here?"
My girlfriend looks at me a bit shocked and we have to take a second to compose ourselves.
"ummmm okay.... We just wanted to know if you were busy and how long of a wait...."
We get cut off again, "We are a walk in restaurant and we don't do that."
*Click* 
I hung up so neither I nor my girlfriend could have the chance to lay into her for being so rude. We went somewhere else and had a great experience.
I'm not sure if she is the owner or just a hostess but she has single handily stopped us from coming back. Its too bad because I like the food and there aren't too many dog friendly places out there. After talking to friends, we found out that some of them had similar issues with the hostess. I have had some bad days in the service industry but there is no excuse for treating customers this way. We only wanted a simple question answered. I won't spend my money somewhere that treats its customers this way. If this issue gets addressed I would be happy to try again. If the food was as good as last time, it would likely be a 4-5 star review.

Yes, the food is excellent (everything we've ever had was super delicious...personal favorite is the Reuben on sourdough) but what really stands out is the superior service. Everyone who works at Oxbow is so friendly and they all check on you often to make sure everything is good...a nice team effort. Also appreciated is the fact they play old movies on the TVs instead of the usual programs all other restaurants choose. This place is LOCAL as well... if you haven't checked Oxbow out yet... Do so soon!

As a picky eater and a Celiac, I was excited and nervous when picking a restaurant while in Nashville.  We started with drinks.  I had the Nashville signature cocktail with Pickers Blood Orange.  Since I can't have gluten, I typically can't have flavored vodkas, but this is made with real fruit and so delicious! That drink was AMAZING!!!! My other half had a local IPA with no complaints.  We started with the meat plate and it was great! We loved the Sausage-ish pate.  The fig dip was terrific as well.  We then ordered the trout and the pork chop.  Both were fantastic.  The sides were so tasty that came with the trout and I ordered a side, but that was 2 drinks in, so my memory is slightly foggy! Haha!  None of the desserts were gluten free, so our awesome server had the kitchen make chocolate Buckeyes with whipped cream and also brought out a Whisper Creek cream on the rocks that is also made locally.  He even made sure I could drink it since gluten is in so many random things.  Needless to say, this was a fabulous experience!  Our server was so thoughtful and kind and our food was outstanding!!!! Thank you Farm House!!!

Seriously!  I happened to dine here last weekend and had horrible service. Just so happens my kids prom group picked Berryhill for their prom dinner this weekend.  Story goes like this....

Reservation was for 7:30, didn't get seated until 7:45.  Service was bad and it took them 2 hours for dinner which made them really late for prom.  Prom was 15 minutes from being over by the time they arrived.

The worst part however was that Mr. Berryhill himself was there and apparently wast taking pictures of all the girls in their dresses with his phone because there was a cash award for the winner of the best dress.  (No award was ever handed out.)  One girl in the group happened to also be celebrating her birthday and Mr. Berryhill gave her a small dessert that had chocolate in it.  He mentioned to her date to be careful because if his wife was there she wouldn't approve giving that dessert out because it is like an aphrodisiac!  REALLY!  These are high school kids and your taking pictures of the girls and saying inappropriate things to them.  CREEPER!

We had friends in town this past weekend from NYC and I felt compelled to show them that Nashville isn't just country music and fried food - don't worry, we showed them that part, too. We landed at Holland for the ridiculous weekend happy hour steal of a deal.  I bet the restuarant is uber cool once the sun goes down but even at 5pm, it was a really good looking spot. The happy hour menu was full of $5 options. I had a refreshing moscow mule and a four roses chased with miller high life. yum. We shared the juicy hot chicken app, cheese plate, pickled veg, and truffled frites (we even ordered a second serving) and walked away very satisfied with enough money left over to take them on a tour of honky tonk heaven at Robert's. We will return.

Full confession. I'm a boot snob.  Had them all. Timberland (Ok at best), Wolverine (good), Carolina (USED to be good, horrible customer service, etc).  Red Wing are hands down the best.

They are expensive, but you get great boots and outstanding customer service at the Cherry Hill store. The guys are great. Thanks!

I came for the fried chicken, food network told me so. 

I have to say I wouldn't categorize this as the best fried chicken I ever ate, but it was darn tootin' tasty. I actually liked the seasoned green beans with rice and gravy a touch more then the actual chicken. The chicken tastes like chicken and it's hard to muck up the fried part, but the batter was a little heavy to what I prefer. Still not much to knock here, a wonderfully healthy meal that we all enjoyed.

Cornbread on the table was not delicious, I enjoy my boxed Marie Callendar's mix more.

*Note: Be forewarned they did not honor our restaurant.com certificate, they said they wouldn't take them during the holiday weeks, but we could use it in January - tough when I live in Los Angeles.

My partner and I went here for dinner after a long day of travel and sitting in traffic. We sat outside with our pup Stevie and enjoyed a lovely meal. I got the filet mignon sliders and my partner got the chicken sandwich. Both were excellent and a very decent price. Drinks were great as well.

The real star of the evening was our server Mark! He was an absolute delight and made us feel very relaxed and taken care of! 10/10 for Mark!!!

Fresh, excellent Mexican cuisine in a quiet, classy atmosphere.  Just half a block, but a world away, from Bourbon Street.  We get plenty of greet Mexican in California and this matches or beats some of the best.

Love Love LOVE company burger!!! This is definitely my go to burger joint! I come here quite often and always order the double cheeseburger with bacon and a fried egg...gotta add a fried egg!!! We also order french fries, sweet potato fries, tatar tots and onion rings. Everything was amazing except the tator tots....they taste just like regular tator tots. And if you have room for dessert, definitely try their carrot cake!! The pineapple cream cheese frosting was to die for!!!

One of my go to lunch spots. It's super convenient because there is a drive-through. I love the beef and cheese empanada. The sausage and cheese is good, spinach and artichoke taste like spinach and artichoke dip. Their Cuban sandwiches are also very good. I highly recommend!!!

Popular, but busy and noisy with merely okay food. The sevice was the most irritating. We reserved weeks ahead of time, and when we arrived early, we were asked to wait so we could get a good seat. Our reservation arrived and we got seated next to a service area. We asked for something else, but the only other seats we equally mediocre. The severs themselves were helpful, and the food - I had the mushroom tart and the scallops - was good to okay, respectively.

This place will absolutely be my go-to from now on, especially in comparison to the other sparks store, which is just horrible. I'll explain why: the other sparks store was much closer to my work, so I decided to place a cake order over the phone for my boss, who is retiring, and we we were having a little going away party for him. Because I am type A, I called that store the night before to make sure that they had the order and that it would be ready the next day for pickup. The absolutely clueless person on the other end had no idea what I was talking about and said that there was no order for me! And then he said that they need 24 hours notice, so I couldn't redo the order and have it ready in time! In a panic, I called the wingfield store right by my house. I explained what happened at the other store (which sadly isn't owned by the same person at wingfield). That employee gave me the owner's number, whose name is Barbara, so I called her and told her what happened. She said that she would take care of my cake and that it would be ready by the time I needed it. 

Okay, here's the amazing part. When I arrived a few minutes early, Barbara was just finishing up my cake. She was decorating with her little newborn baby in a body sling!!!!!! I couldn't believe it! Her decorator couldn't be there until later, so she brought her baby and decorated my cake so I could have it in time. I was touched. You just don't see stuff like that very often.

Oh, and to the JERK Sophia below, you should have just gotten the triple scoop if you wanted more ice cream. Sheesh!

I live in Soulard and Frazier's has become my favorite local restaurant.  Always consistent with great food, excellent service and nice ambiance.  I particularly enjoy their sea food and they usually have an tasty appetizer special.  They have a good bar and interesting cocktails.  The only negative I feel is it gets loud inside when the restaurant is crowded and is worse at some tables than others.  The staff bends over backward to be engaging and friendly.  It's my go to place.
DELICIOUS! A neighborhood gem! It's a little pricy but so worth it. Lentils are full of flavor. The lamb vindaloo is super tender. Perfect samosas. Just so well done. Plus BYOB!
Best Greek food in the Indy area! The gyro was fantastic, and baklava was perfect, and the service was top notch. Will definitely be back soon!

Came for dinner on a weeknight.  The service was speedy, but the place was pretty empty so i can't say this is the normal time you might wait for a meal.  Also, as of this review the location is under construction as several buffet tables are being added.  It has the effect of making the place look pretty shambled.

Food was good, but not great. I have no complaints, but no raves either.

One personal quibble, that is not just directed at this place, but anywhere that does this.  I hate places where you are supposed to figure out who to pay. This appears to be one of those places where you think you pay the waiter but you in fact pay on your way out.  Maybe there is some secret code for this, but it really makes me feel stupid in a way I don't enjoy when dining out.

Went here a few months ago. Place looked dead. The manager told me that they could not get my insurance authorization online, and they do not do authorizations by phone. I have a very good and expensive BCBS plan, literally the most common plan. Tried to tell me I'd have to pay for the entire visit upfront $$$ and submit it myself. I told him that was BS. Have never had any issues using my insurance anywhere else, and at any urgent care for that matter. Ended up going down the street to another urgent care, and they got my insurance authorization within 2 minutes. Will never go back to this place.

Air Canada's Top 10 New Restaurants led us to Bündok where a few of us got together for dinner.  We each picked a dish to share amongst ourselves.  The sea bream crudo arrived first: looked very pretty, but the taste of the dish itself was subpar.  It didn't feel like the apples brought anything to the dish; they were bland and was just diced up and thrown on top of the fish.  I found the basil to be pretty overwhelming.  A friend declared that she could probably make the same dish at home herself.  We next had the chicken liver tartine - the favorite of the group.  The chicken liver was so incredibly smooth and creamy.  The aforementioned friend wondered aloud if she could buy some chicken liver and make it this creamy at home.  The gnocchi and cauliflower arrived together.  The gnocchi was so soft, it melted in your mouth in a puddle of creaminess.  The same aforementioned friend said there was no way that it was gnocchi, but yes, friend, it was gnocchi, and it was goooooooooood.  The cauliflower was ok; I felt it was nothing special.  Not sure why it didn't come cut up into smaller pieces either.  A coworker had raved about the chicken skins, and really, can you go wrong with fried chicken skins?  The answer is yes, you can go wrong when you expect too much.  I think the over-hype was what led to my disappointment in the dish.  It was nothing special at all, and the honey mustard might have been better served as a dip versus drops on the skin itself.  I was still hungry and convinced the others to try the other tartine - the sweet pear.  Good choice, equally delicious as the savory tartine.  However, I was not much fuller after this dish.  Oddly enough, everyone else.  Either way, the dessert menu didn't really appeal to us, so we decided to call it a night and head elsewhere to fill me up with dessert. 

Great service, dishes came out pretty fast.  We were done our entire meal in under an hour.  

Located right on 104 st, which means no free parking, and limited street parking available.  

Free wifi available.

I really wanted to like LL because it's close by and I've read such great reviews for this place. I should have just booked with Nicole as she has the best reviews at LL by far, but she had no availability the day I went.
My experience however was less than ideal. I booked a gel mani and pedicure. My pedicure was up first ($40). The decor/interior of this place is really nice and I like how the pedicure bench in the back is all one row. The foot bins are steel and they are cleaned properly. My pedicure was ok. I went on a Friday afternoon and they were busy, but honestly that is no reason to rush the whole process. My feet were barely massaged, the application of color took .257 seconds and the entire service was done in 20 minutes. 

Next up, my gel manicure. My first complaint is that they don't have a lot of spots at the front (for manicures). I didn't care for the fact that everyone sits so close to each other. Since everyone sits so close together there is barely any space/room for you to sit and also keep your personal belongings. My second complaint is that the tool that was used by my tech for cutting my cuticles was awful. My cuticles were all types of messed up afterwards. During the process I was cut deep and my nail bed would not stop bleeding. (see photo) I was visibly upset, but they wanted to blame it on the cold weather and my "dry skin." I have gotten numerous gel manicures in my life and I know you have to cure the base (at least 2 times), color coats (at least 4-5 times) and then the top coat (at least 2 times). In total at this salon I was only asked to cure my hands 4 times (1 base, 2 color, 1 top) in total. I know this is why it did not cure properly and also why my photos attached show that my manicure didn't even last 5 days.

As a follow up with LL I called and voiced my concerns. I asked for a refund since I paid ($40) for a gel manicure that didn't even last one week. In the alternative I asked for a store credit as I was willing to go back for a pedicure (with Nicole only). I was told that they do not do either: No refunds, No store credit. They only offered to fix the nails that were chipped. 

I really wanted to like LL. I know they have talented nail techs as there are reviews that show great experiences. I unfortunately am not one of those and I won't be returning.

Their vegan cheese steak is amazing! The "cheese" is better than real wiz and I think I would prefer this sandwich over a meat cheese steak any day. It's been weeks since I was here and I'm still dreaming of the wiz!!! very chill atmosphere and small. They do serve a minimal amount of alcohol so it is a great place to start your night!

I could say before I tried Isgro's cannoli that while I enjoy a good cannoli, I wouldn't go out of my way to get one. Now I feel as if there is a gravitational pull towards that little bakery, and I have to fight with myself every day, every evening, and sometimes at 2am, to not run down there like my hair's on fire just to get a taste.

You might say, "That's a bit melodramatic for a cannoli, wouldn't you say?"

No. Melodramatic would be declaring through heartfelt sobs that there can be no other cannoli in the world that will satisfy my cannoli desire the way Isgro's cannoli can, and I declare my undying love and dedication... And that would quickly devolve into Awful Romance Territory which is just creepy.

Seriously, though. This is a good cannoli.

Tough to imagine what I paid for breakfast!  Did I say 40 bucks for two 7 year olds?  Oh yes; I had scrambled eggs and toast. It was not a forty dollar breakfast, service , taste or atmosphere. Now, in all fairness, the ppl are great?

Daddy's cakes are better!!!!!

If you are looking for a pure sandwich shop that makes great sandwiches this your place. Their bread is baked fresh and is really good. They also offer a good variety of lunch meats. They also offer delivery but it is for a limited area. In my opinion their food is so much better than subway

Very professional! Melissa was wonderful and helped us with a guest artist we had in town for VooDoo Fest. Could not have asked for a better experience. Highly recommended! They will be my go-to for all New Orleans bookings (we are based in SF).

We were delightfully surprised by Feelings Cafe. They have  great piano bar and court yard to hang out and enjoy a few drinks while waiting for your table.  

The dinning room is very nice and cozy with great selection of art and creative touches to please your eyes.  Once you get seated be prepared to have your taste buds wowed! They've got a great selection of vegetarian/vegan dishes along with a classic New Orleans fair.  

We had the Mushroom Boudin, Beet Salad, Crab Cakes, Soft Shell Crawfish, and the fish of the day.  All of it was fresh and bursting with flavor and spices. Ended the night with the Combination Pie which is half peanut butter pie and french silk pie, YUM!  

Combine all this with a solid wine selection and you'll have a night to remember with your loved one or good friends and family.

Garrett was our driver And was extremely knowledgeable.  he gave us great information on the way to the Plantations.  We went  to Whitney and Oak Alley.  Whitney is from the standpoint of the enslaved. They took oral histories done by the Writers project. these people were actually enslaved as children so it is a totally different perspective. A must see. You will never be the same. Oak Alley is famous for the oaks planted by an unknown settler in the 1700's.

Amazing move from first communication to paying the bill! Responded quickly to emails. Checked in with me about an hour before then again 5 min out. Worked fast and efficiently. Organized clean very very friendly guys who were enjoying their day. Nice big truck. Will use again

Food is good but kind of pricey. Chips and queso is very good. Cleaning woman was very friendly. Lots of options on the menu, but I only went with my daughter and when they told me how much I paid I was very surprised how much it cost for just myself and my four year old to eat there.

Brick two story building with inside access to rooms.  Well built, very quiet, no street noise.  Free onsite parking lot is surrounded by brick wall and gate.  I don't know if they close the gate at night.  After dark, they buzz you in.  Common area for eating, full kitchen and refrigerators for guests.  Weekends there is continental breakfast and coffee.  Water cooler and drink machine.  Exercise room, laundry free if you book in advance.  Room had just what I want and no fluff.   They said they had hair driers, ironing board and iron available at desk.  The beds were comfortable and the A/C chilled it down!  They had our room cool on arrival, great in NOLA when it is 96 degrees and 96% humidity.  There is a TV in the room.  There is an outdoor seating area with tables and chairs.  The two employees I talked to were very nice and helpful.

Wondrous! The staff is delightful and totally conversant with the menu and the well-curated wine list. 

The escargot, tuna tartare, charcuterie platter, spaghetti carbonara, and panna cotta were flawless and incorporated
the chef's original touches.

The space is quite pretty, intimate yet airy  and features work by local artists. 

Very much looking forward to our next visit!

I visited Japan last spring and Yoshimatsu is one of the most authentic Japanese spots I've eaten at. Given they do offer a lot more vegetarian/vegan options than most Japanese restaurants, but that's definitely a plus. Me and my bf had dinner here at 9 pm, and felt the service was a bit rushed. Which is understandable as they closed in an hour. We order quite a few vegan items on the menu, such as seaweed salad, tofu noodle ramen, and several pieces of vegan sushi. Your meal already comes with miso soup.

The seaweed salad was super fresh and had a nice crunch to it.

Tofu noodle ramen had really good flavor considering it was a vegetable based broth, and they are served with a Yam noodle, which is an interesting play on ramen and it works really well.

For sushi we had a classic cucumber roll, the plum & shiso herb roll, and we were feeling adventurers and tried the Natto hand roll. Definitely will never try the Natto again but I recommend trying it for the mouth/taste adventure. Our favorite sushi was the grilled teriyaki zucchini. Hands down the best nigir I've had since I've gone vegan. 


So if you're in the mood for Japanese food or just looking for good veg options, I highly recommend this spot for lunch or dinner!
I didn't love my experience here and thought that the diner food was a touch overpriced for what it was, but hey, they do have a good staff and a good location. Not my top pick for a diner though!
Great food and excellent customer service. I recommend the pork chop (nice cut) and Au Gratin potatoes

Notice the number of 5 star reviews all mentioning "Chris." Does that sound authentic to you? Sounds like somebody got a bunch of friends and associates to fill out yelp reviews for them. 

We spent $2k on a bed with a motorized back. Once it was installed, and we had some problems with the remote, the store offered ZERO help. I could not even hire someone to come out and assist me with it! Beware.

My favorite spot I went to on Frenchman Street. Great Jazz music. You can tell they really love what they do and are amazing at it. Place gets extremely crowded and super hot cause of all the people inside. There aren't really any windows or ventilation inside. Maybe consider having a max capacity at some point? Would make the experience inside so much better. Even with that said, I loved this place and didn't care because the music was great and I had a good time. There was a $5 cover charge to get inside.

They have the best carnitas brritos i have ever tasted here!!!! That says it all... Plus they sell beer what more can you ask for.... Whenever im  in Santa Barbara this is a must stop... Highly recommended...

My husband is excellent for buzz cuts, but our son (who is now 13) wanted to go with a style a little out of my awesome hubby's talents. This past Monday, we were greeted with a smile and no wait by Cara E. She was very sweet, thorough and talented. We were all very pleased with her work!! Thanks, Cara!

I was a huge fan of Saki when they first opened and loved that the food was pretty decent for an all you can eat, made to order dishes. 

After the last few visits I have been getting sick from the food and the smell of the sushi vinegar (overly vinegar rice) makes me gag when it arrives to the table. It sucks but the sushi is pretty much trash now.... I do have to say the kitchen food is still pretty good. 

Sashimi is very limited and they only serve a number per person which sucks for people who can't eat rice or too much carbs. 

Service has been pretty meh... slow and sloppy... overall I probably will not return anymore.
I got the Atlantic Cod sandwich this time, it was delicious and melted in my mouth. The fish wasn't over battered or over fried. And, of course the cheese curds, yum!!

I wanted something nice for my wife's 30th birthday.  I went in the late morning and requested a delivery in the afternoon.  I described the type of flowers I wanted but gave them free reigns as long as my bouqet looked romantic.  The end product was awesome and my wife loved it.  They are very courteous and I felt welcomed in their shop.  Definitely recommended.
I have finally decided enough is enough and I am leaving Penn Medicine and talking everybody I can with me.

I'm not completely sure what all the fuss is about this place.  Fiancé and I joined some friends here for a late dinner and drinks recently and were rather underwhelmed.  For a Thursday evening, the place was hopping, so maybe I'm just missing something.

First, the good.  The ambience is great.  The building is billed as a Tucson historical landmark, and it certainly feels that way.  Several dining areas are adorned with large, ornate wooden furniture that feels ripped out of a Mexican hacienda.  The lights are kept at an acceptably low level - dim enough to lend a romantic feel to one's dinner, but not so low that one feels as though the manager is trying to hide something.  The outdoor patio is nicely landscaped and feels like a refreshing desert oasis.  Finally, the manager(owner?) seems like a friendly, stand-up guy.  When his waitstaff seemed to be put-upon and out to lunch, he was kind, solicitous and made some good wine pairing suggestions.

Unfortunately, the menu doesn't really match the overall experience.  Food is awfully expensive for what you get.  While some of the more adventurous entrees have clearly had some care put in to them, a number of the meals and appetizers have a decidedly store-bought feel to them, and the salads seem to contain an abundance of iceberg lettuce to conceal the fact that they don't have much else going on.

The wine list is anemic, and, at least on the night we were there, the first four wines I tried to order were either out of stock or had been removed from the menu.  When I finally settled on a glass of port for dessert, the price was marked up considerably over what the same glass goes for at Rumrunner's bistro.

Our friends thought the place was the second coming of Christ, but for us, Cushing Street fell short.  I mean, it was ok, and if I had to go there for a work function, I wouldn't put up a stink, but, in the end, I felt like the upscale tone the place sets for itself didn't really live up to it's actual dining experience.

The special line for the unlimited pass is always having mechanical problems. The whole point of that line is so that it can get the customers in and out. Absolutely pointless when it doesn't work. Why am I waiting 5 to 10 minutes to get my car washed? Looking forward to the grand opening of the new one in Speedway.

Definitely the best pizza in the area! Overall in the world of NY style pizza it's a very solid pie. Prices are reasonable and employees are friendly. We gotta get Dave Portnoy out here for a real pizza review though!

Gets the job done.  The tonkotsu chashu ramen is my go to dish here.  The chashu has been not as tender as I remember when it first opened, but it is a solid bowl of ramen nonetheless.

The staff is usually pretty friendly and the ambiance is good.

if i could give 1/2 star or zero stars i would.  this hotel has bad ac. the air conditioners are old and do not cool to below 75.  in fact a night manager told me "they simply don't have the btu's."
**** internet is not strong enough to run netflix, and even has trouble with email.****
the worst: be careful, they accept the lowest priceline bids, then "get you" (steal from your credit card) with incidentals .  though it says pet friendly - it is not - its a trick, don't fall for it.

Disgusting food and unacceptable service. 

Went there after a show in Reno, about midnight, ordered a burger to-go since I was staying there at the El Dorado. The man who took my order said it would be about 10-15 mins and I went to the bar right across the way to wait. After 30 mins, and the people who ordered before me already finishing their food, I went to ask about my food. I was told it was almost ready. I guess the avocados weren't ripe yet so we had to wait for them. I checked again at 45 mins and was told he would go look for it. I asked if we should put out a page over the pa system for a missing burger. 

After 1 full hour and 2 beers at the bar, I went and found my bag waiting there. I asked how long it had been sitting there to which the lovely woman who was working replied "Well when did you order your food?" I told her and she stated "Well then it couldn't have been that long could it?"

I threw my burger in the garbage and will be disputing the charges on my card. To any management who may see this. I hope you're shut down soon.

My server was awesome. .very attentive and helpful!  I love the salad and rolls with cinnamon butter.  Jesus and his kitchen staff are great. My food always comes out well. They have NFL ticket on Sundays,  which is fun!

Visiting the area and thought we'd check it out.  The greeting staff was great, it was a Saturday and very busy but we were told 5-10 minutes was only about 5 min. Immediately got drinks and chips. Took our order quickly and food came out relatively quickly and very hot.  Food quality and quantity was excellent.  Overall great experience and would come back again.
Boswell's ist nicht unbedingt der größte , aber dafür einer der freundlichsten Harley Händler bei denen ich je war. Für die recht kleine Grundfläche ist die Auswahl phänomenal !!

this will not be an eloquent review.   

everything is tasty.  the meat is not dry (take that boodles).  sides are ridiculous good.  nom nom nom.  

seriously.  go there and stuff yourself into a blissful dreamy food coma.   you'll be glad you did.  just wear stretchy pants.

also,  sorry for the all lower case.  damn phone.

This is the closest location to the military base, yet they didn't notify my husband that the USAA (military bank) card he was paying with actually qualified him for discounted prices, no young driver's fee and unlimited mileage. I understand this is a business, but with this issue (and others), their customer service was just detestable.

Go to the Mount Holly location. Same business, different location, HUGE difference. So helpful and professional!

We walked in to be greeted by a wonderful women. She helped us "newbies". She was kind and patient. We decided to get the cinnamon rolls and she moved us up the long line to help us out. Awesome customer service.  She went above and beyond. If we are ever back in town we are coming back.

One of the best meals I've ever had! My boyfriend and I went on Valentine's Day and had a great time. 

We both started out with the lobster bisque which was definitely the best lobster bisque I've ever tried. He ordered the Chilean Sea Bass and I ordered filet mignon with truffle butter and added a lobster tail. I'm usually not even much of a steak person but this one was cooked to perfection! I could literally cut it with a butter knife. The lobster was tender and sweet and served with delicious champagne butter. We got the truffle mac & cheese as our side which was to die for.
We finished off with the peanut butter pie which was good, but very rich! My boyfriend loved it but I could only eat a few bites because it was a little too rich for me.

The service was excellent. It took a little longer to get our food but it was understandable since they were slammed for Valentine's Day. We were seated very close to our reservation time. Our waiter was very nice, informative, and attentive. The guy playing the piano sounded great!

Our bill was $200 for two people but it was well worth the money.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience and I can't wait to go back!
Sometimes the food is amazing and other times it downright sucks.  I have never gone to a restaurant that is so inconsistent.  Do they use several chefs?

I love this place.  All the instructors are so nice and patient and you can tell they love what they do.  I am so hooked I want to go every day now.  I got the 6 months unlimited for like $500 so that's like $85/month, which is half the price of the hot yoga studio in NYC I used to go to.  I live just a few minutes away so it's perfect for me to walk, but parking has never been an issue either.  As cliche as that sounds, this place is changing my life for the better little by little every day.  They now have the 30 days for $30 special so I highly recommend giving it a shot.

I just went to Dr Tupps for the first time, and it was the best eye doctor experience that I've ever had over a lifetime of wearing glasses and contact lenses.  He clearly explained all the tests being performed as well as the results, set me up with vastly improved contact lenses, and made the overall experience a very positive one.   His staff was also great - very helpful in making sure that I was taken care of promptly and doing a fantastic job of helping me choose new frames; as an additional note, I have to say that they have the  best frame selection I ever seen - for a range of different budgets and styles.   I actually found glasses that I am excited to wear because they are just that cool!   I've always been uncomfortable wearing glasses, so it's great to have a pair that are fashionable and actually really suit me.   Two thumbs up!

We are very happy with our new latex mattress and adjustable base.  Chris Podgorski, store manager, and Erik Taber, salesman, did a great job.  For some reason, the delivery men did not take our old mattresses with them at delivery as was specified on our receipt which stated that the old set would be taken away.  Chris was responsive to us when we called the store and also when we came out to the store after the delivery people had failed to take our old mattresses away.  Chris came to our house personally to remove the mattresses.  Chris was very responsive to the problem of the old mattresses being left behind and at all times, was very professional and courteous.  Erik also was very professional and knowledgeable when we were deciding on which mattress to buy.  Our new bed is awesome and we are amazed at how much better we are sleeping now!

Always great food when we go here. On a Saturday night, call ahead seating is a must. This place is always hopping.

Our Server took care of us even though this place was a mad house.

The table side salsa is fantastic as well.

Stop by, you won't be disappointed.

UPDATE 10-3-19

We stopped by for dinner. I had the chili Verde and my wife had the combo plate. Both were fantastic and tasted so good. I left my review at a 4 stars because it took them 25 minutes to get us our food when the place was less than 1/2 full.

The food and table side salsa is still worth the wait.

The owner Carole and the hair-stylist seemed very snobbish and pretentious. I hated the vibe there. Also, they are extravagantly expensive and my cut and colour were very mediocre. I much rather prefer Aveda on Whyte Ave - they're  much more reasonable priced and do a better job. For my haircut, i wanted some layers in the front but the hairstylist insisted on a totally blunt cut and i'm not keen on it at all. It doesn't suit me and i wish she had just given me the haircut i wanted. As for the highlights, i wanted them started higher up and the hairstylist didn't bother doing it the way i asked her to.  

All in all, not worth the money. There are better places out there that are reasonable and do a better job. Finally verdict: Nothing impressive - Failed to live up to the hype created about it online.

Cool place to attend!! Especially the art fair!!! I really enjoyed myself.
