Great, fresh, and healthy food! One of my favorite places to go when I am downtown! I love the wraps and flatbreads.

I love this place! I feel like I could spend hours here and look at every item. I can find things here that I can find anywhere else. My kids loves when I go to the Orient Market because it means treats for them. I also found that they are the home of the amazing Baguette Deli. I came on a Saturday for the first time today and I was almost giddy. The fresh fish and produce and the delicious eggrolls. It very well may be my favorite place to be on Saturday morning.

I've been here a couple of times for chemicals.

I had no idea how to take care of our jacuzzi and these guys were the best in explaining everything and giving instructions!

Excellent customer service, which is very appreciated!

Overall friendly staff and good convenient location.

You can trust these guys to help you out with your pool or jacuzzi related questions.
The service is horrible!  The hostess refused to take our name and was incredibly rude.

Truly fantastic French and Italian gourmet Sandwiches.  The side salad that comes with the $9 lunch sandwich (say, Hot Fresh mozzarella, imported salami and pesto) is huge, fresh and tasty too.  Great soups.  Incredible cheese plates.  Some French staff too.  In a great Uptown spot, with nice patio.

We are very disappointed with the quality of service we received.  The pool is well built but after 5 months from promised delivery we still do not have a cover.  After numerous calls and complaints we are always told that the cover is in customs.  Very disappointed and  would never recommend the business.

Jackie Turek and team were fantastic. She had a meeting with my wife on a Friday to determine what we are looking for in a house and then the very next day gave us a list of houses to look at. So there we go looking at houses that day. Just by luck, we were in a new housing area. Jackie asked the office if they had any houses ready to move in. They had one and we fell in love with it. We walked around the community and Jackie would ask people that were walking about the school in that community. She put us at ease the whole time and made sure we were informed during the whole process. The whole Duncan Duo team was very professional and nice. If you are in the market to buy a house please reach out to Jackie Turek at the Duncan Duo Team, you will not regret it.

We love Mister Gregory's! They serve simple and fresh food in an inviting and quaint environment. The staff is very friendly. When in New Orleans, definitely stop by for some great food and a homey relaxed atmosphere.

Food we ate there over several visits:
Congo Square
Jamon
Croquet madame
French market waffle
Salmon, brie, capers french loaf
Jamon beurre loaf
Potato salad
Dolmas

All delicious!!! We will return.
Best burger ever!! Great customer service and very clean. Would def go back again. Had the company burger with bacon and egg. Love it. And those fries are the freshest tasting fries ever.

Awesome neighborhood nail place! Very clean and I feel like you get your money's worth! A pedi is $25, butttttt they also massage your feet and legs. I've gone to places and paid that and got just the pedi, no lil' extras like Tiffany's throws in! They also give you a back rub while you wait for your nails to dry!

Service has really slipped at this Chili's. Seated in the bar area not more a few people in the restaurant or bar area. Bartender/waiter really struggled with the few people here.  Ask to give us "a" minute waited another ten as he past our table 10-12 times. Literally had to shout his name 5-6 times to get his attention. Wife's food (app and main) came first. Nothing for me. Then 4-5 minutes later my main came out. NO APP???? Had to ask "where's my app?  Isn't the app called a starter because it should "start" your meal. They totally forgot it. Holly molly, where is the garlic bread that supposed to come with my meal. Had to ask for that to. Service is just going to have to step up if everyone under the sun want $15an hour and food cost continue to rise.

yaaaaas!
I don't think there are many Indian places in the santa barbara area- yet alone in Goleta. So this is pretty exciting.
I've been craving indian food so we decided to give Masala a try. The space is a bit small but its clean, inviting and nicely decorated.
Ryan and I got Biryani, butter chicken and naan to share. Everything was so delicious!!
I had to knock off some points for prices, it's a bit more expensive than i'd like plus the service was iffy.
We waiting far longer than we needed to. Ryan and I are definitely understanding but we waiting a while to even put our order in.

For anyone wanting to try Indian food- go for it! I know people are iffy about curry but butter chicken or tikka masala is NOT a strong curry taste, i highly recommend to start there!
West Bay Tap House** Place is looking better and better. Service is great, 40+ on tap, and they now have liquor!! Highly recommend checking them out

Service is good but UPS pricing over 50.00 for a package that was no more than 3 lbs to be shipped ground. Shipping was more than contents. 

Will be using USPS from now on. Would rather help save USPS than make the CEO of this outfit even more rich.

BEST FOOD EVER. The entire table couldn't believe how amazing everything was. We went for breakfast and I had the vegan bearcat plate with a side of grits. Amazing. Every time I go to Nola now I'm making time to have a meal here.

It's not nearly as bad as people make it out to be. Lived at 235 south 15 for two years. PMC is good about dealing with issues. Harry, Kenny, and Bob do a fantastic job. 

This has nothing to do with PMC, but the buildings are old and the tenants are horrible, we had multiple packages stolen. Again, It has nothing to do with PMC, they do a good job.

Arrived about 3PM for a late lunch and was delighted with the service and the food. I started with the lobster bisque, very flavorful and rich, We ordered ribs for my GF which she described as "great". I had the salmon on a cedar plank, cooked just right with veggies for sides. The staff was very helpful, especially Vaughn, the bartender who served us. The decor was appropriate for the theme. They have an outdoor patio that looked very nice. We will definitely return to try more of the menu.

Went for the first time Friday and will be back again next week. I was impressed with our waiter, who explained the menu well and answered our questions on pronunciation -- even allowing us to sample something we didn't order but were interested in. The design of the sushi bar was reminiscent of a Wes Anderson movie -- not necessarily germane to how the food tasted, but certainly contributed to the overall vibe -- making it feel like a dining experience. 

Especially for week one, was very impressed, and will be back for more soon. Welcome to the neighborhood!

All I can say is WOW. This place has the hands down best Italian food I have had in Florida. So beautiful inside and the staff is amazing. I like when I don't know something about the menu and someone can help without making me feel weird. Can't wait to go back. Trust me if you like real home cook Italian meal check it out.

I am in love!  I can be pretty picky about my Italian food since my mother is a fabulous cook, however this place takes the cake!  From the homemade pasta, to the creaminess of their sauces, to the very delicate and delicious calamari; it is just superb all around. 

The food:  Items I have tried there are the fried calamari with the sweet and spicy chili sauce, the pescatore, gorgonzola chicken, sachetti milano, and the grilled vegetable lasagne.  I would recommend ANY of these items, however if it is your first there definitely get something with pasta.  It is homemade and out of this world.  This last time I went I tried the gorgonzola chicken and feel in love.  It is going to be difficult for me to switch and try something new the next time I am there.  My dining guests ordered the pescatore and were notified before ordering that they were out of mussels but would make up for it by adding additional seafood of the customers choice.  We agreed that was no problem at all because it is good to know they would only have this food item in stock if it was fresh, and they are not keeping a back up supply frozen. 

Parking: plenty of on street parking, but if you park in the lined spaces back in the space; I believe it is a rule in that part of Conshohocken.

I would highly recommend putting in a reservation because it is a small place, however BYOB which is a nice touch.  Do no be discouraged by the prices because it is all worth it.  Huge portions with great quality food that is only matched in awesome small Italian places in Philly.

This is a popular park in a great neighborhood. 

It looses a star because lately it's been crowded by bench-possessive homeless folks. 

Over the past few years I've seen this park swing back and forth between a dog happy park with acrobats practicing and a park where people go to buy and sell hard drugs.

I'm giving it 4 stars because I like to think of it during its best times...
Fun atmosphere with multiple experiences on each level of the building. Doesn't make 5 stars because I wasn't overly impressed. Definitely a good place to visit, eat, relax, or party.

This vineyard is a great find in the heart of Bucks county! Staff is extremely friendly and provide you good advice if new to wine pairing. On this property there are picnic tables outside where you can sit outside and have wine or wine slushi in the summer months. Pack some food and make a day out of your visit.

The morning manager (female) of the Speedway on Indian Rocks Rd N, Belleair Buffs/Largo, FL appears to be a hard worker? But one thing for sure. She's one of the most bad mannered and impolite managers, or person for that matter, I've ever dealt with. She lacks basic skills to interact with the public. I'm done patronizing all Speedways.
Excellent food, warm and friendly service, and big portions for a good price.  The etouffe, BBQ shrimp, and seafood and okra gumbo were all really good.

We checked out this thrift shop while on our way to pick out some furniture for my boyfriend's new apartment & I'm really glad we stopped in. They have a huge selection of clothing for both men & women & have great sales with them today - the day we stopped in all blue tagged clothing was just $1. But they also have a pretty decent selection of furniture. If we had a truck to transport it, we probably would've gone home with this glass top dining set, a leather love seat, & a couple of side tables. But since we already had something paid for & held elsewhere, we had to save the space in his SUV for those. We'll definitely be back though, especially since shopping there helps out with HIV testing & prevention so it's nice to know our dollars will go even further at a place like this.

Barbacoa taco was the best thing I ate on vacation! All the tacos and tamales were delicious. The service was also great! Very friendly staff. I also enjoyed the atmosphere, it was casual without being too cheap.
You MUST try the 'Ugly' steaks. Yes, that's what they're called and they are delicious. We never get any other steaks now :) Uglies all the way.

Had a thanksgiving feast with the family! Started with delicious fresh oysters followed by a delicious chefs cut with a lobster tail that was to die for. The family ordered the thanksgiving special with the best esquites (mexican street corn)  EVER! Finished it off with pumpkin flan and peanut butter chocolate tres leches! This is the best spot in town. We will definitely be back! Thank you Anthony great service!!!

Happy to have some very good standard Indian so close to us! Just picked up lunch which was a good deal (and they were kind enough to throw in some complimentary dal). Hope to see them survive, it must be hard to open during SIP - welcome to the neighborhood! We had:

lamb korma - finally a korma in the city that isn't to sweet! loved it. 
coconut chicken curry - loved this one's deep flavor and will get next time instead of the tikka masala - definitely has visible fine shredded coconut in the sauce
palak paneer - good flavor but texture was more pureed than we are used to, would still order again
chicken tikka masala - our only miss: too sweet for my taste 
garlic naan - so good! lots of fresh garlic and ghee, thin but tender and bubbly, looked just like the main picture posted.
mango lassi - not too sweet, packed perfectly to withstand carryout

Good place , I coming here all the time 
The best nail spa in area
I do padikor , they very professional here

I had the best and easiest experience ever!! sales agent Edo Valdimar went above and beyond to make sure I was getting what I wanted at the fairest price. I am LOVING my 2014 Mazda CX5 and I feel awesome knowing that the people who work there is people like me... local people WHO CARE about their clients and are smart enough to keep us happy to keep us coming ;) I just had to share the good experience to you all readers !

I had heard so many great things about this place from may friends. We arranged a party of 6 on a busy Saturday night . Cafe Poca Cosa makes a great impression from the moment I entered. More a Mexican restaurant in San Francisco than Tucson. The staff is super friendly almost to a fault. The only problem is for someone like myself who has a very small apatite and a vegetarian too boot this is not the best place. They only serve large entrees and only one was vegetarian. So that was my only choice on the menu. While my friends raved about their food I was brought a $19 plate of corn mush covered in a refired bean sauce. The corn mush was somewhat tasty but overall not worth the price or the hype. My suggestion would simply to offer a wider variety of entrees it would be easy enough to add a couple salad offerings. Overall I would not come back because it is so limited.

Delicious.

Pro-tip: if there's a long line, call in a take out order and go to a bar across the street to have a drink. Come back 45 minutes later, pick up and take out.

This place is strange.  It's a hair salon that sells used furniture and tacky clothing/accessories.  It like a thrift store, garage sale, meets Bijoux Turner, red hat society, oh and by the way there is a salon too, concept simply doesn't work for me.  While I liked the stylist and they have great wash sinks the gal in the shop is soo pushy.  She tries to push these horrible accessories down your throat.  There is NOTHING in that shop I would consider buying!  But inevitably you have to wait for your stylist upon arrival and they want you to buy their crap while you wait.  I gave 2 stars because of the stylist otherwise I would give zero!

As a young blonde female, many automotive repair shops in the area have tried to rip me off. Unfortunately, this is one of those places. I came in for a smog check and Gaspar told me that I "almost passed" but needed to drive my car all the way to Goleta to test it out. After I returned about 25 minutes later, he told me with a chuckle that "I had great timing because he was about to head home" even though he promised to wait for me to come back . 

He failed my smog and charged me $45, telling me I can come back another time but he would charge a $25 retest fee...even though most other places offer free retests! 

I did not make any repairs on my vehicle (my check engine light is fickle and that is why Gaspar failed me) but it turned off on its own and I passed my smog at a different repair shop. I strongly recommend Pedro Smog on Salinas. Great service, I was in and out in 10 minutes without an appointment. I do not recommend getting ripped off at Gaspar's shop.
It's a nice casino, a little dark on the lighting. The sports bars fill up quickly on game days with reservations. A nice variety of games to play.

Had the Pleasure of meeting the owner and he did my nails,SNS  process and he was wonderful! I usually don't converse when having my nails done, but he was cool, nice, sweet and a GOOD CRAZY.. I definitely know I'll be back!! Also very clean, updated , and relaxing salon and spa!! Thanks Kayla
Pizza was burnt.. I understand that sometimes it happens with wood burning, but it was not edible... Staff could care less when I complained... Plenty of other places around the area...
Great place, awesome service, large beer selection and fair price on menu items.  Cubano sliders are very tasty

15 minutes!  That's how long it took these guys to put on a whole new tire and then check and put air in all the others.  I walked in without an appointment and was back out on Washington Street at  8:15 -- with a discount for cash to boot.  Plus they were clear, friendly, and helpful on the phone when I first called; how often can you say that about car repair guys?
Found this randomly while traveling.  Damn good burger and cucumber salad.  Nice beer list with eclectic variety.

May be the food is good, but it is impossible to try it. I've been calling them for about a month to make a reservation. Left voice massages, no one picks up the phone and returns vms. "Nice" treatment of prospective customers?

Mr. Mitchell was prompt and very throughough.  He  got the report to me almost immediately.  The pictures of the problem areas were very clear. His explanations were easy to understand.  i would definitely use him again, especially since I will be trying to buy another house in the area.
Wax + wine gives a homey industrial feel. The owner is very personable and is willing to answer any and all questions. Excellent atmosphere and great experience!

We like the facility .
Tiny gin and tonic mostly ice . Average Martinis, Joes nachos almost awful mostly small broken chips from the bottom of the bag . It was happy hour and we got overcharged by $10 and had to get the bill corrected . We are local and and this restaurant goes to the bottom of our list of the 4 or 5 restaurants nearby .The parking was forced valet parking which is unusual for the area .

Love the food! Everytime I go I usually get a burger. But the past couple times I went I had HORRIBLE service. We walked in and they told us to sit where ever. Our server came by and got our drink order. Before he left I asked him If I could try a sample if the soup. It took him 7 minutes to bring out 2 waters with lemon. When he arrived with our drinks he still didn't have the sample I asked for. I asked him 1 more time and then we placed our orders. He finally brought out a sample and didn't come back to ask if I wanted to purchase some. After finding him I told him that we wanted 2 cups of soup. They were very good and came out in a timely manner. Our food took longer than normal but we didn't mind. Before our food came I asked for some more water. After a couple minutes, our food came out, still no water. I asked him again. After 10 minutes of no water and me having to share a drink with my boyfriend, we finally went up to the bar and asked for some. He came by and dropped off the checks. And didn't have anything else to say. Since he didn't introduce himself at the beginning, I looked at the ticket to see his name. It was under "Tom Cruise" as a joke. We heard his name mentioned by someone else and then knew who he was. We left as soon as we could. Just a few more mistakes: didn't offer desserts, didn't offer Togo boxes, didn't check and see if we were enjoying our food, didn't introduce himself, and barely made conversation. The worst of all is that there were only a couple of 2 tops in the restaurant. And most of the time I could see our server in the kitchen playing on his phone. I will definitely not be returning and will tell everyone about my experience.

Yep! I owe NOLA this review. I love Legacy Kitchen and the NOHSC Brand that it's under. BUT, BUT, BUT.....for being in a downtown NOLA hotel, you have to step your game up. The city was flooded today with people like me taking advantage of NOLA Museum Day. That means locals and tourist and then some. My son and I came in for coffee and beignets rather than going to Cafe Du Monde, regrets! I got a different order from what I asked for. I also got my coffee creamer brought to me by a half gallon of milk to my table! Really guys?! And please let me add in that I passed 4 people before I was acknowledged because I stopped him to ask him for help........
I just had a cup of coffee and it wasn't very good.  I'm giving it a 3 because the girl working was nice.

This place really has their act together. The wait is long on a busy Saturday - mid-morning - but for what we experienced, it was well worth it. While waiting we did order some coffees from their counter. 

Everyone around the table enjoyed their orders as they were all well-executed. My son and I shared the croissant French toast along with the omelette of the day which had chicken sausage and sun dried tomatoes. Both were very good. I was happy to find out they also serve alcohol and made a decent Bloody Mary.
Please do yourself a favor and get the lychee bubble tea and get it with the lychee jellies!!! Yay!!

I've travel for a living. 

This is the best airport in the US. Hands Down.

Not a soul in here on Mother's Day.  $17 bucks for a less than a 10-minute haircut.  Didn't cut it very even across the front and used the clippers too closely on the back.  

I guess it is nice that they give you a free 30-day guarantee to touch up the sides/back but I would rather just have a quality haircut instead.

Guess if you don't have an appointment and need a place upon on Sundays this fits the bill.    Quest for a quality barber in St. Louis continues.

Last week I was hesitant to paid $99 for a detail inside & out, after almost 2 hours my truck was immaculate! However when u was about to leave I noticed my expensive floor mats were missing, no biggie, I asked for them & they brought them back to me. I got hm & realized my $100 car charger was missing as well, so I called them back & the receptionist said the cleaner wasn't in until later, she never called back. I called again & her excuse was the cleaner wasn't back till thur & she'd call me back then. Of course I never got a call back, so I called the manager & amazingly the very next day my charger miraculously appears. 
Check your stuff before & after you leave, or take your stuff out. They've lost my business, so stupid!

Zona always does an excellent job. The decor is relaxing and somewhat elegant but without a hint of pretentiousness.  The staff is attentive, courteous, and well trained. The menu is varied and everything I've had has been delicious. The cilantro humus is amazing, the cheeses they use for their pizzas and other foods are terrific. The wine and beer menu extensive. The prices are very reasonable.

So I went to Mexico this past May and, to tell you the truth, I still don't feel like I'm qualified to comment on the authenticity of Mexican food.  That said, I'm pretty sure Las Margaritas uses American cheese in their dishes, so... maybe not so authentic?  I really don't give a damn though, because the food is still super yummy.  My go to meal is the jumbo crab burrito.  It's freaking huge.  Kind of pricey, I think it's $16-$18, but I've never gotten any less than 3 full meals out of it.  Especially since I usually fill up on chips and salsa before the meal comes out.  

This place probably isn't somewhere worth going out of your way for, but it has a special place in my heart.  If you're around, stop in.  I hear the margaritas are a-okay!

First time for me and wow the service was great everyone was super friendly and the restaurant was very nice in general. The food was excellent the only downside is the portion was small compared to how the price was. If it wasn't for that I would give it 5 stars.

My lady got us a gift certificate for an hour of horseback riding on the trail. We had a tour guide to show us lead us around the property and taught us how to ride the horses and made sure we were comfortable. The horses were easy to ride and the trail had a beautiful scenery with snow sprinkled all over the trees and grass. It was also really cool to experience feeding them carrots. I'm surprised at how smart and sweet the horses were. I would recommend this place to anyone who loves nature and animals.
food was amazing. everyone was super nice and welcoming. I got "the kernel" and those biscuits are literally the best one ive had. thank you!

Decent quick lunch place. We tried nearly every taco and decided the chicken and beef were the best. We originally ordered 6 tacos but ended up with 7 which we were also charged for. Service was quick and food was hot. 

I gave them 3 stars because I felt they should have listened to our order better and that, for the amount of tacos were ordered, there should have been a better ratio of truly enjoyable tacos to "meh" tacos.

The food is fantastic! Get the guacamole appetizer--it's to die for! They make it fresh at  the table. The chips are also fresh and pretty light. I enjoyed the salsas--one was spicy and smoky, the other was tasty and mild. I had the tacos de fajita--steak tacos. Delicious. I also had the ginger mint mango 'rita (actually two). You won't go wrong with this restaurant if you enjoy the flavors of Mexican food but don't like heavy lard-laden food.

I'm very confused by the high reviews at this place because I had a HORRIBLE experience. I made an appointment (since I was told they were required) for an oil change and tire alignment. I was told the service would only take an hour and a half (which I felt was a tad long). I arrived at 11 (because the receptionist said coming early wouldn't be a problem) and my car wasn't touched until 1:15. Why? That is still a mystery to me seeing that there were three others technitians.  Ultimately, this place carried on with a very low sense of urgency, do you want business or not? I had other things to do besides waiting for three hours for an oil change. Won't be back for service. The manager/owner real needs to pay attention to his staff. Ridiculous.

Seeking a good dinning experience, we found ourselves outside Deanie's looking in the windows at how crowded it was, should we wait?  It had good reviews, so why not. Once inside, our names on the list, it was a short wait.  

We place our drink orders and then an appetizer, the lump crab remolaude.  It was really good.  For my entree I ordered the crab quartet, it included crabmeat au gratin, stuffed crab, fried soft shelled crab and fried crab claws.  It also came with french fries and coleslaw.  It was a lot of crab, but it was all very good.  

Our service was good, the food was good and there was plenty of it.  During our dinning experience, "Santa" came strolling through, talking with every table, posing for pictures, holding babies, etc... I don't know if he was hired by the restaurant or was simply a regular.  (my nieces came to New Orleans during the summer and he was strolling up Bourbon street in shorts).  

Overall, a good dinning experience.

If I could give this place no stars I most diffently would. I went here to buy crawfish, turkey necks, pig feet, boiled shrimp, snow crab, crabs, corn, sausage, and pasta; I basically bought the whole store and the food was sub-par, mediocre, and that's putting it nicely. Everything I ordered was OVERCOOKED, their crawfish was not fresh and was visible old and hard. I spent almost 200 dollars to eat good seafood and this was diffently not it. I'm completely upset because I spent a lot of money on food I barely touched because it was not good and OVERCOOKED. I WILL NOT BE BACK HERE AGAIN, and I suggest people look somewhere else to get their seafood because you will not be satisfied here. And in NO WAY am I asking for a refund or my money back, I just will not be back to any of their locations ever again.


I HAD AN ENTIRE BEATLE IN MY BAG OF CRAWFISH. I'm DISGUSTED AND WILL BE CALLING THEM IN THE MORNING. 

EAT HERE IF YOU WANT BUGS IN YOUR FOOD. THIS A DISGUSTING ESTABLISHMENT. THEY NEED THE HEALTH INSPECTORS CALLED ASAP..

Wow there are a lot of old people here during the day. Lol So the place is massive, I expect there to be a ton of people after church. The place is served cafeteria style where you grab a tray and you walk down the food assembly line. I went safe and got the fried chicken, the chicken was nice and juicy but was a tad bland. The Mac and the stuffing were abysmal. The strawberry pie was nice, the strawberries were nice and sweet and the dough was light and crisp. http://www.yelp.com/user_local_photos?select=Li23ohUnVqBhzZ3K5z5VpQ&userid=Y_iTTjKvV5hLy-880SZzlA
Saw Tom Segura here...It was fine. Everything that was said about the bench type seats is on point. I'd still see another show there, though.

A lot of Greek food places are popping up around the area, most of them chain places.  Food dished out of bins, etc. This little restaurant is a gem! Their salads are fresh and delicious and huge. Their chicken Cesar salad is enough for two people to split. My husband loves the traditional village salad, and the gyros are also well made and delicious. They have daily specials and some regular sandwiches and burgers too. Try this place for takeout or dine in their indoor/outdoor areas. And try the Spinach pie!

Dateline: March 15, 2012 7:30 PM.  The succulent taste of "burned" lettuce was all about a recycled sandwich. Nothing says quality like an overpriced sandwich in the first place, but when you ask for the restaurants incorrect preparation to be corrected to conform with my original order and their first repair attempt is a new sandwich (other than the type originally ordered) and they go for a second attempt to correct the order and your original error sandwich is then rescued from the error bin and brought out after a trip through the crematorium, well, its kinda hard to figure. As sandwich numero tres arrived I had to take pictures of it. The lettuce on my "Real Club" was singed like burned hair and large swaths of lettuce were actually coal black. The sandwich got shoved under a broiler and it was ruined. I pointed out the error of the personnel and  the food counter managere du jour informed me that the only way to prepare my sandwich as toasted was to broil it. As a recent former loyal customer of this establishment, I can advise I have had approximately thousands of this particular sandwich for more years than the dolt de jour has roamed the earth living his dream. I have had zee sandwich prepared the same way each time. The dropping of bread into a toaster is not high art and it is easily accomplished. In the past my order has always been somewhat correct. But when zee dolt attempts to urinate on my back and then to inform me that it is but rain, this does not bode well for a person, much like myself, who don't play that game. But what is one to do. I have paid, and I have disassembled my twice served "urn" sandwich and recovered 2/3'ds from the whole that is fit to eat. But for my schedule, I should have ignored it, left it intact and left. At least tonight I shall be charcoal filtered. May I use good sense and avoid this establishment for the rest of my twisty life.

I dropped off my dry cleaning 3 weeks ago. Today go to pick up and am missing a pair of pants. I guess they needed to be sent to wet clean? I wasn't told it would take longer and I think 3 weeks would be plenty of time? So I agree to pick them up later. I was then informed I had to pay for them? even though they weren't in my possession?
The somewhat almost completely rude girl told me that that's how they did it. couldn't get the rest of my stuff with out paying for everything including missing pants. No manager to talk to, don't know if ill get them back? don't know what's wrong with them? If they needed to be sent out why wouldn't they have called and said that. Poor customer service and I think I just donated cash for missing pants. I will not bring my stuff to this very expensive I only go there cause they're green cleaners again..  Lets see if my pants come home.. Part 2..

Incredibly awesome service by people who know what they're doing.  Even had them fix some Oliver Peoples sunglasses that had gotten bent and now longer fit my face. 5 min, no charge, and I finally have sunglasses that fit!

This is definitely the best place on *Main Street*. There are better wine bars and restaurants in other parts of Philly but this is the best in Manayunk. 

I've been here a bunch of times and I keep ordering the same thing because I enjoy it so much. Here are my typical go-to's:

Starter: The charcuterie board is great appetizer.

Entree: Spicy meatball pizza...this is a MUST. It's my favorite pizza in Manayunk. 

Dessert: Ice cream taco. It's absolutely delicious. 

Drinks: They have a decent wine list. I usually go for the Pinot Grigio or Riesling. 

All food aside, the ambience is also great. It's cozy and  classy, great spot for date night. I usually like to sit by the big window when it's nice outside. Service is always good and the food comes out fast.

Orders: Oat Milk Dirty Chai / Pumpkin Spice Latte | Quiche!

This is one of my favorite coffee shop/brunch spots in Reno! Located inside an old Victorian house on Ralston right near Downtown & the University, this cutesy spot offers a good sized pretty patio as well as covered porch & indoor seating. Such great vibes & service always! Oh and FOOD! And drank. Everything I've had there has been obviously been made with great care & ingredients. No detail is overlooked - even the bathroom is gorgeous! Highly recommend you check it out :))

Ps you can preorder seasonal pies & stuff for events. When I grow up, I'll be doing this for sure
Excellent latte!  The Classic egg sandwich with ham and cheese is too salty.  If you watch your salt intake,  skip the ham.  Friendly and prompt service.

Took awhile but I finally found a donut shop in St. Louis that I really like. I've been here a couple times now and the selection is always great. Not too busy and the staff is very friendly. Excellent prices for quality of donut as well. This place is a must try if you find yourself in town.
Always a great place to go to meet great friends... and i lovvvvve their chips and salsa, its a must have :)

First time in since they changed from Sunrise Nails.  Very nicely updated and a lot of employees.  I opted for a hot stone pedicure.  It wasn't busy when I arrived but got busier after she started my pedicure.  I felt she really rushed my pedicure as it got busier.  I paid for the most expensive pedicure which includes a hot stone massage.  I have had these same pedicures at other salons and it is usually an hour start to finish.  This one was 30 minutes.  Very, very disappointed.  The nail tech never said 2 words to me the whole time but spoke to the nail tech next to us in Chinese which I find very disrespectful.  I will not be back.

I'm really confused with the positive reviews for this place. The food was decent, but the portions were not impressive. The Mac n cheese side was smaller than the size of my palm. The corn bread was surprisingly small as well. My boyfriend ordered the brisket and was really disappointed with how petite the portion was. Same with my bbq chicken. It tasted good, but definitely wasn't worth the money. The service was pretty bad too. We showed up about an hour before close and were rushed out. Not cool. I'm a server as well, so I'm understanding, but we had to ask for bbq sauces and were checked on only once. I wouldn't go back here and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.
Heard about this Latin place and gave it a try during lunch. Loved the buffet selection -but not much of a fan of the steak Cuban sandwich. But definitely coming back to try other items. Thank you.
Super delicious! If you're a whore for hot chicken and waffles, this is your dream. Pretty busy but service was still very good, not too loud and nice environment. Would totally come here again

LOVE the instructors here, and the specific focus the entire gym has- everything here is for better weightlifting, learning weightlifting, and increasing your fitness so you can... lift better, and be healthier. 
The facility is a large old, maze, and the equipment is mostly outdated, but still functional. It's not going to be the most modern place, or prettiest, but they make do with what they have and the instructors here all pay close attention to form, regardless of who or what class I've been in.
Bob is a spirit animal unlike any other, I love his Dad jokes and he is super motivating- thank you for reminding me no one else is going to look out for my butt! :)

The crepes here were amazing!!! A friend and I shared one savory and one sweet crepe and split them. So delicious. The rating isn't perfect because the staff is a little weird. One older server kept giving us weird looks and they got our drink orders wrong at first. Would definitely come back for the food despite the weird vibe.

I don't know if it was te breeze/smell off of the lake, the perfect weather, or the vibe but Station 6 manages to serve delicious New Orleans-style food in a Caribbean/Floridian straight up cabana. 

The soft shell crab was amazing. The bread pudding was heaven. The oyster pasta was delicious and just the right serving size. The crawfish and spinach dip was a little small but that's alright. 

We'll probably do another couple of rounds to try the rest of the menu but it'll probably make the rotation when friends visit.

My Yelp and IRL buddy Kelley B lives down the street from Tired Hands Fermentaria. I was in Ardmore for an event and a few of us headed over afterwards for some food and a beer. 

Tired Hands Fermentaria is a really big space. It was a good deal larger then what I imagined. It has a pretty cool industrial chic design also. Our party of 9 was seated quickly enough and our server was attentive. Kelley B. was not in attendance, she was with her plus one in Colorado. Imagine that.

Their beer selection is awesome and varied. I ordered the Forced Harmony: "Oak Fermented Berliner Weisse 4.6%.   first offering from the Dispensary, our all oak fermentation facility! Composed of barley, wheat, oats, and a touch of rye. Fermented quite warm using an expressive mixed culture with a focus on a bright and citrusy lactobacillus presence." I really enjoyed this beer and it sure tasted great on a hot day.

I also  tried the Fish Tacos and as other reviews on Yelp have mentioned, they were very good and also light without being greasy. The rest of the menu looked really interesting also. I'll have to try to visit my friend Kelley more often so I can go to Fermentaria again.

4 Yelp Stars, more if they were closer to Cherry Hill.

I was very disappointed on my recent visit (Aug 10, 2018). Too my family for dinner at this location. When entering the grill & seating area was filled with smoke! Do the grill exhaust fans work?  The floors were sticky and looked like they had not been mopped in several months.  Table tops the sticky to the touch. food and wait staff was OK, but not as good as it had been in the past.  The location need to be closed for a good cleaning. If the front of the restaurant is that bad, wonder what the kitchen area is like? Does the Manager not see this?  I will not go back until I see a good Yelp review.   Sardar Biglari - you need to get on a plane and visit this location
Kristin is a magician! Her salon is always a fun time with lots of laughs! She is one talented wizard and can do anything.

This is a mixed review for this hotel.  I was in St Petersburg for a week and due to an unexpected situation needed to find a hotel very fast.  I found this hotel on St Pete's Beach and it was reasonably priced.  My room had two queen beds that were comfy to sleep on, a shower/tub, table and two chairs and a desk as well as a microwave and small fridge.  There was also a balcony, which was very nice to sit on in the morning for my coffee, although it overlooked the parking lot.  The room was pretty tattered and could really use some freshening up and TLC.  The walls, doors and carpets were in pretty rough shape but there were no unpleasant smells and overall the room seemed clean. 
Now for the bad news- The first day I was there I was in my room for about 20 minutes with the sliding window open.  I looked by the bed and saw a huge cockroach.  I'm not sure if it was in the room or if it came in through the door but- YUCK!  I was pretty creeped out at that point and considered trying to find another place to stay.  I didn't see anymore roaches or bugs in my room after that incident-but it did leave me with a bad feeling about my room especially at night when the lights were out.  I kept all my food in the small fridge and left the bathroom light on as I didn't want to go in the bathroom in the middle of the night turn on the light and see a big roach.  
The nicest part of the hotel was that it was right on the beach and attached to the Toasted Monkey, which is one of St. Pete's best beach bars.  The pool was glorious as well.  So all in all if I hadn't had to deal with the bug I'd give them 3 stars-mostly for the location and the price.
I ordered take out for the first time and I'm back again!   I had the dry rub ribs, baked beans and slaw.  It was very tasty!!!

Quaint little diner. I had high hopes for a new breakfast spot. The food presentation was visually appetizing.  And it would have been enjoyable had the food not been served cold.  It was not crowded, yet the waitstaff had a difficult time managing the tables. It has promised if they work out management.

HORRIBLE. Would rate one star if possible. I went here Friday night again for a few drinks before i walked home. I live one block away. That is the ONLY reason why i came into this place. From all the experiences I have had  none where good.  I only had one drink maybe two tops and was charged 136$. (clearly something is wrong). The original receipt  doesn't say that amount. The bartender either helped her wallet with a huge tip. (she didn't even deserve one at all). I always tip 20 percent regardless, but this chick obviously has issues going on in her personal life or head. That she needs to leave at the door before coming into work. I wish I got her name but she refused to give it to me.  VERY rude, ugly, and obviously ignored me the whole time. The total charge just went through my bank account. I'm not sure how the original amount turned into such a high amount. I already contacted my bank. Also, I have contacted my lawyer. (who is my father who practices corporate law here in Nashville). I have left many messages with no reply. I will be there first thing in the morning at opening 11am to contact the manager.  I have my original receipt from the place  and bank account statement regarding the charge.
Exactly what where you want to be for any sporting event! Great food! Great drinks! Great service! The best wings in the city without a doubt.

Classic Sonoran taqueria in South Tucson. I want to like this place so bad - awesome menu with a variety of meat options, burritos, tacos, caramelos, hot dogs, etc plus a well stocked salsa bar with almost all the accompaniments you could want (only missing some grilled onions and jalapeños ;) . It's a similar layout to El Guero Canelo with inside and outside seating and has a similar menu. They also have the option of adding cheese, mushrooms, green chilies, and onions to a variety of menu items - score. However, Tacos Apson is just a little too "greasy spoon" for my taste. 

Unfortunately, the food wasn't great. Upon first glance at my carne asada burrito, I could tell the whole thing was just soaking in grease. I could only get through half of it before giving up because it was overwhelmingly greasy. I saw the plates of a few other patrons as well, and their tacos and burritos were equally if not more greasy and messy... Now I know street food is notoriously known for being unhealthy, but this was beyond what I've ever seen... Maybe it was an off day or bad timing, but I'm not sure I'd want to go back :/

Was not overly impressed with the customer service here. We came early one morning, but there was no line behind us. The lady at the counter was training a new employee and made me feel rushed and she was a bit rude. Because she was so consumed with getting us through she didn't take the time to listen to me ask for light cream cheese on both bagels. I usually go to a different location, I think I'll be going back there for now on.

Great reminder why I never eat at Chilis.  I wish they would have told me the kitchen was backed up and I wouldn't get my food for an hour.  It's not like I had to catch a flight or anything...Entrees came out staggered and my Girlfriend had almost finished her meal while mine was coming out.  They didn't give me the broccoli that comes with the entree and when I asked about it I got the response,"yeah, they messed it up and recooking".  Do you think I ever got it? Nope.  Could go down as worst restaurant experience I've ever had.  I only listed a few of the many problems...it almost was like a Saturday Night Live  Skit.  Avoid at all costs.  I would rather starve than be subjected to eating at that Chilis again.

This place was recommended.  Service was very good.  Caprese salad was excellent, with sardines.  Rotelle pasta was overcooked like someone who never made pasta before cooked it.  That was disappointing.  How can an Italian restaurant not cook al dente pasta?  The sausage was very good but someone should be teaching these folks how to make pasta.
The service is always great and the food is fantastic. My favorite Thai place in all of Tucson.

I just recently used Billig Jewelers for the first time to get my engagement ring reset.  It was a sensitive subject from the get-go since I just got engaged and we had issues with the other setting.  I sent an email via their website and didn't hear back but when I called Melissa immediately jumped to action!  I was looking at the Danhov rings I found on The Knot.  They only have a handful of authorized vendors so I was pleased that Billig was one of them.  

Melissa was fantastic.  I told her all of the styles I was interested in trying on and she ordered in samples of them so that I could try them on in person.  I went in and none of those styles worked so she ordered another sample I wanted and it was perfect!  I didn't want to be without my ring so they said they could just take the GIA certificate but when they contacted Danhov they preferred to have the diamond to actually set it.  I was nervous but Melissa assured me it would be fine.  I handed over my ring and Melissa even sent me the tracking number as they sent it to LA.  They said 2-3 weeks and in 2 weeks I had my PERFECT! engagement ring back.  Rick even humored me and read the laser inscription on my stone so I felt even better.  

I was surprised to see the negative reviews on Yelp.  I guess it is true that people tend to write more reviews when they are dissatisfied than satisfied.  I thought all of the staff, Jo, Rick and Melissa were very helpful.  They recognized me when I went in and all of the staff had great relationships with the customers that I overheard.  People stayed and chatted and one lady came in to drop her rings off to be cleaned; most were greeted by name!  I know it is hard to find a jeweler you trust and I am glad to have worked with Billig.  I will go back and get my wedding bands from them.  Very pleased.

Great service. Had a great buying experience. 
Friendly staff very knowledgeable. 
Held the car I wanted on line made an appointment to look at the car and bought it. It was easy without complications.

This place was recommended to us by a local at a shopping store nearby. We were unsure what to expect walking in, but really enjoyed our experience. It's a small, casual sports bar behind a pizza to go section. Great bartenders- friendly, polite, accommodating & they have strong pours. The atmosphere was low key but just what we needed for a late afternoon drink & appetizer. The shrimp tacos & nachos are DELICIOUS. Great hidden gem.

I took my dad here before a father daughter date night, and the food was delicious!  
The restaurant is very clean, and the wait staff is very attentive with quick service.

Been here a few times when I visit the area and am usually more impressed. We saw Daddy's Home at a 4:10 showing. The place was a mess, especially the bathrooms. They were pretty terrible. Definitely could use some improvements in overall cleanliness.

This place is absolutely god awful Derek the business owner is beyond inappropriate and has no idea how to run a business the fact one of his pictures on Yelp is him flicking off the camera Is very concerning....he thinks he's a dog i don't know what universe he's living in. I think he needs to go back to being a dead head and stop being a dog i advise everyone to stay far far away

Overall great experience. Cochon was a constant recommendation by friends when I told them I was visiting NOLA. They weren't wrong! Everything was good. My friend put a reservation for 6 of us ahead of time.

Djinn & Juice - The gin was bit too strong for me, but still a great drink to sip.

Wood-fired Oysters with Chili Garlic Butter - easily the best grilled oysters I had.

Braised Beef Short Ribs - Meat was so soft and tender. Rice balanced it out. Typically I am not a big fan of mushrooms, but even that was delicious!
Amazing menu, awesome service, delicious beer, vibing atmosphere and (even) kid-friendly! When in town, this is a "must try" for true craft brew fans! Five thumbs (stars) up!

I was very skeptical as many are I am sure but nagging pain brought me here! Painless and rather neat the way it works! I am 10 hours removed from my session and absolutely feel positive responses in my body. My acupuncturist was Shannon. She was friendly, delightful and explained everything as she went along. I will definitely return! Thank you Shannon!

Not bad at all... I must say.

I have to say, though, I was the youngest person there - by far. I kinda felt I was at a retirement home because of all the old people! But I love hanging out with old farts... they just love to talk and are so knowledgeable. 

Anyway, I saw their ad in the Gambit, which is the only reason I found out about this place... I saw some talk about it under Yelp's "talk" and I figured why not? I like trying something new. I had a little belated birthday dinner here with my parents tonight and we ordered one dozen raw oysters, one dozen chargrilled, one large soup of gumbo and 3 lbs of crawfish... needless to say, we ate everything. The bill was $50 for the three of us - not bad. If you come here on a Wednesday or Saturday they have $4 dozen oysters, or at least that's what the Gambit said. 

It's definitely worth a try.

I recently bought solar shades from Allure.  Every step of the way, the service was excellent form the initial visit to the showroom, to coming to view samples,measure and price, to the installation, everything was excellent: professional but low pressure.  A minor issue after installation was fixed the day after I called - no hassle and no charge.
Highly recommend Allure Window Treatment

Your basic neighborhood dive bar, but the food really is excellent, and not even "for a bar". Wings specifically are awesome, the best i've had in Philadelphia.

Props

I don't know how they make money.  The portions are so large I feel like I'd save money and time by eating here, rather than home.  And don't think that doesn't mean it's not tasty too.  

Now. I understand the stars for a gas station that seemed so invisible before.  Fresh. Cordial-Friendly. Special orders don't upset them.  Fills you up in tasty and belly happiness. This is the type of start-up business. great food, that you wish you'd started yourself, if only you weren't so busy or lazy or both.
Y'all y'all y'all. We are from Texas and this place is GGGGGGOOOOOOOOOOOOOOODDDD.  YES GOOD.  We were only in St Louis for two days but made it here both days for lunch.
Great food, great service, great atmosphere.  Favorite is Cali Chicken Sandwich. Sunny Daze has the best onion rings ever!

Purchased a mattress on 12/01/2015 and opted to pick-up myself the next day. The service in the warehouse is poor at best, and they seemed irritated to even help me load the mattress ontop of my SUV. 

Aside from the irritation, they seemed like they were in a huge rush, but not really doing anything. The guy that pulled my order slammed the mattress ontop of the car and snapped my bike rack. After hearing the loud pop he just ran back inside, shut the door and didn't even say a word or offer to tie-down. I was actually VERY shocked by this because appliances and large purchases like this require quite a bit of arrangements and care. 

I would pay full price anywhere else knowing my goods won't be damaged, and leave feeling confident in the service and quality of what I'm leaving with just based on the associates demeanor.

IHOP is pretty standard fare everywhere I go.  That's why I occasionally go there - it's predictable.  Generally, it's in the same category as other chain family restaurants, with the exception that IHOP specializes in pancakes - thus the name.  

In this case, I had to request the Butter Pecan syrup, which is the other major reason I pick it.  This trip was no exception, with a Chicken Fried Steak and pancakes.  It was everything I'd hoped it would be, meaning good.  

COVID had limited the capacity and I got the impression that they were still bouncing back from having been closed, or at least limited.  The restaurant was not half full, but did quite a bit of business with meal delivery or takeout orders.  The staff was helpful and polite.

As a whole, it reinforced my belief in IHOP as a stable and reliable brand and worth the trip if you're in the area and unsure about some of the other dining options around.

What a warm and friendly place! All the staff knew what they were doing and the food was delicious. It felt like a Vern nice neighborhood restaurant. The owners were right there making sure we were well taken care of and they really cared. A true coffee house but food was just so good and original. We didn't want to leave! It's going to be a must for all of our visits to Reno.

Like Buena Onda, but less chain-y. Illegal Tacos serves up flavorful soft tacos at a reasonable price. The shrimp are nicely seasoned and grilled to order. The toppings are always fresh, right down to the fragrant cilantro leaves. Definitely try a few of the salsas. My favorites are the citrusy, spicy hot version and the smoky-sweet medium salsa, but they are all unique and add different flavor nuances when combined with the tacos and fillings.

The good: Beet salad with arugula was outstanding. Nice addition of quinoa to give it some heft and and air of healthfulness. Hearts of palm salad was nice. Beef/gorgonzola risotto and truffle gnocchi were excellent. Pleasant service and good atmosphere.

The meh: The cannoli shell box from the food distributor was visible near the back, as was the box for the cheesecake. Also, our entrees came out before we finished our salads. (Don't rush me!) Our waiter broke off the top of our wine bottle when he tried to uncork it, rendering it undrinkable. (Luckily, that was only one of three bottles we had.)

Overall:3.5 stars. But given the quality of the entrees and salads and the pleasant staff, I'll give it four above.

Best pizza in the area! So happy to report on a local family owned business doing it right! In a sea of chain pizza restaurants, Campanella's pizza is a by far the best pizza in Pinellas County. I've had tons of NY pizza (yes, in New York) and Camanella's is the closest to taste and portion size then any other wannabe NY pizza joint here. We have not ventured too far down the menu but the Broccoli Alla Campanella will turn the biggest broccoli hater into a fan! And the cannoli...fogettaboutit!

Can't comment too much on service b/c we haven't dined-in in a while (b/c we always do take out) but orders are always right and taste amazing. I highly suggest dining in though because the décor coupled with the food is an amazing Italian dining experience!

I like-like this place. Yes "like-like". Not to the point of love just yet. Mainly because the cooking is good but definitely could do better. It was family night and the community support or crabs legs must be good. Speaking of crab legs!  The specials are crabs legs and shrimp! The specials were good but needed some love to it. Define love you say? Seasoning is the definition. Old bay? If so, just a tad bit more one the spices. This place had people coming in which I did not expect. Buts it's Florida. Not bad but could be better. I gave it this rating because of the family atmosphere and tons of kids for the kiddos to play with. Park is also included. So they can make all the noise they want and the wife and I would enjoy our meals. Looking forwards to more events and meals here especially the fish and chips. Hope it's good. Thanks.

My roommate and I are obsessed with this place! Their drinks are great and they always have a shot of the day that's only $3. The queso is a MUST HAVE, I would come here just for the queso. The tacos are some of the best in town. My favorite is the shrimp taco. The atmosphere is great and the staff is always friendly. I probably come here once every two weeks, highly recommend!

Their facility is a bit cold feeling. There's something about it I don't like - I think it's the lighting. Otherwise, great place! Their ordering kiosks are a great idea, and the sushi is great! Although recently I've gotten some pretty small pieces of sushi. A few months ago, the rolls were huge! I took all my friends there because the rolls were nice and big, and everything was delicious (except their green tea smoothie bubble tea...that needs some improvement). Anyway, I stopped taking my friends here when the rolls got so small. I go here less now. Bummer, because I liked it so much before, but now the rolls are just pathetic!!

Just ordered take out from this place and we had a horrible experience. They forgot my husband burger platter and they gave us chicken tenders dip in bbq sauce instead of wings . Fries was burnt and soggy . We been trying to call the restaurant for a hour now and no answer.  Food taste horrible, Never again !

Kona Grill has great atmosphere with a huge aquarium and a happy hour m-s and all day and on Sunday with 1/2 priced food including sushi cheeseburger sliders,  flatbreads, calamari,  lettuce wraps. There is a little bit of everything on the regular menu as well. Great bartenders.
Just so nice, I thought. Wake up and go here with people you love. You'll have many options and eat fresh food made with care.

Quite unimpressed for lunch for a 4 star Yelp rating. We had two seafood Caeser salads, one regular Caeser, and some seafood bisque. The Caeser salads were served with cucumbers, tomatoes, and red onions and some sort of oil-based dressing that was not particularly Caeser-like. There was a tiny amount of grated, not shaved, Parmesan cheese as well.  The grilled shrimp on the seafood Caesers were quite mealy, though the crab seemed fine. The seafood bisque tasted like Campbell's tomato soup, which suited my 9 year old fine, but was lousy in my opinion. 

Very unimpressed.

Had lunch here. I had grilled cheese quesadilla and they were great. My husband had appetizer of spring rolls. They were real good.  Friend had the salmon wrap. A few beers and all that food. $50. And the service was great

I started coming here about a year ago & have been getting facials with Stella. I eventually progressed to micro-needling and then peels. I've seen significant change to my texture and overall skin tone. Stella explains everything step by step and has been the absolute best. Yesterday I did Botox with Katelyn & I am speechless at my flawless results. She explained everything to me and made sure I was comfortable with the entire process. It hasn't fully set in but I can see subtle smoothness in my forehead. I was sooo nervous about Botox, but I couldn't be happier.

If I could rate a zero or negative star, I would. The phone service was terrible & disrespectful. Every single thing we ordered was wrong somehow.

 We ordered an Ultimate Porker which is ham & bacon, no bacon. Requested no cheese, we got cheese.  Ordered & paid for bacon on a Club Lulu, no bacon. Ordered a Veggie which is supposed to have avocado, no avocado.

When we called to complain they argued with us, told us not to eat yet (we'd already waited more than 20 minutes) because they had to come & "inspect the sandwiches to make sure we weren't trying to get extra bacon & then consult their staff".  

My son had to leave for work & couldn't wait to eat. When we told them that, whoever my husband spoke to said he didn't care & if they didn't see the sandwich to prove us wrong, they wouldn't do anything.

This was their second chance & they screwed up royally.  Not ordering from them again.

***After waiting 45 minutes for someone to come "inspect" the sandwiches, we had to call back.  Turns out someone remade the sandwiches & dropped them on the ground in front of our door without knocking or ringing the doorbell.  There were instructions to leave the food on a table right next to the door. We have no idea how long they were out there & it's almost 100° right now.***

The last meal I had here was sub par but I was eating with friends for their birthday and tried to make the best of it. This time my daughter wanted to go so I said ok reluctantly... we walked in, plenty of tables available they took my name and phone and said 5 minutes. 20 minutes later they we are still waiting and they said they tried to call a long time ago. No you didn't I said. Then they said they texted 3 times. No you didn't I said. I asked why they didn't call out my name since we were standing right there. They said give us 5 more minutes. We waited 5 more, weren't seated and decided to leave. We learned our lesson and won't eat at corporate restaurant chains that aren't cheap for the abominable service and ok food.

The staff was kind and attentive to me when I dropped into the office with an unexpected stomach bug. All the services I requested were offered and my nurse showed compassion. Almost a year later, I got a refund in the mail for my treatment, which my insurance covered. I am grateful for the help.

Yes! Finally St Pete gets an awesome Chinese buffet!  We thoroughly enjoyed this place. Everything was fresh and tasty. The sushi bar was awesome, and they even had a hibachi style place. Service was great too! We will be back!

I love this company and service!  I tried it last year because I needed a great tree, and didn't have the time/resources to help pick it out, haul it home, and then set it up.  I was a little concerned about not being able to pick out my own tree, but the result was even better!  They pick out a perfect tree, deliver it, set it up, clean up, and all in a matter of minutes!  I did it again this year, and another fabulous tree with no hassle.  And really nice guys that work there! 

So, If you want a beautiful tree, with an on time delivery, and perfect setup, this is your place!!!

Date night last night we decided to check out Grillsmith! We both really loved the atmosphere and the patio area it was really chill and so nice this time of year. I ordered an Asian chicken pasta and I don't remember there being a spicy symbol or even a note in the description but the dish was extremely spicy! I couldn't even eat it it was so spicy my mouth was on fire!!! Brandon however who likes spicy things liked it and took it home for lunch today. He ordered a steak and shrimp with jalapeño Mac n cheese last night. The shrimp and steak were very bland and boring tasting ... No flavour! He ordered his steak medium rare but it was definitely medium well and he was not a happy camper. The portions in his meal were also quite small for the price and for a place with grill in the name he wasn't impressed with their grilling skills. The best thing by far was the jalapeño Mac n cheese! We both really liked it and it wasn't even close to as spicy as what I had ordered.

This place is disgusting. The lobby is okay but it's very old. The room feels dirty and it looks like the comforters on the beds are never washed. The shower is still wet from before I checked in and there is something in the tub, I don't want to know what it is. The bathroom floor is sticky. There is a restaurant, but it is overpriced and they are out of almost everything. The front desk lost my registration so I ended up paying twice. Thank goodness I'm only staying here for one night.
Update: The owner of the hotel drove me to the airport-I can't tell if it was his personal car or not... however he was extremely nice and apologized about the lost reservation and said he'd make sure my card wasn't charged twice.
Update #2: My card was charged twice.

When we moved from Long Island to Pennsylvania, one of our fears was that it would be hard to find our favorite Italian specialties. Thank goodness for yelp because it found me Gerome's. They have, hands down, the BEST sausage we have ever eaten. Every flavor has been amazing, with special props for the cheesesteak and pizza sausage. It's so easy to make- bake in the oven for an hour or fry in a pan. Staff is friendly and accurate. And they make their own ravioli and it's SO good (pricy but worth the splurge).  This place is so amazing, I'm not sure how it hasn't caught on even more. If I could give ten out of five stars, I would.

Very good fried rice. They are always busy during lunch but they manage the lines very well. I've never had to wait longer than a couple mins. Their attitudes stay professional even with all the transactions going on. 
The buffett isn't large but they keep the food fresh and what they do have on the buffett is always really good.

Outstanding Saturday brunch/lunch. The biscuits are a must. We tried everything from the LEO (twist on smoked salmon and poached eggs with hollandaise) to pulled pork and Ruben/pattimelt. Plus the cauliflower bites were terrific. Nice atmosphere.
Tacos and queso are great. Only things that would make this spot better would be a tequila bar and some shade options on the patio.

This is a fun place to eat. But when I return I will 1. order a bowl or roll, and 2. get the sauce on the side.

I had read about all the fun dishes you can order on and off the menu at Poke Burri. So I wanted a sushi donut and a sushi corndog. Because, well, where else can you get those in Tampa? And I'm happy that I tried them, but I'm a little angry at myself for ordering just starch and meat (and sauce) with no vegetables (unless you count a slice of avocado).

The sushi donut was fine. The menu only had spicy tuna or crabmeat as options, but when I asked, the cashier said I could switch out the protein as long as I was okay with the other toppings (no customization). Fine. I swapped out the crabmeat and got salmon. The salmon was good. The rice was fine. But everything was drowned in salty, sweet and spicy sauces. I at just the top half of the donut because there was so much rice.

The corndog was certainly a fun novelty. It was crabmeat (that was the only option available today), wrapped in sushi rice, then rolled in panko and fried, then drizzled in several sauces. Eating it was a little tougher than a corndog as the rice and crabmeat don't hold shape like a battered sausage. Also, there was a LOT of sauce on it. My mouth was overwhelmed with sauce, and I left very thirsty.

The location is in a mini-mall (same one as Chicken Salad Chick) with lots of parking. The decor is minimalist, and the place feels clean. The stools are not the most comfortable, but fine for a quick meal. Service was fast.

DO NOT GIVE THIS GUY YOUR MONEY. GO TO A LEGITIMATE FIELD.

Completely unprofessional highly unethical, not safe, also most likely illegal. It's businesses like this that turn people away from paintball and kill the sport. I drove out to the original indoor location to find out that the games are no longer held there. There were absolutely no signs on the building and there were some other people that were about to go to the field so I followed them there. They got lost on the way so I called the number on the website and asked for the location and the owner would not give me the location or answer any of my questions. He specifically told me, "I can't tell you where it is. You need to a reservation so I can have equipment and you need to fill out the waiver, then I can tell you." I received a texted PDF with various information including the field location. The location given was GPS coordinates not an address. I went to the location and found out why he wouldn't tell me where it is. The field was on BLM property and was not a paintball field. It just happened to be a about a 65X25yard area with a bunch of trees and bushes. This is public property. There are no safety nets, staging areas, seating, pro shop, nothing. He charges every player a fee to use the field, rent the equipment, and for paint (No outside paintball allowed). The owner was there with his truck and some equipment laid out on the ground. On the PDF he says he pays to rent out the land to play on but it's public land so he's most likely lying to everyone about that then charging them to use it. All other reviews talk about how he is so concerned about safety well it's probably because he can't get any insurance coverage while charging people to play on BLM land. I've been playing paintball for 10 years so  I'm used to lazy referees, crappy fields, and poor management but this is by far the worst example of a paintball business I have ever come by. I've uploaded screenshots of the texted PDF to share with you guys.

Yum!  Just YUM!  Everything I have had, which is just about everything on the menu, has not disappointed.  My families number one choice when asked should I pick up something for dinner tonight.  I work in the building so my visits are frequent!  Recommend!!

BE WARNED: Pretty much the only positive attribute this establishment has is its speed in food delivery. They're not very friendly serving staff rushes you along every possibility that arises. They add a 15% gratuity to EVERY check whether it's a party of one or 70 without letting the patron know I assume in hopes to get more money as you are unaware unless you inspect the unlabeled "itemized" bill. Super shady. They exclude the customary dollop of guacamole, pico, & sour cream on the combination platters & then try to sell you a full bowl of each instead. Pretty much penny pinchers that do not invest in customer service skills. Annoyed as I depart from this restaurant.

We had a chefs salad, which was huge and beautiful, and a burger. I don't know about the outside area but the bar service was awesome. The bartenders and servers all pool tips so everyone is available and more than willing to assist you with a smile. A super fun place with very good, not fern restaurant food found here! Come and enjoy a beautiful Tampa Bay sunset.

Nice starbucks. It has a very large outside seating, but not so much inside. The drinks are made very consistently and tasted exactly the same every single time. However, one thing that bugs me the most is how freezing this place is. They turn the ac up too high and they will never adjust it for you if you ask. I even find myself bringing a sweater or jacket here on summer days. Trust me. It is freezing cold in there to point that I feel a little sick just trying to sit there and study for 15 minutes.

Decided to try a new salon for a cut and color. Thai did an amazing job! I have curly, thick hair and she made it look gorgeous with subtle highlights and a great haircut. This salon is beautiful and everyone is so friendly! I will definitely be back and I highly recommend it.

Very cute cafe. They have great parties and coffee. We went back to try the breakfast sandwiches but they were closed for a two-week holiday. Hopefully we can catch them next time. If you're in the area, stop by. You will not be disappointed.

This place is absolutely gorgeous. I got an amazing rate for this place through priceline.com and it really paid off. The lobby is beautiful. Everywhere you go there is art hanging. From the Chihuly in the main floor to the local art scattered around the floor, there is something to see.

The service was top rate as well. Our room was located on the 4th floor and had a nice view of downtown New Orleans. The room was clean and our beds were super comfy as well. It's quite a walk to bourbon street and the french quarter but if you have a car, you can get there in about 5 minutes. The only thing that sucks is that if you have a rented car, its $28 a day to park there. Ridiculous!

But other than that, I loved my stay here and would come back!

I think this place deserves at least 1 star, after all, the manager replaced my meal after learning that our waitress basically told us that she couldn't do *anything* and the **kitchen is too busy**?!  My steak tacos were hard as a rock! The chicken enchaladas came out cold as if it's been sitting out waiting for the other foods to cook... This was our first time dining here for Mother's Day.. We love to dine out and check out new places :) Too bad we WON'T BE COMING HERE - not so much that the food came out over cooked or cold but the SERVICE WAS NOT GOOD at all.. Our waitress didn't make ANY effort to address our concerns or offer a replacement meal? She said what she had to say and walked away as if it was resolved by saying "that's how they cook the steak and the kitchen is too busy"? Of course the qualify of food matters when dining out but I believe the experience, atmosphere, and SERVICE are a big deal too...

Amazing service. He food was great, it hit the kebab craving I've been having. They made it extra spicy just for me, had the food out very quick and it was very very tasty. The service was amazing! Funny story actually, the waitress brought a box and I accidentally spilled it all over myself! Even though the restaurant had no fault whatsoever they went ahead and made me a complimentary dessert! It was really good.


EDIT: I've since returned to this restaurant and they seem to give this dessert to every customer. Amazing nevertheless

Excellent breakfast skillet and great service. I am from here and visit about once a year and typically go to the place across the street (Denny's), but I wanted to try something different. I'll be coming back here from now on.

Located in the heart of the tourist district...

$47 dollars a day! (ouch)

At least the clean up before dawn from the previous night.

While this is not my favorite Dollar Tree location in Nashville, I do drop in at least once every two weeks because it is still fairly close to my home.  Staff here have always been courteous at checkout, not quick to greet you as you enter like my favorite location.  I have no true complaints with this store.  It is fairly neat when I visit.  It is a larger store so aisles are wider.  I don't think I've ever found anything here that wasn't in the other locations but when my favorite Dollar Tree is out of something, I try this store.   So there you have it, a Dollar Tree is a Dollar Tree is a Dollar Tree but the staff make the difference and the staff at this location do a pretty good job!
Best Chinese food place in our area.  I love the flavor and I love the appetizer fried noodles they give you as well.

I don't even want to give 1 star but that isn't an option.  I had booked this place for several days.  After driving from VA to MO (15 hours), I arrive after check in time and the room wasn't ready but I only had to wait a few minutes.  I had reserved the King room with a refrigerator and microwave.  There are no words to sufficiently describe how filthy the room was.  There were clumps of hair on the baseboards  It honestly looked like someone had picked their nose and wiped it on the bathroom door.  The bathroom was disgusting!  I went downstairs and told them that I was leaving and that I would still pay for the night that I was leaving.  They asked if I wanted to stay since I had paid for that night and I told them that there was no way that I would stay!  I told them I didn't want my dogs in the room because it was filthy.  They offered me another room that was "clean" and it was cleaner than the room I was in at first but it was still dirty!!!!  I did get a refund with no problem for the remaining nights though.  I told the man at the front that I have NEVER walked out of a hotel before but I was shocked they are open and in business.  I am sorry but this place is not fit for rodents to stay in!
