I really wish there was 3.5 star option, but since it's only been open a couple of weeks I decided to give it the benefit of the doubt and give it 4. I think it has a bright future once it works out the kinks.

This building has special memories for me...I saw every Disney movie as a preschooler in this theater and I remember the staircase. The concession stand and the popcorn was against the left wall of the restaurant area. The front bar is where a full size replica of Herbie the Love Bug stood when I saw that movie.

If you're not suffering from depression or your meds are spot on - you'll love the dark decor. It's really dark, especially when breakers are still flipping. Seriously though I actually appreciate the fact that they found an ambiance that allows for conversation at normal levels and doesn't require escalating your volume like so many open restaurants with concrete flooring requires. Don't valet - the red shirt valet company has abused more cars than a Blues Brothers film and refuse to be accountable. We also had three brown-outs so clearly still a lot to work through as the entire infrastructure where the restaurant gets rebuilt.

The cocktail menu looks fantastic; I remember the name of one we tried was the "When Rande met Cindy" but both were craftily prepared and a great start.

We started with the "bread and butter", and "the Pig and the Peach" and they were both fantastic. I was really skeptical about butter as an app but they definitely make it worthwhile. The Pig and the Peach was a perfect combination the salt in the various porks and the sweet of the fruits.

For entrees my wife had the Walleye and had the French Onion Frites. The walleye dish was fantastic for her; it was very light and the beans and almond really made for a nice flavor profile. If you order this make sure and mix the dimensions into a single bite; the walleye seems to be poached so not a ton of flavor in the fish by itself. I wanted to something heavier and the French Onion Frites was the perfect entree for that. I saw another review that really abused this dish - bear in mind that yelper rated Calypso Cafe with 5 stars so you really shouldn't take her seriously on any review. So the ribeye isn't wagyu. So what. it's a great meaty bite to the crouton, onion, and cheese and it is a fantastic bite!!! It's worth a couple of extra miles running to order. The frites with it were crisp and salty like they should be. I got the house steak sauce and it's WAYYY too sweet - almost shouldn't be called a steak sauce.

For dessert we had a bit of let down - we ordered the Caramel Corn and the Chocolate. The caramel corn was the better of the two but I thought the Profiteroles were pretty chewy, they should've been lighter. On the Chocolate the mousse was phenomenal but the Bouchon was hard as rock. We literally couldn't cut into it so it went uneaten.

The service was great although we knew are server from Pinewood Social so she was already well trained by the Goldbergs before showing up at Sinema. We met Q who is the transplanted manager from another restaurant and he was super nice, really understands wine because he immediately recognized what we had brought with us!

We'll definitely be back once things have settled down and we've been able to work through some of the other new restaurants in Nashville.

Beautiful space with lovely people! Cleanliness and safety are a priority at this gem of a spa. The spa itself is chic and relaxing. Summer is extremely knowledgeable about all things skin related and I left there with 3 products that have significantly improved my skin's tone and hydration. I'm definitely looking forward to making time for myself to come again soon!

We came to seaworthy tonight for dinner and waited an initial 1h for a table before enquiring as to our progression in the queue. We were extremely upset as the hostess was completely dismissive of us and slightly rude telling us we needed to wait 
another hour unless we wanted to sit at the bar. 

Usually we wouldn't complain but we were starving so we spoke to Matt (I think that was his name) who was the acting manager. He literally made our night by being so courteous and understanding. He immediately rectified the situation and made us feel extremely comfortable at a lovely table. By the time we left we all agreed we would definitely return. We are some fantastic seafood here including the popcorn shrimp, bacalaito (so yum!!) and the bbq shrimp. Cocktails were fantastic too! 

Our recommendation would be to book ahead and enjoy.

Great looking place,  tons of TV's, but lackluster in food. I got the Philly cheesesteak with fries. The fries are puny, like Steak-n-Shake, which almost guarantees that they will not be hot, which they were not. The meat had several pieces of gristle that I had to spit out. There wasn't a good percentage of filling in the large french bread that it was served on. Not sure if I will return.

My friend suggested this place for an evening meet so we went as party of three to this location. It was in the beautiful street in king of Prussia . Nice place to spend time with friends and family with outdoor heating and Ambience is good in the street.
 Now about Paladar the ambience is good internal and outdoor seating. We got an outdoor seating and the drinks menu is awesome their rum flight is a treat for people like rum. Had a margarita with watermelon and ginger that was amazing ! Great recommendation from bartender !! We wanted to get some food however the appetizer collection lacked variety ( hence 4 star) we ordered chicken tamales and some chips and guacamole. 
        Banana and yucca chips are a must try !! Weill definitely try again !!

Ate here again, this time for my son's 18th birthday.  As usual the service was fantastic, no complaints as our drink glasses were kept full and the food was delivered timely.  My oldest son, myself, and the wife ordered sushi, my youngest son ordered BBQ eel.

First my son's review of his eel.  Delicious but the portion was a little small.

The sushi arrived quickly (we beat the evening rush) and the presentation was very nice.  All of the rolls were perfectly prepared and were totally addictive.  We tried a few of the "Specialty Rolls" just to mix it up a little.  They were good, but I wouldn't buy them again, just because I'm a cheap bastard.

One thing to note, for some reason, this visit we were able to tell the tuna was previously frozen.  We are in Indiana so I am used to expecting that, but this time is was noticeable, the tuna was a little washed out and not as firm as it usually is.  This has never happened here before, and the flavor was only slightly different so I won't ding the review this time.

Also, this is no fault of the restaurant, but they sat a couple with two small brats behind us.  They couldn't control the little sh!ts and the entire meal they were kicking the booth and looking over at us.  Leave your diaper monsters at home people, we don't want to share your joys of parenthood.  I spent $150 for a meal, not an (up)Chuck & Cheese experience.

Be sure to get your coupons for this place at www.coupons4indy.com

I think most people don't come to New Orleans to go to a museum and learn about WWII. That being said, this is truly a must-see if you're in town. The information is presented in interesting, emotional, gripping ways with many personal stories that really hit home. It is obviously important for us to honor the men and women who fought to preserve the freedoms that we enjoy today, but even more important than that we have to learn about our collective histories so that we can avoid repeating them.

Rude rude rude. Didnt even make it past the door because just as I walked in the surly salesman barely lifted his head to say something rude to me. I turned right back around and left. First and last time there. Honestly probably wouldn't buy anything there anyway.. I'd rather just go to goodwill or salvation army. I was just bored and depressed by the Mardi gras madness. However, I for one am loving the gentrification of oak st! Good work, folks.

Ordered delivery. I actually enjoyed the portobello burrito and the massive said of plantains. the food is not great but delivery was quick and what i ordered. Don't think I would ever visit the actual establishment - there are far better mexican restaurants in philly but what with the limited delivery options I would order again if I had a craving.

Normally I wouldn't write a review for a gas station, but after seeing the 2 star rating for this Thorntons, I wanted to help them out. 

I love the Thorntons gas stations. If possible, I only use then. I drive out of my way to go to a Thorntons even though there is a speedway on every corner in Indiana. 

First, this specific store: the workers don't change every day. They have a set crew of about 8 people that have been employed here for at least the year I've been frequenting it. I go almost everyday for a fountain drink, sometimes I go at 630 am, sometimes at 2am, sometimes in the middle of the day. So, I have gotten to know the entire crew, and they all recognize me. They are friendly and always chat while you are in the store. 

As for Thorntons as a whole, it has a local feel even though it is technically a chain store. This year, they got rid of the 44oz fountain cups. I inquired why, and was given a very Valid answer: their vendor increased the price for the 44oz cups, and thorntons wasn't willing to increase their drink prices (all are a flat $0.89), so they just quit ordering the cups. That worker then showed me the 64oz refillable thermal cups, and suggested I buy one of those. I did. Shortly after that thorntons changed their refill price to $0.59, saving me $0.30 per fill. The cup only cost $7 so it only took 25 fills to make that profitable, plus I get 2x as much in each cup. 

Lastly, they don't just sell the standard "Thorntons" mugs like some of the bigger players. They have IU and Purdue cups in Indy, university of Kentucky cups in Louisville, and I'm sure others in their additional markets. 

Don't fall for the speedway, market dominating trap. Check out the smaller guy, you won't regret it.

Best fish tacos in Tampa!  And a friendly, awesome staff who always get our order right!  The Baja style sautéed shrimp and sautéed fish tacos keep us coming back!  We always get a smile from Paul and his team!
Love the food so much, but it is astonishing how expensive it has become.  The cashew chicken is now a $19.99 dish. Heartbreaking.
Mediocre and overpriced pho. They cheap out on the meat, and the service has gone down. There's better places out there in Nashville for pho.
This place is dirty and nasty. I do not see the big deal. Overhyped.

The food was pretty good. I ordered the Vaca Frita and I thought it was okay. The prices are pretty high for the amount of food you get. The ambiance is nice, nothing to fancy. The service was also okay. 
I like the restaurant, but in my opinion I can get the same food for 1/3 price somewhere else in Philly.

Very honest and knowledgeable.  They came out to fix three faucets in our home.  The faucets outside was not under our home warranty, and they let us know the most cost effective way to get that fixed.  Would recommend.

I had a canvas gun case that I had spilled gas on.
The were quick it looks like brand new and it only cost $10
I was very impressed.  Let's give them more business

Out of guacamole
Out of sour cream 
Out of veg
Crew seamed stoned and particularly slow 
MANAGERS WHERE ARE YOU?
These guys are the best. Helped me with a sink repair that costed $73. Mr. Quick wanted $750 for the same job.

Great food and FANTASTIC service. VERY CLEAN bathrooms. Will definitely come again. 

This is some solid Mexican food. The tortillas were suuuuuuper fresh and just wonderfully soft, warm and delicious. We had the La Major enchiladas (beef and chicken), a few tacos and a chicken salad. We also had the chorizo queso as an appetizer and I practically licked the bowl clean... I also had jalapeños added to it because I prefer spicy queso. What really stood out to me was the service. I wish I got his name but we came in around noon and sat in a booth in the left back corner. Very attentive, friendly and quick. I will definitely come back here!!

Also to note - this is the same menu (and looks like same restaurant manager as Pueblo Real in Franklin), but I had entirely different experiences when it comes to service and the taste of the food - I prefer Tito's. Not sure what makes the difference but Pueblo Real's meat was very dry when I dined there compared to Tito's today.

It is what is expected. Loud, noisey, people running around wanting food and lots of it.
Waitress srvice was fine, drinks were always filled up and plates cleared away quickly. The food was ok. Was not expecting a gourmet meal and I left full. The price is awesome.
My second visit and I have been extremely pleased both times. First time needed a strap tightened on a pair of sandals. Second needed shoes stretched. Both gentlemen very kind each time.

Fernando is an awesome guy. 

While attending UCSB, I went to him for oil changes, smog checks, and air vent replacement. After going to him for his service the first time, I knew he was someone that I could trust. He would give you recommendations if certain things truly need a fix or replacement and totally respects your decisions. In general, the guy always has a great attitude whenever I go see him for auto help and always gets the job done!
Great ramen! Probably the one of the best around town. Make sure to try the spicy ramen.

Best wine shop in Reno hands down.  We've tried Vino100, TJs, Total Wine, Bens, and Whole Foods but keep coming back here.  Brian is the wine buyer and when he is around always hooks us up with the newest selections.  They also offer 10% off on a single case and 15% off two cases or more.

I thought this was the ultimate burger stand.  I'm a HUGE beach/bar foodie- and I like quality over ambiance, so this place resonated with me.  Our first try was ordering fish sandwiches from Undertow Bar and having delivery.  The fish was awesome!  Not over-fried and it was super fresh.

Today we had the burger (my fav dish in the world) and ribeye sandwich, and both were suberb.  The owner was on site and completely involved in the service as well as our experience- which was delightful.  This is a MUST try, but more importantly a must repeat venue for anyone on St. Pete Beach.  

Congrats Smiley's.  Well done.

We stopped at National Mechanics after dinner on a Friday night.

The building was cool, outside and in.

Their drink specials and variety were solid.

The DJ was playing a sweet mix of indie and 80s dance music.

There were too many people in plaid flannel shirts for my liking, but it wasn't that hard to push them out of the way and order my libation.

Overall, a less-lame spot to party in Old City.

If I could give them 0 stars I would. I'm a delivery driver and I usually get deliveries from this location. Tonight when I was assigned a delivery I went to this location, and the wait to order was already excessive. After notifying them that I was a delivery driver, I am given a order ID to give them for my customers order. Throughout the visit I was never given the chance to give them this ID. When I got to the pickup window, the crew member threw the order at me. I figured it was correct since they usually only have one order when I arrived in the past. Today they gave me the incorrect order and I was notified of this after the order was brought to the customer since I cannot check for accuracy. When I go back to rectify this for the customer I'm told they cannot remake it for me, the employees demand the ID number (couldn't this have helped when I had the number accessible?) and also demanded the order I did receive back. Due to COVID-19 I cannot take the order back from the customer. And your establishment should not be allowed to take an order back and bring it into range of other orders. This is how you spread a DEADLY ILLNESS! Your employees are very disrespectful, and your manager is not trained on proper protocol for delivery troubleshooting. Very disgraceful.
We indulged in the fried bacon and oyster app and the crab cake. It was absolutely glorious. My martini was incredible. Will be back!

Pappardelle with rabbit is one of the best pasta dishes I have ever had-tasted like dark meat turkey in light gravy with just a hint of sweetness from apircots. Amazing!

The salmon special-great sized portion, mussels were amazing, salmon a touch overdone for my taste (I like mine a little on the rare side), sauce was a spicy tomato- had a lot of oil that separated from sauce-this is my only real critisism. 

Pork piccata, bread and fried, nice portion size, not a traditional type piccata.....lacked sauce. There was just a touch of piccata sauce, needed way more.

Bakersfield was really good! The mahi fish taco was FIRE! Yes was a little salty cause i went for the shrimp tacos and they didn't have any. But i left happy! Oan the chicken Diablo was the bomb too! Spicy for sure! I'll be back....that's what matters!

Oan the watermelon margarita was sooo good!

BTW- Manager Roger Jones never came to the table, no one offered a single thing to appease us. Asked for the corporate # and the manager didn't even have the balls to come to the table...sent an asst. with his card. Klassy with a kapital "K"

Sat on the second floor of Butcher Bar on somewhat chilly Friday night--it was lovely and the food was incredible. The duck on the charcuterie board was my favorite part of that appetizer--the entire board is a must get. And the bone barrow you can't pass up--great crispy outside crunch and the most smooth and delicious taste. For the entree, my partner and I split the pork chop special with the pork belly still attached, and it was perfect. Pulled the bone right out of the slab because it was that perfectly cooked. Wish it was always on the menu! 

Also a shoutout to our server! Not only was she really knowledge about the menu (gave the most accurate cheese descriptions) but also she loves cats and made us laugh. Really enjoyed having her help us out that night! 

Great food, great atmosphere, great staff.

Went to skin deep to get a piercing and he did an amazing job! Super quick, clean, and informative. Also helped consult/trouble shoot me on a bad piercing from a different shop. Austin is great, visit his IG for more info on how to book an appointment , @ im_a_piercer

Seriously the best all around.  Watch their weekly videos on FB or Instagram.   Everything they stock is awesome, and Mary is just the most accommodating and helpful person I have ever dealt with.  My favorite store!!

Amazing, great and honest service.  We went to another place and they said the tire could not be fixed and we needed four new tires at over $1,000.  Firestone fixed it for no charge and we were on our way!!!  They will do both our cars in the future and we love a place we can trust!!!!

I love this place. It's not American Style Chinese food, it's real Chinese food. Umm..I couldn't get other good Chinese food in Goleta and IV..I come here twice or three times a week...I agree that the service here is not that good..but still acceptable...

This restaurant is a staple for quick, tasty, and plentiful food. Their portions are huge enough for 2 adults or 2 separate meals. The customer service is good, and the staff is courteous. I have tried their country fried rice (rice with smoked fish and a bell pepper and onion type gravy on top), with either the tilapia/snapper/goat meat.  The proteins are nicely flavored. They give you a small pepper sauce on the side which always tastes good but sometimes the spice level can be really HOT! I would 100% recommend for tasty African food

Horrible management he's condescending and Rude. 
After spending $500 you'd expect a well done job no matter where you receive a prescription from. 
Service and staff are efficient and nice Not a great experience there with management and having to go back and forth constantly not being able to see, then get bad service and at the end it's not my fault since I'm no oculist not a way to show customer service when we don't know I you're doing your job right and you get mad for a consumer coming back with a concern.

College is kind of like real estate in a way...........location, location, location! Let me tell you, I don't know of anyone that can argue that UCSB is anything but prime location! This college is amazing........and I am proud to say that I was, and always will be in my heart, a GAUCHO!

When I went to college I actually went at a later stage in life, so I wasn't looking for the party scene. But trust me, it is there in full force for those of you that are looking for it as a needs to escape the books and lectures! I heard many stories  and actually attended a few "parties" with some friends of mine but since I did not live on campus and had to get back home to my husband and teenage sons I did not participate in that part very much! :)

My situation may be a bit different from some as I was older ( 32) when I entered college. I had married right out of high school and had two sons, so my dream of college was put on the back burner for a while. I did attend community college but my dream was to attend a university. So that being said I cannot tell you much about student housing, although I did meet quite a few females that lived in the Tropicana Student Housing. They all claimed to loved it and seemed very happy living there. I went inside the complex a couple of times and it was very clean, practical, and depending on how you fixed up your place it could look really nice and could function well.

Now, the best part of why we go to college in the first place; to educate ourselves!  After seeking out several colleges due their academic success rates I finally decided upon UCSB. They offered a wide variety of classes, highly admired professors, was high up there on the best ranking universities list, and  the campus was close enough to my home to still be able to have time to study and also be a mother to my two teenage sons. I loved my four years at UCSB and will never forget them! It truly is a great college! The professors, students, guidance counselors, and everyone at this college are amazing people! I have learned so much from them and will keep what I have learned with me always!

I am proud to say that I graduated with High Honors with a Bachelor's Degree in Business Economics with optional emphasis in: Accounting. My counselors were always there when I needed them and helped me to pick my classes accordingly. I would highly recommend UCSB to a student coming straight out of high school, a transfer student from a community college, or a mom like me who had children at a young age and had to drop her dream of college for a few years.

The people that I met there were wonderful and I am still in touch with many of them. If you are looking for a college where you can get a great education, meet a lot of wonderful people, have beautiful surroundings all around you, and have plenty of places to go and hang out when you are not studying then I highly recommend UCSB!

Came here on the recommendation of the hotel I was staying at. Good bad and ugly. Good the brisket was delicious. Great flavor and cook to perfection  The nachos with the BBQ beans great. The chicken dry so dry it was like eating saw dust. The cowboy beans tasted like a can of hormel chili. The coleslaw worse I have ever had hands down. The Texas brisket sushi creative and very good. Which we at least make the effort to accommodate. The young lady who greeted was very nice and once leaving thanks us for coming in.  Like the interior just was surprised a place like Tennessee know for it BBQ would have better representation. I live in Maryland and have had BBQ HANDS DOWN.Maryland is known for crabs not bbq ju
sy saying
Yum!  So quick- so delicious- so perfect!  I haven't had a bad pizza or sandwich here- absolutely love this place and it is parking- which is a plus in midtown!

Booked the Wine and Hops tour for my daughter's 22nd birthday.  Shawn showed at our hotel right on time and we had a wonderful day!  He was very knowledgeable and engaging.  We went to several beautiful wineries and one local brewery.  It was an amazing trip and this tour made it even better.  Highly recommend "Wine Edventures" for your adventures every time!
Lillie was wonderful.  An excellent waitress.   We are always impressed with the service.

I've never been to a place like this before, it was really fun! And they give you full details of how it all works and how to throw and what kind of hatchets there are in the different ways to use them. It was very helpful! Great customer service! The first time you go most the time they explain to you everything, and then the time do you go after that you can just play. It is reservation only or call ahead

Booked this on OpenTable for a table of 12 and we were able to secure their semi-private room for our Saturday brunch. Took us forever to get seated but this is American comfort food as advertised! I had something called the Braised-N-Confused, which was very tasty. Although it says it comes on a roll, there is so much cheese and grease on it that I used a knife and fork instead. My only complaint was with the mimosa, which they forgot to add whatever it was to make it raspberry. They seemed pretty understaffed at the time and we had to ask for the check way ahead of time for it to even show up when we were done eating. My friend said that their bacon fried rice was just "okay" as well.

If your in St.Pete Beach area come over. I'm a Blackened Grouper sandwich kind of guy but the freshly fried grouper sandwich is one of the best I've ever had. Staring at the beach and ocean while I sip on a Corona is a good problem. 

Live music on the beach patio usually on the weekends. Jimmy Buffet and ZBB are music of choice. Chilling like a playa!! Happy Happy Happy 

Headed back over the bay to Tampa tonight. See you at Eddie V's for dinner.

We went yesterday based on reviews.  My daughter and husband love pancakes and I wanted something hot.  We ordered the silver dollar pancakes and eggs, $9 for kids and I think $11 for adult.  The worker cut open a plastic bag of frozen silver dollar pancakes and put them in the oven.  At this point I should of said forget it!  But I was not feeling and we already paid, so I just sat down and waited for my hot oatmeal.  About 15 minutes later I got my instant cold, not even warm oatmeal.  I asked for boiling water to pour over and he gave me warm water.  He made me a new bowl and it was the same I asked him to boil some water and he did but the oatmeal never became hot oatmeal.  The workers were nice guys but the food was lamo!  The cafe con leche was good tasting but guess what?  It was not a hot cup of coffee, it was warm!  If you want their silver dollar pancakes I'm pretty sure you can get them at your local trader joes-they are nice and chewy! My advice, just take the pancakes off your menu.  Of course, they are making a lot of money off of them, most expensive kids meal I've ever paid for, and we eat out, a lot!
They've only improved with age and they've added some new sandwiches. The staff are as friendly as ever. Love this place.

Just to update went in again and the "Cheesy Burger " was once again Amazing! Owner as pleasant as before. Can't wait to go again.
This place doesn't disappoint. The " Cheesy" is still a great hamburger. The way they make it here is super good!

Highly recommend going here if you want Mexican. Thursday margarita specials are awesome, but it can get crowded fast, so show up early. They have great burgers, too. I have been here several times and it has never disappointed.

Nice little spot nestled right inside of a strip mall. Options Galore, everything is fully customizable. If you're in the mood for a sandwich ,they've got it, in the mood for breakfast ? They have it. If you're in the mood for a delicious NUTRITIOUS bowl, no problem . Fresh juice at the ready, smoothies? ( OMG oh my goodness) SMOOTHIES the likes of which you could only create in your minds imagination. Family-owned, super-friendly, very knowledgeable and oh, did I mention it's also very very healthy? Whenever I'm in the area it draws me away from other places nearby. Which considering how delicious and nutritious Vitality Bowls foods are, that's a great thing. A gotta STOP by and experience it for yourself.

Healthy Hut has been closed for quite some time. I wish that Yelp would recognize that. CLOSED!!!! PS: I use to LOVE going here when it was open, it was convenient having a health food store/cafe here at the beach... but alas, tis GONE!!!
Amazing impromptu dinner at Teddy's - service, atmosphere and food were excellent, we would definitely go back.
We stayed at this place for 10 days with 2 kids. It's close to Moneky Joes ( indoor playground ), Publix, gas station etc. You get free breakfast. Nice selection. Nice staff.

World F*cking Champions!! 
Love these guys, we've come a long way since the game I went to when I was 6. I lost a tooth while eating cracker jacks and I cherish the memory.  Go Phils!

went there to look at a toyota and while the salesman was quite nice the new car manager wasn't , offered us nothing for a 4 year old car with correct mileage, so we walked away, went to reedman toll and got a nice mercury ( for the same money ) justwithout being ripped off, we had expected so much better

THEY DOWNSIZED DRINKS! I my boyfriend and I just went for my birthday in December, I returned in May only to see that they made the drinks smaller and kept the prices the same. The waitress swore they'd always been the same and didn't know what to say when I showed her pictures! the lies. -1 star

It's hard to eat at Le Pain Quotidien without feeling like a bit of an ass. I've been to this one and to two locations in NYC (Upper East Side and Soho). The reason I say this is because the food, while tasty, is always served on teeny tiny plates, just urging you to make a mess of crumbs and debris from your open face "sandwich." And the atmosphere is so unspeakably ostentatious - in its good taste - just reeking of privilege in a way that I find embarrassing. I like the freshly baked spelt bread, the tuna/pesto "sandwich", and the coffee, but I feel like such a douche-bag when I eat here. It's just the vibe.

Big fan.  Dishes are superb.  The Duck Confit borders on fine dining (although mine was a bit salty... almost as if it was cured or something), while the sandwiches are gourmet bbq.  The 20 hour Pulled Pork is out of this world.  The bbq meats on the menu are served without sauce (except the ribs I believe), which I've noticed is only common at places that use meat they aren't ashamed of... (Chicago's 'Smoque', for instance)

The corn bread is a mini pie of corn bread served in a cast iron skillet with honey and sweet butter.  It's solid.  The mac and cheese is a good option for a side.  Out of the gumbos, the shrimp and andouille is the best.

The beer selection is quite strong.  The atmosphere is exactly what you'd expect from a place that shows off it's duck dishes... like a classy pub.  It's a small place, but the tables seemed to turn over quickly enough where nobody had to wait.

I'd highly recommend checking it out.  It's not just a bbq joint.  It's dressed up quite a bit.  I'd look at it more like a classy-casual restaurant that happens to serve a ton of great bbq.

Typical govt employees at this location, rude and condescending attitude of the welcome idiot who actually called me a smart-ass, next visit I  will set this jackass up. 1 star for ignorance and stupidity.

hi yelpers....been here prob. 6x's  in the past few years and I have to give this place now 5stars...let me tell u y..this has to b one of the top 10 dive bars in PHL......came here a couple of Mondays ago with a buddy of mine and we had a ball....met butch the bartender and he had me in stiches....funny guy...you come into this place and it looks like a PBR museum....you can walk around and you can check out all the PBR memorabilia...had their city wide special...12oz PBR can and a shot of jim beam for 3bucks....what a deal....if you like dive bars and r I PHL then check this one out !!

Fantastic Mediterranean restaurant. Appears to be a meat free place, which I'm fine with (vegetarian) but for the meat eaters it's still filling enough that you won't leave hungry. Best lebnah (yogurt dip) I've found since moving here. The falafel was delicious, not as crispy as others but so good and not overpowering with the spices. I'll be back, if not to try other menu items, I'll definitely want more lebnah & Moroccan mint tea.

Very nice place on Treasure Island. The atmosphere and lighting is cozy and intimate. The night we stopped in a very talented guitarist was deep into his music.
We sat at a hightop table in the bar area and had drinks and appetizers.
Two of us had the lobster bisque and two had a salad. Both were excellent. We also split a middle-eastern sampler which was very good. A little weak on the tap beer selection but the cocktail drinks were generous and tasty.
We would definitely return if we are in the area again to try some of the entrees which looked amazing.

We've been wanting to try Kanella's brunch for about a year now and given that we needed to be in the area, we decided to try it out. We stopped in without reservations around 1pm and when my bf told the server we didn't have a reservation but it was his birthday, they did their best to accommodate us. Luckily, one of the tables didn't show up for their reservation so we got to stay! Our server was AWESOME. So eager to help and make recommendations, and super friendly. We decided on the watercress salad and cuttlefish, both of which were specials. We also got the lamb sausage and duck egg breakfast. The food was good, but we weren't OVERLY impressed by anything. We really enjoyed the lamb sausage dish, but felt that it was a bit small. The salad was good, but nothing special. I felt that the flavor of parsley somewhat overpowered the cuttlefish, but I also don't really like parsley so I may have been particularly sensitive. Given the incredible reviews, I'm wondering if we just didn't order all that well, especially because we LOVE Meditarranean food. The service was excellent...the server put a candle in our order of baklava without our even asking. I would definitely go back and try it again.

I decided to give this place a try with an order of my favorites - butter chicken, garlic naan, and veg samosas.  Everything I got was awesome.  Butter chicken can be so oily at some places, but this was perfect.  One less star because: a) you have to pay extra for rice and b) I did pay extra for rice but never got it.  That was sad - messed with my meal experience.  It wasn't busy, at all, so I don't feel that there was any excuse.  I'll definitely be back to get my combo of food, but I'll make sure I get everything I order next time.

The jewel of the City Market! Never disappointed. From probably the best iced sugar cookies you'll ever have (and often seasonally iced in cute shapes!) to French breakfast pastries to cakes and macarons worth taking home for dessert--you can't go wrong. Incredibly reasonable for a downtown treat, and always worth the calories. And the good folks who work there are delightful.  They do special orders and offer classes, and in the last few months expanded to delicious artesian-quality breads. Accept cash and cards. I could go on, but just do yourself a favor and treat-yo-self.

This place is exactly what Fairmont needed. A chill market down on the first floor, serving all home made  pasta or panninis or a full service BYO upstairs. I experienced both and I will back many many times.

Prosciutto pannini, meatballs, bucatini, and chicken parm all incredible.

I am your prototypical meat, beer, and potatoes kind of guy who wouldn't be caught dead in an establishment like this under normal circumstances. The place is the size of a bread box, the prices are near astronomical, and you have a better chance of hitting the lottery than you do of scoring a seat inside. But damn is that arugula taco salad with a green lemonade a delicious lunch! I've also hit big when trying the wrap. 

The salad tastes great and is loaded with many things that seem to be very good for the body. Overall I do like this establishment, but you know what would be really hip of this place? Giving more than one napkin with your order! This food can get a little messy. Be prepared use the bag if you don't grab a few extras for the road...

We continue to place orders for their delicious coffee. I had ordered @ Christmas one of their many holiday flavors. 14oz Spiced Butter Rum. We ordered one for a gift to give a coach at my daughters gym & the other for us! It was such a huge hit at the gym that ALL the coaches drank it, enjoyed it & they will be requesting more in the future..LOL Our coffee here at the house was a Holiday hit & the many guest we had visit were impressed with the brand as well.
Every time I call to order the staff is so friendly & accommodating, which makes the process so much easier. 
Note-asked for it ground as your preference if you have an auto dip coffee pot: it's all packed as whole bean. There is no additional cost to have them grind it for you!
If you've NOT tried this place, I HIGHLY recommend you do! If your local go into thier shop: they have so much more to offer & sample the goods- you'll love their coffee too!

Love this little place just left and I feel amazing the staff are great there. I never had a bad experience here I have fibromyalgia and Amy does a real good job I feel pain free for the rest of the day. I only do the 60 minute foot and back massage. Great little place I always go back when I have money to treat myself.
Burger was really good! Shake was a little disappointing, but overall this place is delicious!

We booked this place because the users on Orbitz gave it a decent review and it was recently priced. Big mistake. To put it simply... It's clean enough to sleep in but I want to get out of the building as soon as possible. The staff is not friendly, they're pretty dry and are not helpful. The room has the bare minimum and the walls are so thin I can hear everything going on around me (which makes it hard to sleep through the whole night without being startled awake by a strange noise coming from outside our room). Don't book this hotel!
PJ's is my go to place! Everytime I get excellent service and great food! Bonnie, Kelly, and everyone there are just fantastic!

I love Press'd I order quite often for lunches and work functions, and their staff is always friendly & helpful. 
They always go out of their way to make sure our needs are met even if it's something as simple as throwing together some child friendly platters.

The food is always fresh and delicious. There is a great selection of items that are both classic and new and exciting.
I highly recommend Press'd to anyone who asks.

Ordered a sandwich and asked for no red onions, was told the sandwiches are made earlier that day and couldn't be opened to remove said onions. Waitress had zero enthusiasm and became frustrated when we took a long time to shuffle through the endless menu. Poor poor service.

I reasearched this place on Yelp. Wow what a extremely ,diligent well organized place that has an amazing turnaround time.I left a bike there in July of 2012 and went back yesterday and it was still there and repaired as promised!!It is refeshing to see a business like this prosper on their service and dedication.

BEST TACOS in Tampa. There are so many options and different combinations there is something for everyone. The guac and the queso are both to die for (with homemade chips) so I would suggest trying both and maybe two tacos to start with. The bigger your group the better because you can try a few more things. I have tried about a dozen different flavor tacos and you just cant go wrong. I always have a favorite of the day, but I have never not liked a pick. The steak is extremely tender and flavorful if you are really trying to decide on a filling. I must say I was also surprised at the kids burrito, it was pretty good size and came with lots of different fillings. Perfect stop for lunch, dinner or even a snack :-)

Delicious food and healthy after a great walk. Awesome awesome awesome yyyyyyyuuuuuuummmmmmtyyyyyyyh

Oh and healthy

I really enjoyed Crushed Red the two times I've been. I've had their pizza and their salad, both of which are excellent. I enjoy the ordering system how you order then follow your salad down the line. There is also some outdoor seating here which provides a great atmosphere right in the heart of Kirkwood.

The services was great, the food not so much. The piss clams were supposed to be littleneck clams and the fried green tomatoes were good but not tender. The mussles  were the only thing I had that was good. I also had the shrimp boil and for first time in my life I had the hardest time peeling the shrimp because they were over cooked, a lot of the shrimp was coming off attached to the shell. Out of three of us only 1 good meal was server it was the lobster boil and at $40 a pound thank goodness. The clam chowder was pink and  not New England style it was Cajun style so everything had a little spice to it. So if you are looking good seafood keep looking this is not the place!

I've been here a few times, and I've always had a pleasant experience and tasty food.  Recently, we went back after several trips to Ceviche in SoHo to do a little comparison, and we were impressed with how well Tinatapas stacks up against the tapa masters at Ceviche.  Would I say Tina's is better?  Definitely not, mainly because their menu is much, much smaller in size, but I will say that what they do offer is delicious.  

POLLO Y CHORIZO A LA PLANCHA - Mixing chorizo and chicken is always a swell idea, especially if you're going to grill them onions and peppers and serve them on a stick!  This is a good "first-timer" choice for people who aren't familiar with tapas.

GOAT CHEESE AL FORNO - Wonderful!  Served up with some toasty toast (haha) and red tomato sauce!  This actually makes a good dipping tapa for your other dishes, specifically the CHICKEN TENDERLOIN HABANERA!  The spicy island chutney that comes with the tenderloins is good, but trust me, dunk those bad boys in the goat cheese tapa.  You won't be sorry.

SANGRIA - If you check in using the yelp app, you get a free glass of sangria.  It's good for FREE, but I'd be angry if I paid full price for a glass.  It was just "OK."

As always, I'd eat here again if I were hungry and at Channelside, but I definitely wouldn't make a special trip for the food.  Good, but not that good.

A pleasant respite after walking in the muggy Quarter streets. We picked up some po boys to go and picnicked here, with a good view of the river and steamboat, then visited the aquarium. Shady, cool - very nice.

Incredible atmosphere. Awesome for celebrations!!  By far the best fried chicken I've ever had!! Try the bourbon punch!!! Danny was so kind- we loved the staff & will definitely be back. So impressed!!!

Food is good and soda machine is awesome. Service is pretty piss poor. Last two times I have been in this place, gave me the wrong order and see ya..... I order through the app several times and I come in......
"ummmmm I forgot to put paper in the printer"..... Just disappointing service.... No knocks on the wings though
You might think "it's just a plain ol' western omelette" but you'd be wrong.  Amazing food.  Excellent service.

Drove to the store, waited in line for 15 min and was then told I could not order chips and salsa because chips were only for online orders. I could clearly see a lot of chips so I asked again and was told that they did not want to run out of chips for people ordering online.  I guess they could care less about the customer that actually in the store.  Mexican food without chips, that's ridiculous. Absolutely pathetic policy.  This is no way to treat your customers that are literally standing right in front of of you.  With so many restaurant options I will never go to back to a Chipotle ever again.
I ordered the fruit crepe, very hard tasteless. The servers are friendly, but again the food is tasteless and I'm leaving hungry.

Stopped in here today for some curbside-to-go.  Personally, with a place like Chili's, I would prefer to sit there and eat, but my boss never wants to sit down anywhere, so we always get take-out.  Whatever.  

Anyway, our experience was okay. Not the best and not the worst.  You have to pick the food up from the bar area, and it seemed like it took a good several minutes for the bartender to get to us.  There were two people at the bar and one other person ahead of us picking up.  We just actually weren't even sure if she had even seen us cause she didn't exactly acknowledge our presence.  When she did turn her attention to us though, she was very nice, but I would have to say the service was a little lackadaisical.

The food was good (we all got the Mexican platter where you get two tacos/enchiladas, etc. and two sides - great deal for $8.50!) but we were sad that they forgot to put the salad dressings in our bags.  That's right - they forgot all three of us.  Luckily I had some vinaigrette in my desk at work, but it was not the same as the avocado ranch.  We were really looking forward to that avocado ranch.  Oh well.  We will be sure to really check our bags next time.

The restaurant wasn't very full either, even on a   Friday. I noticed maybe six tables or so. Back in the day, this Chili's was packed and you had to wait for a seat. Times have definitely changed.

Oh, and the chips and salsa were fabulous, as always!  Super  thin crispy and the best smooth salsa. So good!

they charged me $1.49 for a small cup of coffee. 
we used to stop there often. i was never before charged for a refill.
this time when i asked for a refill they said that would be another $1.49!!
i promise never to eat at any taco bell again and tell everyone that this is the wrong way to get customer's loyalty.....

i took my 5-7 times per week out to fast food to carls for their excellent 49cent coffee with refills.

vote with your dollars. people will respond or change occupations.,

Cozy place with a bright vibe focused in musician portraits. Get whatever the waitress recommends! You can't go wrong. We had the Cochin special and shrimp crepes. Heavier, rich, and affordable (for the area) dishes. It looked like they had a good bar. Beer selection was relatively limited but they did have 2 local taps and others bottled. Waitstaff was super friendly and speedy!

Horrible experience. Never not left a tip before. Table behind got seated after us and got served before us....a party of 13 to our small 3. We waited over an hour and never got served our food and mind you we ordered a salad, cheesesteak sand which and tenders with fries. Sadly we left at 9pm with no dinner and extremely dissatisfied. I will never dine here again. My child did not eat dinner after waiting for over an hour. Never thought I could have had this bad of experience after a great time at the beach. Publix subs take less time than this experience. Save your money!
I'll drive here from Sparks to get my cleaning and alterations. This is how you run a business. So friendly and their work is 2nd to none!

Absolutely delicious! I've been here three times. Do yourself a favor & make a reservation - and avoid the "lounge" area (unless you enjoy swinging while eating dinner!) 

All the food is perfectly delicious. Keep in mind the portions are small, making dinner a pricey ordeal. Margaritas are also perfection! I always get a fresh fruit. I've had pineapple and grapefruit and they are the best! 

All in all, we go for celebrations. Very expensive but thoroughly enjoyable!!

Shrimp scampi was not good. The dish was much too creamy and the shrimp ruined the pasta. You know that weird metallic taste that funky shrimp gives off? Well, it was that. I dodged the shrimp but the fact that they were even mixed in ruined the actual pasta too. 

This was also a delivery so I don't know if this contributed to the awful flavor, but I would say no. Wouldn't order any seafood dish from them ever again, but the reviews seem positive in regard to their pizza, so maybe I'll give that a shot.

I have to say visiting the dentist tends to bring me panic and after a horrid experience at another office I was scared. However, from my first phone call to set an appointment to my services today I am thrilled. Not only was everyone friendly, but they took the time to explain every step and price I was going to be charged. The dentist never pressured me into services and was very patient with all my inquires. I am thrilled to suggest this dental office to others. Even if you don not have insurance do not be afraid. I'll be back for my followup shortly!

Wouldn't honor a coupon. This is twice this Krispy Kreme has done this to me.
Donuts were not hot either.
Amazingly beautiful!! The arrangement I ordered was exactly like the picture on the website.

My experience at this restaurant today was so terrible that I think it would be morally wrong to not write this review. First of all, there are no signs stating the hours of this restaurant. Like many of the other places in Downtown Franklin, I assumed they would be open at least until 5 or 6. I assumed wrong. I walked into the place at 2:50, there was a couple of girls working but did not seem pleased that we had entered. They did not tell us that they would be closing within 10 minutes. So we ordered our food and sat at a table outside where another couple was eating. We got our food (which was mediocre) and within the next 15 minutes one of the girls came outside and told us we had to leave so that they could close. We hadn't even finished our meals and she snatched our trays away. Now I would feel bad if they had told us they were closing soon while we ordered but they didn't say anything. And there were also no signs stating the hours. They gave us no warning at all, which was completely rude. We literally still had half of our food left.  If I was a tourist, this would give me a bad view of Franklin. Thankfully I am local and know that Franklin is full of nice people and nice restaurants, just not at this particular establishment.
If your traveling with a infant don't check your car seat take it with you they lost mine and told me they couldn't do anything about it so I'm stuck at the airport with my infant

Went tonight with my fiancée. Best service and food! So nicely plated. We had the mofongo and it was great! Our server Linda was very attentive and knowledgeable (since it was my first time having mofongo.) Looking forward to bringing my parents here, I'm sure they'll love it. Keep up the great work !

The venue and the food is out of this world. The details to service, flavor, style, and cleanliness is worth 10 stars. The prices are a little higher, but it covers the beautiful interiors and exterior designs. Live music outdoors. Jessica, out waitress, was as sweet as can be. Take your time and enjoy the beautiful bay view. Very very lovely. Be sure to try as many of the homemade deserts!

A very 'family friendly' restaurant with a very nice, friendly staff, and great food (I had the seafood platter).  This is a 'no frills' kind of a place but that helps with the quaint, local atmosphere.  You do order at the counter and, when it is ready, they call your name and you have to go back to the counter to pick up your order.  Enjoy!

Saw the movie, About Time, last night.

This isn't a movie review site, but if you are looking for theaters it does not hurt to get an idea about what is playing. 

This was a feel good movie with enough suspension of disbelief required to last for weeks.  If you enjoy time travel (who doesn't like going back in time), then this one is for you.  It is light, funny, and endearingly idiosyncratic.  Yes, it leaves many questions unanswered, but that is not the point of romantic comedies.  

The acting is believable, and the London and Cornwall locales attractive.  

Looking for something to do next Sunday night, check this one out if you want a movie that leaves you with a smile, rather than a grimace.  If you want dinner with that, do what we did and go to Misto Diner for an above average Chinese meal first.

CASH ONLY!

Reasonable & a cute place in West Philly to go for happy hour. $4 margs, $5 nachos (HUGE)... 
Tacos are $2-3/each which is reasonable.. you can get a decent amount of food! 

Nice vegan options with seitan & spinach, mushrooms, & tacos. They have vegan cheeses are well so you can get nachos/burritos/quesadillas made vegan. :) Ask them to heat up the vegan nachos as we got them cold (noooo). 

Service was friendly & attentive. Definitely hipster, West Philly vibes. Cool on the inside. 

Not the best mexican food I have ever had but a fun happy hour spot to hit up. Do not need a res if you go early enough.

Terrible lay out, extremely hard to get into, even to get around, crowded tables, aisle, everywhere. Almost impossible to get drink, then to eat... What a horrible place...  Hamburger supposed one best around town.  Guess if like cold buns and raw meat.  Choices limited to menu, could not order fruit or French fries it came with baked potato, sounds good, wrong, they ran out of potatoes!!!!     Service sporadic.  Then try to leave... I hope there is never an emergency...  Never again.
Love this place every time we go!  Nice was our server - couldn't have been a better waiter and he was cracking us up. Highly recommend this place. Oh, and the food is incredible!

This is so hard for me to finally write and put into words how my animal was handled and how I was treated as a customer. 

We have been long time customers 10 years to be exact bringing all of our animals and never hesitating to bring in our animals to the vet. 

Two years ago I purchased a new family pet. We knew that we would be wanting to breed her. We set up the puppy consultation and everything was wonderful and smooth along with our other two animals we loved this place and Dr. Emily is amazing. 

The time finally came as she was two years old and in her second heat when we started the process of having her progesterone tested. Four days in of having progesterone tests I was told how they were performing the tests which is very very inaccurate and i was shocked. I knew there was a two day window between when she needed to be artificially inseminated due to her being a French bulldog. Which I told the girls that would meet me at my vehicle to come out and get her. For an entire week I drove every day getting these tests waiting for her to be ready. The last and same day I knew she would be ready they informed me as I showed up they magically ran out of tests. I was amazed....I told her this was pretty important but okay she was ready and today was her day. They then informed me they were two weeks out on procedures....2 weeks...artificial insemination...you can't just wait...which I told her...I got a sorry not sorry answer and I hung up. 

Thankfully we found animal emergency and specialty in Reno. After frantically calling around town for three hours. I explained the situation and they were shocked and had me bring her down immediately with my male. Thankfully they were able to get us in because just like I predicted she was ready that exact day and needed to be artificially inseminated ASAP. 

My advice for anyone even after being told that they handle all of these procedures and breeding programs they actually do not or the office staff is not competent enough to understand the severity and urgency when it comes to breeding especially with French bulldogs. 

We have since moved vet offices and our beautiful girl delivered five healthy puppies today. 

My recommendations if you are running a business especially one that caters to Patience is to stop trying to shove so many clients in one day that you can't even take care of them properly.

A great little pizzeria in Lutz!  Enjoyed a late lunch here. Although I did go with the lunch special, I think ordering a fresh pizza would've been best based on reviews from others.  I enjoyed a classic 2 cheese combo and also tried the eggplant parm.  The interior is decorated nicely and they do have outdoor seating.  Service is great and they have QR coded receipts (using Toast) for a much faster payment process!
An actual underground hidden gem. Such a relaxing atmosphere; purchasing a massage rock for my mom!

The Almanac is a modern and well decorated medium size restaurant/bar. We got seated really fast which was great. The sitting was comfortable. In regard to the overall environment, the noise level in this place is excessive. People were shouting and it really made the dinning unpleasant. The server was also somewhat frazzled, she was unable to memorize order and was obviously distracted. If I have to say something really good it would be the drinks. The cider and the "I drink and I know things", were amazing. The vegan entree was decent, the beans were slightly undercooked. The duck sandwich and fries was decent as well. Overall I rated 3/5 starts due to the time for cocktails. The time for a cocktail was 8 minutes when the bar was slow. Which is really slow for a cocktail. I would still recommend this place but go when you have all the time of the world.

Talk about a happy hour! 
Not only really and I'm talking REALLY amazing food, Amanda and Tommy had exactly in mind what we needed.
Perfect drinks to go with really reasonably priced food for the perfect happy hour experience.

Irene is great but where did she go? 
Great service. Take time and don't rush you out

the 1-star is because they're open all night...other than that, it was not good AT ALL!!!  i ordered an omelet with spinach & mushrooms...they may have well just brought me the egg-in-a-shell...the eggs were pretty runny and the omelet was gross-looking, so i told the waitress my concern and asked to have it cooked more...the 2nd time back, it STILL was not cooked properly...so, i was done! i had pancakes (which came with the omelet)...can't really mess those up...at least i got SOMEthing on my stomach, after a long night of partying!

Great food! My husband had been disappointed with the last steak he had at a different restaurant and my sister recommended Harold Seltzers. I had the ribeye and my husband had the filet -- both were delicious! Baked potatoes and salads were good too. Good service too. The only reason I gave this four stars is that we didn't get any dinner rolls or bread.

This place is great. We recently enrolled our 4 year old into their intro to swim classes. Classes are 30 minutes, once per week, year round. They offer 3 to 1 student to teacher ratios. You can tell they know what they are doing as they really take their time to make sure the kids are improving. They do offer make up classes if you miss. 

Nice indoor facility with a good waiting area (with windows) for the parents. 

Little more expensive then I would have liked but it's a good value for what you get. I've heard from others the progress is slow but that makes sense at 30 minutes per week. 

I would recommend for others.

Expensive and gross

Chips not cooked, food average staff were helpful. We sent food back several times.

Had to leave and get a drink elsewhere to get the taste out

Eh. First experience here today. It was pouring and when we walked in we almost fell because there's no mat at the door. They also seemed irritated with me having an umbrella and the floor getting wet. We ordered and it only took about 10 mins to get the food so that was nice. We both got the teriyaki chicken bento. It was kind of surprising to me that when we placed our order they asked for here or to go and we said here and still received our order in styrofoam....soooo bad for the environment. The chicken had no flavor. Nothing about the dish was teriyaki. The sauce they brought us on the side was very confusing. It was like a ranch of some type??? It was good but didn't pair with the dish in our opinion. The California roll was decent, very small pieces. The crab Rangoon was the highlight of the trip. One of the best Rangoon's I've ever had. It was also freezing in the place, pouring down rain and 65 outside and the AC was blasting! I'm giving 2 stars because of the Rangoon and the portion size. Even if I wasn't wild about my meal it was a large amount of food for a low price. If we go back we will probably not order the bento since there was no flavor and lean more towards sushi.

We don't usually get dessert with dinner and wine, but here, it's a MUST, and I'm talking about the Belgium waffle dessert! They make it fluffy, so it's not as thick and filling as a regular Belgium waffle, but has the same great taste topped with delicious ice cream! 

The menu does not have descriptions, so definitely ask the wait staff about anything you want! Our waitress was extremely knowledgeable and explained several of the appetizers and entrees to us in order to make a decision. The extensive wine list is also in Italian, and I usually drink Napa Valley Cabernets, so the waitress recommended one of the best wines I've ever had! 

They serve a variety of salad, pasta, seafood, and meat entrees along with a large selection of bruschetta, meat, and cheese appetizers. 

Appetizer must: Sal's famous meatballs with tomato covered potato. You get three juicy meatballs with a little potato underneath them, and the flavors were impeccable!

We were looking for pasta and had the ricotta and tonnarelli dishes. Both were outstanding. While other reviews mentioned "generous" portions, I would categorize them as below average for what we usually receive at high-end Italian restaurants. We both finished our plates and could have eaten more, whereas usually I cannot finish an entire pasta entree. This was even after consuming one appetizer, fresh bread (provided to all patrons but with no dipping oil), and our complimentary side (described below).

The service was top notch! Besides our waitress being attentive and knowledgeable with everything, we were offered a complimentary side that we shared while waiting for our meals because the chef was not happy with how the entrees resulted. Therefore, he started over while we enjoyed the side. We greatly appreciated this level of service! 

I'm surprised it's rated $$$ because most entrees were $16-20 a piece minus a few exceptions. We got a bottle of wine, two entrees, one appetizer, and one dessert for $115 plus tip! The ambiance was upscale, yet we saw people wearing anything from t-shirts and flip flops to dressy. 

They have $18 valet that is the best option unless you want to park and walk quite a bit. They had outdoor tables, but we opted for inside as outside seating is on the sidewalk by where everyone arrives, walks by, and valet.

We enjoyed our date night and would definitely go back as we are huge fans of the Vetri restaurants!

Literally the best place to go for a beer, best Herman and Belgian selections in all of Tampa! 
Don't forget go the cafe that's connected, food is unbelievably great! Meat,dairy, and vegan options   service is always on point. I have been coming here since the opening and I can tell you that at no point has this place ever skipped a beat. Thank you Independent for making my hometown hood bad ass again

I went here for the first time last weekend and will be coming back whenever I am in Philly. We were able to sit down right away which is always a plus in this city. It was a great bar atmosphere for a Sunday with fairly priced beer. 

Okay food but I was personally very impressed by the amazing service provided by our waiter Zoe. She was so friendly, polite and so upbeat. She had great food recommendations (chicken wings and anything fried) and great beer knowledge. She made sure we were taken care of and our drinks were constantly filled. I would come back here solely on the service! Thank you Zoe!

I've been here for a little over a month now and I'm quite happy with it. I think the landscape is very pretty. And the Staff is quick to fix anything we ask about.  All in all I'm glad to live here. It's great for a first apartment. And being a young adult.
Mediocre pizza. The crust tasted weird and I've honestly had frozen pizzas that tasted better. Won't order again.

Came for dinner on sat around 8:45pm. Estimated 45 min wait for a party of 7. Scored a table upstairs where there's more room to maneuver. Ordered the crab claws, raw oysters, and charbroiled oysters to start. The sauce the crab claws came in was really good. Too bad I ran out of bread to soak it up in. Just wished the dish was a little hotter; it came out lukewarm. I favored the raw oysters over the chargrilled. Something about the chargrilled ones were a little too salty. The baked shrimp tortellini was a pretty heavy dish but tasted better than the taste of New Orleans. You can check-in for a free app but it was only $10 off; not the full price of the appetizer. That wasn't indicated anywhere for the check-in so a little false advertisement there. Not sure if I would come back since there's a million creole restaurants nearby.

I am beyond obsessed with the pork buns. The veggies were crisp and fresh while saucy, the pork was perfectly done, the bun itself was toasty and crisp on the outside and fluffy and sweet on the inside. It's like the flavors were born to be together.
The tonkatsu ramen was also incredibly fresh and well prepared, the broth was the perfect compliment to the pork, the mushrooms and noodles had satisfying give, and they absorbed the broth so nicely. After work in the cold, this warm, soothing dish was everything I needed.
I ordered to-go, but my experience in the restaurant was still very pleasant. The person who helped me was very nice and welcoming, they were compliant with COVID-19 guidelines, the lighting and atmosphere was very relaxing and cool.
I'm not going to lie, they honestly hit it out of the park for me. I'll definitely be back, typing this out made me hungry
This is our favorite breakfast place.   Chickpea scramble is AMAZING!!  Service is outstanding!

The food is very VERY poor quality. But the cheapness doesn't stop there, he even has the audacity to SKIMP, which adds insult to injury. Don't bother wasting your time requesting anything done to specifications/ special orders, it will not only NOT get done, but the brute, Neanderthal husband will blame the wife, who played NO PART in the BAD food, BAD service or BAD preparation. The partial refund was more insulting than satisfactory. The wife is a wonderful, hardworking, gracious earth-angel, I pity sweet women like her, married to a satan's- son.

From our first visit/estimate to project completion, Par 4 did an excellent job! The owner Jim brought our vision for our new paver walk way, paver patio and yard to life. Jim and his crew showed up every day, on time, and were even flexible with our schedule. The work was done efficiently and exceeded our expectations! We couldn't be happier!!
This restaurant never disappoints.   Always a large selection of specials!  Ordered a,strip steak for first time here and it was perfectly cooked, medium rare!  It's a great BYOB too!
Rude and rough employees. Guy jerks basket intentionally with my kid in it causing her immediately say hey, that wasn't nice and that it hurt her neck. Wait time was also poor to checkout.

We visited 4 restaurants in the food hall.  We got tea at the coffee shop, and the woman there was so nice.  Then my daughter who is a vegetarian had the vegan red beans and rice - she loved it.  It was spicy and sauce was thin, but she thought it was delicious.  I ate at Market Deli.  I had fresh tomatoes and mozzarella over foccacia with pesto.  I LOVED it.  Tomatoes were fresh, mozzarella light and tasty.  The perfect lunch.  We got a cheese plate from the deli also.  Really enjoyed 2 of the 3 cheeses and the pickles.  Finished at the bakery.  Brownie and chocolate cookie were good not great.  Peach cookie a little bland.  My friend really liked the red velvet cake.  The place is very nice inside.  Clean and bright.  Cool bar in middle.  I would definitely go back for lunch.

With a warmer weather like this, my coworkers and I decided to take a stroll to Reading Terminal and check out the new grilled cheese place. Their menu online looked promising and we were all excited to try it out. We walked around the market trying to find where it is located, but there wasn't any clear sign. Thanks to a person who works at the market we were able to find it towards the back of the market. It's close to Irvine Produce. 

I had a hard time deciding between the Brielle and Somerset. Per their recommendation, I got the Somerset with a small cup of fountain soda. It came with homemade potato chips. All together it cost me around 10 bucks. The sandwich was huge and definitely very filling for lunch. The bread they use is thick and tasty with the right amount of melted cheese in between. Being picky, I wish there were a little more of crunchiness from the bread and pickles. 

They don't just make grilled cheese sandwich there but also sell their cheese. I didn't get a chance to check that part out. Next time!

Reilly is alright, but I much prefer Tough Luck Club downstairs. The food is pretty good (try the Brussel Sprouts) but it just doesn't seem worth the money to me, and the waitstaff are sometimes kind of slow and inattentive.
Amazing food and cocktails, but tainted by the horrible waiter... Such a disappointment!

It felt like I was in an out and really appreciated the guy at the front desk taking his time to explain everything to me. 
For the 1st I got in my car after having it serviced and neither my AC or radio had been messed with.
I am definitely going to continue going to Goodyear as long as everything stays

Ordered a basic pie with mushroom, pepperoni and cheese and was more than satisfied.  I prefer a thin crust and this place delivers.  They also do pizza by the slice, which is always an added bonus in this area. From what I hear, the owner is the nephew of the Mike's Pizza and Deli on 49th St.  The place looks very quaint and cute and the outside patio area was a nice addition to the previous set-up.  I'm definitely looking forward to warmer weather, having a beer and sharing pizza there with friends.

In a city with some of the best independant shops I've ever seen this mall is an absolute travesty.  Soulless, expensive, unappealing, and boring.  The only plus of this place is for people who don't want to wait in the assinine lines of the original Cafe Du Monde - you can get the exact same mediocre donuts and coffe right here while looking out on the river.  The view is nice - but you can get the same view from the actual riverwalk.  I guess it might be nice here during the summmer when it is too hot to sit outside....maybe....probably not.

I love Pizza Delicious. Very flavorful. Really good pizzas, and I highly recommend ordering the garlic knots.

Worth the trek from other parts of the city. It is in a wonderful creative and progressive neighborhood. Near a nice riverfront park. I'd recommend getting your pizza and enjoying the nice park. 

Good service and nice architecture. 

Must visit while you are in New Orleans.

It's good! Not brilliant, but always solid.

The korma with meatballs does not hold up to some of the more complex korma recipes in town. I prefer a vegetable korma that is an explosion of ingredients.

The owners are pleasant and welcoming. We had a large group event there and the buffet was well stocked and hot and tasty.

It's most popular as a lunch spot and, for this, I highly recommend it. It's in a great location and you get in and out for a great deal.

I would love to see a better korma.

I want to first start off saying that the only reason I decided to go here is because I was under the impression that the place was BYOB.  A local Philadelphia website described the place as a newly opened cash-only BYOB.  Although the business owner was not the person responsible for publishing this article, I would imagine you would want to be aware of any publicity you were getting which was clearly not the case.
Upon entering this dining establishment, I was told that the restaurant was not BYOB and the hostess even tried to imply that I was wrong about the article and must have been reading about the Hopewell, NJ location.  First mistake.  
Our server only had a few tables and was stopping by so frequently that it was almost becoming annoying.  Also, we said we were ready to order dinner and my friend decided to first order another drink before rattling off his food order.  Immediately after he ordered his second drink she said "I'll be right back with that" and ran off leaving our table speechless.
Drink prices were reasonable and if the pizza would have been the quality of Pizzeria Stella, the food prices might have been reasonable.  This was not the case.  The ingredients were all over the place in big clumps.  The presentation reminded me of a kindergartner's creation at a make your own pizza party.  The flavor was slightly better than a store bought Dijiorno pizza.  
My suggestion: buy a bottle of wine and attempt to make your own pizza.  However, the experience was at least laughable and my friends and I will have something to joke about for a short period of time.
P.S. I almost forgot, the floor is uneven upstairs.  Not exactly ideal for a place where they give you a fork and knife to cut your own pizza.

I went to Tony's last week and had the most unbelievable dinner.  I LOVED that it's BYOB and they have a large menu to choose from.  The Garlic knots were to die for and the chicken dish I had was excellent.  I cannot wait to go back!

Went today with a party of four for brunch. We ordered the Coca-Cola toast with vegetables, the cheese omelette with kale salad and the banana pancakes. The pancakes were so fluffy like a cake almost and very tasty. The kale salad was delicious- whatever dressing they used made it great. The omelettes were good and the avocado toast was fine. The sweet potatoes fries were cold but the waiter exchanged them and all was good. The restaurant has indoor and outdoor seating and just when we were finishing out meals a musician started performing indoors. The neighborhood is great to walk around and there is a farmers market close to the restaurant. Anyway - it's a good place for a tasty brunch .
They deliver on the Westside of SB and the food is tasty. If you need a quick Chinese meal then you should check this place out.

ROXBOROUGH FAVORITE!!! Lenny's is a great neighborhood place to pick up some hoagies. They have a wide selection of hoagies to choose from. My favorite has always been the Cajun Turkey. The sandwich has a great Cajun Mayo on it which makes it unique. The rolls they use for their hoagies are hearty, just generally great bread. They are always fast at taking and making your order (which is great when you are in a rush during lunch break). The prices are good. Most hoagies are about $7.50 and they are quite large. Definitely the BEST spot on Ridge Ave in Roxborough for a great sandwich!!!

Super service combined with a great, fun atmosphere and oh such a gooood menu. The nachos are memorable. Nick was so fantastic behind the bar that we came back and met Dallas. Another delight. Get away from the overrated and try Hi-Fi Clydes.

Found this place on yelp went in the bartenders were fun love the cheers kinda of bar got to talk to a few locals. We got the fried oyster basket it was breaded they were great he got the shrimp po boy it was great too will be back for sure.

By contrast, my review for the second Limoncello location in Chester Springs, well, let's just say it didn't get 5 stars. The best Italian restaurant I've found in Chester County is right here, right in the boro, right on Walnut St.

From pasta to fish, from beef to veal, from chicken to dessert, your choices will work because everything is great here.

If you are on vacation in the French Quarter and missing your furbabies back home, you really need to stop here.  I bought my pups a stuffed crawfish and a gator that they just love. Even better were the little bone shaped cookie treats that my dogs couldn't get enough of.  They have a good selection of gifts for pet lovers too.
Highly recommend online pre-ordering. Friendly and helpful service - tricky parking. Will return!

Went there and ordered two slices and after I already put my hands on my slice any wife took a bite out of hers the guy tells us 10 dollar minimum on debit cards. Now there was no sign or anything to tell us that, so I had to find some sodas and stuff to make it to 10 bucks. So far I don't even mind the inconvenience even know my wife does...lol. But just when I get done paying and getting ready to leave the delivery guy decides to reach over my slice of pizza with his dusty sweaty arm to grab his next delivery! I was so disgusted after this I threw my slice in the trash and grabbed my sodas and left. I will never go back. If anyone wants great pizza with great service go to Ginos pizza on frankford ave right near cottman. Thanks for your time god bless and have a nice day.

Smelly, claustrophobic and busy. 3 words to describe the gateway arch ride to the top, but it was o so worth it! We had some great views of the city. Too bad the only thing we saw in st louis was the arch since we had to go further on our trip! Next time we make sure to check the city out as wel!
Great diner food.  Breakfasts are awesome and fresh from the flat top griddle.  Wait staff is friendly and atmosphere is laid back southern hospitality.

Great timely friendly service. I brought my car in to buy a new tire and to change the oil and the whole staff was friendly and attentive the whole thing was done in 40 min. I just walked across the street grabbed a coffee, and it was over before I knew it. Definitely coming back here to get my car serviced when I need to.

Writing this review because I desperately need a haircut and am debating driving the three hours away from my house to go to this salon because Nicole (I hope she's still here) is the only hairdresser that has never, ever done me wrong. I'm one of those people who says "just kind of trim it all over?" and she turns it in to what I didn't know I wanted it to be. I want to pack Nicole and take her wherever I move!

I have also had the 30 (maybe 60...) minute facial here which is COMPLETELY WORTH IT because of the Yonka products they use-- it really makes a difference and people could always tell. 

I think I probably will make that drive now... just book a whole bunch of treatments in one day to justify the drive to myself!

I have been to long branch twice now. I have enjoyed it each time. I wouldn't call it authentic in any way (they even note that on their website). I would classify it as if you were on a cooking show and needed to make traditional Chinese dishes with unorthodox ingredients. I've drunk my way through most of the cocktail list (or tried them at least) and tried most appetizers. Here are my favs:
