Go anywhere but here
Great authentic Vietnamese cuisine. Diggin the lunch specials. Steak special is the Bomb. They're still new so I give them extra love. Banh Mi is solid.
For being slam packed on Mother's Day, the food was great and service was awesome.. Thank you we will return!

Our first experience there was amazing! I ordered vegan Broadmoor Melt and my wife had Barrio historico tlayuda. Both were absolutely delicious! I was pleasantly surprised with the homemade chips that were fantastic, and their salsita is just OMG! We also asked if they were offering any vegan desserts and it turned out that their pudding is vegan until they pour caramel on top of it, which the cashier/host helped organized for us. Thank you for that! It was delightful.

I will come back 100%. I loved everything there, the food, the staff, the interior, the cleanliness. The only thing that was upsetting is one of the customers who was ignorant enough to not wear a mask inside the restaurant when placing an order and talking to a member of the staff.

These guys are really good people. I was passing through on 295 and still a long way from home when my engine started to overheat. I was able to find these guys and get to their shop 5 minutes before they closed. They didn't even bat an eye about the fact that they were pretty much closed. They got me coolant and filled it for me so I could get home. 

They were so nice. I definitely suggest going there. If I lived anywhere near them I would patronize their business as much as possible. Please do so on my behalf!

One of my favorite places to get tacos in Philly! If you're a seafood lover like me, get the Kraken which has fried octopus. I've been here a few times and although I always read over the full menu, I can never resist the Kraken. 

Heffe is a walk-up taco stand with cute outdoor table seating. If you're in a hurry, they offer take out. Each order comes with two tacos. 

Their tag line is "Tacos That Don't Suck"... and trust me, they definitely don't!

the parking lot is a  nightmare and it drives me crazy the TV signal and remotes never seem to work so I have to go to 5 machines to find one that works.  No I'm not there to watch TV but it certainly makes the workout seem faster.
 Staff has never really acknowledged me when I walk in. Not sure why i even bother to scan my tag anymore since no one pays attention. You could definitely walk into this gym for free. Never got a grand tour of the place when opening membership but I see everyone else get them.  As far as the gym goes...it's Nice and big. Plenty of equipment and open late.  I really enjoy their 2 designated circuit areas.
No hidden fees?  Yeah there is a fee each year and also a fee to cancel.
AMAZING FOOD!! I got the veggie sandwich and my man got the ropa vieja. Both were quite tasty! Service was fast and exceptional.

Food is AWESOME! Prices are reasonable. Portions are large. Service is terrific.

We eat here every couple of weeks and really hope this place makes it. It's the sister restaurant of Guillermo's Double L on 4th Ave. So it's a lot closer for us. And I actually think the food is better, even though they have the same menu. I can't understand why this place isn't packed every night. We have never had a bad meal. I will say the decor is a little overdone, but it's clean and spacious. You should really give this place a try.
Been going here twice a week for a year now - food is yummy yummy yummy, got to try the spicy tuna

Reallt enjoyed this location.  Food was great. You order, pay at the counter and take a seat.  We had friendly service.  Tony the waiter even gave us a champagne bottle that would have otherwise been discarded.   We enjoyed the home town feel of the place and it's delicious food.  4 and not 5 stars because the were out of a dish our guest requested and then got her modified order wrong.
Had a great Beer Masters tour by Mark.  So much information for a novice such as myself. Prepare to walk and taste test beer.  Very interesting.

I work down the block. Garces used to be my regular lunch spot and even occasional dinner/brunch place. It no longer is because their food over the years has gotten saltier and saltier. It's gotten to a point that I can't even eat my favorite dishes such as the salmorejo, vichyssoise, duck salad, and various pasta dishes. 

I've returned the soups a number of times and a couple of times left uneaten entire dishes. Waiters have been very nice about it, assuring me that they would let the chef know. If they have, it seems like the chef doesn't care or assumes that salt attracts diners. But if we wanted a plate of sodium we would go to McDonald's. Chefs, please respect our complex palates.
This Philly native is sooooo not impressed.  Donuts stunk!  Don't understand the hype

I was in Philly for the Step Into Greatness Tour featuring Eric Thomas and a group of friends and I went there for dinner. Two of us ordered the sliders and the rest has brick oven pizza. Everyone enjoyed their meal and the food was delicious! I love how they use organic and they gave choices as to gluten-free, whole wheat or white crust for the pizza. The staff was friendly. Since there were 6 of us it seemed long of a wait but I guess it was because we were hungry; but it was worth the wait. They have a simple menu, easy to read with good food choices. I would definitely go visit again if I'm ever in the area. Great experience!

This was absolutely disgusting I want to throw up don't ever waste your money here ... Please I'm begging you ignore the stars on this place these people are out of their minds and were probably paid to review it.

This is fast food.  Therefore the review is based upon that concept.  Been there numerous times.

You want fast?  Then the drive-thru does a great job.
Service inside is simple.  The place is clean.

Food?  It's Taco Bell level food.  They failed a time or two on the bean burrito.  But no biggie.

Would I go back?  Yep.  Would I recommend to a friend? I wouldn't tell them to avoid it.

Food is okay . But not the original jamaican food . I will not be returning . If youre a lady and you were to go by yourself at the night time i wouldnt recommend that . Go accompanied . There be drunk people that act like fools.

Hands down the very BEST place to go for personalized shirts, hoodies, bags, license plates, banners- you name it, C&C will do it! I've had everything under the sun done here and it was all done fast and flawlessly! Go check them out, you won't be disappointed!

Our tour guide told us about the $20.14 lunch special for which we are very grateful. 
We both had the salad of greens, walnuts, strawberries and feta with a balsamic vinaigrette. The gulf shrimp creole was good with tender succulent shrimp and light creole. The pecan bread pudding could be the love child of bread pudding and a pecan sticky bun, decadent and also delicious. The 25 cent martini's were a nice touch. Our wait staff graciously also gave us a tour of this amazing restaurant. Enjoy.
Great food and service with no pretense. Steak and potatoes, not much better. Salad bar, breads and cheese to start with amazing cakes and sundaes for desert.

Looking for a great happy hour during the week? This is the place! I met a friend of mine here to grab some drinks and apps. We sat at the bar and Jose was our bartender. He was the best!

As soon as I sat down he came over with water and offered me the drink menu. Since I knew I was about to go to a yelp event with wine, I decided to try the white peach sangria. AH-MAZING! Jose hooks it up! If its too strong or too sweet, he will remake it for you, so you have the drink just the way you like it. 

Now lets talk about the food! I mean this place has everything. My friend and I ordered the 2 rolls for $15 off the happy hour menu. We got he KFC roll and the Mexican roll. Both were delicious. I was familiar with the Mexican roll, but never tried the KFC one and it was awesome. Its fried chicken in a sushi roll - you can't go wrong with that mix. There was a gentlemen who sat next to us at the bar and he ordered some sort of vegetable stir fry over rice and it looked amazing as well. He told me he comes to this place often and always sits at the bar for Jose and usually always orders the vegetables. 

This place is so cute and just beautiful inside. On Saturdays they do live jazz. They said it is just one guy, but he is really good.I will definitely be back with my husband to try them out for dinner and hear the jazz.

I ordered the Impossible Burger (in-n-out style they currently have) with the vegan cheese. I opted to keep the sauce on as well - very similar to the actual, true in-n-out burgers! 
It was cooked perfect, melted cheese on top, as well as the lettuce, tomato, onion, & sauce combo that keeps it all simple.
As we are still in the 'to-go/delivery' type of world, I picked up my order, which was quick & efficient. This place looks like it'd be a lot of fun, with a fairly decent size lawn and some lawn games and tables.
The one burger was $10.25 ; so a little pricier than the typical in-n-out (also, non-vegan burgers were still about $9.25) - before adding any fries or soda, if that's how you roll!
A great place to have a lite lunch. The alligator was amazing... And our waiter gave us excellent service.

I've been coming here for years.  While the building isn't the classiest and parts are perpetually unfinished, the food is amazing.  I always get the Louis Roll; it's named after the owner and is fantastic.  The prices are extremely fair, too.  Don't expect to be blown away by ambiance or lots of fancy things...  It's all about the sushi here.

Goodbye, Subway(s) in the CBD.... HELLLLLLO, JIMMY JOHNS!

Ludicrous amount of seating.  Very clean.  Sandwiches?  BAMF! Done, here ya go! Have a nice day.  

CHEAPER THAN SUBWAY AND YOU GET MORE!

I have found my new favorite cold sub sandwich place!

Very happy with Apsara, it's my new salon! I received a very precise and careful haircut along with great color by Enkeleda. Michael and the staff are attentive and kind. I never felt rushed or moved around too much. Start going there!

Enjoyed everything about eating here last night. Large portion and delicious dips. They even gave me extra pita to finish the dip. I ordered a small salad with feta, tomato, cucumber, and romaine. It was seasoned well and was rich in flavor.  The main dish I ate was Branzino. The fish was a medium size, but with the salad before it I had plenty of food. The fish was grilled and came with a small side of spinach and olive oil leak. Thanks to the staff for a great meal. I will go there again.

Second time I've stayed at this resort. I somehow got placed in a handicapped room that doesn't have a tub and the water kind of just gets everywhere. Also didn't find an ironing board so that was a bit disappointing. I don't like the fact that it is one hell of a long walk to the room unless you hop on one of the golf carts. The drive to State street is ridiculously far too so when staying here you pretty much have to hang out around here.

Now the good part of this resort.. the in-room bar has plenty of options. Probably one of the best I've seen for a hotel. The food option is pretty good in the resort. Service is extremely friendly here, and the beach is close proximity.
Best sushi happy hour in the city just am be sure you sit at the bar. Otherwise get the LSU roll.

The place seemed nice enough and the staff was friendly and attentive. Ordered 3 panckakes, i ate one that was under cooked.  The pancakes are so thick that they are not enjoyable. Eating one is like eating a small cake.  I ate one, gave one away (he didnt care for it either) and threw the other one away.  I have heard such nice things about Sabrina's so i will try it again, but i will never again order the pancakes.

Can't say much about the food since I had the "Butterscotch Pudding" but it was amazing, highly recommend it. By the looks of it Ffish and Chips" looked really good and so did the "Seasonal Pie". Ambience was great, service was fast as well. Very friendly servers
My favorite spot for lunch and customer satisfaction is #1  I love the tuna and cheese on rye.

Now, I've been to Flying Saucers before, but never in good ole Nashvegas. This location is HUGE as far as pubs go and the beer selection is larger than you are likely to find in most places. Thursday nights, they offer $3.50 American pints. Considering their beer selection, this is an all but limiting selection. It was exceptionally crowded but the open patio area is great for the cooler weather we've had lately. 

I will warn you, shots and chuggers are no where near economical. One Irish car bomb set me back $9. That's pretty steep. The service was a bit spotty at the bar. Maybe it was a particularly hectic night, but from what I experienced, try to find a male bartender to help you.
Best donuts!!! Can't beat breakfast special! Super nice staff. Highly recommend cinnamon crunch donut!!

We were excited to try this place but ended up in disaster. The hot sauce bottle they gave us exploded all over 2 of us and not only did they just offer a couple of dirty rags from kitchen, they didn't offer to cover our meal or even our dry cleaning cost! 

Walked out covered in hot sauce (which I later noticed we were charged for)  after paying full price for a meal that was ruined! Will never eat here again, management needs to learn some manners.

I really like the atmosphere at Bully's. The waitresses are nice and you usually get served pretty fast. 

Every time I head to Reno I have to stop at Bully's to get their chicken tenders tossed in buffalo wing sauce. During happy hour they are pretty cheap and they come with fries.

When I want to experience an IMAX movie, my first thought is to check here.  They have both first run movies and nature documentaries.  This IMAX has excellent quality and you really feel immersed in the movie.  Online ordering is a breeze.  Don't let the parking garage pricing deter you; you'll receive a parking discount.

I had an extremely welcome surprise here. 

Toyota sent me a warranty enhancement opportunity through the mail. I was able to schedule any appointment and have my car diagnosed. 

Ed Campbell provided unparalleled customer service and listening skills. 

This is my first and only interaction with this specific location, and highly recommend Ed.

Me and my two girlfriends needed to find a house with enough space and bathrooms to keep our sanity. Not only did George and his agent Gary find us that space, they found us a house with a bathroom for each of us and room to spare. Every step of the way George went above and beyond to make sure we got what we wanted. I could recommend a business or agency more!!!
This is our spot everytime we come to St. Louis. Great food! Will definitely be back here for more wonderful meals and will recommend it!

I've been to El Camino many times and never had a problem until tonight. The wait was short but the host was friendly and accommodating. My issue is the time it took for the waiter to take my order(10 minutes) and another 30 minutes for my food to arrive. I was so annoyed I sent the food back and ask for my card so I could leave. The manager comes to my table not to apologize for the wait but to say that the food only took 20 minutes to cook which tells me it took my waiter another 10 minutes to place my order. The 10% COVID charge added to the bill and wait time is why I won't be returning. So disappointing because I used to like this place.

We enjoyed the wings, tater tots and pickle fries. Service wasn't great, soooo slow, and our food came out staggered so one of us was done eating while the other 2 of us were just getting started, and 1 of us was still waiting. We hoped it would be worth the wait, but no. The burgers were nothing special (patties are too dense, would be better tasting if hand formed and not pressed so thin) and they were burnt, not char-grilled, but burnt. Also the burgers are $8.50 for the bare minimum burger up to $15 for a special one without a side. Too expensive for the quality. Lesson learned.

Wonderful variety of unique donuts! 
Happy donut lovers!!! 
Reese's, Cookies and Cream, Samoa's, Twix, Caramel M&M & more!

The Bar is great and always packed but if you want to be able to have a conversation move as far away as possible into the dining room and away from the kitchen.

Food menu is varied and always okay. My Biggest complaint that I have and talked about by many of my friends who go there.
" It is the side of ketchup". It is disgusting.

They must pore the ketchup at 8:00 AM  into those little white dishes and leave it uncovered in the refrigerator all day.

Two nights ago was the worst. I couldn't get the French fry to go into the Ketchup. I was poking it with a knife and no luck. There was a 1/4 of an inch thick hard crust on top. The table next to us  had the same thing.
 I spoke with an assistant manger, this is unacceptable.

Just a suggestion tell your waitress when you order you want fresh pored ketchup.

I have now had Randazzo's twice sober. I have my roommate and I hooked. I know the perfect timing to call when I'm walking home from work and by the time I walk in the door its coming out of the oven and by the time I walk it home its the  perfect edible temperature without burning the roof of your mouth! 

This is the pizza that poets write sonnets of. It is perfect in its cheese factor, sauce is perfect not to sweet not spice-ladden, the crust. Oh The crust! The crust is thin and perfectly crispy. 

We have pizza once a week now.
Supposedly they have milkshakes as well, but I'm scared to try them for fear they will be the end of me.
It was very crowded at lunch during the week.  The weather was great so I didn't mind waiting outside.  The burger was great, but the fries were very salty.  Try 5 Guys if you haven't already.
Very surpised to find a holster, I wasn't even looking for, so that's a plus. But most of the staff was too busy talking with each other to help any customers.
Love this chain!  Menu is massive and full of offerings.  They have a significant bar/mixed drink offerings as well.  I love their flatbread pizza and lunch melts.

Store very clean and employees very friendly.  Prices on par with area.  We got a supreme pizza which has pepperoni, sausage, peppers, onions and mushrooms.  I would have to say it was just ok.  There was way more vegetables than meat.  The pepperoni was good but sparse.  It was hard to see the sausage but I am sure it was there.  They seem to slice the sausage into small pieces rather than the large chunks you normally see.  Don't recall having a lot of cheese either.  There was very little sauce which probably didn't matter as it didn't have much flavor.  Finally, we ordered crispy crust but with so many vegetables it came out a little soggy.

We decided to have dinner here shortly after we arrived in New Orleans.  I say that because after being seated I realize it should have been thought out instead of a spur of the moment decision.  My reasoning is I would have dressed a lot nicer and felt more comfortable.  It was such a beautiful romantic restaurant.

The staff was friendly and the atmosphere was upscale and nice.  We were presented with the drink list and the dinner menu.  I started with the Sparkling Strawberry Cocktail.  It was perfect - not too sweet and very good.  We were presented with an extensive wine list after we ordered our drinks.  If you are a wine lover as I am you will want to ask for that list before ordering drinks.

I had to go with the Berere Spiced Tuna for my entree.  Gulf Tuna with okra and black-eyed peas in a coconut cream sauce.  It was so delicious!  There is nothing better than dining at a nice restaurant with amazing food!  Hats off to the chef.  This will be a must stop for every trip to New Orleans.  It was that impressive!

Been going here off and on for bike night "Wednesday" for years, it's alway a great turn out with live band. Foods great with a lot of choices on the menu. The decor is something to see with cars and bikes literally hanging from the ceiling and walls. If you ride a motorcycle of any kind it's a must check out on Wednesday night if not then I'd still say check it out on another night because it's worth the stop just on cool factor alone.
Good, authentic Mexican food at a reasonable price.  I am always encouraged when a Mexican restaurant is staffed by people who grew up on the food.

Our stay at the chase was terrible. It was my wedding night and  we had nothing with us and were in need if a few items. The front desk was less than accommodating to our needs telling us they would not be able to just charge our credit card on file and bring up the items, but instead we needed to come down. Later I called for some Tylenol to be brought up and was told it would be up shortly. 45 minutes later nothing. I went down to the desk wearing just my tux pants barefoot, only to be told they did not have any, and the one key to the gift shop that was supposed to be left behind for the night was missing- they told me that I would have to either drive or hail a cab to walgreens. There was no apology offered for not calling to inform us there was not going to be anyone coming up as promised. If you are looking for good service from a hotel, do not stay here.

First off, I'm stoked at Pete is able to generate such a quality restaurant.

This place is awesome, has the perfect atmosphere, etc etc. feels a lot like a speakeasy, mildly similar to a mix between ciro's and oxford exchange. 

I had brunch here and it was pretty great; got the brioche French toast, home fries, and the omelette, as well as some fresh squeezed OJ.  This isn't going to be very helpful, but everything was perfect and completely in par with the quality if the decor. 

I want to see this place succeed because it's the most justice I've seen bestowed on a st Pete restaurant in ten years. 

Find it underground in the big white 100 year old building down town.

A small critique to management: your dinner menu needs a vegetarian dish

Love, Blake

Each ingredient, alone and together, tastes like microwavable grocery store mass produced frozen pizzas. Tastes just like Totino's frozen pizza bites for example. From the Grocery store, grab some Hormel Pepperoni, a jar of Prego, a generic raw Pie Crust and store brand shredded Mozzarella..... same taste..... Epitome of Meh.
   We got a Chicago Style Deep Dish with Pepperoni.
   The service was good, though I don't believe in adding stars for service, only subtracting.
   I'd never choose to go there again.
   BTW; it takes close to an hour for them to make a Deep Dish.

What everyone else says: this place rocks.  Yep, a bonafide hole in the wall, with an A health rating.  I had pho and bahn mi for lunch. Yes, that's a big lunch :-)  Total: $10.50.  

Recommended.

A complete disaster of a company -- do not use!

The short story: Moved apartment from San Jose, CA to Denver, CO in June 2018. Initial apartment walkthrough/quoting went smoothly in April 2018. Items were loaded on the truck on time and the two guys loading the truck were good. After the truck was loaded, that's when nobody at Mayflower knew where the truck was in transit, where our items were in storage, and when we could expect delivery. We eventually received our items a week after the contracted delivery date, and only after threatening legal action. We were compensated (poorly, in my mind) after the delivery was finally made, and after spending a week trying to figure out where our items were.

The longer story: It is clear to me that Unigroup (Mayflower/United/Subsidiaries) has a lot of work to do to better their customer service and logistics. The initial quoting and pickup went very smoothly. We packed the apartment ourselves, and the pickup guys got everything loaded very quickly. We were told Mayflower didn't have a driver for immediate transport to Colorado, so our items were going to stay in a warehouse in San Jose for a couple of days, which was fine. 

As we were getting closer to the delivery day, I received an email saying that delivery will be delayed by 2 days, which I was fine with. Then Mayflower went silent. My repeated calls and emails, trying to find out where our items were and when they would be delivered, over the course of nearly two weeks, were either unanswered or met with a response along the lines of "I'm unsure... let me email/call *so-and-so* and I'll get back to you" (which they never did). It appeared that nobody in the company knew where the truck was, or if the items even arrived in Colorado. This was when I was ready to get my lawyer involved. Then, like clockwork, Mayflower started to figure out where our items were. But they were unable to give me a firm delivery date. 

The 10-days after we were supposed to have the items delivered, we finally hear that our items had made it to a warehouse in Colorado, and were going to be picked up for delivery later at night (the delivery guys showed up around 7pm). However, this was not scheduled, and the delivery guys at Buehler Moving (which does contract deliveries for Mayflower apparently) only made the delivery to help solve this issue I was having with Mayflower. They had made a move earlier that day. I'm greatly appreciative of them doing so!

Everything made it in one piece, thankfully. We submitted a late delivery claim and Mayflower offered $100/day that the delivery was delayed, plus "goodwill" compensation for the time I had to try and do the job of Mayflower, tracking down our items and getting a delivery date. Both the standard late delivery compensation and "goodwill" money were hardly worth my time doing so, and really felt that they should have covered the entire move. But this is what Mayflower felt was fair. Don't expect any out-of-the-box thinking or having their customer service team expend a little extra energy to solve customer issues.

Mayflower/UniGroup has a lot of work to do in improving their customer service and logistic planning. This contracts were signed two months before this move happened, and it appeared to me that they were not prepared to move our items, except for the initial pickup. Do not use this company for your move -- our experience was a gigantic headache and I hope to save you from the same.
Great service!!! Ask for a Alisha, she recommends the best and never forgets to remind me of the deals or specials
Awesome appetizer! Get the clay pot bbq shrimp shrimp! The atmosphere is inviting and not too loud.

You really can't go wrong at Jeni's. Correction: I feel like you can't really go wrong with ice cream. Jeni's is the pinnacle of artisan ice cream, and you can tell that she puts a lot of care and thought into her creations. From where she sources her ingredients to the fun flavors and names that go with them. The guy serving the ice cream was crazy nice and super generous with the scoops into my waffle cone. This time around, I had the sweet potato pecan praline and the churro. So yummy!

Even though I live in Cincy (which is only a little bit away from Columbus), there aren't any Jeni's around. I'm glad we got to stop in here for a sweet little dessert before heading back home.

We went on two tours with this company, the French Quarter and Garden Walking Tour. Both were excellent. Well-paced, knowledgable guides, low-key and fun! The guides love their city, and they were both funny and interesting to listen to. Highly recommended.

We thoroughly enjoyed our dining experience here. We came to New Orleans for a quick birthday getaway and after our rum tour we stop in Broussard's for dinner. The staff was excellent! They were personable and knowledgeable. Gene,Will, and Ryan were delightful. I enjoyed conversing with them. Broussard's have become my new "go-to" spot when I come back to visit New Orleans.

I would definitely start saying...'Reeeeddd Robbinnsss YUMMM'. 

I am not a big fan of burger but I love the burgers here. Have always tried veg patty with Fiery Ghost, the Garden burger, Burning love, Banzai, Sir Acha Tavern Double. Banzai with Pineapple inside it and Burning love with Jalapeno on top of it are my fav ones. Unlimited fries!!! And I prefer replacing regular fries with garlic herb fries. Mint Brownie Milkshake is classic. The service is hit or a miss sometime you might end up waiting forever to get the food . But the wait is totally worth it. I have visited quite a few times...but hoping to continue doing so!!! Looking forward for some more additions to the burger list.

We were driving through midtown and just happened to find this place! We were seated right away, which is rare for a Sunday morning! I got the Desperado crepe, and my fiancé got the breakfast tacos. Both with a side of fruit. So yummy!!
The staff was so friendly, and on top of getting anything we needed!
Crème is a hidden gem in midtown, and we'll definitely be coming back!

Good came a bit cold.  Bacon and sausages were good. Pancake could have been better, omelets were good
Crispy chicken blt was very good

I was very impressed by the creative menu & the freshness of the ingredients. Portion size is good. My wife had the veggie burger & almost couldn't believe it was not the real thing. I had the soba noodle bowl & added chicken. It was full of wonderful flavors & textures.
Definitely a place to visit often!

It was a meh experience. The view is good outside before it gets dark but the water does have an odor so it was not that romantic sitting outside. The food was mediocre and overpriced. Their signature cocktail is wet woody, which is a frozen cocktail. I personally don't like any frozen cocktail and regret ordering it. Anyhow, I was disappointed and don't think I'll come back again.

This place was really cool! I went on a weekday evening, and it wasn't too crowded. The shopping center, though, was really crowded, so we had to park a little ways away. It was kind of like Chipotle-style but with Indian food. Everything I had was delicious, and I'd definitely come again.

Visiting Indy happens to pass by this small bar. All the bartenders are super nice. Great music and selection of drinks. I'm more of a scotch person and they do have good selection for scotches. Very reasonably prices.

I am obsessed with this balayage that Clari did at Salon Six Zero Seven! She is so incredibly fun, friendly and very talented!!!! By far the best experience I have ever had getting my hair done and I am in love with the results!
This chick fil a was open and we came 5 minutes before closing and they were happy to serve us and served hot fries!!

It might have been that their foods were cooked differently than I'm used to. I ordered the Kalbi-tang and I'm used to a full egg cracked on the top of it, but this egg was stirred in with the soup. Which isn't the biggest of deals, but I'm half-Korean and was  brought up that way. They also lacked a few Korean dishes that I'm used to, and/or beverages too.

Per Trevor on 7/26, it MAY be the best in Tampa, because.. this isn't Koreatown, after all. But it's not the best, if you're used to truly down-home Korean food.

This is a place that I am definitely glad I went to when I visited Boise.  When I walked in, it seemed like such a small bar.  I honestly didn't expect for it to have great food because there wasn't really a kitchen in sight.  But regardless, I liked the feel when I walked in.  It definitely looks like a local place to eat and once I saw the menu I knew I was going to like whatever I had.

I had the spicy lamb with a house salad and my boyfriend ordered the lamb kebab with their white bean and ham soup (which was delicious!)

Right when I got my dish, I knew it was going to be super tasty.  It was steaming with lamb, pepper jack cheese, jalapenos, mushrooms, and onions and it came with a delicious dipping sauce (au joun).  I could barely take a bite because it was so hearty and full but once I did I was in heaven.  The lamb was prepared so well and soft, not very gamey as lamb meat sometimes can be.  The bread was so fresh (the menu says it is prepared fresh daily).  All of the meat and fillings in the sandwich kept falling out and it was just overall an enjoyable meal.  My boyfriend and I barely talked during the meal because we were so focused on our food.  

His lamb kabob wasn't the best but the vegetable kabob that came with it had deliciously grilled vegetables, although it had a little bit too much vinegar.  

Overall, I really enjoyed the place.  It has a decent beer selection and I think I made the best choice in terms of food.

This is a great spot for breakfast. Belgian waffle is to die for-waiter told is sugar is baked into the batter! Omelet was fresh and tasty though I would have liked more Gruyere cheese. Watermelon cooler was refreshing-bit pricey though! Overall, a good meal.
This place is outstanding. Really crowded, but they seat you right away. The food is amazing and the service is fast.

I have been bringing my cars to Bowe's since I moved to Conshohocken. I found my experiences to be courtesy, honest, and genuine. Gerry, the guy working behind the counter, really goes above and beyond to help customers. During the winter months, I frequently stop by to have them check and adjust my tire pressure & they do it at no charge! They're flexible with scheduling and always able to accommodate!!

Dr. Lieberman saves the day!!! 
I was eating  with some friends last Friday and took my first and last bite of my lunch.  I had a cracked filling that needed repaired and I kept putting it off (work & holidays).  Well, it finally broke and took part of my tooth.  Yes...OUCH!  My nerve was exposed and I was freaking out!  I called Dr. Lieberman's office about 2:00 expecting a recoding and hoping to get an emergency number for an emergency dentist.  Dr. Lieberman's office is closed on Friday.  To my surprise, Dr. Lieberman answered the phone :)  He wasn't working but, there to tie up some loose ends for the week.  He asked me to come by the office so he could fix my tooth within that day.  He called me on Saturday...yes Saturday, to make sure I was ok and in no pain.  Need I say more?!!  What an amazing person he is!  He truly loves what he does and he is the best!  Thank you from the bottom of my heart!  Tampa bay is so lucky to have Dr. Lieberman!  I learned my lesson!  Take care of your teeth NOW!!!

Disappointed, horrible, dumbfounded, and appalled is the perfect description of my experience at this establishment. My girl friends and I arrived and got seated promptly.  As soon as my one friend sat in her chair she realized that she sat in something wet. It appeared to be water so we dismiss it. We were greeted by our waiter David. We ordered our drinks and appetizers. As we were talking, the same friend that sat in a wet spot, noticed that water was dripping and falling on the table. As we liked up at the ceiling, the pipes were leaking. We informed the waiter and he said " It's only water!" and he proceeded to put a rag down on the area where the water was dripping. We asked to be moved and he was put off by our suggestion. He checked and found a place, but he informed us that it was a high top table and he would have to squish a spot for the fifth person in our group. As he moved us upstairs, he had the audacity to tell us that "only the girl that got wet would be get a free drink." We sat down and our food arrived. Our appetizers never made it to the table. After I asked the waiter about our appetizer, he asked us " do you still want them?". Obviously we wanted them or we never would have ordered them!!!! The manager Dave spoke to us and said that our drinks and appetizers would be taken off the bill. As well as my other friends meal that given the wrong order.  The food was good, but unfortunately the service was an abomination!!! Service is a huge factor in having a great meal and this restaurant lacked it. Needless to say there was nothing "happy" about my birthday celebration!

We've been here several times now and the result is the same - Really like the space, food, beer selection and people. Generous portions, BIG sandwiches. Best Chicken Caesar my wife has ever had. It's sort of "Upscale Casual" (if that's a term) and a comfortable place to hang around. Not a "new" look - still has character - and definitely not a pretentious place. The back bar is a hidden gem I didn't notice the first time I was there. 
CFT is the best new addition to local eateries that the area has had in years. We will definitely keep returning. Have not yet visited for brunch - just lunch and dinner. Almost forgot- Excellent Happy Hour!

So far so good. Very good experience. They are still working. But so far everything is great. Best company by far. Professional, reasonable prices, great work, wonderful office staff. Highly recommend.

Just wanted to tell the young ladies working today. AWESOME job. You 3 girls were extremely busy and was still polite and professional. Food was great and the service is one you don't see much of anymore.

This place was great! My mom was visiting from the San Francisco area, so I found this place on Yelp and brought her- we liked the idea of Southern with a modern twist. The decor is chic and the overall atmosphere was very pleasant; it seemed like it belonged in the Bay Area. I had the shrimp and grits and I think my mom had the pork chop. Both of the dishes were delicious! We got a side of cornbread that came in the cutest little iron skillet. Everything was so good, we had to take a good part of it home since we stuffed ourselves (good-sized portions!). I also liked that they're a farm to fork restaurant and get their meat from local farmers. Would definitely go back! Perfect place for a date night,
I have personally used Derrick for my home purchase and have referred many people to him as well! He is professional, knowledgeable, friendly and has a great team of people!!!

Great looking cigar lounge with solid selection.  Cool bar area that also has comfy leather couches if wanted.  There's also a living room like second floor which looked fun.  Friendly staff and overall a great 3 hour experience for a stogie and a few pours of bourbon.  Can't wait to return.

I moved out of state in December. Have been trying to cancel my membership since January. I have called multiple times. Sent emails multiple times to many people. Still is active and now owe a lot of money.

This small diner was a big surprise in a good way! CBB on the menu or "Cajun eggs Benedict" was out of this world! The coffee was hot and kept coming. The servers and table tenders were attentive and full of Cajun wisdom. One of our table tenders took the time to tell my daughter to "pay attention to how a man treats his mama" while clearing away our dishes. The people and food are exactly why we love New Orleans!
Great location, other than the ridiculous garage parking fee. We always park on the street and walk which there is usually a lot of spaces during the week.

I have been to Teca a few times now. Every time I feel that they miss the mark. The food is really expensive for being mediocre. Chicken marsala was sickeningly sweet. It seems as if these are chefs that are pretending to cook Italian food.
Food was bland and crust was burnt, yet food was cold. Wouldn't order again. Spoke to the staff about my dissatisfaction and was told someone would call me back which never happened.

I think I'd give 0 stars if I could. I needed to have my wisdom teeth removed and went here because they were the only office within my region that had holistic dental services. When I originally called to make the appointment, this was discussed in detail. When I arrived to the appointment (consultation and appointment are together) they said it would only take 45 minutes for both together and then we'd be out of there. I asked the Dr. a bunch of questions pertaining to the holistic methods and he shrugged off the methods that other holistic dentists were using. This didn't make me feel comfortable and as I was asking more questions, he was trying to dominate my questions by saying that those holistic methods don't help patients. Meanwhile, a VERY LARGE fly was flying around the ceiling of the exam room. It was totally disgusting, can you imaging that fly flying into your mouth during a procedure. This office doesn't have holistic methods and is not clean! Beware and take your business elsewhere!
AMAZING service and fabulous food! And $5 mimosas- can't get any better! Went for a bachelorette party and had a blast with a huge group!

Okay place for a beer. Food isn't great. They say the seafood is fresh everyday. I live close and don't see a food delivery truck there everyday. I've had both salmon dishes and both were bad. The grouper is pretty good and their salad is fresh. Just not great food. The Ohana is our favorite with Ozona Pig second.

I'm giving this place 5 stars because it's 7 hours later and I'm still talking about the amazing veggie burger I had at Firkin!! And omg those fries! I'm a vegetarian and most of the time vegan.....and I've had my fair share of veggie burgers. This was THE MOST DELICIOUS veggie burger I've probably ever had and let me tell you....I AM PICKY! So delicious! The service was fantastic as well! Can't wait to go back and devour another Veggie burger! Yum yum!

Pleasantly surprised by this place!  I normally have stayed down the road. I love the boutique hotels on the back side of the Quarter, but this has become one of my new favorites.  The staff was insanely nice and relatable, despite the ridiculous pace of New Years Eve night going on around them.  My room was wonderful. Old school NOLA charm, but modern conveniences and comfort.  (The fact that it opened up directly onto the street was so cool to me!) I can't wait to stay here again.

I liked the ambiance. It was a cute, relaxed environment. Plenty of parking.  The interior was really charming. There was someone at the front desk who promptly greeted me and asked me if I wanted a beverage. They have Redken chemistry conditioning treatment which not all hair salons use (and it's awesome!). Also, I liked that I was able to make an appointment online.  The overall experience was good. It didn't take too long but didn't feel rushed. My haircut was alright. They don't take American Express but not a big deal. I think I would give this place another chance but a 3.5 stars is about where it's at for me.  The price was fair. For the haircut, blow dry and deep conditioning, I think it was around $60 (not quite sure because I bought a product) but I probably would just rather pay more for a better haircut but it was alright. Not bad, just kind of average.

Really enjoyed the place, however the pictures online through Google made it look less formal than it really was.  
More formal and expensive than we thought but overall a very good place.  

Pretty amazing selection of gluten free products, including garlic bread, pizza and pasta, would eat there again
To my surprise this place was really good. Friendly staff and good food....meatball sandwich is the bomb.

Well look what happened. I have to raise my rating of Kingside Diner to three stars.  We ended up there after trying to go to another place that has stopped serving breakfast. I wasn't to happy about it because of past experiences.  What the heck. It was close by. We were very lucky to get a table outside. 

We ordered orange juice ( which was very good) and looked over the menu.  He decided on the corned beef hash with poached eggs in top and I went with my usual bacon and cheese omelet. It came with a side of hash browns and toast. DJ was our server and was prompt in everything he did.  Despite having a full crowd, our food came out in a timely fashion.  What happened here?  Our food was actually hot. Even the toast was warm. My omelet was filled to the brim with bacon and his poached eggs were perfect.  The hash browns were also good. 

Would I come back here?  I would because I can't wait to see what my next adventure here will be like.

We love this place for happy hour. They have lots of fun, diverse, bar foods for HH. Not just "mozzarella sticks" and "tater tots" and "wings". They have lots of variety in their offered apps - so that is an immediate huge win for me. They, also, do not ONLY have beers and cocktails on their happy hour menu, they have wine! (Another win!) Pours are never weak. 

The beer selection is pretty expansive and diverse and Jon, the bartender, is experienced and well-traveled so that you can say "Hey, I like this kind of beer (insert name of another beer you like) - can you recommend something on this list I will like?" and he will know what you will like.

The service is always friendly and prompt - they only lose a single star because the parking situation makes me very sad and frustrated when its even slightly busy - but that is solely due to the juxtaposition of this place to other business and residential. 

Tables can accommodate large and small groups, there are plenty of TVs for various sports, etc. 

You will like the food, you will approve of the service, and you will enjoy if you go especially for HH as it won't break the bank and you won't feel disappointed with what you were offered!

I purchased a Groupon back towards the end of October for a 1 hour photo session and some Christmas cards. I'm not really the type of person to dress up my baby in some absurd dress for the sake of taking some photos... but figured since this wasn't some department store photo studio, we'd be able to get a bit more casual and creative. I was right.

Lacy was fabulous, allowing us to do a combination of casual shots with our 1 year old and snap a few by the Christmas set up for cards. There was one unfortunate mishap where the baby destroyed a Christmas decoration from the tree, but Lacy and everyone else at the studio handled it like a pro. Same with the few cranky outbursts that occured towards the end of the session.

The photos turned out amazingly well. We received a call and email that the Christmas cards were ready about a week after the photo shoot, and then the extra prints that I ordered a few days after the cards. This gave me time to send out the cards with a few days to spare - even the ones that I sent via UPS to my family in Canada! The prints are proudly on display in my office and in our living room. Others will soon be given to the grandparents.

All in all, a great experience. I did have the Groupon, but from glancing over the regular prices while I was there, I do believe it is competitively priced.

I think this is a fun place if you don't cook often. The apps are pretty good, I had the guac, mussels, and chicken, spinach, and artichoke flat bread. The flatbread was good and crisp, but I found the wonton chips for the guac very greasy and had to wipe my hand every time I ate some guac. The mussels were savory and good. The drawback for me eating here was probably it's name sake the Black Rock. It's a fun idea to cook your own food but I don't think it's worth it. Instead of waiting 15 minutes comfortably seated and enjoying your group you sit staring at a sputtering piece of meat and get coated along with the entire table with a film of grease. Like I said it's a fun place if you don't cook cause you get to see how a steak goes from raw to cooked, but if you overlook the meat for too long you could end up spoiling an expensive steak and overcooking it. I also did not like that I needed to have the rock changed because it got cold, I'd rather just have a steak cooked. I can see a lot of people ruining their own dinner and having no one to blame because you are in charge of cooking yourself. As we were leaving one of the people with me almost fell over a cart being pushed by a waiter which was full of hot rocks, I understand there is a high turnover on staff, but they should be taught to announce themselves, especially while carting around hot hot hot rocks. Honestly I'd rather not sacrifice my shirt (because of the grease) to get some steak.

If I could I'd give them negative stars. This company has either gone completely nuts or they are committing fraud on my account because I have a large balance to use at year end. This should be illegal what they are doing. A "claim" showed up on my account putting me in the red when I had over $1000 left in FSA account. I am unable to pick up prescriptions or order prescription eyeglasses or use my card at all when there are very few days left in 2019. They continue to bounce me and my HR rep back and forth with bogus answers. Then they made changes to my account that put me even MORE into the negative by listing my "election amount as $1 for 2019!! WTH?? So far this has amounted to several days of time on the phone and no resolution. I will NOT be contributing ANY funds to my FSA in 2020. This is incompetence and fraudulent on their part.

Can't say enough I was expecting to leave my vehicle all day and the service writer said that he would take care of the car within a hour. It might've been a small issue but this service writer who is been there for 20 years and knew how to handle a customer he got me in and got me out even look for me in the waiting room when I told him I was going to be going to the diner for breakfast. Can't say enough in there for times for service bought two cars from the dealership and they really Stride to take care of the customer.

Much more than an amazing "healthy " food place!
Everyone walking in the door is in for a treat.  The bright colors and eclectic furniture can not help but put a smile on your face.   If not the play dinosaurs on each table will.   Even the play area for children had fun toys for all ages....
The food!!!  Flavorful, huge variety, fresh, cooked exactly as it is described.   Lots of vegetarian and vegan options.   The soup of the day can be smelled the second you walk in.    Tempting desserts as well as a variety of beverages.
Had a great experience with the food and staff. Super yummy and fresh mid eastern dishes. Would highly recommend.

Thank you Yelp for another amazing find when I was in St. Louis! I followed raving reviews to this place and fell in love. The space and decor is perfect for a cozy-cool breakfast or brunch, and it's perfect for the family get-together or the hangover cure, whatever the morning may bring.

The bloody mary menu was our favourite highlight, which were so fun to try and went great with the crepe options. I would recommend anything and everything here, and I can't wait to come back again!
I had 4 tires installed on my car today. Alex and his team had my car in at appoint time and finished before the estimated time!! That's great service.

I showed up to my appointment 20min ahead of time to fill out any Paperwork ahead of my scheduled appointment, I walk up to the reception desk to inform the lady I'm a new patient, before any words come out of my mouth she says  "sign in on the sheet and have a seat" at this point there was only 1 other person in the waiting room already seated when I go to sit down. I wait there for 20-25min and am finally called back up by her so she can hand me a clip board to fill out my paperwork. Still only one other person in the waiting room, I fill out the paperwork and hand it back to her promptly 25min later I'm called in. I went to see the doctor about an injury giving me a lot of pain and discomfort, I was told that the only 2 options I had was to get a cortisone shot for "temporary relief" or to "live/deal with the pain" when I said I'm not a fan of needles and asked a few to many questions about it than he was prepared to answer or felt like spending his precious time answering the doctor was very arrogant and even went as far as saying "so you won't be needing a follow up appointment". He seemed to almost disregard and belittle the pain I deal with everyday and night. Then handed me a piece of paper and sent me on my way. So I left, still in pain, no real answers as to why I'm in pain and super pissed off that I wasted my time waiting 1hr to see some asshole of a Doctor. I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone or ever go here again.

I truly am so happy MedMen is here.  My second visit to this dispensary & I will be going back.  Very friendly & knowledgeable staff.
Shout out to Hannah who helped me today. 
If u haven't been here, please go , u won't be disappointed.

Flew in today (since 4am) and arrived 1pm at the Omni Majestic looking forward to taking a quick shower and having meetings all afternoon.  The place looked empty and the one person at the front desk told me they won't check anyone in until after 4pm. Is this a business hotel in 2017 or a B&B in 1885?  Next time in town I'll be trying somewhere else.

I've been wearing glasses virtually my entire life and have been to my fair share of eye doctors along the way. Dr. Ana Nielsen, her husband and the rest of the team at The Eye Site are all delightful and make the trip to the doctor a breeze.

I was in and out in roughly 45 minutes. Their updated technology helps expedite the appointment, produces more accurate results, and is more comfortable for the patient.

Dr. Nielsen is incredibly professional and friendly. If you're in the market for a new eye doctor, I highly recommend checking out The Eye Site.

We went here during the Covid lockdown and all the staff observed all the protocols.
Nice thin crust pizzas with great texture and flavor.  What more could you ask for?

So this didn't happen to me but I saw it at the bar.  The wrong food brought to the wrong person.  I don't understand why every bar doesn't have a simple system of this food goes to seat 7 at the bar.  Too many places have food brought out and it is brought to every person at the bar "did you order this" and so on.  Why is it so confusing?  This is not done for the tables, why do it at the bar?

The quality and creativity of the food served at Fond is excellent. The service is attentive, but not bothersome. The restaurant recently revamped its menu. Their are no printed menus. Today's selections are posted on the wall. List 1 are  small plates/apps. List 2 would be considered entree sizes.

When I was driving up to the Delta Hotel by Marriott I didn't know what to think.  The outside didn't look like any Marriott property I have ever visited.  It was dark (as in poorly lighted), and kind of oddly situated between a Marriott Hotel and a Red Roof Inn.  Once I found the entrance and walked into the lobby, I was pleasantly surprised. The Delta Hotel Indianapolis East is what was formerly a LaQuinta Inn.  

I implore you not to be thrown off by the exterior of the property.  I was in a Queen room that is clean and modern and very comfortable.  They have remodeled and redecorated the interior of the hotel. I am sure they will be doing the same to the exterior of the hotel as well. It was everything I have come to expect from a Marriott brand hotel. This newest addition to the Marriott hotel chain is positioned to go up against the Clarion and LaQuinta Inn type of hotels. 

The hotel is located off I-70 East. There are a good amount of places to gas up your vehicle and grab something to eat.  You can also get food delivered.

I will definitely be looking to stay at a Delta Hotel by Marriott again on my travels.

My Adult children and Husband took me there yesterday for an early Mothers day dinner surprise. The food was outstanding and the service was great. We have been coming here for years and have always been satisfied.
 K. McGee Birkelbach

I used to love our dog park but it is become a point of contention now. we never know when it's open when it's closed you can't just get up and drive there because it could close before you get there we got a hotline to call because of the rain drops hit the ground... we can't go.
During the Coronavirus Park was closed most of the time because they wanted to use this time to make beautiful grass my thoughts were it was a great place for us to go and relieve stress caused by this world of 2020. Unfortunately the management doesn't seem to be as worried about its members as much as its beauty of the  grass

Been a loyal customer customer for years. My favorite thing about the shop is the old fashioned family run atmosphere. Service is the reason I will never leave these guys. They never try to up sale you and are always looking out for you. The world is changing quickly but it is nice to see old school still hanging in there. You will not be disappointed when you visit the shop.

I love breakfast.  And this place was definitely not for me

I had coffee, sub-par with a soapy tasting mug. If you serve breakfast, you should make great coffee, and serve it in clean and rinsed mugs. 

The orange juice was good.  I'll give you a star for that. 

Veggie omelet with hash browns, fruit, toast or pancakes. I chose the toast, whole wheat. Was barely toasted and came out soggy. Too much butter on one slice, none on the over slice which was really not toasted at all. Few veggies, including canned mushrooms, in the omelet topped with slices orange cheese food, maybe velveeta. Not cool. Gross as a matter of fact

The second star came for the fast service. Too bad the food was nasty.

I might get tarred and feathered for saying this, but I think that Cafe Beignet was better than Cafe du Monde - because of that I came here TWICE in my 4 day adventure in New Orleans. The beignets are light and fluffy but 1 order can definitely be shared between 2 people (as long as you're not STARVING, then you can probably eat 1 per person). They are about 2 inches by two inches and heavily sprinkled with powdered sugar. So much so that you will get it all over your face and clothes and you will not even mind because they are so delish. They also have food other than the beignets, but I did not try any of that.

The ambiance of Cafe Beignet is also so cute - it's like you are transported back in time. 

I am giving this 4 stars instead of 5 only because the 2nd time I went there the beignets were a little over cooked - perhaps because we went there in the morning so they weren't in a rush to get them made. But even a little overcooked they were still good.
They did a terrible job on my nails. I asked for specific services, which they did not accommodate and were not willing to fix it. The customer service was horrible. Will not be going back.

After drinking fancy drinks at a trendy joint, I found myself here. And I'm still processing it, because it was a very strange experience for me. I'm thinking that if I had gone to a frat party when I was in college it may have been like this. There were sports being watched while people chugged beer and The Grateful Dead was being played. Very loudly.

So while I tried to deal with this strange new world I randomly found myself in, I enjoyed a delicious beer and some very tasty french fries, served with my required side of honey mustard. De-lish! And our bartender was a sweetie. But the bouncer was the first dude in a long time not to ask for my ID when I came in. Does that mean I'm looking really old or he's just a slacker? If you're thinking the former, then please just lie to me. Pretty please? I'll share my french fries with you!

I chose this spot for a pre-movie dinner with  y boyfriend, and it was hands-down THE best, most satisfying meal I've had at a restaurant in a while! 
I started off with a beer flight and the lobster flatbread. Let me tell you this flatbread was EVERYTHING I hoped for and more. Crust was perfectly light and crisp, the lobster chunks were huge and perfectly cooked. 
And then I had the Drunk Monk Burger (with bacon instead of mushrooms) and again, phenomenal! Flavorful aioli, everything cooked perfectly, and the brie was such a good addition.

I could not rave enough about it!

First time back here in about 4 years. Great steaks second time around. Friendly cooks and fast service. The meat is cooked thoroughly and they even chop the onions smaller for you. I got a chz steak with American, wiz and pickles.

I love my cut and partial highlights done by Lori!  It was my first time at Nicole Carman's and I am very pleased with the service(s) they provide.  It feels like your own personal salon and they have wonderful specials, too.  I am definitely recommending this salon to friends and am looking forward to going back.

I'm so glad we read the reviews and gave this place a try! There was something for everyone in our family of six. Attractive wrought iron seating next to a large tiered fountain in their beautiful open-air courtyard. 

The shrimp and grits was the best I have had and my husband loved his Pasta New Orleans. Both had plentiful portions. The older kids enjoyed the snow crab that overflowed their plates while the younger kids enjoyed kid-friendly "boats" that held their pasta and chicken fingers. 

Service was excellent from the street greeter to the server. Oh, and the hurricanes are the real deal. :) highly recommend and I never review anywhere!

We ate here with the kids the other day. The kids got a kids burger and mac and cheese and we got tacos. They were both great and the kids ate it all. Better yet was the beer selection. We got a pitcher of beer and definitely drank it all. It was great and extremely tasty! We will be going back, next time with Uber so we can stay longer.

If you like authentic Indian food, this is the not the place for you. That said, if you are not a very adventurous eater and prefer more Americanized cuisine (nothing wrong with that!), I think you would enjoy this place. 

The food is mediocre at best (I think I'm being kind). I'm Indian and perhaps have a higher standard for Indian food but this food is barely edible. Before I discovered Coriander and Indiya, this was one of my few choices when I was craving Indian food. I gave it maaaany chances, trying the buffet and also ordering ala carte. 

The food was either consistently bland or tasted of one particular spice, as if they only grabbed the cumin or turmeric etc that day. If you asked for spicy food, all you could taste was the cayenne. 

Add the fact that the servers are very creepy (they would ask odd personal questions) and I just couldn't keep returning.
Coming here saves me a lot of time not having to do it myself and clean up afterwards. This is my favorite spot for a quick smoothie. Great service and delicious smoothies.

Best soul food in town and with all you can eat, it's just icing on the cake. Entertainment is also very enjoyable and talented. The only problem is the place is so small it easily gets crowded quickly.

To make a long story short, I don't think the stylist at the salon know how to do men's cuts very well. In addition to that, guest services and managers were not helpful in rectifying our situation. Poor customer service, poor skills, we will never return.

It's tough to find a Mexican restaurant serving up authentic Mexican food with the flavors found in Mexico.  A recommendation from a tortillaria up the street led us to Mole Poblano.  We were hopeful with guarded expectations.  Wow were we impressed.  Not only was the food authentic the service was good as well.  I recommend the carne asada with a glass of horchata. Buen provecho!

Have never really been a fan of this place due to service which seems to be the issue with others as well.   Beers are a little overpriced and it's a little too uppity in this joint.  Anyway 4 of us came here after a volunteer event and sat at the bar just in time for happy hour.  Beer prices were good and nachos were half off.  Have to say the nachos were fantastic. We got them with buffalo chicken on top.   They were huge and plenty for all of us.  Some even got taken home.  Wings were also .75 each. We got 2x10 pieces-one of the Thai wings and one of the Jack D BBQ wings.  Both sauces were good and we did ask for them well done.  A couple were a little rubbery.   The service was actually pretty good and then I guess there was a shift switch.   The first bartender was fast on the drinks and food. We cashed out to make sure she got the tip.  I guess new guy that took over didn't want much to do with us since there was no tip to be had.  Working in the restaurant biz for years what comes around goes around.  We sat with dirty dishes in front of us forever and had trouble getting another beer.  Bottom line is happy hour food is good!

When want good brunch in Philly, we go here. The beer taps usually offer a good variety of quality craft beers. The menu is good a changes regularly. The pancakes are tasty in either iteration they offer. And the coffee is fantastic. I know most people aren't coming here for coffee, but it is definitely worth drinking.
 The staff has always been friendly to us. They give us enough time to enjoy our meal and beverages without being interrupted every 3 minutes but not so much our glasses have ever gone empty without offering a refill.
 Thanks for having a great place to eat in this part of town...

We decided to try this place because we got a gift card for Christmas and we love pizza.

I want to start by saying the service is soooooo slow. So slow. Really slow. Did I mention it was slow?  It took us longer to get our check than it did for us to eat the entire meal, appetizers included.  When the check came back, it was wrong, and you don't have the option to tip with the gift card which stinks but isn't super surprising.

The pizza is good but nothing spectacular. You can definitely get better in town. They have some novel concepts and interesting pizzas but they didn't really taste that great. The traditional pepperoni pizza was good though. The wings were the best part of the meal. 

The atmosphere is a little pretentious for a pizza place but the staff was super nice when they were around.

Overall, if your friends want to go here then go ahead and tag along but I wouldn't make a special trip to go here.

I have only been there before COVID-19.  I found the salads to be great-the bread is really fresh and the service is to brag about.  The entire menu for lunch or dinner is quite appealing.  They have fresh clams or mussels all day long.  My cup of tea!

As a regular drive-thru customer who gets tacos, fajitas, chalupas, and nachos, I'm always pleased.  My order has always been accurate; it's always been tasty, although inconsistent (same items taste different on some days, like more black pepper than usual or more jalapeños, but I don't mind it because it's still good).  

Given its popularity, to serve that many customers in a day in a small spot, and to also get us through a drive-thru in a good amount of time, bravo to the crew, who have been polite and nice each time I roll through.

Love this restaurant!  Hands down best authentic Japanese cuisine in Santa Barbara.  Normally they serve Kaiseki style meals that are incredible.  During covid lockdown they are doing take out bento boxes.  So fresh and so clean.  From pickled veggies, seasoned egg, and rice triangles to cooked fish or meat of the day and a very generous serving of sashimi, including uni on a shiso leaf.  Best take out ever!  Support your local restaurants during covid, including Yoichi.

New Years Day? More like worst day! Literally came here for New Year's Day lunch not only did my food take an hour and a half to come to our table it came out uncooked and completely wrong! Our entire table had their burgers wrong. The server didn't care at all! Didn't apologize at all. She just kept saying "it's busy" ummm what kind of excuse is that? Never again!

This is my favorite Chinese place in Nashville! I have been here abouy 10 times since it opened just a month ago, and I can always rely on the Zhou's Beef Noodle. I always get it light spicy with spicy chili oil on the side. The juices and teas are also really delicious.
Amazing environment and good food. Great service and plenty of drink options. The only thing I would note is that I wish they would have a larger food menu.
James is awesome! On time and set about getting our place fixed up with a list of jobs we had built up. Very friendly ave knowledgeable. We'll definitely be utilizing James' services again.

Have been here four times in the four days it has been open. Conveniently located. Great prices (discount for cadence residents). Would highly recommend a BBQ chicken pizza with garlic oil added as a sauce. Management is friendly and approachable, staff is learning but getting there. Pizza takes about 6-8 minutes and is fired right in front of you. Pizza cookie is small but delicious. Beverage selection is from Pepsi which is not my favorite. But overall would highly recommend.

Oh, Cold Stone, how much I love you. Yes, you may cost a little more than, say, Baskin Robbins, but that cost is clearly reflected in the quality of the ice cream and the toppings. Oh, the toppings. And the flavors! Even just plain ice cream  is a delightful dance of tastiness on my tongue. But throw in the signature combinations and now we're talking. 

BTW, go for the waffle bowl.

I'm impressed. Called in for a quick to-go lunch which didn't turn out that quick (didn't answer the phone until 15 minutes after they opened then had to wait for them to remake my pizza because they messed it up) but still delicious! Their bbq beef pizza was super tasty, enough cheese to satisfy any cheese lover. A little spendy but so good.
Finally somewhere in Clearwater with a diverse menu of healthy and tasty food. You can make your own bowl or get a fresh plate, the finadene chicken and lemon bar dessert are bomb!

I'm always hesitant about running stores, I feel like most people that work there are not as knowledgeable as they'd like us to think they are. HOWEVER, I had been having some serious problems with my feet, with feet pain during runs over 8 miles and I was set to run the Goofy this past weekend at Disney (The 1/2 on Sat and full on Sunday!)  I went in with my old shoes in hand and the two girls that helped me were AMAZING.  I'm certain they didn't know what to do with me...the wear on my shoes they said they'd never seen before!!  They did tell me that the last version of the Brooks I had were known to NOT be all that good...they put me in the 17s with a cushion insert and I thought I felt a difference right away.  They were leery of me wearing these new shoes for my races but I honestly had no choice!  For my 13.1 on Saturday I had ZERO foot pain...and on Sunday, the pain didn't start until mile 20, and it was NOT as bad as I had previously experienced in my other shoes and inserts!  I want to go back in and give them huge hugs!!!  I was so afraid I'd never ever run pain free again, but this weekend showed me otherwise!! These people know their stuff and I couldn't thank them enough!!

On my recent FL work event (aka "food tour") I had to stop by one of my fav relatives of Cafe DuFrain.

I was happily greeted by name, after a 10-month absence, by Ula (ooh-lah). Personal service is the best!

As you know, I am a bar sitter, and reconnected with  bartender Gage. He is a former Seattle-ite and quick to reminisce about some of my food experiences there.

Chef Mike circulates the tables to ensure all is well.

If I ever move to Tampa, I will be on Harbour Island, and a regular at Watervue and Dufrain.

I had the fish dip which ranks well compared to dips from former Bahia Cabana in Fort Lauderdale, and a hole in wall place in Key Colony. My entree of mussels... is it wrong to want to drink the broth?

See you on the next go-'round in early 2020!

My grandmother was a historian and tour guide for Philadelphia. When she shared the many stories and facts about the first US capital, I was far too young to have any appreciation. This Halloween, I was reminded of the old saying, "you don't know what you have, until it's lost".
My boyfriend and I bought tickets for the Dark Philly Vampires, Sex and Ghosts tour. Adam, a high school history teacher and historian, showed our group of roughly 20 people, a great time. We lucked out with the weather, but the intermittent clouds only added to the effect. We learned about tales that my local family members didn't know. 
I don't want to ruin the experience for anyone, so I'll leave my review with... HIGHLY RECOMMENDED, TWO THUMBS UP!!! This experience was excellent, had bonus content and Adam is top notch. FYI, he is a bourbon man and will share some local spots to try. Concierge, Teacher, Tour Guide Aficionado and Historian!

Got the extra star for being so welcoming to us arriving 30 minutes before they close.

Covid table spacing and masks/gloves observed here. In and outdoor seating. Friendly service.

Wines by the glass. Beer. Even port wine.

Good variety of well made dishes. The calamari steak I had was crispy on the outside with substantial happy thick pieces.

There is complimentary oval bread served with oil & vinegar.

A classy, spacious restaurant.
If you like their super oily and unhealthy noodles served on a styrofoam plate for over $10. Go there

Food and service were good.  Great spot to take kids.  It can be loud in the dining area, so don't go if you want a quiet dinner.   I'm looking forward to using this as a great take-out option when in need.

The Wee Book Inn is a local chain of used bookstores and is the best of these kinds of stores as far as I am concerned.  The Whyte Ave location is huge with over two levels of fantastic used books.  I am always astounded by what I find in here and there is a very good selection of well preserved old, rare books on the second level.  There is also a large selection of old magazines, including adult ones, and DVDs.  I haven't sold any of my books to this store, although I have bought plenty and I find the prices very reasonable.  They are open early and close late.  I like wandering in here on Saturday mornings while checking out the Strathcona Farmers Market as well!  If you are allergic to cats, be warned that they have a resident kitty, but as an allergy sufferer I didn't have any problems.

The cookies at all of the locations are fantastic but this location is the best. 

Josh & Keairra are wonderful people and the reason I walk a few extra blocks to this location.

Keep up the good work!

We looked forward to The Landing because friends in the area recommended it, but they were as disappointed as we were. First, we were met by no fewer than five hostesses, several of whom were clad in Daisy Dukes, tank tops and flip flops. We pondered why so many girls were being paid to stand at the front and sip Dunkin' Donuts coffee coolers, but were unable to come to a consensus. 

Arranging two tables to accommodate four adults and three kids (all under age 4) took several staffers a few minutes, but they had fun shouting insults at each other and sharing tales of last night's adventures. The Landing has no high chairs, so we balanced the youngest baby on our laps. 

The food was poor overall. The gazpacho, (perfect for a hot day, right?) had grapes and canned pineapple in it. It was bizarre and inedible, but the server removed it from our tab. On the plus side, two of our friends enjoyed chicken wraps very much. The pear salad had a very heavy dressing. The kids' grilled cheese sandwiches were doughy and barely cooked. My one year old ate the beets and pear from my salad but wouldn't touch the sandwich. We asked for more iced tea and the server said, "I have to charge you for another bottle." I'm no restauranteur, but wouldn't it be cheaper to brew a big pot of iced tea than to stock bottles of the stuff?

Service was slow and inaccurate, with the teenaged wait staff laughing and shouting at each other over diners' heads. They can't be blamed, really. We never saw a manager type appear, so they're probably just in need of supervision, training and a dress code. 

To top it all off, we were hit with an 18% gratuity because our party was more than six (we had seven.) We'd pay it without complaint if the service was good, but had trouble stomaching it considering that three of our diners are one, one and three years old! We ordered food for them, so I guess I can see it, but it was hard to fork it over when we were tempted to tip nada. 

There are several other cute places in New Hope. We wished we'd gone to Triumph Brewing Company instead.

Just returned from a horrible, smelly, filthy and uncomfortable lunch.  Sat outdoors -- stinky apparently from a neighbor's algae-ridden pool -- but totally uncomfortable.  The knives and forks were wrapped in napkins, but two of four sets had to be returned because there was dried food on them, not to mention the soap spots.  House salad was just  bunch of greens that seemingly hadn't been rinsed well, since there were wilted leaves in with the better ones.  Also, the cucumber seemed to have been frozen -- watery rather than crunchy.  Small bowl of chili was as acceptable as Dinty Moore's out of a can -- and just as cold.  Had to wait 15 minutes after having been served the chile for the accompanying corn bread, which was OK.  Asian salad was acceptable.  Mushroom pizza had more of other stuff (ham, sun dried tomatoes, et al) than the canned mushrooms. NOT A PLACE I AND MY FRIENDS WILL RETURN TO.

This company is a joke, don't go to them unless you want to get ripped off, they say they are under new management but seriously how? The techs name is p. Miller I will be talking to the manager and taking them to court. Receptionist name is m salyer

I had a wonderful experience. Our server was great! Our food was great! The atmosphere was great. I loved it. The parking lot is made if dirt so watch your shoes in a rainy day. Great for family dining!

9:40 am flight delayed then cxld after hours of waiting.   They said a 30 min delay at first.  They do t have mechanics in SB. 1st mechanic arrives and says he's the wrong mechanic.  Now have to wait for another mechanic.  This is the 4th time this "no mechanic in SB" has happened.  
11:45, over 3 hours later, missed the connecting flight, I'm told the only way to fly out today is to drive 2.5hours to LAX to catch a 4pm flight.
Run to the car, drive through traffic to go out of LA?  
They say no availability of flights tomorrow out of SB either.  
Seriously?  No mechanic in SB?  3+ hours of waiting with no reasonable alternative.  AGAIN. 

No cash back, no apologies, no alternative options from American. 

Through online research found an alternate airline to fly out of SB tomorrow.  Wish me luck.

American has screwed us in transfers from LA back to SB in the past late night too. 

Not happy with American 

Start asking the airlines if they have mechanics and staff in your local "big " airport in case something happens.

This place is def one of the best coffee shops in tampa, if you love the taste of coffee this place is for you. It could easily be said that they have the freshest coffee in the Bay. From cortados to americanos the taste is superb. Plenty of seating inside and friendly baristas. Discover caffeine!

What a trip. 

Girl doesn't get all 20 pizzas we ordered. We as customers are blamed. Then manager start getting sideways. Like I'm not saying customer is always right but when someone coming to pay for 20 pizzas and tip on top of it you would think they would say hey, we screwed up. 

But no, have to get on the phone with "Big Belly, Donny". My god the owner literally starts accusing the customer of lying and this being far fetched to where he starts sharing how GREAT of customer service they have.
