Like bro, chill, you have 32 reviews and I'm giving you the courtesy of 33. Then starts going through their procedures like "she read the order back". Ummm no, cause she didn't ring it in and she went, she wrote it down. And poor girl probably would lose her job because the owner just seems the type to blame it someone instead of saying, "hey, things happen, we are a food establishment" cause you know, real owners do that and admit mistakes. 

then we get the pizzas and they are about the same as dominoes. Like what?! FAM!!! Better places to eat. 

Would recommend elsewhere.

OMG. I'd give this dump a zero stars but can't. Here for the EMS Expo. Waited 20 minutes in line - 2 employees working. The young girl Loyce was great. Ordered Cold Brew 1/1. The other girl tried to give me a hot coffee with caramel. I asked for the right thing and had my receipt. She ROLLED her eyes at me. 3 + dollars and it was not drinkable. No DD for me again!
Awesome service!!!  See Victoria for the best experience. Yummy with a smile and laughs!!!

I had Pappy's at a BBQ festival in NYC (I know, not the best representation. However, these ribs are so so good they warrant an immediate Yelp post). 

O-M-G the ribs.. the Ribs were so so good - fall off the bone, sweet and salty and sticky. The ribs didn't need any sauce. The beans were sweet and tasty, but perhaps a little overly sweet. 

I need to figure out how to get these ribs shipped to NYC from St. Louis. Can they please start offering shipping??!?!

Sunday Brunch at Bristol's has everything you are looking for in a brunch buffett with a healthy and sophisticated  spread.  This is highly recommended for $20 per person including coffee and orange juice no one in st. Louis can touch this.  See you there!

This restaurant has changed from being a very crammed and humid place to a much better ventilated dining spot over the years. They have decent quality and and a nice selection of food. They also provide quite a bit for their lunch special and sometimes they offer dessert for free. However, there was an incident where a friend found a fly in her veggie (~2.5 years back). We're unsure if the fly didn't get washed out of the vegetable or if it flew into the soup...but they offered her a free lunch.
Good food good service has never disapointed! Try the. Beef pancake! Or order a milk tea they have some good ones, parking is tight though.
How did this place not have 5 stars?! I love it, yeah the food can be pricey but the quality so much better than other stores. Not to mention the coffee is pretty stinken good.

Had fish tacos last week at red star In the Exton Mall and loved them. Went back this week and it was a different story. There was bearly any fish in them this week. At $14 for two tacos and a bit of rice , this was disappointing to say the least. After I ate them, I noticed that the menu said it was 1/2 price taco Tuesday, so I thought that might explain the inconsistency, so I asked the manager and she said that that should be the same taco, however it clearly wasn't. It tasted good, the fish was moist and flavorful but there was just one tiny sliver of fish in the taco. Had that been the first time I had them, I wouldn't have come back. I can't help but think they were skimping on the fish because of the half price taco, which by the way, I did not get. Although it was advertised in the menu as 1/2 price taco Tuesday from 5-7, I was told that it only applied to people ordering from the bar, although this was not mentioned in the menu. Had to stop on the way home for a snack to fill myself up!
DELICIOUS! And great service too! The heirloom tomato salad is the BEST salad I've ever had! The flounder was okay, but everything else was great! The service was wonderful as well!
Food court is filthy and disgusting. Tables are dirty food on the floor. If this was a restaurant it would get shut down. Seems like there's no air conditioning over there roasting hot.

I'm feeling the difference after only 3 visits! I have bulging disks/pinched nerves in my neck.  Which is extremely painful. 
But, Tracy McGowan is the best! She knows just what to do to get me back on track. 
There's a machine that has heat & laser that really seems to be effective. 
So grateful that I can turn my neck and not be in that kind of pain!

Our wedding cake was spot-on exactly what we wanted. Fresh fruit wasn't a problem and our custom topper went without a hitch. I could only try our chocolate (gluten-free) layers and it was great. Everyone else said the rest of the cake was also delicious as well. Looked and tasted precisely how we had imagined. 

The reason I can't give a 5 star review is because of the delivery service. The lady was 40 minutes later than agreed on - barely making it in time for the reception. The cake was not centered on the table and some of the fruit had fallen off around the cake. It was easily fixable but shouldn't have been an issue.

David was my server and he was serving me an amazing attitude with a professional smile. David gave me recommendations on what to eat. I was here for HH on a Monday. I ate fried rice without the cauliflower and two bites of Hot Chicken Bun. So yummy! I was pleased with the restaurant ambiance. What bothered me the most was when David was not around other staff members were messing with my vibe when I was trying to eat. They were like asking me ever 5 seconds can they take my plate away.. when I was clearly not done nor asking them to. It was annoying and made me feel unwelcomed as if they were trying to get me outta there. I was trying to take my time to enjoy the vibe of the place but the other staff bussers ruined that. Anyhow... I would only recommend this place if David is your waiter. Other than that pass. A-OK that is all.

wors store ... masks and gloves ? are you serious ?
even the airports doesn't require that
Delicious food! Great service...very personable! Owner is friendly and courteous! We are now regulars !! My husband loved the mango pudding and the butter chicken.i loved the veggie options!

My first time ordering from here. The lunch specials are a great deal, you get so much food for the price! Some other stuff on the menu seemed pricey, but have yet to try them so can't say if it was worth it or not. I was a little disappointed that I had to spend $20 minimum for delivery, but I took it as an opportunity to try a few different things . The chicken teriyaki lunch was delicious, full of flavor. I also ordered Spring rolls, which were very crunchy and tasty. I didn't care for the crab rangoon, which was disappointing. However the lunch meal was worth it, and the Mango Bubble Tea hit the spot! I would definitely order from here again! It actually came earlier than anticipated, which was nice. Delivery guy was very friendly!

Ok breakfast food. Been there several times with friends but with every visit comes a problem. The first time two people at the table never even received their food and it wasn't corrected because the server never checked up. The second time the server didn't come to the table for 25 minutes. The third time the eggs were completely raw. I honestly don't know why I keep going here but it's cheap and when you're hungover and out of options you have to make do.

After an initial disappointing visit I revisited with some friends on a Friday at 8 pm. This experience was much better. The ribs this time were more like what I would expect. I didn't have the chicken this time but the brisket was moist and tender. Everyone enjoyed their food including my vegan wife. We'll be back

You might be enticed by this buffet's extremely affordable price, but I swear going to a more expensive buffet is worth it... I came for weekday lunch and the food selection was literally garbage. Everything was CLEARLY extremely cheap, a bunch of dishes had almost no flavor, and several were so oily I couldn't take more than a few bites. Only thing that was acceptable was the sushi and seaweed salad. Don't even get me started on dessert.... I didn't even know dessert could be that bad??? Like I think a lot of sweets are delicious even if they're basic and cheap, but this was next level ew. The "cream puffs" and chocolate "cake" legit tasted fake, which I didn't know was even possible. Also, drinks (except water) cost extra. 

2 stars only because it is extremely cheap and you could probably eat your money's worth if you went for the meat/seafood. Maybe weekend/dinner is better because they have more selection + better seafood, but I would not recommend coming here for weekday lunch.

Great hotel, my wife and inlaws stayed here for my wife's 30th. The staff was amazing, they upgraded our room to a beautiful suite and Adam at the front desk was very accommodating for our whole family.  The location is great, right off bourbon so you can get some sleep but are close to the action.  Will be staying here again for sure!

Why 5 stars? Because where else can you get edible cookie dough?

   ---   ---   ---

Once my wife heard that there was a place in Tampa that was going to be selling edible cookie dough, it instantly rose to the very top of her to-do list. She was religiously checking the Dough Nation Facebook page for updates and once a Grand Opening was announced, we were all set to head over there. Apparently thousands of other people did the same thing because it turned out that they ended up selling out of their product before we could even get there, and we read about people waiting more than an hour in line. 

Fortunately, things calmed down and when we visited a couple weeks after the opening, we only waited a few minutes in line before we were served our weekly caloric intake in one sitting. The wife opted for raspberry truffle ice cream with chocolate chip cookie dough and I went with salted caramel ice cream with sugar cookie, cookie dough. I really liked mine, but it was definitely very rich, which resulted in me only eating about half. The texture of my cookie dough seemed like legit cookie dough, where the chocolate chip was just a tad off. 

If I could go back and do it again, I would have just ordered the cookie dough by itself. Not that the ice cream wasn't lovely, but the cookie dough and the ice cream combined together was just a lot to eat. I found myself trying to dig around the ice cream just to get to the cookie dough. 

If you do opt for the combo, definitely don't even consider ordering anything besides a small. I don't know how anyone could eat a small and wish they had more, because it was a lot to eat. I wish they would add an extra small, because that would have been ideal.

At one point, the line probably got to about 6-7 people deep, and the employees seemed really confused about who was next up as they didn't really follow the order of who was next. And one guy behind the counter was a bit pushy for people to line up a certain way, but it didn't seem to serve much of a purpose or help that problem much. Definitely not a big deal, but worth mentioning. 

Overall, there's nothing like this anywhere else in Tampa Bay, and I'm definitely happy to have it!

Great spot! Great service! Cool people!
Will be frequenting this spot and the Vegas location! Thanks to Max! 
He was super friendly and very pleasant to talk to!  New fave travel and eat spot!

This is a nice local bar just off Bourbon but seems like a world away. They had some decent beers on tap. 
While we saw lots of people ordering po boys, we weren't that hungry so opted for the Sampler appetizer. It was a fried platter and neither surprised nor disappointed us. 
I definitely recommend this for a break from the typical Bourbon Street crowd.

Have been here several times, both for lunch and dinner. It is a bit pricey but Groupon helps! I can honestly say I have never had a bad meal or drink here. The burgers are good. The mushroom soup amazing. Have done the tasting menu twice and both times been very happy with the food. Nothing is over-seasoned. The fish has been cooked perfectly. I like beef rare and it has always come out to my liking. The gnocchi,when on the menu, are pillows of perfection!

Let me start by saying that my first experience with Endodontic Associates was at the Green Hills location and was very pleasant. Dr Freeland did a good job with my root canal and I was as comfortable as you can be with a root canal.  Also, the facility is clean and nice. 

Now, experience #2, I can't judge the root canal because they have told me they will not do it due to "too many cancellations."  History...I cancelled the first time due to personal reasons. The second time (3 weeks later), I had been throwing up repeatedly since 2am, along with the rest of my family, as we had contracted a stomach virus.  Now, I could have tried to go to the 8am appt.  I actually considered it, but then I thought it would be a pretty terrible thing to potentially infect everyone in that office with whatever hell had taken over my body since 2am. 
The morning of the appt, I called and left a message before they opened, and then called back 2 more times to make sure they knew I wouldn't be able to make it. When I got someone on the third try, she told me I wouldn't be able to reschedule due to having cancelled 3 times. I told her repeatedly that I had not cancelled 3 times, and she insisted that I had and would not give me any other alternative. So I sat there with terrible stomach cramps, a fever, a puking husband, a puking 2 year old, and still a painful tooth with no end in sight.  I've even gone back in my call log in my phone to see if I'm completely brain farting on the extra reschedule/cancellation, and there's nothing. Their records seem to be wrong and they won't listen. They would rather lose a customer. 

Thank you Endodontic Associates for making my already awesome day more awesome. :/

Riviera Smiles is fantastic...friendly and professional staff, beautiful office, and a great atmosphere. I felt so welcomed and comfortable as a new patient. Dr. Martinez is such a wonderful and skilled dentist. I highly recommend Riviera Smiles.

we got a cake (fresh cream, strawberries)
it was incredible.  it was made on site with traditional french way
cream puffs and chooket (looks like cream puff without cream) it was great

I was craving some good ol' BBQ and Famous Dave's was on my list for quite some time so I decided to finally check them out. 

The night we went there apparently was a huge party and they seem to be very understaffed. Having been a waitress before, I could totally understand the stress they were going through and despite that, the service was great. Specifically our server, Lindsey (I'm not sure how she spells it) but she was awesome! And let me tell you, not all the customers were friendly but she was still on her game.

Our food...DELICIOUS!! I got the BBQ Mac & Cheese topped with the Texas brisket and corn bread muffin. My mouth is watering just thinking about it..so good. I only ate half cause I knew I wanted to have leftovers. On the table there were sauces. My favorite Sweet and Zesty. Nice twist to the Mac & Cheese. Devil's Spit is also good. More on the spicier side but has a decent kick to it.

Overall great food, great service...I will definitely return.

Note: These are hard times and most restaurants are understaffed. Be kind and understanding to your servers.

Came here for a nice date night out. My girlfriend has recommended it multiple times and I've never been so I figured why not! We also had a $25 off coupon!
Firstly, service was nothing special but nothing bad either 
It was pretty busy and I also felt as if the space was definitely on the small side. Our table was tiny!!
It wasn't too much of a problem though.
The inside did look nice 
For a starter we ordered the crab wontons which I really enjoyed! The sauce on them was really good.
The bread they served to us was good as well
For my meal I ordered the margarita flatbread 
This was really good! It had a nice chat of it that I enjoyed 
My girlfriend got the fish and chips that enjoyed as well 
After the meal we ordered a slice of plain cheesecake to take home to my mom
After tip and the coupon we only paid $12!!! 
This restaurant wasn't  mind blowing, it wasn't perfect either but it was a good meal and an above average experience. 4/5

Tried Bowman's Tavern again on December 30 for a late lunch.  Again, a very mixed experience. Some food was great, some not.  But once again, the service was very slow, and when we did get the attention of our waitress, she came by with a perfunctory "everything ok?", and then ran off before anyone could even say anything!  

Most of the food was good, including my mom's burger, and my husband's meal.  I had a salmon steak, and while the fish was wonderful (under the surface), the top of the salmon was very salty.  The accompanying vegetables were very good though, including the roasted brussels sprouts that were great.  My son had the butternut squash risotto.  It was very disappointing.  The presentation looked more like a stew, and it was so salty he really couldn't eat hit.  I thought he should send it back, but by the time we could get any attention, he didn't want to bother.  

So I don't know - I really wanted to love it - the site is gorgeous as is the interior.  But I'm still not sold on it.

This is a really nice cafe but, in my book, not a "real cafe". 
I was a fan of the old Good Cup but it really needed an up-do....and it really got one! For one, it is no longer the Good Cup ( but they do have some of the same great  baristas). It is now all white walls and seats, and that spare, open, new look that is so...well, contrived to the point of boring. 

What I do love here now is the natural curved wood communal table in the center space, their loose leaf tea, local pastries, and super nice baristas. 

It is open early but closed at 7 pm ( and sadly, they really let you know....way too much  so, if you are there after 6 pm to the point of discomfort).
Super fast service! Woke up this morning with a flat tire and they put a new one on in less than 5 minutes. Still got to class on time too :)

Ate here for the first time today after shopping at not only Nordstroms but outside of it. Not sure why we haven't eaten here before. We were starved and wanted to eat before getting back on the road. We over ordered thinking we could always take it home. Service was perfect. Soup of the day was tomato and chipotle rice. Husband and I both had a cup (mine was tomato his the other)  I'm a tomato fan and it was amazing. I only had a taste as we had salads coming. Their salad was perfect. Croutons were so crisp. Husband raved at his balsamic dressing. He had chicken sandwich (hold the cheese) with caramelized onions. It looked heavenly. I had the salmon pasta. It was perfect. Only thing that would have made our meal better was wine but we had a drive. Love that they offer it though. I will be back. Nordys is one of my favorite stores.

Awesome location if you plan on clubbing in Ybor and not too far from I-4, so book in advance if you are planning on staying. (My brother went to Tampa a few weeks later, but he didn't book in advance and all the rooms were already taken.)

Hotel was pretty clean and the staff was very helpful and gave excellent service.

This is by far one of my favourite restaurants. I went on my 18th birthday last year and as always the food was amazing. It is a small restaurant but the food makes up for it. I always order the mussels in red sauce as the entrée and the Pescatore for the main course. They give you so much pasta...I was pretty much eating it for two or three days afterwards. I would also recommend the crab-stuffed flounder. I've never experienced flavour like that anywhere. I just really love this place.

The tables are crowded and you might just share elbow space with your neighbor but damn do they do it right. Even on a Wednesday night they were bumpin' hard, but no lackluster attention had been paid.

Service is bar none- our waitress was Tiffanie. Any question we had, stupid or not, was answered with the utmost knowledge and passion for the food they served, and it leeched through her voice.

Fried catfish served over.. basically, ritz crackers and crab meat. Exceptional. I don't think I've ever witnessed my boyfriend experience a foodgasm but this brought it out of him. So delicate, so tender. Spiced to perfection.

Crawfish éttouffée.. I lack the words to describe the relationship I had this this meal, completely devoured. 

Such a casual setting with food displays much the same, even the pre-meal salad we had was impressive. Again, simplicity. 

Would highly recommend.

Visiting Nashville from the Northeast, we had to get BBQ. I plugged in best bbq in Nashville, and Martin's popped up. I overlooked it at first, but the other BBQ place was closed. Well, I am the one who lucked out. This place is AMAZING. I got the Pulled pork sandwich with mac n cheese, and coleslaw. It was so delicious. My husband got a sampler with pulled pork, brisket, and ribs, and he didn't speak throughout the whole meal. The place was packed, but we ordered take out, it was quick, and the people were very friendly. It was reasonably priced. Do yourself a favor, eat here.

Seems like the overall consensus based on previous reviews is that service can be slow which makes me hesitant to eat in at this spot, but I will rate my review solely on my experience which was grabbing take out today for my office. The food was ready right on time and everything was fresh and hot. I ordered a variety of sandwiches and everyone at the office had good things to say. I had the Cubano sandwich which was one of those things I just couldn't stop myself from continuing to eat even when I was way past the point of being full. Luckily the sandwich is so big that I have half left for dinner :) definitely would order take out again!

Manager was great. He agreed to service my car, a few minutes after their closing time. He seemed fair, accommodating, and he didn't tell me I had multiple issues with my car so he could sell items to me or make more money for service. They changed the oil, checked fluids, and I was on my way.

Wonderful pizza!   Crust tastes like pizza we have had in Italy!
And the people are so nice.  
Also a very delicious salad.

Um no. Had lunch today with 6 coworkers and most everything that came out of the kitchen was subpar. The fajita nachos and fajita plate were probably the best of the orders. 

But mine was just yucky. I ordered fish tacos which came with rice and beans. Let me just say that I do not like rice with peas in it, so that's a strike against it. And the beans were runny. Ick. 

The worst of the offenders were the fish tacos which were smothered in mayo. Yup. Mayo. Not aioli but just two clumps of flavorless, greasy mayo that ruined everything else. Not again.

One of my favorite bookstores since the selection is massive! Pricing is a little high but the quality & quantity always makes up for it.There were two books I was looking for specifically and I found at least one which I was excited about. I found an extra book to buy that just seemed too good to pass up. The store was very clean and organized. I love the center aisle and end caps with popular or recommended books to check out. The staff also put up tabs of brief descriptions on books they recommend which is super fun. The staff are always friendly and eager to help which makes for a great shopping experience.

Went carting today. We had been 2 weeks earlier and it was great. Track had not been cleaned was super slippery like driving on ice. Could only go half speed. People spinning out every lap. Super disappointing that we were not told about the poor state of the trac today. They charged me $115.00 for 3 people. It wasn't worth $15.00. Pretty awful. They charge a premium price and we didn't get a premium experience!

Service was sheit lol and food was a bit expensive but good of course and Harry Potter was on so I got to watch that while there. Food came pretty quickly too I remember. The gulab juman is so small not even worth ordering. I would probably not come back but it was okay for a meal before the airport.

I really enjoyed looking at all the wagons and sleds hanging above us in the dining area along with a lot of antiques throughout the restaurant for decor. The food was okay. My French dip was sliced thick and overflowing with meat, the fries were good. My date's fish from his fish and chips was overcooked. The waitstaff seemed eager to get us out and kept checking on us every 2 minutes and interrupting our conversation over and over. Was not impressed and probably won't go back.

Visited some time ago while checking out SLU. Beautiful and tasty. You know sometimes you see a beautiful dessert and you just find it disappointing. Not here. Everything we tried was as tasty as it was beautiful. Dessert Martinis! Why yes thank you! Scrumptious! Like being an adult kid. Love the atmosphere and furniture. We really enjoyed the living room feel in parts of this place which was great for conversation. The dessert platter is great for a group.

This hotel is over priced. The king room I purchased was very outdated, there were barely any plugs in the room, and the lighting situation was horrible. The only reason why i  gave 2 stars is because the staff was very nice and welcoming.

i'm not a vegan, or even vegetarian, but was blown away by this food. so delicious and not at all oily as i sometimes find vegan food to be. and everyone was super friendly. only downside was sitting in hi-ho lounge with some music that i did not like going on, but at least it wasn't loud. they said they will be moving soon, and i hope they find a nice spot. near me!
we had the scallion pancake appetizer which i loved. also had the vegetable dumpling which was good but maybe not quite my favorite.
shared two entrees: glass noodles where phenomenal! the braised tofu was very nice as well, but paled next to the noodles ;-)
for dessert we shared the black sesame sorbet, that was... amazing! and then came the dessert pancake... also amazing!

I never really do reviews unless they're absolutely amazing or absolutely terrible, I walked in and there was one person in front of me while three people are waiting for their coffees, The girl working in the morning had a conversation for about three minutes before taking the next person's order and then didn't even greet me which is fine because she's busy however I waited 18 minutes just to be told that they couldn't even do my order even though it was on the menu, and being advertised. Definitely the worst experience I've ever had at Starbucks.

Stay away from this place at all cost. There is a group of thieves targeting tourists and stealing wallets and purses. Management does nothing about it.  
They work the crowd in the main room where it is super crowded with people.  They hang around a small table to the right of the stage/DJ between two doors.  I was there about 2 minutes tops and felt my wallet taken out of my back pocket. Turned around and two women looked at me like "what?"  Then one turned around and hurries out the door but Nobody saw anything.

We had great fun on our 5-in-1 tour. Adele kept us engrossed in stories about ghosts, vampires, voodoo, werewolves and other unsolved mysteries. The information was conveyed in a fun yet accurate manner. Although we witnessed nothing more exciting than a Captain Jack Sparrow sighting, we still learned a lot and had a good time.  I especially enjoyed my stop at Lafitte's Blacksmith Shop. What an ambience!! It doesn't take much convincing to think it could be haunted.

Very beautiful zen setting. Food is great.  There is wine and beer.  Great family and romantic environment.  tables have a fire place which makes it so nice and relaxing.  its truly one of the most beautiful restaurants in santa barbara.  staff is also super nice, professional and friendly.

This is a great restaurant. The food is consistently fresh and delicious. They are accommodating if you want something adjusted on the menu, and the staff is friendly. The place is always very clean. Kid friendly too.

Went for a birthday celebration. I had a 20oz bone in Ribeye with mushrooms on it. Baked potato and salad completed the main course
My wife had a strip steak cooked to perfection and of course we start every meal out with a blooming onion.

The service as always is impeccable.  Upon asking our waitress just how many servers were working on a given night she informed us that all she has responsibility for are three tables hence the great service.

Looking forward to our next visit to a great restaurant

I'm not a fan of chain restaurants but Brio definitely holds its own. Think a major step above The Olive Garden. 

Since it was Wed, it was $5 martinis. Not bad at all. We skipped appetizers and ordered a side salad which was big enough to split in 2 for just $7. I ordered the lobster and shrimp fettuccine which was solid but nothing spectacular. I would try something else the next time especially as the entree was $22.

LOVE, love ,love " EVERYONE " there!!! Brought in our hairy child twice now for shots, check ups, and even some tests to be taken. From making an appointment to seeing the doctor has been such a wonderful experience. They are all sooooo sweet, kind, loving, helpful, and professional!!!! Its important to have trust in your pets doctor, and care. Well we've 100% TRUST in the doctors, nurses, and even the staff. Even our hairy child is comfortable there, and isn't scared. That means a lot to us. They all explain everything to you from your pets health, medications, to billing. They all make us feel like a member of their family there. EVERYONE IS SO VERY WONDERFUL!!!!!! OUR MANY THANKS TO ALL THERE!  Juanita & Allen
Came in for a pedicure with two friends. The salon is welcoming, cute, and so clean. The staff is professional and friendly. They did a very nice pedicure and had a great color selection.

The restaurant is very nice inside and the staff is friendly but I wasn't impressed with the food. My chicken, rice and peas, and plantains were dry and although my jerk chicken was spicy it wasn't flavorful. There were a few hits in my meal: the corn bread,  callaloo, and the mango drinks were tasty but overall it a few side dishes aren't enough for me to frequent this restaurant.

What a fun music venue. We saw Bobby Bare and Bobby Bare Jr a couple of weeks ago and it was a fantastic show. It's nice to have dinner options beyond the standard bar fare (ahem, 3rd and Lindsley). The wine selection is as good as you'd expect from a place called "winery". A few gripes - we bought VIP tickets and must have been the only ones, because they didn't open that section. They gave us decent seats, but didn't offer to reimburse us. The tables are community, so we got seated with some obnoxious college kids constantly snapping selfies. Service seemed to still be working out the system. But a great show will save a lot of service sins.

This steakhouse of as absolutely ridiculous! The quality of everything was awesome! Steak which we received medium rare was cooked to perfection! The bacon Mac and cheese was also so damm good!  But the best part wasn't even the steak!!! The biscuits were to die for!! The butter with a hint of honey was out of this world!!!!

Would 150% recommend this place to anyone!
There was almost no food available. The hot food here options were shut down. There were very few cold food options. I went next door to the Love's. They had everything I expected the Pilot to have.

Gave them deposit money and they said it would be 4-5 weeks to be put on the schedule.  3 months later and they still could not give me an installation date.  It took numerous calls and emails to force their hand to start my job.  Most of what they promised never happened.. there was no "crew" only 1 man showed up, there was never a supervisor on the job.   When an inspection finally took place (a supervisor only showed up to get their balance due) it was discovered that there was an item that didn't get installed.  Still waiting for an outstanding issue to be completed but they have my money and I'm getting no response from them.  Buyer beware!!!

My husband and I did 3 different tours with Free by Foot while staying in New Orleans. I learned so much on each tour and each one of the tour guides were upbeat and loved there job, it definitely showed. IMO these free tours are a great idea the tour guides want to be there and do a good job because the tip is you give is their pay. 

The Tours I did: 
Ghost Tours of New Orleans - Mikko Tour Guide
St. Louis Cemetery Tour - Kathy was the Tour Guide - FANTASTIC TOUR and she was so full of history, facts and life! 
Garden Tour /Lafayette Cemetery - Sarah was the tour guide - Another FANTASTIC tour - Bubble personality and really new the Garden District and her passion for the City showed! 

Would highly recommend doing any of the tours. We learned so much about New Orleans from all the tour guides.

https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g60864-d2391416-r444523928-Free_Tours_by_Foot-New_Orleans_Louisiana.html#

One of the best Cubans I've ever had! 

The place is a whole in the wall & sometimes you gotta park across the street but it is worth it. 

My Cuban was pressed nicely, the ingredients were fresh and worked very well together. Their coffee is their own special blend and it is fabulous.

This is the second or third Korean restaurant to open in the same Grant road location.  Kogi Korean BBQ is a small mom and pop restaurant with a grandma cooking in the kitchen.  As you enter the restaurant, you have visibility of the kitchen, which provides transparency to the staffs cleanliness while cooking.  My family and I truly enjoyed our meal.  We order beef fried rice, beef bulgogi and bibimbap.  Bibimbap is a korean dish with rice, assorted veggies, over easy eggs, beef, and hot sauce.  Mix all ingredients together and enjoy!

Always super busy, which is the hallmark of a good restaurant. Good beer selection, particularly the Free Will options - Free Will Brewing is across the street. When it's super busy, service can kind of grind, but we've been here many times and will continue to visit. You cannot beat the price for the quality of food, and the staff is always friendly.

This showroom location is absolutely huge and has an impressive selection. I have been to other showrooms and it is rare to find one of this size. I bought a piece of furniture at a different Raymour and Flanigan when I was on vacation, and had them ship the piece for pick-up to this store. It actually saved me a lot of money on tax, since it is calculated based on the taxes of the pick-up state. The staff I spoke to in order to confirm my pick-up date was very nice and helpful, and I was able to pick-up on a Sunday, which is not always an option in other locations. The man who helped me load the piece into my car was great as well.

Called in a take out order for Pepper Steak.  When the order was picked up, was told they were out of peppers.  They should have called back (had our phone number) and ask for a substitution.  Instead they made Pepper Steak without one piece of pepper.  Almost all onions and very little steak. Unbelievable.

I love this little store!!  I stop in every time I am in town.  It is local, authentic and has really cute and comfortable clothes.  Lots of cotton and cashmere fashions perfect for California.  It is what a local small business should be.  Really a little gem.
Really enjoyed our aioli pasta, classic gyro, spanakopita and spicy feta.  Not too fast not too slow, time between courses was just right.  Our servers were fantastic.

I just booked an amazing house in Downtown Santa Barbara, and I am so excited for this trip! Tera made it extremely easy to book, and answered all of my questions quickly and efficiently. I originally found the listing on AirBnB but a quick google search saved me over $400 booking directly with the company!

9:30pm on a Friday night booth was dirty, food on the floor, told server sat at table 53 Hispanic waiter who didn't seem to care about the lack cleanliness.  But he Was sure to let us know how backed up the kitchen was. In general awful experience!  Don't get me started on the disgusting bathrooms. Food came salmon was dry baked potatoes was over cooked mush.  Salad was warm.  They can remodel all they want but their food quality is why this chain is doomed.
Normally ok; today I waited about 10 min with no server. They weren't busy, maybe 5 customers

Amazing amazing place...they serve u food even at midnight,and the lady behind the counter takes care of one order at a time...we were super hungry after new years eve and couldnt find food anywhere else but here...and they have the best veggie food...

Amazing customer service, excellent staffing and a clean environment to feel comfortable buying a new car. Every representative I encountered had a smile on their face and were eager to assist me. The sales managers and even owner helped me throughout the process. I've sent several friends to have service work done there and they've always been taken care of. Highly highly recommend taking a chance on Bayou Nissan!

This was by far THE BEST fried chicken I have ever had in Philly! The skin is very crispy and flavorful and soft and moist on the inside. Their corn bread muffins are also amazing topped with their honey butter. If you walk in and place an order, it will take some time before you get your order since they can be pretty busy. It is best to call it in ahead of time before you make your way there! I highly recommend this place and will be returning again.

Another of our first night in town spots we hit up, The Hut is truly a tiki hut beyond compare. David ordered a whiskey and I had water. The décor reminded us of a clean Bikini Lounge on steroids. And this place is HUGE!! We enjoyed a game of giant Connect Four.

(9/1/2013) Time to update these reviews people! Every time I visit, I come here. Always good food and service.  The manager - Larry I think - was super friendly.  I asked about French toast and it appeared less than 3 minutes later.  Thanks for some great eats!

Been here many times and never have reviewed the place, but the other night we had to wait awhile for a table even though we had a reservation. The manager working that night and our server Tyler W. did an amazing job making up for it and making it a memorable experience. The service was perfect and the food was good too.
Devil's Dungeon is awesome.  The actors are amazing and did a great job.  The scare factor is definitely there.  It is definitely worth the money.

We managed to get a Saturday dinner reservation. Parking was easy on the weekend, especially after hours. The restaurant was a beautiful sight, mostly glass encased, modern rustic style with a white palate and repurposed wood with accents of clear glass pieces. 
We were seated promptly and service was prompt and efficient, our water was never empty. Our server checked in at an appropriate frequency and was not difficult to get in spite of a packed house. 
We got a couple of cocktails to start, we loved one of them, but the other was too strong for us. Kudos to our server and restaurant for switching our drink with no fuss and no extra charge. 

We started with "Purple Top Turnip Tacos" which is a light and fun take on tacos using thinly sliced turnip as taco shells. Filled with strawberry sofrito, charred vegetable mole, kale, sour cream, cilantro. We chose to have 2 each of mushrooms and pork. The mushrooms were delicious albeit slightly less tender than I would have preferred, the pork was finely ground and umami packed, with a unique bite texture. Great start!

Next we got the "Rutabaga Carbonara". You may have heard of zuchinni noodles, this is Rutabaga noodles! Warm, al dente and a perfect vehicle for the sauce, which to me was one of the most flavorful explosion concoctions I ever had. 

For entrees, we ordered the chicken and the pork from the grill. 2 pieces of perfectly grilled, melt in your mouth pork belly and 2 pieces of lightly smoked pork loin. The treatment of the meats were simple: salt, heat and smoke. We also got the chicken which was served as 2 slices of chicken breast and 1 piece of thigh. Note that each order of meat was a total of 4oz, you don't get a whole chicken breast or a whole thigh, just slices, which I appreciate as a matter of not feeling overfed at the end of the meal. 

For sides we got the "Missouri Rice" which was wild rice with ramps, asparagus, spring onions and flowers, drizzled with chorizo oil. Perfect play of textures and sizes. We also got "Shelling Beans", which was a mix of beans with turnip greens and flowers in a sauce of ham hock and horseradish. Both of these sides illustrated the kitchen's masterful play of salt, fat and acid. 

For dessert, we got "Anne's Garden" and the "Rhubarb float". Yes, rhubarb float...we almost did not get it just on account of the name, but by the time of dessert, we were convinced that nothing comes out of this kitchen that we would not like, and we're glad we got the rhubarb float. It was comprised of celery sorbet sitting in a bath of sweet buckwheat sauce with pieces of soft, poached rhubarb. Sweet with hints of savory. Wonderful.
We also got Anne's Garden, which was a perfect piece of art to end the meal. Mildly sweet panna cotta, with chocolate "dirt", picturesquely decorated with color-popping petals to present a otherworldly garden escape. 

Vicia is certainly amongst my top 3 favorite restaurants of STL. We made our next reservation before we even paid the bill! Thank you!

I went to jeans today instead of my normal place and I regret it. 

First, the prices are not listed, however there are signs saying gel manicure 25.

I opted for a regular manicure figuring I would pay around 10 dollars.

Jean charged me 20, saying that there was a five dollar charge to remove old gel.

Furthermore, it is 3 hours after my manicure and the polish is not set and there are marks and dings. I will say I stayed under the dryer for at least 30 minutes and still the polish is not set.

I am now at Walgreens buying nail polish remover. I wasted 20 dollars today. I would
not recommend jean. Perhaps the other manicurists are better?

My review is going to be a bit different from the previous ones here but I had a different experience than the other people here. I had a 2bedroom suite booked for 2 days which came with 1king size bed, 1 queen size bed, a nice living area, and a kitchen also. I was pretty surprised by how spacious the whole suite was and very impressed. It was also very cleaned and well put. It had a lot of towels in it which some people said they didn't. I had brought extra towels from home for that reason which I didn't end up using. 

- the elevators and escalators were all functioning but their restaurant was under renovation. 
- most front desk people were nice and made eye contact. D'Asia was one of the nice employees who helped us check in and she was really sweet. Also another time, I wanted coffee filter and cream and the front desk lady sent someone up with those things within 30 mins
- the AC was intially not working for one of the rooms but we called the maintenance who came and fixed it within 10 mins and also gave us a fan meanwhile until the room got nice and cool
- they have an amazing rooftop pool that's open from 10am till 10pm with a great view of the arch and the city! You can see it from one of the pictures I posted
- their check in starts at 3pm but our room was ready by 2:15 pm while we were waiting in the lobby 
-their car garage is indoor and it's 20$ for overnight self parking! But if you want to go in and out during the day..you just have to get the parking sticker validated each time and it's free! 
- the only reason why I deducted a star is because the bath tub clogged right after 2 people showered and we couldn't use that anymore. 
- the best part of the hotel is it has amazing view from the room windows!!!
-I would definitely recommend it for their suite!

It is one of those places you can either miss if you drive past it too quickly or allow the surrounding location to distract you.  Yes it is part of one of those game entertainment centers/min golf. But the mom and pop small places are always the best.  Fresh and hot, bursting with flavor, plenty of fun varieties and toppings to pick. I would/will go again when I am in Reno. The staff was friendly as well. Good eats indeed.

One my absolute favorite places in St. Louis. They have put so much work into each item on the menu. The Shroomed Out  Ramen is  the broth is heaven. The crab rangoons are among the best I've ever had. Perfectly crisp. The spring rolls and their sauce are also delicious. 50/10 would go here again tomorrow.

I wanted to send a special Thank you to Dave and Anthony on the timely and special care done to my father inlaw's car. He has a 2004 Chrysler 300. From the air conditioner that needed a shot of freon to cleaning up a botched wiring repair from another mechanic to the inspection. The price was right and I didn't see any of those tell tale sign of mechanic finger prints after the job was done.  They have a new customer.
Very impressed so far. They came 3 times to my home in a short period to assist in a long lapse in pest control prior. The tech and office ppl also very nice!

I wish I cold give them 6 stars!  Peel wood has a great atmosphere and tons of space in their bar area for quick happy hour drinks or snacks.  Highly suggest you stop in during happy hour....cheap drinks and food items!  Our service was great and we even got a free slice of cheesecake for celebrating a birthday.  

Food: 
-goat cheese dip (do it!, better than Barcelona's...if you've ever been to this other Clayton spot)
-kale Cesar salad
-balsamic chicken pizza....DELICIOUS
-apple cheesecake....free....even better!

I came here last night for a friend's birthday and I was not impressed with the service. I usually come here once a month and I always have a great time, but definitely not last night. 

Walking into the bar, the doorman was nice and friendly, but the bartender was nothing but rude. I was with a group of friends trying to have a good time, and it seemed like he wasn't paying attention to us. I can understand if it was busy and there were a lot of people at the bar, but there was not, just a group of 3 aside from my group and I. We waiting for 10 minutes to get refills on our drinks, which were not well mixed. He told us to wait a moment while he flirted with the group of females that had just sat down. Very professional. Towards the end of it all, it seemed like we were overcharged for our drinks, which we found out he charged us for one drink 3 times, something we didn't even order. 

The other times I've been here, I've had the female bartender and she was amazing. She paid attention to each patron, she was sweet and nice, and she made the drinks exceptionally well. 

I don't know. I guess I came here on a bad day.

Entirely underwhelming in all aspects. A place that pretends to be a high end restaurant but really does not belong there.

Food was merely okay: the famous popover was cold; half of the dishes were way too salty: the escargot soup, the octopus, etc. The octopus was really a shame.... The chocolate mousse cake was very pasty - definitely a let down. 

Service: Our table was wobbly so i asked the server to fix it. He did; but acted like he did me a huge favor and never apologized for the problem. Waiters kept hovering around and took away our dishes as soon as we put down the fork, once while I still had the food in my mouth -- Gees what's the rush?? 

Poor ambience. Tables are set so close to each other that i felt i was having dinner in a party of 6 instead of just the two of us. We could hear the conversation of neighboring tables and I'm sure they could hear us. So awkward. It's impossible to get up without guests at the neighboring table making way. Absolutely not cool. A business venue not a romantic one.

I haven't had anything from here that I didn't like (both locations) the French toast was bomb and the crepe I just had today was tasty and a great mix of sweet and savory. Mimosas are good and so are the cocktails (not sure if ripple location has cocktails but mass ave does). Great spot for a clean brunch.

The beef and meat here are mostly frozen not freahly cut. Dont get regular chicken and beef, too tough to chew. Place has a good selection of sauces. Hot pot servers were weird and I think only spoke mostly chinese. Ingredients were eh, some things like seafood were not fresh. It was alright, had much better.

I'm a big fan of big brand tire! They sealed and rotated my tires for free! The people at desk were welcoming and polite. I also got a free t-shirt for checking in! The chairs in the waiting room were even comfortable and let's be honest, life's all about comfort!

I have been coming to this place for over 8 years now and love it! The quality of the food is fantastic and they accommodate to many different dietary restrictions. The inside doesn't have the greatest appeal, but once you look past that, you will be pleasantly surprised. Anytime my body is feeling depleted, this is my go-to spot! My two favorites... a #12 smoothie and a happy bowl!

The price is ok, especially if you buy the wash books for the summer but the inside is old and smells like mold.  Did an OK job vacuuming out my car except for in between the seats so I had to spot at a different spot to vacuum it myself.  I prefer the carwash on Rt 33 I think they do an overall better job and the inside isn't as gross.

First time here and I would never come back again.  I ordered the drunken angel pasta. It was very salty.  The server even tasted the sauce and agreed that the dish is not normal.  Then the second dish came. It was the same.  
Then I ordered the trout. Fish was ok.  I found something in the rice that came with the trout that looked like a thin long black piece of something. I was so excited to try this place and it was a horrible experience.  But our server Jessye went above and beyond to make this experience somewhat better.

Great service. Great rice. Great lemonade. Thai curry had lots of chicken, which was very tender. However, the curry sauce was watered down, pretty bland, not sweet enough, and appeared to be made with water rather than coconut milk. Yuck.

I had never been to an Even Stevens before, and was visiting from out of town. I went here on my lunch break, and boy was I happy I did. 

The breakfast sandwich with ham was massive and the Hawaiian bun it was served on was fresh. The tots were spectacular and the service was great. I also did the Yelp Check-In to get a free cookie. The atmosphere was really 'cool' and modern. This would be a fun place to hang out or chat with friends. 

Overall, a great meal at an outstanding price.
quesadilla was burnt but tacos were great. really liked the salsa bar
Tammy and Paul are wonderful people and always service with a smile. Great food and better than Subway IMO. Prices are competitive with the other major shops and even have daily specials.

I highly recommended this place. I get the grilled chicken Breast and the house salad. Most excellent. Also the Devil eggs are good too. The staff is very nice and helpful. Whenever I'm in Franklin, TN, I'll make sure I come to Jim 'N Nick's!!

Still the sub par Electric Factory in disguise. 
Crappy sound - check. 
Overpriced booze - check. 
Shitty bathrooms - check. 
Metal detectors, hey thats new! And what's this?! You added Ikea lights on the second floor? How thoughtful!
On a positive note, parking inside the lot is still $15, they haven't raised that (yet...they will).
Didn't even get a new sign yet, a shame.

Again, it's always great being able to support a black owned business! Went here as a Sunday brunch option. They were pretty busy however I was seated fairly quickly despite the crowd. My drink order was just a water, nothing too fancy-- it took forever for someone to bring to me. When she brought the water, I made sure to have my food choices ready to speed up that process. It took a while to get my food (peachy waffle and cheese grits), so I again requested my check when the food was brought out and guess what? That took a long time also! :)

Simply stated: the waffle was really good and flavorful, I did not need to add syrup to it, it was perfect as is. The grits, however were awful and bland. Based on the waffle and my desire to support black businesses, the experience was okay. Room for improvement is most definitely the slow service and better grits.
Give stars. Great date place , covid friendly dining. The bar has amazing specialty drinks and the staff is super attentive. Have to go back a few times to try everything

Yaaaaaaaa ice cream! Really good. Hey its ice cream cant really screw this up unless its melted which it wasent. Go there. Ice cream makes me happy and it will make you happy too. Only thing better then ice cream is my jeep! Mmmmmmm ice cream in my jeep....perfect

Best pharmacy/ gift store around!! Pharmacists are efficient, thorough and so friendly! Penny at the gift shop desk is helpful and a pleasure! There gift items are adorable and wrapped beautifully for easy gift giving!! Been going here for years and will go for years to come ;)

Dang. This food was perfect. Every dish was well balanced, flavorful and fresh. My partner has a severe peanut allergy and many of the fried menu items use peanut oil, so we were initially disappointed  when we couldn't order our preferred menu items. What followed however, rather than being second choice fare, was a show stopper. The mussels were decadent and herbal, the burger was perfectly cooked, buttery and topped with crispy lettuce and flavorful tomatoes. This place has got it down - something I find rarely in hip restaurants that seem to invest more in aesthetic than pleasing our palette. Go here. You will feel happy.

I drive past this place every day coming home from work, so decided to try it instead of Argento's my usually place. I ordered ahead and when I got there it was not busy and picked up my order. Got home missing part of my order. I called and told my only options where come pick it up or credit my card.....   Hunger, pissed off kids so I had to drive back and pick up the rest of order.  No sorry,  thank you we will credit you order......  Kids said food was good but still left a bad taste for me....  I tried to support a new local place but disappointed with service....

The service was AWFUL. We were put upstairs and forgotten about. Had to get our own drinks and then go ask for our bill. When our issue was brought to the attention of a young lady that represented herself as the manager , her exact response was that they were busy. I asked why put someone in an area that the will be forgotten about. No offer of discount or future visit discount. We will never go back. Prodigy Burger is just around the corner!

Iove everything here! Especially their chile verde! Also best horchata in reno. 
I do wish they had hotter hot sauce. But it's still delicious!

Great seafood, great beer! My son says buffalo shrimp is his new favorite food. Stone crab was great. Everything was fresh and tasty. Service was friendly and gracious though a tad slow. Wish we lived near here!

I've been grooming 25 years and this salon is the greatest!  Sevy, the owner, and all the Groomers genuinely care about the dogs - how they are treated, how they look, and making sure the customer is pleased. I am very proud to work here.

Another excellent meal at Cracker Barrel! My family stopped here to meet up with more family members for a late lunch. This is a great location just off the highway with lots of parking. There were ten of us in the party and we had about a 30 minute wait before we were called. This is an easy place for my family to come to because there's always plenty on the menu we'll eat and the portions are just right. We were introduced to two servers, one was training and rightfully so. She was having a very difficult time so we were thankful for the trainer that was with her. The trainer did an excellent job at keeping our orders straight and our glasses filled. She was very kind and even took the time to show us some cheats for the games set on the table.

For lunch I finally had something other than the cornbread dusted haddock; I had the pot roast. It was amazing! So tender, I didn't even need a knife to cut it. As with most of their meals, you can pick 3 sides. I got mashed potatoes, Mac and cheese and steamed broccoli. I've had these sides before so I knew what I was getting would be good. I will definitely be getting this meal again on my next visit!

This is a hidden gem of a work spot! The space has plenty of comfy chairs and couches plus tables set up far enough apart from one another to prevent eavesdropping! The music is quiet and brings a calming vibe, plus their separate rentable rooms allow for group meetings with your own space.

The tea and coffee are tasty and they often have treats baked locally.

I like to meet people here versus bigger coffee spots as there is private parking, plenty of seats and it is quiet enough to hear my group!

Plus they have good tea options which is perfect for a later meeting.

Free WiFi which is really rather fast for a space this size.

Highly recommend it if you need a spot to chill or work.
This is where I go when I'm looking for food, drink, or supplements that I can't find anywhere else.  They also have a deli that makes delicious smoothies and sandwiches.

This place is definitely the place for your sunday brunch! Our server Megan was very attentive and just all around awesome. Her drink running a prebussing skills are top notch ;)
Next time I am in Nashville I will go see her again for sure
Best burger in the city.  Cheese puffs are a fav as well as the Fudge sundae.  It is worth the wait.  Get there before 5pm to get a seat.

I have two rings that I wear every moment. They aren't expensive but they have a ton of memories and high sentimental value. Hand sanitizer turned them colors and I was worried I'd no longer be able to wear them. Walking into The shop, Russell assured me it was an easy fix, took them in the back and emerged with perfectly silver rings! He was so helpful and kind! During my visit he was also talking to a woman about the memories of her late husband who had given her a bracelet. I just appreciated the kindness and humanity, especially in a hard time. I don't ever write reviews, but this was a notable experience!

This is the dog park of all dog parks. Lots of open areas with wooded trails and creeks to explore. There's is no dog park in our town and the couple of dog parks in the neighboring towns are small fenced areas. Well worth the 30 minute drive. I'm not sure who enjoyed it more, us or our dog.

My husband and I love going here! It has the best decoration, and typically is a quiet date night spot. Staff is friendly and I love the Massamum curry dish. So good! My husband says it's his favorite pad Thai in the city.

I got my Tragus and navel pierced. The guy that attended to me was really nice and helpful and patient as I couldn't decide on the jewelry to choose for my navel. Hika my piercer was friendly,calming and professional.Both piercings went great! 

I went in again a couple of days bc I thought I had made my jewelry  shift from sitting in a particular way, I was once again attended to quickly and professionally although it was 15mins to 9pm (closing time). 

I'm done with piercings but if I should ever want to pierce again I'd definitely have it done at infinite.no where else!

Love love love bartaco! My girlfriend and i always get the fish tacos and the shrimp tacos. We recently went and tried the cauliflower taco and to our surprise was amazing! Staff are also very friendly! Tacos are $2.50-$3.50 a piece and i find that  reasonable
The best pizza bar none, great ingredients, fun and lively staff, the perfect place to grab a high quality pie.

This has been my worse hotel experience in as long as I can remember.  This place may look a little dated, but acceptable as you pass through the lobby, but it is a complete shithole.  Let me list the ways I hate you Doubletree.  

1. Super noisy wall-mounted heater-AC.  It sounds like it's having it's dying quivers and I should be getting out the defibrillator.  The only way to make it stop was to unplug it and it took me 30 minutes of messing with the wall control to finally give up.  

2. The walls are paper thin.  I can hear the people talking clearly in the next room.  I also heard them farting in the bathtub, hacking, grunting and, well, you get the point.  TMI!!  If this isn't bad enough, I thought their alarm was mine (they had standard iPhone alarm).  It was so clear and loud I woke up and tried to hit snooze only realizing then it wasn't my phone.  I just yelled "snooze" and punched the wall twice and my gaseous neighbors hit their snooze button. Teamwork!

3. Television is a giant turd.  There are constant interference and weird digital crap patterns all over the screen while the voice keeps turning weird turn on and off.  I have seen much better units discarded  in apartment complex dumpster areas.  

4. I tried to take a shower and felt like Sylvester Stallone at the police station in First Blood.  Decided it hurt too much, so I took a bath which revealed a side of the bathroom I could have gone my whole life without seeing.  The side of the toilet has giant holes in it and there is a big hole in the wall behind the toiled with used q-tips sticking out of it.  Photos attached. You can't make this up.  Unfortunately I didn't have any used toiletries of my own to offer up to the shithole Gods. 

5.  Opened the window and have a huge ac thingy is all I can see.  Picture attached. The windows were disgusting too. Super dirty. 

6.  Room refrigerator froze all my shit making it unusable.  I had to throw everything out.  I had just filled it up with salad vegetables and other healthy sundries.  It was set on 5/10, so obviously broken.  So much for eating healthy on this trip.

7.  They keep pinging my debit card.  I have 7 charges on my card.  3 of the are for $30 and the other four are random amounts all totaling almost $300.   Did they think I was going to take something from the room?   I would not let my dog use the early 90s crap they populated this shithole, with, but just in case they have me covered.  I DO look shady. Maybe they though I was going to eat and run breakfast?  

8.  The gym IS nice. I suppose that because nobody uses it and dumbbells haven't changed much since 1990.  I can attest to this.  They also have water and apples in there (I'll probably get charged for what is took).  I think I have a hotel imp following me around and billing me for everything I do.

9. Pack your own pillow and blanket.  If you have a moon-suit, grab that too!  The two pube-covered sheets they provide will keep you freezing and the horribly stained pillows will keep you up all night trying to figure out how the ($:&: all that brown and yellow juice came off of someone's head.  

Trust me, you don't want to stay here especially considering the price, you will be expecting much more and be very disappointed.

Not even with a coupon was this haircut worth it
I've taken the scissors to my own hair 3 times to even it out!
Worst worst haircut EVER
(Stylist = LaPaulla)
Not coming back
Best cleaners around. Friendly and helpful and always willing to go the extra mile. I won't go anywhere else!
Great lunch specials $7 is a great deal! Soup and salad! Yummmm! Not very busy at lunch so got seated right away,

I usually end up here after the Wednesdays on the Square.  They usually seem to have a nice crowd of nice looking ladies about the place so that is always a nice bonus.  I've also noticed a few sloppily dressed hipster type people hanging out around here sometimes and I'm not a fan of the hipster culture (so that makes my evil, preppy, Republican soul recoil a bit).  I also believe this place is smoke free which is another big bonus for me (as I always see people outside smoking and getting up to go outside so I'm assuming smoking is not allowed inside).

They have some good burgers that I've tried and those have some of the toughest (not in a bad way tough more like hearty real bread tough) and chewiest hamburger buns of anyplace I've ever been.  I'm also a bit unhappy with the fact they charge $12 for a burger and it doesn't come with any side (so fries will cost you extra).  There are some other interesting items on the small menu that I've never sampled and I'm sort of interested in the chicken & dumplings but not at the price they charge.  The bathrooms are a bit strange and a little bit of an adventure to get to so you might need to ask directions if you've never been before.  

Have I mentioned I usually HATE Gastropubs but this place seems to have a good selection of beer I like and it feels comfortable (like a normal bar with people that I like to be around) so I don't hate it and actually like it but I won't be eating here on a regular basis.
Seriously the best spring and summer rolls I've had in the city. Tasty and delicious phô and the broth of course is what makes it!
Delicious food! We all ordered different things and they were all delicious. Very fresh and flavorful. Service was prompt and friendly and we will definitely return!!

Stayed here on July 1-2. The room was extremely small. We were travelling with a 40lb dog and her crate took up the walking space at the bottom of the bed. We had to leave the crate in the vehicle and we're unable to get room service since the dog was out. After a long HOT day of sightseeing we went back to shower. Called front desk for fresh towels and was given 1 towel for 4 people. Called again and was given a very hard time. After numerous calls and arguments we ended up getting 2 bath towels 2 hand towels and 1 washcloth. The room was dirty! My 2 year old ran around on the carpet for 30 minutes after her bath and her feet were black. When we arrived the front of the bath tub was off and laying in the floor. The bath room had cacked up dirt in the corners of the floor. A shelf had been added or repaired behind the toilet which added much needed space but the sheetrock dust was never cleaned up and covered the floor around the toilet. The only thing good about this hotel is the location.

By far the best Mexican food & restaurant I've been to. I've traveled all around the country and this place is still at the top of my list. Always great service, food, and drinks. Order the queso off the bat. Plus the portions are huge with awesome prices! Never disappoints.
My husband and I have came here twice, we have never had anything bad! Their food is so delicious omg , I really enjoyed the pad thai, fried tofu, and Tom yum soup!

We ended up at Marrakesh after we couldn't get into Zahav (if you want to walk in there, show up before 4 pm, 5 pm was too late to get in at any point that evening) and did a quick yelp search for somewhere nearby that we could walk.

I have to say, I'm actually glad that we didn't get in to Zahav because we had such an amazing experience at Marrakesh. First thing to know: Ring the Bell to get in. We stood outside for a while waiting for them to open the door before I decided to ring it.  We were the first ones there when it opened at 5:30 pm and at first they weren't sure if they could accommodate us without reservations, but when we told them we had just arrived from out of town, they were very kind and squeezed us in to one of the best tables downstairs. They said they were fully booked that night, but if we were able to eat quickly they could get us in.  

With no menus and no prices, we had no idea what we were in for and just went with it.  They told us it would be 7 courses, and 7 courses it was. And this is not one of those tastings where each course is a bite of something.. each course in itself was enough for a full meal.  

The meal starts with them washing your hands in rose water - you are going to  be eating with your hands, after all, so this is the only civilized thing to do.

Courses:
1- eggplant, carrots, and cucumber salad that you eat with pita bread (which they bring out in large tins and you can have unlimited quantities of) - LOVED the eggplant so much I almost filled up on Course 1
2- some sweet chicken pastry thing - we didn't care much for this one just because we aren't fans of mixing sweet into our salty
3- chicken on the bone, cooked to such perfection that it comes right off the bone - some of the best chicken I've ever had, and that's saying a lot
4 - couscous and chicken - also amazing
5 - a spanokopita thing
6 - an entire bowl of fruit that we couldn't even touch - a full apple, banana, orange, grapes, strawberries - does anyone eat this, I wonder?
7 - baklava served with some of the best tea I've ever had

Note: We don't eat beef so they switched out the beef/lamb kabob, not sure which dish they switched.

The bill came and we braced ourselves - and it was $25 per person, with tax and tip (automatically added at 18%), the total was $64. One of the best deals ever.

As we got up to leave, they brought out a big doggy bag with the leftovers from each of our courses wrapped nicely up for us. What a nice touch!  We were hurrying to free up the table as we knew they did us a favor, but they did not make us feel rushed at all, and even wouldn't open the door to let us out until we were completely fully bundled up ("it's cold outside!" they said).

Some of the nicest people I've ever met, definitely the nicest in Philly, and such an amazing experience overall. Loved it!

New Orleans is a unique place. It's a melting pot of various cultures and styles of cooking that contributed to the  fabrics of the society. The narrow old streets , the musics and creole cooking smells everywhere. All cultures, songs and different styles of cooking were intertwined here in NOLA . It was a nice breezy day I decided to take a walk. I was looking for something different, found this place to have dinner. The place was very simple. Even half of the tables were empty I was given a seat next to kitchen. The whole place was noisy. Informal atmosphere. Small menu. The service was great. Grill oysters with butter chili was very tasty. Love it. The shrimp was refreshing with cucumber and basil leaves. The whole Grilled Red Snapper made my day. I was too full to have desserts. Price was $$$. Parking on the street, hard to find. Good place to have lunch and dinner.

Hands down I believe this will quickly be voted as Indy's best park! The new grounds are fantastic in every way! They incorporate music, exercise, a variety of materials - individual activities and group activities. The fact that everything is Astro turf and that the hills were purposefully made to be easy to slide down for kiddos - is amazing! the rubber side walks are "bouncy" says my three year old! The slides are fast and fun for all ages! The rock climbing areas are incentive and the musical instruments are a fave for our kids! The family swings are neat and we can't wait for the splash pad and the cafe/coffee shop/ etc that will hopefully be open in the spring or summer! What a great addition to the neighborhood! Great park!

They have really improve their foods and drinks! The chicken ceasar salad i order is the best I ever had and I eat a lot of ceasar salad. My husband order chicken creamy fettuccine and it was also good. The server we had super nice and friendly. We came in late and they were very accommodating.

This sushi place is great! Quick and very tasty. The prices are awesome as well, unbeatable. They always give a complimentary miso soup and the flavor is perfect, not too fishy and strong. They also serve boba and treats up front! The service is great and the place is well managed. 100% recommend for sushi lovers!!!
Smaller burgers but so delicious! One of my favorites!!! And it's never over packed. I love it!

I have officially been going to Shellak for more than 2 years now. My previous review was written after just a first visit, but now I can say this place is the best. Over the last 6 months or so I have had to go to many different nail salons for friend's weddings or birthdays etc and they just don't compare. My Shellac manicures easily last 12-14 days (with working out and doing dishes etc) and the luxury pedicures are (a little pricey) but amazing. If given my choice this is the only nail place I will go to in S. Tampa  (or Tallahasse or Temple Terrace or Jacksonville).

We live close by so wanted to give this place, which recently opened, a shot. Very nice "upscale casual" environment with a large bar area as well as large indoor and outdoor dining areas.  Unfortunately, as is so often the case with these types of restaurants in the suburbs, the food was both mediocre and expensive.  Duck confit pizza had very little duck and the cheese (cheddar i think) was over-powering. Paella was mushy and appeared to have been made with arborio rice (which is typically used for risotto).  Gnocchi was very dense and a small portion. The restaurant was also very loud, especially in the bar area.  It was difficult to carry a conversation.  So, nice atmosphere with good bar and outdoor areas, if that's what you're looking for, but keep your expectations reasonable on the food.
Seriously the best sushi in town! We generally sushi s of Kennedy and this place is soooo much better. Not going to name other places as they are good but origami on Hillsborough is simply excellent!

WOW. Got this recommendation from a local bartender & I'm so glad he told us about it. This meal is up there with my all time fav meals. Had the eggplant with crab for appetizer and Fish Michelle..grouper with shrimp & crab and this amazing stuff called Ocean Sauce! Seriously good and worth the wait.

Solid food in a bar/restaurant that reminds you of your grandads basement, but in the best way. 

Dark wood, model train running around the ceiling, and approachable food at decent prices. A good alternative to the loud and slightly bougie Westport Social up the block. 

Would have liked to see more local beer on tap, but that's just me. 

It gets busy at lunch, and service on my four visits was hit or miss.

SOUP DUMPLINGS!!!! OMG this is drugs!!!!!  I introduce everyone about this place and they love it.  and their home made Hot pepper seeds (hot oil) are soooo good.  OMG I love this place and its so cheap.  And they just moved out of their old spot under the building.  Beautiful cute place.
This place rocks! We ordered the lamb lollipops, French onion soup, pad thai, and drunken noodles. Everything was delicious and the staff was fast and friendly!

A very Americanized Korean food place. Think Korean Chipotle. It was Ok. I probably would choose one of the other 3-4 Asian places in the new Bourse. 

I got a bowl. Brown rice. Shredded pork (not spicy but rather salty). Kimchi slaw (tasted just like cole slaw). I added pickled diakon radish for $.60. Gogejong (like catchup, but supposed to be Spicy and was not). A Korean salsa and sesame seeds. 

That plus a bottle of water $12.36. Meh.
Love the coffee and almond croissant here. The interior design is great. I wish there is wifi here.

I purchased my Prius about a year ago from O'Brien and had a great experience working with Danielle, who was most helpful.

I recently noticed a rattle coming from underneath the body of my car. I made an appointment with O'Brien's service center, as I wanted the issue repaired properly. I drive about 600 miles per week and was willing to pay dealership prices to keep my vehicle in top shape.

When I arrived at the time of my appointment, I was told that I "shouldn't have scheduled these repairs on a Saturday" as they only have a "skeleton crew" on site. However, the staff was able to complete my repairs for a reasonable rate. I paid the bill and left the service center.

Flash forward several hours: I walk out of my apartment and immediately notice a crack in the front bumper of my car. I took a closer look, and something had obviously been hit. The light in the bumper was knocked out of its bracket and was pushed up into the bumper. I had washed/vacuumed the car on Thursday evening, and there was no damage at that time. I called the dealership, leaving a message about my concerns, and also emailed photos to the service manager.

Monday came and went and I received no response from O'Brien.

On Wednesday, I connected with the service manager, Dan. He told me that, though no one had noted any damage to my vehicle upon intake, his staff was sure they hadn't done caused this damage. He also told me that the skeleton crew comment I received on Saturday wasn't accurate, saying "I don't know why he said that". He told me he had 29 years in the repair business, which was not helpful or relevant.

Interestingly enough, Dan was sure his staff hadn't caused this damage despite him not being there, and he was equally convinced that I had hit "a piece of tire rubber on the highway" or a "curb" on my way home, despite the fact that neither of these things would explain the type of damage that occurred to my bumper.

I get the drill here; I left the dealership, and once that happens I can't say with certainty that the damage occurred while it was being handled by O'Brien's service staff. I can say this for sure, though- I let the car out of my sight for a very short time, and I ended up with damage the very same day. I can also say with certainty that I didn't hit either some tire rubber or a curb on the ten minute drive home that day.

Whether or not this damage occurred while my vehicle was in their possession, there's an easy way for me to be sure that my car won't be damaged by O'Brien in the future- taking it elsewhere for service, which is what I'll do.

I have always had amazing food experiences here. Its a perfect date spot or girls night out place because the food is tapas style so they are little appetizers to share. Its perfect for someone like me who likes to try everything. The lamb is to die for! I also had a blood orange margarita which I loved! The ambiance is really nice too. They had betty boop playing on the tv and really nice music as well. It is pricy but you certainly get what you pay for and more!
Wonderful, fresh, organic suishi!! Beautiful presentation and friendly service. Place was clean and service was fast. We will definitely  be back!!!
Loved everything about this restaurant, including our server (Cullen) except the music. It sounds like the beat over and over and over.....

We had a very large limb come down during the storms that damaged our fence. They were able to come out quickly to give an estimate  ( a few other companies didn't even return my call). The estimate was fair and the work was scheduled within a few days. They showed up on time and worked very hard on a holiday weekend (July 3rd) to get the job done. They did a great job and took care to not cause additional damage to the fence. I also had them trim the tree and the tree in front of my house. They did a very professional job. They workers were friendly and careful not to damage my property. The cleaned up all the debris at left my property in good condition. Great Service! Highly recommended!
