I cannot understand why this place has only 2 stars!  This is the ONLY place I will go for paint, paint supplies and advice and help.  The guys know their stuff and always take as much time with me as needed to explain what I need to do.  While Benjamin Moore paint is pricey, it is well worth it.  Paints well and lasts a long time.  Extremely washable and environmentally easy on the lungs.  I love this place
We love this Starbucks... they are quick, friendly, and do a great job.  Other than the hoodrats hanging out on the front step, it is great.  Also. I would clean more thoroughly the front porch!!

Very yummy & quick! Not over priced at all. They have a large menu to choose from and open 24 hours which is nice. Guess you can go shopping at Walmart at 2 am and stop at Mel's after for a nice meal. LoL joking aside they have a cute 50's diner theme too! Fun place to stop and good place to bring the kids too.

Though their small menu feels somewhat limited, I still found myself drawn to to two dishes. I was so drawn in fact, that I had to get the server to weigh in to help me decide. She recommended the jambalaya, which as far as I can tell from all of the patrons around me ordering it, must be a specialty of theirs.  

The food was good, with the star of the dish being the mac & cheese hush puppies. They were just the right amount of cheesy, creamy and breaded. The jambalaya was alright as well. 

Rocky Mountain Ice House offers happy hour until 7, which means their house red, a cab merlot, is only $4.75, which is good news because it's quite drinkable.  

I was initially drawn to the place because it wasn't packed to the rafters like every place for the next block. Read into that if you like, I would come here again.

Side Bar has become my husband and I's new favorite restaurant! We've tried a good portion of the menu so far, and have yet to try anything that wasn't good! The service is very good. If you have either of the ladies named Abby, you're in for a treat!

The beer list is always on point with a generous happy hour offering. Our favorite appetizer is the fried Brussels sprouts. The sweet potato tots are also amazing. There are weekly specials that we always end up ordering something off of. All of their soups are delicious! 

In terms of meals, the roast pork is hands down our favorite sandwich, with the Piri Piri chicken, and Ahi Tuna BST coming in a close second. The chicken and carne asada tacos are both extremely flavorful. The seafood linguini had about double the seafood I expected. The filet was perfectly cooked and delicious! In sum, if anything on their menu looks good, try it!!

This has been my dad and I's saints game pregame spot for years now. We come for the bloody Mary's and stay for the nachos. They have awesome (big) poboys, giant delicious nachos, and fall off the bone wings. A great cocktail and beer selection and the atmosphere on game day is like no other. It's not too bad of a walk from the Dome either.

Very nice staff, clean, yummy food.... What more can you as for from a new restaurant?  Reasonable prices, have take out, great baklava as well. This is our second visit in two weeks and will be a regular pick for suburban casual after work with husband dates.

Yesterday I purchased a certified preowned car.
Salesman was a wimp and the sales manager Ed Merrill a total
d*#@!!!  Couldn't care less about the customer, only their pockets.
There was no hiding my lack of enthusiasm.
If it didn't need the car and had an alternative i would have walked.
Whereas the car went into get detailed and prepare a new key fob.
Took them 5 (FIVE) HOURS!  I watched and waited for an eternity.
I watched 3 mechanics in the garage  on their cell phones doing NOTHING!   Totally unprofessional dealership.
Buyer BEWARE!

I took my wife in for breakfast this morning. It was my second time and my wife's first. 
We proceeded to order when my wife needed to adjust her mask because it wasn't on straight.
The young lady immediately said to her "please cover your nose."
My wife was completely embarrassed because that's exactly what she was in the process doing. 
Ironically, the people sitting directly behind us weren't eating any food yet neither one of them was wearing a mask. 
I wish this was the end of the story but things got worse. My wife ordered a pumpkin late or so she thought.
The coffee was warm at best and tasted "funny." She drank a few sips and ended up throwing the rest away. 
I asked her how her breakfast sandwich was and she said it was ok but had that chewy rubbery texture when bread is microwaved. When we got home she spent the next hour in the bathroom with an extremely upset stomach. I ended up having to give her something to help settle her stomach. We're really not sure if it was the coffee or the sandwich?
I had a breakfast burrito that tasted just fine but my coffee for some reason was barely warm ( to be fair I did add a splash of half & half) but I was surprised when I took my first sip it was very bitter and to be kind I'll just say it was warm at best. 
So I think the tone was set when the young lady asked my wife to cover her nose so abruptly before even realizing that's what she was in the process of doing.  Then the upset stomach and strange tasting pumpkin late and my barely warm bitter coffee....
I seriously doubt there will be a third visit.

I've pretty much accepted the fact that I'm addicted to Jeni's. The first step is admitting it, right?

And now that this location on 12th Avenue opened (which is much closer to where I live than the East Nashville one), I find myself paying Jeni's a visit more and more often. The interior is always clean, brightly-lit and the employees are very welcoming. Feel free to try as many samples as you like, there are so many good flavors!

At $5 for two scoops and $6 for three, Jeni's can be on the pricey end. But they flavors are so unique and freshly made that any ice cream lover will think the money is worth it. My personal favorites are the brambleberry crisp, goat cheese with red cherries, wild lavender, and roasted strawberry buttermilk. Any of the chocolate-infused flavors are amazing as well. Actually, they're all divine - you can't go wrong with Jeni's. :)
Best cakes you're going to find. Maybe a bit pricier than others, but worth it for special occasions.

Smokey Joe's was okay.  They had an okay selection of beer and could mix drinks, but really the problem was that they just couldn't handle a crowd on a Thursday evening.  Since it was so hard to get drinks (even though the place wasn't actually full) we ended up moving on after just one.  Didn't try any food here, so can't really speak to that.

I'll add though, might be a fun place when they have more staff, but if you intend to be able to talk, a busy night will be real loud.

For a hotel restaurant in the Godfrey Hotel & Cabanas Rampa, it was good. Our server Carly was very sweet. The have a breakfast buffet but all five of us ordered off the menu. All the food was great, but beverage refills were a little slow and the first round of coffee were cold even when said it was going to be a fresh pot. Beautiful setting overlooking Tampa Bay so you can dine inside or out.

I used to love this place! Not sure what happened, but the food is not near the quality it used to be. Had the General Tso's chicken last night and the chicken was hard as a rock - practically inedible. The eggrolls are completely different too - not good. I also saw the delivery driver leave a full soda can that he dropped on the side of the street. Ugh, such a shame.

Typical gas station, nothing special that I've found.  They have a service side, which is really unusual to see thesedays.  I generally go to the self-service, mainly  because I don't know how  the service side works/how much it costs (guess that shows my age).  Good location with two places to enter/exit and the gas is reasonably priced.

Our kids love Sierra Kids Dentistry!! The Dr. and staff are amazing! They are very fun and caring and make my kiddos enjoy going to the dentist! Dr. Gray is knowledgeable and compassionate, he listens to any concerns we have and gives us options. I find his treatment recommendations to be on the conservative side, which I appreciate as a parent.
Food is usually excellent, but the service is always something that can be improved. Forgetful, neglectful, always seems to be the norm for Cracker Barrel.  : stars.

A great place for great Mexican food. They give complimentary chips and salsa while you wait. I love their all you can eat Taco Tuesday. My 10 year old daughter spent her birthday dinner here and we all had a blast. They gave her a free birthday icecream  which she ate in front of all the rest of the kids lol  it's ok because it's her birthday  
The food is always so delicious. Their margaritas are F'n great  and the service is great. I especially love the lady who pronounces all the Latin servers names so incorrect lol but that's ok Linda- you keep trying.
The Hot and crunchy tuna bowl with spaghetti squash is my absolute favorite dish! Highly recommend Ciccios Cali!!
I went in looking for a recumbent bike, Dave was so helpful, and plesent to work with! I am totally pleased with my experience and my new bike!

I got a "getting taken advantage of" vibe from the male that helped me.  He had very broken English so we had a language barrier AND he charged me very high prices. For a USPS flat rate package he charged me $9.99 and the actual flat rate price is $6.65 at the post office. How can they make money on a USPS item that they get for free?  I am sending a notice to the postal inspector regarding this.  I'm just not sure about it!  The address was typed incorrectly with capital and lowercase letters used incorrectly and no spaces used and the package was returned to me! I mailed the exact same item at the post office and I paid $2.87. Be warned!!!!

Love this store. Go to place for all my Asian essentials. They have everything for soup mixes, sinigang, ramen, pho, udon, you name it! One time, I bought a soup spoon from them and decided I did not like the color. So I came back later that day to exchange it without a receipt and the guy said, "uhh yeah". Good man.
This dental office is highly recommended by me. It's nice to know there remains practices that Care this much for their patients. Excellent care at an affordable price.
Had a wonderful session with Mie Mie. She's a gem. Very strong. Able to get in and work on my many knots. I look forward to returning soon. One of the best massages I've ever had.

I went to see Troy Taduron DO for chronic back pain. He wasn't interested in seeing past medical records. He fired questions at me but didn't seem interested in the answers. He did not explore any reasons for my chronic pain. It was a shockingly poor assessment and quality of care. He had a terrible bedside manner. I would not recommend.
We love chopstick house! Their orange chicken and lo-Mein are my favorites. Their combos are an excellent value, and their service is quick and always perfect.

My daughter had her nails done today. They are crooked, uneven, and painted horribly. I demanded they be fixed and the woman argued with me. She insisted "we do good job." I then demanded my money back. The manager screamed at us they don't do that. She then threw her hands in the air and walked away. My daughter has been getting her nails done for 3 years and this was the worst set I have ever seen done. We will not go back. Also, if you value the look of your nails don't go there and waste money.

I am a huge fan of Mongolian BBQ, but this place was not for me. The food looked and tasted old and some of the meat on the buffet line was frozen. I didn't finish my bowl and left hungry. I'd never go back.

Had a reservation at Casona recently and was really looking forward to checking it out. At first glance at the menu, it reminded me of Mixto in Center City which I love so I was eager to see what they had to offer. 

It must be noted that I had plans after dinner and wanted to keep my dinner relatively light. If/when I return I hope to have the opportunity to really dig into the entrees and will review again.... 

But on to this visit ... 
Food - We ordered the guacamole sampler for our table of four. It had so much potential but really fell flat. The different varieties should have had so much flavor - we're talking Asian tuna, crab, shrimp & grapefruit and roasted tomatillo. The only one with a real taste was the crab variety and even that left me emotionless. I would have been just as happy with Wholly Guacamole from the supermarket. 
For my entree I had the Ensalada Mexicana. This was good. That's it. I was glad that I added grilled shrimp to it to give it a little more taste. 
Again, when/if I return I will definitely step up my ordering as those who know me know I would have chosen something else had I not had plans following the early meal. I am thinking Ropa Vieja which is a favorite of mine. 
My friends seemed to have enjoyed their meals well enough but no one was freaking out about anything, leading me to believe that they might have felt the same way. 

Service - Service was ok, waiter was attentive enough but not too pushy. What I did find odd was when the manager-type guy delivered our guac and we asked which one was which he pulled a face and struggled to tell us. Hmmm....this is one of your signatures....how do you even have to think about it? Weird. 

Price - Dishes were on the pricey side. I was surprised and taken aback. While it is a BYO and that tends to be the case, it still raised an eyebrow for me. Our bill wasn't out of control because we didn't order in excess but I can see how the check could get out of hand. 

When all is said and done, I love Mexican and Cuban and I can enjoy pretty much any of it anywhere. I just wouldn't make a special trip here when there are many better options much closer to home.

Fast food Chinese. Pretty tasty and the service is fast and friendly. 

Very good staff.
They do wonderful work and make amazing transformations!  I definitely recommend their services!  Expensive, but you get what you pay for - so if you want great quality, it's worth the splurge!

I came here looking for a cellphone, only to find that it's not a sprint... it's a marathon. Oh well.

If you're in the neighbourhood just west of downtown Tampa in the middle of the night, then you have three or four gas station options, and this is one of the better ones and is often cheaper than some of the others. For that reason I appreciate it. After all - it's a marathon not a Sprint.

A New Orleans legendary chef John besh has this jewel and a more formal restaurant August. He rules New Orleans.  But Luke's has the best burger I have ever had. Period  broiled oysters and shrimp and grits. Don't fall far behind.  A must when in New Orleans

I can't say I love as impressed with my experience here.  The seats were very narrow which meant no arm space for you or your neighbor.  This made sitting next to a stranger pretty awkward.  The concert, however was great!
Always good reliable pizza place. Probably best in immediate area. Love the vodka pizza add bacon!

So this place gave me and my son good vibes fahreal. Like we enjoyed watching our snowball flavored dreams getvturned into some rolled up ice!! Lol!! Honestly I give the spot 5 stars because they treated us really nice. They were very understanding that we didn't understand nothing of the sorts. I am reallyhappy to be honest that everything ran smoothly considering the fact we were so undecided. My son loved the bathroom...he loved the paintings and had so many questions about it. I got the orchid vanilla which was incredible. I really had a good time here. Beware of parking and long lines though...but honestly I understand why the long lines. We had fun.

I've been bringing three dogs here for about two years now and every visit has been a wonderful experience. The vet techs are very knowledgeable and they and the vets get right down on the floor with the dogs. Everyone is patient, gentle, and thorough, they explain everything in detail, and give accurate estimates so you know exactly what it will cost. In fact, when one of my dogs required more extractions than they originally estimated, they actually charged me less than the estimate.

Dr. Kranch and Dr. Ireland have both done surgery on my aged Basset hound with excellent results.

The front office staff is friendly and efficient. I'm pretty sure everyone here loves my pets almost as much as I do.
The idea looked really appetizing but it was poorly executed. Americanized asian food...the bao bun was hard and broke in half lol. As cool as it looks, it's really not worth the price.
Amazing place to go for brunch/lunch on Whyte. There is never a wait, service is fast, and the food is great! You won't be disappointed with lots of menu options catering to everyone's taste!

I usually love this place. We had a reservation for four people. They sat us upstairs next to a table of about twenty. They were extremely loud and we could not talk to each other the entire night. The waitress was lovely, but could not hear us well enough to meet our needs. It was forest rating to say the least. I always order pasta and this time decided to try something different. I asked the waitress how the Chicken Marsala was. She highly recommended it. Well, by the time I got it, it was so cold, a film had formed on top of the gravy, there were two mushrooms and the sides looked like something you would get at a school cafeteria.they were an ice cream scoop of mashed potatoes and boiled broccoli and cauliflower that was like mush. By the time the waitress came by to ask how things were, everyone was done eating and it was too late to send it back. I got an apology and a chocolate dessert to take home that I did not ask for, and didn't eat. I will probably go back, but I will request to sit downstairs and I will only order a pasta dish.

Arrived during an afternoon where there were about six people at the bar. I was not acknowledged by the staff and was not assisted when I asked for help- because the menu is weird and confusing. All their teas are "mystical" and have air/Fire/earth signs listed with them. Maybe this is "hip" and "trendy" but it doesn't work if it's confusing and there's no one to help customers. The space was really weird too- like it doesn't know what it wants to be. On the plus side, the patio looked nice. Also a woman was vaping at the bar- which I don't mind in open-air spaces, but no doors were open in the space so it was just being blown in my face rather than filtering throughout a space or out an ajar door.

Super nice hotel and great location, easy to get across town or to tourist areas. 

Best parts:  

Staff - Super nice.  We stayed 7 days and they were always super nice whenever we asked questions or requested extra items.  

Lobby Movie Theater - 9 recliners in a dark room with a 50 inch TV with a great audio.  Tip - rent either from their movie selection or grab a Blu-Ray from Red Box on the corner.  

Great outdoor pool.  

Gas BBQ grills by the pool area.  

Complimentary Food - Complimentary Breakfast daily.  On certain days they offer light dinner and drinks.  

Lots of extras for a hotel.   Laundry, Dishwasher, kitchenette, close to shopping and restaurants.  Definitely staying with Staybridge Suites whenever possible.  

Tip:  You can hear the airplanes go by, but it's not distracting.  Especially if you have the a/c or fan in background, then you can't hear them at all.  The planes don't fly directly over the hotel.  Mostly we heard the Davis-Monthan AFB jets doing routines during the day.

I'm going to keep this short because there are so many other reviews if you want more information. I love Han Dynasty! Delicious spicy Chinese food that is a far cry from the hole in the wall places in Chinatown. Prices are very reasonable as well.

Highlights:

Dan Dan Noodles: Spicy so don't order this if you have a low tolerance for spice.
Wonton soup: Homemade wontons in a clear broth that reminds me of the kind of soup they serve in Taiwan.

You can't go wrong here. Also, I've experienced nothing but excellent service here.

The appetizer we had (andouille balls?) was amazing. So was the gumbo. However this was our first go at a true New Orleans po boy and we were both very disappointed. I had the shrimp and hubby had the fish. They were very plain and bland.

My girlfriend and I got the mufaletta. It is pretty big. So you probably want to share one. The place is as causal as it gets. Food is already pre-made so it is quite quick. The mufaletta is quite good and recommended. I think that's the only thing they sell or the only thing people seem to order. It served cold but it is still good

My friend Lisa lives in a Graduate Hospital and urged that we try this place. Full disclaimer, I've never really had an experience with Indonesian food, so I really don't have anything to base my review on other than first impressions.  
The space was very cute, with fun cartoons painted on the walls with pancakes saying hello to Philadelphia's who make their way inside. 

We got the Martabok original with chicken and cheddar and it took some time for them to prepare, which is why I'm sure they urge for you to call ahead to alleviate wait time. 

The original was good, but I felt very heavy afterwards and could only have a piece or two. Anymore would've had me feeling like a statue filled with butter. I'm not saying it wasn't good, but very very heavy. 

Next time I think we'll try the desert options, because they seemed more up our alley. Overall the staff was very friendly and helpful, so I won't prorate the star rating on the fact that I wasn't a fan of what I got (that's my fault not theirs) just based on my preference. Next time dessert it is!

Although I liked the atmosphere of this café I have to leave a negative review because of my order. Recently on a Wednesday afternoon, around 4:30/5:00 pm, I came in with a friend for the first time. I have a sensitivity to caffeine, so I ordered a decaf hot coffee, and my friend an iced coffee, also decaf. The hot coffee came out immediately and tasted strong but good. About an hour later I had a headache (which I assumed was due to not eating--we had wanted to eat something but there was virtually nothing left since it was near closing time). I was unable to sleep that night, and wondered about that coffee. 

Yesterday, I went into Parliament and asked for a decaf coffee. I was told that they could make me an "Americano." I never drink americanos because usually they taste like water--they mix decaf espresso with extra water. I replied that I didn't want it, but that a week ago I had been in there and was served decaf. They said that they do not MAKE brewed decaf and they only can make americanos.  

This is a warning to anyone who wants decaf coffee due to health reasons. It really makes me angry that people do this at restaurants and cafes. I cannot sleep for 24 hours at least after drinking regular coffee. Other people may have WORSE symptoms/effects from it. I only went that day to Parliament because my friend wanted to--he likes it better than La Colombe. I will stick to La Colombe. They have their own decaffeinated beans and brew them, so I can be assured that they are serving me decaf when I ask for it.

Delicious pulled pork, cole slaw & baked beans. Excellent service. We met the owner, Shane, and he was extremely pleasant and grateful for our business. 

We ordered the meal for 4-6 people. We had four people and had tons left over!

Would highly recommend for carry out or dining in for a casual spot. 

Highly rated by others on Yelp so we decided to stop in.

Ordered from here & while the chicken was good, it was only warm and not hot when it arrived. The mashed potatoes though were very good and warmer than the chicken. Delivery took nearly an hour to arrive and by that time I was already starving. I think they need to improve their delivery because if it arrived even within the 1/2 hour, it would have been at a good temperature to eat. All in all, the flavor was great & I would get chicken from here again, but not by delivery. I will go pick it up instead.

The staff is very friendly, so I am pleased with the service. I also I really enjoyed the ganache-covered icing. However, compared to other cupcake bakeries I have visited, these cupcakes are small and overpriced. The cake itself is pretty average, if not a little drier than I would have liked.

This place looks run down on the outside but stepping inside it is super beautiful and modern. If you like Mexican food or looking for a new place in Tampa to try I highly suggest checking this place out. They have a fantastic brunch that features watermelon mimosa's and a bloody maria with tequila. They always bring out fresh salsa and chips the second you sit down and the guacamole is amazing.  I had the Miguel's Benedict which was poached eggs with cheese on top of an english muffin with steak topped with avocado and served with deliciously spiced homefries.

Has everything you would want in a craft brew house...

Dank beers on tap.

Good food.

Nice big bar.

Friendly staff.

TV's for sporting watching.

I started with a light ale and worked my way up to the Triple IPA (10.5%) toward the end of the night.  Had a strong buzz on by this point.

I slammed a burger down and it was real good.  Bun, not wet / soggy etc...  Everything was real flavorful.

Its a real nice atmosphere.

Excellent quality local brews too.

Went there this past Saturday, bought new snapper ride on mower, delivered to my door Saturday afternoon ready to mow my lawn. Great service! You don't get this personal service at the big box stores and if I need repair they are an authorized service center and local. I highly recommend them!

I will NEVER buy a Toyota again. Not because of the vehicle, but because of the customer service I received at Dolan. I went in to get maintenance done on my car and had issues with one of my tires (which I had also mentioned previously when I went in but they told me it was due to the weather). This time around, I asked them if my tires were still under warranty because I was still having issues and originally they said yes until the end of November of this year. They looked at my tire and came back a quote for a new tire and then told me they weren't under warranty. I then asked Jorden to print me a copy of the "expired" warranty and that I would get tires elsewhere. He told me the leak was very minor and I'd be okay to just put air in it temporarily and he left. When Jorden came back, he told me they couldn't find it the warranty. Jorden also told me that because of the small leak, they may not allow me to leave without putting the spare or new tire on even though he had just told me it was minor and I'd be fine. Then he tried telling me I never purchased thru their Toyota Dealership and told me I'd need to go to Carson and became argumentative to the point where they told me I needed to provide them PROOF that I purchased my vehicle thru them and made me dig thru my glove compartment. Then when I found the paperwork, the manager came up to me and "magically" found me in their system. They told me my tire had a small leak but couldn't repair it because it was on the sidewall and asked Jorden to show me. When Jorden showed me and the manager the leak, the manager said it was tread that he was pointing to and I laughed and told them that was tread and can be repaired. The manager then told me they don't have the kit and would need to go somewhere else. Long story short, after 3 1/2 hours of this crap I left and I'm searching to get rid of Toyota all together.

Excellent meal.  Organic Spinach salad, wild thing pizza, garlic chicken, Organic Irish Salmon, chocolate torte.  

  The raisins and dressing in the salad created a sweet balance to the spinach. Pizza was garlicky and really cheesy. Thank you for leaving a bit of the rind on the Brie. Garlic chicken also had garlicky goodness.  It was stuffed and fried. The crust on the chicken was crispy and light.  The salmon was cooked perfectly.  And I mean that it wasn't over cooked. I want my beef medium rare, my tuna seared but raw in the middle, and my salmon crispy on the top with perfect flakiness underneath. 
Chocolate torte was rich and dense. 

We ate outside on the patio. Our waitress and host were attentive.   

Just go.  Remember, you get what you pay for.  You want quality then get yourself over to Wild Flower. This meal was around 90 with tip.
Came across this place while traveling and I LOVED it! Amazing vegan food and gift shop! I had a tasty veggie burger, delicious chow mein, and I picked up a natural deodorant and safe spray.
Great place right on Kings Highway. Amazing array of made to order donuts cakes stuffed cookies and amazing bread pudding. Very nice and they will be glad to tell you what they do.
My favorite local Thai restaurant!  I have been coming here for years and will for years to come.  Elegant interior, great service, and amazing food.

A workmanlike adequacy to the dishes but no real magic. Interesting touches like deep fried arugula were cancelled out by little irks like having nowhere to put the knife and fork we were asked to hang on to all evening. I had hoped I'd found a gem to return to but I don't see a good reason -- having sampled pretty much everything on the menu I was sincerely underwhelmed. Maybe they were just tired.

We were so pleased with the kindness and consideration we received at Varcoe-Thomas Funeral Home. Jason Oszczakiewicz, the owner of the funeral home, was there for my family every step of the way. He handled all of the details as he helped us with our immediate-need funeral arrangements. Jason was professional, knowledgeable, kind, and patient with us during a difficult time. We highly recommend this wonderful, full-service, establishment.

Food is good, and always good quality not too expensive.. only thing I ask y'all to change is not allowing people to order at the to go window, if that's going to be the case make the people wait somewhere else until their food is ready. I have to sit and wait longer times because of this and my food is usually somewhat cold by the time I get to the window.

Always great food, great service & atmosphere!  Love the hot & honey sauce!  TV's throughout if you're headed out to watch a game.  Also hosted a birthday party in the back area about a year ago, everything turned out perfect.  Recommended :)
The steak was AMAZING! It melted in our mouths. Our server Freddy was the absolute best! I am so impressed and would definitely come back to St. Louis just for this food.

Sheesh its been a good 6 years or so since they helped me get my license but when I saw their listing I knew I HAD to review them.  I had tried a few other driving schools with no luck (my biggest issue was parking) My instructor Salem really broke down the basics of parking for me, I was able to pass my exam with only 3 lessons from him.  I had to deduct a star because Salem can be quite the flirt...I don't wanna marry just wanna pass my exam :O lol

After an evening of drinking and dancing at the Cat's Meow, we wanted to sit for a spell and chat with a cocktail. Rita's was nearby and look appealing, with its never-ending tequila shelf, so we stopped in.

I asked the bartender to make me some kind of fruity cocktail. Sadly, he made one with blue curacao, which killed it for me. I should have specified that I hate the stuff. Sigh.

They brought us chips and salsa, which was a nice touch. Staff was super friendly (as they are everywhere in NOLA). 

Wish we'd been hungrier so we could have tried the grub, but we had a nice little chat sitting at their bar.
Fun, loud German beer hall with surprisingly good food and excellent beers

Be careful ordering from here on any delivery service, they sent me half done fish and potatoes with my food. I'm not sure if this is the normal for them as I usually go to the one on Woodland Ave. I'm so displeased with my order

Great local breakfast. I ordered the chicken and waffles with grits! The reason i gave it a 3 was there was no one in there and the food took forever and the fried chicken was dry as hell! The taste was on point and several locals have assured me it could have been a one off as their food while pricey is consistently delicious!

This tour was great! Max was a wonderful tour guide and he had an extensive amount of knowledge about the land and the wildlife that we saw during the tour. I would definitely recommend doing this tour while in New Orleans and be sure to bring a camera, phone or go pro to take pictures and record video to document your trip!
Dang good REAL tex mex. visiting from west Texas where we choose dinner based off their chips and salsa. I had a steak quesadilla and I was floored with how delicious it was!!!

So happy I tried Pa & Ma's! First off, Ma was working the register and is CRAZY NICE! Explained the whole setup to me and the husband, every daily special, hours, the works. Super friendly and helpful. The food is served cafeteria style so walk up, select your main (we both got rib tips with sauce) and two sides. The portions are monstrous. Ridiculous for the money. Such a good deal! I got Mac'n'Cheese and beans with weanies. The Mac is fan-freaking-tactic. I'm usually 100% suspicious of restaurant Mac as it's always watery, gritty, and gross. This was hands down the best Mac ever. Creamy, legit cheese tasting, nice big shells/noodles. I could have just ate that and been content. Seriously get it! The baked beans were great. Perfect ratios of seasoning and sauce thickness. The hubby got mashed potatoes as a side and said they were definitely real potatoes. The rib tips were great. I absolutely love their BBQ sauce. I also ordered a dessert as I can't resist pie. It was a clear takeout container that I'm pretty sure was packed with three slices of apple pie. It was great! I wished I lived closer so I could come back more often! This is a winner folks! Prices are ridiculously affordable, you will have a full belly, you'll encounter super friendly staff, and you'll have terrific BBQ!

This motel is absolutely horrible. Don't come here. Metal pieces coming out of the bed and water is sooo cold it's like trying to shower in pool water. DONT COME HERE. I'm surprised I didn't see cockroaches in the bathroom.

Also forgot to mention, came here for New Year's Eve. Heard a bang around 7pm. My family thought ppl were starting fireworks already but it turns out that someone was shot! 

Again, don't come here. Ghetto and poor maintenance

Hmm . . Well it's Sunday, we arrived for a table for 2 around 4:30pm made orders at about 4:40ish didn't get our - one taco with side of beams and rice and one single tamale till 520. Not once asked us how the food was as she just brushed off her tables to the other waitress  but I think they might do that on purpose so you are nkt given the opportunityto tell them that it's overly salted as well as over priced.

And as we were (not) finishing our food because we literally couldn't eat it two tables left and they both had something to say about the service to the other tables coming in. If only they told us that before we sat down. 

I paid 35$? Five or take a few bucks for one tamale, side salad, one taco and side and beans &rice with a beer. Huh? 

I wouldn't have given this place any stars if I could.
Bob was friendly and informative,  and I liked how we were able to taste all the offerings,  even a bit of the 20 year rum.

eh.  it's alright.  mad props for hosting us for a yelp event, but this place can get a douchey crowd in here when there's not yelp people around.  coupled with the fact that it's small and kinda expensive, it's not a place that would be high on my list of places to go were I not tempted out by free rum.
Great Dive Bar for Bar Flies and Alcoholics!! Stiff Drinks and a Live Music Spot! What More Do You Want?

For a quick drive thru option on a short lunch break I'll totally vouch for these guys. Processed is not my first choice and this chicken was anything but. The rice could have used a little seasoning but the black beans weren't over done or soupy and that made up for it. Perfect place for on the go.

The Palino family does it again with the opening of another amazing eatery!  They are restaurant royalty in Newtown for sure!  Their new gourmet pizza restaurant, Acqua e Farina, is not only 'pleasure for the palate', but the atmosphere gives as much warmth and comfort as their delectable pizzas.  The pizza is just fantastic!  You couldn't get any more authentic unless you flew to Naples.  Centered around the restaurant's wood-fired stove is a beautiful rustic atmosphere, which is coupled with the Palino family famous hospitality.  The Palino's now give you two AMAZING restaurant choices that deliver satisfaction to anyone's palate!

Ugh. Cheap rooms if you need a place to pass out drunk or something, but that's about it. Booked 5 rooms for me and a large group to crash in after a bachelor party. It served its purpose,  but I woke up with hives all over me and was itching horribly. Something to do with the horrible bed I guess.  The staff is useless, the place is falling apart, but it is somewhat legendary in Fenton. Check out the bar amd volleyball, but I don't recommend staying the night!

This was my first time here as a recommendation from a colleague. The atmosphere is an artistically random collection of paintings, items, and wall decorations that come together to give an element of comfort. It matches the place well.

Upon ordering we started with the Shrimp & Alligator Cheesecake. Sounds gross right? Absolutely not. It was heavenly. So delicious and wonderful, it pretty much stole the show. Definitely recommended. Their cornbread was extremely flavorful too.

I ordered the Grilled Duck Breast (which I love duck) and ordered it medium rare. Unfortunately it came out medium well to well. After noting that to the waiter they immediately took it and re-fired another plate. Once receiving this one it wasn't medium rare but more medium. According to the waiter the duck is prepared sous vide which makes it appear cooked more than one would expect, but it still is cooked a little more than desired temp. Nonetheless the flavor was excellent. Even the first plate had amazing flavor. If you do order the duck don't expect a perfect choice temp due to their preparation choices.

Due to the complications the chef remedied our meal with dessert on the house: creme brulee and the coconut bread pudding. The brulee was on par with most but the bread pudding was top notch. Definitely worth a bite on a full stomach.

Service was great. Food was great. Even though my protein lacked the right cooked temp, it was still a great meal. 5 stars well deserved. When I'm back in town I'm definitely coming back.

Ashley did a great job taking our family photos.  She has a way of getting kids to relax and let their personality come threw in pictures.  We had four different backgrounds and had an outfit change for our toddler, and the shoot went flawlessly.  They were very professional and easy to work with.  It's not inexpensive, we spent a little over $700 for 64 portrait sheets (8x10 or 5x7's), 8 larger prints that featured multiple pictures, a high-resolution CD of all photos with copyright release, an two 8.5x8.5 hard cover portrait books and two 5x5 soft cover portrait books, and shipping for the photo books.  We felt it was worth the money to get the most extensive package they have because we have never done a family photo session before.  I'm not sure how much other studios charge, but PI had multiple less expensive options, we just loved so many of our pictures we went all-out!  I would definitely recommend this location.

I'm a hot chicken fan so I wanted to try the new place near my house. The prices were right and I got 6 tenders and one side for 11.99. Solid! I got my tenders "hot" and honestly they were too spicy to eat. I can handle me some hot chicken. I've had Princes extra hot numerous times and can handle really spicy food. This was way over the top in spice. The flavors were good and the chicken was very tender but I could only really get through one tender. So......guys......chill on the spice. You're gonna kill somebody. Sides were good!

Nice cute little deli in downtown dunedin. I got the half sandwich with a soup/salad combo yet somehow got both the soup and salad. I am not complaining though. Soup of the day was celery and it was delicious. Nice and warm and very flavorful. The salad was a pretty well filled one, chopped olives, spinach, banana peppers, beans, tomatoes...really good. My sandwich was the roast beef and it was pretty nice. The lady serving me was very helpful and quick.

Had a higher rating, but honestly, Everytime I come in here the tables aren't ready, floors are always dirty and though they seem nice, the servers more often than not are more interested in talking than taking care of customers or cleaning.
I mean, if you see the window blinds... Covered in dust and goop.
It's right next door to my office, but management is lacking. Like, big time.
Simply put.  Hipster yumminess!  Try the turmeric or beet latte!  It might be a bit busy but that's a testament to its coffee.

For the second time, a group of us friends - female - got terrible service. Truly no service.  

We ordered, food arrived, plates got taken away, ck magically showed up. No follow up, no water glasses refilled, no ANYTHING. 

On principle, I have no problem w a group gratuity being added; I had a big problem paying for Zero Service.  We won't be back to reward their snotty misogyny again. 

Oh, and my Grilled Vegetable Burrito had raw vegetables.  Was I supposed to not notice?!  

Altogether, we'll spend our $ elsewhere.

It is great to see this refreshing service come to Indianapolis. I've never done this before but my experience was really wonderful. The idea is to quiet the mind and restore the body as you float in a sea of salts and minerals.

I chose the open spa because I wasn't sure about a closed environment, but now that I have a comfort level with the whole experience I will definitely try the lidded pod next time. This spa is beautiful and reflects the concept of serenity. The items provided were great. The towels were perfect spa towels and very absorbent and luxurious, the earplugs were very good and didn't leak. The temperature of the water and room were very nice although I personally, could have handled it a tad warmer. The open rain shower was pleasant and I have to admit I fell in love with the shampoo. After my float I sat in the quiet room for a minute, I wish I could have stayed longer as it was very quiet and comfortable. I hope visitors resist the urge to use their phones here and instead enjoy being unplugged for a little bit longer. 

Overall my experience was fantastic. And although I didn't get my mind to rest, by any means, on this first trip; I think I got great benefits. The floating was pretty much what I expected. But what I really didn't expect is how I felt afterwards. I was surprised by how calm, at peace, and "centered" I felt. Just an overall sense of well-being, it really surprised me. Totally unexpected, and totally wonderful. I was also surprised with how soft my skin and hair for several days afterwards. As someone with a bad back, who commutes way too far every day and works on the computer all day long, I will float again. I think I'll also schedule my husband for one as soon as possible.

Mercato might just be my favorite BYO in Philly. The crispy skin striped bass (caramelized cipollini onions, artichokes & pancetta crisp, chianti reduction) will change your life. It's cozy, and romantic with the perfect bustling urban vibe.

Great new place. Busy on a nice Thursday night. Beer is good, a few IPAs that I like. Cream Ales, and even the stout that I liked. (I don't like stouts) lots of seating indoors and out. Be sure to bring food.
I have been getting my nails done here for a while and I would recommend to other people. Nails look great. Only downfall is they're pricey., but worth it because they do a great job.

I just learned something new! Wednesday's at Applebee's is Ladies Day. Ok, your asking, what does that mean and why are men left out again.
Well, why men are omitted is obvious,  if men were included,  it wouldn't be Ladies Day.  Ladies Day on Wednesday means females get a smaller portion of any of the appetizers offered on the 3 item appetizer assortment for only $3.00 per appetizer.
Hearing this bargain, I had to try an appetizer and see if it wet my appetite. 
It was cool last night, so I choose a favorite of many, the hot spinach, artichoke and cheese with tortilla chips. What a mistake. The first thing I noticed upon inspection was it was 3/4 cup and a lot of chips, so financially a good move. My second observation was, where is the cheese? I am a lady that takes her cheese quite seriously and it was hard to find, the disappointment set in. There was steam coming off the dish, so I held out hope.
Upon tasting the dish, the hope was in vain. A grossly unseasoned dish of basically a strange semi creamed spinach.  What a let down! When bagged chips taste better than the food, that is bad.
The reason for 2 stars is my relationship with the restaurant itself and usually being able to get a decent meal.
What's a girl to do? I will fearlessly continue to persue my love of good food!

I've never written a review ever in my life. But this place is something else. I just want to go back to NOLA just to eat here. Our waiter suggested the turkey neck and we Loved It!!!!
Every thing we had there was soo good. The ambience is wonderful so are the people that work there. Great place and I would recommend this place without a second thought

On the bikeride  down from fancy or "sexy" Rouses, as some have donned it, i make some sort of excuse to go to The Roosevelt Bar.  Usually Roxanne is there-dynamic engaging woman, she.  If she and i went to High School together, we'd never mix.  But her heart is in the right place, as is her savviness.   Apparently she makes parties for all types of occasions along with one of her girlfriends.  i'm not a nerd, per sey, but this is not me scene.  Roxanne makes all this whirlwind feel inclusive, trying to engage others.  Noted.  
    It's a small place, but so what?  View to the street.  Used to have some bands, but understand that it wasn't costworthy.  (or permit legal?)
    Your Girl Roxanne was fixing to host an Anti-Valentine's Party today.  She and said friend were buying loads of stuff for prizes and decorations, etc.  This i applaud.  They are trying to make a little something out of nothing on a tough street.  And succeeding!  
     Please come visit this sweet little spot and tell your friends.   But not too many.

I ordered something online from these guys, and they provided a tracking number but never shipped the item after 6 days.  Finally provided a refund when I asked the 2nd time.  Lots of other shops out there that will provide better service, avoid this one.

TL;DR for the Cheesesteak crowd: whiz is put on the bread and not the meat leading to a bit of a soggy roll, perception of skimping on the cheese. Roll has sesame seeds on it. These sins aside, probably the best quality and flavor of any cheesesteak in the area. If you are limited in time and choices for a foray into the cheesesteak culture, this should be your first stop. 


Okay so you've made it this far. If you're looking for a review of the other menu items move along. They all looked amazing and reasonably priced, but we were on a mission. 

Location and ordering:
Restaurant is clean and seating upstairs is comfortable. Staff was polite. Pretty versatile menu including shakes for dessert and a way above average beer and spirits collection. Food is brought up to you which is a nice touch I haven't seen in any of the typical cheesesteak joints. 

Food and drinks:
Straightforward order of a Cheesesteak with whiz and onions. They offer a 1 lb option for the ravenous, but truth be told the portion of meat on the standard sandwich was generous. Meat is chopped into fine bits and has a great flavor. The roll was crispy on the outside, soft and chewy on the inside. They serve the whiz directly on the bun so it gets a bit soggy after a few bites and you can't help but feel robbed of some cheese. Onions are chopped medium and fully cooked but lacked the caramelization that some look for in the idea onion. 

They have a mini Coca Cola freestyle machine. It lacks a bunch of the fringe flavors though (no mellow yellow options to be found). If you're looking for a beer to pair with your meal, this place should be at the top of your list. The menu was impressive with many local and craft options. 

This place might lack some of the nostalgia that the original cheesesteak joints have, but it more than makes up for it with quality ingredients, atmosphere, and versatility of menu. If you are limited in time and choices for the foray into the cheesesteak culture, this should be your first stop.
Really good fish, very reasonable prices, and they deliver!

I went with my sister on a Monday night and we were impressed with the great service and delicious food. I had been once since the change to the Italian Farmhouse, but didn't get a chance to try the food until the most recent visit. We started with the chef's board, which was packed with fresh meats, cheeses, nuts, fruit and bread. I ordered the vegetable salad with farro, beets, kale, figs and almonds (among other veggies). The server suggested I add salmon which was an excellent choice. I only had enough room to eat half my salad, making sure to save room for some dessert. We had a sampling of donuts with lemon cream, a jar with some kind of goodness I don't really remember (bananas, chocolate, caramel and graham cracker crumbs, maybe??) and a warm apple crisp. Everything was fantastic. The manager, Seth came by to make sure everything was good, and told us all about the meat cutter they got from Italy!

Mixed feelings but was saved by the stiff drinks and a delightful convo with one of the bartenders' mom! 

My bf on a whim kidnapped me to SB and after a day of hiking and beaching we were famished. I yelped and Brophy answered. We got a pager for a table which apparently was a dud bc the hostess told us she paged us 20 minutes ago. Really? Bc we had an open tab at the bar for a good 45 minutes! Oh well it happens. It was a packed house so we kept cool and kept at a drinkin til our new pager went off.

In the meantime the cutest elderly couple pulled up aside from us and the wife told me how this place was awesome except for the fact that they don't stock up on her beloved 0 calorie tonic! She then proceeded to pull out her own Diet Shwepps out of her purse and mocked the bartender with it! Turns out he was her son.

When we were seated we ordered half dozen oysters and calamari. OMG THE BEST OYSTERS I've ever had! So creamy and not at all oceany/briny! The seafood pasta was perfect. Noodles were the right degree of al dente and the shrimp and scallops were pump, tender and juicy. I don't even know what my date ordered bc I was too caught up with my plate! But I'm pretty sure it was amazing. 

I took off a star just because of the pager/wait mix up but otherwise this was a great date experience.
Never called me back for my order for a sis in-law cancer dcx suppose to be the IT local florist. Don't think so, it missed the mark. Too many apps to deal with

I would first like to say that I am a manager of a different restaurant and I WAS having a wonderful day. Then we decided to have dinner at Gino's, that's where my good day turned into an awful night. As we entered Gino's Italian restaurant in meridian Idaho the hostess smiled and greeted us as she should then took us to our table. On the way not one employee smiled at us other than the hostess they all just looked miserable. She seats us all but touching the table of a family beside it. No big deal I just had to slide our table further away so my wife would stop bumping the lady beside her, servers have sections I know, but every table near us was available and clean. Our server Todd greets us and grabs our drinks. This guy knows the menu well and seems nice, we soon found out that's where his skills end and his inattentive skills begin. Todd brings us bread and already by this time my ice tea is empty;  sorry I was thirsty... and I still would be if it was up to todd. Now we are ready to order, Todd knowing the menu as well as he does has no problem walking us through the Italian names and ingredients. Putting it into layman's terms if you will. We both choose a dish as does my son and as Todd leaves our table he stops to check chat with a table closer to the kitchen. I couldn't hear what the guest asked todd but I think everyone in the area heard his answer, he said " HAHA yeah like I'm gonna support the guy doing rails of blow." I'm pretty sure if my 9 year old son would have asked me what rails of blow is? I would have come off my hinges. Two other children under the age of 12 within arms reach of us by the way. Extremely inappropriate, and I'm guessing by the awkward silence that the guest at the table wasn't talking about committing felonies. Dinner was served and the food was actually really good, normally I'd never complain about having so much chicken in my Alfredo but I love noodles too. When I ran out of noodles and had a plate full of chicken and sauce I stopped eating and waited for my server Todd to check on us.... no Todd, and still no ice tea. Time goes by and a man comes to the table asking if I need a box so I said yes, just giving up. I asked him if I could get some extra noodles in the box as well. Then Todd shows up and asks if we would like dessert. We order dessert mostly cause I was still hungry and cold chicken from my unfinished meal didn't sound good anymore. Dessert shows up and still no ice tea. At this point there isn't even any ice left in the tea glass. Todd explains to us that the whip cream blew up on him so my son's dessert is on the house because it doesn't look as pretty as it should. Todd said it's  just easier to give it to us for free then to make a new dessert. I'm cool with free anything so we except it, who wouldn't take free dessert. We finish dessert and the bus boy clears our plates and I finally break down and ask if he could grab a tea pitcher and fill my glass. The bus boy brings back room temperature tea in a pitcher and fills our glasses. No ice : ( So desserts gone, my moods shot and we wait and wait and wait. I'm looking around and we put our jackets on and gather our things, I see todd coming out of the kitchen chewing something hanging out by the computer talking to other servers, I assume he sees our jackets on and our sour faces and brings the check finally. We pay and I went from the best tipper in the room to the 10% guy every server hates. 10% was too much but I just don't have it in me to stiff anyone. As we walked to the door the friendly host said her goodbyes and complained the whole way home. P.s. I read some other reviews and my chicken Alfredo was 22 dollars not 12 dollars like Kyle C. posted and they charged me 4 dollars for the noodles I waited for until my dinner was cold. I'd like to thank the hostess for being the only person in the restaurant that knew how to do her job. A Manger should have been touching tables to make sure people aren't treated like this and if it was my place I'd be calling a mandatory front of house employee  meeting. We won't be dining at ginos again any time soon. This is the only complaint I've ever posted about a fellow restaurant. 3/25/2015.

We just purchased the 780 Hanover Sundance from the S. Virginia location and couldn't be happier with our entire experience! No pressure sales from Ryan at Sparks location and Shawn at S. Virginia location...both very knowledgeable and helpful in guiding us through our first spa purchase! Excellent financing options that made it affordable for us. 

I was a bit nervous about the delivery process yesterday as there was snow/ice on ground and had to be transported over rocky/uneven terrain, but the crew of Anthony, Nick, Al and Oscar did a phenomenal job!! Install went very smoothly, I couldn't believe how fast they had it installed! Overall very pleased with our purchase, would definitely recommend them!

Came in for opening night. Nice layout in bar area. Large square walk around. Premium Margarita was nice. Kinda small thou. Disappointed they didn't have DosEquies. Had a Chicken Burrito. Very tasty, fresh and good. Nice Guac selection. Had chunky" not enough guac thou", also had spicy guac, I highly recommend. Salsa was fresh and chunky with a little bite. My family liked it, I prefer more kick. Loved the shirts staff had on. "It's 5 O'Guac Somewhere". Was disappointed they didn't have Enchiladas on menu. Not yet they said. Weereplaying Reggae music which I thought it should have been some Mexican music for opening night thou. Over all nice place and I will return. Oh every day everyone at bar gets free shot of Tequila at 5 o'clock. Nice tradition I thought. I'll have to try that next time.
This place has gone down hill.  The last three times I've been there the pizza was horrible and so has the staff.  Three strikes your out.....
Just basic interior but basic good food and good people

This is a classy and casual restaurant that serves really good food. Typically, I'm not a huge fan of Asian fusion, but I'm happy to make an exception for The Black Sheep.  Yes, it'll cost you, but it'll totally be worth it.

My sister and I went in for dinner the other night. We were looking for something quiet, and were a little disappointed when we stepped inside because it was a bit loud. When asked if there was a quiet corner they offered us a table outside which was perfect. 

We had Vietnamese style Wagu beef carpaccio, snap peas with togarashi, burrata, beets and beer...and a really good cheesecake for dessert. All of it was delicious, with interesting flavors that went together well and made for for a nice light meal for a warm Santa Barbara evening. 

Service was friendly and attentive, but not intrusive.  Other diners seemed just as happy as we were, drinking wine and lingering over conversation;  this is not the kind of place that will rush you. 

I'd go back in a flash.

Awesome food and the people working there are awesome.  I just ordered some food and my young daughter couldn't decide if she wanted a burrito or a taquito.  She decided on a burrito and we were on our way home.  Get home, and they had snuck a taquito in with her burrito.  Very cool!
This place always has amazing dishes for all, and a good buffet price! Soups, salads, pasta, flatbreads, and desserts! Great enviornement and a nice staff.
Food is good and quickly made although at times you have to request how you like ur food cooked but honestly for is great in that area but slightly overpriced if you truly ask me
This place was super cute. It was small and only to go due to covid but it was delicious. It was an interesting twist on breakfast foods. They even had dessert options!

A very good & convenient take-out seafood restaurant & market.  Quite clean and neat. with efficient service from an Asian (Viet) staff.    The fresh seafood was well displayed and clearly fresh, as the staff was continuously scaling/cleaning fish to go on ice.

Good variety of seafood choices....from Mullet to grouper, shrimp etc.   Standard options for sides with excellent hush puppies, and superior breading on fried fish/shrimp.  We had basa, catfish & shrimp....all very tasty and quickly served even though they were busy on a Friday night.  Also you can have your seafood boiled or steamed, and fried rice is another option.

Thoroughly enjoyed it, and will undoubtedly be back for more.

Fond is currently one of my FAVE restaurants in Philly right now. The chef and pastry chef both have le bec-fin pedigree, and the front of the house manager has lacroix background... and seriously they totally live up to that pedigree. 

I've been a few times now and it's consistently awesome. During our last visit, though, we got to dine at the "chef's table" which is set up in the private garden at the back of the restaurant. It is SO cozy/intimate and cute, with lights strung on trees and some strategically placed plants. The only slightly odd thing is that you have to walk THROUGH the kitchen to get to the restroom during your meal, but it's kind of charming nonetheless. You feel like you're visiting friends and they are cooking you a wonderful meal. 

oh YEAH and BYOB! booyakasha!

WHAT WE ATE (ok, there were 6 of us, we ate everything. but here were my favorites. the rest are on trifectabam.blogspot.com if you want to see full on pics and descriptions)

*Crispy Veal Sweetbreads 
a MUST TRY. Even if you're not very adventurous and have no idea what sweetbreads (don't look it up!) are, these are very approachable for new foodies and simply put, taste INCREDIBLE. Not to sound totally cliche, but they really do taste quite like fried chicken...

*Roasted Cauliflower Salad
You'll want to smother the roasted cauliflowers until they are coated with the smoked paprika yogurt. Do it. Don't be afraid. I won't judge you. too much.

*Seared Skate Wing
his is a dish I have tried a few times now, and it never fails to impress me. I'm a big fan of risotto and I love when chefs make a lemon risotto that is so tart and bright because it goes so well with fish - especially skate, which is usually a saltier fish. 

*Berkshire Pork Loin
it is GOOOOOOOOOOD. The pork is tender and flavorful, while the soft beans and tart tomatoes all meld together in that delicious thing known as pork jus!

*Chicken Breast
I generally shy away from ordering chicken when I go out to restaurants because ... well... I mean, you can imagine why, yes? Chicken is boring. Chicken is so often dry and bland. Chicken is for the non-foodies to order while their foodie friends scoff at their unadventurous spirits. BUT BUT BUT  (what what, in the ...heh) this chicken was none of those things. Juicy and flavorful and tender.... mmmmmm. The house-made pasta on this evening was a pappardelle, which was wonderful with the mozzarella and veggies.

*Tahitian Vanilla "Cannolis"
Fond's take on cannolis.. sooo good. The thin shell is made of hazelnut praline and it's so delicate, but is sweet and crispy enough that it holds the light whipped mascarpone perfectly. The plum sorbet adds another layer of tartness that keeps everything fresh.

*Pistachio Tart
Okay, this is where I go off and use superlatives and rave and drool and whine until I can have another bite. The pistachio tart is, BY FAR, my favorite dessert... of ALL TIME. Was that clear enough?
Best mechanic and body shop in all of SB! Long live #Armenia and #Armenian people! SANCTION and CONDEMN turkey and azerbaijan hitler dictatorship of our time! We live in a System of a Down!

The company Christmas party was held here and I was excited since I've never been to it before. 

There was a storm rolling in, so instead of putting the party out under the stars, they brought us inside. THat was a bit warm and crowded and I could smell the fog juice/ fog scent they used during the haunt, but that didn't seem to bother others. 

The ship itself is awesome. We had a docent give us some pointers on the guns on the deck, and show us the quarters for the sailors.  I really do look forward to come back here. It isn't the easiest place to find, but it's a great place to visit!

I'm coming back for sure!
Pretty place. Pleasant atmosphere. Nice bar. Some outdoor seating. Service a very good. Food is good. Good for a dinner date, business meal or a family meal.

I've only had the PB & Acai bowl, it's about 10 bucks and dang filling. A few times the frozen acai was not smoothly blended, so that's annoying but still tastes good. The bowl is topped with fresh bananas & natural peanut butter. It takes awhile to get your order, I mean considering they aren't cooking anything & it's too loud to have a conversation in there with all the high powered blenders echoing. Do yourself a solid & take your delicious snack to Rittenhouse Square & enjoy it outdoors whilst your feet are dangling from the wall.

What a gem! Just found this place - at random - on a trip from Denver to Walnut Creek. The friendliest folks and REALLY good salads and burgers! (And a VERY nice Pinot Noir as well!) A local gem that we will DEFINITELY stop at next time we pass through!!!!

Great drinks, great food, great prices, friendly service, no attitude!  Can't wait to go back.  I've been to SB a bunch of times and never found this place before---- thanks yelpers!

Loved the citrus  cosmo, and the Monday night special sirloin dinner.  Even the house Cabernet was quite drinkable and only $5.

I am surprised and disappointed by the poor reviews. I have had consistently good service; I do try to make an appointment, but not always. I recently bought an iPhone 8+ after many visits, indecisive, looking at different ones, comparing with my iPhone 6 and asking questions. (Okay, there was one rep. who was not pleasant, but she was the exception.) When I finally did get it, the rep. couldn't have been more helpful. I stopped back yesterday because I couldn't open the SIM tray; to my surprise the salesperson remembered my name, said that it was in the "envelope" that I hadn't seen; without hesitating, she got the pin from the back and opened and switched the cards. Small thing, to be sure, but the service both times, without appointments, was great. I didn't get her name, but she's originally from Russia (I asked about the accent.) ...When I got home I looked for the envelope and there it was; seeing only the Apple sticker, I had missed the pin. It's a treat to visit there for the classes (wish there were more!) - and the service.

I love Qdoba, however today's lunch experience was less than appealing.  The food was good, not great, but the restaurant itself was a DISASTER - trash everywhere, food on the floor, trash can areas overflowing and just plain dirty.  The staff was less than appealing as well - not pleasant, not friendly, and they all seemed to be mad at each other.  The line when I arrived was 2-3 people long, however, when I left, there were at least 10 in line and they didn't look happy.  I'm going to have to think long and hard before going back to this location, which is too bad because it's close to work and I normally love the food.

Quick service, no line when I got there. It's inside the outlet. Don't be like me and walk outside and try to look for it there in the cold. Cash only. $5 for two orders of beignets (3 pieces per order). Everything on the menu is not expensive at all. I got my beignets hot and fluffy, covered with powdered sugar. Sat in the dining area to eat it with the river view until I realized it was too cold for me to deal with the door opening and closing while trying to devour my beignets.

If you're attempting to eat healthier, avoid avoid avoid this spot! But if you're hoping to indulge in incredible sweet and savory popcorn, you've found the right shop.

I stopped in once during a festival awhile ago and remember being annoyed by the lack of helpful service. This was obviously a dumb and petty reason to stay away. Fortunately, I was a full-fledged zombie craving junk food after a crap-filled day at work earlier in the month, and Gourmet Popcorn Creations was right around the corner from my newest home.

I walked in, browsed a bit, picked out three savory bags for $12, and brought them to the counter. Twenty minutes later, the store's phone rang so I excused myself from chatting with the owner! He was THE nicest shop owner! I've already been back (during May Fair) to stock up on more popcorn and even a bag of delicious dill pickle peanuts.

From what I've tried, I'd have to say my current favorite is the garlic and parmesan popcorn, with the white cheddar coming in at a close second! I still have plenty more flavors to explore, and look forward to stopping in again soon.

The crispy calamari salad set the bar high. The sushi is great quality compared to other places in town. Our waiter new the menu, made sure we enjoyed our food, and was very friendly. I would order the ramen spicy next time and avoid the spicy mustard on the steam buns just my personal preference.

Ignore the haters. Ignore the 3 star reviews.

This. Is. The. Best. Fried Chicken. In. The. U. S. A.

It's like Jesus and Fergie had a baby....and the baby is this fried chicken. Num, num, num. That's a delicious fried chicken baby.

Bread pudding is also le tits. 

10/10. 100%. A+. Fried chicken.

Great practices start with the front desk and they are wonderful .  Nice, helpful and guess what..they follow-thru on your requests.

My daughter saw Dr. Cabry--he is excellent. He spends time with you and unlike the CHOP ortho physician, he spoke directly to my daughter--asked her questions and treated her with the utmost respect.

I had not been to Meme in about 2 1/2 years but went again the other night and will be visiting more regularly than every 2 1/2 years.  I have a soft spot in my heart for any BYO that accepts reservations, so Meme starts on a high note.

The menu is small but has terrific options.  I started with the roasted bone marrow - this was amazing.  I offered some to my dining companions and was quickly disappointed that I was overly generous in sharing my food with them. I ordered the tilefish special which was quite good as well.  

I am really glad that Meme has gone back to no corkage fee . . . it makes it a lot more likely that I can afford to go!

My favorite ice cream place in the whole country. Amazing staff that always remembers us. Bob is the owner and he's fantastic. Try the Graham Crackers in Milk frozen yogurt-- it is so good! I love the thick milkshakes they make here as well as the Brazilian Coffee Chip ice cream. Can't beat this place.

Everyone knows about the chargrilled oysters but the REAL Surprise is.....the BBQ Shrimp! I have been eating here for 12 years and the only thing I usually get is the chargrilled oysters (which ARE awesome). But on my last visit one of our friends had the BBQ shrimp. Not expecting much I tasted it and it blew me away. The BEST! So from now on I will order BOTH!
Beautiful historic building; Good food, customer service, & good size plates, well presented.

Wow. This place is the real deal! My friends and I hopped off the plane to Nashville, and Arnold's was our first stop. 

Caution-it's definitely more of a dive than some of the photos/reviews make it sound. It's less hipster, and more "this is what it's looked like for the past 30 years". Again, this isn't a huge deal when the food is amazing, but it might be something to think about if your event requires a bit more fanciness.

The roast beef and fried green tomatoes here are phenomenal. Of my friends, I was the only one to get roast beef, and they were both basically stealing the food away from me at the end! Ahh, so good! Plus, the entire meal for 3 people was around $30 (most of it drinks!). Awesome for people on a budget.

This is a must-see for anyone in Nashville who's interested in food.

Solid place to get decent Korean food. Prices are reasonable and service is good, though often slow. I believe they have had a shift in staff lately though. The adjuma that always made my jjapchae is now at another restaurant in town.

Went to the bar side. The guy working behind the bar didn't even pay attention that I was sitting alone at the table and just sat on his phone. Was really looking forward to checking the place out, won't be going back.
Great dining experience from beginning to end. Outstanding service and amazing delicious food at very reasonable prices. The Boudin Balls appetizer is a must!

When I was a kid this was one of my all time favorite places.....but I have been very disappointed. I went here with friends from out of town, and I'm glad at least their food was better than mine. I was in the mood for salmon and I was skeptical about ordering it here, but I wanted to go for it anyway. Try it. Well....bad idea! I ordered the Salmon Salad. It took longer to come out than my friends meals so you would've expected it to be prepared correctly. In the picture attached, it looks pretty decent. I cut into it and was completely appalled. It was COMPLETELY frozen. It was like it had been cooked for a total of 10 seconds than poured glaze all over it. It wasn't even warm! The center was 100% ice! I should've ordered what I normally order (any one of the sandwich's and friends pickles) and I'd probably be more satisfied. This experience definitely but a dent in my liking for Russell's, but the only reason I'm not giving this place one star is because our waitress was very kind and also appalled that the chef didn't cook the salmon. My friends and I also got Tito's bandanas. I wish I would've taken a picture of my frozen salmon, but I did not, so enjoy what looks like a decent salmon from the outside!

One of my favorite sushi places to go to. I've been here many times and the sashimi slices are thick cuts and some of the freshest I've had. I come here mostly for their fish, so I usually split a sushi sashimi tray with some friends. It's definitely the best deal with the quality of fish you get. I also order their takoyaki every time and would highly recommend! Overall good food and I plan to keep on coming back.

These are by far the best doughnuts I've ever had. I'm still trying to recover from the sugar and how good they were.

We happened to be at Sesame Place for our yearly tradition and I saw this was a 35 minute drive away, which sounds like a lot to go to the middle of nowhere Pennsylvania, but absolutely worth it, because it really is the best doughnut spot I've been to.

It's a little stand inside Whole Foods, but they literally had TWENTY SIX different kinds of doughnuts today. We bought everything for $72 (two bakers dozens) and I had the time of my life.

I heard of them when they opened a stand in New Jersey in 2015 and were featured on Grubstreet, but wasn't able to make it during the small window they're open until just now, and now I need to come back any time I'm in the state of Pennsylvania.
This place was really good food, fresh tasting Ingredients. They were very helpful and the customer service was on point. I will come back next time I'm in Santa Barbara!

So my friend hits it big on the slots and she took us all out for breakfast! I got the spinach and cheese omelet with a side of fruit which was really good and the coffee was just how I like it: hot, black and strong!
Service was quick and attentive. 
Why would anyone want to order Asian food in a non-Asian cuisine restaurant? Probably not a good idea. There has to be other Asian restaurants in Reno I would assume but one never wants to ASS U ME.

I'm going to give this place a very bad review simply because they don't know what the law is concerning a service dog. I have the most well behaved German Shepherd real service dog who goes everywhere with me and is better behaved than 98% of the population. And this place won't even seat me? I am outraged by this.

I just moved here from Las Vegas and this is the first time in years and establishment would not see me because of my service dog. Outrageous!

My experience with Diligent was nothing less then fantastic. They accommodated my schedule, we're great communicators, and overall some of the most professional people I've dealt with. 

Maureen helped me schedule the inspection, and she was pleasant and professional, and pretty funny! 

Chris was our inspector, and he was incredible. He was thorough, prompt, and made sure we understood exactly what the inspection covered and how the pressing issues could be remedied. 

I highly recommend Diligent to anyone who needs a home inspection!

I've been bringing my vehicle to this place on and off for the last five years, and would rather give a 2.5 star rating than a 2 since it's so hit and miss.

There have been times I have been thoroughly surprised at how good of a job they did, and other times I am angered at how much money I feel I wasted.

Why do I keep going back? Time is rarely on my side, and my vehicle periodically reaches the point to where I simply cannot take the filth anymore. Despite the occasional long lines, it allows me to get the vehicle clean(ish) on the quick, while allowing me time to work, catch up on emails, etc.

A large menu is displayed as you approach the entrance to the vacuum bays. A quick interaction with an employee produces two tickets; one to tell the staff what services you have ordered, and the other for the cashier inside.

Once you pull your vehicle into a vacuum bay, you exit your vehicle to the left into a long hallway. Some folks choose to utilize the windows to watch their vehicle go through the wash.

The hallway dead ends into a gift shop, or you can make a sharp left to bypass directly to the cashier's counter. Tips can be left on a credit card, or cash in the wooden lockbox just outside of the cashier exit.

Our experience with Kate Conroy and Laurie MaGuie at Tony Baroni's team was amazing. Kate is highly knowledgeable of the market and intuitive of client's needs. Laurie really helps close loose ends. My husband and I moved our family from CA to Tampa, FL and we couldn't be more delighted and blessed to have been able to work with a team that made the transition smooth. Moving an entire family from one state to another after 18 years in CA comes with a lot of stress. It's nice to know that your realtor will ensure that the buying experience be the least stressful event of the entire transition.

Do not shop here. Had a terrible time here: 
1. Wanted salads made. Stood at place to have salads made for ten minutes and no one came. Babies started crying so I gave up waiting. This has happened more than once. Employees looked at me and said someone was coming. No one came.
2. The aisle with baby food is too narrow to sustain cross traffic be it a stroller vs a shopping cart. 
3. Person bagging groceries put sushi and baby food in same bag. Sushi (poke) leaked all over baby food. Raw fish is not something babies should eat.
4. When leaving, door to parking garage blocked with shopping carts, not carts customers left behind it was an employee who was collecting shopping carts. He would get one, put it by the door then walk around to get more carts.
5. Lady in front of me offered help out to her car by employee bagging her groceries. We appeared to be the same age with the same haul of groceries. She had no children. When we arrived employees were helping customers load their groceries. I didn't need help but if you're going to offer the rich white lady help and not the Hispanic looking dad with twin babies help something is extremely wrong. 

Overall this place is a horrible place. The selection is of that similar to Whole Foods or Target, which are a mile away on Dale Mabry. The only difference is the shopping experience here is terrible.

1 star is too much..This was the absolute worst experience EVER...I was told this was a nonsmoking room...IT REEKED IF SMOKE..then the manager sprayed chemicals...there were cigarette butts everywhere outside...terrible
