We stopped at this park and really enjoyed our walk and chat here. Definitely coming back. We only left because it was getting hotter and the heat was getting to me. I get sunburned quite easily so that was my fault.

Great place, good food and good service. They have half off glass of wine for lunch!
Loved how food runner mentioned that my pizza was his personal favourite upon delivering it. Pizza was Babbos and it was great! See you soon guys, cheers!

Big dealership, dismal customer service lounge. Very disappointing. Waiting over an hour just to have an oil change was unreasonable. Sitting in a customer lounge that was uncomfortable and had no real coffee was unpleasant at best.

My second visit was much more enjoyable than the first!  After my first review, someone replied stating that they'd address my concerns and make sure that everyone, no matter how late they arrive, receives amazing service.  I'm not sure who to thank, but we tested the waters at 20 minutes until midnight once again and received awesome service.  The servers were attentive and the Alfredo Tagliatelle with Blackened Salmon was to die for!  I mean, I wanted to drink the sauce....that's how good it was!  The wine, the food, the service....all amazing!

The BEST spinning experience I have had. I love that the class is interactive, somewhat competitive with the leaderboards, and that the app gives you feedback and stats at your classes. The facility is perfect, studio is great and dark, staff is helpful and friendly.
Overpriced typical Italian food. Service is good however. Wasn't wowed by the food for the money so won't be returning.

This is my go-to place for supplements and non-cured products. I've been shopping here since about 1998.

Locally owned. Excellent customer service. They are very helpful.

I will be back again.

Ive had Arby's before and since I had their local competitor Lions Choice I wanted to see how Arby's roast beef would stack up. I have been to Arby's a few times before (not this location) and I am particularly fond of their reuben sandwich that is very good especially in a pinch. I ordered the same roast beef and cheddar as I did at Lion and OMG was this thing terrible. Cold sandwich served on a stale onion roll with meat that tasted like rubber, cheese with no taste that I could barely detect and ice cold french fries. This was by far the worst thing I have had since coming to St. Louis. Trust I will never come again, especially at this location.

Came in for a simple smog check, had to return three times, paid twice and worst of all, they used a radiator cap and forced it on as an oil cover because they had misplaced mine.  Unbelievable.   This company is down right scary!!

The most unique Donair to date. Different than any other and far tastier too! Pressed and seasoned, with many varieties to choose from. Consider it a gourmet and much tastier version of a greasy favorite... minus the grease.

What a fun and cute spot! Sometimes it can get super busy though because let's be honest who doesn't want a freshly made waffle with ice cream on top. Each one is carefully made with love but that's another reason why it sometimes takes a while. Usually there are only one or two employees managing orders. The waffles are Yum and the ice cream on top to die for!

The interior is really cute and fun, be sure to check out local artist artwork up for sale on the wall, it's always fun!

There is indoor and outdoor seating but it's limited due to the size of the shop, so grab it while you can :)

I enjoyed this place.  It's sort of pricey, but it's decent ice cream.  They have two menus, so keep that in mind when ordering.  The big board has a bunch of flavors and blends, and the smaller laminated menus have pre-mixed options.  I got the Moose Tracks mix, and it was really good.  The smaller size was over five dollars, which seemed a bit high to me.  The place does accept credit card, but they do have a ten dollar minimum.  If you're getting mixes for two, you'll probably break ten dollars.  It's a cute place, but I'll look for something else next time.

Two Words: Vanilla Coke!

One of the few places in the University area that sells 20 oz bottles!
The store is clean with helpful employees which is great ! 
24 hrs /7 days a week!

Unfortunately, I was not blown away. I thought Chef Aaron Sanchez would be running a kitchen that would be up to par with his standards. The place is beautiful but the service is awkward and uninviting. The food looks really good but the flavors aren't there. Pollo con arroz tasted like public school food- bland. The burrito massive but mostly tortilla and pickled mess.
This was a fun tour with our host, Bob. Lots of great tasting rum, plus a free shuttle from the french market.
Quick, very clean, efficient and delicious. This is a hidden gem in Fenton. A must try.

What a hole in the wall.  Place is a joke.  Staff is not friendly and are not accommodating.  I would expect better especially given the lackluster atmosphere.  Average food at best. I wish I would have went elsewhere.
My car looks great, and they squeezed me in for the next day early in the morning. Great customer service and service!

Solid BYO - we both had the Mushroom Bisque to start which was creamy and a good start to the meal. I chose the butternut squash gnocchi which was tasty but heavy. Fiance had the braised short ribs which was so good. We will probably be back since we love a good BYO.

I think this place has been around since I was in high school or at the very least since I had my first apartment in Havertown in the 80's. 
We were in the neighborhood the day after Christmas and not expecting much because of the holiday. We were pleasantly surprised to not only to be warmly greeted by our server but to have a choice between breakfast and lunch. We both chose egg breakfast items with my daughter choosing coffee over my choice- Bass.
Both of us loved our breakfasts and beverages which were very reasonably priced along with enjoying comfortable seating in the dining room with great service.

If you ever feel like a beer with a great breakfast, stop on by here. 
 'Twas lovely to have the option.

So thankful Bluebeard is back open to indoor/outdoor dining because wow did we miss it! They still don't take reservations but we took our chances on Saturday night and were seated right away on their patio. If the weather is nice enough I would recommend sitting outside because it is the cutest patio in Fountain Square. 

Our server was one of the best we had in a long time so shoutout to him for making the night so great! We weren't sure what we wanted to drink that night so he just asked us a series of questions (liquor preference, fruit forward or citrus etc.) and he nailed our drink orders. Made the drink ordering process a little bit more fun and exciting not knowing exactly what you are going to get and then getting something so good.

Typically we order the charcuterie board but decided to switch it up and order the beet salad and spaghetti for starters. spaghetti may seem odd for a starter but it was actually very light and had a lot of lemon and lemon zest that made it almost refreshing. It was the perfect compliment to the beet salad which was also delicious. We ordered the bouillabaisse which was kind of like a seafood stew and it was fantastic! surprisingly not too heavy either and was the perfect amount.

In my opinion, Bluebeard is back better then ever and I can't wait to have many more memorable meals here!

Well, I can't review the food because I didn't stay long enough to experience the food.  My mother, 5 year old daughter stopped in after a day of shopping.  It them forever to acknowledge us waiting to be seated.  After we were seated there were another 20 minutes and nobody greeted us, bought water or took even an appetizer order.  We left and went around the corner to another Asian restaurant. The Customer Service Stinks!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Walking up I instantly liked this place with their Dog Friendly AF sign on the window. LOL. They have a bowl outside their store as well. 

Inside you find subtle artwork painted on the walls and I found an almost empty display case. But it was a little after 2pm so that is great for them, bad for me. But that also helped narrow down my options. I choose the Caramel Popcorn to try on my first visit. 

I took this "breakfast" item home to be nice and share with Ben. It was still fresh and "fluffy" and the caramel tasted just like the kind used with caramel popcorn. A few bites had actual peanuts in them which was also really good. 

The donut itself is a pretty big size and nice treat to share. Can't wait to be down in that area early when they have all options available to pick from.

We ordered delivery on a Sunday evening. In our experience, it is hit or miss in terms of quality. Pho Loc Tho was fresh, fresh, fresh! The sandwiches were on crunchy bread. All the veggies were crisp. It was clear that everything was freshly cut and prepared. We will definitely be ordering from there again.

What?! I get to be where one of the most iconic films was filmed, AWESOME! 

Yes I had to run up those stairs and jump around, Don't worry you won't be the only one! Jaja. Everyone is recording each other trying to run without losing your breath or falling in the small steps. 

Then right next to the steps is the rocky balboa statue! This is located in a beautiful museum! I didn't go inside because the entrance was $20! Pretty pricey plus I was not in Philly to look at paintings. 

The parking like in all downtown it is horrible, I almost paid $12 to park right across the steps when we realized there a big street with parking spots right next to it, lucky enough we found one spot, I definitely recommend to drive around a walk a little before paying so much money for 20 mins in the stairs .

I moved to Lower Moyamensing in South Philly last year and one day walked past this classic looking neighborhood bakery and decided to pop in. I picked up a few rolls to bring home and they were great. I went back to try their version of the tomato pie, a South Philly classic and it was great, crisp but not too crisp crust, no butter so it's not greasy (and vegan), and their sauce is what I'd imagine my grandmother would have made if she had been Italian, best of all the slices are huge (picture is one slice I cut into 3) for $1.85!
Super clean place with very knowledgeable staff. I only come here for my reptile needs
I love this place alot! I have been here several times and I haven't been disappointed yet. I would definitely like to see healthier items added to the menu...As well as friendlier customer service.

I miss the days when I lived above this place.  

The smells coming into my room early on a Saturday morning would often wake me from even the deepest hungover snooze.  Mr. Ray's cooking would coax me downstairs in my still half drunken stooper to collect one of the best poboys in NOLA.  

The fried okra?  Yeah, awesome.

My only complaint is that I could never get a poboy after I got off of work.  Like every good poboy shop, they are not open past mid-afternoon.  

C'est la vie.

The last couple times I've been to the Dairy Queen and Plant City Florida it's tasted like a metal that stings your tongue not sure what they're doing with the ice cream but don't think I'll be going back for a while. Really needs an update

I was extremely impressed when I got my haircut here. They pay attention to detail and it's worth the slightly elevated price compared to some shops. Everything from making my appointment through the final product (my haircut) was expertly executed. I also enjoyed the free beer (or coffee). It's easy to get to and they will be my go to next time I'm on the road and need a cut.

Gorgeous botanical garden that's definitely worth checking out in Santa Barbara. Very well manicured with tons of different environments from the chaparral to the redwood trees to the desert area. Easy to spend at least an hour here walking around to take in all the views. The map is very easy to follow and there's a guide who can recommend paths to take!

A must see in Santa Barbara.

Changing hairstylists is nerve wracking, and when I moved here from New York, boy did I hit some duds that gave me cringy looks.  But my husband googled "Best hairstylist in New Orleans", and that's how he found Scott for me.  Now I constantly get compliments on my hair, and I am NOT good at fixing it!  The cut, and the color, make it happen.  Jupiter is a gem of a salon, and Scott is a rock star.  Plus an all-around great, and entertaining guy.  I've sent several people to him, and they all rave about his work, and him in general.  Love you, Scott!

I got a Avocado bagel and a perrier with the tip it came out to be about $11.00 i found that to be a bit on the high end. The place was so very clean and the people were so nice. I had never been their before and found them to be over the top helpful. The food was very good. I just found for what i got to be a bit on the prices side. 

But the people and how clean it was may keep me going back.

I've been here a couple of times for a quick after work happy hour and for dinner and jazz. Each time I thoroughly enjoyed myself. Last night was my longest visit and I could've stayed all night. We went there to celebrate a co-workers new job, it was about 12 of us and everyone enjoyed the drinks (great specials from 4-7), the bar menu had excellent choices. We ordered the shrimp deviled eggs, Nashville chicken sliders, kale flat bread, the South burger and the hush puppies. Everything tasted soooo good, the table favs were the deviled eggs & the chicken sliders. We had abt 3-4 orders. The ambience is so welcoming and comfortable. We had the perfect spot right near the entrance and bar, there was a wrap around sofa with tables and chairs for groups. Our server Franchesca was awesome! Very attentive, very pleasant & personable. One of the main things that I like about South is that it's not your traditional soul food. The food is very light, not at all greasy & i don't feel wigged down after dinner. I am looking forward to going back and I definitely recommend South to any & everyone!

Just opened, this is the latest spot from by Chef Joncarl Lachman. I've been to most of the others, like Noord, Neuf, The Dutch, and this one is a very worthy addition. Great and delicious food, really cute and comfortable space, and super welcoming service. It has breakfast and lunch menus every day and weekend brunch.

Very affordable food. Fast delivery. Best recommended for hangover food or if you are on a tight budget. I just moved to the area so I am trying out all kinds of places. See my profile for more reviews.

Went tonight based on a recommendation... never again! My nails don't look horrible even though there is a few uneven lengths by a tad. However, they were all over the place due to not being properly staffed. So what should of not two and a half hours....did. I was charged $8.00 dollars extra cause I wanted coffin shaped nails (never hear of such nonsense before. Was also up charged on the pedicure for dead skin removal. Honestly! That is a part of the pedicure process at my normal salon. Which is actually great at half the price. Also they don't allow tips on the credit card which probably means they are not claiming taxes on that.  Did not find that out until at the register. I was pointed to an atm for tips. Yeah but no. Never again!

Iguanas and Tab Benoit mighty five time
Haven't danced that much in a long time
Great sound, good times, good gumbo!
What a bkast!

I love warm foods especially deserts so I was super excited to taste their strawberry lavender donut. They make the donuts in front of you and dip it right into the strawberry lavender "seasoning" - the donut just melts in your mouth, it's so good!!! My friend however had their regular donut that was made on earlier and she mentioned that it tasted just okay. From my understanding only certain donuts are made fresh and served warm, so I would recommend opting for that one if you visit this place.

Three stars for food and one star for service. The server only returned once to our table, but never took dirty plate or refilled drinks. I just found out that there were two servers and one busier, the only server I saw was Darren and he was horrible.

I'm having a moment right now where I'm questioning my insistence on moving away from Broad Ripple to live downtown. I can now add Public Greens to the list of my favorite restaurants in Indy, which seem to be mostly based in Broad Ripple. Most impressive to me, aside from the delicious food, is the fact that all proceeds from sales go to feeding hungry kids in Indy.

The food is served cafeteria style and priced by dish with the price going down the more dishes you order (one dish is $6, two dishes are $10). After ordering and paying, grab a seat and they bring the food and drinks out to your table.

On my first visit here I had the Kung Pao Broccoli which had carrots, bean sprouts, cashews, and kung pao sauce, with broccoli, of course, and Gotta Jibboo Salad which consisted of soba noodles, cucumber, cilantro, scallions, sesame, and sweet chili sauce. Both dishes were bursting with flavor and the sweet chili sauce had a perfect balance of sweet and spicy. 

There were several other vegan and non-vegan options, and the vegan options are clearly identified by a "V" symbol on the chalkboard menu. I can't wait to come back here asap with my partner for a weekend dinner!

So they don't brew their own beer.  Moving on.  If you read nothing else, read this:  Ask for Marny.  She was our server and was outstanding.  She made the evening fantastic for us.  We sat outside on a Friday night and were very impressed with their set up.  We chose a table at the far end under the umbrellas where we sat for hours undisturbed.  The sun was hot so Marny moved the umbrellas a few times to keep us in the shade.  I ordered a beer but when it was given to me, Marny pointed out that she thought it didn't look right and asked my opinion.  When I agreed, she took it back and gave me different beer of my choice for no charge.  Really?  Who does that?  I was so impressed because it was obvious she was committed to making sure we were happy.  

I ordered the lettuce wraps and thought they were very tasty.  The sauce was flavorful and the crunchy wontons on top added good texture.  My friends ordered the appetizer platter and seemed to enjoy it.  I snuck one of the coconut shrimp off their plate and thought it was tasty.  

Yes, the food is overpriced but overall I had a great experience and will return to sit outside with Marny as my server.

I love the old garage vibe of CBC's new location. It feel like it belongs in the neighborhood. It hits all your liquid needs - it offers coffee in the mornings (Living Room), beers on draft and beer to-go. 

I really like that you can grab a beer from the to-go section and drink it on-site for only $1. That's unheard of! To-go prices are decent, and you can create your own six-pack for about $10. Draft prices are a little higher, but the beer selection is varied and there are normally a few super unique options available. 

I feel like this will be my new favorite place to grab a beer - or six!

Man I love this place!  To be fair I might be slightly biased because I came here for a Beyonce Dance party event and it was one of the best nights of my life.  But a big part of what I loved about the night was La Peg itself.  We showed up before the event started and we enjoyed sitting outside in the beautiful late summer air in, warming ourselves by a firepit with the beautiful Benjamin Franklin Bridge in the background.  Drinks were good and strong.  The atmosphere inside is really cool, as well.  We sat and ate some wings and goat cheese fries.  The wings were good but pretty standard but the goat cheese fries were really delicious.  Overall I had such a fun time at La Peg and I would definitely go back for just a regular night out or for a date.

I agree with many of the other reviewers. The long line to check in and having to stand there for 20 or 30 minutes is unacceptable. Secondly the walls are paper thin. I stayed in the A tower and the person in the room next to me had their alarm going off for 30 minutes and it sounded like it was on my night table. My non-smoking room smelled like cigarette smoke. The bed was also uncomfortable. I have stayed in many chain motels like Hampton Inn and had vastly superior beds. Last, the resort fee is a joke. why am I paying 35 extra dollars a day when almost everything is closed? There's no in room dining and most of the amenities are closed because of Covid. Why am I paying extra for a pool which is free at any other hotel in America? The plus side is that the room was clean and well decorated and the front desk dealt with the alarm issue right away

Okay okay okay, not many people will open a restaurant during a pandemic, but Union Ramen isn't like many people! Opened about a month ago, this place not only puts out delicious ramen, their customer service is top notch!

I recommend getting everything you want, there's always to-go boxes. Here's what we got: watermelon belly, crawfish & crabmeat lumpia, pepper jelly wings, and Slap-Ya-Mama Kimchi dry ramen & their original Tori ramen.

IG: PhidingTheFam

- What did I eat? The combo set with 6 different kinds of meat including bulgolgi beef, pork belly and a couple other meats 
- Ambiance? Not sure how to describe it. Not really anything different in particular. It's a bit more modern than their original location 
- Service? Service is friendly. They have mainly guy servers and they're all very helpful 
- Parking? There's a large lot and it's located by the Big Lots
- Would I go back? They're the only ones with this style kbbq in Tampa so would go back but mainly cause it's the only one
I unfortunately got food poisoning from UFO pizza and landed up at the ER on a drip! It must have been one bad piece of ham on the Hawaiian pizza! I can't go back again!

We went here for brunch on Cinco de Mayo, and were not disappointed. The mimosas were fabulous and pretty good sized.

As a huge fan of Eggs Benedict, I was impressed with the entire menu page dedicated to southwestern Benedict variations! I got the Five-Alarm Benedict, which came on tamale cakes instead of English muffins. It was pretty tasty, though to be honest I still prefer the traditional Benedict flavor. For Cinco de Mayo, though, it was a fabulous twist. They also have a ton of other creative dishes and I'll definitely be back to try them.

The waiter was kind enough to give us a Snickerdoodle pancake on the house, and it was AMAZING. If you go here, you HAVE to get a Snickerdoodle! I'm not a huge fan of pancakes usually, but this one was, as my friend put it, like a Cinnabon but without any of the 'fake' flavors. I would come back just for that pancake! Really a fabulous brunch spot for Tucson and I would definitely go again.

Kuryn is an amazing therapist who tailors each session according to your needs and takes her time to ensure you are taken care of.  Her studio is very private, soothing, and clean.   She has helped me work out tightness and scar tissue after surgery.  I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a caring, personable masseuse passionate and gifted at her craft.

I love seafood and this is the place to be if you do! The inside of the place is very basic, tables and chairs. I always get the shrimp with the 3 sauces mixed together. I tried a couple of their fried baskets and they're terrible! They're fried from a frozen bag, tasteless and rubbery. But if you go to a place like this it's for the "fresh" seafood.

When our Zoey abruptly showed signs of a urinary tract infection (UTI), Dr. Gina immediately carved out a spot in her busy schedule to treat our 'little girl.' This was our initial visit to Cat Doctors and what a tremendous first impression. I am pleased to report that Zoey is symptom free and back to her normal rapscallion self. Thank you Dr. Gina (and Staff), we look forward to our return - this time for a routine annual check-up.
God bless you!
      Kelli D.

I LOVE Del Friscos. I go back for the crab cake Benedict every time. I always have a great experience but just recently I had a phenomenal experience. My server, Canaan, and the chef went above and beyond for me when I unknowingly ordered a dish on Friday that is only available on Sunday's. But they made it happen for me. It was fresh and as delicious as ever!! I will always go back to Del Friscos!!

I recently went into their Clearwater location and was pleasantly surprised by how fast their electric go karts were. We had a group of 5 and the staff was friendly and accommodated our group very well. We will definitely be coming back soon to take advantage of their week day specials.

Moe's Southwest Grill is a fast casual Mexican chain a la Chipotle or Qdoba where they make the food in front of you while you direct what you would like on your burrito, tacos, nachos, etc. Sort of like Subway, with a Mexican accent. (Olé!) I am a girl who is a sucker for even the most tame burrito, so when I saw this in the Publix shopping center in Belle Meade, I knew I had to try it.

Listen, I know I shouldn't be surprised (it's a chain, it's barely Mexican,etc.) but this place was a complete disappointment. I'm not a Mexican food snob -- I can get by fairly well at the aforementioned Qdoba or Chipotle -- but the ingredient quality at Moe's was sorely lacking. What I like most about these types of restaurants is the ability to get a fresh, tasty meatless meal and not feel like you are deprived by not chowing on some animal protein. I'm not a vegetarian, but sometimes a girl wants some damn veggies. I ordered the vegetarian burrito without the shell, and added all of the vegetables they had available to bulk up the meal a bit. The "veggies" at Moe's consisted of some of the saltiest, overcooked mushrooms, green peppers and onions I've ever had the misfortune of ingesting. Ick. The black beans were pretty bland as well. The only thing I was happy about was the guacamole, which was a little bit heavy on the cilantro but still tasty. It's really hard to mess up avocados, y'all.

Also annoying about this place is that all of their food has cutesy names: the overachiever, the triple lindy, the art vandalay. I'm all for creativity but I don't want to have to struggle to remember the name of the thing I ordered when the cashier asks. Also, I feel like a complete fool asking for an "art vandalay" in the first place. What does importing and exporting have to do with my vegetarian burrito, anyway?

There are a few upsides (which is why I gave a whopping 2 stars instead of one): they have a salsa bar, and even though the salsas are pretty terrible I like the option of being able to try them all and add as much/little to my food as I would like, they don't make you pay extra for the chips, and they have fresh AND picked jalapenos as options for your burrito. That was kind of unexpected and cool. Everything else? Not so much. Also, I didn't try any of the meat options so perhaps I am missing out on a great menu item. Unfortunately, I probably won't be back to give them a chance.

Rude. Office was packed thats ok i asked if i could walk nxt door to let my kids play and the guy said sure. About 45 mins later i walk over an a lady goes we called you like 3 or 4 times im just like i told him where i was going an he said ok then she goes well you cant leave i cant send people looking im like ok someone shouldve said that when i asked. I didnt just walk out an explore the mall. Then they start tlking spanish which is rude when someone is standing right in front of you. Then she was just rolling her eyes and not making eye contact. The guy seemed genuine though. I ended up leaving because i didnt want my kids around her

Caveat - I came here for a conference and did not choose to stay at this particular hotel/resort.
First of all, the staff were all amazing. Super friendly, super fast, and super helpful. I was actually really impressed.
The hotel/resort itself is also very nice inside. It's basically a giant indoor tropical forest with a faux river running through the whole thing. Apparently you can ride a "Mississippi-style" boat down said river but the lines were very long every time I checked.
Throughout the indoor forest are various shops and eateries as well as hotel rooms made to look like Italian-style apartments (?) with wrought iron balconies that guests can lounge on while sipping a piña colada or something similar.
There are also several restaurants in the hotel, from steakhouses to burgers to upscale Italian to BBQ. Unfortunately, each time I was able to carve out time to eat, the lines were way too long to wait.
This brings me to my biggest gripe: the outrageous prices for incredibly mediocre goods and food offered via in-room dining or the only "convenience"-type store on property. I paid over $80 for a cold BBQ sandwich, soggy chips, a pretty forgettable creme brulee, a baked potato served only with butter and sour cream, and four small bottles of Pepsi. The baked potato had a lot of black spots inside making it very unappetizing. The pulled pork barbecue was actually good, but not something I'd pay more than $3-5 for regularly.
It just seemed that I was being price-gouged at every opportunity and I really resented it.
I'm still stinging as I write this, so I may feel differently after some reflection. If so, I'll edit my review accordingly.
My coworkers and I order delivery frequently from Greek Lady and the food always arrives hot and delicious.

Absolutely wonderful place! I had the nachos which were not quite as amazing as I've had in other places (the roasted cauli is a "no" for me!). Good rinks though! But the best parts of this place are the service and ambiance of the place. Took the kids there on a Monday for lunch the day before school year started and it was a fantastic place to celebrate end of summer.  So much to do there between the darts, giant Jenna, corn hole, pinball machines, etc etc.  If the nachos were a tiny bit better I would give it a solid 5 stars.

Loveless Cafe was awesome! Everyone I knew recommended I go on a recent trip.  The food was amazing and though there was a wait, as expected, it was only 30 minutes and gave us time to check out the little shops they have there which we enjoyed as well!

We had a delicious meal! The plantain empanadas were my favorite followed by the fresh guacamole and salsa w a long list of tacos to work through! The ambiance is more for adults than children with a scenic bar which makes it more of a romantic or special occasion restaurant. I know they are in the growing stages but would love to see outside seating in the future!

My medical office had our Christmas party in 2016 at The Depot Craft Brewery Distillery.  Food was EXCELLENT.  Employees were courteous and professional.  We were in the upstairs large group gathering room, which was awesome. We had a bartender and servers all to ourselves.  Did I mention the food was EXCELLENT!!!!!!!!!!!

Only con? Parking for us arriving at 5 pm was waaaaaaaay in the back behind the building and it was raining that night.  :(

This would be a 3.5 star review. 

Your run of the mill deli/quick breakfast place. 

Most recently, I've ordered the Morning Special, which is a breakfast sammy of 2 eggs over easy, cheese, bacon and tomato served on a bagel of your choice (I chose wheat). This is a hearty sandwich albeit messy, the yolks were perfectly runny, and I'm a sucker for egg and cheese anything so no complaints there. Also ordered a side of roasted potatoes which were nicely seasoned. My eating partner in crime got the challah french toast, which was also delicious. 

While both of these items were really good, I didn't rate this place higher for a few reasons. Being a ridiculously die-hard breakfast fan, I don't think I'd order any of the lunch items too frequently, but I have had the matzoh ball soup. Pass. Marathon's is far and away a better choice. I've also had an omelette which was below average (overcooked, not enough cheese to veggie ratio) and an egg and cheese on an english muffin (hard to fuck up, but the english muffin coulda been fresher). Their iced coffee is also not as tasty as other places in the area (Manhatten Bagel's is surprisingly good).

All this being said, they do deliver for free within the immediate area, so I will probably use this place as a delivery staple for ravenous mornings when leaving the bed seems an unlikely possibility.
The Cadillac Fajita's are delicious. It's enough to feed 2.  They mix pork beef shrimp and mussels in with green pepper and onions and cover it in a sauce that's to die for.

This restaurant/pub is "Zionsville".  Known for their famous fried pork tenderloin sandwich their other menu items are equally as tasty!   Their chili is some of the best in the area.  The owner and staff work HARD in this restaurant and it can get quite crowded, noisy and very busy often having over an hour wait sometimes but if you have the time...wait and experience what being a local feels like in a charming town.  If you have room for dessert - you have to give their Apple Dumpling with ice cream a try....it is absolutely delicious all year round!

Visited on Feb 18th with friends. It was our first time trying Colombian cuisine.

Started off with drinks - strawberry margarita and mango mojito. The mojito was wonderful but the margarita was a tad too strong and had a bitter aftertaste.

Ordered Maiz De La Rueda, Pollo Grilliao and the vegetarian arepa. For dessert we had Tres Leches and Flan. The food was excellent, especially Maiz De La Rueda (corn + cheese is the best combination ever!).

Service was on the slower side, but had great company, so wasn't too bothered by it :).
Professional automotive repair shop. Best prices on new quality tires. Knowledgeable staff.

In all the years I have been coming to Tampa, how did I not know about Oystercatcher's? This idyllic location on Tampa Bay while "in the Hyatt," is a good shuttle ride away from the hotel.
  Huge brunch offerings from typical to exotic. All you can drink champagne, mimosas or bloody Mary's.  My glass was never less than two thirds empty! New service for each trip to the buffet and arrive back to your seat to find your napkin refolded and ready.
  When they saw me opening cards, for my birthday, note was made and I had a dessert medley with candles at the end of brunch!
   Awesome, go light on the carbs till you have tasted all the treats. If you want some eggs you can scale back but enjoy with the quail eggs on the omelet bar!

It's down the street from my house.  Thats really the only reason i go here. 
I hate the service, the unexpected fees, the miserable tellers,  the wait,  god its awful.   Dont go there in a Friday if you plan on seeing the light of day!   It's terrible.  
However,  its very convenient.  They have the penny arcade thing there.  One customer service rep, Tom,  is always very helpful.  If he is there, i usually wait until i can get him.  The other ones, at least from what i have experienced, are miserable and dumb.  
They will charge you for everything though. Beware.

Their over-the-phone customer service is lacking. I never received a return phone call after being put on hold while they tried to locate the part I ordered and my part was shipped to the requested location with no paperwork.

Great place...great bunch of guys. Always helpful and upbeat. 

Had an issue with the front tire of a bike we bought there and they were super helpful in trying to figure out the deal. Went out of their way to keep me informed of what they were doing to fix it and were very patient with me. 

Cheers!
Love it! Beautiful greenery and good prices. Definitely glad I found this place. Easy to get to as well.
Nice spot for a casual lunch or breakfast. Nothing fancy, just a good ol Americana diner. Nice place to stop by for some great grub !!!

The food and wine were delicious but it wasn't the greatest experience.  My husband and I came here on May 14th for our 8 year anniversary.  The moment we walked in I felt a little awkward.  The staff were nice but...I don't know it felt a little odd.  They sat us at our table and the dinning room was very beautiful.  We were the second table to be sat as I assume they had just opened up for the evening.  It took our waiter over 5 minutes to bring a wine menu, didn't get a regular menu until 10 minutes after we were sat and didn't get to order our food or wine until 20 minutes after we were sat.  I could understand if they were busy but like I said there was only one other table sat and there was plenty of staff wondering around.  About 10 minutes after we were sat a party of 4 were sat in the center of the dinning room and they were treated like royalty as at least 4 staff were waiting on them and talking and joking around while we were sitting right next to them being completely ignored.  
Our waiter was very nice and everything but it just felt like we were not worth their time.  

The only reason I am giving this place a 3 star review is because their food was absolutely delicious the the place was beautiful. We are willing to give them another chance in the future because the food was so good but my expectations will be a little lower so I am not as disappointed again.  I was really excited for this place for our anniversary and I left a little bummed.

SRAC is by far the cleanest and best gym in Reno. Besides having a full variety of machines and free weights, they offer a HUGE section of classes (including yoga) that are all including in your monthly membership. The gyms busiest time is around 5:30. Any other time before or after that, it's pretty empty and easy to get in and get out. I find the staff is very friendly and inviting once you enter the facility. They offer free daily use towels which is very nice. I highly recommend this gym!
Huge beer selection!! Make sure to ask for their honey wings :) the bar side seems to usually be a little better than the restaurant side in my opinion.
I don't even like donuts, and this place is so good! We got the huckleberry (so good we ate it too fast to photograph) and a Boston cream  they are SO fluffy and layered and amazing.

My food was incredible! Curbside Pickup was super easy, the food was affordable and delicious, and the entire online ordering process was incredibly quick and simple! I got a Create Your Own poké bowl, and there were so many ingredients to choose from! I also got Miso Soup, and they actually waited until I arrived to package my soup so that it would be fresh and hot! 

Everything tasted delicious, and I can't wait to come back again for another meal!

Still not really sure what all the hype is about. While I think Besito is a charming place with a lot of character and nice outdoor seating options and interior - I also think the food is insanely overpriced and portioned very small. Entrees are around $25+ and I don't think the food is anything impressive. 

On a more positive note, table-side guac is delicious and they have decent happy hour specials. Just wish overall the prices were more reasonable and they gave you more food.

This is another one of those rare businesses I can't say enough good about. Timmy and Nick really make it seem like you're visiting friends and just happen to be buying the ingredients you need to make the perfect homebrew.

Need help? They've got your back. 

After they get to know you, will Nick make fun of you? Maybe. Maybe probably. But it's all in good fun. Great guys. Reasonable prices. Good selection. Awesome events. What more can you ask for?

Be very careful before ever allowing these people to do any sort of imaging without first enquiring about cost.  Medical professionals are very quick to order tests without disclosing costs, but it is we, the patients, who end up with outrageous bills.  This group charged $324.00 to read a ct scan.  It probably took them all of 5 minutes since they misdiagnosed it.  The results came back saying it was a possible limpoma (benign soft tissue tumor), when in fact the small hard lump on my cheek was what I had said it was all along - a blocked duct of some sort - since it went away a day or so after having the cat-scan.  The total bill from St Luke's and the Boise Radiology group came to almost $2000.00 for a procedure that took less than 10 minutes.  There was no reason to have the scan because the biopsy had come back showing normal cells.  I can only assume that given the outrageous costs, the doctor, Scott Morrill of St Luke's primary health, got a kick back and that's why he ordered it.
This place is awesome. Went in for a pedicure and left with a pedicure and two back massages. So relaxing. They took their time. Just an overall great experience.

I was born and raised in San Diego and used to make it a point of going to the actual city of Tijuana for tacos. I have lived in Reno for 10 yrs and this is the closest I have gotten to So Cal or Tijuana tacos. The food here is awesome all their meats are appropriately spiced and delicious. I don't know why people complain about the employees cuz they have always been beyond wonderful to my family and I. My first choice for tacos 100% of the time

Amazing Vietnamese. Our go-to place. We always start with an order of delicious fresh summer rolls with their addicting peanut sauce and just now I tried their coconut lemongrass soup with shrimp and OH BOY was it good, its what prompted me to finally write this review. Their Pho is great and I often get the vermicelli bowl with lemongrass. My S/O consistently gets beef cubes and they, too, are great. Everything is bright and flavorful. The only negative is that the wait is long, but its well worth it. Its also more expensive than the typical Pho spot, but definitely doesn't stop us from coming here often. Definitely give this place a try, its one of the gems in the area.
Excellent beer selection and the charcuterie n cheese plate was great. Sat at the bar which has tons of bar top space, attentive and very friendly staff. Good pretzels as an app.
this place has everything you could need. Its a little hard to find as its in the industrial area almost but the owners are very friendly and helpful. Decent prices too

We used to love this place.  Previously generous portions and large beer selection.  On a recent Friday night my husband and I ordered the monster pizza and Cesar salad.  The pizza advertises multiple meat and vegetable topping.  The pizza we got had microscopic pieces of meat, very few veggies and hardly any cheese.  The salad was flavorful but couldn't make up for the disappointing pizza.  The beer list was similarly disappointing. My husband and I ordered different beers but they tasted the same.  This business has grown a lot in the recent past and it seems quality has been sacrificed.

Why do we like this place for dinner?  I mean, really.  Eating inside is completely out of the question: it's deafeningly loud, dark, and crowded, and smells like spilled beer.  Eating outside is unpleasant: it's noisy (train tracks), cold (malfunctioning heaters), scuzzy (homeless visitors), and smoky (patio=nicotine addicts).  Whether inside or out, the service is unbelievably bad: slow, rude, inaccurate.  Consistently.  Check your bill.

The prices lean high, and the food doesn't always justify it (be careful of new specials).

And yet... and yet... particularly with a large group of friends on the patio, this place shows its charm.  Throw together enough tables and there's room for all of you.  Be polite but persistent with the staff and eventually you'll get what you need, more or less.  And the food and drink are typically delicious and satisfying, and that's the point, innit?

Start with the beer -- a good selection of house brews and fine bottled imports.

Try some appetizers.  The artichoke is UNBELIEVABLY GOOD -- huge, smoky, flavorful, with a couple of dipping options.  The homemade potato chips with gorgonzola are justifiably famous. 

The salads are big and delish.    Gorgonzola again plays a champion role.

Entrees are hearty and generous -- this is the kind of place that offers bacon-wrapped steak.  On a cold night outside, go for shepherd's pie -- a big dish of gravy with savory lamb and comforting root veg, kept warm beneath a steaming mashed-potato lid.  Or try the Brewhouse Enchiladas -- made with filet mignon, drowning in sauce, served with lovely corncake, they are a delight.

And if you're po', never fear, just gamely plow through the menu and you'll find a few cheap and tasty sammies buried under all the over-$20 entrees and specials, and you'll find them just as satisfactory as the fancy options.
The service was so so. The  employees weren't pleasant at all. We went in on a FrIday afternoon. The food was not good. The spinach artichoke dip tasted like it came out of a container.

Trying new restaurants during Restaurant Week can be hit or miss. However, Amada's RW menu consisted of items they normally offer and between the two of us we were able to try a good amount.

Worth getting again,
Sea Bass - Very good and prepared well. 
Beef Shortrib Flatbread - Tasty and filling. 
Chicken w/Fried Egg - Something different, but the combo worked well. 

Probably skipping next time,
Spanish tortilla - Very bland. 
Grilled Calamari - Too salty and drenched in oil. 

We also tried the fig & cherry marmalade, garlic shrimp, and the white bean & ham stew - good but very simple.

Disappointed and amazed, apparently they don't honor the Dunkin ' special on the JW MITCHELL MUSTANG discount card #fail guess they don't support the local high school, you need to go to the one of 2 on us 19. When we got doughnuts they were just tossed in a bag, including ones with frosting :(
This specific location has been very consistent with it's serving portions customer service. Their salad is fresh which is obviously important.
Best nail salon. Only place that puts up with my particularity. Chris always makes sure that my nails look perfect. They also do a great pedicure. Finally found my nail salon since moving up here.

I wish I can give this hotel less than 1 star. The service is terrible, room dirty, really not worth the money. There are many options around that area, have tried Drury Inn and was absolutely great. Please do not come to this place, you will regret!!

Can't believe this.  My husband went into the store to get a replacement remote that stopped working.  Was told my the employees they do not have the replacement in stock, and don't  always have the parts. One employee said you can find a technician truck and they can replace it. That's funny, because they're recommendation is to try and track down a truck to replace a part. The other employee said he could call 611 and have technician come to the house. He couldn't believe the attitude of the employee who could recommend to try and find a truck! That's ridiculous ! And he wanted to argue about that point. My husband tried to explain how difficult it would be to find a truck and tell them how does he do that wait outside the house for a truck to drive by. One of the employees said "I didnt say that". How else is that to be received as a customer? He needs training in how to talk to customers. He even sounded angry when he said it! I have to say I would have complained to his boss. Maybe this is better. Oh and by the way, the employee who gave this ridiculous advice walked away mid conversation.
Great customer service they delivered on my vision. The cupcakes were fresh and delicious. I didn't try the cake but the couple told me it was yummy!

Ordered a Margherita pizza and a steak and cheese all the way. The steak and cheese is literally steak in cheese in a bun with nothing else on it...no onions..peppers...mushrooms..nothing! See pic

The pizza was very bland even for that type of pizza...sauce tasted like can sauce.

The restaurant itself is dinghy...under average food and a place that isn't very clean...no thanks.

First time here tonight and I'll definitely be back! Great food and a very friendly staff. The meal started with a cup of soup that I can only describe as a cross between a minestrone and an egg drop type soup. Very tasty. Next we got a small salad with a peanut dressing. I ordered a red curry dish with prawns and chicken and in terms of spicy I ordered a 3. Next time I`ll order a 4; 3 was spicy but a notch up would be perfect for my taste buds. Beverage wise I just had to order a Thai iced tea which is my favorite and then I wanted something warm so I ordered a hot Jasmine tea. The aroma of the tea was exquisite.  At the end of the meal the waitress brought us a small dish of a frozen, fruit salad type dessert. It was different than anything I`d ever had. The food is very good, the menu has many choices, and the prices are very reasonable. We even got a gift as we were leaving!

I honestly wish I could give this salon more than 5 stars. The space, the staff, and the work is absolutely beautiful. Christopher is hands down the most talented stylist who has ever worked on my hair and his down to earth and welcoming personality made the experience even better. He completely transformed my hair and I have never left a salon feeling this confident until now. I can't say enough about this salon, it is really a game changer. Thank you a million times over!!!

Visit this place once, you'll be a fan and keep coming back.  I appreciate the personal service of the staff.  These guys really care about fish and their customers and they're always ready to answer questions or offer advice.  I feel like I learn something new every time I visit about how to cook what I'm buying or  what is a good value from the vast selection they always have.
Great Food and Great Owners! Chicken Katsu Roll and Rock-n-Roll are amazing! Haven't anything bad!

It's a nice place to hang out and meet friends. You can buy or bring your cigar and smoke it in the patio. Stay away from their own brand cigars. Second cigar I've smoked from their own line. Unfortunately, once again one of the worse I've had. Burns really bad, uneven burn, empty pockets inside the filler. Taste wasn't too bad. Other than that, staff is friendly and great selection on drinks.

Their omelets here are really good.
Their smoothies look decent. They use frozen fruits from Costco.

If you like bold or medium roast coffee, you will not like what they serve. I ordered regular coffee and it was watery. Then I got an americano and still it was too weak. Go here for the egg scrambles.
Amazing. This hotel is one of the best I've ever been in. You could live in here for a year and never leave. They have everything.

I only give one star because I have to. The food is ok. The pho had no flavor it was like water not a broth. And my daughter found a hair in her soup. But this rating is mainly customer service. I remember about 6 employees. We came before a major rush, and the service was one of the worst I ever seen. One short lady was very rude, she even ask a customer to put away utensils in the middle of their meal, as if she couldn't just do it after they left. As the restaurant got more busy they had to rush to clean the tables, and they placed all of the dirty dishes on one table in the middle of the restaurant. Another employee was yelling at customers to move out of the way when all they was trying to do was write their name down.  Why would you have the main entrance by the kitchen door where you bring the food out, and this all happened before we were seated. When we were seated there was a stench of wet towel full of fish sauce left after they wiped the table. The man that brought out our food didn't even say the right number for my daughter's meal, but luckily it was the right order. I would never recommend this restaurant to anyone in the area, I would recommend any other place. The only reason we actually finished our food was because we just came from a long day of snowboarding. I have no idea how they have three and half stars. Another thing, we could've walked right out and not pay because it was so crowded by the register and unorganized.

Post-work, and shift-cocktails the mister picked me up and we went to grab some late dinner at Camellia Grill. Once we realized that it was Friday night, and that there was a bit of a wait, that our innebriated appitites wouldn't allow, decided to check out O'Henry's. O'Oops. It's one of those places we keep seeing, but never went into we went. We won't again. 
Boring. We each got build-your-own burgers. They had some cool toppings, which ended up flavorless. They also managed to mix up my veggie burger with a real burger... Not tragic, I noticed before I chomped in. They had cheap cocktails, that were liquorless and nice servers, that were serve-less. 

Oh well. Once again, not horrible. Just left a lot to be desired.

While my experience here was wonderful, I felt it was just a tad overrated. I came here with a group of 4, and other than the ribs, I felt like everything else was just your run-of-the-mill American dish. Chicken and biscuit, burger and fries, etc.

However, the 36-hour Pork Ribs, I have to say, were probably the best I've ever had. They were melt-off-the-bone good and had a perfect balance of sweet, tanginess, and kick. The portion size was also hefty enough that I couldn't finish the entire serving myself. But while the ribs are delicious and definitely worth trying, it will run you about $30 when tip and tax are accounted for.
Absolute beautiful space and in a cute area of town. I definitely recommend Alexa; I followed her from Local Honey. She's an awesome stylist and an awesome person.

I really like the Brewhouse and being that I just created my first Yelp List and it is about beer I noticed that I hadn't yet reviewed one of my favorite places to get one.   

The Brewhouse is an instituion in Santa Barbara.  It has been there for years and years!   They brew some of the best beer in town but that isn't all there is so much more to the Brewhouse.

They have a little patio outside which is wonderful on a warm afternoon.   They are very dog friendly so there is a always a cute little pooch to play with.   

They have the best Sunday Brunch in town and all of their food is so delicious.    The gorgonzola potato chips are the best!     So is the artichoke.   

Every year they do an Oktoberfest which is so much fun!!

The IBC is the best place to get a beer in Carpinteria. It has a great low-key vibe, is very dog-friendly, and has delicious craft beer. My two favorites are Paradise Pale Ale and Avocado Honey Ale (seasonal). Make sure to raise your glass to the trains passing by!

We went with four people in our group and were grouped with four more people but that was fine because it helped with solving the clues!  Lots of twists and turns and a whole lot of laughs!!  I would definitely recommend this if you are looking for a fun team builder!

Probably the best sandwich I've ever eaten - The Luca meatball parm is OFF THE CHARTS.   And the commish is a classic for vegans and they nailed it.  It's my favorite sandwich on the menu.  Can't wait to try the Mush Man and the Uncle Tony.   Creative menu, friendly staff, massive portions, cheap $$$ for the portion sizes!   You can't find gourmet sandwiches this good & this big for 10 bucks.  It will be a routine weekly stop on my way home to pick up dinner for the fam!
Our first time here... great staff (Olivia), comfortable booths, noise a little loud, good, fresh food !

I'm an experienced foodie. I stopped here by accident and LOVED IT! The food taste fresh and so much flavor. Homemade no kidding. They even have Kabobs!
Cool place. Try it!
Very professional, quality tailoring service. I was very happy with my wedding reception dress and another wedding dress I had hemmed with them. Their prices are very reasonable as well.

Hello Rose Cafe, where did you come from? We stumbled upon this place by accident. We were trying to go to a place nearby that had great yelp reviews but they were closed for Easter. We drove around aimlessly trying to find another place to eat that was open and up popped Rose Cafe! It is the perfect lil ma and pa type of restaurant. It is set up like a diner where you can belly up to a bar with stools or choose one of the tables set up for four. 

The table side salsa was so fresh and had a great kick to it. My husband and I ordered the Red Chili Pork and Carna Asada plates share. The portions were extremely generous and the food came out very fast. 

The red chili pork was very flavorful, not spicy, and the meat was very tender.  We got both flour and corn tortillas. I enjoyed the flour tortillas slightly more as they were slightly grilled. The Carne Asada was a little dry but it was so well seasoned. I think it was my favorite plate!

As a whole the service and food was excellent. We are so glad we ended up here.

Played tourist on a weekday in Tampa using these
boats to sightsee. The boats are comfortable.
There is bench seating in front and tables with
bench seating in the rear. There is also a small
bathroom in the rear. They sell bottled water,
beer and wine on board. 
There is a captain who pilots the boat and a first mate who takes care of everything else. The pilot
also narrates during the cruise. I learned much
about the history of the city and some of its iconic
landmarks.
There are more than a dozen stops along the river.
The home base are the docks between the
Marriott hotel and the Tampa convention center.
You can get on & off and buy tickets at any stop.
If you stay on for the entire round trip it takes
about one and a half hours. You can make an entire
day out of the trip by getting off at several stops
to have lunch, dinner, visit a museum and/or shop.
We got off at stop 3 which is Columbia Cafe at the
Tampa Bay History Center. We had a great lunch
which I reviewed on their site. We did not have 
time to visit the history center. 
The weather was perfect for a boat tour. Partly
sunny and a high of 73F.

This place is phenomenal!!! Everything was delicious! The servings are huge and the prices are very reasonable. I haven't had Mediterranean food this good in years. And the employee working was so sweet and friendly.

We waited for so long for this restaurant to open and we were not disappointed.  The atmosphere was fabulous, the food was beautiful and favorable, and the prices were in line with similar places.  Everyone who I have taken with enjoyed the variety and quality of food. It was apparent that the owners were watching, training and prepping their staff. It shows.

Amazing Thai food in Tucson. I had the drunken noodles medium spicy and they were excellent! Cute decorations and very friendly waitstaff. Will definitely go back for more to try other things. Great menu!
Partied here on Sat 10/23 and had a blast. The bartender was awesome and the customers were a lot of fun.

Barnes & Noble is one of our family fun & family time kinda place just because we enjoy books esp the kids. We come here to skim on books & if we like it we buy it, we usually get one each for the kids most of the time, we like to build our family library! I like that there's a Starbucks inside & you can bring & drink coffee while reading. Aside from books, they have CD's, videos, games, toys here! You get 15% off if you have a membership including coffee. Great place to hang out & develop the bookworm in you! I have to admit though that the prices are not so great, sometimes I see the same book & discounted much like Ross/TJ maxx or even online! Of course this place has huge selection which can't be beat!
Got the chorizo poboy which was Good and unique.  It seemed pretty simple to make yourself but it inspired me to try to make myself. It was tasty and will likely try a different poboy in the future.

Definitely one of my favourite places to go lately. A friend recommended it to us and it was amazing. My favourite item was the chocolate hazelnut croissant. The chocolate is not too sweet and the hazelnuts make the croissant nice and crunchy. We also tried the pistachio, tiramisu and the classic eclairs. Would definitely order the tiramisu and pistachio eclair again. 

We also ordered the chocolate espresso hazelnut torte as a birthday cake for my boyfriend and we all really enjoyed it. The full size was good for ~8 people. I liked that it wasn't too sweet but had a hint of espresso and hazelnut.

I shopped at this location and the sale associate Andrea was very rude to me and her coworker. A kind young lady was helping me find boots, and I could tell she was new but I was very patient with her, Andrea walked over and rudely interrupted our conversation trying to show me different boots that I had no interest in. I could tell she had no respect for her coworker and her intentions seemed to be to make the lady feel dumb for not knowing everything. The only reason I'm giving it 2 stars is because the lady who I initially spoke with kept her calm in a stressful situation, props to her!

Everything about my visit to this Sabrina's last Saturday was excellent. We arrived in the early afternoon without calling ahead and were told there would be a half hour wait. Fortunately, a couple of the people ahead of us turned out to be no-shows, so we were ushered back to a cozy corner table within a few minutes.

For my meal, I chose the chicken salad sandwich with a side of fries -- forgoing the gigantic french toast and the chicken cutlet on this visit (though both sure are hard to resist!). The chicken salad was really good. It wasn't the kind with grapes or walnuts in it (phew), but it still tasted quite healthy. It wasn't overpowered with mayo like some chicken salads. Looked like it might have had little tiny pieces of carrots in it! Oh, and the melted swiss MADE IT. I chose sourdough bread and that was also fantastic.

All of the staff members were super friendly, including our nice server and the accommodating host (who even held the door as we walked out).

Despite the somewhat scary parking lot, I would absolutely return to this Main Line location!

Food was great. It's more about the people working there. Some of the staff were giggling about my grandmas name being "Karen" and taking pictures. I get the whole speaking to the manger thing but my grandma didn't do anything. All this caused was anxiety while I was there. I really wish for kindness in the world. It's sad that I can't enter in my grandmas name without this sort of thing happening.

Vastly overrated. I have told everyone I know to STAY AWAY from this place. Have eaten at Casa Tina at least a dozen times and can never recall exceptional service. All of the servers I've had seemed trained (by Tina?) to act arrogant and bored rather than friendly and willing to go the extra mile. The food is good and fresh but it takes forever, and AMBIENCE means something to me, a concept that the owners of this place either don't understand or just don't care. One other thing--the tables are SCRUNCHED together so closely that it's discomforting. I ALWAYS have to ask for extra napkins. They NEVER bring out plates with which to eat the salsa and chips. Drinks and water are refilled SLOOOWLY. Every time. 

Just a bummer of a place. Stay away. Go to the Smokehouse or Serendipity instead. Casa Tina is an overrated snobby place, owned by a presumably miserably bitchy Mexican woman who thinks she's hip by acting like her customers are annoyances.

Use to be loyal customer. The last few times they sent us the wrong order. We called to get a delivery the right way and they told me to hold the wings to get them returned or else they wouldn't charge double. They also said they would have "cancel other customer orders" to get us our refunded order. The guy called me an a$$ hole.

Anybody that don't eat fried chicken ain't right with the lord, and anybody that don't eat it hot ain't danced with the devil. You gotta be the perfect mix of naughty and heavenly, ya know what I mean? Honey this place KNOWS WHAT I'M TALKIN ABOUT. At first ole Yvette thought that the purple one himself was the owner/creator of this place, but I guess I'm just havin a hard time lettin Prince go in his little red corvette. This place got the good stuff. Big ole clean place with HUMMINBIRB CAKE!!!1! Even if you wanted to escape the bathroom, you'd probably have to stay a bit extra cause this chicken is HAWT but it'll sure give an old lady her fire back. round back more specifically... but hey it was hashtagWORTH IT### AMEN!
Delivery took a little while but the food was excellent. IMO one of the best Indian food restaurants around. Will definitely order again.

If you like Indian food you should definitely try. Standard dishes very well executed ( korma, tikka, vindaloo etc) plus some lovely inventive things, esp among the appetizers .  Here on a crowded Saturday night, so one star off for slight slowness, but still... yum.
Doc Thom is the man. He helps maintain a high level of function even when I don't stretch and maintain as much as I should.

We were looking for somewhere for breakfast on Sat.  Chose papas based on reviews and the potential menu options that a diner has to offer. 

The menu was just what you'd expect from a diner and the service was great.  Our waitress was very friendly & helpful and they were very accommodating when my dad wanted to order from the diner menu.  

Things were looking good....

I ordered the French toast.   It was ok, but upon further inspection,  I noticed that there was VERY little or no egg.  It looked just like my son's side of garlic bread,  but with powdered sugar!

My friend had what he stated was the worst eggs Benedict he had ever had and the grits that came with it were extremely watery. 

All the sides were below average....cold fries, over steamed veggies, and cold mashed potatoes.  

The coffee was not bad and my dad LOVED his liver and onions, so all was not lost, but we will not be back to Papas.

My guy and I went to this place on a whim while walking around up on State st. The place is a little hole in the wall that actually has a warm feel to it when you walk in. With the homey decor paired with the acid washed concrete flooring, I get a trendy yet cozy feel to the whole place. The staff were friendly, and the food was good. I wish there was a better break down of what certain foods really are for those of us who are not regular gourmets. 

As someone else mentioned there is a lack of understanding of how to handle chopsticks. They should never be just set on the table and certainly not pointing your dinner partner. please get chopstick rests or wrap them with the silverware.

Other than that my experience was pretty good.
We went for lunch over the weekend. It was the best lasagna I've ever had! The beer was cold and the service was great. We really enjoyed our time there.

I come to this spot every single time I wind up in ST. LOUIS. The staff is as friendly as they come. The Food is spectacular! Perfect sized portions and sides. I always wind up with leftovers. Highly Recommend this place for some Amazing BBQ!

Not happy with the tipping scheme. If your manager gets a cut you should protest! 

I tipped and then the receipt asked for an "extra tip". We had already tipped and my wife tipped again because of the receipt. 60% is a bit over the top. We'll keep an eye on our transactions with this group from now on.

I can't say Coat Check is my favorite coffee in the city or even Mass Ave, but I think that says more about the quality and prevalence of good coffee in Indy than it does something negative about Coat Check. 

The historic building contains art and connects to the Indy's past while still feeling clean and welcoming. The building is shared with the YMCA and the Rathskeller so it's doing triple duty and pulling it off pretty well. 

The coffee and pastries are good! It's an interesting and modern menu -  tonight we tried a rosemary maple latte and a caramel miso latte. Their non-coffee drinks are just as interesting but I can't speak for the taste. 

This is definitely not a coffee shop with weak syrups. When they say a flavor, you'll get that flavor - you just may lose some of the coffee taste in the process.
Delicious falafel and the guy who runs the truck could not be nicer. Great experience with this truck, definitely will seek it out again!

Finally ate here, was hesitant before as the reviews here in yelp are not too good.  I am giving it 4 stars since we just ate here so i cannot speak for most of the food.  But with that, we are quite pleased with the food, the taste and presentation, as well as the location, and lay out of the restaurant.  we had negamaki, xmas roll, seafood casserole, and dimsum and they were all good!  the price is also reasonable.  Our server was very attentive. We will definitely come back to try more.

Good location for breakfast in downtown, plus they open very early and not long waiting lines. I went for brunch and ordered an omelette. Portion sizes are big and it comes with two sides. If you love butter then the toasts are for you. I will order mine plain the next time. Friendly staff and outdoor sitting available.

The Inspection Pros were amazing! I got two inspectors for the price of one! They were very professional and extremely thorough! My husband and I flip houses and have used other inspectors in the past, but since using The Inspection Pros, I will never use anyone else but them! I highly recommend them!

They allowed a kid to steal my son's personal belongings and would not even question the thief.  We can't be part of an establishment that allows stealing.  The workout facility is nice but just don't bring anything that you wouldn't want to get stolen.

On both of my visits I had a sandwich featuring pastrami. The first time was straight pastrami "fully involved'... more on this in a minute. The second time was the New York Steamer with pastrami, corned beef, provolone, mayo and Italian dressing. Both sandwiches were very much to my liking. My wife tried their meatball sandwich , which their radio advertisements brag about. Her base comment was that it lacked flavor, but we agreed that their bread is among the best of the sandwich shops.

Now back to... pastrami. I recommend getting "fully involved" with your pastrami sandwich here. Which is to say it would be the aforementioned pastrami tucked in that nice, soft, fresh bun underneath a blanket of provolone decorated with mayo, mustard, lettuce, tomato, onion and a pickle spear on the side.  Of course, you can always get your sandwich as stripped down as you want, but if you are going to build a relationship with a sandwich this good, you need to get fully involved.

I love getting my hair done here. I always feel welcomed and comfortable. Tera has been doing my cuts and color for over a year now. I always love how my hair comes out. Tera knows color and is able to adjust it if I want a change. She is very talented and also great to talk to!  The others in the shop are all very friendly and accommodating.

1. The website menu is NOT ACCURATE. 
2. The seats are completely uncomfortable.
3. The cocktail glasses and beer glasses are smaller than usual, and drinks a tad pricey-so a big disappointment when your drink arrives in a very small glass. 
4. The vegan biscuit and gravy came out in a solid glop. In case you were wondering, glop is not an appealing word and neither was this dish. 

I'll stick with crepes at the original downtown location.

We had such a nice experience at Maypop! We stopped in earlier in the day for a drink at the bar, and after looking at the food menu we decided to come back later for dinner. The three dishes we got were all amazing - hand pulled noodles with crab and sausage, alligator sauce piquant, and the lamb. Very comforting, rich dishes that really hit the spot. We also had the bread service, which was well worth the $4. The jelly that comes with it has a great kick to it. This is a great spot for a nice dining experience in the warehouse district.
The portions are huge, go hungry or consider sharing. The chicken and waffles were super yummy. The staff is also very sweet and welcoming.

Our usual Indian spot was closed, so our cravings made us try Mood.  We were glad we did!  Jalfrezi and Karahi were very tasty, but the Saag took the prize! Delivery was sooner than predicted for an extra bonus.  They even threw in a Galub dessert for us!  Mood just cracked into our rotation!
great sandwiches. all chicken cutlet combs are terrific. defy you to find one you don't like.
Cleanest and best equipped gym downtown and a friendly staff!!! Front desk staff are always nice and helpful.
I would rather come here than Starfucks! The best tea. I got Vanilla Ceylon. It's good as is, no sugar necessary. Yum Yum.
Vegan Chocolate Cherry Almond Oat Milk Latte was on fire. Local art was cute and affordable! People were sweet and decorations were cute!

Ronnie with a pony tail made our dinner one of the most pleasant experiences we have had in a while. The pot roast fries, along with Ronnie's recommendation of the binnette along with his customer service made sure we will be back!

Although I only went for a drink, I found Good Dog bar to be a pretty nice place. The first floor bar had a decent beer selection and the service was friendly and fast. The top floor seemed like a great place to play pool or Darts with friends and was much quieter than the first floor.

Been a while since I'd been to Sola, maybe 4 years. I would go more often, but unless you have 4 or more they wont take reservations after 6:30. Manager explained to me that they are just too small to tie up tables for 2 when they can fill 4 tops. I understand his point but having been to places like Fond, Little Fish and other small BYO's it seems those places manage to stay in business with taking 2 people after 6:30.
Anyway, the food is still as good as I remember it, and the service is excellent.
Chopped salad was very good, as was the duck breast and Striped Bass. Didn't have dessert. 
More parking now that Food Source is gone. Small charge for corkage, but overall a very nice, quiet place.
Darian & Jackson were polite, tidy, and worked as fast as could be expected. When they left the house, everything was in it's place, and as clean as before they came.

I'm hesitant to leave this review as I would like to keep this gem a secret. I've been here several times for breakfast and it is outstanding. The salsa, fresh- and hand-made tortillas, and any of the breakfast dishes are excellent. I've been to most Mexican breakfast places and this is my favorite and it's not really that close.
Very nice old world hotel.  A short walk from bourbon street and the superdome.  Free pb&j sandwiches every night. Not overly expensive for the quality.

The food was really average. Or for that matter lower quality than other thai restaurants in the area. We got the thai green curry and the roasted duck and both the dishes were real bad. They were very very spicy. And I am used to spicy food but this was too spicy to handle even for me! The waiters and the service was also below average. Spend ur money on some ither thai restaurant. Aviod!

Nice they no longer charge for extras like queso. Had an excellent taco salad in a fresh bowl. Got everthing I wanted and nothing that I didn't.  Husband able to get just chicken cheese and queso on his quesadilla without the up charge.

I bought my 15 half ton almost 3 years ago but I'm writing a review now because over my nearly 3 years of ownership with this truck I have nothing but positive to say about both the sales and service process.  When I bought, I was very particular about what I wanted and how much I wanted to Pay and they worked with me on both.  As it turns out the truck I wanted was with the Ram Rodeo crew during Reno Rodeo week as one of their displays, they worked hand in hand to get me in it.  Was a total dream driving over to the rodeo grounds with the Reno Dodge crew to pick it up, had 26 miles on it when I drove it away.  The deal took less than 3 hours.  A few warranty items came up as they always do with new vehicles and the dealership took care of them every time without blinking and fast, I am a particular owner and I even took a ride with the service manager so he could hear my concern to find out, there wasn't any need for any concern at all.  I've had all the maintenance done with them, always professional and timely.  Not to mention I've received follow up calls both during the holidays and my birthday every year, that's impressive to me.  Well done reno Dodge.
I can't say enough great things about this business.  Car ready when promised & at price quoted. Car wash inured at no extra charge.  Friendly, knowledgeable, helpful, and so much more.
The best tacos I've ever had. Always go with ribeyes tacos and tamarins drink. Fast serve and the staffs are so friendly. Highly recommend!

I'm a sucker for ice cream, coffee, cookies and anything sweet. Located in the middle of the college town, Iv drip is home to my satisfaction. Whether it's raining and I need a hot coffee and fresh baked cookie or its 80 degrees and 30% humidity and I need a Ice cream to cool off, iv drip is the place to be. Their ice cream comes from my favorite ice cream shop in McConnells in Santa Barbara home to fresh local grown fruit found in the ice cream. The staff is super kind and always there with a smile. On final or midterms week it's .99 cent coffee days and that's awesome ! Thank you iv drip for saving my life as a student at UCSB.

Ok so I'll say in advance that I don't expect much from this type of fast food place.. with that being said this honestly is hands down the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. I've been there a few times and the drive up is a mess.. not only is the wait time ridiculous but I can't even describe the mess the service was... trying to put in a simple order was beyond frustrating with multiple interruptions from the person taking the order while they were yelling and cursing at people in the background, talking to themselves and yelling some more.. this happened not once mind you but the first couple times I was there. Guess I should have known, but went a third time and yup.. it was worse than the first 2 times!! I finally get to the window to pick up my food and there was a worker there who had a wad of bloody napkins up his nose! Suffice to say it was not only the last time I was there, I actually beg and keep reminding my family to PLEASE NOT GO THERE. Really, do yourself and your family's health a favor and STAY AWAY

Food was average at best. But that wasn't the problem. For a Sunday afternoon sitting in the bar side the bartender was the only one serving in the whole room. I cannot knock the bartender because she was doing the best she can do. I put this solely on management. Sad to see that place go down that way.

I'm not sure why this place is even still open but I've tried it for the last time and it is faithful in disappointing. The fries even suck and that's really hard to mess up. I only give them a one star for the customer service because they are at least nice to people but this chain could be so great if they would just hire someone to care about the Product. Years ago every Krystal across the board was worth stopping at and should have been nationwide.
