I just wonder why it's so consistently horrible everywhere I stop and not just at this one location. The Manchester location we tried today because the store looked newer and it was as equally disappointing. Sorry, not sorry. This place needs a revival or something before someone gets food poisoning. Hello?! Corporate ?! Check your product or the cooks you hire because they are failing you miserably.

Totally unimpressed with this gym. Especially for it being considered a "super sport" there is nothing super about it. This gym could use a major upgrade! First off when you check in super sports are supposed to provide towels to their clients. No towels provided. Not to mention the weight room section their equipment is out dated! I'm from out of town and our 24 hour sport are better equipped and cleaner than this super sport. As far as being clean I'd give it a 2 out of 5. If I had other options of working out at a different gym when I visit I would.

Decided to try the alligator appetizer - hubby and I both really enjoyed it!  Also, the portion was very generous for the price.  Highly recommend the charbroiled oysters and the crawfish boil.  The crawfish are spicy and we couldn't believe the price, only $13.25 for a pound of crawfish- which also includes sausage, corn and potatoes.  Reasonable prices on bottles of wine, too. The service was excellent, and our server, Keyira, made our visit very enjoyable.  Took her recommendation to try the bread pudding - it  was amazing.

I've been looking to have a thorough cleanse, so I came to Thai Chili thinking their Coconut soup would do it. While I really wanted the runs, somehow this soup solidified my stool. Who'd've thunk it?
My sister and I escaped the 1980s, and it was a lot of fun; we were the only two in the room and we still managed to win.  The inclusion of 80s technology was interesting and fun.

oldie but goodie.  

i love going to this place. had many events at this bar and always packed. 

food and karaoke nights aren't too shabby

Came on a Sunday morning for brunch. We made reservations and were seated very quickly on their gorgeous patio. The food was fantastic with larger portions than expected, and the service was impeccable! Will definitely be returning on our next Sunday Funday

Good food and a great atmosphere.  I decided to go all Hoosier up in the joint and got the Pork Tenderloin. Seriously, can you ever go wrong with a tenderloin?  It was very good.  I don't order them often because of it being fried, but it was a cheat day for me.  As if the fried tenderloin wasn't enough, I ordered onion ring chasers!  Was I miserable all night because of my fried food frenzy, yep!  I take responsibility for it too!  This place is great and I highly recommend it.  Oh, the only downside to the place is the menu is pretty limited.

I love the food. Also the hot and sweet sauce. The service is great. So is the food specially for the price..I'll got there weekly. I do like that now we have servers . I don't like the brunch menu tho :/ foods amazing definitely worth the money!!

This was my first time at Goree, and they definitely  did not disappoint. This was also my first encounter with traditional African cuisine, and I am now hooked! I had the Mafe which comes with white rice. And I ordered a side of plantains. Large portions, for a great price!!! Lovely spot.

Relaxing place for a casual meal near the end of Magazine Street.  Happy hour specials on drinks and delicious food all the time.  Indoor or outdoor seating.  Clean, modern environment that would work for a couple, a family, or just a bite by yourself.  Much better than any picnic food I've had and they have the good sense to pair it with whiskey.  Really--what more could you want in a restaurant?

Finally tried the staple ice cream of the area. I was PLEASANTLY surprised by how good it is. Rich but not overkill, creamy, smooth texture. I got birthday cake and blueberry pie - so good! Birthday cake has giant sprinkles and pie has actual pie pieces. Very delish.

It's a car wash, gets your car washed, it's not brushless but the vacuums are free at the end. The staff is always friendly but for some reason the little wet wipe towels they offer to clean your dashboard always seem to be dried out. Even if you pull 5 out, not sure what the deal is there, I'm just being nit-picky though. The plus is you do not have to get out of your car unless you want to vacuum it and there is always a friendly guy at the beginning offering to swipe your card or feed your money for you if you can't reach the machine. The vacuums are great too, strong, always seems to pick up all the dog hair in my car, and there always seems to be a ton of dog hair in my car. 

I will also say, I always feel like a new scratch is added to my car when I leave the car wash, I don't know if it's the brush or maybe I'm just being paranoid and it's a scratch I already had acquired and my car was so filthy I couldn't see it. I will need to start counting my scratches in the future.

After finding Doma and Sabrina's closed for dinner, we resigned ourselves to eating at Kite & Key...and were pleasantly surprised.  We started with an order of Edamame (generously sized portion that was perfectly salted) and then both ordered off the specials menu.  I loved the freshness of the Chickpea Salad and we agreed that the spicy, juicy chicken in the Blacked Chicken Club was great.  We'll be back...even on a night when the neighboring restaurants are open.

This is the best food my husband and I have had in a long time. Everything we've tried was amazing, fresh and homemade! A must try is the pizza and the cheese steaks! The homemade soups are just so good ! So glad we found this place!!

The chips and salsa were tasty, though it was irritating trying to get the salsa out of what appeared to be maple syrup containers. The horchata was pretty tasty, full of cinnamon and sugar. I tried the chorizo and enchilada tacos with guacamole and cilantro.  The dish came with cucumber slices and radishes on the side.  The chorizo tacos had some spice to them and the tortillas used for the tacos were good. I wasn't as impressed with the enchilada tacos. There wasn't a lot of spice and the meat had this odd lumpy look and texture, as if they'd made up the meat before hand and it sat around.  The only other comment I'd make is that the service was a little slow. The meal was reasonably priced.

This is one of (if not my all-time) favorite breakfast/brunch places. I was incredibly excited to find out that there was another location in Clearwater as I've only been going to the Georgia one. I would have rated it 5 stars, however, they don't do free refills for their hot mochas. Everything I've tried so far has been delicious and the waiter was extremely friendly as she catered to our every need. My family and I will definitely be visiting again sometime!

I had engine problems with my F250 diesel pick up while on vacation in Tucson.

Both local Ford dealerships could not schedule an appointment any sooner than 10 days out.

I called Affordable Diesel Tech which got me in that day.

Both the office manager Mel and the mechanic Ronnie listened carefully to my issue and explained in detail the diagnostic results.

They could have sold me a $500 alternator, but that was not necessary - and they said so up front.

I took a chance and the service exceed my expectations.

Sam Masters
7 MAR 2019

I went to this restaurant a second time last night and the experience was poor again. The drinks took 10+ minutes to arrive, the waiter never asked us if we wanted more drinks. Food was blah again.The owners were sitting down having shots while the restaurant is left unattended. If the service/food continues to be like this, the restaurant will not be here very long. PLEASE bring back Burgs!

So here's the thing about a filet mignon, it is a cut of meat that can and should stand alone, in and of itself. You don't put a mustard sauce on it. And you especially don't put a terrible mustard sauce on it. I ordered the filet medium-rare, and half of the cut came back medium and the other half was medium-rare. ------ I ordered fries as an app, they were overcooked and dry. ----- The only reason this review is getting 2 stars is I liked the veggies that came with the entree. ----- The potatoes that came with the entree was average, at best. ------- I would not recommend this place to those with discerning taste.
1st time ordering Pho & Cafe Saigon from Ubereats, and I was pleasantly surprised. I had Vegetarian Fried Spring Rolls & Pho Shrimp. I enjoyed my meal, & plan to give them a try again in the future.

I've walked past this place for 4 years and have never stopped in - a pandemic seems like an apt time to test it out. My phone was broken so I was actually window shopping places that door online ordering because I was hangry so as soon as I saw they did that, I went back to my apartment to order. Major plus.

The food was prepared on time and was piping hot still after I was 15 minutes late (and a 15 min walk to my apartment). The serving sizes are HUGE. If you can eat a full container in one sitting, you must be a horse because no human possibly can; the (convex) lids barely shut. The order of fried rice and pad thai fed me for 4 meals.

The food itself was average. Like I previously stated, I was hangry so anything would have sufficed honestly. I wish the pad thai had more vegetables and bits of tofu like I'm used to. I would be inclined to try less basic dishes if I'm in the area again, but I wanted to play it safe for my first time around.

Worst service ever. There were 5 open tables in the small place but for some reason they would not seat us (party of 2) and asked us to wait at the bar which we had no problem with... But after 30 minutes of waiting we just ended up leaving. Seems like they we're having some management problems. Nobody seemed like they knew what was going on. Definitively will not be goin back to this spot.

Had really high hopes for this small locally owned restaurant. Ambiance is quite nice as is their wine selection. After having been there several times I can only say the food is hit or miss. The service definately needs to be stepped up. At our last visit our wine was poured without the opportunity to taste it. Not good style if you are spending upwards of $40 a bottle. Our meat was tough, advised the staff and no offer to replace it or credit our check was made. Please -- if you are trying to be an upscale restaurant give your staff some training. Probably will not try you again. Third strike, you're out.
American cuisine and bar.  Great beers on tap

I visit the area at least 2-3 times a year and always stop in for drinks but on a recent visit we where treated horrible and I will never go back and be sure to tell anyone that visits to do the same. Due to the current state of the world they are at a limited capacity which we completely understood and waited our time in line to get in during which they let people in ahead of us even though they were at capacity we said nothing patiently waited our turn. We where enjoying our drinks and had just ordered another round when a man that works there not sure if he was a manager or what approached us and asked us if we could finish our drinks and leave he has a line outside and would like to give other people a chance to come in I asked why us when there are other people that entertained ahead of us therefore they had been in longer than us his response was some garbage about they ordered food and we didn't. Another side note there is supposed to be no bar sitting and he basically had a full bar or people hanging at the bar minus stools. He then wanted to state the fact that some people at the bar where good tippers mind you he has no clue what kind of tippers we are side note 2 of us work in the industry so as a matter of fact we are great tippers and what on earth did that have to do with anything. There's a couple other things that where said but this basically shows how he treated us. Another side note his wife is the bartender and said something to him in order for him to say we could stay but really who should want to stay after being treated like that!!

ONE OF MY FAVORITE MEALS OF MY ENTIRE TRIP TO NOLA. If I had time to eat here again, I would in a heartbeat and I would have ordered a plate for just myself because the food is that good. 

The wait was a little long because I was in a large party and the restaurant is a tad on the smaller side, but it's SO WORTH IT. The service was amazing and our server was extremely kind, it felt like I was eating a home cooked meal with family. I shared with my friend and we ordered the fried chicken with Mac n cheese, corn bread and fried okra. We also ordered the turtle cheesecake for dessert. The food was AMAZING. Our plates were clean and our stomaches were full by the end of this meal!  If you ever come here, the fried chicken and the corn bread are a must.

Nice roof top lounge. Drinks are good and the food is actually quite good and reasonably priced!

Added edit: The tuna roe/caviar is awesome and such a great value. 
Go early, sit while the sun sets, eat some food, and then go dance!

Simply had to share our recent experience attempting to dine at Commanders for Thanksgiving. Background; we live in NOLA and dine here frequently. In fact I have maintained a standing reservation for Thanksgiving for decades. 
On this Thanksgiving I requested outdoor seating, confirmed same 3 times, and was advised 2 days prior to Thanksgiving that we would be accommodated as reserved unless it was raining. My family arrived on a sunny Thursday at 12 noon for our reservation. It had not rained any that day, and indeed did not rain until late that night. 
Essentially we were turned away for outdoor dining by the maitre'd. He advised us that the management had decided to cancel courtyard dining for that day pending inclement weather?! He implied that those holding a reservation were contacted, but I assured him that we were not notified. Indeed their representative had confirmed our reservation the day prior to Thanksgiving. 
No offer to accommodate our outdoor party on this sunny day was offered, ie a solitary outdoor table in their empty courtyard was NOT an option! People in our party felt uncomfortable with the risk of indoor dining during the Covid pandemic. An inadequate, "We are sorry" was given. Finally, we were advised that take away food would be unavailable to our party as well. Commanders essentially sent us home with NO holiday meal options, and never notified us of their decision to descend all outdoor dining reservations! I am certain this will all be blamed on Covid, but in reality this crappy outcome had little or nothing to do with Covid. Rather someone at the vaunted dining "Palace" dropped the ball.

The service every time I go in is always impeccable. Today I called 3 minutes before they closed due to a flat tire and they told me to come on in and fixed my tire with no hesitation or attitude. Great service and products. Thank you guys and Blake for the great customer service!

Ordered our food at 8:02pm with an expected delivery time of 8:45pm. It is now 9:11pm and our food is still not here. 

I called the restaurant to see if the delivery guy left or if he was okay and the lady who picked up said, "yea, he left already, but you live too far so it's going to take longer." We live 3.7 miles away, lol. 

We won't be ordering from them anymore.
A good gas station they generally are a little less than the Speedway across the street.  They also have a nice store with plenty of cold beverages.

I had a great food and OK service. I ordered gumbo and crabs for my friend and I. She loved the crab, as did I; the flavor was outstanding. The gumbo had great flavor too, served piping hot with awesome French Bread. It was early in the evening and not very busy which made me wonder why I had to prod the host to seat us. After that, the server was attentive and helpful. I would definitely come back for the food, even if I had to fight for a seat. I can't wait to try other things on the menu. There's plenty of parking in back so don't let the small lot that's visible from Williams deter you. Just make the turn there and boom ... big lot in back.

Went to Lift for the second time and had a deep tissue massage with Gina this time. Again, another great experience. Gina was very knowledgeable and welcoming. She made me feel welcomed and relaxed. She listened to my concerns and often asked if I was okay. I felt great when I was finished. I was so relaxed that I went home and took a nap!  You really need to try this place out!

Did I enjoy the Santa Barbara shellfish company? Well you should ask my feet that have been pecked on by pigeons scowling for food. Not only was the so called restaurant located at the end of the pier, where the sound of fog horns and obnoxious tourists, there was a huge waiting list to get a table. At this point one would think if there's a waiting list it must be good, do not be fooled. After deciding to get takeout and sit outside, the crab sandwich was soggy and flavourless, all of the food was cold and the classic duo of fish and chips is non existent. However, the three flavourless breaded onion rings were much to my disappointment. The lobster tacos also flavourless. Overall this meal was not worth 75$$! Seems to me like your paying for the view of tourists feeding pigeons! Don't fall for this tourist trap!
Still our fav for a few drinks and bs talk old fashion booths make it cool prices high food good still going Steady

FINALLYYY a matcha latte that I can taste actual matcha in. very cute coffee shop with a great millenially-oriented aesthetic decor and perfect for your coffee-snob friend menu. they also have baked goods which if I hadn't already gotten some from another bakery I would have tried.

lots of open space to do work, including a community table. it's pretty busy for a Wednesday afternoon, would come fully charged but there are outlets available near the community table if needed.

I don't even know where to begin. The place looks like it's falling apart. Dingy and dirty. The food is abysmally flavorless. Nothing was seasoned. Sushi should not be chewy. First visit, and also last visit for me.

My husband and I came here for our 9 year anniversary. We made a reservation online which was very easy and they say us as soon as we arrived. The hostess even laid out rose petals on our table. Chelsea took the best care of us on our first trip to Ruth's Chris! She walked us through the menu and helped with portion size and everything! We order the seafood tower, do it you won't regret it! My steak came out sizzling on the plate. My husband salmon was cooked perfectly and the Cajun sauce on time was delightful!

The room is ok but the mobile check in line was twice longer than the normal check in line. The parking lot is like a maze and was hard to navigate through some one way area. The only wifi they have is not secure, even for hotel guests. Expressed my concern of data being stolen, and the front desk lady said that it has never been reported of data being stolen. I responded GSR has never been robbed but I'm sure they have tight security every. She basically said it was the risk I would have to take and ended the call. What a joke for a supposedly high end hotel and shows employees don't care about the concerns of their guests.

Great spot if you're on the couch and want delivery. They have a robust menu and everything on there is solid. Good cheesesteaks, hoagies, burgers, wieners, pizza, and fries. Reasonably priced too esp the wieners and Texas wieners($3-$5). They have great melted American cheese to top hoer fries. Open late too. When in up in the air, def my go to.

My go-to for real honky tonk music in downtown Nashville. Do my best to go 5-6 times a year. My last visit came a week ago, and my usual cheeseburger and fries were spot on. Swear they are best fries in downtown. The beer is good; the waitresses are attentive, despite the chaos, and music is great. What more do you want?!
Such a great place for good pizza and beer. Awesome ambiance and very reasonably priced.
Loved it!!! Lived the food, the service, the drinks, and the atmosphere. Traveling through, would definitely stop again.

This restaurant is really unique and beautifully decorated. The food is excellent and the staff is wonderful. I've only ever been there for lunch, but it gets very busy at that time of day. Definitely make a reservation!

I really enjoyed this fantastic little restaurant. The food was marvelous, service was fast and friendly, and the selection was perfect. I had the Army Pot, it was unusual but really enjoyable. We tried the pumpkin pancake to start and the house dessert... Wow, spectacular. How is this place not busier? I can't say enough good about it. If you're on the fence about trying it... Go for it. You won't be disappointed.

This group of professionals are the best. Dr Fong is the most caring doctor I have ever worked for and encountered. And the staff is awesome. I wish them a long and successful furure,
Jennifer

Never heard of Raising Canes chicken fingers. So we gave it a try. The menu has four meals to choose from and one kids meal.  I got the box. The chicken fingers where good the coleslaw and toast where great the fries are just plain fries. The sweet tea was refreshing and the canes sauce was nothing special.  We will be back.

I gave Rolling Stars another chance and I'm very pleased with this time. I was there on a Friday this time, around 10:30/11am. I was able to phone ahead and my order was still warm and exactly ready when I asked to it to be. The staff were noticeably more helpful and friendlier this time around. I did notice what seemed to be the manager helping the employees and making sure things were running smoothly. I also noticed there were plenty of bagels still left, and they still looked very fresh. I actually took my bagel and had it later, and i re-heated it up to get it even toastier... and it was still very delicious. I'm glad to have gave Rolling Stars another chance, and I'm happy to recommend getting your breakfast/brunch here! I am not sure how they are doing to accommodate for the lack of social distancing in regards to the line (because there was no line when I arrived), but I hope they have fixed that issue. Overall, thank you to a business who takes feedback and adjusts accordingly.
Very tasty smoothies, although they are pricey. At least they start with whole fruits and vegetables, unlike many smoothie places.
Great food, friendly staff and music the night we visited. Made me think I was in a restaurant in Philly.

I love Debbie! She is responsive and extremely reliable. You can tell she absolutely loves all animals.

But really, if my two cats are alive and happy upon my return, I'm good. 

Oh and to add - she sends me pictures and updates of them while I'm away.
All good until the manager and bartender had issues with anybody coming in and dancing. Complete blindness. Don't have open doors if not legit. Sorry dude.
Fantastic meal! The best homemade pasta from a restaurant in SB that I've ever had. Service was excellent and atmosphere is perfect. Hidden gem for sure.

Medical care was fine, but it took two hours to get in and out.  There were only two others ahead of me and two practioners working.  Good exam and treatment for my allergies, but the wait was excessive.  I waited over half an hour just to see the nurse practioner.  Med, yes.  Fast, no.  If you're really in need of rapid care, go elsewhere.
Came here for happy hour and the service was great. Geri, our server, was very friendly and helpful. The grilled oysters were a bit on the small side compared to Felix and Acme, but just as tasty.

Love this place! The atmosphere is great and food is amazing! The best part of the night was a bartender named Shelia! Definitely will be coming back to say hi to her! 
Thank you and see you soon !!!

Jim the manager is the best!!  He always makes sure to find by and make sure everything is ok. However, I used to give this place 5 stars, but after taking my son and some friends here, I changed it.  My sons friend ordered chicken fingers. O. M. G. The worst! They, I guess we're cooked, but so hard you couldn't eat them. The tostadas, the tortilla was so wet from the lettuce and tomatoes, that is was soggy. You couldn't even pick it up.  The frozen ice cream, is smaller then a small scoop at Baskin-Robbins. So not impressed anymore. Food taste was bad.

My time hasn't been kind to Pinto.  Took out Pad see ewe tonight. It's was inedible. I threw it out. The broccoli tasted rotten and the noodles clumped together and were way undercooked. No flavor either.  I hate to be harsh during covid, I suppose I could call them end tell them  but I most likely will never return.

This place was a great find! I would skip Carrabbas in a minute to go here. The food is authentic Italian. The atmosphere is both pizza joint in the front and little Tuscan villa in the back. They welcomed us when we came in the door. The food was excellent and the portions were large. They give you extra unique bread and even throw in desert with dinner. The cannolis were a little too sweet but they tasted great. BYOB

Disappointed!  Cocktails, food and service are just not good. Over priced for this new restaurant that is struggling to find their identity. When you walk in you are greeted with a strong fish odor, their cocktails are not great tasting, the waitress disinterested (not engaging about the menu, no bread basket, no plates for appetizers....), the 700 degree salt stone was interesting to say the least, the halibut dish was fishy but the chicken fried chicken was good!  We decided to leave before considering dessert.  Hope this new restaurant in town finds it's niche because it sure is cute inside and would be great for the locals to go.

This office is great! The building and facilities are nice and new and clean. It smells like animals haven't even set foot in it which was a huge perk for me! Dr Hollis was so super kind and took his time with us and our puppies. His assistants were just as wonderful and the front staff is super efficient as well. Just an all around good choice for your animals veterinary care.

Been coming here foot a short time now and it's am never disappointed Taz is a really good barber pays close attention to details he makes it super easy with low wait time when you book your appointments ahead of time took my son here  for his  first haircut he did really great didn't even cry as long as Taz is at that shop they have my business.

Needed a place to stay overnight due to our A/C going out at home. As an LQ Military Rewards member, (my husband) we have stayed at many LQ Inn's & Suites over the years. Most of them have been very good with a lot of them being remodeled or newly updated. This location is in need of a remodel and updating. We had to take their last room they had left, which after getting settled in our room felt like the last hamburger under the warmer at the end of the day! The housekeeper overlooked a open, spilled can of coke in the fridge left by a previous occupant. The freezer needed defrosting, there were fresh per urine stains on the carpet, and a few splashes of liquids on the walls. We were extremely hot, tired and just wanted to sleep in some A/C - otherwise we probably would have had the energy to speak with management as I normally would on a "normal" visit if I feel the room is subpar. (Which is not often, we usually have good luck at LQ) I will add upon checking out, a room up front outside next to the entrance decided to open their window and hang their bathing suits or clothes out to dry! I can honestly say that was a first! I probably will not choose this particular location again due to cleanliness, being outdated and overall appearance. LQ can do better, I hope this location will improve.

I came back from New Orleans a week ago and I have been craving that cajun/creole cuisine.  I visited a restaurant that was close to me and the food was horrible so I was really hoping that this place would make sure that I didn't have to go back to NOLA in order to have some good food.  I had the sampler platter and I was not disappointed.  The food is wonderful.  The portions are so great that I believe I will have at least 4 meals out of my order.  I placed a take out order and the man who took my order was very courteous and it was waiting on me when I walked in the door.  I will be back, SOON!

Believe it or not I've never been to a Hooters before. I say because whenever I tell people that they look at me like I'm crazy. I didn't understand the hype then and after going, I really don't understand the hype. We ordered wings and beers and the wings were good. They weren't phenomenal but they were good. I will say that wings were pretty big. Like they weren't pitiful little wings with hardly any meat on them. I also ordered the pretzel because I've also heard Hooters makes a mean pretzel. It was pretty bomb but it was kinda salty. I found myself scraping the salt off to make it edible. 

They were pretty overstaffed and there were a lot of people just standing around. Our server was ok. She wasn't fantastic or anything.

I think the part that would make me never go back to this location was how awful the bathrooms were. Now, I really don't understand how the women's restroom was so gross seeing as the majority of the staff are women. In fact, I was in there and a girl walked in, initialed the bathroom log, and left. Like, this girl didn't even touch anything in the bathroom and she damn sure didn't wash her hands after going in there.\

Yea, I'll pass on this.

I am religious with manicures, so when I moved to Santa Barbara I was expecting a wide assortment of offerings for good nail salons. BOY WAS I WRONG. It took me 7 months to find Famous Nails but god was it worth the wait. I tried many, many other places and none compared to here.They do a wonderful job and its not nearly as pricey as some of the places. LOVE them and will continue to go back time and time again!

The sauce is REALLY good! The pizza itself isn't appealing to the eye in my opinion. But it was good.  Over priced for what you get.  We ordered a large cheese and a large sausage with half jalapeño and an order of 5 breadsticks for $34 and that was with one of the pizzas HALF off with coupon. . Won't order pizza again, but will probably try something else.
I absolutely love the classes, the environment, and the instructors.  I always feel fabulous after every class!!  I would highly recommend Pure Barre to everyone I know!!

I had breakfast here once before on a previous trip.  Although I don't remember what I ordered that time, I DO remember the Bacon Bloody Mary in my to-go cup!  They were somewhat busy on this morning, but took my order right away.  The order itself took awhile, but I wasn't in a hurry.  My Crab Catch Omelette arrived with hash browns & wheat toast.  The omelette was composed of crab, shrimp & gruyere; I'd asked them to please omit the creamed spinach.  It was good & the perfect amount for me, but the shrimp weren't deveined.  That seems to be the norm in New Orleans, though.  It wasn't enough to bother me, so I did clean my plate.  Good service, friendly staff.

I wish I could go here everyday and try all the flavors. I had the brown sugar boba milk tea and it was amazing. Decently sweet and creamy, plus you can customize it how you'd like it. You can order online and then drive-up to pick it up without getting out of your car.

I stopped in for lunch on a weekday. There was one person ahead of me they took my order and food was out in 10min. Got back to my office food was still hot and boy was it good. Got the fish hoagie, lettuce tomato and pickles were very fresh. To my surprise it even came with fries. Ive gotten a lot of fish hoagie they've never come with anything extra. Had the second half for dinner that night.
Excellent Mexican cuisine, made with care!   Loud, busy and still service was terrific.   We were passing through and won't have an opportunity to come again.  Highly recommend.

I like that Harvest is on the second floor of the building and when you dine outside you get a beautiful view of the city. The service is efficient and the food is good. They had an apricot tea that was quite tasty. I also got the caprese sandwich with chicken. It was a winner. 

At lunch time the atmosphere is quiet. Even though I didn't get to try any their cocktail drinks sounded amazing. I would like to go back to try some of their concoctions.

Wow wow wow !!! 5 Starts, today was my first time here & I ordered take out the Vegetable Pho & man o man when I tell you the Broth is amazing, it is seriously one of the best that I have tasted besides Vui's. I was a bit nervous since it was my first time but I am NOT disappointed, so happy to find this place. They sent a lot of fresh vegetables & all kinds of sauces that I added inside my bowl.  5 Starts. Just try you all :)

I took our golf cart down there because we need air in the tires and they are just across the parking lot. the guys were tickled that somebody brought a golf cart. They seem like a good group of people

Really? That much for a just-average brazilian steakhouse meal? You're paying for the hype and the atmosphere. Was not worth it.  Yeah, I know...the meats just keep coming. Duh, it's a rodizio brazilian steakhouse. But nothing about the entire experience from entrance to exit was impressive enough to return. 
Go to TeraMarr in St. Pete instead. I tried it on my last trip and for half the price you get a much more enjoyable & delicious experience.
Hey, I just wish we had any rodizio's up in Virginia so I can be picky about the ones down here for my trips. Down here only 6 times a year, so don't have dissapointments to spare.

Today's brunch was a less than stellar experience.  It was not that busy, but they were very slow and it took quite some time for the food to arrive.  One of us ordered the small nitro cold brew coffee, and it was a tiny cup for $5 - it really was not worth it.  When the food came, the avocado toast have very little avocado.  The omelettes were underdone, with some of the egg not cooked and the veggies sort of hard.  The flavor was rather bland.  The waiter never checked to see how our food was, and we had to flag him down to clean our plates and gives us a check.  It did not seem like their A team was working the brunch today.
Loved the blue moon smoothie highly recommend. Also got the Island Bowl (not pictured) which was so fresh and delicious and even a regular seemed like it was pretty big for a portion

Termini's will always have my heart as well as my stomach.  Since I was a wee sprat we always got our special holiday treats here -- cannoli for a family party or gingerbread ladies on a trip to the city before Christmas. 

The aroma of the bakery precedes the sight of the old-school Art Nouveau neon sign, directing you inside where stern signs warn you not to touch anything.  A white-coated lady will fill your box with cookies, biscotti, sfogliatelle (clamshell pastry) and finally, freshly-filled cannolli.  Ricotta cannoli are the only kind we get -- I never was into the pastry cream type. 

If you are seeking classic, not-too-sweet Italian cookies, the amaretti, taralli and pine nut cookies are wondrous.  Termini will even package cannoli for travel, and send you on your way with an expertly packaged box of shells, and the loaded pastry bags to fill them. They even ship this setup, chilled, across the USA.

Not impressed at all. The bagel was extremely dense and the fixings are always lacking in quantity. 

I have been there multiple times with friends and I always regret it but only go for the company of my friends. It's tough for me to find something good to say about this place since the coffee is average and the drink selection is below average. I would recommend going to angelos or pb's or even WAWA because honestly they are all much much better

I have been a customer of Gravois Auto Repair for 10+ years. Yes, I said 10+ years! Why do I keep coming back? Trustworthy, honest, fair and local. After experiencing several dishonest auto repair places and dealing with additional damage and repairs they caused, I was fed up! A family member referred me to Gravois Auto and I have been taking my cars there ever since. I have also referred several family members and friends, who are also happy with the service they provide.

Here is the way my visits at Gravois Auto go:
I have a problem with my car and bring it in for them to check it out. I am greeted by one of the friendly employees at the front desk. I leave my car and shortly after, I receive a call stating the issue and the cost. They inform me of the problem and ask my permission before they start any work. I feel comfortable asking questions because they are answered in an informative, non-condescending manner. I "okay" the repairs, and a few hours later receive a phone call that my car is ready. If they are extremely busy that day they will let me know on the initial phone call that my car will be ready the next day, but this is rare. Generally, my car is  the finished the same day (depending on what time I bring my car and what repairs are needed). I pay the bill, am given a detailed receipt of the work, pick up my car and have no further issues. 

In general, car issues and repairs can be stressful and expensive! I continue returning to Gravois Auto Repair because I don't want the additional worry of dishonesty and unfair prices/expenses.

Hunan Wok changed my perspective on oriental food and especially fried rice dishes.  I stopped in on a whim right before Covid hit because I wanted to try something different.  The pork in the pork fried rice was actual strips of pork, not the chunks of something that has some kind of dyed skin on one side that you get from other places.  The flavor was magnificent.  But this review no longer matters as I've noticed recently when I drive by that it's always closed.  I just GOOGLED it.  They shut their doors permanently on July 4th of 2021, 4 months and 4 days ago.  A shame.  I think the pandemic did them in.  I guess I'll have to find a new place.

This place was awesome. The cashier was so nice, pleasant, and patient with our complicated kid order, not to mention our order for grown up sandwiches. She also handled my brother's single order with ease. Our food was served just as ordered and super delicious. My husband and I both had the brisket sandwich. It's HUGE! We could have shared and been happy with our serving. As it was, we each ordered our own sandwich and neither of us was hungry enough to eat dinner. We highly recommend this place for quality food and service.

Just writing to say I'm still an Evie's believer after all this time! I've been going to Chi religiously and she always does a phenomenal job. I get Pinterest-worthy nails every time I see her. Check out those Christmas tree light nails! I've always been happy every time I see her and highly recommend the services of Chi.

Excited that Bodega came to Tampa! Love the vibe and food, plus always a fan of the Humming Bird smoothie with ginger! Service was great too! I have no pic to post cuz well I ate it too fast! Oddly enough I didn't even pause to do the Instagram photo shoot before going down on that Cuban Lechon! Hey, get your head out of the gutter!

Overhyped because of the Food Network. Small portions of sides. I understand it's supposed to be a dive or hidden gem, but it wouldn't hurt them to clean up a bit as it was very dirty. Chicken was good, and hot does mean hot. I wouldn't recommend anything past medium for newbees

Great salon - love the interior, it's very chic and organized without being too pretentious.  I called and got an appointment with Rachel the same week to cut my very short hair.  I needed some damage control on a bad haircut but hadn't even told the receptionist that.  When I showed up and explained the situation to Rachel, she said she loved fixing bad cuts (YAY!) and she hooked me right up.  She knew what I wanted and offered good advice, plus was quick and efficient.  The price, the atmosphere, and the professionalism at this salon were all first-rate.  I'd definitely recommend the salon and Rachel in particular!

4.2*     Had the brisket, ridiculously tender and so much flavor. My friend had the ribs which fell off the bone. The sides: the garlic Mac and cheese was a bit overwhelming for my taste, garlic lovers would be in heaven,  the baked beans were delicious.....smokey, sweet and slightly spicy.......the portions were satisfying and it was reasonably priced.....overall great place, with friendly fast service... would recommend!

I love this place and would normally give it 5 stars but can't bring myself to do so after eating the Praline Bacon, Egg, Cheese Biscuit - ahem, my favorite item on the District Menu.

My children and I occasionally stop into this District sub-spot on our way to school with anticipation. 

Whoa! Totally new menu - gone are the amazing hand pies that we loved and replaced with 10 different donuts. Okay,
no problem. But....those hand pies..... :(

Then I laid my eyes on the Praline Bacon, Egg & Cheese Biscuit. Actually, it was the first thing I saw when I walked in. I LASER FOCUSED on the item, not noticing that the egg was, ummmmm, NOT what I'm used to at the MAIN District location.

This wasn't scrambled eggs either - this was (ohhh, I hate to say this), upscale version of McDonalds. 

The biscuit top was nothing like how it is at the main location either.  I looked at this food item and it stared dully back at me. I could just hear it whimpering, "please don't hate me," over and over.

So.....hungry as I was, I cut into it. Sigh....no runny egg. I did take a bite out of curiosity and was disappointed. Even a poached egg would have sufficed (in fact, I was hoping for a poached egg to save me from writing this review).

The praline bacon was amazing as usual, biscuit too. But gone are the days that they took a torch to anything to crisp it or warm it. My biscuit a la McDonalds was also warmed in similar fashion to McDonalds. Honestly, I don't mind waiting. Maybe I should change my rating to 3-stars. Ugh, I'm on the fence here.

Good points to mention: gone are the ridiculously small cups of espresso drinks that were priced ridiculously high.  Those have been replaced with 12 and 16oz cups. Good for you if you can drink 16oz of espresso, milk and sugar. I betcha you are an energetic bunny at work: go-go-go till ya drop and give me 20 (more shots of espresso).

This rating deserves a 3.5 - I say this because the staff admitted they are "streamlining" because they have expanded. Well, sorry not sorry - when you streamline you need to REMAIN CONSISTENT FOR THE SAKE OF YOUR CUSTOMERS.

Like me.

Sigh....

I miss your hand pies and over easy eggs in the Praline Bacon extraordinaire biscuit.

Heard great things about this place and finally checked it out for myself. 
I agree that it is a cute little restaurant, service is good, food is great, so I'll join the bandwagon... 

BUT... I am not entirely comfortable of my food traveling down the sidewalk along the parking lot before it comes to me... That's a very busy street out there too...  One may say, well you would get that too if you're sitting outside... but I'm not siting outside... it just is off putting... hope no bird comes by or a nice little wind to blow whatever into your food there...

I got lucky and mine arrived in good condition. The chopped salad was huge and delicious, nice crisp light and simply yummy. 

Pizza crust delicious with just the right amount of crunch to it. Sauce appears to be fresh made not canned and the toppings were delicious. 

And I do appreciate the Aperol Spritz, very Italiano... hard to find in this area...

Again, the only reason I am taking off a point is that the food travels along outside.
Excellent sub!! And gluten free? Even Starbucks, subway and wawa don't have gluten free. Big hearts from me

I want to give it 5/5 stars but I've only been there once so that may change.... I might go back and order something else and hate it but....

first time going there today with my roommate who suggested the place as they have catered STLCOP's events in the past and she said nothing but good things about them. We went in around 1pm or so for a late lunch.

Firstly, there was only ONE woman working in there, like waiting tables and stuff. But she was very sweet and cheerful and seated us right away. She brought us our drinks pretty quickly and took our orders quickly too. That's always a plus. Unlike places like sekisui where it takes them freaking forever!

I ordered green tea and my roommate ordered water but she brought us both green tea and water. My roommate ordered the roll lovers combo. It's like cali rolls, some other kind of roll, and I think comes with a soup and salad. I ordered the chef special III, tuna rolls, salmon egg nigiri (ikura), sweet shrimp (ama ebi), and sea urchin (uni.) If you've seen my other reviews you know I am a sea urchin nut, so yeah... hehe.

Even though my meal doesn't technically come with a soup or salad, and I didn't ask for any, she brought me some too. Wow. I was worried I would be charged extra for it but I wasn't! She didn't even charge us for the green tea or soup and salad. Damn. Nice!

The soup was tasty and fresh and tasted like they just made it--not like it was sitting in a pot all day. The seaweed and mushrooms in the miso broth weren't soggy but nice and firm! A+ The salad was served in a miniature ceramic cup that had been previously chilled which made it all the more enjoyable. It tasted mostly of cabbage and it has a refreshing ginger dressing on top. The dressing didn't drown the salad either which I approved of.

The chef special III was a wacky combo of red snapper, apples, cucumber, crab meat, ponzu sauce, sesame seeds, and tobiko roe. It was really refreshing and crispy/crunchy! Not bad but kind of expensive. ($12.) I probably wouldn't order it again but I wanted to try one "fusion" thing while I was there. The tuna rolls were good but probably could have been a tiny bit fresher. I think Whole Foods has the best tuna rolls I've ever had in the US but that's just a random tuna-lovers side note. :P The amaebi was YUMMY! They even included the deep fried prawn head which is a pretty traditional way to serve it, IMO. The salmon eggs were also fresh and tasty. Lastly, the sea urchin. It was GREAT! Delicious, creamy, refreshing and basically the way it should be. It wasn't as "yellow" or "golden" as some other sea urchin I've had, it was more like a light orange/yellow color which made me skeptical, but when I tried it, I was a believer. 

Long story short I had a really great trip here. I also loved the interior and the furniture. 

Overall, a great trip. Hopefully my next trip will be just as fabulous! :)
Great drinks made with boba, has teas and coffee.

Amazing sandwiches with a ton of meat! I love this place! The roast beef is to die for. I could take or leave the mat zo ball soup but that's just my personal taste. Fries and potato salad are both great. Everything is priced around $10 so pick your poison and dig in!

A fantastic salon with a wonderful, friendly staff and inviting atmosphere. I have loved both of my experiences here, my pedicures were fantastic. I will be back and I look forward to trying their other services. Highly recommend this new gem for a unique and fun experience.

Why 4 stars? Because of the following items...

   ---   ---   ---

Keeping this one short and sweet:

-Great beer selection
-Tons of TV's
-Not over-crowded
-Solid overall vibe.

4 good characteristics = 4 stars*

*This is not an exact science.

They let my daughter leave the building and she was standing outside for nearly an hour by herself. She's only 8. She had 2 classes today and instead of attending her second class, she walked outside. When I pulled up she was just standing there  outside crying, for nearly an hour, and nobody did anything. Unbelievable!

Quick delivery. Food is ok. Minimum for delivery. The con is its so cheap that you get so much for your minimum. Con is... you get so much grease that you dont needcthen there's also a delivery charge. Each dish is a hit or miss. Somethings taste good. Some taste like cardboard.

I have been remiss in taking a sec to say YUM and what amazing creativity!!! Recent birthday for the Hubbie gave me an excuse to bring a delish traditional yellow cake home and it didn't disappoint. But friend"a big birthday recently with a quirky theme resulted in this amazing artistic work. With just a little direction they went to town and it was the talk of the party!

If you wanna have your cake and eat it too.... can't miss Triple Crown!!!!

Completely forgettable.  Food was bland.  Wings were dull and slimy.  Fries were tasteless.  Burger wasn't the worse I've had this week.  But come on - it's 2011... why are 90% of their TV's low resolution 4:3?  HDTV is pretty much the standard now.  Catch up.  Some of their big screens looked like they were in use in the 80s. Seriously?

Went today and clearly half the place was watching the Giants/Eagles while the other half was watching the Pats/Bills.  Yet both games had no audio and were put to the worst tv's in the place.

The lunch menu is such a deal! I got the General Tsos Chicken which comes with your choice of rice and your choice of soup. All tasted great and service was decent as well. I would go again for the great prices!

I went in for a Citizen Eco Drive watch repair and spoke to a car-salesman looking gentleman, who carried himself as the owner of the establishment.  He made a sales pitch that consisted of two key points: my Citizen watch was worth around $300 and it probably needed a new capacitor to fix--which would cost $85.  He then asked when I bought it, I told him 2012, and said he often sees owners come in for a new 'capacitor' after 2-3 years for Eco Drive watches like mine.  He then began using mental pressure and deception by presenting misleading information and speaking quickly without offering me the time to speak or think.  I found myself looking at new watches at his instruction and realized I was being 'sold' against my will.  I returned to the issue of fixing my watch and informed him I bought my watch for $130 so I was not considering $85, he tried to sell the 'capacitor' to me for $65 before finally agreeing to just readjust the hour hand and minute hand, as I initially requested, for $15.  After verifying that the price was $15 and clearly stating that if they were to attempt more costly repairs they should contact me first, I left.

At home I researched Citizen Eco-Drive watches on the Citizen website and found that the watch had an energy cell that was often "incorrectly referred to as a capacitor."  Furthermore, the expected life of the energy cell was a lifetime and in "the unusual event the Eco Drive energy cell fails...the cell will be replaced for the life of the watch."  

Source: EcoDrive - Citizen Watch - Eco-Drive, Drive - English (US). (n.d.). Retrieved March 28, 2016, from http://www.citizenwatch.com/eco-drive/faq-category/eco-drive/

Two weeks later I get a call that my watch is ready, as I was out of state I had a family member pick it up for me and they charged $75...

I strongly encourage anyone who is considering this establishment to go to a different place of business that is invested in a future relationship with their customers.

My favorite brewery pub in PA.  Where else can you enjoy great food, awesome beer and then enjoy playing ping pong where you never have to bend over to pick up the ping pong ball as there are baskets  full of more ping pong.  Great concept. Plus four table shuffle boards and a foosball table.  Plus you're right across the street from the iconic Colonial Theater (reference The Blob).

What a great restaurant and nice change of pace from a lot of the places my wife and I go out to eat at.  I am surprised it took us this long to finally get there.  The restaurant  is tucked away off the main South Grand dining corridor on the corner of a residential street.  It's small inside with a nice bar in the front and dining room in back.  We got there at 6 trying to beat the Saturday night rush and it was already slammed, good sign I thought.  They told us it would be about 45 minutes so we ordered a couple of the local STL craft beers they have on tap.  You can tell they put a lot of thought into their craft beer list as it is one of the better bottle lists I have seen in the city.  They had 4 Hands Brown Ale, Urban Chestnut Pils, Perennial Southside Blonde and one other last night on Tap.  The bar was packed but within about ten minutes they called our name and we were sat a one of the high tops in the bar area.

The bartenders both took care of us and were extremely attentive, nice and had great food selections.  The food here is absolutely amazing.  It is kind of a refined soul fool/barbeque.  Not to refined though, slow smoked meats but they also have things like Duck Confit and many awesome looking flatbreads.  We took the waitresses 3 suggestions because we seriously would have been happy with everything on the menu.  She said the wings were probably the best in the city.  They were smoked, then deep fried, so the meat was perfect with crispy skin.  She wasn't kidding.  They were served with mango, ginger, habanero bbq sauce.  It was the perfect amount of sweet and balanced in the beginning with a little lingering spice at the end.  We went with the 1/2 baby back ribs that comes with a side.  It seemed like every plate we saw came out with their mac & cheese so we figured we had to try it.  There was a reason everyone was getting it.  Perfectly al dente, creamy cheese sauce with a baked on crust.  The ribs were absolutely fall off the bone and the second best I have ever had.  I was almost full when I started eating them so I can't wait to try them again hungry.  The rub was perfect, no sauce necessary but feel free to dip into the 3 they had on the table.  Super lean meat and the dry rub left a little kick.  We were kind of fulll because we ordered the smothered potato wedges as well and split them first.  Not something I would usually order but WOW!  Imagine a potato cut into wedges, baked to the perfect doneness, then smothered w/ a homemade white cheese sauce, slow smoked pork, bacon, baked beans and then topped with bbq sauce.  These things were amazing and a meal on their own.

We will definitely be going back to try other items and hang out at the bar.  For the price of everything, this may be one of the better values in town.  Super affordable, delicious and great beers.  Just a great restaurant and it was nice to see that they were slammed and have been open for over 3 years.  Great job!!

I was disappointed. We came because of the famous courtyard and due to a chance of rain in the forecast (skies remained clear all day) they had closed the courtyard. We also weren't aware it was buffet (our own fault) and by the time we arrived at a little after 11, the breakfast part was all being cleared away. Overall the food we had was decent. The ambiance was still nice, as was the live music and the dessert. I just personally don't think what you get in terms of quality of food is worth the money.

Randy and small staff have a hidden gem. Wide selection, always friendly and knowledgable, reasonable pricing, unbelievably low hot drinks to go price. Look,for pre-Inventory Specials! Ask for Everyday Sale Items, in the meantime. Worth diverting a trip to new neighbourhood cmpetitors. I don't know how he stays in business, but obviously it's a labour of love-and it shows. Now, how about setting up a patio?? Big enough for a Mobility Scooter, obviously. Kudos!

The best healthy and consistently great turkey burger with crispy sweet potato fries in town! Also service personnel is consistently nice even if it's just a quick take out order. My favorite place to grab a quick bite and hear some great uplifting music/go to local place that has a fun atmosphere. Thanks

Very disappointed. Finally found a chance to eat here after a very long time of trying. They have a nice happy hour for a few hours until 6:00pm where wine and other beverages are half off, and some food is half off, great deal! We came here at 5:15pm and waited 30 minutes to be seated, which was fine. The table we were finally seated at was raggedy and uncomfortable. We ended up moving inside where the ambiance was nice. Our waiter tended to our table at around 5:52, greeted us, and said that they have a happy hour which ends at 6:00pm and to order quick. He immediately left and then nobody serviced our table for over 10 minutes even though I had been flagging people down. When our waiter came back we asked if we could get the happy hour price and his response was "ooooh you just missed it. Ended a few seconds ago." Maybe we wouldn't have missed it if you looked at me waiving you down for the last 10 minutes??? That was a horrible start and I was very upset. My lamb sliders came out cold which is not a great taste for lamb. Their fries are delicious and I would recommend trying them. I was very upset with the experience and will not come back. Nice happy hour though if you don't miss it by 5 seconds after being ignored for 10 minutes.

I placed my order and was told it would be 55 minutes. 2 hours later no pizza. Absolutely rude management! Then said it would take 5 to 7 business days to reverse the charge! When the fee is posted to my credit card in seconds! I will not be ordering from that location again. My place of business is only 2 miles away!

The cooks were absolutely awful.
Food was over cook but cold.
I would never return.
The poor waiters were going around saying sorry to everyone over and over.

I'm always willing to give the benefit of the doubt and am kind but I recommend that you don't waste your time if you do business with this shop owner who identified himself as John speaking with an accent. I mention this for authenticity. 
I recently bought a bike, an expensive electric pedal assist bike to be exact, so I'm riding on my lunch and decide heading back home to stop and order a gyro, here in Seminole. I've never had a problem or an issue before but lo and behold, when I get home, looking forward to my gyro, I take a bite and there is no meat. I thought I missed it or something and open up the flaps and no meat! 
I call and they want me to drive back and I tell them I would like it to be delivered at their expense. I offer to send a photo via my cell. I eventually speak to the owner and he doesn't listen to what I have to say, he simply yells at me and accuses me of trying to scam him for a free meal and hangs up on me. He could have handled it many ways, but he was simply a jerk.

So I'm calling you out John. I am well off, respectable and don't need your charity but I say to you...may your disrespect and dishonest behavior come back to you tenfold! 8 or 9 bucks is not a big deal to me, but it's the principle of the matter now...
So...

Great pizza, friendly staff and welcomes families. I went with another family with kids and enjoyed Mama's appetizers and an extra large ham and pepperoni- delicious!

Good beer list, loud ambiance, lots of black and white pictures of dogs on the walls. But more than a little chilly... We sat on the second floor and the interior temp couldn't have been more than 60, what with the wintry draft coming up the stairs. This was the floor the kitchen was on, too.

Apparently the winter chill infected my food, because my duck pot pie came out COLD. Not hot, not warm, not even lukewarm, but solidly cold in the middle. It was the classic microwave oven problem: the dish comes out burning hot, but the food inside is still fridge temp.

This would be a 2-star review if the staff hadn't made it right, but they did: they heated my meal to an edible temperature, and offered our party an extra round of drinks--classy indeed. 

Love the 50-50 potato/sweet potato fry mix. Nice variety of comfort food. Good service, fair prices, and a small happy hour discount.

NB: Bathroom on the third floor.

Ok...here's my story. I am new to the world of tattoos and, honestly, I was a little nervous. In addition, I'm considered high risk since I take a blood thinner called Coumadin. While visiting Santa Barbara, I met Mark as he was closing up shop one evening and asked if he would tattoo someone on Coumadin. He said he would. I went back to where I was staying to think about it and do more research.  I called several other places that were not very nice when I mentioned Coumadin and basically hung up on me. I went back to Mark the next day and showed him what I wanted. He was so sweet and helpful, and really made me feel comfortable and welcome. Mark took precautions, took his time and gave me a beautiful tattoo! 5 stars to Golden Eagle Tattoo and their staff!

This studio is amazing! It has everything for every type of fitness junkie! The staff is always going the extra mile for their clients. I would highly recommend anyone who is looking to get in shape and lose inches to come check out this studio! I love you Reforming Indy!!

Tacos were pretty good but nothing to write home about. Margarita was okay, but nothing to write home about (tasted exactly like premixed jose cuervo). Service was okay, no complaints but just barely good. This place seems like a place that is never bad but also never great, just always "ok"....the prices just aren't really justifiable, even for taking into account it's broaday.

3 visits in three weeks, all of them pleasant.  Service is prompt and friendly, food is on par with any similar establishment coast to coast and the selection is generous.  I had the wings, a burger and the pulled pork sandwich and all were just fine.  The atmosphere was relaxed at the (mostly early) times I visited and the background music was not too loud. The 5 TV screens are always showing sports.

If I could give 10 stars! I would! Tasha's beautiful personality and face brought us in last night. She's a very sweet service manager! Our server Garland took amazing care of us. He was polite, and listened well. Definitely a tour guide! My friend and I are both so picky, so after explaining to him what I do and don't eat, he picked my meal for me as a game so I had no clue what I was getting. I had the crab cake and shrimp sandwich with potato salad, it was phenomenal! He also let my friend know her choice was good for her. We both left happy and full.
So tonight we swore we'd eat some where else, but we ended up right back at The Governor! The service and food last night was so good we knew we could enjoy dinner again! This time we had Ti as our server and she was so sweet and accommodating! She didn't seem the least bit annoyed at our being so picky. Garland wasn't even our server tonight but had remembered us so he stopped by our table to see how everything was, he even remembered what we'd discussed for dinner the previous night! Tasha was also here again, and made us feel at home as if we came here every night. I definitely recommend this restaurant for affordable, delicious food and quality service! FABULOUS SERVICE AND DELICIOUS FOOD!

My fiancé and I went to Shane Co. yesterday to pick out our wedding bands and some pearls to wear on my wedding. There are a few people that I try to avoid when going to get my scheduled cleanings, just because I think they're a little rude. But yesterday we found Amy and were so happy with her. We were there for over 2 hours and she happily showed us everything we wanted, even if we weren't that serious about it. She was so patient and knowledgeable. She even helped us create a pair of earrings that they did not sell. Everyone needs to ask for Amy. She was amazing!

I think the name "Fine Shaves & Cuts" speaks for itself. I have been going to Avi, one of the barbers for well over a year now and have always been more than satisfied with the results of my haircut. I am a student, so i get a discount which is helpful when you are on a tight budget. They are always flexible with scheduling and a pleasure to converse with during your cut. If you want the most for your money, definitely check this place out!!!! Located at 10th and Walnut it is easily accessible from the subway, bus or bike. Would definitely recommend to somebody looking for a reliable and quality haircut every single time!!!

We met Austin and Dara through a childhood friend while planning our wedding in 2008. Since then not only did this very loving and adorable family have become our GO TO photagraphers but good friends and great play dates. 

There quality is the best ever and you can bet that they will do what ever it takes to make picture taking for 8 hours a great experience throughout.

Seriously one on the Very best meals from all perspectives  I've had in awhile: I was so ready to snap a picture to send to my Mom- I restrained myself because no one should be tortured like that. I'm already planning to bring her here on her next visit! Secondly I asked for a box so I could enjoy it tomorrow for lunch!  Oh and let me just briefly touch base of the service welcoming, warm, and friendly. This place is easily in my top 5 places to frequent. See you next thank you for a wonderful evening.

The food at Moo Dang is fantastic, which is probably why I've gone back four times in a week. My favorites are the Pad See Ew, fish balls, and mango sticky rice, and I always make sure to have at least one of those each time. (Or all. I love food.) Definitely 5 stars for the food!

But this review isn't about the food.

Anyway, this past visit was my least favorite. Food was great, as always, but service was the worst I've had in a long time. My boyfriend and I had brought our group of friends, and we were excited to show them our ~new favorite restaurant~ in town.

We placed our orders down the table. All together, we ordered two pad see ews (one at a spice level 3, and the other at 0), a tom ka soup, a sukothai soup, drunken noodles, and a pad thai. Our waitress came back about 20 minutes later, asking us which choice of meat we wanted for the tom yum soup. We were a little confused, as no on ordered a tom yum soup. We asked if she meant the sukothai soup, and she mumbled something, and just asked which meat we wanted for the tom yum.

When our food arrived, both the pad see ews had 0 spice, so one needed to go back. We waited about 30-ish minutes for the last order of pad thai, and watched it go to three different tables before it got to us. My friend who ordered the Sukothai soup isn't entirely sure which soup he got in the end.

At the end, we split the check, and we split it by item. After thirty minutes, we get the checks back, and two of them were split wrong. We stopped caring, paid, and left.

Five stars for the food, 2 for service :( I hate giving less than 3, especially to my favorite restaurants, but we just had an awful time with the service.

it took me 35 minutes to get a sampler, which im pretty sure they microwaved and then had sex with. not sure, cant prove it, but im positive. the entire wait staff seemed as if they were active drug addicts. the one woman told me she had been sober for 3 months and was 6 months pregnant! not something i want to be told while im eating at your establishment. also it smells like a refugee camp in the bathroom. never eat here and if you allow your children to, well then may god have mercy on your soul.
