BBB was quick, good food, fair service and a friendly environment. We joined the waitlist and had to check in by 11:10 with an estimated seating time of 11:31. We were sat at 11:35 which it totally fair. Our waitress was very friendly but not attentive, after she took our order we didn't see her again until she brought our check. Someone else brought our food out and my dad ordered milk with his food which we never got. The food was good, but not great. I had the breakfast crumble, it had a tomato gravy with diced tomatoes... it was a big overwhelming. It was also supposed to be served over grits, there were probably two bites of grits. All the food was good portion sizes and the prices very reasonable. I won't go running back but would try again.

I'm not in Fairmount too often but I was in neighborhood yesterday, so I popped in here for brunch (they were doing it all day from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.). We were seated right away in the cozy bar room - dark wooden bar, exposed brick, and bottles and bottles of whiskey. I ended up ordering the mussels, which was served in a white wine sauce with shaved brussel sprouts and chunks of whitefish. I've never had mussels the size of these - they were gigantic! After hearing the daily omelette featured house-made lamb sausage, we couldn't resist and ordered that as well. Their omelettes are served with an adorable hash brown cake, which is kind of like a shredded potato croquette. Although their chic cocktail list looked enticing, I opted for a great pilsner from the quaint Neshaminy Creek Brewing in Bucks County. 

Lemon Hill is a very elegant gastropub tucked away in a more residential section of Fairmount. Places like this that are off the beaten path tend to offer a good representation of the neighborhood. After my visit to Lemon Hill, I'll be sure to visit Fairmount more often.

We went Saturday morning for breakfast. My fiancé, who has a service dog and I were all there. We walked in, and the hostess (semi tall, Caucasian girl with short hair and glasses, in case management is reading) asked us if we wanted to sit outside or inside. We chose outside due to Tucson being 100 degrees and Mt. Lemmon being around 75. 

We were told that our service dog (a corgi) might scare some people, so instead of being offered one of the two open tables we were told we had to sit at either the bar or the "lounge area" which was 4 lounge couches and a table in the center.  While we were not denied service, we were not treated according to ADA and felt discriminated against.

We choose the bar, which was the wooded deck. No bugs and a view of the humming birds. So that was a plus. Order was taken right away, but 15 minutes later our waitress tells us the pancakes my fiancé ordered, they were out of pancake mix. She had to order French toast. This took an additional 20 minutes before we got food.

We ate, check and our credit card were taken in a good amount of time, but then we waited. And waited...and waited. it took them over 10 minutes to run my credit card, with no apology for the delay. 

The waitress who said she would "make it up" to us for not having pancakes, did nothing to make it up for us.

Rentwell has done an excellent job managing my property. I live out of state and they keep us updated on everything we ask. We really enjoy working with Rob and he does a wonderful job keeping everything in order.

Went with the usual lunch group -- with a coupon. That didn't hamper the service we got in this linen-clad dining room at LUNCH time.

Lovely traditional dishes. Great salads. Everybody loved their dishes.

Upon leaving, we got a coupon for a complimentary bottle of wine on next visit.

They're a great bunch who's glad you came and is happy to serve you!
Good food at a great price. Scallop risotto is fantasticThe wait staff is great and the bread...

Reservation for 6 on a Saturday night. Service was very good. Caesar was great. Out of all the meals on our table, eggplant parm and cioppino seemed to be the winners. I would absolutely go back for the Caesar as a meal with protein choice on top, probably shrimp for me.

Garbage! I seriously don't understand how people can still go here and enjoy a meal. I haven't been there in years and when I finally go back it's even worse than before. Never going back there again. The salad was good but it was a damn salad, who can eff up a salad lol. I don't know what the hype is about the breadsticks. The pasta I ordered was stuck together and the sauce watery. I ordered a white sauce and hubby ordered a red sauce pasta with shrimp. I took a bite out of his and idk how even even managed to eat half, the sauce was watery and tasteless and the amount of meat they put into the dish is a rip off. Will never be going back. It was a waste of time and money.

Lame lame lame. Overpriced overpriced overpriced and not worth being overpriced. Service is mediocre the owner seems sweet but all about making a profit. It's cool to have gluten-free and healthy alternatives but not at a more than Whole Foods price. The atmosphere is certainly cute but again everything is way overpriced and you're not experiencing tremendous flavor experience for the price.

Oh goodness, I'm following around Emily Y.  

Wait...  I went here with Emily Y.  :)  

Rustic Thai, home styled cooking with decorations laden with country style thai accents.  The obligate portrait of the King is present, as well as bamboo structures recalling another time and place.

The food that we enjoyed on our visit were competently executed, but without any striking highlights.  I fear that my palate is becoming increasingly jaded... and nowadays, I'm still looking for that epicurean epiphany of flavour.  None here... but I left sated nonetheless.

4/5 particularly with attention to context.

The Mango Tree is truly a little Central Avenue gem! The food is always fresh and delicious. The sushi chefs are meticulous at presentation and I have to admit it certainly pays off.  My biggest hangup is that the menu is sooooo big. Not physically of course, but long and cumbersome. I think this is something sushi/Japanese/Asian restaurants get sucked into because there is an effort to appeal to many tastes. 

Pro-tip: Sit at the sushi bar and go off menu if it's slow. Tell the chef what you like and let him work his magic. Omakase style!

The food was absolutely amazing! Our server Freddie H was attentive , offered assistance on picking out items on the menu and was very kind. I got the skinny tex mex and pancakes and my friend got the French toast. Everything was yummy. We used the Yelp waitlist which was EVERYTHING. Saved so much time. *Note everyone in your party must be there to be seated!*

I can recommend the Sunday brunch at Parkshore Grill. They have both outside seating (good people watching here or a nice place to bring your dog) and inside. The restaurant is pretty inside and based on the awards on the wall, they have been successful in gaining positive critics reviews for several years.

I used OpenTable to make our reservation, which I find makes sure you get a good table. We sat inside because it was windy, but they accommodated my request for a table near the window.

The brunch menu included about 10 items. The prices range from $10 for blitzes on up to around $15 for a meat-based item. My friend ordered the banana brioche french toast and really liked it. The dish came with a small bottle of real maple syrup. She said she enjoyed her "sugar hit". I had an item off the lunch menu - the portabella stack with a side of fries. The portabella stack was very good with chopped sautéed portabella, tomatoes, goat cheese and balsamic vinegar redux all served over some water cress. It was very good. The fries were so-so in that they were not crisp. I was hoping for something closer to the Belgian frites, which are always very hot and crisp. I think they could work on their fries. 

They offer Bloody Marys and Mimosas for $5 each. The Mimosas were made with what appeared to be fresh orange juice and were good.

Parkshore Grill offers a few small dessert options for $3. We did not have one, but I hope to try that next time.

Parking is either valet or find a space on the street. On Sunday, some on-street spots with the meters are free. Other spots that do not have a meter are only good from 2 hours, even on Sunday.

This restaurant looked clean and had clean rest rooms. Check out the health department review of any Florida restaurant at the website link, below:

myfloridalicense.com/wl1...

With all the hype around this place, I was very disappointed.  And maybe if I would have known better what I was going into, I could've lowered my expectations.

Let's start with the atmosphere... or lack there of?  I hardly call a yard strewn with loose #2 stone, old school bus seats, and various wire spools for either tables to seats an atmosphere.  At least compact the stone so it's easier to walk on - it was as bad as walking through sand on the beach.  I get that it's off the Monon, but it doesn't need to look like it was created with remnants from the build of the Monon.  And that's just the outside.  I can't even describe the inside - it's like they were desperate to create a hole-in-the-wall place in Carmel.  If that was the goal, then NAILED IT!

Next, service.  There was no server, so you had to go to the bar.   And there was one bartender.  So, slow.  And the beer was nothing to get excited about, at least when we were there.  I get that the selection rotates, though, so maybe it was just a bad week?

Maybe people look for this type of 'atmosphere' if they're on the Monon, but it's lacking any reason to go otherwise.  Or for me, any reason to go back.

This is a really Hong Kong style duck restaurant.  I usually get the duck and noodle soup.  I love the fact that I see roasted ducks all over the restaurant.  It reminds me of growing up and going to Chinatown in Washington DC (which is pretty much non-existent now).  I tried the other Sang Kee Restaurants in Wynnewood and University City, but they were just passable Americanized copies of the real McCoy.  Stick with Chinatown Sang Kee and you will be happiest!

I've come in twice now.  There is NEVER anyone else in the store.

The product line feels very dated to me, certainly conservative.  Don't come in looking for anything with bright colors because their hues tend to gravitate towards the bland - I mean neutral.  Can't just seem to bring myself to get enthused about Orvis.

The service here is great. I was very happy that there are some very delicious options for vegans and I was able to bring my carnivorous friends who also had a great meal. The spinach saag (the only dish I can have being vegan and gluten free) is out of this world. 4starts because I've been there 5 times and the sometimes the dish is different

Have been here for breakfast and dinner.  Both are excellent.  Service is fast and the full bar is well stocked.  They make some of the best Michiladas I've had....and they're huge!  Great selection of flavors...pick just about anything, you can't go wrong.  Prices are excellent and servings are huge.

We were disappointed in the service today from a female employee. Don't know her name but she was the only one working on Saturday, February 27, 2021 at  4:42 pm when we ordered a latte. She acted like she didn't want to be there. Quite unfriendly. Took the  coffee order and asked my first name. to put on the cup. We sat at the table closest to the cash register and espresso machine. She never told us she finished or called my name. Finally, I went down the hall to the side of the espresso machine area and saw the cup sitting there. The coffee was cold by then. We had seen her moving pastries and doing other things and looked at us sitting at the table. Not a word from her that the coffee was done. My wife told her it was cold. Then she made another one that was scalding hot. We think she did it on purpose. My wife and me both wore American Flag covid-19 masks. It's possible that she is a woke liberal venting her anger. Never going there again. We had been going there for years. Oh well. There are plenty of coffee places in town.

This is such a great addition to Philly's cafe scene! I've been here twice so far and I love it. The owner made me "the Pop" which is a carefully prepared toast with artisanal meat of your choice. As he meticulously prepared it he told me it was looking like a garden on a piece of bread and it definitely did! It was piled generously high with fresh sautéed kale and mushrooms. The flavor was incredible, something about how the meat and mustard harmonized with the sautéed veggies was magical. The drip coffee here is solid too, not at all bitter. 

I went back a week later and got "the Lewey" which included poached apples and cranberries atop meat of your choice. I love that the meats are carefully selected and crafted locally. 

I haven't gotten much by way of specialty coffee drinks here but I'm really floored by the concept of super fancy/tasty open faced sandwiches at a cafe! 

Environment was super nice, the place has lots of seating and is really cozy even when it's an absurdly cold day. I will be back often!

Mango's Cafe serves delicious food. It's a must try. I had the basil pasta w/ a side salad. My husband ordered a steak burrito. He has also ordered their chicken in the past and says it's one of the best! We both enjoyed our meal. Maria the owner is very nice and welcoming.

I would stay away from this company. If you ever hear about contractors trying to pull one over on you this is the type of company those people are talking about.

One of the best dining experiences I've had in a while.  Food is delicious,  health conscious and priced well.  Their menu changes every three months to keep up with what's in season.  Server was phenomenal, could not have been nicer! Will definitely return!
This place is alright, overpriced for the quality of food you get and beer is pretty expensive too, I had a burger which wasn't too bad but the quesadilla's my mom got where just ok.

i love friday's in general.  it has a great menu & i have definite favorites (cajun shrimp & chicken pasta, pot stickers, nachos, green bean fries, sizzling chicken & cheese, to name a few) & i also worked there in my early 20s.

so my boyfriend & i went just yesterday & sat in the bar area.  we enjoyed a couple drinks & i wasn't very hungry so i thought i'd just do soup.  i hadn't tried the french onion (always used to have the broccoli cheddar) so i went for that.  he decided to start with the endless apps for $10 & got a burger/fries to go after.

first off, the endless app thing is per person.  i told our waitress i had a stomach issue & was just going to try a bite of what he ordered & she let it slide so i was not charged to share with him (also, when she came by she could tell i was not lying, i had one meatball & one pot sticker).

OH MY GOD.  the MEATBALLS.  where the HELL did those come from?!  i wanted to eat 40 of them but i couldn't.  they were incredible & not what i was expecting from a mid-level chain.  pot stickers were also as good as always!  & i actually really liked the french onion soup!  i had some elsewhere a couple months ago & there was SO much bread that i literally had no broth left.  i LOVE soup so i want my actual SOUP, not bread soaked with it.  this one was the perfect ratio.

i don't know how more people don't enjoy friday's.  our server was cool, food was great, drinks were what i wanted, walls are always fun to look at...maybe i'm biased haha.
We love the atmosphere, the food, the service, the owner is a doll, and did I say the staff is so nice!  Thank you!

Alcazar is worth the slightly higher cost than what you normally expect from a tapas bar. Lana is an angel server, and I would highly recommend the passionfruit mojito, french gimet, and the champiñones. 

Also to help with the bill, coupons for half off a tab of $30-40 can usually be found at places like nightout.com, which is a great incentive to give the place a try to see for yourself why it deserves 5 stars.

I just moved to the area.  I find this store EXTREMELY convenient. They also recently extended their hours to 12am on weekdays. 

When its 11pm and u need toilet paper, juice, snacks, AND a lightbulb... You'll be glad this place was here & open. 

The staff has always been friendly-ish.  But they are young and I really only expect them to tell me where to find _____.... And ask "Credit or debit?"

I dont know what these other reviewers want from a neighborhood drugstore, but for me I want late hours, well lit, safe, and nearby.  
This Rite-Aid does all of those very well.  
(Now pls sale alcohol too!!!)
:-)

I love Minado. For a sushi buffet in the suburbs, it is amazing and gives you such a good variety of sushi and all other Asian foods. The sushi buffet is only a part of the total buffet, as they have a selection of other hot Asian foods, cold Asian foods and even an udon noodle bar! They also have a great dessert selection with some of the best matcha flavored soft serve I've ever had. 

They have the best deal during lunch time, which is somewhere around $20 per person to eat the all you can eat buffet. The only time I would go to the dinner buffet and have it be worth it is knowing that they have some higher quality stuff so they'll charge more, like raw oysters and maybe more sashimi options. Otherwise, I love going to Minado for sushi buffet, you just have to be prepared to eat!

Not as pleased as I used to be. Food is still very good but they would only serve the tuna and salmon as a roll. I wanted it as either sashimi or nigiri. Would have paid a bit more. Will not support a restaurant that can not cater to customer requests. Will not return.

I'm soooooo glad this place is so close to my home. This is my new go-to place. The people are super friendly and the food is FRESH and FABULOUS! I had the Falafel "Cheese" burger that I split with my husband, it's HUGE. The flavor was OUTSTANDING and the texture was perfect. I also bought a kale, spinach, pineapple, and mango smoothie. 

If you love fresh, delicious, and vegan/vegetarian options close to home with friendly service, look no further. I can't wait to try the rest of the menu. 

Thank you for making QUALITY food for our community!

Stopped in for take out. Incredibly friendly server. I ordered the half Greek Salad( potato salad on side) and half Spanakopita (Greek spinach pie). A savory pastry filled with chopped spinach, feta cheese, onions and seasoning. Large, packed with flavor. Enough for two meals. Also ordered traditional Gyro for Hubby. Came with amazing tasting sweet potato fries. Loved them. He wasn't too crazy about Gyro. Ate half. He liked the potato salad though. Will go back to try other dishes. Prices are moderate. Interior is nice. Fun sayings all over the walls. Need to check out the specials for the day.
I tried their sushi for lunch and that tasted like the leftover from yesterday .

Clean! Friendly staff! Great prices. 

This is the best nail place I've found in the area. They actually sterilize the equipment and use plastic liners in the pedicure tubs. It's $20 for the express pedi and $12 for a regular mani. Good color choice, clean bright space with free snacks and water. Very accommodating for parties. Hope this place stays in business!!!

Cheese Curds? Yes please! Enjoyed a quick lunch today at Culver's. The best thing on the menu? The cheese curds and the cement mixers. Yum-O! Peanut butter fans...get a cement mixer with peanut butter AND butterfinger mixed in! DE-LI-CIOUS...I'm through!!  Everything else is typical fast food fair.

I used to go to Crabby's a lot but I have  but stopped when I had trouble due to physical limitation. I started getting take out from LuLu's, they were always so nice to me there! but getting there was hard. Now I found them on Door Dash OMG! I took a chance and ordered!  It was fantastic. I kept waiting for one of the Seafood places on the beach to get on with Bite Squad. (Grub Hub doesn't deliver to the beach). Especially when I found out the food was coming from the IRB location.

The food was the best I think I ever had at Crabby Bills, I had Fried Grouper and a side of peel and eat shrimp. Amazing! Thanks Crabby's for teaming up with a delivery company. It arrived Hot and Fresh, as well the driver was friendly too!

My wife and I came here for dinner on a Friday night. The ambiance is nice. Cozy and romantic. Definitely enjoyed the live music that was going on. We came for an early dinner so the restaurant wasn't all that packed yet. I'm sure it would've been great. The wait staff was awesome. We were looked after very well and they did everything they could to take care of us. Food was decent. My wife got the special of the seafood ravioli. A bit on the salty side. Overall, I'd come back again here. It'd be a good place to bring a family too.

This Dunkin doughnuts location has to be the worst in the city. My coffee order is always wrong the bread is sometime stale and this morning the sandwich guy had not arrived. When I tried to place an order for something else I was told three more times that the sandwich guy had not arrived. When I tried to ask a question I was told once again that the Sandwich guy had not arrived. I will not be back!

My fiancé and I shopped around a handful of diamond and jewelry places around Nashville. We were more interested in quality above anything else and had our fun encountering many many different personalities who catered to us (or at times, didn't). I noticed that many shops tried to sell us the ring in whole, when what I really wanted was to be able to handpick the diamond and the setting. We researched different metals, setting types, sizing, and everything I could get my hands on to learn how to choose a diamond that worked for me.

Then we met with Patricia here and it clicked. She sat us down and patiently went over EVERYTHING that satisfied our curiosity. It was so refreshing that she took the time not only to help us pick out a diamond and a setting, but to educate and share what she knew about the industry, which she has a ton of experience in. (I may be misremembering, but I believe she worked with the GIA.)

I learned a lot from her during our first visit. From there, we shared what we were looking for in terms of our preference on the 5Cs (cut, clarity, color, etc.) so she could pick one out. We connected again not too long after and checked out what she found for us. I decided on a diamond and setting that day during our second visit.

Fast forward to my fiancé proposing - yay, yay, tears were shed, congratulations were made - and our engagement as we planned our wedding. I opted for a matching wedding band and OF COURSE wanted the same quality of product and service we experienced before. Since I am moving out of state, and our wedding is taking place elsewhere, I emailed Patricia put in an order so I could get the ring in before I leave this summer.

Then COVID-19 hit and slowed things down. Luckily, their store was able to remain open since they are also considered a financial institution from having inherited a pawn licensure. This made them even more accessible in light of the pandemic, all of which I was relieved to see that they've also taken great measures to ensure that the space was safe for visitors (it's not a space for a large number of visitors to begin with). The nice thing about their storefront is that it's more of an intimate one where you can sit across from the seller at tables to go over your options, not one where you have to do everything standing up at the counter.

I just picked up my wedding band today and it looks just as gorgeous as my e-ring. David, the owner, was also there. I've met him in passing a couple of times, one of which he assisted in submitting a change to the size of my wedding band when I wasn't sure about how it would fit with my e-ring.

They were spot on from start to finish. Patricia is a gem, literally. She remembers everything in our conversations and picks right back up from where we last left off. I am so excited because I have a really, really shiny diamond that takes little effort to glow in any space. I love getting compliments on it, one time in a dark Lyft even (lol), so I know we made the right choice.
Call any other pool company. Nightmare. Dug the first shovel of dirt on June 8th and finally installed the fire bowls on November 19th.
Absolutely wonderful place! Friendly staff, DELICIOUS bagels (the bagel and lox is my personal favourite), and amazing coffee! What else could you ask for?

I went here with some friends and I would recommend this place for some great drinks. They have some unique cocktails and cordials. But I was disappointed in the food.  It was just bland and nothing exciting.  The service was pleasant but it didn't make the food any better. Come here if you're looking for a variety of booze but don't come hungry.

Benny was excellent. From the beginning he made me feel very comfortable. Extremely knowledgeable and professional. The session was very painful but 100% effective. Benny mentioned I needed a few more sessions but my neck a back already feeling much better. 
I will go back to him again.

My co-worker took me here for lunch and the food was unforgettable. SO STINKING GOOD. I had the paella and didn't leave a single piece of food on the plate. The plantain fritters are also pretty spectacular!

Staring at a drink menu listing a good variety of beers ranging from pale ales to dark stouts to select from, a slender Naomi Watts looking server by the name of Laura approaches and points out the list of rotating drafts on the wall to select from as well.  She recommends the "Funky Buddha Chocolate Milk Sout"; already I like her.  A stout with the words Chocolate and one of the greatest fat men in history combined has to be a good thing.  I order a flight of 4 including her recommendation as well as my all time go to: Yuengling, a Horchata stout, as well as the Cigar Maduro stout.  Although all were good, Laura was right.  The Funky Buddha Chocolate Milk Stout was my favorite.  It was robust like a strong coffee, but in the words of the "Zohan" (Adam Sandler reference for those unaware), it was silky smooth like milk chocolate, of course.

Okay okay for you non beer drinkers (aka "weirdos"), onto the food....I had to have looked at the food menu for a good 20 minutes not because Laura was inattentive or slow to take our orders, but because I thought everything on the menu sounded like a great idea! While I was trying to make a decision, I went ahead and ordered the fried green tomatoes with bacon tomato jam and pimento. The tomatoes were sliced to a perfect thickness.  The combination of the tomato bacon jam with the pimento enhanced the of depth of flavor of the mild green tomato. The tomato slices weren't caked in breading, but just enough crust to give it added texture and crunch.

The Apple Jack pancakes are reminiscent of a rich, decadent hot pocket.  They're thick layers of pancake folded over a creamy, sweet raspberry cream cheese.  The "pocket" is then covered in crushed Apple Jacks, fried, then sprinkled with powdered sugar and drizzled in syrup.  It's cavity inducing and on the way way other end of the diabetes friendly spectrum for sure, but oh so good! 

Then on the savory side, there's the "Melvin".  Layers of salty corn beef  and apple slaw between fried pickle chips and jalapeno cheddar bread.  There's so many things going on in this sandwich from the salty sweet of the corn beef and apple slaw to the crunchiness of the fried pickle chips and the softness of the jalapeno cheddar bread.

Lastly, the shrimp and grits with andouille sausage might have been my favorite.  They didn't skip out on picking the largest, most succulent shrimp to show case this entree with.  The roasted poblano buerre blanc sauce added a smoky element to the cheddar grits and paired well with my stout beer. My only complaint was that the sausage lacked flavor.  I was surprised after eating everything else that had so much depth of flavor. (Side note: everything is prepped and made in house.)

Service of course was excellent.  Laura was on point with her recommendations and was attentive to our needs.  I don't know who he was, but I'm assuming he was a manager by the name of Josh approached our table to make sure we were enjoying our visit.  I informed him that the only thing they needed to add or change was the fact that they didn't sell the tee shirts with the clever sayings that our lovely server, Laura was modeling.  He apologized, but a few minutes later, came back to our table with shirt in hand available for me to purchase. Thank you Josh! And thank you Laura! (I hope you get that much deserved beer!)  If I lived in the area, I'd definitely a regular. (By the way, they have another location in Trinity, but come to see Naomi Watts at this location.) This is definitely not the last time I'll dine here.  Like Arnold says, I'll be back.  I have to, so I can try the Belgium clucker (chicken and waffles), the peanut butter pie, the BLT, the sweet potato tots, the Sriacha shrimp Mac and Cheese, the peppermint chocolate cheesecake, the crab grilled cheese and lobster bisque, the other 20 beers on the rotating list, the bourbon banana pudding, the angry pig sandwich....(See why I stared at the menu for 20 minutes!)

What an adorable little restaurant this is!  Driving from Ojai back to the Santa Barbara Airport, we wanted Mexican for lunch. How lucky were we to find this one?  Yeah for Yelp!  Excellent food, good service, fantastic margaritas!  Check it out!!

I was craving for some food, drink and atmosphere from home. This place didn't disappoint. The place was packed (good sign) but they were pretty fast and the service was great. As an appetizer we ordered the Antojitos Puertoriqueños, The alcapurria was perfectly cooked (crunchy on the outside and soft in the inside) and the meat was also nicely seasoned. The empanada de carne was great and the meat had a lot of flavor. Also, the sorrullito de maiz was cooked to perfection.

For the main course my girlfriend ordered the Pechuga de Pollo with criolla sauce with a Mofongo. The chicken was very well seasoned and juicy and the criolla sauce had very good consistency. Mofongo was a little bit dry for how we usually like it but flavor was perfect with hints of garlic. The salad had a house vinaigrette and was fresh. I had the Chillo Frito Entero. Sometimes when you order this kind of plate they will overcooked the fish; that was not the case. It was cooked to perfection and with hints of lemon. As a side I had arroz con gandules and tostones. The tostones were freshly made and not frozen and the arroz con gandules was very closed to my grandmother's, give it a try! 

Drinks were also really good. The piña colada had the correct amount of sweet and I was impressed by their mojito.

We ordered Vanilla Flan for dessert. It was moist in the middle and the edges were not burnt (simply perfect). They did not charged us for the flan because they were really busy and supposedly took more than usual for the food to come out. I think the wait was ok, but what a great service! 

Finally, price is what you would except from this type of restaurant, is not on the cheap side but I've been to other similar restaurant and they are not at the same level as Rice-n-Beans.

This is probably the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. It looked like the 8 or so employees were just shuffling around trading places and only one of them was actually making drinks. I walked in and there was NO LINE and only 3 cars in the drive thru yet it still took 5 minutes of me standing directly in front of the register to have my order taken and 5 more minutes to get my drink. I ordered an iced chai! Literally scoop ice, pour milk in, pour chai concentrate, serve...and THAT took 10 minutes. 

Adding to the frustration is the fact that my nearly $5 "tall" (small) drink tasted like a glass of chai-flavored milk because there wasn't enough TEA in it. This will be my first and last trip to this Starbucks. I'll go to a gas station or drive to the Kahwa truck before I walk over to this place again.

The ambience is kinda eclectic.  There's a stuffed cougar at the bar.  A buffalo head on one of the walls on the first floor.  The bathroom is tiny!  There's an attendant who will hand you paper towels & an assortment of different liquids & solids (ranging from deodorant to antacids).  The pool tables are rented by the hour ($5 per hour).  Music is incredibly loud as is standard of most bars.  I kinda wish it wasn't that freaking loud.  Nearly made me deaf.  Smoking standard as well.  But, hey there are cops in front of the place patrolling.
The Roast Pork with Sharp Provolone is good.  Cheesesteaks are ok.

Tonight was our first time here and it wasn't good. The meat wasn't hot, the cheese was cold and fell out of the burger. Fresh jalapenos on a burger? RUFKM? Sick. Juicy Lucy's (1 block down) is way better, plus they have beer.

This is my favorite pizza place, ever. For several months, I was coming here every other week (payday!) and I almost always ordered the portabello mushroom and roasted garlic pizza....ohmyyyygod. Invariably, I stuffed down the whole thing along with a bottle of house made lemon iced tea and, when available, I'd grab a chocolate mousse, too. The crust is delicious - chewy, crispy and I love that it's always just a tad different. The crust doesn't have much salt in it, but I like that because a salty crust plus salty toppings would just be too much. I've also had the Felicia's special, which is as delicious as the portabello mushroom pizza except with spinach instead of mushrooms. And then there was a caramelized onion and prosciutto pizza...no words to describe it. Almost too delicious. I also like to get the mozzarella sticks, but I'd recommend not ordering those for take out or delivery  because they're not very good once they've cooled down. Definitely sit on the rooftop deck at least once in good weather. You'll be surprised how relaxing it is looking out over a parking lot. And be sure to have some fun with Tony - he's super friendly, very outgoing, and great for a laugh.

I ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS PLACE!!! I have been ordering from Bhan Thai almost every week because they are THAT good. The staff is very friendly and extremely knowledgeable when it comes to certain things on the menu. I love Pad Kee Mao (Drunken Noodle) and green curry. Last night I ordered fried calamari, seafoods spicy fried rice and Thai style sausages, they were AMAZING as usual! I honestly cannot name one thing I don't like about this place...

I came here for dinner tonight and had a great meal!   The waiter was friendly and attentive without being overbearing, he made some great recommendations for drinks and food items.  I started with a control state cocktail which was perfectly refreshing in the summer heat.  The waiter recommended small plates to share with each person ordering 2.  I have found that at small plate restaurants I usually over order on the waiter's recommendation so my friend and I ordered an app to share and then each ordered a plate.  We shared the mussel toast-wow.  Flavorful and delicious.  I got he shrimp and grits which was also wonderful.  I. Any wait to come back and try more things like the steak tartar.  And a bonus, the ambiance was great!

By far the best car transaction ever! The entire staff was friendly! Unlike other dealerships we've been to they didn't try to take advantage, change the price or play any games! If you're looking for a car please give this place a try!!  You won't be disappointed!!

It was almost as busy as Cafe Du Monde but had the added savory options of breakfast and lunch.  Beignets were lighter and softer/less crisp than at Cafe Du Monde and made #2 on my list (#3 was Cafe Du Monde and #1 was Bakery Bar).  They had the right amount of extra powdered sugar and you have to order them to go so they're in the bag w/ the sugar and you can shake it like shake and bake to fully coat them.  Always best eat fresh.  And yes, I ate all three.

John Snyder texted me over the last weekend and apologized for missing our appointments and not contacting me due to some unforeseen emergency. He offered to send a crew if I was still interested, which I accepted. Zack and Anthony called 30 minutes before arriving, as I had requested; they were friendly and down to earth and did not shy from many obstacles the old dishwasher set up had thrown on their laps. They had to go and get parts and came back to fix all the plumbing issues. Everything worked great and I was very satisfied with the work. John compensated me for the inconvenience by giving a discount on the fees. It was very reasonable and now I am ready to give them more plumbing jobs when needed.

What a breath of fresh air! I had Squaw passes last year, and grew tired of "the show." Living in Reno, everyone said Mt. Rose was the way to go. So, leap of faith, I bought season passes blindly-- never been. Today was the first, and it was just what i wanted: No crowds, no "dudes," solid runs, and an overall good time. Sure, Squaw has massive runs and epic trails, but really, are you ever going to catch 30 feet of air? Not me, I have bills to pay and I really like being able to breath without a ventilator. If you want to tempt the neurosurgeons, there's always the Chutes. 

Overall good place for Reno locals. Minimal Bay Area peacock action. Just ski and be happy.
it took 30 minutes for us to sit down and there were many uncleaned tables. it also took 20 minutes to get our drinks. awful costumer service.

I agree with the other reviewers that this place is hit or miss. I've been coming here for six years because I live right down the street and it's convenient. Sometimes I get a lovely tech who does a great job and other times I get someone rude who does a horrible job. Most of the male employees are actually excellent. I also learned to pick a gel color that is on display on the counter because those are the new colors and can last 3+ weeks. If you choose a color in the case, chances are that it is very old and will chip after just a few days.

Dr. Conkey and staff are wonderful.  They greet you upon arriving and leaving.  Very knowledgeable regarding insurance coverage. Complete and thorough exam every year, and we have been going for over 10 years now.

Our first time to try was today. Extremely tasty tamales. We are visitors but love trying local businesses.  This is definitely a good find and we will return. Didn't try any of the sides yet and anxious to try more of the plentiful variety. Who knew you could pick from about 20 flavor choices?!!

Great everything! We've been here many times now and everything we've tried was very good. We've even eaten at the original in Brooklyn and the ones here are close. Calzones are my favorite and there cheesecake, as well as the other desserts, are to die for.

Great dance studio for about high school age and up. She has kids classes sometimes too. Best value I've ever seen for dance lessons and best entry-point for beginners. 

There's an ongoing groupon for your first course of classes. Once you pay for a course/level (there are presently 6 levels for salsa) you are currently invited to repeat it as often as you like for free. 

Maria breaks down the steps well. I took salsa lessons in high school (so over a decade ago, I'm rusty) but level 1 taught me a lot of things I was unfamiliar with. I'm in the level 3 class now and loving it!
Drinks, pho and great service (oh my!). Always a favorite for apps and pho. Love the fruity freezes too!

Terrible service today. I stopped in, I've been here a few dozen times and love the Falafel Hummus bowl. The person behind the counter was rushing through everything like there were 20 people behind me. I finally had to ask her if she was in a hurry because I felt rushed ordering the toppings on the 2 bowls I ordered. I've felt more relaxed during the lunch rush, so, why the hurry Naf?

UPDATE:
Came in and again the server is rushing me through the line and not listening to my order. PLEASE SLOW DOWN. On my way out I picked up a menu from the place next door. Look for my review of them next week.

So we got here early didn't know the rooftop bar had a certain time it opened but we got there at 455pm and was told they didn't open up until 530 and that we could just walk around and come back at 5:20pm , which we did and they had a line, by the time the host got to us after standing in line for 13 min we're told the rooftop was full and we could only sit downstairs ...I will be damned! If they would had told us hey it fills up fast you should wait I would have, but the fact we literally left for 20 min and then to be told they were full but it was 530pm but that's the time it opened so how was it full?? Save ya coins and go elsewhere too many locations with balcony/rooftop in this city!!

Stopped in here for a quick lunch today.

Pros: 
Pleasant dining area
Clean bathrooms (other than sloppy patrons dropping toilet paper on the floor)
Decent coffee
Coffee free for seniors
Fresh ingredients

Now for the downside.

They offered a nice new healthy choice on the menu - a Mediterranean Power Salad. Ingredients listed on the menu board: grilled chicken, quinoa, hummus, feta cheese, roasted vegetables, red onion, balsamic vinaigrette (Lettuce and tomato are to be assumed, I suppose.)
What arrived (sorry, no camera with me today): A big bowl of lettuce mix with a few grape tomatoes and shards of red onion, topped with a generous amount of chicken and splashed with a very loose "hummus." A few curds of feta were spotted, a couple of flecks of red pepper, too, and a few loose chick peas and navy beans. Unfortunately, no quinoa - the SECOND item on the ingredient list. Actually, one errant grain was stuck to the side of the bowl. That's it. Two sachets of dressing appeared with the menu item, as well as a packet of croutons (another unlisted item).

Expectation: a chicken and quinoa salad.
Reality: a lettuce salad with chicken on top.

Bland overall.

Service was brusque.

I paid in cash and needed to ASK for the change from my bill.  

Wendy's Morrisville, you are way off your game.

Is staff morale poor? Is training inadequate? Is quinoa a mystery to the food preparers?

I hope these issues are solved. With a new WaWa moving into range, business is only going to become more competitive.
I love the square in the early fall, when the weather is temperate and it's quiet.
Updating to 5 stars for the cacio e pepe and salted caramel gelato. So good.

Three stars, because the omelet bar and fresh fruit at breakfast made for a decent meal in the morning. The breakfast buffet is a little pricey at $19 but this is a hotel restaurant, so that's to be expected. There's a cheaper continental breakfast buffet, but the oatmeal they had on offer was like glue. 

Lunch and dinner wasn't great. Being a vegetarian I chose the black bean veggie burger. It was just ok. The same patties you could buy at the market, a big soft bun, melted cheese, some tomato, pickle chips and some limp lettuce. Inexplicably, they put *two* veggie patties on the burger. With the fries, it's a lot of food. I have a big appetite and I can't eat that much. I took one patty off and it went to waste. For the money I'd rather have had a free dipping sauce or a little side salad. 

The burger tasted all right and the fries were good, not too greasy, but the whole meal was way too salty. I think they must dump a good amount of salt on the burger while it's grilling. Wish they'd dial it back. 

Service was friendly but occasionally confused, as when my full cups of coffee and water got bused from the table when I got up for my first trip to the buffet at breakfast!

Overall: you're in a city of amazing restaurants. Eat at Wow if you're staying at the Doubletree and convenience is the most important factor. Otherwise, there's no reason to come here!
Great atmosphere and good portions.  The meat had a little too much smoke for me but still a good meal.

How this place has 3.5 stars is beyond me, like wayyyyy beyond. The server literally yelled at me "what do you want" to ascertain my order. I travel a lot and have come to expect crappy service at airport eateries, this is no exception. Go somewhere else

Really like this new pizza place. Great pizzas and terrific delivery times! I really like their 'special' program - 1/2 price pizzas change weekly when you sign up on their website. The website isn't the most intuitive but their pizza is soooo much better than other area pizza places( Marcos, Pizza Hut or Monical's). The Eve is our new fave - who'd ever have thought broccoli and garlic and diced tomatoes on a truly crisp but "tasty" thin crust pie could be sooo good!!

I I've this restaurant!! The food is fabulous but it's also the friendly service that brings e back. They make you feel right at home and they really do care about your satisfaction  I have to keep coming back so I can try everything on the menu!

I love this local unique coffee shop! They have amazing organic food and they create some stupendous drinks. 

For example, the fire cider is a taste explosion! Complete with garlic, ginger, turmeric, jalapeño and habanero... it will get you started, grab you and shake you. Who needs caffeine to wake up when you can start a fire instead!? Try it!

Outside, they have a decorated bike from Warren, the famous Tarpon Springs @FlowerBikeMan! Check him out on Instagram! He began creating these bikes to help his wife find her way when she had memory problems. They are beautiful works of true love and now are found all around town!

My wife and I went here our first night in New Orleans, unfortunately we did not have reservations but they put us on the call list and we are so glad we did!
We had a late dinner and service was great with the exception of not being very helpful with insight on which dishes to choose.  We ended up with:

baby crab claws for an app - good but not great
blackened stuffed pork - melt in your mouth delicious with the sweet potato mash incredible
blackened Louisiana drum - great! 
sweet potato pecan pie - not memorable

The ambiance is like eating dinner in your parents kitchen but the entrees and service are definitely worth the trip.

I definitely love this place! I have been in this area approximately five years now for school and I have been wanting to try Mei's World Pizza for the longest time now! 2018 I think has been a year of really getting out of my food comfort zone and trying something new! The first time I went here with my friend she had so many recommendations I had no idea what to try but I ordered the beef noodle soup and it was out of this world!!! The beef is so soft and pairs quite well with the noodles and broth that is in the soup! I also ordered the freshly made chive and pork dumplings and I was speechless, it was so juicy and flavorful! I honestly look forward to the next time I go, I want to try the pizza which I have been eyeing each time I go. If you are looking for a wonderful hole in the wall place built into the fabric of this community, definitely give this place a try! You will not be disappointed!!

This place is ok I mean I went on a Sunday so I really can't give a thorough review. I can say the food is good, well from what I had and it was just chicken fingers. I can't rate the drinks because I'm a shot girl, that's all I buy. What I don't like about this place is that I couldn't enter with a white shirt on. I have never been to a bar where I couldn't wear a white shirt. I can understand hoodies or white beaters but a regular white shirt ? You have to be kidding me. Luckily my cousin had a shirt I could put on in her car. I understand ppl run their businesses how they want but come on, what's bad about a white shirt? I think I won't return ..

Nectar offers a great twist on traditional Mexican food. The portions are fair for the price. Ordering is a bit funky with the register being up front, yet the servers bring out food and check on your table. I think it would be better for the servers to take the orders so they don't get jipped on tips. 

Steak and cheese torta was really good. Cheesy, ooey, gooey, full of skirt steak and came with chips and salsa. 

Pastor tacos were good in flavor. My only suggestion would be to serve on a fresh tortilla. Those prepackaged tortillas are just too dry and bland. 

Mexican street corn has excellent toppings, but the corn kernels were a little overcooked for my liking. 

The atmosphere is top notch. They have backyard games and picnic benches if you want to hang outside. 

I'll definitely be back to try more!

First time here. 

Pros:   it's large and has a lot of TVs

Cons:   Service is meh.  The drinks are slow.  The food is WAY slower.  I ordered two appetizers and they took forever and came out ice cold.  No one checked on me to see how the good was.  So I sat with cold food forever.  

I will never come back.

After years of wanting to try The Melting Pot I have finally done it. It was a nice surprise that they had their Devour Menu going the same time I was there. The restaurant is very clean, appealing, and overall attractive when you first arrive. I was seated in a round booth facing a window which was really nice. It was really secluded and you barely remember you're at a full restaurant with several other people. 

The first course was the cheese fondue and we chose the spinach and artichoke! It was amazing and very filling! 

The second course I ordered the surf and turf, which was chicken, steak, and shrimp. This is where I understand when people say "it's an experience". They bring you your meat and veggies raw and you cook it in oil and seasonings you have chosen. So, It could take you a while to finish your second meal just depending on how quickly you cook your food. I wonder if people ever complain about raw chicken? 

The third course was the chocolate fondue and I mean honestly what could I say here besides it was delicious! There was one strawberry that was rotten on our plate which made me think they probably have several of the plates pre-made in the refrigerator. But nothing I would dock them on. Hey, quick food service is still quick food service. 

My only tip is come here hungry because I was stuffed before the dessert and I am not sure how left overs work here. I also would make sure you have at least an hour and half to enjoy the full three course meal experience. 

Cheers!

I think a more accurate score would be 3.5 stars. I'd say the ambiance is better than the actual food. The space is great with seating and two bars downstairs as well as additional seating and a third bar upstairs. We ordered the octopus, the 14 1/2 pizza, and the braised pork pasta dish. Our favorite was the pasta, but the octopus and pizza were just alright. For the price, I was expecting the food to be better. The atmosphere was laid back for a Friday night, but it seems like the space has the potential to get more energetic as their is a ton of room. If I came back it would definitely be for drinks, not good. Definitely a cool spot to meet up with some friends for drinks before going out.

I was recently in New Orleans for Jazz Fest and came across Trashy Diva after reading reviews on Yelp of various stores. I was specifically looking for different, unique, locally owned boutiques and found the perfect one. I decided I must check out Trashy Diva in the French Quarter before my 6 hour drive back to Houston....and ended shopping only in the Trashy Diva dress store after finding the CUTEST dresses!.

First off, I love that as soon as I walked in I felt like I was in a combination of a vintage store (without the vintage smell), a Diane von Furstenberg boutique because of the prints, a Betsey Johnson shop with the touch of funkiness, with a tad of Tucker mixed in...yet, it was a local owner in the New Orleans French Quarter, a lovely sales girl, with prices half as much as the designers mentioned!


As I browsed around getting excited about all the cute clothes, a lovely redheaded sales girl, Rachel was her name I believe, was so sweet, helpful, knowledgeable, with a great love for the clothes. I actually heard her say to herself how much she "loved her job"...how often do you hear that? 
And after coming from a high-end retail background of over 10+ years, including managing a Barneys New York Co-Op, it was so great to have fantastic customer service in a great shop where the products didn't start at the amount of a mortgage payment.

I tend to have trouble finding dresses because of my body shape & bust, never find cute structured dresses, and I felt like I struck gold when I started looking around.
Trashy Diva not only had sizes from 0-18 in stock, but the entire store was reasonably priced for well made items in cute quality fabrics. Most of the dresses I look at were in the $100-200 range which is hard to come by for well made clothes and unheard of in designer owned boutiques. 

Anyone who knows rarely sees me in dresses since I'm a jeans & tee/blouse kinda gal, but these dresses were too flattering to pass up. 
What's also awesome about these dresses is that not only can I see a preppy girl with pearls and pumps wearing one to a garden party or brunch, but I can easily see the tatted up rockabilly gal with black blunt bangs, red lips, hitting her favorite dive bar in one too.

I noticed she had the same several styles/cuts in different prints which is good to know *when* I order more dresses online. The designer is brilliant to keep the styles consistent and just change up the prints from season to season...that way I know exactly what style works for me, and I can just order that in different colors going forward.

I could have easily left with several dresses, but I ended up with 2; the "Audrey" dress and a "Sweetie" dress from the new collection that the sales gal pulled from the back just for me to try...talk about going above and beyond!

I didn't go into the Trashy Diva lingerie or shoe store next door since I already did enough damage, but I am so excited they have an online store, I will absolutely be back to Trashy Diva next time I'm in NOLA, and I'm already thinking of when and where I'm wearing my new dresses!

Lastly, I would love to commend Candice Gwinn, the owner and designer of Trashy Diva, on making well made, adorable, relevant, great fitting dresses at an accessible price!

We arrived at Pizza World tired and hot after a long day of moving and driving from NC.   We were greeted with a smile and recommendations.  Then they provided a coupon and a military discount.   We were SO appreciative.   The pizzas were REALLY good!!!  If we lived in the area,  we would be back again and again.   Thank you for supporting military families and for being a lovely highlight in our day!!!

Why is this place not more crowded? Granted, it is kind of expensive - our lunch for 2 people came to $100. We split one app and one entree, had two rounds of drinks, plus dessert. Service was great, location is great. Food was good, not exceptionally great, but you are paying for the location (and I guess the great service).

I highly recommend Carl.  He submitted an estimate promptly, then arrived punctually and finished the work quickly.  He returned for a followup as one of the latches did not work properly.  He was helpful and explained to me what was going on (I like to DIY!).  He is very professional and, although I hope I do not need to (!), I would hire him again without reservation.

Well the location was good but hearing an announcement to evacuate the hotel via the stairs was not a good start to our stay. Daily problems with housekeeping and some days the room was not cleaned till 4 pm. To add to this the housekeeping discarded as trash a bag containing all our purchases from the French Quarter. Ugh.

Muriel's continues to be one of my favorite places in NOLA.  

The location is awesome... The staff is friendly and the food is always great.

Ask for a tour of the upstairs... very cool!

I don't get to Dunedin often but this will definitely be a repeat spot to stop! I got the open-faced pulled pork sandwich with beer cheese dip and potato salad for lunch. Sooo delicious! My mom had a burger and said it was cooked perfectly. Great service as well, our waiter was super witty and polite.

Stumbled on this place while strolling down Royal street Christmas evening! 

SO GLAD we came. They said 35 min wait for 2 at around 6:30 but ended up being much faster. By the time we were seated the wait for all tables was at least an hour which made me wonder if the food was all that good??

Delicious! Ordered the Rockefeller oysters shrimp platter and a sampler of étouffée, jambalaya, and gumbo.

Shrimps  in the platter we're HUGE! Tastely breaded and fried to golden perfection. Also the hush puppies and fries were superb!! The cole slaw was heavy on the mayo but and also had apple added in the slaw.

CrAw fish Étouffée was soooooooo delicious the sauce everything about it was lip smacking good! Would come back and order the étouffée dish for sure.

Oysters were very tasty and topping was excellent. Would recommend this as we saw all tables with copious orders of oysters. 

Crowded and a little loud but it added to the authentic atmosphere

Service- good!!

Everything about this place is great. The people are super nice and friendly, the prices are low, and to top it off it's the best dry cleaning I've ever had in Indiana. The lady upfront is always smiling and cheerful. Not to mention her nails are always amazingly beautiful. 
I come here for all my hand wash that I would normally do at home because of the convenience, price, staff, and location. Zip cleaners is a great addition to the neighborhood. I frequent this place at least once a week. Thank you for being here.

This is such a special place. The bread is the best you'll ever have. Not to mention everything is vegan. It feels like a little French cafe where everything is made with care. Have been going here for years-highly recommend.

We went there for lunch from recommendation of people.  The older man i assume is the owner can't seem to get things right!  He takes so long in taking our orders.  He seems so unsure of what to do and the food.  Our food took forever.  When we ask about our food he keeps telling us a few minutes.  But we never got it.  It took over 20 min to get our food  We will not be going back.

I noticed even more small touches here. I love it and highlight it because it shows they truly care about the user experience. They have a full length mirror and hand lotion in the bathrooms and phone chargers outside.

Once in a while a special occasion rolls around and it is time to reward Ms T for putting up with me.  This time it was for a special birthday.  I took her shopping at Michael Genovese.  She is not a heavy jewelry wearer but this was our sixth visit and purchase in the 10 years since we first went in.

This is a very good jewelry store with great people.  She had wonderful assistance from Elizabeth and Norma.  Elizabeth provided most of the assistance and was extremely helpful.  Since we don't make these purchases every day, we need the help.  Norma came in to consult, provide support and confirm the choices. We have dealt with Norma on our previous visits and she is always great.

Because of the experiences we have had, when it is time to shop for jewelry, there is no other place for us to go.  I'm sure you can find cheaper places, but I have never spent as much as I expected going in and the purchases continue to earn "Diamond Lil" plenty of compliments.  The quality has been excellent and they won't push things that you don't want.

Service can be slow if there are only 2 people working the line, especially since the person you order the meats from has the unenviable task of quickly weighing the meats. 

Anyway, I think the food is good- much better than other BBQ I have tried in the area. I have always gotten the fancy pork sandwich and then added a cup of the original BBQ sauce on top since it's a bit bland without it. If you don't mind waiting about 10-15 minutes for your food, it's worth it. Each meal comes with free ice cream, if that's a draw for you. 

One thing that bothers me is that they only offer reusable cups for drinks. We've been here several times and keep forgetting our cups so we now have a whole stash at home.

Staff is great !!! Can move easily between units!!! Maintenance requests are handled in a timely fashion!!! Best leasing company I have had in Santa Barbara in the 6years I have rented here!!!! Ask for Ava @beach city she will help you with all your rental needs!!! Legit the best!!!

I hate to say this I think it's overrated. Don't get me wrong was food was good & our server was great but I personally I was expecting more. Still go & experience if you'd like but you won't be blown away. Sorry!

THIS IS NOT A REVIEW OF THEIR FOOD.

I'm giving this place a one star review on their business practices. Came up to Reno with a friend for the weekend. She found this place on yelp that had good reviews for food so we decided to go here for lunch. When we arrived in Reno on Friday at 2 we went here for lunch but they close from 2-5. So we decided to come back Saturday for lunch and there was a sign on the door saying they were closed today. The hours sign was gone and we did not see any sign on the door Friday mentioning they would be closed Saturday nor was there an explanation on why they were closed Saturday afternoon when we went. Saturday evening we passed by here and they were open. This place needs to realize they are a business and needs to put accurate notification on their doors. Because of this, no matter how good their food might be my friend and I will not be coming here.

The check-in was quick and friendly.  I was welcomed back since I had stayed there before. My room was quiet and away from noisy areas (elevator and ice).  I never heard a peep from other guests.  I used the pool and spa and both were a nice temperature and well kept-up. 
The breakfast area is spacious and quickly restocked to keep up with the large number of airport travelers.  I had two small issues:  the A/C went through some noisy cycles during the night, and when I tried to reheat something in the microwave, the microwave itself started to smoke.  
With free spacious parking, free wi-fi and free breakfast, this place really is a good deal.

My sick dog was taken to AVS by rolling pet ver. I have to say I felt I was financially taken to the cleaners. There was no other option they literally wanted to put my dog to sleep if I wouldn't pay a close to  $2000 bill. We complained and got the charge reversed by our credit company. I think some of the vets there are decent but the ones we dealt with were not. As far as I'm   concerned.
Today my dog is strong, happy, healthy a joyful pet. The experience we had  AVS was one of the worst ever. In my opinion we need kinder less expensive quality after hours emergency pet care in Santa Barbara.

This place is horrible. I'm not sure I saw a single employee without a scowl on their face. 14 dollars for fish and chips, 14 for fried shrimp. The shrimp were inedible. We saw our waiter 3 times the entire time. Just as a side note - take it as a subtle clue when a restaurant says the will not serve their hamburgers any way other than well done. I hardly ever give one star. This place is weak. Eat anywhere on Hampton Ave before you get stuck in this tourist trap.

Pop in here for an impromptu dinner with friends post OutFest. Nothing too special about the food. We ordered Turkey Burgers and Fried Green Tomato Salad. The drinks were perfect, the hostess was amazing but the shining star for us was our server Emily. She's a very laid back, down to earth, wish she could have sat and enjoyed the meal with us kind of lady. We loved how personable and attentive she was. If we decide to venture back we'll make sure Emily is working. You could have meh food but a cool server can make it an awesome experience...

The "archer" sandwich is absolutely delicious. It has portobello mushrooms, swiss cheese,  sauteed onions,  and a special sauce on toasted wheat.  Their desserts are divine too.  From sweet to savory, you can't go wrong at Everything Dolce.

Ugh.  I really wanted to like this place.  But finding good Sushi here is just straight hard.

I tried 3 different rolls, super crunchy, one with yellowtail and one with tuna.  None of them tasted good.  I pulled the fish out and tasted it on its own and it was okay.  The rice tasted off and it tainted the whole flavor of the sushi.

First time my kids have ever said they didn't like sushi...  :(

We love to dine in here for authentic Chinese food. It gets great selection from seafood, szechuan dishes to noodle soups and dim sum. Dine in here is like a combination experience of many other restaurant in Chinatown. So whenever you feel unsure about what Chinese restaurant to go to, you can consider here. And -- they even get karaokes!

The food would have been okay, had it not been obviously sitting in the kitchen for quite some time. This happens EVERYTIME, I'm at this specific Chili's. Seriously, this just makes the food look even more unappetizing. Service is terrible on multiple occasions. 

I only go when my friends force me. At least it's open late but I'd much rather eat somewhere else.

I was skeptical about going to an auto auction - even with the pre-auction preview and research you can get burned with a major engine or transmission issue.  I purchased a car in the auction and expected to take it in for several hundred dollars in repairs based on my research of the vehicle and I was fine with that based on the price we paid at auction.  However, we were surprised to learn of a significant issue from the mechanic the following Monday on the transmission.  I spoke with Lightning Auctions and explained the situation.  Per their request, I brought the car back to them with the mechanic's write up and their mechanic looked into the issue to confirm it.   After their confirmation - they provided a full refund.  This is a quality outfit and knows how to keep customers coming in for more.  I will be going to their next auction as well.  Special thanks to Linda and the team!

I don't know why I even returned to this place. The staff is absolutely disgusting!! They will treat you like it's a burden to service you. Especially the woman that works in the front. Wish I had her name. She  likes to yell out your financial information in front of everyone. As if to force you into paying for a service even if you are not ready too. She yells out your name and tells you that your insurance will not cover anything. Then proceeds to yell out, how much you have to pay out of  pocket, then she would ask if you are ok paying that amount upfront. Everyone's eyes and ears are on you instantly because she has that loud obnoxious voice. If you can't afford to pay that amount out of pocket at the moment you have to walk out of that place with your head down and humiliated just like I did. She didn't care to ask if I needed to reschedule.  Let me also mention, I called ahead of time to make sure my insurance plan was in network and they accept it. I knew I may have to pay some money and I was prepared to do so; however, prices kept changing. For them to charge me to measure my eyes for contacts, when I've done that same exam before, less then a year ago. Makes no sense to me. Because I don't measure my eyeballs every time I re order contacts using the same prescription. I felt like that lady was condescending down to me and took it extra personal because she didn't do it to anyone else there. I was the only black person in that store and felt like that itself brought extra attention to me. I'm not one to cry out race unnecessarily and I'm used to not paying any mind to it, because race is not a new thing in this world and won't be going away either. But when you are the only person of color and your financial situation is being discussed in front of everyone it puts a lot more pressure on you. I will always need glasses and two of my kids will too. But I assure you that Optical outlet in Tarpon springs will never have our service again!

The menu set up is neat! Pick hot or iced, pick flavor sauces, pick nitro or regular cold brew, ret-2-go! It was also really quick, and I know you're probably thinking cold brew is premade of course it's really quick, but if you're thinking that then you've never waited 10 minutes for a cold brew with nothing added to it. For the coffee itself I'm actually think more of a 3 star than a 4, but the presentation, ease of access, friendliness of the staff, speed of the staff, and that sweet little stamp card to get free coffee after so many trips I feel like I need to bump it up to 4.

Recommended if you're looking for a quick coffee that still gives you plenty of options, we will certainly be stopping back in the next time we are in the area.
Really amazing tortillas. They are so fresh and soft. I ordered the vegetarian quesadillas and they were so good.

Alberto came out to my house within an hour after calling his business for a quote. His quote was extremely reasonable compared to some other quotes I received from other tree services.
A date was set to do the work and Alberto showed up on time with his crew and equipment.
Alberto and his crew did an outstanding job trimming back a cotton wood tree along with a globe willow and several cypresses. He has all the tools and experience needed to do big or small jobs.
I would highly recommend Expert Tree and Yard Service to anyone who is looking for a professional that is needed to get the job done.
I plan on using them again.

Just left here for a Brazilian wax ! I was nervous at first, but Anna was very comforting and accommodating! I would definitely be back if I wasn't moving! Very professional, clean, and very nice. All of the reviews in here about her being a nurse are all true! She knows what she's talking about. Loved it!
Quality ingredients great service - nice atmosphere... sooo tastyyyyy ... healthy options and mutiple fresh made juice
They were a Christmas miracle- they were open on Christmas day, and the wait was long but food was delicious!! We tried the naans, chicken Tikka masala and assorted appetizers. Nice sheek kabab!

I don't know where to begin! Great place in Tucson for brunch!

Please try the maple bacon donuts holes! they are fantastic.  Table of 5, everyone ordered something different and loved their meal.  The Bacon Bloody Mary is totally worth it!
 
Service was great, and price is extremely reasonable given the portion and the quality.

I love the donuts here. They're the perfect amount of sugar and dough. Recently, I came here and bought a dozen to bring to school, to share. But i forgot them at home.. typically, I will share with my roommates, so there was some confusion when they ate all of them. oh well. 

the rest of their food, not as much. My first visit was for breakfast, on mardi gras day. everything was tasty, but a little too buttery. It was a very average breakfast. grits, bacon, sausage, eggs and toast. but it was great for the price. 

on a recent visit,  it involved a shrimp po-boy which was pretty average. the gator balls were not very good. they did not keep their ball shape. they were mushy, and mostly bread crumbs than gator meat. The fries were fried pretty well. 

I love the people here, they are always so nice and pleasant. one day, soon, I will come here just for a donut and coffee, sit outside, and eat and read a book. 

the neighborhood isn't as trendy as some ohers around town, but it has soul. don't be put off by the neighborhood, or the uneven street. this is a great place to go for your donuts.
Awesome job Hofbrauhaus!  Great food, friendly service, clean, super cute interior, cold beer....what more could you ask for?  I think I have found my new favorite restaurant!

This joint was recommended by a waiter who served us supper, said the red velvet waffles were to die for....ummm no suicidal thoughts here...totaly not worth the 1hr wait and is extremely loud....forget about conversation. We had the breakfast fondu....where is the fondu pot and skewers? And the $3 coffee was yucky! Service wasn't the best either. I'm getting the feeling that the waiters around here think because they probally won't ever see you again they don't have to give good customer service. You basically have to ask to be waited on.#RoadtripUSA

This is some good eats! The only thing that keeps them from pulling of a 5 of 5 is the prices and my desire to prioritize value. Get ready to pay premium prices for their premium product, mostly meats (in line with their name). I would frequent the place, but I would be broke. My favorite is the Gambino sandwich and the mac-n-cheese. The price for a sandwich will set you back around 12 dollars (+/- 2). I work in the general vicinity, and I avoid it for a weekday lunch, but I would go once in a while if I'm craving a solid sandwich. 

I would recommend going if you are in the mood for a sandwich and are willing to pay well for it. I f you fit the description, I would even recommend going a bit out of your way for this place, here or The Camellia Grill (in uptown).
Best Salty Caramel I have ever had & you know I love you Jeni! Your shits still splendid but boys in NOLA got you here.

We visited on a day with near record heat and since there isn't air conditioning, it was warm. The educational information regarding the formations and processes that created the geologic features and rocks in the area were informative. The museum has a great number of various specimens found throughout the state. A few small displays discussed historical mining. Mike, a volunteer, was there to answer any questions. A geophysicist with a PhD, it felt like he was a teacher at some point, as he was able to explain things very clearly. Overall, we spent about an hour and a half there, and it was free (with a suggested donation).

Very impressed; excellent quality and good prices.  I've had the cheesesteak and breakfast items.

They use Boar's Head meats.  Owner very friendly.  Open for breakfast and lunch so far; I expect they'll expand hours when COVID-19 is less of a worry for us all.
Delicious! I had the Metairie roll and miso soup. Fairly priced, clean and attractive environment, friendly and attentive service. Giving 4 stars because they did not offer brown rice for the sushi.

When to GC with my son to buy him a mixing board for his birthday.  Waited outside for over an hour in 99 degree heat because they were allowing 3 people at a time in the store.   Not three people at a time, three people total in the store!  This means they have more employees than customers in the store.  When it came time for our turn, one person walked out, so only one person could go in...I asked if I could join my son since I needed to shop and pay for him...they said no only three people in store.  
We ended up purchasing from Amazon, and now you know why Bezos is the richest man on earth.

Always loved this place even when I was a kid. My dad loved coming here because of their low prices on wings,pizza, fries and celery sticks with carrot sticks. 

If you knew my dad you would know why he loved any place that had some good fresh wings. 

Back in the day we would get a large pizza and a bucket of wings, which was 50 wings I believe. Mmmm so good. My mouth is watering just sitting here smelling all the yummy goodness. 

Yes it's a pretty run down place. The tables are kind of sticky, the bathrooms have flies flying around when you tinkle, the chairs are ripped up. But hey it's been here for a very very long time.  

They have cool arcade games that I remembered playing as a kid. Rampage is one of them. Who remembers rampage? Haha. Anyway. A great price to some pretty good pizza if you eat it there and amazing wings.
First time in New Orleans and our driver Justin was great! Super fun and all the history was amazing. Next time I come back i will be back on this tour

By far one of the best seafood restaurants. We had charbroil oysters, oysters brochette and the shrimp egg plant stack. One of the best meals I've ever had and I promise you. Two thumbs up to the staff as well

I love this Resturant in every city I've visited it. This one in Westshore plaza is no exception. I went for an early lunch and got the special where u can take home an entree'  mom's lasagna is exelante' lol. Bottom line If u want to eat  well and have top notch service look no further.

one of my 2 favorite starbucks in Tucson!  I love taking my kids here on our starbucks "date".  The staff is super kid friendly and always happy and helpful.  I love that they blend the naked juice for my kids too...so nice!
Pretty nice inn. The problem is it's close to airport.. Plane noise is bad. Room very clean and Wi-Fi was good

This was the first place I had ever left my dogs for an extended period of time and from now on, I will only leave them here. This place is wonderful and I'm really bummed that they were full when I had to go up to Reno a second time and had to go elsewhere. I was given a tour of the facility, the employees were cordial and professional and my dogs came back to me healthy, happy and clean. Trust this place with your dogs!!!
Lemonade is my guilt pleasure! Love love love the girls who were working here! Super sweet and kind. Will be back every time I am in town!

This is not my first time at this place, but this is second time I get my nail done by Peter,  in both time he did an amazing job. Not only he is fast, but is also very professional. I have been looking for the right place and the right person to do my nail  for the past couple of years in Tampa, I have tried more than a dozen  nail salons, they have been all somehow "average".  My search for the right manicurist has ended.

We love the Parish! This spot is located conveniently close to our house and we've been there a few times in the past year since relocating to the area. Favorite dishes include the burger (always more than I can eat, and the flavor delivers) and the Drunken Pasta. You don't find a lot of Cajun/Creole/Southern flair in Tucson, so this spot is welcome. Lunch and Happy Hour prices are a good - wish we got to take advantage of those more often! Totally recommend the cocktails and upgrading to the hush puppies for your side - they're super delicious.

Dr. Kleinova is truly a great Dentist and I'm very grateful for having found her. 

First, it's clear she cares about her patients and her work. She is both gentle and very careful and never rushes the work. 

Second, She is highly talented and skilled and always does a great job (you can tell she is a perfectionist) . I've gotten a few crowns and some fillings and always walk out happy.

But what really blew me away is the way she took care of my mother who was visiting from Denmark. My poor mom suddenly cracked one of her teeth in the back. It was hurting a lot and I called Dr. Kleinova and her kind assistant Vincent to see if there was any way for them to see my mom quickly. Without any trouble I got an appointment the next day and when we went there, my mom was taken care of in the best way and a temporary crown was put on.
