The mundare sausage had been sliced so thin and over grilled that they were tasteless   My companions found their meals just okay too.  If Hart wants to be a neighbourhood go to place I suggest a new menu and better service from the kitchen. And leave the lights on!

Probably the best food we've had since arriving in New Orleans a few days ago. We had been excited to try the southern fare but have been disappointed so far, except for here!!! Very reasonably priced. Great job!!!

My husband and I were both seen and are not from around town. Staff as extremely friendly. The office was very clean. It is difficult to find using maps on my iPhone but once you do, you can't miss it. The physician listened and explained everything thoroughly. If you need an urgent care, this is the place.

Andy was cooking, took order and hosted me by himself when I was checking this place out. I like his smilley face and how friendly he was. 

I saw the only 1star review of this place and wonder wtf you order breakfast take out and complained it came cold?!?! Such an idiot ...

All food I have had was great, coffee tastes great and o think if I live close by , I would eat here almost everyday.


Only thing is the fried potato was a little oily ... I would love the real German style potato salad more...

Drove out from South Philly to try this place out.  Was not disappointed, very tasty sandwich!  Was served on a sturdy kaiser type roll, which seems to solve the issues some reported with a regular hamburger roll falling apart.  Truffle fries also good.

Navis is the suggested shipper for the auction company where I buy a few items every year. After an auction in Manhattan, I emailed the list of purchased items to this branch for a quote. The quote arrived, I approved it. Turns out they had left out an item: they added the item to the quote and resubmitted. I approved it. The items were collected in good condition from the auction house, but, it turns out that more packaging was needed, resulting in more weight, so a 29% increase in the quote followed. I approved it. I also bought the insurance, which is provided by an underwriter described as "a tier-one carrier that is not in the business of denying claims", prophetic words if there ever were any. The shipment arrives (on a truck with a broken tail lift, but that's another story), and two of the items come out of the packaging damaged. I notify the office, and they tell me that unless the exterior crates are damaged (which they are not), we are out of luck. Time to submit an insurance claim, right, because that's what insurance is for? Denied.

Follow-up point #1: Most communications I received from this Navis office consisted of three or more paragraphs of meaningless, self-aggrandizing sales babble. I was assured several times that I would not regret hiring the best pack & ship company. For how much they toot their own horn, they failed miserably in more ways than one.

Follow-up point #2: My previous experience using Navis in a different part of the country went similarly, with a very large and fragile item being packed inadequately and damaged in transit. Except that they took responsibility and paid for the repair to the broken item.

Bye bye Navis. I tried, I really tried.

Spring for the shelled shrimp (extra $1). If you order it unshelled, you end up having to devein the shrimp, and you end up losing flavor to the shell. 


The killer shrimp broth is delicious.

I was visiting St. Pete for one month to scout out a place to relocate and while strolling Central Avenue discovered this wonderful shop. I'm no stranger to balsamic vinegars and this shop does not disappoint aficionados. The selections will satisfy any palate - sweet or savory - and coupled with the right olive oil, you will have tasty marinade or dressing.

Try the cinnamon pear with lemon olive oil whisked together for a nice dressing over a warm salmon salad. Also use the cinnamon pear and sauté onions for a nice addition to your sausage on a toasted sourdough bun.

Thanks guys. You are my official go to store for my balsamic. It's mail order until I get to St. Pete on a permanent basis.
Food wonderful. Atmosphere awesome. Service friendly and nice. Definitely going back. The pancakes are addictive. OMG.....

I've been here twice now and I love the atmosphere-- The bartender was friendly and the food really good. I got the tomato/basil/mozzarella sandwich; love the panini, not impressed with the overdressed ceasar salad.  I was impressed by the draft beer selection-- some unique stuff here!  Complimentary valet parking, but also ample street parking if you don't want to deal with it.  There's a wood-burning stove/fireplace; it makes the place very homey, but be prepared to go home smelling a bit like smoke (and beware if you have a sensitivity to smoke).  Nice to be at a bar that's not filled with drunk people or loud partiers.
Don't call and ask for information.  Either they are too busy or they just fell off the turnip wagon.  Good grief!

I've been here a few times and it's a really good sushi spot  
The buffet is OK and I'd recommend sitting at the bar for the best service.
Not the best place for kids unless they really like sushi

This Walmart is about to change my mind about the Walmart Superstore brand! I went into this location because I wasn't far from it to bring back some things that I bought for Christmas. I didn't have a receipt but they were able to look up my purchases through my credit card. From the time I entered the door, every employee was so friendly. The greeter was polite and showed me where to go. I went to customer service to make my return and the cashier was efficient and professional. The store is super clean and put together. Is this a new store? I walked around the whole store just so I can get a feel for the store in general and every section was clean, tidy, and in order. I checked out the produce and all of it looked fresh! Which can't be said for a lot of  Walmart produce. :-(    It wasn't very crowded for Tuesday and it didn't take long for me to make my purchases. I actually enjoyed my Walmart experience!
The coffee!  The food was delicious, service was friendly despite the fact that was were under-dressed.  The gluten free options were plentiful and delicious.  I would definitely go back.

GREAT tour!! Joshua was extremely knowledgeable about the history of the town and all of the creepy stories that inhabit it. We were in a small group so it was very personable. We saw other tour groups and they were extremely large. Some of the other tours had guides that were extremely loud but my attention was directed only at Joshua as he explained the stories. Highly highly recommend this tour with Joshua.

It's always been hard for me to decide which stylist should be MY stylist. You know, like those people who go to the same one for 30+ years?! Well, I may have found it here in Kasey. 

My co-worker recommended her, saying she was informative, creative and affordable, so I had to give it a shot. I made an appointment for a cut and style, and she was everything and more. We started with a consultation where she listened closely to how I felt and what I wanted. She definitely took her time and I never felt rushed in the whole process. 

The best thing about Kasey is she really listens and is happy to tell you how she's cutting your hair and why. I will definitely rebook with her! 

Pro Tips: 
-Bang trims at this salon are free for returning customers. 
-Check in on Yelp to get your complimentary deep conditioning treatment.

Adrian the owner has always been supper helpful and nice. I went to the shop at first to meet a client there, and my car died. He quickly checked my battery and gave me a jump out of the goodness of his heart. 

So when my husband had tire troubles. I knew just were to go. Every time I have come to this place I have been greeted promptly with a smile and had excellent service. Definetly recomend this place if your in need of tire or battery service!

Nothing served is really that good, but the variety and general quality leaves you satisfied, especially at an exceedingly reasonable price.  I like to stop there on the drive to Delaware.  It's not far off 95.  Service is friendly.
We stopped in on a Saturday and it wasn't busy, the waitress was friendly and prompt and the ribs were phenomenal.

When my friends and I want to make plans to come to Taste of Key West, we say "Let's go back to Miami!" I have lived within 15 min from this place for a year and a half, and only tried it for the first time last month. It is a hidden gem.

As you and your friends sit at a table on their outdoor patio overlooking the marina, Corona in hand, you will feel like you have been transported to a beach town. We listened to the live band playing outside, enjoyed a table-full of yummy food, and ordered buckets of beer. It feels like a vacation.

We have decided that we will be back every few weeks for a little "getaway." =)

Well we had a very interesting experience at this restaurant. I gave it two stars because the food was good, but we waited about 1 hour for our 3 meals two of which were salads. Two of our party had salads and those were brought out first while our third person waited about 10 mins after our salads were delivered for her meal to arrive. Then the waitress said she was sorry and comped us 1/2 a drink, which I have never in my life seen that before. She proceeded to bring out literally 1/2 a drink in a tall glass. The owner was there walking around and did not say one thing to us, which was very surprising. After waiting for such a long time for our meal the credit card machine breaks and we are told there is a service technician on the way to fix it, but offered no solutions for us. Did they expect us to wait for the technician to fix the credit card machine? Also on top of all this we had a child with us that could not wait any longer. With all of the choices in Reno for dining I think I will pick another place next time.

Maybe this place with improve with new management as the new manager introduced himself to us the other night. It appears he wants to improve the joint. haven't eaten here and only stopped in for a  beer to watch the warriors game. On the plus side it's  big with lots of staff and good service, but....as a sports bar they need to have a way better large screen. I usually go to the Peppermill because of the awesome led screens. It's worth the extra 12 minute drive. Also, why keep looping outdated games when the Stanley cup and NBA playoffs are on? Do you think everyone is here on a wed night to watch an Alabama game played last Saurday? Turn the majority of screens to the LIVE action.

Totally beautiful garden center adjacent to the Farmers Market.   I could have walked out with a ton of plants but even more pots, statuary and gift items.  It's a good thing we were driving (and not flying) because I did buy one of the most unique pieces of garden art I've ever seen.

If I lived in Nashville, I would attend the FM at least weekly and browse through the Gardens for inspiration, supplies, and fun.
This theater is very nice and good surround system in this place ! Very luxury on the southern of Tucson az.  If you never know this place please need to try it .

Wow. Have things changed. 

Do not go to Minado Japanese Restaurant in East Norriton. Never treated so rudely by a restaurant manager regarding food and tip. Have spent years recommending this place to many. The food has truly gone downhill. Fighting the urge not to be sick in the parking lot from eating crab and beef that wasn't fully cooked. Raw oysters that smelled questionable. At one point the owner came out personally to apologize about the undercooked crab so it's not like they weren't aware. Too many opportunities for possible food poisoning.  Could have handled the situation like a professional but the manager just made it worse. Spoke in a condescending tone with "Happy New Year" at every opportunity and not letting us speak.


https://pa.healthinspections.us/_templates/629/inspection/_report_full.cfm?inspectionID=587126&parentTableName=tblInspection&dsn=DHD_629&domainid=629&wguid=1367&wgunm=sysuser&wgdmn=629&logintime=%2200:00:00%20AM%22&public=1

Good food, fun New Orleans ambience, and amazing service! 

We ordered half dozen of the Char Grilled Oysters, Nashville Hot Chicken, and the Bacon and Cheese Quiche. The oysters were SO delicious, be aware that it is a different taste compared to New Orleans char grilled oysters (not better or worse, just different). The Nashville Hot Chicken was yummy too, my only issue was that the bread got soggy very fast. And the quiche (which included veggies and potatoes) was good as well but the portion size was disappointingly small. 

The wait here can be very long but the wait is actually only for the main restaurant side. The restaurant is split into two halves: the main restaurant side and the bar side. On the bar side, it's first come first serve, so I recommend grabbing a table as soon as you see someone leaving (we did this and avoided a 45 min wait!!) 

Love the ambience of the bar side! It's full of energy and it was decorated as a New Orleans restaurant so that was cool! Our waitress was very nice and helpful, despite being the only person taking care of food for the bar side (we were seriously impressed).
Short wait times and excellent service. The shampoo was particularly worth it and Katie did an excellent on the haircut.
Amazing food!!! This place had  great outside dining. The tables were very spread out and they cleaned the table thoroughly before and after.

Traveling through the area and stopped at Guac's for lunch. Was happy to this fresh option sandwiched between the fast food chains of the area. Very nice customer service, biggest and best burrito I have had in awhile. Lots of fresh topping options and a comfortable atmosphere. Would give 5's if they had margaritas, though I was driving so this was not an issue.

Favorite coffee shop in Santa Barbara.

Cyclist hangout but don't let the spandex scare you - non-cyclists also welcome.

Simple menu consisting of espresso coffee and pastries. Only use Strauss organic milk. Vegan friendly. 

Tons of outdoor seating.

If there's a line, wait it out. Service moves fast. 

Street parking available (75 minutes) or there's a parking garage just past it on the corner (first 90 minutes are free-ninety-nine).

The price of the tires are comparable to Walmart so not sure there is a better deal out there. Professional, friendly and calm service. I say that because these guys were crazy nuts busy last Saturday. With the anticipated weather and holiday weekend approaching, everyone had the same thing on their agenda NEW TIRES! I had a appointment for my first visit so that helped a little. A hour and a half wait but they have comfy chairs, thank goodness. I was very please with my tires and they even shined them up for me.

The second visit with the other car on Tuesday I did not have an appointment. I waited over 2 hours for 2 tires that literally took them 10 minutes to change. The wait for others was almost at 4 hours. HANGRY starts to set in!!! They need a vending machine with food and drinks and a better system for sure. I highly recommend you drop your car off and pick it up when it is ready and your experience should be about perfect!

I met a friend here for lunch during a workday and it was nice: we got in and out in plenty of time to enjoy our meals, had good service, and got to enjoy the temperature controlled nature of an indoor restaurant with the bright lighting that comes from good windows letting the sun in from outdoors. 

My food came in large portions -- I did not necessarily need two sides to go with my salmon club sandwich but I enjoyed both of my sides a lot -- perhaps they were even more delicious than the sandwich itself (the sandwich was good but nothing fancy or really worth writing much about): the quinoa salad (refreshing!) and the jalapeño cheese mashed potatoes (which really didn't need the provided gravy). It was all in all a good meal from a mid-level chain restaurant with an upscale/pub feel.
Oh my it was amazin, better than most Italian spots good amount of Food and good price. Mrs Angie was amazing she made my first Experience at ABC the best ever

V.kitchen used to be really good when they first got in business . Now they have gotten really comfortable selling anything and on top of that you call them and sometimes they don't have food left . I had a platter a week ago and the food was scarce ,salty and the people taking your order are unprofessional . Never will I ever eat here again .

Amazing experience! 

I came in with a tough job for them - in addition to needing my very worn boots resoled, the metal piece on the boot's toe ripped off and was all bent. Neither one of us thought it would be salvageable - thought they'd have to repair by removing both metal pieces.

Came back prepared for bad news only to find that they were able to fix it!!! 

Great service - friendly, skilled, and reasonably priced. If comparing to Villa's, I've had a good experience there, too, so probably can't go wrong either way. But I can definitely say that Caruso's exceeded my expectations! I'll be back, and highly recommend.

While I understand this was a Saturday night, this restaurant treated us absolutely terribly. We came here because of the good reviews. Atmosphere was great, the host was also very kind. Sat at the bar very briefly while we waiting for our high top table (only seats available since it was kind of late ~8pm). Bartender acted pretentious... quickly took our drink orders and couldn't get away from us faster.

Get to our high top table with the host a few minutes later, and a gentleman came shortly after asking if we needed more drinks. He took that order and disappeared for awhile, even though our table was literally touching the bar. Finally comes back with the drinks and disappears for pretty much good, bussing other tables and never tried to take our food order. 

Finally we flag a random waitress down who took one out of the four of our orders. She tells a group of fellow waiters that we ordered, and a few moments later the bartender comes over and snarkely asks for the rest of our food order. 

No one told us the bartender was our waiter ?? He never showed his face to us the entire time we were sitting at our table. I guess we were supposed to read their minds and assume he was our waiter. The rest of the night we had to flag him or anyone down for anything. It was a disgrace. The food was great but not sure it's worth coming back to since we were so mistreated.

Bummer, I guess I got the guy who thought I wasn't serious about a purchase or didn't look "rock star" enough for him. The entire store was completely cool to me except this older gentleman.. oh well immediately drove over to guitar center and bought myself the same Taylor acoustic... bummer
What a great little theater in midtown. We saw A moon for the misbegotten and were really impressed by the quality of the cast. Highly recommend you check it out
Its so good. the food...the service...just so good. i haven't been able to order anything besides the pizza the 10 plus times I've been there. its just so freakin good.

We love Trader Joe's.  I don't know why, but my wife and I love going to unique little grocery stores.  It's always fun to find and try new things and things you don't always see at the big chain stores.  Trader Joe's is great.  This particular store was bright, clean, and welcoming.  The staff we friendly and very open to helping.  We go to Trader Joe's as often as we can and you should too.

They received a much needed makeover but no one keeps up on cleaning the bathrooms and every time I've come the bar has been closed. Sunday at 5pm closed. Saturday at 8pm closed. Friday at 4pm ..Is it ever open? Seems like a waste of money to invest in something to never utilize it.

Teryn has been doing my hair the past few times.  I left both voicemails and sent texts to her phone that I needed to set up an appointment.  To this day she has never called back to apologize or see if she could help me.  Luckily, MIchele is more responsible, and tried to handle the call for Teryn.  Had I have been able to get my hair done, I had planned to buy a gift card for services from Teryn.  I would have been terribly embarrassed if what happened to me happened to the person I was going to buy the gift card for.

Love my protein smoothies and Boba is now offered. The drinks are from fresh ingredients and are like a meal. I love that so I can carry it around with me while I shop. Great customer service and owners. I highly recommend this location and adding protein to your drink.

I love Parc! 

I came here a couple of times for brunch and I think last Sunday was one of my best experience. Something happened with my food I could not finish it. It happens. it's a restaurant. But what the management and our server did just make me forget all about the horrible experience. When I realized something about my food, I called over my server, he apologized and told me that he will call his manager over. The floor manager comes right away and apologizes for the inconvenience and asks if she can give me a new plate etc. I was already impressed with how the server and the manager handled the situation but to make things better, she provides us with delicious macarons.  

What could have been a horrible experience, the server, and the manager made it into a positive experience!!

This particular location is very convenient to my office so we drop off packages sometimes weekly. The owner has yet to be friendly when I have to deal with him. His staff however are always very friendly. I went in today to drop off a box and also do an amazon return. Not a hello, thank you or even have a good day. Every single time I deal with him he is rude to me. I'm done giving them my business and I would suggest anyone else in Oro Valley do the same. Find another location that appreciates your business.

Wonderful.  The happy hour is great with choice of many really good wines and fantastic pizza.  The regular menu also brilliant.  Ended up eating here several times last visit.  Great service from bartenders and the waitress Peggy was as good as it gets, vwery welcoming, always exactly there when needed, great with wine and food recommendations, and unobtrusive otherwise.

The smell of all the great food stole me away from my office for a nice lunch break. I arrived on bike with a co-worker and sampled the Planet of the Crepes Butternut squash crepe filled with walnuts, cheese, onions and maybe a few more items.... totally hit the spot on a warm sunny day. Then I had to wash it down with a Red Raspberry Margarita Hawaiian Ice at the adjacent food stand. It was very refreshing as we walked around the courthouse stage checking out the other vendors and the old carriage buggies. I headed back down there for dinner this time trying the Pad Thai and Ice Tea from the Buddhist Temple, love their tofu!  We finished the night watching African Soul and dancing away all the calories we ate during the day!

If I were just rating on the flavor, I think we're really talking 3.5. If we add in the excellent service, it tips the scales to 4 stars. Place was spanking clean, service was helpful, friendly, fast. My sweetheart of a server gave me a small tasting of the 3 different hummus - regular, red pepper and spinach. They were creamy with a mellow flavor. Fave was the regular. The menu is rather extensive - more so than necessary I think, but, hey, I'm not the kitchen cooks, so it's all good with me. It's a nice place to have lunch though I think the happy hour is probably the real draw here given its location and clientele (Valley folks) who are always in need of more decent bar,/restaurant choices. I think the only thing that keeps me from being a bit more excited about this place is I feel the flavors are pretty tame and even the garlic sauce isn't that garlicky. The servings are generous though and I would come again &  order items there menu lists as spicy and see if that rings my bell a bit harder. All in all, good food good place good value.

The owner of this establishment is one of the most unreasonable and dishonest people I've ever met.  He has no sense of fairness or moral right or wrong, his only concern is making maximum profit no matter who he has to cheat.

My company and a handful of others were contracted to do work on the new location a few years ago and he refused to pay for the work we performed.  Although he admits that we did everything we were asked to do on the job, he knows that we cannot afford to sue him over a few thousand dollars because the lawyers would cost more than the settlement.  So, he laughed in my face and said he would not pay me for my work.  I was amazed someone could do such a thing to someone who did a good job for them.

The food may be good or bad, I don't know and I will never know.  If you want to spend your money at a restaurant that profits a liar and a thief, than this is the place for you.

We arranged a play date for our kids at Defy on New Years Day. They were all so excited! We checked the website to make sure they were open. The website said they opened at 9 am on New Years Day. We arrived a little after 9 there was a few other cars in the parking lot but the doors were locked. We waited around, called,  (hours on the phone stated they opened at 9) and by 9:30 we decided to leave. DEFY- for future reference, if you plan to be closed on a holiday please post online, on your door, by phone something... to eliminate future confusion. Needless to say, we were all very disappointed.

For my mothers birthday my family decided to give this place a shot. Was a gamble since we normally order from one place and they never disappoint. However this was our first time trying pizza from Rino's. The cheese pizza was specifically requested to be well done. It was not. The pizza was a floppy mess and their was so much oil I thought the US might invade it. The Sicilian on the other hand was eh. Tasted more like something I can Pick up from Pizza Hut for a fraction of the price. Spongey; bland and lacking enough sauce. Lesson learned; don't order from here.

Celebrated one of the rounds of my 50th birthday there for lunch.  Have been looking forward to the flavors of the dishes and I was not disappointed.  Started off with pot stickers chicken lettuce wraps and hot sour soup.  The only thing off with any of these dishes is the fact they didn't give us the 3 sauce options for the lettuce wraps.  I figured they had just changed the recipe until I saw a neighbor get it as I remembered 
We moved on to entrees of Kung po and Mongolian beef with white and brown rice. 
I had a mai tai and hubby had wine. Both fine 
Last part I didn't rate 5 stars was I wasn't offered dessert even though I mentioned it was my 50th birthday. Of course after all the food I wasn't starving for dessert but a nice birthday slice of cheesecake would have been nice.

The Ketel One cosmopolitan ($9) was neither sweet nor sour enough.  It tasted watery.  Smokey the Bandit ($11) is still the best mezcal cocktail around.  Gumbo ($15) had a good liquid base, but was short on solids.  There was most of a crab body, hollowed out, and 2 legs, requiring lots of work for little gain.  There wasn't much else in the bowl.  Charbroiled oysters ($14) were almost as good as raw on the half shell.  Crab and craw beignets ($13), crawfish (crayfish) mac and cheese ($13), and soft shell crab ($26) were all good.  Overall, it was a good experience with good, creative food, as in the past.  I'd return, but would avoid gumbo.
This is the spot to take all of your out of town guests! If you are coming from out of town, stop in and try the "Shut the Cluck Up" spiced level chicken

One of the most fun tasting rooms in Santa Barbara.  I took my girlfriends here on May 11, 2012, although I had been there before.  In fact, I was so happy with my last visit that I made my girlfriends come to this room first.  I feel terrible that I forgot the name of the lady who served us, but both times I have been there, everyone there has been super friendly and knowledgable.  Not only did she do a great job of explaining the nuances and origins of the wines, she was really great about taking pictures of me and my girlfriends - it was our first girls trip together in over a decade, so we were a little excited!  The first time I had been there, they were pouring a preview of their Bright White, which hadn't been released yet.  I was so happy that it was now available - I had raved about it to my girlfriends and we all liked it so much that we went home with a bottle or two.  Don't miss this tasting room - it has a great funky vibe, and nice places to enjoy a glass and some cheese on their patio or one of their tables.

There's usually a long wait at this location. Great for me, I usually go with a party of 2-4, so grabbing an open table in the bar is quick and easy! The service in the bar is quick. The server was responsive and went above and beyond, packing our leftovers and even throwing in extra breadsticks without us asking.

I love wearing fun glasses and switching up my style on a regular basis, so I was relieved to find a hip and trendy glasses store in Nashville. I was immediately drawn to the ridiculous large framed and glittery cat eye glasses. Although not very professional they are quite fun and quirky! 

The price point is actually quite high for someone like me who likes to buy glasses all the time, so I much prefer my goofy glasses to come from cheap stores online like Zenni Optical where I can get a complete pair (Rx included) for less than $20. 

As far as originality is concered, I really like SEE to find cute and different glasses but I just didn't feel that it was worth my money to invest. Maybe when I get that promotion at work I've been deserving..... ahhhh hopes and dreams.... :P

This place is a great local business. The food is excellent. Any of the old fashioned rice bowls are a sure bet.

I also have celiacs disease, some restaurants treat me like a leper and others have no idea what I'm talking about. I'm not even a pain in the ass type celiacs, I'm the type that is ashamed to ask. One of the owners took the time to talk me through all the ingredients and make sure I was safe, without me asking. 

The location is a little small, and the walls are  dark, but damn... The food is on Pointe and the staff is very good. They always have some dope movie or show on and plenty of tchotchkes to make any nerd feel at home. 

Just go, it's real good.

Came here on a family vacation last week (we go every year for our family reunion). Our service was so good last time for dinner that I told everyone we had to go back and see Monica. After finding out from one of the other bartenders that she was let recently go, we were bummed because she made our experience so great last time, but stayed because we were still hungry. Ate on the 6th floor. Their food and service has gone way downhill. My moms old fashioned tasted like sugar water and was made with well bourbon. Our bartender was inexperienced and rude. My salad was missing the chicken that was supposed to come on it, and took an additional 20 minutes to arrive. Will not go back. If I did, it would just be to ask where Monica works now.

THE place to go for cheap produce. Quality is generally pretty good, but every now and then you'll get a bag of veggies that doesn't last the day before starting to go bad. There are 3 different lines, veggies on the left, and fruits on the right, and flowers near the front entrance. Not sure why, but you have to pay for each one in the respective line. For example, you can't buy kale and apples and pay for it all at once. You need to go to the veggie line for the kale, then go over to the fruit line to pay for the apples. Not a big deal, but good to know when you roll up to the fruit counter with a cart full of veggies.
We shop here all the time, and will continue to do so.
Great food paired with a enticing ambience both outside and inside, fault lies on the service, or lack there of. Overall good but not great.
The worst bar anywhere.  The noise is awful. Don't waste your time visiting.

Outstanding experience. Went here for my birthday and it was one not to forget. Service was impeccable, atmosphere very vibey, the food was marvelous. Mushroom risotto with crab was wonderful, and the trio of soups was a lovely way to start. The $0.25 martinis are dangerous of course, but a great accessory to an already awesome meal!
I wasn't impressed when I was there. I feel that there are many Mexican food restaurants out there that are much better.

This place would be worthy of a 4 based on location, taste, and service, but a couple of things bothered me that made me drop my score to a 3. First of all, the location is great, right in a little plaza off of State St. in downtown. There's a neat fountain with live turtles right in the middle of their outdoor seating. Super cool! The wait staff who helped us were friendly and knowledgeable. 
I was eager to try the house made gluten free meatballs (I am GF) from the small plates menu, but they only came with regular breadsticks. It seemed weird to tout your GF meatballs but not offer them with a GF sauce dipping option. So the staff helped me come up with a side of their cauliflower crust with a little cheese melted on it - like GF cheesy breadsticks. I thought it was awesome...until I found out that they charged me full price for a cauliflower crust pizza ($20!!)!! That made my meal $31 total for 3 meatballs and cheesy bread. It was really good flavor, but it was not worth that cost.
My daughter had their braised rib grilled cheese on sourdough and said it was good. My husband had the crispy chicken and bacon salad and liked it a lot. So, food was a 4.5, prices were a 3. 
AND, another factor for the 3 - I saw one of the other waitresses in the bathroom and she did NOT wash her hands after exiting the stall. Maybe she did so somewhere else in the kitchen, but it kind of grossed me out, especially amidst our Covid world.

This was a great dining experience the whole evening! From the moment we checked in for our reservation till we left. Everyone was kind and friendly and service was impeccable. 

The shrimp and grits were amazing but also the gumbo! The best we had in New Orleans! I recommend getting both as an appetizer! 

The pork tenderloin was cooked perfectly and the mango  sauce was a nice sauce. Loved the mashed potatoes and asparagus. 

Drinks were delicious and service was great. Love the atmosphere in the courtyard, absolutely delightful. 

The cherry bread pudding was yummy and the perfect ending to a wonderful night!

My first and LAST visit. Ick.  Lots to choose from on the menu but our party of 6 found none of it to be worth eating ever again.  The burgers are clearly frozen patties. The shredded cheddar cheese wasn't even melted on the burger. The buns were soaked at least have way through with grease and that's all you could taste.  The Pepsi was flat, the ice tea was about two shades darker than water.  The service was slow and they forgot one of the children's entrees, leaving her to wait a significant amount of time for her food while the rest of us had ours.

None of us drank any beer but I can't imagine its that amazing given the food quality.

The decor is really nice but who cares when the food is so blech?

If you have ever been to Granite City Illinois... the food here tastes like GC IL looks.

In the area for a few weeks and have eaten here 4 times. Service is great, breakfast awesome. Today I inadvertently left my phone in the booth I was sitting in. I didn't realize it until I got home. Went back 30 minutes later and the waitress had turned it into the manager and all was well. Thankful for honest people in this world.
The sand is sugary, the sunsets spectacular, a great place to hang at the beach, have a cocktail and a bite to eat.

I have stayed here twice and have grown to hate it each and every time. The doors are so thin that I could hear everyone and their mothers outside of my door in the morning and not to mention, the highway is literally right next to this hotel. The icing on the cake was that the beds were uncomfortable as well. Yelpers- stay away from this place!

For the past five years Jenni has given me some of the best haircuts of my life at Plume (http://www.yelp.com/biz/plume-salon-philadelphia?hrid=2XtND62-h7AS4x7UKLEz0g#src:self). Of course the engaging conversation and beer that the salon offered didn't hurt either.. So when I heard that she was moving onto a salon of her own that she was opening with a manicurist friend in my favorite part of South Philly, I was ready to head down and give it a shot. And when I finally did I found all of the things that originally had me sold and then some!

The new space is a quaint first floor salon across from the Dolphin that features vintage furniture, artsy knick knacks and baubles, a small but roomy salon with a manicurist station, and a serene back outdoor patio that is totally zen. Its perfectly feng shui'ed to fit the style of both Jenni and her partner.

From being offered a Sprecher Summer Pilsner and a tour of the salon upon entering, to the conversation that happened throughout my cut service was definitely solid. And after reviewing my specifications Jenni hooked me up with a dynamite short cut that can just as easily made sleek and professional as it can be wild and spiky. And all of the above definitely sums up why tPrepp & Foxx is my new salon of choice.

this is a great greek restaurant. the staff is always friendly and love yelling OPA!

the melted flaming cheese is easily the best app, you should get that every time.  they do serve pita that seems to be fried on one side, that is also incredible.  the salads are great, a little strange with the potato salad under it all but the dressing makes up for that.

main course, i know the whole fish is great.  i also like the gyro platter and the grape leaves.

dessert is probably the best.  great baklava and the greek cannolis are similar to lobster tails in boston.

The meatball banh mi was a bit dry like it was missing some sort of sauce or dressing, the meatballs themselves didn't have a lot of flavor either.  Co-worker got the grilled pork banh mi that was a lot better, egg rolls were also interesting...expected mostly vegetables and a little pork in the inside but got what seemed like a sausage link wrapped in egg roll paper left in the deep fryer a little too long.  With all the five star ratings was hoping for something over the top but was left underwhelmed.

Maurice is a gem! He was so kind and helpful while I opened my account and made sure I understood all the terms and how to work the app. Also, let the record state I ran in in a panic at about 3:50 and they closed at 4pm. He took his time and stayed with me until almost 4:30 which was so appreciated. Great experience.

Hands down the best southern food in Reno and surrounding areas. I've visited a few times and everything from the sweet tea or lemonade, ribs, chicken, red beans and rice to the mac & cheese has been delicious. I will be a regular.

This place really is like having breakfast at someones house, the staff is super friendly and it seems like everyone here is a local. The egg specials are a great deal and the pancakes are excellent. The food is not going to end up on the food channel, but for your basic down home breakfast, thats cheap enough, this is the place. I have my reservations about the waffels, the batter seems a little too sweet for me. If you leave here hungry, its your own fault.

Great friendly people with a wealth of knowledge. This is a great little smoke shop with a lot to choose from with very good prices. They always have a sale on some items. I especially enjoy the four pack of Perdomo's for only $20.
They have the greatest guys that work there that are so knowledgeable and so friendly they make you feel welcome every time.

Consistently great pizza and service. I prefer the hand-tossed crust as veggie toppings will saturate the thin crust; meat toppings won't. The service is fantastic. They went above and beyond when I goofed our online order and expedited a re-do while we waited. Best pizza in E. Nashville.

We devoured some delicious sandwiches here while we were vacationing in the area. My husband chose a salad that was fabulous too. We got everything take-out as our hosts informed us that sometimes they are a little slow. We called ahead of time. I think good food takes time to prepare. 

I got a chance to enter the establishment when we picked up the food. I was impressed by their shelves of gourmet products and cookbooks in the front of the store. They seem to carry a lot of hard-to-find stuff. The seating was sparse at least in the front (it is a big space so I think there may have been more seating towards the back but I can't be sure). The front seating consisted of high tables and stools (not exactly kid-friendly but that's ok). 

Our guests also ordered dessert -- mini Chocolate Damnations to split. Very rich and delicious. Even half a mini one was more than I could eat at once!

I'd love to come back if we visit the area again!

Tried this based on the yelp reviews and was not disappointed. Had their special of two spicy stewed beef tacos, absolutely delicious! We were taking a work break and even though the parking lot and restaurant were full the food was served fast and hot. Would definitely go back.

I'm giving 5 starts to the assistant- operator ALEXIS.
I will be honest, this company takes forever to approve your documents and certifications, you have to be constant calling and communicating with them. If you need to talk with someone for help I recommend asking JUST FOR ALEXIS. SHE SAVED MY LIFE literally. I needed my visa screen to be sent (I kept waiting for months for them to approve all my papers that were sent for long time ago) and she was the only one willing to help me, the other people kept saying "you have to wait, the emails and documents are reviewed in the order they are received" and my case was an emergency, I needed this in order to kept living and working in the USA as a nurse. I waited for 2 months just for one of my titles to be reviewed for second time and she was the only one that contacted the right person to help me getting my documents finally approved. Thank you again Alexis, you saved my life and as I promised you I was gonna do, here I am writing a review to thank you again and let know everyone you were the best operator there by far!
Just remember people, if you need help and get to call them, ask for her and she will do her best to help you as much as possible!

We love Yats. They are price very well and the food is good.  The staff is friendly.
Two people can eat for under $20. We love the Chilli Cheese Crawfish Etouffe, spinach and mushroom,  and red beans all served over rice. 
If you aren't sure, ask for a sample.
Yum!!
This one lacks the atmosphere of the College Ave or the old Massachusetts location.

Typical blocked drain in our kitchen sink. Came on slowly and then just stopped draining at all. This after one pound of lye and several tries with baking soda and vinegar. Our serviceman, Sammie, just left. My first call for a plumber was about 9:30am. Bruce called 15 minutes later and we set up a visit for between 1 to 4 pm today. He called back at 10:30 to ask if they could come now....yes please! Sammie ran his cable 3 times to completely clear the drain. He was professional, clean and pleasant to deal with. Basic service charge for one hour of work, including travel time to Cold Springs. I would be delighted to have them for any future plumbing work. They care about good customer service!

The Rays are one game out of the wild card in late August and I HAD TO ASK FOR THEM TO PUT THE GAME ON.  They have like 30 TVs.   Shameful.   Nachos sucked too.  Cheese not melted.   Get your sh#t together.

Went today for a trim.  The barber I had, Rhonda, was fantastic.  Her attention to detail was outstanding.  She mostly used scissors, and with precision, not running straight for the electric trimmer like so many lazy or non professional ones do. To get 5 stars from me means a place excels in quality of food, service, and value that is far and away beyond the competition. Pickles is definitely a 5 star. 
First the service. What a nice bunch of happy people. When you place your order they are hopping on it and getting with it.  Happy? No one can be that happy. They acted like they were having fun. Smiles and laughs from all. Their up beat easy going attitude set the mood for a 5 star experience. 
Food. I had a Ruben and pasta salad. My wife had a Philly cheese steak and red potato salad. Her Philly was like it came from Philly. The bread was light and crispy crust with insides light cotton candy. How about putting the bread with lots of butter on the menu. Outstanding.  The Philly steak was well seasoned and perfect. The cheese was the way its suppose to be done. Not a gob glopped on but mixed with the steak. Not completely mixed tho. Perfect.
The red skin potato salad was the best ever. The potato's had been cooked to just the right texture. Not to hard but not mush. The seasoning was 100% spot on.
Pasta salad must be difficult to make. I've had it with too much oil, too much vinegar, too much seasoning, too tough pasta. Pickles has the perfect balance. I saved the review of the Ruben for last. WOW! Perfection. The rye was lightly toasted with just the right amount of crispness. Not a strong rye which can be too over powering but a nice light rye where you can enjoy the taste of rye without over powering the rest of the sandwich. The pastrami was so tender and piled high.  The saurkraut had that touch of sour yet is also sweet. I was pretty hungry when I got there but stuffed when left. A 1/2 order would have been enough but then there wouldn't be as much to enjoy. 
Value. 2 large sandwiches, 2 sides, and 2 drinks - $22. What?!? In St Louis? Someone must left something off our ticket. 
We'll be back. Definitely. But do I try a corn beef Ruben? Or a Cuban? Club? What if they're not as good as the pastrami Ruben? I hate taking risks.
One final thing. Did I mention just how good the pastrami Ruben was?

Anyway, it's a decent place to go and grab a quick bite to eat.

My boyfriend and I went here for our anniversary, and honestly, we would have had a better experience if we had gone to my favorite restaurant, Toyko 1613 (1613 Walnut St.).  The decor at Raw is very nice, but the hood ends there.  Except for their miso soup which was absolutely delicious, dark, and savory.  The sushi was not good.  On par with mall sushi.  Seriously.  The space is cramped, and we were sitting elbow to elbow with other patrons... Hardly the romantic, intimate atmosphere we were hoping to share on our special night. The green salad's dressing is completely inferior to toyko's. I ordered the shrimp tempura roll, and it was so bland.  The presentation was non-existent.  The rolls were just stacked on a plain white plate, with wasabi and ginger in sad little balls on the edge.  The tempura was not crispy, or hot, which screams pre-made to me.  My boyfriend's sweet potato tempura was DISGUSTING... it was cold, and again, not crispy or hot.  My boyfriend expressed his dislike to the waitress, and was just told "Oh, I'm sorry".  No attempts to remedy the situation were made, and she avoided us for the rest of our dinner, instead sending another waitress to clear empty plates, refill our water, etc.  We decided to skip the main entree altogether and left.  Very disappointing.  I will not return.  If you want fresh, beautifully presented food, and want some ELBOW room...  go to Tokyo on 16th and Walnut.  It won't break the bank, and the sushi is the best I've ever had .

One kid deliberately ran up and bumped into me. Then another kid who looked around 16 years old (I soon figured he was the ring leader), started verbally harassing me, name calling, etc. Since I did not feel safe leaving my car while I shopped, I immediately got back in to leave. As I pulled out, one of them threw something that hit my car. It didn't appear to cause damage. No matter, I kept on going. Based on this experience, I do NOT recommend Ikea in South Philly to any woman shopping alone, or to anyone who may be vulnerable to this kind of harassment.
